TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_001: Listen well. The spy we have been seeking all this time is none other than Flame Marshal Eline Roaille, Raubahn's second-in-command.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_002: Prior to joining the Immortal Flames, she was a mercenary of no small renown. They say her skill with a polearm had to be seen to be believed.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_003: Of Ishgardian birth, she is the highest-ranked foreigner in the Immortal Flames─barring the Flame General himself, of course.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_004: When he formed the Grand Company, Raubahn chose people based on their worth. Whence they hailed was of no interest.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_005: The Monetarists saw things differently, however. Having funded the enterprise, they reserved the right to reject candidates nominated for high-ranking positions.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_006: And 'twas no secret that they did not favor foreigners─Ishgardians especially, after the way the Holy See forsook the Alliance.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_007: Yet the Monetarists did not raise so much as a murmur of protest when Roaille was appointed to her post. Passing strange, is it not? Could it be that the Ivy has some hold over the Monetarists?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_008: ...But these revelations are secondary to our current mission. Of foremost interest to us is Roaille's presence here now. As you may be aware, it is the duty of the flame marshal to command the Immortal Flames in the absence of the Flame General. While Raubahn attended the council of Alliance leaders, she should have remained in the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_009: The woman has no business being in Gridania─yet here she is nonetheless, on some pretense. She is up to something, mark my words.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_010: Even as we speak, I have a dozen men trawling the Flames' records for evidence of Roaille's guilt─but if we can catch her red-handed, we shall have all the proof we need.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_011: ...Which brings me to the plan. I have people watching the city gates, the airship landing, and the docks─every point of egress. She cannot leave without our knowledge. All that remains is to shadow her until she betrays her true purpose. Can I rely upon your eyes, Scion?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_012: You have my thanks. Let us go, then, and take care not to alert our quarry.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_020: Roaille is headed in the direction of the Blue Badger Gate. With me, Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ROAILLE_000_030: Ahhh... The forest air is so cleansing. I feel like a new woman every time I visit Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_040: So, Roaille has entered the Carline Canopy... Meeting someone, perchance? Or could it be she means to board an airship?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_041: Pray look for her within. If she is not on the upper floor, try the landing area below.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_042: One of mine is stationed there, and she may have seen something. Ephemie is her name. I shall remain here in case Roaille reappears.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_050: Quickly now─look for Roaille inside the Carline Canopy. If she is not on the upper floor, try the landing area below. Speak with Ephemie─she may have seen something.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_EPHEMIE_000_060: ! Such an unexpected pleasure! What brings you here?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_EPHEMIE_000_061: Ahem. A social visit, you say? How pleasant! (No─she didn't come this way. I've noted every passenger, and none bore any resemblance.) Well, don't let me keep you!
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_EPHEMIE_000_070: Still no sign of your friend, I'm afraid! (And I mean that.) I do hope you find him!
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_080: ...Nowhere to be seen, you say? And you are sure she did not board an airship?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_081: Hmph. She did not come back out, either. Where in the seven hells could she have gone...?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_083: Rhalgr strike me down for a fool!
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_084: I will search the premises. While I do that, I need you to speak with the men I posted at the three main gates and the pier.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_085: Find out whether there has been any suspicious activity, and then meet me at the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SECONDSQUADRON00079: Nothing to report at this gate, ! No one resembling the suspect has been here, !
Nothing to report at this gate, ! No one resembling the suspect has been here, !
No, . The suspect didn't come this way. Given how little traffic passes through this gate, I would have noticed if she'd tried to slip by.
The suspect didn't come this way. Given how little traffic passes through this gate, I would have noticed if she'd tried to slip by.
...The suspect? Haven't seen her. Best check with one o' the others.
Suspect hasn't been here, sorry to say. Best check with one o' the others.
No, . A few Elezen women did leave on the last ferry, but none of them matched the suspect's description.
A handful of Elezen women did take the ferry, but none of them matched the suspect's description.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_170: Well? Have there been any sightings?
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_171: Damn it all. I turned the Roost upside down, but Roaille was nowhere to be found.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_173: The innkeeper told me that she had availed herself of a room, but no one saw her leave. She has donned some manner of disguise, of that there can be no doubt, but as to where she has gone...
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SHINOBI00079_000_17: (-Peddler-)Greetings, good sir. Might I interest you in some Mun-Tuy tonic? A cup a day imbues a man with great vigor, if you take my meaning. Heh heh...
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_176: ...Wait. That necklace─ You are a shinobi of Doma.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_SHINOBI00079_000_17: The woman you seek has left Gridania by way of Westshore Pier.
She was attired as a merchant, but these eyes are not so easily deceived.
You may wish to take your search to the East Shroud. Rest assured that we shall continue to support you from the shadows.
TEXT_GAIUSE411_00079_ILBERD_000_180: Thank the Twelve for the Domans. Were it not for their unique talents, Roaille would have disappeared without a trace.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_000: Our hunt leads us to the East Shroud, Scion. I suggest we follow Roaille's example and take the ferry from Westshore Pier.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_001: You'll doubtless wish to make certain preparations. See to them while I go on ahead. I shall wait for you at Sweetbloom Pier.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_011: Your quarry makes for the Hawthorne Hut.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_012: Very good. We must make haste─
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_014: There is another matter which requires your attention─and most urgently, I fear.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_016: A short while ago, an imperial squadron was observed departing Castrum Oriens. They march at speed for the South Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_017: So they have decided to take action...
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_018: Indeed. They seek to destroy the jamming device.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_019: An explanation is in order. You may be aware that the Garleans have their own method of communicating over great distances.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_020: Well, our ingenious friends at Garlond Ironworks have provided us with devices which disrupt these communications, and we have installed them around the city-states. In so doing, we have made it difficult for imperial agents to correspond with their masters.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_021: Of course, we did not expect the Garleans to remain silent. If they wished to communicate, they would find a way, be it via covert correspondence or secret meetings.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_022: Needless to say, we hoped they would risk the latter. And Roaille has not disappointed us.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_023: As a well-known face in the Immortal Flames, she cannot move about Thanalan without being recognized. It would only be a matter of time before someone saw through her disguise.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_024: 'Tis for this reason, I believe, that she has chosen the Black Shroud for her clandestine meeting. , and  not like to turn any heads.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_025: However, were the jamming device to be rendered inoperative, Roaille would no longer need to meet her masters in person, and their planned rendezvous would almost certainly be called off.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_026: ...And we cannot have that. It would deprive us of the opportunity to secure damning evidence against her─which is the very least we need if we're to convict someone of her standing.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_027: All rests upon the continued operation of the jamming device. It must needs be protected. If you could attend to this task, my shinobi and I will continue to observe Roaille.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_000_028: Very well. Scion─I would have you intercept the Garleans while my men move to cut off their retreat. None must escape.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_000_029: Several of my countrymen have already taken up positions in the South Shroud. Seek out the shinobi at Quarrymill, and he will apprise you of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_YUGIRI_100_020: Pray seek out the shinobi at Quarrymill. He will apprise you of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_ILBERD_100_021: Make haste and find those Garleans. I will send my men to cut off their retreat.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SHINOBI00080_000_03: We meet again, my friend. I have no Mun-Tuy tonic to offer this time, I'm afraid.
As I believe you know, imperial forces are in the South Shroud on a mission to destroy the jamming device. We must see to it that they do not succeed.
...So the Crystal Braves will cut off their retreat? Very well.
My countrymen and I shall attend to the soldiers. Their infernal machines, we leave in your capable hands.
At present, the Garleans are in the vicinity of Amdapor Keep. Let us head there at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SHINOBI00080_100_03: The Garleans are in the vicinity of Amdapor Keep. Let us head there at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE412_00080_SHINOBI00080_000_04: That was a most impressive showing, my friend.
As you can see, we too have not been idle. The Ivy will receive no warning of our coming.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SHINOBI00080_000_02: Now that the jamming device is no longer at risk, you may safely return to your hunt. Pray rejoin Lady Yugiri. She awaits you at the Hawthorne Hut.
I shall remain here and have a few words with this sorry lot. Nothing serious, I assure you─just a spot of small talk.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_SHINOBI00080_000_03: I shall remain here and have a few words with this sorry lot. Pray rejoin Lady Yugiri at the Hawthorne Hut.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_040: I am given to understand the mission was a success.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_041: Not a single imperial soldier made it to our position. Thorough work as always, Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_042: By way of reward, we can now turn our attention to Roaille once more. What news, Lady Yugiri?
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_043: My people report that she has departed for the Bramble Patch.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_044: So she means to go ahead with the meeting. Excellent. It is time to close the net around her.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_045: My countrymen and I shall lie in wait in the shadows. Tread warily, my friends.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_001: Just beyond, Roaille is in conversation with an individual clad in the manner of an adventurer. An imperial intermediary, no doubt.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_003: Flame Marshal Eline Roaille! You are under arrest for treason and espionage!
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ADVENTURER00084_000: (-Dubious Adventurer-)You were followed, you bloody fool!
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_007: You are unarmed, my lady...and scarcely garbed for battle. But if you wish to fight...you are welcome to try.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_FLAMEMARSHALROAILLE: What is the meaning of this, Captain? Would you arrest me for strolling in the Twelveswood? When last I looked, that was no crime─and neither was conversing with passing strangers.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_009: You would feign ignorance, then? Very well.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_ILBERD_000_010: If you do think of something to say, there will be plenty of time to say it later. Now, come quietly, or I shall make you wish you had.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_FLAMEMARSHALROAILLE: I will offer you no struggle. After all, I have naught to hide.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_050: Even a warrior of Roaille's renown could not have hoped to escape by force. Despite her claims, her surrender does not bespeak innocence, but an awareness that her position is untenable.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_051: With the Ivy thus uprooted, it is to be hoped that the tendrils she entwined around the Immortal Flames will gradually wither and die.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_052: Mayhap then the people of Ul'dah will have the Grand Company they deserve. But let us speak of the present. If I may ask, what will you do now, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_053: ...So the Scions seek a way into Iceheart's sanctum.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_054: Then I daresay you are eager to return to the Rising Stones. Pray do not let me keep you.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_055: Fear not─my countrymen and I shall tend to the aftermath. You need not waste your talents here.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_056: And speaking of talents, you have been training in the art of the shinobi, have you not? The change in your bearing is quite evident─to me, at least. I look forward to seeing you in action. Till next time, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_YUGIRI_000_057: And speaking of talents, have you considered training in the art of the shinobi? You have the aptitude for it, I believe, so please give it some thought. Till next time, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_MINFILIA_000_060: Welcome back, . I understand that Alphinaud had a task for you. May I ask what it was?
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_MINFILIA_000_061: Charges of treason and espionage against Eline Roaille? I can scarce believe it...
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_MINFILIA_000_062: Could there not have been some manner of misunderstanding...?
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_MINFILIA_000_064: No, it avails us naught to dwell on it. Whatever the truth may be, we must trust to the authorities to uncover it.
TEXT_GAIUSE413_00081_MINFILIA_000_065: Let us speak of another matter. I am pleased to report that we have made progress in our efforts to find a way into Iceheart's sanctum...
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_000: There's naught behind these convent doors for a worldly type like you, . We're the Dutiful Sisters o' the Edelweiss─all pure an' saintly, like. Now bugger off.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_010: There's naught behind these convent doors for a worldly type like you, . We're the Dutiful Sisters o' the Edelweiss─all pure an' saintly, like. Now bugger off.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_011: ...Hang about. Ain't ye that  as goes by the name o' ?
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_100_011: ...Hang about. I thought ye was just some simple errand , but now I've had a proper look─yer , ain't ye?
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_020: Heh, I knew it. Somethin' about millin' primals leaves its mark on a , it does.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_021: Anyway, you bein' who you are, ye must have an inklin' as to what goes on here, eh? The Admiral sent ye to meet with one o' me associates after that business with Leviathan, if ye recall.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_022: That's right, ─ye stand at the entrance to the Rogues' Guild. 'Course, 'twould be a poor sort of underground organization if we put a bleedin' sign up on the front door.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_023: Anyway...from what Lady Yugiri told me, yer pretty handy in a scrap.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_024: She's off seein' to some private business right now, but I reckon we might have some use for a  like you.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_025: If ye've an interest in joinin' us, tip us yer daddles an' we'll put a hilt in each one, just like the gods intended. ...So what do ye say? Fancy learnin' a new trade?
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_030: Heh, I knew it. We like to snilch all the risin' talent, an' from what I hear, yer head an' shoulders above the rest.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_031: If ye can handle yerself half as well as they say, ye might well be of use to us.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_032: ...Ah, forget all that “Sisters o' the Edelweiss” bollocks. That's just a bit o' fun to fob off the curious culls. We're a guild o' rogues, , an' it's mainly our marks as does the prayin'.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_033: Me an' mine work in the shadows o' Limsa, takin' a keen edge to the rooks an' cacklers what've earned 'emselves a millin'. We don't tout for members, but every now an' again, we might offer a promisin' young cove a place in the ranks.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_034: If ye've an interest in joinin' us, tip us yer daddles an' we'll put a hilt in each one, just like the gods intended. ...So what do ye say? Fancy learnin' a new trade?
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_Q1_000_040: Do you wish to join the Rogues' Guild?
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_050: Good to see yer keen. But I should probably warn ye on a few points afore ye dive in.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_051: Where most guilds take pride in turnin' their members into the best bloody candlestick makers they can be, we only care about gettin' the job done.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_052: An' the job ain't pretty. Ye become one of us, an' ye'll soon be neck-deep in scum an' knife fights.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_053: So if yer lookin' to scamper across rooftops an' bilk dandies o' their blunt, ye'd best take up with a different crew. Think on that, an' come back if yer still keen.
TEXT_CLSROG001_00101_LONWOERD_000_060: Not for you, eh? Suit yerself. Me an' me chaste sisters'll pray for yer immortal soul an' so on.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_1: A word with you, . I hesitate to make such a dangerous request, but might you assist us in thinning the number of anoles on Naked Rock?
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_2: In our efforts to commune with the elementals, we conjurers often find ourselves in the area. Of late, however, our meditations have all too frequently been interrupted by unprovoked anole attacks. Truly, the beasts grow more aggressive by the day.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_3: Their numbers have continued to grow since the advent of the Seventh Umbral Era, you see, forcing packs of the scalekin to come down from the mountains in search of food. If you could slay half a dozen or so of the beasts, that should lessen their need to hunt and also serve as a warning to the anoles to remain within their territory.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_4: But I am afraid you must do more than thin the existing population. If we are to truly break this spiraling growth, then we must also target their future offspring. Bring me four anole eggs, and you will have played your part in returning balance to this area of the forest.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_10: Ah, you have returned. Now might my brothers and sisters continue their meditations undisturbed. You have my thanks.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_11: As for these eggs, may I ask you to deliver them to Tsubh Khamazom at the Bannock?
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_PAULINE_000_12: Anole eggs are both large and filled with nutrients─the perfect meal for a soldier. She will be more than a little pleased to see you, I should imagine.
TEXT_SUBFST031_00125_TSUBHKHAMAZOM_000_2: Who goes there!? Oh, , it's you. Hm? Another delivery?
I'm not certain I should be the one to─ By Nophica, these are anole eggs! The troops will be glad indeed to see these at table! And you say Hearer Pauline sent you on this errand?
I hear the anoles are more numerous than ever, yet you appear to have managed the task with your skin intact. Your skill and bravery continue to amaze me, .
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_GALFRID_000_1: , injuries to several of my men have left me shorthanded, and I require a capable sort to complete their unfinished duty.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_GALFRID_000_2: The task is simple: put down as many of the local chigoe population as necessary to acquire eight of their egg sacs.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_GALFRID_000_3: Having done so, you are to deliver them to Monranguin at Gilbert's Spire. He will answer any queries you might have. Now, I have other business to attend to.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_MONRANGUIN_000_10: Ah, you must be the adventurer standing in for our injured companions. Terribly unfortunate business, that.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_MONRANGUIN_000_11: It seems, however, that you had little trouble gathering the egg sacs in their stead. Excellent work. I shall have them sent over to the Trappers' League immediately.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_MONRANGUIN_000_12: Lest you wonder, these egg sacs are not destined for the dinner table! Members of the Twin Adder and the Wood Wailers are assisting the league by collecting the samples they need to check for signs of sickness.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_MONRANGUIN_000_13: The chigoe, you see, is one of the few creatures capable of transmitting the disease known as the Creeping Death. Until relatively recently, any Hyur who contracted this ghastly illness would almost invariably perish.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_MONRANGUIN_000_14: Indeed, a single outbreak once claimed the lives of a third of the Hyuran population here in Gridania. That was a long time ago, of course. With the medicines available to us now, the Creeping Death is not the killer it once was.
TEXT_SUBFST034_00128_MONRANGUIN_000_15: Even so, it is best to halt any new outbreaks before they occur. Thus we gather chigoe eggs on a regular basis in order to assist the Trappers' League with their ongoing research. Your timely assistance is most appreciated.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_1: Seein' as you're here, I've got a favor to ask: gather me six seeds from those plantlike monsters they call roselets.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_2: The oil from them roselet seeds has a calmin' effect on skittish chocobos, see. Any wrangler worth her salt usually has a jar or two lyin' around.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_3: I thought the stock I had would last me a good while, but lately the birds've been as restless as a summer storm.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_4: Chocobos are sensitive creatures at the best o' times, and it ain't unusual for 'em to act a shade agitated all of a sudden... But this is somethin' else.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_5: You'll find them roselets I mentioned up near Galvanth's Spire. Go on now, time's a-wastin'.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_10: Did you have any trouble gettin' them seeds?
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_11: Let's see here...one, two, three...yep, there's the full six. Nice big ones, too. We'll squeeze some good oil out o' these.
TEXT_SUBFST050_00156_KEITHA_000_12: I still don't have a clue what's been unsettlin' the birds, but whatever it is, hopefully the roselet oil will help calm 'em down a bit...
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_1: I am told that adventurers are valiant heroes who bite their thumbs at danger, and scoff in the face of death. Do such rumors hold any truth?
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_2: I certainly hope they do, for I would ask you to confront the creatures known as marshlights.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_3: They began appearing in this area not long after the Calamity. Now, night after night, the creatures assail every living thing they come across with showers of fiery sparks.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_4: They seem fond of flames, and I dare not build a fire for fear of drawing them upon me. I shudder to imagine how much worse it must be for the poor Hearers... Their duties require that they ofttimes travel at night, you see, and they can scarce make do without their lanterns.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_5: But it is the marshlights' fondness for flames that may yet prove their downfall. In this pot, I have placed a smoldering coal. Use it to start a fire at Lilystone, and lure the creatures to you, putting them down as they arrive.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_6: Ah, yes, and be wary of the local, uh, “wildlife” as you make your way to Lilystone.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_11: I witnessed you extinguishing their lights at Lilystone as I cowered here in the darkness. With so many slain, I may even muster the courage to start a cooking fire again.
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_ARMELLE_000_12: There is no reward great enough to express my gratitude, but this will have to suffice. Thank you, .
TEXT_SUBFST053_00159_SYSTEM_000_20: The flames from your fire flicker and dance...
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_1: Welcome to the Gladiators' Guild, adventurer. Here, our members train tirelessly with sword and shield so that their names might one day be writ in legend!
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_2: Hm? Was that a flash of interest in your eyes? If you wish to study swordplay, know that admission to the guild is free of charge!
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_11: You say no today, but the lure of fame and fortune will bring you back! When you inevitably change your mind, you need only seek me out, and we can discuss your future as a gladiator.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_21: What's this? I thought you somewhat versed in the arts of combat, but it seems you are anything but experienced.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_22: Before you can learn how to wield a sword, you must become more proficient in your current pursuit. Pray return when you have achieved this.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_31: I had marked you as a  of action. I am pleased to see that I was not wrong!
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_32: Now, while you may be familiar with the deadly dance of battle, you are new to us, and must begin at the beginning.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_33: If you would take your place in these hallowed halls, you must be willing and ready to undergo the most rigorous training. You must endure cuts and bruises beyond counting, and like as not far worse.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_34: A daunting prospect, I concede─but there is no other way if you mean to take to the bloodsands one day. And why wouldn't you? The Coliseum is only the most celebrated place of public entertainment in all of Ul'dah!
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_35: Where else could a poor man amass a fortune so vast as to one day allow him to claim a seat on the Syndicate?
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_36: Ahhh...there's not an Ul'dahn alive who isn't inspired by the rise of the self-made man.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_37: And there is no truer embodiment of that dream than the gladiator who wins riches and fame with his sword.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_38: Throughout its long and storied history, this guild has nurtured countless champions. Our training methods are second to none, and our members ever strive to develop new techniques.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_39: If you desire true glory─to fight and triumph, 'midst the roar of ten thousand voices─then this is where you belong, adventurer.
TEXT_CLSGLA001_00177_LULUTSU_000_40: ...Think of it. Think of your legacy. And if your soul stirs...join us.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_1: Greetings and welcome to the Pugilists' Guild!
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_2: We pugilists are specialists in hand-to-hand combat. Through rigorous training, we forge devastating weapons of our fists and feet, which we employ to great effect in battle.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_3: There is no better place in all the realm to train in our discipline than here. If you would walk the path of the pugilist, I highly recommend you add your name to our roll. What say you, friend?
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_11: That is truly a shame. I could see you doing quite well among us.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_12: Should you have a change of heart, I invite you return here.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_21: Hmmm... Looking closely at your physique, it would seem you are still somewhat...soft.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_22: I'm afraid the guild requires a basic level of fitness in its recruits. You must condition your body further before you can join us.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_31: A decision you'll not regret! But before we proceed to the paperwork, it is essential that you know something of our guild's storied past.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_32: Since time immemorial, man has used whatever has been at his disposal to settle disputes. In the beginning, that meant fighting with his fists. Such hand-to-hand combat existed in various forms throughout Eorzea, each evolving independently of one another.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_33: The origins of pugilism as we know it, however, can be traced back to the staging of bare-handed bouts at the Coliseum. These contests attracted fighters from far and wide, bringing their myriad styles crashing together on the bloodsands.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_34: Amidst this chaotic intermingling of styles, there rose a pugilist of singular strength and skill. This woman made it her life's mission to master every form she encountered, that she might refine her art.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_35: Among her many song-worthy exploits, we pugilists remember her participation in a gladiator tournament most fondly. Back when bare-handed fighting was still seen as a pastime for peasants, she took on fully armed and armored gladiators, and effortlessly bested the lot of them.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_36: Word of her feat spread across the realm like wildfire, of course, and Ul'dah swiftly transformed into a center of pugilism, with people flocking from all over to train under this master among masters.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_37: The woman's name was Cornelia, and it is to her that the Pugilists' Guild owes its existence. The art practiced here is based on her all-encompassing style, and this training hall is modeled upon the one which she once built.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_38: And there it is─a brief history of our guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_39: I've told this tale a thousand times, but gods, it never fails to fan the flames of my fighting spirit!
TEXT_CLSPGL001_00178_GAGARUNA_000_40: Now then, before we can proceed with your enrollment, you must first obtain the guildmaster's approval. Let me know when you are ready to meet him.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_0: Ho there, adventurer. Curious about the Marauders' Guild, are ye?
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_1: Any axe worth wieldin' needs two hands on the haft an' has a blade what can chop clean through a galley's mast. That's the kind o' weapon our members train to use with deceptive swiftness an' brutal force.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_2: If yer of a mind to make the marauder's art yer life's work, then our guild welcomes ye with open arms. What say ye, ? Keen to join the ranks?
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Marauders' Guild?
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_8: Ye've got the right kind o' fire in yer belly, I'll give ye that. But yer still a bit wet behind the ears, . Come back when ye've had chance to plant yer feet firmly as an adventurer, then we'll talk axes.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_SYSTEM_000_9: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_11: Well then, here's a bit o' guild history so ye know what yer gettin' into. It all started with ships, ye see. What've ships got to do with axes, ye ask? Well, buildin' 'em would be pretty bloody difficult without a sturdy tool to lop down trees for timber.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_12: An' since only the Navigator Herself knows when a ship'll run afoul of a storm or worse, it makes sense for the crew's carpenter to carry an axe on board. But any tool on a ship can become a weapon─an' the axe is perfect for hookin' yerself over the rail of an enemy vessel, lettin' loose in a whirl o' steel, an' generally layin' waste to all about ye.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_13: As more seafarers took up the axe as their weapon o' choice, so did the bloody art o' the marauder begin to take shape─'specially among pirates, where strength an' skill decided yer place in the world.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_15: With an eye to assemblin' crews o' battle-ready raiders, the pirates started teachin' the proper way to wield a choppin' blade to their new recruits. An' that's how the Marauders' Guild first came to be.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_17: After the Galadion Accord was signed, though, the Marauders' Guild was never the same─it was taken over, restructured, an' purged of its pirate elements. It had been reborn as an institution dedicated to naught but the teachin' of axe fightin'.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_18: The members o' this new Marauders' Guild weren't no greed-driven cutthroats, neither─they were warriors what sought to use their martial prowess for the good o' society.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_19: Still keen, are ye? Think it over, then let me know if ye decide to join our ranks.
TEXT_CLSEXC001_00179_BLAUTHOTA_000_5: That's yer choice, ─the axe ain't for everyone. May the Navigator guide ye on whichever path ye decide to set yer feet on.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_1: Welcome to the Lancers' Guild, adventurer.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_2: If you seek to refine your skills with the polearm, then you have come to the right place.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_3: Here at the Lancers' Guild, spear wielders gather to train with one another, and further hone their abilities under the tutelage of our fine instructors. Do you seek membership with us?
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Lancers' Guild?
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_4: I see. It would seem you are already occupied with other pursuits.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_5: In which case, you have no further business here. Please be on your way.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_6: While your enthusiasm is commendable, you are yet a stripling among adventurers.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_7: You must gain more experience before you can be considered for a place within these halls. Return here again once you have done so.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_SYSTEM_000_8: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_9: Very well. I shall provide you with an insight into the history of our guild.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_10: More than just an instrument of war, the spear is also a tool for hunting, and with game ever plentiful in the Twelveswood, the weapon has been the mainstay of the locals here since before the founding of Gridania.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_11: With the passing of time, our nation became a gathering place for spearmasters from across the realm─many eager to test their mettle against the famed might of our Wood Wailers.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_12: And it was here in Gridania that their myriad fighting styles came into contact, eventually giving rise to the art taught here today.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_13: That spear technique could be formalized at all owed much to the founding of the Lancers' Guild by Wood Wailer captain Mistalle nigh on a century past.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_14: The tradition of accepting students from without as well as within Gridania's borders persists to this day, ensuring that the art of the polearm may not only survive, but also continue to evolve.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_15: Well, there you have it. I hope this brief history of the guild has helped settle any doubts in your mind.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_16: The Lancers' Guild is always eager to welcome new initiates.
TEXT_CLSLNC999_00180_JILLIAN_000_17: If you've a will to enlist, speak with me again and we can begin the enrollment procedures.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_1: Greetings, adventurer, and welcome to the Archers' Guild.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_2: It is here that archers the realm over gather to master the bow. We engage the enemy from a distance, ever seeking to alter the course of battle with a single, well-placed arrow.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_3: If you have a mind to become an archer, then you have come to the right place. Do you wish to join our ranks?
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_4: A pity. You might do well among us.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_5: No doubt you wish to focus on your current discipline─a commendable attitude. Should you ever crave a new challenge, though, know that you are always welcome here.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_6: While your enthusiasm cannot be faulted, it seems you still have much and more to learn about adventuring.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_7: I suggest you focus on your current pursuit for a time. Let us speak again once you have cut your teeth as an adventurer.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_SYSTEM_000_8: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_9: Marvelous! Then allow me to enlighten you on the history of both our art and the guild.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_10: The bow is an ancient tool that has existed since before our fair nation came into being. As an implement of war and hunting both, it protects us from our enemies even as it keeps us fed and clothed.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_11: Archery as practiced in Gridania was born of two distinct styles of bowmanship.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_12: The first was devised by the longbow sentries of the Elezen who once ruled the lowlands, while the second belonged to the shortbow hunters of the formerly nomadic Miqo'te. As you will doubtless be aware, both races ultimately came to call the Twelveswood home.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_13: Though the two peoples began as rivals, they gradually learned to live together in harmony.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_14: During this time, they learned from one another, their two schools of archery intermingling to give birth to the art as it is known today. Ah, but this wouldn't have been possible were it not for the Trappers' League.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_15: The guild was established in order to promote sustainable hunting and cooperation within the hunting fraternity at large. As a happy consequence of this union, the guild's members came to engage in friendly contests of skill.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_16: Inspired by such competitions, a handful of their number began to focus on perfection as opposed to mere practicality, transforming a skill into what may be termed an art. These individuals would go on to form a guild of their own.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_17: Aye, the Archers' Guild, where men and women gather to attain mastery over the bow. More than a few members of the Gods' Quiver loosed their first arrow within these very halls.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_18: ...And that, my friend, is a brief history of archery in Gridania. Doubtless you are more eager than ever to take up the bow.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_19: It would be my pleasure to recommend you to our guildmaster─you must receive her permission if you are to join us.
TEXT_CLSARC999_00181_ATHELYNA_000_20: If you would excuse me a moment, I shall see to it that the relevant lists are amended. Pray speak to me again in a short while.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_1: Well met, adventurer. You are come to Stillglade Fane, home of the Conjurers' Guild.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_2: We conjurers harness the powers of earth, wind, and water that abound in nature, and thereby weave spells of healing and protection.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_3: Ever do we seek noble souls to initiate into our mysteries. Might you be such a soul, come to join the guild?
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Conjurers' Guild?
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_4: My apologies. No doubt you wish to remain wholly dedicated to your current pursuit.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_5: Yet should ever you long to become one with all creation, I invite you to return here. It is never too late to the learn about the forces that surround us.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_6: While your zeal cannot be denied, you are yet wanting for experience as an adventurer.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_7: I recommend that you first deepen your acquaintance with your chosen discipline. Fear not─even having done so, there will yet be time for you to learn about the forces that surround us.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_SYSTEM_000_8: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_9: Then allow me to provide you with an overview of what it is to be a conjurer.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_10: Conjury is the art of healing and purification. Its practitioners harness the power of nature, that they might bring about change in the form of spells.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_11: Primitive magic such as that once wrought by individuals known as mages─meaning those with the ability to manipulate aether─has existed since the dawn of time.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_12: It was not until some five centuries ago that conjury emerged from this shapeless agglomeration of spells and charms─an event which led to the founding of Gridania.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_13: In those dark days, the elementals would not suffer man's presence in the Twelveswood, forcing our forebears to make their homes beneath the earth, in the great subterranean city of Gelmorra.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_14: But their desire to settle in the Twelveswood continued to burn fiercely; time and again they sought to curry the elementals' favor.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_15: Unlike men and other creatures bound in temples of flesh, the elementals are beings of pure aether. Recognizing this, the mages of eld reasoned that their talent for aetheric manipulation might allow them to commune with these theretofore enigmatic entities.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_16: It took five long decades, but our forebears finally succeeded. Their reward: the elementals' permission to dwell in the Twelveswood. So it was that the nation of Gridania was born.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_17: Since that time, the elementals have taught us to live as one with nature, speaking to all Gridanians through the Hearers─those mages who are able to commune with them.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_18: And for their intimacy with the elementals, the Hearers would go on to attain greater mastery over the forces of nature. Thus did they conceive the art of conjury.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_19: ...And that, my most attentive listener, is a brief history of conjury.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_20: If you have a mind to walk our path, I wholeheartedly recommend you join our guild.
TEXT_CLSCNJ999_00182_MADELLE_000_21: It would be my pleasure to explain the initiation process to you. Pray speak with me again when you are ready.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_1: Welcome to the Thaumaturges' Guild. It is fate that has guided your steps here, friend.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_2: Within these hallowed halls, the arts of devastation are taught─primeval magicks with which to bring about an enemy's ruin.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_3: If you would join our ranks and wield the power of thaumaturgy, I urge you to seize this moment and confide in me your arcane ambitions.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Thaumaturges' Guild?
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_12: Ah, but I see the stars were not yet aligned. Your time will come, and I shall be waiting.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_21: ...I fear my words of destiny and desire were spoken in haste. Your aura bespeaks a certain...unpreparedness, as if your spirit is reluctant to abandon a path yet freshly begun.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_22: Pray continue down that path until a fork presents itself. Perhaps the choice you then make shall lead you back to the gates of thaumaturgy.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_31: Yes. There truly was no other answer, was there? Lean closer now, and I shall whisper to you of thaumaturgy's beginnings.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_32: The nation of Ul'dah inherited its traditions from ancient Belah'dia, a city founded by the descendants of the first mages.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_33: The secrets of these illustrious sorcerers were ultimately entrusted to the priests of the Order of Nald'thal, who have passed them down from generation to generation ever since.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_34: Focused and refined over centuries of use in the Order's funereal rites, the arcane magicks of our ancestors eventually emerged as the art we now know as thaumaturgy.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_35: A freezing blizzard to halt corruption; a raging fire to cleanse the corpse; a bolt of lightning to expel the sins of mortal life... The dweomers employed in the preparation of the dead are equally efficacious when applied to the living.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_36: Thus does our guild thrive in the depths of Arrzaneth Ossuary─a sanctuary devoted to Thal, the divine arbiter of the afterlife.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_37: What say you, then, adventurer? If you would plumb the abyssal depths of thaumaturgy, let our learned sages guide your descent!
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_38: Ah, but before you leap into the darkness, you must prove to our guildmasters that you are possessed of the spiritual fortitude necessary to look upon that which waits therein.
TEXT_CLSTHM001_00183_YAYAKE_000_39: When you are ready to submit to the judgment of our most eminent mages, say the word.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_1: Greetings, adventurer, and welcome to the Carpenters' Guild.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_2: We are the artisans who take wood and grant it new form and purpose as the archer's bow, the lancer's spear, and the novice's shield.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_3: If carpentry holds any appeal, you should consider joining our guild. Might you be interested in learning the ways of woodworking?
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_5: Know that our door remains open, however. Should you find that you have a mind to join us after all, I will be happy to furnish you with the necessary information.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_6: While I appreciate your ambition, I fear you want for experience.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_7: I think it best that you focus on your current path. One must take the time to get to know one's own trade before contemplating abandoning it for another.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_SYSTEM_000_8: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_9: Wonderful, wonderful! Now, before we proceed, I think it only right that I acquaint you with our guild's storied past.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_10: Since the founding of Gridania, we have built our homes and crafted our weapons from the trees of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_11: As our nation grew and prospered, the woodworker's repertoire expanded to encompass a greater variety of articles, and carpentry developed into an art.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_12: At first, there was no association of carpenters; each individual worked and sold his services independently. However, the advent of watermills meant that more efficient construction methods were needed, along with formalized maintenance regimes, all of which necessitated organization.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_13: The Carpenters' Guild was founded to oversee the operation of watermills and promote cooperation between woodworkers.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_14: Now, I must mention at this point that we owe much and more of our prosperity to the Greatloam Growery.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_15: Thanks to the hardworking botanists, we are blessed with the finest lumber in all Eorzea.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_16: This confluence of ideal circumstances allows us to provide all manner of goods and services to the people of Gridania.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_17: ...My apologies, that was rather longer than I intended. Still, I trust you have gained a greater understanding of our guild.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_18: We expect our members to drink deep of the collected wisdom that the guild has amassed over the course of its history─to actively seek an understanding of wood and the techniques required to work it, rather than simply waiting to be taught.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_19: We expect, in short, nothing less than total commitment to the craft.
TEXT_CLSWDK999_00184_CORGG_000_20: If you wish to start down this path, speak to me once more. I shall explain to you the enrollment process.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_1: Unless yer blind and deaf, I presume ye've wandered into our forge of yer own accord. Drawn by the siren song of our smitties' hammers, no doubt.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_2: In these here hallowed halls, Limsa's finest pound metal into all manner o' tools and weapons. And when I say “Limsa's,” I mean the whole bloody realm's. Make no mistake─ye need more than a big arm to join our ranks.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_3: But if ye've got iron in yer veins and the Builder's blessin', speak up.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_11: You haven't, eh? Hmph. And there I was thinkin' ye'd got potential...
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_12: Well then, bugger off. I've no time to waste on idle adventurers who've got naught better to do than run around pesterin' honest guild receptionists. Don't bother me again unless yer resolved to join.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_21: Hmmm...ye've got fire in yer belly, , I'll give ye that. Might even make a half-decent smitty one day.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_22: But that day's a way off yet. I reckon ye should see where yer current path leads before choosin' a new one.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_31: Heh! Well yer not short on confidence!
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_32: But do ye truly know what yer gettin' yerself into here, ?
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_33: Ours is a trade born o' blood and brine. Fer as long as pirates have sailed the Rhotano, smitties have forged their weapons and fitted out their ships from keel to cannon.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_34: 'Course, “till sea swallows all” ain't just an idle sayin'─brine'll eat through even the stoutest iron given time, and our forebears long struggled to forge more rust-resistant alloys.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_35: Lucky fer us, the smitties of eld were a determined bunch, and clever too. So when they learned that the kobolds knew somethin' of advanced metallurgy, the smitties set out to make it their own.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_36: Thanks to the kobolds' wisdom─which they generously gifted us with only the merest hint o' pirately promptin'─Lominsan smithin' came on leaps and bounds.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_37: 'Twasn't long before the Gridanians and Ul'dahns started eyein' our knowledge like we did the kobolds', though. And so, some hundred and fifty-odd years ago, two particularly forward-thinkin' men named Theor Naldiq and Bryce Vymelli had the bright idea of establishin' a respectable business.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_38: Bein' fair-minded fellows, they'd sell their wares to anyone who had the coin─pirates and foreigners included. And when folks weren't inclined to pay, they made sure to remind 'em that we hadn't completely forsaken our pirate ways.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_39: Times have changed, though, and we're a wee bit more willin' to share our wisdom these days. The company's been runnin' the Blacksmiths' and Armorers' Guilds fer years now, welcomin' any soul with the necessary talent and will to work.
TEXT_CLSBSM001_00185_RANDWULF_000_40: As to whether ye've got enough of either...well, that's fer the forgemaster to decide. Speak to me when yer ready to present yerself to him.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_1: Sound o' hammerin' bring you in from the street, did it, ? It's well that you find the din invitin', for the Armorers' Guild is not the place for quiet reverie.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_2: If the clangor o' metal strikin' metal is music to your ears, mayhap you've the spirit of a shipwright.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_3: Are you of a mind to join our guild? Take it from me, , there's no greater joy than workin' a shapeless lump of iron into a shinin' breastplate with your own hands. What say you, then?
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Armorers' Guild?
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_11: Hmph, seems I read you wrong.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_12: Well, I'll be here if you decide you need another earful o' why our guild is the right choice for you.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_21: Hmmm... Now that I take a closer look, I don't think you're ready.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_22: We can't be takin' on initiates that lack the inner steel to stick with a discipline for more than a bell or two─not in troubled times like these. We need people with perseverance. Show me you've got some, an' we'll talk.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_31: Well said, . Now, we should cover a bit o' guild history afore forgin' ahead with the formalities.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_32: The armorer's craft is an offshoot o' blacksmithin'. Time was when armorers an' smitties were one an' the same.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_33: But as the years trickled by, the techniques for workin' sheet metal into armor plates became a specialized trade.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_34: An' the smitties who showed uncommon skill an' passion for this trade earned 'emselves the title of “armorer.”
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_35: Now, as you can probably imagine, the skills necessary for makin' armor are also needed for shipbuildin'. But buildin' ships is a bit harder than knockin' out simple helms, which led those armorers who were good enough to work on boats to claim the title o' “shipwright.” 'Course, it was one thing callin' armorers blacksmiths an' shipwrights armorers, but it was quite another callin' shipwrights blacksmiths, 'cause buildin' a ship an' makin' a hatchet couldn't be more different.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_36: It seemed as though a line needed drawin', an' seein' as how Limsa Lominsa was built on the strength o' her navy, you can imagine why the armorers chose to cut their ties with the smitties, an' established a guild o' their own.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_37: As for the smitties, well, the whole notion of an independent Armorers' Guild never did sit well with 'em, an' there's been a fair old rivalry between our two factions ever since. Always tryin' to outdo each other, we are.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_38: Which is why we're ever on the lookout for new talent to help us keep the smitty bastards in their place! All you need do is impress the forgemaster, an' we can start you on your trainin'.
TEXT_CLSARM001_00186_GWAHNAKO_000_39: Be warned─Forgemaster H'naanza's tongue could strip the scales off a fishback at forty paces. Sayin' that, you won't find a fairer mistress this side o' the Strait o' Merlthor. Let me know when you've mustered the courage to speak with her, an' I'll see to the rest.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_1: Good  to you, adventurer, and welcome to the Goldsmiths' Guild. Have you come to observe our artisans at work?
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_2: Indeed, it is a marvel to watch goldsmiths transform raw metals and uncut gemstones into sparkling rings, earrings, and necklaces─some of which possess magical properties, no less!
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_3: You know, if you'd like to try your hand at goldsmithing, the guild is open to adventurers like yourself. No prior experience is required, for we teach all you need to know about the craft. Would you be interested?
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_11: Forgive me, it seems I've misunderstood your intent. Forget I said anything.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_21: Oh dear, this part is always so awkward. I would love nothing more than to welcome you into the guild, but you are still somewhat rough, and in need of further refinement.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_22: That is to say, you are yet lacking in worldly experience. But I do not doubt that it won't be long before you are ready to take up the chaser hammer.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_24: It pleases me greatly to hear you say so. As the first step, I would have you understand the purpose of our guild.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_25: The vast mineral resources of Thanalan have given rise to a grand goldsmithing tradition, which has been refined through the ages. Our techniques are renowned across the realm, our creations held in the highest regard.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_26: However, we of Eshtaime's Lapidaries, the premier source for Ul'dahn jewelry, were not content to rest on our laurels.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_27: Seeking to advance our craft, we turned our eyes to the East, the only place in the known world whose goldsmithing was said to rival our own.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_28: We built the finest facilities to beckon their masters hither, and blended their foreign techniques with ours. Our guild quickly became the center of Eorzean goldsmithing.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_29: Aye, here you shall benefit from the refined wisdom of countless veteran craftsmen. You will learn to see the potential in your materials and shape them to your will.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_30: These are essential skills, for a goldsmith must hone his eyes to identify and appraise all manner of materials, and─when needs be─recognize imitations for what they are.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_31: It is even said that a master goldsmith can ascertain the authenticity of a man himself.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_32: You may one day come to possess such vision. But even the most magnificent jewel begins life as a rough-hewn stone. It must first be cut and polished before it can delight the eyes with its brilliance.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_33: If you would become a goldsmith, you must needs refine yourself as you would a gemstone. It will take much time and effort, and there is no guarantee of success.
TEXT_CLSGLD001_00187_JEMIME_000_34: Should you be certain that this is the life you seek, speak to me once more.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_1: Greetings and welcome to the Leatherworkers' Guild. Here we produce the finest leather goods, taking care to honor the lives which were sacrificed for their creation.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_2: Our leather armor is worn by the archers and lancers of this great nation, and favored by all who prefer that their protection does not come at a cost to mobility.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_3: If you wish to place an order, I bid you visit Fen-Yll Fineries. If, on the other hand, you have a mind to join our guild, I should be happy to assist you. Might you be interested in becoming a leatherworker?
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_4: A pity─but better that than a grudging yes. Guildmaster Geva expects nothing less than complete dedication.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_5: Should you ever wish to learn our craft, come and speak to me again. It would be my pleasure to furnish you with the necessary information.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_6: I wish I could consider your application, but Guildmaster Geva would never admit such an inexperienced adventurer.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_7: She demands our recruits possess a certain level of worldly experience, you see, and has a decidedly low opinion of those who would choose a career upon a whim. When you have taken the time to acquaint yourself properly with your current profession, we can speak about your future here.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_SYSTEM_000_8: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_9: Nothing would make me happier than to welcome a new initiate into our ranks. However, it is essential that you first understand the burden that every leatherworker must bear.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_10: As you cannot have failed to notice, the Twelveswood is blessed with an abundance of life, and we Gridanians have long hunted the forest's creatures for both nourishment and clothing.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_11: But Gridania is unlike any other place. The elementals that watch over the Twelveswood have never looked kindly on the taking of life, and those who flout their governance do so at their own peril.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_12: The elementals decreed that life not be taken without due necessity. And so the Trappers' League was formed to regulate the hunting of animals.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_13: The Leatherworkers' Guild was subsequently founded to manage the fair and equitable distribution of pelts.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_14: Nowadays, adventurers are a major supplier of pelts, and leather goods have become widespread. But in times past, they were rare and precious.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_15: The Leatherworkers' Guild has not forgotten those times. We treat leather with no less respect than the living creatures whence it comes, and craft goods of the highest quality. In so doing, we honor the lives lost, and minimize the need for further killing─an oft-forgotten benefit of our products' surpassing durability.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_16: Our guild is also the sole producer of the famous Fen-Yll brand of leather goods─the pride of Gridania. These products represent the ultimate expression of our core tenets and the transcendent technique which shaped them.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_17: Know, though, that being a guild member does not automatically make you a Fen-Yll artisan─you must earn the right to become one. For most of the leatherworkers here, having the fruit of their labors bear the Fen-Yll brand is yet a distant dream.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_18: That is the life which awaits you, should you choose to walk our path.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_19: Success will not be handed to you─but I guarantee that you will have the opportunity to seize it.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_20: So, if you wish to make a name for yourself─and craft goods which are the envy of all─you have come to the right place.
TEXT_CLSTAN999_00188_RANDALL_000_21: Speak to me once more if you wish to learn more about the enrollment process.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_000: Greetings, adventurer, and welcome to the wellspring of Ul'dahn fashion.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_001: From humble thread, our peerless artisans weave wonders─dreams in fabric form.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_002: We are renowned as Eorzea's finest purveyors of quality textiles, and as her foremost arbiters of style.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_003: Needless to say, such renown was not won without effort. Ours is a tremendously demanding profession, you see...but also a highly rewarding one. It is little wonder that so many adventurers have set their hearts upon joining us. Might you be one of them?
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_011: Well, should you be seized by an urgent need to weave, I will be happy to assist you.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_020: Excellent! Then allow me to─ Wait...am I right in thinking that you...?
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_021: Oh dear, I fear we may be getting a little ahead of ourselves. Now that I look at you, you don't seem quite as...well traveled as I thought.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_022: Please try to understand─we feel that those who would pursue the creative arts require a measure of worldly experience. I suggest you learn more of your current trade before trying your hand at ours.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_SYSTEM_023: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_030: Ah! I thought as much! Then I'm sure you're eager to learn all about our illustrious history.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_031: As I'm sure you know, Thanalan can be a perilous place, its vast deserts being wont to punish the unprepared. While a menagerie of ferocious beasts stalk the sands, the greatest foe is, of course, the midday sun.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_032: And so, ever since man first set foot in this region, he has favored light, flowing fabrics that shield him from the sun's rays while allowing his skin to breathe.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_033: Of course, Ul'dahns have ever been a people of taste, and demand for more extravagant designs spurred innovation, resulting in textile goods whose appeal extended far beyond our borders.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_034: Merchants had little trouble selling Ul'dahn fabrics in foreign markets, so great was their reputation for beauty and quality.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_035: And when traders from those same markets sought to peddle their lesser products in Thanalan...
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_036: Well...it gave us little cause for concern.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_037: Sunsilk Tapestries is synonymous with the textile trade in Ul'dah, you see. Those who come here hoping to peddle cheap rags swiftly learn the price of doing business in our territory.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_038: Wiser men and women with an interest in our trade choose instead to join the guild, which the company generously operates for the betterment of Ul'dahn society.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_039: We offer our members the tools and techniques needed to become successful. And should they prove themselves especially skilled, they may even be offered direct employment as Sunsilk weavers!
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_040: Just imagine, adventurer─your designs could one day dictate the course of Ul'dahn fashion!
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_041: If you desire such fame and influence, then you might be granted a place with us...
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_042: Provided that you are willing to embrace hard work.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_043: To ensure candidates can endure the rigors of our profession, our guildmaster has taken it upon himself to evaluate each one personally.
TEXT_CLSWVR001_00189_MARONNE_044: When you are ready to submit yourself to his rigorous scrutiny, say the word.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_000: Ah, an adventurer, one of my favorite kinds of people! I find your unquenchable thirst for exploration neatly complements the burning hunger for sagacity that marks our dedicated members. Welcome to the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_001: Though I hesitate to define alchemy in such narrow terms, our main field of expertise is the concoction of various potions and elixirs. There are salves to treat all manner of afflictions, not to mention miraculous libations that enhance the imbiber beyond  natural physical limits.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_002: As an adventurer, I am sure you can appreciate the eminently practical applications of our work. What say you, ? Care to take up mortar and pestle and join our ranks?
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_Q1_1: Do you wish to join the Alchemists' Guild?
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_010: No!? After hearing my most persuasive argument to the contrary, you tell me no!? You...you have perhaps heard stories of our guildmaster, then?
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_011: Well, n-never mind that! It benefits neither party should you attend our teachings with but half a mind to do so. A waste of both your time and ours!
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_020: Yes? Wonderful, then let us continue with the initi─ Oh dear. It seems I was somewhat premature in extending to you an invitation to join our guild.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_021: In my enthusiasm, I failed to inquire as to your status with the other guilds of the realm. My apologies, the fault lies entirely with me. Please do return once you have gained the approval of your current guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_SYS_022: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_030: Wonderful! Now then, allow me to give you a brief history of the guild before we tackle the official paperwork.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_031: Though alchemists are presently known as the quintessential brewers of potions, the profession itself arose from the desire to achieve an as-yet-unrealized ambition.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_032: The original driving purpose behind our art was─and perhaps still is─the discovery of a process that can transform base metals into gold or silver. And the mystical medium thought necessary to effect such a transformation is the Philosopher's Stone─which is itself believed to have panacean properties and be capable of bestowing eternal life.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_033: Though success yet eludes us, years of endless experimentation towards this golden goal had the initially unintentional consequence of unearthing a wealth of knowledge in the field of alchemical medicine.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_034: Regretfully, alchemy's potential to enrich the lives of the masses was first met with a wave of distrust. As if our ability to create helpful compounds was akin to dabbling in back-alley witchcraft!
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_035: The profession eventually gained credibility in Ul'dah through its integration into traditional medicine by Frondale's Phrontistery, an institution known for producing respected physicians.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_036: Once the city's shift in perception became known, budding alchemists wishing to study without fear of persecution journeyed to Ul'dah from every corner of the realm. It was not long before this gathering of inquisitive minds banded together to form the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_037: Thus, while our organization is intensely focused on perfecting and sharing the fruits of our research, it is also of paramount importance that we uphold the reputation of alchemy itself as a legitimate discipline.
TEXT_CLSALC001_00190_DEITRICH_038: If you would revel in the secrets of our art, then you must be prepared to shoulder the responsibility I have described. Take a moment to dwell on these words before you truly enter the world of alchemy.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_1: I beg your pardons, good , but this is the Culinarians' Guild. If you are here to dine at the Bismarck, one of our waiters will be along shortly to show you to your─
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_2: ...Oh, you're not a patron? Might I assume, then, that you wish to become a culinarian?
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_3: If so, I wholeheartedly recommend you join the Culinarians' Guild, where one may learn the culinary arts under the finest chefs in all the realm. What say you?
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Culinarians' Guild?
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_11: Oh... Please accept my apologies─it would seem I misread your intentions.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_12: If you are here to dine after all, our waiters shall attend you at table. I hope you enjoy your meal.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_15: Ah, but I sense you require more time to steep in life's piquant marinade─by which I mean you lack the worldly experience that the guild requires in its acolytes. I apologize if I have unduly raised your hopes.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_16: But do not despair─judging by the glint of determination in your eyes, I suspect it shan't be long before you are ready to take up the skillet.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_SYSTEM_17: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_21: Wonderful! Then without further ado, I shall acquaint you with the history of our guild.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_22: As you are doubtless aware, Limsa Lominsa has long been the gastronomic capital of Eorzea. The city's rich culinary tradition is the product of a unique combination of factors. The first is our proximity to the fertile lands and plentiful seas of Vylbrand, which have ever yielded bounteous produce.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_23: The second is our standing as the realm's foremost trading port, which grants us access not only to exotic ingredients from faraway shores, but also to foreign merchants versed in their use. We are, in short, the beneficiaries of culinary knowledge from every corner of the world.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_24: Until recently, knowledge of this kind was passed on solely through word of mouth, and was therefore susceptible to corruption and loss. But that all changed when one man made it his mission to catalog every recipe of note. His name was Admiral Guolskyf Bhaldwaensyn, also known as Mastcleaver.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_25: The man's love of fine cuisine was such that, at sea, he would regularly spend as much time preparing meals in the galley as giving commands on the bridge. It was none other than he who founded the Culinarians' Guild and codified cooking methodology.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_26: Today, the guild carries on Bhaldwaensyn's legacy, though the scope of our endeavors has expanded significantly. Not content with simply preserving existing recipes, we labor tirelessly to devise wholly novel culinary creations with which to delight the senses.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_27: To this end, our doors are open to folk from all walks of life, including adventurers such as your good self. One may liken our guild to a great pot of stew, and each member to an ingredient imparting a unique flavor.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_28: As with every dish, however, adding ingredients willy-nilly is certain to spoil the taste. Before you may take your place in the pot, you must be deemed a worthwhile addition by Guildmaster Lyngsath, a man whose passion for cookery burns hotter than any oven.
TEXT_CLSCUL001_00191_CHARLYS_000_29: Before troubling him, I must warn you that ours is a truly sweltering kitchen. As such, you would be well advised to ask yourself: can I stand the heat? If you earnestly believe that you can, speak to me once more, and I shall be glad to guide you through the enrollment process.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_0: Well met, adventurer. You stand within the Miners' Guild, the place where seekers of the realm's mineral wealth gather.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_1: With pickaxe and sledgehammer, we miners work rock and earth that they might yield us ores, fossils, precious stones, and more.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_2: If you have a mind to join our ranks, you will be pleased to know that we are currently recruiting. Great riches await those with strong backs and keen eyes!
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Miners' Guild?
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_10: Oh. I take it the prospect of striking it rich does not appeal.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_11: Well, to each  own, I suppose.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_12: Should you undergo a change of heart, know that I will be here.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_20: Excellent! Ah, wait a moment... Would I be right in thinking you're rather new to adventuring? You are, aren't you... Oh, don't ask me how I know─it's something that comes with experience. Anyway, I regret that you do not yet qualify for membership.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_21: To be considered for a place in the guild, you must first prove that you take your work seriously. In your case, that means devoting a little more time to your present pursuit.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_22: Once you have done so, I invite you to visit us again. Rest assured that there will still be minerals to mine when that day comes.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_SYSTEM_000_23: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_30: A decision you will not regret. You have just taken your first step toward striking it rich!
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_31: To look at the lands around Ul'dah, one would be forgiven for thinking the region barren of opportunity, but beneath the surface, the scene could not be more different. There lie veins of copper, silver, and gold beyond measure!
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_32: For as long as he has dwelt in Thanalan, man has availed himself of these vast deposits, giving rise to a thriving mining trade, which forms the foundation of our nation's prosperity.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_33: Of course, the mining trade as it is today owes much to an event which took place some century and a half ago─namely, the Mad Mythril Rush.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_34: Never before had the sultanate seen such an influx of migrants. Endless throngs came from lands near and far, spurred on by the dream of discovering the mother lode. Alas, a harsh reality awaited them.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_35: You see, the vast majority of these poor souls were miners in name alone, and they possessed neither the proper equipment nor the training to realize their dreams. To make matters worse, the mining concerns, who in those days held absolute power, did not scruple to exploit them.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_36: Presented with a glut of unskilled labor, they proceeded to fill every tunnel to bursting, and atrocious working conditions soon became the norm. Miners were paid a pittance for backbreaking labor, and saw naught of the riches they unearthed.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_37: Pushed to breaking point, the workers banded together to form the Miners' Guild, with the aim of improving conditions while protecting the integrity of the trade.
