TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_38: Since then, we have sought to educate folk in correct mining practices, both to prevent accidents and to curb the impact that our trade has upon the environment.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_39: I trust you now have a better understanding of what we do. All that is left is to commit your name to our roll.
TEXT_CLSMIN001_00192_LINETTE_000_40: When you are ready to do so, pray speak with me again. I shall guide you through the enrollment procedure.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_1:
Hello there, and welcome to the Botanists' Guild. What brings you here today?
...Hm? Interested in becoming a botanist, are you?
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_2: Then you've come to the right place. At our guild, you can study under some of the finest botanists in all the realm. An enticing proposition, is it not?
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_3: So, what say you? Would you like to add your name to our roll?
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Botanists' Guild?
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_10: Oh... Well, that's a shame. I'm sure you'd find botany a singularly rewarding pursuit. I know I do.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_11: If you ever have a change of heart, feel free to return here. The guild is ever looking to welcome new members into its ranks.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_21: ...Is what I would say if you were a suitable candidate. Alas, my instincts tell me you've only just started out as an adventurer. You don't lack for enthusiasm, I'll give you that, but you're still as green as spring grass. Come back when you've seen a bit more of the world, will you?
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_SYSTEM_000_22: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_30: Excellent! Now, you're doubtless eager to dive headlong into the nearest shrubbery─but first, a brief explanation on the origins of the Botanists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_31: Our guild boasts a long history. Its roots can be traced back some five hundred years, to when our nation was still in its infancy. It was around that time that a precursor organization to our own was established to facilitate communion with the elementals...
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_32: Ah...but I suspect you're already confused, not being forestborn. Let me put it in a way that your kind would understand.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_33: The Twelveswood doesn't belong to man, but almighty beings known as elementals. It is by their leave that we Gridanians dwell here in the forest, and it is by their leave that we receive of its bounty.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_34: Ever since mankind settled in the Twelveswood, it has been necessary for us to obtain the elementals' permission prior to taking aught from their domain. Historically, this was a rather involved process in that only a precious few could actually commune with them─specifically, those conjurers blessed with the ability to hear the elementals, aptly known as Hearers.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_35: In order to relay the elementals' will to the botanists in a more timely manner, a new organization was formed with a Hearer as its mouth and ears. This organization would eventually evolve to become the Botanists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_36: To this day, the guild employs the services of a Hearer who offers guidance to our members. Yet this is no longer our organization's sole concern. We also seek to promulgate correct harvesting practices─that is, practices which honor the will of the elementals.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_37: ...And that, my friend, is the story of how our guild came to be. I trust you have a newfound appreciation for the work we do.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_38: Now, with all this talk of elementals and communing, mayhap you're wondering whether you're fit to join us. Well, you may cast such doubts aside. You don't need to have been raised as a good little forestborn  to be a botanist, nor do you need to know the secret forestborn salute─I jest─you just need a healthy respect for nature and the will to learn.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_39: If you honestly believe you possess these things, it would be my pleasure to recommend you to our guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSHRV999_00193_LEONCEAULT_000_40: Please wait a moment while I see to the formalities. Speak to me again when you are ready to begin the enrollment procedures.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_GALFRID_000_1: A word, if I may? There is a difficult matter with which I could use your assistance.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_GALFRID_000_2: Allow me to explain. The nearby river is home to a colony of black efts whom I sent a party of recruits to slay. Yet scarcely a bell after I had done so, the youngsters returned─hysterical yet noticeably unbloodied─and loudly bemoaned their misfortune at ever having been sent to contend with such “hells-born horrors.”
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_GALFRID_000_3: Pitiful. My great-grandmama could dispatch an eft with her walking stick and a harsh word. That such a task should cow a whole party of able-bodied men and women is beyond belief. I would have you show these quivering milksops how it's done: make your way to the river and put down four of the creatures.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_GALFRID_000_11: I had my recruits watching from the banks as you dispatched the efts. It appears your skill in battle has inspired them.
TEXT_SUBFST039_00196_GALFRID_000_12: Either that or they have no wish to be upstaged by an adventurer─it matters little which. What does matter is that they have resumed their training with renewed zeal, and that I have you to thank for it. I am in your debt.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_PAULINE_000_1: If you might spare the time, , I would have you thin the numbers of hoglets in Greentear.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_PAULINE_000_2: While these beasts have always called the Twelveswood home, their appetite has grown so insatiable of late that I fear they will devour every nut on the forest floor. The cycle of life cannot well sustain such gluttony.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_PAULINE_000_3: I must ask you to slay at least six of the creatures. Their sacrifice will be to the greater good of the Twelveswood, I assure you.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_PAULINE_000_10: Yes...the elementals rejoice at your actions.
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_PAULINE_000_11: The life of the forest relies on a delicate balance, and the unchecked proliferation of beasts would mean a slow but certain death for the Twelveswood. It is our duty to correct such imbalance, and swiftly, even if it means shedding blood...
TEXT_SUBFST042_00198_PAULINE_000_12: Though it may seem trivial, you have performed a vital service this day. May the elementals bless your future endeavors.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: You're an adventurer like myself, are you not? I realize we've only just met, but I am in dire need of help. Hear me out, I beg you.

You may be familiar with a traveling troupe of entertainers called the Continental Circus. Its members have come to the three city-states to help the people celebrate All Saints' Wake...or so they claim.

Lest we spread undue panic, what I am about to tell you, I ask that you keep in the strictest confidence: the members of this troupe are not people, but fiends who possess the ability to alter their form at will.

Since setting up for the festivities, they have yet to do any harm, but there is no guarantee that that will remain the case. The safety of the citizens being paramount, the Adventurers' Guild has tasked me with keeping watch for suspicious activity.

Upon learning that the circus is recruiting helpers, I thought to volunteer myself that I might get close to its members and determine if they pose a threat. Alas, at some point, they became aware of my intent, and I can no longer proceed as planned. This is where you come in.

Your face is not yet known to circus members, I believe, and you should be able to volunteer your services without arousing suspicion. If you are willing, head into Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, and speak with the illusionist on the stage.

Volunteering your services to the Continental Circus may be the only way to determine if it poses a threat. If you'd be willing, head into Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, and speak with the illusionist upon the stage.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CONJURER65772_000_0: Greetings, adventurer! It seems to me you're wanting for something to do. Our circus troupe is in town to help the people celebrate All Saints' Wake, and we're in need of volunteers.
As you may know, All Saints' Wake used to be terrifying business. While the saints feasted in the heavens, the fiends wreaked havoc on the realm below.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CONJURER65772_100_0: But these days, the Wake is all about having fun, and we of the Continental Circus have made it our mission to see that everyone has a frighteningly good time!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CONJURER65772_000_0: How do we mean to achieve this, you ask? Through the art of illusion, that's how! I shall cast a spell that will lend you a most frightening guise. While in that guise, I would have you terrorize the citizens.
The people you see in Old Gridania should make suitable victims. But without further ado, let the terror begin!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_100_013: Your appearance will be altered through the art of illusion. Make your way around Old Gridania and frighten the people, and help to make this All Saints' Wake the most enjoyable in living memory!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_110_013: Please note that you cannot perform any actions while under this status. Furthermore, you cannot interact with characters who are unrelated to the quest.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_120_013: The status will fade if you leave the area. You may receive it again by speaking with the uncanny illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CONJURER65772_000_0: If the glamour wears off, just return here, and I'll cast it on you again. Now, off you go to frighten the citizenry!
Your glamour has worn off, has it? Well, that is easily remedied. Now, off you go to frighten the citizenry!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_000_01: How fares the investigation? If you learn aught of interest, be sure to let me know.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_100_01:
Uwaaah!
...Oh, it's only you. By your appearance, I take it that the investigation is faring well. If you learn aught of interest, be sure to let me know.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_130_017: This person seems to be deep in thought, and does not respond.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_PARSEMONTRET_000_02:
A monster!? Nophica protect us!
...No, wait. We are in the midst of All Saints' Wake, are we not? It must be some kind of illusion. A fiendishly convincing one, to be sure, but an illusion nonetheless.

My lady! T-To what do I owe the pleasure of your presence?
...No, wait. This is highly unlikely. It must be some kind of illusion. A fiendishly convincing one, to be sure, but an illusion nonetheless.
Ah, so I was right! This calls to mind the time I first witnessed sylphic glamours. I was but a child, and was rather awed by it all.
Since then I've had something of an interest in illusions, and yours, my friend, is most impressive. My day was anything but eventful until you came along, and I thank you for the diversion.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_100_023: Parsemontret seems to be delighted rather than affrighted by your antics...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_PARSEMONTRET_000_02: The Wood Wailers are up in arms. There are whispers that sylphs have stolen into the city, blending in with the crowd during the festivities.
It has been a while since I've seen such an impressive illusion. My thanks for the diversion, adventurer.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CEINGULED_000_030: A fiend!? How did you manage to get past the gate guards!? No matter─I shall take care of you myself!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CEINGULED_000_031: E-Elder Seedseer! W-We were not expecting you! I mean, your visit does us great honor!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CEINGULED_000_032: ...What? An illusion!? <sigh> In light of the season, I suppose I ought not be surprised... But festivities or no, I would thank you not to startle me like that!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CEINGULED_000_033: But no... It isn't right for me to direct my anger at you. 'Tis my own fault that I failed to see through your guise. If I am to perform my duties as Wood Wailer, I must learn to discern truth and falsehood at a glance...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_100_033: Ceinguled's initial fright and indignance seem to have given way to gratitude...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CEINGULED_000_034: Security within the city has been tightened during All Saints' Wake. If you have business with us, I ask that you keep it brief.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CEINGULED_000_035: It troubles me deeply that I could not see through your illusion. If I am to perform my duties as Wood Wailer, I must learn to discern truth and falsehood at a glance.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_MELLAINE_000_040: Most peculiar... Though your form is that of a fiend, your aura tells me otherwise. Some manner of illusory magic is at work, I am certain of it.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_MELLAINE_000_041:
My lady. Is there aught you require?
...No, something is amiss. Though your form is that of the Elder Seedseer, your aura tells me otherwise. Some manner of illusory magic is at work, I am certain of it.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_MELLAINE_000_042: A spell woven by a member of the Continental Circus? Most intriguing...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_MELLAINE_000_043: Among the ranks of voidsent, there are those who possess the ability to alter their form. I have had occasion to encounter such fiends, and I can say that the glamour you wear is no less convincing than theirs...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_SYSTEM_100_043: Your guise appears to have impressed rather than frightened Mellaine...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_MELLAINE_000_044: The city is come to life in celebration of All Saints' Wake. Let us give thanks to the elementals for granting us the peace to engage in light-hearted revelry.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_MELLAINE_000_045: Among the ranks of voidsent, there are those who possess the ability to alter their form. I have had occasion to encounter such fiends, and I can say that the glamour you wear is no less convincing than theirs...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CONJURER65772_000_0: Done your round of Old Gridania, have you? Marvelous! Here, allow me to remove the illusion for you.
So, how did you fare? You gave the people a right proper fright, yes? Sent them fleeing, crying for their mammies?
...What? They enjoyed it, you say? But they were supposed to be terrified! What went wrong?
<sigh> At this rate, there won't be enough terror. And if we don't gather enough terror, we can't usher in the Night of Devilry, like that woman said...
Errr... I was, um...rehearsing my lines in a play for the festival! Scary stuff, right? Right!
Th-Thanks to you, the people of Gridania are having a splendid All Saints' Wake! We'd be most grateful if you could spread the fun to Limsa Lominsa!
The stars are aligned! We shall recreate the Night of Devilry, that terror may reign over─ Er, I mean... Let us make this year's All Saints' Wake the most enjoyable in living memory!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_PUMPKIN65772_000_05: (-Pumpkin-headed Woman-)Heh heh heh... The most enjoyable indeed...
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_CONJURER65772_000_0: Thanks to you, the people of Gridania are having a splendid All Saints' Wake! We'd be most grateful if you could spread the fun to Limsa Lominsa!
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_000_06: Ah, you're back! And with useful information, I hope?
...The Night of Devilry, you say? This investigation has borne more fruit than I had dared hope.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_100_06: Legend has it that, on the Night of Devilry, creatures of darkness led by a pumpkin-headed fiend shall descend upon the realm and wreak unimaginable havoc.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_000_06: If the illusionist's words are to be believed, the Continental Circus means to usher in this night of terror and destruction. Yet by your account, they have only succeeded in bringing joy to Gridania. What are they playing at? Is this but the laughter before the screams?

We have learned only enough to be worried, but not enough to take decisive action. We must continue our investigation. They bade you go to Limsa Lominsa to “spread the fun,” and it is thither that we must go. I shall go on ahead─seek me out at the Aftcastle when you arrive.
TEXT_FESHLW101_00236_GODRIQUELAIN_000_70: Ah, there you are, my friend. Time is of the essence, so let us get started.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: Since arriving in Limsa Lominsa, I have conducted a preliminary investigation into Continental Circus activities.

As was the case in Gridania, they are calling for unsuspecting volunteers, doubtless to help them bring their vile plot to fruition. We must uncover precisely what they mean to do, that we can prevent the Night of Devilry from coming to pass.

The tactic we previously employed to gather intelligence worked like a charm, and I see no reason why it will not work again. Go to the illusionist nearby, and offer your services to him. Keep your eyes and ears open, and learn all you can.

The tactic we previously employed to gather intelligence worked like a charm, and I see no reason why it will not work again. Go to the illusionist nearby, and offer your services to him. Keep your eyes and ears open, and learn all you can.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: Well met and welcome, adventurer. I'm given to understand that you assisted our troupe's activities in Gridania. I would be much obliged if you would assist us here as well.
Now then, no All Saints' Wake would be complete without pumpkin lanterns. Alas, Limsa Lominsa is sorely lacking in them. I would remedy this with your help.
I shall give you three pumpkin lanterns, which you must place at the locations─and in the exact order─I specify.
The Drowning Wench is your first destination, after which you are to go to the Coral Tower. Last but not least is Maelstrom Command. Be certain to remember this.

What is the significance of this order, you ask? Why, it is essential in creating the magicked patterns by which we shall usher in a night of ter─er...terrific fun. Y-Yes, that's right─terrific fun for one and all!
With that established, I shall use the art of illusion to lend you a form most intimidating. No one will dare obstruct your lantern placing, and we shall be one step closer to realizing our ambition!
Remember, your first destination is the Drowning Wench.
Hm, the illusion has faded, has it? I shall refresh it for you. See to it that all the lanterns are where they are supposed to be.

TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_020: (-Baderon-)Oi, what do ye think yer doin'? No junk on me bar!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_100_020: (-Baderon-)A monster...with a lantern!? What kind o' twisted joke's this!?
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_021: (-Baderon-)Oi, what do ye think yer doin'? No junk on me bar!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_100_021: (-Baderon-)A-Admiral!? I weren't expectin' ye fer a couple o' bells yet! An' beggin' yer pardons, but that lantern...?
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_022: (-Baderon-)...An illusion, ye say? Bugger me, I should've known. The sight of it all was so absurd, fer a moment I thought I was hallucinatin'─an' I 'aven't smoked the sort o' stuff what does that to ye in years. Good to know I 'aven't gone an' lost me wits.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_023: (-Baderon-)Now, ye were sayin' ye wanted to put yer lantern 'ere? This bein' All Saints' Wake an' all, I ain't averse to a few decorations, but this thing's bleedin' enormous! What with the Admiral an' 'er retinue comin', I'd rather not 'ave the place cluttered...
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_024: (-Baderon-)Look, there's no point in me keepin' ye. Jus' leave that thing with me, I'll find a spot fer it, alright?
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_025: (-Baderon-)Bugger me, the Admiral an' 'er retinue's arrivin' soon, but I ain't even started preparin' yet. We're gonna need more grog, that's fer sure. A lot more grog...
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_BADERON_000_026: (-Baderon-)Bah, where to put this thing... If only it weren't this bleedin' enormous...
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: You've placed a lantern at the Drowning Wench? Wonderful! Lest you've forgotten, the second one is bound for the Coral Tower. Off you go now!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_GODRIQUELAIN_000_02: I know full well the great burden I've placed upon you, but the safety of the citizenry is at stake. For their sake, you must continue the investigation.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_GODRIQUELAIN_100_02:
Uwaaah!?
...Oh, it's only you. Looking sharp, my friend. Pray carry on with the investigation. Remember, the safety of the citizenry is at stake.

TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_030: (-Reyner-)You there! What do you think you're doing with that─
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_100_030: (-Reyner-)What's this!? You will rue the day you dared enter the Coral Tower, vile fiend!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_031: (-Reyner-)You there! What do you think you're doing with that─
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_100_031: (-Reyner-)A-Admiral! M-My apologies! I did not notice that it was you! If I might make bold, however, you do not seem to be yourself today. Are you feeling unwell?
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_032: (-Reyner-)...Illusion magicks for the All Saints' Wake festivities? Setting aside the unwarranted start you gave me, it certainly is a very convincing disguise.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_033: (-Reyner-)And as for the lantern, I do not object to your placing it here, but be forewarned that I may later have it removed at my discretion.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_034: (-Reyner-)We are expecting the Admiral to come here for inspection, you see, and when she does, the Coral Tower must be in immaculate order. This means no decorations, seasonal or otherwise.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_035: (-Reyner-)If you have business, I ask that you speak with one of my people. I must needs make the tower ready for the Admiral's inspection.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_REYNER_000_036: (-Reyner-)I must confess, the lantern is beginning to grow on me. Mind you, this does not mean that it can stay when the Admiral comes.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: So you've placed the second lantern at the Coral Tower? Well done! That leaves us with just the one for Maelstrom Command. Run along and see it done.

TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_RASHAHT_100_040: (-R'ashaht Rhiki-)A fiend!? You are either bold or foolish to come here! Say your prayers to whatever dark gods you keep!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_RASHAHT_000_041: (-R'ashaht Rhiki-)What in the name of the Navigator are you doing with that thing!?

TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_RASHAHT_000_043: (-R'ashaht Rhiki-)Now, I personally have no issues with your leaving the pumpkin lantern here, but know that the Maelstrom will not be responsible for its care.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_RASHAHT_000_044: (-R'ashaht Rhiki-)We will not hear any complaints if it gets damaged. Furthermore, if it's deemed a nuisance, it will be summarily removed. I trust I have made myself clear.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_RASHAHT_000_045: (-R'ashaht Rhiki-)'Tis been a while since the Admiral last graced us with an inspection. We must see to it that everything is to her satisfaction.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_RASHAHT_000_046: (-R'ashaht Rhiki-)Remember, the Maelstrom is not responsible for the care of the lantern. We will not hear any complaints if it gets damaged, and if it's deemed a nuisance, it will be summarily removed.

TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SYSTEM_000_048: In order to progress further in the quest, you must be under the transfigured status.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_100_0: Ah, you are returned. The illusion has served its purpose. Here, allow me to remove it for you.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: So, you have placed all the lanterns, yes? Wonderful, wonderful!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_100_0: Being the fools that they are, they did not even suspect our motive! And now the magicked pattern is complete, precisely to that woman's specifications!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: 'Tis only a matter of time before the gate bursts open! My dark brethren will overrun this realm, and the Night of Devilry shall come again! Ahahahaha!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_SYSTEM_100_052: A conversation between two Yellowjackets carries over to you.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_YELLOWA65773_000_05: Oi, 'ave ye 'eard? Some daft sod's been goin' around leavin' these creepy dark pumpkins all over the city.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_YELLOWB65773_000_05: Aye, I did hear about that. One each at the Drowning Wench, the Coral Tower, and Maelstrom Command, right? What's to be done about them?
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_YELLOWA65773_000_05: They've already been rounded up an' thrown out, if that's what yer askin'. Can't leave that shite lyin' about─people might take a tumble an' 'urt 'emselves!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: Errr... Lest you misunderstand, that was but a...a summary of the, er...play we're planning as part of the festivities. Th-That's right, a stage play! The premise is very original, do you not agree?
'Tis a shame that our props were removed before the play could take place. We must remember not to make the same mistake next time... <sigh>
A-At any rate, you have more than done your part here in Limsa Lominsa. We would be most grateful if you could next help out with the festivities in Ul'dah. My thanks again, adventurer!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_PUMPKIN65772_000_06: (-Pumpkin-headed Woman-)Heh heh heh... Such charming children... The best is yet to come─pray enjoy All Saints' Wake to the fullest...
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_CONJURER65773_000_0: You have more than done your part here in Limsa Lominsa. We would be most grateful if you could next help out with the festivities in Ul'dah. My thanks again, adventurer.
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_GODRIQUELAIN_000_07: Ah, you are returned. How fared the investigation? You must tell me everything you have learned!
...A magicked pattern? By the gods, how many ways are there to usher in the Night of Devilry? And to think that you might have been party to it if not for the Lominsans' unwitting intervention!

But the danger is not passed. The illusionist bade you help out with the festivities in Ul'dah, which means that yet another scheme is in progress. And having failed in their attempts thus far, I fear that the Continental Circus will stop at nothing to see its dark ambition realized.

Make no mistake, the situation is coming to a head. We must continue our investigation in Ul'dah. Make your way there as soon as you are able, and meet me in the vicinity of the Ruby Road Exchange. Safe travels!
TEXT_FESHLW102_00237_GODRIQUELAIN_000_08: 'Tis good to see you, my friend. You must be weary from the road. Take a moment to catch your breath, and I will share with you what I have managed to learn thus far.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: Without further ado, let us resume our investigation. Since arriving in Ul'dah, I have learned that the Continental Circus is planning to host a costume parade.
As the procession makes its way along Emerald Avenue, its participants will cast some manner of charm upon onlookers, which purportedly brings happiness and fortune to those who receive it.
Sounds like harmless fun, but make no mistake, this event is but another means for the shape-shifting fiends to usher in the Night of Devilry. It falls to us to see that they do not succeed.

As before, the Continental Circus is recruiting volunteers, and I would have you answer their call. Considering the assistance you have lent the troupe thus far, they will surely take you on again without suspicion.
Now then, go and speak with the illusionist who stands by the entrance to the Ruby Road Exchange. Offer her your services, and do whatever she requires of you.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_100_00: In the meantime, I shall pursue my own line of investigation. Once you have completed your task for the troupe, seek me out in front of the Quicksand. Godsspeed!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: The Continental Circus means to bring about the Night of Devilry, but how do they mean to go about achieving it? We must cast light upon this mystery.
Uwaaah! Wh-What do you want from me!?
A-Ahem. Of course it's only you. <sigh> I really must do something about my propensity to startle...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Hello there, adventurer! Are you here to help out with our splendidly spooky parade by any chance? ...You are? Marvelous!
We've prepared flyers to spread word of the event, and we want you to hand them out to the people in the Quicksand.
In order to give them a taste of what's in store, I will weave an illusion to alter your appearance to something frighteningly festive.

Oh, and be sure to say this to each person who receives a flyer: “If you invite fourteen people within four hours and then join the parade, you will know great happiness!” It's a surefire way to make the parade a rousing success!
But without further ado, it's transfiguration time!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_500_014: The action Festal Cant is now available on the pet hotbar.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_501_014: Festal Cant is used in the FATE “Main Street Spectral Parade,” and has no effect elsewhere.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Please hand out the parade flyers to the people in the Quicksand while you're in your frighteningly festive form.
To each person who receives a flyer, remember to say: “If you invite fourteen people within four hours and then join the parade, you will know great happiness!”
Oh dear, it looks like your illusion has faded. Allow me to refresh it!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_000_020: This person seems to be deep in thought, and does not respond.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_020: Aiiiiiie! Please don't eat me! I don't taste very good!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_021: <gasp> M-My lord! I b-bid you welcome to the Quicksand! Will you be dining with us this day?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_022: <gasp> Y-Your Grace! I b-bid you welcome to the Quicksand! Will you be dining with us this day?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_023: ...Only an illusion!? You wicked, wicked adventurer! My heart nigh stopped beating for the fright!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_024: But what's this flyer you've brought? Ooh, a charm that brings happiness and fortune! I must round up my whole family for the parade!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_028: Hello there, traveler. Are you enjoying the All Saints' Wake celebration? They say it's twice as fun if you're in costume.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PAPASU_000_029: My thanks for the flyer! I shall round up my whole family for the parade!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_021: G-General Raubahn! 'Tis an honor to meet a great hero such as you! I would be your man, if you will have me! I can deliver your packages, scrub your mail, and...and massage your sore feet after a hard day's march!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_022: Y-Your Grace! Th-This is no place for a woman of your exalted personage! You're liable to get kidnapped...or worse! Allow your humble servant, Botulf, to spirit you to safety!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_023: ...What? It's just an illusion? Godsdammit! If I'm so easily deceived, how can I expect to survive in this viper's nest of a city?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_024: ...Eh? I'll know great happiness if I invite fourteen people to this parade of yours!?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_025:
This...this isn't another trick, is it? Because it sure sounds like one...
Ah, what the hells─I'll be there with whomever else I can drag along. It's not like I have anything to lose.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_027: <sigh> Of all the stupid blunders I've made, this one trumps them all. Gods, I need a stiff drink to forget my woes. And I need the coin to buy that stiff drink. Thal bugger me dead...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_028: If I can bring fourteen people to the parade, I'll know great happiness...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_BOTULF_000_029: I don't want to set myself up for disappointment, but there's a part of me that desperately wishes for it to be true. I'll be at the parade with whomever else I can drag along.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_020: Egads! A fiend in the Quicksand!? To arms, to arms!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_021: <gasp> General Raubahn! The tales of your valorous exploits are known even in my native Gridania!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_022: <gasp> Your Grace! I am moved beyond words that you would honor me, a humble outsider, with your presence!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_023: ...An illusion? I-I knew that, of course! I was simply, er...playing along. 'Tis All Saints' Wake, after all, and I am not one to spoil the festive mood.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_024: Needless to say I should be glad to participate in the parade of which this flyer speaks.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_025: ...What's that? Come with fourteen friends, you say? Assuming they are willing, my comrades here make two, leaving twelve more to be found... Hmmm...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_028: The All Saints' Wake celebration here is rather more boisterous than what I'm accustomed to in my native Gridania. I expect that the costumes, too, will be a deal more lavish.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MARTEIRE_000_029: I should be glad to participate in the parade. As for the fourteen friends you requested...I shall see what I can do.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Welcome back! Thanks to your deft distribution of the flyers, we're expecting record attendance at the parade! Well, this is the first time we're holding it, to be sure, but you get my meaning.

Welcome back! Thanks to your deft distribution of the flyers, we're expecting record attendance at the parade! Well, this is the first time we're holding it, to be sure, but no need for us to dwell on semantics. Oh, but before I go on, allow me to remove your illusion.
You have served us admirably for the parade's preparations. Next, I would have you participate in the parade itself─our troupe's centerpiece for this year's All Saints' Wake!

Oh, there is nothing to it. You simply have to march along Emerald Avenue and cast a charm upon citizens who have come to spectate. “Festal Cant,” the charm is called, and it brings happiness and fortune to all who are touched by it! Delightful, is it not?
Yet not everything is sugar and rainbows, I'm afraid. You must beware the mages of the Thaumaturges' Guild, who have concealed themselves among the crowd.
For reasons unclear, they bear our troupe no love, and will seek to spoil our efforts to spread joy in Ul'dah. Should you cast the charm upon them, they will strip you of your illusion.
For the sake of our spectators' enjoyment, we must avoid showing our true forms during the parade. Do have care where the charm is directed.
Go now, adventurer, and show the people of Ul'dah a frighteningly fun time! I look forward to hearing from you upon the parade's conclusion!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_000_039: The FATE “Main Street Spectral Parade” can be commenced by speaking with the ogre pumpkinhead on Emerald Avenue.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_000_040: Accompany the ogre pumpkinhead as she makes her way along the avenue, and use the action Festal Cant on any unsuspecting citizens you come upon.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_000_041: You must be transfigured to participate in and complete the FATE. This status can be received by speaking with the unusual illusionist.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_000_042: Please note that you cannot interact with the ogre pumpkinhead while transfigured. You must remove the status if you wish to commence the FATE.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_SYSTEM_100_042: Lastly, in order to obtain the FATE's rewards and advance the quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Go on and show the people of Ul'dah a frighteningly fun time! I look forward to hearing from you upon the parade's conclusion!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_TRANSFORMATION_000_: I am a wondrous wizard of illusion! I am a maker of mirages and a rearranger of reality, with a thousand hi-potions' worth of health and infinite piety. I have received word of you, adventurer, and will grant you a frighteningly festive form, if that is your desire.
There, the illusion is in place. The parade awaits─pray spread the joy of All Saints' Wake to the people.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: I am told the parade was a rousing success! You have been a great help, adventurer.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_100_0: I am told the parade was a rousing success! You have been a great help, adventurer. But here, you won't be needing the illusion anymore.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Finally, our mission is accomplished! The Impresario shall be most pleased!
...What mission, you ask? Why, the parade, of course! What else could I be referring to?
Now, if you'll excuse me, I must go and meet with the Impresario. He is expecting a report. In the meantime, might I suggest that you take part in more parades?
...Where's this meeting taking place, you ask? Why, the Gold Court, of course! Where else could it─ Oh...

N-No one is supposed to know of this! You mustn't come, do you understand? If you do, I'll get turned into a pumpkin cookie! Being the kindly adventurer that you are, you don't want that to happen, right? Right!

N-No one is supposed to know of my meeting with the Impresario! You mustn't come, do you understand? If you do, I'll get turned into a pumpkin cookie! Being the kindly adventurer that you are, you don't want that to happen, right? Right!
Of course not, sir! And you can be assured that not a soul knows of this meeting! ...Before we begin, would it be possible to shed this cumbersome form?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_000_062: It does get wearisome having to stand on these crude limbs. Very well.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Ahhh, that's more like it! Natural is the way to go!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_000_064: Aye, well, just remember that we've got to be more vigilant. Now, give me that report.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Yes, sir! I'm pleased to say that the parade was a resounding success. A gullible adventurer came along, and  followed our instructions to the letter.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_000_066: Heh heh heh! Our hard work has paid off! The Night of Devilry will return!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Turning people into our brethren rather than summoning them─it's so simple, I don't know why we didn't think of it before!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_000_068: The use of illusions, the plot for each nation... That woman suggested it all. And as if that weren't enough, she offers to lead the parade!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_100_068: I still don't have the faintest who she is, but we couldn't've come this far without her. Hells, if I didn't know better, I'd say she's the Great Gourd of legend come again!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: Ooh, it's about time the charm took effect. When the citizens become us, the terror that ensues will be delicious! We won't want to miss a moment of it!

Heh heh heh... It's so close, I can almost taste that sweet, sweet terror...
Oh, hello there, adventurer! If you're not busy, might I suggest that you take part in more parades?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_08: You are returned! Tell me, were you able to uncover the troupe's plot?
...They're using the parade to transform the citizens into fiends!? Gods be good... The situation is far graver than I had anticipated...
I know not what can be done for those who have already been affected by the charm, but we cannot allow any more to fall victim to it. We must put a stop to the parade!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_083: Sounds like you're in a spot of bother, Godri. Trouble with the womanfolk, mayhap?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_08: Allow me to introduce you to Miss Momodi, the owner of the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_086: I also have the pleasure of lookin' after adventurers like yourself here in Ul'dah. Pleased to meet you!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_087: I was just at the parade with some friends, and we had a grand old time. I stood at the front of the crowd and got a double dose of that charm! I feel as though I'm walkin' on clouds!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_08: What!? M-Miss Momodi, there is something you must know. That charm is not what you think it is. It turns people...into fiends!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_088: ...People into fiends? Ahahaha! Godri, did you get into my mead while I was away?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_089: Do I look like a fiend to you? I don't think so! I appreciate your concern, but you're worryin' for naught.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_090: 'Twas a traditional charm for promotin' a sense of well-bein' what was bein' cast. I've known 'bout it since I was a wee lass. The bit about bringin' fourteen friends, though? Now, that's bollocks.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_091: Anyroad, if you saw 'em as went to the parade, you'd see that they're all grinnin' from ear to ear─like yours truly! Ain't no better proof the charm did as promised.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_100_091: This has been the most enjoyable All Saints' Wake I've had in ages. I daresay even the fiends had 'emselves a good time!
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_MOMODI_000_092: Anyroad, it's past time I got back to work. Be seein' you! La la la la la...♪
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_09: So the Continental Circus had been misled all this time? Words do not suffice to express my relief...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_PUMPKIN_000_094: (-Disembodied Voice-)Heh heh heh... Happiness and joy for man and monster both─things are as they should be...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_GODRIQUELAIN_000_09: D-Did you say something? No? I could have sworn I heard a voice...
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_000_096: Hmmm... This is passing strange. Why has the transformation not begun?
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_CONJURER65774_000_0: I'm sure it will happen any moment now, sir. We just need to be patient.
TEXT_FESHLW103_00238_IMPHEAD_000_097: Yes, no doubt you are right. The wait will make it all the more glorious when this city is overrun with our kind! Ahahahahaha!

TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_VOLUNTEER65783_000_: Filled with the spirit of giving, are we? Let's set you to your task, then.
All you need to do is collect a single child's message from one of the Starlight sentinels within the Lavender Beds...all while wearing your Starlight tunic, of course.
As you know, there is the tree we helpers set up here in Yainu-Par, but there are also decorated sentinels to be found in the gardens of your fellow adventurers' estates.
You should also know that the type of fallen star you receive for your efforts will depend on the sentinel from which the message is retrieved.

Did we talk about fallen stars? It's a simple system we devised to reward hardworking volunteers─a type of festive currency that can be exchanged for seasonal goods. Speak with the Starlight crier if you'd like to know more!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_000_001: The position of Starlight sentinels will be displayed on your minimap. Search the residential area to pinpoint their locations!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_100_001: You can only obtain one seasonal message at a time, so choose your sentinel wisely! Keep in mind which fallen stars are needed to purchase the seasonal goods you wish to acquire.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_VOLUNTEER65783_000_: Pray bring me a message from any of the Starlight sentinels found within the Lavender Beds. Oh, and don't forget to don your scarlet apparel!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_000_002: The position of Starlight sentinels will be displayed on your minimap. Search the residential area to pinpoint their locations!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_100_002: You can only obtain one seasonal message at a time, so choose your sentinel wisely! Keep in mind which fallen stars are needed to purchase the seasonal goods you wish to acquire.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_000_010: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_000_011: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_GUIDE65783_000_012: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_VOLUNTEER65783_000_: Hello again! You've returned with one of the children's messages, I trust?
Excellent. Now comes the fun part! Take this gift, and deliver it to the waiting youngling. Remember: the wee ones expect someone dressed as a little helper!
You should find an expectant child waiting nearby. Don't forget to dress the part!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDA65783_000_030: A little helper! Yay! Do you have my present!? Can I have my present now!?
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDA65783_000_031:
I got a pre-sent!♪
A present from the go-ddess!♪
Thank you, little helper!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDB65783_000_032: Excuse me, ... I was told to wait here for my present...
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDB65783_000_033: ...Can I really have this? Thank you so much!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDC65783_000_034: Wow, are you really a little helper? Well, I've been good this year, so is it okay if I get my gift now...?
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDC65783_000_035: Thank you! I'll be sure not to play too rough...
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDA65783_000_036: I'm waiting here for the little helper to bring my present! I wonder what's taking so long...
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDB65783_000_037: Have you seen a little helper anywhere? Maybe they forgot about me...
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_CHILDC65783_000_038: If I wait right here, a little helper is supposed to bring me a gift. That's what they said...
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_100_038: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_110_038: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_GUIDE65783_120_038: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_VOLUNTEER65783_000_: You've returned to me empty-handed. Good! I do hope the youngling enjoys the gift!
Amh Garanjy does so dearly love to see the children smile. When I once marveled at her dedication, the celebrant explained that her fervor grew from her troubled past as an orphan.
She would spare any child the misery and loneliness she experienced, even if it meant funding the entire Starlight Celebration by washing dirty dishes at the Carline Canopy for a year.
And I must admit, her intensity is quite contagious! I assume you must feel it too, otherwise why else would you find yourself compelled to help us again and again?
I believe I heard the delighted laughter from here! Good show, little helper! I hope I can count on your assistance again in the future!
TEXT_FESXMS001_00247_SYSTEM_000_050: You have contributed to the Starlight Celebration in every residential district! Report to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_VOLUNTEER65784_000_: Ready for a run through the ward, then, are ye? That's the bloody spirit, !

'Tis the same job as ye've done afore: find yerself a Starlight sentinel, an' collect one o' them adorable little imps' messages. And don't forget to wear yer bleedin' tunic, all right? Ye know, the bright bloody red one?

Oh, an' I s'pose I ought to mention 'ow there's more of them trees about the place aside from the ones what we 'elpers put up─aye, ye might want to check the sentinels what are decoratin' the gardens o' some o' these estates.

Yer probably thinkin', “Why would I run me arse to the far side o' the ward when I can just grab a letter from the tree over there?” Well, that's 'cause the type o' fallen star ye'll get as a reward'll change dependin' on the sentinel ye took the message from!

An' dependin' on the seasonal loot yer lookin' to bag, ye might need yerself a different fallen star to exchange for it. Make sense? Well, the Starlight Celebration crier'll explain it nice an' clearly for ye if me charmin' Lominsan brogue is too 'arsh for yer delicate sensibilities.

TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_GUIDE65784_000_012: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_VOLUNTEER65784_000_: Back now, are ye? Where's me tear-jerkin' message, then?
Aye, that's...that's just lovely. Warms me brutish 'eart, it do. Right, time for some gift givin'! 'Ere, take this to the wee bugger waitin' over yonder.
Go on wiv ye! Go an' 'and out that present afore me stoic facade starts to crumble!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDA65784_000_030: Hmm, so yer one o' them little 'elpers, are ye? I weren't sure ye'd actually come. ...Is it true ye'll give me a present for writin' that letter?
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDA65784_000_031: Yer really givin' this to me!? Hooray! Me mates'll never believe this!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDB65784_000_032: Hey! Over here! Aye! Me! Give the toy to me!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDB65784_000_033: This festival is the best! Thank you!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDC65784_000_034: You think to deceive me, you crimson-clad charlatan!? I'll have you know I plan on becoming a famous arcanist! My magic eyes will see right through your tricky gift illusions!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDC65784_000_035: ...This feels solid. Y-You might just be who you say you are. So...I can keep this? Yay! A present for me!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDA65784_000_036: The grown-ups told me that if I wait 'ere, then a little 'elper'll come an' give me a present. Sounds like a bunch o' bollocks...but I'll stay a mite longer, just in case.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDB65784_000_037: Awww, you're just an adventurer. Can you move outta the way so the little helper can see me?
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_CHILDC65784_000_038: I suspect that the little helper who was meant for me is an impostor. A real helper wouldn't be taking so long. I mean, how many other children can there possibly be!?
