TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SYSTEM_110_038: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_GUIDE65784_120_038: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_VOLUNTEER65784_000_: 'Anded out yer gift an' brought a child festive joy an' all that, 'ave ye? Good work, good work. Yer a chip off the ol' saint's block!
Speakin' o' the ol' saint, Amh Garanjy said she met a white-bearded bloke what was wearin' Starlight garb when she was a but a wee lass 'erself.
She was weepin' over a special ring she'd lost or summat o' the sort, an' this saint-like fella gave 'er a new one to replace it. Cheered 'er right up, she said.
Sometimes kindness finds ye when ye least expect it. I'd thought this world a bloody cruel an' lonely place till I met decent folk like you an' Amh Garanjy...
...An' now I'm gettin' all bleedin' emotional again. Sod off, then─ye've done yer part for the now. Maybe I'll see ye back for more work afore the celebration's over an' done, eh?
Done wiv yer gift givin', are ye? Ah, I live to see them little buggers' faces light up. Yer doin' good work, ! Come back again afore the celebration's over an' done, eh?
TEXT_FESXMS002_00248_SYSTEM_000_050: You have contributed to the Starlight Celebration in every residential district! Report to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_VOLUNTEER65785_000_: Ready to spread that festive cheer? Then let's get straight to work, shall we?
Visit any of the Starlight sentinels within the Goblet, and bring back one of the children's messages. And be sure to wear your Starlight tunic─you never know when the younglings will be watching!
...Ah, I should mention that, aside from the trees that we volunteers placed ourselves, there are sentinels to be found within the gardens of your fellow adventurers.
Visiting different trees will bring rewards in the form of differently colored festive tokens─a form of festival currency we've taken to calling “fallen stars.”

These fallen stars can be exchanged for a range of seasonal merchandise, and an industrious little helper can speak with the Starlight Celebration crier to learn exactly which hue of fallen star is obtained from visiting which tree.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_000_001: The position of Starlight sentinels will be displayed on your minimap. Search the residential area to pinpoint their locations!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_100_001: You can only obtain one festival message at a time, so choose your sentinel wisely! Keep in mind which fallen stars are needed to purchase the seasonal goods you wish to acquire.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_VOLUNTEER65785_000_: Head out into the ward and visit one of the Starlight sentinels. But do not collect a message without first donning your scarlet tunic! The sight of an armor-clad, bloodstained adventurer fails to inspire the same level of innocent wonder, you understand.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_000_002: The position of Starlight sentinels will be displayed on your minimap. Search the residential area to pinpoint their locations!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_100_002: You can only obtain one seasonal message at a time, so choose your sentinel wisely! Keep in mind which fallen stars are needed to purchase the seasonal goods you wish to acquire.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_000_010: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_000_011: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_GUIDE65785_000_012: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_VOLUNTEER65785_000_: Quickly, now, let's see what you've brought.

...Ah, yes, a very Ul'dahn sentiment. Would you believe some of these younglings attempt to negotiate for extra presents? So precious. Here, pray deliver this gift to the merchant-to-be waiting nearby.
Pray hand over the present to the anxious child you'll find lingering across the way. Remember: the younglings expect to meet a little helper!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDA65785_000_030: Hello, little helper. Is this the part where you give me a present?
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDA65785_000_031: Yes, I suppose this will do. Thank you─that will be all.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDB65785_000_032: By Thal and by Nald! A little helper! That means it's gift time!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDB65785_000_033: Huzzah! This is my favorite festival of the year!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDC65785_000_034: I waited and waited and waited and now you're finally here! May I have my present now,  little helper?
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDC65785_000_035: Yay! I'll never forget you,  little helper!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDA65785_000_036: I'm told that if I wait here, a little helper will arrive to shower me with riches. How very exciting.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDB65785_000_037: Come on, little helper, I'm here! Thrill me! Come on, thrill me! I'm here!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_CHILDC65785_000_038: I'm supposed to wait for a little helper, but my brother says it'll just be a normal grown-up in disguise. If I get a present either way, I don't know why that would matter...
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_100_038: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_110_038: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_GUIDE65785_120_038: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_VOLUNTEER65785_000_: Gift giving all taken care of? Very good.
I don't know what we'd do without kind-hearted souls such as you...and our mysterious celebration-funding benefactor.
Even our celebrant, Amh Garanjy, has only met with this philanthropist's agents─never face-to-face.

All I know is that with the costs involved in running this festival, it must be a personage of considerable wealth. A bored merchant-prince─or princess─perhaps? I suppose, in the end, the reasons are less important than the results...
But I detain you overlong with my idle musings. I shall be here handing out tasks the entire festival through, should you be struck by the desire to volunteer once more.
Placed the present in eager little hands, have you? Very good. Feel free to return to me for another task should you be struck by the desire to volunteer once more.
TEXT_FESXMS003_00249_SYSTEM_000_050: You have contributed to the Starlight Celebration in every residential district! Report to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_000_000: Ah! An adventurer! Marvelous! The name's Xavalien, and I scratch the parchment for a little publication called The Raven. Might I enlist your aid in a matter concerning the Starlight Celebration?
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_000_001: ...You are familiar with the festival and its origins, yes? Ishgardian knights rescuing poor orphans from the frozen fingers of winter?
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_100_001: The principal hero of the tale─a snowy-bearded captain─is often referred to as the “Saint of Nymeia,” for it was by his unorthodox order that the wayward waifs were given food and shelter. The compassionate acts of this saint and his soldiers are now honored by an annual tradition, wherein gifts are given to younglings during the coldest days of the year.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_000_002: Which brings us to this year's celebration. As is the custom, the Starlight celebrant and her colleagues have donned scarlet apparel reminiscent of the jackets worn by those charitable knights─the saint's “little helpers,” so to speak. Thus attired, they plan to distribute gifts to every child who writes a letter to Nymeia, patron goddess of celestial wonders.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_000_003: “A fine seasonal piece this shall make!” thought I, and proceeded to publish an article that brought news of this wonderful event to folk across the realm...
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_000_004: ...Since then, however, it appears the celebrant has encountered some unexpected difficulties. Would you be so kind as to offer your assistance to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds so that the festivities might proceed as planned?
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_SYSTEM_110_005: Board a ferry bound for the Lavender Beds by speaking with the skipper at the Mirror Planks in the Central Shroud.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_SYSTEM_000_005: To proceed with the quest “A Starlight Miracle,” you may visit any residential ward within the Lavender Beds.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_XAVALIEN_000_006: Seek out Amh Garanjy within the Lavender Beds, and she will surely welcome your proffered assistance with open arms!
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Yes? Yes, I am Amh Garanjy, the Starlight celebrant. ...Ah, Master Xavalien sent you to me, did he?
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_011: Then pray allow me to explain our dilemma. As you have no doubt heard, our plan for this year's event is to pass out presents to every sweet-cheeked child who composes a letter to Nymeia, be they from a northern land or a southern sea, an east-end city or a west-end town.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_012: An ambitious endeavor, to be certain! Once The Raven printed word of our activities in its publication, however, we were contacted by an anonymous supporter─a generous benefactor who offered to fund the entire celebration, gifts and all.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_013: Originally, our idea was to have the little ones place their messages at the foot of the Starlight sentinel we erected in each city.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_015: Our scarlet-clad helpers would then retrieve the letters, and hand presents to the waiting younglings. Simple.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_016: ...Unfortunately, the wee darlings didn't know which of the seasonal trees in each city was our tree, and now even the decorated boughs found within adventurers' estates have become receptacles for misplaced mail.
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_017: As you might imagine, this has transformed a fairly straightforward task into a ward-wide marathon...
TEXT_FESXMS004_00250_AMHGARANJY_000_019: And as eager as we are to plaster a joyous smile on every child's face, we simply cannot hope to cover so much ground with so few helpers. We are in need of a Starlight miracle...
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_000: You'll be the miracle we need? Oh, thank you, dear adventurer!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_001: With your assistance in gathering the messages scattered across the Lavender Beds, we can be sure that all those adorable letter writers will receive the gifts they were promised.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Rather than send you tramping directly into the gardens of your adventuring fellows, however, I suggest we start you off somewhere close.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_003: The Starlight sentinel we placed here in Yainu-Par recently had a small visitor. Would you be so kind as to check the base of its trunk for messages to Nymeia?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_004: Oh, and do be so good as to dress yourself in “little helper” attire while you go about Starlight business. Maintaining the fantasy is of utmost importance. 'Tis all for the children, you understand.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Your first task will be to retrieve a letter from the Starlight sentinel here in Yainu-Par. Oh, and pray be sure to don your little helper apparel while you work!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDA65787_000_010: Wow, are you really one of the saint's little helpers!? You've come to collect my letter, haven't you!? I waited and waited, but I wasn't sure if anyone would come!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDA65787_000_011: That one there is mine! No other children came to this tree, so I got it all to myself! ...You'll make sure my message is delivered to the goddess, won't you?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDA65787_100_011: Well, I guess I should let you go now. Bye-bye, little helper!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SYSTEM_000_012: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SYSTEM_100_012: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_GUIDE65787_110_012: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_020: Welcome back...er, , is it? Do you have the letter?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_021: Ah, isn't that precious? This young lady has written “Thank you!” in big pink letters, and drawn charming little pictures of flowers and stars. Here, you must be sure she receives her present.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_022: You should find her nearby, eagerly glancing about for the appearance of a little helper. Let's not keep the little darling waiting, shall we?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_023: The wee one who wrote that letter should be waiting nearby. Deliver her gift while wearing your Starlight tunic and see her face light up with happiness!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDB65787_000_030: Oh, there you are! Was my letter good enough for a present!?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDB65787_000_032: ...Huh? What's this? I found someone else's letter...
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDB65787_000_033: Silly helper! You must have wrapped it with my gift by mistake! Here, you better make sure it gets delivered to the goddess!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_CHILDB65787_000_034: Come on, little helper, where are you? ...Maybe my letter wasn't pretty enough!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SYSTEM_100_034: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_SYSTEM_110_034: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_040: Hello again, . Was the child simply transported with joy?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_041: Oh! Oh dear. How did that get in there? We must remember to thank the young lady for bringing this missing message to our attention.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_042: ... Did you happen to glance at the contents of this letter? Listen:
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_043: (-Letter to the Spinner-)There's no such thing as a Starlight miracle! If you, the saint, and the little helpers were real, you'd bring back my father!
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_044: The poor thing. I, too, know the pain of losing a parent...
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_045: Perhaps there is something we can do... Yes, I shall look into it─after all, it would not be a successful Starlight Celebration if we failed to put a smile on every child's face, now, would it?
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_047: Otherwise, I believe you have proven yourself more than qualified to wear the scarlet of a little helper. Your continued assistance would be most appreciated.
TEXT_FESXMS005_00251_AMHGARANJY_000_048: And not just here in the Lavender Beds, either! I am certain my colleagues abroad could also benefit from your aid...assuming you were so inclined?
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_000: What a resplendent spectacle─'tis as if the stars themselves have descended from the heavens to toast the occasion! ...Erm, I mean─pretty, ain't they, these 'Eavensturn decorations? Nothin' like a lantern show to usher in the new year!
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_001: And it ain't just a new year we're usherin' in, neither─it's all change up in the 'eavens and all. Every 'Eavensturn, the Twelve pick out which one of 'em'll be takin' the reins for the comin' year.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_002: Your astrologians have divined─ I mean...I've 'eard mutterin's it's to be Menphina this year─the goddess o' love. An 'ole year o' peace, love, and understandin' 'twixt kinsmen and sweethearts alike... Ain't it a grand time to be alive!?
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_003: But it seems there's some who ain't quite feelin' the love. Every new year there's a gaggle of Easterners─“Easterlings” as we call 'em─what come over to Eorzea to mark the occasion, but it looks like their leader ain't in the 'oliday mood. Proper rainin' on the parade, 'e is.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_004: 'Ark at 'im there, in the middle of the square─mutterin' to 'imself somethin' rotten. Tried talkin' to 'im meself, but 'e waved me away─“no job for a fishwife,” 'e said, the woolly-'eaded prig. Say...yer an adventurer, right? Maybe you'd have better luck gettin' through to 'im.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_005: 'Ow that 'itsuji bugyo plans on usherin' in a year o' love with a miserable kipper like that on 'im, I don't know. Someone needs to cheer the surly bugger up before 'e drags the 'ole year down with 'im!
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYSTEM_000_006: The tender lamb ignores you completely.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: If only they could see...or be made to see─ Hmmm? Do you have some business with me, ? I have important matters to consider. Prithee, leave me to my thoughts.
Oho? Hold a moment, ─you are an adventurer, are you not? Pray forgive me my discourtesy. For a moment, I thought you another prying  come to instruct me to “turn my frown upside down.”

Allow me to introduce myself: I am the hitsuji bugyo. Many malms have I traveled across the seas from my Far Eastern homeland for one purpose: to celebrate the changing of the heavenly guard, and to strengthen ties between this realm and our own. ...Ahem. Two purposes, then.

Mark you the wondrous creature that crowns my helm? It is the sheep─totem beast of my birth year, and of the year to come. Whilst my official role is to herald the arrival of the sheep to its rightful place in the heavens, a greater mission fills my heart: to expand the Fleece Force from the East to Eorzea!

For too long have we sheep been derided as weak-willed softies, lacking in leadership. But no more! For many years now, I have been leading research into breeding sheep for the battlefield, culminating in the masterpiece you see before you: my prototype of fell fluffiness─the tender lamb!

Just imagine─armies of warsheep like these may one day patrol your borders, strengthening not only the realm's defenses, but also the bonds of brotherhood between your people and mine! Alas, it has proven a struggle to win local support for my vision...

Full many gather to admire my fleecy helm, but my words of war and warning fall upon deaf ears. “So cute!” they say, as I speak of my companion's mighty enchantments. “So fluffy!” they cry, as I boast of its potential for quelling riotous peasantry.

People are wont to be suspicious of the unfamiliar, and perhaps my foreignness renders them disinclined to consider the lamb's potential. But if an upstanding local such as yourself were to lend us your aid...! I beg you, ─join us, and help us spread word of the Fleece Force across the land!
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_Q1_: Will you join the Fleece Force?
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Y-You will!? Oh, how my heartstrings sing! You have made an old bugyo very happy, . But we have no time to waste on sentiment─allow me to introduce you to the lynchpin of the Fleece Force project: the tender lamb.
You would see Eorzea shorn of her defenses and naked before her enemies? Will you not reconsider? The fate of the realm may well rest upon irresistibly fluffy fleece!

Our sheepmasters have developed several varieties of ovine armament─some imbued with envenomous magicks, others that can muffle the tongue. But this is our most advanced weapon yet: a sheep with the ability to put its prey to sleep.

Do not be fooled by its button nose and fluffy coat, for by this dainty display does it ensnare its foes! Thereby lulled into a false sense of security, the lamb unleashes its hypnoturgical blast, felling enemies where they stand.

In my opinion, it is this soporific branch of the Fleece Force that has the widest potential for civilian and military applications alike. However, there remains one small problem with the hypnoturgical blast─it doesn't work.

Not in the manner intended, at any rate. My plan for the Fleece Force has it that the sheep's abilities should be triggered by the aggressive energies of their commanding officer, or sheepwielder, upon encountering an enemy force.

But in practice, the opposite applies: the hypnoturgical blast will not fire in response to a sheepwielder's aggression, but only to  exuberance. To wit, whenever its master attempts to cheer an ally along, the sheep will respond by putting said ally to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: If this problem is not rooted out, the entire project could be doomed to failure. And so, , as you travel abroad, spreading word of the Fleece Force, I would also ask that you investigate why this lamb refuses to answer to aggression.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000:
But enough talk─go, sheepwielder! Journey to the many corners of this realm, proclaiming the arrival of the Fleece─
...She's been completely ignoring you all this time, hasn't she?
Hmmm... If she refuses to recognize you as her master, you will not be able to call upon her hypnoturgical blast. A fine advertisement for the Fleece Force that would be...

We must do something to strengthen your bonds... Aha─I have it! There is a man in Hawkers' Alley─a trader by the name of Engerrand. I recently ordered some special fodder for our friend here through him: a special blend of herbs and grasses to nurture her magical abilities.
They say the best way to a sheep's heart is through its belly. If you were to present her with such a tasty treat, perchance she would warm to you a little.

Engerrand runs a tradecraft supply stall in Hawkers' Alley─it was through him that I ordered the feed. It should be ready for collection by now. Do not dally, sheepwielder─deprive her of treats for too long, and you risk arousing more wrath than respect.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_ENGERRAND_000_050: Yer the one who ordered this bowl o' twigs, are ye? Whatever floats yer boat, ─I'll be stickin' to the ol' meat and two veg, thank you very much!
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Did you collect the fodder from Engerrand? Excellent. Prithee feed the lamb from your own hands. In so doing, she will come to look upon you as a .
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYSTEM_000_061: The tender lamb ignores you completely.
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Oho! The plan worked! A free meal was enough to earn the lamb's loyalty. To be sure, this trusting nature is a weakness...but for now, all is ready! Your bond with the lamb is secure, and she should now respond to your cheers.

A sheepwielder's path is long and stony, , but I am convinced that your footing is sure. And so, it will be my honor to place the tender lamb under your wing. With the two of you working hand in hoof, the Fleece Force cannot help but flourish!
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_000_070: You always did have a liberal tongue, bugyo─that adventurer merely had to unbutton your lip, and the words spilled out like water. Warsheep indeed...
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SYOJO_100_070: So you yet contrive to put that senseless project of yours into action? On my honor, you shall answer for this folly!
TEXT_FESNYR101_00252_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: I have already dispatched my subordinates to the three city-states of Eorzea, where they strive tirelessly to spread the word, and the reputation, of the Fleece Force. If you would be so kind, I would have you assist them in their efforts.

To solemnify your admittance to our fellowship, it will be my honor to present you with a kabuto just like my own, crowned with the living image of the noble sheep. Wear this, and my comrades will know you for a friend.

Should some disaster befall you, and the helm is lost or destroyed, never fear! The hitsuji shonin have laid many more in stock for those who assist us. I shall inform them that you are a friend of the flock. And so, the time for talking is done...let us put this plan into action!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO_000_000: , . A little bird told me yer workin' fer the bugyo. ...What do I know about it? Hee hee! That's my little secret!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: It is my mission─nay, my destiny!─to make our plans for the Fleece Force a reality. My trusted yoriki are already working to this end in the cities three, with orders to reward any Eorzean who assists them in their duties with a ceremonial helm.

If any man, woman, or child should prove their devotion to the cause by earning all three helms, my appreciation would know no bounds. I believe you have what it takes, . I pray you, help to make my dream a reality─if not for me, then for the future of Eorzea!
I await your triumphant return, . Though the victory of the Fleece Force is its own reward, rest assured that should you return to me with the three kabuto, it shall not be your only reward...

, you have returned! My yoriki have already sent word of your achievements. How my heart swelled to hear of your triumph over the passions of youth in Aleport! Your services to commerce in the Black Shroud! Your dominion over the Brass Blades in Thanalan!

Oh, but I am getting ahead of myself. I am old enough to know that words are but wind, no matter how balmy the breeze. Prithee, ─if you have rightly earned the white, crimson, and black kabuto, permit me to examine them, and confirm the truth of these tales!

These are indeed my yoriki's helms... Then their reports were true! My eternal thanks, . You have worked wonders in the service of sheep. Why, thanks to you, the creatures have become the talk of the town!

However, this talk is not quite what I intended. On every corner, the great unwashed discuss how the sheep is cute, how the sheep is clever, how if one recites “tender lamb” three times in a glass, one's wishes will come true... But naught have I overheard of the mighty Fleece Force.
Tell me, ─why do they shun the hypnoturgical blast so? Why do they insist on confining their sheep to the fold, instead of unleashing them onto the battlefield?
Was my plan flawed from the start...? No, no, it cannot be... The only flaw is in their understanding. Their eyes are closed to the sheep's true potential!
Forgive me, , but I have one last favor to ask of you: could you speak with the people of Limsa Lominsa on my behalf, and assess why they refuse to believe in the sheep's worth as a weapon?
Why can these people not see what the sheep has to offer to their defenses? I pray you, ─speak with them, and discover why they spurn the lamb so.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_GINNADE_000_030: ...You wish to speak with me about sheep? Ah, yes, I have heard the rumors─a little lamb wandering from town to town, helping those in need. A most edifying tale, I'm sure.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_GINNADE_100_030: But using sheep as weapons? Don't make me laugh. We have plenty of the things milling around outside the Zephyr Gate already, and they've hardly been striking the fear of death into the local beasties. Besides, using something so fluffy as a weapon of war... I'd just feel too sorry for them.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO_000_032: Sending sheep into battle? Hmph. I see the bugyo insists on beating his ignominious little drum.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO_000_033: Ah─I mean, erm... I don't know nothin' 'bout fightin', , but I don't reckon I'd 'ave it in me to send a cute little blighter like that into battle. Just thinkin' o' them wee darlin's up against soldiers, an' monsters, an' what-'ave-ye... Brings a lump to me throat, it does.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SWOZBLAET_000_031: I always thought the sheep a doltish creature, its mind as woolly as its coat. These recent tales of its quick wits have quite confounded my prejudices. But a sheep as a soldier? Hah! I've never heard the like. The poor little things wouldn't survive for a single shake of their own tails!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO_000_034: You shall pay for this temerity, bugyo... Ah, erm─sorry, . I was just sayin' 'ow them sheep're just so fluffy, it'd break me 'eart to see 'em forced into fightin'...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYSTEM_000_038: The tender lamb looks at you...tenderly.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: A thousand welcomes on your safe return, . I am sure our comrade here bids you the same. So tell me─what was the public's reaction to sending sheep into battle?

They would feel sorry for them!? Gladly do they sup on their flesh, yet they quail at joining forces with them out of pity? Agh, these fools leave me no choice... It is time I brought together the full might of the Fleece Force, and showed these boneless milksops the true power of the sheep!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_041: (-???-)You shall do no such thing, hitsuji bugyo!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: What in the─? What are you doing here!?
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_043: (-Merry Maid?-)You are undone, bugyo! I am here to put an end to your barbarous plots!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_044: I thank you for your unwitting assistance, adventurer. I am the hitsuji ometsuke. It is my dishonor to be the commanding officer of this most scurrilous of bugyos. Though you thought me the merry maid of Limsa Lominsa, 'twas but a clandestine facade for my surveillances.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_100_044: He told you he plans to expand the Fleece Force from the East to Eorzea? An opprobrious lie! His perverse project has been banned in our homeland. I feared he might recommence his research in Eorzea, but it was only by your assistance that I was able to gain the proof I needed.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_045: You have put a prohibited plan into practice. You have experimented on innocent animals, in breach of every national and natural law. You have used your position as an envoy to promote your own sorry schemes. You... You... You fool!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: And I would've gotten away with it, too, if it wasn't for your meddling! The Fleece Force is my dream, and I will not allow it to be crushed! Not by you─not by anyone!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: Do not think I shall go gently, ometsuke! You may be my commanding officer, but I am the master of my destiny. And, lest you forget, I am also the master of the tender lamb! Let's see if a little show of force won't change your mind. Lamb─a hypnoturgical blast, if you please!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: What!? No, not me, you...! Uhhh...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_048: Hoist with his own petard... Ah! Adventurer─the lamb!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_049: She has collapsed in turn... But why? We must wake the bugyo─he may be a fool, but none understand sheep better than he. Hold on, dear lamb! Help is coming!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Ohhh, my head... The hypnoturgical blast is a powerful weapon indeed...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: ...But this is unprecedented! Why would the lamb use her magic without receiving a direct order? She has never acted alone before...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Ah... And it seems she has paid the price for doing so. Her blast requires great energies─both in its execution and its activation. The latter must be provided by the sheepwielder's exhortations. In activating the spell without the proper mandate, she has all but exhausted her life force.

Only by replenishing her vital energies may she recover, but that may be more easily said than done. For the spiritual energy of one being to flow to another, their hearts must needs be in perfect accord...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_053: Adventurer─your bond with the lamb is the deepest. I pray you, do whatever you must to save the poor creature's life.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_054: The tender lamb has tirelessly instilled cheer in the hearts of Eorzeans, asking nothing in return. It is past time that the favor is returned!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_055: She used her powers to save us... Now it is our turn to save her. Prithee, adventurer─cheer for her, and lend her your strength!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: The tender lamb was not designed to activate her powers independently─her life force barely suffices to power the blast itself, let alone its activation. Such energy is provided by her sheepwielder's cheers, but I fear she is too far gone to be roused by a mere cheer now...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYSTEM_000_059: The tender lamb is fading fast.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_070: Now is not the time for idle merriment, adventurer. Cheer for the lamb with all your heart, before it is too late!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_072: It worked! Your fervent cheering has brought her back from the brink! But it is still not enough... Speak with her, adventurer─give voice to your passion, and arouse her ailing heart!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYSTEM_000_073: With the chat mode in Say, enter “Don't give up!” to revitalize the tender lamb.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_074: Your cheers staved off the darkness, adventurer, but she is still so weak... Tell her she must not give up! We believe in her!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYSTEM_100_059: The tender lamb looks up at you with bleary eyes.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYSTEM_000_101: The tender lamb pricks up her ears, and trembles all over.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_102: Is it still not enough? No...there must still be a way. We must not lose faith. ...Why, that is it! You must show her the faith you have in her! I beg you, adventurer─clear your mind of all but the lamb, and pray for her with all your heart!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_103: Your words had some effect, adventurer, but actions speak louder. Prithee, pray for her with all your heart, and prove your devotion!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: She clings on to life with every onze of her being. Never have I seen such a tenacious will to survive.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYSTEM_101_059: The tender lamb's breathing is labored, and she struggles to stand.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_110: Come, adventurer─only you can save her! You must pray for her recovery!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: It is no good... She is beyond help...
What in the─!? I can scarce believe my eyes! This is a miracle!
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_114: A miraculous recovery indeed. But one that was never in doubt, to those sensible to the bond of trust between this  lamb.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_115: ...A bond that was forged as they journeyed this land together, bringing peace to troubled souls, and tempered by the love they came to share as comrades, allies, and friends.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: What hogwash! If the lamb's recovery can be explained, it will be in terms of the transfer of aetherial energies, not woolly words of “love” and “peace.”
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_116: Tell me, bugyo─why do you think I gave you charge of this year's Heavensturn celebrations? It is because I know that there is none who loves the sheep more than you. But in your passion to prove their military worth, you hardened your heart to your true feelings.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_117: The totem of the coming year is the sheep, but its patron deity is Menphina─the goddess of love and tenderness. I wished to have you reflect upon your love for sheep, and not your plans for them.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Love...and tenderness? I...I had not even considered such things. So this is why my plans came to naught... If there is no place in the Fleece Force for friendship, it is small wonder that the tender lamb took me for an enemy...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: Is this why she would respond only to encouragement, and not hostility? Did she, too, wish to show me the error of my ways?
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_101: What a fool I have been...
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: ─if I may still call you that─would you do this fool a great honor, and take charge of this lamb, for once and for all? I have done too much damage already to inflict myself upon her any longer.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: I fear her recent exertion may have divested her of her powers, but that is not the reason why I press her into your arms. I believe she would be...happier...by your side than by mine.
TEXT_FESNYR102_00287_SYOJO00287_000_120: A new year, and a new friend... It seems your astrologians were correct, adventurer─the goddess of love is truly smiling down on you.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Our plans are in motion, . Already I have a man on the ground in Gridania, trumpeting the Fleece Force from the very treetops.
But four lungs are better than two. Go to him, and lend your voice to his. Oh, and prithee wear the hitsuji kabuto I gave you, so he will recognize you as an ally.
I have sent the prototype lamb on ahead to my yoriki's charge. Follow her to Gridania, comrade, and show those forest dwellers the true power of the sheep!
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: ...And what is this? You already have charge of the tender lamb, and yet you come to take on further duties? Ah, your commitment to the cause brings a lump to my throat! Away to Gridania, ! You don't want to see an old bugyo cry!
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_GOLDENSHEEPYORIKI_0: Hmmm... Could you be the one who...? No, perhaps not. Pray forgive me, , I mistook you for another. You match the description of the  I await in every aspect but one─your choice of headgear.
I would recognize that kabuto anywhere! Then you are the stalwart ally the bugyo sent word of? Your arrival is most welcome, my good , and timely to boot.

On a recent tour of the forest, I chanced upon a traveling merchant who has been waylaid by affliction of the horsebird. A sudden bout of some ague or other has plunged her chocobo into an existential torpor. For days now the bird has neither slept nor eaten, and is fair wasting away.

All very tragic, I'm sure...but with great hardship comes great opportunity! Just imagine how the fame of the Fleece Force would carry were a traveling trader to sing its praises from mart to market across the land!

And what is more, the hypnoturgical blast has only been tested on men and monsters thus far. This is the perfect chance to see if it affects these horsebirds of yours with equal efficacy. Valuable information were the Fleece Force to encounter a mounted army, I'm sure you'll agree.

But I digress... Take the tender lamb to Bentbranch Meadows, , and speak with the trader there. Should you succeed in putting her ailing bird to rest, and restoring its spirits, the Force's reputation shall surely rise above the highest pine in the Twelveswood!
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_025: During this quest, the tender lamb will accompany you as a minion.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_026: However, if you summon another minion or companion, or log out of the game, the tender lamb will leave your side and return to the golden hitsuji yoriki.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_100_026: In order to progress in the quest, the tender lamb must remain summoned.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_027: Should the tender lamb leave your side, it can be retrieved by speaking with the golden hitsuji yoriki once more.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_100_027: During this quest, the tender lamb will accompany you as a minion.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_110_027: However, if you summon another minion, or log out of the game, the tender lamb will leave your side and return to the golden hitsuji yoriki.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_120_027: It will also be dismissed if you leave the city while a companion is summoned. Please withdraw your companion in order to proceed with the quest.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_130_027: Should the tender lamb leave your side, it can be retrieved by speaking with the golden hitsuji yoriki once more.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_GOLDENSHEEPYORIKI_0: My stalwart ally! Tell me, what befell? The tender lamb returned to me alone, bleating in sorrow. Have you come to collect her?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_100_028: The tender lamb will be dismissed if you leave the city while a companion is summoned. Please withdraw your companion in order to proceed with the quest.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_Q1_000_001: Take charge of the tender lamb?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_GOLDENSHEEPYORIKI_0: In this unassuming ball of wool lies the hope of our order. Her hypnoturgical blast shall open the eyes of Eorzea to the possibilities of the Fleece Force! To Bentbranch Meadows, , and the glorious future!

Prithee do not dally, ─should the merchant move on, or the horsebird recover, this opportunity will be forever lost. If the Fleece Force is to gain a hoofhold in Gridania, this chance must not be missed!

When last I saw it, the restive chocobo had drawn up in Bentbranch Meadows, and was refusing to move. Most vexing for a traveling merchant, wouldn't you agree? Go to her, , and offer the lamb's soporific services.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_041: Sorry, , I ain't here to trade. S'posed to be heading to Gridania, but me chocobo's in a right funk. The breeders 'round here can't make beak nor brush of it. Well...there was that one feller─seemed to think a magical sheep'd sort her out. Wonder what the chocobokeeps'd make of him...
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_042: What a lovely little lamb ye've got there... Hey, hold on─ye ain't the “stalwart ally” that madman in the woolly hat was going on about, are ye? Ye really think ye can help me chocobo out?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_043: Gods bless ye, ! I was this close to giving up hope altogether. Ye see, ever since we got here, poor ol' Betsy here's been acting odd. One minute she was up, the next she was down...and she's been down ever since.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_044: What worries me most is that she only seems to be getting lower. She's right off her food, she can't get any sleep, and her pitiful whimpering's enough to break yer heart. If she could just get some rest, it might give her a bit of energy back, but...
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_045: Yer sheep's got magical powers? Ye just need to cheer for me chocobo and she'll make her fall asleep? Pah! Yer as mad as yer friend. Still, I s'pose beggars can't be choosers... It can't hurt to try.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_046: Ye need to get some rest, don't ye, girl? Don't ye worry─the nice little sheepy here's going to help ye get off to sleepy-byes. Yer a good little girl! A lovely little─ ...Hm?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_047: The tender lamb is staring intently at something outside the gates.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_048: Seems like yer lamb's more interested in something out there than she is in helping me chocobo... Unless whatever she's spotted has got something to do with all this? Go and have a look, will ye? I'll stay here with me Betsy.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_060: Yes, yes─it was somewhere around there. Maybe a bit to the left... No, the other left... Ah, it's no use. That lamb of yers was the one that spotted it, whatever it is. Where'd she go, anyway?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_400_001: You find the tailfeather of a chocobo pressed into the ground.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_070: What happened to yer sheep? Bring her back, will ye? Betsy seemed a little more relaxed with her around.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_100_070: So, did ye find anything? If it'll help calm Betsy down, I'll take it!
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_071: What's this...? A chocobo feather? Oh, yes, very well done─ye've found a chocobo feather just outside a chocobo ranch. I'm sure this must be a clue of the utmost impor─ ...Huh?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_072: Why're ye so interested in this feather, Betsy? She looks so sad...and yet somehow, soothed... , if ye ain't lying about yer sheep, then please, use yer magic now. It might stand a better chance while she ain't so restless.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_500_001: The feather seems to have calmed the chocobo down a little. Cheer for her to activate the hypnoturgical blast.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_073: Whatever that feather was all about, we can look into later. What Betsy needs now is sleep. If that lamb of yers can really do what ye say, now's the time for it, before she gets all skittish again.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_500_002: The feather seems to have a calming effect on Betsy. Cheer for her to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put her to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_080: Now's the time for that lamb of yers to do her thing! ...Hey, wait─where's she gone? Please, , I'm tired. Don't start messing me about.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_100_080: Eh? I thought ye said ye had to cheer for her to get yer lamb to do its thing? That didn't look like no cheer to me.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_081: Thank goodness... She's finally asleep. I don't know how ye did it, , but I can't thank ye enough. And yer little sheep, too...
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_082: But I still don't get this business with the feather. Maybe Keitha would have a better idea─she's the head wrangler 'round these parts. Why don't ye go and ask her about it?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_083: Keitha's the chocobo expert 'round here, but even she couldn't work out what was winding Betsy up. It's something to do with that feather, I'm sure. Take it to her, will ye? It might just jog her memory...
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_KEITHA_000_090: Sorry, ─if you've got business with me it'll have to wait till later. Ranchers say they've seen a lamb on the loose inside the meadow gates. If a scurryin' furball like that gets into the stables, the birds'll go mad!
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_KEITHA_000_091: Eh? You think that chocobo's problems've got something to do with a feather? Give us a look at it. Hmmm... Looks like it's from the bird I sold to that scattergood who paid us a visit the other day. Wanted to buy the whole ranch, he did─we talked him down to just one chocobo.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_KEITHA_000_092: Ahhh, so that's what this is about! That chocobo was an old clutchmate of the merchant's bird. We asked the feller to wait a few days so they could have their little reunion, but he had some business to the south that couldn't keep, and he wouldn't take no for an answer.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_KEITHA_000_093: The poor bird must've smelled her mate's scent by the gates, and then not bein' able to find him... Perhaps she thought the worst had happened. Chocobos form bonds like us, but I've never seen a bond this strong. Nay, not in all my years workin' with the creatures.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_KEITHA_000_094: I never realized she'd take it so hard... Pass along my apologies to the trader, will ye? We tried our best to keep hold of her bird's friend, but the fact is we can't run the place without coin.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_100: Did ye find anything out about the chocobo feather? But wait...ye've lost yer lamb! I couldn't live with meself if anything happened to her, after all she's done for Betsy. Please, , will ye find her and make sure she's safe?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_101: Did Keitha tell ye anything? ...Ah, I see. Aye, I know the chocobo she means. S'pose ye could say him and Betsy were chick-hood sweethearts. Betsy was born and raised here in Bentbranch Meadows─she must've been looking forward to stopping here ever since we set out from Thanalan.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_102: But when she got here, her friend was gone, eh? Small wonder she was all shook up. ...Alright, girl, we're turning back. The markets can wait─when Betsy wakes up, we're going after that bird!
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_100_102: Keitha said they've only been gone a day or so, right? I'm sure we'll be able to catch them if we put our minds to it. I might lose out on a bit of coin, but if it brings the twinkle back to Betsy's eyes, it'll be worth it.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_103: Thank ye, , for everything. Without yer help, me darling Betsy might've wasted away before me eyes. Oh...and will ye thank that friend of yers for me, too? Tell him I'm sorry for calling him a madman, and saying his hat was stupid.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_104: But most of all, I thank that little lamb of yers. She's a keen-eyed little bugger, and that magic...well, I've never seen anything quite like it. You and her make a great team.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_105: The tender lamb looks at you with pride.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_106: By working together to soothe the restive chocobo, you and the tender lamb have grown a little closer.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_107: Your joint effort to ease another troubled soul has brought you and the tender lamb even closer together.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_SYSTEM_000_108: With a third successful mollification, you and the tender lamb have become fast friends.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_BREEDER_000_109: I never thought that little lamb of yers'd ever be able to calm Betsy down, the state she was in. Thank ye, me dears. And thank that friend of yers in the woolly hat for me too, will ye?
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_GOLDENSHEEPYORIKI_0: What ho, my stalwart ally! How fare you in your quest? Is the Twelveswood abuzz with word of the Fleece Force?

What ho, my stalwart ally! Your tender lamb returned to me not a moment ago, wagging her tail behind her. Does this mean you have completed your quest? Is the Twelveswood abuzz with word of the Fleece Force?
I see... So the hypnoturgical blast does work against chocobos. A welcome development indeed! I shall be sure to underline that fact in my report.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_GOLDENSHEEPYORIKI_1: Although it is unfortunate that the trader will not be calling on Gridania. The combination of a loud-mouthed merchant and a busy marketplace seemed the perfect grist for the rumor mill.
TEXT_FESNYR103_00289_GOLDENSHEEPYORIKI_0: But no matter. The trader was impressed, was she not? No doubt she will sing of sheep to all and sundry along her travels. Mayhap we shall even find a benefactor in this affluent fellow she plans to trail. As such, I judge your mission a roaring success!
Please allow me to present you with a replica of my own helm, a snow white hitsuji kabuto, as a token of my appreciation. By this, the bugyo will know that you have done great deeds this day.

Heavens forfend it, but if by some unhappy twist of fate the kabuto should become lost or damaged, rest assured the hitsuji shonin will know you for a friend, and permit you to purchase a replacement. When you have all three helms, report to the bugyo─I am sure he will reward you for your efforts.
Well then, all that remains for me is to return the prototype lamb to my master. You have proved yourself a true ally to our cause this day, . May the Fleece Force be with you!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Alas, the Heavensturn formalities keep me from devoting myself to my true mission. But fear not, ─I have a trusty familiar working on my behalf right here in Limsa Lominsa.

In fact, there he is over there─the fellow in the crimson cuirass. An able man, but provincial. He is like to give short shrift to an Eorzean like your good self, unless you prove your allegiance to the Fleece Force. The kabuto I gave you should assure him of your good intentions.
I have already deposited the tender lamb in his care. With the three of you working together, we shall surely soon see a squad of sheep in each and every La Noscean port!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: That is, if the lamb fails to convince him. But I am convinced, ! To see my prototype patrolling the streets at the heels of an Eorzean sheepwielder─'tis as if my vision has become reality!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_00: Yes, I saw you speaking with my master. And no, I do not trust you. If you are as true a comrade as you claim, then where is the kabuto he gave you? Don it now, or begone.

That kabuto looks authentic, but... No, no, it must be! Forgive my suspicion, comrade─this city is not kind to strangers. Why, only , I had an unfortunate experience in the lower decks. I had merely stopped to ask a comely maid for directions, when all at once a hand darted into my hip pocket, and...

A-Ahem! But I shan't burden you with my personal troubles. To business! I have scoured this land for the perfect opportunity to demonstrate the power of the tender lamb, and I believe I have it: in Aleport, there is a baby...and the baby is crying!

What of it, you ask? If it is a baby's job to cry, then this particular child puts the most industrious docker to shame. The floodgates opened several days ago, and nothing has succeeded in drawing them to a close. Its constant wailing has denied so much as a wink of sleep to mother and baby both.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_10: This is our chance, comrade! The lady in question is the wife of a fisherman, and you know how fishwives are wont to gossip. If the lamb succeeds in calming the child where all else has failed, the Fleece Force will be heralded across the isle!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_00: Unfortunately, that if may be a sizable one... Our initial trials suggested that the hypnoturgical blast may be less effective against smaller quarry. I have full confidence that our sheepmasters will remedy this issue in time, but be aware that, should the blast fail, you may have to improvise.

However you achieve it, the Fleece Force must be seen to play a vital role in silencing the child. To begin, take the tender lamb to Aleport, and offer its services to the baby's mother. Should you succeed today, comrade, this infant may grow to be the sheepwielder of tomorrow!

TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_00: Missing something, comrade? Fear not, I have the tender lamb right here. Do try not to misplace her next time.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_100_030: The tender lamb will be dismissed if you leave the city while a companion is summoned. Please withdraw your companion in order to proceed with the quest.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_Q1_000_001: Take charge of the tender lamb?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_00: Godsspeed, comrade. Let the mothers of La Noscea know the power of the Fleece Force!
They say that babies are the children of the wind, comrade─their only constant is change. If its screeching should cease before the lamb can cast its spell, our chance for glory will be lost.
There is no time to lose, comrade. The longer the baby cries, the harder it may be to soothe. Take the tender lamb to Aleport, and put this problem to bed!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SAILOR_000_040: I was out at sea when me little girl was born. Sailed back special to see 'er. But the moment she gets a glimpse of this ol' mug o' mine, she starts screamin' 'er 'ead off. I know I ain't pretty, but I never reckoned meself that ugly neither...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_041: My baby won't stop crying... Why won't she stop crying? There was a gent here before who said something about a magical sheep... Or was it a sheep talking about a magical man...? Oh, why won't she stop crying!?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_042: Another sheep? I've never seen so many in town before. First the one on that strange man's helmet, and now... Wait a moment─you're not the  he was talking about, are you? Please, you have to help me!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_043: You see, my husband just returned from a long sea voyage. He was so looking forward to seeing his newborn daughter for the first time, but when she saw his face she burst out crying, and I just can't seem to make her stop... Oh, why did I marry such an ugly man!?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_100_043: She never cried like this before... I just don't know what to do. The man in the helmet said you could help─that you could stop her crying. Can you really stop her crying!?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_044: ...Your sheep can make her sleep? Well, she can't rightly cry in her sleep! ...Oh gods─she can't, can she!? Please, just do what you can... If this lasts any longer, my heart shall break!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_400_001: The baby is crying loudly. Cheer for her to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put her to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_045: She's been crying for days, now. I've tried everything, but she just won't stop. I beg of you─whatever it is you mean to do, please do it now! I can't bear to see her like this...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_400_002: The baby is crying loudly. Cheer for her to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put her to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_050: Please, I─　Wait...where's your lamb gone? But I thought she was the one who could─　...Oh gods! My poor baby's never going to stop crying, is she!?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_100_050: Was that it? B-But...your lamb didn't even move! Are you sure you know what you're doing?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_101_050:
(-Suckling Babe-)Blub... Burble... Wuh... Wah...
WAAAAAAAAAH! WAAAAAAAAAH!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_000_051: The hypnoturgical blast has some effect, but fails to put the baby to sleep. It serves only to make the baby more tired, and increasingly upset.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_052: Wh-What have you done? You've just made it worse! I can't cope with all this! I─I just... Wh-Why won't she...? Why can't I...? Wh-Why is your lamb looking at me like that!?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_000_053: The tender lamb is staring intently at the baby's mother.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_054: Why was your lamb looking at me like that? It's my baby who needs your help, not me! She needs to sleep! Why won't you help her sleep!?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_500_001: The tender lamb seems more interested in the mother than her baby. Cheer for the stalwart saltwife to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put her to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_060: Where has that lamb of yours disappeared to? My poor little baby's crying even harder than she was before! I beg of you─call her back, and try that magic again. It's my only hope...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_100_060: Please, stop messing about! First your lamb stares at me, and now you're doing strange things! If that sheep of yours can really make my baby sleep, then I beg you, make her do it. I...I...I can't cope with this!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_600_001: The tender lamb seems more interested in the mother than her baby. Cheer for the stalwart saltwife to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put her to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_061: Ah! What did you...? O-Oh... I feel so...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_062: So calm, and sleepy... I can't remember the last time I felt so relaxed. ...B-But, I can't sleep now! My baby, she─ Ah!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_063: She... She's stopped crying. But why...? Your lamb used her magic on me, not her...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_064: Ahhh, I see... So it wasn't my husband's face that was upsetting her, after all─it was me. She had never screamed so hard before... I was so worried about her. My worries must have been fueling her tears, which only made me more worried, and her more upset...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_065: I just needed to calm down...didn't I, my darling? I got so wound up worrying about you, when all the while you were worrying about me. But it's all right now, all thanks to this little lamb.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_066: What a clever little thing you are. You saw that I was the one who needed calming when no one else did. Why, if I didn't have my hands full, I'd cuddle you rotten!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_067: But...<yawn>...that will have to wait till . It's high time we were snuggled up in bed. Thank you─both of you─for everything. And thank your friend in red for me, too. Oh, and...if you get the chance...tell my husband he's not so bad, really. Not so bad at all.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_000_068: The tender lamb looks at you cheerfully.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_000_069: By working together to calm the crying baby and her fraught mother, you and the tender lamb have become closer.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_000_070: Your joint effort to ease another pair of troubled souls has brought you and the tender lamb even closer together.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SYSTEM_000_071: With a third successful mollification, you and the tender lamb have become fast friends.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_MOTHER_000_073: She's fast asleep... Isn't she just adorable? I really can't thank you enough for all you've done for us. Oh, and thank your friend in red for me, too, would you? In the meantime, I think I'll join her in taking a well-earned snooze.
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_SAILOR_000_074: Thank you, ─from the bottom of me 'eart. I just don't know 'ow I can show me face again, after all the damage it's done. ...What, she really said that? <sob> Oh, me darlin' girls─I'll never leave the two of ye alone again!
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_00: Welcome back, comrade! So, how fared your mission? Did that baby succumb to the might of the Fleece Force?
Welcome back, comrade! The tender lamb has already returned to me, with a grin on its face. I have never seen a lamb grin before. Does this mean the plan worked?
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_10: I see. Then it is as we thought─the effect was weak against a crying infant... Is it simply a question of size? Of age? Of emotional state? Hmmm... This matter must needs be researched further, before we embark on the production phase...
TEXT_FESNYR104_00290_BLACKSHEEPYORIKI_00: And you say the gossiping will have to wait until the mother and child get a good night's sleep? Why, the lazy─! Ahem. Better late than never, as they say. Let the saltwife rest her voice, so that it might sing the Fleece Force's praises all the louder!

In honor of your success, this crimson kabuto is yours. Should you misplace it, fear not─I shall send word of your achievements to my comrades, the hitsuji shonin. They will gladly issue a replacement to a  such as yourself.
But for now, I do believe your work here is done. Have you already assisted our comrades in Ul'dah and Gridania? I have no doubt that with your help, the bugyo's plans for Eorzea are sure to succeed.
Allow me to return the tender lamb to him. You have done much for us this day─it is only fair that I should do something for you.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_ROGER_000_1: Word is, Black Brush Station's sorely undermanned. The Stone Torches there can't get a moment's peace.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_ROGER_000_2: It don't help none that the antlings've been multiplyin' like it's nobody's business. For every critter Warin an' his crew put down, two more o' the buggers spawn in its place.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_ROGER_000_3: I was thinkin', mayhap ye can make yerself useful at the station by cullin' some antlings. I don't doubt Warin would appreciate the help.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_ROGER_000_4: An' if ye win his trust, he's like to have more work for ye. Mind ye, ye'll need to show the man proof o' yer deeds. Five or so antling mandibles ought to do the talkin' for ye.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_WARIN_000_10: What? You say you put down some antlings? You are scarce the first to come here and make that claim, hoping to earn quick coin. Unless you have proof of this feat, you'll not see a single gil from me.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_WARIN_000_11: Thal's balls...are those antling mandibles!? Then it's true─you really culled the beasts! I apologize for doubting your words.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_WARIN_000_12: With Ul'dah nearby, you'd think we were out of harm's way. Truth is, the antlings have been more active than ever. We can never have too many able-bodied adventurers to help preserve the peace in the area.
TEXT_SUBWIL062_00305_WARIN_000_13: If you would lend us your aid, I should gladly assign you a task. Gods know we have no shortage of them here.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_1: We Stone Torches are sellswords hired by Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern to protect its interests. Our primary duty here is to keep the tracks clear of pests, and it is for this purpose that we require your aid.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_2: You have proven that you have some skill at arms, but before I send you into the midst of fell fiends, I would inspect your gear.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_3: A single piece of gear can mean the difference between life and death. I'll not have it on my conscience that I sent an ill-equipped adventurer to an untimely demise.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_4: See to it that your arms and armor are in order. When you are ready, present yourself to me again.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_SYSTEM_000_5: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or above before returning to speak with Warin.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_10: So you are ready for inspection?
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_12: Yet know that naught is guaranteed in this world. Fate is a fickle mistress, after all. At any rate, capable adventurers like you are few and far between, and I would not have you throw your life away.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_13: I have had to bury too many comrades who brushed aside cracks in their hauberks and dints in their helms. No matter what you face, do not disregard the importance of gear.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_WARIN_000_14: By the gods, ! However in the seven hells did you survive the antlings equipped as poorly as you are? I cannot in good conscience send you to face savage beasts until your gear is in order.
TEXT_SUBWIL063_00306_SYSTEM_000_15: Equip your head, body, hands, legs, and feet with gear of item level 5 or above before returning to speak with Warin.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SHEEPMISSIONARY_000: Perhaps you imagine that the scorching sands of Thanalan are no place to be wearing a woolly coat? But no, ! The lamb's white fleece reflects the sun's rays, keeping it cool even in the burning desert. I have a man in Ul'dah explaining as much to the local forces.

Unfortunately, the froward fellow insists on wearing his black kabuto. He always has been a hot-headed type, but I fear the heat may exhaust him before his efforts do. Prithee, ─go to him, and assist him in promoting the Fleece Force before his blood boils over.
I shall dispatch the tender lamb to his keeping. Oh, and when you meet with him, do wear the hitsuji kabuto I gave you. It would not do for both of you to succumb to the heat.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SHEEPMISSIONARY_100: You already have charge of the tender lamb? Then all is ready. To Ul'dah, adventurer! Oh, and do remember to wear the hitsuji kabuto I gave you. It would not do for both of you to succumb to the heat.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_000_: A happy Heavensturn, my friend! ...Hm? You say the bugyo sent you? No, no, there must be some mistake. He told me the  I wait for would be wearing a hitsuji kabuto.
Oho! The ! The bugyo told me of your coming. And it is not a moment too soon! Tell me, friend: do you know of the Brass Blades?

They are an elite military force here in Thanalan─men and women, strong and true, who protect the people against beasts, and thieves, and other Brass Blades... But what is a military force without sheep, you ask? I have asked the same question. To the Blades. Directly.

Indeed, I have only this moment returned from the desert, where in a hostelry of sorts─the Coffer & Coffin, I believe it was called─I came upon a band of Blades who were drinking heavily, and acting in a most scandalous manner. Sadly, my exhortations were met with an...unkind response.

But now, a plan comes to me! These Blades are proud military men, like me. Their minds are merely befuddled by the demon drink. If you were to take the tender lamb to this inn and use its magic on the captain there, how thankful he would be! How he would revere the Fleece Force for restoring his senses and honor both!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_100_: ...If the plan should work, that is. Truth be told, the hypnoturgical blast has never been tested against the...well oiled. But we will never know until we try! To the Coffer & Coffin, friend! Save that captain from himself!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_025: During this quest, the tender lamb will accompany you as a minion.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_026: However, if you summon another minion or companion, or exit the game, the tender lamb will leave your side and return to the black hitsuji yoriki.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_100_026: In order to progress in the quest, the tender lamb must remain summoned.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_027: Should the tender lamb leave your side, it can be retrieved by speaking with the black hitsuji yoriki once more.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_100_027: During this quest, the tender lamb will accompany you as a minion.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_110_027: However, if you summon another minion, or log out of the game, the tender lamb will leave your side and return to the black hitsuji yoriki.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_120_027: It will also be dismissed if you leave the city while a companion is summoned. Please withdraw your companion in order to progress with the quest.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_130_027: Should the tender lamb leave your side, it can be retrieved by speaking with the black hitsuji yoriki once more.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_000_: My friend, it is good to see you safe! When the tender lamb returned to me alone, I feared the worst. Have you come to take her back?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_100_028: The tender lamb will be dismissed if you leave the city while a companion is summoned. Please withdraw your companion in order to proceed with the quest.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_Q1_000_001: Take charge of the tender lamb?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_000_: The future of the Fleece Force is in your hands, and her hooves. It is time to show the Brass Blades what they are missing!

Please do not delay, my friend. This is our chance to show the Brass Blades the powers of the Fleece Force firsthand. Yet judging by the ruddy glow of the captain's cheeks, it is only a matter of time before our window of opportunity closes. Or collapses, if you will.

When last I saw them, the Brass Blades were carousing at the Coffer & Coffin, and making a most vulgar spectacle of themselves. Take the tender lamb to them, and cast its spell on their captain, before he does something he regrets.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_040: Them folks outside didn't pester ye none, did they, ? They're good people at heart, but when they're in their cups, it takes a better man than me to tip 'em out. Just hope they knock themselves out before they do it to another poor sod...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADEA00309_00: What're you looking at? Go boil yer head, ─can't ye see we're drinkin' here?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADEB00309_00: Down it, down it! Hic! Nice work, Captain! Let's make this a Heavensturn to remember!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_0: Huh... Whuzzah? Are you the servin'  I sent for? It's about bleedin' time! Bring us a platter of that special yer mate was goin' on about─the tender lamb. And make it snappy!
Ha ha ha! Bottoms up, lads and ladettes! Hic! Let's get drinkin', let's get stinkin'!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_200_001: The Brass Blade captain is extremely drunk. Cheer for him to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put an end to his unseemly behavior.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_1: ...Whuzzah? You takin' the mick, ? Stop moonin' about an' get a glass down you.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_200_002: The Brass Blade captain is extremely drunk. Cheer for him to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put an end to his unseemly behavior.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_1: Woooh... Hic! I feel kinda groggy... N-No, I can't... I'm not done drinkin' yet... Roger! Another round!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_045: The hypnoturgical blast has some effect, but the captain shakes it off, determined to continue his drinking.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_1: Here, , have a drink on me... Huh? But these're all empties... That bastard Roger's been holdin' out on us! Go an' give him a kick up the arse, will you, ? We want the strongest booze he's got, and we want it now!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_0: I'm spittin' feathers here, . Where's that lazy bastard Roger got to with the booze? I must have some booze... I demand to have some booze!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_060: Now, I might be wrong, , but didn't ye have a little sheep with ye? I'd go after her if I was you─there's no shortage of beasties 'round these parts what'd snap up a tender morsel like that fer breakfast.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_100_060: Ah, crivens. So he's finally twigged I'd been holdin' out on him? I was hopin' they'd be too far gone to notice, but no such luck. Can't rightly call time on 'em now, but the more they drink, the more trouble they're like to cause.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_061: Don't get me wrong, they're good eggs, really...but when they get the wind in their sails, there's no stoppin' 'em. Seems like they're really hittin' it hard . ...But say, what's up with yer lamb, there?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_062: The tender lamb is staring intently at a shadowy corner of the bar.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_063: Somethin's caught her eye, has it? Oh, hells, don't tell me she wants a drink an' all. Hold on, I think there's somethin' there...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_064: What is that...? A pair o' spectacles? Ah, I remember now. They're the captain's wife's, they are. Left 'em in here a couple o' moons back. I figured she'd be straight back in fer 'em, but I suppose she ain't noticed 'em gone. To be honest, I clean forgot about 'em meself.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_100_064: But maybe it's a good hap I did. The captain's pure devoted to his wife, ye see─a glimpse o' these might be enough to get him thinkin' about headin' on home.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_065: Aye, one peek at them specs an' the captain'll be itchin' to hie his way homewards. Will ye do me a favor, ? Take those spectacles on over to him before he drinks himself blind.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_0: Oho! It's the  with the─ Eh, but where's your sheep gone? I fancied a ride on the fluffy little blighter!
Oi, oi! If it ain't the ! Empty your cups, blades, we got reinforcements─ ...Huh? What's that you got there?
A pair of spectacles...? But these are─ They're...they're hers... Uh... <sob> Urgh... UWAAAAAAH! J-J-JULIAAAAAA! WHY DID YOU LEAVE ME!?
Waaaaaah! <sniff> Uwaaaaaaaaah! <sob> Urrrgh... I...I'm sorry. My wife, she... She passed away a few days ago.
I promised her we'd see in the new year together, but she... She didn't make it...

It hurts so much to think about her, but I can't stop. Every time I close my eyes, I see her face... Gods, what would she think of me now─drinkin' to forget? But I don't want to forget her! I just want it to stop hurtin'. I just want to sleep...and dream of my Julia...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_500_001: The Brass Blade captain appears to have sobered up a little. Cheer for him to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put him to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_0: Gods, I'm such a coward... Too scared to close me eyes an' face the facts, so I drink meself stupid an' act like a lout. If I could just get some sleep...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_500_002: The Brass Blade captain appears to have sobered up a little. Cheer for him to unleash the hypnoturgical blast and put him to sleep.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADEA00309_00: You rotten swine! Why'd ye have to go and show him those bloody things? The captain just lost his wife, for gods' sake!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADEB00309_00: The captain ain't one to show his feelin's, but even we could see he were right cut up about losin' his wife. We couldn't rightly leave him alone on Heavensturn now, could we?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_0: Agh, it's no good─now I've thought of her, I can't get her out of my head. I...I can't take it... If only I could get some sleep... That feller with the curly black hair said he knew some way of knockin' people out. You don't know anything about that, do you?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_1: I just can't stop thinkin' about her... Oh gods, what's the point? Nothin's ever goin' to cheer me up...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADECAPTAIN_0: Ohhh... I-I...feel so sleepy... Did your sheep...do this? Thank you... I can finally...get some rest...
Oh, Julia, my darlin'... Didn't I tell you we'd see in the new year together...? The sunrise...is so beautiful... Just like your eyes...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADEA00309_00: Is he...dreamin' about his wife? <sob> ...He managed to keep his promise, then. Maybe we was wrong to make him drink his cares away. When he wakes up, we'll tell him─he might've lost his wife, but he's still got us. We'll always be here for him.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_BRASSBLADEB00309_00: We'd better get him home to bed. Here, ─you couldn't do us a favor, could you? Let Roger know we're sorry for causin' any trouble, and we'll come and settle up .
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_110: Another round, is it, ? ...But where's that sheep o' yers got to? Tell ye what─you go an' find her, and I'll get to changin' the barrel.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_111: Ah, so that's how it is... Well, ain't I a churl─the poor bastard's grievin' for his wife, an' I'm here moanin' about his drinkin'.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_112: But there ain't no time like Heavensturn for makin' amends. So here's me new year's resolution: the captain's drinks...ah, to hells with it─everyone's drinks are on the house!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_113: I can't have me payin' customers startin' the year with tears in their eyes. We're all friends here, in good times an' bad─an' one man's misery affects us all. We'll help him get through this, no matter what it takes. Ladies and gentlemen─to the captain! May he always find friends at the Coffer!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_114: That goes for you and yer little lamb, too, . She's a sharp one, ye know─spottin' those spectacles in the middle of all this mess. Had a glint in her eye, she did. I reckon she knew exactly what was goin' on, right from the start.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_115: But I tell ye, I never thought that friend of yers─the black hitsu-whatsit─was speakin' the truth. Nettlin' the Blades with talk o' magical lambs...I was this close to givin' him the ol' heave-ho. Thank Thal I didn't, eh? Pass him on me thanks, will ye, ?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_116: The tender lamb looks at you with satisfaction.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_117: By working together to comfort the grieving captain, you and the tender lamb have become closer.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_118: Your joint effort to ease another troubled soul has brought you and the tender lamb even closer together.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_SYSTEM_000_119: With a third successful mollification, you and the tender lamb have become fast friends.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_ROGER_000_120: Aye, I was gettin' a mite worried for yer friend earlier─the black juicy Lucy or whatever he calls himself. Seemed to be rilin' up the Blades no end. But he must've known what he was doin', to send you and yer sheep along. Pass him on me thanks, will ye?
