TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_000_: My friend, you have returned! In triumph, I trust? Tell me, did the hypnoturgical blast take effect? Will the Brass Blades be placing an order?
My friend, you have returned! Your lamb has reported to me already, but I do not understand sheep-speak. Not yet, anyway. Does she bleat of success? Did the hypnoturgical blast take effect?
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_100_: Hmmm... So it took two shots to down the drunken captain? We had thought our testing on adults complete, but it seems further research is needed on the interference of inebriation...
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_000_: And you say the man was grieving for his lost love? That is unfortunate indeed─both for the man, and for my plan. I had hoped he would be overawed by the lamb's powers, not simply consoled... It seems we must settle for the consolation prize this time.
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_100_: But a prize is a prize, after all. The Brass Blades have been introduced to the Fleece Force─it is simply a matter of time before the first order comes in. My congratulations, friend! A difficult job well done!
TEXT_FESNYR105_00309_REDSHEEPYORIKI_000_: Allow me to present you with this kabuto, as proof of our friendship. The shonin, too, will hear of your deeds. Should you happen to lose the helm, I am sure they will be as proud as I to present you with a replacement.

As for the bugyo─while he might frown on my kabuto's shade, he will understand its significance. All the best, my friend, and may the Fleece Force triumph in Gridania and La Noscea, as it is sure to do in Ul'dah!

I shall return the lamb to the bugyo, with word of your successes. I thank you for your work this day, just as the whole of Eorzea shall come to thank you when the Fleece Force brings security to these shores.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_1: Ye know, , if yer just gonna stand around with yer thumb up yer arse, I can give ye somethin' to do.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_2: Thanks to me unbelievably low prices, we've no shortage of customers here at the Coffer & Coffin. But by the same token, I can't afford to hire much help. We're chronically understaffed.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_3: What's more, there's those lazy-arsed types what refuse to come an' order at the counter. It'd be a great help if ye could attend these customers for me.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_4: Mark their orders on these here slips, then bring them here. Oh, and don't forget about ol' Adalfuns outside.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROUNDELPH_000_10: Thal's balls, I'm spent! Grilled dodo, and a tankard of ale to wash it down!
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROUNDELPH_000_11: Gah, here I am again, spendin' what meager coin I've got at the Coffin... It ain't me fault, I tell ye! Ye'd do the same if yer wife served up shite every bleedin' day!
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ADALFUNS_000_20: Roger's new errand , are you? Well then, I'll keep it simple for your sake: a tankard of your finest ale, chilled with an ice shard.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ADALFUNS_000_21: Heh heh... There's nothing like a tall drink to help one forget about the trifling things in life─like work.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_SOLIDTRUNK_000_30: The strongest brandewine you've got. I need help to forget...
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_RICARD_000_40: Gods, I'm starving! Bring me ale, grilled dodo, and smoked shrew loaf! And make it quick!
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_RICARD_000_41: Business is good─too good, even. I've nary got the time to take a piss, let alone eat. The mere thought of the Coffin's cooking makes my mouth water!
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_51: Let's see here... Ale, brandewine, grilled dodo...
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_52: And for Adalfuns... Lemme guess─one tankard of ale. Right bleedin' miser, that one. I oughta put me boot up his arse.
TEXT_SUBWIL070_00324_ROGER_000_53: Anyroad, ye did good, . By way of thanks, I'm gonna tell ye somethin' what ought to prove to yer profit.
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_AMHGARANJY_000_000: You wish to do more for the celebration? Wonderful! Should you wish to focus your efforts here in the Lavender Beds, then pray speak with the little helper over yonder.
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_AMHGARANJY_000_001: A slew of errands always accompanies the festivities, and I don't know what I would do without my dedicated volunteers. For as much as I would like to shoulder the entire burden, it simply isn't possible...
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_AMHGARANJY_000_002: ...But let us not waste time with maudlin thoughts! We've a joyous festival to run!
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_AMHGARANJY_000_003: If you wish to continue your efforts here in the Lavender Beds, then pray speak with the little helper over there to the left of the mammets. Thank you for your assistance, !
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_VOLUNTEER65861_000_: Hello there! You must be the adventurer the celebrant mentioned.
If I'm not mistaken, you've already retrieved a letter and delivered a gift, yes? Then you're quite prepared to perform the tasks I shall give you, for they are identical in nature.

Oh, were you perhaps concerned about the contents of the presents you'll be handing out? You needn't be. They are but simple items fashioned of wood─toy bows and hairpins and the like─blessed by the Hearers themselves!
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_SYSTEM_000_14: A daily quest is now available from the little helper in the Lavender Beds.
TEXT_FESXMS006_00325_SYSTEM_000_15: By completing this repeatable task, you will obtain fallen stars which can be exchanged for Starlight Celebration seasonal goods.
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_1: Ah, . I daresay you are the right  to solve this mystery.
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_2: Someone or something has been littering the tracks with pieces of silver ore.
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_3: Even a tiny chunk can send a wagon off its course, so I've had to devote significant manpower to locating and clearing these obstructions.
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_4: We can't keep this up forever, though. I need you to find the culprits and put an end to their mischief. Search for any pieces of pockmarked silver ore on the tracks. If you're lucky, you'll catch the bastards before they escape.
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_11: The little critters gnaw on ore as a hound on a bone. The rocks on the track were their godsdamned leftovers!
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_12: Some superstitious miners believe that spriggans are harbingers of fortune, but by my reckoning the creatures are naught more than pests, like coblyns.
TEXT_SUBWIL073_00327_WARIN_000_13: As far as I'm concerned, there's no better omen for Amajina & Sons than you. Ever since you began helping out at the station, our operations have been running without so much as a single hiccup.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_000: I thought I told you to get out of here. What, looking for a chance to do some good? <sigh> I guess I can't force you to leave. Damn stubborn adventurers, the lot of you. Fine, then. Listen well.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_001: A band of outlaws has taken up residence at the Quiveron Manse on the ridge to the south.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_002: Their leader has styled himself heir to Eolande Quiveron, the Syndicate member who died in the Calamity. <spit>
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_003: The baron and his cronies are naught more than a pack of jackals. They prey on the people of Lost Hope, robbing them of what little they have.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_004: I myself cannot act without endangering the refugees, as they know my face and will retaliate against Lost Hope. You, however, are not known to the bandits or their allies. If you wish to help us, then deal with the baron.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_010: So it is done? Good. I hope that wretch died screaming.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_011: Ul'dah is more prosperous than ever, some say. That may be true for the Syndicate, but none of that wealth has trickled down to the smallfolk.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_012: It's all a mummer's farce. One day, I refused to play my part─and so I was made to leave the stage.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_LEOFRIC_013: Aye, my time has passed. The Brass Blades of the Rose must look to others for guidance.
TEXT_SUBWIL083_00331_POP_MESSAGE: The air begins to crackle with dark magicks...
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_000: Pardon me, . I know this is sudden, but I have no one else to turn to.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_001: Our village has long been a haven for...unscrupulous characters. One such band has taken over our tavern.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_002: They demand that we serve them buzzard thighs, thickshell legs, and scaphite slices─none of which we have in our larders. Could you procure these ingredients for me, adventurer? I have not the skill to harvest them from the creatures.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_010: Have you the ingredients? If we fail to satisfy the bandits, they will take their displeasure out on us.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_011: Bless you, adventurer, bless you! We may yet pass this  without incident.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_012: Though I know not what terrors tomorrow may bring. These outlaws do whatever they please, and we have not the strength to stand up to them.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_013: The Brass Blades of Horizon and Vesper Bay see no profit in protecting a poor village like ours. Most of them pretend we do not even exist.
TEXT_SUBWIL087_00335_MERILDA_014: Worst of all are those in league with the bandits...
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_AMHGARANJY_000_000: As I've explained, it is not only the Lavender Beds that suffer from too few helping hands. Your assistance with the Starlight festivities would also be most welcome in Mist.
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_AMHGARANJY_000_001: If you've the occasion to visit Limsa Lominsa, might you consider sacrificing a few more moments of your time for the sake of the children?
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_AMHGARANJY_000_002: My colleague in the Seagaze Markets will assign you any tasks that need doing. May Nymeia bless you and your charitable soul, !
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_SYSTEM_100_002: The work of the saint's little helpers is never done! The entrance to Mist can be found in lower La Noscea, east of the Red Rooster Stead.
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Should you find yourself in Limsa Lominsa with time to spare, pray consider lending your aid to the little helper in Mist. As things stand, I fear the younglings will be faced with bitter disappointment...
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_VOLUNTEER65874_000_: 'Ere now, yer a right strappin' , ain't ye? Nymeia bless the celebrant for sendin' ye me way!
The job I've got for ye ain't no different from what ye've already done in the Lavender Beds: collect the wee brats' letters, then give 'em their bleedin' presents. No problem, eh?
Them young scamps'll be grinnin' ear to ear when they get their blunted daggers an' coral jewelry an' what-'ave-ye. Aye, I love to see them little buggers 'appy, I do!
<cough> Ahem. Well, ye didn't come 'ere to listen to me wax all sentimental, now did ye? Just give me an 'oller when yer ready to get to work!
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_SYSTEM_000_014: A daily quest is now available from the little helper in Mist.
TEXT_FESXMS007_00338_SYSTEM_000_015: By completing this repeatable task, you will obtain fallen stars which can be exchanged for Starlight Celebration seasonal goods.
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_AMHGARANJY_000_000: While we will certainly miss your tireless efforts here in the Lavender Beds, my colleague in the Goblet could also benefit from the presence of a dedicated volunteer.
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Should you happen to have business in Ul'dah, might you consider paying her a visit and easing her burden?
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_AMHGARANJY_000_002: You'll find your fellow little helper in the Brimming Heart amongst a forest of Starlight sentinels. Don't you just adore how the seasonal decorations transform our cities?
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_SYSTEM_100_002: The work of the saint's little helpers is never done! The entrance to the Goblet can be found in western Thanalan, southeast of Scorpion Crossing.
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Look for your fellow little helper in the Goblet in Ul'dah. Remember: every gift you deliver means another merry child!
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_VOLUNTEER65876_000_: Well, it's about time you showed up! The celebrant's been promising help, but promises won't mend the holes I've worn into the soles of my boots!
The task itself is hardly complicated, and you've already had a taste of what needs to be done, I hear.

The only thing that's different is the gifts themselves─here in Ul'dah even the younglings can appreciate precious metals, so the Goldsmiths' Guild's been busy churning out pretty trinkets by the dozen.

Catch your breath and have a sit-down if you need one, but don't be too long about it, eh? We're aiming for happy children here, not screeching and wailing wee ones who missed out on their Starlight presents...
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_SYSTEM_000_014: A daily quest is now available from the little helper in the Goblet.
TEXT_FESXMS008_00340_SYSTEM_000_015: By completing this repeatable task, you will obtain fallen stars which can be exchanged for Starlight Celebration seasonal goods.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_000: ! My little helpers from across Eorzea have been most pleased with your timely assistance! I knew from the moment we met that a gentle soul lurked beneath your steely adventurer exterior.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_100_000: ...Might it be asking too much to prevail upon your generosity of spirit once more? As it happens, I have been able to track down the child who demanded the return of his dear, departed father in his letter to the Spinner.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_001: His name is Timothey. I know this might not end up being the easiest of conversations, but I wonder if you might go to him to see what happened.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Though I wish to talk with him myself, he will, I imagine, feel more comfortable speaking with a little helper rather than the Starlight celebrant.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Hurry, now, , and you should find Timothey yet lingering near Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_004: Take Timothey's letter, and speak with him near Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_010: A little helper!? Wh-What do you want with me?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_011: ...Yes, I wrote that letter. And I'm not sorry! You, the saint, the goddess─you're all fakes and liars!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_012: You want to bring me a gift? Then bring me back my father!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_100_012: I've gone and lost the bracelets he made for me, and now I've naught left to remember him by...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_014: Oh, hello. Have you come to see Timothey?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_013: Hm? I'm not really in the mood for talking, ...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SYSTEM_100_013: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SYSTEM_110_013: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_GUIDE65790_100_014: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_020: Pray excuse my son's poor manners. ...If I may ask, what was in that letter you showed him?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_021: Ah, I see. Perhaps it would help if I told you something of our troubles.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_022: As was the case for so many, the Calamity devastated our family─we lost our home, our livelihood...and Timothey's dear father. We only arrived here in Gridania after a long and difficult journey.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_023: 'Twas during that journey that Timothey dropped his treasured bracelets. My husband was a goldsmith, you see, and they were the last pieces that he ever crafted.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_024: You can understand how their loss might affect my boy─with everything else destroyed in the fires, it was as if he had lost his father all over again. I fear Timothey will never smile again...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_025: ...The bracelets? We were attacked by beasts on the road, and I assume the things slipped from his wrists as we fled for our lives. I dared not allow him return in search of them.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MOTHER65890_000_026: If I recall correctly, the attack came not long after we entered the Central Shroud, but before we arrived at Bentbranch Meadows. I'm not sure of the exact location...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_030: Welcome back, . Were you able to learn aught that might allow us to ease that poor child's grief?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_031: ...Ah, I understand only too well how the loss of such treasured mementos might dampen his spirits. Our course seems clear.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_032: What say you, little helper? Will you brave the wilds of the Central Shroud and look for these bracelets?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_033: I knew I could count on you! 'Tis the season for goodwill, after all!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_034: If, as the boy's mother says, the mementos were dropped on the road to Bentbranch Meadows, then I would suggest you begin your search in the vicinity of the Mirror Planks. The Spinner's luck be with you!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_035: Assuming the bracelets were dropped somewhere on the way to Bentbranch Meadows, then you might begin by scouring the area just beyond the Mirror Planks.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SYSTEM_000_036: You find no sign of the bracelets...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SYSTEM_100_036: Still no sign of the bracelets...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MASKMAN65890_000_03: (-???-)Aha! I've finally caught up with you!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_MASKMAN65890_000_04: Why, it's been simply ages since we...er, that is to say, how do you do! I am but a humble gold...en-hearted pilgrim, wandering the wilds!
How do you do! I am but a wandering pilgrim, performing good deeds where good deeds need to be done!
No, you need not speak a word! Your plight is known to me. I have here the very bracelets you sought to find!

Of course, I'm sure you're wondering, “How did this ruggedly handsome man come to learn of my noble quest?” Well, the moment my eye was caught by the glint of precious metal in the grass beside the road, I immediately discerned the tale behind this treasure's abandonment.
A wandering pilgrim is wise indeed in the ways of the world!

I took up the bracelets, damaged as they were, and repaired them─adding only a bare minimum of subtle flair and daring elegance to the basic design. I then went in search of a little helper for a little help with the delivery.
These reborn bangles should bring the grin back to little Timothey's face, don't you agree? Take them, now, take them! And be sure to preserve the magic by wearing your festive attire!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_046: You've found the bracelets already!? Then you must deliver them to Timothey straightaway! He should yet be by Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_050: Oh, it's you again. Why do you keep bothering me? ...What!? Y-You found my bracelets!?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_051: Ha! I knew you were a liar! These aren't the ones my father─ Wait.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_052: Where did you get these bangles!? I've seen them in a book my father had─it was filled with pictures of some famous goldsmith's masterpieces! He always said that one day he hoped to be skilled enough to craft like that...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_053: You're certain they are the bracelets my father made? ...And a man with a white beard and scarlet tunic found and fixed them for me?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_054: But that would mean... Great Spinner! You must've met with the Saint of Nymeia! Who else would know about the bangles my father wanted to make!? I can't believe he's really real...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_055: (-Smiling Timothey-)Thank you so much, little helper! I'm sorry I didn't believe you!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_CHILD65890_000_056: Hm? I'm not really in the mood for talking, ...
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SYSTEM_100_056: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_SYSTEM_110_056: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_GUIDE65890_120_056: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_060: , you're back! How did you fare with young Timothey?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_061: ...That is most heartening to hear. His mother must be thrilled to see him smiling again.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_062: And this talk of a wandering pilgrim sounds awfully familiar... When I was but a girl, I, too, encountered an itinerant gentleman who matches your description of this snowy-haired senior.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_063: When he found me crying over a special ring that I had lost, he raised me out of my despair by gifting me with a new band he had forged himself.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_064: That one moment of kindness shaped my future, I believe─it kindled in me a desire to bring joy to others, in the same way as that nameless saint brought joy to me.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_065: ...Could it be that the pilgrims we met were, in fact, the same person─perhaps the Saint of Nymeia himself?
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_066: Now there's a wonderful idea! With the magic of the Starlight Celebration all around us, I can almost believe it to be true.
TEXT_FESXMS009_00354_AMHGARANJY_000_067: Either way, we cannot leave the bringing of joy to the saint alone! Come, adventurer─there are yet gifts to give, and smiles to find!
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Ere I forget, I believe Moenbryda has requested a gathering of the Scions. I assume there has been some progress concerning our efforts to combat the Ascians.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Pray inform her that our business with the Ishgardians is concluded for the moment─I shall be along once I've completed my communications with the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Would you be so kind as to inform Moenbryda that our Ishgardian visitor has departed? I must speak with the Crystal Braves, then I shall join you all forthwith.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_MOENBRYDA_000_010: All done with your talk of dragons? Wonderful, because Ascians are next on the menu! Let's head into the solar, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_YDA_000_011: I'm telling you, Thancred: keep pestering Moenbryda and the only thing you'll become intimate with is her axe...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_PAPALYMO_000_012: There have been no reports of suspicious masked men in Gridania, that is certain. Mayhaps they weave their dark plots in other lands?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_THANCRED_000_013: Such statuesque beauty─and possessed of a mind for research to match her belly for hard liquor! What does a woman of so many charms see in musty old Urianger...?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_YSHTOLA_000_014: I keep my senses strained for signs of Ascian activity, but there is little news to be had.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_YSHTOLA_100_014: Have their schemes reached some critical step? This silence is most disturbing...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_MINFILIA_000_015: I've summoned everyone to the solar. 'Twould seem Moenbryda has something exciting to share with us.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_MINFILIA_000_016: Of all our adversaries, the Ascians could well be considered the most dangerous. I do hope Moenbryda's research has borne fruit...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_TATARU_000_031: For a small organization, we certainly chew through a prodigious amount of foodstuffs. Perhaps I should put a lock on the larder door...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_HIGIRI_000_032: We do seem to be running low on provisions. I believe an excursion to the marketplace is in order.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_033: I see that the Scions once more ready themselves for the road. I, too, must make preparations for an absence from the Rising Stones...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: It seems you have barely arrived before you must once more plunge into the fray. Duty is an unforgiving mistress, eh? Though the tasks we tackle are not like to be as realm-shaking, Coultenet and I must also heed her call.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_COULTENET_000_035: Hoary was most eager to join you on the front lines of battle, but, as fate would have it, the Antecedent had other plans for our talents.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_MINFILIA_000_036: Though I have little doubt you will prevail against the Empire's forces, I shall pray for your success nonetheless. Our very future may depend upon Moenbryda being free to pursue her experiments.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALPHINAUD_000_050: 'Twould seem that events have once more conspired to rob us of rest and recuperation. Though I would wish it otherwise, I must ask that you head straightaway to the processing plant.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALPHINAUD_000_051: The 4th have already deployed to the area, and await the arrival of the Scions. Wilred will brief you on the developing situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Meanwhile, I must rendezvous with Captain Ilberd at our headquarters in Ul'dah. I shall take command of our forces there with a lighter heart, knowing that you go to support the front lines.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: Your duties take you to northern Thanalan, do they not?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_COULTENET_000_061: We, too, must say our farewells to the Rising Stones for a time. F'lhaminn travels to Ul'dah, and we shall serve as her escort.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_062: At my daughter's behest, I go to contact certain old acquaintances in the gilded city.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_063: We are beset on all sides by civil unrest and imperial machinations, threatened by primals and troubled by dragons─we need all the allies we can muster.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_064: Many of my friends hold positions of power, you see, and it is my hope that they can be convinced to aid the Scions' cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_065: If past events have taught us anything, then we know that Eorzea must present a united front or we shall fall...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_100_065: Ah, how extraordinary that my little Ascilia is involved in such far-reaching affairs.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_066: I am proud that I might now stand at her side not only as a mother, but also as a colleague.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_COULTENET_000_067: A colleague with influential connections! But I fear that Ul'dah has become a place of danger even for one so familiar with her streets.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: Bah! Woe betide the blackguard that so much as glares in your direction, milady!
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_FLHAMINN_000_069: Ahaha, I shall be well protected, it seems.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_COULTENET_000_070: Shall we be on our way, then?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALIANNE_000_071: 'Tis unsettling to think that an enemy base lies but a brief stroll beyond these walls...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_090: Commander Leveilleur sent word that you'd be coming─a veteran of your talents is most welcome.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_091: Not that I don't think we can handle the situation, mind you! I've learned a trick or two since that disaster with the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_092: But returning to the task at hand...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_093: The Flames' reconnaissance scouts have reported imperial soldiers assembling at Raubahn's Push. Such a force is likely interested in only one thing: getting their hands on the resources found here at the processing plant.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_094: The Garleans could begin marching on us at any time, and I think it's time we speak with Lieutenant Edelstein to finalize our counter strategy.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_110: ! My soldiers yet tell tales of your deeds during Operation Archon!
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_111: Would that we could sit a while and reminisce about old times...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_112: Are the Garleans on the move, then?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_113: Not as such. The civilian draughtsmen have, however, come across several highly suspicious crates within the boundaries of the processing plant.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_114: I had my sappers take a closer look, and our worst fears were confirmed─these boxes contain powerful explosive devices. Devices of imperial design, no less.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_115: Found inside the plant, you say!? But...how!? We've had guards stationed around the perimeter day and night!
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_THANCRED_000_116: 'Tis likely the plant was infiltrated long before the Braves arrived.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_117: Master Thancred! Have the Scions come in force, then?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_PAPALYMO_000_118: All who could be spared, yes. Now, there are likely more of these imperial explosives about the place, so I suggest we spread out and conduct a thorough sweep of the compound.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_PAPALYMO_000_119: Considering the volatile nature of ceruleum, allowing even one such device to escape our search may lead to us enjoying an uncomfortably close view of a rather spectacular explosion.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_120:
<gulp> R-Right, then. I'll pass the word on to the 4th.
...Uh, what exactly should we do with these crates should we find them?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_121: Bring them here to me. Carefully, mind you. My sappers will render the devices harmless, as they did with the first batch we found.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_THANCRED_000_122: Very well. Let's get started, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_WILRED_000_123: J-Just another day for the Braves! Guarding the front lines. Keeping an eye on the Garleans. Tracking down potentially lethal explosive devices...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_ALIANNE_000_124: How goes the search? I've not had much luck myself...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_PAPALYMO_000_125: I wonder if these devices could be effectively disabled through the focused application of ice-aspected magicks...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_THANCRED_000_126: I've found only one suspicious container thus far...and it contained naught but the remains of some hurried worker's midday repast.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_YDA_000_127: I'm having a contest with Papalymo to see who can find the most explosives! Hmmm. I may have forgotten to mention it to him before I started looking...
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_YSHTOLA_000_128: Thancred told me of the explosives. Let us secure the plant, and swiftly, that we might proceed with our original agenda.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_MOENBRYDA_000_129: I've done some exploring, and located the perfect place where I might conduct my experiment. A pity, then, that we must deal with all this Garlean nonsense before I can begin testing my theories.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_130: I would ask that you bring any suspicious containers here to me─my sappers will safely disable these little surprise gifts from the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_100_140: Should you discover any containers that appear out of place, then hand them over to me. My sappers will determine whether or not these objects are explosives─and then disarm them should they prove to be so.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_140: There were four more of those blasted things!? I'll have our engineers disassemble them at once. Fine work, as always,  .
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_141: The entire compound has now been scoured from top to bottom, so I should hope that's the last we've seen of these explosives.
TEXT_GAIUSE505_00367_EDELSTEIN_000_142: Our troubles with Castrum Meridianum, however, are far from over. Scouts have returned with news of movement on the front...
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_KEITHA_000_1: Seein' as you're new 'round here, let's start you off with an easy job that'll help you get your bearin's, eh?
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_KEITHA_000_2: It just so happens it's feedin' time for the chocobos. Grab yourself a few bunches of broad-leaf gysahl greens from the pile beside the field there, and stick 'em in the feedin' troughs.
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_KEITHA_000_3: Bentbranch is a big place, mind, so don't you go missin' any. Off you trot, then.
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_KEITHA_000_11: Thank you for dolin' out the greens, . I trust you got a rough idea how the place is laid out while you were at it? Good.
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_KEITHA_000_12: Here at Bentbranch, we nurture our chocobos from the egg to young adulthood. So you might say we have 'em for the duration of their “formative years.”
TEXT_SUBFST047_00374_KEITHA_000_13: 'Tis backbreakin' work keepin' the birds free of illness and injury, and I'm sure me fellow workers'll appreciate any help you can give 'em.
TEXT_SUBFST066_00382_LOTHAIRE_000_1: I must admit that Eylgar is right, and that this road has grown too hazardous for travelers. Since you have shown yourself to be so adept at slaying beasts, perhaps you could be of further assistance.
TEXT_SUBFST066_00382_LOTHAIRE_000_2: I would have you journey to the Tam-Tara Deepcroft and slay the magicked bones which have escaped from within.
TEXT_SUBFST066_00382_LOTHAIRE_000_3: These abominations are beginning to wander as far as the main road, and I have had to rescue several wagons from their mindless assaults. Even a slight reduction in their numbers would improve the situation.
TEXT_SUBFST066_00382_LOTHAIRE_000_11: It is no small feat to face the walking dead. The road is much safer now, thanks to you.
TEXT_SUBFST066_00382_LOTHAIRE_000_12: Such an unnatural thing, for the fallen to rise again...and in such great numbers. Those who perished in the Calamity deserve to rest in peace, yet something or someone has roused them from their slumber...
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_1: Ah, great gobs o' gobbie spit. There're still a couple o' parcels left in the balloon.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_2: An' wouldn't ye know, the bloody courier has already left. Here now, , ye seem to have yer hands free.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_3: Do a poor sod a favor an' deliver these packages to the personages what are writ on the cards there. Ye can read, can't ye? This one's for Syngithuv o' the Foremast, an' the other's for Jessamine o' the De Nevelle Checkpoint.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_31: All sorted, then? Thank ye kindly, adventurer. 'Twouldn't do to have people whisperin' nasty rumors about the quality of our delivery services.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_32: With all this loadin' an' unloadin', there's always the chance that somethin' gets left behind. We wouldn't even need the damn balloons if we could carve a ramp up the cliff face somehow...
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_33: Bah, but the city ain't got the gil or the time for that, what with the beast tribes an' the Empire breathin' down our bloody necks.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_WYRKRHIT_000_34: All the competin' cargo companies had to pool their resources just to get this little operation off the ground. Hah! Get it? Off the ground! Ahem. Anyroad, we'll just have to do things the hard way for now.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_SYNGITHUV_000_11: Are you come from the Skylift? You didn't happen to overhear any talk of undelivered packages, did you?
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_SYNGITHUV_000_12: Why, this is the very parcel I was expecting! Marvelous! Hm? The smell? Ah, that would be from the lavender pouches I ordered from the Red Rooster Stead.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_SYNGITHUV_000_13: The soldiers here at the Foremast train until exhaustion, you see, often leaving them scant time to sluice away the day's sweat. The lavender fragrance helps cover their, uh, bodily aromas.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_JESSAMINE_000_21: You've come with a delivery from the Skylift? Please tell me it's the book my brother sent from the La Thagran Checkpoint.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_JESSAMINE_000_22: Huzzah! Now I can spend my off-duty hours reading instead of losing my wages throwing knuckles with the captain.
TEXT_SUBSEA101_00398_JESSAMINE_000_23: The gods know there is precious little else that passes for amusement around here...
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_1: The Calamity was a most horrendous event. It took from me my father, destroyed our home, and scorched our fields. It crushed my hopes and dreams.
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_2: All that I have left of my dear old dad is his notebook. He scrawled down a fair bit of nonsense in that ratty, dog-eared tome, but as I was leafing through the pages one day, I found a passage entitled “For the Future.” It described the location where my father had buried his “earthly wealth,” in an area that was once a bustling neighborhood.
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_3: I was not aware our family possessed much in the way of treasures. Could the crafty rapscallion have squirreled away a bulging bag of gil or precious stones? Just think of the contribution I might make to Swiftperch's revival with such a fortune at my disposal!
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_4: The catch? Ah, yes, the catch. The area is crawling with bandits and wild jackals. I need someone─that is, I need you─to search among the derelict houses in the Flock and dig up the casket my father buried.
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_11: My father was a frugal man, thus I expect the casket to hold quite a substantial bounty.
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_12: This...this is my father's entire earthly wealth!? Why, there is naught here but a fistful of wheat seeds. What in Eorzea could have possessed him to so carefully conceal such a mundane─
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_13: Ah! I remember now! He once told me that our family's wheat was as a stubborn weed. It was one of the few crops that could take root in the barren soils of western La Noscea!
TEXT_SUBSEA107_00404_LYULF_000_14: With these seeds, our lifeless fields could once again sprout golden stalks! Thank you, oh, thank you! You have truly given this settlement the chance to build a new future.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_000: Ere you commit yourself to the siege, you should know what it is you are tasked with defending. Beyond the Gates of Judgement lie the Steps of Faith─a great bridge of stone that leads directly to the city of Ishgard.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_001: More than simply a means to cross the Sea of Clouds, the bridge serves as a foundation for the arcane wards that form the barrier we call Daniffen's Collar.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_002: Alas, in dispelling the barrier's outermost layer, that thrice-damned witch Iceheart stripped the bridge of its protection, and thus are the dragons now able to land unhindered upon the Steps of Faith.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_003: Should the Dravanians succeed in destroying the remainder of the wards, the winged devils will be free to swarm within the city itself.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_004: Needless to say, we cannot suffer that to happen. It shall be our task as defenders to prevent any harm from coming to those parts of the bridge wherein the wards are sealed.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_005: All now rests on us, adventurer. Lead your comrades out onto the Steps of Faith and prepare to meet the Horde. ...May the Fury guide your blades!
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_006: If the Steps of Faith fall, so too shall Ishgard. We must defend them to the last man.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_007: Rally your comrades, adventurer, and join us in our stand against the Horde!
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_HEISHI_000_020: (-Ishgardian Knight-)The dragons─ They are withdrawing! Victory is ours!
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ESTINIEN_000_021: One of Nidhogg's greatest champions...slain. The Horde will not soon recover from this blow.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ESTINIEN_000_022: But what of you, Nidhogg? Why did you not join your minions and make of this battle a slaughter? Have you grown so fond of the stench of your lair?
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ESTINIEN_000_023: Mayhap you prefer to have your allies fight your battles for you... You have a girl to do your bidding now, do you not? No matter. I shall slay Iceheart, and all the rest...
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ESTINIEN_000_024: ...But I yearn to spill the blood of a great wyrm, Nidhogg, and only your death will sate my lance.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_030: By the Fury... You have driven the Horde from the Steps of Faith! You! A stranger to our land! I confess, I did not think you capable of such a feat...
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MARCELAIN_000_031: Yet you yielded not an ilm in the face of dragons that would turn my brother knights' blood to ice. The Fury Herself must walk at your side!
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_CHAUNOLLET_000_032: Nay, I'll not deny it: without your skill and fortitude, the city would now be ash. Would that more of your adventuring brethren possessed such qualities.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_LOANNE_000_034: You have served us well, adventurer─the Temple Knights would have been hard-pressed indeed to turn back the Horde alone. Mayhap 'tis time I returned to the practice yard...
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_040: ! The dragons are routed! Lest you wonder, the fighting at the Steel Vigil was also fierce, but my Crystal Braves were not found wanting!
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_AYMERIC_000_041: Commander Leveilleur, ... True to your word, you arrived to aid us in our hour of need.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_AYMERIC_000_042: On behalf of the Holy See and the people of Ishgard, I offer you my humble thanks.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_AYMERIC_000_043: Though I would stay and lavish you with well-deserved praise, I fear I must away to oversee the aftermath of the siege. Not all the dragons are fled, and there are yet wounded to be carried from the field. Pray let us meet anon that I might express my thanks with the proper courtesy.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_044: I too would offer my thanks, . Through your deeds, we have achieved a victory of singular importance.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_045: With the Dravanian Horde thus weakened and scattered, the threat to Ishgard has been greatly diminished.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_046: And, mayhap equally significant, the Holy See must now recognize the necessity of cooperation with foreign powers.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Long have they barred their gates against the outside world, but I am confident that the day will soon come when Ishgard proclaims itself a member of the Eorzean Alliance once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_048: Much have we sacrificed in our struggles against dragons and primals, the Ascians and the Empire. But, step by unfaltering step, we march ever nearer to our goal.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_049: And, as ever, the journey is made with you in the van.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_050: The victory you have won this day gives us greater hope for the morrow.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_051:
'Tis a hope that shall sustain us in the days to come, and bear us past the many evils that yet seek to hinder our progress.
Yes, we have done well, my friend, and I, for one, would take a moment to savor the enormity of our achievement!
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_052: ...The demands of duty, however, allow me little time for levity. I must accompany Captain Ilberd back to Ul'dah, and reassign those Braves whose squads suffered heavy losses.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_ALPHINAUD_000_053: You, my friend, have earned a rest at the Rising Stones. Pray return to Revenant's Toll, and share your tale with Minfilia in person.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MINFILIA_000_061: Alphinaud sent word of the siege. And, of course, of the role you played in ending it.
TEXT_GAIUSE607_00419_MINFILIA_000_062: Your deeds never cease to amaze me, ... Thank you.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_CARDGAME_000_000: Triple Triad is taking Eorzea by storm! Care to try your hand at this entrancing new card game?
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_Q1_000_000: Try your hand at Triple Triad?
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_CARDGAME_000_010: Are you sure? It's easy to begin, and challenging to master! Well, another time, perhaps!
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_000_020: And so another challenger is born! Welcome to the world of Triple Triad, where you pit your cards against an opponent's in a tense battle of skill, strategy...and the odd dose of luck!
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_CARDGAME_000_021: Here at the Manderville Gold Saucer, I am pleased to present all new players with the cards they need to get started!
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_CARDGAME_000_022: To play a match, however, first you'll need to build a deck composed of five cards from your registered card list.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_CARDGAME_000_023: Oh, and I suggest speaking with the nearby Triple Triad trader should you wish to expand your card collection!
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_100_030: You can now play Triple Triad.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_000_030: You are now able to challenge opponents to Triple Triad matches. New cards can be obtained from a number of sources, including the Triple Triad trader, victory spoils from winning matches, and prizes from Triple Triad tournaments.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_000_031: Play against the Triple Triad master to learn the basic rules of the game. Before you can begin, however, there are several steps that must be completed.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_000_032: First, you must Use the cards in your inventory to register them to your Card List. Your card list can be viewed via the Gold Saucer options found under Character in the main menu.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_000_033: Next, access your Card Decks, also located within the Gold Saucer options, and build a deck by selecting five cards from those you have registered.
TEXT_SUBGSC102_00437_SYSTEM_000_034: Speak with the Triple Triad master once your deck is ready, and she will engage you in a tutorial match.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_000: Welcome to the Arcanists' Guild. It is here that we research and develop the field of arcanima.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_001: Arcanima is the science of employing “arcane geometries”─intricate patterns that map the unlocked mysteries of existence─to draw forth and manipulate the body's aetheric energies.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_002: If you prefer an arcane art built on structured thought and precise reasoning, then your discerning intellect may find a home here at our guild. Might you consider enrolling yourself as an initiate?
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_Q1_000_000: Do you wish to join the Arcanists' Guild?
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_5: You display an admirable measure of self-awareness. The path of the arcanist would be rocky indeed should you lack the requisite intellectual curiosity.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_010: Ah, I admire your academic ambition. But I am afraid your enthusiasm is a step ahead of your ability─we cannot accept initiates who have yet to build a solid foundation in their primary discipline. Your focus must not be unduly divided, you understand.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_SYSTEM_000_011: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_20: Aha, just as I predicted. Before we proceed any further, however, let us first feed your appetite for knowledge with a morsel of guild history.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_21: The roots of arcanima can be traced back to the esoteric calculations practiced by the people of the south sea isles. It was these island folk that first discovered a method to express natural phenomena in mathematical terms.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_22: Building on this process, the existing mathematical formulae were further developed into arcane geometries─precise patterns that allowed a practitioner to weave aether into specific magical effects. The mages who invoked this new form of magic became known as “arcanists,” and the school of arcanima was born.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_23: Many such mages, wishing to expand their understanding of the world, took to the seas aboard trading vessels. Upon their arrival in Limsa Lominsa, arcanists found themselves welcomed into the academic elite, and soon secured positions in the realms of governance and counsel.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_24: The knowledge of an arcanist, however, is traditionally passed on from master to chosen disciple. As such, Admiral Merlwyb, counting several wielders of arcanima among her personal staff, became concerned that this exclusionary practice would lead to the eventual extinction of the art.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_25: So, at the Admiral's express orders, an official Arcanists' Guild was established, and funding was provided for research and training.
TEXT_CLSACN001_00451_MURIE_000_26: The complex and demanding nature of arcanima, however, remains the greatest threat to its own future. If you invite such cerebral challenges, then you have but to reaffirm your commitment to joining our guild.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_GURCANT_000_1: Blast! How's a botanist supposed to accomplish fieldwork without a field to work in?
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_GURCANT_000_2: Washed-up pirates are well and good when you want a field pillaged and plundered, but not when you need it plowed.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_GURCANT_000_3: A lone horticulturalist such as myself hardly strikes fear in the hearts of monsters, but your gait is such that I believe you might.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_GURCANT_000_4: I'd be much obliged if you could rid the field of some mandragoras. With five fewer of the sprouting critters roaming about, I'm sure I could return to my work.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_GURCANT_000_11: How about that! You've already done more than that whole lot of slothful sea slugs combined.
TEXT_SUBSEA052_00464_GURCANT_000_12: If only they spent half as much time proving their worth as they do talking about it.
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_DAYLY_000_000: Welcome, welcome, fair traveler! Care to test your luck with a Mini Cactpot ticket?
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_Q1_000_000: Try your hand at the Mini Cactpot?
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_DAYLY_000_010: Very well, . But remember: with the Mini Cactpot, prosperity's but a scratch away!
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_DAYLY_000_020: Splendid, ! Now, allow me to explain: Mini Cactpot is a game of chance, available to you thrice every day.
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_DAYLY_000_021: Playing is simplicity itself: just guess the value of the covered numbers to win it big. If Nymeia's grace is with you, you'll be rewarded with Manderville Gold Saucer points galore!
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_DAYLY_100_030: You can now purchase Mini Cactpot tickets.
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_SYSTEM_000_030: You can now purchase up to three Mini Cactpot tickets per day.
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_SYSTEM_000_031: The counter for Mini Cactpot tickets resets daily at   (Earth time).
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_SYSTEM_000_032: Each Mini Cactpot ticket has nine slots arranged in a three-by-three grid. Each slot is randomly assigned a number from one to nine. When you purchase a ticket, a single number will be revealed.
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_SYSTEM_000_033: To play, uncover any three other numbers. Based on that information, guess the sum of each line.
TEXT_SUBGSC103_00488_SYSTEM_000_034: Finally, select a single line. The payout of MGP will depend upon the total sum of the line you have chosen.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_010: Welcome to the Jumbo Cactpot, where the Eorzea of your dreams is only four digits away! Can I tempt you with a ticket, ?
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_Q1_000_000: Try your hand at the Jumbo Cactpot?
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_020: Well, the customer is always right...but what's life without a little risk? When you're ready to take a chance, I'll be waiting.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_030: Excellent! Let me enlighten you as to how it all works.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_031: First, you purchase a Jumbo Cactpot ticket from me. You then pick your four lucky numbers─any from zero to nine that tickle your fancy─and inscribe them upon your ticket.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_032: After that, simply wait till we announce the winning number to see if you have any matches. Check your digits from last to first─the more matches you have, the more Manderville Gold Saucer points you'll win!
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_033: If all your numbers match, then ding, ding, ding─you've hit the Cactpot! You'll receive an embarrassingly large number of MGP, and an extravagant prize besides!
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_034: And with the Jumbo Cactpot, the more participants there are, the grander the prizes become. Just imagine how many MGP you'll stand to win if all your friends and allies join in the fun!
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_035: When the time comes to draw the winning number, look no further than the lovely Cactpot cashier. She will provide you with everything from first prize to consolation points.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_WEEKLY_000_036: Last but not least, I will be here to assist you, day or night, if you are ever at a loss.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_SYSTEM_100_040: You can now purchase Jumbo Cactpot tickets.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_SYSTEM_000_040: You can now purchase Jumbo Cactpot tickets. The winning number for this lottery will be drawn every  (Earth time).
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_SYSTEM_000_041: After the drawing, you will have until the following  (Earth time) to claim your prize.
TEXT_SUBGSC104_00489_SYSTEM_000_042: Once this one-week period ends, please be aware that you will be unable to claim any prizes from the previous drawing.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_BUTLER00499_000_000: You are an adventurer, yes? Oh, thank the Twelve! If it would not be too much trouble, might you spare a few bells of your time to assist my master and me with a most trying predicament?
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_BUTLER00499_000_001: As you doubtless have observed from the colorful decorations about town, Little Ladies' Day festivities are in full swing here in the sultanate. It is in the spirit of this season that Master Nanapasi has devised a plan to make his dear daughter's dreams come true.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_BUTLER00499_000_002: And yet, I fear the preparations have proven far more troublesome than he foresaw. Why, the last time I saw him, he was racing up and down Emerald Avenue like a chocobo with its head cut off! Please, friend, pray lend us a helping hand.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_BUTLERXXX_000_003: Master Nanapasi means only the best for his daughter, yet it seems he has bitten off more than he can chew. You will help him, won't you, friend? You will find him a little bit further down the street.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_010: What say you, Ninimo!? Behold this grand stage, soon to be adorned with life-size figurines the likes of which this realm has not looked upon for ages! Just sit back and enjoy the show─Daddy dearest will see to the rest!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_100_011: What say you, Ninimo!? Behold this grand stage and the life-size figurines which stand so elegantly and majestically upon it! It is but a matter of time before work is complete. Just sit back and enjoy the show─Daddy dearest will see to the rest!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NINIMO_000_011: How many times must I tell you, Father? I did not ask for you or anyone to build a stage for me. I wanted only to create something with my own─
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_012: Do not be ridiculous, my dear girl! What sort of father would I be if I let my very own little princess soil her dainty hands on her special day? ...No father at all, I say!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NINIMO_000_013: ...Very well, Father. I shall look forward to seeing the finished work, I suppose... <sigh>
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_015: Oh, Nanapasi! You've done it this time, you bloody half-wit! She hates you, absolutely hates─hm? Do you have business with me, stranger?
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_016: Truly!? You are a godssend, my adventuring friend! I beg of you, lend your strength and deliver this fool of a father from his own folly!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_017: ...F-Forgive me. I have a habit of letting my emotions get the better of me. Might you join me outside the Quicksand to discuss the matter further? A brief stroll should suffice to cool my head.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_018: (He just doesn't understand! Oh, Ninimo, if only you had the courage to say something...)
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_020: It is heartening to see you, friend. Your assistance in this matter is appreciated to no end.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_021: I trust you're aware of Little Ladies' Day and its origins? Each year, in honor of Princess Edvya─the adventure-seeking little lady that the festival is based on─artisans across the realm craft exquisite dolls, and fathers play doting seneschals to their precious princesses.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_022: My Ninimo, strong-willed girl that she is, never took much interest in the festivities─until this year, that is. “Father, Father!” she said to me one day, “Would it not be divine if we could recreate the grand stage and life-sized dolls of the Thorne Dynasty!?”
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_023: <sniff> Oh, it brought a tear to my eye! Through the years, my work had prevented me from duly doting upon my daughter, and she learned quickly to fend for herself. And yet here was my beautiful girl, for the first time I could remember, practically begging a favor of her daddy dearest!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_100_023: I thought to myself: do the tales not speak of how Princess Edvya's ruse and the events with the miller's family brought about newfound understanding between the sultan and his daughter?
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_110_023: Yes, my heart leapt, this is my chance to bridge the chasm that gapes within our own household, and forge a new bond with the daughter for whom I care so dearly!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_024: ...So it was that I swore to Ninimo that I would personally oversee the creation of the most magnificent Little Ladies' Day decoration Ul'dah had ever seen!
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_025: Sadly, it appears that I spoke too soon. I quickly learned that to recreate the decorations of the Thorne days would require materials which are all but impossible to find in modern days.
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_026: Costumes and accessories I have managed to prepare, but if the dolls themselves are not of Thorne Dynasty make, any attempt to dress them up will seem hollow indeed. I fear that at this rate, my promise to my daughter will prove an empty one...
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_028: As you saw, I have prepared a grand stage, but with nothing to adorn it, it is a very lonely one indeed. This is where you come in. What say you, friend? Will you come to this hapless father's aid!?
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_029: With the help of your fellow adventurers, we have managed to secure some of the materials we need, but I fear we are still far from creating a piece that will win my dear daughter's heart. What say you, friend? Will you come to this hapless father's aid!?
TEXT_FESPDY101_00499_NANAPASI_000_030: If you can find it in your heart to help us, pray take this map and speak with my attendant here. She will tell you everything you need to know. You have my sincere gratitude for any and all assistance that you are able to offer!
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_000: Greetings, kind adventurer. On behalf of Master Nanapasi, allow me to express my most sincere gratitude for your cooperation in this matter.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_001: As you have heard from the man himself, my master seeks to assemble a modern-day recreation of the Little Ladies' Day decorations seen in the Thorne Dynasty days, as a special gift to his dear daughter Ninimo. Sadly, the task has proved a daunting one.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_002:
While tales of the dolls' beauty are many, actual descriptive records of the materials used and the means by which they were made are not so easily had. To further complicate things, the Thorne dolls were destroyed back when the Ul Dynasty came to power.
While this was doubtless done in order to sever cultural ties to the past and reinforce the Ul Dynasty's rule, it does not make our job any easier.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_003: That said, all hope is not lost. It is said that among those tasked with the charge, there were those so smitten with the dolls' beauty that they simply could not bear to destroy them, instead concealing them outside of the city walls.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_004: If these stories are true, then my master's dream may yet be realized. Though the remnants will be too ancient to use as they are, any parts we could obtain would go far in allowing us to properly fashion our recreation.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_005: The map entrusted to you by Master Nanapasi marks the location where some dolls were said to be buried. If you could venture afield and recover whatever might yet be found, we would be forever in your debt.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_000_006: The doll parts sought by Master Nanapasi and his attendants can be obtained from treasure chests discovered by examining Thorne Dynasty maps.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_000_007: Use the action Decipher to extract the map and examine its contents.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_000_008: The action Decipher can be obtained by completing the quest “Treasures and Tribulations,” which can be undertaken by speaking to H'loonh in Wineport.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_000_009: If you are unable to learn Decipher, or if you are below the recommended level of 40, you are encouraged to form a party with your fellow adventurers and undertake the quest together.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_100_009: Thorne Dynasty maps can be obtained by completing this quest, or purchased from the capitalistic chambermaid stationed in the immediate vicinity.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_009: Welcome back, adventurer. Have you come to offer us your aid once more? We would be forever in your debt for any doll parts you are able to recover.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_110_009: Thorne Dynasty maps can be obtained by completing this quest, or purchased from the capitalistic chambermaid stationed in the immediate vicinity.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_010: Welcome back, friend. On behalf of Master Nanapasi, allow me to once again extend my most sincere gratitude for your efforts on our behalf.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_011: As you know, my master intends to work with Miss Ninimo to transform the menagerie before us into a spectacle of beauty the likes of which Ul'dah has never seen! Should you be so inclined, we would welcome your continued assistance.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_020: Your return heartens us, friend! Were you perchance able to recover any of the extant doll parts that we seek?
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_MAID00500_000_021: Why, yes, this should serve marvelously! Master Nanapasi will be overjoyed. We are forever grateful for your service, and would be even more so if you would deign to lend us your aid again.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_000_022: This quest may be undertaken multiple times. The quantity of doll parts recovered in a given World will be reflected in the appearance of the doll stage, which will grow more and more extravagant over time.
TEXT_FESPDY102_00500_SYSTEM_000_023: Join forces with your fellow adventurers, complete the quest as often as you desire, and revel in the splendor of Nanapasi's creation as it takes full form!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_000: Impeccable timing, my friend! Thanks in no small part to your efforts, the doll stage that I promised to my dear daughter is at long last complete─and it is truly a wonder to behold, if I do say so myself!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_001: When my dear Ninimo sees this, there will be no doubt in her mind as to the depths of her father's affection. Yes, I daresay no other man in the realm has gone to such lengths to make his daughter's dreams a reality!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_002: As a token of my gratitude for all you have done, I would like to personally invite you to attend as I unveil the grand stage before my daughter's eyes. Go on ahead─I shall see to it that my daughter is along shortly.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_003: As a token of my gratitude for all you have done, I would like to personally invite you to attend as I unveil the grand stage before my daughter's eyes. Go on ahead if you will─I shall make sure that Ninimo is along momentarily.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_010: Behold, friend! Tell me, are these not the most magnificent dolls you have ever set eyes upon!?
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_011: Ninimo's dreams, my superior craftsmanship, and the kindness of you and your fellow adventurers have come together to realize one of the greatest masterworks Ul'dah has ever known!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_012: Yes, my dear daughter will surely be blinded by the shining radiance of her father's love! Oh, and speak of an angel... Here she comes!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_014: My heavens, it's...it's beautiful! And you did this for me? I...I do not know what to say, Father...
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_015: You are the adventurer who made this possible, yes? Then I owe you my thanks as well. For I have finally found the opportunity─and the courage─to tell my father what I should have told him long ago.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_016: ...Father. The doll stand you have built for me is beautiful...beautiful beyond my wildest dreams. But to speak the truth, it is not what I truly wanted.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_017: You are quick to dote on me, but I fear you are as blind to my true wishes as the sultan was to Princess Edvya's in the legend of yore...
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_018: For you see, Father, it was not this grand spectacle itself that I truly desired. To speak the truth, even the humblest replica would have sufficed, had only the two of us created it...together.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_019: ...N-Ninimo. So that is why you were so insistent on... Th-That is why you... Oh, Thal take me─what have I done!?
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_020: Oh, what an imbecile I have been! A more unworthy father this realm has never known! Ninimo, my dearest daughter, what can your fool of a father do to earn your forgiveness!?
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_021: Oh, Father...do not berate yourself so. I never doubted your love for me. I was merely waiting for the day that you would finally understand─a day that has finally come.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_100_021: All I ask is that you allow me to contribute to the decorations in my own way. After all, it is hardly fair to impose solely on the generosity of adventurers.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_022: Oh, Ninimo! My dearest daughter's kindness truly knows no bounds! I daresay that at this moment, there is no prouder father in all of Eorzea!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_023: ...Nor a happier daughter, for the events of this day have brought us together much as it happened so many centuries ago for Baldric and Edvya Thorne.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_024: ...N-Ninimo! Promise that you will always be my princess!
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_025: Oh, Father... <sniff> Must you always be so sentimental?
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NINIMO_000_026: I cannot thank you enough, adventurer. Were it not for your kindness, I would not have had the opportunity to open my heart to my father on this most fitting of occasions.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_027: ...And I thank you as well, friend, not only for your part in seeing my creation to completion, but for bridging the gaping chasm of misunderstanding that threatened to tear the two of us apart. Pray visit again, that I might properly reward you for all you have done.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_030: There you are, friend! After discussing the matter, Ninimo and I have decided to embark on a reshaping of the doll display─one that this time shall be crafted to meet the aesthetic ideals of father and daughter alike.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_031: Doubtless we will continue to have our differences, as all parents and their children do. But now that we are able to share our thoughts freely, I have no doubt that the bonds between us will grow even stronger in the days and years to come.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_032: Word has it that there are still doll parts out there to be found. If you would be so kind, any continued assistance you might offer would be a great boon to us in our efforts.
TEXT_FESPDY103_00501_NANAPASI_000_033: Little Ladies' Day comes around each and every year, but I know now that I was blind to the true meaning of the occasion until today. Please accept this as a token of a father's most heartfelt gratitude.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_001: Well, well, what have we here? Another adventurer come to bask in my splendor? I am Lady Lisette of House Valentione, but should you be willing and able enough to serve as my retainer, I give you leave to call me Lissie!♪
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_002: Ah, but I know you! The fashions may change, but I could never forget the name that goes with that face. How glad am I to see you again, , and on this day more than any!
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_003: Tell me, my dear: might I tempt you into lending yourself to our cause? We need all the bodies we can claim, and most gladly would I lay my hands on yours. A  such as yourself would make a fine bedfellow!
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_004: For today is Valentione's Day, and once again we of House Valentione come bearing a simple message: ardor and affection for all! Such is the solemn vow of our house, ever since the days of my uncountably great grandmother, the Countess Arabelle, who braved every hardship in a lifelong quest for love!
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_005: So it is that we too have journeyed from our homeland to herald her heroic message. For too long have Eorzean hearts been stifled by the miasmata of apathy and abashment. Ours shall be the wind that dispels these poisonous fogs, and sweeps every shrinking violet into the arms of their beloved!
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_006: Or at least, so was the plan. We sought to lend our strength to those unable to confess their feelings in person, yet it seems there are some whose inability stems not from diffidence, but from ignorance. And honestly, how do they expect our arrows of love to find their target, when they themselves cannot?
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_100_006: Thus do we seek the assistance of worldly-wise adventurers in the aid of these helpless souls. If you consider yourself a fair match for the task, then go to my man Hortefense─he will tell you more of our predicament. Oh, and don't forget to tell him that Lissie sent you!♪
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_LISSETE_000_008: Do not dally here all , ─there is work to be done! If you have a heart to aid those who suffer without, then speak with my man Hortefense. Oh, and don't forget to tell him that Lissie sent you!♪
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_010: Happy Valentione's Day, ! ...You say that a “Lissie” sent you? There must be some mistake─I know no one by that name. Unless─dare I dream?─I have a secret admirer!? Tell me, adventurer: does the lady send a note? Chocolate? A ring, perhaps?
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_011: Oh ho ho! So it was Lady Lisette who sent you! Pray pardon my misunderstanding. I am most grateful for any assistance you can offer. As my lady informed you, we have run into something of an impasse in our efforts to ensure that no love remains unspoken across Eorzea.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_012: Allow me to explain: every year, a delegation led by House Valentione departs from Ishgard to travel the length and breadth of Eorzea, urging the people to air their passions─to confess their true feelings to their beloved with a word of affection, or a sentimental gift of some kind.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_013: Yet there are some who struggle to do such a simple thing, their hearts silenced by shyness. It is to these poor souls that I and my emissaries have come to offer our services. We lubricate the wheels of love, so to speak, by delivering heartfelt missives on a timid suitor's behalf.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_014: However, there are some who have sought out our services for another reason: they lack not the confidence to confess their love, but merely the knowledge of where their loved ones are. Sworn as we are to bring succor to every pining soul, we have pledged ourselves to their cause.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_015: Yet I fear we Ishgardians have been cloistered in our own lands too long to be of any use in tracking these missing sweethearts down. We lack the knowledge of Eorzean geography that would allow us to deduce their locations from the scant clues the petitioners can provide.
TEXT_FESVLT101_00512_HORTEFENSE_000_016: Which is precisely where you come in. No doubt you have traveled much in your adventures, and have a better idea as to the lay of the land. And if Lady Lisette herself recommends you, who am I to disagree? With you aboard, , none shall go unloved this day!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_HORTEFENSE_000_000: A lady from this very city came to us, requesting our help to deliver a Valentione's gift to her roving swain. Yet, try as we might, we have been unable to pick up his trail in this labyrinth of trees. Why, if not for the bread crumbs I scattered in my wake, I might very well have been lost myself!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_HORTEFENSE_000_001: Mayhap a  such as yourself, who is more familiar with these parts, will find some insight in what little information the lady can provide. Pray speak with my man at the amphitheatre gates─he will introduce you to the lady in question.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_HORTEFENSE_000_002: I could find my way through a blizzard in a snowfield by the merest undulation of the ice, yet in these forests I cannot tell one tree from the other. Pray meet with my man by the gates, and listen to the poor maiden's story. No doubt there is some vital clue in her words that we have overlooked.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_MISSIONARY00515_000: Good , . Might you be one of the assistants of whom Lord Hortefense informed me? Very good. I shall fetch the lady forthwith.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_GIRLA00515_000_011: I am most grateful for your assistance, adventurer. If my darling doesn't receive my gift before Valentione's Day is over, we shall be doomed to part. It may seem like mere superstition to you, but for me it is painfully real! Please find him, I beg you!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_GIRLA00515_000_012: My love is an adventurer like yourself. He set out on an expedition some days ago, but he has yet to return. I'm sure no harm can have come to him─he's so strong, and brave, and handsome─but I do wish he would have told me where he was going.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_GIRLA00515_000_013: This is my gift for him─a charm I prepared from a cutting of the most fragrant tree in the Twelveswood. I agonized for hours over selecting the perfect spray, and poured my heart and soul into whittling it just so. If he could only see it, I am sure he would understand just how much I care...
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_GIRLA00515_000_014: ...Do I have any idea where he might have gone? Well...I can't be sure it's related, but he oft spoke of chocobos before he left. I'm sorry─it isn't much to go on, I know...
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_GIRLA00515_000_015: ...Do I have any idea where he might have gone? Well...I can't be sure it's related, but he oft spoke of the Central Shroud before he left. I'm sorry─it isn't much to go on, I know...
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_GIRLA00515_000_016: Forgive me for burdening you with my troubles, but I simply must have him know of my love before it is too late. If you could find him for me and deliver my gift, I would be eternally grateful!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_MISSIONARY00515_000: So there you have it. That is the information we have to go on. Do you think you will be able to find this adventuring sweetheart of hers before Valentione's Day is over?

Should you find the task too daunting, perhaps you might discuss the matter with your fellow adventurers. They may have bumped into this fellow on their travels, or gleaned some other clue as to his current location.

I am afraid that all I can offer is a redoubled request: please do whatever you can to find this man, and deliver the charm unto him. For this is Valentione's Day, and as a loyal servant of House Valentione, it pains me to see such a gift go undelivered. I am counting on you, !
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SYSTEM_000_020: During this quest, the location of the absent adventurer will not be marked on the map, nor will any identifying symbol appear above the character's head. Speak with other players and share your information, and try to find him!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_MISSIONARY00515_000: It seems the gentleman in question was talking about chocobos before he left. Might he be looking to hire one...or purchase one, perhaps? I fear I would not know where to go were I to attempt the same. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

It seems the gentleman in question was talking about the Central Shroud before he left. ...Which way is that again? Forgive me, ─I fear I know too little of these forests to be of any use to you. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might be of more help?
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_HORTEFENSE_000_023: What ho, ! How fares your search? I must make a little confession: you are not the only adventurer I have asked to assist us in this matter. When it comes to finding loved ones, the more the merrier, I say!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_LOVER00515_000_030:
Ah, a fellow adventurer! , is it? Might you be interested in joining my party? I was just about to head down into─
...What? You have a Valentione's Day gift for me?
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_LOVER00515_000_031: A charm...? Why, this is a gift from my darling! I would recognize her craftsmanship anywhere. Thank you for bringing it to me, ...but however did you find me? I don't recall telling anyone that I was coming to Bentbranch.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_LOVER00515_000_032: I see... Then I thank you again for the trouble you've taken. Did you know that these charms have become something of a Valentione's Day tradition in Gridania? Superstition has it that couples who fail to exchange them are fated to separate, and my lady has quite convinced herself this is true.
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_LOVER00515_000_033: ...A fact that I had quite forgotten. Forgive me, , but I had best return to Gridania─I have a charm to prepare. Thank you once more for seeking me out, my friend─if not for you, chances are I would be sleeping in the stables tonight!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_MISSIONARY00515_000: Welcome back, , and congratulations on finding the missing man! He passed through the city gates not a few minutes ago, the charm at his belt. There they are over there, do you see? Reunited at last, and displaying every evidence of happiness!
