Thanks to your magnificent efforts, their devotion to each other has flowered anew! You have done a great service for House Valentione this day.
...And speaking of services to House Valentione, did you happen to come across a “noblewoman of paramount virtue” on your travels?

Prithee, do not misunderstand─I do not seek one for myself. Lord Hortefense requested that I search for such a lady. If you happen to know of anyone who fits the description, I am sure he would be most grateful for the information.
But for now, your work in Gridania is complete! Thank you, ─without  like you, the world would be a less passionate place!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_HORTEFENSE_000_045: How goes the search, my ? ...You have already located the missing man!? Oh, but that is wonderful news! I knew that I could rely on you!
TEXT_FESVLT102_00515_SYSTEM_000_050: You have successfully assisted the emissaries of House Valentione in all three city-states! Return to Hortefense in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to report your success.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_HORTEFENSE_000_000: My man in Ul'dah has met with a similarly sticky situation: a number of traders have picked a most inopportune time to go on their travels, leaving their lovers bereft. Sadly, my assistant has met with no more success than I in tracking down the missing men.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_HORTEFENSE_000_001: Prithee go to him, and see if you can make head or tail─or better yet, both─of the information his petitioners can provide. You shall find him at the Ruby Road Exchange. I shall send word to him of your imminent arrival: he will be gratified to know that succor is on its way!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_HORTEFENSE_000_002: Prithee go to my man in Ul'dah, , and offer him your assistance. Let it be the heat of the deserts of Thanalan, and not their desolation, that finds its way into the people's hearts!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_MISSIONARY00523_000: So you're the  Ser Hortefense sent to assist me, are you? Let's see if you're as shrewd as he claims. Wait right here─I'll fetch the girl.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_011: Please, , you've got to help me! It's Valentione's Day, and me old feller's nowhere to be found!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_012: I don't reckon nothing's happened to him─he's always going missing. Me darling's a trader, you see. Going to get himself on the Syndicate one day, but till then, he's out plying the trade routes. Sometimes he'll be gone for weeks, then turn up on me doorstep out of the blue, laden with presents!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_013: But the minute I try to give him something, he bloody well disappears again! Here's the letter I wrote him─poured me heart and soul into it, I did. Slipped in a little chunk of topaz and all. If you could track him down and hand it over to him, I'd be ever so grateful!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_014: ...Did he say where he was going? Not bloody likely─trade secrets, ain't it? I did hear him talking to a merchant friend of his before he left, though─something to do with “copper.” Does that mean anything to you?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_015: ...Did he say where he was going? Not bloody likely─trade secrets, ain't it? I did hear him talking to a merchant friend of his before he left, though─something to do with some “gates.” Does that mean anything to you?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_016: ...Did he say where he was going? Not bloody likely─trade secrets, ain't it? I did hear him talking to a merchant friend of his before he left, though─something to do with a “king.” Does that mean anything to you?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLA00523_000_017: I know it's a lot to ask, but if you could find me darling and give him me letter, I'd be much obliged. Why, if he don't get it, he might die of heartbreak! Or even worse, go broke! Our future happiness depends on you, !
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_018: Oh, hello. Are you the adventurer who is helping the Ishgardian emissaries deliver presents? Thank you for offering your assistance. The gentleman here has been ever so kind, but sadly he seems woefully ill equipped to locate my darling.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_019: My love is a highly successful trader, always traveling about Thanalan, negotiating with his clients. Why, he's out there now, somewhere in the desert... All alone... Ah, but it breaks my heart to think of him like that on this day of romance! He must know that he is loved!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_020: I stayed up all night to draft this letter. The words simply poured out of my heart and settled on the page! Would you be able to deliver it for me? Be careful how you hold it─I put a small piece of topaz in the envelope. A token of my most heartfelt wish...
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_021: ...Did he say where he might be going? Not to me. Not directly, anyway. I did overhear something of his conversation with another trader, the day before he departed─something about a “mine.” I'm afraid that's all I remember...
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_022: ...Did he say where he might be going? Not to me. Not directly, anyway. I did overhear something of his conversation with another trader, the day before he departed─something about a “saloon.” I'm afraid that's all I remember...
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_023: ...Did he say where he might be going? Not to me. Not directly, anyway. I did overhear something of his conversation with another trader, the day before he departed─something about the Sunway. I'm afraid that's all I remember...
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_GIRLB00523_000_024: Forgive me for placing this burden on you, but I would be ever so grateful if you could find my darling, and hand him my letter. I cannot bear the thought of my beloved spending Valentione's Day alone, without a word of love to soothe his aching heart!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_MISSIONARY00523_000: Is there anything more beautiful than a woman in love? Gladly would I sift through every grain of sand in the desert to reunite her with her darling! Yet without some firm idea of where to begin the search, I fear the man may not be found before the festival is over.

If only we had a better idea as to his destination... Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have gleaned some other clue from the lady's words? Pray speak with them─there must be at least one among your number who knows where the man can be found.

The reputation of House Valentione rests on your shoulders, adventurer. Should you fail in this mission, the very foundations of our house might crumble, and our honor collapse! You must find this man, or die trying!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SYSTEM_000_028: During this quest, the location of the traveling trader will not be marked on the map, nor will an identifying marker appear above the character's head. Speak with other players and share your information, and try to find him!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_MISSIONARY00523_000: The missing trader was heard speaking of “copper” before he set out...though I'm afraid it means less than a little to me, stranger to these lands that I am. Does the word give you any inkling as to where the man might be found?

The missing trader was heard speaking of “gates” before he set out...though I'm afraid it means less than a little to me, stranger to these lands that I am. Does the word give you any inkling as to where the man might be found?

The missing trader was heard speaking of a “king” before he set out...though I'm afraid it means less than a little to me, stranger to these lands that I am. Does the word give you any inkling as to where the man might be found?

The missing trader was heard speaking of a “mine” before he set out...though I'm afraid it means less than a little to me, stranger to these lands that I am. Does the word give you any inkling as to where the man might be found?

The missing trader was heard speaking of a “saloon” before he set out...though I'm afraid it means less than a little to me, stranger to these lands that I am. Does the word give you any inkling as to where the man might be found?

The missing trader was heard speaking of a “Sunway” before he set out...though I'm afraid it means less than a little to me, stranger to these lands that I am. Does the word give you any inkling as to where the man might be found?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_040: You're an adventurer, aren't you? If you're looking for a trade, I'm afraid you've come to the wrong feller─I only deal wholesale. ...What!? You think I'm the “darling” you've been searching for?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_041: Oh, you mean her darling! You had me worried there for a minute, . Aye, I'm your man, alright. I'd recognize that handwriting anywhere, and that scent... Ahhh! Oh, and what's this in the envelope─a little bit of topaz? She's a girl after my own heart!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_042: For a few years now, it's been a tradition in Ul'dah to send some kind of precious stone with your Valentione's Day letters. Something the Miners' Guild dreamed up, and not a bad little gil-spinner, either. I wish I'd thought of something like it myself.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_043: The way they've set it up, all the different stones have got different meanings. And if I'm not mistaken─which I'm not─topaz stands for “prosperity.” By giving me this, she's wishing me success in all my commercial transactions.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_044: And I think her wish is already coming true. Why, I've just signed and sealed my biggest deal in years! I'll head back to Ul'dah to give her my thanks, and a ruby as big as my fist! Thanks to you, too, adventurer, for coming all this way to find me─you've made me a very happy man!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_045: You're an adventurer, aren't you? Sorry, , but I'm not that kind of trader─I only deal wholesale. ...You've got a letter for me?
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_LOVER00523_000_046: Let's see... “From your darling”... Begging your pardon, , but my darling's handwriting doesn't look anything like that, and that ghastly fragrance... Pooh! I think you must have got me mixed up with somebody else.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SYSTEM_000_047: This is not the trader you are looking for. Try searching somewhere else.
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_MISSIONARY00523_000: I've been waiting for you, adventurer! It seems Ser Hortefense's judgment was sound─you truly are a most discerning  indeed. Pray observe the fruits of your labor...

As you can well see, the lady's plea has been answered. My heart is afire to see such affection─whether through joy or jealousy, I know not...and care not! All that matters is that two more souls have found love this day─a love that could not have found its mark without your guidance.

Pray return to Lord Hortefense, and tell him that our obstacles in Ul'dah are overcome. Oh, and could I ask you to relay a further message? Please inform him that I have as yet found no trace of the lady he seeks.

I am sure he will be disappointed by the news, but hardly surprised. Ser Hortefense seeks a lady of the Ishgardian nobility, whom he met just once many years ago, and has been searching for ever since. Halone knows what such a lady would be doing all the way down here in Thanalan.
But at least one love has been found this day, and it is all thanks to you, ! The doors of House Valentione shall ever remain open to you!
TEXT_FESVLT103_00523_SYSTEM_000_060: You have successfully assisted the emissaries of House Valentione in all three city-states! Return to Hortefense in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to report your success.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_RAUBAHN_000_000: For the final phase of the operation, my Flames will storm Castrum Meridianum and suppress what is left of the imperial garrison. If all goes well, this will allow you to reach the Praetorium unopposed─fit and ready for your encounter with the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_RAUBAHN_000_001: Yours is the most dangerous mission of all, but the best must bear the heaviest burden, and you're the best we have. There's not another soul in this realm that could see this deed done, and Merlwyb and Kan-E are of the same mind as me.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_RAUBAHN_000_002: Though all hangs on your success, you must not let our plight make you desperate. Victory belongs to the bold, not the reckless. Bards are wont to sing of heroes who valued their life at naught next to honor, love, and liberty, but I tell you now: that which men value at naught, they sell cheap. Risk no more than you must, you hear me?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_RAUBAHN_000_003: Now, best you were off─we have work to do, the both of us. See that your preparations are in order, then report to Cid. He awaits you with the Enterprise at the Ceruleum Processing Plant. May Rhalgr grant you strength.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_010: The Enterprise is at your disposal. When you're ready to head for the Praetorium, you need only say the word.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_011: If we succeed in destroying the Ultima Weapon, it will deal a crippling blow to the Empire's hopes of conquest. After that, the XIVth Legion would not dare to move against us─barring the discovery of further Allagan doomsday devices, that is...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_012: Let's be on our way, ! Gaius and his plaything await!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_015: The Enterprise is at your disposal. When you're ready to head for the Praetorium, you need only say the word.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_301: The Ultima Weapon will almost certainly be housed in the depths of the complex.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_302: You know, the sort of place a Warrior of Light would boldly go with no thought for personal safety. Oh, if only one were with us!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_341: Ah, Cid, my boy... You are late.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_342: There is something I always meant to tell you, yet the time never seemed right. It concerns your father.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_344: In the winter of his years, Midas came to abhor his part in Meteor. He told me that he wanted nothing more than to wash his hands of the whole sordid business.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_345: But he did not wash his hands of it. He helmed the project until the day it killed him!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_346: Come now, Cid...you must know that he did not have the luxury of choice. By the time he realized his error, it was too late. Meteor had him completely in its thrall.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_347: Shortly before his...transformation, mayhap sensing that something was amiss, your father confided to me all the regrets of his life. Most of them concerned you.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_348: Early on in your career, he realized that while you had a talent for devising armaments, it would never fulfill you. Long before you knew your own mind, he saw that you would be far happier using your knowledge for peaceful purposes, and the thought touched him. He was a changed man for it, though he could not let it show.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_349: You ripped open walls in this place just so you could say this to me!? What is it you want, Gaius!?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_350: I want you at my side, Cid. Take up your father's mantle, and become the Empire's lead engineer. It is your destiny.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_351: My father had a change of heart─you said so yourself! Besides, I have long known my destiny, and I assure you, it lies not with the Empire!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_352:
A pity.
And what of you, adventurer? Will you not consider making common cause with me?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_353: With your powers joined to mine, we might do much for this realm. Together, we could bring order to Eorzea, and usher in a lasting peace.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_354: No? And I can expect no better answer than this? So be it. It was your strength that made me proffer my hand in friendship, and it is your strength that makes me proffer now my blade. Save as an ally, you are too dangerous to be let to remain.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_GAIUS_000_355: Run, Cid. Or stay. It makes no matter. You cannot escape the past.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_370: Knowing Gaius, he is headed for the Ultima Weapon. If we find him, so too will we find our quarry.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_371: With these instruments, we can monitor every nook and cranny in the castrum.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_372: I think it's time we divided our forces. Pray go on and give chase. I'll track your movements from here and guide you through the complex.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_373: We'll stay in contact via linkpearl. Be careful, all right?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_401: I trust you recognize our old friend. “Maggie,” was it? They must have shipped her here from Centri.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_402: Considering all she's been through, it's a wonder she's still operational. Tough old girl!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_403: Now that you're suitably armed, you can blast open that bulkhead. The external walkway will take you back there.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_404: Follow it till you come upon a way down to the lower level.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_450: That bulkhead is composed of a special alloy. Extremely tough. Ordinary fire won't leave a mark, I'm afraid.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_451: You'll need to divert all power to the magitek cannon, as I did at Castrum Meridianum.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_452: The armor's core is like to expire from the strain, but there's no help for it if we want to press on.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_453: Now, listen well. Press...<buzzzzzz>...the control...<fizzzzzz>...engage ancillary...then fire away. Don't mind the warning lights.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_454: You're a natural at this! All right, the way's clear, but it's just you and your own two feet now, so be careful.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_500: You have been leaving a fine mess in your wake, adventurer.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_502: Garlond, old friend. How it warms the heart to hear your voice again after all these years.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_504: You sound well. It would seem this savage land agrees with you.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_505: The highest ranking tribunus of the XIVth... It was you all this time?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_506: Tell me, Garlond. How long do you intend to keep all the glory for yourself?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_508: Don't play the fool with me. Ever since the Academy, I have been condemned to live in your shadow.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_509: By all objective measure, I was the more talented of the two of us, yet that fact counted for naught beside your privileged birth. You were admired as the young prodigy simply because your father was the great Midas nan Garlond!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_510: When you defected, I felt sure my star would finally rise...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_511: But by disappearing, you acquired the status of a legend─your reputed genius gaining credence merely by dint of your absence! Instead of cursing you for a traitor, the people actually came to think of you more fondly! To this day, you are still the young prodigy of magitek!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_512: I, meanwhile, have ever been made to feel second-rate─I who have continued to serve our nation faithfully. Whenever I fail to excel─why, it is only to be expected! Yet when I exceed all reasonable expectations, people proclaim that I walk in the footsteps of the great Cid nan bloody Garlond!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_513: Nero, I...I don't know what to say.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_514: It matters not a whit what I achieve. Your existence has rendered mine worthless. Even Lord van Baelsar saw fit to offer you a place at his side─and this in spite of your betrayal! Did he extend any such offer to me─the man who has remained loyal to him for all these years? Why, no. He did not.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_515: Long have I endured this injustice...but no more.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_516: Lord van Baelsar is in the midst of activating the fully powered Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_517: It is my magnum opus─the creation that will win me the recognition I am due. I will not let anyone interfere.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_519: Ever since I first set foot in this benighted land, I have watched you─every move you have made, every step you have taken.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_520: You have felled eikons, a feat made possible by the Echo, a peculiar power which shields you from their corrupting influence.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_521: It is of little wonder that my lord has taken an interest in you.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_522: As have I, if truth be told. It is my desire to harness your power for use in the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_523: Should I succeed, Lord van Baelsar will surely take notice! Beside this, Garlond's achievements will be as child's play!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_524: Come, adventurer, and yield to me the secrets of your power!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_551: I am the greatest engineer...the Empire has ever seen! By my hands...the field of magitek...shall reach its zenith!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_NERO_000_552: Ahahahaha! The Ultima Weapon is activated, and it brims with the power of eikons! Nothing can withstand its might!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_555: In the instant prior to the blackout, the instruments detected a massive power surge from the deepest chamber.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_556: Gaius is certain to be there! We have no time to waste!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_557: Word arrived from the Alliance a short while ago. It seems the Order of the Twin Adder has completed its blockade of Castrum Centri.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_558: What hands they can spare are hastening this way even as we speak, and likewise for the Maelstrom. All that's left is to destroy the Ultima Weapon!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_559: ...I should warn you: the chamber which houses the target appears to be saturated with aetheric energies. There's bound to be heavy interference.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_CID_000_560: But even if we lose contact, you must go on. Just don't do anything I wouldn't do, all right?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200010_CID: Look for the lift's control panel─it'll be somewhere nearby.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200020_CID: Take the lift down, and you should find yourself in the chamber of the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200030_CID: Keep your eyes peeled─Gaius could be waiting for you down there.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200040_CID: Oh, and don't even think about dying. You're too bloody useful!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200050_CID: The interference is getting worse. I don't think the connection will last much─
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200060_GAIUS: Tell me...for whom do you fight?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200070_GAIUS: Hmph! Do you believe in Eorzea?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200080_GAIUS: Eorzea's unity is forged of falsehoods. Its city-states are built on deceit. And its faith is an instrument of deception.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200090_GAIUS: It is naught but a cobweb of lies. To believe in Eorzea is to believe in nothing.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200100_GAIUS: In Eorzea, the beast tribes often summon gods to fight in their stead─though your comrades only rarely respond in kind. Which is strange, is it not?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200110_GAIUS: Are the “Twelve” otherwise engaged? I was given to understand they were your protectors. If you truly believe them your guardians, why do you not repeat the trick that served you so well at Carteneau, and call them down?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200120_GAIUS: They will answer─so long as you lavish them with crystals and gorge them on aether.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200130_GAIUS: Your gods are no different from those of the beasts─eikons every one. Accept but this, and you will see how Eorzea's faith is bleeding the land dry.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200140_GAIUS: Nor is this unknown to your masters. Which prompts the question: why do they cling to these false deities? What drives even men of learning─even the great Louisoix─to grovel at their feet?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200150_GAIUS: The answer? Your masters lack the strength to do otherwise!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200160_GAIUS: For the world of man to mean anything, man must own the world.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200170_GAIUS: To this end, he hath fought ever to raise himself through conflict─to grow rich through conquest.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200180_GAIUS: And when the dust of battle settles, it is ever the strong who dictate the fate of the weak.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200190_GAIUS: Knowing this, but a single path is open to the impotent ruler─that of false worship. A path which leads to enervation and death.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200200_GAIUS: Only a man of power can rightly steer the course of civilization. And in this land of creeping mendacity, that one truth will prove its salvation.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200210_GAIUS: Come, champion of Eorzea, face me! Your defeat shall serve as proof of my readiness to rule!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_200220_GAIUS: It is only right that I should take your realm. For none among you has the power to stop me!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_300230_GAIUS: I had not thought to be so hard-pressed.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_300240_GAIUS: Your strength is...most impressive. Such power befits a ruler!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_300250_GAIUS: Yet you lack the resolve to put it to proper use. A waste.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_300260_GAIUS: Allow me, then, hero, to do that which you will not!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_300270_GAIUS: Bear witness to the true power of the Ultima Weapon!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400280_GAIUS: But the Ultima Weapon is all-powerful! Why does my enemy still stand!?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400290_GAIUS: Can  strength truly be so great?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400300_LAHABREAEORZ: It is the blessing of Light that confounds you.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400320_LAHABREAEORZ: Your foe acts under the protection of the Crystal  bears.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400350_LAHABREAEORZ: If you are to prevail, the hammer of Darkness must needs be brought to bear upon the shield of Light.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400360_LAHABREAEORZ: And so it shall, for the Ultima Weapon is host to a power of which you are as yet ignorant.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400380_LAHABREAEORZ: The Heart of Sabik. It is the Weapon's core─an enigma whose surface even the vaunted scholars of ancient Allag failed to scratch.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400390_LAHABREAEORZ: The magic within has lain dormant for eons.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400400_GAIUS: Of what magic do you speak?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400420_LAHABREAEORZ: I sought the life force of the primals for no other reason but to quicken the core. For the true power of the Ultima Weapon lies within its now-beating Heart!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400440_LAHABREAEORZ: No more than was necessary...for my god to be reborn.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400460_LAHABREAEORZ: The hour is at hand! Behold but a sliver of my god's power!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400470_LAHABREAEORZ: And from the deepest pit of the seven hells to the very pinnacle of the heavens, the world shall tremble! Unleash Ultima!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400490_GAIUS: Such devastation... This was not my intention...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400500_LAHABREAEORZ: Oh, Hydaelyn...it seems the task of keeping Your champion alive has exhausted what strength You had left.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400510_LAHABREAEORZ: Van Baelsar... Your enemy's shield is broken.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400520_LAHABREAEORZ: The rest I leave to you.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400540_GAIUS: But first, I must deal with you. The question of who is mightier remains!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_400550_GAIUS: Come, adventurer! Let us find the answer together!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_500570_GAIUS: Heed me... The subjects of a weak ruler must needs look to a higher power for providence...and their dependence comes at a cost to the realm.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_500580_GAIUS: The misguided elevate the frail... And the frail lead the people astray.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_500590_GAIUS: Unless a man of power wrests control...the cycle will never be broken.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_500600_GAIUS: You... You of all people must see the truth in this. You who have the strength to rule...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600620_LAHABREAEORZ: You boasted of unrivaled power. You were entrusted with the ultimate weapon. The ultimate magic!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600630_LAHABREAEORZ: And still you failed. So much for the glory of man.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600640_LAHABREAEORZ: The growing imbalance afflicting the planet must be redressed.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600650_LAHABREAEORZ: If it is permitted to worsen, the very laws of existence─both aetheric and physical─will be warped beyond all recognition.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600660_LAHABREAEORZ: Know you the root of this corruption? Hydaelyn!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600670_LAHABREAEORZ: Like a parasite, She must be burned out if the planet is to recover.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600680_LAHABREAEORZ: And naught but the return of the one true god will ensure Her complete excision.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600690_LAHABREAEORZ: Yet to pave the way for the master's return, a chaotic confluence of untold proportions must needs be brought about. And that will necessitate the presence of the primals.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600700_LAHABREAEORZ: Needless to say, both you and your Scion accomplices can not be suffered to interfere in this endeavor.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600710_LAHABREAEORZ: You will not leave this place alive.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_600720_LAHABREAEORZ: It is past time your flame was extinguished...“Bringer of Light.”
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_700730_HYDAELYN: If thou wouldst pierce the shadows...make thee a blade of Light.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_700760_LAHABREAEORZ: The Light...it binds them... They are too many!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_800780_GAIUS: And so my conquest ends, Cid.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900820_HYDAELYN: The Darkness hath fled before the unclosed brilliance of thy spirit.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900830_HYDAELYN: Yet it lingereth still beyond the sight of men, in forgotten corners of the world.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900840_HYDAELYN: In the depths of the abyss yet resideth the Dark One, watchful ever.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900850_HYDAELYN: Till this evil be cast out, never shall the world know aught but a passing peace.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900860_HYDAELYN: Yet for the present, a gentle light shineth o'er the realm of Eorzea.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900880_HYDAELYN: From sparkling mote shall it swell to glorious sun, and all the world shall bask in its warmth.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900890_HYDAELYN: Blessings and joy be upon thee.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_900900_HYDAELYN: Go forth, my child, and be as a beacon of hope for Eorzea and the lands beyond, through all the days of thy life.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A00910_SERPENTAGENT: My lady! All Twin Adder units have fallen back to the outer perimeter!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A00920_FLAMEAGENT: The Flames have completed their withdrawal, General!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A00950_RAUBAHN: Cid! Has there been no word?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A00980_YDA: 's going to make it! I know  is!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A00990_YSHTOLA: Yda is right. We must have faith.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01000_KANESENNA: Cid! Can they not be evacuated aboard the Enterprise?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01010_KANESENNA: That adventurer and the Scions are as the Warriors of Light reborn.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01020_KANESENNA: We cannot abandon them to their fate! Not again!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01030_CID: I wholeheartedly agree! But flying into the midst of that would only add to the fireworks!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01040_ALPHINAUD: There must be something we can do!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01050_MINFILIA: Please, Mother Hydaelyn. Please light  way through the darkness...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_901060_HYDAELYN: Look into the Light, my child. If thou wouldst see thy companions returned safe to thee, reach out to them now.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01080_YDA: Can it be─? Is it really !?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01090_PAPALYMO: I knew it! I knew it all along!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01100_KANESENNA: Who speaks...? The Crystal! She calls to us!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01110_MERLWYB: I hear Her! The voice of Hydaelyn Herself...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01120_RAUBAHN:
She speaks of...
Strike me down! No wonder  seemed familiar! 's one of the Warriors of Light!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01130_RAUBAHN: What are you smirking at, Cid!? You knew, didn't you!?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01140_CID: Oh, you mean our adventurer friend? Did I forget to mention  was one of the Warriors of Light?
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_A01160_MINFILIA: The shroud is lifted. They remember you...
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_MINFILIA_000_900: The Archons have conducted a preliminary investigation into the origin of the roar that rang out during the celebration. Their findings strongly suggest that a new primal has appeared.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_MINFILIA_000_901: The roar generated a distinctive wave pattern in the aether, a pattern observed only once before in history─five years ago, to be precise. I should like to think it mere coincidence, yet we cannot discount that possibility... Well, I trust I need say no more.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_MINFILIA_000_902: At great sacrifice, we have delivered Eorzea from the threat posed by the Empire and the primals, and thereby secured peace. We cannot well allow the realm to be plunged into chaos once more.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_MINFILIA_000_903: You have given your all for our cause, risking life and limb on I know not how many occasions, yet our struggle continues, and we need you now no less than before.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_MINFILIA_000_904: Please continue to stand with us, and together we shall safeguard the future of the realm─of this very star!
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SYSTEM_000_910: You can now fly while mounted in La Noscea, Thanalan, the Black Shroud, Coerthas central highlands, and Mor Dhona.
TEXT_MANFST503_00524_SYSTEM_000_911: To take flight, simply jump while mounted.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_HORTEFENSE_000_000: My man in La Noscea reports a veritable surfeit of ladies who seek our services in locating their absent swains. Despite the increased numbers, we have met with no more success in finding these men. I do hope that they haven't succumbed to the waves...or the sharp side of a pirate's cutlass.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_HORTEFENSE_000_001: Pray go to Limsa Lominsa, , and introduce yourself to my subordinate─you will find him by the Aftcastle. He will present one of these wanting women to you, so that you might listen to her tale of love and woe, and gather what clues you can.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_HORTEFENSE_000_002: The emissary awaits you in Limsa Lominsa, . Prithee go to him and assist him in his mission, lest the city itself be washed away by a flood of lonely tears!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_MISSIONARY00527_000: Might you be the  Ser Hortefense sent to assist me? I am most grateful for your help. To be honest, I was quite at a loss how to proceed... Allow me to introduce you to one of the ladies who requires our services.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_011: 'Ere, are you the 'venturer who reckons  can ferret out me feller? Ye don't look too “worldly-wise” to me, but I suppose ye'll do. Any 'elp ye can give me's better than a slap in the chops with a wet fish.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_012: Me feller works a wagon, carryin' whatever comes in at the docks to wherever it needs takin'. It ain't a glamorous life, but it's regular work, and at least it keeps 'im out of 'arm's way. Only problem is, I got no way o' knowin' where 'e's got to 'alf the time.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_013: If ye manage to track 'im down, give 'im this, will ye? It's a bit o' mint chocolate─'is favorite. Cooked it up meself, I did. One whiff o' this, and even a daft bastard like 'im'll realize how much I love 'im.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_014: ...Do I know where 'e went? Do I bugger. I never reckoned 'e'd be gone this long, so I weren't payin' much attention to what 'e were blatherin' on about before 'e left. All I remember's 'im sayin' somethin' about “fruit.” Does that mean anythin' to ye?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_015: ...Do I know where 'e went? Do I bugger. I never reckoned 'e'd be gone this long, so I weren't payin' much attention to what 'e were blatherin' on about before 'e left. All I remember's 'im sayin' somethin' about a “settlement.” Does that mean anythin' to ye?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_016: ...Do I know where 'e went? Do I bugger. I never reckoned 'e'd be gone this long, so I weren't payin' much attention to what 'e were blatherin' on about before 'e left. All I remember's 'im sayin' somethin' about “pirates.” Does that mean anythin' to ye?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_017: ...Do I know where 'e went? Do I bugger. I never reckoned 'e'd be gone this long, so I weren't payin' much attention to what 'e were blatherin' on about before 'e left. All I remember's 'im sayin' somethin' about a “plantation.” Does that mean anythin' to ye?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLA00527_000_018: It ain't much to go on, but if ye can somehow get that chocolate to 'im, ye'll 'ave me thanks. The poor ol' bastard probably thought I was ignorin' 'im, but I weren't! I were just too busy thinkin' up what to make to show 'ow much I love 'im! If 'e ends the day with naught, we'll be finished!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_019: Are you the adventurer who thinks  can find my man? I should be ever so grateful if you could.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_020: My man isn't missing, per se─I just don't know where he is. He's a wagoner by trade, so he travels about a great deal, delivering goods to wherever they need to go. He doesn't have a fixed route─it all depends on what comes into the docks that day.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_021: If you do happen to find him, could you give him this piece of chocolate? I made it especially for him. It's his favorite─choc-full of galago mint. He might not be the sharpest knife in the pantry, but if he can get a taste of this, I'm sure he'll understand how I feel about him.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_022: ...Do I have any idea where he might be? It might not be anything, but when I last saw him, I recall him mentioning something about “ships.” Perhaps that had something to do with his next assignment?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_023: ...Do I have any idea where he might be? It might not be anything, but when I last saw him, I recall him mentioning something about “construction.” Perhaps that had something to do with his next assignment?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_024: ...Do I have any idea where he might be? It might not be anything, but when I last saw him, I recall him mentioning something about a “lighthouse.” Perhaps that had something to do with his next assignment?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_025: ...Do I have any idea where he might be? It might not be anything, but when I last saw him, I recall him mentioning something about “salt.” Perhaps that had something to do with his next assignment?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_026: I do hope you can find him and give him my gift. I spent so long making sure the chocolate was just right, I'm not sure I could do it again. If he doesn't get to taste this batch, he might never know how I truly feel about him...
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_027: Well, aren't you a pretty little thing. You look like you've got what it takes to find my man, and more besides.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_028: My darling boy works as a wagoner. The coin isn't much to write home about, but all that heavy lifting pays dividends, if you follow my meaning. The only real downside is that he's always out traveling, so it's difficult to lay my hands on him when I really, really want to.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_029: If you're able to find my darling, would you give this to him? Mint chocolate of my own special recipe: two-thirds kukuru solids, with a lavish handful of fresh galago mint, and a dash of pure, unadulterated passion. As soon as it touches his lips, he'll know exactly how I feel about him.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_030: ...Do I have any clue as to where he might have gone? I'm afraid not. When last we met, I was too busy drowning in his eyes to pay much attention to his words. There was one thing I remember, though: something about “booze”... Could he have been talking about his work?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_031: ...Do I have any clue as to where he might have gone? I'm afraid not. When last we met, I was too busy drowning in his eyes to pay much attention to his words. There was one thing I remember, though: something about a “tidegate”... Could he have been talking about his work?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_032: ...Do I have any clue as to where he might have gone? I'm afraid not. When last we met, I was too busy drowning in his eyes to pay much attention to his words. There was one thing I remember, though: something about a “lockup”... Could he have been talking about his work?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLC00527_000_033: ...Do I have any clue as to where he might have gone? I'm afraid not. When last we met, I was too busy drowning in his eyes to pay much attention to his words. There was one thing I remember, though: something about the Sahagin... Could he have been talking about his work?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_GIRLB00527_000_034: I'm really very timid when it comes to expressing my love... If he doesn't get my gift now, will my darling boy ever know of my burgeoning passion? Of the flames he kindles in my racing heart? Please find him, adventurer, and let him know how much he means to me!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_MISSIONARY00527_000: ...So there you have it. Forgive me for burdening you with this impossible task, , but I have tried and failed to find the man myself. It is my one slim hope that an adventurer such as yourself might divine some clue to his location from the lady's words.

Did they mean anything to you? Some connection to a local landmark, perhaps? Should you find yourself at a loss, pray speak with your fellow adventurers. We have enlisted many of your kind in our cause─mayhap the lady revealed some other information to them that she neglected to mention to you.
Go, then, , and seek out this missing wagoner. I shall remain here to comfort the lonely ladies of Limsa Lominsa in their darkest hour. Together, we shall await word of your success!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SYSTEM_000_038: During this quest, the location of the wayward wagoner will not be marked on the map, nor will any identifying symbol appear above the character's head. Speak with other players and share your information, and try to find him!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_MISSIONARY00527_000: “Fruit,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. I am afraid my own attempts to find the man have borne little enough of it. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?
“Ships,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. I'm afraid I'm all at sea when it comes to naval matters. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?
“Booze,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. I must admit, I am entirely befuddled by it. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“A settlement,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Long have I racked my brains at what it might mean, yet my thoughts have failed to settle on any definitive answer. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“Construction,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Long have I racked my brains at what it might mean, yet I have failed to construct any definitive answer. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“A tidegate,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Yet rack my brains as I might, the gates of my understanding remain obstinately closed. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“Pirates,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. I'm afraid my ignorance of the local area has plundered me of any possible insight. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“A lighthouse,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Yet I remain entirely unenlightened as to where he might be found. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“A lockup,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Yet when it comes to finding the man, I'm afraid I am a prisoner to my ignorance of the local area. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“A plantation,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Yet I fear it has failed to plant any seed of understanding in my mind. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“Salt,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Unfortunately, I can make neither head nor tail of it, unseasoned as I am to these climes. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?

“The Sahagin,” the lady said... The only clue we have to her lover's location. Yet the creatures inspire only loathing in me, and not a whit of insight. Perhaps your fellow adventurers might have some better idea?
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_060: All right, that's that job done. Now...what's next? Oh, hello there, ─you'll be one of those adventurers, right? Say, if you've something needs delivering, I'd be happy to take it for you.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_061: What's this...? A piece of mint chocolate? And it's from her!? Gods be good, this is the best Valentione's Day ever!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_062: I don't know what they get up to elsewhere, but in La Noscea, there's nothing that beats a bit of chocolate when it comes to Valentione's Day.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_063: And if a girl gives a feller some chocolate, it can only mean one thing: she truly and honestly loves him. Do you hear that? She truly and honestly loves me!
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_064: Sorry, , but whatever you'd have me deliver, it'll have to wait. I'm going to head back to town, and into the ever-loving arms of my beautiful girl! Thanks a million, !
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_065: Phew... That was a heavy one. Still, there's no time to be hanging around─I better get asking after another job. Oh, hello there, . You're one of those adventurers, ain't you? Say, if you've something needs delivering, I'd be happy to carry it.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_066: ...And those were her exact words? That's funny... It don't sound like anyone I know, and certainly not my sweetheart. Sorry, , but I think you've got the wrong feller.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_LOVER00527_000_067: This is not the wagoner you are looking for. Try searching somewhere else.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_MISSIONARY00527_000: Welcome back, ! I see that your efforts have succeeded where mine failed. How can I ever repay you? Ah, but perhaps the love you have brought into bloom is reward enough. Look, over there, at the fruits of your accomplishment!

Ah, how it warms my heart to see the lady's passions reciprocated! I thank you, . Without your insight and endeavor, this love may forever have been stifled into silence, instead of breaking forth into song.
However, there is one love of which I have heard nothing: when you return to Ser Hortefense, pray inform him that the lady he seeks has yet to be found.

And honestly, how could he hope for me to find her? He knows not the lady's name, nor her face, only something of her “spirit”... While he may be disappointed by the information─or lack thereof─I doubt he will find it unexpected.
But your other news he will find most welcome indeed: that thanks to you, Limsa Lominsa basks in the warmth of reciprocated passion! Our house is forever in your debt, , and we shall not forget it.
TEXT_FESVLT104_00527_SYSTEM_000_080: You have successfully assisted the emissaries of House Valentione in all three city-states! Return to Hortefense in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to report your success.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_000: How good it is to see you again, ! My men have already sent word of your successes in reuniting the ladies with their missing men. Thanks to you, no yearning shall go unappeased this Valentione's Day.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_001: ...Ah. Excepting my own, then. To tell the truth, though I journeyed here with the Valentiones, I am a knight of House Fortemps. I volunteered to help with their house's mission in return for the emissaries' assistance in locating my lost love. Yet in my heart of hearts, I knew it to be a fruitless endeavor.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_002: It has been several long, lonely years since first─and last─I set eyes on my beloved. In a bloody battle against the Horde, I was cut down, and left for dead in a barren snowfield. 'Twas then that my angel came to me, saving me from the snow's icy grip, and melting my heart with the warmth of hers.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_003: So severe were my injuries, my memories of her are faint at best. I know not her name, and her face remains but a beautiful blur in my clouded mind. All that I can recall is her voice and her bearing, both of which struck me as belonging to a lady of the highest nobility.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_004: , loath as I am to impose any further on your kindness, might you not have some inkling as to who my angel might be? An Ishgardian noblewoman of exquisite grace, with a mellifluous tongue and a heart of unfathomable tenderness?
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_005: If my description strikes even the faintest chord with you, then pray tell me all you know. Though I know it may be a fool's errand to try to find her, you have proved that you are eminently able to accomplish such tasks. Have you any idea who my love could be?
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_006: The angel I seek was a noblewoman of Ishgard, with a voice of crystalline clarity, and a heart filled with the utmost compassion. If you have any idea as to who or where she might be─any at all─then please, tell me.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_010: That Hortefense'll feel the back of my mitt if he doesn't snap to it! What does he think he's doing, standing around mooning to himself while there's work to be done? It's a good thing this land's swarming with adventurers docile enough to do his work for him!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_011: O-Oh, hello, ! I didn't see you there. I was just, ah, reflecting on what splendid work you adventurers are doing, selflessly plying the cause of House Valentione without any thought of personal reward. ...Is there aught I might assist you with in your travails?
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_012: Ser Hortefense? I had heard something of his plight, but had little idea his tale was quite so dramatic. Oh, to inspire such ardor from so fleeting an encounter! This noblewoman must be a most enchanting lady, indeed!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_013: Could it be someone that I know? The story does stir some kind of bygone memory─a knight, rescued from a snowfield, and nursed back to health... A piece of court gossip, perhaps? ...I'm sorry, but I simply can't place my finger on it.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_014: Mayhap my emissary by the gates might recall the story in more detail. If Ser Hortefense kept the true tale of his lost love from me, of all people─authority that I am in the field of romance─no doubt he failed to properly acquaint his subordinates with it.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_015: A lady as captivating as Lord Hortefense describes would make a most valuable ally to the Valentione cause, yet I fear I have yet to meet such a magnetic individual. ...Present company excepted, of course. Mayhap my emissary might recall the story in greater detail.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_MISSIONARY00527_000: Well met once again, . Is anything the matter? You honor me with your continued interest, but rest assured that your work in Gridania is done─the remaining petitioners we can handle ourselves.
Ah, I see... So the knight rescued from the battlefield was Ser Hortefense, was it? The fellow was in such a bad way, small wonder I did not recognize him without the blood and the bruises.
Thank you for informing me of this, . It seems you have solved the one outstanding duty of the day, for I believe I know just where Ser Hortefense's lost love may be found.

All that remains is to set the stage for his long-deferred confession. Forgive me for imposing on your kindness once more, but I would be most obliged if you could ask Lady Lisette to remain in place for the nonce, while I speak with Ser Hortefense.
Pray speak with Lady Lisette, and bid her remain in place while I talk to Ser Hortefense. I am sure he will reveal the happy tidings to her in due time...
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_030: Ah, . Did you meet with my retainer? Was he able to offer any assistance in uncovering the identity of Ser Hortefense's beloved?
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_031: He bids me wait here, with you? The sheer audacity of the boy! Has he not learned that it is I─and I alone─who gives the orders? I shall have to think of a suitable punishment ere we quit this city...
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_0032: Lady Lisette, my search is over! At long last, I have found my shining star! My savior! The patron saint of my heart!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_033: How wonderful! Why, it is a veritable Valentione's Day miracle that you should find your lost love in such a one-chocobo backwa─ I mean, such a faraway realm as this. But tell me, Hortefense: is she as captivating as you remember? Have you spoken with her? When shall we be introduced?
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_0034: Oh, my lady! You take a man's heart in your hands and laugh in its face! Do you not already know? It is none other than you, my dearest Lady Lisette! You are the angel of beauty who gave me my life and stole away with my heart!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_0036: Do not deny it, my lady! The emissary told me everything─how you carried my broken body from the icy wastes, reclaiming me from the claws of death with sweet whispers of compassion. No wonder I could not recall your features until now, so blinded was I by your radiance on that fateful day!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_037: Well, that's as may be...but are you quite certain it was me? There was that one knight I pulled from the snow, but surely the fellow could not have survived. The poor wretch was in such a bad way, I only knew him as one of ours by the bloodstained unicorn on what was left of his cuirass...
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_0038: The blazon of House Fortemps! Then it is beyond doubt─you are the one I have been searching for all these years! ...Lisette de Valentione, would you make me the happiest man in Eorzea? You need only say “I do.”
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_039: Bloody hells, Hortefense, what in Halone's name do you think you're doing!? You get back on your feet right now, or you'll wish you had died in that snowfield!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_040: Of course, my lady. Forgive my presumption. I was a fool to dream that my angel might ever regard me as I do her...
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_041: Th-That's right! And there'll be more than your dreams getting crushed if you try any of that nonsense again! I'm not all sweetness and light, you know─if you got to know the real me, I'd be off that pedestal of yours in a flash!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_042: Hardly, my lady, for I know the real you already: that angel of boundless compassion, who rescued a stranger from certain death, and bestowed every tenderness upon him to bring him back from the brink. My heart is yours, Lisette, and no words can ever change that.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_043: Rather the opposite, in fact, for how long have I dreamed of hearing your sparkling voice once more! However brusque your tone, however harsh your words, knowing that they flow from the throat of my beloved makes them ring like the sweetest birdsong in my ears!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_044: G-Good gods, Hortefense...! What am I supposed to say to that?
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_100_044: Grrr! This is all your fault, ! You're the one who put him up to this─talk some sense into this blockhead's skull or I shall have the both of you flogged to within an ilm of your life!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_045: <sigh> Look, Hortefense, you're a fine knight, and it's not as if I don't like you, it's just...it's all so sudden. Perhaps...if we were to get to know each other a little more─as friends I mean, and nothing more!─then...
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_046: I understand, my lady. To simply be permitted to remain in your presence is the greatest honor I have ever known. As friends, we shall come to know each other's true hearts, and perhaps, in time, you might find some small place for me in yours, as you hold dominion over mine.
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_047: Fine, fine, whatever you say! ...And you, , what are you still doing here? This isn't some mummer's farce to be gawped at by the great unwashed─it's my life, and I'll thank you to keep your nose out of it!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_HORTEFENSE_000_048: , my dear . How can I ever thank you for all you have done? I had braced myself for another Valentione's Day of despair, yet thanks to you, my heart leaps with hope and joy!
TEXT_FESVLT105_00547_LISSETE_000_049: Well, Arabelle would be pleased to hear that... And so, I suppose, am I. It's not what I expected, but it is what I wanted: for no love to go unspoken this day. I must admit, you've quite knocked me off my perch, . And for that...I thank you.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Come one, come all, and bear witness to the miracle of Hatching-tide! There are eggs to be hunted, high jinks to be had, and wondrous treasures to be found! The Archons of yore have spoken once again, and invite you to join the revelry!
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Blessed be... , is that you? The Archon who returned anew, has returned anew! With your good self on board, this year's festivities are sure to be as rousing a success as the last.

I shall never forget how you appeared before me that day, towering heroically above the shining vessels we had prepared for Hatching Hour. It was as if I had been transported back to that fateful moment when the Twelve Archons came to me in my dreams, prophesying their return. And return you have...
Greetings, young Dreamer. , is it? Might you be interested in partaking in this year's hunt? My Dreamers and I have hidden a multitude of eggs abroad, each containing a fabulous prize.

Why eggs, you ask? It is a strange history, but every word the truth. Some years back, the Twelve Archons of ages past blessed me with a vision. In my dream, they descended from the heavens atop vividly patterned eggs, and bid me ready the vessels for their return.
Every year since, my loyal band of Dreamers and I have painstakingly decorated eggs to match those from my vision, in the sure knowledge that one day they would summon the Archons to life. And would you believe that last year, the prophecy finally came to pass!
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: But pray, do not think that I hold the festival again in mere mimicry of last year's wondrous events. The memory is too dear to my heart to desecrate it so. No, ─the Archons have seen fit to bless me with a new vision, with the promise of great happiness for all!

In my dream, the towns and fields of Eorzea were thronged with spriggans─the habitual enemies of Hatching-tide, who have bedeviled festivals past with their obsessive egg theft─but no nightmare, this. For they were not real spriggans, but adventurers in spriggan form!
All excepting one, that is─a mysterious auspicious spriggan, who guided the joyful masses to a glorious treasure!

My Dreamers and I have done all in our power to set the stage for my vision to come to life─we have even found a means to transform men into beasts, just as they were in my dream─yet there is one matter that weighs heavily on my heart: the auspicious spriggan has yet to make its appearance.

But the  is still young, and the more adventurers who partake in the hunt, the greater the chances that one will happen upon the creature. If you would join in the revelry, pray speak with the sylphic sorceress by the amphitheatre gates─she will grant you the necessary disguise.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: If my dream is to come true, we need every able-bodied adventurer we can muster to join the hunt. Should you vouchsafe to partake in the day's festivities, speak with my sorceress friend by the amphitheatre gates. She will be only too happy to magick you into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_FRIENDLYSYLPH00556_: Happy Hatching-tide, fellow walking one! Ha ha! This one tricked walking one! This one isn't really a walking one, this one is really a sylph! Sylphs are experts at skin-changing tricks!
Dreaming one asked these ones to help make dreaming one's dreams come true, by using these ones' magicks to make walking ones look like furry ones. Does walking one want to turn into a furry one too?

Dreaming one has hidden Archon eggs all around Old Gridania. Once this one has magicked walking one into a furry one, walking one can hunt for the eggs, and collect the Archon cards inside. Take three cards back to dreaming one and dreaming one will exchange them for a wonderful prize.

But cards are not all walking one might find! Dreaming one dreamed there was a lucky furry one─a real furry one─somewhere in the city. If walking one sees the lucky furry one, make sure to tell dreaming one right away!

Dreaming one tries to keep a brave face, but deep down inside, dreaming one's thoughts are scrambled. Dreaming one is very worried that the lucky furry one might not appear, and if the lucky furry one doesn't appear, dreaming one's dreams will be scotched!

TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_09: Greetings, my friend. It brings joy to my heart to see you partaking in the egg hunt. If you have collected any cards, I should be only too happy to reward you with a prize─one for every three you find.
Oh, but forgive me─I'm sure you wouldn't wish to remain a spriggan for the rest of your days. Allow me to dispel that enchantment for you...
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: Goodness gracious! This is a platinum Archon card─the rarest of all the prizes my Dreamers prepared for the hunt. The eggs containing them were secreted in such secluded spots I was beginning to fear they would never be discovered. I can't believe you actually found one!

What!? A strange spriggan holding a checkered egg was standing over its basket? B-But that means─ ...Yes, it must be! The auspicious spriggan that the Archons of yore revealed to me has finally shown himself!
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_11: Oh, how wonderful! You never fail to astound me, ─or should I call you Archon ? Once again you are making my dreams come true!
Oh, how wonderful! Then my vision is coming true, after all. Thank the Twelve...
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_12: After last year's successes, my Dreamers have quite convinced themselves that my vision would again come true, and have devoted themselves utterly to preparing this year's festivities. I could never have forgiven myself had my dream proved to be no more than a fantasy.

But now the auspicious spriggan is discovered, and all is proceeding as the Archons of yore revealed it to me. If we can only keep track of the creature, he is sure to lead us to the wondrous treasure of which the prophecy spoke.

Hatching-tide is about to begin in earnest! If I might further impose on your kindness, could I ask for your assistance with the next stage of proceedings? Come and speak to me again whenever you are ready. Until then, , may the Archons of yore bless you and keep you.
TEXT_FESEST101_00556_SYSTEM_000_900: In order to proceed further in the quest, you must be under the transfigured status.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Are you ready to fulfill the next step of the prophecy, ? In my vision, the auspicious spriggan first appeared amid verdant woodland, but soon the light grew brighter, the air warmer and scented with rich perfumes. The ground beneath his feet was no longer leaves, but stone and sand.

There is but one explanation: the spriggan shall leave the tranquility of Gridania, and reappear amid the hustle and bustle of Ul'dah! Follow him there, ─if the creature is to guide us to the wondrous treasure that the Archons spoke of, he must not escape our sight!

What is more, the prophecy held black tidings of a hidden threat lurking in the desert... I know not at whose hands, but I fear the auspicious spriggan may be in danger. So I turn to you, my friend: you found the spriggan once, and I have full faith you shall do so again.

Go to Ul'dah, , and meet with my good friend Nonotta by the Ruby Road Exchange. She is leading the revelries in the city, and will be the first to hear if the spriggan has been sighted. Good luck, and may the Archons of yore bless you and keep you.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: It was the will of the Archons that you should discover the auspicious spriggan, and surely your destiny to follow in its footsteps. Pray journey to the Ruby Road Exchange in Ul'dah, and speak with Nonotta. She is leading the revelries in the city, and should be best informed as to the current situation.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_030: Greetings, friend. I wish you happiest of Hatching-tides. ...You say that Jihli sent you to join the hunt? Then you are most welcome─any friend of Jihli's is a friend of mine.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_031: But this is no time to be gallivanting around hunting for eggs, my dear─the auspicious spriggan is in terrible trouble! We must hasten to his rescue, lest the prophecy be torn to tatters, and the wondrous treasure lost for all eternity!
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_032: Did Jihli mention the auspicious spriggan to you? The creature appeared to her in a prophetic vision─she saw it travel across Eorzea with a band of revelers in its wake, leading them to a great reward. First she saw it in Gridania, then it moved to Ul'dah...and as sure as eggs is eggs, here it moved!
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_033: However, there was another element to her vision─a lurking menace, hidden in the sands─and sure enough, the very same has come to pass! A band of ruffians have made ingress to the city, and are hunting down the spriggan to Thal knows what sinister end.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_034: They call themselves the Shellshockers... A name that inspires revulsion in any enthusiast of Hatching-tide, wouldn't you agree? There can be no doubt that it is they who are the malignant force from Jihli's vision.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_035:
I beg you: track these villains down, and save the auspicious spriggan from their evil clutches! Oh, and do be sure to go in disguise. Believe you me, these men are dangerous, and it would not do for them to recognize the face of one who would deny them their quarry.
Luck has it that a number of sylphic sorceresses are assisting us with the festivities. Pray speak to the one just across the road from here─she will transfigure you into spriggan form. Good luck, , and may the Archons of yore bless you and keep you.
TEXT_FESEST102_00557_NONOTTA_000_040: If the prophecy is to be fulfilled, those awful men must not be allowed to get their hands on the auspicious spriggan. Forget all about it, and never speak of his impudence to anybody─ever! ...Do you promise that you won't tell Jihli? Cross your heart and hope to die?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_100_000: Thank you, . Well, now that little unpleasantness is out of the way, let us return to business! Hatching Hour is nearly upon us, and there is much and more to be done before the prophecy is realized.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_001: As the Archons of yore revealed it to Jihli, the “bearer of fortune” shall guide the realm to a “wondrous treasure.” Do you see? We must track down the auspicious spriggan once again, so that he might lead us to our prize!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_002: In Jihli's dream, she first saw the spriggan in the dappled light of the Gridanian forests. Then the air became heavy with heat and incense, and she saw it scurry down the cobbled streets of Ul'dah─just as we witnessed it but a few moments ago.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_003: It is the final part of her vision that interests us now: how the sands grew brighter beneath the creature's toes, and the air around him rang with the voices of gulls and shantymen. It can only mean that the auspicious spriggan is to reappear in Limsa Lominsa!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_004: If so, he may be in mortal danger once more. Do you remember what my friend─ ...I mean─that awful, evil Shellshocker said? That he was to see you later in Limsa Lominsa! He must mean to follow the auspicious spriggan there, to follow through on his murderous plot!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_005: So I beg you, : head to Limsa Lominsa, and save the spriggan from the clutches of those abominable bandits. I must remain here to attend to the festivities in Ul'dah, but my dear friend Motte will be able to help you. May the Archons of yore bless you and keep you both!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_010: If the Shellshockers have their wicked way with the auspicious spriggan, all hope of the prophecy being fulfilled will be lost. Go to Limsa Lominsa, my friend, and speak with Motte by the Aftcastle. It is she who leads the revelries there, and will gladly grant you any aid you need.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_020: Welcome, adventurer. Might you be , the  who saved the day in Ul'dah? Nono told me you would be coming, and I should be most grateful for your assistance.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_021: If it is news of the auspicious spriggan you are after, I have it in two varieties: good and bad. Let us begin with the good news: just as Jihli's vision predicted, a spriggan carrying an unusual egg had indeed been sighted in the city.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_022: And now for the bad news: there is more than one. Several spriggans, each with an egg unlike our sorceresses' illusions, have been spotted around the town. There can be no doubt that all but one are fakes─men using magicks of their own device to disguise themselves as the auspicious spriggan.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_023: It can only be those wicked Shellshockers from Ul'dah. They mean to distract our attentions from the true auspicious spriggan, and snatch it away from right under our noses!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_024: But when it comes to sneaky tricks, no man can match a sylph, and it just so happens that my sylphic helper has a cunning plan to expose these brigands. We only awaited a brave adventurer to put the plan into action, and now here you are! Speak with her, , and she will explain all.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_030: The sylphic sorceress over by the steps is an expert in the arts of illusion. She has come up with the perfect method of exposing those fiendish Shellshockers for the scoundrels they are. Heed well her plan, for it may be our only chance of finding the true auspicious spriggan.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPH00559_: Happy hunting, walking one! This one has a clever plan to find out which furry one is the lucky one, and which are the shocking ones! Let this one tell walking one all about it.

There are shocking ones in the city, using these ones' skin-changing tricks to look just like furry ones, and holding lucky eggs to look like the lucky one. So how can walking one tell which one is the real lucky one? With more of these ones' tricks, of course!

Take a look at these, walking one─magick-breaking scalebombs that can see through the most powerful sylphic tricks. All walking one needs to do is find the lucky-looking ones, and toss a scalebomb at each one. Then walking one will see what walking one will see!

Dreaming one says there are three suspicious ones that look like the lucky one around the upper decks. Dreaming one thinks one is the real lucky one, but they might all be shocking ones in disguise! Throw scalebombs at all three to find out which one is which!

But if shocking ones see walking one coming, shocking ones might get a shock, and run away! Better to change into a furry one again, to catch shocking ones unawares. This one will magick walking one into a furry one right away!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_056: Three spriggans carrying unusual eggs have been sighted on the upper decks of Limsa Lominsa. Disguise yourself as a spriggan, and throw a scalebomb at each of the suspicious spriggans to discover if the auspicious spriggan is among their number.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_057: Should you succeed in uncovering the true auspicious spriggan, report back to Motte. If your transfiguration should fade before you have completed the task, speak to the sylphic sorceress again to be magicked back into spriggan form.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPH00559_: When walking one sees a lucky-looking one, get the lucky-looking one's attention, and throw a scalebomb before it can run away. If the lucky-looking still looks lucky after the bomb goes off, it must be the real lucky one!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_075: , is that you? Did my sorceress friend give you the...merchandise? Excellent. Seek out the suspicious spriggans, and use the scalebombs on them. Oh, and do try to stay in disguise─if the Shellshockers see you reaching for another gift, they're sure to run for their lives!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPH00559_: Happy Hatching-tide, walking one! Ah, but walking one should be disguised as a furry one, otherwise shocking ones will see walking one coming! This one will change walking one back straightaway.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_085: Do you have the scalebombs, ? Good. Before you commence the operation, ask my sylphic assistant to transfigure you again. In spriggan form, those nasty Shellshockers won't know you from any other Hatching-tide reveler─until you spring the trap!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SPRIGGANA00559_000_: Eggy, eggy, eggyyy! I'm a lucky Spriggy! Lucky, lucky Spriggyyyyyy!
Eggy, eggy, eggyyy! I'm a lucky Spriggy! Lucky, lucky Spriggyyyyyy!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_EGGCRUSHERC00557_00: Aaagh! Oi, you! What d'you think you're─ ...Er, I mean...whatty, whatty, whattyyy─ ...Stone me, what's happened to my disguise!?

Grrr... Looks like the jig's up. You got me, bang to rights─I ain't the real auspicious spriggan, I'm a Shellshocker through and through. But while you're wasting your time on me, the lads are closing the net! Happy hunting, big ears!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_125: One of the spriggans was a Shellshocker after all? Then there's no doubt that another must be, too...if not both! Hurry, , and track the two remaining suspicious spriggans down─we must find the real auspicious spriggan before they do!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SPRIGGANB00559_000_: Eggy, eggy, eggyyy! Who's a lucky Spriggyyyyyy!?
Eggy, eggy, eggyyy! Who's a lucky Spriggy? Are you a lucky Spriggyyyyyy!?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_EGGCRUSHERA00557_00: Agh! What in the seven hells was that!?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_EGGCRUSHERC00557_00: My disguise, it's gone! Sod this for a lark─they never told me I'd be taking a bomb to the face, let alone two... I ain't sticking around for a third!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_150: You found a second suspicious spriggan, and he was a fake, too? Then the only one left must be the real auspicious spriggan! ...Provided it's not another bandit in disguise. You had better drop a scalebomb on him, too─it's the only way to be sure.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SPRIGGAN00556_000_1: Spriggy find egg! Eeeeeegg! Spriggy find treasuuuuuure!!!
Spriggy egg! Biggy egg! Big treasure! Treasuuuuuure!!!
Spriggy egg! Biggy egg! Big, big, biiig! Lucky treasure! Luckyyyyyy!!!
Big, big eggies in the wild! The wiiiiiild! Lucky eggies! Lucky treasuuuuuure!!!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPH00559_: Walking one found the real lucky one!? Hooray for walking one! Dreaming one will want to hear about this right away!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_200: Welcome back, ...if that is you under all that fluff. Allow me to dispel your disguise. Oh, don't worry─I'll just use a sprinkling of truesight scales. No cause for a bomb this time!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_100_200: So tell me: did you track down the third suspicious spriggan? ...You did? And it really was the auspicious spriggan from the prophecy─the same one you met in Ul'dah!? Thank goodness it was you who found him first, and not the hated Shellshockers, sworn enemies of Dreamers near and far!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_A1_101_200: Enemies? They seemed rather friendly with Nonotta...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_103_200: Wh-Wh-What!? Surely you can't suspect Nono of being in league with those villains? Why, the very idea is absurd! So absurd that it doesn't bear repeating...to anyone. Ever. But enough of this silliness─tell me, : did the auspicious spriggan say anything to you?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_104_200: And please you have! Rest assured, when this day is done, you shall be the guest of honor at─ ...But we can talk about that later. We have more important matters to discuss at present: the auspicious spriggan first and foremost. Tell me, , did he say anything to you?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_201: “Big eggs, big treasure,” or words to that effect? The image they conjure seems somehow familiar... Of course! The enormous eggs from Jihli's vision!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_202: Did she mention them to you? It wasn't just the cities of Eorzea that Jihli saw bustling with spriggans enjoying the Hatching-tide revelries, but the fields and valleys, too. Out in the wilds, she saw the creatures dancing around immense, floating eggs.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_203: From her descriptions, we were able to divine the very locations she had seen in her dream, and what do you know? There they were! Giant, decorated eggs, buried beneath the topsoil! We had only to prise them free from the ground, and they took off into the air.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_204: It was just as Jihli described it to us...excepting the lack of spriggans. So just as we have done in the cities, sylphic sorceresses have been posted to each location where the giant eggs were found. There they are conducting a special Hatching-tide event that we call the enormous egg hunt!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_205: Once our sylphic assistants transfigure adventurers into spriggan form to match Jihli's vision, they are free to cavort around the floating eggs─striking at them, and trying to crack them open. Whosoever lays an egg low is permitted to claim the prize inside.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_206: Could the wondrous treasure from the prophecy be contained in one of these eggs? What in the world could it be...? If I gave you a list of all the places we found the eggs, would you go there, join in the enormous egg hunt, and bring whatever you find inside back to me?
