TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_207: Bring the scenes from Jihli Aliapoh's prophetic dream to life by participating in the FATE “Gloria in Eggcelsis.” Crack open the giant, floating eggs to obtain the lucky eggs within.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_208: The locations where the FATE will appear are noted in your journal. Complete the FATE in any of the listed locations to proceed in the quest.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_209: In order to participate in the FATE, you will need to be transfigured into spriggan form. Speak with the sylphic sorceress at the FATE location to be transfigured.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_210: When the enormous egg appears, attack it using the skill “Quickchant,” which can be activated from the pet hotbar. Continue to attack the egg until it cracks, and you will be rewarded with lucky eggs. There is no limit to the number of lucky eggs you can collect.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_211: To open a lucky egg and collect the prize inside, simply use it from your inventory.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_213: Alternatively, lucky eggs can be exchanged for special items by speaking with the Hatching-tide Dreamers in any of the three city-states.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPH00559_: Out in the wilds, adventuring ones are dressing as furry ones, and cracking open giant floating ones! Will walking one be joining in too?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPHFIELD_: Greetings, walking one, and welcome to the enormous egg hunt! This one will turn walking one into a furry one, then walking one can join in too. Crack open the giant egg to win what's inside! Just be careful it doesn't crack walking one open first!

Now walking one is ready to join the hunt! If walking one cracks open the enormous egg, walking one will win a wonderful prize. If the magick fades, come back to this one, and this one will magick walking one into a furry one again.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_250: Greetings once again, my friend. How went the egg hunt? My sylphic sorceresses tell me that the floating giants are yielding lucky eggs to their victors. Were you rewarded with the same?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_260: You were! Is the great treasure that shall bring great joy to all the realm contained within this unassuming orb? My fingers itch to open it, but I promised Jihli that I would wait until─ ...Ah, but here she comes now.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_26: , I came as soon as I received word! Does Motte speak true? Have you found the wondrous treasure the prophecy spoke of?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_262: Indeed  has, and it dwells within this very egg I hold in my hands. The auspicious spriggan guided  to the enormous eggs from your vision, and this was the prize  found inside. It can only be the prophesied treasure!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_26: A lucky egg that  won from the enormous egg hunt? But didn't we prepare all those prizes ourselves? The treasure from my vision was supposed to be a gift from the Archons of─ ...Hmmm?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SPRIGGANA00559_000_: Spriggy done job, now Spriggy want pay! Paaaaaay! Give me eggiiies! Eggiiiiiies!!!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_265: Not now, Spriggy! I'll give you all the eggs you want, but only when the festival is over, and not a moment earlier. Until then, you're the auspicious spriggan, and don't you forget it!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_100_265: Quickly now, there's a good boy! And don't let me catch you in the city until─ ...Ah.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_26: Motte! What is the meaning of this!? That was the auspicious spriggan that I saw in my dream, I am sure of it─but how do you know him? And what is this talk of pretense and payment? , please, tell me: what in the world is going on!?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_A1_000_272: I don't know. Maybe Motte can explain...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_28: What!? You mean it's not only Motte and the auspicious spriggan, but Nonotta, and the Shellshockers too...? Why, Motte? Why would you try to fool me like this?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_290: I'm sorry, Jihli... I can't keep the truth from you any longer.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_300: Jihli, ... The truth is, we've been deceiving you both. Everything that has happened─the auspicious spriggan appearing, being chased by the Shellshockers, guiding you to the giant eggs─none of it was real. We staged it all.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_301: The auspicious spriggan is actually my friend. Spriggy is his name. I made an egg for him, just like the one you described in your vision, and asked him to pose as the auspicious spriggan in exchange for a hundred Hatching-tide eggs...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_302:
As for the Shellshockers─they're Nonotta's friends from the Weavers' Guild. When they're not acting as bandits, they make the most adorable quilts. And the enormous eggs─we did find them buried in the ground in the places you dreamed of, I swear, but they were ugly, metallic things.
We decorated them to match the Archon eggs from your vision, and filled them with lucky eggs to act as the prophesied treasure...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_30: So it was all a lie? You, Nonotta, and the other Dreamers...you staged everything to make it match my vision? Why would you do this!?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_304: Because we were worried about you! Every time we saw you, you were so very anxious─frightened that this year, your dream wouldn't come true. So we pledged to do whatever it took to make sure that it would!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_30: But it hasn't! My visions are blessings from the Archons of yore, not mere pantomimes to be acted out by a band of second-rate mummers! I wished for us to set the stage for the prophecy to be fulfilled, not act it out ourselves! Now the whole thing is ruin─ ...Hm?
Wh-What is this...this feeling? It is as if I have witnessed this scene before... Yes, yes! It was in my dream! I saw myself...and you, Motte. I saw us quarreling...
I...I saw it through your eyes, ! All of it─the auspicious spriggan in Gridania, the Shellshockers in Ul'dah, the scalebombs in Limsa Lominsa, and the enormous egg hunt!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_308: Jihli, do you know what this means? Your dream was indeed a vision of the future─it is not so much that we staged the events of your vision, but that you envisioned the events that we were to stage! Your vision has come true, and so shall the prophecy!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_30: Perhaps... But still,  was unaware of your secret plans─you have been quite beastly to , treating  as an unwitting pawn in your games. My vision ended here, so tell me, Motte: what was to be the denouement of your little drama?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_310: Well, if you promise not to be angry... My sylphic friend taught me another of her tricks─no magicks, or explosives, just a little sleight of hand. I do not know what 's lucky egg contains, but it is no great treasure─I was planning to substitute its contents with this map.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_31: ...With a cross over the Bismarck. So if I go there, I'll discover what “wondrous treasure” you've laid in store for me?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_312: Yes. , you must come too─a share in the treasure is the least I can offer for all we've put you through. Speak with the fellow with the eyepatch by the restaurant entrance. I'm sure you'll find you have much to discuss...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_330: I do hope you can find it in your heart to forgive us, and meet with us at the Bismarck. If you do decide to come, a...friend will be waiting for you by the entrance.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_FRIENDLYSYLPH00559_: This one, and the lucky one, and the shocking ones, and the dreaming ones... These ones were all in it together! This one is sorry this one didn't tell walking one anything, but these ones wanted to keep it a secret...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_350: , thank you for coming. And welcome to the party!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_EGGCRUSHERC00557_00: Good to finally have you with us, Miss Aliapoh! ...Miss Aliapoh? Ha ha! Looks like we've really knocked her off her feet!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_354: Well, it wouldn't be a surprise party if it wasn't a surprise! We saw that you were worried about the festival, and your nameday was coming up, so we thought we'd kill two birds with one stone! We all worked together to make it happen!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_EGGCRUSHERC00557_00: And I got the short end of the stick! D'you remember me, adventurer? Aye, I'm the Shellshocker who took a couple of your scalebombs to the mug! No harm done, though. Jihli's always so kind, laying in all these gifts for the smallfolk. It was well worth it to give a little something back.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_MOTTE_000_356: We're sorry for keeping you in the dark, . We were so fixated on making the plan work─recreating the scenes from Jihli's vision, and leading her to a surprise party at the end of it, we didn't think of the strain we'd be putting on the adventurer who found the spriggan...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_35: Y-You mean...you did all this for me? I'm honored, truly I am...but─

But this isn't how it should be! Hatching-tide should be about joining hands with adventurers to bring the will of the Archons to life, not tricking them into following our own secret schemes! It should be about bringing joy to all, not just to me...
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_EGGCRUSHERC00557_00: Aye, and that's what we've brung! You've done so much to raise the spirits of the smallfolk since the Calamity, it lifts all our hearts to do something for you in return. And anyway, this party ain't just for you and us, Miss Aliapoh─everyone's welcome to join the revelry as they please!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_NONOTTA_000_360: And when the party's over, we'll return to our posts, and get back to running the Hatching-tide festivities─the real festivities─with all our hearts! We'll fulfill this prophecy if it's the last thing we do!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_36: Thank you, Nonotta─everyone... But perhaps the prophecy is already fulfilled. In my vision, I saw the arrival of the auspicious spriggan, and the drama that you laid in store to lead me here, but there was more: the Archons of yore also delivered a message unto me.

“Arise, young Dreamer,” they said, “follow in the footsteps of the bearer of fortune, who will tour the wonders of this blessed land. Only by this may you surmount a grave peril, and find a wondrous treasure.”
At first, I thought that the bearer of fortune must be the auspicious spriggan, and the peril the Shellshockers, but if all was an act, that can scarce be so...

Instead, I have come to quarrel with my dearest friends─a grave peril that could have spelled the end of the festival. But by the warmth of your hearts, we have overcome these troubles, and together we vow once more to make Hatching-tide as joyous as it can be.

It is this that is the wondrous treasure! The scenes that I saw in my vision may have been mere mummery, but nonetheless, the prophecy has been fulfilled! We have overcome a grave peril, and found a wondrous treasure, all guided by the bearer of fortune: not the auspicious spriggan...

...But you, ! It is through your eyes that I witnessed the scenes from my vision, and by your hands that the drama reached its finale. Thanks to you, the will of the Archons has been brought to fruition once more!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_371: I been after ye all evenin', . Don't worry yerself, now─I ain't lookin' fer the last dance. I've got a little somethin' fer ye, on behalf o' the guild.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_372: A little bird tells me ye 'elped save the realm from a worse lickin' than a kiss with a fishback. 'Tis only right ye get yer reward fer findin' them Allagan killin' machines, and doin' away with 'em afore they did away with us!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_373: Don't be so modest, ! You an' yer mates might've hushed it up, but the guild's got ways an' means o' findin' these things out. We both know what them “enormous eggs” really were.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_374: If them 'oary ol' contraptions'd been left to linger, they would've blown all Eorzea to kingdom come! Small wonder ye kept it to yerselves─if the smallfolk caught wind of the 'orrors lurkin' 'neath their feet, we would've 'ad a panic on our 'ands.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_375: That was yer thinkin', weren't it? Dress it all up as part of the Hatchin'-tide revelries, an' take the buggers out quick an' quiet afore rumor can spread. Ye've got a wise 'ead on them shoulders, , an' the guild's seen fit to grant ye a fittin' meed.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_376: What? Ye were only goin' along with that lass's dream? Followin' a bearer o' fortune to find a great treasure? An' ye reckoned that bit in the middle about “tourin' the wonders” was talkin' about travelin' 'round Eorzea?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_377: No, , no─it were those enormous eggs it were goin' on about! Ye saved us from the peril o' those Allagan abominations, an' as fer the wondrous treasure─well, what more can a feller ask fer than to wake up in the mornin' an' find he ain't been blown up in 'is bed?
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_378: An' the way ye tell it, ye never even 'ad the faintest glimmer ye were savin' the realm from a right royal keelhaulin'... If that ain't the work of a bearer o' fortune, I don't know what is.
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_BADERON_000_379: So it seems to me, at least, but what does a rum-soaked ol' bandit know 'bout visions an' prophecies? Let's you an' me keep this between ourselves, eh? When it comes to learnin' the realm's been saved by luck and luck alone...ignorance is bliss!
TEXT_FESEST103_00559_SYSTEM_000_900: In order to progress further in the quest, you must be under the transfigured status.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_5: I thank ye fer takin' the time to 'elp me out. Now, I'm sure yer busy, so I'll come straight to the point.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_6: Word 'as it some suspicious-lookin' buggers 'ave been sneakin' in an' out o' the Sastasha Seagrot, an' I need a trustworthy sort to 'ead up north of Aleport an' find out who they are an' what they're up to.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_7: Don't sound like much, I know...
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_8: But since that nasty business over in Swiftperch, folk've been a bit uneasy. Well, I say “a bit”... 'Tis all they can do not to soil 'emselves every time the bloody floorboards creak.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_9: But it weren't so long ago as the fishbacks' pet pirates paid us an unwelcome visit, an' folk are feelin' a bit nervous.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_10: If you would permit me, Master Baderon, I should be happy to elaborate.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_11: Well, well, if it ain't the chief Yellowjacket 'imself. To what do I owe this rare honor, Commodore Reyner? Come to make sure me patrons are behavin'─or just thirsty?
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_12: Neither, in fact. I came to welcome  back to Limsa Lominsa. It is well you have returned.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_13: Neither, in fact. I was informed that you had requested an adventurer to assist in my investigation, and I came to offer what information I could sift from recent reports.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_14: Over the course of the past moon, there have been several sightings of an unfamiliar vessel off the coast of Aleport, in the vicinity of the Isles of Umbra.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_15: This information came to my attention no more than a few weeks after a squad of my own soldiers had completed a routine patrol of the region, the Sastasha Seagrot included.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_16: Their search revealed little, save that a family of coeurls had taken up residence in the caves. Nothing to concern us, in short.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_17: In light of recent developments, however, it would seem wise to search Sastasha again.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_18: But with the Sahagin testing our defenses daily, I am loath to assign the task to the limited forces at my disposal. Our line is stretched as it is.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_19: Thus I sought the services of a competent adventurer to conduct an investigation in our stead. Any aid you can offer in this matter would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_REYNER_000_21: Sastasha is located in western La Noscea. For more detailed instructions on how to reach the place, I suggest you consult V'mellpa. She can be found at the ferry docks on the lower decks.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_22: You 'eard the man! Good luck to ye, !
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_VMELLPA_000_25: You're here about Commodore Reyner's investigation? Then you'll want to board a ferry bound for Aleport.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_VMELLPA_000_26: Once you arrive in western La Noscea, head to the north and you'll come across the Sastasha Seagrot soon enough. We have a scout stationed by the entrance to the cave with orders to brief you on the situation.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_VMELLPA_000_27: Whatever else he tells you, be ready for pirates. There's never any shortage of the bastards. This is Limsa Lominsa we're talking about...
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_30: Please tell me you're here on Yellowjacket duty, and not some daft sod out for a stroll. I can't take any more of this blasted waiting. You are? Thank the gods.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_31: I assume you already know about the ship seen slipping around the Isles of Umbra?
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_32: We've been on the lookout for pirate activity ever since that vessel was sighted, thinking a crew of cutthroats might have a den nearby.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_33: So when we received word that men of questionable quality had been seen passing in and out of Sastasha here, we weren't entirely surprised.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_34: I've yet to see them for myself, but if this lot belongs to those fishback-fancying Serpent Reavers...
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_35: Well, you can imagine the panic it'll cause. The kidnappings are still fresh in people's minds.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_36: Anyway, your task is to poke around in the caves, and find out exactly who we're dealing with. While you do that, I'll be keeping watch out here...praying you don't spot any blue face tattoos.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_AVERE_000_40: What took ye so bloody long, Edda? If me purse was too light, ye might've considered usin' some of yer own bleedin' coin to get us what we need!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_AVERE_000_41: Ye've only ever been as useful as the contents o' yer pockets─the gods know ye can barely 'eal a scratch!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_AVERE_000_42: We took up the 'venturin' life to take on the big jobs an' claim the big rewards. How're we meant to do that if ye can't even get our supplies in order?
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_AVERE_000_43: Hm? It's ─the one Baderon was talkin' to!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_AVERE_000_44: Well, we'll see who gets the glory! This job should've been ours in the first place!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_LIAVINNE_000_50: Bwahahaha! Edda, you're so slow, you'd lose a footrace to a tree slug.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_PAIYOREIYO_000_55: This is perfect for our inaugural outing as a party─wandering around in the caves, turning over a few rocks... How difficult could it possibly be?
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_PAIYOREIYO_000_56: I never expected our first visit to the Adventurers' Guild would yield such a straightforward way to win fame and fortune.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_EDDA_000_60: <gasp> I-I'm sorry, Avere! I came as fast as I could!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_EDDA_000_61: I tried haggling with the merchant, but two potions was the best I could get with the money you gave me. I had no idea how expensive they were!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ISILDAURE_000_65: Ah, a fellow adventurer. You, too, are here to unravel the mysteries of Sastasha?
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ISILDAURE_000_66: I have adventured across this wide realm for more seasons than I dare to count, yet still Eorzea manages to surprise me with her beauty and splendor.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ISILDAURE_000_67: Our journeys are not ended by the attainment of riches or fame. It is an unquenchable thirst for the unknown that drives us into the wilds time and again.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ISILDAURE_000_68: Even if I explored the world for a thousand years, I would never grow weary of this life.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ALIANNE_000_70: Grandfather and I are companions on the road.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ALIANNE_000_71: We travel where the wind takes us, and drink in all the wonders this world has to offer.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ALIANNE_000_72: Only an adventurer can understand the joy of such freedom─of discovering hidden places and experiencing sights and sounds that few may ever know.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_ALIANNE_000_73: The passing years have begun to take their toll on the old man, but no force save death itself will sate his appetite for adventure!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_75: The fishbacks and their Serpent Reaver lackeys cannot be allowed to establish a permanent base in these lands.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_YELLOWJACKET_000_76: You must uncover the truth behind who or what is lurking in these caves, adventurer. The peace of western La Noscea may depend on it!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_80: Aye, such a task was on the books. “Was,” mind. I'm afraid that ship 'as already sailed, friend.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_81: Ah. Might you be the adventurer who accepted the job of investigating Sastasha?
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_82: Hmph. It would seem that ship has not only sailed, but now returns to harbor, none the worse for its voyage. A pity. We dragged our boots too long on this one.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_EMANAFA_000_83: No matter. The wheel will turn and our chance will come.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_84: You are right, of course. But there shall be no rest till we have attained our goal, lofty though it may be!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_KIKINA_000_85: Not a wink of sleep, great leader!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_86: Our aim, lest you wonder, is to perform such feats of heroism as will earn us a place in the songs of every alehouse in Eorzea. We mean to write a legend which will inspire adventurers as yet unborn to follow our shining example.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_87: Do you have such a goal? Large or small, it matters not. Only have a star to reach for and you will reach higher.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_88: Purpose can sustain you through times of hardship. Keep your eye on the prize, and all obstacles will be overcome in time.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_DOLOROUSBEAR_000_89: You would not think to stride into battle unclad, would you? Well, goals are as arms and armor for the spirit! I wish you fortune in your endeavors, !
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_90: Back then, are ye? With all yer limbs, an' a tale to tell, I'll wager.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_91: Fishbacks? An' there I was thinkin' ye'd only 'ave to crack a pirate skull or three. Seven hells... Ye turn yer back fer five bloody minutes, an' the scaly bastards've set up shop on yer bleedin' doorstep...
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_92: Still, sounds like ye left 'em in pieces, so I don't s'pose they'll be carryin' out whatever mischief they was plannin'─unless they was plannin' on feedin' 'emselves to the fauna o' Sastasha, o' course. Anyroad, all's well that ends well!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_93: Thanks fer sheddin' some light on this mystery. I knew ye'd get the job done, ─ye always do!
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_94: On behalf o' Limsa, I thank ye fer sheddin' some light on this mystery. Ye've lived up to yer reputation, an' I couldn't ask fer no more'n that.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_95: Now, I'll bet yer dyin' fer a rest, but just in case yer not, I was wonderin' if ye might be interested in takin' on another job? It just so 'appens that I've 'ad a request from our sister guild in Gridania, see.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_96: Seems the forest folk're in need of a 'venturer what can get things done.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_97: Fer them to ask fer 'elp like this, ye can bet the task won't be no skip through a sunny glade. But after the way ye dealt with our fishback infestation, I doubt it's anythin' ye can't 'andle.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_BADERON_000_98: Give us a shout when yer ready, an' I'll lay it out fer ye.
TEXT_MANFST203_00675_TALK_SCENE00008_000:
Temp: Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with
“It's Probably Pirates”?
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_000: Well! If it isn't  , reporting for duty. That's the zeal I like to see from an enterprising young Serpent.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_001: Hail, adventurer. I bid you welcome to the Adders' Nest. Do you seek to entwine your destiny with the Twin Adder?
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_YDA_000_002: , Commander! Sorry to disappoint you, but other business brings us here today.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_003: Yda and Papalymo, always a pleasure to see the two of you. My men tell me you quest in the name of the Scions of late.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_PAPALYMO_000_004: Quite so, Commander. A little bird told us that the Twin Adder was in need of our adventuring prowess.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_005: Aye, your little bird sings true. No doubt you've heard that we're investigating the sylphs─that curious beast tribe that calls the depths of the Twelveswood home.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_006: The sylphs are, for the most part, a peaceable bunch─much to the delight of the Elder Seedseer, who has no desire to see her people embroiled in yet another fruitless war.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_007: The Twin Adder is of the same mind, and 'tis precisely for this reason that the sylphs' relation to the primal Ramuh has raised a flag of warning amongst our ranks.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_008: Friendly as they may appear, beastmen will be beastmen.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_009: Should there be even a sliver of a chance that the summoning of the primal might disturb the balance between Gridania and the sylphic tribes, it is a possibility we cannot ignore.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_PAPALYMO_000_010: Better to be safe than sorry, indeed.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_011: Do we strike at Ramuh, or leave the sylphs to their own ways? That is the question, yet I find myself lacking ample knowledge to arrive at an answer.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_012: Opinions abound within Gridania, but to listen only to one's own is among the greatest mistakes a commander can make.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_013: I would hear from the other side─the sylphs themselves─and seek an impartial party to serve as my liaison. That is where you Scions come in.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_014: The sylphs of Little Solace remain untempered, and have held many a productive dialogue with our people. I would hear their candid thoughts on their tempered brethren.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_015: That said, I urge you to exercise due caution. Sylphic tradition and etiquette bear little resemblance to our own. It would not do to have any cross-cultural faux pas get in the way of a productive parley.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_VORSAILE_000_016: En route to Little Solace, you will come upon the Hawthorne Hut. Our officer stationed there can enlighten you as to how to win the sylphs' favor. May your expedition be a worthwhile one.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_PAPALYMO_000_017: A friendly palaver with the sylphs? This should be a pleasant enough diversion.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_PAPALYMO_000_018: The Hawthorne Hut, was it? Why, I believe the ferry departing from Westshore Pier should take us straight there.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_YDA_000_019: A friendly palaver, indeed! I hope this will be as straightforward as you say, Papalymo.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_MITAINIE_100_010: Aye, the ferry docked at the base of this hill will carry you across the lake to the East Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_MITAINIE_100_011: Once you're ashore, head due east and you should find the Hawthorne Hut without much trouble.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_MITAINIE_100_012: The Hawthornes are most welcoming folk who have shown us no small measure of goodwill. Still, a bit of courtesy goes a long way: I would encourage you to stop by Fullflower Comb and introduce yourself to Rosa before you travel on.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_020: An adventurer! Thank the Twelve! You couldn't have come at a more opportune time. Please, you must help us!
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_021: Why, it's our bees! The poor little dears are under attack by a murderous swarm of hornets!
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_022: These beehives are our livelihood. You must save them!
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_030: Thank you, friend! Finally, our bees can make their honey in peace. I knew you were Twelvesent the moment I laid eyes upon you.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_031: Hm? You travel to our hut, you say? And would speak with the serpent officer there?
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_032: There is one who goes by Amelain. He is a sentry at Josselin's Spire, but makes regular excursions to our hut. He's quite enamored of our honey and the tales of my husband, Rolfe. Though I've found him to be tight-lipped around those he's unfamiliar with.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_ROSA_000_033: ...Ooh! I know what we might try. Why don't you take a jar of fresh honey to him? I reckon you'll find him more than talkative then.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_AMELAIN_000_040: Indeed, I am Amelain of the Twin Adder. Your face is unfamiliar to─hm? You have a present for me, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_AMELAIN_000_041: A jar of Rosa's honey, and freshly harvested to boot! You certainly know how to make a first impression, friend!
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_AMELAIN_000_042: Ah, so you are the adventurer of whom the commander spoke! Do forgive me for being curt; my stomach was rumbling something fierce. My word, this honey...like liquid gold... Mmmmmm...
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_AMELAIN_000_043: A-Ahem... Forgive me. You have come to discuss not honey, but sylphs. For all their whimsy, they are a wary lot. Particularly since the Empire has come to the Shroud...
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_AMELAIN_000_044: Earn their trust, however, and they're as friendly as any folk. They have their quirks, but so do we all, no?
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_AMELAIN_000_045: Would you know more, you'd do well to speak to Rosa's husband here, Rolfe. He's forgotten more about the sylphs than I'll ever know.
TEXT_GAIUSA002_00708_POP_MESSAGE_000: A deafening buzzing assaults your ears!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_YDA_000_000: Say, . Are you in the mood for dancing?
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_YDA_000_001: That's right: dancing! You went through all that trouble to learn the sylphs' traditional greeting, but you've greeted hardly any of them.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_YDA_000_002: While you're at it, why not dance for the Gridanians around here, as well? Why, if I were a sylph, I'd be beside myself with delight to see an adventurer sharing my culture with  own kind! Me? Of course I'd be happy to join─ow, ow! There go those bloody leg cramps of mine acting up again!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_AMEEXIA_000_010: This one is weaving cloth. Walking one would know more? This one does not trust walking ones who do not show respect.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_AMEEXIA_000_011: Walking one would be a friend to these ones? This one is overjoyed! But this one keeps the ways of weaving a secret. Even if walking one learned the secret, walking one could not weave in the same way.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_AMEEXIA_000_012: Walking one is strange. This one has nothing to teach to strange ones.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_ZACHEUS_000_020: Looking to befriend the sylphs, are you? I've spent my fair share of time in these parts. Go ahead, greet me as you would a sylph─I'll let you know if your moves are up to scratch.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_ZACHEUS_000_021: That's some fine dancing, friend. Why, if you were half as tall and twice as green, I might have mistaken you for a sylph myself! Anyroad, the sylphs are a peaceful folk. Approach them with an open mind and heart, and they'll open up to you in turn.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_ZACHEUS_000_022: Gods help me! Are you supposed to be a sylph, or a lemur in heat? You'd best work on your greeting skills, lest you frighten the poor sylphs clear out of the Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_KNOLEXIA_000_030: Walking one's belly is rumbling? This one is not making a meal! This one is boiling bark and flower seeds to dye thread. Color must be jolly, and so must greet-making.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_KNOLEXIA_000_031: Oooh, walking one knows jolly dance! Jolly dance fills this one with good cheer! Let these two be friends!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_KNOLEXIA_000_032: Walking one makes strange motions. Strange motions make this one ill at ease. Go away! Shoo, shoo!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_PELIXIA_000_040: This one cannot follow walking one's words. This one begins to feel...sleepy... Does walking one not know proper greeting?
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_PELIXIA_000_041: Walking one has sprightly steps! This one is amused! Tee hee! But this one is still...sleepy... Zzzzzzzzzzzz...
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_PELIXIA_000_042: This one knows not what walking one means. This one...tries to...stay...awake...but... Zzzzzzzzzzzz...
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_IMEDIA_000_050: So you're greeting all in Little Solace in traditional sylphic fashion? A lovely gesture, I must agree! Would you be so kind as to show me? Sylphic greetings never fail to bring a smile to my face.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_IMEDIA_000_051: How charming! You'll fit right in here in Little Solace. Be forewarned, though: such pleasantries will get you nowhere with the sylphs who dwell in the homeland.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_IMEDIA_000_052: I'm not entirely certain what that was, but it's more likely to frighten the sylphs than befriend them. You'd best brush up on your sylphic greetings if you intend to accomplish anything here.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_DELLEXIA_000_060: What does walking one want with this one? Elder one warned this one not to get too friendly with walking ones...
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_DELLEXIA_000_061: Ah, walking one is a friend to these ones! Friendly like gracious elder one of forest city. Knows how to dance into these ones' hearts!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_DELLEXIA_000_062: Is that how walking ones greet other walking ones? If walking one wants to find other walking ones, maybe walking one should go home.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_MARINTERRE_000_070: In these times, Gridania can never have too many friends. As such, your enthusiasm in befriending the sylphs is admirable indeed. Very well, then, let's see how you intend to do it.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_MARINTERRE_000_071: Magnificent! You'd make an excellent ambassador to Little Solace, friend. Mind you, not all sylphs are so welcoming of outsiders. The woodland sprites would gut you before you got your feet off the ground.
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_MARINTERRE_000_072: Ye gads, ! Thank the Twelve I'm not a sylph, or we'd have a diplomatic disaster on our hands. Try that again, will you?
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_NATHAXIO_000_080: Nasty ones live beyond here. Is walking one nasty one, or happy one?
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_NATHAXIO_000_081: Ah, this walking one is a dancing one! This one is always happy to see dancing ones. Tee hee hee!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_NATHAXIO_000_082: This walking one does scary thing. This walking one is nasty one, yes? Go away! Go away, nasty walking one!
TEXT_GAIUSA103_00717_YDA_000_090: ! Would you like to hear the good news, or the better news? The good news is that your lovely dancing has brought smiles and high spirits to all of Little Solace! The better news? Why, I've thoroughly recovered from those accursed leg cramps! Onward to our next adventure!
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_PAPALYMO_000_000: . As an adventurer, you're no stranger to helping distressed folk, I'd wager.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_PAPALYMO_000_001: Tales of good deeds are quick to spread. The adventurer who comes to the aid of the local populace can go from stranger to hero o'ernight.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_PAPALYMO_000_002: No doubt you see what I'm getting at. The sylphs who make their home in Little Solace do so having been driven from their woodland home. Surely, they have their fair share of troubles.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_PAPALYMO_000_003: Seek out troubled sylphs, and see what might be done to ease their worries. A sound plan, would you not say?
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_PAPALYMO_000_004: That said, the sylphs are not known to share their worries with outsiders. You would be better off inquiring with Hearer Imedia; of the Gridanians who reside here, she is most like to be privy to the sylphs' troubles.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_IMEDIA_000_010: Ah, you've returned. Praise be to the elementals─I cannot express how happy I am to see an adventurer with a truly gentle heart. The sylphs of Little Solace are sorely in need of aid. Pray hear me out.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_IMEDIA_000_011: Being a temporary settlement, Little Solace wants for amenities, not least a stout set of defenses. Consequently, beasts from malms around are free to wander in and terrorize the hapless residents.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_IMEDIA_000_012: If you could put down the ziz gorlins and gall gnats that roam these parts─five of each should suffice─the sylphs and I would be eternally grateful.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_IMEDIA_000_013: Furthermore, perhaps you could gather five brownie brushes as well. They play an important role in sylphic culture─I do not claim to know the details─and what with such feral beasts prowling the forests, they are not easily come by.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_IMEDIA_000_014: When you are done with the deeds, seek out Komuxio. He is slow to warm to outsiders, but your good intentions will not be lost on him. My own experience speaks to this.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_KOMUXIO_000_030: Dancing one is still here? Dancing one can dance all ─this one's trust is not so easily earned.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_KOMUXIO_000_031: Hm? Dancing one brings brownie brushes for this one? This one can dye thread once more. This one is pleased.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_KOMUXIO_000_032: Dancing one kills bitey, buzzy ones? This one hates, hates, hates bitey, buzzy ones! Dancing one is kind... Too kind.
TEXT_GAIUSA104_00718_KOMUXIO_000_033: Many walking ones come to these ones' abode, but few are friendly like dancing one. Perhaps this one was wrong not to trust dancing one, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_000: No word on the sylph elder yet, but I'm sure it's only a matter of time. In the meantime, how about doing a favor for old Buscarron in return?
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_001: Right, then, let's put you to work. There's a customer outside who's spoiling for a fight and I need you to cool him off for me.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_002: No need to go cracking any skulls, though. Just grab the tub out back, fill it with cold water, and douse the drunkard. Tends to do the trick.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_003: My patrons can swill grog all night and carouse loud enough to wake the dead if they wish, but as soon as it turns violent, I've got to put my boot down.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_NPCA_000_050: What are you starin' at!? You wanna keep them eyes in yer face?
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_NPCB_000_051: Grrr... If this were anywhere but the Druthers, I'd have that fool spittin' teeth before he formed a second word.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_NPCA_000_060: Ugh! Nophica's teats, that's cold! What do you mean, “no fightin'”? This Duskwight scum was─
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_NPCA_000_061: Yeah, yeah, I know the rules. That bastard gets to keep his skin...for now.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_NPCB_000_070: Thanks for steppin' in there, friend. Not that I couldn't handle myself against a bleatin' milksop like that bloke.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_NPCB_000_071: And I don't want to cause no trouble for Buscarron. You know, havin' to mop up blood and bits o' teeth and the like.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_080: Nicely done, . I'll not have my patrons picking fights with each other over a bit of petty prejudice.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_081: In case you didn't see, the bloke who caught the brunt of that outburst is a Duskwight Elezen. They're a people who shun cities to live in the wilds, making them no better than brigands in the eyes of many.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_082: To be fair, the Duskwights can be an unruly lot, but they ain't so bad once you get to know them. And it don't seem right to bar a whole race of people from the Druthers for the misdeeds of a few.
TEXT_GAIUSA203_00726_BUSCARRON_000_083: There should be at least one place where anyone willing to pay the coin and drink in peace is welcome, don't you think?
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BUSCARRON_000_000: I appreciate all the good you've done for our patrons. If you aren't disinclined, I have a favor of my own to ask you.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BUSCARRON_000_001: There's a Qiqirn friend of mine, you see─name of Teteroon. A good lad. It was right after the Calamity that I came across him fallen in the Shroud. He nearly died in all the havoc. So, I took him in and nursed him back to health best I could.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BUSCARRON_000_002: He worked here at my Druthers for a spell after that. Got to talking about striking out on his own, he did, and not long after cast his lot with a merchant bound for La Noscea.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BUSCARRON_000_003: Well, it just so happens I got to cleaning up around here and came across something of his─this scarlet earring. I know he was fond of the thing, but he must have just forgotten it when he left. So, I'd like to see that it gets to him.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BUSCARRON_000_004: Can't say for sure where he ended up, but might be a friend of mine can. A Roegadyn fellow named Baensyng. You can find him on Hawkers' Alley in Limsa Lominsa. He knows everything of the comings and goings of merchants there.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BAENSYNG_000_010:
Ye found yer way to 'Awkers' Alley, friend.
...Hm? A Qiqirn what worked at the Druthers? Aye, ye speak of Teteroon.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BAENSYNG_000_011: Related to that Kyokyoroon bloke just o'er there by some blood or another. Two of 'em put in together an' were makin' good coin. But ol' Teteroon up an' left Limsa not long ago. Couldn't say as to why or where.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BAENSYNG_000_012: Yer better off askin' Kyokyoroon himself. He can be tight of lip, though, I warn ye. Best to take a chicken egg with ye. Li'l bastard loves the bloody things.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_BAENSYNG_000_013: Heh... Good to hear about ol' Busc, though. Sounds as though he ain't changed a bit. Just like him to send a 'venturer along. Too shy to come his own self. Gods, I miss drinkin' with that fool.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_KYOKYOROON_000_020: Customer, be welcome! Not customer? Not come with custom? Kyokyoroon busy with business. Too busy for blather.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_KYOKYOROON_000_021: Chicken egg! Kyokyoroon love chicken egg! Love chicken egg more than love customer!
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_KYOKYOROON_000_022: Looking for Teteroon? Teteroon no here no more. Teteroon leave Limsa. Teteroon go look for sparklies.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_KYOKYOROON_000_023: Now working at trading post. Good trading post. Forget where trading post is.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_KYOKYOROON_000_024: Wineburg know Teteroon. Wineburg know trading post. Wineburg at ferry docks. You go to ferry docks.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_KYOKYOROON_000_025: Kyokyoroon forget things. Wineburg remember things. You talk to Wineburg, not Kyokyoroon.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_WINEBURG_000_040: Teteroon? Aye, I seen him. That is to say, I saw him.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_WINEBURG_000_041: He was headed somewhere up north, by way of the ferry to Aleport. Might as well head there and see what ye can suss out. The skipper here can take you there.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_WINEBURG_000_042: When ye arrive, I'd start by askin' Ahldfoet. He's an old hand what knows a great deal about a great many things.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_WINEBURG_000_043: All's I know is that Teteroon stopped in Aleport. If ye want to find him, ye'd best look there.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_AHLDFOET_000_050: Teteroon? Aye, I saw him. That is to say, I seen him.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_AHLDFOET_000_051: He took himself north, through Skull Valley, into Oakwood. Was lookin' for a place run by his fellow Qiqirn.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_AHLDFOET_000_052: I reckon he meant the one right on the shore of Bronze Lake─Memeroon's Trading Post. Follow the road and yer sure to find it.
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_TETEROON_000_030: Customer, be welcome! Not customer? Not come with custom? Bring something for Teteroon?
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_TETEROON_000_031: Teteroon forget this! Forget at Druthers. Teteroon swore would never forget earring...but never forget forgot. Teteroon thank! Teteroon thank!
TEXT_GAIUSA301_00733_TETEROON_000_032: Good Buscaroon doing good? Good Buscaroon good to Teteroon. Teteroon miss good Buscaroon... <sigh>
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_TETEROON_000_000: Good Buscaroon help Teteroon. Teteroon dead without good Buscaroon. Must give thankies. Many, many thankies. Teteroon make Qiqirn firewater for Buscaroon! Buscaroon love firewater!
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_TETEROON_000_001: You help Teteroon make firewater? Need thingies to make. Need many, many thingies.
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_TETEROON_000_002: Need good water. Good water from Fool Falls. And need coeurl whiskers. Need five good coeurl whiskers.
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_DUMMY_000_010: （愚か者の滝の指定地点に空のタルを使用し滝の水を入手）
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_DUMMY_000_011: （クアールを討伐して「クアールの髭」を入手×５）
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_TETEROON_000_020: Teteroon make firewater for Buscaroon. You bring thingies Teteroon need?
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_TETEROON_000_021: You brought all thingies! Teteroon make firewater now. Make good firewater for good Buscaroon.
TEXT_GAIUSA302_00734_TETEROON_000_022: Teteroon start making firewater now. Good firewater take time. More time, more good. You come back later.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_000: I'm glad you've come, friend. There's something I want to talk to you about. You know I said I thought we might have a traitor in our midst─someone as was aiding the Garleans? Well, I'm thinking I may have identified our suspect.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_001: There's a regular of mine who used to dine on thin soup, and sip his pint on account of not being able to afford another. But of late, he's taken to ordering my best wines and the finest cuts of meat I can lay my hands on.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_002: Were he a merchant, I'd prob'ly think nothing of it, but this lad's a Wood Wailer.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_003: ...And Wood Wailers don't earn that kind of coin. By chance, I was musing on where the money was coming from when you first told me about the Garleans in the forest, and I couldn't help putting two and two together.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_004: Suffice it to say, if a Wailer's working for the Empire, none of us is safe.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_005: The lad I'm talking about goes by the name of Laurentius. Last I heard, he was in the South Shroud. Find him, , and if he is up to no good, put an end to it─and him, if it comes to that.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_010: Can you not see I am on patrol? Be gone. If you have business with the Wailers, take it to the Barracks.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_020: You again? I told you I am busy with my duties. Now piss off!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_030: Not long now... Hmph. To think patrol routes and rations would fetch such a price...
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_031: No more than I deserve, though. 'Tis little wonder the Empire has risen to such heights. If only the Wailers paid men their worth...
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_032: Y-You! What did you─? How long have you─? Help. Help! Heeelp!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_033: Please! Come quick, my friends! It is I, Laurentius! I am under attack!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_100_033: You should have buggered off when you had the chance. Now die, you interfering little swine!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_034: How...? How did you...? You just... I-I know nothing! I was on patrol. He just appeared! I...I thought you were working for the Garleans!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_040: Wh-Why are you following me!? Leave me be! I told you─that Garlean just appeared. I know nothing!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_050: How long do you mean to keep this up? What is it you imagine I've done? Enough! Enough, I say!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_051: It's... It's over, then. Aye, I sold maps and rations to the Empire. It was I. I meant no harm. I only wanted the coin.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_052: The Wailers are good. Strong. I was proud to join their ranks. Am proud. But... They do not provide. They preach justice, honor, duty. But in the end, it is those with money who do as they will. Who live as they will.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_053:
...So I sought an opportunity to change my fortunes, and took it. All I've done, I've done for money. Endangered myself, my home, everything and everyone I love...
Why, my actions have put your life in danger, too...
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_054: ...Though you do not yet realize how much. Heh heh heh! Bloody idiot─did you imagine that you had cornered me? It is not I who is cornered.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_056: Permit me a question, if you will. Are all adventurers so deluded as to believe they can challenge the power of Garlemald?
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_057: You would need a veritable mountain of gil to fund such an endeavor! Such is the cost of fighting great power. Or of making it. Or of remaking it, as we will Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_NPC_000_058: So that's the way of it. Swapped your hard bunk at the Barracks for a feather bed in Garlemald, did ye? <spit>
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_NPC_000_059: You there, . You stand here at ol' Busc's wish, no? Then you don't stand alone.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_070: Impossible... How did you best the Empire's finest? And with bandits and poachers at your side!? They are your sworn enemies! Why do they fight with you and not against you!?
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_071: ...Ah, but I know the answer only too well. Buscarron. This is his doing. His words are wont to inspire men to act. Better men than I... Gods, what have I become? What have I done?
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_072: I... I am sorry. No more will I pursue this folly. No more lies. No more bribes. I will go to the Order of the Twin Adder and confess my crimes.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_000_073: There is something I would like you to tell Buscarron. Tell him Laurentius the fool says “thank you.” I feel as though a veil has been lifted from before my eyes.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_080: Aye, Laurentius confessed to his crimes. I just had word from the Twin Adder. Seems he marched straight into the Nest and gave himself up.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_081: The lad's had quite a life, you know... His mother was killed by a brigand when he was only small. As a young man, he joined the Wailers, hoping to spare his fellow Gridanians the misery he'd known growing up.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_082: Trouble is, protecting Gridania's too big a job for one man, and he came to believe that he couldn't make a difference─that it was hopeless.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_083: There are few things more dangerous than desperation, and a man lost in the dark is easily drawn to the glimmer of coin. I reckon he thought that if he couldn't change the lot of his fellow man, he might as well change his own. Thing is, he was making a difference─just not on his own. Somehow, he'd failed to grasp one simple truth─that those things we cannot do alone, we must do together.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_084: ...Eh? He asked you to thank me, did he? Then there's good in him yet. I just hope them at the Adders' Nest are able to see it... What he's done ain't easy to forgive, but I'd like to think he'd be afforded a chance to make amends.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_BUSCARRON_000_085: But let us leave fates to the Twelve. I have other news for you, . The sylph elder has been found!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_POP_MESSAGE_000: A foreboding wind blows through the treetops...
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_BATTLETA: You mean to stand against the might of the Empire with this Redbelly rabble at your side? Hah!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_REDBERRYLEADER_BATT: Your eyes betray your words, coward. You know full well the Wailers fear the Wasps' sting.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_IMPERIALLEADER_GAIU: After these trees drink your blood, I will see to it they are cut down and burned.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_BATTLETA: Show them what happens to those who oppose the Empire!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_COEURLCLAW_GAIUSA30: If this is a fight Buscarron wants won, then the Coeurlclaws will fight it.
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_BATTLETA: How? Why!? You scum have no allegiances!
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_IMPERIALLEADER_GAIU: So, this is to be my end...
TEXT_GAIUSA308_00740_LAURENTIUS_BATTLETA: How...? How has it come to this?
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_000: Ah, the investigative adventurer! Are you still on the trail of that masked man, by any chance? I happened to remember something, and would share it with you!
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_001: You'll recall my telling you how the Qiqirn have been raiding Highbridge nigh without cease. Well, there is a rumor that those filthy rats have been meeting with a great hulk of a man in secret.
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_002: While I can't say whether this is the mystery fellow you seek, I reckon it's as good a lead as any other.
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_003: According to witnesses, the rendezvous takes place in the Qiqirn lair located southeast of here. If you go there, perhaps you'll come upon some kind of clue. Be careful, though: the nasty buggers don't take kindly to visitors...
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_DUMMYTODO_000_010: You have found an invaluable clue!
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_020: So, did you end up investigating the Qiqirn lair?
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_030:
A letter you can't make heads or tails of? Let me see here...
...Hmmm, this is written in Amaljic. You're in luck! Just so happens I learned a spot of it back in the day, so as to expand my potential clientele. Seems the contents pertain to... Whoa! People trafficking!?
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_031: Gods be good... If I'm reading this right, the Qiqirn are trying to strike a deal with the Amalj'aa. They mean to catch hapless souls at Highbridge and sell them off like sacks of popotoes!
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_032: To think that different tribes of beastmen are colluding in their villainy... I must warn everyone to maintain vigilance!
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_033: You have my thanks, adventurer. Had you not braved the Qiqirn lair, no one here would have known what the creatures were plotting until they actually began picking us off, one by one.
TEXT_GAIUSA410_00752_HIHIBARU_000_034: On the other hand...I suppose this means you're no closer to finding your man. Well, unless it's an Amalj'aa you're looking for. But, uh...probably not, huh?
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MINFILIA_000_000: While you were tending to business in Thanalan, some new information arrived courtesy of our friends the sylphs.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MINFILIA_000_001: An individual fitting Lahabrea's description has been sighted in the North Shroud. This sighting comes in the wake of a series of mysterious deaths in the selfsame area. My instincts tell me that our man is involved.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MINFILIA_000_002: I would have you continue your investigation where you left off. Twelve willing, we will pick up Lahabrea's trail once more.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MINFILIA_000_003: Noraxia can furnish you with the details. Pray speak with her, and take it from there. As always, be careful out there, .
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_NORAXIA_000_010: Walking one is to investigate sinister one? Then heed well this one's words.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_NORAXIA_000_011: This one is friends with a walking one in the Ashcrown Consortium. According to friendly one, a digging one named Medrod had an encounter with a scary masked one. This masked one is most certainly sinister one!
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_NORAXIA_000_012: Walking one should go and speak with digging one Medrod. Digging one is to be found at Fallgourd Float in the North Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_020: P-Please leave me be... I'm not long for this world...
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_021: I...I looked death in the face... 'Tis only a matter of time before he comes for me, just like he came for that poor woman...
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_025: <sob> Mummyyy! I'm sorry I wasn't a better son! I'm sorry I didn't eat my greens and do my chores! Waaaaaah!
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_AIDEEN_000_030: You wanted words with Medrod? Well, as you can see, that might be...tricky. He's been this way near a fortnight. If you need him to make sense in a hurry, might be as I can give you some advice. Though he looks a man grown, Medrod's still a little boy on the inside.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_AIDEEN_000_031: You might try feeding him a serving of lentils and chestnuts, his mother's specialty. Stuff should be easy enough to find in Gridania. Oh, and a few soothing words wouldn't go astray either. Nothing like Mummy's cooking and her expert ministrations for a skinned knee, as it were.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_040: It was horrible...a waking nightmare... Cannot unsee... Oh, gods, what have I done to deserve this? MUMMYYY! <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_041: <gasp> You...you found it! This is my favoritest dish in the whole world! Mum made this for me whenever I felt glum, and it never failed to make me forget my─ Wait a minute! You're trying to make me tell you...tell you...about that, aren't you!? No... Too horrible...
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_050: I don't care how much of my favoritest dish you give me! Nothing on Hydaelyn is worse than what I saw... Nothing!
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_060: ...Y-You're right. It's not as bad as it seems. I saw something terrible, that's true, but that hardly means I'm going to suffer the same fate. Thanks to you, I can think straight again. I believe I can even recount what I saw without losing it.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_061: It was just another ordinary day. I was headed back to the Float when I noticed a suspicious character in the distance─a masked man garbed head to toe in black. He had a hideous fiend in tow, a winged creature that was all eyeball and jagged teeth. Taken by curiosity, I crept as near as I dared...
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_062: ...To see the corpse of a woman! One glimpse was enough to tell me that she'd died a gruesome death!
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_063: In that instant, I knew right away that the masked man was a minion of Thal, come to claim her soul for His realm.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_064: What!? You're investigating this same masked man!?
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_AIDEEN_000_065: If that's the case, we'll help you in whatever way we can!
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_IVAURAULT_000_065: Aye, anything to ensure that we won't have to suffer Medrod's hysteria ever again.
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_066: All right, teamwork! That's what I wanted to─wait, I haven't been that bad, have I...? At any rate, I'm all for helping this adventurer. It's the least I can do to repay  for bringing me lentils and chestnuts!
TEXT_GAIUSA711_00784_MEDROD_000_070: Wh-What are you playing at!? If you're trying to soothe me, you're going about it all wrong!
TEXT_GAIUSA801_00785_AIDEEN_000_000: So, here's what I know about the deaths: all the victims were found with their faces torn to shreds.
TEXT_GAIUSA801_00785_AIDEEN_000_001: Among the local fauna, only the scalekin known as ziz could inflict such wounds. That's why some folk are pointing the finger at them.
TEXT_GAIUSA801_00785_AIDEEN_000_002: I somehow doubt that the answer's that simple, but for the sake of thoroughness, we should look into it. Why don't you put down, say, six of the creatures, and see if you can find any proof connecting them to the deaths?
TEXT_GAIUSA801_00785_AIDEEN_000_020: You've already seen to the ziz? Good work, adventurer! So, were you able to find aught to suggest that the creatures are our culprits?
TEXT_GAIUSA801_00785_AIDEEN_000_021: ...Nothing? Truth be told, even if there were proof, I wouldn't know what it looked like. Aaanyway, I believe we can safely strike ziz from our list of suspects. Which leaves us with...the masked man and his winged eyeball!
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_000: Let me be clear: this business between you, me, and the captain must remain a secret.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_001: See, I don't regret my time spent with the Company in the slightest. Traveling the world, meeting interesting people, killing them─it was all jolly good fun.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_002: Alas, Gridanians are, by and large, an unforgiving lot─Detoh here being a rare exception.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_003: I've had to go to great lengths to ensure that I am seen as a model citizen, with no taste for drinking, whoring, gambling, and all those other activities I so dearly miss.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_004: So understand that if you ruin my little charade by wagging your tongue, I'll fashion a noose with your entrails and hang you from the nearest heavenspillar.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_005: Now then, where were we...ah, yes, the egg. The first thing you must do is deal with the sentries patrolling the adamantoise breeding grounds. Poaching is illegal in Gridania, in case you were unaware.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_006: A shame we have so few Wailers to spare─especially with brownie brushes almost in season. Matron forfend if agaric flies claim the crop before we receive additional sentries...
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_007: Aye, we will also soon need barrels of stingbrew to weaken and ward off the pests.
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_100_008: But if any of the vilekin were found near the shrooms before we can take preventative measures, we would be forced to shift our patrols immediately...
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_008: You will, of course, notify me if you encounter any agaric flies in the vicinity of the Lower Paths, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_021: I pray this year's crop of brownie brushes comes late...
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_022: Oh my, is this a brownie brush? And you say you slew a whole swarm of agaric flies!?
TEXT_GAIUSB008_00815_LANDENEL_000_023: Matron's teats, we cannot wait for reinforcements! We must do something!
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_LANDENEL_000_000: This agaric fly infestation requires our full attention. I thank you for bringing it to my attention, adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_LANDENEL_000_001: If I may impose upon your kindness further, I would ask you to inform my subordinates of this dire development.
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_LANDENEL_000_002: I have three Wailers currently standing guard in Rootslake. Inform each man that they are to proceed to the Lower Paths and search for agaric fly swarms until further notice.
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_KIKOKUTAIA_000_010: Agaric flies? In the Lower Paths? Then I mustn't delay! Thank you for relaying Captain Landenel's orders, adventurer!
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_KIKOKUTAIB_000_020:
A message from the captain?
Damn, those vilekin are a danger to travelers on the road. I will depart immediately.
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_KIKOKUTAIC_000_030: What's that? Everyone is to search the Lower Paths for agaric flies? Hmmm...I know we haven't had to deal with poachers recently, but I cannot help but worry that they will strike in our absence. <sigh> But an order is an order.
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_LANDENEL_000_040: ...I take it you have informed my men, then? Excellent work, .
TEXT_GAIUSB009_00816_LANDENEL_000_041: However, I cannot keep the roosters distracted for too long. If you wish to pillage the hen house, you must do so now.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_000: Well, what are you waiting for? There's a perfectly good adamantoise egg in a nest to the east of here, just ripe for the taking.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_001: Not that I expect you to live long enough to claim it! The mother never strays far from the child, and you will surely be attacked the moment you lay hands upon the egg.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_002: ...There will be other heroes, . You do not need to challenge Titan. Abandon your quest, or your corpse will rot in this swamp.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_020: I thought you might have the good sense to leave this place. By your continued presence, I take it you intend to persevere to the bitter end?
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_025: Ahahaha! Such bravery, such recklessness! That will serve you well against Titan.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_026: Leave the egg with me─I'll see that it gets to the captain. You should make haste to southern Thanalan.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_LANDENEL_000_027: In Forgotten Springs, you will find a man named U'odh Nunh. He will be your next guide. Safe travels, .
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_UODHNUN_000_040:
State your business, adventurerrr.
<snort> Hah hah hah! So this is the one Wheiskaet sends me.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_UODHNUN_000_041: I haven't the foggiest what he sees in you─and until I do, you will rrreceive no aid from me.
TEXT_GAIUSB012_00819_POP_MESSAGE_000: You feel the ground tremble beneath your feet...
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_000: Perrrsistent bugger. Very well, let's have a look at you.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_001: ...You've seen your share of battle, there's no mistaking that. And you did manage to obtain that adamantoise egg. However, that was naught more than a display of brrrute force and blind courage.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_002: The nunh I once fought also believed that his strrrength would save him. He was wrong, and now I am nunh.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_003: Many years ago, I joined the Company of Heroes to hone my skills, instead of challenging my predecessor before I was ready. Even when I was young, I understood that victorrry goes to the patient, the cunning, the pragmatic.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_004: That is why I claimed my position, and it is why I still hold it. And it is why I will not help an unprrroven whelp.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_005: The Children of the Sands do not offer aid to strangers. To do so is a sign of weakness. However, if you were rrrecognized as a skilled hunter in your own right, it would be permissible to assist you.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_006: A child who wishes to become a hunterrr must collect the blood of seven sundrakes. You are not a child, so you may find this to be easy. But you are not of the U tribe, so perhaps not.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_007: I will consider your rrrequest once you have brought me the blood, and not a moment sooner.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_030: I will not help an unproven whelp. Brrring me the blood, or we have nothing to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_035: You are a hunterrr of beasts. This much I now know to be true.
TEXT_GAIUSB101_00820_UODHNUN_000_036: But Titan is no mere beast. If you mean to hunt a god, you must prove much more to me.
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_WHEISKAET_000_000: Bravo, . Thanks to you, our guests shall be honored with a marvelous banquet.
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_WHEISKAET_000_001: But what good is an exotic feast without an equally exquisite aperitif?
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_WHEISKAET_000_002: Aye, your work is not yet finished. Before we can discuss Titan, you must first bring us a suitable wine. Speak with Dyrstweitz over yonder─he is overseeing preparations for the banquet, and will tell you what you must do.
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_DYRSTWEITZ_000_010: Beg your pardon, , but I've got my hands full with─ Oh, you're the adventurer sent to pick up the wine! Thank the gods, we've nothing on hand that will meet with Master Gegeruju's approval.
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_DYRSTWEITZ_000_011: Take this order slip and run along to Wineport. One of Wheiskaet's friends from the old days, Shamani Lohmani, is our supplier.
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_DYRSTWEITZ_000_012: Who'd've thought that a former mercenary would have such refined tastes, eh? Everyone here agrees that he's a natural vintner. If you're lucky, maybe he'll let you have a taste!
TEXT_GAIUSB208_00839_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: ...Sweat, grime, and blood. Aye, you reek of blood. An adventurer, unless I am mistaken. What brings you to Wineport?
An order? Let me guess─a request for the finest vintage I can muster.
<sniff> <sniff> The paper smells of loam and perfume. Costa del Sol. And there is also the─<cough>─unmistakable odor of goblin cheese...
Yes, Master Gegeruju would not settle for anything less than the best. Dyrstweitz and his crew must be quite busy preparing an exotic feast, hence his decision to rely on an adventurer.
Ah, but perhaps you are confused. This display of deduction was not intended to impress you.
When one loses his vision, he is forced to compensate in other ways. But you've no interest in my affairs─you wish only to discuss the wine, I suspect.
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_000: Do...do you have any children? I've a...a son and a daughter. They were so little when I left... They probably think I'm dead.
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_001: I've been saving for years to...to buy passage back home somehow. But...still not enough. Maybe...maybe you could bring me some jungle coeurl skins? I...I can sell them. I just...I just want to go home...
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_020: Please... Even a few skins would help...
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_031: You...you helped me. Even after what my comrades and I did to your country...
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_032: We were on a reconnaissance mission when the Maelstrom caught us by surprise. We tried to escape, but the others... N-No one else survived.
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_033: I didn't ask for this, dammit! I'm not even Garlean! They conquered my lands just like they tried to conquer yours!
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_034: I...I don't want to die in some blasted jungle halfway around the world...
TEXT_GAIUSB306_00847_DREST_000_035: I just...I just want to go home...
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_000: I hate to impose further after everything you've done, but would you mind helping Dyrstweitz lay out the banquet?
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_001: Our guests of honor are already here in Costa del Sol, and so Master Gegeruju has demanded that we finish preparations immediately.
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_002: Hm? The guests? Oh, I'm told that one is a beautiful Miqo'te scholar. Personally, I'm more curious about her companion, some famous adventurer with an endless list of accomplishments.
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_003: But you can judge for yourself soon enough.
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_004: Anyway, go and lend Dyrstweitz a hand. The poor man is liable to collapse from the stress.
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_DYRSTWEITZ_000_010: Perfect timing, ! Take all of this and arrange it on the counter!
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_DYRSTWEITZ_000_011: No time to chat─they'll be here any minute!
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_030: Excellent timing, . Now that both our guests are present, the feast can begin!
TEXT_GAIUSB313_00854_WHEISKAET_000_031: Where are they, you ask? Why don't you ask your associate? I'm sure she'll be happy to explain.
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_EADUUARD_000_000: Aw, just my luck! I scavenged this here oven, thinkin' I could use it to make myself hot meals, but it looks to be in a bad way. Lots of dents, a few holes even...
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_EADUUARD_000_001: Hey, you're pretty well traveled, ain't ye? Ever seen one of these before─or better yet, know how to fix it? No? Bah...
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_EADUUARD_000_002: Wait, I know who we ought to ask. Mind showin' this oven to Marques for me? He repaired a clockwork toy I found once, so maybe he can do somethin' with it.
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_MARQUEZ_000_010: ...Is there something I can do for you?
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_MARQUEZ_000_011: This...this is an alchemist's alembic. You say the boy wishes to use it for cooking?
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_MARQUEZ_000_012: I suppose it would be possible, were I to make some modifications...but I would need a bronze ornamental hammer to do so. Can you bring me one, ? You need only go so far as Camp Drybone to find a merchant who sells tools.
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_MARQUEZ_000_020: I can convert the alembic into a makeshift oven, but only once you have brought me that hammer.
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_MARQUEZ_000_021: Thank you, . It shan't take more than a day, I believe.
TEXT_GAIUSB502_00871_MARQUEZ_000_022: It's strange...I know I must have learned these skills long ago, but I haven't the foggiest when and where that was...
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_000: Excuse me, ...do you have a moment? It concerns this broken horologe which was found in the pocket of a man brought here for burial.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_001: There is something...familiar about it...but just what I cannot say. Perhaps if I tinker with the device, it will come to me.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_002: However, I lack the proper tools to do so. I would ask that you journey to Ul'dah in my stead to obtain a bull-point chisel and a pair of needle-nose pincers. If you are willing to do this, please note that, as they are uncommon tools, you may need to visit the Goldsmiths' Guild and browse the markets in order to find them.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MEMEDESU_000_010: A bull-point chisel? Why, yes, we happen to have a surplus of that particular tool. By all means, take one if you so desire. An odd request, if you don't mind me saying─it has a very limited number of applications...
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_SYNTGOHT_000_020: Welcome, welcome! What might a discerning─ My word, did you say needle-nose pincers? You must be a skilled craftsman indeed! Please, take this pair as a gift. By the by, do you have representation here in the exchange? If not, I would be most interested in discussing a partnership...
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_030: Have you brought the tools I requested?
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_031: Hmmm...something occurs to me. Please wait here for a moment.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_032: It was for naught. Though I repaired the device easily, this sensation that stirs within me remains a mystery.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_033: But how...how did I do it?
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_034: These hands...my hands, they moved with a mind of their own, deftly manipulating the clockwork mechanisms...
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_035: There was no doubt or uncertainty. I knew exactly what to do, as though I had performed the same motions countless times before...
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_MARQUEZ_000_036: P-Pardon me, ─this was a mistake. Please give the horologe to Sister Eluned. The man who once owned it is currently in her care, and I think it best that it be returned to him.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_ELUNED_000_040: Good  to you, . Have you come to pay your respects to this man?
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_ELUNED_000_041: Never before have I seen such a queer device. You say that it measures the passing of time?
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_ELUNED_000_042: Mayhap they are more common in Garlemald. I am given to understand that its cities are filled with all manner of amazing technologies.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_ELUNED_000_043: Marques said that it belonged to the deceased? Oh dear... You don't suppose that the owner might have been a Garlean spy? It may behoove us to notify the authorities in Camp Drybone.
TEXT_GAIUSB503_00872_ELUNED_000_044: But...mayhap more importantly, how did Marques manage to repair this device? I knew he had a talent for the trades, but this goes far beyond mending fences and thatching rooves...
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_000: There is one thing I regret to inform you: though we wished to inter your comrades on church grounds, the number of fallen Scions far exceeded our estimates.
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_001: After discussing the matter with Father Iliud, we have concluded that we have no choice but to bury the dead in the same plots as those who perished in the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_002: Please forgive us. We do not wish to dishonor the memory of the fallen. But, as caretakers of the lichyard, these are the realities we must face.
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_003: ... What befell your order was an unforgivable crime. If you would have these villains brought to justice, consider making a pilgrimage to the mark of the Warden.
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_004: Though I do not follow the teachings of Azeyma, it is said that to offer prayers before Her mark is to invoke Her divine judgment. Regardless of your faith, mayhap it would be worth the effort.
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_SYSTEM_000_010: As you kneel before the mark of the Warden in a moment of quiet solitude, you breathe deep of the dry desert air. The roar of the rushing waters is punctuated by the faint chirping of vilekin and the shrill cries of a hawk. The gods, however, remain silent...
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_020: You have honored the dead with your pilgrimage, . Even if Azeyma did not hear your prayers, I believe that they provided comfort to your fallen brethren.
TEXT_GAIUSB508_00877_ELUNED_000_021: Remember that although the body is but a vessel that must one day be surrendered to the Lifestream, our souls shall endure, and the righteous shall find solace in Thal's realm.
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_000: Excuse me, . You don't know me, but I've observed you assisting the priests with their work. I too would like to offer what succor I might.
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_001: Since tending the lichyard in this heat can quickly sap one's energies, perhaps a restorative drink made to combat fatigue would be ideal.
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_002: Of course, Aqua del Sol! That would surely do the trick!
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_003: To make it, I would need a freshly cut brazo del sol. I've not the skill at arms to slay a wild sabotender del sol─but you do, so...
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_004: You need only go as far as the spring east of Camp Drybone─the beasts are often sighted in that vicinity. If you brought me one of their arms, I could make enough Aqua del Sol for everyone!
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_021: I never imagined that you would return so quickly! Thank you so much.
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_022: It's an incredibly simple beverage to prepare. If you would wait but one moment...
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_023: There! This should serve as a sample of─wait, don't drink it! I mean, I...I was hoping you might give the first glass to Marques on my behalf.
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_ILCUM_000_024: Of course, I intend to provide everyone with a glass eventually. It's just that Marques is so...
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_MARQUEZ_000_032: Was it perhaps the girl who...? No, no, it couldn't have been her.
