TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_MARQUEZ_000_033: I appreciate Ilcum's kind gesture, but Father Iliud is in far greater need of this juice. His work places great strain on his body and soul, yet he continues to neglect his health...
TEXT_GAIUSB512_00881_POP_MESSAGE_000: You hear the pitter-patter of tiny feet...
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: It may take some time before I receive any information regarding your missing airship. While you wait, mayhap you might indulge me a small favor?
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: It is obvious to me that you know much and more of the ways of war. I ask that you share that knowledge with our knights, so that they might be better prepared when next the Dravanian Horde strikes.
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_002: One of my veteran knights is presently conducting a training session just beyond our western gate. Pray seek him out and introduce yourself. He will explain how you can help.
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_NPC_000_010: A fine  to you, . Lord Haurchefant tells me you possess a great deal of experience─certainly more than the green boys I mean to test today. If you will allow, I would like to even the odds by setting all three against you. No objections, yes? Then let us begin─knights, to arms!
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_NPC_000_015: Hah! You certainly live up to Lord Haurchefant's expectations! 'Twas a privilege to watch you fight, .
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_020: I observed everything from the western wall. Splendid performance, !
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_021: Mayhap you have discerned this during your short time here, but House Fortemps regards outsiders differently than the other High Houses. We have no objections to employing adventurers and sellswords, for example, whereas the others have, for all intents and purposes, forbidden the practice.
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_022: They do so at their peril. To disregard a man's talents solely because of the circumstances of his birth is shortsighted and foolish.
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_HAURCHEFANT_000_023: You know...after watching you spar with our knights, I am reminded that you are a  of action. Doubtless you would rather take a more active role in my inquiries, yes? Then let us discuss how you can do just that.
TEXT_GAIUSB701_00896_POP_MESSAGE_000: A trio of battle cries assaults your ears!
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: The man with knowledge of the Enterprise awaits you outside. I pray his information proves useful to you.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_010: How quickly the commoners' opinions change. They say Lord Francel is innocent now, but just a few days prior...
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_011: Anyway, you were inquiring as to the whereabouts of an airship last seen in Coerthas several days before the Calamity, yes? Well, it so happens that I was monitoring the night sky at the Observatorium during that period. I recall that a small vessel came from the direction of Gridania and landed somewhere in the far northwest.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_012: Relying on my memory alone, I can say no more than that. However, were you to bring me the astroscope log from the evening in question, I could calculate a more accurate location.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_013: The log I require is volume six of the 1572 readings. It should be stored with the other past logs on the uppermost floor of the Observatorium, just below the astroscope. I believe it will be a large red leather-bound tome─though you ought to confirm the date and volume number if you are at all unsure.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_020: The past logs are all stored on the uppermost floor of the Observatorium. There's no security, so you can freely peruse them. Of course, even if you did find the correct volume on your own, it would be useless without an astrologian to interpret the data.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_040: Did you perchance find the correct log? The sixth volume from 1572? I would understand if you failed─the other catalogers were often careless when returning old volumes to the shelf.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_041: My word, you actually found it! <sniff> <sniff> This musty old smell brings back such fond memories... Ah, here we are! If you would permit me a moment to make some calculations...
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_042: Hmmm... It is as I feared. The ship landed near the Stone Vigil, of all places, which means that the garrison almost certainly seized the vessel and brought it within their walls. If so, then you would need an army of knights to have any hope of securing it.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_NPC_000_043: Though Lord Haurchefant is, from all indications, quite fond of you, so mayhap he can lend you a few? In any case, I have done my part. I shall pray for your success, friend.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_HAURCHEFANT_000_050: Oh, so you've at last located the Enterprise! I believe congratulations are in order.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_HAURCHEFANT_000_051: The Stone Vigil? Ah...perhaps I spoke too soon. The outpost has been held by the dragons for years, and all access is restricted by decree of House Durendaire.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_HAURCHEFANT_000_052: I will write a letter to Lord Drillemont of Whitebrim Front and request that he grant you permission to enter. That said, I fear my influence alone will not suffice, so I suggest that you request Lord Francel do the same.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_HAURCHEFANT_000_053: Now that your business in Camp Dragonhead is concluded, I suspect we may not meet again for some time.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_HAURCHEFANT_000_054: I wish you well in your journeys, . May Halone guide you.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_FRANCEL_000_060: Wonderful to see you again, ! If there is anything I can do to repay you, name it.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_FRANCEL_000_061: ...So the airship you seek is likely inside the Stone Vigil. It shames me to say that it too was once an outpost held by House Haillenarte. In the chaos that followed the Calamity, the Dravanian Horde caught us unawares. The fiends have held the outpost ever since.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_FRANCEL_000_062: As we lack the strength of arms to retake the Stone Vigil, House Durendaire instead has been charged with the duty. Given that, I doubt that my words will carry much weight with Lord Drillemont. Nevertheless, I will write you your letter.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_FRANCEL_000_063: Before you depart, a word of caution: the cravens who attempted to destroy House Haillenarte have yet to be unmasked. Though their plans were foiled, they doubtless still harbor great hatred towards us─and towards you now as well.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_BRUNADIER_000_070: You desire an audience with Lord Drillemont, do you? Hah! I desire a night in a warm bed with my wife, but wishing won't make it so.
TEXT_GAIUSB808_00917_BRUNADIER_000_071:
What do we have here? Letters from Lords Haurchefant and Francel, is it? A likely─
...Oh, you're serious. Hmmm...what to do, what to do...
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_BENEDICT_000_000: Come now, you didn't think it would be that easy to earn Lord Drillemont's trust, did you? Even if you are who you claim to be, it would be reckless for him to believe your story without question.
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_BENEDICT_000_001: At the very least, you ought to show your support for House Durendaire by culling feral crocs in our stead.
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_BENEDICT_000_002: A simple gesture like that would probably earn you the respect of Ser Clotairion, as he's always struggling to find men to attend to the task. Why not give it a try?
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_CLOTAIRION_000_020: A little bird tells me that you slew some crocs in an effort to curry my favor. I'm afraid you've been had, ─that young fellow merely sought to shirk his duties.
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_CLOTAIRION_000_021: Still, your heart was in the right place, and it cannot be denied that the people of Coerthas are better off without those beasts. Very well, I will see that Lord Drillemont is made aware of your deeds.
TEXT_GAIUSB902_00925_CLOTAIRION_000_022: Do try to understand my lord's position, though. It is his responsibility to ensure that Whitebrim Front is prepared for every eventuality, be it an endless blizzard or a Dravanian assault. He will not put our efforts to retake the Stone Vigil at risk without good cause, which you have yet to give.
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_000: Oh, it's you! Beg your pardon, , but I've heard whispers that you wish to prove yourself trustworthy to Lord Drillemont. Perhaps we can be of service to one another. I am a humble herald of House Haillenarte, you see, and I was to deliver a most important missive to Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_001: I was traveling along the road when a fearsome flurry of snow began to fall. As the curtains of white descended around me, a sudden gust of wind from the Sea of Clouds tore the parchment from my hands! I fell to my knees and groped blindly, hoping to recover it...but to no avail.
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_002: It could not have been blown far from the road, but the wilds are treacherous and filled with terrors! I had no choice but to seek shelter here. And so I must ask you to recover the missive and deliver it to Lord Drillemont in my stead.
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_DRILLEMONT_000_020: Did I not make myself clear!? Begone from my sight, foreigner, or I shall have you removed!
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_DRILLEMONT_000_021:
A missive? Give me that!
...“Houses Fortemps and Haillenarte hereby formally advise that all restrictions on employing foreign sellswords be─”
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_DRILLEMONT_000_022: Hmph. These are naught more than the ill-conceived notions of a hopeless romantic and a naive lordling. House Durendaire would not even be in this position had not House Haillenarte failed to hold the Stone Vigil!
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_DRILLEMONT_000_023: They would have us pit one horde against another. Nay, I say! We need only Ishgardian steel to cleanse the realm of these godless heathens!
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_030: Lord Drillemont rejected our proposal, didn't he? I could hear him shouting even from here...
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_031: Alas, he is not the only one to heap disdain upon House Haillenarte. Ever since we lost the Steel and Stone Vigils, we have been at the mercy of the other High Houses.
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_032: We should be the ones fighting to reclaim the lost outpost. Yet it is House Durendaire that must pay the price for our failure.
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_NIVIE_000_033: But how can I bear Lord Drillemont's harsh words back to Lord Francel? Ah...mayhap I should remain here for the nonce...
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_POP_MESSAGE_000: You hear the beating of wings...
TEXT_GAIUSB903_00926_ACCESS_MESSAGE: The missive slips through your fingers.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_000: Might I have a word with you, ? It concerns the chirurgeons. After speaking with them earlier, I learned that they lack sufficient alembics for their needs, you see...
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_001: So I used some of their broken equipment to craft a more advanced alembic─both as a gesture of goodwill, and as a means to help me recover my memories, since working with my hands kindles familiar feelings.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_002: All I require to complete the device are the cores of six ice sprites. Though commonly used to reduce the temperatures of alchemical mixtures, there is a way to alter their properties so that they draw the cold within rather than radiate it without.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_003: It must sound ridiculous to you─impossible, even. Yet somehow I know it will work.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_020: Have you obtained the cores? If so, please show them to me.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CENOTA_000_031: What an amazing device! But...is it truly an alembic, sir? I've never seen its like before.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_ASTIDIEN_000_032: I too am unsure what to make of this machine. While certainly impressive, I've no idea how to make use of it.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CENOTA_000_033: Nevertheless, if it is as effective as he claims, it will be a great boon to the infirmary! Think of the medicines we could create, the lives we could save!
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_GUILLAIME_000_035: Ware thee the kindly stranger, bearer of gifts wondrous and strange, for his generosity comes at cost.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_GUILLAIME_000_036: Their earnest efforts are but a means to an as-yet-unknown end. Moreover, you should be wary of associating with individuals who have interfered with the questioning of a suspected heretic.
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_ASTIDIEN_000_037: They did what!? Bless you, Inquisitor, for coming along when you did! We almost succumbed to the temptation proffered by these...these unbelievers!
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_038: Why does that man detest us so? Is it all because we interrupted Lord Francel's trial?
TEXT_GAIUSB914_00937_CID_000_039: Whatever his reasons, he clearly means to oppose us at every turn...
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_000: Ahhh, so rare it is to find fellow intellectuals in this region. 'Tis even rarer to find one capable of comprehending the nature of corrupted crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_001: Come to think of it, there was another─a hermit to whom the church had given sanctuary. Curious fellow. Unsociable, rather daft at first impression, yet possessed of an amazing affinity towards the scientific pursuits...
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_002: But to the matter at hand─did you say you wish not to conduct field observations, but to harvest a corrupted crystal?
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_003: Egads, ! At least take the necessary precautions so that you do not suffer from exposure to its harmful energies! I'm beginning to wonder if you've sufficient qualifications to handle such hazardous materials...
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_004: Still, your ignorance is somehow endearing. If you bring me a suitable vessel─say, a common clay pot─I shall coat it with an alchemical sealant of mine own design. Simply store the crystal you seek within this pot to protect yourself from its deleterious effects.
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_005: Hm? Where might you find a clay pot? Well, I'm hardly a merchant, but surely some fellow at the Golden Bazaar has some for sale.
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_ENPC_000_010: You get a pot! And you get a pot! Everyone gets a pot! Ahem, sorry─I get a bit carried away when disposing of old merchandise. Anyroad, take my pot, please.
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_ENPC_000_015: If this is about the pot, bugger off. I'm not taking it back.
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_020: Fascinating...even accounting for the unusually strong aetherial currents in this region, the crystalline formations are─ Oh, you've returned! Any luck finding a pot like I suggested?
TEXT_GAIUSC103_00954_LAMBERTEINT_000_030: Well, this is indeed an unremarkable piece of rubbish! But for our purposes, it shall suffice.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_CEANA_000_000: Don't fret, now─I know exactly where to find a corrupted crystal comprised of ice-aspected aether. An associate of mine in Gridania has been studying the effects of one such crystal on living beings.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_CEANA_000_001: Eh? What's with that expression? I thought you would be pleased to hear this news! This is not another wild-dodo chase, I assure you!
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_CEANA_000_002: And what's even better is that this time, you needn't use that warded pot of yours to protect yourself from this crystal's energies. Hedyn's findings suggest that it is quite safe.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_CEANA_000_003: Why, you ask? Well...let's just say that it has undergone a unique process that has rendered such precautions unnecessary.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_CEANA_000_004: Anyway, do not let me keep you. It has been a pleasure, . Come back and see me sometime, all right?
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_000_010: Greetings and salutations.  , I presume? Ceana informed me of your adventures in Aleport. Terribly sorry about the misunderstanding. Though, as Professor Lamberteint is fond of saying, “No action taken in the name of science is ever truly wasteful.”
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_100_010: To the matter at hand─corrupted crystals possessing the properties you seek could be found in abundance at the Standing Corses following the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_000_011: Alas, that is no longer the case...and while there is at least one suitable crystal that remains to be found within the Twelveswood, precisely where it is at any given moment is more difficult to say.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_000_012: Permit me to explain. You are familiar with spriggans, yes? The furry little rascals that are wont to seek out ores and other stones? Well, one such creature with an infamously insatiable appetite has single-handedly devoured every corrupted crystal in the Twelveswood. Fortunately for you, these crystals take an eternity to digest─assuming they can even be digested─and I am reasonably confident that one still resides within his gut.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_000_013: It's quite fascinating, really. My theory is that this “Giggity” first consumed a corrupted crystal when... <sigh> You couldn't care less about all this, could you?
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_000_014: To the point, then. Giggity has grown so ravenous that even his fellow spriggans now fear for their safety. Some have gone so far as to petition the other inhabitants of the Twelveswood for succor.
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_HEDYN_000_015: In fact, the other day, I heard that a spriggan had been spotted in the vicinity of Little Solace. I propose that you find this wayward creature and use him to track down and slay Giggity. I can think of no better method to locate the rampaging beast, can you?
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_KOMUXIO_000_020: This one is pleased to see walking one! Has time come for this one to wreak furious vengeance upon imperial ones!?
TEXT_GAIUSC301_00968_KOMUXIO_000_021: Oh, so walking one seeks furry ones? This one just saw furry one wandering about. Was very worried for furry one─worried for furry one's safety!
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_000: Furry one came to Little Solace in search of helpful ones. Asked these ones for aid and succor.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_001: But these ones could not do what furry one asked, so furry one went elsewhere─went north into Larkscall.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_002: This one tried to warn furry one, but furry one would not listen! Many vile ones lurk to the north, and touched ones too!
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_TIGGY_000_020:
Tiggy greet sylph! Sylph bad sylph! Friend save Tiggy! Frieeeeeend!
Tiggy go back! Back to good sylph!
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_030: Walking one is ever most helpful one! Furry one Tiggy spoke highly of walking one's bravery. But this one wonders why walking one first sought to find furry ones.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_031: Walking one seeks furry one Giggity!? Even these ones have heard tell of hungry one!
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_032: Furry one Tiggy asked these ones to hunt hungry one. But these ones have not means to do so.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_033: Furry ones crave ores, yes? But hungry one is clever─clever and cautious.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_034: If walking one wishes to catch hungry one, walking one must use very rare, very special ore.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_KOMUXIO_000_035: This one knows little and less of ore, but walking one Maerwynn at Sanctum of Twelve knows much. Walking one should seek aid of goldsmithing one.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_TIGGY_000_040:
Giggity hungry! Always hungry! Huuuuuungry!
Tiggy run far! Far away! Awaaaaaay!
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_MAERWYNN_000_050: Yes? What is it? Ah, so you wish to lure out that rampaging spriggan with a rare ore.
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_MAERWYNN_000_051: Hmmm... I have an idea, although it is a bit unorthodox and convoluted...
TEXT_GAIUSC304_00971_POP_MESSAGE_000: The spriggan cries out for aid!
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_MAERWYNN_000_000: A chert golem was recently sighted near the gates to the Sylphlands. Who created it and why it was left free to roam is anyone's guess. In any case, the construct's presence is profoundly serendipitous, for the soulstone of a chert golem is created by enchanting a chunk of true heart ore. True heart, in case you were unaware, is an exceedingly rare ore, one which Giggity has almost certainly never tasted, and will therefore be unable to resist.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_MAERWYNN_000_001: So, all you need do is search for the golem, slay it, claim its heart, and use it to bait the spriggan. Oh, and do remember to rub the soulstone against a sufficiently large concentration of amber, say, Amberscale Rock in the Central Shroud. Short of petitioning a mage versed in golem magicks, that is the only way I know to dispel the enchantments woven into a true heart. Eh? Why are you looking at me like that? I had relations with a thaumaturge once, if you must know.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_TIGGY_000_035: Ore!? Shiny ore! Ore, ore, ore! Ooooooooore!
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_TIGGY_000_036: Tiggy ore!? Ah! Giggity ore! Friend stop Giggity! Giggity, Giggity, Giggityyyyyy!
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_TIGGY_000_037: Giggity is home! Tiggy is afraid! Friend come home! Friend stop Giggity!
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_HEDYN_000_050: Ah! Pray do not sneak up on me like that. I was engrossed in─wait, what is that─<sniff> <sniff>─what is that gods-awful smell?
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_HEDYN_000_051: My word, that is a breathtakingly beautiful crystal. I see my supposition was not mistaken.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_HEDYN_000_052: Ugh... And I also see you weren't averse to digging through spriggan entrails for your prize.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_HEDYN_000_053: We owe our furry friend a debt of gratitude, you know. This thick coating of digestive juices is protecting us from the harmful effects of the crystal, just as the warded pot you once used did.
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_HEDYN_000_054: Why so glum, friend? You've finally obtained the corrupted crystal you sought─one overflowing with earth-aspected aether!
TEXT_GAIUSC307_00974_HEDYN_000_055: Calm down─I jest, I jest! It is comprised of ice-aspected aether, worry not. I suppose that joke was in poor taste, considering your previous two attempts were for naught...
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_000: You are called , yes? I have heard of your plight from my friend Glaumunt. As a fellow adventurer and son of Eorzea both, I would offer you my assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_001: In order to infiltrate Castrum Centri, you and your comrades must disguise yourselves as imperial soldiers. The question is how to go about acquiring the uniforms and helms.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_002: There are places a man might purchase them, but individuals who deal in such wares are not the sort to whom you would entrust your secrets.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_003: It would be more prudent, I believe, to procure what you need via traditional means─from the bodies of their recently deceased owners.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_004: The fortified area before Castrum Centri never lacks for imperial patrols. It ought not take long to obtain three sets of gear, one for each member of the infiltration team─Biggs, Wedge, and yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_005: When you have what you need, please return here and allow me to inspect the spoils.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_DUMMY_000_010: (Defeat imperial mages, get damaged uniforms x 3)
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_DUMMY_000_011: (Defeat imperial fighters, get damaged helms x 3)
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_020: Were you able to obtain three sets of imperial equipment?
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_021: ...Damaged, as I had suspected. In their present condition, I fear these uniforms and helms are like to draw suspicion.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_022: They must be repaired, if only superficially. Fortunately, I have some skilled artisans among my acquaintances.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_023: Please take the uniforms to the Weavers' Guild in Ul'dah, and the helms to the Armorers' Guild in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_024: I will send word so that both places know to expect you. Rest assured your mission will be kept in the utmost confidence.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_AETHELWINE_000_030: Ah, you must be the adventurer ! Welcome, welcome! My lord Sark Malark sent word that you would be along. So, what garments are these that require attention?
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_AETHELWINE_000_031:
<gasp> Oh, my...
Well, I am certain you have your reasons, and I shan't question them. Nor do you need fear that I will spread gossip.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_AETHELWINE_000_032: My lord Sark Malark is one of our very best clients, though these days I'm told he spends more time roaming the land as an adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_AETHELWINE_000_033: Far be it from me to question my lord's tastes, but I struggle to understand why a man of his fabulous wealth would forsake the comforts of his estate for a life of danger and hardship.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_AETHELWINE_000_034: ...And the repairs are done! I was instructed to prioritize swiftness, and so I did. While I can't vouch for the protective capacity of the garments, they certainly look the part, even if I do say so myself.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_AETHELWINE_000_035: Payment? Never you mind that─sending my regards to my lord Sark Malark will be payment enough.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_HNAANZA_000_040: . I have been expecting you. Sark Malark gives me to understand you come on his behalf with unusual helms.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_HNAANZA_000_041: ...Yes, very unusual indeed. Though no more outlandish an order than I have come to expect from the merchant prince-turned-adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_HNAANZA_000_042:
Your awkward staring tells me I said something improper.
...Oh. Sark did not mention his background to you. <sigh> That was likely his intent, but I suppose there's no help for it now but to tell you the whole story.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_HNAANZA_000_043: Sark Malark is the son of a successful Ul'dahn merchant. Though still tender in years, he has an eye for profit, and has made millions in his own right. Having achieved thus, he turned his attention towards his true passion─adventuring─and left the management of his fortune to trusted aides.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_HNAANZA_000_044: The helms are ready. With a little more time, I could have achieved a far higher quality finish, but I was given to understand that you are in some haste. These should serve your needs well enough.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_HNAANZA_000_045: Lest you wonder about payment, Sark Malark has already settled the bill. Do pass along my regards when next you see him.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_050: Have you had the uniforms and helms repaired?
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_051: Yes, these will serve beautifully. Both Aethelwine and H'naanza never fail to impress. The quality of these repairs would fool even a legatus.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_052: Thus equipped, you should not have any trouble blending in amongst imperial forces.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_053: Lest you fear that the Garleans might detect your “foreignness,” foreigners in fact form the greater part of the Garlean invasion force in Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_054: You see, when the Empire subjugates new territory, it assimilates the people of that land into its armed forces. In turn, these conscripted forces are sent to subjugate faraway lands. In this way, Garlemald nips rebellion in the bud and expands its territory in one fell stroke.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_055: With that, my part in your mission is done. I am full glad to have been of assistance to your cause.
TEXT_GAIUSC603_01003_SARKMALARK_000_056: ...Hm? Why would I, a wealthy merchant, wish to help you? I know not where you heard such a tale, but believe me when I say that I am but another humble adventurer, one who desires only to act in the best interests of the realm.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_ARENVALD_000_000: My dear friends, A'aba and Aulie, came to the Scions with a burning passion to deliver this realm from darkness─a passion that I could never muster. They fought bravely, and with honor...until they could fight no more.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_ARENVALD_000_001: Me, I was never worth much on the battlefield. I wanted nothing more than to honor my fallen comrades─to carry on their fight─but how?
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_ARENVALD_000_002: One day, it struck me. I may be woefully lacking on the battlefield, but my mind is sharp enough. I resolved to plot a course of action and recruit capable allies to our cause.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_ARENVALD_000_003: One thing is clear to me─we can ill afford to be distracted by the beast tribes with more ominous storm clouds gathering on the horizon. To that end, we must find strong and loyal allies to quell the beastman menace.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_ARENVALD_000_004: You are familiar with the U, perhaps? A tribe of fearsome hunters and huntresses, I am convinced that they would prove invaluable allies in the battle against the Amalj'aa, if only they could be won over.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_ARENVALD_000_005: The U respect strength above all─I fear they'd sooner gut me than listen to my tale. But you... If you spoke, they would listen─I am certain of it. And so I ask, friend: travel to Forgotten Springs and speak to U'odh Nunh in my stead.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_UODHNUN_000_020: The slayer of Titan rrreturns. The slayer seeks something of the U, yes? What is it that you seek?
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_UODHNUN_000_021: So you would have us join your fight against the Amalj'aa. Hmph. The U do not care for the lizardmen, this is true. But the U fight no battles but our own.
TEXT_GAIUSC704_01016_UODHNUN_000_022: ...That is what my tribesmen will say. I am not unwilling to help you, but I know you better than they.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “My Little Chocobo ().”
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SYSTEM_100_001: You may accept the quest “My Little Chocobo ()” by speaking with .
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_020: All present? Then let us begin.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_021: We have received the details of the impending operation.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_022: In what promises to be the largest single counteroffensive in the realm's troubled history, the Alliance will strike at every imperial stronghold standing upon Eorzean soil.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_023: As might be expected, the operation will be complex, but you need not commit its intricacies to memory.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_024: It is enough that each man understands his part and plays it to the best of his ability.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_025: The finer instructions, you will receive at each staging point.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_026: To begin, let us review the distribution of our forces.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_027: From west to east─the Maelstrom of Limsa Lominsa, the Immortal Flames of Ul'dah, and the Order of the Twin Adder of Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_028: Next, let us examine the locations of the imperial strongholds.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_029: Near Limsa Lominsa, we have Castrum Occidens, situated in eastern Vylbrand, and Castrum Marinum, which lies to the south and east, in the midst of the Rhotano Sea.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_030: Near Ul'dah, we have Castrum Meridianum to the north, and the coastal outpost at Cape Westwind which connects Castrum Marinum to the mainland by means of a magitek transporter.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_031: Near Gridania, we have Castrum Oriens, which lies upon the eastern edge of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_032: And finally, in Mor Dhona...stands Castrum Centri. A thorn in the heart of Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_033: The forthcoming operation will see Allied forces assault each of the aforementioned locations, with the ultimate objective of destroying the Empire's new weapon, housed within Castrum Meridianum.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_034: As one might expect of the Black Wolf's seat of power, Castrum Meridianum boasts all but impenetrable defenses. If we are to breach it, we must needs isolate it from its sister strongholds.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_YSHTOLA_000_035: To do otherwise would be to risk being caught 'twixt hammer and anvil.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_036: The operation will comprise four distinct phases, all told.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_037: The first shall see us eliminate one of the Black Wolf's most trusted lieutenants─Rhitahtyn sas Arvina.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_038: According to our intelligence, the praefectus is due to visit the imperial outpost at Cape Westwind for an inspection.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_039: When he arrives, we shall dispatch an elite adventurer unit to eliminate him. , we would have you lead this assault.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_PAPALYMO_000_040: Rhitahtyn is a peerless field tactician. Shorn of his leadership, the garrison at Castrum Occidens will be as a snake without its head.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Phase two will see us sever Castrum Meridianum's primary lines of supply.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_042: As soon as Rhitahtyn's presence is confirmed at the coastal outpost, the Maelstrom will lay siege to Castrum Occidens.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_043: At that very hour, the Lominsan Armada, helmed by the Admiral herself, shall move to blockade Castrum Marinum.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_044: Meanwhile, in the Twelveswood, the Order of the Twin Adder will surround Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_YDA_000_045: And they'll have the sylphs to help them! Frixio's been waiting for a chance to avenge these ones!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Phase three shall see us neutralize Castrum Meridianum's defenses.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Forming our main thrust, the Immortal Flames will march against the stronghold with all their strength. While the enemy's eyes are thus drawn outwards, another elite adventurer unit shall infiltrate the castrum.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_048: Its mission: to disable the magitek field generator which protects the Praetorium, a fortress within a fortress wherein the Ultima Weapon is believed to be housed. , we would have you take command once more.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_049: Meanwhile, the Order of the Twin Adder will blockade the railway which connects Centri and Meridianum, preventing the timely arrival of reinforcements from Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_PAPALYMO_000_050: A wise precaution. The monstrous locomotive which runs back and forth between the two castra is capacious enough to transport a small army, by all accounts.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_YSHTOLA_000_051: It is well the Garleans did not think to give it wings.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_052: Once Meridianum's defenses have been compromised, the operation will enter its fourth and final phase.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_053: This will see the Immortal Flames enter the stronghold and suppress the remnants of the enemy garrison.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_054: ...Allowing 's unit to pass unopposed into the Praetorium, where they will locate and destroy the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_055: By this feat shall the operation be deemed a success.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_056: In addition to the Grand Companies, we can count upon the support of a variety of other parties, from the pirates of Limsa Lominsa to the Monetarists of Ul'dah. In all, the operation will involve no fewer than twelve major factions.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_057:
Legend holds that the Archons were twelve in one, and one in twelve...
It is for this reason that our grand endeavor has been dubbed “Operation Archon.”
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_058: Countless free companies have also pledged their swords, and more join us by the day. At long last, all of Eorzea is rising as one.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_059: As before, we Scions shall work in concert with the Grand Companies. Yda, Papalymo, Y'shtola─pray accompany your respective organizations on their missions.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_060: Urianger, I would have you represent us in Ul'dah. Reassure the financiers that they have made a sound investment. When that is done, pray return here and aid in the coordination of our forces.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_061: Tataru, please assist Urianger in any way you are able, and ensure that everyone is kept abreast of the latest developments.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Minfilia, Cid, and I shall accompany the main host in an advisory capacity. It will be our task to analyze intelligence as it comes into our possession, and make the necessary recommendations to command.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_063: As Alphinaud mentioned, you are to lead the elite unit of adventurers whose task it will be to see each of Operation Archon's main objectives fulfilled. Yours is the most important role of all, and like to be the most dangerous. Pray choose your party well, and stint not in your preparation.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_064: The battle for the future of the realm is about to begin. Together, let us show the Black Wolf the power of a united Eorzea!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_065: Pray report to the Immortal Flames encampment situated to the north of here when you are ready to be briefed on your first mission.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_MINFILIA_000_066: I cannot stress this enough, but please be careful. May you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_050: You are well come,  of the Scions. As communications officer, it falls to me to issue you your orders, and provide guidance on forthcoming missions.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_051: Your first mission is to infiltrate the imperial outpost at Cape Westwind and eliminate Praefectus Rhitahtyn sas Arvina.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_052: All participating units are now in position and awaiting your arrival. Please proceed to the staging point and report to Lieutenant Adalbert.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_053: This is but the first step in our bid to purge the realm of the Garlean menace. I shall pray for your success!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_300: So you're , the fearless leader of the elite adventurer unit. We've been expecting you.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_301: Our Maelstrom friends report that Rhitahtyn sas Arvina departed Castrum Occidens a bell ago.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_302: And sure enough, a convoy of imperial airships landed here just now.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_303: The likelihood is high that our target was aboard one of the vessels. I've dispatched scouts to verify his presence before we strike.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_FLAMERUNNER_000_304: Command to all units. Requesting status report.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_FIRSTPLATOON_000_30: This is Antlion I. Target has not been sighted.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_SECONDPLATOON_000_3: This is Antlion II. Likewise, target has not been sighted.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_THIRDPLATOON_000_30: Antlion III here. We've got nothin' for ye neither.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_FOURTHPLATOON_000_3: This is Antlion IV. Nothing to report as of─
Wait! Disregard previous message! Target sighted. I say again: target sighted.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_311: Attention, all units. This is Lieutenant Adalbert Cotter.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_312: The first step of Operation Archon begins with us. Should we falter here, all hope of victory will be lost.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_313: 'Tis no small burden, but know that I believe in all of you. So believe in yourselves, and together we will blaze a path for our brothers and sisters of the Alliance to follow.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_314: We will create multiple diversions and disperse the enemy garrison. That should give you a chance to breach their defenses.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_315: Go now, , and bring us Rhitahtyn's head! May Rhalgr grant you strength!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ADALBERT_000_400: Go now, , and bring us Rhitahtyn's head! May Rhalgr grant you strength!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_500: It would appear we have unexpected guests.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_501: Now, where have I seen you before? Ah, but of course─the  who felled the mighty Titan.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_503: I see. The commotion without is naught but a diversion.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_504: Allow me to hazard a guess: by eliminating me, you hope to undermine the garrison at Occidens.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_505: A bold strategy, to be sure, but have you the strength to see it to fruition?
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_506: Leave us. None of you are a match for .
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_507: Send word to Castrum Occidens. Tell them the Lominsans are coming.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_509: Fifteen years have come and gone since Lord van Baelsar first set foot in Eorzea, yet his ambition for the realm burns as strong as ever it did. Know you what fuels it, adventurer? The desire to deliver the people from their suffering.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_510: The lands he has conquered were all beset with problems─poverty, starvation, lawlessness, and strife. My homeland was no exception. Had my lord not reached out and claimed it for the Empire, it would eventually have destroyed itself.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_511: But under his sage leadership, my people enjoyed such peace and stability as we had never known. And he only desires the selfsame for the people of this realm. Under his rule, Eorzea would be free from the shackles which bind it─the shackles of false faith.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_512: There would be no feeble leaders to misguide the masses, no eikons to bleed the realm dry. True peace would reign, and the people would be free to live their lives without fear of persecution or oppression.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_513: Should you doubt the truth of my words, I bid you look upon me. I am no son of Garlemald, yet Lord van Baelsar saw fit to raise me to a station of great honor.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_514: He measures a man not by his birth, but by his worth. Such is his sense of justice. By the grace of His Excellency, I am where I was born to be─upon the field of battle.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_515: He has given me a noble cause to fight for, and worthy adversaries to smite.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_516: I am not wont to bare my steel needlessly. But if you are deaf to reason...
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_517: In the name of Lord van Baelsar, I, Rhitahtyn sas Arvina, do swear to strike you down!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_RHITAHTYN_000_541: Forgive me... I have failed you...
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_551: , are you there? What news of Rhitahtyn? ...Fallen?
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_552: With this deed, you have sown the seeds of our ultimate victory.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_553: The fading of that light presages an end to the Empire's tyranny!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_554: Rhitahtyn sas Arvina is no more!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_ALPHINAUD_000_555: Let the next phase of Operation Archon commence!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_CID_000_557: 'Tis I! It seems you've done it again, !
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_CID_000_558: I'd raise a tankard to you, but I'm afraid we've no time to savor the victory. There's still the small matter of infiltrating Castrum Meridianum and destroying the Ultima Weapon!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_CID_000_559: I know, I know...no rest for the preternaturally gifted. Now stop feeling sorry for yourself, and make your way back to the Immortal Flames' encampment. The communications officer will issue you your orders. I'll be waiting for you with the main host.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_LAHABREAANCIENT_000: Look, Hydaelyn─Your minion comes...bringing the Light.
Alas, the gate to the void already stands open. Soon, Darkness shall consume all, and you shall bow down before the one true god.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_IMPERIALMILITUM_000: Regrettably so, my lord. And at the hand of the eikon-slayer, if the centurion who survived the attack is to be believed.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_GAIUS_000_703: Where were his men when he faced the enemy!? Fleeing, even as their commander yielded up his last breath!? If it should prove they questioned his right...
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_IMPERIALMILITUM_000: I-I cannot speak for them, my lord.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_IMPERIALSTAFF_000_7: ...Beg pardons, my lord, but there is more. The Maelstrom has laid siege to Castrum Occidens.
Likewise, the Crimson Fleet moves to blockade Castrum Marinum.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_GAIUS_000_708: Very well! We shall crush them as we crushed the eikons!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_GAIUS_000_709: Go forth and show them the futility of their resistance!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_250: Scion ! Your deeds this day are an inspiration to us all!
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_251: With the death of the praefectus, Operation Archon has entered its second phase. Even as we speak, the Maelstrom moves to blockade Castrum Occidens and Castrum Marinum.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_252: And far to the east, in the Black Shroud, the Order of the Twin Adder advances upon Castrum Oriens.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_253: Already, you have done much to advance our cause, performing such feats as are worthy of song─but if our plan is to succeed, more is required of you.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_254: Let me know when your preparations are in order, and I shall relay to you the particulars of your next mission.
TEXT_GAIUSC901_01036_KANRIKAN_000_270: The assault on Cape Westwind is but the first step in our bid to purge the realm of the Garlean menace. I shall pray for your success!
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_000: I have a favor to ask of you, as a fellow comrade of the Alliance. As I mentioned, the garrison's mood is dark. The fault, it pains me to admit, is partly mine.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_001: I am no veteran of large-scale campaigns, you see, and the men and women under me are nervous for this knowledge.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_002: Seeking to lift their spirits, I remembered the tale of a Gridanian general from a century past. Vainchelon was his name, and he was a lancer of great renown. History holds that, in spite of his rank, he would regularly cook meals for his troops while afield.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_003: Most generals know to break bread with their own men on occasion to foster camaraderie, but Vainchelon took it one step further. By actually making that bread, he showed that he was truly one of them─a hero and a comrade.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_004: Though I wouldn't presume to compare myself to a man of his stature, I thought it might be well to at least emulate the deed. To be sure, this is a testament to my desperation.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_005: I had begun making preparations for basilisk stew, all the while wondering whether it would be any good, when an honest-to-gods hero appeared. I speak of you, of course.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_006: My gratitude would know no bounds if you could take up the ladle in my stead. The stew is just about ready─all it needs is some basilisk meat, which can be readily had north of here. Please procure the meat and add it to the cauldron bubbling just outside the camp.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_007: When the stew is ready, I would ask that you also distribute it among our troops. Receiving the stew from you is certain to give them heart. I doubt I can say the same were it to come from my hands.
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_ZEZERAGI_000_010: Brrr... It's always so dark here...and cold... Maybe I shouldn't have enlisted... It's not like killing Garleans will bring my friend back...
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_ZEZERAGI_000_020:
Mmmmmm, this smells good...
<gasp> Aren't you the adventurer who triumphed at Cape Westwind? To think that a hero fights beside us! And this stew, it whets my appetite for vengeance! Just you wait, you Garlean whoresons! I'm coming for your heads! Muahahaha!
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_ADELENA_000_030: Gods, this is all so hopeless! The Garleans are going to crush us with their steel monstrosities! We're all going to die! <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_ADELENA_000_040: I'm...I'm so sorry. I don't know what came over me. Your words and this hearty stew have given me courage. Yes, a fire positively burns in my belly! ...Or is it just the basilisk venom?
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_BETYN_000_050: I-I think I'll pretend to be sick. That way I won't have to fight. Maybe they'll even send me home to my family. It's not as if one man would make a difference, right?
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_BETYN_000_060: You made this stew...for me? I...I never dreamed that I would share a meal with a hero, let alone partake of something  made. I wanted to be a hero, too, you know─to my family. I took up arms because I wanted to protect them...and I will! I won't run─not today, nor any other!
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_070: Your basilisk stew has done wonders for our troops' morale! I cannot thank you enough!
TEXT_GAIUSC904_01039_CRACKEDFIST_000_071: The seeming hopelessness of the situation─not to mention this accursed gloom─had dampened their spirits, and for a time they had forgotten their purpose. But your presence and culinary skills helped them to remember, and I'm confident they will do their part to protect the realm and their loved ones.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_CRACKEDFIST_000_000: Before you continue on your way, there is one more favor I would ask of you.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_CRACKEDFIST_000_001: North of Camp Bluefog, approximately halfway to the Ceruleum Processing Plant, there stand two Alliance watchtowers. I would be grateful if you could bear a message to our sentries at each.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_CRACKEDFIST_000_002: When the next phase of the operation commences, linkshell communications may be disrupted for a time. Should this happen, messages must be conveyed the old-fashioned way─on foot, or with fire.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_CRACKEDFIST_000_003: The west watchtower is under the care of one Private Wymund, while the east is held by Private Hopeful Dawn. On my behalf, please remind them to be fully prepared for this eventuality.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_CRACKEDFIST_000_004: Once you have visited both, continue north and then west to the Ceruleum Processing Plant. Lieutenant Edelstein, commander of the garrison, will be expecting you. Twelve speed your way.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_WYMUND_000_010: Why, if it isn't  ! What brings you to my humble watchtower?
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_WYMUND_000_011: ...Linkpearls may cease to function, you say? Rest assured, , we have an ample supply of torches and swift legs to spare. If there's a message that needs sending, it will be sent.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_HOPEFULDAWN_000_020: <gasp> 'Tis an honor to meet ye in the flesh, ! Is there aught I can do fer ye?
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_HOPEFULDAWN_000_021: ...Provisions fer when the linkshell's out o' commission? I always make sure we've got a good store o' torches an' well-rested legs. The east watchtower's ready fer anythin', never ye fear!
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_EDELSTEIN_000_030: Ah,  . Well met and welcome to my garrison.
TEXT_GAIUSC907_01042_EDELSTEIN_000_031: Battle preparations are proceeding well, I am pleased to say. The Flame General himself arrived a short while ago, and has been inspecting our troops.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_EDELSTEIN_000_000: General Raubahn would no doubt be pleased to hear from you. You will find him over by the aetheryte.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_RAUBAHN_000_010: Ever a sight for sore eyes, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_RAUBAHN_000_011: I'm told you worked wonders on the morale of our garrison at Bluefog. I would have you do the same for the troops here.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_RAUBAHN_000_012: They put on a brave face when I'm about, but the fire in their hearts quivers as a candle in the wind. Aye, I can see it in their bearing.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_RAUBAHN_000_013: About the camp, there are green recruits whose resolve falters. Find them, , and rekindle their fighting spirit the way only a hero can.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_RAUBAHN_000_014: Once you have seen to the others, go and do the same for Edelstein. No matter what he may claim, the lieutenant would also be better for a bit of rousing. Trust me, I know.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_RAUBAHN_000_017: About the camp, there are green recruits whose resolve falters. Find them, , and rekindle their fighting spirit the way only a hero can.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC1_000_025: Uwaaaaaah! The Garleans are not near as frightening as you! I'd sooner face a vanguard while naked as my nameday!
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC1_000_030: Er...thank you. I think. Whatever that was, it momentarily distracted me from my woes. <sigh>
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC2_000_040: Ah, the oft-rumored hero... Doubtless you will single-handedly save us all...
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC2_000_045: Your stirring gesticulation has reawakened me to my purpose! Hero or no, I will fight tooth and nail to protect the realm!
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC2_000_050: I should be honored to meet a hero, but I just don't have the will to care...
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC3_000_060: I-I'm fine, t-truly! N-Nothing to w-worry about! Just a m-mild case of b-battlefield nerves!
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC3_000_065: YAAAAAARGH!!! I BREAK MY FAST ON GARLEANS! AND RIGHT NOW, I'M VERY HUNGRY!
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_ENPC3_000_070: <gasp> Th-The hero of Cape Westwind! D-Don't look at me! G-Gods, don't look at meeeeee!
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_EDELSTEIN_000_080: You would stoke my fighting spirit as you did our recruits'? Hah hah! A kind offer, but hardly necessary. I assure you, the fire in my heart rages as strongly as it ever has.
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_EDELSTEIN_000_085: By Rhalgr... Without my realizing it, the fire of my resolve had grown dim. But thanks to you, it burns red-hot once more! If needs be, I shall lay down my life to secure victory for Eorzea!
TEXT_GAIUSC908_01043_EDELSTEIN_000_090: Would that we had the time to get better acquainted, but right now we must focus on the operation. Should we fail, our lives─if indeed we still live─shall never be the same again.
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_EDELSTEIN_000_000: A short while ago, the Flame General struck for Castrum Meridianum. Alas, no sooner did his contingent gain the resistance line than an imperial patrol fell upon them.
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_EDELSTEIN_000_001: We are informed that they successfully won through, but enemy patrols yet linger in the area. Our main host could easily crush their like, to be sure, but we dare not deploy them at this juncture lest we prematurely stir the hornet's nest.
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_EDELSTEIN_000_002: That the operation might proceed unhampered, I would have you thin out the imperial presence at Raubahn's Push. It should suffice if you were to vanquish three each of their vanguards and foot soldiers.
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_EDELSTEIN_000_003: Once you have accomplished this, pray join the Flame General at the operation's staging point. May Rhalgr give you strength!
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_RAUBAHN_000_010: I see you've cleared the way for the main host. My thanks. I might've given the task to another rather than risk your neck before the mission, but what's done is done. Besides, it probably served to loosen up your joints.
TEXT_GAIUSC911_01046_RAUBAHN_000_011: This is it, ─the moment of reckoning. Eorzea's future hinges upon our deeds this day.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_001: No living Padjal─not even our sister─possesses such power. Without the blessing of A-Towa-Cant, there is nothing we can do.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_003: Look around you, Sister. Open your eyes and ears. Time is one thing we do not have.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_005: The fury of the great one mounts with each passing moment─it will not be contained much longer. No, the time for waiting is long past. Now is the time for action.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_007: The situation is far from ideal. Yet we have no choice─we must trust in 's powers and do what we can.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_009: I may be stubborn, Sister, but I am no fool. I have witnessed 's abilities with my own eyes. There can be no doubting that  is a mage of the white, one as worthy as you and I.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_081: ... I speak to you now as my peer. The fate of Gridania lies in the balance─we can ill afford to fail.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_020: The great one's rage is too strong! I cannot reach him!
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_022: But, Sister...the forest itself turns against us!
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_027: D-Do... Do my eyes deceive me!?
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_056: And yet by his power─and that of his successor, ─the great one's fury is quelled, and the Twelveswood is safe.
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_057: Though Master A-Towa traveled the world, no doubt his heart always remained here. In the forest home he loved, he waited for us...
TEXT_JOBWHM500_010841_ARUHNSENNA_000_059: Strange, is it not? Perhaps I have finally learned something from you, dear sister.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_RASHAHTRHIKI_000_00: Ah,  ─just the  I was hoping to see. Your exploits of late have been the talk of Limsa.
Don't let this puff your sails up too much, but I've heard some of the higher-ups saying that the Maelstrom would be lost at sea without you.
But I suspect you're not the type to rest on your laurels. Nay, the tempest raging in your eyes tells me you're looking for new waters to navigate.
Fortunately, we have just the place for people like you. Have you perchance heard of the Wolves' Den?
It's a proving ground of sorts established by the Eorzean Alliance─a place where the most promising of Grand Company recruits are sent to hone their skills.
The Wolves' Den is to be found just off the shores of La Noscea. The ferry at the Moraby Drydocks in lower La Noscea will grant you passage there.
Upon your arrival, seek out Storm Captain Berkoeya Loetahlsyn. I've let him know that you'll be coming, so you can count on a warm welcome.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_BERKOEYA_000_010: I don't recall seein' yer ugly mug around here before. Hm? Ye say that Rhiki sent ye!?
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_BERKOEYA_000_011: She said she was sendin' a new wolf to the Den─bah! More like the runt of the litter, if ye ask me.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_BERKOEYA_000_012: Ye barely have fangs for the honin', but I guess I'm feelin' godsdamned generous, so I'll throw ye a bone─start yerself off with Crystalline Conflict. Them trainin' bouts are made special for feckless adventurin' types who can't tell sound strategy from a horse's arse.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_BERKOEYA_000_013: I still reckon it won't be  before ye run home with yer tail between yer legs, cryin' for yer mum, but ye can have a word with Lieutenant Gungi Zelungi if ye insist on givin' it a go. Ye'll find him outside, assumin' ye can work up the nerve.
TEXT_COMLIM001_01104_BERKOEYA_000_014: And stand up straight, maggot! This ain't no place for the weak of spine. Dismissed!
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_000: Listen well,  . The Order of the Twin Adder does not just welcome glory-seekers willy-nilly into our ranks.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_001: You stand here today because we believe in your potential. We believe that you will go forth as a Serpent and help restore order to a world gone mad.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_002: ...And yet, potential alone will not carry you far. Indeed, the road to glory is littered with the bodies of would-be  who lacked the determination and diligence to hone their innate talents.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_003: But you will not suffer the same fate─I am certain of it. It is with such high hopes for your future that I would send you to begin the next phase of your training.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_004: The venue shall be the Wolves' Den, a proving ground established by the Eorzean Alliance to prepare Grand Company recruits for the battles that lie ahead.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_005: The Wolves' Den is to be found just off the shores of La Noscea. The ferry at the Moraby Drydocks in lower La Noscea will grant you passage there.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_VORSAILE_000_006: Upon your arrival, seek out Storm Captain Berkoeya Loetahlsyn. I have already taken the liberty of submitting a letter of recommendation on your behalf.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_BERKOEYA_000_010: I don't recall seein' yer ugly mug around here before. Hm? Ye say that Heuloix sent ye!?
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_BERKOEYA_000_011: He said he was sendin' a new wolf to the Den─bah! More like the runt of the litter, if ye ask me.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_BERKOEYA_000_012: Ye barely have fangs for the honin', but I guess I'm feelin' godsdamned generous, so I'll throw ye a bone─start yerself off with Crystalline Conflict. Them trainin' bouts are made special for feckless adventurin' types who can't tell sound strategy from a horse's arse.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_BERKOEYA_000_013: I still reckon it won't be  before ye run home with yer tail between yer legs, cryin' for yer mum, but ye can have a word with Lieutenant Gungi Zelungi if ye insist on givin' it a go. Ye'll find him outside, assumin' ye can work up the nerve.
TEXT_COMGRD001_01105_BERKOEYA_000_014: And stand up straight, maggot! This ain't no place for the weak of spine. Dismissed!
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_000: . I have been keeping a close eye on you of late. Your efforts on behalf of Ul'dah do us all proud.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_001: Yes, I understand now what the Flame General saw in you. It would not be an understatement to say that the future of our Grand Company is riding on your capable shoulders.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_002: And yet, it is also clear to me that you have only begun to tap into the depths of your potential.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_003: Your flame burns strong, but it may yet grow stronger. Yes, I would see you become a blazing inferno that reduces all that oppose Ul'dah into smoldering embers.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_004: It is with such hopes that I have made arrangements for you to receive training at the Wolves' Den─a proving ground established by the Eorzean Alliance for the training of Grand Company recruits. Mayhap you are familiar with it?
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_005: That look in your eye tells me you are eager to take to the road. I knew I had not misjudged you.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_006: The Wolves' Den is to be found just off the shores of La Noscea. The ferry at the Moraby Drydocks in lower La Noscea will grant you passage there.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_SWIFT_000_007: Upon your arrival, seek out Storm Captain Berkoeya Loetahlsyn. I have already taken the liberty of submitting a letter of recommendation on your behalf.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_BERKOEYA_000_010: I don't recall seein' yer ugly mug around here before. Hm? Ye say that Swift sent ye!?
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_BERKOEYA_000_011: He said he was sendin' a new wolf to the Den─bah! More like the runt of the litter, if ye ask me.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_BERKOEYA_000_012: Ye barely have fangs for the honin', but I guess I'm feelin' godsdamned generous, so I'll throw ye a bone─start yerself off with Crystalline Conflict. Them trainin' bouts are made special for feckless adventurin' types who can't tell sound strategy from a horse's arse.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_BERKOEYA_000_013: I still reckon it won't be  before ye run home with yer tail between yer legs, cryin' for yer mum, but ye can have a word with Lieutenant Gungi Zelungi if ye insist on givin' it a go. Ye'll find him outside, assumin' ye can work up the nerve.
TEXT_COMULD001_01106_BERKOEYA_000_014: And stand up straight, maggot! This ain't no place for the weak of spine. Dismissed!
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_000: ! Doing the Maelstrom proud as ever, I see.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_001: As a matter of fact, you're just the  I was hoping would come along. House Dzemael of Ishgard is in some distress, and you're just the one we need to answer the call.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_002: Your task: travel to Dzemael Darkhold and purge the subterranean fortress of voidsent.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_003: Once you're ready, make your way to the central highlands of Coerthas─I trust you'll have little trouble finding the Darkhold. Ophelie, a retainer in the service of House Dzemael, will brief you in greater detail when you arrive. We await word of your success!
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_OPHELIE_000_010:
Whaaaaaa, who goes there!?
...Oh, you must be the reinforcements. I beg your pardon. Recent sights have left me as skittish as an untrained chocobo.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_OPHELIE_000_011: Dzemael Darkhold. The name itself sends a shiver up the spine, does it not? The place has been infested by all manner of fearsome voidsent of late. Why, I've even heard word of statues come to life!
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_OPHELIE_000_012: While we Ishgardians pride ourselves on seeing to our own defenses, the threat this time is simply too great. You'll see to those abominations, won't you?
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_020: Welcome back,  ! Word of your success has already reached us. If anyone deserves a plenitude of Storm Seals in recognition, it's you.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_021: The House Dzemael knight spoke most highly of the outcome. This will go far to improve the Maelstrom's reputation in Ishgard. Rest assured that your superiors will hear directly from me of your efforts.
TEXT_COMLIM010_01128_RASHAHT_000_022: At this rate, it won't be long until you have a shiny new rank to show for yourself, I'd wager. Be strong, and be safe, ─till sea swallows all!
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_000: Ah,  . Doing the Twin Adder proud as ever, I hear.
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_001: You've arrived at a most opportune time. House Dzemael of Ishgard has requested our assistance with a matter of some import, and I've decided that you're just the  for the task.
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_002: Your mission, in brief: travel to Dzemael Darkhold and purge the subterranean fortress of voidsent.
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_003: See to your preparations and make your way to the central highlands of Coerthas─once there, you should find the Darkhold without much difficulty. Ophelie, a knight in the service of House Dzemael, will meet you upon arrival and brief you in greater detail. I await word of your success.

TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_OPHELIE_000_012: While we Ishgardians pride ourselves on seeing to our own defenses, the threat this time is simply too great. You'll see to those abominations, won't you?
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_020: Welcome back,  . Word of your success has already reached us. I would guerdon you a measure of Serpent Seals in recognition of your loyal service.
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_021: The House Dzemael knight spoke most highly of you─this will go far to improve the Order's reputation in Ishgard. Rest assured that your superiors will hear directly from me of your efforts.
TEXT_COMGRD010_01129_VORSAILE_000_022: Should you continue to serve us as you have done, I suspect a promotion is in your future. Stay true to the wood's will, , and be safe in your travels.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_000: . Your deeds of late have not gone unnoticed.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_001: As fortune would have it, we have just received a distress call from House Dzemael in Ishgard, and I've a mind to assign you to the mission.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_002: Your task, in brief: travel to Dzemael Darkhold and purge the subterranean fortress of the voidsent that lurk within.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_003: Prepare yourself, then make your way to the central highlands of Coerthas, where the Darkhold lies. Ophelie, a knight of House Dzemael, will provide you with a more comprehensive briefing when you arrive. I trust you will not let us down, .

Whaaaaaa, who goes there!?
...Oh, you must be the reinforcements. I beg your pardon. Recent sights have left me as skittish as an untrained chocobo.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_OPHELIE_000_011: Dzemael Darkhold. The name itself sends a shiver up the spine, does it not? The place has been infested by all manner of fearsome voidsent of late. Why, I've even heard word of statues come to life!
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_OPHELIE_000_012: While we Ishgardians pride ourselves on seeing to our own defenses, the threat this time is simply too great. You'll see to those abominations, won't you?
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_020: Ah,  . We have received word of your success. Have these seals, along with our congratulations on a job well done.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_021: The goodwill earned with Ishgard due to your efforts will no doubt profit us in our future efforts. Fear not─I will file a report to upper command to see that credit is given where it is due.
TEXT_COMULD010_01130_SWIFT_000_022: Yes, I see further promotion through the ranks in your future. But you must never allow yourself to become complacent. Always remember why we fight,  : for coin and country.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_RASHAHT_000_000: Ah,  ─ever the shining example to your fellow members of the Maelstrom.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_RASHAHT_000_001: Time and again, you have risen to the call. Today, I would give you the opportunity to add to your growing list of accomplishments.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_RASHAHT_000_002: In return for battle chocobos provided to us, the Holy See has petitioned our aid in purging the cavern known as the Aurum Vale of its most foul inhabitants. Our contact from Ishgard, Ser Willielmus, will apprise you of the particulars of the mission upon your arrival.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_WILLIELMUS_000_010: From the Maelstrom, I presume? Yes, I suppose you should suffice. The Holy See is not wont to beseech assistance from foreign armies, but the task before us is a daunting one, and our own knights are occupied with matters of greater import.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_WILLIELMUS_000_011: Mayhap you have already heard rumors of the Aurum Vale. Many a miner has been lured into its cavernous recesses by promises of vast fortunes to find only death, and doubly so.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_WILLIELMUS_000_012: If the noxious fumes don't get them, the carnivorous fronds that lurk are happy to oblige. While there is little we can do about the former, dispatching the latter would go far in sparing the lives of unfortunate treasure seekers. So it is that we turn to you.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_RASHAHT_000_020: I had no doubts that you would triumph, , but the swiftness and surety with which you have done so is impressive indeed.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_RASHAHT_000_021: As head of the Foreign Levy, I daresay I've never been prouder of an adventurer under my command.
TEXT_COMLIM011_01131_RASHAHT_000_022: Rest assured that your deeds have been conveyed to the powers that be. I look forward to the day when I can congratulate you on a well-deserved promotion. Till sea swallows all!
