TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_000: Well, a well-wishing welcome to you, adventurer friend! You've worked your way to Fisherman's Bottom.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_001: When you want fish for just a day, you can call a culinarian, but we fishermen feast for life!
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_002: I've set the bait. Think you're ready to bite?
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_Q1_000_1: Do you wish to join the Fishermen's Guild?
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_003: Oh? Here I hastily hoped to hook you in, but I suppose I'll find other fish in the sea.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_004: Feel free to swim back if ever fish fit your fancy!
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_005: Oops! I hooked you only to find a snag─it appears you're on course for a different dock.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_006: I really hate to release such a considerable catch, but here's to hoping you swim back once you've grown into your gills!
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_SYSTEM_000_007: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_010: Hooray, hooray! Looks like we've got a live one! Let me walk you through the life of a fisherman in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_011: Since we're surrounded by the seas, the fishing sites are a fisherman's delight. If you can't fish it here, you can't fish it anywhere!
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_012: While some of us rope our fish in with rods and reels, others skim the seabed with nets for creepy-crawly critters.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_013: You might say we cast a wide net─people prattle about our pullers just about everywhere in Limsa.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_014: And there's much and more I haven't mentioned. We shepherd the ships, preside over the ports, manage the mongers, all while making sure not to leave any adventurers out to sea.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_015: I'll wager you prefer to work alone, so we'll start you off with the rod and reel.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_016: Now, you may not necessarily net the numbers net-fishing yields, but pole-fishing positively pulls prettier prizes.
TEXT_CLSFSH001_01134_NNMULIKA_000_017: And that's the long and short of it! When you're ready for another bite of bait, I'll reel you in before the guildmaster!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_050: Brothers and sisters of the Alliance! I would share with you glad tidings!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_051: Doubtless spurred on by news of the siege of Castrum Oriens, the Maelstrom has struck a double blow! Castrum Occidens and Castrum Marinum are now under blockade!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_052: Phase two of Operation Archon is a success!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_053: Reports tell us that the Garleans offered fierce resistance─but that the Admiral yielded them not one ilm.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_054: With Occidens, Marinum, and Oriens thus suppressed, the third phase may begin in earnest!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_055: Even as we speak, the Order of the Twin Adder moves to block the railway leading hither from Castrum Centri. And that can mean but one thing...
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_056: The hour is come to strike at the heart of the Garlean invasion force!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_057: ...Castrum Meridianum, the den of the Black Wolf!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_058: My fellow Eorzeans. I am Minfilia, Mistress of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_059: There exist myriad barriers that divide us─those of race and nation, language and creed, to name but a few.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_060: Such barriers serve to isolate us from our neighbors...yet they also serve to define who we are. Shorn of them, there would be little to distinguish one from another, and the rich variety of our lives would give way to sterile orthodoxy.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_061: These barriers can never truly be broken down, of course─not so long as there is liberty in the world─but they can be transcended!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_062: Verily, we do so now in coming together for this grand endeavor, to fight side by side in defense of our shared home!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Before me stands the adventurer . You all know  as the  who will lead the unit tasked with destroying the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_ALPHINAUD_000_064: We Scions know a different , however. We know  as a dear friend who has endured untold hardship on our behalf─a true hero who has ever blazed a path for us to follow. And why do I tell you this? I tell you, friends, because it is time for us to blaze a path for !
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_065: Our objective is to wreak such havoc outside the walls of Meridianum as to afford  and  comrades the time they need to disable the magitek field generator within.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_066: With the path thus cleared, we may finally turn our minds to the true goal of this operation─the destruction of the Ultima Weapon! All troops, prepare for battle!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_067: I fear I can't accompany you this time. The unenviable task of facilitating communications between our forces has been entrusted to the Ironworks, you see. Know, though, that I will be praying for your safe return.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_068: See that you come back to us, my friend. May the Crystal bless you and keep you.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_069: We will suffer the Black Wolf to prowl our lands no more! Let us teach the hunter what it is to be hunted!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Go now, , and bring us one step closer to the dawn!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_100_070: We will suffer the Black Wolf to prowl our lands no more! Let us teach the hunter what it is to be hunted!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_140: If I didn't know better, I'd swear you had a personal grudge against magitek armor.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_141: What can I say? I couldn't bear to let you have all the fun.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_142: Don't worry─Biggs and Wedge have everything in hand. Truth be told, I think they like having the work of three men.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_143: Wedge wasn't exactly pleased to be left behind, though, and made quite sure I knew it. I must say, our recent struggles have done wonders for the lad's spirit.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_144: Given the size of this place, I suspected there might be an armor or three to be had. And here we are.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_145: Hmmm...not as bad as I thought. If I have half Marques's talent for mending things, I should be able to get it working again.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_146: Listen, ─we intercepted an imperial communication indicating that the Ultima Weapon is indeed being housed within the Praetorium.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_147: We also learned that the field which protects the compound is powered by no fewer than three generator towers.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_148: If you're to deactivate the field, you'll need to locate and disable them all.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_149: And I'm here to help you do just that.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_150: See that chute? It leads to waste disposal.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_151: Somewhere nearby, there will be a ceruleum facility supplying fuel to the closest of the three towers.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_152: Find the place and break things.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_153: Go on ahead, . I'll be along as soon as I finish my repairs.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_201: I didn't have the patience to take the long way 'round.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_202: I see you've disabled the first generator. That leaves us with two.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_203: Ah, bugger. That was me, wasn't it?
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_204: Well, there's nothing for it but to press on. We must see to the remaining generators before the enemy has the chance to regroup!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_205: You go on ahead, ! I'll bring up the rear!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_221: Stand clear. I have a mind to loose some fireworks.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_223: Damn it. There goes the core. I fear I may have overestimated its maximum operating capacity...by a few orders of magnitude. I blame Marques.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_224: Ahem. We'll need to find another way to bring down the third generator.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_225: Well, well...the traitor himself. And with his meddlesome friend for company.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_226: You go on ahead, . I need to get to the bottom of something.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_260: It's me! Are you all right!?
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_261: That's an assault craft you're up against! You don't stand a chance with conventional weapons!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_262: You're going to need something big to bring it down. A mortar, a cannon─anything!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_263: Hold on, ! I'm on my way!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_290: Fools! If you are resolved to die here, you might at least have done so without first making a mess of the place!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_291: I see that Garlond is not with you. More's the pity, I had hoped to slay him myself. But never mind the traitor for now.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_292: I have so looked forward to this meeting....
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_293: Yes, I know much and more about you. About your strength...and your hidden talents.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_294: I would sample them firsthand─and you will indulge me.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_320: My lord was quite taken with you and the power you possess─the “Echo.” Naturally, I could not help but wonder whom this  might be...
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_321: Only to discover that you are but another adventurer. No better than the multitude.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_322: Yet in spite of this, the masses hold you their champion, and shower honors upon your head. It defies all reason.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_323: How is it that you could be such a thorn in our side? Wherever you appear, you leave havoc in your wake. You even slew Rhitahtyn, one of our very finest.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_324: Well...I will not speculate. Truth be told, I couldn't care less how you have done these things. What matters to me is the fact that you have done them.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_325: If you are allowed to continue, you will eventually deprive me of all that I have toiled for─all that is mine by right!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_326: My minions, my comrades...even my lord Gaius!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_328: His dreams and ambitions, his body and soul─they are mine, do you hear me!? All mine!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_329: I lost everything once before! I will not suffer it to happen again!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_330: I will kill you, adventurer! Only your death can bring me peace!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_LIVIA_000_361: Please... I cannot bear it... <sob> Don't take him...away from me...
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_363: Another poor fool who craved Gaius's affection over all else... May her soul know rest.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_364: 'Tis a miracle no harm has come to you, my friend. One for which I will happily give thanks.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_365: And thanks to your fine diversionary work, we've succeeded in bringing down the generator tower─and with it, the magitek field!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_366: The way to the Praetorium now lies open. The only problem is, we can't reach it on foot.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_367: Nay, we'll need to take the Enterprise. I left her at the Ceruleum Processing Plant, so let's regroup there.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_CID_000_368: This is it, ! The final confrontation awaits!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_900: I knew you wouldn't let us down, soldier!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_901: With the Praetorium stripped of its defenses, the way to the Ultima Weapon lies open.
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_RAUBAHN_000_902: The time is come for the final phase of Operation Archon!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_ALPHINAUD_000_950: Go now, , and bring us one step closer to the dawn!
TEXT_MANFST502_01136_MINFILIA_000_960: See that you come back to us, my friend. May the Crystal bless you and keep you.
TEXT_FESLGT001_01153_PETYRWINSOME_000_00: Greetings, friend. I am Petyr Winsome, reporter for the Harbor Herald. Could you spare a moment to aid me with an article I hope to pen?

It is nothing scandalous or unseemly, I assure you. I simply wish to interview an adventurer about  firsthand experiences dealing with the recent and inexplicable profusion of monstrous wildlife beyond the city gates.

I am especially curious about the spawning megalocrabs out at Three-malm Bend, and a particularly ravenous dodo dubbed Gertrude running rampant at Quarterstone. Should you encounter any of these creatures, I would greatly appreciate aught you might share with me!
...And though I doubt not your integrity, would you mind returning with some physical evidence of your efforts? I have a reputation as a seeker of truth to maintain, you understand!
TEXT_FESLGT001_01153_PETYRWINSOME_000_02: A delight to speak with you again, adventurer. So, tell me: have you discovered aught to share with the Harbor Herald's readership? Any tales to mesmerize─and inform, of course─the masses? Hm?
A lady warrior, you say? And she left behind this parcel?

Allow me to confirm the facts. A puissant and powerful woman in exotic raiment appears, introducing herself as “Lightning.” And after the battle is won, she vanishes like a bolt of the very stuff for which she was named.
Finally, left in her blinding wake, you find what can be described as naught else but an “otherworldly” package. Incredible! I say we peel back the wrapping and have a peek at what's inside!
...I have never before seen such craftsmanship. I imagine even the famed artisans of Gridania would struggle to reproduce this degree of quality.
A mysterious knight of unknown origin wielding a weapon of equally enigmatic design. Yes, this shall become a most interesting article indeed. Your contribution has been invaluable!
With your profession in mind, I believe the contents of this parcel are best left in your hands. After all, I have need of no other accoutrements but my mighty quill!
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_000: A hearty hail to you, adventurer. I am Dural Tharal, renowned reporter for the Mythril Eye. It is the experiences of esteemed explorers such as yourself that I have come to collect and collate.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_001: Are you aware of the latest object of many an Ul'dahn adolescent's ardent attention? Aye, it is that lady-warrior Lightning and her awe-inspiring appearances across the land.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_002: Ever since the Harbor Herald printed its infamous article, the feisty fighter has found herself quite the following. And to add fuel to the fire, she has been witnessed, most recently, wielding her weapon out in the wilds of Thanalan.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_003: The knight was said to be on course to clash with a creature of nightmare incarnate.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_004: As for the specific “where,” the rumors suggest several sites, such as Highbridge in eastern Thanalan, and Little Ala Mhigo in southern Thanalan. Would you care to confirm these sightings, and indulge my career-driven curiosity? Some form of souvenir would be sufficient.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_020: So, were you successful in sighting the soldierly siren and securing a souvenir of the experience? You must tell me the tale in its terrible totality!
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_021: Be still, my beating heart! You battled a beast that bore resemblance to a behemoth? And Lightning fearlessly flung herself into the fray?
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_022: How heroic! But this bewildering box that Lightning left behind... Such a mysterious memento merits immediate investigation!
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_023: What curious contents we have uncovered! In all the meandering markets of this merchant metropolis, never have I gazed upon more enigmatic garments...
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_024: Whence does this hearty heroine hail? You opine that her origin is otherworldly? A jolly jest, but I'm afraid facts, and not flights of fancy, are my forte.
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_025: Your eyewitness account, however, shall accord my article the required amount of authenticity. The next issue of the Mythril Eye will sail off the shelves!
TEXT_FESLGT002_01154_DURALTHARAL_000_026: Here. I appreciate that adventurers enjoy acquiring such uncommon apparel. It is past time that I put pen to parchment!
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_000: Greetings, adventurer. I'm Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven. You have heard of Gridania's leading tabloid, I trust?
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001: And I assume that you have heard the rumors of the lady-knight known as Lightning? It seems she is everywhere at once!
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: The public's obsession with this mystery warrior grows with each passing day, and the publications of each city-state feed the frenzy with endless feature articles.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003:
“Lightning Drools over the Bismarck's Delightful Grilled Dodo!”
That's a headline from the Harbor Herald.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004:
“The Trinkets of Eshtaime's Lapidaries Fail to Strike Lightning's Fancy!”
That one's a groan-inducing pun typical of the Mythril Eye and its mediocre reporting.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_005: Any gazette that includes an article on Lightning─no matter how trivial the details─is guaranteed to sell down to the last copy. And The Raven needs to seize its own share of the potential profits!
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_006: The word around town is that Lightning was last seen traveling towards Coerthas. I ask that you seek out any evidence of her passage, and learn for me some tasty morsel of gossip!
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_020: How fared you in your travels, adventurer? Were you able to track down any sign of the lady-knight who has captured the imagination of the masses? Pray tell me you learned some heretofore unknown snippet of news!
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_030: Lightning fought against a magitek-like machine? But it was not, to your knowledge, of Garlean origin?
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_031: Hmmm, well, I know little of such matters, but the tale of a battle with a mysterious mechanical opponent shall make for a riveting article nonetheless! I'll just grab my quill and─
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_100_031: Hello, who have we here? A friend of yours?
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_100_032: So you're one of those so-called adventurers, right? Free to go where you want, and do as you please? Must be nice.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_000_033: I always seem to be at the mercy of some power or fate I can't control. In fact, I'm probably only here as part of an insane god's trial.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_000_034: To be tested and tempered like some unthinking weapon, so that I might be ready to fight...
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_000_035: I'll fight, all right, but it'll be on my own terms. No one pulls my strings anymore.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_000_036: Although if I had to be sent somewhere, I could do worse than this place.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_000_037: So beautiful, so full of life. My sister, my friends...they would love it here.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_LIGHTNING_000_038: ...Heh, I'm starting to sound soft. I better get going.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_039: J-Just a moment, now! Was that the Lightning!?
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_040: Ugh! I'm such a fool! I might have snared an exclusive interview with her!
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_041: But how astonishing to see the rumor in the flesh! All that we have to mark the occasion is this parcel...and the garment I found within.
TEXT_FESLGT003_01155_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_042: She must have wanted you to have it, in appreciation for the aid you rendered during her struggles. Here. Be sure to treasure this memento, adventurer.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_000: Hee hee hee! Have you perused the latest edition of The Raven, good adventurer? My feature on Lightning is selling like honey cakes!
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001: After our previous conversation, I searched through the city for our famous warrior friend...and I found her! I finally had my exclusive interview, and the resulting article has our readership enthralled!
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: I compensated her for her time, of course. Lightning seemed quite fascinated by our culture and dress, so I gifted her with the traditional garb of the Miqo'te clans.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003: Hee hee! Those other reporters must be choking on their quills at my good fortune. I─ Oh, but what am I saying!? There is far more important news afoot!
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004: According to the latest alehouse gossip, fell demons were seen converging on Lightning's location. It would be safe to assume they bear her naught but ill.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_005: Accounts place the lady-knight in the region of Mor Dhona! You must hurry to her side, and help her fend off these black-hearted fiends! ...Oh, and if you happen to acquire another one of those odd parcels, I should like to see what it contains.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_020: You seem weary, adventurer! Did you see battle? How does Lightning fare? Did you acquire any more unusual packages?
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_030: Thank the gods. I'd feared the worst, but you've set my mind at ease.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_031: I thought I might find you here.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_032: Mistress Lightning! It is good to see you hale! What brings you back to Gridania?
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_100_032: I wanted to say my good-byes.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_033: The time I've spent in Eorzea has been a welcome respite. I'm grateful for the peace I've found...when I've not been fighting monsters and fiends, of course.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_034: Believe it or not, the place I come from is far more grim and dark. But it is still my home, and there are some things too precious to abandon.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_035: If things were different, I wouldn't mind living out the rest of my days here...
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_036: But watching you follow your heart and fight of your own free will has reminded me that I must do the same.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_100_036: So, I've decided to head back, blade swinging.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_037: I'm ready to return...and ready to finish this.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_038: Hmph. God or not, someone's going to regret putting me through these trials...
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_039: ...And it looks like that someone was listening─just waiting to hear my declaration of war.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_100_039: I'm being called back. It's a shame; my memories of this world probably won't last...
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_PETYRWINSOME_000_04: <gasp> ...Heard word that... <pant> Lightning was on her way... <huff> to Gridania. Came as swiftly as I could...
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_DURALTHARAL_000_043: Confound it! Are you telling me we were too tardy!? The fighter fair has faded forever!?
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_044: She was such an intriguing character...
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_045: But it seems she had unfinished business elsewhere─people to protect, and a home to save.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_046: I wonder if the odd parcels she left behind were not some material manifestation of her determination... 'Twas a strange phenomenon, to say the least.
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_047: Well, I must be off to craft these events into another article! I hope I might beg some more of your time for another interview, my dear adventurer!
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_DURALTHARAL_000_048: You mean to monopolize all the most momentous material!? Are you not satisfied with your stunning success thus far!?
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_PETYRWINSOME_000_04: I, too, must criticize this unseemly avarice! The Raven has not the right to deny my publication a slice of the glory! After all, 'twas we who published the story which started it all...
TEXT_FESLGT004_01156_LIGHTNING_000_050: Maybe we'll meet again...in another time, another place.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_SYSTEM_000_000: Eorzea is currently celebrating All Saints' Wake. Adventurers wishing to partake in the festivities may do so in Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, or Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_SYSTEM_000_001: The rewards will be the same regardless of venue, so do not hesitate to join the celebration in the nation of your choice.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPA_000_010:
From spooks and shadows do not shy～♪
Come one, come all, for All Saints' Wake is nigh!♪
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPA_000_011: Yes, the ancient tradition of All Saints' Wake has returned to Eorzea. 'Tis a night when the saints feast in the heavens above, and the denizens of the realm below partake in masquerades and mischief.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPA_000_012: And who am I, you ask? Merely a humble circus performer, come to Gridania with my troupe on a mission to add some spice to the celebration. My costume is most convincing? Oh, you are far too kind. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPA_000_013: At any rate, we'd be most obliged if you could lend us a helping hand. If you're interested, you need only speak to the leader of our troupe, the Impresario, and obtain a costume of your own. Happy haunting!
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPHEAD_000_020: Greetings, my adventuring friend. Do you perchance feel a chill in the air on this eerie autumn eve? A boding, as if the night is ripe for wiles and witchery? This would be for good reason, for All Saints' Wake has returned to Eorzea!
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPHEAD_000_021: First, allow me to introduce myself. I am the Impresario, manager and stage director of a traveling circus summoned to this nation to enliven the seasonal festivities. It is a pleasure indeed to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPHEAD_000_022: The observance of All Saints' Wake can be traced to eras long past. Legend has it that once each year, come harvest time, the Twelve would show their favor to the saints─those exalted personages that grace guildleves─by inviting them to a lavish feast held in the celestial realm.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPHEAD_000_023: The townsfolk, not accustomed to being without their guardians for even a night, quickly grew fearful of the common beasts around them. This spurred them to don the guises of specters and engage in all manner of mischief and revelry, that they might ward away the terrors─or at the very least, forget their fears until the dawn.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPHEAD_000_024: Sadly, such customs have fallen out of favor since the Calamity, with more pressing concerns leaving little time for idle celebration. So did the august leaders of Gridania call upon the services of my humble band of thespians, that we might restore the tradition to its former glory.
TEXT_FESHLW001_01163_IMPHEAD_000_025: This ghastly garb I wear was crafted by a costumer in my troupe's employ, and it is with pleasure that I furnish you with an outfit of your own. I bid you to take your place among the dead, that a night of delightful terrors can be had by all!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_000: We humbly ask that all adventurers don their costumes before taking part in the festivities.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_001: Superstitions aside, let me assure you that dressing up as one of the dead is half the fun. Cling not to life! Cast off your worries and take your place among the terrors of the night!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_002: Those tattered rags are most becoming on you, friend. Had I not known otherwise, I would have suspected you were long since dead. Heh heh heh... Now, with no further ado, let the hauntings begin!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_003: My troupe has prepared a spine-tingling diversion worthy of the occasion. Thespians under my direction have disguised themselves as ghastly gremlins of all stripes and taken to the streets of the three city-states to haunt the local populace.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_004: It is your task, dear adventurer, to outspook the spooks, as it were. Give my troupers a good scare, and you shall be rewarded with candy.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_005: Feed this candy to the magic pot you see at the entrance to this amphitheatre, and you will be rewarded in kind for your efforts.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_006: Oh, and do take your time, friend. For the night is long, and full of most delightful terrors...
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPHEAD_000_009: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPB_000_010: Well, hullo there. Looking for a treat, are you? Had you come a few bells earlier, I'd have been happy to oblige, but I fear I'm clean out of stock.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPB_000_011: My oversized companion here, on the other hand, still has plenty to dole out. For some reason, it would appear that you adventurers are hesitant to try your scare tactics on him. Hee hee hee...
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPB_000_012: Because I'm so nice, I'll clue you in on a secret. My partner might look imposing, but the truth is he's scared to death of loud noises. Don't believe me? Just start clapping and see for yourself.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPB_000_019: Hm? Oh, let me guess: you're dressed up as an adventurer for All Saints' Wake. That's cute─really, it is─but I've got my orders: no costume, no candy.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPB_000_020: Oh, don't let him frighten you─his bark is far worse than his bite. Why, he hasn't eaten an adventurer in almost three moons! Now give him a rousing round of applause, as if to congratulate him on his aplomb. That'll put the fear of the gods in him, I guarantee.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_OGRE_000_022: You keep clapping, little , I...I crush you like ant!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_IMPB_000_023: Oh, don't let him frighten you─his bark is far worse than his bite. Why, he hasn't eaten an adventurer in almost three moons! Now give him a rousing round of applause, as if to congratulate him on his aplomb. That'll put the fear of the gods in him, I guarantee.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_OGRE_000_031: No...n-no hurt me! Scary ghost t-take candy! Take candy and go far, far away!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_081: Wh-What's the big idea!? An adventurer like you might not understand, but we zombies are delicate creatures. Why, the last time someone t-tapped me on the shoulder, my arm fell clean off!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_082: Now look at what you've done! You gave me such a fright that my worm-eaten heart dropped into where my stomach used to be, and the moldy, maggot-infested cookies I was using to patch up the gaping holes in my body are scattered everywhere! The least you could do is apologize.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_083: But noooooo, you just want my candy. Well, too bad─you're not getting anything from me. If you're starving for sweets, eat those cookies. I'll carry on...<sniff>...somehow.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_089:
Wh-Whaaa...!?
An adventurer!? Y-You don't scare me! Besides, the boss told me only to answer to my fellow undead.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_090: <sob> Holes, holes everywhere. <sniff> How could anyone ever love me?
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_091: M-My...my cookies! You're really giving them back to me? Maybe you adventurers aren't so bad, after all.
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_ZOMBIE_000_092: Sadly, I've no candy to my name...save for this piece that I've been using as a makeshift eyeball. Just give me one moment to pop it out and wipe the pus off, and... Voilà, good as new!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_040: I don't got no candy for you. So get lost!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_A1_000_000: I'm from the Culinarians' Guild, and...
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_050: I told you to get... <gulp> The C-C-Culinarians' Guild!?
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_051: P-P-Please don't eat me! I swear on every onze of jelly in my body, I taste disgusting! Why, just look at this sickly color! And have you taken a whiff of me? You'll have the entire realm throwing up in their chamberpots!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_052: H-Here, take this instead! You have my word, it tastes a hundred times better than I ever could! Now, really, get lost─you're giving me the creeps!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_060: Costume...? What cos─ I mean, thank you! But flattery won't get you any treats from me, if that's your plan. Now shoo!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_070: That's right! You got a problem with that!?
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_PUDDING_000_079: I got nothin' to say to adventurers. Come back in costume, or shoo!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_MAGICPOT_000_100: Gimme an elixir! No, that's not right...
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_MAGICPOT_000_101: Gimme some candy! Yes, you heard me─I clamor for candy!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_MAGICPOT_000_102: Now that's a tasty treat! Got any more?
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_MAGICPOT_000_109: No costume? No cookies for you!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_MAGICPOT_000_110: I'm still hungry! More, I say!
TEXT_FESHLW002_01164_MAGICPOT_000_121:
Earth, wind, and fire～♪
That's what I desire～♪
Here, this is for you!
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_000: The night grows ever deeper; the streets teem with spooks and shades. Yes, everything is proceeding precisely according to plan... Hm?
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_001: Ah, you return. I am proud to say that the traditional observance of All Saints' Wake has made a rousing return to Eorzea, thanks in no small part to your efforts. Why, I daresay there might be a place for you in our troupe someday.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_002: But the night is still young, and there is work yet to be done. You have, no doubt, observed the warding lanterns about the streets─those that bear a striking resemblance to the mask I wear. This mask, in turn, was crafted in the likeness of the Great Gourd, the patron spirit of All Saints' Wake, who descends upon the realm but once a year...
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_003: In any event, the lighting of these lanterns is yet another All Saints' Wake tradition, intended to keep evil spirits at bay. The chill autumn winds blow strong, however, and I fear that many a flame has been quenched. Were the streets to be plunged in darkness, who knows what terrors might descend upon the city? Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_004: I have entrusted to one of my men over there a supply of bomb digits. If you would be so kind, adventurer, procure some and set the dimmed lanterns aflame once more.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPA_000_010: Come to help us light lanterns, have you? Heh heh...your kindness is most appreciated. Here, these severed bomb digits should suffice for the task.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPA_000_011: A word of warning before you depart: you'd be wise to stay in costume. After all, the specters lurking in the shadows aren't like to take kindly to an adventurer's meddlings.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPA_000_019: I'd be wary of walking around like that if I were you, friend. The spirits of the dead walk the streets tonight, and they bear little fondness for the living...
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPA_000_030: (-Disembodied Voice-)This one...still draws breath. Return to your bed, living one...lest you ne'er wake to see the dawn.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_040: It is good to see you safe and sound, friend. I feared you might have been spirited away by the Great Gourd. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_041: My troupers tell me that the warding lamps burn brightly once more. The citizens of Gridania have you to thank for keeping the demons of the night at bay.
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_042: Yes, this has truly been an All Saints' Wake for the ages. But , and the most terrifying delights are yet to be seen. Do stay a while and enjoy the festivities, friend. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW003_01165_IMPHEAD_000_050: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_000: Back again? I thought I'd given you enough work to keep you out of our─ Ahem! Your efforts on my troupe's behalf have so impressed me that I would entrust to you the most important task of all. What manner of task, you ask? Why, that would be, ah...erm...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_002: Yes, I am certain there is some unlit nook or cranny of this city that is in dire need of illumination─say, the falls to the north of here─and you are unquestionably the  for the job!
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_003: Now, procure the necessary supplies from my associate over there, and hop to it. I have more important matters to attend to! Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPA_000_010: One final lantern? How odd, I could have sworn that we had lit them all...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPA_000_011: But who am I to question the Impresario? Very well, take this bomb digit and do with it as you will.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPA_000_019: Is it truly wise to be walking around without your costume like that? These streets aren't safe for adventurers...heh heh.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_PUMPKIN_000_020: (-Disembodied Voice-)Don your guise, living one... 'Tis unsafe to reveal yourself here...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_PUMPKIN_000_030: (-Disembodied Voice-)Ah, the flames warm my belly. Thank you, living one...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_PUMPKIN_000_031: (-Disembodied Voice-)The monstrous troupers you consort with...do you not wonder whence they truly hail?
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_PUMPKIN_000_032: (-Disembodied Voice-)Should you be curious, you would do well to speak with their purported patrons. But be warned, friend─some secrets are best left to dwell in the darkness...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_UPHANNE_100_000: Ah, those performers. Their guises are a bit too convincing, if you ask me. All Saints' Wake or no, I am ill pleased to see such baleful creatures skulking about the streets of our fair nation.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_UPHANNE_000_040: To the Order, safeguarding Gridania and its people is paramount. I must admit that I have my reservations about engaging in such idle revelry in these trying times.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_UPHANNE_000_041: But the troupe is here at the invitation of the Elder Seedseer herself, and it is not my place to question her. If you would know more, seek out Hearer Damaris at Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_DAMARIS_000_050: Uphanne said what!? That ghastly troupe was summoned by the Elder Seedseer herself? Preposterous!
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_DAMARIS_000_051: Dashing through the Twelveswood dressed as ghosts? Hacking up pumpkins to serve as frivolous decorations? I shudder to think of how the elementals would react. No, this is all the Adventurers' Guild's doing. If you would know more, take it up with Miounne. Why, I daresay I've a mind to do so myself!
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_MIOUNNE_000_060: Is that what you were told? Why, the Adventurers' Guild would never act against the wishes of the Elder Seedseer.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_MIOUNNE_000_061: It would seem that each of us has heard a different story about the troupe's origins. Most curious indeed...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_MIOUNNE_000_062: I have a feeling that someone─or something─has pulled the wool over our eyes, and I have a fair notion as to who the culprit might be.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_MIOUNNE_000_063: Yes, I think it's time we find out just who that Impresario is, and what he and his minions are scheming. Take this─I daresay it should scare the truth out of him.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_071: M-My disguise! It's ruined! What did ya have to do that for!?
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_072: Bah, seven hells! All right, ya got me. That's right, the self-styled Impresario is a real, honest-to-goodness imp.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_073: Whoa! Settle down, ! So the whole traveling circus thing was a ruse─ya got me there. But, cross my wings and hope to die, I swear we didn't mean ya no harm.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_074: Back in the old days, when celebratin' All Saints' Wake was in fashion, it was the one time a year when we could leave the dank ol' dungeons we called home, stretch our wings a bit, and mingle with the city folk.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_075: Sure, we caused our share of mischief─and occasionally spooked some ol' grandma half to death─but we never hurt no one. Not on purpose, at least...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_076: Ever since the Calamity, though, everyone's so godsdamned serious. Can't even come within eyeshot of the city without some overzealous adventurer like yourself wavin' a weapon at me, out for blood. Can ya blame us for wantin' to bring back the old customs?
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_077: Ah, but what does it matter now? Thanks to your meddlin', our charade is through. And I know exactly what happens next.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_078: Yep, you're going to tear off the costume I so kindly provided for you─free of charge, I might add─slip into your favorite suit of armor, and hack my poor little wings off. All for the crime of trying to have a little fun.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_080: Who'd've thunk it? You adventurers aren't all so bad. Me and my minions, we'll not forget this kindness.
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_081: That said, ya have to admit that our ruse was quite the clever one. Just tell me this: however did ya manage to see through it all?
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_082: A pumpkin spilled our secrets, ya say? Hah, that's a good one!
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_083: Listen, the Great Gourd was just a tall tale that I cooked up to give adventurers like you a good fright! Are you suggesting that some overgrown pumpkin could truly...?
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_084: Well, this is All Saints' Wake. Who knows what mysteries the night still holds?
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_085: So tread carefully, adventurer! And do be wary of the shadows. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_PUMPKIN_000_086:

And with this, my work is done～♪
TEXT_FESHLW004_01166_IMPHEAD_000_090: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_SYSTEM_000_000: Eorzea is currently celebrating All Saints' Wake. Adventurers wishing to partake in the festivities may do so in Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, or Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_SYSTEM_000_001: The rewards will be the same regardless of venue, so do not hesitate to join the celebration in the nation of your choice.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPA_000_010:
From spooks and shadows do not shy～♪
Come one, come all, for All Saints' Wake is nigh!♪
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPA_000_011: Yes, the ancient tradition of All Saints' Wake has returned to Eorzea. 'Tis a night when the saints feast in the heavens above, and the denizens of the realm below partake in masquerades and mischief.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPA_000_012: And who am I, you ask? Merely a humble circus performer, come to Limsa Lominsa with my troupe on a mission to add some spice to the celebration. My costume is most convincing? Oh, you are far too kind. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPA_000_013: At any rate, we'd be most obliged if you could lend us a helping hand. If you're interested, you need only speak to the leader of our troupe, the Impresario, and obtain a costume of your own. Happy haunting!
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPHEAD_000_020: Greetings, my adventuring friend. Do you perchance feel a chill in the air on this eerie autumn eve? A boding, as if the night is ripe for wiles and witchery? This would be for good reason, for All Saints' Wake has returned to Eorzea!
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPHEAD_000_021: First, allow me to introduce myself. I am the Impresario, manager and stage director of a traveling circus summoned to this nation to enliven the seasonal festivities. It is a pleasure indeed to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPHEAD_000_022: The observance of All Saints' Wake can be traced to eras long past. Legend has it that once each year, come harvest time, the Twelve would show their favor to the saints─those exalted personages that grace guildleves─by inviting them to a lavish feast held in the celestial realm.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPHEAD_000_023: The townsfolk, not accustomed to being without their guardians for even a night, quickly grew fearful of the common beasts around them. This spurred them to don the guises of specters and engage in all manner of mischief and revelry, that they might ward away the terrors─or at the very least, forget their fears until the dawn.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPHEAD_000_024: Sadly, such customs have fallen out of favor since the Calamity, with more pressing concerns leaving little time for idle celebration. So did the august leaders of Limsa Lominsa call upon the services of my humble band of thespians, that we might restore the tradition to its former glory.
TEXT_FESHLW011_01167_IMPHEAD_000_025: This ghastly garb I wear was crafted by a costumer in my troupe's employ, and it is with pleasure that I furnish you with an outfit of your own. I bid you to take your place among the dead, that a night of delightful terrors can be had by all!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_000: We humbly ask that all adventurers don their costumes before taking part in the festivities.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_001: Superstitions aside, let me assure you that dressing up as one of the dead is half the fun. Cling not to life! Cast off your worries and take your place among the terrors of the night!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_002: Those tattered rags are most becoming on you, friend. Had I not known otherwise, I would have suspected you were long since dead. Heh heh heh... Now, with no further ado, let the hauntings begin!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_003: My troupe has prepared a spine-tingling diversion worthy of the occasion. Thespians under my direction have disguised themselves as ghastly gremlins of all stripes and taken to the streets of the three city-states to haunt the local populace.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_004: It is your task, dear adventurer, to outspook the spooks, as it were. Give my troupers a good scare, and you shall be rewarded with candy.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_005: Feed this candy to the magic pot you see off to my right, as you approach the Adventurers' Guild. Rest assured you will be rewarded in kind for your efforts.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_006: Oh, and do take your time, friend. For the night is long, and full of most delightful terrors...
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPHEAD_000_009: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_010: I don't got no candy for you. So get lost!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_A1_000_000: I'm from the Culinarians' Guild, and...
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_020: I told you to get... <gulp> The C-C-Culinarians' Guild!?
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_021: P-P-Please don't eat me! I swear on every onze of jelly in my body, I taste disgusting! Why, just look at this sickly color! And have you taken a whiff of me? You'll have the entire realm throwing up in their chamberpots!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_022: H-Here, take this instead! You have my word, it tastes a hundred times better than I ever could! Now, really, get lost─you're giving me the creeps!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_030: Costume...? What cos─ I mean, thank you! But flattery won't get you any treats from me, if that's your plan. Now shoo!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_040: That's right! You got a problem with that!?
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_PUDDING_000_049: I got nothin' to say to adventurers. Come back in costume, or shoo!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_081: Wh-What's the big idea!? An adventurer like you might not understand, but we zombies are delicate creatures. Why, the last time someone t-tapped me on the shoulder, my arm fell clean off!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_082: Now look at what you've done! You gave me such a fright that my worm-eaten heart dropped into where my stomach used to be, and the moldy, maggot-infested cookies I was using to patch up the gaping holes in my body are scattered everywhere! The least you could do is apologize.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_083: But noooooo, you just want my candy. Well, too bad─you're not getting anything from me. If you're starving for sweets, eat those cookies. I'll carry on...<sniff>...somehow.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_089:
Wh-Whaaa...!?
An adventurer!? Y-You don't scare me! Besides, the boss told me only to answer to my fellow undead.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_090: <sob> Holes, holes everywhere. How could anyone ever love me?
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_091: M-My...my cookies! You're really giving them back to me? Maybe you adventurers aren't so bad, after all.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_ZOMBIE_000_092: Sadly, I've no candy to my name...save for this piece that I've been using as a makeshift eyeball. Just give me one moment to pop it out and wipe the pus off, and... Voilà, good as new!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPB_000_050: Well, hullo there. Looking for a treat, are you? Had you come a few bells earlier, I'd have been happy to oblige, but I fear I'm clean out of stock.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPB_000_051: My oversized companion here, on the other hand, still has plenty to dole out. For some reason, it would appear that you adventurers are hesitant to try your scare tactics on him. Hee hee hee...
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPB_000_052: Because I'm so nice, I'll clue you in on a secret. My partner might look imposing, but the truth is he's scared to death of loud noises. Don't believe me? Just start clapping and see for yourself.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPB_000_019: Hm? Oh, let me guess: you're dressed up as an adventurer for All Saints' Wake. That's cute─really, it is─but I've got my orders: no costume, no candy.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPB_000_060: Oh, don't let him frighten you─his bark is far worse than his bite. Why, he hasn't eaten an adventurer in almost three moons! Now give him a rousing round of applause, as if to congratulate him on his aplomb. That'll put the fear of the gods in him, I guarantee.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_OGRE_000_062: You keep clapping, little , I...I crush you like ant!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_IMPB_000_063: Oh, don't let him frighten you─his bark is far worse than his bite. Why, he hasn't eaten an adventurer in almost three moons! Now give him a rousing round of applause, as if to congratulate him on his aplomb. That'll put the fear of the gods in him, I guarantee.
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_OGRE_000_071: No...n-no hurt me! Scary ghost t-take candy! Take candy and go far, far away!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_MAGICPOT_000_100: Gimme an elixir! No, that's not right...
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_MAGICPOT_000_101: Gimme some candy! Yes, you heard me─I clamor for candy!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_MAGICPOT_000_102: Now that's a tasty treat! Got any more?
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_MAGICPOT_000_109: No costume? No cookies for you!
TEXT_FESHLW012_01168_MAGICPOT_000_110: I'm still hungry! More, I say!

TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_000: The night grows ever deeper; the docks teem with spooks and shades. Yes, everything is proceeding precisely according to plan... Hm?
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_001: Ah, you return. I am proud to say that the traditional observance of All Saints' Wake has made a rousing return to Eorzea, thanks in no small part to your efforts. Why, I daresay there might be a place for you in our troupe someday.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_002: But the night is still young, and there is work yet to be done. You have, no doubt, observed the warding lanterns about the streets─those that bear a striking resemblance to the mask I wear. This mask, in turn, was crafted in the likeness of the Great Gourd, the patron spirit of All Saints' Wake, who descends upon the realm but once a year...
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_003: In any event, the lighting of these lanterns is yet another All Saints' Wake tradition, intended to keep evil spirits at bay. The chill autumn winds blow strong, however, and I fear that many a flame has been quenched. Were the streets to be plunged in darkness, who knows what terrors might descend upon the city? Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_004: I have entrusted to one of my men over there a supply of bomb digits. If you would be so kind, adventurer, procure some and set the dimmed lanterns aflame once more.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPA_000_010: Come to help us light lanterns, have you? Heh heh...your kindness is most appreciated. Here, these severed bomb digits should suffice for the task.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPA_000_011: A word of warning before you depart: you'd be wise to stay in costume. After all, the specters lurking in the shadows aren't like to take kindly to an adventurer's meddlings.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPA_000_019: I'd be wary of walking around like that if I were you, friend. The spirits of the dead walk the streets tonight, and they bear little fondness for the living...
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPA_000_030: (-Disembodied Voice-)This one...still draws breath. Return to your bed, living one...lest you ne'er wake to see the dawn.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_040: It is good to see you safe and sound, friend. I feared you might have been spirited away by the Great Gourd. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_041: My troupers tell me that the warding lamps burn brightly once more. The citizens of Limsa Lominsa have you to thank for keeping the demons of the night at bay.
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_042: Yes, this has truly been an All Saints' Wake for the ages. But , and the most terrifying delights are yet to be seen. Do stay a while and enjoy the festivities, friend. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW013_01169_IMPHEAD_000_050: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_IMPHEAD_000_000: Back again? I thought I'd given you enough work to keep you out of our─ Ahem! Your efforts on my troupe's behalf have so impressed me that I would entrust to you the most important task of all. What manner of task, you ask? Why, that would be, ah...erm...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_IMPHEAD_000_002: Yes, I am certain there is some unlit nook or cranny of this city that is in dire need of illumination, and you are unquestionably the  for the job!
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_IMPHEAD_000_003: Now, procure the necessary supplies from my associate over there, and hop to it. I have more important matters to attend to! Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_IMPA_000_010: One final lantern? How odd, I could have sworn that we had lit them all...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_IMPA_000_011: But who am I to question the Impresario? Very well, take this bomb digit and do with it as you will.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_IMPA_000_019: And remember: don't forget your costume. These streets aren't safe for adventurers...heh heh.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_PUMPKIN_000_020: (-Disembodied Voice-)Don your guise, living one... 'Tis unsafe to reveal yourself here...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_PUMPKIN_000_010: (-Disembodied Voice-)Ah, the flames warm my belly. Thank you, living one...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_PUMPKIN_000_011: (-Disembodied Voice-)The monstrous troupers you consort with...do you not wonder whence they truly hail?
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_PUMPKIN_000_012: (-Disembodied Voice-)Should you be curious, you would do well to speak with their purported patrons. But be warned, friend─some secrets are best left to dwell in the darkness...
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_OADENEK_100_000: Ah, those performers. Their guises are a bit too convincing, if you ask me. All Saints' Wake or no, I am ill pleased to see such baleful creatures skulking about the streets of our fair nation.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_OADENEK_000_040: It is the Maelstrom's sworn duty to safeguard Limsa Lominsa and its people. I cannot help but have reservations about partaking in such idle revelry in these trying times.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_OADENEK_000_041: And yet the Yellowjackets are convinced that this sort of merrymaking is just what Lominsans need, or so I've heard. If you would know more, Sundyrund might be able to elaborate.

TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_SUNDYRUND_000_051: I think I speak for us all when I say that I've seen enough spooks to last me a lifetime. No, this is all the Adventurers' Guild's doing. If ye'd know more, take it up with Baderon. Hells, I've half a mind to do so myself!

TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_BADERON_000_061: 'Ells, if I had me druthers, I'd keelhaul the lot o' them.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_BADERON_000_062: No, somethin' stinks 'ere, an' it sure as 'ells ain't me grog.
TEXT_FESHLW014_01170_BADERON_000_063: I've been savin' this 'ere fer a special occasion. Aye, why don't ye pay one last visit to that so-called Impresario an' see if this doesn't 'ave 'im singin' a new shanty.

TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPHEAD_000_002: Those tattered rags are most becoming on you, friend. Had I not known otherwise, I would have suspected you were long since dead. Heh heh heh... Now, with no further ado, let the hauntings begin!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPHEAD_000_003: My troupe has prepared a spine-tingling diversion worthy of the occasion. Thespians under my direction have disguised themselves as ghastly gremlins of all stripes and taken to the streets of the three city-states to haunt the local populace.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPHEAD_000_004: It is your task, dear adventurer, to outspook the spooks, as it were. Give my troupers a good scare, and you shall be rewarded with candy.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPHEAD_000_005: Feed this candy to the magic pot you see just across the way to my left, and you will be rewarded in kind for your efforts.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPHEAD_000_006: Oh, and do take your time, friend. For the night is long, and full of most delightful terrors...
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPHEAD_000_009: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_011: Wh-What's the big idea!? An adventurer like you might not understand, but we zombies are delicate creatures. Why, the last time someone t-tapped me on the shoulder, my arm fell clean off!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_012: Now look at what you've done! You gave me such a fright that my worm-eaten heart dropped into where my stomach used to be, and the moldy, maggot-infested cookies I was using to patch up the gaping holes in my body are scattered everywhere! The least you could do is apologize.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_013: But noooooo, you just want my candy. Well, too bad─you're not getting anything from me. If you're starving for sweets, eat those cookies. I'll carry on...<sniff>...somehow.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_019:
Wh-Whaaa...!?
An adventurer!? Y-You don't scare me! Besides, the boss told me only to answer to my fellow undead.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_020: <sob> Holes, holes everywhere. How could anyone ever love me?
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_021: M-My...my cookies! You're really giving them back to me? Maybe you adventurers aren't so bad, after all.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_ZOMBIE_000_022: Sadly, I've no candy to my name...save for this piece that I've been using as a makeshift eyeball. Just give me one moment to pop it out and wipe the pus off, and... Voilà, good as new!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_030: I don't got no candy for you. So get lost!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_A1_000_000: I'm from the Culinarians' Guild, and...
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_040: I told you to get... <gulp> The C-C-Culinarians' Guild!?
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_041: P-P-Please don't eat me! I swear on every onze of jelly in my body, I taste disgusting! Why, just look at this sickly color! And have you taken a whiff of me? You'll have the entire realm throwing up in their chamberpots!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_042: H-Here, take this instead! You have my word, it tastes a hundred times better than I ever could! Now, really, get lost─you're giving me the creeps!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_050: Costume...? What cos─ I mean, thank you! But flattery won't get you any treats from me, if that's your plan. Now shoo!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_060: That's right! You got a problem with that!?
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_PUDDING_000_069: I got nothin' to say to adventurers. Come back in costume, or shoo!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPB_000_070: Well, hullo there. Looking for a treat, are you? Had you come a few bells earlier, I'd have been happy to oblige, but I fear I'm clean out of stock.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPB_000_071: My oversized companion here, on the other hand, still has plenty to dole out. For some reason, it would appear that you adventurers are hesitant to try your scare tactics on him. Hee hee hee...
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPB_000_072: Because I'm so nice, I'll clue you in on a secret. My partner might look imposing, but the truth is he's scared to death of loud noises. Don't believe me? Just start clapping and see for yourself.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPB_000_079: Hm? Oh, let me guess: you're dressed up as an adventurer for All Saints' Wake. That's cute─really, it is─but I've got my orders: no costume, no candy.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPB_000_080: Oh, don't let him frighten you─his bark is far worse than his bite. Why, he hasn't eaten an adventurer in almost three moons! Now give him a rousing round of applause, as if to congratulate him on his aplomb. That'll put the fear of the gods in him, I guarantee.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_OGRE_000_082: You keep clapping, little , I...I crush you like ant!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_IMPB_000_083: Oh, don't let him frighten you─his bark is far worse than his bite. Why, he hasn't eaten an adventurer in almost three moons! Now give him a rousing round of applause, as if to congratulate him on his aplomb. That'll put the fear of the gods in him, I guarantee.
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_OGRE_000_091: No...n-no hurt me! Scary ghost t-take candy! Take candy and go far, far away!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_MAGICPOT_000_100: Gimme an elixir! No, that's not right...
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_MAGICPOT_000_101: Gimme some candy! Yes, you heard me─I clamor for candy!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_MAGICPOT_000_102: Now that's a tasty treat! Got any more?
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_MAGICPOT_000_109: No costume? No cookies for you!
TEXT_FESHLW022_01172_MAGICPOT_000_110: I'm still hungry! More, I say!

TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_000: The night grows ever deeper; the streets teem with spooks and shades. Yes, everything is proceeding precisely according to plan... Hm?
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_001: Ah, you return. I am proud to say that the traditional observance of All Saints' Wake has made a rousing return to Eorzea, thanks in no small part to your efforts. Why, I daresay there might be a place for you in our troupe someday.
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_002: But the night is still young, and there is work yet to be done. You have, no doubt, observed the warding lanterns about the streets─those that bear a striking resemblance to the mask I wear. This mask, in turn, was crafted in the likeness of the Great Gourd, the patron spirit of All Saints' Wake, who descends upon the realm but once a year...
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_003: In any event, the lighting of these lanterns is yet another All Saints' Wake tradition, intended to keep evil spirits at bay. The chill autumn winds blow strong, however, and I fear that many a flame has been quenched. Were the streets to be plunged in darkness, who knows what terrors might descend upon the city? Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_004: I have entrusted to one of my men over there a supply of bomb digits. If you would be so kind, adventurer, procure some and set the dimmed lanterns aflame once more.
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPA_000_010: Come to help us light lanterns, have you? Heh heh...your kindness is most appreciated. Here, these severed bomb digits should suffice for the task.
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPA_000_011: A word of warning before you depart: you'd be wise to stay in costume. After all, the specters lurking in the shadows aren't like to take kindly to an adventurer's meddlings.
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPA_000_019: I'd be wary of walking around like that if I were you, friend. The spirits of the dead walk the streets tonight, and they bear little fondness for the living...
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPA_000_030: (-Disembodied Voice-)This one...still draws breath. Return to your bed, living one...lest you ne'er wake to see the dawn.
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_040: It is good to see you safe and sound, friend. I feared you might have been spirited away by the Great Gourd. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_041: My troupers tell me that the warding lamps burn brightly once more. The citizens of Ul'dah have you to thank for keeping the demons of the night at bay.
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_042: Yes, this has truly been an All Saints' Wake for the ages. But , and the most terrifying delights are yet to be seen. Do stay a while and enjoy the festivities, friend. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW023_01173_IMPHEAD_000_050: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_000: Back again? I thought I'd given you enough work to keep you out of our─ Ahem! Your efforts on my troupe's behalf have so impressed me that I would entrust to you the most important task of all. What manner of task, you ask? Why, that would be, ah...erm...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_002: Yes, I am certain there is some unlit nook or cranny of this city that is in dire need of illumination, and you are unquestionably the  for the job!
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_003: Now, procure the necessary supplies from my associate over there, and hop to it. I have more important matters to attend to! Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPA_000_010: One final lantern? How odd, I could have sworn that we had lit them all...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPA_000_011: But who am I to question the Impresario? Very well, take this bomb digit and do with it as you will.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPA_000_019: Is it truly wise to be walking around without your costume like that? These streets aren't safe for adventurers...heh heh.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_PUMPKIN_000_020: (-Disembodied Voice-)Don your guise, living one... 'Tis unsafe to reveal yourself here...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_PUMPKIN_000_010: (-Disembodied Voice-)Ah, the flames warm my belly. Thank you, living one...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_PUMPKIN_000_011: (-Disembodied Voice-)The monstrous troupers you consort with...do you not wonder whence they truly hail?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_PUMPKIN_000_012: (-Disembodied Voice-)Should you be curious, you would do well to speak with their purported patrons. But be warned, friend─some secrets are best left to dwell in the darkness...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_AMBRIC_100_000: Ah, those performers. Their guises are a bit too convincing, if you ask me. All Saints' Wake or no, I am ill pleased to see such baleful creatures skulking about the streets of our fair nation.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_AMBRIC_000_040: It is the sworn duty of the Immortal Flames to safeguard Ul'dah and its people. I must admit to having my reservations about encouraging such idle revelry in these trying times.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_AMBRIC_000_041: But the summons came directly from the sultana herself─or so I've heard─and it is far from my place to question Her Grace. If you would know more, Raragun of the Sultansworn might be able to enlighten you.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_RARAGUN_000_050: Ambric said what!? That the sultana herself invited that troupe to Ul'dah!? Preposterous!
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_RARAGUN_000_051: No, this was all the Adventurers' Guild's doing, if I've heard true. I suggest you take it up with Momodi─hells, I've a mind to do so myself!
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_MOMODI_000_060: You were told what? That it was the Adventurers' Guild─and me in particular─that brought that ghastly troupe to Ul'dah?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_MOMODI_000_061: Utterly ridiculous! After all, with that troupe taking in all the proceeds, what profit could possibly be in it for me?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_MOMODI_000_062: No, I've seen enough thieves and tricksters in my day to know when someone's pullin' a fast one on me.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_MOMODI_000_063: Why don't you take this and give that self-styled Impresario a scare of his own? I reckon that'll spook the truth out of him.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_071: M-My disguise! It's ruined! What did ya have to do that for!?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_072: Bah, seven hells! All right, ya got me. That's right, the self-styled Impresario is a real, honest-to-goodness imp.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_073: Whoa! Settle down, ! So the whole traveling circus thing was a sham─ya got me there. But, cross my wings and hope to die, I swear we didn't mean ya no harm.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_074: Back in the old days, when celebratin' All Saints' Wake was in fashion, it was the one time a year when we could leave the dank ol' dungeons we called home, stretch our wings a bit, and mingle with the city folk.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_075: Sure, we caused our share of mischief─and occasionally spooked some ol' grandma half to death─but we never hurt no one. Not on purpose, at least...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_076: Ever since the Calamity, though, everyone's so godsdamned serious. Can't even come within eyeshot of the city limits without some overzealous adventurer like yourself wavin' a weapon at me, out for blood. Can ya blame us for wantin' to bring back the old customs?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_077: Ah, but what does it matter now? Thanks to your meddlin', our charade is through. And I know exactly what happens next.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_078: Yep, you're going to tear off the costume I so kindly provided for you─free of charge, I might add─slip into your favorite suit of armor, and hack my poor little wings off. All for the crime of trying to have a little fun.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_080: Who'd've thunk it? You adventurers aren't all so bad. Me and my minions, we'll not forget this kindness.
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_081: That said, ya have to admit that our ruse was quite the clever one. Just tell me this: however did ya manage to see through it all?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_082: A pumpkin spilled our secrets, ya say? Hah, that's a good one!
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_083: Listen, the Great Gourd was just a tall tale that I cooked up to give adventurers like you a good fright! Are you suggesting that some overgrown pumpkin could truly...?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_084: Well, this is All Saints' Wake. Who knows what mysteries the night still holds?
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_085: So tread carefully, adventurer! And do be wary of the shadows. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_PUMPKIN_000_086:

And with this, my work is done～♪
TEXT_FESHLW024_01174_IMPHEAD_000_090: What's the matter, friend? Have you misplaced your costume? I fear I cannot allow you to participate in the festivities unless you are dressed for the part.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_MINFILIA_000_000: Leave Ul'dah... Has it truly come to this?
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_MINFILIA_000_002: He is engaged in some business or other and requires your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_MINFILIA_000_003: Pray be on your way. Alphinaud waits upon you, and I have much to think about.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_MINFILIA_000_004: Oh, and...tell him he shall have my answer in due time.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Confound it. She knows what must be done, and still she hesitates.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_011: All because of these fanciful rumors.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Hm. I should explain. Minfilia's mother─well, adoptive mother─was among the great many who perished during the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_013: F'lhaminn was her name, though you may know her better as the “Songstress of Ul'dah.” She was a performer of singular talent, and much beloved by the people of Eorzea─not to mention a certain Sharlayan minstrel.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_014: As you may imagine, the news of her passing was greeted with shock and disbelief by her adoring followers, many of whom refused to acknowledge what had happened. That her body was never found only served to encourage speculation.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Minfilia, too, struggled at first to accept the truth, but as F'lhaminn's absence stretched from months into years, she saw that there could be no other explanation.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Until recently, at any rate. For whatever reason, rumors have once again begun to circulate that F'lhaminn is alive and well.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Alas, they have served to rekindle an irrational hope in Minfilia which now clouds her judgment. This talk of Ul'dah as our home, and of the insurmountable difficulties of moving to Mor Dhona─it is no more than an expression of her unwillingness to let go. Nonsense, in a word. But until the tales of F'lhaminn's miraculous preservation have been categorically disproved, I fear she will remain lost to reason.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_018: That being the case, I propose we set about disproving them posthaste. Let's see how these fanciful claims stand up to investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ALPHINAUD_000_019: One of the most recent of this latest crop of rumors comes to us by way of Father Iliud. Question him for me. I shall look into another alleged sighting and follow anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ILIUD_000_030: Good  to you, . Alphinaud told me to expect you.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ILIUD_000_031: Now, you are doubtless eager to ask me certain questions, but before you do, I must stress that I myself did not see F'lhaminn─though I very much wish I had. I merely hearkened unto the tale of a mourner who came to stay with us.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ILIUD_000_032: He is still here, if you wish to hear it for yourself. You will find him in the lichyard, I should think.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_GRAVEMAN_000_040: ...Aye, I saw F'lhaminn─just as clearly as I see you now. And yes, I'm sure it was her, before you ask. I could never forget a woman like that!
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_GRAVEMAN_000_041: 'Twas nigh on seven summers ago I first set eyes on her, and I still remember it as if it were yesterday.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_GRAVEMAN_000_042: I'm happy to report that the years have only made her more beautiful!
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_GRAVEMAN_000_043: Where did I─? Oh, Costa del Sol! She was giving lessons to Gegeruju's women, and her voice─gods, her voice... That soft tinkling of bells resonated in my very soul.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_GRAVEMAN_000_044: I dare not say how her songs touched me...
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_GRAVEMAN_000_045: I didn't think I'd ever feel this way again─not when I lost you, my dear... And it's not the same, it really isn't... But it's been over a year now, and I've been so lonely...
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ILIUD_000_050: ...Do I believe the man's tale? Well...I believe that he believes it. Though I do wonder...
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ILIUD_000_051: I doubt I would recognize someone I barely knew whom I hadn't seen in seven years.
TEXT_GAIUSE102_01176_ILIUD_000_052: But if there is even the slightest possibility that F'lhaminn yet lives, do we not owe it to Minfilia to pursue it?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ILIUD_000_000: If this woman resembling F'lhaminn was employed at Costa del Sol, then that is where you should go.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ILIUD_000_001: I will inform Alphinaud of these latest developments. You need only concern yourself with the search.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ILIUD_000_002: Master Gegeruju should remember you from your past engagements, so I suggest you waste no time and approach him directly.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_GEGERUJU_000_010: <sigh> O sweet siren of the sands, my Miqo'te muse! Why have you forsaken me...?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_GEGERUJU_000_011: T-Titan's Bane! I mean, ! What brings you to my humble resort?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_GEGERUJU_000_012: F'lhaminn!? You mean to tell me the goddess-made-flesh who dwelt among us until so very recently was the Songstress of Ul'dah!? Egads, ─if I had known that, I would've chained her to my bedpost and never let her leave!
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_GEGERUJU_000_013: Ahem! An exaggeration for dramatic effect. As to her current whereabouts, I recall she mentioned Wineport. Ah, but there is no need to pursue her, my friend! When she tires of her rough way of living, she will make straight for Costa del Sol, and fling herself into my waiting arms, flushed and breathless...
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_JUNGHBHAR_000_020: ...Eh? You want to know if I've seen a Miqo'te lass by the name of F'lhaminn? I wish! I haven't seen a lass of any description for far too bloody long...
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_BYRGLAENT_000_030: Well, if it isn't , the savior of Wineport! To what do we owe the pleasure?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_BYRGLAENT_000_031: Ah, yes, we did receive a customer matching that description. She was a delight to behold, to give the woman her due, but her perfume was so ghastly, I had no choice but to eject her from the premises. Interfering with tastings, you understand.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_BYRGLAENT_000_032: If she is your quarry, why not consult your blind associate? His olfactory perception is without peer. Given that I could smell the woman from a malm away, I daresay he could smell her from ten.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: <sniff> <sniff> I see you have had many grand adventures since last we spoke, . You must share them with me sometime.
The girl from a little while ago? One does not forget a perfume like that. So robust and intoxicating...yet simultaneously familiar. Reminiscent of a bloom native to these parts, in fact.
I said as much when we spoke. She complimented my powers of observation and asked me where she might find some of the flowers.

So I told her to follow the road south into Raincatcher Gully and then head east after crossing the second bridge. The flowers which grow in the shade of the cliff have the strongest scent, you see. If you make haste, you may yet find her there.
The lady you seek did not leave all that long ago. Make haste to the second bridge, then head due east. Look for the flowers which grow in the shade of the cliff, and with luck you may yet find her.
