TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_050: I am in your debt, stranger. I did not realize my activities had aroused the goobbue's ire until it was too late.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_051: Their oils can be used to make a perfume, you see, and I─
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_053: Who are you? Whom do you serve?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_054: Typical. Of all the many leads, yours obviously had to be the one which bore fruit. I don't know why I bother...
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_055: The Songstress of Ul'dah, I presume? Minfilia─or should I say, Ascilia─is looking for you.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_057: You are the very picture of health, milady─yet the world thinks you dead.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_058: I can only conclude that this was by design. The question is: why?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_059: Not everyone who endeavors to find me does so with the best intentions, child.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_060: You will be pleased to know that I fully intend to reveal myself to Minfilia─when the time is right.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Oh! Well...that does please me. More than you know. But tell me: sojourns in the forests of La Noscea aside, when exactly will the time be right?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_062: When I deem it so. Do you imagine I traveled all this way on a whim? As I was telling your associate prior to your intrusion, I came here to harvest these flowers for use in a perfume. Does that satisfy your curiosity, or would you interrogate me further?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_063: M-My apologies for the interruption. Anyway─now that we all have that which we came for, might we continue this conversation in a safer locale? Wineport, say?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_070: This...this is not at all how I had envisioned it.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Ahem. Having been apprised of our situation, Lady F'lhaminn has consented to plead our case to Minfilia regarding the proposed move to Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_072: However, she will only do so once her perfume is complete. Moreover, she insists that we aid her in obtaining the final ingredient.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_073: She will not be swayed. I assure you, I tried.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_ALPHINAUD_000_074: ...Let's just get this over with, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_080: Rescued yet again from the jaws of a ravenous goobbue. How quickly we forget the lessons of the past.
TEXT_GAIUSE103_01177_FLHAMINN_000_081: <sigh> Though I was not solely to blame for that foolishness...
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_000: Believe me when I tell you that I am every bit as eager to return to Vesper Bay as you are. There is work to be done ere that, however, so listen well.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_001: I require pristine salamander oil to complete my perfume.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_002: Oil this pure can only be obtained from the belly of a gurangatch, a notoriously elusive species of wavekin native to Bronze Lake.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_003: Elusive, I say, yet no less sensible to the allure of the right bait. In this instance, that would be freshly slain mud pugils. Three placed at the water's edge should be sufficient to tempt any gurangatch lurking nearby.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_004: They are aggressive when startled, and will attack on sight. Yet given the ease with which you dispatched that goobbue, I doubt they will trouble you unduly.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Despite her years of nomadism, it would seem Lady F'lhaminn has kept a close eye on the affairs of our order. Surprisingly close, in fact. Suffice to say, she is nothing if not resourceful.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_ALPHINAUD_000_011: One does not develop such skills without effort─or without reason.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_020: Understand it is of the utmost importance that I finish this perfume before I accompany you to Vesper Bay. Please bring me the oil as soon as possible.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_021: Once again, I am in your debt.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_022:
I distilled the flowers' oils in your absence, so all that remains is to...
There. It is ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_023: And so am I. It is time we went to see my daughter.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_025: We've no reason to stay here. Why do you delay? I have kept my daughter waiting long enough.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_TATARU_100_032: (I haven't seen her like this in years, !)
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_033: I...I never truly believed it when they told me you were dead. But...what kept you away for so long?
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_034: The imperials came for me, as I always knew they would. And so I resolved to stay as far away from you as I could, lest their pursuit of me endanger you and our cause. I could think of no better way to grant you the freedom to continue our work.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_035: And continue it you did, achieving things I would not have imagined possible. I followed your every success, and celebrated in secret.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_036: I'm so proud of you, Ascilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_038: I have a gift for you.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_040: How could I ever forget? You wore it all the time. If ever I lost sight of you, I could find you again, just by following my nose.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_041: I did not think it was made anymore. You must have gone to so much trouble...
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_042: It was no trouble to me, my darling. I fear I cannot say the same for , however. I could not have made it without .
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_045: This...this is the cat's-eye I found! All these years you kept it...
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_046: My father was a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_047: When I was yet a child, he brought me here to Ul'dah. The accident which claimed his life happened shortly after our arrival.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_048: It was Lhaminn who took care of me then. She raised me as her own─taught me everything I needed to know to survive.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_ALPHINAUD_000_049: Hmm. I am no stranger to the facts of your history, yet I fear I have failed to grasp their implications. It is clear that there is much I do not know─about you and your mother both.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_050: One of her first lessons to me concerned mining─and I was a very dedicated student.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_051: This cat's-eye was the first stone I unearthed. It wasn't much, of course, but I was exceedingly proud to have found it nonetheless.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_052:
So I gave it to Lhaminn as a gift. She said it was beautiful...
But there I am at a loss. Why are you returning this to me? Is something amiss?
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_053: No, Ascilia, nothing is amiss! Quite the opposite! I need you to realize how far you've come, and how much further you may still─must still go.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_054: You and your allies have accomplished more than I could ever have hoped. You have succeeded where I failed, and made me so proud that...that words fail me.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_055: But even as I marvel at the woman you've become, and at all the many things you've done, I cannot help but think of that which you have yet to do, and of what it may entail. Ascilia...Daughter─you cannot stay here anymore. You and the Scions must leave Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_FLHAMINN_000_057: You built it once, Ascilia. You can build it again. And this time, we'll do it together.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_059: Alphinaud. The time has come for the Scions to leave Vesper Bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_060: We shall establish a new headquarters in Revenant's Toll, as you proposed.
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_MINFILIA_000_061: Much work lies ahead of us. Inform our fellow Scions, and send word to the Students of Baldesion: preparations begin at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE104_01178_POP_MESSAGE: Ripples in the water catch your eye...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_000: As ever, your enthusiasm is greatly appreciated.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_001: Our first step will be to secure the cooperation of the Adventurers' Guild representatives in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_002: Were it not for the guild's considerable efforts, the original Camp Revenant's Toll would have never been established, much less its more heavily fortified successor.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_003: However, with construction still ongoing, and resources in short supply, it seems certain that the guild will require something in return for their support, sympathetic to our cause though they may be.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_004: Whatever they ask, I shall not begrudge it. To be plain, we need them more than they need us. Without their assistance, such essential tasks as securing new facilities, cultivating relationships with local merchants, and recruiting adventurers would prove difficult, if not impossible.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_005: You need not concern yourself with such matters, Antecedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_006: Really, Alphinaud─if I need concern myself with anything, it is surely matters such as these.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Indirectly, perhaps. I submit that you might instead concern yourself with a different matter: namely, to whom the resolution of such matters might best be entrusted. And here I am! Nor do I come alone. May I present the esteemed emissary of the Adventurers' Guild at Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ADVEMISSARY_000_008: It is an honor, Antecedent. Upon receiving word of your intentions from Master Alphinaud, we thought it best to begin talks at the earliest available opportunity.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ADVEMISSARY_000_009: Know that my associates at Revenant's Toll hold the Scions of the Seventh Dawn in the highest regard. We should be honored to welcome your organization.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_010: There are, of course, certain provisions which must needs be negotiated. If it please you, I would do so.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ADVEMISSARY_000_012: , unless I am much mistaken, you are the one known as , are you not? May I say what a pleasure it is to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ADVEMISSARY_000_013: Slafborn spoke of you in the most glowing terms. To steal an imperial reaper and then use it to infiltrate a Garlean castrum is an undertaking few would contemplate─and fewer still survive.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ADVEMISSARY_000_014: You shall always be welcome at Revenant's Toll. We hope you will favor us with your presence again ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_015: Well, well! It would seem your reputation precedes you, ! Mayhap I should dispatch you to Revenant's Toll with all haste, as first intended...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_016: But there is something else I would ask of you first─not as a Scion, but as a friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_018: I have seen her behave this way before, and I know she will dismiss my concerns if I inquire. Despite our closeness, she has ever been unwilling to burden me with her problems.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_019: It may be that she will welcome your concern, however. She likes you, . And more importantly, you are not family. Do not bother with subterfuge─she will know I sent you─simply do what you can to help her. That is all I ask.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_030: Hmph. Have I become an open book, or has she acquired still greater powers of insight? I shall choose to believe the latter.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_031: If you must know, one of my earrings is damaged. I am not wont to sigh for such trifles, but...they were a gift.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_032: Here─you wish to help, yes? Then do what I cannot. Take them to the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah, and see if anything can be done.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_040: There are places to which one must never return. Grasping, insatiable places. They strip us of our wisdom, our worldliness─reduce us to our lesser selves...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_041: And leave us cold and shivering.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_050: Yes, what is it? Earrings, you say? Very well, let me see them...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_051: By the Twelve, I know this design! ...Humble cat's-eyes polished and set so exquisitely as to make the clearest of diamonds seem dour and dull...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_052: F'lhaminn's Aria! A-And if I am any judge of quality─crafted by Master Niellefresne himself!
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_053: ...Oh! Oh dear me... Ahaha! And I thought myself above sentiment. Look at my hands! They're shaking!
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_054: I require no payment, . To be entrusted with this duty is reward enough!
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_055: But since I must needs devote my full attention to the task at hand, mayhap you could attend to a small matter while I work?
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_056: I have an appointment to meet one of my suppliers─a fellow by the name of Odinel─at Byregot's Strike in southern Thanalan. He has prepared a shipment of ores for me, you see. If you would collect it in my stead, I should be most grateful.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_058: Breathe. Concentrate! Remember your training. It's just another piece. It's just...another...piece...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ODINEL_000_060: ...You came all this way on Memedesu's account? Well, bloody hells! Can't deny as I'm a bit surprised by that.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ODINEL_000_061: He's normally a right pain in the arse, see. Always comes to collect his goods in person, and then spends the gods know how long inspectin' 'em. It'd take somethin' serious to stop him. Hey, he's not on his deathbed, is he? ...No? Strange.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ODINEL_000_062: Here's his ore, anyway. We're square, right? Then give the man my regards.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_070: You've returned at the perfect time, friend! Ah, yes─may I have my ores?
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_071: Good, good. I shall sort through these later.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_072: Now─the Aria! Fortunately, only the clasp was damaged─the rest seemed remarkably well maintained. You may be sure that I took every possible precaution when replacing the broken section. Oh, and I also took the liberty of polishing the piece, as you can see.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MEMEDESU_000_073: No, no, I require no payment. Truth be told, I would happily have paid you for the privilege of laying hands on such a masterpiece. To have attended to its restoration may well be the defining achievement of my career thus far. My sincerest thanks.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_080: Well? Did you do as I bid you? Pray tell me your trip was not for naught.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_081: , I... Thank you. They sparkle as they did the day Nielle gave them to me.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_082: ...My Nielle, who sleeps even now─looking for all the world as if that cursed blade had taken his young life mere moments ago...not years. Ye gods, I could almost bear it if he were truly gone...but here he lingers.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_083: Can the soul be at peace while the flesh yet remains? Every day I pray that he has entered Thal's realm. I pray and I pray and I pray.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_084: To love is to lose, child. One can but postpone the moment of parting.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_085: And so I shall. My daughter will not lose me again─not for a long while yet, gods willing.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_FLHAMINN_000_086: Tell Ascilia that I am quite well, . She should concentrate on more important matters─and so should you.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_090: Ah, . Were you able to get some rest? I would ask you to come with me to the solar. Alphinaud has just returned, and it would seem there is something he would share with us.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_091: You're here. Good. I come bearing news.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_094: Our friends at the Adventurers' Guild have agreed to furnish us with new facilities and material support in exchange for our assistance in the ongoing defense and development of Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_095: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn shall have a new home in Mor Dhona: the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_YSHTOLA_000_096: A bittersweet victory, if truth be told. I cannot deny that I had come to look forward to Tataru's tales of our many guests and their many, many demands.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_THANCRED_000_097: From the Waking Sands to the Rising Stones... Passably poetic. That wasn't your doing, was it?
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_098: I too have news to share. In expectation of this momentous day, I personally informed the Alliance leaders of our plans, and they have each pledged their full support─General Raubahn included.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_099: Moreover, I have decided that the time is right for us to cast off the vestiges of our order's veil of secrecy and announce ourselves to the world.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Are you sure that is wise, Antecedent?
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_101: If anything, it is a mere formality. Our existence is quite possibly the worst kept secret in Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_102: Let us affirm our identity, proclaim our achievements, that all may know what the Scions of the Seventh Dawn stand for!
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_PAPALYMO_000_103: Well...obvious risks apart, it would be nice to receive a little more recognition...
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_YDA_000_104: And the people have a right to know who saved them!
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_105: It is my hope that this gesture will encourage the people of Eorzea to place their trust in us. I would reveal to them the true extent of our power, yes, but in so doing, I would show them that it is a power accountable to no one, and at once to all.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_106: ...And what of us? We who have felled primals and faced down the Empire. To you, my fellow Scions, I would say this: prepare for the challenges which lie ahead, for they will be great indeed.
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_MINFILIA_000_107: Great, I say, yet no greater than us. And we will rise to them, as we have time and again...united as one!
TEXT_GAIUSE105_01179_TATARU_000_108: Hmm... There must be some way I can─ Wait, that area is said to be rich in minerals. Maybe I should ask F'lhaminn to teach me the basics of mining too...
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_MINFILIA_000_000: Do you ever wonder how he does it? Alphinaud, I mean. It was almost predictable that he should appear with an emissary of the Adventurers' Guild mere moments after I had expressed the need to forge ties between our organizations. Truly, his sense of timing rivals even your own...
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_MINFILIA_000_001: Setting such mysteries aside for the present─I have two tasks for you.
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_MINFILIA_000_002: First, I would like you to deliver these documents to Slafborn. They concern our forthcoming move. Second─and this is the more onerous task─I would have you place yourself at his disposal, in accordance with the agreement between ourselves and the Adventurers' Guild. Represent us well, .
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_SLAFBORN_000_010: I was told to expect a Scion, but I didn't expect it to be you. It has been far too long, . You have something for me, yes?
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_SLAFBORN_000_011: Let's see, now... Yes, everything appears to be in order.
TEXT_GAIUSE106_01180_SLAFBORN_000_012: You'll be staying with us for a while, yes? Excellent. Would that we had a dozen more like you. Since we don't, though, we'll just give you the work of a dozen men. Heh! I jest, I jest... Well, you'll see soon enough.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_000: Well, now. In the nick you are, , again showing up just when you're needed.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_001: I'm waiting on a supply carriage from Gridania. It should've been here by now, even if they stopped a spell in Fallgourd Float to wet their whistles.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_002: The carriages always pass through the North Shroud. Here, stretch those  legs some, why don't you? Go and ask the Wood Wailers over in the Float if they've seen something.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_003: The supply route runs through the North Shroud. One of the Wood Wailers over in Fallgourd Float ought to know something.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERA_000_010: A supply carriage bound for Revenant's Toll? Hasn't come through here, I can tell you that.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERA_000_011: But...maybe it's the same one? We just received word of an Ixali attack on a carriage, you see.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERA_000_012: Seems like too much of a coincidence, but you never know.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERA_000_013: May as well have a look, eh? You'll find one of our men on the scene─the carriage was waylaid on the road just east of here.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERA_000_014: The carriage should still be stopped on the road east of here, if you want to poke around.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERB_000_020: Hell-o, what have we here? An adventurer, by the Twelve, and a suitably gaunt one!
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERB_000_021: As you can see, a few gentlemen of the road─er, gentlebirds if you must─ambushed this carriage. Took the cargo and both coachmen─how's that for a day's work?
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERB_000_022: The tracks lead to the Ixali logging grounds to the north. You look a hungry sort─how about it? Will you rescue the coachmen and recover those provisions?
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERB_000_023: Looks like the Ixal took their spoils to the logging grounds north of Eugenia's Spire. Someone needs to rescue the two captives and recover those provisions, if you take my meaning.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_WOODWAILERB_000_024: I knew you could save them! Well done!
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_ELEZENCOACHMAN_000_: Thank you for freeing me, stranger. I can manage alone from here on.
I shall await your safe return at the carriage. Twelve speed your way, adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_HYURCOACHMAN_000_03: Whew, I thought I was done for! These supply runs are getting a little too interesting for my tastes.
I'd best get out of here before the birdmen come back in force. Many thanks, and try not to get killed!
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_ELEZENCOACHMAN_000_: We are both in your debt, good adventurer. I shudder to think what fate the Ixal had in mind for us.
You seek the provisions meant for Revenant's Toll? It pains me to say, but this is all that remains.
The carriage is in no state to resume the journey, nor are the chocobos. We shall have to arrange another transport. Would you take word back to Guolgeim?
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_HYURCOACHMAN_000_04: I'd say it's time we all made haste, before someone else gets captured. Then where would we be? Our heads lopped off and lining the road, likely.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_ELEZENCOACHMAN_000_: With the carriage in this condition, we would not survive the journey to the Toll. What is more, the provisions you recovered were only a fraction of what we intended to deliver.
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_050: Attacked? By the Ixal!? Well, roll me in stardust and dash me from the sky!
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_051: Not that I ought to be s'prised, mind you. Gossip's fleet where adventurers sleep, and I've heard the talk of the primals waking. Beastmen won't let a sleeping primal lie, will they?
TEXT_GAIUSE107_01181_GUOLGEIM_000_052: But never mind that, you did well enough saving those two coachmen. I'd go put some meat on your bones with that reward─looking far too thin, you are.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_000: There is much work to be done right here in Revenant's Toll, and we hope you can help.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_001: The Toll grows and prospers─and attracts the jealous attention of Garleans and low creatures. We must see to our fortifications if we are not to be overrun.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_002: The perimeter wall is solid enough. What we lack is less perceptible─magical defenses that will repel our enemies, the sort scholars of antiquity say were powered by ancient wardstones.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_003: I am told there are many such stones in the ruins at Qarn─the Sunken Temple. More than a few temple raiders have been foiled by their magicks, no doubt.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_004: It seems a fine jest that we adventurers are now to be guarded by the same magic that protected the treasures of Qarn against our too-adroit fingers!
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_005: The temple is in southern Thanalan, as you may know. A lass by the name of Bibimu is the resident naturalist there. She will grant you entry, for she owes a favor or two to our guild.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_006: I've no doubt you'll come across a wardstone as you make your way through the ruins. Bear in mind that your success will serve to strengthen relations between the Adventurers' Guild and the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_007: In southern Thanalan lies the Sunken Temple of Qarn. Speak to the scholar Bibimu to enter the place.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_008: Penetrate the mysteries of the ruins and the wardstone will be yours. Think of the protection that Revenant's Toll will gain...and of the agreement which must be fulfilled.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_BIBIMU_000_020: Behold the magnificent ruin of the Sunken Temple of Qarn! We know it was used by the Belah'dians for the greater glory of Azeyma the sun goddess... As for the rest of it, you'll hear that when I'm good and ready to publish.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_BIBIMU_000_021: Oh, you're the adventurer that Slafborn sent word about?
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_BIBIMU_000_022: Yes, no doubt there are wardstones to be had deep inside the ruins.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_BIBIMU_000_023: I regret to remind you, however, that this temple has been the death of many an adventurer─Slafborn wasn't too specific about that, was he? These ruins are practically the antechamber to Thal's workroom. But do not let me deter you from your task! If you wish to proceed, be my guest.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SYSTEM_000_025: You must complete the Sunken Temple of Qarn to proceed. Please note that completion of the Sunken Temple of Qarn (Hard) will not affect your progress in this quest.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_030: You'll have to explore the Sunken Temple of Qarn if you're to find a wardstone. Succeed, and you earn the undying gratitude of the Adventurers' Guild. Fail...and Thal will reward you in the next life.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_040:
You found a wardstone? Incredible! Ahhh, can you not feel the power that emanates from this humble stone?
...Eh? Not really?
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_041: Ha! Just like , practical to a fault! Let me tell you, there is more true magic than you credit in taking all possible precautions.
TEXT_GAIUSE108_01182_SLAFBORN_000_042: One thing's for certain: that temple managed to stymie more explorers than ordinary dangers can account for. If any of that can be attributed to this stone, then it's Garleans and beastmen who'll have to settle their accounts with the gods!
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_000: Ah, ! It is most welcome to see you again.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_001: Look at the hustle and bustle of adventurers, where there were but rocks not long ago! As one of those who has been here since the beginning, I am humbled by the sight.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_002: Yet none of us can be full glad, for the Garlean forces nearby like not our bustle at all, and our hustle even less. They seek to move on us soon, we are all but certain.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_003: This is no idle speculation, . Three steel-bound crates of the familiar type were delivered to Castrum Centri not two days ago.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_004: The contents are no doubt arms. To defend the land they hold? To take what we hold? Neither is a particularly attractive prospect, you must admit.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_005: I propose a third outcome that is less like to claim lives, if you would aid me─destroy the crates and their contents now.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_006: Use these explosives I had rushed from the Alchemists' Guild. They will do the job, rest assured.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_007: Who better to make this attempt than you, who once walked undetected into Castrum Centri? Twelve speed your way,  adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_008: Please, you must destroy the crates being stored in Castrum Centri, before it's too late.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_009: Those explosives should be more than sufficient for the task. Each one contains twenty-four onzes of firesand and will detonate on impact.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_020: We could hear the explosions─I knew you would make a success of it!
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_021: This should draw the Garleans' sting for a while─but not for too long. We must be vigilant, for─
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_022: ...How ever did I afford such quality munitions, you ask? Oh, , you needn't concern yourself with such trivial details.
TEXT_GAIUSE109_01183_SARKMALARK_000_023: Nevertheless, your stealth and compassion are appreciated in equal measure! I am a lucky man indeed to be a part of this fellowship─adventurers, one and all!
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_000: What to do, what to do... Ah, . Mayhap you can cut through this knot of ours.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_001: Revenant's Toll grows yet does not prosper. We draw adventurers from far and wide─or rather, the Allagan ruins draw them.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_002: So busy are they collecting tomestones and relics that they've no time for calls from the Adventurers' Guild. I fear that many who come to the Toll have no sense that we are a guild!
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_003: You visit Rowena's establishment, do you not? That's the kind of bustle and camaraderie I'd like to see at the guild!
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_004: Now, tales of your derring-do are certainly known to all. You're the genuine article, and I'd ask humbly for you to render some service to us in this matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_005: Might you join a guildhest, and show others the glory and the honor of these undertakings?
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_006: The Ul'dahn Adventurers' Guild is currently seeking valiant volunteers to rescue a noble's gil turtle, and you are the  to inspire others to join in this hest.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_007: ...You have joined a guildhest before, yes? If not, you must seek out one of the battlewardens stationed in Bentbranch Meadows, Horizon, or Swiftperch. They will guide you through the process.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_008: At present, the Ul'dahn Adventurers' Guild is seeking volunteers to rescue a noble's gil turtle. What it would do for our organization to have someone of your standing participate!
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_009: In the highly unlikely event that you have never undertaken a guildhest until now, you must travel to either Bentbranch Meadows, Horizon, or Swiftperch and speak with the battlewarden stationed there. It is their duty to assist the uninitiated.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_020: Ahhh, ! The Adventurers' Guild has marked the completion of this guildhest, and honors your service.
TEXT_GAIUSE110_01184_SLAFBORN_000_021: Already, the Toll buzzes with talk of the hest and the impromptu fellowship born of it. Not a few adventurers have chosen to join one themselves! Know that the Scions will hear of your success.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_000: Ah, I forgot to mention before─I received word from the guild that they've seen more adventurers join hests in the last few days than in the past moon.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_001: Heh, but of course one good turn leads to another...we hope. There's a hest that might be too much for those who have expressed an interest. Your presence could mean the difference between life and death.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_002: There's a morbol─ Now, don't you roll your eyes, I've smelled my share of them too! As I was saying─there's a morbol making a nuisance of itself that needs getting rid of. Not that I've no faith in the other volunteers, but I suspect few of them have felt the lash of a morbol's feelers before.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_003: Ignominy isn't something we can afford at the present. We have appearances to keep up if we are to maintain our growth, after all. A seasoned adventurer like you ought to know that a bad reputation's like bad breath: no one will ever speak frankly of what ails you.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_004: You're to complete a mission at the guild's behest. If anybody can handle a cross morbol and its raw helpers, it's you.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_005: Not the most pleasant hest, I'll warrant, but with your prowess, Toxic Tamlyn is likely to meet his demise without lashing the hide off some youngster first. Think what you'll do for other adventurers...and for the Scions' relationship with the guild.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_020: You return, and smelling as sweetly, I rejoice to remark.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_021: Your reputation precedes you yet again─the Seventh Heaven is abuzz with talk of your deeds. We've already signed up a score or more for new guildhests.
TEXT_GAIUSE111_01185_SLAFBORN_000_022: Revenant's Toll grows and prospers, to the benefit of the guild and the Scions. Did I not tell you there is much magic in being prepared?
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SLAFBORN_000_000: I can't tell you how grateful we all are to have you here─now more than ever. We have a major crisis on our hands, you see─one which will demand your full attention for weeks if not months. I'm sorry, . If you've made any other plans, you'll just have to cancel them.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SLAFBORN_000_001: ...Heh heh! You honestly believed me, didn't you? There's such a thing as being too long-suffering, you know? I fear we may have overdone it with the errands, necessary though they were.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SLAFBORN_000_002: Anyway, your work here is done─for the time being, at least. Master Alphinaud has sent word that you are to report to him at the Waking Sands. I gather he wants to know how you've been getting on. Be sure to tell him how welcome we've made you feel, won't you?
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_SLAFBORN_000_003: As much as I would like to impose upon you further, Alphinaud was insistent that you return to Vesper Bay at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Ah, ─you've returned. I trust they kept you busy in Revenant's Toll?
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_ALPHINAUD_000_011: We have had nary a moment's rest since you departed. Despite our best efforts, however, we've begun to fall behind.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_ALPHINAUD_000_012: No matter. We shall soon make up the lost ground with you here to help us. Now, there are a number of packages which must needs be delivered to Revenant's Toll as a matter of urgency.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Don't give me that long-suffering look─I only require you to take them upstairs to Tataru. She will handle the rest. The packages are scattered about the halls, but each is clearly labeled, so you should have little trouble finding them. Now, if you will excuse me... Hm? Your report? Later, later...
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Of course I wish to hear your report, but you've caught me at an inopportune moment. I daresay I will have some time to talk when you have finished your little errand.
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_TATARU_000_020: Uwaaah! So much to do, so much to do! At this rate, we'll never get to Revenant's Toll!
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_TATARU_000_030: Bless your heart, I had completely forgotten about those!
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_TATARU_000_031: Let me check the labels against my list... Oh, these are the last ones! Thank the Twelve, it's almost─
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_TATARU_000_032: Oh dear, I did contact the courier, didn't I? Um...
TEXT_GAIUSE112_01186_TATARU_000_033: Ah! It just so happens that I had been meaning to contact you, ! I've an important personal request, you see, which I couldn't possibly entrust to anyone else.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_000: Preparing for the move is taking a terrible toll on everyone's mental and physical well-being. People have been carrying on for days at a time with barely any food or drink, never mind rest. Some have been too busy to visit the privy, for gods' sakes!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_001: I try to lift their spirits, but encouraging words simply aren't enough anymore.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_002: Given that nothing short of hitting them over the head with something heavy will persuade them to rest, my only remaining option is to try improving their diet. I know just how to do it, too: with a special tonic proven to revive flagging spirits.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_003: But for that, I require highland tea leaves─and the one merchant I know who sells them is completely out of stock. Harvesting them myself isn't an option, either, as the plant only grows in Coerthas, and I'm in no position to leave the Waking Sands at present.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_004: But you are, ─and since you now understand how important this is, you'll surely agree to assist me? Great! I'll take that silence as a yes.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_005: I learned the recipe from an Ishgardian acquaintance of mine who serves at Camp Dragonhead. Medguistl's her name. She'll know where to obtain highland tea leaves, I'm sure of it. Godsspeed!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_006: Highland tea leaves don't seem to be a very popular commodity outside of Coerthas, so I doubt you'll find them for sale in these parts. Nevertheless, they are an essential ingredient of this tonic.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_007: It was my friend Medguistl who gave me the recipe, so she must surely know where the tea leaves can be obtained. Please, hurry to Camp Dragonhead and ask her. You know how important this is!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_MEDGUISTL_000_010: Now there's a face I shan't soon forget, not after all the chaos you left in your wake. 'Twas for the best, of course, but still...
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_MEDGUISTL_000_011: Tataru sent you in search of highland tea leaves? Ah. Had you come but a few bells sooner, I'd have given you my remaining supply. Alas, you did not, and now I have none.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_MEDGUISTL_000_012: Where did I acquire my stock? Emanuel, where else? He sells more than wines and spirits, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_EMANUEL_000_020: As ever, it is a pleasure to serve such an esteemed personage as yourself. Alas, I cannot furnish you with that which I do not have.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_EMANUEL_000_021: I know not when my next shipment will arrive, but I fear it will not be soon. Assuming you cannot afford to wait, might I humbly suggest that you consider harvesting the leaves yourself? If you travel to Boulder Downs and scour the riverbanks, you should have no trouble finding the plants.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_EMANUEL_000_022: The real challenge will be keeping the local fauna at bay while you set about picking the tea.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_EMANUEL_000_023: But what are mere beasts to the brave adventurer who fought at Lord Haurchefant's side!?
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_EMANUEL_000_024: As I believe I mentioned, I cannot say with any certainty when my next shipment of highland tea leaves will arrive. Rather than resign yourself to what may prove to be a lengthy wait, you might consider visiting Boulder Downs and harvesting the leaves yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_030: I'm at my wit's end, ! This tonic is the Scions' only hope! Without it, I don't know what will become of us! Please─you have to find those leaves!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_040: You brought them! You really brought them! Thank you so much!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_041: There's no time to waste─I shall begin brewing without delay!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_042:
A dollop of honey, a fresh sprig of mint,♪
Aloe extract, just so...♪
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_043:
A tincture of tea, but no more than a hint,♪
To buoy my beloved beau...♪
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_044:
Nix eyes and flan flesh ground to a paste,♪
Fresh ogre offal for─
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_045: <gasp> ...The NEWS! Uwaaah! I knew there was something I'd forgotten to mention!
TEXT_GAIUSE113_01187_TATARU_000_046: Ill tidings, ! As ill as ill can be! Another crisis in the making!
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_TATARU_000_000: A messenger from the Twin Adder came to the Waking Sands while you were in Coerthas. I wasn't privy to his conversation with the Antecedent, but I did see the look on her face after he took his leave. Something is definitely amiss.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_TATARU_000_001: Could it be that the Ixal have summoned Garuda again!? Or mayhap imperial forces have been sighted within the Shroud!
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_TATARU_000_002: Well, whatever it may be, I'm absolutely certain it's nothing you can't handle. Now go and ask the Antecedent if there's anything you can do!
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_TATARU_000_003: Pray do not tarry, ! The Antecedent needs you!
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_010: I knew this day would come, yet I prayed it would not come so soon.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_011: We have reason to believe that another primal─or an entity resembling one─has been summoned in Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_URIANGER_000_012: Thine arrival is customarily timely, . The aetheric waves leave little room for doubt; thy talents will be needed ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_URIANGER_000_013: If there be truth in my suspicions, 'tis a familiar foe we face, though one quite unlike the Lady of the Vortex...
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_014: We dare not draw conclusions without evidence, but as Urianger says, the readings bear a strong resemblance to ones observed more than five years ago.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_015: <sigh> Though I had hoped the Mogglesguard beyond such follies...
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_016: Suffice it to say, this disturbance warrants a full investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_URIANGER_000_017: Thy presence hath been requested by Commander Heuloix. He awaiteth thee at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_018: Pray hasten to Gridania, . Yda and Papalymo will rendezvous with you there. May you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_MINFILIA_000_019: We cannot ignore this aetheric disturbance, . Journey to Gridania and speak with Commander Heuloix of the Twin Adder. Yda and Papalymo will rendezvous with you anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_VORSAILE_000_020: A pleasure to see you as always, .
TEXT_GAIUSE114_01188_VORSAILE_000_021: I could think of no one more qualified to─ Ah, but we're getting ahead of ourselves. Allow me to explain...
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_000: Let us set aside the matter of this Ascian until after we have completed our move to the Rising Stones. There is but one final favor I would ask of you before I depart.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_001: I believe I mentioned before that my father was a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance. The truth, however, is more complicated than that.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_002: As far as the Empire knew, he was their spy. He maintained the deception for nigh on half a decade, furnishing the Resistance with vital imperial secrets while feeding his paymasters subtly conceived misinformation.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_003: When he died some fifteen years ago, my father left behind his journal, which I have closely guarded ever since. It contains every shred of information he and his agents could steal on what they believed to be the single greatest threat to Eorzea: the primals.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_004: Its wisdom has guided me through the years, though there is much within I still do not understand...
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_005: It is my hope that Urianger will fare better.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_006: Tell him to treat it with care. It is all I have left of my father.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_007: Please, before I reconsider, give my father's journal to Urianger.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_010: I thought thee departed. To what end dost thou linger?
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_011: The father's final bequest...the daughter's lifelong labor.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_012: It is no small thing to surrender such a cherished memento. Well can I imagine the Antecedent's pain. Upon mine honor, I swear to spare no effort in the study of these materials, lest my lady's sacrifice be in vain.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_021: Forgive me, but I could wait no longer─I have departed for the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_023: ...Once you have given the journal to Urianger, I bid you come to the Seventh Heaven in Revenant's Toll. Tataru will be there to show you inside our new headquarters.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_024: Assuming you have already attuned to it, you may wish to make use of our new aetheryte in Revenant's Toll. After all, it is right on our doorstep!
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_025: Thou hast been summoned to the Rising Stones, yes? Then keep not thy fellows waiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_TATARU_000_030: Welcome, ! Welcome! This is your first time here, if I'm not mistaken?
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_TATARU_000_031: I think you're going to like our new home! ...Well, what are you waiting for? Go in and have a look!
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_TATARU_000_032: You're the last to arrive; everyone else is already here.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_TATARU_000_033: Why are you standing around here talking to me? They're waiting for you inside!
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_041: Today marks a new beginning for the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, for today we declare our independence.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_ALPHINAUD_000_042: We shall henceforth be beholden to no nation, but serve all of Eorzea's people, proudly and openly.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_ALPHINAUD_000_043: But this does not mean that we will sever our ties to the Eorzean Alliance. On the contrary, the Antecedent and I shall endeavor to strengthen them. Rest assured, however, that we shall not permit political considerations to influence our decisions.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_044: Our identity remains unchanged, as does our cause. We are the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, and our single purpose is to safeguard the future of Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_046: A moment of your time, . I would speak of Elidibus─
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_047: Pardon the intrusion, my lady, but the matter which bringeth me will admit no delay. Mine every attempt to contact the Students of Baldesion hath been met with silence.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_049: How odd. Allow me to try.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_050: ...No response. Surely they would not ignore us?
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_051: They have never yet, my lady. I fear we must assume the worst.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_052: No. No, I will not believe it. An outpost, perhaps, but not their headquarters.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_053: Their wards are beyond circumvention. Had they come under attack, they would most certainly have raised the alarm. None could penetrate their sanctum unnoticed─
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_054: But for those who lack the gift and the knowledge both. Oh no...
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_055: Contact their agents in the field at once. If aught has befallen the Students of Baldesion, they may know of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_056: ...Though the thought of it pains me, until such time as we have evidence to the contrary, we can but assume the worst. Accordingly, we must needs seek another source of information on Elidibus.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_URIANGER_000_057: 'Tis possible that others in the homeland are possessed of such knowledge. Be fairly warned, however: they are unlike to yield it unconditionally.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_059: Yet another unforeseen and unwelcome development...
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_060: What could be next, I wonder? A visit from a crimson-clad Ascian, perhaps? Or ocher? Or puce? And which of our allies will then fall silent...?
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_061: ...For a time, I thought we had gained the upper hand.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_062: When you shattered the Crystal of Darkness and cast out Lahabrea, I dared to hope that we had found a way to rid ourselves of the Ascian menace.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_063: But I was wrong. He endures, and may yet return. Upon that point, I have no doubt that Elidibus spoke true.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_064: Yet there must be a way to destroy them utterly─a way to spare this world their unholy machinations!
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_065: I dare not consider the alternative...
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_066: There are forces at work we do not understand, .
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_067: I discern them all around─in disturbances too great and too numerous to be dismissed as mere coincidence. Doubtless the Paragons are involved, but how and to what end is far from clear.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_068: I know not what will come, but I do know that we will rise and meet it as one.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_069: Ah, my stalwart hero... Your face is a picture of resolve.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_MINFILIA_000_070: I know that you will be ready when the time comes. With luck, however, that will not be for a while yet. Pray return to your private affairs with my blessing. Should anything arise, you will be informed.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_NABRIALESEORZEA_000: We question. Our plans are in motion, your intentions unclear.
TEXT_GAIUSE119_01193_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-Elidibus-)They survived the Seventh Ardor and are stronger now in the gift. Does that not intrigue you?
(-Elidibus-)Serve as you will. So too shall I. We labor not at cross purposes.
(-Elidibus-)The wisdom of His plan shall become apparent in time, when the veil is lifted from their eyes...
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_NERO_000_000: Do I know you? ...Ah! Unless I am very much mistaken, you are the famed adventurer who bested the Garlean Empire's general, are you not? The great  ! Amazing─and more than a little serendipitous. One might even call it fate. I but recently received word of a truly unique opportunity, you see─an opportunity the like of which none but one of your proven worth could take advantage.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_NERO_000_001: The reward? Naught less than the accumulated knowledge of a fallen civilization. The risk? A single misstep could cost you your life. But what is a little danger to a storied hero such as you?
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_NERO_000_002: A  with absolute confidence in  own abilities stands to profit handsomely from this venture. No, no, I crave no recompense for my part in bringing this opportunity to your attention─the historic discoveries you shall make will be reward enough, I assure you.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_NERO_000_003: If my words have fanned the flames of your curiosity, then I bid you seek a man by the name of Rammbroes at Saint Coinach's Find. It is he who stands at the doorway to untold marvels, awaiting the arrival of a champion bold enough to march across the threshold.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_NERO_000_004: It is Saint Coinach's Find to which you must travel. Seek out the man known as Rammbroes, and learn what treasures─and dangers─await you.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_010: Why, if it isn't  ! I was not expecting such a celebrated guest. To what do I owe the honor of this visit?
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_011: You were directed here, you say? By a man clad in foreign garb? Well, the opportunity he spoke of must surely refer to our latest anthropogeographical endeavor. Quite how he came to know of it is another matter. All knowledge of this project was supposed to be restricted to my organization...
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_100_011: ...But that is something for me to ponder in private. You are here now, and your services will, I am certain, prove invaluable. I must warn you, however, that the venture we have in mind is no simple excavation─an unprepared or incautious adventurer could very well find  on an unplanned and unpleasant journey to Thal's solemn halls. Knowing this, do you still wish to lend us your cooperation?
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_012: I rather thought you would say that. Your courage is scarcely a secret.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_014: What brings you to Saint Coinach's? Don't tell me─the Alliance has sent you on another realm-shaking, history-making mission to lay low an apparently insuperable foe, yes? No?
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_015: Ah, I see you two are already acquainted. That is well. Master Garlond, our intrepid hero here caught wind of the forthcoming expedition, and has kindly pledged to assist us.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_016: has, has ? Glad to have you aboard, ! You...don't have the faintest idea what you've volunteered for, do you? Very well, let us begin at the beginning.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_017: The Sons of Saint Coinach are tasked with unearthing the secrets of the long-fallen Allagan Empire, and this present endeavor aims to delve more deeply into the civilization's mysteries than ever before.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_018: ...Ah, but I know that look. In the event that you feel ill equipped to contribute much on the subject of Allagan archaeology, I invite you to recall your encounter with the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_019: That mechanical monstrosity represented a feat of engineering far beyond aught Garlemald can presently achieve─Nero tol Scaeva simply awoke it. I mention this by way of a reminder that you have had what one might term...extensive firsthand experience with a notable Allagan relic. In short, you're practically an archaeologist.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_020: Now, to the core of the matter: here in Mor Dhona, there stands an entire Allagan structure which we have yet to investigate. I speak, of course, of the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_021: After witnessing the destructive capabilities of the Ultima Weapon, and the lesser moon, Dalamud, before it, it seems wise to treat any remnants from that era with the utmost caution. They must be analyzed, monitored, and─above all─kept from falling into the wrong hands.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_100_021: To put it plain: I have no wish to see another megalomaniacal legatus wield one of those weapons. It was this thought which first moved me to contact the Sons and propose that the tower be explored.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_100_022: For several millennia, the Crystal Tower remained hidden, buried deep underground. But, like so many other things that were better left undisturbed, the structure was freed from its stony prison by the great upheaval which accompanied the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era. It now stands revealed in all its splendor, a gleaming spear of crystal, pointed at the bosom of the heavens.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_100_023: We believe the tower to be the repository of much of the ancients' wisdom. Unfortunately, its entrance is guarded by formidable defenses, and we cannot so much as peep through the keyhole, much less set foot inside.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_101_023: These defenses take the form of statues, carved into the likeness of giant swordsmen. “The Eight Sentinels,” as the Sons are wont to call them, is the first barrier we must overcome.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_102_023: Why not simply fly over them in an airship, you ask? It's been tried before: any vessel that ventures too close to the tower is blasted out of the air. We either destroy those statues, or the front door is forever beyond our reach.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_024: My colleagues and I are ill-suited to negotiating such deadly hazards. Thus, if we are to gain access to the tower's secrets, we must needs employ the services of an experienced adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_100_024: It will be difficult and dangerous, , but I can think of no finer  for the task.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_CID_000_025: If I didn't know better, I'd say you had a taste for these deadly escapades! I look forward to working with you again.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_026: There is much and more to be done before we can begin the expedition proper. Take some time to prepare yourself, and I shall explain the challenges that lie ahead...
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_030: Our first objective is to reach the entrance to the Crystal Tower. As I previously mentioned, however, that will prove no easy task.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_031: The entrance is guarded by powerful defense mechanisms, each utilizing one of the four elements of fire, water, wind, or earth. Anyone attempting to simply stroll past these unsleeping sentinels invites swift obliteration.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_032: Based on Master Garlond's analyses, however, we are reasonably certain that the attacks of these lethal contraptions can be reflected using a crystal of the corresponding element.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_033: Naturally, these crystals must be of surpassing clarity, free of the slightest impurities─much like the flawless specimens used by the beastmen in their primal-summoning rituals.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_034: Ahem. Mayhap I should have said “exactly like” the specimens they use... <sigh> Were there any other way, we would not ask this of you, but we need someone to enter the beast tribe strongholds and “liberate” their perfect crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_035: For the moment, I would have you focus on obtaining two of the four crystals we require. Pray make for La Noscea, where both the Sapsa Spawning Grounds and U'Ghamaro Mines are located.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_036: You may be certain that the materials used in the beastmen's sacred rituals will be well defended. As such, I suggest you join or organize an orchestrated strike with the express purpose of defeating the crystals' guardians. Whatever you do, please be careful!
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_040: How progress your efforts in infiltrating the beastman strongholds?
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_041: So these are the famed flawless crystals of the beast tribes... I have seen countless specimens from I know not how many excavations, but nothing to compare to these. Their purity is...astounding.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_042: You have done well, . With these in our possession, we lack only the crystals of fire and wind. The former lies in Zahar'ak, the war camp of the Amalj'aa in Thanalan; the latter, in Natalan, the roost of the Ixal in the hills of Coerthas. Claim them for us.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_043: As before, your best course will be to take part in a coordinated attack against the defenders of the crystal caches. I look forward to receiving word of your resounding success!
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_050: ! It is good to see you. Tell me, were you able to obtain the remaining crystals from the beastmen?
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_051: Wonderful! With all four crystals in hand, we are now ready to proceed to the next stage of our preparations.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_052: Ah. I hope I did not give the impression that we would be embarking on our journey to the Crystal Tower just yet. Alas, there is another step which must be completed ere we come to that. While the crystals you acquired are indeed flawless, they are of little use to us in their present form. If they are to reflect the elemental forces of the tower's defenses, they must needs be cut and polished.
TEXT_GAIUSD201_01199_RAMMBROES_000_053: ...A process which calls for a very particular set of materials. Procuring them will be a challenge in itself, I fear. Needless to say, we will be requiring your services once again...
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_KHLOEBAJHIRI_000_00: ! A moment of your time, if you please. I'm Khloe Bajhiri of The Raven: every Gridanian's favorite source─well, their only source, but that's neither here nor there─for the latest tidings from the Twelveswood.
And you, my adventuring friend, are precisely the  I've been looking for to assist me in investigating a scoop of─quite literally─earth-shaking proportions.

Mayhap you have observed some alarming atmospheric phenomena of late? Searing flames raining down from the heavens, blizzards burying mighty oaks in snow and ice, cyclones so fierce as to whisk a pack of goobbues clear off their feet...
Why, those that have borne witness and returned to tell the tale talk as if another Calamity is upon us.

Most ominously of all, one witness─a proper half-wit, but I've long since learned not to discount any of my sources─swears to have sighted a towering black demoness at the eye of the storm. He said the bellowing laugh of the “She-Devil”─that's what he called the thing─haunts his dreams ever since.

Commander Heuloix, in all his stubbornness, insists that this is all merely a Garlean diversion, but I cannot agree. No, my nose for news tells me that something─or someone─far more sinister is afoot. Something...not of this world.

Why, I'm so certain of this that I've already begun thinking up suitable headlines. “Extradimensional Devastation Portends Eorzea's Ruination!”, “Preternatural Sorcery Wreaking Havoc─Will Our Realm Avert a Fate Most Tragic?”
I am not wont to employ rhyme in my articles, but the unprecedented nature of this story stirs in me a flair for the dramatic.

I have compiled eyewitness reports from all across Eorzea─here, I shall jot them down in your journal so you might have an idea of where to begin your search. I implore you, adventurer: find some proof that the disasters are of otherworldly origin, present it to Commander Heuloix for a proper analysis, and return here with a scoop worthy to grace The Raven's front page.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_010: An otherworldly force of destruction? <sigh> I can tell you only what I have told the others. Without proof that this is more than just an imperial diversion, I will not risk the lives of my men chasing after shadows.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_011: What have we here? 'Twould appear to be some kind of doll. You retrieved this after felling a towering she-devil at the eye of that sorcerous storm?
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_012: I have not seen its like before, and yet I am quite confident in saying this is not of Garlean make. Perhaps I was too hasty to dismiss that reporter's presumptions...
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_024: (-???-)Caught unawares by my stunning arrival? Such heedlessness is ill conducive to your continued survival.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_025: (-???-)Certainly a guest of my repute deserves a more befitting salute?
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_026:
(-???-)I expect to see more than mouths agape, if my wrath you wish to escape.
As a matter of foremost urgency, you might begin by groveling for mercy.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_027: Vorsaile Heuloix of the Order of the Twin Adder does not grovel. And now that I have given you a proper introduction, I daresay you owe us the same courtesy.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_028: (-???-)Owe? What a funny man. Do you not see your fate rests in the palm of my hand?
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_029: (-???-)But I shall overlook your insolence, if only this once. After all, I suppose you can't help being a dunce.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_030: Stay your hand. I am not enamored of our visitor's arrogance, yet I would hear her out.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_031:
Your judgment is quite wise─you may yet stave off an untimely demise.
Now heed me well, lest you come to woe─you stand before the illustrious Shantotto!
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_032: The Federation of Windurst in Vana'diel is my demesne, where I preside as supreme mistress of all matters arcane.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_033: Lofty words. And yet both your name and your homeland are unfamiliar to me. Pray tell, what brings you to Gridania?
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_034: A full answer would cause your meager minds to unravel. Let us just say that my powers allow for interdimensional travel.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_035: Sadly, I had to seal away this most marvelous spell, for reasons upon which I'd rather not dwell.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_036:
Anyhow, I recently revisited the incantation, for the purpose of making some ameliorations.
You know how the saying goes: the mind of a genius is never at repose.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SERPENTOIC_000_038: C-Commander... I cannot begin to comprehend what our visitor is trying to convey.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_039: In all honesty, I am not faring much better. 'Twould appear the gist is that her powers are not to be trifled with.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_040:
Why, that's the most astute observation you've made all day. I suggest you quit while things are going your way.
Anyhow, testing the spell, I found myself by chance in your land─and quickly observed that things have gotten out of hand.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_041:
Beast tribes run amok, imperial plotting─the very core of your...Eorzea?...is rotting.
Fortunately, I was at once inspired, with a plan to deliver you from the fate in which you are mired.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_042: Raze your realm to the ground, leaving nary a shred, then erect an empire of my own in its stead. Yes, the only way to save this dimension...is to bring about a true Shantotto ascension! My golem was assessing the feasibility of this plan, until it came to a grinding halt at this adventurer's hand.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_043:
Fortunately for you, I can forgive and forget. Besides, you've afforded me data that may prove useful yet.
In return for your─albeit unwitting─aid, I'd offer you this creation of mine in trade. But be warned...
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_044: Should you fail to treat her right, I shall set your pants alight!
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SERPENTOIC_000_045: C-Commander! I daresay this vile witch poses a greater threat to our realm than the beast tribes and the Garleans combined...
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_046: ...But I've dallied long enough in this dimension. Matters of actual import demand my attention.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_047: Fear not─should your realm remain in disarray, the esteemed Shantotto shall return to rescue the day.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SHANTOTTO_000_048: Meanwhile, worry not about my wayward creation. In its current state, it could at best overthrow a single nation!
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_SERPENTOIC_000_050: Commander! Should we not pursue her?
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_051: And how do you propose we do that? No, it is clear that this...Shantotto...is a singular force of destruction the likes of which we cannot hope to contain.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_052: Better that she depart of her own volition, lest that appalling plot of hers come to fru─er, pass.
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_KHLOEBAJHIRI_000_05: Who-the what-the where-the why-now? Someone tell me I haven't been sitting on my arse deaf and dumbfounded as the scoop of a lifetime came and went before my eyes!
TEXT_FESEVN001_01287_VORSAILE_000_054: In any event, you've done a great deed for us in getting to the bottom of this mess, . It would seem we've not seen the last of Shantotto's crazed creation, but I trust you will see that it brings no further harm to our realm.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_000: I am Havak Alvak, a self-styled student of sundry subjects. Though I am best known, perhaps, for putting pen to parchment for a popular paper, the Mythril Eye.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_001: In these times of trials and tribulations, a subject of singular strangeness has ensnared my senses─magical monstrosities, more commonly known as “golems.”
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_002: But I speak now of no common creation of magecraft. No, these shambling servants of stone have no equivalent in all of Eorzea.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_003: Should these curious constructions contain ores of extraordinary origin...well, I can only imagine the influence it might exert over Ul'dah's economy.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_004: Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern has come to a congruent conclusion, and its superiors seek a savvy adventurer to separate the facts from the fantastic.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_005: A representative of Amajina & Sons awaits outside Arrzaneth Ossuary. If exploring this enigma seems an entertaining endeavor, then I would wander over before this window of opportunity is wasted!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_010: Hey! Don't sneak up on me like that! Are ye tryin' to make me soil me breeches!?
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_011: Hm? Yer here for the job, are ye? Well, I hope ye've experience dismantlin' golems.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_012: We've been gatherin' reports o' some never-afore-seen constructs what've begun showin' up all over the damn realm.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_013: Nary a soul knows what the creatures are made of, so Amajina & Sons means to be the first to take a pickaxe to this mystery mother lode!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_014: I need ye to get out there, take apart one o' them shamblin' piles o' bricks, an' bring me back a good size chunk o' the remainin' rubble. What do ye say, eh? Will ye give it a shot?
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_016: No!? Surely, ye can't pass up this once-in-a-lifetime chance!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_017: Good ! I'll have a nice “refreshing” reward for ye when ye get back!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_020: Have ye taken a sample of one o' them odd golems?
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_021: Ooh, now ain't that special! That luster... That shine...
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_022: Can ye smell it? 'Tis the scent o' profit, my friend!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_023: That's some fine work ye did, adventurer. Very fine, indeed.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_024: Now, just as I promised ye, I've prepared a payment yer sure to enjoy!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_030: Don't be shy now, . We all need a bit o' pamperin' from time to time!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_PAFUPAFUA_000_032: Can we interest you in ze...'ow can I say? Puff-puff?
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_PAFUPAFUB_000_033: Zis way! We show you a good time!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_PAFUPAFUA_000_037: You will 'ave twice ze fun with ze eyes closed!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_PAFUPAFUA_000_040: (-Associate-)'Ave you ever felt anything so warm and soft? Just relax and enjoy.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_PAFUPAFUC_000_042: Feels good, doesn't it? We sometimes indulge in a bit of ze puff-puff ourselves!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_043: Me thanks again for yer cooperation, . Here's a little somethin' extra what ain't so...fleetin'.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_RESEARCHER_000_044: Au revoir! Er, I mean... <cough> 'Twas good meetin' ye. Look forward to doin' business with ye again sometime!
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_045: Ah, the adventurer! You were triumphant in your tussle against the towering titans, I trust?
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_046: As it so happens, I have been hired by Amajina & Sons to craft an account of the aforementioned anomaly. I'd best begin before the focus on these fantastical foes falls out of fashion.
TEXT_FESDXQ001_01288_HAVAKALVAK_000_047: My remuneration is promised to be most “refreshing” and perhaps a touch “risqué.” I fear I haven't an inkling as to what is implied, but I shall look forward to it, nonetheless!
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_DAMARIS_000_000: You would know more about Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre? An adventurer with some culture, I see! This, my dear , is where we celebrate Heavensturn.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_DAMARIS_000_001: All is change in this world, and not even the influence of the Twelve remains constant. Who will wax to gain the ascendant position over the other eleven? We shall learn the answer at Heavensturn.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_DAMARIS_000_002: Surely, a rolling stone such as yourself understands the import of this occasion?
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_DAMARIS_000_003: I can see that you do. Marvelous! My heart warms towards you─why not enter the amphitheatre? Have yourself a souvenir of this Heavensturn!
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_DAMARIS_000_004: What is it? Oh, a helm from the Far East. They will send these curious tokens of friendship, those Easterlings.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_DAMARIS_000_005: One of them is in there right now, and she cuts a figure most...unusual. For the love of the Twelve, don't laugh, my dear . Or if you must, do it discreetly.
TEXT_FESNYR001_01292_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: In honor and glory do we first lay eyes upon one another. I am that which the betters and worse alike call the uma bugyo, come from the Far East to tend to the fire of friendship with your Eorzea.
I see that your eyes wander in wonder to this artful helm! Well and good is your penchant in such matters, . The selfsame kabuto you shall have.

See you the lines of this kabuto, ? Strange it seems to your Eorzean eyes, but no Easterner would fail to recognize it as the horse, the totem of this coming turn. Proper and customary it is for us of the Far East to choose a totem before every Heavensturn.
Now hear me, , and hear me well, lest wonder quickly curdle to derision, as is wont to do with Eorzeans.
Hoof to neigh, Eorzea knows not the horse for one reason and one reason only: the horsebird. I speak of that which the slow- and the quick-tongued alike call chocobo in your parlance.

The lay of your lands, the cut of your climes, the plumpness of your posterior─the horsebird was admirably suited to Eorzea in every way. But was and is are no more alike than a man bedded and a man wedded, as we say in the Far East.

The scent of knowledge is on you, adventuring one, and so it needs but a mention that much has changed in Eorzea. The East would bring the horse to water if Eorzea is ready to drink, if  takes my mixed meaning.

Truly and secretly, 'twas my mission to begin the horsing of your fair lands. When the new totem proved the horse, it seemed the Twelve smiled upon us; for even in Eorzea, minds arch high and wide during Heavensturn...
Yet I am stymied, for the laws of your woods say no horse may enter the Black Shroud! If my faithful steed is not to present his noble self, how will Eorzeans know the beauty of the horse?
Assuredly and absurdly, you must be the answer to my prayers. Else, , I must return to the Far East empty-handed!
No horse may enter the Black Shroud, but an adventurer may. Clear and clandestine is our way─you, , must don the kabuto and be the horse!
Nay is but a hoofbeat away from neigh!
In humility and jocundity do I receive your assent. Don the kabuto, then, , and aid our yoriki three in Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah.
No mere mummery, this that you do, . You must embrace the equine if the noble horse is to ever canter alongside the strange and off-putting horsebird throughout the breadth of Eorzea.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_YELLOWGENERAL_000_0: An adventurer of this unkind land who would embrace the horse and assist us? The uma bugyo is a lady most subtle to find such a one.
How are things, you ask? Quite bad, thank you. Cold shoulders and colder cabbage soup are our rewards for tireless attempts to show the beauty of the horse to these...these ingrates.

Are they beautiful? What a question, but no matter. I shall have to fill that gaping void in your sensibility that your begetter so unthinkingly left you with. Yes, the horse is more beautiful than your chocobos, and it falls upon you to prove the point.

Hm? Can we get this show on the road? Do you mean that you are eager to begin the mission? Very good! Don your kabuto and take yourself to Bentbranch Meadows, where the one who serves me with the heart of a son and strength of a brother will guide you.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SUBORDINATEA_000_01: Judging from the kabuto, I take it you are on our side? Welcome to Bentbranch Meadows. A foolish name, considering most branches are bent! But then again, I am among fools here.

Yes, fools! They have eyes, but will not meet my gaze. They have ears, but will not listen to my petition. The only things they do use in a manner proper are their legs, with which they scurry away like milk-livered children.
To one of their own kind, though, they must turn their gaze and unstopper their ears. So please, good , strike a pose and show these galoots the beauty of the horse!

I have learned that the way to an Eorzean's single-chambered heart is through the chocobo. If you can show the horse in a light favorable to those overgrown fowls, then perhaps you will succeed where I have not.

But for that, you must sally to where the horsebirds gather, and pose amongst them! Let the chocobokeeps witness the pose-off and the truth blast the amber from their eyes and the wax from their ears!
Don you the uma kabuto, and show this benighted land the fearsome beauty of the horse!
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_BREEDER_000_030: Eh now, what are you up to!? You're scarin' them is what! Knock it off!
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_BREEDER_000_031: Eh? Do I think the horse a beautiful creature? Don't rightly know what you mean by that, but sure, I guess the real thing would look fair enough. A sight better than that thing on your head, that's for sure.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_BREEDER_000_032: Are you going to stop horsing around now? It's Heavensturn, and look at all the ruffled feathers! You take yourself off to a tavern like a gods-fearing .
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_BREEDER_000_033: Whatever you want, I ha'n't the time for you now. Gots to look for some joker in a fleem-ugly mask who was scarin' the chocobos.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SUBORDINATEA_000_04: Ha! “Comely,” he called the horse? Out of the mouth of foes comes the greatest of compliments! Bitter has been the battle of Bentbranch Meadows, and sweeter for it the victory!
Afeared, you say? What craven birds are these, to quail so before the overmastering beauty of the horse...

But lest I forget, the horse is merciful and generous in victory. More generous than I would be, frankly. Go and rally these shrink-clawed chocobos, and show that in beauty of mind too, the horse is superior to the bird.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SYSTEM_000_051: The chocobos respond with much excitement.
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_SUBORDINATEA_000_06: Yes, adventurer, these are tears you see upon my cheek. Seeing you rally those horsebirds so...
What a curious land you hail from! You are more discomfited by a man's tears than a man's blood. Yet your masterful rally evokes my beloved steed with all the eloquence of the East...
