As unschooled as you are, you have captured the beauty of the horse. The tears you regard with unease are a testament to your empathy most equine.

Nothing more remains to be done in Bentbranch Meadows, so overmastering has been your achievement. Take this carrot to the golden uma yoriki as proof of your success. May the gods speed your way to Gridania!
TEXT_FESNYR002_01293_YELLOWGENERAL_000_0: Would I like to hear your report? Yes, I believe we would both be served by it. Well, what says the doshin? Were you able to instruct those chilly chocobokeeps in the beauty of the horse?
The doshin's carrot? He gave you this, and wept in a manner most manly? Most lacking in imagination is that one, and for him to see evocations of that which is most precious to him in life...
Your inner horse, my dear adventurer, must be a steed of rare beauty. Perhaps the West is not without its own subtlety.

I, the golden uma yoriki, thank you for your assistance. When the noble hoofbeats of the horse ring through these woods, know that you are ever remembered. And this kabuto, too, shall remind you of the deed.

What good is it? Your questions have grown less discomfiting as I warm towards you. What good is this kabuto? You shall ever look upon it and remember this Heavensturn─and the inner horse of great beauty that canters through the chambers of your heart.
You can do no more to persuade  of the beauty of the horse. May you have success as great in other lands, and may the uma bugyo find you not wanting.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_BLACKGENERAL_000_00: I mark you as an adventurer come to our aid, lo!

I am that which the East and the West alike call the black uma yoriki, though, lo, one knows the name by heart and the other by ear alone. To Ul'dah was I sent to tell of the speed that is the birthright of the horse!
Hoarse have I shouted these tales of fleetness─no pun intended─but a man's voice is poor substitute for a horse a-gallop, alack!

A man a-run, however, such makes a better substitute, but only a man fleet of foot would do! Hard would I charge if I felt myself equal to the task, but lo! A lifetime on horseback makes a poor runner indeed.
Now, an adventurer in the prime of  life may achieve the spirit─if not the substance─of the speed that lo, sends manes flying and hearts thundering! Such and that are yours to achieve.

One who whiles her life away in my benevolent shadow has placed markers along the road to the Silver Bazaar. As the winds of the East race to a stormcote you must run, horselike in your speed...from marker to marker and so on to the Silver Bazaar, using naught but your own legs!
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SUBORDINATEB_000_01: (-Black Uma Doshin-)What travesty is this!? I look upon you, and I see not a horse! Don the uma kabuto for this most important journey!
(-Black Uma Doshin-)...Question not how I manage to bear witness to your deed from afar. Be as the horse, and leave behind all doubts and bafflement!
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_NPC_000_020: Beg pardon, a moment of your time?
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_NPC_000_021: Now here's a curious sight─a  in a most peculiar helm running up this road like fire through tinder. It's upset this chocobo something fierce.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_NPC_000_022: Embracing the inner horse, you say? Advocating for an Eastern mount? Nonsense! You see a  running  heart out in an outlandish helm and you think...you think...
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_NPC_000_023: Why, you think there must be a good reason for a  to mortify  so, and...and you wonder just how swift this horse must be for  to go to all this trouble and nonsense!
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_NPC_000_024: The revolution comes! A new mount to rival chocobos, even replace them! What does it mean? Whom shall I tell? ...And how might I make a few gil off of this?
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_NPC_000_025: I thank you kindly for the information, horse-! Spread the word of the horse's speed far and wide. We who adopt the mount early will have a greater joy of it.
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_SUBORDINATEB_000_04: You have finished your task, . Well did you run your appointed course.
I have watched you from afar and near alike, and aye, you were as a charger! Who could fail to be awed by the spittle flying from beneath your kabuto?
...Your boots as thundering hooves sending up plumes of dust, your taut flanks gleaming with sweat...well! A worthy mount you would make, .
I am not the only horse-lover in the Silver Bazaar tonight, I'll wager. I saw many a pair of eyes shining at the sight of flying manes, lips parted as though to drink in the muscular gallop...

And did you yourself not feel a dim echo of the exhilaration that is the natural gift of riders and mount alike? So long have we of the East partaken of this that we feel the need...the need for speed.
It is our custom to reward a horse with a carrot. Take this, my fleet piebald steed, and present it to the black uma yoriki in Ul'dah.
You will continue to don the kabuto, I hope. With so many eager eyes upon you, it would be a sore disappointment to see the horse revealed as mere .
TEXT_FESNYR003_01294_BLACKGENERAL_000_05: By the dust upon your coat and lo, the foam upon your chest, I mark the celerity of your journey hither! What have you there?
A carrot! However did you rouse the doshin to such favor, such fervor? A seeker of pleasure and a spirit most free she is, but since arriving in Eorzea, she has been as watered wine, alack!
Much do we value speed in the East for lo, life is hard and full of besiegement. We can plod in uncertain safety or...gallop in certain rapture!
An adventurer carries  in much the same way, ha! No wonder it is that you succeeded beyond my wildest hope. This is your reward, lo, a kabuto that is a twin to mine own!
Never plod, adventurer. Death shall unhorse us, every one, but until then...until then, lo, we shall canter, we shall gallop, we shall leap!

The word shall spread throughout Ul'dah of the speed of the horse. You have hotfooted and hightailed your way to glory and grace! Continue your work for the uma bugyo, I say, then return to her in Gridania.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_000: knows the role we play in this enterprise, I am hoping.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_001: Rescuers, , rescuers. Fair Eorzea, fettered in feathers, shackled to shame. It is sad, no? So on horseback we are riding, to the rescue!
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_002: I am liking Eorzea. The sights, the food, the people...but not the horsebirds, no. Wretched, kweh-ing things. We of the East must be saving Eorzeans from wretched mounts.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_003: I am talking of boyish things.  will pardon, yes? Let us speak now of your task.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_004: The harvest, it proceeds at the Red Rooster Stead. They are needing a nice strong horse, but do they know it? No, .
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_005: I am thinking, perfect! What chance to show the strength of the horse. I am having a nice cob on the Stead already; you are to help him carry the harvest. Go, go.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SUBORDINATEC_000_01: <pant> <pant> ...Come to relieve me? Oh, thank the Twelve. Blasted yoriki and his ideas! He's a northeasterner, you know. They're all off their gourd.
<groan> I put my back out! But no matter, we're to transport the harvest from the Stead─some proof of a horse's power.
My back went before I actually collected the vegetables or loaded the wagon. The harvest's still scattered hither and yon.
Gather up the harvest and hand it to a farmer, won't you? Then you can hitch yourself to the wagon and show all that “horse-power” the yoriki blathers on about.
Ow...owww! If I call you , will you put that kabuto on?
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SUBORDINATEC_000_02: (-Red Uma Doshin-)Hold up, you're here to be the horse. Put your uma kabuto on first.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_030: Good gods, another one of those horse mummers. We can't all be having fun 'n' games during the harvest, ye know.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_031: What's this? Hauled me some carrots, did ye? Well, that's a useful sort of a mummer now. Not like the last one─man couldn't lift a twig.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_032: Got a strong back there, do ye? Powerful sort of shoulders? A mummer could make  even more useful and carry the giant carrot left there by the field.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_039: Don't see no horse helm on ye, . If yer just passing through, then keep on passing. We've vegetables to harvest.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_050: Well? Hefted the giant carrot, or didn't ye?
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_051: Oho! Really put yer back into this one, eh, ?
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_052: That oughta do her, at least for this harvest. Don't need ye anymore. All I got to do is to hitch this wagon to a chocobo, and...
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_053: What? You want to pull the wagon instead?
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_FARMER_000_054: That's my kind of crazy talk. I appreciate that, but no thanks. Believe you would pull the cart, though! Horses are that strong, eh? Or at least you are.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_SUBORDINATEC_000_06: Ungh... Ah, , you're back. Hm? He said what? “Horses are that strong”?
Well, there's our task done and nobody had to hitch themselves to a wagon. I call that a win!
You make a fine horse, . A sight better than me. Why, if I really were a horse, I'd be for the knacker now.
You've more than earned this carrot. Give it to that beast from the northeast, and my message too...
“I am thinking the Red Rooster Stead is won, amazing show of horsepower.” Full stop and...owww.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_070: A good result you are having down at the Red Rooster Stead? Tell me, .
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_071: Oh, the doshin's carrot. His back, he is throwing out? Some poultice I am sending, then.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_072: The vegetables are reaching Limsa Lominsa, but do you know what else, ? The reputation. Horses, Lominsans are hearing, horses are strong.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_073: Now you are taking this crimson kabuto, for all your pains. The doshin?  is kind to be remembering him, but a poultice he is already getting.
TEXT_FESNYR004_01295_REDGENERAL_000_074: The rescue of Eorzea is almost done! I am thinking how pleasant it is to be having a Lominsan lamprey pie now.  forgives the notion?  has more work to do, and only then is  visiting the uma bugyo in Gridania.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: Yours is to advocate for the noble horse in Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah. They that look to me for wrath and succor already toil in those cities three.
If your efforts bear fruit, a kabuto of colors varied you shall have. Gather all three─golden, black, and crimson─and present yourself before me in a manner customary for such occasions.
Now, , know that in the East, the journey belongs to the  but the destination to  master. This pageant of kabuto must follow an order proper, but the quests are yours to order as you like.
We must begin with gold, for it opens that chamber of the heart where sings the canary of covetise. Do not be baffled, : we of the East make a place for our desires.
I see and mark the golden uma kabuto. Let us agree that Gridania has been tutored in the beauty of the horse.
That which is called beauty by the base and the fine alike is but a dream of a song, and through every one echoes a hoofbeat...in Eorzea now as well as the Far East.
Now comes red, for we must remember, , that where gold goes, blood follows. The crimson uma kabuto of Limsa Lominsa awaits an advocate worthy.
I see that your head wears not the golden uma kabuto of Gridania, and so the pageant is not yet complete. Offer yourself in amity and perspicacity to yon golden uma yoriki.
I see and mark the crimson uma kabuto. Let us assent that Limsa Lominsa has learned of the power of the horse.
Prodigal it is that a doshin fell in the line of duty. Were it not for  assistance, these Lominsans would see not the horse as a helpmeet.
The pageant must end in black, betokening a darkling of the senses that the bold and the craven alike call death.  knows I speak of the black uma kabuto of Ul'dah.
I neither see nor mark the crimson uma kabuto of Limsa Lominsa upon your crown. Such a kabuto will be your due, , when the red uma yoriki receives your help.
I see and mark the black uma kabuto. Let us accept the schooling of Ul'dah as a deed of speed, done and dealt.
The speed of the horse is a grace unmatched! That which is named Ul'dah, , is but a millstone that grinds in the desert. Sorely in need it is of such grace.
Gold, crimson, black. Noted and marked, and so the pageant is complete. Let us to another matter attend. Tongues waggle and curiosity piques about the horse, such is  success.
Yet, others would deny their fellow Eorzeans even the mildest flirtation with the horse, , and here it is that we must strike.

Those they call the “Fraternal Order of Chocowackers”, in the harsh accents of Eorzea, are the fronds that fan the flames. In their iron grip toil the chocobos of burden here in Gridania, and no rivals will they brook.
Yet do they not say in the northeast, “the people are speaking, the gods are speaking”? Even the chocowackers dare not resist a groundswell of support.
knows that our Eastern countenance freezes the tongue and hurries the feet. Don the uma kabuto again, for to you falls the task. The people shall speak their minds, straight to the horse's mouth!
Have you the black uma kabuto, ? It no doubt gathers dust upon the shelf of the black uma yoriki in Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_NICOLIAUX_000_060: That's a horse, right? I know all about that!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_NICOLIAUX_000_061: It's fast, faster than anything. An adventurer from Ul'dah says he saw one─he just caught a quick look afore it disappeared, that's how fast! I want one so bad...
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_NICOLIAUX_000_069: The lady in the Amphitheatre, she's got a helm like nothing I've seen. Wish I had one...
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CEINGULED_000_070: Well, I would be lying if I said your helm─kabuto, it is called?─if I said your kabuto was not without some appeal. It...grows on you.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CEINGULED_000_071: Especially since I hear the actual beast is a powerful creature. It needs some studying of course, but...any tactical advantage against the Garleans would be welcome indeed.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CEINGULED_000_079: Where is your strange yet glorious helm? Surely, you have one?
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_MELLAINE_000_080: Hm, is that the horse kabuto that's the talk of the town? It puts me in mind of a rare beast I saw in the hinterlands of Coerthas.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_MELLAINE_000_081: A unicorn, they called it. I saw it just that once but you don't forget something that beautiful. Horses are beautiful, too, aren't they? What a fair sight it'd be, to have them here!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_MELLAINE_000_082: Do you have a kabuto? I'd like to see one up close. I know they me in mind of something.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0: Oh, for the love of the Twelve, the entire  spent dealing with inquiries about this horse thing! We deal in chocobos, people!

And what can I help you wi─
...Oh! ...Oh. You're one of those horse folk. Come to harass us in person, hm?
You brought the voice of the people? What is that, some sort of a periodical? Oh. “Want one so bad,” “tactical advantage,” “What a fair sight”...
These are just...personal opinions! You're not changing our minds with this dross!
Eorzea has a long and proud tradition of portage. We are a chocobo-based economy, you know! This newfangled horse thing has no place here.
Say no to alternative portage! If that uma bugyo insists on waving the horse-head on our turf, we'll bring out the big birds, you can be sure of that.
Since you helped them, you're helping us now. I've sent for the finest chocobo Coerthas can breed. Bring that bugyo to Treespeak Stables, and we'll put her in her place.
If you need a chocobo porter, you'll have to go next door. Ugh, I hope one of those horse-headed freaks shows up─I'll give 'em a piece of my mind!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: relayed the voice of the people to those high-necked chocowackers? They were suitably humbled, I assume yet ask?
...And I am schooled, that an answer assumed is unlike an asking answered. Irrational and partial these chocowackers are, and they shame even the horsebird in their witlessness.
A chocobo-based economy, indeed! A long and proud tradition of non-competition, is what is meant by the left and the right side of her mouth alike.
Far have I come to stoke the flames of accord with Eorzea, , and these chocowackers would see it turn to cold ash! Nay─neigh, I say!
This challenge I will accept.  will guide me to this Treespeak Stables, and there I will face off against the keeper of horsebirds.
Quick, don the kabuto! A horse you must stay, until this labor is complete.
In honor and glory do we first lay eyes on each other. You are that which is called the chief of chocowackers by Eorzeans and outlanders alike. I am the uma bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0: Thank you for coming, esteemed visitor from the Far East. Let's settle this thing once and for all, shall we?
A truly magnificent chocobo is about to arrive in these stables. After that, we can both go home because it will be pretty clear even to you that we've no need of horses in Eorzea!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: Your initial courtesy was as a thin soup before a meal of bones. You speak of things becoming clear, m'lady, but there is no clarity in your own mind─only folly.
Thanks to this adventurer most beautiful, fleet, and powerful, Eorzea desires to know more of the horse. Is that not clear to you?
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0: Excuse me!? You think a cheap stunt like that means anything? The last  to put on a funny hat and clown about was selling lardy cakes, and people talked about that for a few days, too!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: Funny hat!? A work of high art and cunning craft this is, and in the image of mine own courser fair. Oh, the scurrilousness!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0: The scurry-what!? Nobody in Eorzea even understands what you're saying! As for your precious horses, they're just unicorns with a big empty forehead. Hornless! Hornless!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_208: (-???-)Abandon your quarrel, your tongues are sharp enough to shave an urchin!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_209: (-???-)Treespeak sends for the finest chocobo in Coerthas, and I have brought it thus... Now, what ails you that you would keep me waiting?
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0:
But that armor is Haurche─
...No, that can't be. Excuse me, who are you? I didn't send for a horse-head to deliver my chocobo!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_211: Well, if you cannot name me, I have no name to claim! The helm I bought off a passing adventurer. It has a certain...vigor that appealed to me.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_212: Esteemed visitor from the East, I have the honor to have been born under the unicorn sigil of a proud house. Horn or no, I know the love you bear for the mount of your homeland.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_213: The supple muscles under the silky coat, the music of the hooves...the velvet of the muzzle, and the inscrutable black sea of their eyes. Ah, the horse!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_214: But I am also a man of Coerthas, where the love of chocobos runs as deep as their bloodline runs pure. Which is better, bird or horse? I could not say.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: You could not say? Exactly useless, then, was that soliloquy! M'lord seems not to comprehend that I am now honor-bound to prove the horse superior to this...this chit!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_216: Then your honor is forfeit, as is hers. The finest creature here is neither the horse nor the chocobo...
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_218: ...but my trusted comrade of many adventures, !
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_219: Look at the scars upon  kabuto. How mightily  must have toiled to become a horse...and against all odds, succeed!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_220: The docility to accept well-nigh impossible commands, the physical talents to carry them out─to a warrior born such as I, there are no virtues greater in a steed!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_221: I say, be my personal steed! There will be none greater, furred or feathered. The finest carrots you will have. Your feet I will scrape, and...
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0: Uh, Lord Haur─I mean, Lord No-name, I think you made your point. You can stop now. Please.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: I must agree with m'lady here. If we agree to discuss the matter at some later and calmer time, m'lord, will you refrain from further flying of fancies?
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_224: Well, if you are in agreement, I see no further need for my presence here. I shall take the chocobo and return north.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_225: Adventurer, we were well met. A  of your talents is welcome at our camp any time.
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_226: , we were well met again. You will one day make your way back to our camp, I trust? We will sit by the fire and talk of glory and adventure!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HAURCHEFANT_000_227: May the new turn be a blessed one!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_CHOCOBOMISSIONARY_0: You! Put that horse helm back on. I want that uma bugyo to know how peaky a horse looks next to a chocobo!
TEXT_FESNYR005_01296_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: In rue and chagrin do I face you after such fit of temper. I tremble to think what reckless words may have tumbled from this mouth without the Ishgardian lord's interruption.
Curious it is how the best of intentions curdle so quickly into an act of spite.  has much to teach me in the clean-breaking ways of the rolling stone.
The chief of chocowackers also regrets her rash words. In tranquility and amity we have determined to meet again, to search for a two-beast solution.
The people have seen, the people have spoken─all thanks to . The way is open for the horse, and someday, with the chocowackers' assent, we shall canter into Eorzea.
Much has been asked of  adventurer, yet more has been given by . Accept this Heavensturn dish, traditional in the East, as a token of our friendship and promise.
May the new turn be a blessed one for you, for you from the Far East we pray.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LARSONIENT_000_000: Wherefore the dour mien, adventurer? Have your toils and troubles taken such a toll that you can spare not a moment to bask in the fragrance of a beautiful rose?
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LARSONIENT_000_001: No, this will not do─not in this season, and not in the presence of Larsonient, knight in proud service to House Valentione!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LARSONIENT_000_002: Ardor and Affection─so the Valentione house words are writ, and verily, for we do battle with the ever-encroaching specters of sequester and solitude with no less ferocity than we visit upon the dread wyrms that plague our ancestral demesne.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LARSONIENT_000_003: Not a single lovelorn tear shall be shed, no affection shall go unrequited─such is the noble crusade that brings the Lady Lisette to these far-flung shores.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LARSONIENT_000_004: If you would truly serve your realm, you would do well to seek her out in haste, and save your mundane adventuring for another day. For truly, there is no greater quest than the quest for love!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LARSONIENT_000_010: Lady Lisette of House Valentione has come to this realm on a crusade of love, and awaits those who would lend their strength and passion to her cause. Will you rise to the occasion, or shirk away like  who lacks the courage to bare  heart to  one true love?
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_020: My love burns brighter than the sun, and deeper than the sea. Gladly would I share it with thee, and thee, and...ooh, most definitely thee!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_WOTA_000_021: (-Adoring Fan-)She ain't just beautiful, she's a poetess to boot! M'lady, do say that last “thee” was for me!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_022: Mayhap no, and mayhap so...I fear you'll never know! After all, what is a lady without her secrets? Not a direct descendant of the Countess Arabelle de Valentione, that much is for certain!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_023: No, your ears do not deceive. I, Lisette de Valentione, trace my lineage back to the oft-sung beauty who did traverse the realm in lifelong pursuit of true love.
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_024: Mind you, my celebrated forebear's pilgrimage of passion was not simply to satisfy her own desires─heavens forbid! No, House Valentione ever seeks to share its riches with those less fortunate in love, and it is in that selfsame spirit of giving that I stand before you, in all my beauty, today!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_WOTA_000_025: (-Adoring Fan-)M'lady Lisette! Even a whit of yer love'll warm me lonely heart for a fortnight's journey! Chocolate, m'lady, I beg ye for a morsel of yer chocolate!
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_026: Oh, the time will come for confections. Until then, mayhap you can content yourself with my affection?
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_027: Well! What have we here, if not an adventurer. I imagine you lack not for glory or riches, but what of treasures closer to the heart?
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_028: Ardor and Affection, speak the words of House Valentione, and a realm bereft of both is a wretched one indeed. What say you put aside other allegiances for the present and serve as my loyal retainer for a while?
TEXT_FESVLT001_01297_LISSETE_000_029: I can promise you the experience will set your heart a-dancing and a-prancing. Serve me well, and I may even see fit to reward you...personally. Tee hee～♪
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_LISSETE_100_070: Across the realm, hearts pine and yearn. How fare you in bringing them succor?
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_LISSETE_100_071: You know not where to look? Why did you not say so sooner!? By the powers vested in me by my ancestors, I shall divine for you the whereabouts of a heart in need!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_LISSETE_100_072: What have we here...? Oh, for woe! Yellow Moon of Ul'dah, she of sun-kissed tresses, would deliver to her beloved a gift straight from the heart, yet she struggles most painfully in the process. In the name of House Valentione, I command you to hasten to her side!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_000: Whatever shall I do now? Poor Yellow Moon, this time you may have finally bitten off more than you can...hm?
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_001: Beg pardon, friend. I am not one to impose on the kindness of strangers, but I find myself in a most pressing predicament.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_002: This year, I promised myself that I would surprise my numerous admirers with an assortment of homemade Valentione's chocolates. I soon realized, however, that I had completely miscalculated the sheer volume of ingredients needed to prepare such a quantity of confections.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_003: They say that the surest way to a man's heart is to cut a hole through his guts and innards...or something like that, yes? Why, if my culinary creations fail to sate my admirers' prodigious appetites, potential flames of love might be quenched without ever having had the chance to blaze!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_004: As I said, I am loath to impose upon the kindness of strangers. That said, I imagine there are a few individuals about town─male individuals─who might show some sympathy for my plight. You'll seek them out, yes? A simple mention of my name should suffice─no need to go into detail.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIA_000_010: Yellow Moon sent you!? Well, it's about time!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIB_000_011: I've been holding onto this phial of ziz venom for her for nigh on a fortnight now! Nasty bugger almost chewed my arm clean off, it did.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIB_000_012: Just between you and me, I'd take on a horde of those beasts for the faintest sliver of hope at receiving even a morsel of her homemade chocolate. Yes, my love, none are more devoted to you than I!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIB_000_015: Yellow Moon? You were sent by Yellow Moon!? My Yellow Moon!? Of course, I would happily donate this orobon liver to her cause!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIB_000_016: Oh, my precious Yellow Moon! It only pains me that it is not my own liver that I gift unto you! ...Actually, I suppose that would pain me somewhat more. And yet I would present the gift no less willingly! Such is the depth of my love!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIB_000_017: Oh, my precious Yellow Moon! It only pains me that it is not my own liver that I gift unto you! ...Actually, I suppose that would pain me somewhat more. And yet I would present the gift no less willingly! Such is the depth of my love!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_020: Ah, your return is welcome indeed. Well? Were my friends as cooperative as I imagined they might be?
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_021: Ziz venom and an orobon liver? I couldn't have asked for more! My friends are far too kind─yes, this batch of sweets will be my most passionately potent one yet!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_022: And yet, with so many friends, so many chocolates remain to be fashioned! I say, might I trouble you to make the rounds once more? I suspect that I might have just a few more friends out there willing to come to my aid.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIC_000_030:
Yellow Moon sent you!? Bahahaha, that's a laugh!
Why would she not come to see her loyal admirer herself, hm? Hmmm!? I trust you about as far as I could throw you─actually, a fair bit less!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIC_000_031: Then again, what if you do speak true? If I refuse you, my beloved might never speak to me again! Ah, damn it all─I am but a fool in love, but I would have it no other way. Take this, and begone from my sight!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIC_000_032: I know not what need Yellow Moon has for morbol bile, but it is not my place to ask. So long as it brings a smile to the fair lass's face, I ask for no more.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEID_000_035: Yellow Moon has no interest in me, this I know. I doubt she even knows my name. Why, to tell the truth, I'm not even sure I remember it myself.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEID_000_036: What were we talking about again? Does it even matter? I think not. Take this and give it to Yellow Moon. Or don't. Just leave me to my fantasies. They're so much more compelling than reality, you know.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEID_000_037: What day is it again? Valentione's Day? That's the furthest thing from my mind. Or it would be, if I had even heard of such a silly holiday to begin with. Which I haven't. So there.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_040: So many chocolates to make, and my secret ingredients vanish from my shelves moment by moment! Whatever is a comely young lass like myself to do?
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_041: Why, I am surrounded by saints─both you and my many friends! Yes, I simply must return the favor...
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_042: And yet, curse it all! I lack for the ingredients to express my gratitude. Might I impose upon you just once more? It would mean ever so much to me. Pretty, pretty please?
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIE_000_050: Yellow Moon has sent you, yes? Of course. It was but a matter of time before she came to me─her one true love. I give you this, knowing that whatever divine confection she prepares is for me, and me alone.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIE_000_051: Now be off with you. You are but a tool that serves to join me with my beloved, and every moment you tarry here serves but to delay our glorious destiny.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIE_000_052: Be off with you. You are but a tool that serves to join me with my beloved, and every moment you tarry here serves but to delay our glorious destiny.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIF_000_055: My goddess sent you, you say? Stand still a moment. Yes, the scent of her perfume wafts gently through the air to my nostrils.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIF_000_056: What I give unto you, I retrieved from the depths of the seventh hell. I know not to what end my goddess requires it, but it is not my place to ask. I say only this: deliver it to her in good faith, or you will not wake to see the morrow.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YMSHINEIF_000_057: What I give unto you, I retrieved from the depths of the seventh hell. I know not to what end my goddess requires it, but it is not my place to ask. I say only this: deliver it to her in good faith, or you will not wake to see the morrow.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_060: Is something the matter out there? ...Ah, no matter─I have chocolates to make! Well, were you able to procure my ingredients?
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_061: Joy of joys! Yes, with this, I will be able to prepare a veritable bounty of lovingly handcrafted confections─one for each of my many admirers.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_062: And of course, one for you as well, for being so selfless in my time of need.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_063: Needless to say, I'm saving my tastiest treat for my true beloved─and that's one gift that I'll deliver in person.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_YELLOWMOON_000_064: Who's the lucky man, you ask? Oh, come now! Are you trying to turn poor Yellow Moon red with embarrassment? No, you'll just have to use your imagination... Tee hee!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SYSTEM_100_080: You have successfully assisted House Valentione in spreading love to all three city-states.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_SYSTEM_100_081: Return to the festival square in Limsa Lominsa and inform Lisette de Valentione that you have done your duty.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_DEADMANK_000_110: The man does not stir, uttering only the occasional groan.
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_DOUZINA_000_111: Healers to the Weavers' Guild entrance, and with haste! We've a mass ingestion of some vile poison on our hands!
TEXT_FESVLT002_01298_DOUZINB_000_112: Seven hells! Does the Empire strike against our very food supply?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_LISSETE_100_110: From the Farreach to the Sea of Ash, hearts pine and yearn. How fare you in bringing them succor?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_LISSETE_100_111: You know not where to look? Why did you not say so sooner!? By the powers vested in me by my ancestors, I shall divine for you the whereabouts of a heart in need!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_LISSETE_100_112: What is this!? Oh, this will not do! Nemoh Maimhov, a gentle young maid of Gridania, passes many a sleepless night waiting tirelessly for her beloved to return to her embrace. In the name of House Valentione, I command you─see that this Valentione's Day marks the end of her solitude!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_00: Hm? Pay me no mind, friend. I just enjoy the scenery here, that's...hm? A herald of love, you say? I suppose there's no harm in telling you my tale.

It feels like yesterday, and at the same time like ages ago. Before the Calamity, a handsome young soldier promised me his hand in marriage on the eve of his departure for the Battle of Carteneau─a battle from which he, sadly, would never return.

Family and friends alike tell me that he is lost─that I must accept his passing, and find another. And yet─call me a silly little girl, I care not─deep down, in my heart of hearts, I know that he still lives.

...And so I wait, and wait with eyes and ears open. Why, not bells ago, I caught wind of a rumor that a young Midlander with cheekbones high and locks of gold was sighted in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
They say he dons a white beret adorned with a single plume─the selfsame gift I presented to my love before he went off to war. This is my Gwayne─yes, I am more certain than ever!
And yet, what if I am once again mistaken? The disappointment would be too much to bear. I beg of you, friend─would you be so kind as to go ascertain his identity in my stead?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_010: Yes? Might I be of service to you, adventurer?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_011: A winsome lass by the name of Nemoh pines for her beloved Gwayne? Indeed, fortune smiles upon her today! For I am...yes, I am none other than...
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_012: (-Gylbart-)...None other than Gylbart, a thrice-damned lovesick fool who hoped against hope that posing as another man might win me the affections of she who would not otherwise give me the time of day.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_013: (-Gylbart-)I have loved Nemoh since we were both yea high to a goobbue, but to this day, she sees me as no more than that little boy, his hands soiled after a day of mischief in the Twelveswood. With the rumors of Gwayne's return, I thought, perhaps... But no, I will receive her love willingly or not at all.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_015: (-Gylbart-)Do take care, adventurer. There are rumors of a dangerous swindler in these parts of late.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_RASIKIMAN_000_020: Gwayne? The name is unfamiliar to me. I am but a humble adventurer, having recently found my way to these parts.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_RASIKIMAN_000_021: I, too, have lost friends and loved ones to the horrors of war─rare is the one who has not in this day and age. The poor girl has my sympathies.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_RASIKIMAN_000_025: I, too, have lost friends and loved ones to the horrors of war─rare is the one who has not in this day and age. The poor girl has my sympathies.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_RASIKIMAN_000_030: Gwayne? I fear you've mistaken me for another. This is most curious, however...
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_RASIKIMAN_000_031: It may be no more than a coincidence, but I could swear I heard talk of a man by that name on my last visit at E-Tatt's Spire. I can make no promises, but it is an avenue worth exploring, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_RASIKIMAN_000_035: It may be no more than a coincidence, but I could swear I heard talk of a man by that name on my last visit at E-Tatt's Spire. I can make no promises, but it is an avenue worth exploring, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_04: My love was nowhere to be found at the Amphitheatre, you say? <sigh> I suppose I deserve as much for getting my hopes up prematurely.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_100_04: Hm? A man calling himself Gwayne was seen at E-Tatt's Spire!? Oh, you will travel there and investigate the rumors for me, won't you?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_04: Whatever Gwayne's reason for not returning to me─his betrothed and beloved─it must be profound, indeed. Oh, I do hope that he is well...
Whatever Gwayne's reason for not returning to me─his betrothed and beloved─it must be profound, indeed. Oh, I do hope that he is well...
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GWAYNE_000_050: Yes, I am Gwayne─what of it? Nemoh? The name is unfamiliar to me.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GWAYNE_000_051: ...As was my own name until a fortnight ago. I took an axe to the head at Carteneau, you see, and my memories of my past have not returned to me since.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GWAYNE_000_052: The girl has my pity, but even if I saw her now, I would not know her from the Elder Seedseer. Aye, it is best that she and I both let go of the past. And with that, I must take my leave.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_06: You have returned from the spire, yes? Oh, do tell me that you found my Gwayne!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_100_06: L-Lost his memories!? But this cannot be!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_06: I was his love, his destined one─he told me as much with his parting words! We had met not a fortnight before, but I had never felt so certain of anything in my life. <sob> Oh, my dearest Gwayne...
I beg of you, friend, take this to him. 'Tis a piece of chocolate made especially for my beloved on this Valentione's Day.
Tell him that even if he cannot recall my face or name, my love for him is as deep as─
Oh, Gylbart, pray listen! I have at long last found my beloved Gwayne, but he... H-His...
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_065: (-Gylbart-)Enough, Nemoh! I have heard everything, and I cannot bear to see you go on like this any longer! Gwayne is not the man you once knew─this much is clear. For your own good, forget him and move on with your life!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_06: You are wrong, Gylbart! Even to this day, you are nothing but a silly boy. Gwayne is my destined one, and it is but a matter of time before his memories return.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_067: (-Gylbart-)Open your eyes, Nemoh─the Gwayne you knew is dead!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_06: H-How... How dare you!? You cold, heartless fool! I always knew you were jealous of the love that Gwayne and I shared, but I never knew you could be so cruel!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_069: (-Gylbart-)You are wrong, Nemoh. I say this only because I love you. Because I have always─
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_NEMOHMAIMHOV_000_07: Love!? How dare you speak to me of love!? Begone from my sight! I never want to see your wretched face again! <sob> <sob>
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_071: (-Gylbart-)I am sorry that you had to witness that, friend. I would speak to you further, but not here. Seek me out at E-Tatt's Spire, and speak not a word of this to Nemoh.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_080: Ah, you've come. Behold the truth of the man named Gwayne.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_081: ...A philanderer and a swindler, through and through. Aye, Nemoh was not the only poor lass he offered his hand to before heading off to “battle.”
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GWAYNE_000_082: Hah! You're just jealous that I'm a hundred times the man you'll ever be!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_083: Answer me this: how much gil did you earn from selling off all the presents you swindled from those poor girls? Enough to enjoy a nice vacation while your countrymen were fighting for their lives at Carteneau, no doubt!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GWAYNE_000_084: Swindled? Watch your tongue, boy. Those presents were given willingly. What can I say? Such is the effect I have on the women around me. When was the last time a girl gave you anything but a hearty serving of rejection?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_085: Silence! Men like you make me sick! I hope you've had enough romance to last a lifetime, because you'll be spending the rest of your years rotting away in gaol!
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_086: This is the truth I wanted you to see. You will keep this secret from Nemoh, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_087: I thank you. It was not easy to endure that tongue-lashing from my beloved, but playing the villain was the only way to save her from a truth far more cruel than anything she could have imagined.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_088: What's that? A box of chocolates from Nemoh? Whatever would you have me do with this?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SYSYTEM_A1_000_1: Ask Gylbart to deliver the box to Gwayne.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SYSYTEM_A2_000_2: Tell Gylbart to keep it for his own.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_089: I cannot accept a gift that was not given willingly, nor deliver it to a man who betrayed poor Nemoh's gentle heart. No...if anyone deserves this gift, it is you, friend.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GYLBART_000_090: As for me, I have not given up hope. Nemoh still grieves, as well she should─the wounds are still fresh. Yet she is a strong girl. She will recover before long, and I will be there for her. As a friend, if that is what she would have me be...
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_GWAYNET_000_100: Ouch, that smarts. The seven hells have no fury like a jilted lover, eh?
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SYSTEM_100_120: You have successfully assisted House Valentione in spreading love to all three city-states.
TEXT_FESVLT003_01299_SYSTEM_100_121: Return to the festival square in Limsa Lominsa and inform Lisette de Valentione that you have done your duty.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_LISSETE_100_080: Across the realm, hearts pine and yearn. How fare you in bringing them succor?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_LISSETE_100_081: You know not where to look? Why did you not say so sooner!? By the powers vested in me by my ancestors, I shall divine for you the whereabouts of a heart in need!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_LISSETE_100_082: What's this? Even strapping seawives are no strangers to pangs of the heart, 'twould seem. Yes, a young Siren by the name of O'kalkaya, not a stone's throw from where we stand, awaits you, though she is not like to speak willingly of her plight.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_000: If yer lookin' fer a place to wet yer whistle, scrag, I'd advise ye to turn tail an' run.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_001: ...Hm. A landlubber who can look a Sanguine Siren in the eye an' not flinch? Ye've got more guts than most, I'll give ye that.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_002: Look, I ain't the type to warm to strangers, but I'm comin' to the end of me rope. Perhaps ye can do me a favor?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_003: It's our cap'n, y'see. She's in a foul mood of late─fouler even than usual, which is sayin' quite a bit.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_004: What's more, she's been sneakin' about late at night, and to the Bismarck of all places. Call it sailor's intuition, but sure as the tide, I swear there's somethin' amiss... Could a showdown with those bloody Krakens be a-brewin'?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_005: The cap'n's a tough mistress, but she's always been there for us, and I'll not abandon 'er in a time of need. Ye'll investigate for me, won't ye? Lyngsath should be able to tell ye a thing or two.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_LYNGSATH_000_010: Cap'n Rhoswen? Aye, she was 'ere the other night. What's it to ye?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_LYNGSATH_000_011: What sort o' chef would I be if I went about blabbin' me customers' secrets to any swab who walked through these doors, eh? Aye, a dead one, like as not. So let's just say she's asked me to whip up somethin' that's sure to make some sparks! Hah hah!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_020: “Sparks,” 'e said!? Aye, that can mean only one thing─firesand. No doubt a showdown with those low-down Krakens is close at hand. But why the Bismarck? To hide the explosives from our foe's wanderin' eyes, ye reckon?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_022: Blast! That Kraken spy 'eard everything! Quick, after the scurvy dog!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_KANPAN_000_030: You're a bell late and a million gil short, landlubber. I've already told the captain everything I heard.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_KANPAN_000_031: ...Not that I needed to. Yes, the schemings of those uncultured Sirens are as easy to read as the stars in the sky.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_KANPAN_000_032: You've got some nerve showing yourself here after befriending that bunch. Fortunately for you, we Krakens are a more civilized lot, aye.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_KANPAN_000_033: As a matter of fact, the captain has expressed a desire for a parley with you. If you're wise, you'll not keep him waiting long.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_040: Welcome. You're a brave  indeed to come here. But fear not─I wish only to talk.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_041: You consort with the Sanguine Sirens, yes? I doubt I need tell you that the feud between Kraken and Siren is an old one, dating back to the years before we united under the Admiral's flag.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_042: Just yesterday, a missive from Captain Rhoswen was delivered to me, challenging me to a duel. It would appear that my rival has at long last summoned the courage to settle the score between us. Needless to say, I welcome the challenge, but I will stand for no less than an honest fight.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_043: As an adventurer, you are not beholden to either crew. I would ask that you serve as witness to the duel. The place is the Anchor Yard, and the hour...is almost nigh. Hurry there to ensure my opponent plots no treachery, and I shall follow promptly.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_050: The Siren does not show? No doubt she has come to realize that she is hopelessly overmatched. Victory by default is hardly as satisfying, but it is victory nonetheless.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_RHOSWEN_000_051: Save yer godsdamned blabberin' for when the battle is done...if ye've still got a mouth to speak with, that is.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_RHOSWEN_000_052: That said, I do give ye credit─I reckoned ye'd be too much of a scurvy coward to even show yer face.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_053: Hah! I fear you vastly overestimate your own capacity for intimidation. Why, I would have challenged you sooner if I did not fear for the repercussions on your delicate heart.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_RHOSWEN_000_054: Delicate!? I've been ready for this day since ye were sucklin' at yer mum's teat!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_055: ...Ever the songstress. Doubtless 'tis your silver tongue that earned you the name of Siren, yes? But enough talk─have at you!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_057: This ambrosial aroma. This couldn't possibly be...chocolate!?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_RHOSWEN_000_058: B-Bloody ridiculous! You watch yer tongue, or I'll rip it from yer throat!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_059: Ah, yes. Distract me with your feminine wiles, and then strike when my guard is down? I fear your feeble ruse will not avail you today. I prefer my ladies a bit more...refined, you see.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_RHOSWEN_000_061: No woman in 'er right mind would fall for a puffy-shirted fop like you, anyway! What in the seven 'ells was I even thinkin'!?
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_062: ...Ahem. I am not entirely certain what just transpired, but what I do know is that this has been a dreadful waste of my valuable time.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_63: As witness to the duel, I ask that you see to the disposal of that suspicious substance in my stead. It simply will not do to leave such hazardous materials lying about.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_CARVALLAIN_000_64: I suggest you return it to the Sirens responsible for its creation. If not that vulgar Rhoswen herself, then one of her lackeys. Now, if you will excuse me, more important matters demand my attention.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_070: I thought ye'd never return! Whatever 'appened at the duel? The cap'n just returned, and I 'aven't seen 'er seethe like this in ages!
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_071: Eh? What's this ye 'ave 'ere? This is what the cap'n got from the Bismarck? The smell ain't like any firesand I've...
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_072: ...Oho! So that's what ol' Lyngsath meant when 'e spoke of makin' sparks.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_073: After all these years on 'er crew, I thought I knew the cap'n, but it'd seem she still 'ides a secret or two up 'er sleeve.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_074: If ye value yer tongue, ye'll not speak a word of this about town. We Sirens 'ave a reputation to protect, aye.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_OKALKAYA_000_075: 'Ere, take this for yer troubles. Now if ye'll excuse me, I reckon the cap'n's lookin' for someone with whom to drown 'er sorrows.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SYSTEM_100_090: You have successfully assisted House Valentione in spreading love to all three city-states.
TEXT_FESVLT004_01300_SYSTEM_100_091: Return to the festival square in Limsa Lominsa and inform Lisette de Valentione that you have done your duty.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_000: I swear, is it always this bloody hot here? No wonder the whole city smells of sweat and watered-down ale.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_001:
“Oh, Lisette! Pray honor me with a piece of your chocolate!”
I'd just as soon honor the lot of them with a swift kick to the face.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_002: Hour after tireless hour do I slave to bring the joys of love to these uncultured boors. What, I ask, is in it for me? Hm? Hmmmmmm!?
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_004: Well, if it isn't my dutiful adventuring friend! How fare you in spreading my boundless love across the land?♪
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_005: ...I require no answer, of course! As a lady of House Valentione, I am ever attuned to the hearts of would-be lovers the realm over!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_001_006: Yes, though not all romances can end in happiness, it is clear that many a heart rests easier after your efforts. I am proud to declare you a worthy retainer to House Valentione!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_006: And what of yourself, adventurer? Do you long for the company of another? As you have served me with such loyalty, I would deign to return the favor.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_007: This is my final order to thee: deliver one morsel each of bitter heart and pure heart chocolate to me, and do so with all haste!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_008: And how might you go about this? Why, you need only seek out a  willing to make a trade─a task which I am sure is well within the powers of one as brave and  as yourself.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_009: What if your offer is spurned, you say? Are you an adventurer or a chocobo chick!? Begone from my sight, and don't return until you have both chocolates in hand!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_010: I command you to bring me one morsel each of bitter heart and pure heart chocolate. Yes, I, the Lady Lisette bestow upon you the perfect opportunity to seek out that special someone. Dishonor my house by wasting it, and I can assure you that you will rue this day!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_020: I command you to bring me one morsel each of bitter heart and pure heart chocolate. Yes, I, the Lady Lisette bestow upon you the perfect opportunity to seek out that special someone. Dishonor my house by wasting it, and I can assure you that you will rue this day!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_021: Well, what have we here? Yes, this is truly a glorious day! Yes, you must tell me all about the special young  from whom you obtained this chocolate.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_022: ...Oh, would you look at the time! I fear I must prepare to be on my way. Yes, time simply flies when you are spreading love to hundreds─nay, thousands!─of solitary, godsforsaken souls.
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_023: Till next we meet, adventurer, may your days─and nights─never want for ardor and affection!
TEXT_FESVLT005_01301_LISSETE_000_024: ...Phew. I thought it would never end. I swear, next Valentione's Day will be the one I spend in the company of my own true love, whoever and wherever he might be...
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_000: Good  to you, adventurer! I trust that you are enjoying yourself during this most wondrous of celebrations. I do believe this year's Little Ladies' Day will be the most splendrous festival to have graced the realm.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_001: What is Little Ladies' Day, you ask? Why, it is a day when the gentlemen of Eorzea assume the role of seneschals, doting upon the needs of Eorzea's fair maidens who are as princesses for the day.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_002: The tradition began some three centuries ago with Princess Edvya Thorne of Ul'dah. Mayhap you have heard the tale?
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_003: This year, I have the honor of being a royal seneschal, overseeing preparations for the festivities. I take this role quite seriously.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_004: Manifold are the delights to revel in during this fair season, but that which captures my fancy most of all is this year's Princess Edvya doll contest.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_005: Even as we speak, townsfolk the realm over are tailoring gowns for their dolls in the likeness of Princess Edvya. Once ready, the little ladies of each city-state will cast their votes to determine the fairest figurine of them all.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_006: The victor shall be rewarded handsomely for  efforts, though I daresay the joy of dollcraft is its own reward. Would that I had time to participate, but there is ever so much to do! What say you give it a try? There is no better way to partake in the holiday spirit.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_007: What? You lack the manual dexterity required to make a doll for the contest? I will hear no such nonsense!
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_008: Still, if you so doubt your aptitude for crafting, you might consider purchasing a doll for the contest. It is not unheard of for those who cannot create their own to use one.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_009: The key to this contest is the doll's dressing, so at the very least, you will have a proper foundation for your entry. With a little effort, your own little princess might be judged the most charming in the realm!
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_BUTLER_000_010: Yes, hurry along and place an order with Serendipity at the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah. There is much to do if you wish to enter the contest in time.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_010: Greetings, and welcome to the Goldsmiths' Guild! People call me Mistress Serendipity, but you can call me Sera!
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_011: What did you say your name was? Ah, , that's right! What can I do for you today?
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_100_010: Oh, ! I imagine you've been refining your skills since last we met. What can I do for you today?
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_012: A Princess Edvya doll? Oh, dear...
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_013: I would like nothing more than to help you─truly, I would─but we're absolutely swamped with commissions. Why, it would take a miracle just to fill the orders we already have!
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_014: That said, I'd hate to see you miss out on the festivities.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_015: There simply must be a way to get you a doll for the contest.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_016: You have your heart set on entering, yes? Then I suppose there is one thing we can try.
TEXT_FESPDY001_01302_SERENDIPITY_000_017: Let me know when you're ready to get started, and I'll see if we can't get you a nice princess doll.

TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_000: Eager to hear my plan, then? Excellent!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_001: As you might imagine, we've received hundreds of orders in the weeks, even months leading up to the contest. Why, our most doll-crazed customers placed their orders not days after last year's festivities ended!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_002: After hearing so many of them boast and brag about their intentions to demolish their opponents, I'm starting to wonder if they've forgotten what Little Ladies' Day is truly about.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_003: Yes...I can't put my finger on it, but I am convinced that you will bring something special to this contest─something none of the guild's other clients can.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_100_003: And so this is what I propose: Eshtaime's Lapidaries will submit its own entry to the contest. The goal is to win, then sell the doll at auction.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_004: Your job will be to visit each of the city-states, putting this masterwork on display for all to admire and adore.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_005: Little ladies of all nations will be casting their votes, after all, and they are not like to vote for a doll they have not seen.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_006: I trust that traversing the realm will not overly trouble an accomplished adventurer such as yourself.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_007: I've no doubt you're well accustomed to teleporting all about the place. I suppose it's faster, albeit slightly more expensive, but─ Ahem. Where was I? Oh, yes!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_008: An admirable plan, is it not? You get to partake in the festivities, Eshtaime's Lapidaries gets its publicity, and I can get back to filling the several hundred commissions I'm neglecting at this very moment. Everybody wins!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_009: And now, the moment you've been waiting for. Behold, your very own Princess Edvya doll!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_010: Isn't she darling? And if you thought you'd have to carry her, think again! You'll find she's quite capable of getting around on her own.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_011: I recommend you first travel to Gridania. The little ladies there love to gossip, making it the perfect place for your doll's debut. Oh, and take these blossoms as well─a small gift will go a long way toward winning their hearts.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SYSTEM_000_012: The Princess Edvya doll minion must remain summoned in order to progress in this quest.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SYSTEM_000_013: The Princess Edvya doll minion will be lost upon dismissing it or logging out of the game.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SYSTEM_000_014: The doll can be retrieved by speaking with Serendipity.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_020: Oh, ... I have a feeling I know why you're here...
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_Q1_000_001: Tell Serendipity you lost the doll?
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_021: Haha, no need to fret. She knows to return home when lost. Now off you go, and be sure to enjoy yourself!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_022: Oh? Everything is fine? Wonderful! Well, off you go, then! Be sure to tell me all about your trip to Gridania when you're done.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_023: The gossiping girls of Gridania will spread word of the doll for us. Just remember to hand each a blossom for Little Ladies' Day.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_100_030: Dolls, dolls, dolls...each more beautiful than the next, yet none of them speak to me. Did Princess Edvya concern herself with glory and riches? I think not!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_000_030: Dolls, dolls, dolls...each more beautiful than the next, yet none of them speak to me. Did Princess Edvya concern herself with glory and riches? I think not!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_000_031: Flowers? For me? That's terribly sweet of you.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_000_032: Did you know that peach blossoms were in full bloom on the very day that Princess Edvya went missing all those years ago? It is to honor her memory that the flower was adopted as the symbol of Little Ladies' Day, adorning the town as you see today.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_000_033: 'Tis rare to see one who remembers the old traditions in this day and age. Why, even your doll is dressed in traditional garb! Well, I know who I'm voting for this year. Ah, if only I could have a doll like this of my very own!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_000_034: What's that, you say? Eshtaime's Lapidaries plans to put this selfsame doll up for sale after the judging is over? It looks like a visit to Ul'dah just might be in order!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G1_000_035: I wish you the best of luck in the contest! Not that you're like to need it, with such a masterpiece as your entry.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G2_100_040: This is the one day of the year where I have the chance to be treated like a princess, but all my friends care about is winning that blasted contest. <sigh> So here I am all alone, feeling like a pauper.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G2_000_040: This is the one day of the year where I have the chance to be treated like a princess, but all my friends care about is winning that blasted contest. <sigh> So here I am all alone, feeling like a pauper.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G2_000_041: Oh, I shall treasure these more than any gem! Thank you, .
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G2_000_042: They say the peach blossom was emblazoned on the royal family's coat of arms during the Thorne Dynasty. It's why the peach blossom has become so deeply entwined with Little Ladies' Day─to remember Sultan Baldric Thorne, and the kindness he showed that poor miller girl in the tale so often retold.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G2_000_043: Such a lovely doll─as beautiful as any blossom, I say. If you're competing in the doll contest, rest assured that my vote is yours. It's the least I can do to repay your kindness.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G2_000_045: Best of fortune to you, . You've certainly earned my vote.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G3_100_050: Of all the festivals held here in Gridania, Little Ladies' Day has to be my favorite, although I cannot help but feel something is amiss this year...
