TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G3_000_051: More peach blossoms? But of course! There were far more peach trees in bloom around the Twelveswood last year. It was the perfect way to pay homage to Princess Edvya and the tradition of charity she gave birth to.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G3_000_052: What's more, planting saplings gives me reason to use the new gardening kit I purchased a few moons past. You wouldn't believe what a bargain it was, and made with high-quality darksteel to─
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G3_000_053: Ahem, excuse me. I got carried away for a moment. Is that a doll for the contest? Why, it's as pretty as a peach. You can count on my vote for the contest. Oh, think nothing of it─thanks to you, I finally have a use for my new gardening tools!
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_CHARISMA_G3_000_055: I pray you do well in the contest. Now where did I put that shovel?
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_060: Welcome back, ! You're just in time. Not long ago I received word of the contest rankings.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_061: It looks like you're slowly climbing up to number one! The little ladies of Gridania must have really been taken with you and the doll.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_062: She is oft reluctant to express her emotions─as princesses are wont to be─but I'm sure she's excited to hear the news, as well.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_063: I've crafted many a doll for this contest, and yet I find myself growing more and more partial to this one. If I had a vote, I daresay it would go to you.
TEXT_FESPDY004_01305_SERENDIPITY_000_064: And it would appear that this little lady has grown partial to you as well, . This is only the beginning, though. Keep up the good work and you're sure to win!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_000: Hello there, . All rested up from your excursion to Gridania?
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_001: I would hope so, at least. If you would see your doll to victory, your journey has only just begun.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_002: Your next opportunity to shine light upon our little princess will be in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_003: It would appear that preparations for Little Ladies' Day have only just begun there.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_004: Make a good impression on the little ladies of La Noscea ahead of time, and, like as not, your doll will be the talk of the sea city-state before the competition even shows up!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_005: Let me get your doll and you can be on your way. Now where did she get off to?
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_010: Now remember: preparations for Little Ladies' Day are still underway, and the little ladies of Limsa are likely full to bursting with anticipation, waiting for the festivities to begin. Take this pouch of confetti with you, and see if you can't fulfill their need for festival fun until the contest starts.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_011: Oh, ... I have a feeling I know why you're here...
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_Q1_000_001: Tell Serendipity you lost the doll?
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_012: Haha, no need to fret. She knows to return home when lost. Now off you go, and be sure to enjoy yourself!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_013: Oh? Everything is fine? Wonderful! Well, off you go, then! Be sure to tell me all about your trip to Limsa Lominsa when you're done.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_014: Hurry along, lest another contest participant wins the favor of Limsa's little ladies first!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L1_100_020: Little Ladies' Day is such a dreary affair! Princess, schmincess─you don't see anyone bathing me with blossoms or honeyed words, and that suits me just fine!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L1_000_020: Little Ladies' Day is such a dreary affair! Princess, schmincess─you don't see anyone bathing me with blossoms or honeyed words, and that suits me just fine!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L1_000_021: A celebration in my honor? Tee hee! My loyal seneschal is far too kind! I suppose I could deign to partake in the festivities, if 'twould mean that much to you.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L1_000_022: Oh my, your doll is simply gorgeous. Will you be entering it in the contest? If you do, I will be sure to vote for you. You've been so kind to me today, it is the least I can do.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L1_000_025: A doll as splendid as yours is sure to win. I wish you luck in the contest!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L2_100_030: Come ashore for Little Ladies' Day, they said. Princesses? Bah! On my ship, I am queen of the seas! City life holds nothing for me─not even a single admirer to welcome me upon my return... <sniffle>
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L2_000_030: “Come ashore for Little Ladies' Day,” they said. Princesses? Bah! On my ship, I am queen of the seas! City life holds nothing for me─not even a single admirer to welcome me upon my return... <sniffle>
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L2_000_031: Ohoho! Finally, a seneschal come to pay homage to my greatness? Well, perhaps I could stay here a while longer, at least until the doll contest has ended. I would hate to disappoint one who adores me so.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L2_000_032: What is that you have there? A doll for the contest, you say? Well, friend, you can count on my vote. Anyone who takes time out to cheer me up the way you did deserves that much.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L2_000_035: As soon as voting begins, you can be sure I'll head right over. May Oschon smile upon you!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L3_100_040: Does no one know how to decorate in this town? Honestly, what were they thinking with these drab colors and dreary ornaments? Were I Princess Edvya, I would be rolling about in my grave!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L3_000_040: Does no one know how to decorate in this town? Honestly, what were they thinking with these drab colors and dreary ornaments? Were I Princess Edvya, I would be rolling about in my grave!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L3_000_041: Amaranth, carmine, vermilion, peach! Finally, someone who knows how to coordinate  colors. And...what have we here? That's quite the dapper doll you have as well. I don't suppose you'll be entering the contest?
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L3_000_042: Well, if the decorations around town are any indication, there will be no competition worth speaking of. You'll have my vote all the same, though. I simply cannot bear the thought of some chromatically challenged doll winning.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L3_000_043: It's going to be auctioned off by Eshtaime's Lapidaries after the contest? Hmmm, I may have to save my gil for a trip to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_CHARISMA_L3_000_045: No need to worry about the contest, friend. I'm sure the other entries will be as laughable as these festival decorations.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_050: Oh! Welcome back, . I have wonderful news!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_051: The rankings have been updated again, and do you know who stands at the top of the charts? No, not the porcelain doll from Black Rabbit Traders, you silly! You do! I can't believe she's grown so popular in such short time.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_052:
Why, just look─even she rejoices at the news!
...At least, I'm sure she would. If she weren't a doll.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_053: A-Ahem, I'm sorry. What was I saying again? Ah, yes, our petite princess seems to enjoy your company, and it shows. At this rate, she's certain to win the heart of every little lady in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_054: I can only imagine the rich sum she will fetch when she goes up for auction!
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_055: Keep up the good work, . She's going to make some little lady very happy once this is all over.
TEXT_FESPDY005_01306_SERENDIPITY_000_056: Hm? What's this? Unless I'm losing my mind, she looks somehow...different...than a moment ago. Her expression is almost...sad?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_000: Oh, . Forgive me, I've been a bit preoccupied with your doll. She's been acting awfully strange lately, though none of her parts seem damaged. I do wonder if something's wrong...
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_001: But no matter! She began functioning properly when I mentioned your name. If I didn't know better, I'd say she's taken a fancy to you. Oh, but that would be silly, wouldn't it?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_002: With the contest nearing its end, I daresay it's time for a grand finale─something the little ladies of Eorzea will remember for ages to come.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_003: I have it on good authority that a number of dignitaries will be visiting Ul'dah for the festival. They have a bit more sway in the voting, if you know what I mean, so we really have to make a good impression.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_004: Though not likely to make an appearance in public, talk of a spectacle in town should make them take notice. I've often heard they foster a love for the arts, so a dance of sorts should be to their liking. If they were to hear a dancer is entering the contest, I'm sure they would look favorably upon your doll.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_005: Speaking of which, where did she wander off to this time?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_006: Is it just me, or does she seem...upset about something?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_007: Hm. I must be imagining things. It wouldn't be the first time! But anyway, off with you. I expect good news of your performances around town.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_010: Oh, ... I have a feeling I know why you're here...
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_Q1_000_001: Tell Serendipity you lost the doll?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_011: Haha, no need to fret. She knows to return home when lost. Now off you go, and be sure to enjoy yourself!
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_012: Oh? Everything is fine? Wonderful! Well, off you go, then! Be sure to tell me all about your performance when you return.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_013: There's no need to be nervous. It's not like you'll trip while doing your dance. Why, I remember the time I fell down a flight of stairs practicing a dance for─ Ahem, never mind that. Just do your best and everything will be fine.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SYSTEM_000_020: Take center stage and excite the crowd with a dance.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SYSTEM_000_021: Retrieve the Princess Edvya doll minion from Serendipity before trying to impress the townsfolk.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_GUNSHU_000_022: (-Dark-haired Elezen-)Well, if that ain't the best dancin' I ever did see! No one said anythin' about dancers in the festival. But wait, what's  doin' with a doll?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_GUNSHU_100_022: (-Enticed Onlooker-)Isn't it delightful? The spitting image of Princess Edvya. Oh,  must be entering the contest! Just wait until my friends hear about this.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_GUNSHU_000_023: (-Excited Youth-)What a show! I once said the Miqo'te dancers on Ruby Road were the best in Ul'dah, but now I stand corrected.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_GUNSHU_100_023: (-Enthralled Maiden-)Oh, forget the dance... Look at  doll! The gentle amaranth pink of its dress, accented with hues of peach and creamy white... A masterpiece of dollcraft to be sure. I best cast my vote before the ballot boxes are closed.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_GUNSHU_000_024: (-Beguiled Archer-)Well, well, it would seem someone's been enjoying  this Little Ladies' Day.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_GUNSHU_100_024: (-Enchanted Elezen-)Amazing... The likeness to Princess Edvya is uncanny. And look at her little fan! Have you ever seen anything like it? I know which doll I'm voting for.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_030: Welcome back, . There's been another update of the rankings, and your lead over the other entries grows with every passing hour. It's beyond belief!
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_031: First place is all but assured now, thanks almost entirely to your efforts. As a matter of fact, Eshtaime's Lapidaries has already begun preparations to auction off the princess doll.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_032: Wh-What!? Whatever is the matter with her now? I know she was acting a bit odd before, but this...
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_033: No, this is not good...not good at all. Why, just look at her core! It may very well be beyond repair...
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_034: Gods, I'm going to get an earful for this... Even if victory in the contest is all but assured, who would want to purchase a broken doll? <sigh> I just don't understand what went wrong.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_035:
She...she was the perfect little princess─so warm and full of life! <sob>
...Well, not to say she was actually alive, but you know what I mean. And she always seemed so happy every time you came to─
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_036: But...of course! Why did I not realize it sooner?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_037: Little Ladies' Day is the one time of year when every girl can be a princess, and maybe─if fortune smiles upon her─have her heart's desire granted. Our little princess cared not for fame or riches, . All she wanted...was to be with you.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_038: What a fool I've been! I simply must make amends─yes, we must mend her and set things right. My supplies should be right around...oh, dear. I seem to have exhausted my supply of oil on all of my Little Ladies' Day commissions.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_039: It was no ordinary oil, you see─it was prepared specifically for the princess dolls, extracted from only the freshest of peach blossom petals. I fear what might happen if I leave the doll alone in this state... Please, could you go out and gather some more in my stead?
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_040: She is very delicate and prone to rust in her current immobile state, so please hurry back. Be sure to pick only the most fragrant blossoms you can find.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_050: Please, , tell me you've found blossoms for the repairs. Time is of the essence.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_051: They're beautiful! Positively perfect for the oil we need. Let's get started, then. There's not a moment to lose.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_052: Phew, that should do it. Her core's been reset and gears well lubricated. I only pray we weren't too late to save her...
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_053: Oh, please come back to us! Little Ladies' Day just won't be the same without our little princess.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_054: This can't be happening... I was so careful with the repairs; how can she not be working? <sniffle> I wish there was more I could do, but...I'm so sorry... I've failed you both.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_055: It wasn't supposed to turn out like this, ! She was destined for fame, fortune, and a lavish, loving home fit for a true princess... Only now do I realize...that was never what she truly wanted.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_056: <sigh> In any event, the contest has concluded by now. And since we've heard no news, I can only assume that someone else's doll was crowned prettiest princess. Please forgive me─my thoughtless treatment of my own creation has rendered your hard work for naught.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_057: I intend to reimburse Eshtaime's Lapidaries for the doll, but I would ask one last favor of you. Would you...take her with you? I am loath to ask after all you've already done, but I just couldn't bear to see her cast aside, and besides...I'm quite certain that this is what she would have wanted.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_100_057: Please don't be that way, . After all the time you've spent together, do you mean to say you feel nothing for our little princess? I beg of you, please reconsider.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_059: Oh, joy of joys, ! Our little princess... She's come back to us!
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_060: And she looks no worse for wear despite this whole ordeal. It appears our oh-so-innocent little princess was having a bit of fun with us.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_061: I've every reason to be angry, and yet...why, I feel a tear coming to my eye. To think she would resort to such ends, risking her very life─such as it were─to be with you. Yes, it almost reminds me of something...
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_062: But of course─the legend of Princess Edvya herself! Longing to see the world beyond the palace walls, she disguised herself as a peasant girl and snuck out undetected. I think she would be proud of our clever little princess here.
TEXT_FESPDY006_01307_SERENDIPITY_000_063: Every little lady─even if she's just a doll─deserves the chance to make her dreams come true, wouldn't you say? Yes, I can think of no better way to celebrate the true spirit of Little Ladies' Day. , I leave our little Princess Edvya in your loving care!
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_000: Truly, there is no rest for the weary. Scarce had I begun to make myself at home when I received a request for assistance from Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_001: It would appear their storehouse in Horizon has been the target of a series of covert robberies.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_002: Minor as they seemed in isolation, occasional discrepancies in the manifests were long dismissed as clerical errors. It was only during the Concern's annual audit that a pattern became apparent...
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_003: Significant quantities of crystals─and only crystals─were missing.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_004: I need hardly tell you what that may imply.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_005: The Brass Blades charged with investigating the thefts believe that someone within the Concern is selling the crystals for profit. Alas, they have as yet been unable to identify a likely suspect, and the Concern's proprietors have grown frustrated by their lack of progress.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_006: Needless to say, I would not have agreed to intervene had the stolen goods been of merely monetary value. If there is even a possibility that the thief acts not out of self-interest but in service to a primal, we can ill afford to wait for the Blades to realize their mistake.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_007: Pray depart for Horizon at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_008: Rendezvous with Y'shtola when you arrive. She and Thancred have already begun a preliminary investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_009: I have every confidence that the three of you will get to the bottom of these thefts. I only hope our fears prove unfounded when you do.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_MINFILIA_000_010: When you arrive in Horizon, be sure to speak with Y'shtola. She will inform you as to the latest developments. For my part, I shall continue to speak with the Concern's representatives. They may have additional information which could be of use.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_010: Ah, . Your assistance is most welcome.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_011: I have already spoken at length with the Brass Blades of the Rose─albeit to little avail. It would seem that the thieves took great pains to conceal their activities.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_012: I could go into further detail, but your time might better be spent in conversation with Fufulupa. He is the officer charged with leading the investigation, and I would only be repeating that which he related to me. If aught eluded my attention, mayhap it will not elude yours.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_015: We shall speak anon, . I have a number of theories which I must needs consider further.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_FUFULUPA_000_021: Terrible business, these thefts. We have yet to confirm the quantity of crystals stolen, but I daresay it may be greater than─
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_FUFULUPA_000_022: Ah, but never mind that! I have news to share! A short while ago, the driver of a heavily laden carriage refused to halt for inspection and broke through one of our checkpoints on the Royal Allagan Sunway.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_FUFULUPA_000_023: Alas, my colleagues had no mounts with which to give chase. However, our scouts have reported seeing a cart of the same description bound for eastern Thanalan. These could be our thieves, don't you think!? We must inform Y'shtola at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_030: ...A speeding carriage? That would seem a curious choice for thieves of such proven cunning.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_031: ...Yet the Amalj'aa do have a foothold in eastern Thanalan. Hmmm.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_032: Thancred is already afield with a unit of Brass Blades. I shall instruct him to take up a position to the east of the beastmen's encampment. Pray join him there.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_035: Pray do not tarry, . Should violence erupt, Thancred may require your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_040: Ah, . For once it is you who is fashionably late. We seized the errant carriage and its excitable coachman not long ago.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_041: In all my years, I have never seen such a prodigious quantity of somnus. The Blades were calling it one of the greatest─
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_042: ...Hm? Ah, sadly not. The coachman had no hand in the crystal thefts─and judging by my survey of their encampment, neither did the Amalj'aa. But let's discuss this in Y'shtola's presence, shall we? I'll see you back in Horizon.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_YSHTOLA_000_050: ...And so we find ourselves back where we began. <sigh> What have I overlooked...?
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_050: Against all expectation, it would seem the Amalj'aa are innocent of this particular spate of crimes. By all indications, they have yet to replenish the stores of crystals exhausted during their last attempt to summon Ifrit.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_051: What I can't fathom is why anyone else would go to such lengths to obtain crystals─and in such quantities.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_052: It cannot be that we are dealing with simple thieves. If their motive were profit, why would they limit their trade to crystals alone...? Plainly, we are missing something.
TEXT_GAIUSE201_01345_THANCRED_000_053: While you think about what it might be, I shall inform Urianger of our progress─or lack thereof.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As Lord Lolorito goes, so goes the Syndicate...
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_000: My people could not endure another long sea voyage. But if Ul'dah will not accept us, what choice have we?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_KASASAGI_000_000: “Prone to violence and criminal activity”!? Who is he to speak of us thus? Are we to be punished for sins we may never commit?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_KIKYOU_000_000: Did they not hear Lady Yugiri's pleas? How can they turn us away, knowing what we have endured?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: It bears repeating that Lord Lolorito does not speak for the Syndicate.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_TELEDJIADELEDJI_100: The others harbor doubts, I will allow, but in time they shall see the error of their ways.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_000: As you observed, Lolorito is not afraid to speak his mind─nor is he like to change it.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_001: Oft have I wondered how a man so skilled at weighing the worth of things should be so incapable of seeing the value in people...
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_002: Bah. I will waste no more words on him─not when the Domans are yet in need of aid. Everyone, follow me to the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Hmm... Mayhap I should have considered the likelihood of failure more deeply beforehand.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_010: A galleon is no place for my people─for any people─to call home. This cannot continue.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_KASASAGI_000_010: Is there naught we can do to earn the approval of these Ul'dahns?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_KIKYOU_000_010: We do not wish to live by the grace of others. We want to work; we want to contribute!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: I will not deny that certain portions of the refugee population have been a burden on the sultanate─but I take issue with my counterparts' contention that they account for the majority. In this they are plainly mistaken. Even so, we must not think ill of them for wishing to protect our great nation.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_011: The Syndicate has spoken, and I see no point in moving that the matter be reconsidered. The Monetarists have made their position clear.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Agreed. Ul'dah is not an option.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Nor are Limsa Lominsa or Gridania, I judge, given the state of their internal affairs.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Which leaves our Doman friends confined to a ship. Gods, the thought of them huddled in an airless hold with no hope of better treatment...
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Would that I had more time to find an alternative! A place not bound by the concerns of the great nations─
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Minfilia. ...That is precisely what I wished to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_017: I understand the Syndicate's decision, I do. We all wish to preserve that which is ours, especially when we believe it to be under siege.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_018: But I cannot meekly accept this judgment─not while my people suffer. Would it be out of the question for the sultanate to accept us for a limited time? A week, mayhap, or even just a few days...?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Excellent. I shall keep you informed.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Lady Yugiri, I have a proposal, if you would hear it.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_022: The headquarters of my order, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, stands in a place called Revenant's Toll, an outpost in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Like most outposts, it is frequented by mercenaries and other men of action, and lacks the comforts of more well-established settlements. However, the leaders of Revenant's Toll have been doing their utmost to change that.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_024: To that end, they have need of able-bodied individuals willing to work as frontier hands. Hard labor, lest you doubt, with naught save food and shelter by way of reward.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_025: Terms not unlike those which you yourself proposed, Lady Yugiri.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: Though I will not hear a word said against our beloved Ul'dah, Revenant's Toll would offer certain advantages─the absence of unhelpful bureaucracy being the most obvious.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_027: If they can accommodate us all, we shall gladly accept!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_028: Master Alphinaud, once again I find myself in your debt.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_029: Pray do not thank me, my lady. The life your people go to is one of hard labor and few comforts, as I told you. And before that, there remains the matter of how they may safely be borne to Revenant's Toll─which will be no small feat, considering the distance and their present condition.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Mayhap the Ul'dahn Adventurers' Guild can be of assistance. Look for me there anon, .
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_031: Lady Yugiri, if you and your people would accompany me, we may discuss what aid the Immortal Flames can provide.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_040: We are concerned that the Doman refugees may find the journey to Revenant's Toll too much to bear.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Too long have they been sequestered aboard their ship, with insufficient supplies and scarce room enough to breathe, let alone stretch their limbs. With that in mind, Mistress Momodi has kindly offered to accommodate the Domans until such time as they are ready to set out for Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Those healthy enough to travel will embark as soon as transportation has been secured, while those too weak to leave at once will be permitted to stay until they regain their strength.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Transportation remains our greatest obstacle, General. Is there aught the Immortal Flames can do?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_045: I fear that exceeds our mandate.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_046: Were it a smaller number, mayhap it would go unnoticed.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_047: But the Syndicate will not bear the cost of escorting more than two hundred Domans to Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: When government fails to act, the responsibility falls to us private citizens.
I will engage the services of the Seventy-Seven Caravans on the Domans' behalf.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_RAUBAHN_000_050: Very well─we should begin contract negotiations at once. Your generosity is most welcome, my lord.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: After all that has befallen these good people, it is the least I can do.
Come what may, you shall ever have a friend in Ul'dah, Lady Yugiri.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_YUGIRI_000_053: And you in Revenant's Toll, my lord.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_MOMODI_000_054: Well, it sounds like we all have work to do! Lady Yugiri, let's put our heads together an' settle the details of our arrangement, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Mistress Momodi is quite right. There is much to be done. , I would like you to visit Gigiyon, the Seventy-Seven Caravans representative in Scorpion Crossing, to ensure that everything goes according to plan.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_056: We must leave naught to chance. Go and speak with Gigiyon to confirm the availability of our carriages.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GIGIYON_000_060: Welcome, , welcome! May I say what an honor and a privilege it is to serve you. Our finest carriages have been set aside for your use, and each will be driven by a highly experienced coachman─save, uh...for one.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GIGIYON_000_061: Beg pardon? Why not all of them? Ah... Well, there was an incident, you see─nothing bad, I hasten to add─and I had no choice but to discipline the fellow responsible. Alas, he proved unduly...discouraged by this, and elected to leave our employ. A pity, really─he was so familiar with the route in question. Why, under different circumstances, 'tis very like that I would have chosen him to oversee this very caravan! Ha ha! Ha...ha.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GIGIYON_000_062: Ahem! A thought occurs to me. You are an accomplished adventurer, are you not? Then...mayhap you could go to the Coffer & Coffin and...persuade the fellow in question to return? Needless to say, noble , I would never suggest such a thing were it not in your best interest. It is just that a venture of such import would seem to me to demand the very best, would you not agree?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_065: As I said before─we must leave naught to chance. If this coachman is truly the best, I would have him lead our caravan.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_070: ...Eh? Lead yer 'van? Bugger off! Me drivin' days're done.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_071: Gigiyon saw to that. Wouldn't listen when I tried to tell him what happened. “Report it to the Blades,” he says. <snort> 'Twas the godsdamned Blades what took me stuff in the first place!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_072: To him, it's all excuses an' whinin', o' course. Tells me I've got to pay for the missin' goods out me own bleedin' pocket! The nerve of that bastard!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_073: 'Tweren't only his stuff as got robbed... <sniffle> They...they even took me ring─an' I was gonna give that to me lass, ye know!? <sob> But does he give two shites about me, an' what I lost!? Does he bollocks!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_080: <sniffle> Bugger Gigiyon an' bugger you! What about my problems, eh!? What about me!? <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_081: <sniffle> Bugger Gigiyon an' bugger you! What about my problems, eh!? What about me!? <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_085: Eh? Ye...ye mean to say...ye'll take care of it? Get the stuff back an' everythin'!? Praise the Twelve! Things are finally startin' to look up!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_086: I hear tell the whoresons take it all to somewhere in Nophica's Wells. Shouldn't be too hard to find─'tain't like they've got to hide their doin's, bein' Blades an' all.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_087: But ye'd best be careful, ─they ain't like to return what they took just 'cause ye ask polite.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_088: Oh, an' watch out fer the big lad! Ye'll know him when ye see him.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_DOUJINDAN1348_000_0: ...I don't like your face, . Makes me want to do things to it. And I reckon my mates feel the same way. Ain't that right, lads!?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_POP_MESSAGE: You hear several sets of approaching footsteps...
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_BALLOON_000_091: Useless weaklings! Out of the way!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_BALLOON_000_092: Wh-Who is this ─the bloody Warrior of Light !?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_DOUJINDAN1348_000_0: I yield, I yield! It's all yours! Just don't hurt me, please!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_100: Eh? Ohhh, it's you! Any luck findin' them Blades what robbed me?
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_101: Twelve bless ye, ! Now I can settle me accounts with Gigiyon!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GYOSHA01348_000_102: I'll make me way to Scorpion Crossin' straightaway. Lookin' forward to workin' with ye!
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GIGIYON_000_110: The  of the hour! I hoped you might persuade him to return, but to go so far as to recover the stolen shipment... I must say, that was a welcome surprise.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_GIGIYON_000_111: Pray inform Master Alphinaud that our preparations are complete, and we await his orders.
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_120: No further delays, I trust? Excellent. I should leave more tasks in your capable hands. On which note...
TEXT_GAIUSE204_01348_ALPHINAUD_000_121: The Hourglass is now ready to receive the Domans, which means our next order of business is to ensure their safe passage to Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As we speak, the Domans are being ferried to Vesper Bay, after which they will be transported by carriage to Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Alas, while our plans have proceeded relatively smoothly until now, efforts to coordinate the refugees' preparations have met with less success.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_ALPHINAUD_000_002: , I would have you return to Vesper Bay and facilitate the process through tasks great and small. In short: whatever must needs be done, do it.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Speak with Hozan when you arrive. He has been designated the leader of the first group.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I know that these tasks may seem trifling at times. However, they are vital to ensuring the safety of the refugees for their pending journey.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_010: Greetings. Alphinaud informed me that a Scion would be arriving to help with the preparations. I am honored to meet you, though shamed as well. A great warrior should not be tasked with such trivialities.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_011: Aye, I knew from a glance what manner of  you were. I too have some skill at arms, as do many of our people.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_012: Little good it does us when our enemies are the elements and starvation. An act so simple as carrying a heavy crate is beyond the capabilities of our healthiest men, believe it or not.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_013: Pray forgive this trifle, but would you bring to me the aforementioned crate on the docks? There is no one else to whom I can turn.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_015: Brought low by a crate─hah! It almost beggars belief. Alas, I speak true when I say we cannot carry it ourselves. If you would be so kind, please bring it to me.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_020: Is that the crate I spy in your arms? Pray give it to me quickly─the contents are dear.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_021: Hurk! I thought my strength somewhat restored, but that clearly is not the case...
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_022: By the gods, the armor! How could this have happened!?
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_023: 'Twas bestowed upon my father for feats of valor. Every scale forged by a master smith, guaranteed to withstand the test of time─or so we thought.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_024: The armor must have shifted within its confines during the long sea voyage. Many scales have come loose, and there are holes in the bottom of the crate...through which the four missing scales I count must have fallen.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_025: It can be repaired in time, but only if we recover those scales. Please, , retrace your steps and collect any scales you come across.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_026: Only four scales appear to be missing. If we are fortunate, they but recently slipped through the holes in the crate and are somewhere between here and the docks.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_030: I know not how I can face my father should those scales be forever lost...
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_031: Bless you, ; I am in your debt. All that remains of Doma now are our mementos and memories.
TEXT_GAIUSE205_01349_HOUZAN_000_032: I can only hope that when such keepsakes are lost to us, those memories will be enough...
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_000: While you were seeing to that crate, the other members of my group finished preparing their belongings for shipment. Once all of the carriages arrive, we can begin loading.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_001: Oh, but you needn't concern yourself with that! We can manage with the coachmen's help.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_002: Rather, I would like you to help round up the children that have been given into my care. My son Yozan can tell you more.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_005: These have been trying times, but Yozan has handled himself well. I only wish there were more I could do for him.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_YOUZAN_000_010: Oh, hello there! I'm Yozan, son of Hozan. Will you be coming with us to Ul'dah? I hear we're traveling by horsebird-drawn carriage!
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_YOUZAN_000_011: But...don't you think they're queer? Giant birds that people ride like horses? I still want to try riding one, but─
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_YOUZAN_000_012: What's that? You're looking for the others? Don't worry. I already told them to get ready for the carriages.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_YOUZAN_000_013: I'll need your help, though. We were just finishing a game of hide-and-seek. Three players are still in hiding, and since Lady Yugiri told us to take it really seriously, they won't move until they're found. But Vesper Bay isn't that big, so I bet you can find them in no time!
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_KOHARU_000_020: Hey! You're not Yozan! Who're you?
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_KOHARU_000_021: (-Koharu-)I'm Koharu. , eh? I didn't know anyone else was─ Waaait a minute! You're one of those, um, Stallions, aren't you!?
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_KOHARU_000_022: (-Koharu-)No─ Scions, Scions! Then you must know Lady Yugiri, right? Isn't she great!? She's really good at hide-and-seek, too! Oh, right─ It's almost time to go. Nice meeting you, !
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_CHILD01350A_000_020: How'd you find me!? Bah! Guess I need to practice more.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_CHILD01350A_000_021: Or maybe you're just good at this? I mean, the Garleans didn't find me...
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_CHILD01350B_000_020: Um... Are you playing? Ahhh! No fair! Yozan didn't say anything about adults!
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_CHILD01350B_000_021: Huh? We get to ride a horsebird carriage? I don't know... It sounds scary. But if Yozan says it's safe, I'll go.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_030: Wonderful! All the children are accounted─ Hide-and-seek? Ah, I see that you are curious. It is quite simple, really.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_031: Lady Yugiri thought it best that the children know what to do in case the Garleans found us.
TEXT_GAIUSE206_01350_HOUZAN_000_032: I should hope that those days are behind us, but I nevertheless take comfort in knowing that we are prepared.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_000: All of the carriages have arrived, but my father... <sigh> Stubborn to the last, he is refusing to leave.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_001: 'Tis the smell of the chocobos. Many of us find it difficult to bear, but he cannot abide it.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_002: To be honest, I find it odd that I've yet to meet an Eorzean who shares our sentiments─other than the waitress at the Pissed Peiste.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_003: Hmmm... Mayhap she has a means to address the smell. Might you go and see what she knows?
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_005: Any advice you can glean would be of great value. As I said, my father is not alone in his revulsion.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_FOLCLIND_000_010: The Domans are sickened by how chocobos smell? Hah, I know just how they feel! Carriage rides make me more queasy than boat rides because of that alone.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_FOLCLIND_000_011: Why not try using this perfume to mask the smell? I can't promise it'll help, though. I swore off carriages ages ago. Too much vomiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_021: (-Hyuran Coachman-)Oi! What in the seven hells're ye doin' to me birds!? Dousin' 'em with gods-know-what alchemical concoctions... That ain't right!
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_022: (-Hyuran Coachman-)They're skittish creatures at heart! Get 'em riled up, an' they're liable to go every which way but the one ye want. Explain yerself!
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_023: (-Hyuran Coachman-)...Hmph. Well, what's done is done. Reckon ye'd best make sure it did the trick afore ye call the old man over, though. Get in there an' take a good, long whiff. Don't be shy now.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_024: (-Hyuran Coachman-)What are ye waitin' fer, an invitation? Go on an' sniff that chocobo. Make sure ye take a nice, deep breath─really suck it all in. Gotta be sure now.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_030: (-Hyuran Coachman-)Bwahahaha! Like some vial o' flower water'd cover up a chocobo's musk! Bless yer heart, .
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_031: (-Hyuran Coachman-)Yer goin' 'bout this the wrong way. Rather than pourin' perfume on everythin' what offends yer olfactory senses, just do it like the gobbies do.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_040: (-Hyuran Coachman-)What, ye don't ken me meanin', or ye ain't never traded tongueflaps with a gobbie trader?
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_041: (-Hyuran Coachman-)I'm talkin' 'bout their masks, . Gobbies don't care much fer the air 'round these parts, hence why they wear 'em contraptions. They pack 'em with herbs an' whatnot.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_042: (-Hyuran Coachman-)Here, take this scarf, splash a few drops of that there perfume on it, an' tell the old man to tie it 'round his face like so. 'Course, ye'd better hope he doesn't hate the perfume, too!
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_GYOSHA01348_000_045: (-Hyuran Coachman-)It ain't a proper gobbie mask, but it's a damn sight better than nothin'.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_050: Try as I might, I cannot convince my father to board the carriage. Have you any ideas how we might deal with the chocobos' smell?
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_051: Of course, why did I not think of that? Such a simple, elegant solution.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_052: We should take this to my father at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUMEI_000_060: <sniff> <sniff> If I close my eyes, I can remember what it was like before. <sniff> <sniff> Yes... Just like that...
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_060: 'Twas happy coincidence that Folclind's perfume was made from peach blossoms. At first my father scoffed, but one sniff was enough to put his mind at ease.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_061: Oh, if only you could have seen our orchards. So vast, so vibrant. Foreign merchants clamored for our fruits, so great was our reputation.
TEXT_GAIUSE207_01351_HOUZAN_000_062: ...It is past time that we move on. The carriages are waiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It is past time Lady Yugiri met with the guild representatives in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Since I do not foresee any further matters arising here in Thanalan which might require your personal attention, I would instead have you serve as an escort to the Doman delegation for the duration of the journey.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Speak first with Slafborn upon your arrival. He is the one with whom the Domans will be working most closely, I should think.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Afterwards, introduce Lady Yugiri to Minfilia and the guild emissary. If both meetings go well, the resulting ties should stand the Domans in good stead for that which is to come. Safe travels, .
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_005: We are ready to depart at your earliest convenience. But say the word and we shall follow.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_KSASAGI_000_005: Many great and terrible beasts roam the wastes of Mor Dhona, yes? Then we must needs keep a closer eye on the children.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_KIKYOU_000_005: I hope this proves to be the final leg of our journey... The malms have taken their toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SLAFBORN_000_010: And this must be the esteemed Lady Yugiri and her associates. I greet you all as friends, and bid you welcome to the Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SLAFBORN_000_011: I hope you do not find our dearth of fineries off-putting. Poor though we may seem, we have a wealth of spirit─and camaraderie to spare!
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SLAFBORN_000_012: You see, race and creed don't enter into it here. We welcome all sorts─provided they are willing to earn their keep, of course.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_013: We are no strangers to hard work, Master Slafborn. You may rest assured that we will carry out your orders with due diligence.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SLAFBORN_000_014: Oh, not for a moment did I doubt your commitment, my lady! Pray understand, I give the same speech to all new arrivals. And you needn't bow your head or call me “Master” either. We are both frontier hands, as far as I'm concerned.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_015: As you wish...Slafborn. May this meeting mark the beginning of a long and fruitful relationship.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SLAFBORN_000_016: Our guests have yet to meet the Antecedent? Seven hells, , why are you wasting time with me!? See them to the Rising Stones!
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_KSASAGI_000_018: The sentries appear more than capable... Even so, it may be best to forbid people from venturing beyond the walls unescorted─for the time being, at least.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_KIKYOU_000_018: At long last, we have an opportunity to prove our worth. You shan't regret this, .
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_020: To whom much is given, much is expected...
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_021: Forgive me─I require a moment to compose my thoughts before meeting with your leader. We shall join you at the Rising Stones anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_025: The Rising Stones is in the Seventh Heaven, yes? We shall follow anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_031: Our attempts to reach the Students of Baldesion continue to meet with failure. Urianger has explored other avenues of inquiry, but they too have yielded naught.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_032: We will persevere, of course...yet within our hearts, the truth is clear. We are but awaiting confirmation of that which we already know.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_033: How fare the Domans? I am given to understand you were kept quite busy in Vesper Bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_034: Mayhap you question the wisdom of aiding refugees when the primal threat remains unresolved.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_035: I should not blame you if you did. Nor would I deny that this matter falls outside our normal purview. Be that as it may, I could not ignore the plight of these refugees─not when it was within our power to help them.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_036: Lady Yugiri is here? Please, show her in. I should very much like to meet her.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_037: We have no objections. Pray do so with our blessing.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_038: Your answer pleases me beyond words, my lady─but are you quite certain? We have no way of knowing how many might answer my summons.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_YUGIRI_000_039: In the event that Revenant's Toll could not accommodate us all, we would need to find an alternative solution.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_MINFILIA_000_040: Should that come to pass, we will find it together.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SISHA01353_000_041: As ever, it has been a pleasure, Antecedent. Alas, we must take our leave as the first carriages are due to arrive at any moment.
TEXT_GAIUSE209_01353_SISHA01353_000_042: Should you require aught else, pray speak with Slafborn. Lady Yugiri, .
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_MINFILIA_000_000: I pray the Domans' journey has been uneventful. They have endured too much hardship, and for far too long...
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_MINFILIA_000_001: Ah, forgive me─there was another matter I wished to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_MINFILIA_000_002: My mother was to see to it that the Domans received a welcome supper. Now that the first group is nearly here, would you go and see if she is in need of assistance?
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_MINFILIA_000_005: I should think that Lhaminn has everything well in hand, but it would put my mind at ease if you were to go and check on her.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_FLHAMINN_000_010: Hello again, . To what do I owe the pleasure?
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_FLHAMINN_000_011: Ah, ever the worrier, my Ascilia. The Seventh Heaven should have the meals ready by now, though I believe they have yet to be delivered.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_FLHAMINN_000_012: Would you mind speaking with Alys to be sure? Oh, and take this wine with you─the adults will appreciate it.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_FLHAMINN_000_015: You should speak to Alys about those meals. And don't forget to take the wine with you!
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_ALYS_000_020: What'll it be? Wine, or something stronger?
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_ALYS_000_021: How very kind of you to volunteer your help! Here, take these meals to the emissary's assistant outside the northern gates. She'll handle distribution.
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_ALYS_000_025: Best deliver those meals while they're hot. And don't you dare take any for yourself!
TEXT_GAIUSE210_01354_HONBUBOUKENSHA01354: As you can see, the Domans but recently arrived. I was assured we would have food and drink by now, but we've yet to receive aught from the Seventh Heaven.
Ah, excellent. Many thanks, . While they had rations to sate their hunger during the journey, there is no substitute for a freshly cooked meal.

I must say, I was not expecting you of all people to deliver these. Far be it from me to question your organization's delegation of duties, but surely there are other tasks better suited to your talents...
Though, on further consideration, I should probably consider this a blessing. We've a situation which would benefit from your personal attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_HONBUBOUKENSHA01354: Mayhap you have already heard, but the lake cobras that inhabit the area along the road to Saint Coinach's Find have multiplied to plague-like proportions of late.

This wasn't a concern for us in the past, as only proven adventurers tend to gather in Revenant's Toll. However, with the recent arrival of the Doman refugees, among which are the elderly and the young both...
Suffice it to say, it would not do for our newly arrived guests to fall prey to the local fauna. For their sake, would you be so kind as to rid us of these rampant cobras?
The creatures have made nests amongst the broken pieces of the imperial airship. You can use these slices of rancid eft meat to lure them out.
How fares the cobra culling? In case you have forgotten, the creatures have made nests amongst the broken pieces of the imperial airship. The rancid eft meat ought to lure them out.
So the culling is done? Thank you! You have done us all a great service!

While you were afield tending to that business, I saw that the Domans were fed. They are weary from their long journey, and the memory of their lost homeland is heavy in their hearts. Yet I daresay I sensed a glimmer of hope in their bearing. In time, they may yet regain a semblance of inner peace.
Oh, I ought to mention that something seemed to be afoot over at the Rising Stones. Lest you be absent for a matter of import, it may be well to report back.
TEXT_GAIUSE211_01355_POP_MESSAGE: With a flurry of hisses, the enemy strikes!
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_000: As you may already know, Maelstrom scouts have been dispatched to reconnoiter the Sapsa Spawning Grounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_001: Among other things, they have orders to determine where Leviathan might emerge...assuming it comes to that.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_002: That our scouts might move unhindered and return unscathed, diversionary maneuvers are presently underway.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_003: In charge of these maneuvers is U'jughal. If you are otherwise unoccupied, mayhap you would be willing to offer her your aid.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_005: That our scouts might move unhindered and return unscathed, diversionary maneuvers are presently underway. If you would lend a hand, pray speak with U'jughal.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_UJUGHAL_000_010: You're here to help with the diversions? Aren't you supposed to be that irreplaceable adventurer the success of the operation is hinging on?
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_UJUGHAL_000_011: I'm inclined to say it's not worth risking your neck for something so trifling such as this, but if the hero insists, who am I to argue?
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_UJUGHAL_000_012: Here, take these explosives! Use them to blow the Sahagin pavises sky-high, and create a commotion in Halfstone the likes of which the fishbacks have never seen! That ought to keep them good and occupied.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_UJUGHAL_000_013: Oh, and in the event that the Sahagin come after you, there's no need to be shy. Stay around, get yourselves acquainted─whatever it takes to buy more time for our scouts.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_POP_MESSAGE: The Sahagin have been alerted to your presence!
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_BALLOON_000_017:
Tonight you'll sssleep
with the fishhhes!
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_020: It sounds like the diversion was a success. Aye, I heard the fireworks all the way over here. My thanks, friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE213_01357_FALKBRYDA_000_021: We've done all we can for our scouts. All that's left is to pray that they return safely.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SYSTEM_100_000: Eorzea is currently celebrating Hatching-tide. Adventurers wishing to partake in the festivities may do so in Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, or Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SYSTEM_110_000: The rewards will be the same regardless of venue, so do not hesitate to join the celebration in the nation of your choice.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Greetings, friend. I take it the vibrant assortment of eggs here has piqued your curiosity.
Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Jihli Aliapoh, and these eggs are for the celebration of Hatching-tide, which is nigh upon us.

The tradition began several years ago, after I was blessed with a vision by the Twelve Archons of ages past. These heroes are said to have lived through the Sixth Umbral Calamity, fighting bravely against an encroaching darkness that would have otherwise seen to the realm's destruction.

Descending from the heavens atop brilliantly colored eggs, they delivered a message unto me which, to this day, burns brightly in my mind:
“Rise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessel for our return.”

My purpose in life was made clear, and so I set out to prepare their vessels─beautiful eggs bedecked with the same exquisite designs as seen in my vision. A laborious task for one person, to be sure, but I would not be alone in this endeavor for long.

In time, other believers would join my cause, and come to be known as Dreamers. Years have passed since our vigil began, and still they remain by my side, awaiting the return of those fabled Archons of yore.

And so every year during Hatching-tide, we gather here with eggs to serve as their vessels. They have yet to appear before us, but I believe this year will be different. For it was by their grace the realm survived the Sixth Umbral Calamity, and I am sure they had a hand in our survival of the Seventh.
That's right, my friend, the time has come for the Twelve Archons to return, and their vessels will soon be ready!
If you would join in our celebration, you must first acquire a traditional headpiece. Though this tradition is still quite young, it is an integral part of the proceedings, as you will soon discover.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_00: There are several to choose from, but let us start with something simple yet festive─a pristine egg cap should suit you nicely.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: But do not worry, there is no need for payment. Simply speak with the Dreamers and they will be more than happy to supply you with a headpiece.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Are you not excited? To think your first celebration of Hatching-tide will herald the return of such legendary heroes! Now, run along and retrieve an egg cap from one of the Dreamers. I will be here waiting for you.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SHOPGURIDANIA_000_0: I heard, I heard! You have come to join in the festivities! Haha, haha! Here, take this pristine egg cap to start you on your way. And may the Archons of yore bless you and keep you!
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_POPMESSAGE_000_019: You obtain a pristine egg cap.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SHOPLIMSA_000_018: I take it you have decided to join in the festivities? Excellent! Here is a pristine egg cap to start you on your way. May the Archons of yore bless you and keep you.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_SHOPURUDAHA_000_018: I take it you have decided to join in the festivities? Excellent! Here is a pristine egg cap to start you on your way. May the Archons of yore bless you, and keep you.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: This year's Hatching-tide is sure to be an unforgettable experience, so you'll want to be prepared.
One of my fellow Dreamers will gladly lend you a pristine egg cap, so there is no need to be shy.
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_01: Now, hurry along. You want to look your best at Hatching Hour, do you not?
TEXT_FESEST001_01414_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: Well, well! Don't we look splendid with our festival cap?
I think we're just about ready to begin! But before we do, I would ask the name of the budding Dreamer who stands before me. , is it?

Well, , there is still time until Hatching Hour. Might I suggest a bit of egg hunting to pass the time? This is Hatching-tide, after all, and no one can truly say they have celebrated this day without partaking in an egg hunt.
Bear in mind, however, this is no simple ramble about Gridania. Eggs have been hidden in fields all across Eorzea, each containing a different prize.

Three types have been hidden for the hunt: bronze, silver, and golden! Bronze eggs are the most common of the three, and it will be a laborious task to obtain the rarer sort. Golden eggs are without question the rarest, with rewards as precious as the gilded containers that bear them.

TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_001: It is the time of Hatching-tide, and soon the heroes of eld will walk among us once more! Surely, you know the prophecy of which I speak?
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_002: Several years ago, Jihli Aliapoh was blessed with a vision from the Twelve Archons of ages past, sages said to have spared the realm from destruction during the Sixth Umbral Calamity.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_003:

TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_004: Can you imagine what would happen if these Archons returned to Eorzea?
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_005: Truth be told, I thought very little of this vision when I first caught wind of it. But seeing her work with such spirit─such passion─intrigued me, to say the least. Before long, I too would become a Dreamer, and now I work to spread the good word.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_006: Although we have yet to see the Twelve Archons, we have reason to believe this will be the year they make themselves known to us!
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_007: I find it no coincidence that Jihli Aliapoh's vision occurred shortly before the Seventh Umbral Calamity. If they have indeed returned, then surely they played some part in saving us from the most recent Calamity. Trust me when I say that this year's Hatching-tide will see the Twelve Archons' return.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_008: You will join us in the celebration, won't you? If so, you will need to wear a traditional festival cap. Even though Hatching-tide is a relatively new tradition, there will be no leniency for those who fail to adhere to its rules.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_009: Simply speak with my fellow Dreamers, and they will be more than happy to offer you a pristine egg cap for the celebration.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_100_009: As for what festivities to expect during Hatching-tide, I can think of no one better than Jihli Aliapoh herself to explain the finer details.
TEXT_FESEST002_01415_OSCARLET_000_010: I suggest donning your cap before speaking with her, though, that she may know your intentions right away. She can be found in Gridania─arms ever open to those who would welcome the return of the Twelve Archons of yore.

“Rise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessel for our return.”
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_004: And with those words, she began gathering eggs to serve as their means of returning to Eorzea, laying the foundation for what we know to be Hatching-tide.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_005: I stand here before you a Dreamer, like Jihli Aliapoh and the many others who work to prepare for the Archons' return, and we have reason to believe this will be the year of their rebirth.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_006: I realize how outlandish this may sound, but take a moment to consider recent happenings in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_007: The realm was spared during the Sixth Umbral Calamity by the power of the Twelve Archons. In light of Jihli Aliapoh's vision, 'twould make sense if they had also played a part in saving us from the Seventh! Truly, this year's celebration will be glorious, and you are welcome to join us in our revelry.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_008: But, before you can begin, you will need to don a festival cap. Make no mistake, friend: though the tradition is still quite young, we do not take kindly to those who would make light of its rules.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_009: A pristine egg cap should do the trick. You can acquire one from one of my fellow Dreamers, but there is no need for coin. Your enjoyment of Hatching-tide is payment enough.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_100_009: As for how to enjoy oneself during the celebration, I believe that explanation is best left to Jihli Aliapoh herself.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_010: You will find her in Gridania, though I would suggest you place your cap firmly atop your head before speaking with her. She is expecting your arrival, and the cap will serve to discern you from other adventurers in town.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_015: The return of the Twelve Archons is not an event to be missed. I trust you will not be idling here during Hatching Hour.
TEXT_FESEST003_01416_ORSELFAUX_000_016: I have sent word of your departure to Gridania, but do not forget to wear your pristine egg cap when speaking to her.

TEXT_FESEST004_01417_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Hello there, ! Have you had your fill of egg hunting? I certainly hope so, because I have much and more to discuss with you.

Hmmm... The question now is where to begin? You see, before I began preparations for this year's celebration, I was granted another vision. Long has it been since the Twelve Archons have seen fit to bless me with their foresight.

I dreamt of a resplendent ring of eggs, shining with an intensity that would inspire jealousy from the stars. From within this ring arose a figure bathed in light. Although I could not clearly discern who it was, I knew it was one of the heroes of yore for whom I have waited all these years.

I immediately put to paper the egg designs from my vision, that our finest craftsmen could prepare the vessels we require. They were finished not long ago, and were to be shipped here in time for the ceremony, but...
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_004: (-???-)It would appear a band of spriggans has made off with the Archon eggs.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_005: Pardon the intrusion. I take it you are here to assist in the recovery of our eggs? I am Maisenta of Black Rabbit Traders. I've been assisting with the distribution of goods for the egg hunt.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_006: As you can imagine, a great number of eggs have been transported back and forth between the three city-states in preparation for Hatching-tide. The spriggans─with their insatiable need for small, ovoid objects─have taken notice, and are stealing any eggs they can find, including the Archon eggs.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Have my Dreamers not yet ascertained their whereabouts?
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_008: Well, two of the eggs were recovered in Treespeak not long ago and were carried to the Yellow Serpent Gate. Unsurprisingly, however, the spriggans who stole the eggs in the first place immediately gave chase, and have since infiltrated Gridania. I can only assume they mean to take them back.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Ah! , we cannot let them have the vessels! You must retrieve the Archon eggs and bring them here for safekeeping. Though, before you go, there is something you must know... It concerns the festival headpiece you received from my Dreamers.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: In the vision that blessed me with patterns to be used for the Archon eggs, there was also a warning: the vessels may only be touched by those who bear their mark.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_011: We thought it prudent to adhere to this warning when bringing the eggs to the Yellow Serpent Gate, and two of my men retrieved them wearing caps provided by the Dreamers. Unfortunately, our hands are now full handling the spriggan incursion.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_012: If you'd help us, we need you to retrieve a pristine and a vibrant Archon egg, so make sure you're equipped with the right headgear. If you're lacking the proper cap, you can purchase one from the Dreamers.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_100_012: As for the spriggans that still linger here in Gridania, I have an idea. Because you may only carry the egg which bears the pattern of your cap, attempting to carry both will make you an easy target for the spriggans.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_013: But if you were to join forces with another adventurer, I imagine the spriggans would have trouble chasing you both. Before you make your way to the Yellow Serpent Gate, one of you will need to wear a pristine egg cap, and the other a vibrant egg cap.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Ha! Truly, this is to be a chase long remembered! Now, off you go, and speak with Augustiniel when you arrive at the Yellow Serpent Gate. He's been charged with protecting the eggs, but I fear it will not be long before the spriggans find him.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_MAISENTA_000_015: We're counting on you, adventurer! There can be no Hatching-tide without those eggs.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: When you have found a companion to assist you, please make haste to the Yellow Serpent Gate.
If you require a pristine egg cap or vibrant egg cap to carry the sacred vessels, speak with one of my Dreamers.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_020: I apologize, friend, but I have no time for small talk. I have been charged with the protection of these eggs until their carriers arrive.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_021: If you should come across a pair of adventurers, one wearing a pristine egg cap and the other a vibrant egg cap, direct them here immediately. Time is of the essence!

TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_022: Welcome, comrades! By your headwear, there is no doubt my dear Miss Aliapoh sent you, and not a moment too soon. I trust, then, you have heard the good word.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_023: Hmmm? I can't say I follow your friend there, but surely you must know of the word.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_024: No, not birds, my friend, the eggs─the Archon eggs to be precise. They were retrieved from Treespeak without a scratch, and are ready for transport to their final destination.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_025: I have managed to keep the eggs safe thus far, but for lack of an assistant and a pair of egg caps, I dare not attempt to take them further. You and your friend here certainly seem capable of outmaneuvering a few spriggans, though.
TEXT_FESEST004_01417_AUGUSTINIEL_000_026: I leave the eggs in your hands. But be mindful of your caps, lest you offend the heroes for which this day was founded.

TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_100_010: Hello there, friend. Are you by chance the adventurer Miss Aliapoh has sent to assist with the eggs? You resemble the  she described, but she also mentioned a pristine egg cap. Excuse my ramblings, I must be mistaken.

TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_011: Well, you'll be happy to know we found the two eggs not long ago at Costa del Sol, just as she foresaw them.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_012: Augustiniel, the audacious fellow that he is, insisted that he and his partner be the ones to see them brought into Limsa, although I daresay he's gotten in over his head this time.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_013: Spriggans followed them in through the Tempest Gate, but somehow they managed their way to the Coral Tower. Augustiniel was injured in the process, but I would say he did quite well in comparison to his partner. The poor lad will be in the infirmary for weeks.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_014: At any rate, with only one way in or out of the Coral Tower, it would not bode well for Augustiniel to be found with the eggs in his condition. TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_016: When you've found your companion, proceed to the Coral Tower and see the eggs are delivered here posthaste.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_017: And please, do not forget to wear your caps. It is important that we abide by Hatching-tide tradition.

TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_041: I admit this location is not without its dangers until the spriggans are gone, but it will do the people of Limsa well to see the Archon eggs out in the open.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_042: It is believed the eggs are nurtured by the hearts and minds of Dreamers as they bask in the warmth of the sun. No good would come of locking them away in the Coral Tower. If anything, it would dampen the spirits of our resident Dreamers.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_043: Worry not of the spriggans, friend. We will see them driven out.
