She is surely beside herself with anticipation of news, and it would do her heart good to know the eggs are safe.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_OSCARLET_000_044: Your work is done here, friend. Be sure to tell Miss Aliapoh of the news, that her mind may be put at ease.
TEXT_FESEST005_01418_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: Ah, , you have returned! Have Oscarlet and his men secured the Archon eggs?
Oh joyous day! There is hope for this year's Hatching-tide yet.
There are but a few eggs left to be found for the celebration, and with your assistance, I am sure they will be recovered without incident.
Your actions have brought hope to many and more who await the return of our beloved Archons of old. I believe I speak for all of my Dreamers when I say you have earned a respite this day.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Greetings, ! I hope you are well rested from your run through Limsa.
It gives me great pleasure to inform you of my most recent vision─a vision of the final set of Archon eggs waylaid by the spriggans!

Buried in sand, I nearly mistook their location for a beach along Lominsan shores...but then I saw turtles! Monstrous beasts the size of a small cottage. Consultation with Dreamers far more knowledgeable of wildlife than I revealed they were hidden in Zanr'ak in southern Thanalan.

I received word not long ago that they have been retrieved, though not without interference by the spriggans. I can think of no one better to see to the security of the eggs, and so I would ask that you make haste to Ul'dah and speak with Orselfaux. He oversees the Hatching-tide festivities there.
He will be expecting you, but I would suggest wearing your pristine egg cap, that he may readily know of your intentions.
We must secure the last set of eggs before Hatching Hour! Please make haste to Ul'dah and speak with Orselfaux.
Tarry not, ! Orselfaux is expecting your arrival in Ul'dah. And be sure to wear your headpiece when you greet him!
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_010: I would love to chat, but I'm waiting on someone for important business. I do wonder where  could be...
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_015: Ah, welcome, welcome. I take it Miss Aliapoh has sent you regarding the Archon eggs.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_016: Well, you'll be happy to know they arrived in Ul'dah , although I wish Augustiniel would not push himself so.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_017: He was injured in Limsa Lominsa, was he not? You would think the man would see his wounds heal before undertaking more duties, but he insisted on helping deliver the eggs to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_018: I know he means well, but it sounds as though he could barely stand. Having traveled such a long way, in the heat of Thanalan? I would say his chances of success were slim at best.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_019: To make matters worse, a band of spriggans has breached the gates of Ul'dah, and I suspect he and his partner are in no condition to keep the eggs safe. I would ask that you seek him out on the Steps of Thal and, if necessary, move the eggs in their stead.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_020: They were charged with delivery of a pristine Archon egg and a midnight Archon egg, so you will need another adventurer to assist you. A cap matching the eggs is required, yes? You may purchase one from one of my fellow Dreamers if need be, then proceed to the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_021: Augustiniel should be somewhere on the Steps of Thal guarding the pristine Archon egg and midnight Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_022: When you and your partner each have a cap, please see that both Augustiniel and the eggs are safe.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_030: Well, hello there. I take it Orselfaux sent you to find me.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_035: The eggs are safe for the moment, but they've yet to reach their destination at the Gold Court, and I'm in no condition to move them. If you're looking to assist, you'll need to find a friend to help carry one of the eggs.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_100_035: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are too far away.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_100_036: You cannot proceed. One or more party members must equip the appropriate egg cap.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_036: Thank heavens! You are just the  I wanted to see. And you have a friend with you, excellent.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_037: As you can see behind me, we retrieved another set of eggs for the celebration, but in the process, a group of spriggans gave chase into the city before we could reach a safe location.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_038: My partner and I would have done the job ourselves, but before I knew it, my legs had given out from under me, and he has since gone in search of aid, though where he went I cannot say. So here I sit, guarding the eggs.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_039: Please say you will help us. I fear there is little time before the spriggans find out this location.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_040: You and your friend will need to carry the pristine Archon egg and midnight Archon egg to the Gold Court. I trust you have the proper caps for the job. There should be two Dreamers there awaiting your arrival. Stay safe, and be wary of the spriggans here on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_000_041: Carry the Archon egg back to the Gold Court while your arms and legs still have strength.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_000_042: Beware the spriggans lying in wait around the Steps of Thal. Being caught en route to the Gold Court will result in failure.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_000_043: You have 180 seconds to reach your destination. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_045: No need to concern yourself with me. Just make sure the eggs make it safely to the Gold Court.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_AUGUSTINIEL_000_046: The spriggans could be anywhere, so be careful.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_000_047: You must be wearing a pristine egg cap to carry this egg.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_100_047: You must be wearing a midnight egg cap to carry this egg.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SPRIGAN_000_048: You have shiny egg! Shiny pretty egg! Give shiny pretty eeeeeegg! Eeeeeegg!
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SPRIGAN_100_048: Shiiiiiiny! Preeeeeetty! Need more eeeeeeggs! Eeeeeeggs!
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_000_049: This basket seems suitable to hold a pristine Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_SYSTEM_100_049: This basket seems suitable to hold a midnight Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_TAMAGOGARD_110_049: Hello . Perchance you have seen someone carrying a rather large egg nearby? I am to keep watch over one of the Archon eggs for this year's celebration, but it has yet to be delivered. I pray it arrives soon.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_TAMAGOGARD_120_049: Oh, thank heavens you have arrived. I was beginning to worry the Archon eggs had been lost to those horrible spriggans. I will see that this egg remains secure. Please let Orselfaux know that it is in good hands now.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_TAMAGOGARD_130_049: Fear not, friend. I am much more formidable than I may appear. The spriggans will not lay a furry finger on this egg.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_050: Welcome back! I see you managed to outmaneuver the spriggans scurrying about the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_051: Thanks to you, we now have the last set of Archon Eggs required for Hatching Hour, and our timing today could not be better. These eggs have yet had time to be warmed by the good wishes of the Dreamers here in Ul'dah. When the time is right, we will see them safely shipped to Gridania.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_052: Once the spriggans have been expelled from Ul'dah, there will finally be time to look after the egg stocks for this year's festivities.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_053: Perhaps now I can also persuade Augustiniel to rest until preparations for the ceremony are complete.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_054: Anyroad, as much as I would love to see Miss Aliapoh's face upon hearing of today's success, I will leave that honor to you, friend. I must ensure the eggs remain safe until sent to Gridania, as well as take care of a certain overzealous Dreamer.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_ORSELFAUX_000_055: Thank you again for your assistance today, friend. Give my regards to Miss Aliapoh in Gridania.
TEXT_FESEST006_01419_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: My dear ! It gladdens my heart to see you safe and sound. I could not believe my ears when I heard the news, but your presence proves the messenger's words to be true.
Ahahaha! I simply cannot wait! Soon the Archons of ages past will return, and at long last the realm may know peace. There are no words to express my gratitude.
Time still remains until Hatching Hour, but it might be best if you remained close at hand. I am certain this is a celebration you wish to be present for.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: <sob> Oh, ... Something... <sniffle> Something horrible has happened.

The eggs have been stolen! All of our efforts to retrieve them, wasted... The time of Hatching Hour is nearly upon us, but the Twelve Archons cannot return if they have no vessels. I fear my vision has been proven false.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_002: (-???-)It may yet be proven true, my dear Miss Aliapoh!
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_OSCARLET_000_003: The spriggans are still up to their usual mischief, but we've managed to retrieve two pristine eggs for the ceremony. There is still time to find the remaining Archon eggs.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_ORSELFAUX_000_004: But it was thanks to Miss Aliapoh's visions that we deduced their locations the first time. There is simply no telling where the spriggans will take them now.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_MAISENTA_000_005: The Wood Wailers have already been informed of the theft. They have agreed to post guards at every entrance to Gridania, leaving the spriggans nowhere to run. All that remains is to find them and take back the eggs.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_006: Then let us begin the search. Between the four of us and our adventurer friend here, surely we can outsmart a few rogue spriggans.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: No, no, no! That simply will not do. Augustiniel, you and the others must finish preparations for the ceremony. Even if you were to find the vessels, it would be meaningless if everything is not in order when the Hatching Hour strikes.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_MAISENTA_000_008: The Wood Wailers and I will see to the search, but we will require assistance in moving them once found. This needs to be done swiftly, so it would be prudent to move them all at once.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_MAISENTA_000_009: Adventurer, if you would help us, I need you to find three others willing to join our cause.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_010: Why, just the pleasure of meeting me should suffice to entice a few hearty adventurers to accompany you!
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_011: When you are all capped and ready, come speak with me. We should have the locations of the Archon eggs by the time you return.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: , this is our last chance to retrieve the eggs. The return of the Twelve Archons and this year's celebration depend on your success.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_020: Just tell your friends they will have the chance to meet me, and I guarantee they will line up from here to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_021: We should have ascertained the location of the eggs by the time you return. We must reclaim the eggs before the time of Hatching Hour, so please hurry.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_022: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are too far away.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_023: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are not equipped with the appropriate egg cap.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_025: Welcome back. You've done well to gather the numbers we needed in such a short time. Thankfully, we just received word of the Archon eggs' locations.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_026: The last pristine Archon egg was found just outside of the Botanists' Guild, and the vibrant Archon egg was confirmed to be outside the Conjurers' Guild.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_027: The brilliant Archon egg is in the vicinity of Westshore Pier, and the midnight Archon egg is near the Leatherworkers' Guild.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_028: You can decide amongst yourselves who will retrieve which egg, just make sure to bring them back as quickly as possible.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_029: And beware the spriggans. The city has been closed off, after all, so you are likely to find them lingering about.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_030: Now, off you go! There is still much I must do before the four of you return with the eggs.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_031: Carry the Archon egg back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre while your arms and legs still have strength.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_032: Beware the spriggans lying in wait around Old Gridania. Being caught en route to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre will result in failure.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_033: You have 180 seconds to reach your destination. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_034: Which of the Archon eggs were you going to retrieve, again? Was it the brilliant egg near Westshore Pier? Or was it the midnight egg near the Leatherworkers' Guild?
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_035: Wait, no, don't tell me. It was the pristine egg near the Botanists' Guild! No? Well, the only one left is the vibrant egg near the Conjurers' Guild, so either I was right, or you're playing games with me.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_036: But we have no time for that now. You and your friends must hurry and bring the remaining eggs back here to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_037: I realize it must pain you to do this without me, but there are other matters I must attend to before the ceremony.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_038: You must be wearing a pristine egg cap to carry this egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_100_038: You must be wearing a vibrant egg cap to carry this egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_110_038: You must be wearing a brilliant egg cap to carry this egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_120_038: You must be wearing a midnight egg cap to carry this egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SPRIGAN_000_038: Eeeeeegggggg! Preeettyyy! Shiiinyyy! You give shiiinyyy!
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SPRIGAN_100_038: Shiiiiiiny! Preeeeeetty! Need more eeeeeeggs! Eeeeeeggs!
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_000_039: This is a suitable location to place the pristine Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_100_039: This is a suitable location to place the vibrant Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_120_039: This is a suitable location to place the brilliant Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_SYSTEM_130_039: This is a suitable location to place the midnight Archon egg.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_040: Welcome back, hero! I knew you and your friends would pull through. Now all of the eggs for the celebration are back where they belong.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: Oh, my dear , you know not the great deed you have done this day. Thanks to you, we may begin our final rehearsal before the ceremony.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_042: Perhaps you were not aware, but I am not just a Dreamer, but also a singer. Soon you shall bear witness to the beauty that is my voice.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_043: But before we begin, might I ask that you assemble the eggs onstage for us? I realize you must be weary of carrying them to and fro, but we'd like to get an idea of how the stage will appear when everyone is in place.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05:
<gasp> By the Twelve!
I... I cannot believe it... My vision... It has come to pass!
What I saw years past was only a glimpse of what was to be, but...as I look at you...
It was not until the Calamity was upon us that I could begin to grasp the purport of my first vision several years past. But now that you stand here before us today... ! It was you all along!

There is no questioning the power possessed by the Archons of yore; that much is true. But I realize now that the notion they would be reborn again here, in the present...is naught but a childish dream.

Fitting, I think, that we would come to call ourselves Dreamers. Although we have dreamt of heroes long since past, I see now that the Archons of my vision were heroes in the here and now─heroes who would pull the realm back from the brink of destruction at the hands of the Seventh Calamity.
This celebration was founded in the hopes of seeing heroes made manifest, and I believe your actions henceforth will see those hopes bear fruit.
Before us stands an Archon come anew. And I have no doubt that you will lead the realm to a brighter future, as you led this Hatching-tide to a rousing success!

Let us take to heart the lessons we have learned this day, that we all may strive toward a better future. For it was through goodwill and unity that we saved Hatching-tide, and it is that same sense of common purpose that shall serve to protect the realm.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_OSCARLET_000_060: This was certainly an unexpected turn of events. But it would seem this year's celebration was a success all the same.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_MAISENTA_000_061: And here I thought the hero would appear from inside the Archon eggs. Though, technically, I suppose you did, didn't you?
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_AUGUSTINIEL_000_061: Hahaha... That you would end up being the hero from her vision... You have certainly outdone yourself this day.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_ORSELFAUX_000_062: Perhaps our brave friend here is one of the fabled Warriors of Light.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_OSCARLET_000_063: Who else would strive so hard to save our celebration, uniting the Dreamers of the three great nations? If you were indeed a Warrior of Light, it would not surprise me.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_MAISENTA_000_064: Well, to be honest, I cannot rightly say I believe in this talk of visions, or the return of Archons from the past. That aside, you have ensured the success of this year's Hatching-tide, which I might add has been quite profitable for Black Rabbit Traders. For that, you have my thanks.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_MAISENTA_000_066: And as luck would have it, there is still time to spare until the end of Hatching-tide.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: Haha, haha! A point that should not be forgotten! Let us make merry and embark on one last egg hunt, in the spirit of Hatching-tide and the newfound hope this day has brought us!
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)May the Archons of old watch over this newcome , that the realm may someday know peace.
TEXT_FESEST007_01420_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: My dear , there is no way I could begin to repay your kindness, but I would still ask that you accept this small gift.
I had saved this for the day when I would meet the figure that appeared in my vision...and today is that day, . Thank you for everything.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_TREMBLEMAN01443_000: The other refugees are hiding in the caves south of Lost Hope, but to approach them would be fruitless. They would sooner call us agents of the sultanate and try to kill us than listen to reason. Why, the twins might even deign to do the deed themselves.
A pox on all bloody sellswords! They were supposed to train us to fight, but the ones he sent with us vanished during the struggle.
Oh, if only we had never listened to that merchant's ridiculous claims! He said our cause was righteous, that the gods would never suffer us to be defeated─

Though, if they were forced to confront reality... That's it! Challenge the twins to combat and show my brethren that their strongest warriors are no match for one ! Mayhap then they will agree to lay down their arms and renounce this plot!
Hurt the twins if you must, but pray do your utmost not to harm the others.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_REFUGEE01444_000_02: Seven hells, they've found us! Everyone, grab yer gear and make for the rendezvous point!
...So that's yer game, is it? Ahahaha! Sorry to disappoint ye, , but we're more than willin' to kill ye ourselves!
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_REFUGEE01444_000_03: Ye beat 'em like it was nothin'! Thal almighty, what are we gonna do now...?
We yield, all right!? We yield! That's what ye wanted, ain't it!? So go away and leave us be!
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_TREMBLEMAN01443_000: You've returned! Did you find my brethren? What of the twins? What happened!?
I see... Well...you had no choice. Better that a handful of them take a beating from you than the lot get butchered by the Flames.
Tell me, what did the merchant have to say when it was over?
Huh? But where else would he be? Unless... Unless he went to Stonesthrow to recruit others?

As I recall, he wished to approach the refugees there as well, but was waiting until the Flames withdrew their forces from the vicinity. And now that they have, there's nothing to stop him from continuing his work.
How many more must perish in pursuit of this futile cause? How much more suffering must we endure before it ends?
Find him. Convince him to cease his mad quest. It will surely lead us to ruin.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_ELE_000_050: <sniffle> Have... Have you seen my parents?
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_ELE_000_051: They told me to stay here with the others. <sniffle> They said they'd be back soon, but it's been days...
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_ELE_000_052: They left with the man from Ul'dah. The man said they were gonna change everything─make it so we could live inside the walls with everyone else. I liked it when he said that.
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_ELE_000_053: I didn't like it when he talked about making the rich people pay. Everyone looked so angry, and I got scared...
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_ELE_000_054: Lots of people left with the man after that, but no one's come back... <sniffle> <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SWIFT_000_070: Welcome back, . Have you learned aught of interest?
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SWIFT_000_071: You persuaded a gang of refugees to lay down their arms? The Flame General will be pleased to learn of this!
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_SWIFT_000_072: Less so, these other revelations. We must apprehend this treasonous snake at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_POPMESSAGE_000_000: A chorus of cries echoes throughout the cavern...
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_BALLOON_000_010: You should never have come here!
TEXT_GAIUSE303_01444_BALLOON_000_060:
You won't stop us!
You can't stop us!
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SWIFT_000_001: This merchant has not only publicly incited sedition within the sultanate, but gone so far as to provide materiel support to would-be belligerents. It galls me that his role in the uprising should have escaped our notice for so long. Yet I can well imagine why it did. Rightly or wrongly, those with whom he consorts do not trust us.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SWIFT_000_002: Alas, trust is not easily gained, even in times of peace. We must nevertheless try, for I believe it is only with the cooperation of the refugees that we will catch our quarry. And so I would have you to continue your investigation in Pearl Lane.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SWIFT_000_003: We know that the merchant sought to recruit the people of Lost Hope and Stonesthrow, so it seems reasonable to assume that he may have approached the residents of Pearl Lane as well. After all, the first riots occurred within the city itself.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SWIFT_000_004: Most, if not all, will refuse to discuss this subject with you, but there is one who may be willing to do so: a man named Landebert. He too has his misgivings about us, but I believe he understands that these riots do little to further his people's cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SWIFT_000_010: Landebert will not let us down, I think. He is well aware of the precariousness of his compatriots' position within the sultanate. Should he happen to forget, of course, you have my permission to remind him.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_020: First comes a man with the promise of deliverance. Seen your suffering firsthand and will bear it no longer, says he. Your friend, your ally, your comrade-in-arms─take his hand, and he will guide you to a better tomorrow.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_021: Then comes a soldier with the promise of justice. Follow the man who came before at your peril, says , for they who sow the wind shall reap the whirlwind.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_022: The man's no saint; any fool can see that. We're but tools for his task, to be used and discarded. As for this soldier,  thinks only of  mission. 's more honest than the man, but every bit as ruthless, make no mistake.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_023: With whom shall I cast my lot? Neither, says I. Far as I'm concerned, you're no better than the bastard you pursue.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_024: Now the soldier is thinking how else  might get what  wants. 's tried the diplomatic approach and failed; mayhap a firmer hand is needed.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_025: Mayhap  needs to make an example out of this Ala Mhigan scum like  did those five fools from Lost Hope!
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_026: Well you'll get no justification from me, soldier, if that's what you're waiting for. I'll not raise a hand against you.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_027: But neither will I lend a hand to help you.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_028: ...Not that it makes any difference. Pah! The gods seem bent on granting your every bloody wish.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_MERCHANT01445_100_0: There you are, Landebert! Have you given any thought to my proposal?
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_029: There he goes, towards the Gate of Thal! Go and claim your prize for coin and country!
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_LANDEBERT_000_040: Didn't you want justice for Ul'dah? Why are you still here and not scouring central Thanalan? Keen to teach me a lesson before you go?
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_SWIFT_000_045: You found him!? Then why is he not here!? Stop wasting valuable time and go to central Thanalan!
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_MERCHANT01445_000_0: You again!? Wh-Why are you pursuing me!?
Who has filled your head with these lies? Refugees? The selfsame refugees who terrorized the streets of Ul'dah? Hah!
You have no evidence to prove your accusations! None!
N-No, I will not accompany you to the Hall of Flames. You have no right to detain me...
F-F-For the sake of argument, let us say I did do the things you claim. Surely you don't think I give a Qiqirn's arse about politics? It was business─only business.
We both know I am not the one you want. However, if you agree to protect me, I swear I shall tell you everything.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_GUARD01445_000_069: Tell the others to spread out and search the area. The killer may still be close.
TEXT_GAIUSE304_01445_GUARDLEADER01445_00: Hold, adventurer. I would know more about your relationship with the victim, as well as the events leading up to his death.
This man was responsible for the recent riots? Mayhap we owe his murderer a debt of gratitude.
In any case, it is obvious you are not the one whom we seek. You may carry on with your investigation, Scion.
If that arrow was shot from where you indicated, the archer must have a good eye...and a better arm.

TEXT_GAIUSE308_01449_LIEUTENANT01448_000: Ready, are you? Then allow me to explain the finer details of this foray into the Sylphlands.
In order that you might treat with the Lord of Levin, we must first learn where the primal is to be found.

Though we are certain Ramuh was summoned somewhere within the territory of the touched sylphs, his precise whereabouts yet elude us. And aimlessly thrashing around in the undergrowth will only lead to unnecessary conflict.
We are fortunate, then, to have the expertise of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn at our disposal.

Mistress Yda and her companions will make use of their Sharlayan devices to measure recent aetheric activity. They assure me that the disturbance caused by the summoning of a primal shall prove a most obvious beacon.

But we must not get ahead of ourselves. Your first objective will be to join up with your fellow Scions. Time being of the essence, they have already entered the Sylphlands. Fear not, however─they have a Twin Adder escort and a sylph guide for com─

TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_NAMIDA01449_000_020: As you are aware, our party fell victim to an ambush.
TEXT_GAIUSE309_01450_NAMIDA01449_000_021: We scouts immediately moved forward to engage the enemy, and bid the Scions to take cover. Then, before we knew what was happening, the air was filled with that stinging, choking dust.

TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_PAPALYMO_000_084: So the little rascal means to stand his ground, does he? How very courageous. Would you do the honors, ?

TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_PAPALYMO_000_087: Hmm...reasonably convincing. But one cannot be too careful! Remind me, Thancred: what was the reason for our little excursion into the Sylphlands?
TEXT_GAIUSE310_01451_THANCRED_000_088: Did you take a tumble and bump your head, old friend? We're here to locate the site of the summoning so that  might parley with Lord Ramuh.

TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_PAPALYMO_000_020: My measurements indicate a large aetherial disturbance to the southeast.
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_PAPALYMO_000_021: Thanks to the antics of the sylphs, we've been dragged to every corner of the Sylphlands...but none of our various readings returned a result of this magnitude. There can be only one conclusion...
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_PAPALYMO_000_022: Ramuh was called forth in the vicinity of the sylphs' aetheryte!
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_PAPALYMO_000_023: I suggest we proceed thither with all possible haste─after bidding Maxio here a fond farewell, of course. Should our trusty guide come too close to his deity, there is the distinct possibility that he will fall under the primal's influence.
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_PAPALYMO_000_024: Come, . The Lord of Levin awaits!
TEXT_GAIUSE311_01452_LIEUTENANT01448_000: , you have returned! Dare I ask how Ramuh received your visit?
...He challenged you to a test of arms!? It is well, then, that you have some experience in such matters!
The peoples of both Gridania and Little Solace will be relieved to hear that the Lord of Levin has accepted you as the forest's champion of peace.
You have performed a monumental duty this day, . The Elder Seedseer must be informed of your deeds at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_000: Now the matter of Ramuh has, for the present, been put to rest, there is something I would show you, .
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_001: It is a letter of thanks, signed by the leaders of the Eorzean Alliance, acknowledging the Scions' tireless service to the realm.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_002: It mentions, in particular, the names of all of the defeated primals─Ifrit, Titan, Garuda, Good King Moggle Mog XII, Leviathan, and now Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_003: Needless to say, there is only one among our number to have faced them all.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_004: And though these words of gratitude were addressed to our order as a whole, I feel that they were meant for you above all others.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_005: I, too, must offer my heartfelt thanks for all that you have done. In the course of your duties, you have never once failed to answer my call to arms.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_006: You are a true hero, , and Eorzea is that much the safer for your presence.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_007: Pray do not misunderstand me─I said “safer,” not “safe.” I know only too well that we can ill afford to lower our guard. The Ascians may be relied upon to sow chaos in this realm until such time as they are forced to stop.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_008: Why, even without their encouragement, you may be assured that man would foment strife on his own. And that is to say nothing of the beast tribes. Unless we learn to live in harmony, the primals, too, will return to plague us again and again and again...
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_009: And yet...despite all of this, your deeds serve to inspire the people─to give them hope for a better tomorrow. And there is no greater gift.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_010: That we have the courage to strive for what might otherwise seem an impossible peace, we owe in no small part to the dangers you have faced on our behalf, and the people you have won over to our cause in so doing. Our list of enemies has ever been long, but think of the allies with whom we are now blessed...
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_011: Of the beastmen who wish naught of conflict, and who now call you friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_012: Of the sylphs of Little Solace, who wish naught of conflict.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_013: Of Alisaie, who strives to unearth the terrible secrets of the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_014: Of the Ala Mhigans and the Domans who stand with us, determined to halt the dread march of the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_015: And then there is Cid and the fellowship of NOAH, racing to unlock the mysteries of ancient Allag that we might be spared the horror of another Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_016: And then there are the many unsung individuals who have gathered here in Revenant's Toll─honest men and women who seek to employ their skills for the good of all.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_017: ...Of course, when speaking of our greatest allies, we must not forget those closest to us, by which I mean our fellow Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_018: Thanks to their many and varied talents, our order is uniquely equipped to combat the far-reaching corruption of the Ascians─and combat it we shall!
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_ALPHINAUD_000_019: (-???-)Your enthusiasm is truly heartwarming, Antecedent. Given our embarrassing wealth of allies, I trust it will not inconvenience you unduly if I absent myself for a time?
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_020: Alphinaud! I take it the troubles in Ul'dah no longer require your attention?
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_ALPHINAUD_000_021: There are yet some rumblings of discontent, but the air of simmering violence is largely dissipated. 'Tis to report such that I stand before you now.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_ALPHINAUD_000_022: That...and to speak with you concerning the new organization we discussed.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Ah, I have a message for you from Ele─ Ahem. You recall the refugee girl? The one whose parents were missing? They were found unharmed. She wished me to pass on her thanks to you.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_024: Why, Alphinaud! Am I to understand that you made the effort to remember the poor girl's name? I look forward to reading all about her in your report. I do hope you left nothing out!
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_025: ─you have been away from Revenant's Toll for some time now, I believe. Might I suggest that you put the affairs of the realm to one side for the moment and take this opportunity to reacquaint yourself with the town?
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_MINFILIA_000_026: ...Which reminds me─Slafborn but recently inquired as to your whereabouts. I believe he has some small matter he wishes to discuss with you. Why not oblige him with a visit?
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_030: Oho, I see my fine adventurer friend has returned, the dust of the road yet clinging to  boots. Do the Scions have no work for you this day, then?
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_031: Hm? The Antecedent sent you my way, did she? Well, it is naught urgent, but I could certainly do with your help.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_032: You see, Revenant's Toll has become something of a favored destination for adventurers. Part of that is due to the town's growing fame, but a goodly number of green heroes-to-be have come here to follow in your footsteps.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_033: ...And when I say “green,” I mean “fresh out of the ground, don't know one end of a sword from the other” green. I've done what I can, but what they really need is a good talking to from someone they respect. An adventurer who has done it all. Aye, , that would be you.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_034: ...And, naturally, the one lass who would most benefit from your wisdom is nowhere to be seen. She was off to slay hapalits, and was due back some time ago. <sigh> Likely got herself in over her head, as usual.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_035: Now that I think on it, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to treat her to a demonstration of your skills. I'd consider it a personal favor if you would head out to the Singing Shards and show that amateur how it's done.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_040: You'll find our would-be hapalit slayer out in the Singing Shards. Do me a favor, and show her how a real adventurer fights, would you?
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_ADVENTURER01454_100: Gods help me! Any one o' the Twelve'll do! No one told me they were that big!
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_ADVENTURER01454_000: Damn near pissed meself back there! I was hopin' to find meself a little one, but the fates went and threw the meanest bugger in all o' Mor Dhona at me. Typical!
Hold up! You're , ain't ye? The ! Seven hells! Yer flippin' famous!
An' yer twice as tough as they said ye were, an' all! Bugger me...I can't believe I'm talkin' to the !
Aw, an' now ye've gone an' seen me at me worst. 'Twas me bleedin' pet's fault, I tell ye! Doesn't listen to a damn thing I say!

That an' the fact that none o' me so-called mates offered to help me. When I told 'em I was off to gut some hapalits, most of 'em gave me a confused “huh” or a “hmmm,” like I was talkin' out me arse. You, uh...don't agree though, right?
I know I look a right fool, but I'm just havin' a bad day, honest! Yer not goin' to “huh” or “hmmm” at me too, are ye!?
Er...what's that yer doin' there, mate? No offense, like, but...ye've lost me.
Gods, no! Not you too! That's the final bleedin' straw, that is!

<sniffle> I was hopin' you of all people would understand... I mean, it ain't adventurin' if ye don't take a few risks, right...?
...Alright, maybe I am a bit out o' me depth here. I'll be more careful, I promise!
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_060: Ah, , you have my thanks. That lass I sent you out to instruct trudged back into town looking properly chastised.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_061: I thought a lesson from you might pierce that obstinate skull of hers. Nothing I said seemed to work. Truth be told, she seemed more inclined to listen to the rustling of my beard than anything which came out of my mouth...
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_062: Ahem. But now that you have demonstrated the skills she yet lacks, it will not be long before her addle-pated peers hear the tale.
TEXT_GAIUSE313_01454_SLAFBORN_000_063: They will soon realize that one does not become a hero in a day: it requires dedication and perseverance, and learning from each task you undertake. There are no shortcuts, eh, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SLAFBORN_000_000: Gods, would you look at all those people. Seems they're carting in adventurers by the wagonload... And more than a few are eager to rap on the Scions' door.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SLAFBORN_000_001: I wonder if this constant flow of aspiring heroes is what has Tataru looking so perturbed. Might be she could use a friendly ear, hm?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_SLAFBORN_000_010: Tataru's expression grows ever darker each time I see her pass by. Perhaps you might hear her woes and lessen her burden some?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_020: Hello, , what might I─ Oh? Slafborn thought I could use a friend, did he?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_021: What a sweet man, though I did not think my fretting so obvious. Well, I suppose there's no sense in hiding it now.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_022: 'Tis time to reveal my little secret!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_030: Hee hee! It quite suits me, don't you think? But 'tis not simply for show─I've been learning the mining trade!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_031: Why, you might ask? Ah, therein lies the source of my dour demeanor...
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_032: Ever since we relocated to the Rising Stones, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have stepped out from behind the curtain, so to speak.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_033: Our victories over the Empire have granted us a certain degree of fame, and many budding adventurers have traveled from afar with the intention of joining our ranks. And while I welcome each new member that takes up our cause...
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_035: As I'm sure you are aware, we are a strictly neutral organization. And ensuring that neutrality means limiting the funds we accept from outside sources.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_036: The Scions do receive various means of support from the three major nations, and the Leveilleur twins are quite generous with their family's coffers... Yet this modest income cannot keep pace with our day-to-day expenses.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_100_036: There is also the sundry donated materiel, of course. Those are delivered to the Adventurers' Guild, and swiftly allocated to the expansion of Revenant's Toll...
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_037: While I'll cheerfully leave the toppling of primals to you, 'tis my duty to balance the books and fight the demons of debt! On my honor as receptionist, I will raise the necessary coin with my own two hands!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_038: I even paid for this sturdy mining attire out of my own purse!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_039: Which makes it doubly aggravating that my custom-made sledgehammer has yet to arrive. I scrimped and saved especially for that tool...
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_040: . If you would help me see the Scions survive this fiscal disaster, then I would ask you to travel to the Blacksmiths' Guild in Limsa Lominsa and demand they hand over my commission at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_041: Oh, and regarding your travel expenses... I'll have to check our available funds.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_042: Once you have my sledgehammer, pray leave it with F'lhaminn. I shall be out digging up riches the best I can with the equipment I have. Crystal clusters, here I come!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_TATARU_000_043: The Blacksmiths' Guild must have finished my commission by now. Once you've managed to procure my sledgehammer, pray leave it in F'lhaminn's care─I shall be out in the field, unearthing what treasures I may!
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_050: Well now, , what brings ye back to me forge? Got some new masterpiece o' smittin' to show me?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_051: What can I do fer ye, ? If yer lookin' to sign up, Randwulf over there'll run ye through the initiation...
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_052: Eh? Yer here 'bout a commission? Somethin' weren't delivered?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_053: Now that is passin' strange. Unless 'twere an ale-induced dream, I'm fairly certain Mistress Tataru's tool were shipped off days ago. I'm not like to forget the forgin' of a sledge what needed flowers engraved on the head.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_054: ...Could be the porter met with misfortune on the road. If the blokes we employ are in town, then ye'd find 'em south o' the Octant, on one o' them empty landin's.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_055: Seein' as we've heard naught one way or the other, though, I'd be of a mind to cast some doubt on their whole operation. Ugh, what an upsettin' business. I might need a pint or two to put it all behind me...
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_BRITHAEL_000_060: The porters we employ stack their cargo on one o' them empty landin's south o' the Octant. If they're missin' deliveries, ye might want to direct some doubt at one of 'em to see how he holds up under the pressure.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_DELIVERYMAN01455_00: Bugger off. I've work to do.
Ye havin' trouble hearin'!? I said, “bugger off”!
Eh? A delivery from the smitties to Mor Dhona? How the bloody hells should I know!? I just haul the crates!

...Hang on a moment. Ye said, “Mor Dhona,” aye? Me mate was meant to see a shipment up to Revenant's Toll a while back, but took ill just afore he was due to leave. “Not to worry,” I said, “I'll take it there me very own─”

Well, we got bleedin' busy, didn't we! An' I figured someone'd come lookin' if their precious package didn't arrive, anyroad! An' here ye are! The crate ye want is back there someplace, marked an' all. Ye can grab it yer own self!
Gods, yer still here? Look, I told ye where to find the crate. What more do ye want!?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_FLHAMINN_000_090: Greetings, . Tataru made mention of a missing delivery. Were you able to coax her commission from the Blacksmiths' Guild?
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_FLHAMINN_000_091: Wonderful. I shall keep it here with me until Tataru returns from her mining expedition.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_FLHAMINN_000_092: She is not one to approach matters by half, is she? The Rising Stones couldn't ask for a more able administrator.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_FLHAMINN_000_093: Still, I am somewhat worried for her well-being. I realize Tataru means to mine and naught more, but even the outskirts of Revenant's Toll are not free of prowling dangers.
TEXT_GAIUSE314_01455_FLHAMINN_000_094: Would you mind tracking down our industrious Lalafell and see that she has not come to harm? As far as I'm aware, Tataru intended to start her digging in the hills near the Tangle─you may have to call out to attract her attention.

TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_003: Come closer,  . I would prefer that this tale be heard by you and you alone. It concerns a sensitive subject with which you are doubtless well acquainted: the Battle of Carteneau.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_004: Aye, I speak of that bloodbath which marked the end of the Sixth Astral Era, when both the VIIth Legion and Allied forces were slaughtered by that winged abomination which did its utmost to destroy all we know and love.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_005: No part of Eorzea was untouched by the elder primal's rage, least of all the Carteneau Flats, which were ravaged─nay, remade in the fires of destruction. The Flats were rendered an accursed wasteland, and all decent smallfolk know to keep a wide berth.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_006: Consequently, many question why the Eorzean Alliance continues to maintain a military presence in the region, despite the personnel and materiel required to do so.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_007: Allagan ruins, that's why. Allied scholars have been studying them since their discovery following the battle, during which time the Carteneau Flats have been jointly administered by the three member nations of the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_008: This was an acceptable state of affairs for a time, but no longer. Ul'dah, Limsa Lominsa, and Gridania have all formally asserted a claim to the territory. A diplomatic resolution is no longer possible; the matter is to be decided on the field of battle.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_009: Lest you fear that this marks the advent of total war, worry not. We are allies as ever and shall conduct ourselves accordingly. All hostilities will be confined to the disputed territories, and engagements shall be fought to submission, not death.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_010: So you see, you needn't hesitate to join the fray. Should you have the misfortune of facing a friend in battle, you will only be expected to subdue him, not kill him.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_011: Aye, that's right─I tell you all this because we need men and women of your caliber on the front line. These ruins are of vital importance to our nation's security, and we cannot surrender them to a foreign power.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_SCARLET_000_012: You need not make a decision now. All I ask is that you speak with our man at the airship landing and listen to what he has to say.
TEXT_COMGRD002_01527_KOUJATAIHIKUUHEI_00: ! Come to join the fight, have we? Very good, very good indeed!
Now before we proceed, I must warn you: this isn't going to be like some jaunt in the Wolves' Den.
You'll be pitted against wave after wave of fellow Alliance members in battle, and they won't care one whit that you're the Warrior of Light.

This campaign will be long and brutal, and victories won today may be undone tomorrow. Consider the borderland ruins. We need only seize control of each ruin in the region, right? Wrong. Defense is paramount as well, for our rivals will muster forces to challenge our claims.
It is for that reason we have established an airship route direct to the front line. Those who are ready and willing to fight will never want for transportation!
Ah, but that look on your face bespeaks confusion. “Are we at war or not? What is this bollocks about no killing? What in the seven hells is going on!?” That's what you're thinking, yes?

It's less “war” and more “organized violence to resolve a territorial dispute.” And yes, it is to be civilized violence. Killing Alliance members is strictly prohibited─though accidents have been known to happen, mind you.
But you of all people have nothing to fear! You've escaped certain death more times than I can count; what are the odds you'll fail to do so this time, eh?

TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_005: What I'm wonderin' is 'ow knowledgeable ye are with regards to the aftermath, when the Eorzean Alliance saw fit to settle in an' jointly administer the region for the foreseeable future.
TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_006: Waste o' time, money, an' men, most say, what with nothin' o' value in the Carteneau Flats, eh? That's the story to which most folk've been privy─the truth, o' course, bein' a fair bit different.
TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_007: In case ye ain't yet in the know, the primal's rampage laid bare these Allagan ruins, which no one 'ad even the slightest inklin' existed prior to the Calamity. It didn't take a bleedin' genius to recognize that we'd found somethin' important, an' that we'd be fools to let it fall into the wrong 'ands.
TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_008: The powers that be declared that we'd protect an' study the ruins together, an' so we did─until now. Limsa Lominsa, Ul'dah, an' Gridania 'ave all formally asserted a claim to the territory. The time for talk 'as passed; the time for action 'as come.

TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_010: Remember that when yer on the front line, ─beat a man within an ilm of 'is life if ye must, but see that it goes no further.
TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_011: Ye'll be joinin' the fight, won't ye? A soldier with your talents would make a tremendous difference! What's more, ye'd be doin' the nation a great service.
TEXT_COMLIM002_01528_TRACHRAET_000_012: At least speak with our man at the airship landin' before ye decide one way or the other. Think on it, . That's all I ask.

TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_000: Oi, you there, the comely looking one! I take you for an adventurer, and your guild needs you to make this year's Moonfire Faire the merriest in living memory! What say you jaunt up to Limsa and lend a hand?
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_001: In case you're unfamiliar with the festival, it was first held five years ago in order to extinguish the Bombards─fiery fiends who threatened to turn the whole realm into a living inferno. Now, the creatures haven't actually made a return this year, but that doesn't mean we can't have a scorching good time!
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_002: In the absence of a real threat, we're focusing instead on making the commonfolk's love of the faire work for us, the rank-and-file adventurers! Guild identity and all that. Tsk-tsk, how guileless you are! A good name made by honest work is nothing unless kept well polished by favorable talk.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_003: So how about it, my innocent ? Help your guild, help yourself? Go to the Aftcastle of Limsa Lominsa, then! There lumbers Haermaga, the grand chaperone of Moonfire Faire.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_004: You must go garbed in a , or he'll not know you for a friend. Not the sharpest axe in the armory, Haermaga─makes him a fine choice to sit atop the high chair for this undertaking.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_005: If you've no yukata of your own, procure one at a Moonfire Faire vendor. Oh, quibble not─'tis but a small expense, and you'll receive a new set of raiments for assisting with the festivities.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_010: If you wish to help with the Moonfire Faire, take yourself to Limsa Lominsa. Present yourself to Haermaga at the Aftcastle, and go garbed in a , unless you wish to give the chief chaperone the wrong idea.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_EXABU01534_000_011: The yukata can be purchased from any Moonfire Faire vendor. And no, we'll not defray the expense! It's quite piddling as it is. Besides, the guild's coffers are for more pressing needs.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_020: So! You're here to muck in and churn it up for the Moonfire Faire? That's the spirit─the adventuring spirit! Come to think of it, that's what the festivities are about, isn't it?
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_021: The adventuring trade has a─hang my tongue─has a figuring problem, see? The commonfolk can't figure out what we do, beyond doing that hither, doing this thither.
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_022: What we need's a real adventurer living by the sweat of  brow, showing everyone how it's done! And what we do! You know, mucking in, living it up! Making it real!
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_023: What else? Oh! It's about the children. I don't rightly remember why, but it's about the children. Because...because they grow up, that's right. Where would the guild be without the next generation? Getting old, that's where we'd be. Don't know about you, but I'm not spending my golden years crafting ingots!
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_024: So we figured─or one of the other chaperones figured, I don't go to all the meetings─there should be three adventuring events. There's a prize for each one, and we'd be extra appreciative if you do all three!
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_025: So, ah, you ready to do this? If you are, I'll show you where you can find the events!
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_030: Er, you want to help with the Moonfire Faire? Where's your yukata? You're supposed to be wearing one of those─they told me that was decided at the meeting. Sorry, no exceptions!
TEXT_FESSUM001_01534_HAERMAGA_000_031: But I'm a helpful sort of fellow. I'm the chief chaperone here, after all! You can buy a  from any Moonfire Faire vendor. Then you'll be ready to muck in and do your bit for the guild!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_000: Psst, adventurer! Aye, you, who else would I be talking to? If you call yourself an adventurer, you'd better come help out with the Moonfire Faire.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_001: Have you heard of the faire? It has its origins in the Bombard hunts we started five years ago. Fire, dancing, incineration─what's not to love?
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_002: But the faire isn't just about demons. As a matter of fact, there aren't any Bombards about this year. No, this year, we're going to show the folk that adventurers aren't just about making funny faces at Bombards and carting around ashes.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_003: Are you with me? You're with me! Well, go on up to that big lummox over there. That's Chief Chaperone Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_004: But not dressed like that, you don't. Put on a  first, else how's Haermaga to know that you're serious about helping?
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_005: Don't have one of those? Well, worry not! I bought mine from one of the Moonfire Faire vendors for a modest enough sum. You'll also get a new set of garb later for helping.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_010: If you want to help with the Moonfire Faire, go talk to Chief Chaperone Haermaga right over there. Don't forget to wear your  so he knows what you're about.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_EXABU01535_000_011: You can buy a yukata from any Moonfire Faire vendor. It won't set you back very much, so don't be such a gil-pincher!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_020: So! You're here to muck in and churn it up for the Moonfire Faire? That's the spirit─the adventuring spirit! Come to think of it, that's what the festivities are about, isn't it?
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_021: The adventuring trade has a─hang my tongue─has a figuring problem, see? The commonfolk can't figure out what we do, beyond doing that hither, doing this thither.
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_022: What we need's a real adventurer living by the sweat of  brow, showing everyone how it's done! And what we do! You know, mucking in, living it up! Making it real!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_023: What else? Oh! It's about the children. I don't rightly remember why, but it's about the children. Because...because they grow up, that's right. Where would the guild be without the next generation? Getting old, that's where we'd be. Don't know about you, but I'm not spending my golden years crafting ingots!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_024: So we figured─or one of the other chaperones figured, I don't go to all the meetings─there should be three adventuring events. There's a prize for each one, and we'd be extra appreciative if you do all three!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_025: So, ah, you ready to do this? If you are, I'll show you where you can find the events!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_030: Er, you want to help with the Moonfire Faire? Where's your yukata? You're supposed to be wearing one of those─they told me that was decided at the meeting. Sorry, no exceptions!
TEXT_FESSUM002_01535_HAERMAGA_000_031: But I'm a helpful sort of fellow. I'm the chief chaperone here, after all! You can buy a  from any Moonfire Faire vendor. Then you'll be ready to muck in and do your bit for the guild!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_000:
Moon-fire Fa-ire!♪
In Lim-sa Lo-minsa!♪
Hah hah hah! Well met there, fellow 'venturer. Come join us for the guild's Moonfire Faire!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_001: Join us for what, you say? Oh, no being coy now! Time was, we hunted Bombards in the sultry months of summer, and made merry of the heat by calling it a faire.
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_002: But there are no Bombards to be seen this year─and still the folk were wanting to know, when will the 'Venturers' Guild put on the summer faire? So we thought, why, the festivities need not be on account of the Bombards. After all, 'tis our derring-do they want to see!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_003: You should join the faire─have a little fun! All work an' no play makes a drudge of a 'venturer, as they say. Chief Chaperone Haermaga over at the Aftcastle in Limsa Lominsa knows all about that─an' about the faire, too.
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_004: Now, make sure to put on a  before you see him. Keep in mind that this is fun, not work.
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_005: Don't have one? No problem! Just go buy one from any Moonfire Faire vendor you happen across. You deserve to treat yourself. An' the guild will give you a whole 'nother set of togs later, too...assuming you do your part.
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_010: Go to the Aftcastle in Limsa Lominsa if you're in the mood for a little fun at the Moonfire Faire!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_EXABU01536_000_011: Wear your pretty  an' talk to Chief Chaperone Haermaga. If you don't have one, make sure to pick one up from any Moonfire Faire vendor. Go on, treat yourself!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_020: So! You're here to muck in and churn it up for the Moonfire Faire? That's the spirit─the adventuring spirit! Come to think of it, that's what the festivities are about, isn't it?
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_021: The adventuring trade has a─hang my tongue─has a figuring problem, see? The commonfolk can't figure out what we do, beyond doing that hither, doing this thither.
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_022: What we need's a real adventurer living by the sweat of  brow, showing everyone how it's done! And what we do! You know, mucking in, living it up! Making it real!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_023: What else? Oh! It's about the children. I don't rightly remember why, but it's about the children. Because...because they grow up, that's right. Where would the guild be without the next generation? Getting old, that's where we'd be. Don't know about you, but I'm not spending my golden years crafting ingots!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_024: So we figured─or one of the other chaperones figured, I don't go to all the meetings─there should be three adventuring events. There's a prize for each one, and we'd be extra appreciative if you do all three!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_025: So, ah, you ready to do this? If you are, I'll show you where you can find the events!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_030: Er, you want to help with the Moonfire Faire? Where's your yukata? You're supposed to be wearing one of those─they told me that was decided at the meeting. Sorry, no exceptions!
TEXT_FESSUM003_01536_HAERMAGA_000_031: But I'm a helpful sort of fellow. I'm the chief chaperone here, after all! You can buy a  from any Moonfire Faire vendor. Then you'll be ready to muck in and do your bit for the guild!
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_HAERMAGA_000_000: Hah, ready to muck in? Wait till you see this event─it's a real scorcher! The chaperone that came up with the idea─smart as a stitch, that one─calls it the “Rousing Douse.” Clever, huh? Huh?
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_HAERMAGA_000_001: Most folk think we adventurers just slay demons and punish miscreants. Nothing wrong with that─if I don't mete out a good beating once a moon, I go a bit crazy─but we've other skills that are going mostly unused. Fighting fire's one of the big ones.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_HAERMAGA_000_002: Did you know there's a whole lot of adventurers training these─hang my tongue─these beast-things to put out fires? I didn't! They're massed in lower La Noscea right now, near the entrance to the Blind Iron Mines. Was I supposed to go inspect? Maybe later! But you should go now.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_HAERMAGA_000_003: Just take yourself out there and give a friendly yelly-yell to Ethelia. She's a Moonfire Faire chaperone, and she'll find you a beast-thing for the event.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_HAERMAGA_000_010: You promised to muck in for the Rousing Douse event, didn't you? It's over by the entrance to the Blind Iron Mines in lower La Noscea. Just find a Moonfire Faire chaperone called Ethelia.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_HAERMAGA_000_011: Someone who does all three events─now that's what I call an adventurer! Loves the trade, ready for a bit o' fun, never stingy with  guild. An adventurer like that gets a special reward out of my own purse!
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_ETHELIA_000_030: Ah, fresh meat for the elbst... Hah, just kidding! You're going to be on an elbst in a moment, though. We call ourselves the Moonfire Marines, and you're the newest recruit.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_ETHELIA_000_031: Don't look so green. The Sahagin have been keeping elbst for viangaa's years. We at the guild are just getting started, but they're tractable enough creatures.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_ETHELIA_000_032: What a Moonfire marine does is mount up on an elbst for a round of fire-fighting. Elbst have this funny quirk where you poke 'em in the side and they upchuck a bellyful of cold water.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_ETHELIA_000_033: We've some choice pillars of fire set up out there. Trot on over and Saturate the flames with elbst spit. Don't be shy now!
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_ETHELIA_000_034: Give the audience a show─they're there to get doused! No one who's standing there wants to stay dry. It's been a baking hot summer, if you haven't noticed.
TEXT_FESSUM004_01537_ETHELIA_000_035: Let me know when you're ready to begin. Remember, there're some little ones out there who've never seen an adventurer! Make it look good, or I'll be tempted to feed you to the elbst.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_000: Hah, ready to churn it up? I named this event myself─named all of 'em, but the other two got shot down by other chaperones. But this one was a winner! I call it “The Cannon-do Spirit”!
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_001: Demon slaying's always a crowd pleaser, but parents of little ones can be a mite touchy about the hacking and slashing. What I figured is, you need to keep it dry.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_002: So we decided to use cannons instead. More civilized-like and crispy, was my way of thinking. That's why I sit in the big chair, I fancy. Family friendly, that's what I am.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_003: Since when does the Adventurers' Guild have cannons? Weeell, I never could resist something complimentary, and the Maelstrom was─what do you call it?─decommissioning a few. They're safe enough. You've seen their like along the parapets of Aleport.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_004: Since when does the Adventurers' Guild have cannons? Weeell, I never could resist something complimentary, and the Maelstrom was─what do you call it?─decommissioning a few. They're safe enough, this being an exhibition event and all.
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_006: The action's down in the Salt Strand, in lower La Noscea. The chaperone in charge is─hang my tongue, I'm ever muddling up Plainsfolk names─Mayaru Moyaru. He'll show you the ropes!
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_010: You look like you could do with a little noisemaking! Go down to the Salt Strand and ask for the chaperone Mayaru Moyaru. Tell him you're to help with the Cannon-do Spirit event!
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_HAERMAGA_000_011: Someone who does all three events─now that's what I call an adventurer! Loves the trade, ready for a bit o' fun, never stingy with  guild. An adventurer like that gets a special reward out of my own purse!
TEXT_FESSUM005_01538_MAYARUMOYARU_000_03: Ahoy, welcome to, um, the cannon event! I like to think of this as an exhibition that packs a real punch. And also family friendly─look at all the little ones in the audience!

The chief chaperone told you what you'd be up to, yes? Demon slaying, and lots of it! We've acquired some nice 18-ponze cannons. They make a big bang when they're fired at their targets─sabotenders and womandragoras in this case!
And don't go hitting anything other than your intended targets! I think it's been mentioned once or twice that this is a family-friendly event.
I mean...it's not as though someone would die or anything if one were to accidentally get a blast to the face. But a cannonball is still far from a flan puff. I shouldn't think it would be safe.
Besides, it would be in extremely poor taste to shoot any future adventurers with the cannon. We can't have them thinking ill of the guild. And it certainly wouldn't be family friendly!
Now, please think on everything I've said. If you decide you'd like to play by the rules, simply speak with me to participate.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_000: Hah, ready to make it real? There's an event over in middle La Noscea. “A Very Cherry Bomb,” it's called, and it just about captures everything adventuring's about, according to my way of thinking.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_001: We're resourceful, is what we are. And we find the fun in even the gravest of dangers. Take the recent years: there's beastmen rustling about everywhere, making some afraid of their own shadows.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_002: Here in La Noscea, we've been bled but good by kobolds. There's a lot of folk been burned by their alchemical contraptions, like those damn bombs.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_003: You know about bombs? You can kill 'em dead a thousand times, but if the core's intact, they'll just pop right back. You've got to blow 'em up good, core and all, and that's where we come in.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_004: Bomb disposal─that's an adventurer basic! But do the commonfolk know that? Not many do, so we'll show 'em─but we'll find the fun like we do. We'll dispose of the bombs in fireworks!
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_005: You're the very  for the job─fearless and merry both! You and J'nangho should get on like a house on fire. You'll find her northeast of the Zephyr Gate, out in middle La Noscea.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_010: Why aren't you in middle La Noscea? You're the very one for the Very Cherry Bomb event, or my name isn't Haermaga! J'nangho's the one to talk to. You'll find her down northeast of the Zephyr Gate.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_HAERMAGA_000_011: Someone who does all three events─now that's what I call an adventurer! Loves the trade, ready for a bit o' fun, never stingy with  guild. An adventurer like that gets a special reward out of my own purse!
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_JNANGHO_000_030: Welcome to a Very Cherry Bomb, and a very good day to you, fellow adventurer! If you love the smell of gunpowder in the morning, you've come to the right place!
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_JNANGHO_000_031: I have six mortars set up at two disposal sites, one to the north and one to the east. All are packed with fireworks─enough gunpowder and bacon fat to turn bomb cores into fried bread!
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_JNANGHO_000_032: And speaking of bombs, I've released some Bombard blanks in the area. They're your disposal targets, you see! I made sure to choose particularly dim-witted ones so they'd not wander off.
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_JNANGHO_000_033: Blast the Bombards towards the mortar until the gunpowder catches fire, and ta-da─fireworks! Bomb cores disposed, fireworks in the sky...and the crowd goes wild. Do I love this job? You bet your ash!
TEXT_FESSUM006_01539_JNANGHO_000_034: You got all that? Great! Just have a look around, get that energy flowing...then talk to me when you want to start. I'll be right here!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_000: All right, let's mount up and upchuck! No hesitation now─Saturate the pillars of fire set up on the spots I've marked.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_001: When you're ready to begin, just go straight east and talk to the Moonfire marine there.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_EXABU01540_000_05: Want to ride an elbst? I don't keep one in my pocket, you know. Go straight east and find a Moonfire marine to help you.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_EXABU01540_000_010: Mount up, elbst rider! And don't report back to Ethelia until you've Saturated all three targets. Come to me instead if you fall off the elbst.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_EXABU01540_000_015: Come to me if you fall off the elbst. I'll heave you back on quick as a cough!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SYSTEM_100_020: Use the Saturate action on pillars of fire set up on target spots. The action can be selected from the pet hotbar.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_MIQOTEA01540_000_02: (-Sweet Spectator-)Hurrah! You did it; you put out the fire! That was amazing!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_MIQOTEB01540_000_02:
(-Sultry Spectator-)Oooh, you got me...I'm soaked through.
...Oh, were you aiming for the fire? My mistake.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_MIQOTEC01540_000_02: (-Serious Spectator-)Very effective indeed. Yes. And quite refreshing, I might add.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_MIQOTED01540_000_02: (-Spirited Spectator-)Haha! Phew! Isn't that something? I could do with a douse every day!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_MIQOTEE01540_000_02: (-Sedate Spectator-)Wait, wha...!? You mean “douse” like we get drenched? I thought, you know, like looking for water!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ROEGADYNA01540_000_: (-Spirited Spectator-)Hey! Hey! What do you think you're doing? That's just going too far, I tell you─far too far!
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_030: There you are! You did know I was just kidding about drenching the audience? Just kidding! Heard you did great out there.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_031: Made a good impression on the audience, didn't we, especially the kiddies? You cut quite a figure, I'm told. Once you go elbst-back, you never go back, am I right?
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_032: Some of those little ones now say they want to be adventurers, and it's all thanks to you. Oh, you don't think so? Humility's a virtue, my mammy always said─turns out she was just kidding! Best to accept a compliment graciously, my friend.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_033: Speaking of giving credit, Haermaga's the one who started in on the “do it for the children” bit. He goes about pretending it was someone else's idea, but he's not fooling me. Families have turned out for the faire in droves thanks to him.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_034: Oh, he's awfully secretive about things he's actually good at. But he's a shrewd one, a practical man under all that buffoonery. He's right that we need to put ourselves out there─think about the future of the guild, instead of just living for today.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_035: Anyway, I'd better give you your reward─you've certainly earned it! You're welcome back among the Moonfire Marines any time. The audience would love a return performance, I'm sure.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_ETHELIA_000_040:
Another day, another douse! No reward this time, though...
...Haha, only kidding! Here it is, and amply deserved.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SYSTEM_000_050: You have participated in all three Moonfire Faire events.
TEXT_FESSUM007_01540_SYSTEM_000_051: Return to the Aftcastle in Limsa Lominsa to receive a special reward from Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Lovely! I do believe you understand the spirit of restraint and precision that is so important in professional adventurers. Now blast that 18-ponze cannon! You must hit the womandragoras twice and any one sabotender fugitivo once.

Very fleet of foot, those sabotenders. Aim well─stray cannonballs are not appropriate for family events! And don't be shy─you can try the event as many times as you like. Do tell me when you've succeeded, however.
You don't know how to use Cannonfire? I can teach you, if you like!
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_MAYARUMOYARU_000_01: Are you schooled in the use of the 18-ponze cannon? Do not be concerned! You'll be blasting like an old hand in a moment.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SYSTEM_000_011: Inspect the 18-ponze cannon in the event location, and a special action Cannonfire will appear in your pet hotbar.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SYSTEM_000_012: Use Cannonfire on a desired spot in order to hit a womandragora and a sabotender fugitivo.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_MAYARUMOYARU_000_03: Well done! The chirurgeons are quite bereft─they've naught to do! And the children in the audience loved it! They say they wish to join us. I do hope that's not a cannonball they're trying to─oh dear...
It's always one thing after another in this line of work. Chaperoning an event, I mean. Regular adventuring is quite tame in comparison.

Why, I've had to tend to everything myself. Stronger leadership certainly wouldn't have been amiss, but we simply couldn't agree on whom to elect the chief chaperone. Haermaga was the only one we could agree on─we agreed that he was not the first choice for any of us!
Still, it hasn't been all bad having to steer our own events. And attendance has been excellent, for both participants and audience members!

You, for one, have been exemplary! I shouldn't think we've ever had a better live-fire cannon exhibition. Very happy I am to present you with this reward! If you'd like to do it again, you know where to find me.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_MAYARUMOYARU_000_04: Yes, exemplary. You do bring in a crowd, but even better, you leave them without a scratch! Come with your family, depart with your family. Such a good message to send to the commonfolk about our guild!
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SYSTEM_000_050: You have participated in all three Moonfire Faire events.
TEXT_FESSUM008_01541_SYSTEM_000_051: Return to the Aftcastle in Limsa Lominsa to receive a special reward from Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_000: Ready to roll? Blow those Bombard blanks straight towards the mortar. Do it with style, now!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_001: I've set up two separate venues─one to the north and one to the east. Too many mortars in one place is a recipe for singed adventurers and crispy onlookers... So, go to whichever, fry up the Bombards in some pretty fireworks, then let me know how it went!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_010: There're two separate venues set up─one to the north, another to the east. Don't keep all your explosives in one mortar, and all that. Either place'll do─fry up the Bombards in some fireworks, then come talk to me!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_030: Are you good or are you good? You must have some practice blowing up things!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_031: At first I was thinking, “What is this rigmarole? Are we the Adventurers' Guild or the Mummers' Guild?” But the energy of the crowd has me all turned around!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_032: I've done my share of helping out with guild functions. That's why I ended up a chaperone. But let's face it, I'm just a mote in the beam. This faire has a life of its own, you know?
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_033: Something about the energy of clashing personalities. I mean, that prim plum Mayaru Moyaru was either going to garrote Haermaga for his crazy ideas, or they were going to come up with a pretty fine event. And that's what happened, right? The cannon thing?
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_034: Same with the rest of us, me and Ethelia included. An elbst-mad phlegm needle she may be, but Sister Thel's all right. I tell you, what a faire this year! It has such...such heart. Beats me how it happened!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_035: Here's your take for the show, by the way. Well deserved! Come back any time if you miss the gunpowder─and bacon fat. I'll keep the mortars packed for you!
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_JNANGHO_000_040: Another blistering performance! Keep up the good energy, and come back any time.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_SYSTEM_000_050: You have participated in all three Moonfire Faire events.
TEXT_FESSUM009_01542_SYSTEM_000_051: Return to the Aftcastle in Limsa Lominsa to receive a special reward from Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_000: Hrm. She ought to be here by now. <sigh> Might be best to just sit tight...
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_001: Phew, sure is hot. And there's nothing like a tip-top summer day! But it makes me think... I mean, how's that fair? That I'm here and─
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_002: Uwaaah! Dammit, don't go sneaking up on a man like that! I was just...just reciting the minutes from the last meeting. Trying to memorize them, aye. So, what can I help you with?
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_003: You did what? Hah! Finishing all three events... Now that's what I call an adventurer! Went out there and made folks happy, eh? Made some little ones think, “that's the life for me,” I'd wager! Wait till I tell you about the special rewards I've got laid aside.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_004: Oh, you're going to like this! I ordered a tip-top set of fireworks out of my own purse, and that's not all. I'll also teach you a Far Eastern dance more beautiful than anything you've ever seen!
