TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_005: Now, I asked that chaperone to hold on to the fireworks for me. Too sorely tempted to set them off myself, you see. Anyway, go and speak with her, and make sure you don your  like before.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_010: The fireworks I got you as a reward are topnotch, let me tell you! So much so, in fact, I couldn't keep them with me─made my flint-holding hand itchy!
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_020: Here for those fancy fireworks? I'll bring them over to Haermaga when I get a chance.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_021: Right nice of him to lighten his own purse to make the faire a success. You know, as a show of gratitude, mayhap you'd be so inclined to do him a good turn?
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_022: He hasn't been himself these last few bells, you see. Jumpy as a singed cat, hardly notices a thing. He's even talking to himself, so I had a listen.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_023: Best I can tell, he's waiting for someone who isn't showing. He keeps fussing that mayhap this mystery visitor went to the wrong place─she's on this ship, this restaurant, or at that tailor who does wools so nicely.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_024: Well, I figure it's got to be the restaurant─the Bismarck. The harbormaster doesn't allow willy-nilly visits to ships. And it's too hot today for a fitting, especially in wool. Do you think you could run over to the Bismarck and see if anyone's waiting for Haermaga?
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_025: I'm expecting someone in a . You look to be the  that Haermaga told me about, but I sure would feel better if you had the right garb on.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_EXABU01535_000_030: Haermaga hasn't been acting himself. Mayhap someone could do him a good turn, in appreciation for all he's done for us.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_050: Am I looking for Master Haermaga? Oh, thank the Twelve! Did he send you to meet me? I'd nearly given up.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_051: I have a package for him, and I really must go. I've a table waiting and a truculent guest to charm. A merchant's life is run on an unforgiving clock.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_052: A thousand pities I couldn't meet Master Haermaga! My customer thought the world of him. 'Tis for the boy's sake I wrote the good master and made the long journey to Limsa Lominsa. Well, that and to be fitted for a new bliaud.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_053: The boy? As I understand it, Master Haermaga befriended him several years ago. A band of adventurers was attending to the Bombard menace, I believe. The local children would come to spectate, and he was among them.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_054: His name was Chadwick and he'd decided he wanted to be an adventurer, you see. Haermaga taught him much and more. He told the lad that when he was well enough, he'd bring him to Limsa for the Moonfire Faire. But the gods are cruel; his illness finally took him.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_055: In the last moon of his life, the boy asked me about the Far East. He had dreamed of adventuring there, I think, him and Master Haermaga together. He asked that I find a certain Eastern item and take it to the master, along with a message.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_056: I've got it right here─a twisted hachimaki of the Far East, worn by warriors in a traditional dance of prowess. Take it to Master Haermaga, and these words of the boy's, too: “I've gone East. You'll always be my best friend.”
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_060: Why do you linger? Hurry and give the boy's gift to Master Haermaga.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_YAMIMI_000_061: Would that I could meet Master Haermaga, but there's a corsair captain to wine and dine, and I dare not make her wait.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_070: Hah, a runner just came by with your tip-top set of fireworks! That's one reward done─now for that dance lesson! You've never seen its like, the war dance of the Far East...
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_080: Hm? You have something for me? But I'm to give you rewards, not the other way around. On the other hand, I always like a present!
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_081: Chadwick... This is from him? They told me...they told me he left no words at the end. They gave him potions to ease the pain, and he slept the last week...
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_082: He was a skinny little thing. You know how it is. There're always young ones getting underfoot if you're working in a fair-sized hamlet. Wasn't safe, so my alchemist friend scared them off, but one of them just kept lurking there, skulking here...
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_083: Finally, we figured it was safer to just have this boy doing chores instead of falling out of trees. You never saw such joy! All Chadwick wanted was to sign his name in the big book at Revenant's Toll─all he wanted.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_084: We knew after the first day. “The canker is in him,” my friend said. “Too deep to cut out, too strong to poison.” But I felt...I felt in my bones that Chadwick and I were meant to journey together. So how could he possibly die?
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_100_084: I showed him a few things, crafting and the like. What a quick pupil he was! Bright as a lamp, brave as a lion. Read like a scholar, too. Taught me a dance from a book─a book, can you believe that? The Rites of the Far East. Always looking east, he was...
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_085: I'd wondered why Chadwick asked me not to come say good-bye. Now I know and it makes me...makes me proud. Just look at him, hah! He's an adventurer now, sending me exotic gewgaws from his wanderings.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_086: See all the young ones? At the faire and all around you? One of them─one at least─is going to mean something to you. And when you lose him, if you lose him, it's going to be like...like there was a tree growing in your heart, and it got chopped right down.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_087: It's about the worst thing I've felt, and I wouldn't trade it away for all the world. We journeyed together, Chadwick and I. Nowhere as long as we wanted to, but we traveled the road awhile, aye.
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_088: Who's to say the dead don't travel? If the Twelve had any sense, they'd keep the young ones out of their mighty halls and out adventuring in the sun and under the moon. Else they'd be underfoot, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_089: Now we dance, adventurer. Dance and dream of the Far East! Learn it well, and perform it for others!
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_090: The eclectic bomb dance! A rite of summer, suitable in settings both staid and strident!
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_HAERMAGA_000_091: You call that a step, ? Lift and stamp! Lift and stamp! Drop your hips! Drop it like it's 18 tonzes! Now give me that hand clap!
TEXT_FESSUM010_01543_SYSTEM_000_100: You have learned the emote Bomb Dance!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_000: A moment of your time! Who'dn't give a moment 'less they got somethin' to hide, right? I'm with the Harbor Herald─name of Bran. I'm as green as they come. Consider this gaz born yesterday and still learnin' to spell “tomorrow.”
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_001: But I'd have to be beyond green to not know that you're a  that knows things. For example, this mysterious minstrel whose poetry's the talk of the town─you know about him, am I right?
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_002: Flamboyant kind of fella, I hear. Silver bijoux and scented oils. You sure you haven't seen him? Highly doubt an eagle eye like you'd miss him if he were about these parts.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_003: Then again, what do I know, right? I'm as green as the darlin' buds of spring. Hardly fair to think you'd live up to my lofty 'spectations!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_004: Pay no heed to what I said about you bein' an eagle eye and knowin' everythin' that's goin' on! I'll just go talk to some other folks. If you hear anythin' about the mysterious minstrel─not that I 'spect you to─you know where to find me.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_009: If you hear anythin' about the mysterious minstrel─not that I 'spect you to─you know where to find me. But don't strain yourself on my account!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GREGORY_000_010: ...A mysterious minstrel, you say? Might a merely puzzling one do? I met one of those just the other day, when I was about guild business in Gridania.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GREGORY_000_011: Now that you mention it, he did cut a rather dashing figure. It was at a remembrance for the Calamity. I started when I saw his face by the light of the fireworks! We looked alike as brothers, you see.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GREGORY_000_012: Well, fair he was to look upon, naturally. I introduced myself, asked him if he'd lost friends as I have...and what do you know, he thanks me. A puzzling sort of fellow, as I said.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GREGORY_000_015: The mysterious minstrel? Mayhap that fellow I met in Gridania when I was about guild's business. They were sending Azeyma's Candles up for the Calamity's fallen. Very intent he was on the fireworks.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GREGORY_000_016: I, too, see the friends I lost in the lions and spinners... So I spoke to the minstrel and, for some reason, he thanked me. What I did to prompt it, I have not a clue.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GIGIWAZU_000_010: The mysterious minstrel? Why, I believe I met the very man! It was in Ul'dah. I was there but recently, you see. As pleasant as Limsa Lominsa is, I feel the need to return home at a regular tick.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GIGIWAZU_000_011: He had me show him to the heights of the city─to see the fireworks. And, oh, how lovely they were! Flowers for the dead, blooming in the night sky...
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GIGIWAZU_000_012: Ah, but forgive my flights of fancy. The fireworks are quite extraordinary, however. No common green comets or blue spinners there. Might not this minstrel be working on a verse, a song of remembrance and hope?
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GIGIWAZU_000_015: I met what I suppose I would describe as a minstrel when last I nipped back to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GIGIWAZU_000_016: He had me show him the best vantage point for the fireworks. You know, the fireworks in remembrance of the Calamity. Surely, you've noticed them about the night sky of late.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GIGIWAZU_000_017: We must mourn, and we must hope, is that not so? Elsewise we die slowly. The bards understand it the best. I would imagine this minstrel was seeking inspiration for a new verse.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GINNADE_000_010: Have I heard of the mysterious minstrel? We have not merely heard─we have listened! Rest assured, we are on alert for this known troublemaker.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GINNADE_000_011: Let the record show that shortly before the Calamity, he was apprehended in La Noscea and placed in custody. The charges? Inciting a riot.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GINNADE_000_012: Further compounding his crimes, this minstrel vanished from the gaol before his guilt could be pronounced. He will be found, apprehended, and charged with prison breaking or my name is not Ginnade!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GINNADE_000_015: We are on high alert for the infamous minstrel who disturbed the peace of La Noscea in the days before the Calamity. A most dangerous fellow is he, wanted for inciting a riot and prison breaking.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_GINNADE_000_016: While it is true that he might have perished had he remained in his cell, the law is the law. There are proper channels for requesting transfer to another gaol, and I do not refer to the sewer tunnels!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_020: Some bread crumbs for the little bird? I knew you were the  to drop the hint to. This gaz may be raw, but daft he's not! The minstrel was spotted in Ul'dah and Gridania, you say? Knew that already. Watchin' fireworks, though─that's new! The Calamity remembrances, I'll wager.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_021: And the Yellowjackets are talkin' big, uh-huh, uh-huh. That means they're not even close to catchin' the fella. Last I checked, you can't smoke out a fox with hot air. Wager you a brass buckle the minstrel's goin' to show right here in Limsa.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_BRAN_000_022: So! The best vantage points for tonight's fireworks. Eagle eye, somethin' tells me you're the  to hold the fort here in the Aftcastle. I'm off to swarm up the other. Won't have it be said that Bran's ma raised a laggard!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Fancy meeting you here, . I am on a pilgrimage of a sort. I travel from city to city in remembrance of the Calamity, sleeping during the day to witness the fireworks by night.

A rare and beautiful sight are these fireworks, like all night-blooming flowers. That should be the sigil of adventurers, were you a house instead of a guild. Your greatest feats are done out of sun and sight, and smell the sweeter for it.
Do you seek me, good adventurer? Ah, you seek the mysterious minstrel...
That is a name I answer to, though most call me the wandering minstrel. Since the Calamity, I have traveled the land celebrating the exploits of adventurers.
There is fire in the sky again, where once death burned so brightly. I go from one remembrance to the next, singing of valor that aspires not to glory. I sing of you and yours.
There are no coincidences left─not in this time of stealing shadows. You and I are in the right place at the right time. Come, , tell me your tale, and I shall sing it to all the realm.

In the shadow of shadows, the commonfolk look to the adventurers. Have blade, will travel! No job too small, no danger too great! You are the gallants of this new and uncertain age─the lords of the road.
Your tale is the thread from which I weave my verses. A roving tale, to be sure, in need of many hours on the loom. In its stead, let me share with you the words of Louisoix Leveilleur...

Lances of light herald the dawn,
Beckoning shadows deeper still.

Splendor dances with shades
Unsheathed, a rime-kissed blade
Spills crimson o'er fields of white.
How did the Seventh Astral Era dawn but through the intervention of the Warriors of Light─“lances of light”? You are the lances of light, the sword of the morning─you and all adventurers.
Who better to lead Eorzea into the future but adventurers? You are the “lances of light,” make no mistake about it.
But Archon Louisoix warned us that shadows will accompany the coming of dawn. In answer to ascendant Light, Darkness will gather in opposition...or so I interpret his words.
What “a rime-kissed blade” signifies, I cannot yet fathom. But I have heard that roses of blood are blooming in the white fields of Coerthas, in ever greater profusion.

We are come to a strange harvest, adventurer. I fear the lances of light are destined to cross this rime-kissed blade. Pray hearken to these next words of mine, that you might be kept from the encroaching shadows─and as a token of appreciation for all that you have done.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SYSTEM_000_200: You have learned the emote Huzzah!
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SYSTEM_000_300: You have also unlocked the Slide I+XIV mini-game. Mark this anniversary of Eorzea's rebirth with a bout of puzzle solving.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_SYSTEM_000_301: Open the toy chest in any inn room to try your hand at this popular Eorzean pastime.
TEXT_FESANV001_01546_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0:
A growing light o'er all the realm
Fingers bright on highlands white
In an instance, a blade that smites the night.

But ill winds rise as the great gates yawn
Hope rides to meet what naught can cheat
An old despair astride a new-shod mare...
And thus do I wander and spin my words, all for the glory of Warriors of Light─or should I say, for the glory of you?

I have walked the four corners of Hydaelyn, from the Gardens of Xarakish, to the floating lakes of Voor Sian Siran, but never in my travels have I borne witness to tragedy such as that which befell Eorzea.
In the days before the Calamity, I glimpsed a world beyond the void─a new world, birthed from the ashes of the old, delivered from Darkness by the Bringer of Light. The giver of hope. You.
See how many look to you for hope, for the promise that night will end and dawn will come again.
What are you but a growing light, the hope that rides against despair? The rebirth of this realm is entirely because of you, the Warrior of Light.

We who gather to watch the fireworks─we are of one mind. We are not beaten. We live in a world of unimaginable loss and overwhelming suffering, yet we have hope. It is our light in the darkness─a light with which you blessed us.
And for that, you have my undying thanks, Warrior of Light. Mine and many others'.

It is always darkest before dawn, they say, and we will not see dawn for a long time yet. For every day without care, you will see three where the weight of the world will be upon you, for that is your destiny...
...and your hero's journey.

And when your journey comes to an end, who will you be? Though my heart longs to know, my own journey may take me to another land, down that nameless corridor of shades and sprites... Let me, then, leave you with a gift.
Never forget what you are, . The dawn that breaks over a realm reborn, the hope of Eorzea, the Warrior of Light...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_INVESTIGATOR01548_0: My pardon, but you wouldn't happen to be an adventurer, would you? I'm with the Adventurers' Guild myself, and would welcome some assistance if you've the time. I'll try to be brief.

Are you familiar with the Continental Circus? It's a troupe of performers who visit Eorzea's cities around this time every year, obstensibly to add an extra dash of revelry to the All Saints' Wake celebrations.

What we've kept largely a secret, however, is that these entertaining folk are not any kind of folk at all! They are, in fact, a group of imps and other monstrous beings who employ transformative magicks to alter their appearance.
As long as they cause no trouble, we're unwilling to unmask them and ruin the festivities. But these are voidsent, after all─'twould be foolish not to keep a close eye on their activities.
And that's where I've run into difficulties. They've grown wise to my observations, and slip away whenever I approach too closely. Do you think that you might aid me with my surveillance?
Splendid! From what I've managed to ascertain, the circus is recruiting volunteers to help with festival preparations.
Offer your services to the Auri illusionist over there in the amphitheatre, and learn exactly what these fiends are planning.
Should their intentions prove nefarious, then pray report back to me with all haste!
Pray speak with the Auri illusionist in the amphitheatre. Pretend to cooperate with her requests, and uncover any mischief that might be afoot. I shall wait here until you return!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_010:
Greetings from the Continental Circus!
We─ Have we met before!? (You mortals all look alike to me...) Ahem!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_011: Greetings from the Continental Circus! We shall make mischief with our masquerades below, even as the saints feast up above!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_012: Our main attraction this year is an authentically spine-chilling haunted house. This will be an All Saints' Wake to remember, I promise you!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_013: ...Or at least it will be once we have the mansion properly decorated. I'm afraid the preparations are taking rather longer than we anticipated.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_014: As a matter of fact, I've been on the lookout for willing victim─ Er, volunteers!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_015: Every helper will be rewarded with an open invitation to our monstrous manor. You'll be able to visit over and over, completely free of charge! An irresistible offer, yes?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_016: Consider yourself recruited, then! As for your tasks, they are mostly a matter of collecting commissions from laboriously distant locations.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_017: Your first chore will take you to the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah. We ordered some gorgeously gruesome candelabras, but neglected to organize their delivery...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_018: The second will involve a journey to the Bismarck in Limsa Lominsa. I sent one of our junior members to pick up a batch of seasonal cookies, and now I thoroughly regret the decision. Pray visit the Culinarians' Guild and see what is taking the flighty fool so long.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_019: The third and final task is also the closest: you need only walk into the Carpenters' Guild here in Gridania and collect the lanterns we requested. Simply mention decorations for the haunted house, and the receptionist should understand.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_020: Naught too complicated, I trust? Off you skitter, then!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_021: We must have the proper atmosphere if the manor is to have the desired...effect. Hurry back with those commissions!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_JEMIME_000_030: You've come for the Continental Circus commission? Very good. I have them right here for you.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_MEMBERB01548_000_03: Ah, I see─you must allow the butter and eggs to reach room temperature before mixing! This cooking business is almost as complex as spellcasting!
Oh, bubbling brimstone, the cookies! I was so caught up in learning recipes, I lost track of the time! The mistress will have my wings!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_CHARLYS_000_033: Sir! You dropped your─ <sigh> What an odd gentleman.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SYSTEM_000_034: Inducing mortal terror: a list of manor decorations.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_CORGG_000_035: Ah, yes, one of our more unusual commissions. I hope the lantern design is to your liking!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_JEMIME_000_036: When the thespians placed their order, they left us a gift of this adorable lantern. I think I'll keep it on display until the end of All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_CHARLYS_000_037: It's wonderful when our customers show an interest in culinary technique, but I've never met anyone so obsessed with cookies...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_CORGG_000_038: Were the lanterns sufficiently eerie? Our artisans rather enjoyed the idea of making decorations for All Saints' Wake!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_050: How did you fare? Were all our commissions ready for collection?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_051: Wonderful, thank you! Now we can put the finishing touches on our haunted house!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_052: Let's discuss your reward once I've handed these things over to our workers. I shan't be long, so don't scamper too far away!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_PUMPKIN_000_053: (-Disembodied Voice-)Heh heh heh... Know you the place where they work the hides of dead things? I suggest you wait there and watch if you would safeguard the souls of the living.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_054: Why don't you go for a wander, and take in the festive sights? I shall return soon with word of your reward.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_IMPHEAD_000_061: That overly curious mortal remains by his tree, I trust?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_IMPHEAD_000_062: You have done well. The fools will flock to our “haunted” manor, believing it a harmless attraction. And when they realize the true nature of the horrors within, their fear shall be exquisite!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_IMPHEAD_000_063: Like flies to excrement, our malevolent kin shall be drawn in droves by the stench of mortal terror. Once more shall this realm's cities be darkened by the Night of Devilry!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_064: (-Enthralling Illusionist-)A brilliant plan, Impresario! We shall reap a harvest of dread behind a facade of innocent revelry!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_065: (-Enthralling Illusionist-)All is in readiness! We have but to throw open the doors and invite our prey inside...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_INVESTIGATOR01548_0: The Night of Devilry, you say!?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_INVESTIGATOR01548_1: Legend has it that on such a night, a pumpkin-headed fiend raises an army of terrible demons and wreaks unimaginable havoc upon the cities of mortals...
Nay, we cannot allow them to succeed with this fearful harvest of theirs.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_INVESTIGATOR01548_0: ...Ah, I have it!
I shall spread word to all and sundry that the horrors they may experience within this haunted manor are mere illusion─clever magicks meant to enhance the atmosphere, and naught more!
Should folk enter the house with such expectations, then they are far more likely to be entertained than terrified.
Pray gather some few companions and conduct an advance exploration of the manor. I would know what tricks the imps plan that we might better spin them into treats.
Once you have traversed their ghostly halls, report back here to me!
The haunted manor awaits! ...Was there something else? Surely an adventurer with your training could not possibly be scared, could you?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_090: There were a few other matters to attend to, but our preparations are now in order! I─ Why do you stare at me so?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_091: Ahem. Well, thanks in great part to your assistance, we are ready to fling open the doors to our haunted manor!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_100_091: Before you enter, however, I suggest you speak with one of our harlequin guides─they will explain the various amusements that await you inside!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_092: You'll find a helpful circus member right here in the amphitheatre, or you might try the Acorn Orchard should you have business in New Gridania. I guarantee your manor experience will be transformative!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SYSTEM_000_093: You now have access to the Haunted Manor seasonal instance. To enter the manor, speak with the harlequin guide in either Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SYSTEM_100_094: The Haunted Manor is a light party instance (four players). There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_SYSTEM_100_095: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members will be filled out automatically via the matching system.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_094: Still mustering your courage? Speak with one of our harlequin guides when you're ready to brave the manor!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_INVESTIGATOR01548_0: You've returned from the imps' manor, then? Tell me: what awful evils lurked within?
...Cookies? Well, I suppose some might be tempted to face their fears again and again for the promise of more delicious baked goods. And you say they might also be used as currency for other rewards?

Diabolical...
I thank you for risking your sanity for the greater good. Oh, and pray take this treat away from me ere I succumb to its crumbling sweetness.
Hark, over there. It seems others have survived their foray into the haunted house. I only hope that my efforts to undermine its terrors were successful...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_TMARITAA_000_104: It was a little frightening at first, but the monsters were so much fun! Can we go again, Mama!?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_TDANAFA_000_105: Ahahaha, it all seemed so real, didn't it? The circus folk have certainly outdone themselves this year!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_TMARITAA_000_106: (-Cheerful Girl-)It was a little frightening at first, but the monsters were so much fun! Can we go again, Mama!?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_TDANAFA_000_107: (-Motherly Miqo'te-)Ahahaha, it all seemed so real, didn't it? The circus folk have certainly outdone themselves this year!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_108: ...Fun? FUN!? They were supposed to be terrified!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_WITCH01548_000_109: I don't understand it. Our members inside the manor report that the more fiendish they behaved, the more the visitors appeared to enjoy themselves...
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_IMPHEAD_000_110: Where did we go wrong? Have these mortals grown numb to fear?
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_IMPHEAD_000_111: ...No, they are sniveling cowards, each and every one. We must simply redouble our efforts! Their terror will fuel our conquest!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_INVESTIGATOR01548_0: Hah! It seems our interference has gone unnoticed by the imps!
I imagine my rumors will spread themselves as more folk visit the manor, but I'll be sure to nudge them in the right direction. Thank you again for your aid!
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_PUMPKIN_000_114:
Heh heh heh...
All their scheming come to naught. One almost feels sorry for the little devils.
TEXT_FESHLW301_01548_PUMPKIN_000_115: I found this garb inside the manor, and will leave it here for you, brave mortal. Best are the nights when there is happiness and joy for man and monster both...
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: A moment, if you please, ! You are not, perchance, one of these esteemed Eorzean adventurers I hear so much about, are you?

Aha! What astounding luck! You see, I am the tori bugyo come from distant lands to share with your people our Heavensturn customs. Unfortunately, I have been finding it nearly impossible to arouse any interest in our festivities.

While we were aware before arriving on your soils that our styles of celebration differ greatly, never did we imagine we'd be met with such indifference. To the contrary, given that this is the year of the cock, we were convinced your people would embrace us with open arms. After all, Eorzea is home to some of the biggest cocks in the realm─chocobos.

Yet every time I approach the citizens to ask them if they would join me, and together usher in the new year with this virile beast, all I receive are mumbled excuses or disapproving scowls as they quickly rush away.
I thought the problem perhaps originated with the fact that I was doing too much telling and not enough showing, and to remedy the situation, had this forged.

Simply smashing, isn't it? Who, I thought, would be able to resist the allure of this fine creature? Alas, when I asked passersby if I might present them with a lovely yellow cock, I was met with irritated groans and affronted gasps. When I invited them to touch this most prized of Far Eastern treasures, their response was even less enthusiastic.

Rather than risk incurring further offense, I have decided to redirect our efforts and instead bring our people together with desserts! And what better way to do so than with the crown jewel of Far Eastern treats─the rice cake! For that to happen, however, we must first make mochi! I don't suppose you're familiar with the practice of mochi pounding?
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_CHOICE1Q1_000_000: Are you familiar with the practice?
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_CHOICE1A2_002_002: I can't say that I am...
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: To think that you're not only a great adventurer but also one who is so well versed in the art of mochi pounding! Why, the fates themselves couldn't have arranged a more fortuitous encounter.
An esteemed adventurer who is both compassionate and already aware of this unique Far Eastern tradition! Why, it would seem my luck today knows no bounds!

Well, I suppose it then falls to me to explain! Mochi pounding is the process employed to produce mochi─or rice cakes─as they are better known here. They are usually made by pouring bowls of steaming rice into a large mortar, where they're then hammered into a soft, white paste. In the Far East, these mouthwatering sweets are considered a harbinger of good luck.

If the last Heavensturn festival is anything to go by, there's nothing better at bringing people together than rice cakes fresh from the mortar! By distributing these to the masses we are sure to enjoy the same amount of success!

Since nothing satisfies the stomach and warms the heart like freshly pounded rice cakes, we have decided to distribute them to the masses. Once they've had a taste, they'll not be able to resist the temptation to come back for more!

And that is why I stopped you, my friend! You see, after my countless failures I feel it best for me to retire from the front lines of this campaign and leave it to those who have the charm I seem to lack to advertise our sweets. Please, , will you help me spread the word?

Wonderful, simply wonderful! Seeing as I have already dispatched some of my delegates to appeal to the citizens on the upper decks, I would ask that you use that delightful smile of yours to persuade those down below.

No doubt, with a realm-renowned adventurer such as yourself advocating us nothing can go wrong! Haha! I see it already─throngs of people lining up, mouths frothing in anticipation! Our mochi daikan will be beyond pleased.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Did I perhaps hear my na─ Oho! Well, if it isn't ! Aren't you a sight for sore eyes. The call of making rice cakes was too great to resist, I take it? Well, that makes two...or four of us, rather.

I managed to convince a couple of the cyclopes from the last Heavensturn to assist me once again with the mochi pounding. Assuming you've already agreed to help, with both them and you at our side, the year of the cock is certain to be a resounding success!
Did I perhaps hear my name? Ah─and who might you be? ? Well, good to meet you. I am the mochi daikan, come to Eorzea to introduce a little Far Eastern delight known as mochi.

I've convinced a couple cyclopes to assist us with the mochi pounding, so while you spread word to the citizens, I shall go and set them to work. I assure you they won't be disappointed─there's nothing so tasty as mochi, which has been freshly pounded by a set of powerful arms!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: As you can see, the production of our rice cakes is in safe hands! Now all that's left to do is alert the people to the fact that free desserts are on their way!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Our other assistants will be making rounds up above to announce the good news, so I would ask that you try and persuade those on the lower decks.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RYSSFLOH_000_030: Spit it out, . I haven't the time to cater to each and every adventurer who passes this way now.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RYSSFLOH_000_031: Ah! Why didn't you say so sooner─of course I'll be there! Hahaha! As you can see for yourself, I'm never one to turn down free food!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SWOZBLAET_000_032: A fine  to you, ! Are you looking to purchase anything in particular, or are you simply interested in browsing our wares?
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SWOZBLAET_000_033: Oho! A festival, with complimentary desserts to boot!? You can bet your left leg I'll be there! Those of us on Hawkers' Alley are always on the prowl for a bargain and there's no better deal than free.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RBAHARRA_000_034: Why, hello there! What brings you to Mealvaan's Gate?
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RBAHARRA_000_035: Oh, goodness me! Is it that time of year already? Well, I'd best finish my work here so I can join the festivities!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RYSSFLOH_000_036: I've begun to put on a bit of weight of late, but a couple of these Far Eastern rice cakes shouldn't hurt me!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_SWOZBLAET_000_037: The thought of free treats is enough to motivate anyone to attend! I'll be sure to let the others know─I'm certain most folk here will jump at the chance!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RBAHARRA_000_038: I feel like a little girl again─I haven't been this excited about anything in ages!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: , you have finally come! Tell me, were the people thrilled by the news?
Fantastic! We must tell the mochi daikan right away! He has toiled day and night to─ Ah, never mind. It seems he's already heard. Haha! Look─he's so excited he's running this way at full tilt!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Birds... <pant> Birds, sir... <pant> Droves of 'em─all coming to steal our rice cakes! <pant>
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: Wh-What!? Y-You can't possibly be serious!
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Of course I'm serious! Would I have run all this way if I wasn't!? Can't you see we don't have much time and I'm in desperate need of your help─or perhaps...
You! Yes, ! You look like you'd be able to hold your own against the birds and rescue our mochi! Please, might you accompany me back to the site?
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: What is it boy? What's the matter?
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: I think... I think he means to say he wants to come with us. Very well, then.

Before we head off to the pounding site, however, there is one more stop I must make! , perhaps you remember the splendid creature that is Jiromaru? I shall go and fetch him, that we might rely upon his expertise in the retrieval of rice cakes.

Before we head off to the pounding site, however, I must first go and fetch my paissa, Jiromaru. His expertise in the retrieval of rice cakes is unparalleled and will no doubt prove invaluable upon the field!

Allowing a monkey to help with the opening festivities of the year of the cock will invite a mountain of misfortune, you say? Ah, yes indeed. Your confusion is not unwarranted. While in Eorzea paissas are commonly thought of as monkeys, 'tis not necessarily so in other parts of the realm.

Allow me to explain. You see, the paissa is possessed of a grace unlike any other creature. Why, such is their agility, these animals swinging from tree to tree is often likened to that of a large bird in flight. As such, we consider these feathered simians to be more bird than monkey.

But I digress! We have much more pressing matters at hand. Adventurer, please find your way to the mochi pounding site. I shall bring Jiromaru, as well as our eager chocobo friend and rendezvous with you there.
TEXT_FESNYR301_01549_BIRDMISSIONARY_000_: All our hard work─it will have been for nothing if we don't stop them! Please, my friend, go with the mochi daikan and save what is left before it's too late!
Ah, our hero has returned! , I cannot put to words how much I appreciate all you have done for us. Just look at all the joy you have spread to the people of Eorzea!
Thanks to you, the mochi daikan's late nights training with the cyclopes have finally paid off, and the buds of friendship between the East and the West have begun to fully blossom!
But not only that─it looks as though our chocobo friend and Jiromaru have formed a special bond of their own.
Your extraordinary kindness saw us through our darkest hour and is what made this Heavensturn so spectacular!
And for all your hard work, I would like to present to you this─your very own cock kabuto! Wear it with pride, my friend!
Now the festivities aren't over just yet, so it's time you enjoyed for yourself what this most merry of seasons has to offer. You have more than earned it!
Oh, but if for whatever reason you find yourself in want of something more to do, I'm sure our mochi daikan would be eager to have an extra pair of hands to help with the remainder of the rice cakes!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Well, well, if it isn't my old rival, !
Come at last to learn from a true hunter of elite marks, have you?

Forgive me if I seem overly presumptuous. Being the renowned adventurer that you are, I've always considered you to be a rival of sorts. A little healthy competition goes a long way in keeping one's skills sharp, you know.

Forgive me if I seem overly presumptuous. Being the renowned hunter that you are, I've always considered you to be a rival of sorts. A little healthy competition goes a long way in keeping one's skills sharp, you know.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_005: Gahaha, aye! But a hunter ain't worth shite without a smithy to keep him armed and armored.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_006: You'll have to excuse him. He's never been one for social graces. But he's a damn fine hunter, and what he brings back to the forge keeps me in business.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Who has time for grace when game is afoot. Which reminds me, I have news of a quarry that may pique your interest.
I recently came across a rather peculiar bill on the Clan Hunt board. Here, have a look.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_009: The bill depicts a crimson wyvern unlike anything you have ever seen. Unfortunately, further reading of the bill reveals nothing of its origins.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Strange, isn't it? Not only is the drawing unabashedly crude, the bill itself lacks the formality expected of anything approved by the Centurio clan. Still, a bounty is a bounty.

Before setting out, though, I thought it wise to first confirm the details of the request, and therein lies the rub─the Clansmen weren't even aware this bill had been posted. Likely the escapades of some mischievous youth, they said.
But if this beast truly is out there somewhere, what manner of hunter would I be if I didn't go and find out?
And from what I've been told, you're never one to back down from a chance at adventure. So how about it? Will you take up the hunt?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_A1_000_002: I have no time for rumors and hearsay.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Every bit the thrill seeker I marked you for. Glad to hear it.
Oh, come now, . Where's that sense of adventure I've heard so much about? This could be the opportunity of a lifetime!
To make things a little more interesting, what do you say we make this a race, eh? To see who can slay it first.
I'll even give you a hint to get you on your way. The beast we're after is a Rathalos─King of the Skies they call it. From what I've gathered, it was last spotted somewhere around the Azim Steppe.
You're like to learn more if you speak with the locals at Reunion. As for me, I still need to prepare before I can head out, so consider this a head start. Good luck, , and may the best hunter win!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_ORONIRMAN01554_000_: A red wyvern by the name Rathalos? I'm sorry, but you must be mistaken. I've heard stories of a great wyvern that slumbers in the mountains to the north, but it was not red, and most certainly does not go by that name.
Not that it matters now. Rumor has it the beast was recently slain by a band of wyvern hunters. <sigh> If only we had found it first...
But if this Rathalos you speak of truly exists, we may yet have another chance. Mark my words: this beast will fall by a blade of the Oronir!
Still, if this Rathalos you speak of truly exists, slaying such a beast would bring great honor to my tribe. Mark my words: this beast will fall by a blade of the Oronir!
You wait and see. Slaying this Rathalos will bring great glory to the Oronir.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_URAWOMAN01554_000_0: A red wyvern named Rathalos? ...Oh dear.
Perhaps the story I heard was true, then. Of a young man from the Ura clan leading a flock of dzos down from the mountains.

He was making his way to Reunion when a fierce wind began to blow. A terrible, howling gale which left him all but blinded. To his horror, he soon realized the deafening roar he heard was not of the wind's making.
He claims it was that of a great wyvern, which descended from on high to claim several dzos from his flock, disappearing into the sky as quickly as it came.
Needless to say he ran to Reunion with all haste, telling everyone of what had happened. But the man is a known liar and a swindler. Who would believe such a tale coming from him?
Thankfully I've not had the displeasure of seeing such a creature here. Oh, how I hope his story is yet another lie.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_KHAWOMAN01554_000_0: A gargantuan red wyvern? I'm sorry, , but I'm not overly familiar with the comings and goings of this place. I only visit on occasion to do a small bit of business.
Perhaps you should speak with the Qestir. Though speak is perhaps not the right word, seeing as they do not. At any rate, you will find none more knowledgeable of the happenings in the Azim Steppe.
If anyone would know of this wyvern you seek, it would be the Qestir.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Ah, ! Already on the hunt, are we? I suggest you move quickly. Once I've warmed up, the wyvern is as good as slain.
You'd best head to Reunion if you haven't already and see what you can learn from the locals. I'll be along after a few more squats.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_070: Don't look so surprised. Even a smithy needs to stay in shape, you know.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_075: It's nice to see someone taking this barmy fool's stories seriously for once. Crazy as they seem, though, every now and again they turn out to be true.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_091: Upon hearing of a red wyvern, the Qestiri merchant takes on a grave expression.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_093: The Qestiri merchant points southwestward. Perhaps you will find some clue to the wyvern's whereabouts in that direction.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_100: You arrive at the area the Qestiri merchant appeared to be indicating. All you can do now is lie in wait for your prey.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_105: (-???-)What's this? Oh, a hunter! And a furrrmidable-looking one at that!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_110: (-Fashionable Feline-)Have you come to help, then? To hunt the meownster Rathalos?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_A2_000_001: After seeing the bounty I couldn't resist!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_125: (-Fashionable Feline-)Thank you, , thank you! I knew I was right to post that bill.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_130: (-Fashionable Feline-)Oh, that's rich coming from you. Or have you not looked in a mirror lately?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_135: (-Fashionable Feline-)And what's wrong with a talking cat? Have you not seen the turtles and fish around these parts?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_140: I'm an apprentice Felyne hunter, and I've come to this place in search of meownsters. Rathalos to be precise.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_145: But even with nine lives I could never slay one on my own. That's why I posted that notice seeking help.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_150: There's a reason they're often referred to as King of the Skies, after all.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_155: Some also call them fire wyverns, on account of their ability to breathe fire. I feel paw-ful just thinking about all the hunters burned to cinders in their wake.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_160: Yes, yes, and they roar exactly like that. Would you believe it's powerful enough to stun their prey?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_165: That was him! That was a Rathalos! Still willing to help, I hope?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_170: What a day, what a day. Both a meownster and a furrrocious hunter to slay it? I sure got the cream today!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_175: Let's hurry. He seemed to be heading northwest, back into the meowntains.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_180: Oh, before I forget. I never did ask your name.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_185: Nice to meet you, . Now, let's be off!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Ah, ! Already on the hunt I see. If you still mean to beat me, I suggest you move quickly. Once I've finished warming up that wyvern is as good as slain.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_195: Hahaha! Even a smithy needs to stay in shape, you know.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_205: The Qestiri merchant points southwestward. Perhaps you will find some clue to the Rathalos's whereabouts in that direction.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_210: The Rathalos is somewhere along that path, I just know it!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_211: But I'm afraid you'll have to go without me. As I am right meow, I fear I'd only slow you down.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_212: Before you go, though, I insist you take these with you.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_213: When cat-astrophe strikes, a hunter should never be without mega potions. I don't know if you normally keep medicine on hand to treat your wounds, but I guarantee you've never had anything quite like that.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_214: When you and your friends are ready, head on in. You...do have friends to help, right?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_215: Eight? I thought hunters usually fight in groups of four... Well, I suppose you know best.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_216: During the battle the Great Hunt, you will gain access to the duty action Mega Potion.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_217: Be advised that, while it can be used to restore a large amount of HP, its usage is limited.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_218: Upon clearing the duty, you can claim a special reward by examining the remains of the Rathalos. Be certain to do so before leaving the instance.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_220: If you find yourself in a pinch, don't forget to use that mega potion.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_230: I saw the whole thing. That was meow-gnificent!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_231: You even managed to retrieve a scale from his remains. I'm impressed!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_232: I realize this is sudden, but it would mean so much to me if I could join you on more adventures. Would you...would you accept me as your Palico?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_A3_000_002: That depends. What's the reward for slaying the Rathalos?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_234: I promise to be the purrrfect companion. You won't regret this!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_235: O-Oh, of course. You hunters are an astute lot, aren't you. Well, the thing is...I used the last of my funds to purchase those mega potions...
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_236: But I promise I'll make it up to you as the purrrfect Palico companion.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_237: And to think this is all because you saw my bill on the Hunt board.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_238: Hm? A hunter in Kugane showed it to you?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_239: Curious. Do you think we could go and pay them a visit? If not for this hunter, we never would have met.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_240: Then let's be off to Kugane!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: That should do it. I'm warmed up and ready to go hunting!
Ah, . I thought you'd already left. With my preparations complete, you'll need to work fast if you mean to beat me.
Wh-What is that!? Another monster in need of slaying?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_254: I'm no meownster, you brute. I'm 's faithful and dependable Palico.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: A...Palico? Ahem, my apologies. If you're as dependable as you are adorable, I've no doubt  values your companionship.
But let's return to the matter at hand, shall we? , are you ready to set out on our hunt for the Rathalos?
You've already slain him!?
Hahaha! I'd expect nothing less from my rival. Indeed, you're every bit the hunter I imagined you'd be.
Hahaha! I'd expect nothing less from my rival. Indeed, you're every bit the adventurer I imagined you'd be.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_260: Suppose that's what we get for that extra set of squats.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_261: Tell me, friend. Were you able to recover anything from the body?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_262: As a matter of fact,  carved a scale off the Rathalos's hide!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_100_262: That's a mighty fine material for smithing. Mind if I have a look?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_263: Aye, this is a wyvern's scale alright. Light as a feather and tougher than steel. There's still a touch of heat to it, too.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_264: If you'd like, I'd be more than willing to fashion you some armor with it. I'll need more than a single scale, of course.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_265: You'll find no better mail than that forged with Rathalos scales. What do you say?
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_266: Oh, . I can't thank you enough for your help in slaying that Rathalos.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_FELYNE_000_267: If you plan to go hunting again, don't hesitate to call. We'll show those meownsters what for!
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_268: You can now trade Rathalos scales to the smithy in exchange for various goods.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SYSTEM_000_269: Rathalos scales can be obtained by defeating the Rathalos in the Great Hunt.
TEXT_STMBDY991_01554_SMITHERY_000_270: Nothing like a few hundred squats to limber up before smithing.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: The great hunter returns. You did well taking on that Rathalos.
Though I must ask: was the battle grueling? Did the mountains sing with the sound of claws clashing with steel?
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_A1_000_002: It was admittedly more trouble than I expected.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_RIVALMOBHUNTER_100_: Ah, but of course. Perhaps battle with a high-ranking Rathalos would have put a bit of sweat on your brow.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_RIVALMOBHUNTER_101_: Truly? I shudder to think what would have happened had you encountered a high-ranking Rathalos, then.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: Piqued your curiosity, have I? Well, I can only tell you what I've heard.
They say there is a stronger brood of Rathalos that would make short work of your average hunter.
Mayhap that kitten friend of yours knows something of it. He was, after all, the one who originally posted a bill for the beast.
No need to worry over it now, though. I'd say you've earned a rest after your recent exertions in the Azim Steppe. When you're up for another hunt I'll be here, ready and waiting.
The mighty hunter returns, and with  feline companion!
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_FELYNE_000_011: Feline!? How rude! I am a Felyne you dullard!
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_:
I...fail to see the difference...
Ahem. But that is neither here nor there. I asked  to bring you here that we might learn the truth of these high-ranking Rathalos I recently caught wind of.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_FELYNE_000_013: High Rank Rathalos? They're an older, much more powerful brood of wyvern...
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_FELYNE_000_014: Without sufficient protection, even the simplest of swipes is all it would take to rend a hunter in two.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_RIVALMOBHUNTER_000_: If I didn't know better, I'd say you were talking about an elite mark. Yes, a challenge no self-respecting hunter can ignore!
It's settled, then. Are you ready, my friend?
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_FELYNE_000_018: Your enthusiasm is appreciated, but now isn't the time to be kitten around. To be purrrfectly plain, I'd rather not see another hunter charbroiled today.
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_SYSTEM_000_019: You have unlocked the Great Hunt (Extreme). Test your mettle against High Rank Rathalos and reap rich rewards!
TEXT_STMBDY992_01555_SYSTEM_000_020: Please note you may only enter the Great Hunt (Extreme) with four players.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_000: What to do, what to do... Ah, . Mayhap you can cut through this knot of ours.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_001: Revenant's Toll grows yet does not prosper. We draw adventurers from far and wide─or rather, the Allagan ruins draw them.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_002: So busy are they collecting tomestones and relics that they've no time for calls from the Adventurers' Guild. I fear that many who come to the Toll have no sense that we are a guild!
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_003: You visit Rowena's establishment, do you not? That's the kind of bustle and camaraderie I'd like to see at the guild!
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_004: Now, tales of your derring-do are certainly known to all. You're the genuine article, and I'd ask humbly for you to render some service to us in this matter.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_005: If you were to rid the wilds of the seedkin that threaten the Toll's expansion, it might inspire some fledgling guildmates to do the same.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_006: Those laboring on the outpost's frontier are being harassed by morbols coming through the Tangle. I would have you help keep the workers safe by slaying them before they've a chance to leave their wretched home.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_007: Once others see such a storied adventurer as you working to expand Revenant's Toll, they'll surely be inspired to do the same.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_008: The Adventurers' Guild is seeking volunteers to help rid the frontier of the morbols that harry those working there.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_009: I would ask you to travel to the eastern part of the Tangle and strike at the morbols where they live. Your deeds will surely inspire others to do the same.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_020: Ahhh, ! The Adventurers' Guild has marked the completion of their request for aid, and honors your service.
TEXT_GAIUSX110_01561_SLAFBORN_000_021: Already, the Toll buzzes with talk of your valiant excursion into the Tangle. Not a few adventurers have chosen to help on the frontier! Know that the Scions will hear of your success.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_000: Ah, I forgot to mention before─I received word from the guild that they've seen more adventurers take up job requests in the last few days than in the past moon.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_001: Heh, but of course one good turn leads to another...we hope. There's a job that might be too much for those who have expressed an interest. We'd like you to handle this one, before an unprepared adventurer meets an untimely end.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_002: We received word from a scouting party we sent to the Singing Shards that a group of hapalits is making passage impossible. Someone needs to take care of them so the scouts can make progress. Not that I've no faith in the other volunteers, but I suspect few of them have stood against a hapalit.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_003: Ignominy isn't something we can afford at the present. We have appearances to keep up if we are to maintain our growth, after all. A seasoned adventurer like you ought to know that a bad reputation's like bad breath: no one will ever speak frankly of what ails you.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_004: You're to complete a mission at the guild's behest. If anybody can slay the hapalits and clear the way for our scouts, it's you.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_005: It won't be an easy task, I'll warrant, but with your prowess, the hapalits are likely to fall without undue harm to some overeager youngster. Think what you'll do for other adventurers...and for the Scions' relationship with the guild.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_020: You return, and looking none the worse for wear, I rejoice to remark.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_021: Your reputation precedes you yet again─the Seventh Heaven is abuzz with talk of your deeds. We've already signed up a score or more to answer further requests from the guild.
TEXT_GAIUSX111_01562_SLAFBORN_000_022: Revenant's Toll grows and prospers, to the benefit of the guild and the Scions. Did I not tell you there is much magic in being prepared?
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SCARLET_000_000: Gloryhounds such as yourself will be pleased to have this news from the powers that be: the Eorzean Alliance has established a new system known as the Hunt.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SCARLET_000_001: We never lack for creatures and men that disturb the sylvan serenity. Henceforth these miscreants shall be marked for felling, and whoever deals the blow shall collect a reward. 'Tis a bounty system, when all's said and done.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SCARLET_000_002: The Alliance makes much of this joining of sword hands, while allowing rivalries to go unchecked elsewhere. Small wonder that some see a bent branch where we claim a bough true and proud.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SCARLET_100_002: But these are matters for our betters to ponder. For now, you may serve by offering the Hunt your considerable talent for slaughter.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SCARLET_000_003: The bounty is rich, and you stand to gain much for your services. But don't take my word for it─speak with the Hunt billmaster to learn of rewards and other such details.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_SCARLET_000_005: The Hunt is a bounty system when all's said and done, and a rich bounty it is indeed. Ask the Hunt billmaster if you would know more.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_MOBOFFICER_000_010: Here to join the Hunt, are you? Excellent, excellent. I'll get right into the explanation.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_MOBOFFICER_000_011: First things first, you'll want to take a look at this Hunt board. There are bills for all sorts of marks here.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_MOBOFFICER_000_012: There are two kinds of bills. The kind for regular marks and the kind for elite marks. The second of these are the more notorious sort. Before you go after one of them, I recommend you consult a hunter-scholar. These people are veterans of the Hunt who can recite the Raimdelle Codex by heart.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_MOBOFFICER_000_013: Once the Hunt's done, you'll receive tokens called Allied Seals, which you can exchange for exclusive wares.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_MOBOFFICER_000_014: If any of that got stuck going down, you're welcome to come back and ask again...and again, no doubt. I can attend to any Allied Seals you'd like to spend as well.
TEXT_COMGRD003_01563_MOBOFFICER_000_015: Wood's will be done, . If I don't hear from you soon, I'll take it you weren't Hunt material...or that a mark got the best of you. Oh, do cheer up. Better to die once than live ever in shame.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_TRACHRAET_000_000:
I'll wager a salty swab such as yerself'd be keen to know what went on at the big parley. Upshot is, the Eorzean Alliance's called for the 'Unts!
...What's that? 'Unts, I said, like with 'arpoons an' narwhals.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_TRACHRAET_000_001: The 'Unt be a system what puts a bounty on them what flout the law. It don't matter whether they be men or beasts. If ye slay the troublemaker, ye get a reward.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_TRACHRAET_000_002: Aye, it's a nice bit o' cooperation. O' course, we still fight like squid and whales out in the 'interlands. If the Alliance thinks that people 'aven't noticed, the lot of 'em are drunk on seawater.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_TRACHRAET_100_002: But that's neither 'ere nor there for ye. Nay, 'tis the 'Unt we need ye for. Put down some marks, contribute to the peace─the commonfolk'll thank ye for it.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_TRACHRAET_000_003: If ye've got a mind to learn more, 'ead on into Maelstrom Command an' speak with the 'Unt billmaster. The bloke can tell ye all about the details.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_TRACHRAET_000_005: Aye, there's fair bounty to be 'ad in the 'Unt. If ye've got a mind to learn more, 'ead on into Maelstrom Command an' speak with the 'Unt billmaster.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_MOBOFFICER_000_010: Care to sign on to a hunt? Excellent, excellent. You appear suitably flinty-eyed and rough-knuckled. Bear with me as I cover the basics.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_MOBOFFICER_000_011: The Hunt board is your first step, quite so. These bills you see─each one represents a mark that can be hunted for bounty.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_MOBOFFICER_000_012: Your keen eyes will have noticed that there are not one but two kinds of bills: regular and elite. The latter is rather more challenging, and before you go after one of them, you may want to consult a hunter-scholar. These people are veterans of the Hunt who can recite the Raimdelle Codex by heart.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_MOBOFFICER_000_013: The rest is straightforward: slay the mark, complete the hunt. For each kill, you'll receive a sum in Allied Seals, which can be used to purchase exclusive wares.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_MOBOFFICER_000_014: I hope you won't hesitate to return. In addition to exchanging the seals for rewards, I am ever ready to explain the Hunt in greater detail.
TEXT_COMLIM003_01564_MOBOFFICER_000_015: The best of luck to you, adventurer, till sea swallows all. And take heart! I've heard it said that many go to the Hunt, and most return alive!
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MIMIO_000_000: Ah, sound the horns, for the Hunt begins! Quickly now, lend me your ears: the Eorzean Alliance has finally agreed to put a bounty on the worst of the lawless. About time!
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MIMIO_000_001: I mean the creatures and men that gum up the works like errant grains of sand. They're to be marked for extermination, praise the Traders, and such rewards as befit the task paid out. They call it the Hunt, a prosaic sort of name if you ask me.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MIMIO_000_002: Wonderful to see the Alliance come together for such free market initiatives! I might say that cooperation on this point hardly makes a lie of the competition in less, ah, fecund areas. If there is enough to share, we share. If not, then it's survival of the fittest.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MIMIO_100_002: But I forget myself! It is the Hunt that requires your services, not the never-ending bickering of nations.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MIMIO_000_003: And perhaps you need the Hunt as well! The work is no sinecure, but the rewards are rich. Speak with the Hunt billmaster if you would hear more.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MIMIO_000_005: The Hunt rewards you amply for dispatching a mark. If you would hear more, seek out the Hunt billmaster within.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MOBOFFICER_000_010: What do you want? Ah, the Hunt. Do excuse my churlishness─I have my reasons. But let's get on with it, shall we?
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MOBOFFICER_000_011: The Hunt board─it's a board. Not much more to say beyond that. It's for posting bills. They are for the marks to be hunted. One bill for each merchandise─excuse me, black-hearted villain.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MOBOFFICER_000_012: You'll notice there are two kinds of bills. There's the regular kind for regular wares─pardon me, regular blackguards─and an elite mark bill for something a bit more special. Stronger, more murderous, and so forth. Before you take one of these on, you may want to consult a hunter-scholar. That's a veteran of the Hunt who knows the Raimdelle Codex by heart.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MOBOFFICER_000_013: The rest is straightforward: kill the mark and claim your reward in Allied Seals. These I will accept in exchange for exclusive wares.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MOBOFFICER_000_014: Do note that I do not only deal in seals. I am also the resident expert in the Hunt, and it would be well for you to remember whom to come crying to.
TEXT_COMULD003_01565_MOBOFFICER_000_015:
I do hope that you'll not disappoint. After all, this is for coin and country!
...Ahem. Well, that's more than enough of that, thank you very much.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_000: Ah, ! I bid you welcome to the Sanctum of the Twelve! My name is Claribel, and I should be honored to help you make arrangements for your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_001: We have hosted many magnificent ceremonies here, and you may rest assured that our staff is ready and eager to meet your every demand.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_002: The Ceremony of Eternal Bonding optional service allows two players to form an eternal bond with one another by completing the special quest “The Ties that Bind.”
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_003: The service plan for your ceremony is determined by the promise wristlets you and your partner are wearing when you undertake this quest.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_004: Please be advised that your service plan cannot be changed after you undertake the quest.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_004: You and your partner are equipped with different promise wristlets. If you choose to undertake this quest, you will proceed with the  service plan.

Proceed with the standard service plan?
