Proceed with the platinum service plan?

Service plans cannot be changed after undertaking this quest.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_008: If you wish to proceed with a different service plan, please visit the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding site via the Lodestone for more information.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_010: Once more, pray allow me to say what an honor it is that I may share in this joyous occasion!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_100_010: Truly, there is naught more sacred than the union of two souls...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_011: ...And there is no place better suited to host such a ceremony than the Sanctum of the Twelve, the great cathedral in which we pay homage to the gods of Eorzea.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_012: A bond formed here, under the watchful eyes of the Twelve, shall endure for all eternity...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_013: ...And you and your partner shall know happiness everlasting...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_014: ...Provided, of course, that you two receive the blessings of the Twelve. But fear not, my , for you and your partner need only follow my instructions.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_015: In accordance with tradition, you must prepare symbols of your undying devotion to one another.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_016: Namely, the rings which you will exchange during the ceremony.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_017: I say “symbols,” yet these rings are far, far more than mere jewelry, as you will learn...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_018: ...When you embark upon your pilgrimage to the marks of the Twelve in order to imbue your rings with Their blessings.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_019: Ahhh, what could be more romantic than traveling the breadth of Eorzea with your beloved, seeing all that the land has to offer? How I envy you!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_020: Once you have returned, you must then plan and schedule the ceremony itself─a task as daunting as the pilgrimage, perhaps, but no less rewarding, I assure you.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_021: If you prefer a private ceremony without guests, that is certainly an option. However, if you wish to invite friends and family, we will furnish you with invitations to distribute as you see fit.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_022:
And finally, once your preparations are complete, but one task shall remain: to wait until the appointed hour, when you and your partner shall be as one!
...I know, I know─it must all seem rather much to remember.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_023: Allow me to reassure you that you have nothing to fear. In fact, when you at long last stand beside one another in the Ivory Chapel, you will wonder how it could have ever seemed so complex.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_024: As I said before, you and your partner need only follow my instructions. I have guided countless couples through this process without fail, and I shall do so once more. You have my word.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_025: Now then, I believe the first order of business is outfitting you with the proper attire! The young lady over yonder will be of service.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_026: And do remember to smile, my ! After all, this is the first step on a grand, never-ending journey with your beloved!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_027: While certain objectives in the special quest “The Ties that Bind” can be completed solo, other objectives cannot be completed unless your partner is present and in a party with you.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_028: Moreover, please be advised that a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding cannot be held unless both participants have completed all required objectives.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_028: Before you speak with the ceremony outfitter to obtain your garments, please ensure that you have at least  slots in your inventory.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_029: Should you have inquiries regarding the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding, you may speak with the Sanctum acolyte next to the ceremony outfitter at any time.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_040: Pray return to me once you have retrieved your garments from the ceremony outfitter.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_041: Before you speak with the ceremony outfitter to obtain your garments, please ensure that you have at least  slots in your inventory.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_090: I bid you welcome to the Sanctum of the Twelve. If you wish to make arrangements for a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding, pray see to your preparations and speak with me once more.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_091: The Ceremony of Eternal Bonding optional service allows two players to form an eternal bond with one another by completing the special quest “The Ties that Bind.”
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_091: This quest is available to those who have obtained promise wristlets, which may be acquired via the online store.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_092: To proceed, you and your partner must equip yourselves with promise wristlets.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_093: You must also form a party of two with your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_094: Furthermore, if you have an existing bond, you must first have it annulled, and you must also obtain a new promise wristlet.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_095: For further details, please visit the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding site via the Lodestone.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CEREMONYSHOP01578_0: , yes? Congratulations on your pending union! I've no doubt it shall be a ceremony for the ages!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CEREMONYSHOP01578_1: Now, may I ask what manner of attire you wish to wear for this most auspicious of occasions?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_Q13_100_000: What attire do you wish to wear?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CEREMONYSHOP01578_1: Here you are─garments expertly tailored to your specifications, as well as a complimentary token valid for a single consultation with Jandelaine, the esteemed aesthetician.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CEREMONYSHOP01578_0: Despite their rather formal appearance, I think you'll find them to be quite comfortable! Why, you could go traipsing about Eorzea so dressed, should you fancy it.

More traditional-minded folk prefer to wait until the ceremony to don them, so as not to present an unsightly figure when embracing their beloved just so... Hm? Well, of course I look awkward! Anyone would when embracing the air! Hmph!
In any case, that is all I have to offer you for now─though I do have an assortment of other items for sale, if you've a mind to add additional flair to the festivities.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_064: Please be advised that wares on offer are available only to those currently undertaking the quest “The Ties that Bind,” and who have yet to hold their ceremony.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_065: You have learned the emote Embrace!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_067: A new hairstyle is now available. To use it, you must unlock access to the aesthetician by completing the quest “Beauty Is Only Scalp Deep.”
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_067: You may exchange a tailcoat for a gown, or vice versa, by speaking with a Calamity salvager.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CEREMONYSHOP01578_0: Mayhap you feel as though your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding is lacking that certain something? If so, I have an assortment of items you can use to make your special day even more special!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_071: Please be advised that wares on offer are available only to those currently undertaking the quest “The Ties that Bind,” and who have yet to hold their ceremony.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_080: I trust the garments meet with your satisfaction? Excellent!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_081: Let us next discuss that most essential of preparations: the rings.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_082: Only a ring engraved with the symbols of the Twelve and imbued with Their blessings will suffice.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_083: A flawless band suitable for this purpose can be purchased from many merchants, or commissioned from a skilled goldsmith.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_084: You may also elect to craft it yourself, if you possess the requisite skill. 'Tis more common than you may think!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_085: Perhaps how you choose to procure your ring will become a story in and of itself...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_086: Regardless, once you have obtained the band, you must take it to the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah for engraving. Even a master goldsmith must defer to the expertise of the guild when it comes to this particular step.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_087: Afterwards, pray return here to me so that I might inspect the finished work.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_100: I am told that the techniques used to make these engravings are a closely guarded secret...though some speculate that it is a fiction perpetuated by the guild to secure all such commissions.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_111: It is always an honor and a pleasure to assist those who have found true love.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_112: Now then, if you would hand me the ring you wish to be engraved...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_120: Oh? You have yet to acquire a suitable ring? If so, I suggest you browse the market boards. I am given to understand such bands are a popular commodity of late.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_130: A well-chosen piece, . You shall not be disappointed.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_140: Exquisite craftsmanship, would you not agree?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_141: I do not mean to pry into your personal affairs, but I am something of a romantic. If I may ask, how did you acquire this ring?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_A2_000_144: A friend made it for me.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_A2_000_145: I paid for it with good coin.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_150: How wonderful! What better way to express your love than by crafting the ring yourself?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_151: Your friend is most generous─and skilled, I might add.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_152: I can only imagine how hard you must have worked to amass the funds. But as you can see, it was well worth the price.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_153: Hah, how mysterious! Very well. Doubtless you have your reasons for keeping it a secret.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_160: Now that the symbols of the Twelve have been engraved upon the inside of your ring, it is ready to receive Their blessings.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_161: Only rings which have been imbued with these blessings may be used in a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding, as I believe Mistress Claribel informed you.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_162: When you return to the Sanctum of the Twelve, she will need to inspect the ring as a matter of due course.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_163: Once satisfied, she will explain to you what you must do next. Fare thee well!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_JEMIME_000_170: Mistress Claribel will need to inspect your ring before you undertake your pilgrimage. 'Tis merely a precautionary measure.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_190: We welcome your return, my . Have you the ring?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_200: Marvelous, simply marvelous. But beautiful as it is now, it will grow far more radiant as you carry out your pilgrimage to receive the blessings of the Twelve.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_201: Perhaps you are wondering why we place such an importance on this act. Indeed, there are those who believe it to be a wholly symbolic─and therefore unnecessary─tradition.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_202: Yet was it not but a scant few years ago, on the eve of the Calamity, that Archon Louisoix implored the people to seek the symbols of the Twelve, and to pray for Eorzea's salvation?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_203: At the time, the possibility that even the most powerless among us could make a difference was enough to unite countless Eorzeans in common cause, regardless of race or creed. And so I prayed, as did many others...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_204: Whether it was divine providence that we survived, none can truly say. However, in light of recent discoveries, I believe it somewhat likely. You see, during the restoration of the Sanctum, texts of indeterminate age were discovered─a fragment of which has since been deciphered...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_205: In a time long ago, the people of Eorzea faced a crisis no less dire than the fall of Dalamud...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_206: Yet rather than set aside their disputes and rebuild from the ashes, they succumbed to their baser instincts and squabbled amongst themselves. In the aftermath of that calamity, the land slipped further into chaos...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_207: Two souls, united in purpose, rose above their brethren, and together they sought out the marks of the Twelve to entreat each deity for an answer to the question: what must mankind do to survive?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_208: Before each mark they prayed and awaited a response...but the ones they received were not the ones they sought. Yet they pressed on, ever hopeful, and over the course of their journey, a bond began to form between the two...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_209: Many now retrace the steps of their journey, visiting each mark of the Twelve as they did long ago.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_210: And what do you suppose they found at the end of their pilgrimage? You shall know...when you and your partner return from your own.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_211: ...If that fails to serve as sufficient motivation, I should add that some here at the Sanctum consider it to be a fitting test of one's relationship as well. 'Twould not bode well if you could not suffer your partner's company on a journey across Eorzea, after all.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_212: You must begin with the closest marks here in the Twelveswood─those of Nophica, Byregot, and Althyk, for those were the first visited by the first pilgrims.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_213: After that, you must proceed to La Noscea, Thanalan, Coerthas, and finally Mor Dhona.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_214: Pray allow me to mark the locations on your map. We would not want you to lose your way.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_215: When you return, I shall take your rings into safekeeping. Until then, I wish you safe travels!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_220: To receive the blessings of the Twelve, you must pray before each of the twelve marks located throughout Eorzea while you are in a party with your partner, and both of you are equipped with promise wristlets.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_222: The location of the marks you must visit next can be reviewed in the journal entry for the quest “The Ties that Bind,” or by selecting the objective in the duty list.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_240: If ever you are unsure where to travel next, you need only refer to the locations I marked on your map.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_241: And do not forget that you and your partner must pray at each mark together! It would have no meaning were you to travel separately.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_320: As you pray before the mark of the Matron, a sense of calm washes over you...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_340: As you pray before the mark of the Builder, a sense of calm washes over you...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_360: As you pray before the mark of the Keeper, a sense of calm washes over you...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_370: Have you already visited the three marks in the Twelveswood? Good, good. I believe those in La Noscea are next.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_380: As you pray before the mark of the Navigator, the divine band seems to catch the light...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_400: As you pray before the mark of the Spinner, the divine band seems to catch the light...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_420: As you pray before the mark of the Wanderer, the divine band seems to catch the light...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_430: You need not visit all four marks in Thanalan. Traditionally, one would visit both the mark of the Dawn Trader and the Dusk Trader, but since the Sacrarium is still sealed to outsiders, it cannot be helped.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_440: As you pray before the mark of the Dusk Trader, the divine band seems to grow warm...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_460: As you pray before the mark of the Destroyer, the divine band seems to grow warm...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_480: As you pray before the mark of the Warden, the divine band seems to grow warm...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_490: Not that I don't appreciate your eagerness to keep us abreast of your progress, but should you not be headed to Coerthas?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_500: As you pray before the mark of the Fury, you feel a shiver down your spine...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_520: As you pray before the mark of the Lover, you feel a shiver down your spine...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_530: But one mark remains! Pray make haste to Mor Dhona, my .
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_540: As you pray before the mark of the Scholar, you sense nothing unusual. However, when you look on the divine band, you observe that it seems to sparkle with a newfound radiance...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_900: To entreat the Twelve for Their blessings, select the mark and use the pray emote.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_901: To entreat the Twelve for Their blessings, your partner must be present in the same area.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_902: To entreat the Twelve for Their blessings, you must form a party of two with your partner.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_903: To entreat the Twelve for Their blessings, you and your partner must equip yourselves with promise wristlets.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_560: My ! By your countenance I gather you have completed your pilgrimage?
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_561: If so, I must ask you to entrust your ring to me for safekeeping until the day of your ceremony.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_570: Oh, I was under the impression you had the ring in your possession. Pray inform me when you have returned here with it.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_580: How it shimmers in the light... Yes, there can be no doubt. The gods have gazed within your hearts, and they have blessed the bond between you and your partner!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_581: When you exchange rings, this sacred bond shall become eternal, and no calamity─no matter how great─shall ever break it. So it was long ago, when two souls traveled the land in search of answers...
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_582: What must we do to survive? How are we to carry on? At each mark they prayed, and from each issued forth the words of the divine.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_583: “Creation begets destruction, and naught exists which cannot be sundered.” Thus spoke Rhalgr, and the two moved on.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_584: “Death ever follows life, and naught lives which shall not die.” Thus spoke Althyk, and the two moved on.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_585: These were not the answers they sought, and so they continued onwards. They clung to the hope that salvation was within their grasp, even when the gods themselves proclaimed otherwise.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_586: At last, they arrived at the mark of the Scholar─the final mark, and their final destination. As before, they knelt and prayed for a revelation, and as before a voice rang out.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_587: “Together, you have wrought that which you sought.” Thus spoke Thaliak. As the two gazed into each other's eyes, they came to understand.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_588: During their search for an answer, the two had grown closer. Their trust had deepened, and their hearts had become as one. They had formed an eternal bond, and in so doing had touched eternity itself.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_589: When they returned to their homeland, their brethren saw how they had changed. Their example served to unite the disparate factions, which began to rebuild, and in time the people knew peace and prosperity once more.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_590: ...Perhaps you and your beloved will go on to inspire others in the same fashion? Who can say what the future holds!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_593: Ah, but you are doubtless eager to begin planning your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_594: Pray proceed to the Ivory Chapel, where Raitmeaux will discuss the arrangements with you.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_600: If you wish to make arrangements for your ceremony, you will need to speak with Raitmeaux, not me.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CEREMONYGUIDE01578_: Are you planning to host a Ceremony of Eternal Bonding, good ? Then you will need to speak with Raitmeaux within.
Pray speak with me should you wish to enter.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_000_640: Blessings of the Twelve be upon you, . I bid you welcome to the Ivory Chapel.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_000_641: I, Raitmeaux, have the honor of overseeing all ceremonies held within the Sanctum of the Twelve.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_000_642: Pray do not hesitate to inform me of your preferences. It is our duty to accommodate you to the best of our ability.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_100_648: Once you have finalized your plan, you will need to speak with Etoinelle outside to schedule your ceremony.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_101_648: Take as long as you require to discuss the arrangements with your partner. I shall be here when you are ready.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_000_649: To begin planning your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding, speak with Raitmeaux once more. Additional information regarding the planning process can be reviewed in the journal entry for the quest “The Ties that Bind,” or by selecting the quest name in the duty list.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_650: You may preview cutscenes and music by selecting the icon to the right of the selection.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_200_651: You are welcome to change your preferences until the day of the ceremony. However, I should inform you that I am obligated to request plans from both you and your partner, and that if they are not exactly the same, you will need to decide immediately beforehand whose plan is to be carried out.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_RAITMEAUX_200_652: If you have yet to make a reservation, I strongly suggest you speak with Etoinelle and do so as soon as possible.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_200_653: Please be advised that you cannot make a reservation unless you and your partner have completed all required objectives. Moreover, you must form a party of two with your partner, and you must both equip yourselves with promise wristlets.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_655: I trust your preparations are going smoothly? Excellent! I look forward to attending!

TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_ETOINELLE_100_851: This will serve as proof of your registration─under no circumstances must you let it out of your sight. Moreover, it may be used to create invitations to send to your friends and family, if you so desire.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_ETOINELLE_100_852: And with that, your mandatory preparations are complete! I look forward to the day of your ceremony.

TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_SYSTEM_100_858: During the ceremony, you and your partner will receive eternity rings in exchange for your promise wristlets. On the day, please ensure that you have your blank invitation, your wristlet, and one free slot in your inventory.

TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_800: 'Twas a wonderful ceremony! I was fair moved to tears!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_801: Though we are come to the end of our journey together, you and your beloved have already embarked upon a far greater one.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_802: The road before you stretches to the horizon and beyond. 'Twill not always be an easy one, and you may find your bond tested.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_803: But together, you shall overcome any trials the gods set before you, for that which is eternal shall never be broken!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_804: Come calamity and rebirth, your bond shall endure, and ever shall you walk side by side.
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_805: And like those who came before, your example shall serve as a shining beacon to others!
TEXT_SUBCTS999_01578_CLARIBEL_000_806: May you and your beloved ever bask in the glory of the Twelve, and guide us to a brighter future, full of hope and love.

TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_TOBANA_000_000: On behalf of the House of Splendors, , pray allow me to inform you of the latest additions to our stock.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_TOBANA_000_002: The House understands that even the most experienced Disciple of the Land could use a helping hand from time to time. To that end, we are proud to offer an exclusive selection of favors imbued with the blessings of the Twelve.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_TOBANA_000_006: Guaranteed to make your fieldcraft more productive. No refunds.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_SYSTEM_000_008: Favors are now available for purchase from the splendors vendor.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_SYSTEM_000_009: Favors can be used to grant special temporary statuses which allow for the discovery of otherwise hidden gathering points.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_SYSTEM_000_010: Favors are area specific, and will only reveal gathering points in the area indicated in the favor's help text. Concealed gathering points will yield rare items unobtainable at normal locations.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_TOBANA_000_020: Greetings, , I should be glad to inform you of the latest additions to our stock...once I have determined that you are qualified to make use of them.
TEXT_HEAVNY805_02099_SYSTEM_000_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a level 60 Disciple of the Land.
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_KESTERIRONHEART_000: Well, paint me yellow and call me a chocobo─that's Millith's sightseeing log you've got there!
Ahem. Forgive me─I got carried away for a moment. I am Kester Ironheart, cousin to Millith and an explorer of sorts, like most of my extended family.

When I last spoke with Millith, she told me of an adventurer with a keen case of wanderlust─an adventurer that I know now to be you. What say you lend me your log for a moment? Don't worry─I won't eat it or anything.
There, there, and yes─there! That should do it, I reckon.

It's no secret that Ishgard is home to some of the most remarkable sights in our realm. Mind you, I've not seen them all myself, but I certainly know where they might be found. And now, so do you─thanks to the notes and rumors I've seen fit to jot down in your sightseeing log.

Yes, scores of stunning vistas are just waiting to be discovered. Your legs will not carry you to all of them, though. Should you find a particular spot out of reach, you might consider taking to the skies atop a black-feathered bird.

...Oho, but if I were to say more, I would be robbing you of the joy of discovering these spectacular views for yourself. Godsspeed, my fellow explorer, and may this moment mark the beginning of a tour of wonder!
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_SYSTEM_000_008: Heavensward entries have been added to your sightseeing log!
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_SYSTEM_000_009: You must be level 50 or above to record Heavensward vistas. Travel to the location indicated and fulfill the necessary conditions and you will complete the entry for that vista, earning experience points in the process.
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_SYSTEM_100_009: The newly added locations in your sightseeing log will be marked by an orb of light. Should you spot such an orb during your adventures, take a moment to stop and record the entry.
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_SYSTEM_000_010: Use your wits and the notes provided by Kester to identify these stunning sights and the proper way to appreciate them, and see Ishgard as only the greatest explorers have seen her!
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_KESTERIRONHEART_000: Many are the wondrous sights to behold in these lands, but the going is parlous indeed. Would that I were more accomplished in the martial disciplines, that I might see all there is to be seen...
TEXT_HEAVNY807_02107_SYSTEM_000_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must have at least one class or job at level 52 or above.
TEXT_JOBMCH299_02109_STEPHANIVIEN_000_00: Hmmm, my prospectometer seems rather fond of you. Let's see, shall we...? Odd garb. Striking presence. Would I be right in assuming that you are one of those adventurous types?
Hmmm, my prospectometer seems rather fond of you. Let's see, shall we...? Odd garb. Striking presence. Would I be right in assuming that you are the outsider who helped save Ishgard?
Ah, I thought as much! My prospectometer seldom lies! And let me just say, you have made the right choice in visiting our humble workshop.
Ahem. Welcome to the Skysteel Manufactory, where miracles are born from aether, metal, and imagination!

From cannons to ballistas, we develop and manufacture a range of weapons designed for slaying dragon invaders. ...But we are also accepting students who wish to take up a firearm and learn the techniques of the machinist!
What say you? Are you interested in joining us, and exploring the machinist discipline?
TEXT_JOBMCH299_02109_Q1_000_000: Are you interested in exploring the machinist discipline?
TEXT_JOBMCH299_02109_STEPHANIVIEN_000_01: You are? Well, of course you are! Otherwise my prospectometer would not have registered your obvious interest!
Ah. In my excitement, I've neglected to introduce myself. The name's Stephanivien. Stephanivien de Haillenarte. And you are...?
You... No? How odd. I was certain my prospectometer had detected a high level of interest. Come now, you needn't be shy! I shall be here should you surrender to what is obviously your heart's desire!
TEXT_JOBDRK299_02110_CITIZEN02053_000_00: After witnessing a spectacle like that, everyday life seems rather dull in comparison...
Hm? So you didn't see that trial earlier? Ah, your loss. Fury take me, the way that heretic swung that slab of iron he called a sword was a sight to behold!
He couldn't have carried a shield if he'd wanted to, the blade was so big. Had to keep two hands on it at all times! I was amazed he managed to keep up with that Temple Knight for as long as he did.

Fought like a demon from the deepest pits of the seventh hell, bellowing threats and working his arts. I wasn't sure what to make of it at first, but then I heard someone say that he must be a dark knight!
B-But you didn't hear that from me, eh!? In fact, I'm sure I don't know anything about it!
TEXT_JOBDRK299_02110_CITIZEN02053_000_01: Ye gods, are you mad!? We're standing outside the bloody Tribunal!
Fine, fine! But keep quiet and listen well, because I'm only going to say this once!
Aye, aye. Let us speak no more of such things. Never know who's listening...
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_000:
<sniff> <sniff>
Phew! Pardon me for saying so, friend, but you stink. Not an unpleasant stink, mind you. Rather, you stink of chocobo─a distinctive scent for which I must confess a certain fondness.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_001: <sniff> <sniff> Not the musky aroma of a wild bird, nor the common scent of a rental chocobo who has carried thousands. No, yours is a stink singular and true─would I be correct to surmise that you are the proud owner of your very own bird?
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_002: ...Of course I am. As a chocobo trainer, I practically sleep in these stables. Gives you a nose for this sort of thing, if you catch my drift. But enough about me─you must tell me all about your faithful steed!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_003: , is it? A fine name, that! And issued by your Grand Company, you say?
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_004: I know the Grand Companies of Eorzea to have many fine birds in their ranks, but if all you say is true, I daresay your bird is a particularly stalwart specimen!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_005: What's this? Your bird has even been trained in the Fortemps methodology!? I knew I detected a cultured aroma in that scent. Why, I've not sniffed such a remarkable bird in ten─no, twenty years!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_006: Such singular strength and intellect─why, it would not surprise me if your bird could learn to fly!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_007: Oh, I can assure you this is no jest. While it is true that only chocobos black of feather are natural-born flyers, there are records of other breeds that have been trained to take to the skies.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_008: I can understand your skepticism, but to a student of chocobo breeding such as myself, this is little surprise. After all, the flyers and the flightless possess common ancestry. The grounded birds do not lack the physical capacity, but that they have merely forgotten how for lack of necessity.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_009: I daresay that if any chocobo could be trained to take to the heavens like his feathered forefathers, it is your ! What say you, friend!?
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_010: My brother Priorfaix is a chocobo trainer at Tailfeather, and something of an expert in these training methods. Bring your bird to him, and I tell you, friend, the sky is the limit!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_ARNOULAIN_000_015: My brother Priorfaix is a chocobo trainer at Tailfeather, and something of an expert in flight training. Bring your bird to him, and I tell you, friend, the sky is the limit!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_020:
Oh, you must be the one Arnoulain spoke of! <sniff> <sniff>
Yes, there can be no mistaking it! That is the scent of a remarkable bird─a bird who is destined for the heavens!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_021: But why are we talking when we could be flying? Yes, let us begin the training without further ado!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_022: The process of teaching a flightless chocobo to soar involves awakening the instincts of its flying forebears that lie dormant within. The most efficient way to do so is to allow it to experience the life of a wild bird.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_023: Take the chocobos that run free throughout the Chocobo Forest. These birds subsist on wild fruits and berries, but to secure sustenance, they must fight for their lives against hordes of vicious insects.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_024: Yes, if your  were to experience the thrill and fear of staring down the bee clouds of Dravania, it might not be long before the blood of a flyer stirs within those veins!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_026: If your  were to experience the thrill and fear of staring down the bee clouds of Dravania, it might not be long before the blood of a flyer stirs within those veins!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_040: I see that the training goes well. Excellent. In the Chocobo Forest, your bird experienced the thrill of battle, and heard with its own ears the buzzing of those infernal bees.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_041: Many scholars posit that this sound plays an important role in awakening the dormant abilities of a flightless bird. Most chocobos that we export are captured not long after they leave the nest─likely your bird is hearing these sounds for the first time in its life.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_042: Now for the next stage in the training. Your chocobo must feel the same wind that its ancestors once knew.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_043: And yet this wind blows in a place that the average bird would be hard-pressed to reach. Fortunately, the chocobo has a keen sense of smell─and that is where you come in, friend.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_044: Travel to the highest points near Tailfeather and Falcon's Nest. Let the wind embrace you, and let your bird take in the scent. Surely this will go far to awaken the memories of 's high-flying forebears!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_045: Travel to the highest points near Tailfeather and Falcon's Nest. Let the wind embrace you, and let your bird take in the scent. Surely this will go far to awaken the memories of 's high-flying forebears!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SYSTEM_000_050:
The crisp winds of the Dravanian forelands envelop you.
What memories will they awaken within ?
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_SYSTEM_000_051:
The brisk winds of Coerthas envelop you.
What memories will they awaken within ?
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_060:
<sniff> <sniff>
I can smell the winds upon you, friend. I have no doubt that the same can be said of your faithful . With this, your bird's training is complete.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_061: The final stage of the training is yours. You need only learn to read the winds, that you might lead your chocobo safely and surely upon them.
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_062: To read the winds, you must be attuned to the currents of aether. Yes, read them well, send your bird soaring high into the heavens!
TEXT_HEAVNY808_02117_PRIORFAIX_000_063: Be proud of , friend, for only the bravest and brightest of birds succeed in learning to fly. I gladly give you this as a reward to the both of you. Be well, and may we meet again in the skies above!
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_JANNEQUINARD_000_00: Greetings and welcome to the Athenaeum Astrologicum. Perhaps you were drawn by fate to this place of learning─or perhaps you wish to know more of fate itself?
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_Q1_000_000: Do you wish to know more of fate?
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_JANNEQUINARD_000_00: Then you were wise to come hither. For in the stars are written the fates of every woman and man on Hydaelyn.
So you say, yet here you are. You need only learn to open your eyes and see the answers which lie above us in the boundless firmament.
It was there in the stars that I read a  would call upon the Athenaeum this very day. A  who would play an important role in my own life.
Ah, but my apologies. Even the most skilled reader cannot scry a name from the heavens. Would you be so kind as to give me yours, so that I might know who is to be my newest protégé?
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_Q2_000_000: Give Jannequinard your name and become his protégé?
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_JANNEQUINARD_000_01: . Well... I was not expecting that. But what is a name, but an attempt by our begetters to wield power over the lives of their sons and daughters? Lives whose paths have already been foretold! In a sense, that is.
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_JANNEQUINARD_000_00: My name is Jannequinard de Durendaire and I am an astrologian for the Holy See. Remember that name, for it shall echo forevermore in the annals of Ishgardian history. Well...it will once I put it there. Once we put it there!
TEXT_JOBAST299_02123_JANNEQUINARD_000_01: Well...er... That was awkward. It would not be entirely true if I said this was the first time my offer had been spurned today... But Twelve be damned, I was certain you were the  from my vision!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_000_000: See all those balloons? That's right, the Moonfire Faire's back, and promises to be the most explosive yet! What's the Moonfire Faire, you ask? Well, the first one was held five years ago, to beat back the Bombards that threatened to burn the realm to ashes.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_100_000: Ah, if it isn't ! As you can see, the Moonfire Faire is back, and more explosive than ever. Ever since the Bombards were beat back five years ago, we've kept the tradition strong in remembrance.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_000_001: Now, it's been a while since anyone's seen a Bombard, but that doesn't mean we can't celebrate every year─and maybe even get a few more interested in joining the guild while we're at it.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_000_002: Of course, we wouldn't call it a faire if all we cared about was recruiting new members. Nay, our main purpose is to win the hearts of the common people with unforgettable food and other goods.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_000_003: You look like quite the adventurer yourself, and we need all the help we can muster. The festivities are underway at Costa del Sol, but the chaperones are facing a host of problems that're threatening to ruin the atmosphere.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_100_003: Last year's faire was a rousing success thanks to you, and it just so happens we could use your aid again. Our chaperones in Costa del Sol are dealing with a host of problems that threaten to ruin the atmosphere.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_000_004: Please, we can't let our hard work go to waste! Make your way to the beaches of Costa del Sol to speak with our chaperone P'obyano─the guild is counting on you!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_HAERMAGA_000_010: We underestimated the number of hands we'd need at this year's faire. If there was ever a time the Adventurers' Guild needed your help, it's now.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_020: Ah, so you're the adventurer Haermaga sent word of? What's your name, friend?
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_021: ? Pleased to make your acquaintance. It's always an honor to meet a guildmate that's eager to help out!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_022: Thanks to the efforts of members like you, there's no shortage of work to go around. In fact, you might even say there's too much.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_023: That's why this faire is so important─we need to attract as many potential new guildmates as possible! So this year, we wanted to host it in a location that'd bring people from malms around.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_024: With beautiful beaches of silky-soft sand, we decided Costa del Sol was the perfect place! And thanks to Master Gegeruju, our dream is a reality.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_GEGERUJU_000_025: It seems the faire is coming along nicely. It has been too, too long since the last Moonfire Faire. You could not have picked a more fitting place than Costa del Sol!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_PEBALOH_000_026: Master Gegeruju fearlessly met the Bombards in battle, surrounded by his faithful maidservants. Our armor held fast against their flames until we were victorious. Truly, it was a sight to behold.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_027: Armor...? Truth be told, it didn't look too different than what I'm wearing now.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_028: Gegeruju certainly seems to be looking forward to the faire... Ah, well, as long as he's letting us use his land. He also provides our guild with plenty of work through the petitioning of guildleves.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_029: Anyroad, I know you've come here to help, and there's no end to the troubles we're facing. We've got pirates, dirty beaches, and nosy beasts aplenty.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_030: Over there's our head cook, C'zibho Tia.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_100_030: And over there's Espan. Both of them've been going on about needing more help, so either'll be glad to receive yours.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_031: Now, we're not asking you to do this all for free, oh no! You'll receive Faire tokens for your troubles, which you can exchange for all kinds of wonderful gifts.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_032: What's more, I've prepared a special gift for our most devoted supporters. Talk to me again if that piques your interest!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_POBYANO_000_033: Once you're ready to lend a hand, speak to one of our chaperones. I'm sure with your help, this year's Moonfire Faire'll be one to remember!
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_SYSTEM_000_035: Faire tokens can be obtained from participating in FATEs occurring around Costa del Sol.
TEXT_FESSUM101_02124_SYSTEM_000_036: Faire tokens can also be obtained by completing quests from C'zibho Tia and Espan.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_CZIBHOTIA_000_000: Ah, so you've weighed your options and decided to help ol' C'zibho Tia, eh? You have my thanks, and I promise it'll be a mite more enjoyable than what Espan would have you do.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_CZIBHOTIA_000_001: I'm here to fill the stomachs of our lovely faire-goers with battered fish, but so many of us are dealing with the pirates I can barely keep up with demand.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_CZIBHOTIA_000_002: If you'd like to help, we're always in need of battered fish. You can buy haddock, the main ingredient, from the festive fisher just over there. Bring 'em to me when you're done.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_CZIBHOTIA_000_005: We've barely enough battered fish to feed the hungry faire-goers! Bring me any you can before we're forced to turn people away.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_CZIBHOTIA_000_020: Marvelous! I'd eat it myself if there weren't so many customers. Espan just doesn't understand the demand─he's likely still fussing over the freshness of the fish. But when you're hungry, it's all the same once it's battered and fried.
TEXT_FESSUM102_02125_CZIBHOTIA_000_021: You have my thanks. The Moonfire Faire has no shortage of hungry revelers, so speak to me if you feel like cooking for us again.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_000: Ah, you seem like a  of more refined tastes. I've got just the job for you.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_001: I'm selling battered fish made with only fresh haddock. However, with the pirates around mucking things up, we've not enough fishermen to bring in a steady supply.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_002: Care to try your hand at catching a few fish? Don't even think of buying them from the merchant over there─I can smell their rancid stench from here. Hop aboard the Rhotano privateer and bring me any haddock you manage to catch.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_005: Fishing up a few haddock might prove challenging, but it'll be worth it. The Rhotano privateer will bring you out to the open seas, where there are haddock aplenty. I'll be grateful for any you manage to catch.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SYSTEM_000_003: To board the Rhotano privateer, speak with the ferry skipper at the docks.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SYSTEM_000_004: Fresh haddock can be caught by fishing from the bow of the Rhotano privateer.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_SENDO02126_000_08: This ferry'll be heading to the Rhotano privateer. If it's haddock you're looking to catch, there's no better spot than there.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_015: I can't stand to see our faire-goers eating battered fish made from old haddock─gods know how long they've been sitting in the sun. Pray give me any haddock you've caught so I can prepare a superior dish.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_020: Yes...the sheen of the scales, the lingering smell of saltwater. It's as if the fish jumped straight from the ocean and into my hands! A tasteless fool such as C'zibho Tia would never appreciate the delight of frying something so fresh.
TEXT_FESSUM103_02126_ESPAN_000_021: You have my thanks. Of course, more fish are always welcome. Pray deliver them to me if you catch any more.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_100_000: I wager you're eager to hear about my special prize, huh? Well, only brave and industrious adventurers who manage to collect seven Faire tokens are worthy to receive it. Trust me─you won't regret it!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_100_001: Once you've collected seven of the tokens, bring them to me. I'll be waiting for you!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_SYSTEM_100_010: To proceed with this quest, you must be in possession of seven or more Faire tokens.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_000: Only seven Faire tokens for my special prize! So, how many have you brought?
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_010: The Adventurers' Guild thanks you! The Moonfire Faire is shaping up to be a rousing success!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_011: I was afraid this year's faire would be a disaster due to all our difficulties, but people from malms around have showed up for the food and festivities.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_GEGERUJU_000_012: Hohoho! The beach is alive with such heavenly sights and sounds!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_013: Master Gegeruju is certainly enjoying himself.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_014: (-???-)Move yer arses! This beach belongs to us!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_GEGERUJU_000_016: What!? Is that a...pirate!? He's frightening off the lovely scenery─you must do something about this at once!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_017: Y-Yes, of course, Master Gegeruju. We're already dealing with the problem.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_018: My apologies, , but I've one last thing to ask you before you get your reward.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_019: We can't have pirates harassing our guests and disturbing the faire. There must be a way we can solve this peacefully...
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_020: I've a mind to go speak with him myself. But, you saw how angry he was─I dare not go alone! Please accompany me, . Go ahead and I'll catch up after I've found someone to look after the stall.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_030: I need to find someone to run the stall while I'm gone. I'll be right behind you!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_040: You! You were the one storming up and down the beach, scaring our guests! What gives you the right!?
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_041: You'd best get back to your stall, 'less you're itchin' for a fight!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_042: The only thing I'm itchin' for is to fill our guests' stomachs with battered fish! I might be kind enough to give you one if you tell me why you insist on sabotaging our faire.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_043: Hmph, so you wanna know what's got us angry? Well, if it means a free meal, I might as well tell you our tale.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_044: Ye see, this land was once ours to settle under the Admiral's settlement initiative. The cruel salt of the sea made tillin' the soil near impossible, but the blood and sweat we put into our work made us love it nonetheless.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_045: Then Gegeruju struts in and buys up all of it from under us. Land that was ours by rights!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_046: What's a landless lot like us to do but turn back to piracy!? And to see people makin' merry on beaches that were once ours... It makes my blood boil!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_047: What you went through... It'd make anyone angry. But this land was never fit for settling. Might be it was put to better use when Master Gegeruju turned it into one of La Noscea's premier resorts.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_100_047: Limsa Lominsa received a hefty sum of coin for this land─coin which was probably used to help others in trouble. There might be blame for your troubles to go around, but what's done is done, and there's no choice but to keep going.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_048: You might've lost your land, but piracy isn't the only way to make a living. There's plenty of options─like adventuring!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_049: We get all kinds of requests for work at the guild. You've had plenty of practice with a blade, right? You'd never want for work with us!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_050: Join your guild!? I'd rather drink my fill of seawater!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_100_050: Get out of here, if you know what's good for you!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_051: You... Who in the hells're you?
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_052: 's been kind enough to help out around the faire!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_054: Yes, I've heard tell of your deeds while drinkin' at the Drownin' Wench. Made for a good bit of entertainment, they did. Didn't expect to see you here helpin' with the faire, though!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_055: Work hard with the Adventurers' Guild, and people might tell stories about you over cups of mead! Ain't that better than a life of piracy?
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_056: You mean...I could become a storied adventurer!?
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_A1_000_072: You won't know until you try.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_057: You don't say... I've never considered an adventurer's life. But now that you mention it, I think it just might work.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_100_057: You're right, I'll only find out by tryin'. Gotta start from the bottom. Ain't no value without hard work, I suppose.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_058: In fact, the Moonfire Faire's being put on by the Adventurers' Guild! Just give us a shout at the stall, and we can tell you all about the work that we do.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_WUNTHYLL_000_059: Ah, so it was your guild. Let me think on the offer. I'll tell my companions as well. Might be there's some that'll be interested.
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_060: Well, that was the most thrilling part of my day! Thankfully you were by my side, else I would've forgotten what to say!
TEXT_FESSUM104_02127_POBYANO_000_061: Well, I suppose it's time to return to hosting the stall. The Adventurers' Guild will do its best to welcome even pirates with open arms. And for all your help, I suppose you finally deserve your reward. You've earned it!
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Greetings, friend! Have our spirited adornments caught your eye? Perhaps you too are an egg enthusiast?
Wait a moment, I know you! You're , the bearer of fortune who guided me during our last festival. What luck to meet you again!

While I saw that prophecy fulfilled, my work is far from over. After all, our heroes have yet to grace us with their presence! Thus the Dreamers and I have spent day after day continuing to paint, dye, and etch the finest vessels for the Archons, all of which you see before you.

Well then, allow me to introduce myself. I am Jihli Aliapoh, and you are...? Well, , I spend my days spreading the news of Hatching-tide! How did this fascination with eggs come about, you ask? Well, it started with a dream; although I was quite literally asleep!

The Twelve Archons, heroes of the past, blessed me with a grand vision. They descended from the heavens upon beautiful decorated eggs and delivered unto me a message: to prepare like carriages for their return to Eorzea. Along with my fellow believers, the Dreamers, I have dedicated my life to this pursuit!

And it would seem our toils have borne fruit. For you see, the Archons have granted me yet another vision, this one more vivid than the last. So vivid, in fact, that I was nearly blinded by its radiance. It was a shining, golden treasure!

I dreamt that adventurers from all walks of life gathered to rejoice by pursuing an egg hunt and participating in delightful diversions. And at the height of the festivities, the Hatching Hour came and a chosen egg cracked, revealing unto us the miracle.

I thought to myself, if we can re-enact that marvelous scene of revelry, then surely this golden treasure will be ours, here in the corporeal realm. By sharing this treasure with all who believe, surely the Archons will be pleased, thus encouraging their triumphant return.

You will help us, won't you? If you do, I promise you will not leave empty-handed, for the Archons' treasure is for all to share. Speak to my good friend, Nonotta, and she can give you more details on how to participate.
Come, we have a prophecy to fulfill! Join us in our festivities so the golden treasure will be ours!
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_NONOTTA_000_020: Oh, it's ! Do you remember me? Oh, I do hope you forgive us for playing that trick on you last time. But her dream did come true, right? And I have faith this one will come true as well.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_NONOTTA_000_021: A happy Hatching-tide to you! I am Nonotta, Jihli's right-hand Dreamer! She told you the joyous news, I trust? Oh, I cannot wait to see what the Archons have in store for us. I have seen Jihli's dreams come true before, and I know it will happen this time, too.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_NONOTTA_000_022: Therefore, every detail must be absolutely perfect! I have made it my duty to provide the proper atmosphere, recreating everything just as Jihli dreamt. All we need now is a cheerful crowd of revelers!
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_NONOTTA_000_023: With the gracious assistance of Black Rabbit Traders, we have prepared three activities for the festival. You may complete these activities to earn fortune eggs, which can then be exchanged for fabulous prizes!
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_NONOTTA_000_024: But of course, the most important thing is to have fun! After you've participated in each event at least once, come back to me. I will tell you if we are close to the Hatching Hour.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_SYSTEM_000_025: By completing one of three repeatable quests, you will obtain a fortune egg which can be exchanged for Hatching-tide seasonal goods.
TEXT_FESEST201_02128_SYSTEM_000_026: You can also obtain fortune eggs by participating in the FATE “Eggstract and Eggspedite” in Gridania.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA021: Hello there, friend! Fancy yourself stealthy enough to outsmart a spriggan? Why not try your hand at Pass the Poacher?
The task is quite simple─it's the eggsecution that is tricky! Beside me is a basket from which you will choose one decoration. Careful not to over-eggsert yourself, though─they are quite heavy!

You will need to deliver it to my compeer, who has hidden himself somewhere in the quarter. However, if you wander too close to one of the coddled spriggans meandering about, the greedy creature will grab the egg right out of your grasp. You will have to return to fetch another.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SYSTEM_000_003: Deliver the decorative egg to the collector-in-training in Old Gridania.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SYSTEM_000_004: Beware the spriggans lying in wait. Being caught en route or leaving Old Gridania will result in failure.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SYSTEM_000_005: You will have four minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_SPRIGAN_000_010: Big egg! Big shiny eeegg! My biiig shiiiny eeeeeegg!
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFB021: I appreciate you coming all this way, but you appear to be empty-handed! Return to my mentor and fetch yourself a festive decoration.
You've found me! The spriggans did not cause you much trouble, did they? You may report back to the egg...uh, egg...enthusiastic lass at the amphitheatre.
Er, eggsemplary work, ! ...Whew, this is not as easy as it looks.
TEXT_FESEST202_02129_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA021: My fellow Dreamer told me by linkpearl that you have successfully carried the decoration to him. Well done! Here you are, your prize!
Let me know if you wish to embark on another delivery eggspedition!
TEXT_FESEST203_02130_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFB021: No doubt you have seen the enormous egg bounding through the streets of Old Gridania. It has been enchanted by our friends the sylphs for this very occasion; though it rolls over root, stone, and man, there is not a single scratch upon it!

And therein comes the challenge. I will give you magicked powder that, when thoroughly rubbed onto a spot of the egg, will weaken its shell. If you can catch up to it and break off a fragment, bring it hither and trade it to me for a more fortuitous reward!
Remember that timing is everything. You never know when the egg will start moving again, so my advice is to throw yourself upon it as soon as it stops.
Chasing after the egg can tire you out quite quickly. Have you come to rest for a bit?
Aha, it seems your determination has won out. This is indeed a piece of the benediction egg. I shall dispense your reward as promised.

Splendid work, and come again, my good ! ...Ah, yes, noticed I did not say eggsellent or some such, did you? I may be a Dreamer, but like others I find my comrades' humor to be a little...tiring at times.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_MOTTE_000_000: Hello there, . Do you see those colorful partitions in front of the amphitheatre? I painted them myself for the Spriggan Scramble! Surely you'll indulge me and play it?
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_MOTTE_000_001: It's a tallying game. You will need to use your keen observation to count how many eggs were carried by a group of scampering spriggans.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_MOTTE_000_002: There are three degrees of difficulty─beginner, intermediate, and advanced. Once you complete a round, you must proceed to the next until you have successfully challenged all three. When you have done so, return to me and I will reward you with a prize. Good luck!
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFC021: Considering how quickly you blazed through the beginner's step, I would say you are ready to speak to the handsome-looking lad down the road.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFD021: You're done with this round, so go and speak with the eggsaminer across from the amphitheatre. Though I warn you, my fellow Dreamer takes her egg counting very seriously.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFF021: I underestimated your skill at spotting spriggans, adventurer. Have you considered becoming a Dreamer? Spending day after day, training and chasing the little dust bunnies around the meadows. Think of the possibilities.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_MOTTE_000_006: I'll be right here watching you, ! Good luck!
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFC021: Ah, a challenger appears! Well met, .

Did Motte explain this activity to you? Between these plank boards will be five spriggans. Each spriggan will be carrying an expertly embellished egg. For this round, the eggs will have only two motifs.
Be sure to pay close attention! After the spriggans finish their scramble, I will ask you to tell me how many of each you saw. If you are correct, I will send you off to the next round.
But first, I must make sure you are properly acquainted with the designs.
A pristine white egg looks like this...
...and a vibrant blue egg looks like this!
Well, then. Are you ready? Release the spriggans!
Did any slip past you, I wonder? Only one way to find out.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_Q1_000_000: How many pristine white eggs did you see?
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_Q1_000_001: How many vibrant blue eggs did you see?
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_Q1_000_002: How many brilliant yellow eggs did you see?
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_Q1_000_003: How many midnight black eggs did you see?
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFC021: Hmmm... You saw  pristine white and  of vibrant blue?
Well, then, let's see if you were right...
But of course you were! I knew you would be.
You won this time, adventurer. Off to the intermediate round you go!
You were so close! But I'm afraid that is incorrect. Spriggans are quick, so keep your eyes on their prize. Feel free to take the challenge again.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFD021: Passed the beginner's round, did you? Although we both know it is not necessarily a feat. How's about we raise the bar a bit higher, eh?
In this round, six sprightly spriggans will carry eggs decorated with three different designs.
If you have properly warmed up, then we shall commence with the counting.
Ah yes, I nearly forgot. Before we begin, let me introduce the new egg design.
In addition to the ones you saw in the beginner's round, this brilliant yellow egg will also make a debut.
I am lifting the doors, so prepare yourself. Ready...steady...go!
How did you fare? Were you able to count all of them?
Let me understand this correctly; you say there were  of pristine white,  of vibrant blue, and  of brilliant yellow?
You are indeed correct! Quite a sharp memory you have there, adventurer! But you'll have to do better if you want to pass the advanced round.
When you're ready, proceed to the advanced eggsaminer in front of the amphitheatre for the final challenge.
You almost had it, but one or two have slipped your grasp. Too bad. The good news is you can always try again. I'll be waiting.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFF021: Judging by your smug look of satisfaction, it appears you have cleared the intermediate round. Well, counting on your fingers won't save you this time, adventurer.
There will be no mercy in this round. I have a narrower fence, eight bouncing spriggans, and not one, not two, not three, but four different eggs!
Think you have what it takes? Come on, then. Let us see for ourselves.
Before we begin, I will show you the new egg. Be sure to take a good look.
In addition to the other three you have seen, this midnight black egg will also appear.
You look confident, so I'll be releasing the little scamps all at once. Don't blink.
Tell me. How many were there?
So, you say the number of eggs is as follows:  of pristine white,  of vibrant blue,  of brilliant yellow, and  of midnight black, yes?
Because you're absolutely right! Nothing gets past you, I see. You've beaten all three rounds, so return to Motte for your reward!
Because you're wrong! Sorry! I'll save you the shame and call this a practice round. Let me know when you're ready for the real challenge.
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_MOTTE_000_030: Wow, you were able to pass the final round? Even I wasn't able to do it!
TEXT_FESEST204_02131_MOTTE_000_031: Allow me to present you with a fortune egg as your reward, and let me know if you want to play again!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_000: Watching you participate with such vigor is enough to put me in quite an energetic mood myself! Everything is going splendidly.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_001: ...Or so I thought. Judging by Jihli's downcast expression, it seems we are no closer to the Hatching Hour.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_002: What could be amiss? All of the elements seem to be in place. But I'd rather not press her about it. Maybe you can ask her if there is anything else she forgot to mention?
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_003: Perhaps this outfit is not the right shade of pink. Or that spriggan's fur was not properly combed. Or that balloon is floating at the wrong height.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Oh, ! How are you enjoying Hatching-tide?

<sigh> So Nonotta is having her doubts as well. The Dreamers replicated everything, down to the painted partitions. Yet it does not feel as if the time is right for our miracle to present itself. Something is missing.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_012: Jihli! A spriggan from the scramble has pilfered the chosen egg! The one that was to be used in the Hatching Ceremony!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: What!? I told them not to touch that─
<gasp> No, wait! This has happened before─in the dream!
There was indeed an egg hunt...not for many, but a single egg. Yes, yes, all is falling into place!
Come, , we must find that spriggan at once! Without the chosen egg, we cannot bear witness to the Archons' treasure!
I shall stay here and speak with Black Rabbit Traders and my fellow Dreamers. Surely someone else saw the spriggan wander off.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_018: Oh, I knew I should have kept a closer eye on the scramble game! If that spriggan runs away with the chosen egg, all my dreams of gold and riches will be for nothing!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_BERNADETTE_000_020: Come to think of it, I did see a spriggan carry a large white egg through here. I thought the little creature was delivering it to the Carline Canopy. Until he passed it, that is.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_BERTENNANT_000_021: Aye, I let him through the gate. He seemed quite rushed, even for a spriggan. He was taking decorations to Bentbranch for that festival, I imagine?
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_STOUTELM_000_022: A spriggan carryin' an egg? Were it any other time I'd say you were in your cups, but Old Gridania's crawlin' with the little buggers right now. None that stand out as particularly strikin' though, no.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_BERNADETTE_000_023: If it wasn't meant for a banquet at the Canopy, then I suppose it was not a real egg. Pity, that. It looked as if though it could make an omelette large enough to feed ten people.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_BERTENNANT_000_024: Why didn't I go after it? I have orders to bar suspicious and dangerous-looking sorts, and he was neither. Besides, I've seen stranger things pass through this gate.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_STOUTELM_000_025: Sorry I can't be of much help.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: Black Rabbit Traders helped us search the area, and we know for sure he is not in Gridania. Oh, where could he be?
Well, what are we waiting for? A-hunting we will go!
Once we retrieve the egg, the Hatching Hour will be nigh, I am sure of it. I will join you shortly after I inform the Dreamers to gather and make the preparations.
Tarry not, . This is our chance to reveal to everyone the truth of my vision! I will meet you at Bentbranch after I assemble the Dreamers here.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_034: Selfish, greedy spriggan! I'd string him up by his ears if I wasn't so sure he would bite my fingers off first.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_KEITHA_000_040: Aye, a spriggan did come by. We were quite surprised at the size of the egg he was holdin' in his little paws.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_KEITHA_000_041: Poor thing looked as if he was carryin' it for malms. He was pantin' somethin' fierce by the time he reached the stables. Took a nap and went on his merry way, he did.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: Miss Keitha, that egg is the key to fulfilling an important prophecy. It is the centerpiece of our festival, and it needs to be painted and decorated before the Hatching Hour. May we have it back?
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_KEITHA_000_043: Paint and decorate it, are you mad!? Chocobo eggs are extremely delicate!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_000_045: Oh dear, it must have gotten mixed up with all of the plaster eggs. It certainly felt warmer than the others, but I thought that was just part of the prophecy. I'm terribly sorry!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_KEITHA_000_046: Well, the egg's in good hands now and that's all that matters. Can't say I know what this “Hatchin' Hour” business is about, but the egg's due for its own soon. I can take you to the stables to see, if you promise not to do anythin'...strange.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_KEITHA_100_046: 'Twas mere luck that spriggans are greedy enough to clutch things so close to their bodies. If the egg ain't kept warm enough, the last few days can mean life or death.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_KEITHA_110_046: You hear that? Well, little one, time to come out!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: Oh, isn't it adorable? What beautiful feathers!
Beautiful gold feathers! Just like the prophecy! At the Hatching Hour, the Twelve Archons bestowed upon the crowd a shining golden treasure!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_NONOTTA_100_048: Wow, Jihli, you've done it again! Although it's not exactly shining. And the crowd is somewhat small. Even so, I suppose having a close-up of this miracle is also a treat.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_04: Miss Keitha, I apologize for the earlier confusion. Amidst our zeal, we seemed to have overlooked the finer details. We are truly grateful to have witnessed this gift we have been given.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: And with that, the prophecy has been fulfilled! ...More or less. While we cannot share this treasure with the others, it is undeniable that we have witnessed a blessing of the Twelve Archons. Let us return to Gridania, and continue with the festivities!
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_GYSOL_000_050: (-???-)<pant> <pant> Am I too late? I was so busy clearing a space in the stable that─?
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_GYSOL_000_051: It is you! Do you remember me? It's Gysol...like the gysahl green. We met at Tailfeather some time ago. I decided to come here for a spell to learn chocobo husbandry.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_GYSOL_000_052: The hunters seemed supportive of my decision; Loupard even helped arrange for my journey here. And Q'yantaa, well...we agreed it would be for the best. So, how was it? The chocobo hatching.
TEXT_FESEST205_02132_GYSOL_000_053: Incredible, isn't it? I'm always thrilled to see a hatching. Keitha says this little one will be mine to watch over. And this time, I won't let him leave my sight until he's a strong, beautiful bird. I promise!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_100_000: This quest contains branching sections, and during certain portions you will receive no guidance from the journal or duty list. You will need to read the text carefully and decipher the clues to determine your next course of action.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_110_000: Furthermore, the conclusion of the quest will differ depending on the choices you make. However, the rewards will remain the same.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_000: We hope you are enjoying your time at the Gold Saucer, . I am Ollier, and these are my fellow attendants. Forgive my presumption, but you appear to be one that craves amusement, and we have an opportunity that is sure to sate your appetite.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_001: You see, we are devising a number of new attractions which promise to entice even more patrons to our establishment, and we would offer you the chance to partake in these delights before anyone else in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_002: We only ask in return that you provide an earnest judgment of our offerings, so we might use that to refine the final product. A fair trade, I believe. So, do we have an agreement, ?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_003: Splendid! Lord Manderville shall know of your contributions! Now, if you would just follow─
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_005: A scream!? It came from above─ Quickly, we must help!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_006: Was this man a victim of foul play, or did his meal simply disagree with him?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ZNAPHA_000_009: It all happened so suddenly. One moment they were sharing laughs over drinks, and the next...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_FLAURIE_000_021: No... He can't be... Please, no...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ZNAPHA_000_022: It happened in a flash, it did! They were enjoying their meal together, happy as ever, when without warning Master Goncquard keels over as if a chocobo just bucked him in the belly! Now, I'm no chirurgeon, but I don't reckon he'll be getting back up...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_025: Ollier! What is the meaning of this!? You know we do not abide drunkards dozing on the floor! I demand an explanation!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_026: Master Roland!? Why, yes, of course. We have only just arrived, but it appears Goncquard collapsed suddenly during his meal. Given his current state, I can't imagine overindulgence was the cause...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_027: No, such a sudden passing points to something more sinister. Master Roland, I believe this was no natural death. I believe Goncquard was poisoned!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_028: Poisoned!? By the Twelve, a murderer is in our midst! We must act swiftly─ I want the perpetrator in shackles!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_029: Ah, and who better to assist us than  ! Lord Manderville has no shortage of praise for your heroism─and your deftness at deduction! What say you, friend? Will you aid us in bringing a criminal to justice?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_030: And it would seem you already have a capable aide! The profession of adventurer demands some aptitude at deduction, certainly. What was your name, friend? Well then,  , what say you? Will you aid us in bringing a criminal to justice?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_031: Excellent! Ollier, you have my leave to put your current duties on hold. I grant both of you the title of interim inspector, and you shall have my full support in your inquiry.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_032: We shall not disappoint. Now,  , let us step back and take stock of the situation. Assuming Goncquard was poisoned, I gather there are only three people who had the opportunity─if not the motive─to do so discreetly.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_033: Z'napha, who served Goncquard his food...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_035: And lastly─while I shudder to entertain such a possibility─we must also consider Goncquard's wife suspect, as I can only assume she was close to him throughout the meal.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_036: Considering the gravity of the crime, we must avoid making any hasty accusations before we have a clear understanding of what transpired here. To that end, our first course of action should be to question each of the suspects.  , I entrust that task to you.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_037: And for my part, I shall summon the Brass Blades forthwith. I trust the culprit will be unmasked and ready to be apprehended upon my return.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_040: I know as little of the situation as you do,  . Our suspects, however, may be able to shed some light on what transpired here.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_LYELL_000_041: You...you suspect me of poisoning Master Goncquard!? Preposterous! I would never commit such an atrocious act, let alone against one of my most loyal customers! I won't stand for such baseless accusations!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ZNAPHA_000_042: You can't think I'm a murderer! You can't! I just carry the food and drink, is all... I don't even touch it!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_FLAURIE_000_043: My husband's body is still warm, and you accuse me of his murder!? I... <sniff> I have no words... <sob>
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_LYELL_000_044: I would never risk my reputation, my livelihood, by committing such a brazen crime. You're wasting both of our times by keeping me here.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ZNAPHA_000_045: Master Goncquard didn't have an enemy in the world far as I know... He was always so kind to the servers, always paid us extra...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_FLAURIE_000_046: <sob> ...I have nothing more to say to you. <sniff> ...Please, afford me time to grieve...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_050: Hmmm... I must admit, that wasn't as helpful as I had hoped, and I fear pressing our suspects further would only earn us their ire. We need not lose heart, however, as there are other avenues available to us.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_051: No crime is perfect, and even the most meticulous criminal leaves behind some trace of evidence. I am confident that if we search every corner of the Gold Saucer, and question every person within, the answer to this mystery will come together in due time.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_052: Of course, our suspects cannot be left alone. I shall remain here, and ask that you make a thorough search of the Gold Saucer. If you uncover aught you wish to discuss, return here and I will lend what aid I can.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_053: Scattered throughout the Gold Saucer are clues that will aid you in uncovering the identity of Goncquard's killer. Obtain them by speaking to the denizens of the Gold Saucer and investigating any suspicious items.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_054: You may speak with Ollier to discuss what you have uncovered. Let no scrap of evidence escape you, and piece together the puzzle of Goncquard's fate!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_060:
A piece of crumpled parchment lies conspicuously on the floor. Upon closer inspection, you see a message written in a precise hand.
“To the King,
You know what must needs be done. Succeed, and you shall be rewarded handsomely.
From,
The Rook”
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_061: Tucked away next to the pillar is a small phial, drained of its contents. However, a sweet scent still lingers within.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_NORTHERNSTORM_000_0: Goncquard loved his drink, 'specially when his wife weren't with him. Had a bit o' trouble keepin' his hands off the servers while in his cups, though, an' havin' Z'napha around just made it worse. Girl didn't seem to mind, though I suppose the extra coin he paid didn't hurt. I imagine his wife would've given him an earful if she ever found out.
