TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_KOKOMUI_000_063: I saw Goncquard around the Cactpot Board often enough to call him a comrade-in-arms against chance. Luck seemed to always favor him, though, filling his coinpurse while leaving mine lighter by the day. Well, I suppose everyone's fortune reverses in time, eh?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_JOURCEL_000_064: He was poisoned!? By the gods, Goncquard and his wife were in such high spirits when I passed by the Manderville Lounge earlier. To see them laughing cheerily at the antics of that Senor Sabotender, I would have never imagined such a tragic turn of events...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ABBELINA_000_065: Master Goncquard came here most days. Sometimes alone, sometimes with Mistress Flaurie... <sigh> They seemed like such a happy pair. 'Tis heartbreaking that we'll not see them walking cheerfully through the Saucer any longer.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_HITCHCOCK_000_066: Aye, I saw the whole sorry affair from a nearby table. Nearly choked on my own food at the sight, I did. But I acted quickly─ I knew at once that foul play was afoot, so I stole away with the glass from which Goncquard took his last fateful sip...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_HITCHCOCK_000_067: Now, now, I was only acting in your best interests. What if this was lost, or worse? I'm familiar enough with mysteries to know an inspector must always think one step ahead of  quarry. Here, take the glass─ I have an inkling you might need it.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_068: The glass is empty, but a faint, sweet odor still remains.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_069: The plate Z'napha served Goncquard. The pungent odor of bitter spirits is almost overpowering.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_VELEDA_000_070: If you ask me, Lyell's the last person I'd suspect of murder. Someone so serious wouldn't be so rash. Can't say the same for Z'napha, though. Not that I think she has it in her to kill someone, of course; she just hasn't been at the Saucer long enough for me to get to know her.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_000_071: Thankfully, the crumpled figure before you is not another victim, but merely a discarded Senor Sabotender costume. A sickly-sweet fragrance hangs in the air, and the scene makes you uneasy, as if you have caught a glimpse of something no one was meant to see.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_100_071: You inquire about the late Goncquard and the circumstances surrounding his demise.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_110_071: Remember this information well, for it may prove crucial to your inquiry.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_120_071: Your search has yielded all the pieces of the puzzle. It is now up to you to put them together.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_072: Ah, you are returned! Have you uncovered anything that might help us bring this dreadful affair to a close?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_100_072: You have returned at last! Your inquiry has uncovered ample clues, and now it is up to us to make sense of them. Unless you already have, of course! Elsewise, I would be happy to mull over the evidence with you.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_Q1_000_000: Do you know who poisoned Goncquard?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A1_000_001: The killer is among us, and I know who it is!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A1_000_002: I'd like to discuss the evidence I've gathered so far.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_SYSTEM_110_072: The conclusion of this quest will differ depending on the choices you make in the following sequence. However, the rewards will remain the same.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_Q1_100_000: Are you ready to explain your reasoning?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_073: Such confidence! Nevertheless, this is a grievous crime with a grievous punishment, so the burden is on us, the inspectors, to explain our reasoning before making accusations. And so,  , I would ask that you walk us through how you came to your conclusion.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_074: I understand. This is not a matter to be taken lightly. Very well, speak to me again once you are confident in your conclusion.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_000: A prudent choice. Considering the magnitude of the crime, we must pore over every piece of evidence before making accusations. So, what shall we discuss?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_001: Hmmm... Perhaps it would be best if we had something to discuss first. I am certain our murderer overlooked something, and I am certain that with diligence you shall find it. Return to me once you've gathered any evidence that could be of use.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_Q1_200_000: Which piece of evidence would you like to discuss?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_010:
A crumpled scrap of parchment, upon which the following words were writ.
“To the King,
You know what must needs be done. Succeed, and you shall be rewarded handsomely.
From,
The Rook”
Hmmm... Ominous titles, for an ominous letter. Who could these two characters be?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_020: Ah yes, an empty phial found discarded on the staircase. You say you could detect a sweet aroma from within it, yes? Hmmm... What could it have possibly contained?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_030: Ah, Northern Storm, the Roegadyn eying these proceedings so intently. His gaze makes me slightly uneasy, but he did shed some light on Goncquard's time alone at the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_031: It would seem our victim had a habit of imbibing─particularly when his wife was absent─which led to wandering hands and a loose tongue, especially when Z'napha was around. I cannot help but wonder what Mistress Flaurie thought of all this, or if she even knew...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_040: That Lalafell seems to have taken a keen interest in how this affair will play out. Nonetheless, he provided us with valuable insight into our victim's favored pastime.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_041: Kokomui and Goncquard shared the love of the Cactpot Board, though fortune often favored the latter, leaving him with an excess of MGP. In a place like the Gold Saucer, it is plain how such luck could incite envy, or worse...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_050: Jourcel happened to pass by the Manderville Lounge just before Goncquard was killed. He was among the last few to see our victim alive and well.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_051: He spied one of our very own Senor Sabotenders entertaining the couple with its whimsical poses. Not an unusual sight in the Gold Saucer, to be sure, but I'm certain not many expect it to be followed by tragedy.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_060: Abbelina has long been greeting the Saucer's patrons, and as such is privy to their comings and goings. Goncquard was no exception.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_061: He would often be accompanied by Flaurie, as one would expect. But more surprising, however, is the revelation that he would sometimes come on his own. One cannot help but wonder what activities our poor Goncquard indulged in when his wife was not present.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_070: Hitchcock's story itself did not give us much of value, but speaking to him proved worthwhile nonetheless.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_071: He was dining next to the ill-fated couple when tragedy struck, and whether it be by foresight─as he claims─or some morbid impulse, he snatched up the glass from which Goncquard took his last sip.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_072: Of course, it would have been preferable to find the evidence undisturbed, but I suppose we should be grateful to come into possession of it at all.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_073: <sniff> ...Hmmm, I detect a sweet aroma. It seems so familiar, but for the life of me I cannot recall why.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_080: The plate Z'napha served the couple was rank with the bitter smell of strong spirits. Perhaps Goncquard was particular to such libations? Still, even our strongest drink would not cause so sudden a death as his.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_090: Veleda spends her days behind the Cactpot Board counter, and is well acquainted with most of the Gold Saucer's staff.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_091: She seemed certain of Lyell's innocence, but admitted to knowing too little about Z'napha to speak on her character. Hmmm... I appreciate her honesty. It would be a shame if an uninformed judgment led us to accusing the wrong person.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_200_100: Ah, the secret of the Saucer's sabotenders comes out at last. Who could be so careless as to leave the costume out in the open? Nonetheless, it may prove to be a vital piece of this puzzle. The sweet odor you say hung in the air is most unusual. If we could but ascertain its origin...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_075: Very well, then we should start by answering the most elementary question: how was Goncquard poisoned?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A2_000_001: The poison was mixed in his drink!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A2_000_002: The poison was hidden in his food!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_076: Hmmm... So it was the drink that killed him. Of course, of course, an astute judgment. But why not the food? How can you be certain Goncquard's beverage was poisoned?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_Q3_000_000: What compelled the criminal to poison Goncquard's drink?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A3_000_001: Because that's how I'd poison someone!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A3_000_002: Everyone knows poison dissolves more readily in liquid.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A3_000_003: You only need smell his glass. The sickly-sweet scent is unmistakable: it's poison!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_077: Ah, the food! Truth be told, I had arrived at the same conclusion myself. The savory aromas and rich flavors would mask the poison's scent and taste alike. How clever...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_078: True... It would be a trifling matter to slip a few fatal drops into Goncquard's drink, and once mixed properly he would be none the wiser.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_079: That odor, of course! So sweet as to be unnatural, and not befitting Goncquard's tastes besides. There is no doubt─I am all but certain the drink was poisoned. Now we must ascertain when.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_080: There were numerous opportunities for our suspect to administer the fatal concoction.  , pray tell us when you think this occurred.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A4_000_001: While his food and drink were being prepared.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A4_100_001: While his food and drink were being served.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A4_000_002: While the food and drink were already on the table.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_081: Such brazenness! The killer could have peered straight into Goncquard's eyes! It was no simple task─ Several people were there and claim to have seen nothing. How could our perpetrator possibly have accomplished such a feat?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A5_000_001: On second thought, perhaps the poisoning occurred during preparation.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A5_100_001: Perhaps I was wrong. The poisoning likely occurred while his meal was being served.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A5_000_002: The poison was contained in a small, sealed phial!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_082: Brilliant! Why, I am all but certain who the killer is now.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_083: Perhaps you are right. Remember, there is no shame in reconsidering your deductions. We must take great care not to accuse the innocent.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_084: Yes, the phial! Small enough to hide on one's self, and the murderer would only need a moment to apply the poison. Hmmm... Our criminal was meticulous indeed. But not meticulous enough, it would seem!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_085: Well, I believe this mystery is all but solved.  , I would give you the honor of revealing the identity of our culprit. I wait with bated breath.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_086: Senor Sabotender!? I must say, this is quite the unexpected development! Pray forgive my doubt, but I must ask: why?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_Q7_000_000: Why would Senor Sabotender commit murder?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A7_000_001: Trust me, an adventurer knows these things.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A7_100_001: Ah, but if I were to tell you now, it would ruin the suspense.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A7_000_002: Because inside the sabotender was the true killer: Kokomui!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_087: You─ This is no time to be coy! Now, I will ask again. Pray take yourself seriously this time!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_LYELL_000_088: Nonsense! Goncquard was a loyal customer! Why would I want him dead!? Tell me, if you're so sure!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A8_000_001: It was the only way you could put a stop to his drunken behavior!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A8_000_002: With Goncquard gone, Flaurie would finally have eyes for you!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A8_000_003: You were deep in debt to Goncquard, so you paid him back with murder!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ZNAPHA_000_089: Me!? I have no reason to wish Master Goncquard harm! Why would I poison him!?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A9_000_001: You couldn't have Goncquard to yourself, so you made sure no one could!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A9_000_002: You grew tired of his constant advances, and silenced him forever!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A9_000_003: Seeing Goncquard happy with his wife made you mad with envy, so you took that happiness away from them!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_FLAURIE_000_090: You accuse me of killing my own husband!? Why, the very thought is sickening! What gives you cause to make such a bold claim!?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A10_000_001: You thought to make your husband's riches your own!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A10_000_002: This was your punishment to Goncquard for his infidelities!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A10_000_003: Your husband's wandering eyes filled you with jealousy, so you shut them for good!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_KOKOMUI_000_091: So that's the way your mind works, is it? Let's accuse the nearest Lalafell of murder, on account of he's the size of a sabotender? You'll need to do better than that! Why in the hells would I kill Goncquard? I barely knew the man!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A11_000_001: Your gambling habit got the best of you, and you ran out of coin to support it.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A11_000_002: You were envious of Goncquard's luck, and couldn't stand to see him win even once more!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A11_000_003: You were enamored with Mistress Flaurie, and Goncquard stood in the way of your heart's desire!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_KOKOMUI_000_092: Well, you've got me there! It's true my coinpurse doesn't jingle much these days. But tell me, Inspector, how would murder improve my situation, eh? A man can't very well earn coin when he's in shackles!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_093: I must admit, Kokomui has a fair point. Poverty is hardly a sufficient motive... Ah, but something tells me you have already considered this. Pray enlighten us, that we might finally reach the truth of this matter.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_Q12_000_000: Is there more to your accusation?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A12_000_001: Kokomui was after Goncquard's Cactpot winnings!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A12_000_002: Kokomui was promised a reward. From Roland!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_094: What an unexpected conclusion! I shudder to think one capable of such a pitiless act was so close to us all along. Nonetheless, we are in your debt,  . The Gold Saucer is safer for your efforts.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_095: (-???-)Fools! No justice will be served today, my inept inspectors!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_096: Thank the Twelve we caught the true culprit. It would have hung heavy over our heads had we accused an innocent of such a grievous crime. I thank you for helping us avoid further tragedy,  .
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_097: (-???-)Fools! No justice will be served today, my inept inspectors!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_098: (-???-)As expected, the truth is laid bare by  's keen intellect! Excellent work, my friend, excellent work!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_099: Your deductions were impeccable! Indeed it was a Senor Sabotender who stealthily slipped an alchemical concoction into Goncquard's drink, and indeed it was Kokomui inside the costume. All for a reward from yours truly!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_100_099: I suppose you found the parchment then? From the Rook to the King─or in other words, from R to K! Most clever, was it not? You have answered all the questions most skillfully. All, except, for a very simple one: why?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_110_099: Mayhap you recall Ollier's offer to preview our forthcoming attractions? ...Yes, now you understand! I hope you enjoyed unraveling this mystery as much as we enjoyed weaving it. And look there─it appears our friend Goncquard has risen from the dead.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_GONCQUARD_000_100: <yawn> ...By the gods, I've not had such a peaceful slumber in ages! Roland, you simply must teach me the recipe for that potion!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_101: Now, now, my dear Goncquard, this solution is much too strong for that. The phial contained only enough to ensure you would not awaken earlier than intended. And then, perhaps, a bit more. Forgive me, but it would have been an embarrassment had your eyes opened during the dramatic climax!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_102: A climax carried by Kokomui's masterful performance! Such passion! As promised, you can expect a generous recompense for your artful rendition.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_103: And so,  , I do hope you were entertained by the Gold Saucer's new attraction: “Murder at the Manderville Lounge.” I admit there are some performances that could stand to be more believable, but I know with time we shall improve.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_104: As a whole, however, I believe accolades are in order! A round of applause to all involved, and to  's ingenuity!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_100_105: At last, our work is done. Quite expertly, I might add. However, there is one last matter Master Roland wishes to discuss with you. Pray meet us in front of El Coloso as soon as circumstances allow.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_110: I know not what justice awaits the guilty party, only that it will be harsh and swift. We can rest assured in the knowledge that this crime will not go unpunished.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_100_110: What's that? Ah, yes, the new attractions. Given what just transpired, you must forgive me for insisting you wait. Pray return another day, after this tragedy is behind us, and we shall gladly oblige you.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_111: The Brass Blades have escorted the killer from the Gold Saucer, and they will answer for their misdeeds. Well done, Ollier. And you,  .
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_112: It was a pleasure to serve, Master Roland. However, it would be amiss of me to not give most of the credit to  , whose masterful deductions led to the conclusion of the investigation.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_113: Ah, yes, quite masterful! But indeed, even the master can benefit from retracing his work with a more critical eye. Who is to say there was not some subtlety that escaped your attention? If only there was a way you could relive the mystery, to ensure that justice is served, and served properly! ...Ah, pray forgive my rambling. Of course, you shall be rewarded for your efforts, if you would but remain here for an attendant to prepare it.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_114: I shall take my leave. Ollier, I trust that you can resume your duties? Oh, and pray oblige any requests our interim inspector may have, should  wish to...reprise  role.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_115: And you,  , may you enjoy all that the Gold Saucer has to offer. You certainly deserve it.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_116: I sincerely hope you did not take our deception personally,  .
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_117: Ah, it was all in good fun! I only hope the puzzle proved challenging enough to keep you entertained throughout.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_GODBERT_000_118: (-???-)Ho ho ho! I fear we may have to concoct even more devious riddles!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_GODBERT_000_119: Tell it true, . Were you confounded by the mystery's subtlety and nuance? Or was solving it merely child's play to you?
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_GODBERT_000_120: Very good, very good! Once inspiration struck, we labored day and night to create a web of deception and intrigue so thick not even my dear son would be able to untangle it. It would seem, however, that there is more work to be done─more flaws to be hammered out.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_121: Of course, Lord Manderville!  , we are at your disposal should you wish for us to reprise our roles. Who knows, you may even see a performance you missed this time around.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_122: Ollier, I trust you will accommodate  's requests. We must hone our craft until it becomes second nature.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_ROLAND_000_123: In the meantime, my attendants shall prepare a reward for your aid today. And with that, I shall take my leave. Farewell!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_GODBERT_000_124: I shall take my leave as well. Pray enjoy the delights of the Gold Saucer to your heart's content!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_125: And so the tale of Goncquard's murder comes to a close. Ah, but I sense a desire to do it all over again. Perhaps you wonder if it could have turned out differently? Or perhaps you would like to take a closer look at the evidence? If so, simply ask and we can return to the Manderville Lounge once more!
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A13_000_001: Yes, I may have missed something.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_A13_000_002: No, I've seen everything I need to.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_127: Very well! Pay close attention, for even the smallest detail may prove to be the piece that illuminates the truth.
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_128: So, shall we begin? Let us return to the moment of Goncquard's fateful supper...
TEXT_FESGSC001_02133_OLLIER_000_129: Very well, I understand now is not the time. However, if you would ever wish to relive the intrigue of Goncquard's murder, you only need ask and we shall gladly oblige.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_000: Your pardon, . You are an adventurer, yes? Then I take it you have heard about the bug infestation?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_Q1_000_000: Have you heard about the bug infestation?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_010: ...Yes, it was only a matter of time before word spread. I need hardly tell you how these persistent pests might imperil the celebrations.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_020: ...No? Well, take it from me: the mere sight of the things would make your skin crawl with horror.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_030: No one knows whence they came. No one knows why they have come. Only one thing is certain: the wilds just beyond the city walls are teeming with these mechanical monstrosities, and their numbers grow with each passing day.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_031: What ill fortune that this plague should be visited upon us so close to the anniversary of our realm's rebirth! How might our citizens pray and reflect in peace with that skittering horde at our gates...?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_032: Thankfully, this land is not without its heroes. I hear tell of a flamboyant bard who has declared war against the bugs.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_033: The stories speak of him engaging the metallic creatures in both central and western Thanalan. Will you not aid this courageous minstrel in his noble attempt to secure a modicum of tranquility for the coming solemnities?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_040: The bugs have been sighted scuttling about both central and western Thanalan. Won't you join the tenacious troubadour of whom I spoke, and lend your arm to his struggles?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_060: You've sent those bugs skittering, have you!? Twelve be praised, the celebrations are saved!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: (-???-)Alas no, my dear... We are not free of the pests yet.
I thank you for your assistance, . Wheresoever a heroic soul is needed, there shall you ever be found. I could ask for no stouter ally!
I thank you for your assistance─I do not think I could have turned back the swarm alone.

Our victory is, however, but a fleeting one. No matter how many of these bugs we put down, there will always be more to take their place. There seems to be hundreds of them, if not thousands, and more arrive by the day.
I am doing all I can to thin their numbers...but it is a losing battle.
...If I am not mistaken, you salvaged a piece of one of our foes, did you not? Might I see it?
...Curious. 'Tis faint, but I do believe this scrap of metal is humming. Nay, mayhap not humming exactly... The sound has a most distinctive timbre...
As a citizen of Ul'dah, would you happen to know of any professional musicians with whom we might consult? They need not be local in origin─merely local in whereabouts.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_095: Now that you mention it, I did recently make the acquaintance of a visiting composer. He has traveled from afar to attend the anniversary celebrations, seeking inspiration for his next work, I believe. You'll likely find him nearby, sampling all the sights and sounds of the sultanate!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: A propitious circumstance, indeed! If you are willing, I would have you seek out this composer as soon as you are able, and ask if he can identify the mysterious tone that issues without cease from your battlefield memento.
We stand at an impasse, and any new insight into our predicament would be most welcome. 'Tis perhaps fortunate that the anniversary celebrations have drawn such a large and varied crowd.
Surely within the mind of one of these myriad visitors can be found the solution to our problem. Pray begin your inquiries forthwith!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_100: I made the acquaintance of a visiting composer only recently─you should find him nearby, savoring the sights and sounds of the anniversary celebrations!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I shall remain here, and prepare to meet the next wave of bugs. You, my friend, must seek out and speak with those whose expertise might grant us an insight into the nature of our ever more numerous foes.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMUSICIAN02: What do you make of these dancin' lovelies? Not to be prudish, but I can't help feelin' the revealin' costumes take away from the performance a bit... Hm? What's that? You want me to listen to somethin'?
Musical curio, is it? All right then, I'm game! Let's have a listen to this mysterious sound of yours...
Hmmm, this here's more than your standard mechanical hum. There's a definite rhythm to it; a clear melody repeatin' over and over...
An' if you look closely, you can see some symbols on it, fadin' in an' out in time to the beat. 'Fraid the meanin's lost on me, though...
You should show this to a mate of mine─he knows all manner of strange tongues. You'll probably find him in Arrzaneth Ossuary, salivatin' over all them dusty tomes.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_125: I cannot tell you how much it means to me that you have taken up the fight against these awful bugs... I have the utmost faith that you will discover the means to exterminate them for good!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMUSICIAN02: Me mate speaks all sorts of languages I've never heard of. Head over to Arrzaneth Ossuary and ask him to have a look at them symbols for you. He'll know what they mean.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGTRANSLATOR:
...You have need of my linguistic expertise? Hm. I had intended to immerse myself in these delectable volumes...but I cannot deny, the puzzle you have presented to me is most intriguing... Most intriguing indeed...
Very well. I shall indulge you. Silence, if you please!
Uh... Ah. This is the language of a long-dead civilization. I specialize in living tongues, but I daresay I can decipher some few words...
Hmmm. Though the finer details of the message elude me, the word stems suggest a theme of “proliferation” and “command.”

More, I cannot tell you. However...I have had the pleasure of collaborating with a noted author who is well versed in the history and culture of ancient civilizations. It is possible that he might be able to use the hints I have provided as keys to open the next set of doors.
I suggest searching for him at the Quicksand─writers do so love to eavesdrop on the colorful conversations of adventurers.
I suggest you speak with the writer I mentioned. He will doubtless be in the Quicksand, eavesdropping on adventurers for inspiration.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGSCENARIOWR: ...You seem troubled, friend. Mayhap I can be of service. To pen a convincing story, one must first embrace the knowledge of a thousand times and places, and it is possible that on my wanderings I have stumbled across just the pearl of wisdom you require.

“Proliferation” and “command,” you say... Those words bring to mind a passage I came across while researching ancient Allag─background reading for a novella I was planning. As I recall, the passage described a mechanism enabling the mass production of mechanical weaponry.
...But without understanding exactly how the mechanism functions, I fear you will struggle to disrupt it.
'Tis fortunate, then, that I am acquainted with a highly proficient engineer. If anyone is capable of proposing a practical solution to your problem, then it is he.

The advent of the Calamity affected him deeply, so he will almost certainly be here to celebrate the anniversary of the realm's rebirth. And given his professional curiosity, I imagine the mammets of the Goldsmiths' Guild will prove an irresistible lure... You might try looking for him there.
I know of a proficient engineer who is likely in Ul'dah to celebrate the anniversary. And assuming he is here, the mammets of the Goldsmiths' Guild cannot have failed to seize his attention...
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGPROGRSMMER: ...You have need of an engineer's perspective? Very well. Allow me to inspect this mechanical fragment.
...Hmmm. From what you have told me, as well as my own cursory observations, I must conclude that the bugs you fought were constructed with some manner of self-replicating mechanism.

Whenever the total number of active units falls below a certain threshold, it triggers the broadcast of a signal─a command for the remaining units to multiply. Short of simultaneously disabling them all, your best hope of victory lies in disrupting this signal, and thereby preventing further replication.

Pray return now to the friend you mentioned. A minstrel, was he not? Good. Explain to him that he must, upon the elimination of each bug, play in such a way as to disrupt the signal until the unit's remaining components have been destroyed.
I will provide him with a sequence of notes that should achieve the desired interference. Here, I've written down the particulars. Naught remains but to test the results in the field!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMUSICIAN02: I hope me ears were of help to you. When you close your eyes an' truly listen, you'd be amazed how the world reveals itself!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGTRANSLATOR: Were you able to make some sense of that writing? The words are important, aye, but ofttimes you miss the entire story when you focus too much on the literal meaning.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGSCENARIOWR: 'Tis with the greatest of pleasure that we offer up our knowledge and expertise. Composer or translator, author or engineer, we all live to see our skills put to good use!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGPROGRSMMER: Those bugs have no place in this world. Take the answer you have pieced together from our combined efforts, and set your minstrel friend on the path to victory.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Well, my friend? Are we any closer to finding a permanent means of eradicating these bugs...?
...Ah, such a mechanism would well explain their never-ending numbers!
And I need only strum this melody until such time as I have destroyed the creatures' remains, yes? Why, naught could be simpler─it shall be the tune of my triumph!
Thank you, adventurer. Now we might offer our prayers for the victims of the Calamity, undisturbed by the discordant clanging of metallic limbs...
Without your aid─and the advice of those generous visitors─I would never have arrived at the solution you have provided.
It is incredible what can be accomplished when the wisdom and skill of many are bent towards a common goal. In fact, I am inspired to write a song in their honor...

...An ode to all the creative souls who bring such color and vibrancy to our world. Might I treat you to the first verse...? Ahem!
Praise be to all ye men of worth,♪
Who build proud towers from clods of earth,♪
Who grant our fancies form and weight,♪
A thousand wonders incarnate...♪
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_25: (-???-)Greetings, Warrior of Light. You have arrived on the Eighteenth Floor.
(-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
(-???-)All those you see here are creators of incredible fervor. And every single speck of energy and passion they possess is forever channeled towards your realm─towards Eorzea!
...My name is Naoki Yoshida. On behalf of the Eighteenth Floor, I bid you welcome. We are overjoyed to have this opportunity to offer you our heartfelt thanks!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_300: Are you quite all right? 'Twas as if your spirit was transported elsewhere... You hear my words now, though, yes?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Do you wish to hear my tribute to the creative once more?
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_34: I know that each of my colleagues was keen to thank you in person. Have you spoken to everyone?
Would you accompany me for a time, then? There is something I wish to share with you...
Then pray feel free to make the rounds! They are dying to talk to you!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_35: I do hope you're enjoying your time here on the Eighteenth Floor. We've all been so eager to meet you.

You see, Eorzea is our shared passion─from its deepest valley to its loftiest cloud, and all that lies in between. And you, as one who has chosen to fight for this glorious realm, have become a hero not only to Eorzea's citizens, but to us as well!
As I am sure you know, our beloved star once faced a ruinous fate. It was a fate born of arrogance and pride and vanity; a fate we brought upon ourselves.

Thus did we seek to commune with you, Eorzea's heroes, that we might together realize a desperate plan: to forsake our doomed path and begin our journey anew. We would tear down what we had wrought, and build another world amid the wreckage of our hubris.
Since that day of rebirth, more than five years have passed in Eorzea. The land breathes with renewed vigor, and the lure of adventure invites you onwards and upwards into the heavens themselves.
We shall never again make the mistake of believing that Hydaelyn is ours alone: it is the culmination of the history we have made together, and the future we have yet to share.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_35: There will be days when we shall stand side by side, our laughter ringing in the air. There will be days when we shall be at odds, our brows furrowed in frustration.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_101_35: But only through such earnest exchanges shall Eorzea continue to flourish, and new creations take shape. The Calamity taught us the truth of that.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_102_35: It is our fondest hope that your adventures in Eorzea will be a constant source of joy and wonder. May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal!
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_35: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
Ever will we be watching over you and your deeds. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, Warrior of Light...
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: By your expression, I thought your mind adrift on distant seas... Tell me: what manner of waking dream captivated your senses so completely?
...Fascinating. A vision of a world that exists outside of our reality. Was it a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind...? I doubt we will ever know.
I mean to remain in Ul'dah for the duration of the anniversary celebrations. Should you wish to experience the vision again, you have only to ask─I shall be glad to send you on your way with a song.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_NONORA_000_361: It seems to me that both you and the characters in your vision share a powerful desire to protect and nurture Eorzea... Mayhap it was that which gave form to the scene you witnessed.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: ...Let us now take a moment to remember those whose flames were extinguished too soon. The tragedies of yesterday must not be forgotten, lest we take for granted the gifts of tomorrow.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_SYSTEM_000_400: You have unlocked the Concentration mini-game.
TEXT_FESANV101_02134_SYSTEM_000_401: Open the toy chest in any inn room to enjoy this classic pastime.
TEXT_FESGSC002_02135_GSSTAFF02135_000_00: Ah, the astute adventurer who so skillfully untangled the Gold Saucer's murderous mystery! I believe I speak for everyone involved when I say you have our utmost gratitude.
But of course, your efforts deserve to be rewarded with more than just words. Grege at Entrance Square awaits with a prize that I'm sure will prove to be most satisfactory.
Your reward for a job well done awaits at Entrance Square! Ah, if only I could be there to see your face when you receive it!
TEXT_FESGSC002_02135_GREGE_000_010: Say no more─Ollier has already explained everything! Ah, but surely you've already deduced that. Nonetheless, I shall give you my thanks, along with the reward you so greatly deserve! May it serve you well the next time an impenetrable mystery unravels before your wit!
TEXT_FESGSC002_02135_SYSTEM_000_011: You have learned the emote Eureka!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Blimey, it's hot out! This scorching summer heat has me sweating buckets─buckets, I tell you. But no matter! The Moonfire Faire is just around the corner and even this awful weather can't dampen my spirits!

Wait a second... You look mighty familiar. Yes, yes! I remember now─you're the strapping young  from several summers ago. I didn't expect to see you here, but I suppose even adventurers need to forget the summer heat with a bit of celebration!

Ah, ! You can't mean to say you don't know what the Moonfire Faire is!? I've never been much of a storyteller─forget half the details and muddle everything up─but our Moonfire criers have quite the knack for it!
Tell me, , are you as excited as I am!? I'd bet my last gil you are! Haha! Well then, what do you say to helping us add an extra bang to the festivities in exchange for some special rewards?
I knew you'd be interested! Our grand chaperone, Haermaga, has been doling out tasks all ─but I'm sure he'll have plenty for you to do!
Oh, dear... Did I perhaps mistake your friendly smile for Moonfire Faire cheer, when in reality, it was nothing of the sort?
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_010: Another adventurer here to help us add some cheer to the Moonfire Faire, I presume? Well come, my good !
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_011: Do my eyes deceive me or is it truly you, !? Haha! It's wonderful to see you again, and to hear that you've come to lend us a hand makes our reunion all the sweeter!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_012: Now, as you've no doubt noticed, the heat this year has been nigh unbearable! And even though we should've seen the worst, temperatures continue to soar─a phenomenon eerily reminiscent of the events of five years past, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_013: Aye, I fear that the Bombard King has returned to plague these lands, and with power even greater than before at his disposal.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_014: He has been most frequently spotted along the shores of Costa del Sol, so to keep an eye on him, we have decided to host the annual festivities here.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_015: So far, he has been laying low─only surfacing to terrorize the occasional passerby. However, it is only a matter of time before he grows bold enough to venture further inland.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_016: As proud members of the Adventurers' Guild, we must do our utmost to prevent this from happening. To that end, some of us have formed an...er, organization of sorts.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_017: But we'll come to that later. Ahem! With our heat-resistant Cascadier armor and the tactical knowledge we have gained through our studies, the fiend─and his tiny minions─won't stand a chance!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_018: Of course, we would feel much more confident were we to have your help, perhaps with the extermination of those smaller Bombards.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_019: We've found the waters of the elbst are most effective at extinguishing their flames. If you speak with Wunthyll, our stockman, he'll see you paired with one of our finest beasts.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_020: ...There is, however, something else I would ask of you. This is a matter requiring the utmost discretion, so I would prefer we continue this discussion in a more private setting. Pray meet me by the waterfall in a quarter bell.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_029: Do you not know where it is? If you follow the coastline, you'll come across a hidden cove. Just beyond that is the waterfall I speak of. Even from a distance you should be able to hear the rushing waters!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_030: (-???-)In times of desperate need, we hope for a hero. We look to the heavens and pray that someone, somewhere, is watching over us. Well, my friend, you need look no further!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_031: (-???-)The Go Go Posing Rangers are here, and we implore you, Warrior of Light, to stand with us against the blazing summer heat!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_032: With the stealth of a coeurl that slinks through the night─BLACK RANGER!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_033: With the grace of a golden flower dancing in the winds─YELLOW RANGER!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_034: Hot stuff coming through! REEEEEED RANGER!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_035: And in the name of justice we shall punish all that attempt to take these lands into their vile clutches!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_040: So you're the adventurer Haermaga sent! Considering the riffraff the man takes in, I wasn't too sure what to expect, but color me pleasantly surprised. Now then, I suppose proper introductions are in order. The lady in black is Hil─
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_041: For gods' sakes, Yellow Ranger! What purpose do these masks serve, if you insist on always spouting off our names to every single person we meet?
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_042: Indeed, she is right. , I'm sorry to say we cannot reveal to you our true identities. To do so would be akin to breaking the oath we took as Rangers, for we fight solely to protect the people─not for personal glory!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_043: Hear, hear! Humble guardians risking their lives to ensure the peace and prosperity of the realm─a beautiful and pure gesture, much like my twin-slash attack, which transcends even the might of our Firefall Battle Forma─
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_044: Hold it right there, Yellow Ranger! Didn't we agree we would make no mention of the formation until we determined that our companion is as trustworthy as Haermaga says?
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_045: Come now, Black Ranger! I can assure you that few are as honorable as the Warrior of Light! In fact, I think it should greatly benefit our cause to divulge to  all of the circumstances surrounding our current mission.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_046: Hah! And as the Go Go Posing Rangers' premier member, I suppose explaining exactly what that entails falls to me. Before we begin, however, I ask that none of you interrupts. Ahem. Are we clear, Hil─er, Black Ranger?
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_047: Let me start at the beginning. There are two reasons as to why the Go Go Posing Rangers are Eorzea's best bet at beating back the Bombards. First, because we have this smashing Cascadier armor. Second, because my prowess on the battlefield, with these two providing support, is unpara─
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_048: Our combined strength is indeed formidable but only when we manage to coordinate our attacks. The Firefall Battle Formation, however, is something we've successfully executed only a handful of times...
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_049: Yes. It's humiliating to even think about! We formed the Go Go Posing Rangers so that we might protect the land and its people from the Bombards, but the truth is, most of the time we cannot even protect ourselves...
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_050: To remedy this, each of us has prepared a specialized training regimen. We ask that you─as a realm-renowned adventurer of surpassing skill─help us train to the best of our ability.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_051: You are, by all means, free to decline. I would only ask you keep all we revealed today a closely guarded secret. Were the people to learn the men destined to defeat the Bombard King are still undergoing training, it might incite panic. And with that, we shall take our leave and humbly await your reply. Rangers, out!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_052: The old boy needs to learn to lighten up! As our official leader, Red tends to think he bears the responsibility of defeating the Bombards alone. He forgets one very important thing, however─he has the unstoppable Yellow Ranger at his side!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_053: ...That's likely what worries him most. If your mindless drivel isn't what kills us, that inflated ego of yours is certain to do the job!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HILDELANA_000_054: <sigh> All joking aside, I sincerely hope we can count on your support. It's going to take a miracle to pull this off, but somehow I believe, with you on our side, we can make it happen!
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_060: You'll do it!? I knew I asked the right ! The Red Ranger is eager to begin his training straightaway, so I ask you start by assisting him as soon as you are able. My assistant, J'nangho, will explain the details to you.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_061: As I am sure the Rangers mentioned, this is a covert operation, and its success requires your discretion.
TEXT_FESSUM201_02136_HAERMAGA_000_062: That being said, we could not have asked for a more steadfast ally. The future is bright, my friend! Between you, me, and the Posing Rangers, I have faith we can see to a better tomorrow! Go Go Posing Rangers!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_JNANGHO_000_000: Ah, ! What a pleasant surprise! Haermaga mentioned an adventurer would be along to assist the Posing Rangers with their training, but he never said it would be you. Well, you're right on time!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_JNANGHO_000_001: Hello, ! Am I correct in assuming you're here to assist the Posing Rangers with their training? Excellent! Let's get started, then!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_JNANGHO_000_002: The Red Ranger just left to practice with the smoldering dummies. He requests that you follow him with an elbst and compete with him to douse the flames first─him with his fists, and you with an elbst's water.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_JNANGHO_000_003: Our guild's stockman, Wunthyll, is stationed to the northwest and I'm sure he'd be more than happy to lend you one of his elbsts.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_JNANGHO_000_004: I know, I know, he stirred up all that trouble last year, but now he's one of our guild's most hardworking members, and it's largely in part to your inspiring example.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_JNANGHO_000_005: Wunthyll has something of a murky past, but he is now one of our guild's most hardworking members. In fact, the reason he's so dedicated is because he was inspired by an adventurer much like yourself!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_WUNTHYLL_000_010: ? No. That can't be right! I must be daydreamin' again. B-But that powerful stride, that smile... Bloody hells! It's really you, innit?
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_WUNTHYLL_000_011: I didn't think I'd ever see you again! Before I forget, I just want to say thank you for all that you've done for me─it ain't no ordinary  what can convince a pirate to renounce his ol' ways and up and join a guild!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_WUNTHYLL_000_012: So how might I be of service to you this fine day?
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_WUNTHYLL_000_013: Hm. In that case why don't you take her. She's yet to be fully broken in but─having been on the receiving end of it more than once─trust me when I say she can blast water farther than all the others combined!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_WUNTHYLL_000_019: Threw you off, did she? Has a fiery temper, that one. Lemme saddle this ol' girl, and you can take her instead.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_SYSTEM_000_019: The smoldering dummy is enveloped in flames. Borrow an elbst from Wunthyll and use its Saturate ability to douse them.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_020: I see you have not brought an elbst with you. Do you intend to squelch these flames with your bare hands? I hardly think that a fair fight!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_025: Curses! Had I been a split second faster, it would have been extinguished by my hand!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_026: You and your elbst might be fast, , but my fists are faster, and I assure you the next round will be mine!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_SYSTEM_000_029: The burning dummies are enveloped in flames. Borrow an elbst from Wunthyll and use its Saturate ability to douse them.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_030: Do you intend to stand idly by and let me claim victory? If not, I suggest you go and fetch an elbst that we may have a proper competition!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_035: Blast it all! I can't believe I lost again! Ghraaah! Brace yourself, . No matter what it takes, I shall be securing at least one win today!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_SYSTEM_000_039: The blazing dummies are enveloped in flames. Borrow an elbst from Wunthyll and use its Saturate ability to douse them.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_040: Please hurry, and put out the flames with your elbst, ! They climb higher by the second!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_050: Th-Thank you for getting me out of that mess. I had only meant to add a splash of oil to bring the flames to life, but in my haste, my hands slipped. I drenched the burning dummies with a full bucket, and before I knew it I was surrounded by a ring of fire!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_051: That I need be saved from my own stupidity is proof I am unfit for the title of Red Ranger.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_052: Protect the people? Give them a better future? Ha! How am I to do any of that when even a small fire poses too great an obstacle for me to overcome!?
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_053: All I ever wanted was to give hope to the people─to quell all their fears─just as the Warriors of Light have done. <sigh> Perhaps it was too lofty a goal...
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_054: Ah, but what am I doing? I cannot give up at the first sign of difficulty! Today may not have yielded the results I wanted, but tomorrow is another day! I'm sure Haermaga is expecting you, so let us finish here and begin afresh anon!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_060: Godsdammit! I had to be rescued by you, yet again!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_061: I thought for sure I had matters under control this time, but it seems I am full of nothing but empty words and promises I cannot keep!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_062: Yes, I know! Improvement doesn't happen overnight. Hells! I can't even begin to imagine how long it took you to achieve what you have, but I had hoped to, at the very least, conquer the fear that defeated me before.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_063: I must redouble my efforts, lest I squander all the support and knowledge you have bequeathed onto me. Tell Haermaga that while today may have been full of setbacks, tomorrow the flames shall burn higher and I shall punch harder and faster!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_070: Thank you,  for saving me, yet again. <sigh> It seems the time has come for me to hang up this armor for good.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_071: Every step I take, every move I make─it only leads me further astray. This can mean but one thing. Defeating the Bombard King is a task best left to true heroes, and not a fool who but fancies playing the part...
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_072: , watch out! The blazing dummies─they have attracted the attentions of an unwanted guest!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_073: ...And he's intent on giving himself a boost with the remaining oil in the bucket! Garrr! If it's food you want, then it's my fists you'll eat, fiend!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_074: I defeated him? I defeated him! Haha! Did you see that, !?
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_075: Like a man possessed, I sprang into action without a second thought and snuffed the beast out with a single jab of my fist─as if he were a flickering candle and, I, a raging tornado!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_076: Th-That's it! I undertand now! I defeated him precisely because I let my instincts and the skills I honed in training take over, preventing stray thoughts from cluttering my mind and clouding my judgment!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_077: Do you know what this means!? The dream lives on! Ahahahaha! I can't even begin to express to you how happy I am! Now, however, is not the time for celebration, for it is from here that the true work begins.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_080: Ah, , you've returned. I trust the training went well?
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_081: Certainly. While the Red Ranger undoubtedly has a long and arduous path ahead of him, if the passion he has displayed today is anything to go by, we have nothing to worry about!
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_082: It sounds as though he got off to a rough start, but I have faith that he shall improve over the following days and weeks. In the meantime, I request you train with the Black Ranger. The details are with J'nangho, so if you are willing, please seek her out.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_083: Since this is a top secret matter, I would ask that you make every effort not to be overheard. I have relayed to the rest of my assistants that you will be running various errands for us, so your continued presence shouldn't arouse any suspicions.
TEXT_FESSUM202_02137_HAERMAGA_000_084: May all our hard work pay off, and together, let us celebrate the Moonfire Faire in the most traditional spirit of the holiday─by bringing down the Bombard King!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_JNANGHO_000_000: Wonderful timing, ─I was just about to send for you. As you've likely noticed, the sun today has been particularly intense and even the shade provides little reprieve from the heat.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_JNANGHO_000_001: Ranger or not, it is unwise to push the limits of one's body on a day such as this, but my attempts to convince a certain someone to remain indoors have fallen on deaf ears.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_JNANGHO_000_002: If the Black Ranger will not listen to sense, then we are left with but one other option: we must stuff her full of rolanberry shaved ice─one of the few surefire ways to cool the body! I think three cups should do the trick!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_JNANGHO_000_003: You can purchase some from our iceman just below, or should you be so inclined, you can prepare it yourself!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_010: Hut, two, three, four! Hut, two, th─ Ah, , are you here to join me for a round of─
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_011: Oh! Rolanberry shaved ice? It certainly is a kind gesture, but I don't much care for frozen desserts, or cold things in general, really.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_012: This will help me combat the heat, you say? Speaking from experience, I can assure you it will do nothing of the sort.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_013: Nevertheless, it would be a shame to let such an expensive dessert go to waste... Ah, I know! Allow me to propose a contest.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_014: I will go and hide, and you will attempt to find me. While I wait, I will continue to perform squats. Should you manage to find me before I squat one hundred times, you win. If not, I win─and the loser must eat the shaved ice as punishment.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_015: Are you ready, ? Good. Now hold on to the shaved ice for now and wait until the count of twenty before starting your search. Good luck!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_020: Oh, ! I'm glad you're here. This weather hasn't been particularly motivating and I could do with a training partner! Did you bring any of that shaved ice with you?
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_021: Bah! I think it will take me a while to become accustomed to the touch of ice upon my skin. In any case, you remember the rules to our little game, don't you?
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_022: Excellent! I have grown faster and stronger since we last met, so I shall set my goal to three hundred squats. Now, without any further ado, let's get started!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_028: Ah, without the rolanberry shaved ice, it would be considerably more difficult to play our game, don't you think?
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_029: Did you forget the rolanberry shaved ice? Well, in that case I shall wait here and continue with my warm-up while you go and fetch us some.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_030: That was incredibly fast! I had scarce begun to squat when I heard your swift approach. I suppose that means I'll have to eat the ice, then.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_031: Gah! Th-That was incredibly cold, but, just as you said, an extremely effective way to beat the heat!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_032: In fact, I feel so energized I believe I could do five hundred squats in the time it would take you to find me!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_040: I was nearly there! Just a few more to go and I would have beaten you. <sigh> “Would have,” however, isn't good enough, is it? I lose, once again.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_041: Th-That's even colder than I remember! <groan> Did you hear that? My stomach cries out in protest! Any more shaved ice and I doubt I could finish another circuit!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_042: Yet I cannot deny its rejuvenating effects. And with this last spurt of energy I shall do a thousand squats! Steel yourself, , for this next round I shan't lose!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_050: Only fifty...<pant>...to go. Please allow me...<pant>...to finish this set.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_051: Brrr! I feel it from my head to my toes! These defeats have forced me to admit an uncomfortable truth: my abilities are laughably inadequate.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_052: , I must become much faster and stronger! If that means I need spend day after day, training in the scorching hot sun or swallowing so much ice I can no longer feel my tongue, nose, or ears, then so be it! I shall do whatever it takes!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_053: However, I am no fool. Such skill takes years, if not decades to attain. It's not something that can be accomplished in the span of a few days or even weeks, no matter how dedicated one might be.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_054: , the Red Ranger is too proud to ask this of you, so I shall do so on his behalf. Should any of us fail to learn all that we must to defeat the Bombards, would you agree to lend us your strength on the battlefield?
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HAERMAGA_000_055: Thank you. You've taken a great load off my mind. Now, I think I will retreat into the shade for a moment before returning to training. Let us part ways here, my friend!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_060: Already? <pant> It looks as though...<pant>...I'm not...<pant>...the only one who's...<pant>...improving with practice!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_061: Brrr... It seems I stand no chance in winning this game against a seasoned adventurer such as yourself, but at least each torturous mouthful of ice brings me a step closer to my goals.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_062: I shall be looking forward to our next match, ! However, I advise you to come on an empty stomach, for you will be the one chomping on ice after our next session!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_070: Only...<pant>...ten more... <pant> Ah. You beat me...<pant>...again. <pant>
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_071: Oh, dear. I fear I may have dug into this cup a bit too enthusiastically. <groan> It's as though someone's shoved an ice-cold poker between my eyes and into my brain. This sensation, it brings me back to the time I first encountered the Red Ranger...
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_072: It was in Ul'dah─my birthplace─on a day almost as hot as this one, when I had just finished another long shift in the mines...
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_073: There we slaved day and night for a pittance, all the while those running the operation looked for new ways to squeeze even more from us.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_074: Yet, somehow over the years I eventually managed to scrape together a meager sum, enough to purchase shaved ice─one of the most luxurious desserts one could buy over in Thanalan.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_075: Like today, I made the mistake of eating it far too quickly, and in my weakened state, the shock of ingesting something so cold and foreign triggered a terrible migraine, which rendered me unconscious.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_076: I awoke in a soft bed, and to the sight of the Red Ranger's face. He nursed me back to health over the following week, listening sympathetically as I told him my story.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_077: When I had fully recovered, he invited me to join him. And so it was I finally left behind that life of hardship and misery...
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_078: <sigh> It seems I've gone off on a tangent. My apologies. It was never my intention to bore you with stories of my past.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HILDELANA_000_079: However, this trip down memory lane has instilled me with a renewed sense of purpose. Just as the Red Ranger once helped me escape my nightmares, I must return the favor by helping him achieve his dreams!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HAERMAGA_000_080: , thank you for braving this dreadful heat to ensure the Black Ranger's well-being.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HAERMAGA_000_081: Your dedication to the success of the Go Go Posing Rangers and the Moonfire Faire is admirable─comparable, perhaps, to that of my own. I thank my lucky stars that you came to us!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HAERMAGA_000_082: Indeed, it is a hot day, but I see now that the passion that burns in your heart blazes brighter than the sun! I cannot even begin to express how blessed we are to have you as an ally.
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HAERMAGA_000_083: Your discretion regarding this matter has also been commendable and none have yet to catch wind of what is really going on!
TEXT_FESSUM203_02138_HAERMAGA_000_084: I daresay, in addition to his regular training, the Yellow Ranger could do to learn a thing or two about tact from you! Hahaha! I'm sure he can hardly wait to begin his sessions, so I urge you speak with J'nangho, who will apprise you of all the details!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_JNANGHO_000_000: Hello, ! I'm so happy you're here! The Yellow Ranger has allegedly taught himself a new maneuver whereby he can, with a single well-placed strike, blast a Bombard to smithereens.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_JNANGHO_000_001: Indeed, this is exciting news, but he has yet to test this “death-blow” on actual Bombards. Despite his claims, I somehow doubt that swinging his axe at the air and yelling has done much to help him refine his technique.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_JNANGHO_000_002: To allow him to gauge just how effective this would be on a real target and assess what might need improvement, I ask that you weaken three Bygone Bombards, capture them with these flame-resistant nets, and then place them in his general vicinity.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_JNANGHO_000_003: ...And if you could keep this between us, it would be for the best. I'm afraid if he were to learn of our plan, he'd become a tad overeager to prove the potency of this new attack, charge headfirst into a bevy of Bombards, and end up injured or worse.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_009: So you have found me, ! I suppose this is a testament to your skill, for I purposely chose this secluded spot that I might practice away from prying eyes. Should the secrets of my Triple Majestic Slash Attack fall into the wrong hands, it could have disastrous and far-reaching consequences!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_010: You're here to see me in action, I presume? I'd love to indulge you, my friend, but I fear you'll have to wait until we face a sizable threat, that I might reveal to you the true potential of this most devastating attack.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_011: Stand back, ! Those Bombards appear to be of a highly dangerous breed! I shall finish them off!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_012: Graaagh! Begone from whence you came, foul fiends!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_013: Hahaha! That wasn't a very stimulating fight. This must mean I have, through my training, grown to be that much more powerful!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_014: While my skills with an axe are nearly unrivaled, I must nevertheless find a way to counteract the blinding light which accompanies a Bombard's suicidal blast. In a true battle, it could prove most detrimental!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_015: Moreover, it would not be good for morale should the group's most talented member be seen to stumble blindly about the battlefield!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_016: Tell the Re─er, Haermaga─that I shall resume my training as soon as I have finished scrubbing the soot from my armor.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_021: Eager to meet your maker, are you!? Vile fiends!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_022: You, my friend, seem to draw these vicious monsters to you, like moths to a flame. Fortunately, your bad luck has afforded me an opportunity to confirm just how effective my training has been!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_023: Why, my reflexes have become such that I can predict when and what type of attack the Bombards will use, allowing me to avert my gaze and prevent myself from becoming dazed by their blasts!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_024: All this progress has me eager to return to training, so I shall do just that. Oh, and should you bump into Haermaga, do be sure to tell him of the astounding amount of progress I have made─he's certain to be impressed by the swiftness with which I eliminated the fiends!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_030: Your misfortune persists! Fall back, , that I might do away with these fiends once and for all!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_032: Th-There is no need to worry, . Ahem. I was simply caught off guard by the, er, bang that resounded through the area, and that caused me to...trip. Y-Yes, I tripped, but as you can see, I haven't a scratch on me!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_033: Accident or not, however, there is no room for error on the battlefield and I must focus on improving my concentration. The Red Ranger relies heavily on his right-hand man, and I cannot fail him.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_034: He has toiled day and night to become the hero this realm so desperately needs, all for the sake of a promise he made to one little boy who wished for a masked man to banish the Bombards so his imaginary cat might frolic freely in the fields...or, at least, that's what I think he said.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_035: Anyhow, my point simply is this: as our official leader, any promises he makes are, by extension, promises all Go Go Posing Rangers make!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_036: That is why I, too, must become strong enough to weather any trial that may come and not falter as I did today.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_BEAUDEFOIN_000_037: Now, I shall return to practicing, so I might do Red proud and the boy might finally meet the hero he so admires!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_HAERMAGA_000_040: Thank you for taking the time to assist our Yellow Ranger with his training.
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_HAERMAGA_000_041: I hope we can count on your continued support, for the Go Go Posing Rangers need all the help you can provide if they are to take down the Bombard King!
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_HAERMAGA_000_045: J'nangho shared the news with me earlier. Though...not to question the veracity of the Yellow Ranger's claim, but tell me, , is this “death-blow” truly as grand as she says?
TEXT_FESSUM204_02139_HAERMAGA_000_046: Haha! Wonderful! I can only hope all three of our Rangers will make as much progress as he has today. We've no shortage of burgeoning Bombards to attend to, after all!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_000: , thanks to you, the Go Go Posing Rangers' performance has improved dramatically. Every one of them has become an expert fighter in their own right.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_001: As a team, however, they still lack basic coordination─which is of paramount importance if they are to defeat the evil plaguing these shores.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_002: Alas, we are out of time. The Bombard King has made his move and we must rise to stop him even if the Rangers are not fully prepared.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_003: And that brings me to why I summoned you here today. Should their best efforts fail, we need an adventurer strong enough to ensure the threat is kept at bay─someone like you, ! Please, will you help them to dethrone this royal pain once and for all?
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_004: Haha! I knew you'd agree! The Posing Rangers are currently preparing for battle at Hidden Falls. I ask that you go and meet them there, for I'm certain they're eager to discuss their strategies with you.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_009: The Rangers are waiting for you by Hidden Falls. Make haste, , for the enemy will not wait on our convenience.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_010: Ah, , you made it! The Red Ranger should be along shortly, but seeing as the most important members are here, let us start without him.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_011: As you are no doubt aware, the Bombards have begun their advance─something which has come much sooner than we anticipated and puts us at a great disadvantage.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_012: You see, we've only managed to marginally increase the success rate of our Firefall Battle Formation. It's a maneuver that requires perfect synchronization, and some of us have been struggling with it more than others.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_013: I, of course, have perfected the necessary techniques, but Red has a tendency to overthink the steps. His nimble footwork falters, and his powerful swings throw him off balance. Ultimately, an attack which should strike with the force of a hurricane is no more powerful than a mild breeze.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_014: All hope is not yet lost, though! We have recently learned of certain mental exercises that increase concentration. If done correctly, we believe they may help the Red Ranger keep his focus during battle!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_015: The Bombards, however, will not wait even those precious few minutes it would require, and so, with a heavy heart, we request that you─the  we trust above all others─hold off the fiends gathering along the coastline, and buy us the time we so desperately need.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_016: But before you leave, there's something we must show you...
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_017: ...Our true identities! For while you have come to be a dear friend, we have remained masked strangers to you. Therefore, as a show of trust and respect, Beaudefoin and I decided it was time we revealed all.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_018: And since he would undoubtedly object with something like, “A hero must never fight for personal glory,” we would prefer that you keep this a secret from the Red─
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_019: Wh-What is the meaning of this!? Where are your masks!?
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_020: I-I cannot believe it! The both of you─you've broken our oath! A hero must never fight for personal glory!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_021: Come now. You can't honestly expect us to keep our names and faces from !  may not wear our colors, but  is as much a Posing Ranger as any one of us! ...Or do you mean to say you don't trust the  to whom we owe so much?
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_022: On the contrary, Yellow Ranger! Why do you think it is I called upon  and divulged to  our greatest secrets? It is because I trust  more than anyone else!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_023: In any event, let us put this issue to rest for now. Every minute we waste squabbling is another minute the Bombards have to inflict further harm.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_024: , I trust these two have already apprised you of the details? Good. Once the fight is over, let us meet back here.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_026: The last to arrive and the first to leave. Typical! <sigh> Well, not to worry─he can't make it too far in that armor. Beaudefoin and I will see that the Red Ranger's mind is properly centered before heading to meet the Bombards. Godsspeed, ! May we all emerge from this unscathed!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_028: Are you off to fight the Bombards? Good luck, my friend, and stay safe!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_029: Soon after the battle I received word from the Go Go Posing Rangers saying the mission was a success! Ha ha! You should be proud, my friend, for you have helped us defeat the summer menace and restore joy to the realm!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_030: Can you believe it? We did it! We really did it! Ahem. Not that anything could have gone wrong with me heading our assault, of course!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_031: Thank you, . It was only because of your support that we emerged victorious against such slim odds!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_032: It's all well and good to thank  for all  help, but the both of you best remember that this is a fight we should have taken on alone!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_033: We still have a long way to go if we are to become anything like the esteemed Warriors of Light of whom the bards sing!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_034: He finally arrives! I suppose you're late because you were off sulking about the fact that I, Beaudefoin, and my friend  here outshined you in combat?
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_035: I'm not surprised. Just look at you─too embarassed to even remove your mask, are you!? Hahaha!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_037: Then prove it! Take it off, Red Ranger! After all, there should be no need for such secrecy among friends!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_038: Hildelana's right! Even the Warriors of Light you're so fond of were only successful because they placed their full trust in their comrades and did not keep things from one another!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_039: You two...finally agreeing on something! <sigh> I don't know whether to feel proud or ashamed.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_040: Forgive me. It seems I have let my preconceptions of what it is to be a hero lead me astray. It is past time I reveal to you who I am!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_041: But before I do, I just want to express my gratitude to you, Black─nay, Hildelana, you, Beaudefoin, and most especially you, ...
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_042: It is only because of you that we were able to take down the monster that terrorized these lands!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_044: Haha! I bet you didn't expect it to be me now did you?
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_045: Well, it's about time! You could have saved me a lot of trouble and more than a few lectures on “the importance of keeping secrets secrets” if you had just done that from the beginning, as I had suggested!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_046: I...I feel as though a great weight has been lifted from my shoulders! If this were a play─and we the protagonists─then this would be the moment marking the start of a long and illustrious career of fighting evil for the Go Go Posing Rangers!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_050: (-???-)In times of desperate need, we hope for a hero. We look to the heavens and pray that someone, somewhere, is watching over us. However, my friend, in doing so, we sometimes overlook the true heroes that walk among us!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_051: (-???-)Without you, Warrior of Light, the Go Go Posing Rangers would have stood no chance against the blazing summer heat, and it is in  like you that we find our courage─our power!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HILDELANA_000_052: With the stealth of a coeurl that slinks through the night─BLACK RANGER!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_BEAUDEFOIN_000_053: With the grace of a golden flower dancing in the winds─YELLOW RANGER!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_054: Hot stuff coming through! REEEEEED RANGER!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_055: And in the name of justice we shall punish all that attempt to take these lands into their vile clutches!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_056:
And so justice prevails and peace is restored to the realm once
more by the Go Go Posing Rangers and their faithful friend.
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_HAERMAGA_000_057: May they ever watch over Eorzea and deliver her from evil!
TEXT_FESSUM205_02140_SYSTEM_000_058: You now have access to a wider selection of wares from the Moonfire Faire vendor.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_001: Argh, how could I have lost? My strategy was foolproof! Listen, friend, if you have an inclination towards that Lord of Verminion game at the Gold Saucer, I'd say you'd best think twice.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_002: I spent a fortune on my critters, and had scores of victories to boast. Then some newcomer waltzed up and challenged me. I knew there was something strange about him─an Au Ra with hair of vibrant hue, glint in his eye, called himself the “maundering executive” or some such.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_003: Still, I'm not one to turn down a match, novice or veteran. Hells, I even gave him a head start. But the minions he used, they weren't like any I've ever seen before! They were demons, I tell you!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_004: I accused him of cheating, but he said he had petitioned the Gold Saucer to use them for battle...and the little buggers were approved! Needless to say, my beloved team was torn to shreds every time.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_005: Seems like anything qualifies these days. I've completely lost my appetite for the game, but if you're curious about these so-called minions, you should head over to the Gold Saucer and take a look yourself. He was still loitering around there when I left.
