TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_006: ...That blank stare tells me you have no idea what I've been rambling on about. I'd give you a ticket if I had a spare. Hmmm... My well-heeled brother tends to flaunt his winnings around here, and he usually has more than a few on hand. See if he can't help you out.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_LOSER02141_000_010: And that red monstrosity... I've never seen a cat like it. Where in the seven hells did he get it?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_020: Can I help you? Ah, I suppose word has gotten around about this little fellow. I would be delighted to tell you about him, truly, but I'm afraid I'm preoccupied at the moment. I'm waiting for someone who is unreasonably late.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_021: Wait...now that I think about it, you're an adventurer, aren't you? Alternatively, I may have a proposition for you.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_022: If you help me out, I will tell you more about my feline friend here. Do you accept?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_024: Well, you can't blame me for trying. Good day to you, then.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_025: And the deal is struck. Allow me to introduce myself.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_026: I am a tradesman come from far beyond the borders of Eorzea. Though I am a slave to wanderlust, I occasionally return to my homeland where I manage a sizable company that deals in eccentric commodities. Thus the locals called me “the wandering executive,” and I wear the title with pride.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_027: I am often accompanied by an erudite traveling companion, but he appears to have gotten quite lost on this journey. We were strolling in the twilight of the Black Shroud when he grew excited and scampered off to do some sightseeing of his own.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_028: He was aware I had some affairs to take care of here, so I thought to let him enjoy himself while I finished with my tasks and stayed in one spot. But he hasn't shown up in hours. Perhaps you could ask around Bentbranch for me and find out what's keeping him?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_029: Oh, I almost forgot to mention. My friend is not of my tribe. He's a rotund little soul, white as snow and floats through the air like a cloud...except if clouds could speak I would hope they wouldn't be as long-winded as he.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_030: You ask my real name? My apologies, but you must understand I cannot reveal that so readily to someone I barely know in a strange land. If you'll help me by finding my friend, perhaps I will tell it to you.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_KEITHA_000_040: Round, white, and floats through the air? Are you sure it's a person?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_KEITHA_000_041: 'Cause I'd say you're searchin' for one o' them moogles. In any case, you'd be out of luck since they only appear when they want to be seen.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_KEITHA_000_045: I wish I could meet 'em, too! Chocobo chicks have lots of feathered fluff, but I bet nothin' could compare with cuddlin' a moogle.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_GIAHMOLKOH_000_050: That sounds like a moogle, sure enough. Quiet as a mouse when they're hiding, but once they reveal themselves they never stop chattering. The one I saw a few nights ago was hundreds of yalms away and I could still hear his voice.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_GIAHMOLKOH_000_051: I was peering off into the distance between the boughs of the trees, when I sighted a well-dressed Au Ra traveler, with fiery violet hair and a moogle flying beside him. It was a strange sight if I do say so myself.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_GIAHMOLKOH_000_055: Granted, I never saw a moogle myself before this instance, but it most assuredly was one.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_AETHELTHRYTH_000_06: Haven't seen anything like that, but it seems too coincidental that there was talk in Gridania recently about an unnatural being that was disturbing the elementals.
The Padjals were saying they've never seen a spirit like it, and feared it would taint the Twelveswood. Seedseer O-App-Pesi himself sealed it away near the Guardian Tree.
The Padjals said O-App-Pesi actually struggled to contain the thing, despite being well versed in unnatural phenomena in the forest. What was the word they used to describe it? Slippery?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_000_070: A gentle breeze rustles the leaves of the Guardian Tree as the antiquated stone vessel sits unmoving underneath. Nevertheless, you cannot help but feel a shiver up your spine.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_100_000: Ahhh, you have freed me! Much appreciated, much appreciated indeed! But where are my manners? Whisper, at your service! I am a Yo-kai, a supernatural being!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_073: I know, I know. You are wondering why I was in that spooky stone capsule. I was floating along, taking in the scenery when night fell and I lost sight of the path. I wandered until I came across a small boy and asked him how to return to Bentbranch.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_074: But that self-righteous horned child declared me an unnatural presence in the forest, and locked me away! Oh, I was so horribly cramped!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_075: Why would he do such a thing to an innocent visitor of his lands? I never said I was an evil supernatural being. I was defenseless, I tell you. Utterly defenseless! Unwary! Vulnerable!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_076: Aaanyway, I happen to come from a tribe of Yo-kai who know how to reward their liberators properly, and therefore, I have a gift to bestow upon you, my new corporeal friend. Here!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_077: That impressive device is a called a Yo-kai Watch. It will allow you to encounter other supernatural beings like myself! With that on your wrist, the mundane will become magnificent! Oh, the unbelievable things you'll see with that watch!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_078: ...If it weren't broken. Now, now, do not think I would give my savior a watch entirely beyond repair. It's just that I had not found someone worthy enough for a long time. My friend had been meaning to take a look at it, but─
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_079: Yes, that's him all right! He sent you to rescue me? Splendid, splendid! So he was waiting for me at the Gold Saucer, was he? Had I not gotten lost and put in my precarious position, I surely would have set off for the desert at once.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_080: Let us depart without delay! If you give the watch to him when we arrive, I am sure he will repair it for you. And then it will allow you to encounter unbelievable beings like myself!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_081: Whew, we've reached the Gold Saucer at last! Now would be the opportune moment to present my pal with that stylish Yo-kai Watch I conferred upon you. He'll find a way to mend it in no time since he's a creator─er, a creative sort!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_090: Whisper explained everything that transpired. What luck you were able to find my friend. Had you not, I would have never known he had been sealed inside that vessel! You have my sincerest gratitude.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_091: He told me you have something to show me as well?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_092: Ah, I see. So he decided to give you the Yo-kai Watch. ...A broken Yo-kai Watch, rather.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_093: However, there's no need to worry. Whatever my spirited companion did to it appears to be completely reparable. Wait a moment while I get out my tools.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_094: Mmmhm... Yes, I see... Unjam the slot... Set that hand back a couple of ticks... Polish up the face and...
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_095: Success! Your watch is now in excellent shape. Go on, take it!
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_096: And a bargain is a bargain. You wished to know more about my mysterious minions, yes?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_097: I'm certain Whisper mentioned the Yo-kai to you. I brought a handful of these supernatural beings with me from my homeland. Like Whisper, this feisty feline is also a Yo-kai, but from a different tribe.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_098: Some Yo-kai grow to be quite friendly once they get to know you. Others, however, are mischievous, and to blame for otherwise inexplicable happenings. If you wish, I can introduce you to the more affable ones I've brought.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_099: Should the Yo-kai warm up to you, they become stalwart allies who you can summon to fight at your command...well, at the Gold Saucer anyway. But there is a slight caveat. I cannot accept Eorzean currency for my services; I deal primarily in Yo-kai Medals.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_100: I'm feeling generous since you helped me retrieve Whisper, so I'll give you one for free. To obtain more, well, that's where your Yo-kai Watch will come in handy. Should you chance upon certain fate-ful happenings, put the watch on your wrist and you shall be rewarded for your meritorious deeds.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_101: In addition to the Yo-kai, I also brought other wares which may interest an adventurer like you: exotic weapons, specially designed by the fine artisans of my company. We accept Legendary Medals as payment for these weapons.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_102: Here. Should our weapons suit your tastes, this Yo-kai Medallium will prove useful in explaining where you can obtain the necessary Legendary Medals for each weapon. A bit of an inconvenience, I know, but I would be a terrible businessman if I simply gave our wares away for free.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_103: Whew...Whisper's long-windedness is starting to rub off on me. Feel free to speak with me about the Yo-kai or the weapons at your leisure. I still have a few loose ends to tie up here at the Gold Saucer, so trust that I won't be wandering for a while.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_HINOSHIN_000_104: Oh, and my real name is...Nohi. Yes, Nohi. Glad to finally make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_WHISPER_000_105: Yo-kai Medals are a symbol of entering a sacred bond. More than a friendship, more than a marriage! With the Yo-kai Watch, you will be able to gain those medals. I told you that it would allow you to encounter unbelievable beings, didn't I?
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_000_110: Yo-kai Medals can be obtained by completing FATEs while equipped with the Yo-kai Watch.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_100_110: Yo-kai Medals can be found at FATEs in the following areas:
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_200_110:
The Black Shroud: Central, East, South, and North
La Noscea: Middle, Lower, Western, Upper, and Outer
Thanalan: Central, Western, Eastern, and Southern
Coerthas Western Highlands, the Sea of Clouds, the Dravanian Forelands, the Churning Mists, and the Dravanian Hinterlands
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_300_110: Azys Lla, the Fringes, the Peaks, the Lochs, the Ruby Sea, Yanxia, the Azim Steppe
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_000_111: Legendary Medals can be obtained, albeit at a low probability, by participating in FATEs in areas designated in the Yo-kai Medallium while accompanied by the Yo-kai minion designated on the medal.
TEXT_FESYKW001_02141_SYSTEM_100_111: The Yo-kai Medallium can be accessed from the Collection menu or the Minion Guide.
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: Ah, a fellow adventurer! It just so happens that I could use your help with some Adventurers' Guild business. Might you spare a moment or two?
The business of which I speak involves keeping an eye on that troublesome troupe of entertainers─the Continental Circus.

One might wonder why this particular group of performers concerned us so...until one beheld their true fiendish forms. Aye, there is naught more terrifying than the monster who hides behind the face of a man.

Every year, when the season of All Saints' Wake is upon us, these irksome imps visit our cities to spread their mischief and mayhem. Oddly enough, there are many folk who actually enjoy their antics... Thus we stop short of banishing the creatures outright.
In the interests of maintaining a semblance of order, however, the guild would have us quell the Circus's efforts to instigate chaos─discreetly, of course.

Unfortunately, it would appear that covert operations are not my forte. The fiends have grown leery of my clumsy interrogations, and I am in need of a capable replacement. Will you, then, perform the duty that I could not?
Excellent! Your first task shall be to engage the troupe's illusionists in conversation, and skillfully prise forth their nefarious plans. May you fare better in your efforts than I!
Speak with the nearby illusionists, and learn what you can of their wicked scheme.
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERA02149_000_00: The Continental Circus is here! This All Saints' Wake you'll squeal and cheer!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERB02149_000_00: Come, join us in celebrating All Saints' Wake!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERC02149_000_01: We have an extra-special event in store for this year's celebrations! I'd tell you now, but...I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERA02149_000_02: Oh, darling children, sweet and small! Gather 'round younglings, one and all! This All Saints' Wake you'll have a ball!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERB02149_000_02: This year's All Saints' Wake is all about the children! Come to Hyrstmill, my precious younglings, for free costumes and seasonal sweets!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERC02149_000_02: Hm? Seeking to join the festivities, are we? I'd love to oblige you, but I'm afraid our costumes are only for the children this year. Perhaps we'll focus on the grown-ups next time around!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERA02149_000_02: Oh, darling children, sweet and small! Gather 'round younglings, one and all! This All Saints' Wake you'll have a ball!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERB02149_000_02: This year's All Saints' Wake is all about the children! Come to Hyrstmill, my precious younglings, for free costumes and seasonal sweets!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_MEMBERC02149_000_02: Hm? Seeking to join the festivities, are we? I'd love to oblige you, but I'm afraid our costumes are only for the children this year. Perhaps we'll focus on the grown-ups next time around!
TEXT_FESHLW201_02149_GODRIQUELAIN_000_03: Well, my friend? What have you discovered of the fiends' machinations?
Hmmm, so they seek to lure the younglings to Hyrstmill with the promise of costumes and sweets. Why, any manner of terrible plot could unfold so far from the safety of the city...
I like this not one bit. I've a mind to make for Hyrstmill this very instant!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: We must see this investigation through to its conclusion! Pray join me in Hyrstmill as soon as you are able.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_MEMBERA02150_000_00: Oh, darling children, sweet and small! Gather 'round younglings, one and all! This All Saints' Wake you'll have a ball!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_MEMBERB02150_000_00: This year's All Saints' Wake is all about the children! Come to Hyrstmill, my precious younglings, for free costumes and seasonal sweets!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_MEMBERC02150_000_00: Hm? Seeking to join the festivities, are we? I'd love to oblige you, but I'm afraid our costumes are only for the children this year. Perhaps we'll focus on the grown-ups next time around!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_01: I'm glad you've come. Sadly, I must report that my misgivings were justified─it seems that several children have already gone missing.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GUARDIAN02150_000_0: The little ones were laughing and playing together, and they ran out of sight for but a moment...
I thought it merely a frolicsome game of tag-the-goblin! But no matter how long I waited, they did not return. Oh, Matron, forgive me...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_01: Fear not, madam, we will set things aright.
Let us first question the residents of Hyrstmill, and find ourselves a witness to this disappearance. The younglings could not have simply vanished into thin air!
Let us be about our search. Surely one of the local folk will have some hint as to the children's whereabouts!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GUARDIAN02150_000_0: Where could my precious darlings have wandered off to...?
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_VILLAGERA02150_000_: A gaggle of children's gone missing, you say? I'm afraid I've not seen aught worth mentioning...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_VILLAGERB02150_000_: Looking for a gang of little ones, are you? There were some flitting shadows in the woods over yonder, but 'twas likely just some foraging opo-opos. I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_VILLAGERC02150_000_: Younglings? Aye, I saw a few following a lass in a witch's costume into the shadow of that building over there. Giggling and skipping, they were.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_VILLAGERA02150_000_: A gaggle of children's gone missing, you say? I'm afraid I've not seen aught worth mentioning...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_VILLAGERB02150_000_: Looking for a gang of little ones, are you? There were some flitting shadows in the woods over yonder, but 'twas likely just some foraging opo-opos. I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_VILLAGERC02150_000_: Younglings? Aye, I saw a few following a lass in a witch's costume into the shadow of that building over there. Giggling and skipping, they were.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_03: My investigations bore little fruit, I'm afraid. One would think that at least one person in this tiny settlement would have seen something...
...You are certain!? This tale of a witch in the shadows does not bode well.
We must act swiftly. Sneak up on this costumed devil and learn what fate has befallen the younglings. I will inform the guild of our progress.
There is little time to lose. While I update the guild on these latest happenings, you must go to the place the witness described and confirm that villainy is truly afoot.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GUARDIAN02150_000_0: Bring the little ones back safe, I beg of you!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_040: Come closer, my darling! With the help of my magicks, you will become the perfect little monster to celebrate All Saints' Wake!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_042: There! Now don't you look splendid!?
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_CHILDA02150_000_043: Wow! Am I a real monster!?
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_044: But of course! The festivities will be far more enjoyable in this form.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_045: Now, run along to Bentbranch Meadows and join your fellow fiends! Make sure to give a scare to everyone you pass on the way, dear!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_048: Delightful, isn't it? They follow without question, and revel in the transformation.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_049: Would they be so joyful, I wonder, if they knew the enchantment would never fade?
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_IMPHEAD_000_050: With their unwitting aid shall the legend of old be reborn! We shall flood the city with our wicked kin, and usher in a new Night of Devilry!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_IMPHEAD_000_051: We need but reap our harvest of terror. When the younglings learn the finality of their monstrous fate, the outpouring of fear will fuel our darkest spells.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_IMPHEAD_000_052: The zenith of dread will be reached when these metamorphosed children seek solace in their families' embrace, only to have their loved ones recoil in abject horror. With nowhere left to turn, we shall provide their only succor.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_IMPHEAD_000_053: And when they at last succumb to their new fiendish nature, they will join the devilish legions summoned by the nectar of their despair!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_WITCH02150_000_054: Swelling our ranks with the very innocents upon whose fear we supped! A master stroke, Impresario!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_PUMPKIN_000_055: (-???-)Heh heh heh... A troubled soul, all alone.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_PUMPKIN_100_055: Fear not my ghoulish appearance─I offer not harm but counsel. Pray confide in me your woes.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_PUMPKIN_100_056: It has been long since our last meeting, child. Pray confide in me your woes.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_PUMPKIN_100_057: ...Innocent children, trapped in the form of fiends? Such a tragic tale ill befits the festive air of All Saints' Wake! 'Tis well, then, that I have the means to remedy this misfortune.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_PUMPKIN_000_056: Enchanted cookies for enchanted younglings. A single bite, and the curse shall crumble!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_PUMPKIN_000_057: But counter-spells are fickle things─you must offer the treat while garbed in costume, or the magicks will remain dormant. Be sure to dress in your All Saints' best!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_07: I've been in contact with the Adventurers' Guild. My superiors say they will offer us whatever support they can spare. Were you able to learn aught of the children's disappearance?
...Gods preserve us! So that was why they needed the younglings! Legend has it that, on the Night of Devilry, a veritable army of darkness descended upon the realm and wrought unimaginable havoc.
I knew the Circus was up to no good, but I never imagined that they sought to recreate such an abhorrent event. We cannot allow them to unleash this plague of evil...
Hmmm. I am loath to trust the word of that strange apparition you encountered, but I fear we have little choice. Here is what we shall do:

I will rendezvous with the members whom the guild is sending, and widen the net of our investigation. Meanwhile, I ask that you heed the counsel of your pumpkin-headed acquaintance, and rescue the children from their fiendish fate.
Ah, did she not mention something about dressing in your All Saints' best before attempting to hand out those enchanted cookies?
Pray don something appropriate for the season and we'll see how you look...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_SYSTEM_000_076: Equip a witch's hat, a witch's coatee, a pair of witch's gloves, and a pair of witch's thighboots, and then speak with the Adventurers' Guild investigator.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_SYSTEM_100_076: In the event that you do not possess the required items, they may be purchased from the shady smock vendor in Gridania.
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_08: “Dress in your All Saints' best,” she says... Pray don something appropriate for the season and we'll see how you look.
Ah, yes, that should do nicely! You look ready to march in an All Saints' Wake parade!
Let us hope it is enough. Track down the ensorcelled younglings, and have them crunch on those curious cookies!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_STRANGEDEMONA02150_: Raaar! I'll eat you up! ...Wait, do ahrimans say “raaar”?
...What's that? A cookie? For me? The ferocious ahriman accepts your offering!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_CHILDA02150_000_092: Huh? Hey! The monster spell wore off! But I was having so much fun!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_CHILDA02150_000_093: ...Our nanny is looking for us, is she? Uh-oh. I'd better head back before I get into trouble!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_STRANGEDEMONB02150_: Don't you know who I am!? I am the Master of the Void! Gravel...er, I mean, “grovel” before me!
...Is that a cookie!? Oooh, I love cookies! Thanks, !
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_CHILDB02150_000_097: ...Our nanny sent you? Well, I'd best be going, or she might not let us have sweets!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_STRANGEDEMONC02150_: I am the strongest there is! ...Y-You don't believe me? Just wait until I crawl out of this pot!
<sniff> What kind of cookie is that? I prefer chocolate, but I suppose monsters'll eat anything!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_CHILDB02150_000_101: ...Our nanny wants us home, huh? <sigh> I guess I better go, then. Drat, I never even got to scare anyone!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_10: Quickly, now! Track down the ensorcelled younglings, and have them crunch on those curious cookies!
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GODRIQUELAIN_000_11: You've done it! The missing children have all returned, and none the worse for wear!

Aye, I had my doubts about those magical treats, but it would seem the pumpkin-headed stranger did not deceive us. We are making doubly sure, however, that those three younglings remain safe with their families.
That puts to rest the investigation here at Hyrstmill, but I'm afraid our troubles with the Continental Circus are far from over...
TEXT_FESHLW202_02150_GUARDIAN02150_000_1: The parents all assure me that their little ones are home with them now. What a horrible feeling, thinking that I'd lost them...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GUARDIAN02151_000_0: The parents all assure me that their little ones are home with them now. What a horrible feeling, thinking that I'd lost them...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: I've received word from the guild that more wickedness is brewing!
We sent people to the Central Shroud to watch for possible mischief, and it's fortunate that we did─they've reported seeing the Circus's illusionists approaching children at Bentbranch Meadows.
If we leave these fiends to work their vile magicks, yet more innocents may be cursed into monstrous forms! Let us away at once!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GUARDIAN02151_000_0: P-Please, I've yet to... That is to say, I was so overcome with relief, I almost forgot to thank you. You've done a wonderful thing this day!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_000_00: All in a day's work, good madam. Pray pass on a message to those younglings: beware the stranger whose words are sweeter than All Saints' treats.
Now, we really must press on to Bentbranch!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_000_01: The situation is grim, my friend. By my count, there are at least half a dozen of those devilish enchanters prowling about.

The children, of course, find these affable fiends to be absolutely fascinating─it will be next to impossible to convince the little ones to keep their distance. If only there was some way to shield them from the illusionists' sinister spells...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_012: (-Disembodied Voice-)Heh heh heh... Come to me, troubled soul.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_000_01: ...Hm? Nay, I heard no voice. I fear I am deaf to all but the rising panic within my mind...
We must find a way to protect the younglings... A talisman of some kind? Nay, there is not the time to craft them...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_020: Heh heh heh... Once again I find you plagued with worry, and that will not do. That will not do at all. Here, you must take this.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_100_020: 'Tis an enchanted broom. If you so command, it will sweep away whatever you desire: a bad memory, a nagging doubt, the ability to cast a particular spell...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_021: All you need do is sit astride the handle, and its special cant will be yours to intone. Cast the cant on an imp, for instance, and poof! No more transfiguration curses!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_022: Hop on, then, and off you go! ...Ah, children─so eager to become the things that grown men are wont to fear. Such odd little creatures.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_023: You wish to ride the broom again? Heh heh heh... Be my guest!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERA02151_: Just a moment more, then I will help you into your new, uh, costume!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDA02151_000_031: Hurry, hurry! I want to go scare my sister!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERA02151_:
Now, child, hold very still...
Hm? My magic!? Why isn't it working!? Curses and calamities! Y-You haven't seen the last of me!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDA02151_000_033: Hey! What about my costume!? Hmph. I guess I'll just go home...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERB02151_: Here we are: a nice secluded spot.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDB02151_000_035: Can I have my costume now? I'm tired of walkin'...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERB02151_: Your wish is my command! Aaand...hah! Huh? Did I flick my wrist the wrong way? Um, we'll try this again later, okay?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDB02151_000_037: Wait! But you said... Great, now I've shirked my chores for nothin'.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERC02151_: Are you ready for your costume now?
Very well. Witness your new form, and despair! Ahem, I said DESPAIR! ...Er, a little help, Impresario? IMPRESARIO!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDC02151_000_041: Mister Imp, where are you going!? ...Oh, he's gone. What a strange little monster.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERD02151_: Yes, yes, all will soon be in readiness. You would do well to show some humility before a denizen of the void, child...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDD02151_000_043: Where. Is. My. Costume!? I'm going to be late for the festival!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERD02151_:
Writhe under my eternal curse, mortal!
I... Why are you not writhing? Did the spell backfire? Oh, the embarrassment!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDD02151_000_045: Wha─ Hey, come back here! You said you could do magic! Hmph. What a waste of time.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERE02151_: You'll have your treats soon enough, child─after we complete your transformation.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDA02151_000_047: Where are the sweets you promised me? Sweets! Sweets! Sweeeeeets!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERE02151_:
Right! Let's dress you up for the celebrations, shall we?
...Wait, why can't I─ Oh dear. I'll just...go fetch your sweets!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDA02151_000_049:
Okay! Don't be long!
...I don't think he's coming back.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERF02151_: I shall now harness my dark energies! Your transformation is at hand!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDF02151_000_051: Can you really change me into a monster? This better not be a trick!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CIRCUSMEMBERF02151_: Behold! The sinister power...of...the...void? Hmmm. I may have to work my magic on you another time!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDF02151_000_053: I knew it. It's all fake. These performers are just putting on a show to draw in the crowds...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_100_05: You...what!? The illusionists are gone from Bentbranch!? I don't know how you chased off those imps without drawing a blade, but consider me duly impressed.

I am afraid that your actions, however, may have come too late for poor T'danafa here─her young daughter has gone missing. Considering the case in Hyrstmill, we must consider the possibility that the girl has fallen victim to the Circus imps and their transformation magicks.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PARENTMIQOTE02151_1: My daughter and I journeyed here from Ul'dah, thinking we might celebrate All Saints' Wake in Gridania for a change. This “transformation” you speak of was not the kind of change we were looking for...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_100_05: We must track down this missing Miqo'te lass, and break the curse upon her. Ah, if only you had some more of those special cookies...
Might you try speaking with that pumpkin-headed stranger again? Perhaps she could provide you with another batch of baked miracles...

Even should we manage to locate the missing lass, we have no way of returning her to her normal form. Pray speak with the pumpkin-headed stranger once more, and prevail upon her to bake another batch of those curse-breaking cookies!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_060: Heh heh heh... You have swept this place clean of curse-flinging imps, and still your face is as dark as an autumn storm. What more is there to be done?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_061: ...Ah, so the Circus claimed a victim here after all. As for my cookies, well, they must be eaten soon after the transformation takes place, or their meager magicks will have no effect.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_062: Unfortunately, the three cookies I gave you were all I had left, and by the time I baked more it would be too late for the girl. Such is the fickle nature of counter-spells. But there is another way...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_063: The curse can also be broken by burning this witch's broom and sprinkling the ash on the transfigured child.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_064: ...This means, of course, that you will never be able to ride the broom again. Are you willing to make that sacrifice?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_065: Then you'd best forget about breaking the curse. I hope the little girl enjoys her new life as a hideous fiend...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_066: Then take it. Find a nice, hot fire, and cast the broom into the flames!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_SYSTEM_100_070: The witch's broom immediately catches fire and burns down to ash within moments.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GUARDIAN02151_000_0: I thought we'd make a nice cheery fire for the children. Lovely and warm!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDMIQOTE02151_00: <sob> ...But I don't want to be a monster forever! Someone, please, help me!
You... You're not afraid of me? Are you going to change me back!?
You did it! I'm not a horrible, scaly thing anymore!
...Oh gods, my mother must be so angry! I have to go find her! Thank you so much, !
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDMIQOTE02151_10: Oh, it's the nice  with the magic dust!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PARENTMIQOTE02151_0: After hearing your tales I was frantic, thinking I'd never have my darling T'maritaa back again...but here she is, safe and sound. You have my eternal gratitude.
...And as for you, young lady! How many times have I told you not to wander off with strange beings from the void!?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_CHILDMIQOTE02151_00: It seemed like such a good idea to be turned into a monster, and it was really fun at first... But when I didn't change back, I thought I'd be stuck in that ugly body for the rest of my life. Thank you again for saving me!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_IMPHEAD_000_094: Why have our curses failed to take hold?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_WITCH02150_000_095: I cannot understand it, Impresario... Could it be that someone has caught wind of our true intentions!?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_IMPHEAD_000_096: Hmmm... A troublesome thought. And if this meddler has learned the secret of dispelling our transfiguration magicks, then our true identities are at risk...
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_WITCH02150_100_096: But we've been so clever with our deceit!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_WITCH02150_000_097: If there truly is someone who can undo our transformations, then what is to become of our carefully laid plans!? What of the Night of Devilry!?
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_IMPHEAD_000_098: I am afraid it is not to be. We must exercise caution, and spend the remainder of All Saints' Wake maintaining our entertainers' masquerade.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_GODRIQUELAIN_000_10: ...Do they honestly believe they've kept their true nature a secret? Well, at least they'll be causing decidedly less trouble for the time being. Not that I won't be keeping an eye on them, of course!
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_000_101: Heh heh heh... Betwixt monstrous children and childish monsters, it has been a tempestuous time indeed. At last, however, it seems that we might pass All Saints' Wake with laughter and revelry rather than screams and horror.
TEXT_FESHLW203_02151_PUMPKIN_100_101:
For your part in this, our All Saints' savior, you must have a reward.
Even the heavens will not be spared the heights of this celebration...
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_000: Excuse me, . Do you have a moment? I'm Remumu, with the Harbor Herald, and judging by your dress, you're one of those well-traveled adventurers I've heard so much about.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_001: No doubt one as worldly as yourself has heard the rumors. Of an unusual warrior maiden from the Far East? Danger constantly follows in her footsteps, and the Far Easterners I've spoken with claim her dress and fighting style are nothing they've ever seen.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_002: Do you know what happened the last time a strange warrior from unknown lands came to Eorzea? That upstart Petyr Winsome practically stole the parchment from my desk to write his story. Our readership soon doubled, and he's been regarded as the Harbor Herald's finest reporter ever since.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_003: That should have been my story, and I'll be damned if he beats me to this one! But if following her is as dangerous as it sounds, I'll need an adventurer like you to keep me safe. If you're interested, meet me down at Costa del Sol. That's where she was last spotted, so that's where I plan to start.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_010: I hope to see you at Costa del Sol, . If all goes as planned, I'll have a real story to finally put Petyr Winsome in his place.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_020: Ah, you're here at last! I was beginning to think you wouldn't come. She was here just a few bells ago, or so I was told.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_100_020: Look, over there. Could it be...?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_021: Begging your pardons. Please do not think me strange for asking, but can you tell me if we are close to Selbina? Or perhaps Mhaura? I fear I am hopelessly lost.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_022: Selbina? Mhaura? Sorry dear, but you're on the eastern shore of Vylbrand─eastern La Noscea to be precise. I take it you're the Far Eastern traveler that's been the talk of the taverns as of late? You've cut quite the war path through Eorzea from what I've heard.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_023: Yes, I hail from the Far East, but... Vylbrand? La Noscea? I cannot recall such names. Though truth be told, I cannot recall much of anything since awakening in these strange surroundings.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_024: By Byregot's beard! You mean, you've lost your memory!?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_025: I remember...my name is...Iroha. I am training in the way of the glaive, though I feel I am still a novice. Before awakening here, I was on a mission to...to...
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_026: <sigh> Forgive me. It is hard to make sense of what little I can recall. The only clear thoughts in my mind are of Master, and a powerful technique I labor to perfect─Amatsu: Kyori.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_027: I am certain it is essential to completing my mission.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_028: Hmmm. Interesting you'd remember training above all else. Perhaps that's the key. If you continue to practice your master's teachings, it stands to reason other related memories might come back to you.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_029: Recalling my mission by first recalling Master's teachings... Yes, that does seem plausible. I do not doubt many of the techniques I learned have a specific purpose. It would only be a matter of focusing on this particular one.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_030: (This is the scoop I've been looking for! A Far Eastern warrior on a special mission? What if we're in danger? This isn't some faerie tale like Petyr's story. People need to know! But she's no good to us if she can't remember anything. Help her so we can get to the bottom of this!)
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_031: Here, take this map before you go. Training won't do you any good if you get lost now, will it?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_032: Your kindness is greatly appreciated. Thank you. To journey alone in this strange land would be a trial all its own, I am sure.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_033: Hmmm... Might we explore the shore south of here? I recall mention that the beach was an excellent place for training. Something about the aquatic wildlife being suitable for sparring. If the creatures here are similar, I would like very much to try my hand against them.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_034: And I trust you'll ensure she has every opportunity to do so. Now, don't let me keep you. The sooner she remembers her mission, the better.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_035: When she's had her fill of combating critters along the coast, perhaps you should rest in Limsa where it's safer. Bulwark Hall should do nicely. It's the first place she'll see after coming through the gates.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_040: If she's gone south of Costa del Sol, no doubt she'll be near Gullperch Tower. Now remember, if she remembers anything─and I mean anything─I want to know about it. But no need to rush. When she's finished here, you can take your time to talk with her at Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_050: Training at the beach was invigorating. It has been too long since I enjoyed such sport, fighting alongside one so well versed in the arts of war. I would like to think I improved my form by following your example.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_051: At first I doubted crabs would be suitable for practice, but I was quite wrong. Testing my strength against their hardened shells, swing after swing, over and over again. I could easily spend days or even weeks at a time battling them. <sigh> If only I could remember who suggested this training regimen.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_060: Oh my, what a peculiar stone. I sense something within it. Something...familiar. Something dark...
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_070: A grueling battle in the cold against evil made manifest. A lord of shadows, long dead yet somehow resurrected. The fate of the realm hanging in the balance. I remember!
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_071: And yet... I am not convinced these visions relate to my mission. Why would Master entrust me with the means to slay such a foe?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_072: The answers must lie within my memories. They have to. All the more reason I must hurry to complete my training, and perfect Amatsu: Kyori.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_073: While waiting for your arrival, I asked a couple of travelers from...Gridania, I think, where I might find creatures of a more dark and unusual nature. They told me of a place called Haukke Manor. A cursed estate whose grounds play host to various sorts of hellish monsters.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_074: These creatures sound like promising opponents, full of the fury and cunning I would expect in a true battle. Now then, let us be off. When we are finished, we can meet in the nearby town.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_080: So she's beginning to recall her past, eh? Excellent! It won't be long now before I have my story.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_081: You say she plans to slay voidsent near Haukke Manor next? Well, they're certainly more of a challenge than the crabs near Costa del Sol. You keep a close eye on her, okay? If she's not careful, she's like to lose more than her memory.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_100: Thank you for once again aiding in my training. To witness such majesty and grace on the battlefield is truly inspiring. It served as a wonderful lesson in combat.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_110: Oh! You have found yet another strange stone. Yes, it radiates with a warmth much like the last, but the color is─ Wait! Do you hear that...?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_120: A long and arduous journey together with a young girl. This vision is not what I expected.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_121: We fought many battles together. And we were not alone. No, I daresay our comrades were well beyond counting. But what business would I, a lowly student, have undertaking such missions? I cannot make sense of it.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_122: Still, I must thank you for this. Before meeting you, I was hopelessly lost. Smothered by a fog of fear and uncertainty. But now I have your light to guide me. You have brought me yet another step closer to completing my training and unlocking the memories still dormant within me.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_123: After speaking with a few of the patrons here before you arrived, I believe I found the perfect place to continue honing my skills: the Sagolii Desert.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_124: If what I was told is true, a creature of unspeakable terror roams the sands. They say its strength is impossible to gauge, as no one lives to tell of its great might. But together, I believe we can lay the beast low. When we have finished, we can take a hard-earned rest in Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_130: Word spreads fast, friend. I heard not long ago of your exploits near Haukke Manor. I take it then that Iroha is well on her way to remembering her mission.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_131: But if she's going to the Sagolii Desert next, you'll have to be careful. I need her in one piece if I'm to have that story.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_150: There are no words to express my gratitude for your assistance. Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine confronting the legendary Serket. If not for you, I would be but one of the countless victims who succumbed to its poisonous sting.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_160: Another stone. Yes, it comes to me now. A mortal struggle... Forbidden magicks uttered in a final bid for salvation...
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_170: It all makes sense now. The pitched battles, the arduous journeys, the fellowship of adventurers...it was not my life that I recalled, but rather, the tales of a great hero I mistook as myself.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_171: I suspected such feats were too extraordinary to be my own, and the memories held within this stone have removed all doubt. They were of a journey into the past─one that revealed a horrible truth I dare not repeat aloud.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_172: And I remember my home, Vana'diel! It is not some territory or continent, but an entirely different world.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_173: My true memories return to me now, and it is all thanks to you. More importantly, I believe I now understand how to wield Amatsu: Kyori. It should not be long before my path home is clear to me as well. But first, I must see my training to its completion.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_174: While waiting here, I heard unsettling stories of a foul beast terrorizing Bronze Lake. This is the perfect opportunity to put into practice everything I have learned. Today is the day I wield the power of Amatsu: Kyori. After this last endeavor, let us meet in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_180: Thank the Twelve! Looks like all that hard work has finally paid off. I wish I could see her fight for myself, but the battlefield is no place for a reporter. Make sure to bring her back here when she's done. I have so many questions.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_181: Hahaha, I can already see the look on Petyr's face when he reads my story. I can hardly wait!
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_190: There  is! Just the adventurer I wanted to see. So, where is our maiden of mystery?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_191: You didn't return together? No doubt she'll be looking for you at Bulwark Hall, then. Go on now, I can't write my story if she's waiting around down there.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_200: At last, the power of Amatsu: Kyori is mine to command, and my memories are slowly but surely returning. None of this would have been possible if not for your unwavering guidance.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_201: To think I could have forgotten a mission so vital. My resolve was unyielding, my mind focused on the task before me. In the end, I fear I may have jeopardized all I hold dear.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_202: As I told you earlier, my home is─or rather, was─a world known as Vana'diel.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_203: Try as we might, its destruction could not be forestalled. But fate saw fit to give me one last chance. I was allowed to travel back in time, to escape to the past before the darkness had consumed all.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_204: Together with the heroes of the past, I knew that tragedy could be averted, just as it had been so many times before.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_205: Master was the greatest of them all. A hero without equal, whose grand adventures I mistook as my own memories.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_206: I cannot help but feel I am still forgetting something else important, something that happened to Master... Hmmm, I suppose in time it will come to me.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_207: Before I leave, might we go and speak with Remumu? If not for her insistence, I would have been bereft of your assistance. It would be rude not to extend my thanks to her as well.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_230: I cannot shake the feeling I am once again forgetting something, but I suppose it will not matter when I return. Oh, how I long to once more fight at Master's side.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_240: Iroha told me the good news! Her memory is, for the most part, restored. Perhaps more importantly, her training is complete. If you hadn't come with me to Costa del Sol, I daresay she'd still be swinging at crabs along the beach.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_241: Now that I have you here, I'd very much like to talk to you about my stor─ Ahem, about what you were doing before we arrived. How exactly did you come to be here in Eorzea?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_900: And you say you...went back in time, trying to save your world?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_901: Yes, you have the right of it. No life was spared by the darkness. None save for mine, that is. Fate intervened and I was sent back to the past─to a time where I could find heroes capable of saving Vana'diel.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_902: That is how I was reunited with Master, although at a much earlier time than I anticipated. The last thing I remember is a fierce battle and a strange light. When next I awoke, I was here. To be torn away from Master when I was needed most...my heart feels like it may burst.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_903: How awful. You were close, then?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_904: Master was like family to me, and an exceptional warrior besides. I've spent my entire life striving to become such a hero, and live up to the legends I so fondly remember.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_905: It all began with a stone, or so the story goes. In ages past, a sentient jewel, enormous and beautiful, banished the darkness. Its light filled the world with life and brought forth mighty Gods. The world entered an age of bliss. That is, until the Gods fell into slumber. That world is my home─Vana'diel.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_906: It was home to three great nations─the Kingdom of San d'Oria, the Republic of Bastok, and the Federation of Windurst. Powerful as they were, though, in times of strife, they would turn to a single hero─my master.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_907: Be it a demon of rage seeking vengeance, or a spiteful god our destruction, Master was always there to pull us back from the brink of oblivion.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_908: So long as there is light and life in the world, the legend of Vana'diel's greatest hero will live on.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_909: There is little wonder these stories were the first to spring back to my mind. I have all but memorized them. But no matter how many times I asked, you would always─
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_910: Oh! P-Please excuse me. For a moment, when I looked at you, something in your eyes reminded me of Master and I...
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_911: Don't worry yourself over it. I imagine our friend here often has that effect on people.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_912: I realize how ridiculous this seems. Anyone in their right mind would think it some fanciful dream. But for me, this world is the dream, and now it is time to awaken.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_913: When next I open my eyes I will be home, in Vana'diel, once more at Master's side. This may be just a dream, but it is one I shall never forget. Thank you, for everything.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_914: ...It would seem...I am not yet ready to return. Is this, perhaps, the will of the Goddess?
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_IROHA_000_915: If it is by Her will, then so it shall be. I vow to work hard every day, to become a warrior worthy of your teachings. Then, when the time comes, we shall meet again. Here, in Eorzea, or perhaps in the waking world.
TEXT_FESEVN101_02206_REMUMU_000_916: <sigh> There goes the greatest story I'll never get to write. An adventurer from another world, traveling back in time to save her people. Who's going to believe such a silly tale? I'll leave the flights of fancy to Petyr. But for her sake, I hope she finds her way home, wherever that may be.
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_000: Come one, come all! Take part in the grand endeavor to conquer an exciting new frontier─the Diadem!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_001: You there, my good ! Aye, I know an able-bodied adventurer when I see one. Come closer, come closer!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_002: Pray allow me to introduce myself. I am Aurvael de Haillenarte, second son of Count Baurendouin. Ah, I can tell what you are thinking─what would spur a nobleman to leave the lap of luxury to explore a harsh and brutal wilderness?
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_003: Hearken to me, for deep within the Sea of Clouds, beyond treacherous winds and swirling rock, lies a land like no other.
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_004: Isles─nay, pristine jewels─clustered about a massive floating crystal. No less a diadem fit for gods!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_005: But be warned─these isles are home to myriad dangers. Bloodthirsty beasts thought lost to the ages, otherworldly fiends molded into merciless monsters by an unforgiving environment...
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_006: Yet, if the tales are to be believed, this selfsame environment is positively brimming with natural resources─resources which have caught the eye of nefarious sky pirates, I am sorry to say.
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_007: And so, for the glory of Ishgard, we of House Haillenarte have spared no expense! We have at our disposal several outstanding airships, constructed by the Skysteel Manufactory for the express purpose of ferrying our courageous explorers to the Diadem!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_008: We seek the strong, the fierce, the determined! Adventurers brave and true, with whose help we will beat all others to the punch and stake our claim!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_009: What say you, my good !? Will you heed the Diadem's call!?
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_010: Marvelous, bloody marvelous... I should mention, of course, that as ceruleum does not come cheap, all participants are expected to provide a small contribution...
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_011: But that sacrifice pales in comparison to the riches that await us, as you shall soon see!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_SYSTEM_000_020: You can now participate in Ishgardian exploratory missions. These missions allow several parties to explore a remote cluster of islets in the Sea of Clouds known as the Diadem.
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_SYSTEM_000_021: To participate in an Ishgardian exploratory mission, you must have in your possession a mission ceruleum voucher, which may be purchased from Jaquoinie. Afterwards, speak with Aurvael to register for a mission.
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_SYSTEM_000_022: You may register for Ishgardian exploratory missions as an individual. However, you may also embark upon missions with free company members if you have purchased a workshop and constructed an airship. For further details, speak with the mammet voyager #004A in your company workshop.
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_AURVAEL_000_030: Fame and fortune await you just beyond the horizon in an exciting new frontier─the Diadem! And you there─yes, you─need only hone your skills to their physical and mental peak to join us in this grand endeavor!
TEXT_HEAVNY814_02216_SYSTEM_000_031: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic. Limited jobs are not permitted.
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_00: You are a  of the adventuring persuasion, yes? I was told that those of your profession are often willing to lend aid to those in need, and I had hoped to impose upon your kindness...
Ah, but you must think my manners have deserted me. I am the saru bugyo, part of the Far Eastern delegation come to introduce our Heavensturn customs to Eorzea.

When the season of Heavensturn arrives on our shores, we have a tradition wherein monkeys─creatures perceived as living symbols of good fortune─are welcomed into our towns as an integral part of the festivities. We would like to share this tradition with your people.
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_10: Are you perhaps familiar with the practice?
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_CHOICE2Q1_000_000: Are you familiar with the practice?
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_10: Ah, then you must also know how the joyful antics of the monkey are a beacon for harmonious and positive energies! You are well traveled, indeed!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_00: It is common, you see, for monkeys to be recruited by our festival performers. The creatures' joyful antics are known to serve as a beacon for harmonious and positive energies!

I am saddened, then, that Eorzeans do not hold a favorable opinion of these playful beings. Quite the opposite, in fact─the monkey is a wild beast to be cast out and reviled! There is much to be done if we are to undo this undeserved reputation...

Thus did I consult with the mochi daikan, our master of rice cakes, and settled upon an event that will surely soften this antagonistic attitude. Our plan involves the making of a veritable mountain of rice cakes, and then having these fortuitous treats distributed to the masses by the very animal they appear to despise.
As matters stand, we have been able to contact the Coliseum in Ul'dah, and organize some hulking cyclopes to begin pounding the rice on the outskirts of the city-states...

Unfortunately, however, this activity soon attracted the attention of several wild opo-opos, who proceeded to dart in and snatch handfuls of the freshly pounded mochi. I fear that such mischievous behavior will only reinforce the reputation of monkeys as pests...
Before these befurred omens of prosperity further damage our cause, I would ask that you retrieve the mochi from one of the cyclopes, and deliver it into the waiting paws of Jiromaru.
He and his handler will travel behind, and join you at whichever rice pounding site you choose to visit.

If you can but perform this one service, then the festivities may continue as planned! Jiromaru, our most gentle and magnificent companion, shall hand out advent cakes to all and sundry, filling both hearts and bellies with warm appreciation for all monkeykind!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_SYSTEM_100_010: Hoping to share their Heavensturn customs with the realm, the saru bugyo and his Far Eastern delegation have organized rice pounding sites across the lands of Eorzea. The FATE “Pounding Rice, Pounding Hearts” can be found at any of the following locations:
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_SYSTEM_100_011: Southeast of the Zephyr Gate in middle La Noscea; east of the Salt Strand in lower La Noscea; southeast of Bentbranch Meadows in the Central Shroud;
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_SYSTEM_100_012: South of Hyrstmill in the North Shroud; southeast of the Ul'dah Dispatch Yard in central Thanalan; and east of Camp Drybone in eastern Thanalan.
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_SYSTEM_100_013: Complete the FATE by retrieving advent cakes for Jiromaru, then return to the saru bugyo with news of your success.
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: I am the mochi daikan, and the making of mochi is my calling! Have you partaken of this treat before? You may know them better as “rice cakes.”

They are made by filling a mortar with freshly steamed rice, then pounding the whole into a glutinous mass. This is then coated with fine-ground starch, and rolled into balls─they are simply divine, I assure you! In the lands of the Far East, a festival would not feel like a festival without them!
The strongest arm makes the best mochi─this is known. Thus we hit upon the idea of borrowing some brutally powerful cyclopes from the Coliseum...
Such is the terrible force of their blows, however, that anyone attempting to retrieve the mochi risks becoming an unpalatable part of the treat!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_00: Jiromaru and his handler will, in a manner that may seem quite miraculous, be present at whichever rice pounding site you elect to visit. Any rice cakes you manage to rescue should be handed over to them. May the fortune of the monkey attend you!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_RICECAKEREEVE_100_0: You've retrieved our mochi, have you!? Off to the saru bugyo with you, then!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_00: Adventurer, glad I am to see you returned unharmed from your treacherous task! The advent cakes you collected have been starched and rolled and made ready for the festival!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_10: See for yourself! Jiromaru hands out our Heavensturn treats even as we speak!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_RESIDENTS02217_000_: I heard they were performing some Far Eastern custom outside the city, and went to see what all the fuss was about. When I saw what those opo-opos were doing, I thought for certain they were stealing the rice...
But it seems that I was mistaken─it was all part of the performance! They were taking the rice treats so that the, uh, well-fed opo-opo could hand them out in town!
Those clever beasts were even trying to stop foolish adventurers from being injured by shooing them away from that nasty cyclops. And here I thought opo-opos were naught but a nuisance!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: I'm afraid events have been somewhat misunderstood...but I suppose the result is what matters!
If people have begun to see monkeys in a more favorable light, then our mission here is a success. May the sticky goodness of mochi bind us all closer together! Gahahaha!
TEXT_FESNYR201_02217_MONKEYMISSIONARY_00: Well, let us hope that this proves to be the turning point for Eorzean appreciation for monkeys and the fortune they bring. We are most grateful for your assistance!

And as our custom has been so well received, we have decided to continue making and distributing rice cakes for the duration of the festival. We would be most appreciative should you choose to aid us again!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_HORTEFENSE_000_000: Be still, my beating heart! Lady Lisette, you have outdone yourself once again!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_000: Some adventurers are driven by gold, and some by glory. But the rare adventurers who are driven by their hearts, are on this special day brought before me, Lisette de Valentione, of House Valentione!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_001: Ah, but is that !?  who helped the lovesick of the realm to reunite with their wayward beloveds? I had a feeling that you could not resist assisting with this year's celebration.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_002: And fortune smiles upon us, for we are in need of one such as you to help the many misguided souls find their way to happiness.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_003: For Valentione's Day has come again, and our house bears a simple message to any who will listen: all are deserving of ardor and affection! Such are the words we have espoused ever since the days of my grandmother, Countess Arabelle de Valentione, who cast off the shackles of her coddled life to search for romance most pure!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_004: And so, retracing her journey, we have crossed the frosty fields of Ishgard to stoke the flames of passion that burn within the hearts of every man and woman in the realm.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_005: Alas, for many, love is an elusive thing. They cannot see it, and they cannot hear it, so they search in vain until they give up in despair. Thus has House Valentione hired Ishgard's most adroit fortune-tellers to dispel love's mysteries and outline the romantic fates of Eorzea's wondering couples.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_HORTEFENSE_000_006: Lady Lisette, you look radiant as always! This year shall prove to be our most successful yet!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_HORTEFENSE_000_007: And what have we here? The selfsame adventurer who revealed that my lost beloved was none other than Lady Lisette? What a joy to see you again! I must say, our relations are going quite─
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_HORTEFENSE_000_008: Ah, an eager adventurer has already come to our aid. Well met, my . You may call me Hortefense. I am Lady Lisette's, how shall I say...gentleman-in-waiting. Although what I am waiting for, I dare not share in such a public place.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_009: Hortefense, you forget yourself! We are but servants of our house, and nothing more! Now, stay silent and do not interrupt!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_100_009: Pray pardon his interruption. He has become...somewhat emboldened by the season. Now where was I...
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_010: Ah yes. As I was saying, these fortune-tellers can divine a couple's affinity for risk, romance, and riches. They assure me there is no question as to the accuracy of their readings─the arduous journey to find true love would be over in an instant! Yet, it seems not many are so eager to have their fates together known.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_011: And it is to solve this very conundrum that we need you today! I appoint you House Valentione's ambassador of ardor and affection, and task you with finding another adventurer to enjoy the day's festivities with.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_012: Surely once others see you and your companion astounded by the fortune-tellers' revelations, they will be driven to discover their own destinies. Go to our emissary, and he shall explain the preparations that must be made.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_013: You need only form a pair with another ardent adventurer, then visit our fortune-tellers to have the nature of your relationship laid bare.
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_LISETTE_000_014: Once others see such how astounding our fortune-teller's revelations are, they will be driven to discover their own destinies!
TEXT_FESVLT201_02218_MISSIONARY02218_000: So you are the adventurer Lady Lisette has asked for help? As always, her taste is impeccable. Prepare to be astounded by the truths we shall reveal unto thee!
But before we begin, there are several caveats I must needs explain. Once you have steeled yourself, prithee speak to me once more.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_000: Your eyes sparkle with anticipation! Full eager are you to hear the words of our readers, yes? They are masters of the mystic arts, and they have knowledge of esoteric truths known only to a select few. However, before you present yourself, there are several caveats I must explain.

Firstly, you must pair with one other adventurer who strikes your fancy. Although, truth be told, it makes no difference how interested you are in them, as long as you are seen listening in rapt attention. Such a sight shall surely tempt others to flock to our fortune-tellers!
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_100: Three of our most accomplished readers, each of them educated at the Sharlayan Academy of Heavenly Divination, await to unveil your destinies in love, wealth, and adventure. Their insights have already provided guidance to scores of Ishgard's lost and lonely hearts.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_000: Go to each of them while wearing either of these earrings, as proof that you are House Valentione's appointed ambassador of ardor and affection.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_100: Before your reading begins, present each fortune-teller with a Valentione's card.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_000: On these cards is written your name, race, gender, and much more─information that is essential for an accurate reading. Ensure the cards are correct; you wouldn't want a small error to result in an erroneous fortune, now would you?

And with that, you are ready for the Valentione's Day festivities. Quickly now, we did not bring such rare talent all the way from Ishgard to have them sit idly at their tables. Go, my , and face the fates with a smile on your face!
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_000_005: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_000_006: You and your partner must then equip either the platinum paramour's earrings or the paramour's earrings, and then speak with the fortune-tellers to proceed.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_100_007: Please note that you and your partner cannot be equipped with the same earrings.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_000: Our fortune-tellers await! You simply need to wear the correct earrings, and they shall eagerly read your fortune!
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_100: Of course, do not forget to hand them your Valentione's card either!
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_000_008: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_000_009: You and your partner must then equip either the platinum paramour's earrings or the paramour's earrings, and then speak with the fortune-tellers to proceed.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_110_009: Please note that you and your partner cannot be equipped with the same earrings.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_100: Our ambassador returns to us! The fates are in a constant flux, as you know. If you would have your fortune told again, you need only pair with another like-minded adventurer once more!
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_000_127: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_000_128: You and your partner must then equip either the platinum paramour's earrings or the paramour's earrings, and then speak with the fortune-tellers to proceed.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_100_128: Please note that you and your partner cannot be equipped with the same earrings.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_TREASURELUCKTELLER2: Ah, another couple wants to know if riches lie in their future. A wise choice, for rare indeed is the bond that can bear the weight of an empty coinpurse.
See here, I only specialize in telling the fortunes of couples. Bring one other, be it your lover or your friend, and I shall gladly tell you what treasure awaits in your future.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_100_010: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are too far away.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_SYSTEM_100_011: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are not equipped with the platinum paramour's earrings or paramour's earrings.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_TREASURELUCKTELLER2: Well, let us see here... My  is registered to the Adventurers' Guild in ?
And your partner...born in this moon? Yes... Is the path you are destined to walk paved with gold, or will you end up on the street begging for coin? The cards shall reveal all!

The winds of fortune favor you two! They blow at your back, guiding you to the waters of La Noscea. With fishing poles in hand, go forth secure in the knowledge that your hooks shall not remain empty for long!

And if you are not yet avid anglers, now is the time to acquaint yourselves with a new hobby! But don't just go out in any old rags. Fortune often favors the fashionable. ...aye, you are guaranteed a healthy catch with garbs dyed just so.

Fortune smiles down upon you! Take advantage of this rare blessing, and venture deep into the woods. Bring your sharpest axes, and fate shall guide you to stout trunks fit for the realm's most luxurious wares.

A lucrative logging career shall provide a sturdy foundation for your future endeavors. But don't forget the importance of appearances; a fledgling lumberjack must stand out against  drab peers. Yes...  garb shall benefit you both within the forests and without.
A fortuitous reading indeed! Fate beckons you to , pickaxes in hand. There lie rocky outcroppings full to bursting with the earth's bounty.

Go there, and you shall be rewarded with riches most precious! But you must not go as you are and hope to succeed, oh no. Venture forth garbed in , and the earth shall give over its gifts even more readily.
The cards say chance is your most dependable ally! It would behoove you not to ignore this rare blessing. Board an airship bound for the Gold Saucer at once!

The denizens of the Saucer shall flock to you, drawn by the riches you gain from games of luck. But, alas, not if you go wearing that. No, fortune shall favor only those dressed in a glamorous getup of .

The winds of fortune blow languidly, but at least they do not blow against you. In the waters of Thanalan, fish swim to and fro, hungry for their next meal. It is there you should go if you wish for a chance at a profitable endeavor.

Fill your stomachs with fish caught by your own hands, and contentment at a job well done shall be your reward. Your luck may not be the best, but if you cast your lures wearing , then your fortunes may improve.

Hmmm... It seems the path to riches may be rather more taxing than you might have hoped. In the dense forests of La Noscea, stout trees await those with the patience to saw through their broad trunks.

Now may be the time to replace your dull wooden furnishings and tools with brand new ones, and take pleasure in the satisfaction hard work brings. What small luck you have in your endeavors may be augmented by an outfit of .

Hmmm... It seems wealth shall only come to you after grueling work. Go deep within the Black Shroud, to where rocks burst with valuable minerals, waiting for a pair of pickaxes to pry them from the earth.
Bedeck yourself in precious metals and gemstones plucked from the soil with your own hands. And what's this? The earth may be more generous with its gifts if you mined wearing an outfit colored .

Hmmm... You may not be swimming in gold, but neither shall you want for wealth. It may be in your best interests to take a direct approach to riches. With a treasure map to guide you, hunt for wealth long forgotten.

Although after many long and fruitless hours your hope may wane, if you persevere, fortune will see fit to reward you. And what's more, your luck will be much improved if you set out wearing attire colored .

Oh my. This is not good, not good at all. To be blunt, your luck has run out. Bring your fishing poles to the Black Shroud and wait out this spell of bad luck. Whether you catch fish or not is irrelevant; it is most crucial that you avoid any risky endeavors.

But beware as well the fish that bite at your lure. Not all taste the same, and an unappetizing catch may make an already bad day worse. Still, there are some measures you can take to mitigate your misfortune. An outfit of  may serve to keep the worst of it at bay.

Oh dear. It seems fortune has forsaken you. It might be best to indulge in a hobby and wait for this unlucky period to end. Logging, perhaps? Yes... Thanalan would be the perfect place. Lose yourself in the gentle whispers of the desert breeze, until fortune sees fit to smile upon you once more.

However, I would give a wide berth to anything wrought from wood in the meantime, lest a broken chair result in flushed cheeks and a sore arse. Luckily, you need not live in abject fear of misfortune. Keep yourselves dutifully wrapped in clothes of , and you may be spared fate's worst barbs.

Ah... I would not count on fortune to be your ally for the time being. In fact, it may be best to take refuge in the routine, until this run of bad luck comes to an end. The mining in La Noscea is said to be grand this time of year. Yes, busy hands will keep you from inviting hazard.

But take special care of any precious stones you may own. In a moment, a gem may be slip loose from its setting, never to be seen again. However, it may be possible for you to mitigate fate's cruelty. Clothe yourselves in finery of , and perhaps the most unhappy circumstances will pass you by.

Oh no... It seems lean times are ahead of you. Even a treasure map, no matter how detailed, would bring you little more than dirt and a sore back. It's best to give up on any dreams of easy riches for now. You have to be realistic about these things, you know.

Guildleves, however, are just the thing for those who do not─or cannot─rely on luck. Honest pay for honest work. I suggest keeping your pockets filled with those until this unfortunate spell passes. And just to be safe, make sure you conduct the guildleves in attire colored , or else even those might end in failure.

Ah... Misfortune shall follow at your heels for some time. At all costs, stay away from the gaudy lights of the Gold Saucer! If you step foot into that playground of chance, then all of your hard-earned coin will vanish in a flash, leaving you with scant enough to take the airship back in shame.

No, no, that will not do. However, if the allure of the Gold Saucer is too much to bear, at least be content to gaze at it from a distance, your coinpurse far from its grasp. Perhaps if you were wrapped in clothes the color of , it might afford you some strength to resist your impulses.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_ADVENTURELUCKTELLER: So a pair of adventurers wishes to know if they are destined for song and celebration? It is this very question that my cards will answer, if you so desire.
A lone adventurer lives a life bereft of companionship. What interest is there in knowing that? Return to me once you've found another.
Ah, such eagerness! Well then, let us begin! Hmmm...  , are you?
And your partner? Yes...your fate is materializing before me. Are you destined for greatness, or will your names be lost to history? Look, and we shall see!

Oh my, you are a pair destined for glory indeed! Remain steadfast at each other's side, and they will tell tales of your deeds at the tables of admirals, Seedseers, and sultanas alike! The blessings of Llymlaen shall guide you to riches and renown.
The Navigator bids you set sail for the far-off islands called the Cieldalaes. There, you shall begin the first of many adventures that shall be remembered far and wide!
Ah, one of the Twelve looks favorably upon this pairing! Nald'thal beams down from the heavens. All misfortune you have suffered will be eclipsed by the magnitude of the glory that lies ahead of you.
Nald'thal's smile beckons you beneath the earth. Seek out an ancient wisdom buried in the cavernous deeps, and your search shall lead you to adventures most grand!
Ah, one of the Twelve has taken a liking to this pairing! None other than the venerable Halone has granted you Her fury. Any obstacles obstructing your journeys shall crumble before Her might.
With a reliable airship to carry you, venture to the furthest edges of the Sea of Clouds. Among the verdant isles lies a chance at glory and honor!

Ah, you have won the favor of one of the Twelve! The wise Thaliak shall bring harmony to your endeavors together. Even your most difficult tribulations shall serve only to build an unshakable bond between you.

Avail yourself of Thaliak's blessing and journey to the ruins of Sharlayan, where behind each crumbling parapet lies the potential for unforgettable adventure. And, what's more, it seems that there may be an unexpected reunion in store.

One of the Twelve smiles down upon you two! You are fortunate enough to have won the goodwill of Nymeia Herself! Nary a beast can withstand the combined might of this partnership with Her blessing safeguarding you.
After you have weathered countless trials, your path shall lead you to a weapon of unsurpassed power. With it, you shall fight your way into the annals of Eorzean legend!

While not the most heartening outlook, there is no cause for despair. The solitary islands of the Sea of Clouds hold much promise for grand adventure. But beware, for if you drop your guard for even an instant, you may risk losing everything you have worked for.
