It may be best to beseech the Twelve for protection. Go to the mark of the Navigator in Limsa Lominsa, and entreat Llymlaen for Her guidance. To ensure Her blessing's efficacy, carry a fish─alive or dead─with you at all times during your journey.

Hmmm...Azeyma's scales remain level, showing neither favor nor disdain. The omens point to a great adventure slumbering deep beneath the earth. Alas, you cannot hope to succeed in this endeavor without each other's full trust.

Before you depart, journey to the mark of the Dusk Trader in Ul'dah, and beseech Nald'thal to tip the scales ever so slightly to your advantage. During your trials, always carry a precious gem on your selves, as a symbol of His blessing.

Byregot Himself works to build a solid foundation for your partnership. In the Sea of Clouds opportunity for glory lies, but the road to obtain it is fraught with peril. Weather the storm, however, and the suffering will pale in comparison to the ecstasy of triumph.
Before you set off, beseech Halone for aid at the mark of the Fury in the Coerthas central highlands. Make sure always to carry a spear in your hands during your journey, and Her blessing is assured.

You have the reassurance of Nophica that the storms of hardship you are facing will only serve to nourish your future renown. I sense within the ruins of Sharlayan lie the seeds of adventure most thrilling, but only through concerted effort shall they bear any fruit.

The gods can offer you further aid, if you but ask. Go to the mark of the Scholar in Mor Dhona, and beseech Thaliak to grant you the wisdom to choose the most favorable path. Keep a shellfish close at hand during your journeys, and the Twelve will not forsake you.
To see a pair so loyal to each other makes Menphina Herself smile. Set out on a journey to forge a weapon worthy of song, and as the moon waxes, so too shall your work come to fruition.

Surely a journey of creation is worthy of the Builder's blessing as well. Wielding a golden hammer to please the gods, visit the mark of the Builder deep within the Black Shroud and beseech Byregot to lend His steady hand to your work.
This result is...unfortunate. It seems Llymlaen has turned Her eyes from you. Embark to the seas and you shall be met with only languid winds and clouded skies.

It would not be wise to journey across the waters, but you may seek the blessing of another of the Twelve. Journey to La Noscea and pray before the mark of the Wanderer, so that at the very least you shall have Oschon's blessing on the land.
Azeyma's scales are weighted against you, and She judges you harshly. Nald'thal has forsaken you, and to venture underground would mean facing the myriad dangers of the earth.

Your only chance to reverse this misfortune is to go to Thanalan and entreat the Twelve for mercy before the mark of the Warden. Only then may Azeyma's scales shift in your favor. In the meantime, it is best to stay above ground, safe under the protection of the sun and sky.

Oh my... Through affronts known only to Him, you have earned Rhalgr's wrath. Halone is unwilling to protect you from Her father's ire. Beware any adventures in the Sea of Clouds, for you will surely meet with tragedy.

Your only recourse is to request the blessing of another. Journey to Coerthas and pray before the mark of the Lover, and perhaps Menphina's tenderness will assuage Rhalgr's anger. For the present, make safety and security a priority, and do not take reckless risks.

Ah, it seems you two have become pawns in one of Althyk's inscrutable plots. Thaliak is loath to entangle Himself in such a precarious situation, and any endeavors you have planned in Sharlayan will be steeped in danger.

The only hope to wrest free from Althyk's machinations is to rely on the aid of another. Go to La Noscea and make your devotions before the mark of the Spinner, so that Nymeia's blessing may improve your fate. For the time being, however, it would be best to ensure each other's safety, avoiding dangerous battles at all costs.
Halone has chosen to test you two, and Byregot dares not interfere with His sister's plans. If you had hoped to build, or craft, be prepared to toil for longer than is reasonable.

Only one path remains to you if you wish to improve your standing in the eyes of the Twelve. Go to the mark of the Destroyer in Thanalan, and beseech Rhalgr to put a stop to His children's games. Until that time, proceed with caution, and do not let your impatience get the best of you.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_COMPATIBILITYLUCKTE: Another couple comes wishing to know if love can bloom between them. Well, 'tis why I am here! But be forewarned: I am but a servant of fate, and my words may not be what you hope to hear. Knowing that, do you still wish for me to divine your affinity for ardor and affection?

I don't see a partner with you. Do you expect me to tell you if you love yourself? No, no, that is entirely too dull. Come again with another, and I shall tell you what blossoms between you, be it love or...something else.
You answer without hesitation! I sense great confidence in your partnership! Hmmm... Let's see here. You were born in the , and thus your fate is guided by .
And your partner's nameday is? Yes... The threads of fate are coming together. Behold, the cards reveal a couple's fate!
You two are a match made by the Twelve!  Alas, even the most passionate relationship can benefit from a bit of variety.

Everyone loves to see their partner looking their best from time to time. During their next nameday, why not show off your most fashionable  outfit? It just might be the spark that brings you two even closer together.
No two adventurers are more meant for each other than you!  Alas, even the most promising relationship must be treated with care.

The  is a traditional staple of  cuisine, correct? Surely a sample of such a splendid dish would show your partner how much they are appreciated. All that's required is the smallest amount of effort, and you two shall never stray from each other's sides!
The stars must have been aligned when they brought this pair together!  But remember, there is more to life than adventuring. A private moment together can do much to enrich your relationship.
You hail from , correct? It may serve you both well to share a relaxing stroll alone through . There you shall be able to lose yourselves in each other's gazes and whisper many sweet nothings.
You two are destined to be together!  But sometimes you must remind people of your devotion.
Use your particular set of skills as  to lift up your partner both within the battlefield and without. Take care not to be lax in your duties, for a match such as this comes only once an era.
The gods themselves are envious of your affinity for each other!  But without growth even the most spirited relationship can become stagnant.

Strive always to be the  your partner deserves, and through mutual effort you will both be enriched by this relationship. Do not forget the passion of your first meeting, and make sure each moment together is just as ardent at that one.
Ah... It seems there is still work to be done between you.  But do not despair, for relations can change for the better, and with but a little effort you may yet win the heart of your desired!
Remember that being attentive to your partner's needs is essential. Even if they do not say it, there is likely much they are struggling with. Pay attention, and your partner will notice.
Now, pray do not be alarmed, but the stars show no particular favor to you two.  But you need not despair, for this fate is not set in stone.

Even the most hardened adventurers like to look their best from time to time. To celebrate your partner's nameday, present to them a heartfelt gift─a necklace, ring, or earrings─that shows the depth of your gratitude for their companionship. Before long, the lukewarm nature of your companionship may grow into something worthy of celebration!
Ah... It seems there is something to be desired between you two.  But there is still hope! Even the most frigid heart can be warmed by a homemade meal.

The key to a fruitful relationship lies in the kitchen. Treat your partner to a sweet , and they won't soon forget your generosity. But remember, this gesture is but the first of many that will be required to make your relationship blossom.
The cards say the relationship between you is...somewhat tepid.  Mayhap you have forgotten that there is more to a friendship than just nodding silently in agreement to each other.
You hail from , correct? Sit down with your partner at , and over a bottle or two of your preferred libations, have a lively conversation and become more well acquainted with each other.

Oh my. Truth be told, I've not made a reading this unfavorable in some time.  Suffice it to say, I suggest you end this partnership at once! Ah, but you have a look about you that says you refuse to give up. Well, if you must be so stubborn...

Sit down with your partner and have a frank discussion about all that you've endured together. Mayhap then you shall find out what caused this rift between you. Be aware, however, that the road to reconciliation may be longer and more arduous than is worth it.
Oh my. Your outlook is bleak, to say the least.  Hmmm... 'Tis a dark fate indeed. However, the situation isn't entirely hopeless.

Reflect upon how you've conducted yourself lately, and if you are honest with yourself, you may find much that needs improvement. If you value your partner's presence, take heed of their opinions as well and listen carefully to their point of view.
Ah... It pains me to say I must be the bearer of bad news.  The spark of passion that once existed between you has been extinguished, likely some time ago. Yet there may be a way to rekindle it.
Gather your oldest and most trusted allies, and venture into . Retracing the paths of your past exploits may serve to remind you both of what drew you together in the first place.
Steel your heart, for you may not want to hear this.  The situation looks dire, but pray do not be hasty in ending this partnership.

You must also ask yourself: Have I been setting my best foot forward as ? Be honest─and harsh─with your answers, and seek out the candid opinions of others as well. Strive to improve on your shortcomings and mayhap your partner may notice the effort you put into bettering yourself.
This reading is...not good. Not good at all.  It seems you two have forgotten what brought you together in the first place.

Go to where the adventure started. , was it?  is home to many fresh-faced adventurers in need of advice and aid. As a team, lend them a helping hand, and their bright-eyed gratitude may serve to remind you of the reasons you became partners so long ago.
TEXT_FESVLT202_02219_MISSIONARY02219_000: Welcome back! Were the truths revealed by our fortune-tellers to your liking? Even if they were less than favorable, do not lose heart. Our fates are ever-changing, and a bad outlook can turn good with but a small amount of effort.
Nevertheless, it seems that your example has encouraged others to have their fortunes told as well.

Countless couples are now discussing their fortunes with a spirited excitement. No doubt more than a few have been given the courage to confess their true feelings to each other! House Valentione is in your debt!

Of course, your fortunes may have been too vague, or too cruel, or maybe so wonderful you cannot wait to hear more! If that is the case, just speak to me and I will gladly provide you with more Valentione's cards.

Before you approach our fortune-tellers again, however, I must ask you to go and visit Lady Lisette. It seemed she had quite an urgent request to make of you. Prithee go to her as soon as circumstances allow.
Were the truths revealed by our fortune-tellers to your liking? Even if they were less than favorable, do not lose heart, for fortune is a fluid thing indeed.
If you would have your fate read once more, simply speak to me and I shall provide you with more Valentione's cards.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_000: Godsdammit, has Hortefense still not returned!? No doubt he's been caught up spreading ardor and affection... The oaf! Was ever a man so simpleminded!?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_001: Oh, it's you! Our honored ambassador returns, and not a moment too soon! My man Hortefense left his post most suddenly, with nary a word as to why.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_002: His absence has already been noted by a number of curious citizens. It makes me uneasy to have him gone for so long, particularly as more and more couples are pouring in to have their fortunes told. Who will answer their inquiries!?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_003: , I must have Hortefense back! Pray search for him around the Aftcastle, and tell him to return posthaste!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_004: Hortefense could not have gone far. If you see him about the Aftcastle, pray tell him I wish for him to return to his post at once.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_MISSIONARY02220_000: Hortefense? I spoke to him but a moment ago. He was quite animated, going on about how he must know his affinity for his beloved. No doubt he and his companion have joined the other doting couples waiting at the fortune-teller.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_MAIDVLT00315_000_01: You are looking for Hortefense? I sighted him just over there, with a young woman on his arm, but I do not know where they are now. Ah, it fills me with delight to see one of our own find true love!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_MISSIONARY02220_000: Hortefense visited me with his companion but a moment ago, going on about how they must have their fortune told at once. They may be somewhere among all the other waiting couples.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_MAIDVLT00315_000_01: I sighted Hortefense with a young woman by his side, but I cannot tell you where they are now. They may have escaped the crowds to somewhere more private. Mayhap to discuss a fortunate reading?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_COMPATIBILITYLUCKTE: Ah, yes, Hortefense did visit me. 'Twas altogether odd. He rushed off without a word immediately after hearing his fortune, looking absolutely crestfallen. Understandable, I suppose, given the results.

He left his partner's card here in his haste. The name written on it is Lisette de Valentione, but truth be told that lass he had with him bore little resemblance to my lady. Anyroad, 'twould be best to return it to her, but I've still many couples to attend to. Could you return this to Lady Lisette?
'Twas quite odd. Hortefense rushed off without a word immediately after I read his fortune, to gods know where. He looked quite crestfallen... Understandable, I suppose, given the results.

He forgot his partner's Valentione's card in his haste. The name written here is Lisette de Valentione, but truth be told that lass he had with him bore little resemblance to my lady. Could you return this to Lady Lisette?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_030: You are returned! Well, what news of Hortefense?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_031: Wh-What!? He had his affinity for love foretold? But with whom? A hopeless blockhead like him could never hope to─
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_032: "Lisette de Valentione“!? Why, what is the meaning of this!?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_033: The idiot! The imbecile! To get this reading without even speaking a word to me!? And look at this! My nameday is wrong! Not even close!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_034: If he has the gall to do this without my consent, he could at least get the most important details right! , help me find that lout before he ruins anything else. I swear, this day brings out the worst in him!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_100_040: Here he is! What is that stupid look on his face?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_040: My life is naught but a tragedy! Wherefore do the gods sneer so cruelly at me and my beloved! I can hear them mocking us from the heavens!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_041: Hortefense! At last, I've found you!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_043: What the hells're you thinking!? Do you not care a whit for other people's feelings!? Just what've you been taking your sweet time with!? Explain yourself─and choose your words carefully!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_044: I... Well, I... <sigh> How shall I explain...?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_045: Just spit it out, will you!? Enough of your stuttering! I know you visited the fortune-teller!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_046: But... But how? Ah, it does not matter. It is true, I must confess. I approached the fortune-teller with another standing in as my lady. We had our destiny in love revealed to us...
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_047: So the truth comes out at last. Well, perhaps we can glean something useful from your rashness after all. Pray tell us; what did the fortune-teller say?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_048: She was loath to even tell me, it was so bleak. A reading this inauspicious only comes once an era, she said... My lady, we are doomed to sorrow and despair the likes of which even the most melancholy of songs could not convey! So opposed are the gods to our pairing, that to dare continue any kind of relationship would risk inviting the next Calamity!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_049: I see... And so downcast were you upon hearing this that you came here, to wallow in sorrow?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_050: You have the right of it, my lady. Are you not moved to the verge of tears to hear of this misfortune?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_051: Moved? Moved!? The only moving part of this story is your idiocy! My nameday, Hortefense! Remember, I was born in the First Umbral Moon! Not the First Astral Moon!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_052: S-Surely you jest!? The First Umbral Moon!? Bloody hells, what a fool I have been.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_053: "Fool“ would be putting it kindly! If  hadn't returned the card you left behind, then this mistake would never have come to light. In fact, forgetting the card might've been the one thing you've managed to do right in this whole mess.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_054: There may be a way to salvage this catastrophe after all. We shall have to get our fortune told again!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_055: To think, of all things, I forgot her nameday! Fortunately, my lady is right. We have been given another chance at true and undying love! You have my─nay, our thanks.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_056: Alas, trepidation still fills my heart. What if it turns out our fates are not intertwined? What if the outlook is still more grim than before? I doubt I could survive the shock.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_057: That is why we require all the support we can muster. Adventurer, as House Valentione's official ambassador of ardor and affection, your presence could make all the difference. Prithee attend us when we have our fortune revealed.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_058: Our house could not ask for a more devoted ally! I shall make for the fortune-teller forthwith, and there await your arrival!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_100_070: Can't even remember a woman's nameday... What am I to do with him?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_COMPATIBILITYLUCKTE: Ah, so my intuition was correct. I thought the lass Hortefense was with before was lacking Lady Lisette's characteristic enthusiasm. 'Tis a most peculiar turn of events, but if my lady commands it, I suppose I cannot go against her wishes.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_070: Adventurer! You are here at last! Now we shall know what the heavens have in store for us.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_071: Finally! Now, let's get on with it!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_COMPATIBILITYLUCKTE: Patience, my lady! To divine the threads of fate is a delicate art. Now, let us begin. Lisette de Valentione, you were born in the First Umbral Moon, correct?
Yes... 'Tis materializing before my eyes. The many threads of fate are coming together to form a tapestry illustrating your lives together...
And what a tapestry! I foresee a couple more deeply in love, more enraptured with each other, than even Menphina and Oschon. This fortune, 'tis the most propitious I've ever seen!
You mustn't let this moment pass! Confess! Confess your feelings for each other straightaway, and the destiny my reading has promised shall be fulfilled!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_076: This...this is our destiny!? I do not know what to say... No, I do! Lady Lisette!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_077: For long have I yearned for something more than this arrangement, this friendship. And it seems the Twelve favor my desire as well. I wish to call you my love, instead of just my lady. Lisette de Valentione, I wish for you to be my wife!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_078: Hortefense! Th-Think on what you're saying! Your...lover? Your...wife?
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_079: Since the day your angelic arms lifted me from those snowdrifts, I felt we were destined to one day be together. The outcome of this fortune...it is only the gods affirming the truth I knew all along!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_100_079: I have made my confession. I only hope that you feel as I do.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_080: I... Well... This is all so sudden. But, I cannot deny your ardor... Y-Yes! I accept!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_081: Truly!? I had never dared to hope this day would come! Lady Lisette, words cannot express how happy you have made me! I promise you, every day together shall be more joyous than the last!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_082: Why, that goes without saying! Don't you dare think that your work is done just because I've condescended to marry you!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_083: Of course, my love. In sickness and in health, for richer or poorer, my devotion shall remain ever steadfast!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_084: Many thanks to you, adventurer! If not for your intervention, we would be but another lovelorn pair, oblivious to the depth of the affection that might blossom between us.
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_085: What the hells're you smiling at!? Can't you see we are having a private moment! Don't just stand there gawking at the blushing maiden! For shame!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_HORTEFENSE_000_086: My love, let us return to lead the festivities. The strength of our bond shall be the guiding beacon for the many lost souls that still seek romance!
TEXT_FESVLT203_02220_LISETTE_000_087: I...I apologize for my outburst just now. I am not accustomed to such...excitement. I suppose I owe you my gratitude as well. May you also find happiness this Valentione's Day, .
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_REPORTER02221_000_0: Excuse me, ! ! I'm a reporter from the Mythril Eye and am interviewing adventurers such as yourself for an exclusive feature on Little Ladies' Day. Might I borrow but a moment of your time to ask a few questions?
Fantastic! As you may have heard, the Songbirds─a trio of talented pre-teen troubadours─are headlining this year's festival. Tell me, what do you think of them?
You've never heard of the Songbirds?
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_REPORTER02221_100_0: Well, you wouldn't be the first. While the girls have been hard at work trying to liven up the festivities, it would seem their efforts have gone largely unnoticed.
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_REPORTER02221_000_0: Ever since the esteemed F'lhaminn retired, no star of noteworthy ability has come to grace the stages of Ul'dah. We at the Mythril Eye have been following their story in hopes that the Songbirds would be able to fill that void she left behind.
Were they to catch fire, it would serve to bolster the city-state's economy but, as it stands, they are still relative unknowns.

This is the extent of my knowledge, but if you're interested in learning more, I'm sure the royal seneschal would be happy to oblige. Seeing as he's in charge of organizing the festivities, you should be able to find him at the Ruby Road Exchange.
Was he not at the Exchange? I could have sworn I passed him not a quarter bell past.
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_010: Yes, that is correct. I am the seneschal of the Royal House of Ul and am tasked with overseeing this year's Little Ladies' Day festivities. How may I be of assistance?
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_011: You're here to learn more about this year's main event, the Songbirds? Yes, yes, of course! They'll be performing on Emerald Avenue and I presume you'll be coming. In fact, just to be absolutely certain, allow me to present you with one of these fly─
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_013: Ah, excellent timing, girls! This adventurer was just inquiring after you, but seeing as you're all here, why not introduce yourselves?
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_ULALA_000_014: Good to meet you. I'm Ulala─soon to be Eorzea's premier songstress. And you, , are soon to be my biggest fan!
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_NARUMI_000_015: , . I'm Narumi. We have practiced day and night for this opportunity and would be honored if you were to attend our next performance.
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: I'm Masha Mhakaracca, but you can call me Masha. My tongue may not be as sweet as Ulala's, but what I lack in charm, I make up for with my danc─
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_ULALA_000_017: Masha, what exactly is that supposed to mean!? Unlike some people, I'm trying to gain recognition for our group. To do so, it's important to pour on a bit of charm...and if you are without, well, I have more than enough for the both of us!
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Is that so? Then why was Narumi able to hand out twice as many flyers as you?
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_019: Enough with the incessant prattling! Need I remind you this type of behavior is a quick way to lose potential fans? Please, take a moment to go and compose yourselves!
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_020: My apologies, . <sigh> With them constantly at one another's throats, it can be rather difficult to get things done. Sadly, however, that is not our biggest problem at present.
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_021: You see, there are few who are aware of the Songbirds' existence and fewer still who will attend performances. Time is running out and we are nowhere closer to gaining recognition from the good people of Ul'dah than when we first began.
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_022: Adventurer, what would you say to lending a hand in making three young girls' dreams come true? I can't help but feel it must be fate that brought you to us, just as we were about to lose all hope.
TEXT_FESPDY201_02221_BUTLER_000_023: You will? This is most wonderful news! Please speak to one of my staff and they will set you straight to work!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_CHAMBERLAIN02222_00: Are you one of the adventurers that was kind enough to offer to assist us in promoting our trio of talented singers? Delighted to have you with us!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_CHAMBERLAIN02222_10: The seneschal has planted ears about the city to gauge the citizenry's interest in the Songbirds. As of our most recent tally, the girls are seen as .

Thanks to the efforts of adventurers like yourself, one would be hard-pressed to find an Ul'dahn who doesn't know of the Songbirds. As exciting as the thought is, we cannot allow ourselves to grow remiss in our duties, as maintaining this level of popularity will prove to be the real challenge!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_CHAMBERLAIN02222_00: To celebrate this most wondrous occasion, we have prepared some traditional Far Eastern roasted rice cakes─a dessert currently all the rage amongst the nobles, who are always entranced by the exotic. By distributing these sweets alongside our flyers, we hope to garner the people's interest and entice them to gather before our Little Ladies' Day stage. Tedious though it may be, you would do us a great service were you to assist us in this endeavor.
You're back already, ? Do you think our flyers and cakes did the trick?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_SYSTEM_100_002: This quest may be undertaken multiple times. The quantity of flyers distributed in any given World will be reflected in the appearance of the Songbirds, as their costumes and performances grow more extravagant over time.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_SYSTEM_100_003: Join forces with your fellow adventurers, complete the quest as often as you desire, and watch as your efforts transform the Songbirds into stars!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSA02222_000: Little Ladies' Day─I can't believe it's already that time of year again! The days simply seem to fly by!
What's this? A sweetcake and a concert flyer? Hm, if these girls are as charming as you claim, I'll see if I can make the time to attend.
Ah, so this is the group I passed by earlier on Emerald Avenue? I'll have need to sort out my schedule, but you might just see me there tonight.
Oh, yes! I know all about the Songbirds. I went to see them yesterday and was deeply impressed. You can bet your left leg I won't be missing any more of their shows!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSB02222_000: There's nothing quite so stunning as the pink of peach blossoms lining the streets of Ul'dah at this time of year. Puts even the most restless of souls at ease, eh?
By the looks of it, these “Songbirds” or other have shoveled off all the grunt work onto you, eh, ? Well, so long as it comes with this here cake, I suppose I could take your flyer.
So these are the girls that have been singing and dancing down at Emerald Avenue, eh? I might have a friend or two who could be convinced to come along.
Is this what I think it is!? I went to see the Songbirds the other night and didn't regret a second of it! When Masha starts dancing, even the heavens above pause to gaze upon her in awe.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSC02222_000: All this work has left me with little time to partake in the ongoing festivities and an itch in the back of my throat─the likes of which can only be satisfied by a flagon of quality ale. If I were to steal a moment for myself, the chief surely wouldn't notice!

Can't say the name “Songbirds” rings a bell─not that it actually matters. I can't much stand all that screaming and shouting that tends to accompany such events. This rice cake, on the other hand, looks like something I could actually enjoy.

Lately, I've been seeing these rice cakes all throughout the city. You're handing these out for those performers...the Songbirds, was it? If I feel up to it, I might have a gander at their next showing after work.
Is this another one of those rice cakes? I've eaten so many of these things, I'm all but obligated to go now!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSD02222_000: My passion in life is to seek beauty in even the simplest of things. In fact, you might even consider me an expert on the matter.

Attempting to lure in an audience with sweets, are you? Well, such trickery won't work on me! F'lhaminn is the only singer worthy of the title “songstress,” and I refuse to become tangled in whatever illicit schemes you weave!
Oh, yes. I tried listening to them earlier but they don't possess even a fraction of F'lhaminn's prowess. I'll eat your cake, but know I have no intention of ever supporting your Songbirds.
Ah, the Songbirds' rice cake, is it? There's no denying they lack F'lhaminn's flair but I must admit that part of me has come to respect the Songbirds. They try harder than anyone I've ever known.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSE02222_000: Hmm, I can't help but feel as though there's something I forgot to buy.

Ah, that's it─I forgot the rice cake! Today must be my lucky day, to think that someone would be walking around handing some out for free! I can't say I'm interested in this Songbird group but you have my thanks!
Oh, you're still handing these out, are you? I'm on my way to wander the marketplace, so I might stop by on my way back.
Spare me the speech, ─when you've gotten as many of these as I have, you've practically got it memorized! Besides, they've already won me over with their beaming smiles and adorable little routine.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSF02222_000: Little Ladies' Day is in full swing and I couldn't be any happier! It's depressing to think that soon these clouds of pink blossoms will be giving way to barren skies. If only the festivities could continue all year round!
Doesn't this look absolutely scrumptious! If those girls are as good as this wonderful cake, I might just have to give them a chance.
Another one of these delicious rice cakes─what a pleasant surprise! And speaking of pleasant surprises, I went to see the Songbirds. Aren't they all so charming?
The Songbirds...as in Ulala's group, “the Songbirds”? I've come to very much admire Ulala, so it goes without saying that they have my full support!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSG02222_000: No matter how old you get, Little Ladies' Day is the one thing that can put a smile on any girl's face. A proper Ul'dahn tradition, if I say so myself!

You say, by circulating these flyers, you hope to grow the Songbirds' name? My apologies but I strain to find the appeal of such frivolities as singing and dancing. The little delight, however, is something I can appreciate.

Ah, yes, a Songbirds flyer, is it? I can only imagine how difficult it must be for budding young stars to fully blossom, with memories of Ul'dah's legendary songstress looming over them. I might attend and show some support, should I happen to find myself in the area.

Of all the things, I would say it was your persistence that won me over. While I had thought F'lhaminn would remain the undisputed Songstress of Ul'dah for a long time to come, the Songbirds have convinced me that there is room enough in this city-state for...shall we say, comparable talent.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_RESIDENTSH02222_000: My daughter has me rushing about town to fill her never-ending list of orders for Little Ladies' Day. My goodness! Girls her age are nigh impossible to please!

Oh, what a fine little rice cake! If all else scheduled for Little Ladies' Day fails, this at least will put a smile on her lips. I'll leave it wrapped in the flyer, but I doubt she'll bother to look.
Oh, the gods know I can't say no to you or your tasty treats! My daughter absolutely loved the last one and that wasn't the only thing─the Songbirds have found themselves a fan in my little girl!

Oh, it's you again! Day and night my daughter speaks of how she's going to be just like Narumi when she's older. Gods have mercy! No matter how many times I tell her singing and dancing won't put food on the table, she refuses to see reason.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_CHAMBERLAIN02222_00: Already I can hear the city buzzing with excitement in anticipation of our next performance! You've certainly earned yourself a nice long break. The girls are taking a quick recess, and I'm sure they'd be delighted if you decided to join them.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_Q1_000_000: Would you like to visit with the Songbirds?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_051: Oh, , we were also handing out flyers, but it was miserable! Most passersby would brush straight past us without so much as a glance!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_052: We may be invisible now, Narumi, but give it a bit more time. Soon the crowds will be chanting “Ooh la la, Ulala.” After that, we'll be able to forget we ever even had need for flyers!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Ulala's got it mostly right. We cannot allow a few dismissive shrugs and smiles to deter us. Fear not, Narumi. We shall conquer Ul'dah, one fan at a time, if that's what it takes!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_054: Oh, girls, I'm sorry for complaining! You're completely right─I can't allow myself to be so easily discouraged.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: There's no need to apologize. You know we're always here for you if you ever need us. Now, let's make our way back onto the streets and win ourselves some new fans!
, your hard work is always appreciated. Sadly, while people seem to be a lot more willing to accept and even read through our flyers, we've found that they still hesitate to come to our shows.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_061: Maybe handing out flyers and sweets alone is not enough to attract a crowd. We've been focusing so hard on making people take our handouts that we've neglected to practice our singing and dancing.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_062: Oooh, don't tell me you want to do that now. My bones creak with exhaustion even as we speak. Can't we do that after I've taken a nice long rest?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Giving up already, Ulala? What happened to wanting to become Eorzea's number one songstress?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_064: P-Pfft! I...I was only joking about taking a break, of course. Why, I'm so full of energy I feel as though I could dance and sing all day.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_070: ! How was it? Things could certainly have gone better for us. <sniff> It would seem even my charm has its limits.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Yes, it was quite disappointing. Despite managing to gather together a small crowd, not a single person remained for longer than a few moments. I fear that mayhap even the average street performers of Ul'dah surpass us in skill.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_072: I-It's true, . I-I'm so afraid we'll end up naught but failures, left to wither away on the streets with the peach blossoms at festival's end.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_073: Well, all this whining certainly isn't going to accomplish anything! If you two have time to mope, then you should also have the time to pick yourselves back up, look to the skies, and reach for the stars!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: <sigh> While Ulala should be the last person to accuse anyone of whining, she is once again, correct. So long as we practice, practice, and practice some more, there is no obstacle too great!

, we finally have some good news! People have started passing by our stage in droves, more often than not with flyers in hand! It's hard to say for certain, but I think our audience may be growing, as well! ...Don't you two think so?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_081: Oh, yes! I've seen it too! Our flyers appear to be doing the trick!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_082: Ha ha ha! And no doubt the song-starved masses, captivated by my boundless charm, will keep coming back for more!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: , our newfound success has even convinced the royal seneschal to buy us new costumes! We're finally starting to look like the top-tier songstresses that we strive to become, and we owe it all to the many people who have and continue to support us from behind the scenes.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_084: Which is why we would like to properly thank you once again for your tireless efforts!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_090: You're here, ! There's something we want to tell you before anyone else has the chance. Some of our most enthusiastic fans have banded together to form the Birdwatchers. Can you believe it?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Indeed. We've come to recognize certain faces─people in the crowd who attend every one of our shows. Some even come bearing gifts or signs!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_092: You should have seen the wild look in the eyes of some of the girls that came to our last few performances. Like spriggans transfixed by the most exquisite of gems, they simply couldn't tear their gaze away from me!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: ...As I recall, those were the selfsame people holding “We Love You, Narumi!” banners, were they not?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_094: L-Lies, Masha! People are attracted to the flaming passion that burns within me and maybe one day─just like those girls─you'll come to see it, too!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_100: Tee hee hee, you're here, ! Tell me, is it a crime to be this happy? Our dancing and singing has improved so much that soon F'lhaminn will be but a memory to the people of Ul'dah!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: While I wouldn't go so far as to say that, I feel very confident in the steady progress we have been making. Narumi's dancing especially has become so natural I might have need to redouble my efforts for fear of falling behind.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_102: You need to? I can barely keep up as it is!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: There are times I still struggle to hit the high notes for some of our songs, but so long as we're willing to work to improve, our shortcomings are nothing to be ashamed of, Narumi.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_104: You both have my sympathies, but as I've already mastered singing and dancing, the only thing left for me to do is learn to better channel my natural charm!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_110: , listen to this! I'm so happy I can't stop shaking.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: What's gotten into you? I don't think I've ever seen you this excited before.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_112: A nickname, Masha! The fans─they gave me a nickname! It just goes to show how much they love me. Now there's no denying it. I'm truly a star!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Congratulations, Ulala. Though, I believe Narumi's been referred to by fans as Goldengale for quite some time now.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_115: I-I'm so sorry, Ulala! I think the name the fans gave you is just as pretty. Redcap, was it?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_120: , thanks to you, today's show was a success! I never thought I'd perform in front of so many people! How can we ever repay you?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Indeed...it's almost comical to think much of that success can be attributed to you, , helping us hand out sweetcakes. Our current level of popularity is something that could never have been attained without people like you.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_122: More than that, it is my fans we must thank for coming to our performances! Though, I'm far from satisfied. This is only the beginning! We're not stopping until we're the best in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_123: Th-The best in Eorzea!? Wow, Ulala, do you truly think it can happen?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_124: Think it can happen? I know it will happen. You've heard the lecture before. As someone never fails to remind us, the key to success is practice, practice, and more practice!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_Q2_000_000: Who would you like to speak with?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_Q3_000_000: What would you like to ask?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_A3_000_001: How did you become a Songbird?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_A3_000_003: Tell me something about your family.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_A3_000_004: What are your aspirations for the future?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_A3_000_007: (Locked) Tell me something about your family.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_A3_000_008: (Locked) What are your aspirations for the future?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_SYSTEM_100_130: To access this content, you must first help the Songbirds gain recognition from the citizens of Ul'dah. These answers will continue to unlock as the girls become more popular.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_SYSTEM_200_130: Complete the quest “Sugar, Spice, and Everything Rice” as often as you like to help raise the Songbirds' popularity and make the Little Ladies' Day festival enjoyable for everyone!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_130: When I heard from a friend that the royal seneschal was looking to cast people for an ensemble of sorts, I promptly rushed over to the Sapphire Avenue Exchange to secure my place on the register!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_131: Honestly, what choice did I have? With my good looks and bell-like voice, I was born to be a star!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_132: While I was unable to find him on my first try, I set out for the Exchange every day thereafter and finally came across him on my tenth trip. It was all smooth sailing from there!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_134: My father is a merchant from the Far East and I accompanied him to Ul'dah as his apprentice. It was during one of my routine runs to and from the marketplace that I encountered the royal seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_135: Initially, I turned down his offer, but the more I thought about it, the more I realized that this was the perfect opportunity for me to overcome my bashfulness through the two things I love most─singing and dancing!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_136: Being the traditional man that he is, my father was opposed to my decision. It took a while but I eventually managed to convince him to let me try my luck with the Little Ladies' Day festival. I think you already know what happened from there!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: My dance troupe and I would often perform in front of the Gate of the Sultana. One day, during an intermission, the royal seneschal approached me.
He praised me to the skies, saying I had great talent, and offered me a place with the Songbirds. I wasn't interested, but his honeyed words eventually won me over.

It was a real struggle in the beginning─since singing isn't my strong suit─but life is about the challenge! Nobody worth half their salt has gotten to where they are without pushing their limits...or so my mother always says.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_142: It goes without saying that I love to sing and dance. Outside of that, I spend most of my free time reading... What? There's no need to look so astonished!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_143: Most recently, I read a transcription of one of the wandering minstrel's tales about a powerful black mage. A friend from the Ossuary recommended it to me. It was so interesting, I devoured it all in one sitting!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_144: As much as I enjoy reading, I also love spending time outdoors wandering the town! In fact, just the other night Masha, Narumi, and I went down to the Sapphire Avenue Exchange to browse the markets for tiny trinkets and shiny new accessories!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_146: A very good question, indeed! Well, for one, I love trying new foods! This may come as a surprise, but I have a fairly big appetite. Even now, Ulala refuses to believe how much I will eat!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_147: I know, I know, but no happiness beats that of a full stomach─especially if you've just had yourself a large helping of dhalmel gratin!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_148: What else? Obviously I love to sing, even when I'm offstage. It's funny how easy it is to forget all your worries when you start humming a little tune! I suggest you try it the next time you're feeling glum.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Interests? There's nothing I love more than dancing, whether I'm doing it myself or watching someone else. Even if they don't realize it, everyone has their own signature move and that's what makes it such a beautiful art!

Maybe you've heard but one of the most popular choreographists from the Gold Saucer will be releasing a book for the Ballroom Etiquette series. Gah! I don't know how I'll pay for one, but I simply must get my hands on a copy!

I suppose there's only one thing for me to do. It looks like I'll need to sneak my way into a “The Time of My Life” event down at the Gold Saucer. If I can perform as well as last time, I should win enough MGP to both buy the book and have some left to spare!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_154: Seeing as I'm small and have such a winsome smile, everyone often mistakes me for the baby of the family but I actually have a little brother. Aside from him, it's just me and my parents.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_100_154: As my father always likes to tell anyone who will listen, he met my mother on a rainy evening when he was in Ul'dah for work. It was love at first sight, and not long after that fateful day, church bells filled the air and they were married! Romantic, isn't it?
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_155: I'm a fairly versatile person, so even as a child I would always help out around the house by doing the cooking, cleaning, and sewing. Without me, I honestly don't know how my family would have managed!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_156: Why don't you visit us sometime? My parents always love having guests over!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_158: Aside from me, it's just my mother and father. Growing up as an only child could be lonely at times, so I'm terribly jealous of Ulala and Masha.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_159: Being from the Far East, Father would always be forced to travel for work, often leaving me alone with Mother.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_160: It was on my last nameday that my father decided I was old enough to begin accompanying him on his business excursions. Never had I thought that in traveling with him I'd find a place on the stages of Ul'dah!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: I grew up in a household as the third daughter of five. As you likely already know, we Keepers of the Moon are not raised with a father, so it was just my mother with us at home.
Now, of course, I live on my own. After one of my older sisters moved to Ul'dah, I decided to follow her example and leave the Black Shroud.

It was only later I discovered she had run off with a man of debatable character, running an equally dubious business in the city. That said, I'm not in any position to judge, as my current job isn't something most would consider “decent work.”
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_166: Well, that's an obvious one, isn't it? My dream is to become the greatest singer in all of Eorzea─nay─the realm!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_167: Don't look at me like that! While this doesn't make anything I said earlier any less true, I will admit I'm also actually quite satisfied with things as they are now.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_ULALA_000_168: There really is nothing more I could ask for. Every day I move a step closer to becoming the singer I've always wanted to be, with two of my best friends at my side. I suppose, in a way, that's the true dream.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_170: I'd love to someday join a theater troupe...but I doubt anyone would ever take me on.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_171: Where I'm from, we have a unique take on the art, and going to the theater to watch the productions that would be put on was one of my favorite things to do with my mother when I was younger.
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_NARUMI_000_172: It's funny that the idea of acting appeals to me so much now because up until I joined the Songbirds, even the thought of standing center stage would have left me queasy!
TEXT_FESPDY202_02222_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: My dream? To win the hearts of the people through dance. While I've currently pledged my loyalties to the Songbirds, I think I'd like to one day see how far I'd make it on my own.
Dancing has the ability to move people and I'd like to make them realize just how powerful a way to connect with the world it truly is.
Who knows? Perhaps, I'll even publish my own books on the art of dance, which will one day surpass even the Ballroom Etiquette series in popularity!
