TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_000: , adventurer! Your timing couldn't be better! As it so happens, I have one last favor to ask of you.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_001: While the Songbirds have made a name for themselves on the streets of Ul'dah, I fear our current strategy of handing out sweets and flyers may not be enough to propel them towards their ultimate goal.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_002: Instead, what they need is a leader─someone charismatic who, like glue, will hold the group together even through the worst of times. To this end, I've decided to hold a vote on who would best represent them as a whole.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_003: All votes except yours are in, and it looks to be a close competition─so close, in fact, that your one vote may end up being the one to decide it all! Choose carefully, , and take our Songbirds to new heights!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_004: The certificates of collaboration you have received will identify you as one of our contributors. Please hand them to either the slight gentleman over there or the stout fellow beside him, and tell them who it is you believe to be most worthy of being crowned leader.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_SYSTEM_000_005: While the reward will remain the same, the outcome for this quest will change based upon whether you decide to vote using one or twenty certificates of collaboration. If you would like to vote using a single certificate, speak with the slight servant. If you would like to vote using twenty certificates, speak with the stout servant.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_100_005: Please hand your certificates of collaboration to either the slender gentleman just over there or the stout fellow beside him.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_SYSTEM_100_006: While the reward will remain the same, the outcome for this quest will change based upon whether you decide to vote using one or twenty certificates of collaboration. If you would like to vote using a single certificate, speak with the slight servant. If you would like to vote using twenty certificates, speak with the stout servant.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ATTENDANTA02223_000: Ah, our last voter has finally arrived! Before we begin, might I mention that should you use twenty certificates on this vote, your Songbird of choice may have a higher chance of winning. Even so, if you wish to proceed with only one, I shall be happy to accept your certificate.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_SYSTEM_100_010: You may only participate in this vote once. If you would like to cast your vote using twenty certificates of collaboration, go and speak with the stout servant. Please note that while the outcome may differ, the reward will remain unchanged.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ATTENDANTA02223_100: You mean to say you are not currently in possession of any certificates of collaboration? Hm... Do you spy the hefty man beside the royal seneschal? He should be handing some out, so might I suggest you go and speak with him?
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_Q1_000_000: You may only vote once. Are you sure you would like to proceed with just one certificate of collaboration?
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_Q2_000_000: Who would you like to vote for?
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_012: You mean to say that I'm the leader!? Am I surprised? O-Of course, not! After all, it is my destiny to become the number one songstress in Eorzea!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_013: ...And though destiny it may be, I would like to thank you for your support, . It takes a very special kind of person to believe in another's dreams. Not only did you believe in mine but you also provided me with a stepping-stone towards them.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_014: Rest assured I won't be squandering this wonderful opportunity! In fact, it shouldn't be long before the Songbirds are performing on stages throughout the realm, so sit tight and behold the magic yet to come!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_015: I-I'm the new leader of the Songbirds!? I-It's such a huge responsibility─one I'm not entirely sure I'm ready to accept─but I owe it to you and everyone else who has voted for me to rise to the challenge.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_016: I am aware that I still have much to learn, but my team has put their faith in me. For their sakes as much as mine, I must ensure the Songbirds' success. I intend to aim for the skies and, in time, have even the sparrows gathering along the rooftops to tweet along to our tunes.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_017: In fact, I'll work so hard that wherever you may go, you will be sure to hear our name in whispered rumors, and see our achievements in portraits plastered on walls. No corner of Eorzea will be left untouched─that way you'll never forget us!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Me, the leader!? Are you sure? I-I hardly dare believe it. While there's no denying a part of me is apprehensive, if there's anything I learned from being a part of the Songbirds, it's that I need to start trusting in my own abilities.

I will show our fans that their faith in me is not misplaced, and that nothing will stop the Songbirds from rising above and beyond all expectations! With Narumi and Ulala at my side, what could go possibly wrong?

Thank you again, . With all that you've done for us, I'm in no position to ask for favors, but if you could just promise me one thing─when you find the time between your extraordinary adventures, you'll come visit us won't you?
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ATTENDANTB02223_000: I see that not only have you decided on who you would like to vote for, but you're also willing to do so with twenty of your certificates of collaboration! My, won't she be pleased to know she has such an avid supporter in you!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_SYSTEM_100_021: You may only participate in this vote once. If you would like to cast your vote using a single certificate of collaboration, go and speak with the slight servant. Please note that while the outcome may differ, the reward will remain unchanged.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ATTENDANTA02223_100: Have you misplaced your certificates of collaboration? Or forgotten them, perhaps? No matter! The tall man just over yonder should have what you're looking for, .
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_Q3_000_000: You may only vote once. Are you sure you would like to proceed with twenty certificates of collaboration?
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_Q4_000_000: Who would you like to vote for?
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_023: You mean to say that I'm the leader!? Am I surprised? O-Of course, not! After all it is my destiny to become Eorzea's number one songstress!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_024: ...And though destiny it may be, I would like to thank you for your support, . As often as I come across as overconfident, I know deep down that dreams are fragile things, easily shattered in but a moment's oversight.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_025: I can't tell you how happy I was, watching as you pulled in one person after another until we had crowds─actual crowds, ─coming and chanting our names. You gave us strength when we needed it most and there is no greater gift than that.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_026: But enough of that! The reason you love me is for my unshakable confidence and wily charm! Now that I'm here to stay, you'll most certainly be seeing even more of it.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_ULALA_000_027: , never in history has anyone made a finer choice than the one you've made today! You're leaving the Songbirds in good hands. With me leading the way, we'll be unstoppable!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_028: I-I'm the new leader of the Songbirds!? I-It's such a huge responsibility─one I'm not entirely sure I'm ready to accept─but I owe it to you and everyone else who has voted for me to rise to the challenge.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_029: Being a part of the Songbirds has taught me that with good friends anything is possible! Having always been so shy, I could never have imagined that the very stages that once terrified me would bring with them such joy.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_030: The beaming faces of the people as they watched us sing and dance filled me with a happiness I had never before experienced. And all that was possible because I had Masha, Ulala...and most of all you, , standing at my side.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_031: You helped us through our most trying times, and now your steadfast support has lit our path forward. I can only hope in the suns and even moons that lie ahead, your spirit will continue to guide us.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_NARUMI_000_032: I promise to do you proud. I'll work so hard that wherever you may go, you'll be sure to hear our name in whispered rumors, and see our achievements in portraits plastered on walls. No corner of Eorzea will be left untouched─that way you'll never be able to forget us, even if you tried!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Me, the leader!? Are you quite sure? I-I hardly dare believe it.
I-I apologize. I have nothing prepared and I've never been one for sentimentality or speeches, as that's more Ulala's specialty...but as my pumpkin-headed sister might say, “Cor! This is amazing!”
Not even in my wildest dreams had I thought I would be appointed leader, much less by an esteemed adventurer such as yourself. Thank you, .
I'll take us far beyond where the stars reach, to where the peaks of the musical heavens lie, and you'll once again be hearing the name “the Songbirds.”

...And when that day comes, you'll be sure to visit and share tales of your extraordinary adventures with us, won't you? Even were we to conquer all of Eorzea with our singing and dancing, it'd be an empty victory if we couldn't share it with you!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_040: With a new leader in place, there is nothing holding the Songbirds back from achieving their goals.
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_041: As a matter of fact, they're already well on their way. If you haven't heard, the Mythril Eye contacted us, saying they'd like to run a feature article on the girls!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_042: With such exposure, it won't be long until they find themselves performing all across Eorzea. However, until that great day is upon us, we need continue forging onward and upward!
TEXT_FESPDY203_02223_BUTLER_000_043: Thank you again, adventurer! A better friend than you we could not have found, and even after you're gone, you will remain with us every step of the way to the top. Having said that, my staff has just finished roasting more rice cakes. Should you be interested in further helping the Songbirds, you know where to find us!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_COLLYS_000_000: Lovely to meet you! The name's Collys. I'm a reporter for the Harbor Herald, Limsa Lominsa's premier gazette. And let me tell you: no one is as excited as I am that the season for the Starlight Celebration has rolled around again!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_COLLYS_000_001: I don't know if you've heard, but my sources in the Adventurers' Guild tell me that the Starlight celebrant is planning an event that will resurrect a long-lost Starlight tradition! Doesn't that sound wonderful?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_COLLYS_000_002: I'd hoped to put together a special edition on the event...only, it seems there's been some kind of problem. And all the little helpers I've tried to interview have given me the vaguest of responses.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_COLLYS_000_003: You're in good standing with the Adventurers' Guild, aren't you? Fancy helping a reporter share the word on the happiest time of the year?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_COLLYS_000_004: I need you to speak with Baenfaeld─he's this year's celebrant─and convince him to respond to my questions with definitive answers. You'll find him at the Aftcastle, making preparations for the festivities. Please, adventurer! I'll be ever so grateful!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_010:
This ain't goin' well at all...
Eh? Need a word with me, do ye?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_011: ...Aye, I know the lass ye speak of. Me bosses in the Adventurers' Guild told me a Harbor Herald reporter'd be around, an' that I was to answer all her questions. Seems she means to write up some special piece on the Starlight Celebration...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_012: I'd love to help her, I truly would─the event we're plannin' could use the publicity. But unless we sort out the bleedin' snag we've hit, there might not be any kinda event to write about.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_013: ...Here, ye look like a capable . We could surely use another hand with the preparations, an' there'd be a reward in it for ye. Are you in?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_020: I expect ye already know the tale behind the festival, aye? Ishgardian soldiers lendin' their red jackets to wee freezin' orphans, an' all that?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_021: Well, there's another part to the story what don't get told as often: afore the soldiers would set off to round up the younglin's, they would always play a special melody on their signal bells.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_022: The sound o' them bells echoin' through the frigid night air was said to bring the biggest bloody smiles to them orphans─an' even a few hard-bitten veterans as well, I'd wager.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_023: It's a damn shame, then, that that particular tradition weren't adopted into the celebration along with the crimson coats.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_024: Ever since the Calamity made a bloody mess of Eorzea, we've been doin' our best to put the place to rights. But the Garleans an' the beast tribes ain't makin' it easy for us, an' the unendin' flow o' refugees don't help matters neither.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_025: An' when all grown-ups do is frown an' grumble, it creates an atmosphere o' despair for the little ones. How often do ye see the younglin's truly smilin' these days, eh?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_026: That's why the Adventurers' Guild decided to do summat special this year.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_100_026: It's time we resurrected an old custom to ring in the celebration, an' put some big bloody smiles back on folks' faces!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_027: The Temple Knights o' Ishgard was only too happy to dig up their old signal bells from where they was rustin' in some musty storehouse, an' then ship 'em here for the festival. No matter how much we cleaned an' oiled the main bell, though, we couldn't get the damn thing to ding, let alone dong.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_028: The guild's coffers was all but emptied for this event, an' the Admiral's gone an' invited a bunch o' high-an'-mighty dignitaries to attend the openin' ceremony. We can't afford to fail...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_029: Ye'll see this through to the end, though, won't ye? Get that bell to ring, an' I promise I'll talk that reporter's bloody ears off on any subject she cares to name.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_100_029: First, ye'll need to head to Ul'dah. Track down Hervey─he's the guild's top goldsmith─an' see how things is comin' along with the bell repairs.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_030: ...You're ? Uh-huh. So, is that supposed to impress me, or─ Oh! You must be the  Baenfaeld mentioned. Well, your timing couldn't be better.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_031: I just removed the bell's clapper, you see, and was surprised at how light it was. When I took a closer look, I realized that its middle had been eaten away by rust...which explains why no amount of adjusting or oiling could give the bell a satisfying clang.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_032: The problem is, I haven't the slightest idea of how to forge a new one─that's a job for a smitty, not a goldsmith. I suppose we'll just have to ask around, and see what we can find.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_033: Do you know anyone who can craft an iron clapper? Get your hands on one, and I'll tell Baenfaeld to dig a bit deeper for your reward. Meanwhile, I'll try my luck with the local merchants...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_SYSTEM_000_033: An iron clapper can be crafted using blacksmithing, or purchased from the market boards.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_500_020: Get yerself to Ul'dah an' find Hervey, our guild's best goldsmith. Give him whatever help he needs to fix that bell!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_040: <sigh> None of my usual merchant contacts seem to deal in bell parts. I wonder if it's too late to commission a blacksmith...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_041: You've brought me a clapper!? But where did you─ Never mind, let's attach it to the signal bell right away!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_050: Well, it certainly sounds like a bell now, doesn't it? It's just that this melody is rather... Hmmm. Could I be reading the music wrong?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_000_051: You there! What was that song ye were playin' on that bell?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_052: Well, well, if it isn't one of the saint's little helpers. That was a tune we were taught by the knights of Ishgard─we're attempting to reenact an old tradition for this year's Starlight Celebration, you see.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_053: This was once a signal bell for an Ishgardian barracks, and we've only just restored it to working order. As you may have noticed, however, the melody isn't quite festive enough.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_000_054: Let me ask ye a question, lad: what exactly are ye ringin' this bell for?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_055: Why, to make this year's Starlight Celebration a resounding success, of course! The Adventurers' Guild has spent a veritable fortune on festival preparations, and failure is simply unacceptable.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_000_056: ...I knew it. And what is the Starlight Celebration supposed to be for, then, hm? Is it for the prestige o' the bloody Adventurers' Guild? ...Or is it for the happiness o' younglin's all across Eorzea?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_000_058: Now, I'm barely half an artisan myself, but even I can see that ye've done a nice job o' restorin' an old signal bell to its original state. But maybe ye've let yerself get carried away by yer desire to resurrect the past.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_000_059: Over the years, the Starlight Celebration has grown into a festival with the sole purpose o' bringin' joy to children. Maybe this bell ringin' custom o' yers needs some adjustment, as well, to match the era into which it's bein' reborn.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_061: ...You're absolutely right. Somewhere along the way, we lost sight of the true meaning of the celebration. The spectacle became more important than the happiness it was intended to create...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_062:
But that ends right here! We'll turn this prideful mess into the joyous festival it was meant to be! Somehow!
...A little help, little helper?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_000_063: Ah, ye silly oaf! Must I do all the thinkin' for ye? All ye need do is take that tired old melody and add a little magic─make of it a spell what enchants the ears and brings a smile to a younglin's face.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_100_063: You there. Lend this dolt a hand if he needs one.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_JULYAN_101_063: . Lend this dolt a hand, would ye? I'd feel better knowin' ye were involved.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_064:
Add a little magic to the melody...
I think I understand. But we'll need someone as can make it more festive without completely overshadowing the original tune.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_065: And I know just the man to do it! Cahernaut's the composer for a famous orchestra, and they're in Gridania right now for the celebrations─take the bell and the sheet music to him, and see if he's willing to come up with a new arrangement for the song.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_066: I'll head back to Baenfaeld, and we'll figure out how to include more younglings in the audience.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_067: Contacting all the orphanages in the realm and inviting them to Limsa Lominsa for the performance should make for a good start. To the hells with the budget!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_500_030: Get yerself to Ul'dah an' find Hervey, our guild's best goldsmith. Give him whatever help he needs to fix that bell!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_070: Yes, I am Cahernaut. Yes, the Cahernaut. The orchestra is not presently accepting applicants, so if you would kindly─ Hm?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_071: ...And you would have me rearrange this into a less dreary melody? <sigh> Very well. Anything for the children.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_072: I am afraid, however, that the signal bell is not a particularly versatile instrument. There is little even the great Cahernaut can achieve with such a limited musical scale...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_080: (-???-)Oho, then mayhap that bell is overdue for the gentle touch of innovation!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_081: Ah, if it isn't the Saint of Nymeia himself.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_082: (-Saint of Nymeia-)I overheard your little dilemma, and it just so happens that I have some small skill with goldsmithing. If it is extra notes you need, then it is extra notes you shall have!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_084: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Crafting miracles is the Mander...er, Starlight way!♪
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_085: (-Saint of Nymeia-)A masterpiece to brighten your Starlight day!♪
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_086: (-Saint of Nymeia-)See how it shines! See how it glimmers! And if it doesn't produce the sweetest of sounds, then I shall eat my Starlight hat!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_087: Th-The richness of the timbre is inexplicable! Its ringing reverberations will enthrall both adults and younglings alike!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_088: (-Saint of Nymeia-)It's an old bell, to be sure, but the restoration work was impeccable.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_100_088: (-Saint of Nymeia-)The new clapper... That was your doing? It certainly made my task far simpler than I anticipated.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_101_088: (-Saint of Nymeia-)The new clapper... That was your doing, wasn't it, ? It certainly made my task far simpler than I anticipated.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_089: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Well, I'm glad that this humble wandering pilgrim could be of service! Mayhap we shall meet again someday! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_090: I shall begin work on the new arrangement immediately. The saint's genius has called to my own...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_000_091: ...And it is done! Pray convey these masterpieces─both the reworked bell and my Starlight melody─to your colleagues in Limsa Lominsa. Your audience shall be enchanted, I assure you!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_092: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Hmmm. An acceptable result, but not enough flair for my taste. Time to dust off the linkpearl and make some calls...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_500_040: I heard word from Hervey. So, we're to call more younglin's to Limsa, now? I just hope this don't end in disaster...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_CAHERNAUT_500_040: Take the newly refurbished bell─and my masterfully rearranged melody, of course─to Limsa Lominsa and your waiting colleagues. The children are in for a treat this year!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_100: ! Hervey told me everythin' what happened, an' I decided to do some extra shoppin' for the festival while I was waitin' for ye to get back.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_101: ...Ah, so this is the new an' improved bell─an' a newly arranged melody to boot. Ye've been more help than I deserved, all things considered.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_102:
Hervey's tale opened me eyes to what proud clods we've been...
I've already been in contact with the Admiral about cancelin' that overblown openin' ceremony, an' she took me explanation with good grace.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_103: It's time we started thinkin' with our hearts, an' not our bleedin' coinpurses! We'll throw the best damn Starlight Celebration these little ones have ever seen!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_110: Thanks to you, we've got the bell an' the song sorted. Now we just need to do summat about that borin' old metal frame...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_111: That's actually what brought me here to the markets. I was lookin' to decorate the bell frame, and make it a proper part o' the festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_112: But I'm afraid I've less sense for choosin' decorations than a blind Sahagin.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GEVA_000_113: (-???-)Ah, now I understand why our assistance was required.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_SERENDIPITY_000_114: (-???-)If our task is to put smiles on little faces, then they shall be the widest smiles they can possibly be!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_115: But... Yer all guildmasters, ain't ye!?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_REDOLENTROSE_000_11: Ohohoho! Surely you jest, good sir! We are merely the saint's little helpers, wandering the land in search of good deeds to perform.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BRITHAEL_000_117: It were the saint himself what set us on this task, though. Seems ye could use a hand with some decoratin', eh?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GEVA_000_118: Fortunately, we all have a certain amount of experience with such things. You just leave it to us.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_119: Wh-What in the seven hells just happened...?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_120: Ye know, I sent Hervey off on a shoppin' errand o' his own... Ye don't suppose them “little helpers” will track him down as well, will they? Let's go check on him─the poor, unsuspectin' bugger!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_REDOLENTROSE_500_05: ...How unusual for that bearded eccentric to call upon us for help. Well, I suppose I am an expert in the prettifying department. Mayhap Serendipity will wish to coordinate colors...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_SERENDIPITY_500_052: Hmmm. We'll need a decorative design that, while tastefully extravagant, serves to draw all eyes to the main attraction. I wonder if Severian has any ideas...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_SEVERIAN_500_056: What part of “critical juncture in my research” does that persistent patrician fail to understand? <sigh> I suppose I should indulge in one of those “breaks” Deitrich is always insisting I take. Now, where is that linkpearl Redolent Rose gave me...?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GEVA_500_051: ...What an unexpected request. Decoration is not my usual area of expertise, but I'll make an exception in this case. What does Beatin think of all this, I wonder...?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BEATINE_500_054: Hmph, this is so typical of him. How he extolls wood's finer qualities when he has need of my assistance. I assume Geva has experienced a similar overture...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BRITHAEL_500_051:
A request from one o' the best in the business...
I'd best have a drink to settle me nerves, then ask H'naanza how she means to handle this.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_LYNGSATH_500_053: It's nice o' the old buzzard to include me, but 'ow am I meant to contribute? By makin' a meal what Brithael's churnin' innards can keep down? Ha! Well, I'm sure there'll be a way to make use o' me skills...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HNAANZA_500_055: Aiding with these decorations shall prove an interesting challenge. Did he contact us all? Lyngsath must find this amusing...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HERVEY_000_140:
Bah, I thought this would be the perfect place to pick up something exotic and interesting for the decorations, but there's naught to be found...
! What are you doing here?
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_LYNGSATH_000_150: (-???-)Leave it to an expert in procurin' rare ingredients, lad. I've already spoken with the 'arbormaster an' secured a box o' wonders from distant shores.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_151: More guildmasters!? Yer all in on it!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_SEVERIAN_000_152: Guildmasters? Where? I see only little helpers.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HNAANZA_000_153: You'll not find much when your objective is so hazy. Narrow your focus, and consider what it is the client truly desires.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BEATINE_000_154: It would be best if you entrust that bell to us, child.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_HNAANZA_000_155: Fear not: we'll take care of everything!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_156: Am I dreamin', or was our final task just taken over by the master artisans o' three different city-states? I've got to see this for meself! Quick, back to the Aftcastle!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GUIDEXMSCHILD_000_1: (-Orphan Boy-)It were amazin'! A gang o' little helpers came rushin' in like the wind, and done them bells up pretty afore I could even blink! I ain't never seen nothin' like it!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_162: I should've expected naught less from the guildmas─ Er, the saint's little helpers. I'll be sure to thank them all...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_163: What say ye, ? Shall we ring in the celebration? Let's light up the face of every child from here to the harbor!
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_164: (-Saint of Nymeia-)It's important to preserve the past...
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_165: (-Saint of Nymeia-)But it's the culture and customs that grow and thrive with the passage of time that are truly history's treasures. That's what sings to people's hearts.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_GODBERT_000_166: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ho ho ho! I'm sure the Ishgardians who began this tradition of giving would be pleased with the joy the Starlight Celebration continues to bring.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_170: I have to thank ye again for all ye've done, . Ye've helped steer us back to the road we ought to have been walkin' in the first place.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_171: Speakin' o' which, that reporter from the Harbor Herald sends her thanks as well. I've promised her a full interview at her earliest convenience.
TEXT_FESXMS101_02224_BAENFAELD_000_172: Meanwhile, I've more younglin's to delight with that enchantin' melody. Mark me words, I'll have the whole bloody realm smilin' afore this festival's done!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_000: By the Twelve! You there! You have the gait and the looks of someone bound for greatness!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_001: I reckon you've already taken part in your fair share of daring deeds, exciting escapades, and astounding adventures! A worldly  such as yourself might even make an audience swoon, if only you were to try your hand at theater!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_002: Believe me, I would know. I've spent the larger part of my life turning even the most ineloquent boors into masters of the stage, so I know immediately when I'm in the company of true talent. And you, my friend, have talent to spare!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_003: Who am I, you ask? Why, I'm the leader of the Crystal Caravan, the realm's premier puppet troupe. As it happens, I was just looking for an adventurer like you. You see, my leading man is having trouble finding the proper inspiration for his role. I was wondering if perhaps we might draw upon your worldly experience to give him a push in the proper direction.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_004: Excellent, excellent! Then without further ado, let me introduce the rest of the troupe!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_005: 'Tis an honor to meet you, , and I hope our time together is fruitful. On the anniversary of our realm's rebirth, our troupe shall depict the tragic events of the Calamity. I shall play the role of the legendary adventurer─the Warrior of Light!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNMENTOR_100_0: You are doubtless thinking, “But I thought you were a puppet troupe!” Indeed we are, but we strive to set ourselves apart from the rest. I urge you to try and find another troupe as lively as ours! You shall not!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEEL_000_006: Of course, the puppets still play a vital role. My partner and I provide the voices, endowing even the most crudely carved piece of wood with a personality of its own. I only hope you are able to provide our actor here with the inspiration to keep up with us.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: Aye, a soulless performance is a shame to behold, but there'd be no show at all without puppets─or a stage! You can go ahead and thank me for those two indispensable elements. The audience may not see my face, but I appreciate their applause all the same!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_008: It is with this talented crew that I hope to move the hearts of Eorzea's people and win their acclaim!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_009: It has been our dream to perform a play which lingers in the minds of its viewers long after the curtain falls! Indeed, 'tis my hope that this production will be remembered for years to come!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_010: But of course, an ambitious concept is nothing without a first-rate script! Which is why we sought out Eorzea's foremost author of stories, poems, and songs to write it. However, the draft we've received from him is quite, shall we say, open to interpretation.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_011: In fact, I'm not sure if I would call it a script at all. It's more of a...general outline of events. The others insist it's a work of genius, but I just can't see it...
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: Madam, you must look past the words on the page! A play is a living thing, and the playwright has given us the opportunity to let our imaginations run wild. Stirring dramas are born from the reactions of the crowd, the passion of the actors, and yes, even the weather can make a performance more lively.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_013: A stirring drama, yes. That is what we must deliver! To that end, my acting should be informed by knowledge─by the experiences of those who lived through the day firsthand. And who better than an adventurer to aid me in gathering such tales?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: I understand the proprietress of the Quicksand, Mistress Momodi, has a soft spot for adventurers like yourself. She likely has a wealth of stories to share. Good , if you could ask her to regale our star with but a few, the Crystal Caravan would be in your debt.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: And they say adventurers only seek their own glory! You have our gratitude, friend! I reckon you might even put my puppets to shame, eh?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_016: Well then, let's be off, shall we? To the Quicksand!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_019: With your help, we'll make a hero out of him yet!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_019: So this is Mistress Momodi? Seeing her so hard at work fills me with determination. And...something else. Is this...? Ah, no, no, I cannot let myself get distracted. Come on, let's see what she has to say about the Calamity!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_020: Welcome, welcome! Come to celebrate the anniversary, have you? Couldn't have picked a better place, I say. What can I get for you?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_021: Greetings, Mistress Momodi. I am a humble actor of the Crystal Caravan, and we plan to celebrate this momentous day by retelling the story of the Calamity. I come before you to hear any stories you may have of that day, so I might draw upon them to inspire my performance.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_022: Well, ain't that somethin'! I'd be happy to oblige you, of course.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_023: Let me see, let me think... Right, five years back, was it? I remember it like it were yesterday, the lesser moon comin' down hard, growin' bigger and redder by the moment.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_025: Indeed, the moon burned as fiercely as the sun, and grew larger besides. Such a sight made many fear the end of the world was at hand, and rightly so.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_026: Makes me shudder even now to think of it. But not all of us were shiverin' in fear. There were those courageous few who fought on against the odds.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_027: You speak of the Warriors of Light. Heroes worthy of song and celebration. Alas, none can remember what they look like, or even their names. 'Tis a shame, truly.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_028: Right, a damn shame. All the more reason why your play is important! Even if we can't remember them, we can't let 'em or what they did for us be forgotten.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_029: Of course, Mistress Momodi! And thank you, for reminding me of the gravity of our responsibility. I shall do my utmost to ensure the memory of the Warriors of Light lives on!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_030: You call on Baderon over at the Drownin' Wench yet? Ought to if you haven't. I'm sure he'd be eager to speak with you─just remember to ask nicely!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_031: A brilliant suggestion! That settles it then! Let us away to Limsa Lominsa, and speak with this Baderon. Mistress Momodi, it has been a pleasure!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MOMODI_000_039: Reckon there's more than a few with high expectations for this play of yours. I trust you lot won't let them down, eh?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_039: So this is Baderon? He looks jovial enough. Come, let us see what he has to say.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_040: Yer a festive-lookin' pair, ain't ye? If ye ask me, there's no better place to celebrate the anniversary o' the Calamity than right 'ere at the Drownin' Wench! Well then, what's yer poison?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_041: Greetings, Master Baderon. I've come seeking advice to aid in my own celebration of sorts: a stage reenactment of the very events this day commemorates. I would much appreciate if you could share with us any stories you might have.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_042: A reenactment, ye say!? Bugger me, that sounds like a grand idea! But afore I get to ramblin', I should warn ye my memory ain't what it used to be...
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_043: I remember the whole lot of 'em Alliance boys an' girls marchin' off to Carteneau. Dalamud was 'angin' overhead like a sword 'bout to drop from the sky, an' there'd been talk about callin' upon the Twelve to stay its descent.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_044: I can scarce imagine the fear they must have had to overcome, to set foot on a doomed battlefield.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_045: 'Twasn't a task for the faint of 'eart, goin' toe-to-toe with the Garleans beneath the blood red moon. Every man an' woman what fought that day's deservin' of our respect.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_046: Wasn't there meself, o' course, but the survivors said that naught could be 'eard over roar of the battle. That is, till Dalamud burst open an' that thrice-damned bastard of a dragon Bahamut showed 'imself.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_047: Bahamut, the primal that set Eorzea aflame. No matter their strength in numbers, how could anyone hope to win against such an enemy?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_048: They couldn't. But then, just as they were all bracin' to be burned to cinders, the dragon up an' disappears in a flash o' blindin' light. Ain't a soul alive who knows the 'ow or why of it.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_049: I see... Master Baderon, you have my thanks for sharing your story! I shall do my utmost to ensure that our audience remembers the bravery of the soldiers that day. Ohhh... Knowing the full weight of my responsibility makes me all the more nervous!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_050: Some might say that's a good thing! Anyroad, I ain't the only one ye ought to be askin' about that day. I'm sure Miounne of the Carline Canopy'd be 'appy to tell ye a tale or two.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_051: Of course. One can never have too much inspiration! Adventurer, let us depart to the Carline Canopy at once. Master Baderon, thank you again!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_BADERON_000_059: That one certainly doesn't want for passion, eh? I'll 'ave to try and see if I can't make my way to Ul'dah and see this play in person.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_059: I must say, if I had the time I'd be inclined to spend more than a few nights here. Unfortunately, we have no such luxury─we must remain focused on the task at hand! Now, let's speak with Miounne and see what she has to say.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MIOUNNE_000_060: In looking to the past, we take solace in the present, and think of what the future may hold... Ah, pray forgive me. At this time of year, one cannot help but wax poetic. How may I be of service?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_061: It is an honor to make your acquaintance, Mistress Miounne. I have been tasked with portraying the storied Warriors of Light in a play which will commemorate the events of the Calamity. If you would be so kind to tell me of the Archon Louisoix─a resident of this very city I believe─I would be grateful!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MIOUNNE_000_062: Archon Louisoix? Indeed he resided here in Gridania. His sacrifice during the Battle of Carteneau is something we shall never forget.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_063: Perhaps if you were to tell me more of him and his relationship with the Warriors of Light...
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MIOUNNE_000_064: Oh, he had worked closely with the Warriors of Light, even before Carteneau, and on that fateful day he took charge of the Alliance forces, they did not hesitate to fight under his command.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MIOUNNE_000_065: Had they not been there to hold back the relentless assault of the imperial army, many believe that Master Louisoix would have not even had the time to beseech the Twelve for aid.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MIOUNNE_000_066: Alas, in the end, both the Archon and those brave heroes gave their lives in our defense. Though we can never thank them enough, during this solemn time we must honor their sacrifice.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_067: To honor the bond that Louisoix and the Warriors of Light shared, and to commemorate their brave deeds, I pledge to bare my soul on the stage! Just as they risked their lives in the fighting, so too shall I act as if my life depends on it!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_MIOUNNE_000_068: Then I am certain you will receive a standing ovation!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_069: You have my sincerest gratitude, Mistress Miounne. As do you, adventurer. I feel my muse stirring at last! It's time to rehearse, rehearse, rehearse! Adventurer, pray inform the others that I shall set to work at once!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHERO_000_079: I must say, I am quite eager to see what sort of play they put on. Look for me in the crowd!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_080: Welcome back! It appears your research was certainly a success! Our future Warrior of Light set to rehearsing most enthusiastically.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_081: I owe you my thanks, good adventurer, for introducing us to such colorful and knowledgeable characters!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_082: Now, we must begin preparations! Of course, we've prepared a space for you as the guest of honor. May the tale of the Calamity bring tears to your eyes and warmth to your heart.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: Chief, the bloody beam, it fell right on top of him! Gods be good!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEEL_000_085: Our lead was rehearsing the Battle of Carteneau─most passionately, I might add─when he knocked one of the puppets into an unstable beam, which then fell over and knocked him off the stage. He'll recover with time, but only the Twelve know when he'll be fit for theatrics!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_086: Heavens forfend! Just when I thought our problems had been solved... To think his newfound passion was what led to this...
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: Although it grieves me greatly, I see no choice but to postpone our show. It would seem fate does not favor us today. <sigh> ...I'll go and break the sad news to the public...
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_088: W-Wait, I just thought of something! We have an adventurer right here, don't we? And one with no small amount of talent!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_089: Yes, you can channel your own experiences and bring the heroics of the Warriors of Light to life! The more I look at you, the surer of it I become!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: Madam, I believe you may be on to something. Of course, it stands to reason that an actual adventurer would be most suited to play the role of one. Why did we not see it before?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEEL_000_091: Can we really expect a novice to move the audience? Still, I must admit I would rather not disappoint our fans.
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEEL_000_092: And I suppose greatness does sometimes spring from improvisation. Yes... Perhaps we have a chance after all! Besides, our voices should be able to carry the performance. So, what say you? Will you take the stage?
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: Well now that that's settled, I'll get the puppets and the stage ready. No more falling beams─you have my word!
TEXT_FESANV201_02329_NEWBORNHEAD_000_094: Feeling a bit of stage fright, eh? Worry not, my friend, my troupe is more than capable of bringing even the most wooden performance to life. Just act from the heart, and I'm sure you'll impress. Well then, whenever you're ready, just let me know! Until then!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_100_000: Your performance was lauded by all, but none had more praise than the playwright himself! He was so moved, in fact, that he wishes to offer you his personal thanks. He said he'd be waiting somewhere near the Wellhead Lift.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_SYSTEM_100_000: The quest “The Show Must Go On” may be repeated after completing the quest “After the Curtain Falls.”
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_000: Ready to take the stage, are we? Our preparations should be more or less complete. Whenever you're ready, our carpenter is waiting near the wings to let you on the stage.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_001: You wish to reprise your role? Well, who am I to deny our star? If you would reenact the Calamity again, our carpenter will gladly let you on the stage.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_002: Remember, all we ask is that you give us your most heartfelt performance, and return here once you've finished. Oh, and don't forget─our future is riding on your shoulders!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_009: I'm sure you'll do great! The worst I've ever seen an audience do was pelt the performers with popotoes. Ah, but of course, I'm sure that won't happen today!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: Ready to take the stage, eh? Just change into your costume, and you'll be ready to start the show. Took me a bit of work to adjust it to your size─let's hope it brings out the hero in you!

Now, the rest of us will be following your lead, but don't put too much pressure on yourself. We're professionals, after all. Just act from the heart and we'll make the best of it like we always do. Now go on, and good luck!
Couldn't get enough of the applause, eh? I know that feeling! Now, you know where the costume is. Go on─the adoring crowd is waiting!
Let the play begin! I'll be cheering from the wings!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_014: It was the year 1572 of the Sixth Astral Era. A terrible catastrophe known as the Calamity threatened to bring untold destruction to Eorzea.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_015: At the same time, the Garlean Empire overran the Carteneau Flats. The three great city-states formed a grand alliance, that they might repel the aggressors and see their peoples through these dark times.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_016: Among the many who fought that day was a warrior whose noble deeds gave others the courage to carry on. A warrior who was willing to sacrifice  to save the many.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEEL_000_018: (-Commanding Female Voice-)Proud sons and daughters of Garlemald! We shall purge this land of its blight! But first, let us crush its pathetic army under the heels of our boots!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_019: (-Narrator-)The two armies clashed under the specter of the sanguine moon. The Warrior of Light led a band of hardened adventurers into the desperate melee, trying to stem the tide of the relentless onslaught.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_020: (-Narrator-)They fought on until flagging and weary. The moon of Dalamud waxed ever fuller, at last bursting open to reveal the terrifying truth of what slumbered inside.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_025: (-Narrator-)Yes! From within the flaming moon emerged the dread primal Bahamut!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_026: (-Narrator-)Freed at last from his prison, he unleashed his seething rage upon the land, engulfing Eorzea in flames!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_027: (-Narrator-)Our intrepid hero was helpless in the face of such power, and the force of Bahamut's assault left  battered and breathless.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_028: (-Narrator-)But just as the sun was to set on Eorzea's fate, a voice called out, saving our brave champions from certain doom!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_031: (-Narrator-)As round as the red moon and nigh as large, it fell to the ground, the impact of its landing knocked soldiers on both sides to the ground!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_032: (-Narrator-)And then, uh... Their hearts having been melted by the sight of such a cuddly creature, Garleans and Eorzeans alike lost the will to fight! They cast down their weapons, and embraced each other as brother and sister, returning home without further bloodshed!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_033: (-Narrator-)The gargantuan feline, moved by this display of camaraderie, purred with joy! Why, it's purring right now! Can you hear that? It's the sound of...the sound of peace.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_035: (-Narrator-)Dalamud burnt blood red, and just as the tendrils of its flames reached out to engulf the land, down descended the Archon Louisoix from the heavens! He had come to save Eorzea!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_036: (-Narrator-)I said he came from the heavens! Louisoix came to save Eorzea!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Dignified Male Voice-)Ahem! If it is the dreadwyrm Bahamut you fear, then fear no longer. I stole upon him whilst he was in a deep sleep. The battle was short, and I emerged victorious. From his meat did I concoct a stew most hearty, and from his bones did I mix a salve to soothe all wounds.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_038: (-Narrator-)You ate him!? I...I mean, and so did Louisoix consume the heart of his enemy, and thus averted the Calamity! With the medicine made from the dragon's bones, the Archon added years to the lives of Eorzea's people!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_039: (-Narrator-)...And all lived happily ever after. A wonderful story indeed. However, it's not exactly the one I remember hearing...
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_041: (-Narrator-)...A chocobo chick? I mean, of course it was a chocobo chick! Large as a dragon grown! From high in the heavens it tumbled, the earth quaking as it landed!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_042: (-Narrator-)A deafening kweh echoed across the battlefield, and with a violent kick of its legs, the chocobo sent both armies reeling to the ground!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_043: (-Narrator-)Thus did the Battle of Carteneau come to a decisive end! Eorzea was spared destruction, and the chocobo chick hailed as savior of the realm!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_A2_000_001: It was the voice of the Archon Louisoix!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_A2_000_003: The wandering minstrel sang out for them!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_045: (-Narrator-)Indeed, it was the Archon Louisoix's voice that called out over the endless battlefield. The erudite scholar and compassionate commander, who came from far-flung Sharlayan to deliver us to salvation.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Dignified Male Voice-)Twelve above, I beseech Thee! Lend me Your strength, and seal Bahamut within Dalamud once more!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_047: (-Narrator-)But lo! Bahamut's power was too great, and Louisoix's ritual failed!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_048: (-Narrator-)The end of Eorzea was at hand. But in that moment of darkest despair, the Archon entreated the gods once more...
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_049: (-Narrator-)Hearkening to his plea, They imbued the Warrior of Light with Their divine strength. Once more, our hero rose, and stood unflinching against Bahamut!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_050: (-Narrator-)A voice called out, piercing the chaos of the battlefield. The voice of none other than...another Warrior of Light!?
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEEL_000_051: (-Heroic Female Voice-)Be gone, vile beast! You shall threaten the realm no longer!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_052: (-Narrator-)In defense of her fallen comrade, the stalwart warrior stood valiantly against Bahamut! From whence did this mysterious ally come? None can recall, but the fatal blow struck against the mighty dragon resounds to this day!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEEL_000_053: (-Heroic Female Voice-)Darkness shall flee before the Light of my blade!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_054: (-Narrator-)That was amazing! I mean... Thus was Bahamut laid low, and the realm saved! Three cheers for the Warrior of Light!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_055: (-Narrator-)The voice that called out to our desperate warrior was none other than...a cheerleader!? Yes, a cheerleader, whose invigorating words filled our hero with determination anew!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEEL_000_056: (-Enthusiastic Female Voice-)Get up! Get up and fight! Show us your might! Show the realm who's the Warrior of Light!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_057: (-Narrator-)Heartened by the earnest encouragement, our savior stood undaunted against Bahamut! With a single blow,  laid low the dread primal once and for all!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_058: (-Narrator-)With a cheerleader by your side, there's no limit to what you can achieve! Just ask the Warrior of Light! And as it happens, the Crystal Caravan is now selling a limited supply. Yes, you too can have the courage to save the realm for just a few coins!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_060: The voice which called out for our hero was...our carpenter!? What in the seven hells are you doing!?
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: Apologies, Chief, but the fireworks ain't...uh, firin' the way they should. I take pride in my craft, ye see. I just can't let such a thing stand without at least an honest attempt at fixin' it.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_062: And this is your idea of fixing things!? Barging onto the stage like a goobbue run amok!?
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_064: Would you look at that, everyone? Impeccable craftsmanship! So impeccable that the realm was saved! And with that, today's show shall come to a close. Thank you, thank you one and all!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_A3_000_001: Bahamut was slain with a single blow!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Dignified Male Voice-)Brave champions, I leave the rest in your hands! If I can but see you to a new future, I should want for nothing more.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_071: (-Narrator-)Louisoix's final words joined the prayers of every Eorzean, and the Twelve bestowed upon the Warrior of Light Their blessing.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Narrator-)With the fate of the realm resting on  shoulders, our hero lashed out with one last desperate attack, imbued with the power of the gods themselves.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_075: (-Narrator-)Louisoix enveloped the Warrior of Light in magic, whisking  away to safety.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_076: (-Narrator-)Woe unto us! Our saviors have gone! Who shall save us now!? It is hopeless!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Dignified Male Voice-)Brave champions, I leave the rest in your hands! If I can but see you to a new future, I should want for nothing more.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_080: (-Narrator-)Louisoix's incantation revitalized the Warrior of Light, and with a newfound tenacity  fixed  smoldering gaze upon the dragon...
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_081: (-Narrator-)And in a flash Bahamut was defeated! The Warrior of Light was...surprised  foe was felled so easily...
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Bestial Male Voice-)You shall rue the day you stood against me, foolish mortals!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_100_0: (-Bestial Male Voice-)Tremble before me─Bahamut Omega! Tremble, and despair, for I am not the only dragon you must contend with! With my savage roar, I summon Bahamut Alpha, and Bahamut Beta, and Bahamut─
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_082: No, no, no! We don't have all the puppets for─I mean... And so he spoke, on and on, until Bahamut named all of his kin. In fact, some say he is still talking to this day...
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_085: (-Narrator-)Reinvigorated by the Archon's prayer, the Warrior of Light rose anew.  turned to face the dread Bahamut, and unleashed  most powerful weapon: a single pithy quote!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_0: (-Heroic Male Voice-)You don't need a reason to help people!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEEL_000_087: (-Heroic Female Voice-)You don't need a reason to help people!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_088: Bahamut was overwhelmed by the empathetic words of a legendary thief! So moved was he that his breath caught in his throat, leaving him unable to wreak any more havoc unto Eorzea! Huzzah!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_0: Now that was a round of applause well deserved! Seeing you move so passionately on that stage was enough to inspire even me to consider taking up acting.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_091: Thank you, adventurer! Somehow, we finished the play without any major incidents. However, I'm not entirely sure our...uh, dramatic interpretation of the Calamity was true to the facts. Let's hope the public doesn't think we meant to deceive them.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_092: Now, I have no doubt you're quite tired after such an impassioned performance. Take some time and rest, and speak to me again when you've recovered.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_1: (-Dignified Male Voice-)Eorzea is saved! Warrior of Light, the realm is in your debt!
(-Dignified Male Voice-)The threat has been vanquished, and hope can return to the hearts of the people! The bravery of our hero shall illuminate the future of the realm!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: (-Singsong Voice-)The seemingly indomitable Bahamut vanished in a brilliant flash of light! Once more, hope returned to the hearts of Eorzea's people!

(-Singsong Voice-)Unto chaos and despair came hope,♪
a dawn to banish the night.♪
A hero is come to our realm.♪
Hail the Warrior of Light!♪
So long as this hero stands with us, the future of Eorzea shall ever shine bright.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_130: I knew you'd be a success up there! Even so, I didn't expect you'd do that well! You have our thanks, adventurer!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_1: They're still clapping! Well, what're you waiting for? Go back out there and give your adoring fans what they want!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_132: You're still new to all this, aren't you? It's called a curtain call! Now's your chance to bask in a well-deserved applause. Show the crowd your lovely face!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEEL_000_133: Would you listen to that? How long do you think they would clap if  remained on the stage?
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNMENTOR_000_1: For as long as  deserves, I gather. It is not often one has the opportunity to be in the presence of such a radiant actor. It is as if the Warrior of Light  was standing there.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0:
(-Singsong Voice-)Stray seeds quicken in ash's grey embrace.
Valiant blades forged under the Twelve's good grace.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_141: That voice, it is honey to my ears... Whose could it be?
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_142: (-Narrator-)Why, what an unexpected turn of events! A bard sang out for our hero, and his heavenly voice gave  the will to rise again!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: What say you, friend? Do you find despair in these words, or hope? More often than not, the meaning of prophecy lies in the hearts of those who hear it. So close your eyes, and envision the future you desire.
Warrior of Light, to save Eorzea, you must pray fervently for a brighter tomorrow! Unfetter your heart and embrace hope, and adventurers far and wide shall add their voices to yours!
(-Narrator-)As Bahamut's flames lay waste to the land, thousands cried out, certain that the end was nigh. But the Warrior of Light rose from the ashes, unburnt and unbroken. And  prayed.
Although none can know what is to come, I swear that you shall always have my support. I entrust the future of Eorzea to you, brave hero.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_147: (-Narrator-)And so, heartened by the minstrel's words, and emboldened by the prayers of many, the Warrior of Light felled the fearsome Bahamut with a single blow!
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: My apologies─I could not resist the urge to take the stage once you spoke of me! Stirring as it is to hear tales of heroism, sometimes one must be the hero! Although 'twas only on the stage, I thank you for allowing me to live out that dream.
Eorzea has suffered countless hardships, and will doubtless suffer many more. I hold no dread in my heart, however, for I believe you shall lead the way to a brighter tomorrow.
