Tell me true, friend─were my words to your liking? It is a poem of gratitude and hope. Gratitude for the past and for the present, and hope for the future. A hope which I am certain you shall help fulfill.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNFLYMAN_000_1: I've been at this a long time, and that was among the most movin' performances I've seen. I've no doubt the chief feels the same way, too.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_170: I must say, you certainly exceeded our expectations! Perhaps our little accident before was but a blessing in disguise? Either way, I offer you my thanks, on behalf of every member of the Crystal Caravan.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_171: And it would seem you have one particularly passionate fan that would offer you his personal thanks. He has left a message just for you.
TEXT_FESANV202_02330_NEWBORNHEAD_000_175: Once again you've captured the hearts of the audience! I daresay this play was even more enthralling than the last. I await your next performance with bated breath!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHEAD_000_000: Our leading  returns, I see! Once again, I must say you gave quite a memorable performance. So memorable, in fact, that the playwright himself expressed his admiration.
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHEAD_000_001: Although he will soon be departing Ul'dah, he very much wished to speak with you before he boarded the airship. Go now, and you might catch him.
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: (-???-)Greetings, my friend. When I set quill to parchment to recount the story of the Calamity, I did not imagine you would be cast as the Warrior of Light.
'Tis an honor to meet you. It is not often that I dabble in the art of prose, but I am glad my words were brought to life by such a skilled actor. You see, I am more of a poet by nature.

And a poet's heart is wont to wander, which is how I found myself in Eorzea, a land once unfamiliar to me. My travels have been rife with innumerable trials, and often have I found myself indebted to the adventurers who saw me safely through them.
It is to honor the selflessness of these heroes that I write my songs, and 'twas for the selfsame reason that I penned the play in which you performed.
Your superb acting has certainly aided me in achieving that goal. I was so taken with your performance that I found myself unable to stop my applause even after you had left the stage.
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_000_015: ...Which is not to say you were unfit for the role. On the contrary, I could not have hoped for a more talented thespian to bring my words to life. To a man, the audience was moved beyond words, and I found myself unable to stop clapping even after you had left the stage.
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I can only imagine the experiences you must have drawn upon to inform your acting. After today I suspect many shall call you the Warrior of Light in earnest.

Although the Calamity was a terrible tragedy, it also served to sow seeds of hope for the future. Hope in the form of countless brave adventurers, much like the Warriors of Light, who even now protect Eorzea with their lives.

And as much as I would like to see you take the stage time and again, I am certain you will be of more use to the realm as its protector. As an adventurer. For my part, I shall continue to regale others with songs telling of your deeds.

The road ahead will be fraught with hardship─of this I am certain. If ever you find yourself in the midst of a crisis, remember the events of the Calamity. Remember how hope was born from despair, and continue your fight, that I might someday hear of your heroics.
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHEAD_000_020: Have you spoken to the wandering minstrel? Splendid! Ah, but there is one last member of our troupe who would offer you his thanks. Why, none other than our star-crossed leading man, freshly released from the infirmary!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHERO_000_021: When that beam took me out of commission, I was positively crestfallen! It is no small blessing that we were able to perform the show─and to such acclaim!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHERO_000_022: But alas and alack! I was confined to a bed in Frondale's Phrontistery, unable to witness your stunning performance with my own eyes!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHERO_000_023: The chirurgeon has instructed me to refrain from taking the stage until I am fully healed. But I intend to stay limber with some light rehearsing, and I certainly intend to watch your next appearance!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHEAD_000_024: Yes, yes, you simply must reprise your role! We've received countless inquiries from your adoring fans, all curious as to when your next performance will be! The puppet theater is a simple matter to set up─ask and we can be ready in a flash!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHEAD_000_025: To prove how eager we are for you to join us again, I'll add a little bonus to your payment for this performance!
TEXT_FESANV203_02331_NEWBORNHERO_000_026: You've certainly earned it, for all you've done for us. Pray do not let this be the last time I can reward your performance─it would be an honor to tell our tale of heroism and hope with you again!
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_000_000: By reconditioning the anima, you can redistribute the attribute points allocated to your weapon.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_000_001: You may only recondition the anima of the weapon equipped when speaking with Ulan.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_000_002: The process can be canceled at any time.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_A1_000_001: Recondition the anima of a different weapon.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_A2_000_002: Recondition the anima of your equipped weapon.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_000_003: In order to recondition the anima of a weapon, you must first equip it, then speak with Ulan.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_100_003: In order to recondition the anima of a weapon, you must first equip it, then speak with Ulan.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_000_004: You must equip your anima weapon before speaking with Ulan to proceed.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_100_004: You must equip both the Sword and Shield of the Twin Thegns before speaking with Ulan to proceed.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_000: Ardashir tells me you wish to alter the state of the anima, is that right?
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_001: Assuming we do not attempt to push beyond its current limitations, this should be a trivial matter.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_002: Mind you, this process requires crystal sand. If you have none, I will gladly furnish you with more per our original arrangement.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_003: But you need not worry about umbrite. For this we require elementally aspected sand to ever so slightly alter the anima's aetherial composition.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_007: Unless you have any other questions, let us begin!
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_010: You appear to be out of crystal sand, my friend. If you would have more, then I must ask you bring me supplies in exchange.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_030: To carefully modify the anima's aetherial composition, we must make use of crystal sand once more. The process is quite different from our previous endeavor, but thankfully much simpler.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_031: Nevertheless, it still requires a fair amount of crystal sand. If you require more, you must supply me with materials in exchange. A deal is a deal, after all.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_032: Oh, and you need not bother with the umbrite. Stripping the sand of its elemental aspect would be counterproductive this time.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_ULAN_000_050: That went rather well, would you not agree? If you should have need of my services again, you have but to ask.
TEXT_JOBREL399_02334_SYSTEM_000_006: The anima has been transformed, gaining newfound strength!
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Beg pardon, , but might you perchance be an adventurer? 'Tis Starlight season, and I'm searching for a  who might help me work miracles.
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Why, if it isn't my favorite miracle worker from Starlights past! Might you be so kind as to lend me your aid once more? It would mean the world to the children.
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_020: As you know, the Starlight Celebration is a time to celebrate the children of the realm─our hope and our future. As a Starlight celebrant, it is my sworn duty to see happiness and good cheer duly doled out to all boys and girls, particularly those whose daily lives afford them few reasons to smile.
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_021: To that end, I've planned a special delivery for the younglings in the children's ward at Frondale's Phrontistery, but I fear things have hit a snag─the parcel has vanished!
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_022: I trust it has only been misplaced and not stolen─what black-hearted wretch would deny those poor children a rare moment of good cheer? I would search for it myself, but I fear my duties as a celebrant keep me from leaving my post. Might you be so kind as to go looking in my stead?
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_023: Oh, thank you, friend! With you on the job, I'm sure the children will be beaming with smiles within bells. The package is a large box engraved with the mark of Frondale's Phrontistery. One of my assistants says they saw a boy toting a similar box at the Ruby Road Exchange─perhaps you might begin your search there?
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_AMHGARANJY_000_024: Should you find the parcel, pray deliver it directly to the registrar at Frondale's. You have my heartfelt gratitude for your assistance─and remember, it's not just me that's counting on you to work miracles.
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_REAUVERRE_000_040: H-Hey! Where are you taking that crate? I hid it there for a reason, you know!
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_REAUVERRE_000_041: It's wh-what? I saw the mark on it and assumed it belonged to one of the physicians from the children's ward! I was only trying to have a little fun, I promise!
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_REAUVERRE_000_042: I didn't mean to cause any trouble, honest! At least, not for you. So just...just take it and do whatever you want with it. And don't tell anyone you saw me here, okay? I don't want to get in trouble again!
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_DAMIELLIOT_000_060: Greetings, adventurer. Hm? You have a delivery for me?
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_DAMIELLIOT_000_061: Thank the heavens! When the goods the celebrant spoke of did not arrive at the designated time, I feared this Starlight would be a lonesome one for our poor children. Pray tell, wherever did it disappear to?
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_DAMIELLIOT_000_062: ...I see. Thank you for your honesty, and fear not─we will not punish the boy. The younglings here do not live easy lives, but they have good hearts. I shall do what I can to see that they all have cause to smile today.
TEXT_FESXMS201_02375_DAMIELLIOT_000_063: On that subject, might I ask one more favor of you? I realize we have troubled you enough already, but I am certain it would bring the children no end of delight. If you would not be averse to helping us, pray speak with me again.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_000: So you will lend us your aid? I cannot thank you enough, friend!
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_001: As for the task at hand...I would deliver these presents to the children, but I fear they would find little joy and wonder in receiving them from the fusty physician whose face they see every day.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_002: ...But one of the saint's little helpers, on the other hand! Behold─I have the garb right here, and I'm certain it would most become you.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_100_002: My colleague by the door would be happy to show you in to the children's ward whenever you desire.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_003: Meanwhile, I must look into the matter of that mischief-making boy. Thank you again, my friend. When you see the children's smiles, you will know just how much your kindness meant to them.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_100_005: Just as I thought─he is nowhere to be found. Doubtless the boy the adventurer spoke of was...yes, it must be so.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_ALCHEMIST02376_110_: The registrar has told me everything. We thank you for your charity, kind adventurer. It would be my pleasure to show you within.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_PATIENTBOYA02376_00: A little helper! Do you truly have a present for me? I must be dreaming!
Oh, thank you so, so much! This is the best Starlight ever!
Everyone says the city's full of little helpers, but none of them come here. Do you think it's because they don't want to get sick like us?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_PATIENTBOYB02376_00: Well, if it isn't a little helper! Might you have a present for me? Oh, please say that you do!
My heartfelt thanks to you. I can only hope that the Spinner hears my prayers, that I might spend next Starlight with my family...
Just between you and me, the only gift I want for Starlight is to see Mother and Father once more...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_PATIENTGIRLA02376_0: <cough> <cough> ...P-Pardon me. Do you have something─<cough>─for me?
Oh, thank you! I─<cough>─I'm so happy! I'll get better by next Starlight, just you wait and see!
<cough> <cough> ...F-Forgive me. I do not mean to be rude. I just want to go outside and play with my friends, but the grown-ups tell me my body is still─<cough>─too weak...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_PATIENTGIRLB02376_0: Why, hello there, little helper! Might you perchance have a present for little old me?
Oh, but you are truly too kind! I feared my letters would not reach the Spinner from here, but I see now my worries were for naught!
You're not a little helper, now are you? Not that I mind, of course! For I am no child, but a big girl with no need for little toys and trinkets!
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_SYSTEM_000_050: You must have the Starlight robe equipped to continue with this quest.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_SYSTEM_000_051: If you do not possess a Starlight robe, you may purchase one from the recompense officer.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_SYSTEM_000_052: You have successfully delivered a gift to every youngling on the premises. One present, however, still remains...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_060: You have my thanks, adventurer. Hearing the laughter of the little ones, I see you served as a most splendid little helper. But pray tell, do you perchance still have one present in your possession?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_061: ...I suspected as much. Currently, we have five younglings residing with us, but one of them─a boy by the name of Reauverre─seems to have slipped outside unattended.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_062: No doubt this is the selfsame boy you met not long ago─the boy who stole away with our Starlight gifts. But whatever would possess him to do such a thing?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_063: ...But this is no time for idle speculation─we must find him before he comes to harm! You will aid in our search, won't you, friend?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_064: Once again I am in your debt. Let us begin our search at the Ruby Road Exchange, where you last saw him. I will await you there!
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_070: This is where you saw the boy, yes? I do not imagine that one as timid as he would venture far from here...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_ALCHEMIST02376_000_: The registrar has already departed for the Ruby Road Exchange. We cannot thank you enough for your efforts on our─and Reauverre's─behalf.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_BOY02375_000_080: Oh, Father! Father! Can we stop at the stalls before we go home?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_FATHER02375_000_081: We told your mother we would be home by the next bell, did we not? You wouldn't want to make her sad, now would you?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_FATHER02375_000_083: Well, I suppose she would not be devastated if we stopped off at one stall...and bought her a little gift. What do you say?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_REAUVERRE_000_085: Wh-Who goes th─oh, you're that adventurer from before. I-I've been a good boy since then, I promise!
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_REAUVERRE_000_086: (-Reauverre-)W-Well, except for running away, I suppose. I'm sorry...I didn't mean to cause you trouble.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_REAUVERRE_000_087: Between you and me, I don't particularly want to go back, but... I wouldn't want to get you in trouble too, so, I will.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_ALCHEMIST02376_100_: Is something the matter, adventurer? I fear young Reauverre has yet to return. I can only assume the registrar is still searching for him at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_090: You've found Reauverre and convinced him to return, you say? You truly are a miracle worker, friend! Come, let us return to the children's ward. I simply must get to the bottom of the boy's most curious behavior...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_100: How many times must I say this, Reauverre? I do not mean to scold you, merely to keep you safe. Just promise me you will not go running off like that again. Everyone cares for you here, and this behavior of yours causes no end of worry.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_REAUVERRE_000_101: (-Reauverre-)Liar! Nobody cares about me! I could die tomorrow, and no one would shed a tear! So just leave me be, will you!?
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_103: Dear heavens... I am sorry you had to see that, friend. I know not what that boy is thinking these days...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_105: Worry not, friend─the boy's life is in no danger. I have already seen to his treatment. He should be back on his feet ere long.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_106: And yet, it is fortunate we were close at hand. Why, if he had collapsed but a few bells earlier, on his own out on the streets...
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_107: If you have a moment, I would speak to you in private. Pray come with me.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_108: Reauverre's illness is not an especially complex one, but one of the herbs used in its treatment is quite rare and not easily come by. As such, his time in the children's ward has dragged on longer than any of us would have hoped.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_109: Moon after moon spent in the company of strangers─it would not be easy on any child, let alone one as sensitive as Reauverre. And yet, he has fought his illness with admirable courage and nary a word of complaint.
TEXT_FESXMS202_02376_DAMIELLIOT_000_110: That is...until recently. For the life of me, I cannot fathom what has turned him into such a rebellious, sullen child. I only want to help him, and yet I am at a complete loss for ideas as to how I might do so. Alas and alack, whatever am I to do!?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_000: Alas! Alas and alack! Is there nothing I can do to bring succor to the poor boy!? Am I doomed to stand idly by as he descends further into a pit of hopelessness, self-loathing, and despair!?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_001: ...My apologies. My emotions got the better of me for a moment. I often tell the children that even the most potent herbs and potions will not avail a patient who does not possess the firm belief that his condition will, indeed, improve. This is true for myself as much as it is true of my charges.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_002: Sadly, in the case of poor Reauverre, he seems to have all but given up hope. I cannot fathom what happened─he used to be such a sweet, sanguine child.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_003: I beg of you, friend─pray help me help the boy. Might you investigate into the matter, that you might ascertain what ails his heart so?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_004: Thank you ever so much, my friend. I shall go speak with my colleagues at the Phrontistery to see if they might have any insight. Mayhap you could speak with the other children─after your efforts as a little helper, I imagine they'd not be shy to share with you anything they might know.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_010: Have you gleaned anything from the children regarding Reauverre's sullen and dispirited behavior?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_ALCHEMIST02377_000_: On behalf of my colleague, I would thank you once again for your generous offer of aid. Should you wish to enter the children's ward, you need only speak the word.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_PATIENTBOYA02376_00: Reauverre? Now that you mention it, I haven't seen him smile much lately. We used to laugh together all the time. I wonder what happened?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_PATIENTBOYB02376_00: You would ask of Reauverre? Very well. I saw him reaching under his bed the other day, as if he were...hiding something. Of course I did not peek─I'll have you know that Mother and Father instilled me with the finest of manners.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_PATIENTGIRLA02376_0: <cough> <cough> Reauverre? He hasn't seemed too happy lately. Who can blame him? When I think of how long I've been here, so far from home, sometimes I can't help but─<cough>─cry, too...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_PATIENTGIRLB02376_0: I saw Reauverre reading a letter the other day with a terrible grimace on his face. Mayhap something in the words upset him? Or perhaps his sickness is acting up again...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SYSTEM_100_055: You find a letter under the bed!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_060: Ah, welcome back, my friend. Have you gleaned any insight as to what ails poor Reauverre's heart?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_061: What have we here...? Ah, a letter─to Reauverre, from his father. While I am loath to intrude on the privacy of my ward, desperate times call for desperate measures. Let us see, now...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_062:
(-Letter from Father-)“My dearest son,

I promised I would be home for Starlight, but I fear that business calls. Pray forgive your father for this broken promise, and know that I shall return to your side as soon as I am able.”
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_063: Ah...I should have known. Reauverre's father is a merchant by trade, and his travels often take him to distant shores. Few things instill the boy with hope like his father's visits, but they have grown increasingly rare.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_064: Doubtless he prayed to the Spinner for his father's return for Starlight, and was devastated that those prayers went unanswered. If this letter is the cause of his recent malaise, I fear there is little we could do to lift his spirits.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_065: Unless we could somehow find the man and convince him to─wait, I believe I know someone who just might be able to come to our aid at a time such as this.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_066: I will go on ahead and investigate the matter. Pray join me anon at the Hustings Strip. I will explain there.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_ALCHEMIST02377_100_: My colleague awaits you at the Hustings Strip. Pray join him there as soon as you are able. We thank you for your charity, friend.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_070: Ah, friend, your timing is impeccable. With some help from an old acquaintance, I was able to ascertain the whereabouts of the poor boy's father.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_071: The “acquaintance” of whom I speak? An old friend of my departed mother's─and one with a vast web of informants and information at his disposal. He was more than happy to assist─for the right price, needless to say.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_072: But you needn't concern yourself with that, friend─what's important is that we've found our man!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_073: As my source tells it, Reauverre's father is staying over in Limsa, awaiting a vessel that will take him across the seas to Radz-at-Han in the East. If we depart now, we might still catch him before he sets sail!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_074: I would go myself, but─you must understand─I simply could not leave the poor children entrusted to my care. And so I must call upon your generosity again this Starlight season. Pray travel to Limsa in my stead, that Reauverre's Starlight wish may yet come true!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_ALCHEMIST02377_000_: Traveling all the way to Limsa in search of the boy's father? You truly are a  for the season, friend. On behalf of the registrar, my colleagues, and the children, I thank you for your kindness.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERREFATHER0237: ...Hmm? Why, yes, I'm Reauverre's father. Whatever is the matter? Has something happened to my boy!?
I-It...it cannot be! I knew the boy was looking forward to a Starlight reunion, but to think a single broken promise would ravage his heart so!
You must understand, friend. I want nothing more than to fly back to Ul'dah to Reauverre's side, but I simply cannot. No, a matter most pressing calls me across the sea!

Aye, it is not merely a chance at profit and fortune that calls me eastward. I have─at long, long last─found a reliable source for the rare herb needed to cure my poor boy's disease! If I do not sail out on the next ferry, it may be moons─even years─till I find an opportunity like this!
And so, as much as it pains my heart, I must go. I know not if it will suffice, but pray deliver this to my boy in my stead. It is a memento I had meant to give him when I returned from Radz-at-Han.

Take it to him, and tell him this: “Even when his journeys carry him to distant lands, your father's heart is ever with you.” And with that, I must prepare for my journey. Thank you, my friend, and a happy Starlight to you.

Take it to him, and tell him this: “Even when his journeys carry him to distant lands, your father's heart is ever with you.” And with that, I must prepare for my journey. Thank you, my friend, and a happy Starlight to you.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_110: You return, friend, but you return alone. Did the man elude your search?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_120: ...I see. I can only hope that this gift will serve to rouse Reauverre from his doldrums. Pray take it to the boy, my friend. He should be back on his feet any time now, and─given his recent behavior─I suspect he would rather receive the present from you than me.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_130: Pray give the boy his father's gift, friend, and let us hope it will lift his spirits.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERRE_000_140: Oh, you're back. I've been a good boy, I prom─what? You have something for me?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERRE_000_150: A present? But the only thing I asked for Starlight was...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERRE_000_151: A present...from Father? His heart is always with me, you say!? That's a stupid lie! If his heart was with me, then why isn't he here, like he promised he would be!?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_152: Please, Reauverre! You must understand! Your father cares for you more than anyone we know!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERRE_000_153: Then why didn't he come back!? Why is he sailing off to some distant land!? Is coin so much more important to him than his own son!?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_154: It is precisely because you are so important to him that he sails east, my dear boy. He sails out in search of the rare herb that will cure you of all ills, that you might live as a family once more.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERRE_000_155: Y-You're just making things up! Or...aren't you?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_156: I swear on my own father's grave that I am not. This adventurer heard as much from your father's own mouth. Didn't you, friend?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_158: On the contrary, Reauverre, your father just wants to see you well again, as we all do. Will you promise that you'll stop fighting us, and work with us to overcome your sickness?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_REAUVERRE_000_159: Y-You bet I will! I'll get over this and be back living happy with my dad in no time! Just you watch me!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_160: Now that's the Reauverre I know. (Ahem. Might we speak in private for a moment, friend? I'll be at the front desk, if you might spare a moment.)
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_170: (-???-)Damelliot, you insufferable dolt! I swear, can I not leave my bumbling erstwhile apprentice alone for half a bell without him turning the cauldron over and making a right mess of everything!?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_171: M-Master Severian! Whatever brings you to the children's ward at this hour of !?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_172: Are you deaf, dumb, or do you simply enjoy being intentionally obtuse!? It's as I just said, you spectacular fool! I saw you running about town like a chocobo with its head removed from its body, and I deigned to interrupt my far more important research to see if my surpassing knowledge might be needed to rescue you from whatever miserable plight you've surely inflicted upon yourself.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_173: Th-That is most kind of you, Master Severian. I am pleased to inform you that─thanks to the charity of this kind adventurer─the situation was resolved a few brief moments ago. I am quite sorry to have...ah...troubled you so.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_180: Well, well─if it isn't my able assistant! I must say, it's good to see that at least one person in this room hasn't let my esteemed tutelage go entirely to waste like my erstwhile apprentice here. Heh heh heh. Mwahahahahaha!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_190: Well, well─if it isn't that lackey of mine! I know not the details─and am not particularly inclined to waste my time in hearing them─but it would appear that you're more competent at my erstwhile apprentice's job than he is. Heh heh heh. Mwahahahahaha!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_200: What's this? Your face is unfamiliar to me─and I am not particularly inclined to waste my time in getting to know you─but whoever you are, it would appear that you're more competent at my erstwhile apprentice's job than he is. Heh heh heh. Mwahahahahaha!
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_210: Yes, my apprentice... He may be a sappy, sentimental fool, but I suppose it's something to be said that the children's ward hasn't entirely collapsed under his stewardship. Though I daresay my regular visits have something to do with that, wouldn't you say...director?
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_211: M-Master Severian...! Your guidance is, as always, most welcome. But...should you be taking this much time away from─
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SEVERIAN_000_212: Good gods, Damielliot! Whyever are you wasting my invaluable time when you know full well that pressing experiments demand my constant and undivided attention!? <sigh> I swear, the next competent apprentice I find will be the first...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_213: (-Damielliot-)Forgive me, friend, my not introducing myself sooner. My name is Damielliot, and I serve as director of this institution. Though, in fairness, it is simply a position I inherited from my departed parents─and one that I even now struggle to prove myself worthy of...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_214: (-Damielliot-)Nevertheless, on behalf of all of my colleagues and the children placed in my charge─not the least of which is dear Reauverre─I offer my most sincere thanks for the boundless kindness and charity you have shown us this Starlight season.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_215: (-Damielliot-)In my own childhood, I was a patient here myself. I suffered from a most curious ailment─whenever I drifted off to slumber, I knew not when I would again wake. It was only through the benevolence and goodwill of those around me that my condition did at long last abate.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_216: (-Damielliot-)And so it was that, when I came of age, I resolved to carry on my dear parents' life work, that I might do my part to bring succor and solace to those in the greatest of need. A simple motive, mayhap, but one that more than sufficed.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_217: (-Damielliot-)...But I have rambled on long enough. I thank you once again for your kindness, friend. You are welcome in the ward whenever you desire─I am sure your presence would bring smiles to the faces of the children.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_220: (-Damielliot-)And yet...it is strange. Though I could swear we only met this day, there is something in your bearing that reminds me of a  I once knew. One whose face I have sadly long since forgotten...
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_221: (-Damielliot-) was an adventurer who performed a great kindness for me when I was but a suffering child. Indeed, it was the starfall grass  procured for me that cured me of my condition and saved me from a fate of eternal slumber.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_222: (-Damielliot-)The Calamity claimed my parents and left me a friendless foundling. It would be no exaggeration to say that without that adventurer, I would not be standing here today. The depths of my gratitude know no bounds.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_223: (-Damielliot-)...But forgive me. Just because you are an adventurer, like my mysterious benefactor, there is no need to burden you with this sappy, sentimental tale.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_DAMIELLIOT_000_224: (-Damielliot-)And yet it is strange. In expressing my gratitude to you, I feel somehow as if my deepest wishes have reached that gentle soul, and in the doing, that I have awoken from a long, deep slumber.
TEXT_FESXMS203_02377_SYSTEM_000_230: A daily quest is now available from Damielliot in the children's ward.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_000: Ah, adventurer! Your return heartens the children and me as well. I know we have imposed on your generosity quite enough already, but I was wondering─might you be willing to spare a few moments of your time?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_001: In your travels across the realm, surely you have seen wondrous sights of which the children in my care could scarcely dream. It would be an ever-so-special Starlight gift to them if you could regale them with a tale of your adventures. What do you say?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_002: Oh, thank you, my friend! I am certain your story will bring them no end of wonder and joy. I will gather the children in the innermost room. Pray meet us there when you are ready to tell your tale.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_010: Ah, adventurer! Once more, your presence illuminates our humble halls like a shining star in the sky. Have you perchance come to share another of your tales with the children?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_011: Thank you, my friend! Truly, your benevolence knows no bounds. I will summon the children to the innermost chamber as before. Pray join us there when you are ready.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_020: Just look at the eager anticipation in the eyes of the chlidren, friend─they simply cannot wait to hear your tale. And I am not embarrassed to say that I am quite looking forward to it as well!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_REAUVERRE_000_030: That's , everyone! So, what story will you tell us today? My friends and I do love a good tale!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_Q1_000_000: What tale will you tell the children?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_A1_000_000: Of fun and games at the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_A1_000_002: Of your adventures in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_A1_000_005: Of great nations and those who lead them.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_A1_000_006: Of the menace of an empire.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_REAUVERRE_000_040: Thank you, friend! Why, that was one of the most exciting stories I've ever heard! Well, everyone? I told you  stories would be the best!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_041: ...Indeed you did, Reauverre. Friend, your tale was such a rousing one that when I closed my eyes, for a moment I could swear I was journeying at your side.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_042: But as is oft the case, joyous times pass swiftest of all, and the hour grows late. What say you rest here for the night, friend? This room is empty at the moment, and you have more than earned yourself a respite. I shall see you on the morrow.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_GODBERT_000_050: Ho ho ho! I say, it is good to see you again, my friend─ah, we have met before, have we not? It is I, the wandering pilgrim known far and wide for gifting gifts to assiduous adventurers such as yourself!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_GODBERT_000_051: In truth, I had a mind to wield my hammer of legend and forge for you a masterwork of goldsmithery worthy of your efforts, but I fear that my attention was required...elsewhere. But worry not, for I have procured a present which should more than suffice as a substitute!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_GODBERT_000_052: Ah, but it would seem dawn is nigh, and so I must return and do what only a Man─ah, a wandering pilgrim-man can. Until we meet again...and do remember to look under the tree!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YSHTOLA_000_060: 'Twould seem you have done some good this year. And so I come, bearing a gift from the Spinner. Do not ask why She chose me─surely this gaudy frock would better suit Yda, or Tataru...
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YSHTOLA_000_061: Still, it calls to mind one Starlight many summers ago, when I awoke to find a small ribbon beside my pillow. Master Matoya took me to task when I suggested she was the one who had placed it there. Still, I knew the truth, and was rather moved by the gesture.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YSHTOLA_000_062: ...But l have dwelt on the past long enough.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YSHTOLA_000_063: The dawn comes, and I am summoned elsewhere. Be well, friend─and do not neglect to look beneath the tree when you awaken.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_PAPALYMO_000_070: Ah, . Fancy meeting you here. I trust you have been a good adventurer this year?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YDA_000_071: sure has! That's why I brought gifts! Well, a gift, at least. I'm sorry, Papalymo─I forgot to bring something for you!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_PAPALYMO_000_072: Well, then it is fortunate I am not a child, isn't it? If anything, it is I who should be gifting little trinkets to you...not that I have the slightest intention of doing so.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YDA_000_073: O-Of course, silly me! Sometimes I forget that you're so much older than me! Was it forty summers now? Fifty?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_PAPALYMO_000_074: Do you see the sun coming up on the horizon, Yda? That's our cue to leave...now.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_YDA_000_075: Awww, and just when I was starting to have fun! Well, see you around, ! And don't forget to peek under the tree when you wake up!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_THANCRED_000_080: Ah, . Sleeping like a babe, I see. Why the puzzled look? 'Tis I, the saint's little helper. Mayhap you were expecting another?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_THANCRED_000_081: Curious, is it not? Not once did I have occasion to celebrate Starlight as a child, but now, as a man grown, I celebrate it with you─at least, in a manner of speaking.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_THANCRED_000_082: Ah, but dawn is nigh, and I must bid you a fond farewell. May your dreams be sweet, and do remember to peek under the tree when you awake. Till we meet again!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_NANAMOULNAMO_000_09: Hail, adventurer! By the grace of the Spinner, I, Nanamo Ul Namo, seventeenth of my line, do hereby confer upon you a gift for your most beneficent deeds this Starlight season!

I am reminded of our own festivities at the palace, in the days when Father and Mother yet lived. The sumptuous feasts, the beatific choirs, the majestic tree that stretched up to the ceiling─would that I could take you there to see it all!
Yet alas, dawn breaks...and our time together must draw to a close. Now rise, my champion, and claim your prize!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Well met, ! I come bearing a gift from the Spinner Herself as guerdon for your most charitable deeds. That said, just between the two of us, this coat is a tad garish for my liking...
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_ALPHINAUD_100_100: Well met, ! I come bearing a gift from the Spinner Herself as guerdon for your most charitable deeds. That said, just between the two of us, this coat is a tad garish for my liking...
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_ALPHINAUD_000_101: How ironic that Nymeia should choose me of all people to do Her bidding. I was a skeptical child, as you might imagine, and quick to doubt the stories of the saint. Grandfather would spare no effort in concocting elaborate tales to preserve the illusion─yet I would not yield in my pursuit of the truth. Oh, the battles of wit we had!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_ALPHINAUD_000_102: While I would like nothing more than to stay and reminisce, I fear I must depart with the dawn. I shall leave your present beneath the tree. Till we next meet, friend!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_TATARU_000_110: A happy Starlight to you, . I come bearing a gift and a song, especially for you! Just a moment... Ahem! Trololololo～lololo～♪
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_TATARU_000_111:
On this most high and holy night,♪
The snow without lies crisp and white...♪
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_TATARU_000_112:
But love burns hot within my heart,♪
I pray that we shall never─♪
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_TATARU_000_113: Oh dear, is that the hour? I'll just have to sing the rest for you another time! Now, what have I forgotten? ...Oh, yes─your present! I'll just leave it under the tree, shall I? Till we meet again!
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_AYMERIC_000_120: I trust this Starlight season finds you well, my friend? I, Aymeric de Borel, lord commander of the Temple Knights of Ishgard, have come to bestow upon you a most special gift.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_AYMERIC_000_121: As you well know, the observance of Starlight traces its origins to my homeland, where it remains a much-beloved tradition to this day.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_AYMERIC_000_122: I have always been quite fond of the season myself. Though I must confess that as colors go, I am somewhat partial to blue...
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_AYMERIC_000_123: Nonetheless, it is both an honor and a pleasure to celebrate this Starlight with you. So as not to disturb your slumber, I shall leave your gift beneath the tree. Be well, my friend.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_125: Good morning to you, friend. Did you rest well?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_130: Good morning to you, friend. Did you─hm? You say there was something waiting for you under the tree?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_140: Well, well. Might it be that miracles are afoot, and the Saint of Nymeia himself has visited us to personally bestow a gift on one of his favorite little helpers?
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_141: Haha! But forgive me my jest. The children were so stirred by your tale that they simply insisted that they return the favor in some way, and I was all too happy to oblige.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_142: Pray accept it as a humble token of gratitude from all of us at the children's ward for the kindness you have shown us this season.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_143: In your dreams, you say? Well, that is most fascinating indeed. Mayhap the sound of me tiptoeing into your room at night stirred your imagination as you slumbered. Or mayhap─well, suffice to say that this is a magical season, and I would not be the least bit surprised if the Spinner Herself sought to repay you for the miracles you have worked.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_144: At any rate, I thank you once more from the bottom of my heart for all you have done for the children. Should you have the time and inclination to share another of your tales, I am certain they would welcome it with ears and hearts wide open...as would I.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_150: Another present from the children and myself. It is not much, but I do hope you find it to your liking.
TEXT_FESXMS204_02378_DAMIELLIOT_000_151: I thank you once more from the bottom of my heart for all you have done for the children. Should you have the time and inclination to share another of your tales, I am sure they would welcome it with ears and hearts wide open.
TEXT_SUBCTS711_02387_WOODWAILERCAPTAIN01: Well met, adventurer. Thanks to your diligence, we have expanded the scope of our reconnaissance missions in the ruins. Unfortunately, we have yet to find any clues as to who, or what, is the source of our problems.
You claimed the undead spoke of a robed figure, correct? Perhaps this is the foul sorcerer who gave birth to the palace and its inhabitants.
To not only create such a labyrinth, but to fill it with the souls of so many innocents... We are dealing with a foe possessed of dark and terrible power.
It pains me to burden you, but on behalf of the Wood Wailers I would ask that you seek out and put an end to the one behind all this. I can think of none more capable for the task at hand.

My men have not the strength to stand with you in the ruins, but rest assured we shall do all we can to support you here at Quarrymill. Now go─drive out the evil of the Palace of the Dead, before the deceased should find their way out into the Twelveswood.
TEXT_SUBCTS711_02387_SYSTEM_000_010: You can now explore beyond floor 50 of the Palace of the Dead.
TEXT_SUBCTS711_02387_WOODWAILERCAPTAIN01: You have done well to complete such a thorough survey of the ruins, but the road ahead is ever more treacherous. Before you proceed, I would know for certain you are duly prepared for the challenges ahead.
TEXT_SUBCTS711_02387_SYSTEM_000_110: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:
TEXT_SUBCTS711_02387_SYSTEM_000_111: ※ You must be at least level 17 with a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_COMGRD101_02389_SERPENTPERSONNEL_00: ! While I am certain that your duties with  demand much of your time already, I wondered if I might have a word?
I shall get right to the point, . The higher-ups have authorized plans to form a specialized squad and we are on the lookout for a reliable leader. Your name was at the top of the list.
You would be responsible for training and commanding a number of adventurer subordinates, and the position also comes with the possibility of further promotion. What say you, ? Are you ready to lead?
Ah. Well, 'tis hardly the response I was hoping for, but 'tis best we are all honest here. A hesitant commander is a danger to  own troops.
Excellent! Let's get you acquainted with your second-in-command immediately.
TEXT_COMGRD101_02389_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_0: It's an honor to be serving with you,  ! In my capacity as your aide, I'll be filling the role of squadron sergeant.
And these eager troopers are the inaugural members of our squadron. Form up!
Every one of them is a fledgling adventurer who enlisted in the hopes of following in your legendary footsteps. They're green to the military, aye, but we'll harden them up soon enough.
When you've a moment to spare, stop by the barracks and we can discuss their training and deployment in greater detail.
I'll leave you to it, then, Commander.
TEXT_COMGRD101_02389_SERPENTPERSONNEL_00: What do you think? I must admit they're raw as soldiers go, but they certainly have potential. I look forward to seeing what you can do with them.
Very well, I shan't keep you any longer. Your squadron's barracks can be found through the door at the back of the .

Enter the  Barracks and speak with your squadron sergeant to issue deployment orders.

TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_REPORTER02399_000_0: Pardon me, . I'm a reporter with the Mythril Eye covering this year's Little Ladies' Day. Might I trouble you with a few questions?
Excellent! Now, lest the throngs of excited folk haven't already given it away, three special little ladies are due to grace the stage shortly.
I speak, of course, of the Songbirds─the talented trio of preteen troubadours that took Ul'dah by storm last year.
Ever since their debut, their popularity has skyrocketed and shows no sign of slowing. Which brings me to my first question: you know them, of course?
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_Q1_000_000: Do you know of the Songbirds?
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_REPORTER02399_000_0: Indeed, it'd be a wonder if you didn't. Now, as I mentioned, the three are scheduled to perform soon...though not soon enough for their legion of devoted fans─the Birdwatchers.
Truly? The names Ulala, Masha, and Narumi do not ring a bell?

Ah, well, I suppose there's bound to be the odd person. At any rate, as I mentioned, the three are scheduled to perform soon...though not soon enough for their legion of devoted fans─the Birdwatchers.

Which brings me to my next question. I'm informed that the royal seneschal, the man in charge of Little Ladies' Day, is experiencing difficulties and has urgent need of help from a capable─and discreet─adventurer.
While I know not the exact nature of the request, I daresay it pertains to the waiting fans, who grow louder and ruder by the minute. What say you? Would you be willing to aid the poor man?
The lack of details gives you pause, and I don't blame you. At the very least, though, I thought you might overlook it for the chance to get close to our starlets.
Well, it's your decision. But should you be inclined to lend a hand, the royal seneschal can be found by the stage on Emerald Avenue.
Just don't be too long in the deciding, however. I fear he won't hold up for much longer.
Oh, and one last thing─do be careful when passing through Emerald Avenue. If you aren't, you may find yourself swept into a tide of hysterical fans with no way out, just as the royal seneschal was!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_GIRLA02399_000_020: This is an outrage! We've been waiting for hours!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_GIRLB02399_000_021: We want Songbirds! We want Songbirds!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_022: L-Ladies and gentlemen, p-please settle down! The Songbirds are currently preparing and will make their appearance shortly. We ask that you wait just a little longer!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_023: , is that you!? Haha! My dear , you couldn't have come at a better time! As you can see, I am in desperate need of your help!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_024: Y-You there! Y-Yes, you, my good adventurer! Are you the one who was sent to help me? You couldn't have come at a better time!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_025: Please, come with me to the Wellhead Lift. I would speak of my plight in a private setting.
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_030: Thank the gods you came when you did! The Birdwatchers have been like that ever since we began stringing up decorations for Little Ladies' Day throughout the city.
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_031: <sigh> If only I could say that was the worst of our problems... You see, while my staff and I labor to quell the unruly fans, we need someone to take on an even more urgent task─someone who is familiar with the city-states and can travel swiftly between them.
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_032: Before I go on, however, I must ask that you keep our conversation in the utmost confidence. If the Birdwatchers were to learn of this, their angry words and raised fists would become pitchforks and torches!
TEXT_FESPDY301_02399_BUTLER_000_033: It is a lot to take in, I understand, but pray do not take too long to consider. I can already hear the angry shouts growing louder!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_000: Y-You'll consent? Oh, thank you! Thank you so very much! <sigh> ...Now where am I to begin?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_001: You see, the girls... We can't find them. Not only that, their costumes are yet to be made or properly fitted...and the hour of the concert is nearly upon us!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_002: Gah! What a fool I was! When they had asked me to allow them to pick out the fabrics and dyes for their dresses, I agreed. Thought it was a brilliant idea, even!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_003: One thing then led to another, and soon just browsing through local wares wasn't enough. They wanted to see what was available elsewhere. Now they've disappeared off to gods know where, and none of my staff has been able to locate them!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_004: I should have known this would happen! No doubt the reason they don't return is because they are lost, are being accosted by frenzied fans, or something even more horrific!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_005: My dear , I beg of you, please find and see that they are escorted back. This is a task I can only entrust to a capable and dependable adventurer such as yourself!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_006: Y-You'll do it? Mere words are not enough to express my gratitude!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_007: Now then, if the tidbits we've been able to gather are anything to go by, Ulala likely is in Limsa Lominsa, Narumi in Horizon, and Masha in Gridania.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_008: I only hope they haven't wandered elsewhere. We simply cannot afford any more delays, or we may very well be in for a good old-fashioned lynching!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_009: Please, make haste, ─lest the situation with the Birdwatchers spirals even further out of control.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_PIRATE02400_000_020: Seven hells! Y-Yer Ulala from the Songbirds, ain't ye!? I-I can't believe me eyes! We've gotta tell the others 'bout this!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_PIRATE02400_000_021: But first─ Oh, bugger me! Wanted to ask fer yer autograph, but I haven't anythin' to write with...
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_023: Pfft! O-Of course you are! Well, in that case, instead of an autograph, how about I give you something even better─a little sneak peek of our concert!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_024: Tee hee hee! Would you look at that─my dulcet voice has drawn yet another devoted follower! Well, , you're just in time for the─ ...Wait a minute. , is that you!?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_025: Tee hee hee! Would you look at that─my dulcet voice has drawn yet another devoted follower! Well, , you're just in time for the─
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_026: The royal seneschal's sent you to find me, you say? I-I had no idea I was running so far behind schedule.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_027: But it isn't my fault─you saw for yourself, right? I'm simply far too irresistible. Fans have been accosting me all day, and it wouldn't do to ignore them.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_028: Right, then. My apologies to have to cut things short, but it seems I have a performance to put on, so I must be off. I hope you come and cheer for me─er, us─the Songbirds!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_029: I would appreciate it if you could keep what happened here between the two of us. F-For the benefit of the team, of course! After all, if Narumi and Masha were to learn of the tremendous number of fans I have, it could very well deteriorate group morale!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Hmmm... Given the quantity, it would be best to move these crates by ship than by chocobo.
Wait a second... I know you! You're ! What are you doing here?
Apologies, . Are you here to make a shipment?
The royal seneschal bids me return at once? But I haven't been here long at all. Hm, how long have I been here?
That long!? Good gods! I-I must hurry back!
Oh, but what of these boxes!?
Gah! What am I thinking!? Now's hardly the time to be fretting over this!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_100: I'm terribly sorry to have to leave you in a lurch, madam, but I really must be going! Though a daunting task, I'm sure you're more than capable of arranging for their delivery on your own!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Now that that's taken care of, I shall return posthaste!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MERCHANT02400_000_0: You've been staring at my samples for hours now but don't seem any closer to reaching a decision. Are you quite sure you don't want to take the night to think it over?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_041: Oh, I'm so very sorry, sir. It's just that they're all so beautiful. <sigh> Maybe I'll just take this one─ Er, actually, maybe...
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_042: <gasp> ! What are you doing here? What a wonderful coincidence it is to see you! You're looking well.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_043: Oh, am I in your way? My apologies─I'll be finished soon...I think.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_044: ...It's that time already!? I-I can't believe it. I spent that long trying to decide on a color?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_045: And I haven't even made up my mind! <sigh> I find something I like, but then I'm unsure whether the other Songbirds would like it too, and I keep second-guessing myself...
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MERCHANT02400_000_0: Wait a second... The Songbirds? You're one of them?
How could I not!? My daughter absolutely adores you!
You're after dyes for your costume, right? A quick moment, if you would.
What do you think of this one? <wink> One of my finest colors for one of my best customers.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_051: It's absolutely perfect! Thank you, sir!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_052: Now that I have my dye, there's no reason to keep the others waiting! To Ul'dah!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_PIRATE02400_000_053: Ain't no mistakin' the radiant smile an' pink locks! That's Ulala from the Songbirds!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_060: Thanks to you the girls have made it back in time and we've managed to avert what could easily have been a Little Ladies' Day catastrophe!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_061: Girls, come here! I think we all owe this wonderful  here a few words of thanks.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_062: You remember  from last year, of course?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_063: As if I could forget! Though if I had, the start you gave me earlier would've been enough to jog my memory! N-Not that I'm complaining, of course! Thank you for coming to get us. We'll repay your kindness with a performance so dazzling, it'll leave you breathless!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_064: Yes, indeed. It's the least we can do for all your help. While we're still works in progress, we're far from the fledglings that took to the stage last year, and we shall do our best to entertain you.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: I've been practicing nigh every waking moment, working hard on both song and dance. I hope you'll be able to appreciate the improvement.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_066: Oh, and while you are expressing your gratitude, why not introduce yourselves as well?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_067: It's great seeing you again, . I'm Ulala, unofficial leader of the Songbirds and soon to be Eorzea's premier songstress. And you─you are soon to be my biggest fan! Tee hee!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_068: It's good to properly meet you, . I'm Narumi. Thank you for all your help earlier. Had you not come to find us, the concert we have practiced day and night for would have all been for naught. Truly, we would be honored if you would attend our performance.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: And I'm Masha Mhakaracca, but you can call me Masha. While I may not have Ulala's silver tongue or Narumi's sweet voice, I more than make up for it with my dancing. Please, come and cheer us on!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_070: Right! Now that we're all assembled, let us set to work. There's still much to do if we are to deliver the promised concert.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_071: First things first: costumes. The girls were meant to see Redolent Rose about them a good while ago. I'm not certain he'd be able─or even willing─to prepare them in such little time, but we must try to prevail upon him.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_072: Considering what happened when I let these three out of my sight, I would feel much more comfortable if you could accompany them to the Weavers' Guild, and see that they return afterwards.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_073: Thank you, . I've already sent the fabrics and dyes the girls picked out to Redolent Rose, so he should know to expect you.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_074: I suspect one look at the girls will be all Redolent Rose needs to know why you're there, but if he asks, simply tell him that I sent you.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_080: On behalf of the Songbirds, I would like to apologize for our tardiness. Please, Mister Redolent Rose, sir, would you still make our costumes for us?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_081: I'm solely to blame for our delay. You needn't make mine if there isn't time, but I beg you not to punish the others for my mistake.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: No one else but you has the skill to make the costumes! If not for us, won't you please do it for the people?
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_REDOLENTROSE_000_08: First, you miss your appointment. Then, you slink in here last minute, asking that I do the job with barely any time at all?
Well, you three best thank your lucky stars that I'm a fan of the Songbirds!
I've been following your ensemble very closely, and have studied up on the themes and motifs you employ. I believe I have a suitable design.
I've already received your preferred dyes and fabrics, so I shall set to work at once. Once your costumes are ready, I'll send for you for a fitting.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Thank you so very much, sir!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_088: To think that a celebrity weaver like Redolent Rose knew about us!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_089: And if he wasn't a fan before, he certainly is now─now that he's met me, that is! Tee hee!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_REDOLENTROSE_000_09: Hahaha! Now, then, I'm sure I'm not the only one who has some last-minute preparations to attend to before the concert begins. I suggest we all set to work.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Well, girls─you heard the man! Let's squeeze in one last practice of our routine to make sure we don't make any silly mistakes!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_092: I've already perfected all the steps and can hit every note, so I don't need the practice. But I suppose it wouldn't hurt to help the two of you rehearse.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_093: Th-Thank you, Mister Redolent Rose, sir. We can't wait to see you later at the performance!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_094: Sir, we have nowhere else to go! Will you make our costumes for us? Pretty, pretty please with rolanberries on top!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_095: If only I wasn't so indecisive, this never would have happened! Oh, why did I have to spend all that time on picking out a color...
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: If you're not willing to do it for us, please sir, think of the fans and citizens of Ul'dah! They're looking forward to seeing our dresses as much as we are to wearing them!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_REDOLENTROSE_000_09: Not to worry, adventurer. I shall send the costumes over, soon as they are ready.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_100: The girls tell me Redolent Rose agreed to make their costumes! Haha! What wonderful news!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_101: Thanks to you, our biggest problems have been resolved, and we are finally on track to hold the concert. There is just one last thing to be done.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_102: That is, , we must choose who shall take center stage at the opening show and thereby lead the Songbirds to greater heights!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_103: My staff and I have spent so much time with the girls, our judgment has become clouded. You, on the other hand, know the Songbirds just well enough to assess their strengths and weaknesses.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_104: And with your eye for talent, you would no doubt know which of the girls the audience desires most to see take to the forefronts of the stage!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_BUTLER_000_105: Now, the three are already aware that I mean to entrust the decision to you, and they nervously await your answer. Once your mind is made, pray inform the chosen directly.
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_ULALA_000_106: Tee hee! I simply can't wait to see how amazing I'll look in my new dress!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_NARUMI_000_107: Thank the gods that Redolent Rose was also a fan of our ensemble, else we might never have gotten our dresses!
TEXT_FESPDY302_02400_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Only our very best performance will do if we are to make up for the trouble we've caused, and we will deliver it!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_SYSTEM_000_000: Please note that once you accept this quest, you will be unable to accept the quests “Masha's Grand Performance” and “Narumi's Grand Performance.”
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_SYSTEM_000_001: While the reward will remain the same, the outcome of this event will change based upon which of these quests you decide to accept.
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_Q1_000_000: By accepting this quest, you will be choosing Ulala. Are you sure you would like to proceed?
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_A1_000_002: I'd like to have a moment to think things over.
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_002: Wh-What? Of course I'm not surprised! I-I didn't doubt for a second that you would choose me. After all, I am Eorzea's future number one songstress!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_003: And while I may have been the obvious choice, I would nevertheless like to thank you for your support, . It means the world to me. Without you, none of what we accomplished here today would have been even remotely possible.
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_004: You swooped in and lent us your strength when we needed it most─like back there in Limsa Lominsa when I was being held up by overzealous fans. Had it not been for you, I would have never escaped and there would be no show for me to lead!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_005: I-I've also been meaning to thank you for not mentioning that incident to the others. Why? B-Because it would have broken their spirits─that's why! After all, there's no nice way to tell someone that they're nowhere near as popular as you!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_006: <sigh> I'm not fooling anyone, am I? Fine, I'll admit it! My air of nonchalance─it's...it's an act. I like being out there. I like meeting my fans and making them happy. But I'm trying to cultivate an image, and I can't let the truth get out. Not even to my friends.
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_007: Wh-Why are you looking at me like that? It-It's not as though I'm planning on leaving the Songbirds for a solo career. The thought never even crossed my mind!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_ULALA_000_008: I-I should probably go now. The girls want to get in one last practice session before we take to the stage. Thank you, ! You won't be disappointed you chose me!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_BUTLER_000_010: So, my friend, have you decided who will be taking center stage?
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_BUTLER_000_011: Ulala? Indeed, you make a convincing case. The passion and self-confidence she brings to each and every performance is sure to captivate both audience and passersby alike!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_BUTLER_000_012: And speaking of captivating, while you were out speaking with Ulala, Redolent Rose came by with a very special delivery. You guessed it! The girls' costumes have finally arrived and they're absolutely splendid!
TEXT_FESPDY303_02401_BUTLER_000_013: While organizing this event has been a grueling task, to say the least, one cannot say it wasn't worth it when they look upon these! Haha!
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_SYSTEM_000_000: Please note that once you accept this quest, you will be unable to accept the quests “Ulala's Grand Performance” and “Narumi's Grand Performance.”
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_SYSTEM_000_001: While the reward will remain the same, the outcome of this event will change based upon which of these quests you decide to accept.
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_Q1_000_000: By accepting this quest, you will be choosing Masha. Are you sure you would like to proceed?
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_A1_000_002: I'd like to have a moment to think things over.
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: T-Truly? You want for me to take the lead at the upcoming performance? I hardly dare believe it!
Thank you, . While I'd be lying if I said I'm not the slightest bit nervous, I will do whatever it takes to ensure the Songbirds deliver their best performance to date!

I owe it to you for not only granting me this wonderful opportunity, but also for all your earlier help. Had you not come to find me when you did, I'm afraid there would have been no show for me to lead!
<sigh> I should have never allowed myself to get so distracted by something so trivial─and right before such an important event of all times!
It did serve to remind me, however, that I mustn't lose sight of what's before me. Nor forget why I chose to become a Songbird.
That is, to do what I am about to do─take the stage and dance my way into the people's hearts!

I-I suppose we're getting a touch too sentimental now! And while that doesn't make anything I said earlier any less true, I shall leave it at that. , I certainly hope to see you at our performance later─it wouldn't be the same without you!
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_BUTLER_000_010: So, my friend, have you decided who will be taking center stage?
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_BUTLER_000_011: Masha? Indeed, you make a convincing case. When she dances, the whole world stops to gaze upon her grace. No doubt our audience will be left breathless after such a display!
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_BUTLER_000_012: And speaking of breathtaking displays, while you were out speaking with Masha, Redolent Rose came by with a very special delivery. You guessed it! The girls' costumes have finally arrived and they're absolutely gorgeous!
TEXT_FESPDY304_02406_BUTLER_000_013: While organizing this event has been a grueling task, to say the least, one cannot say it wasn't worth it when they look upon these! Haha!
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_SYSTEM_000_000: Please note that once you accept this quest, you will be unable to accept the quests “Ulala's Grand Performance” and “Masha's Grand Performance.”
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_SYSTEM_000_001: While the reward will remain the same, the outcome of this event will change based upon which of these quests you decide to accept.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_Q1_000_000: By accepting this quest, you will be choosing Narumi. Are you sure you would like to proceed?
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_A1_000_002: I'd like to have a moment to think things over.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_NARUMI_000_002: Y-You think that I should be the one to take the center stage? Truly, I'd love to, , but do you think I'm right for the role?
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_NARUMI_000_003: Ah, there I go again, questioning my own ability. <sigh> It's the same sort of self-doubt that landed me in trouble at Horizon earlier.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_NARUMI_000_004: The dye, which had me so distraught then, now seems inconsequential standing here with you... It goes to prove that fear is but a figment of one's mind, and we can conquer it if only we choose.
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_NARUMI_000_005: I will be more decisive...and what better way to start than by leading the Songbirds in the coming show? I will proudly take center stage, and I will put a smile on the faces of all present!
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_NARUMI_000_006: You can count on me, . With Ulala and Masha at my side, I shall bring you a performance you won't soon forget!
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_NARUMI_000_007: Oh, look at the time! My apologies, but I must see to my preparations. Once again, thank you for all that you have done for us! See you very soon!
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_BUTLER_000_010: So, my friend, have you decided who will be taking center stage?
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_BUTLER_000_011: Narumi? Indeed, you make a convincing case. Her gentle demeanor and soft voice will warm the audience to their very cores, and they'll go home feeling as though they caught a glimpse into the heavens themselves!
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_BUTLER_000_012: And speaking of heaven, while you were out speaking with Narumi, Redolent Rose came by with a very special delivery. You guessed it! The girls' costumes have finally arrived and they're absolutely divine!
TEXT_FESPDY305_02407_BUTLER_000_013: While organizing this event has been a grueling task, to say the least, one cannot say it wasn't worth it when they look upon these! Haha!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_000: , the moment we have all been waiting for is upon us! Now that their costumes are here, and we know who will be leading them, the Songbirds are ready to take to the Little Ladies' Day stage!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_001: They are there, at Emerald Avenue, making final preparations. Let us hurry and join them!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_ULALA_000_002: I'm so excited about our new dresses, I can hardly think straight!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_NARUMI_000_003: Look, , he came! Redolent Rose really came! And he's cheering for us!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: That we're here and ready to perform in spite of everything is nothing short of a miracle─a miracle made by you, Redolent Rose, and many others.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_010: , all the blood, sweat, and tears we have poured into making this event a reality are about to pay off!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_100_010: Girls, it is time! Step out there, give the audience what they came for, and make us all proud!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_011: The audience, ─do you see you how their eyes shine, utterly entranced? The earlier vitriol has completely melted away to be replaced with pure delight! The girls have done it! Little Ladies' Day is a rousing success!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_012: And to think I was so convinced that letting the Songbirds go off on their own would ruin all of Little Ladies' Day. Haha! Looking back, I say if anything, all the trouble we encountered along the way has made the conclusion of this event that much more satisfying.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_013: Why, seeing the girls performing now, I would go so far as to say that their hardships have served to bring out the very best in the Songbirds.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_014: Now then, as much as I would like to watch the performance to the end, I must return to my post on the Ruby Road Exchange. There is, however, something I wish to give you later, so please come find me when you are able.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_THREEPRINCESSES_100: (-The Songbirds-)Ladies and gentlemen! Thank you for your patience! Let's make this a Little Ladies' Day to remember!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_020: The Songbirds─they were magnificent, weren't they? Be proud, my friend! It is a success that can largely be attributed to you!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_021: For all your hard work, I would like to present you with these─vouchers that can be exchanged for a variety of Little Ladies' Day goods.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_022: As with past Little Ladies' Days, we have a large selection of items on offer, but this year we are carrying something special.
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_023: And lest you wonder, Redolent Rose was kind enough to design a gentleman's variant of the outfit, that men the realm over might also celebrate as the ladies do!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_024: Should, for whatever reason, you find yourself short on vouchers, any items that catch your fancy can always be bought the traditional way─and by that I mean with gil, of course!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_BUTLER_000_025: Thank you again, ! Now, please, go forth and enjoy what is left of this merriest of seasons. You have more than earned it! Oh, and don't forget─the Songbirds will continue performing throughout the duration of the event. If you have need of cheer, you know where to find them!
TEXT_FESPDY306_02408_SYSTEM_000_026: You have learned the emote Songbird!
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_000: Fair adventurer, 'tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance during this most lovesome of seasons.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_010: Ah, but I remember you! It has been some time since we last met, but I would never allow a  face such as yours to fade from memory.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_030: I do hope you are enjoying the festivities. There is no doubt in my mind that my ancestor, Countess Arabelle de Valentione, would be overjoyed to know that her legacy had inspired this wonderful tribute to her memory.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_031: Alas, the pioneering countess is no longer with us, but her spirit lives on in my retinue and I that have made the journey from Ishgard. We intend to see that the lost lovers of this realm are not left wanting for succor! Tee hee～♪
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_032: But we must not get ahead of ourselves, for there is still much work to be done. Though countless souls seek love's sweet embrace, it is ever fleeting and ethereal in nature. Truly, the power of love is quite a curious thing.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_033: That is why we have taken it upon ourselves to pass along to the populace a time-honored House Valentione tradition. However, be forewarned, this approach is somewhat potent, so see that you do not abuse it. We cannot be having the whole of Eorzea fall in love with you now, can we?
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_034: Now run along and have dearest Hortefense tell you more. Why, it was only last year that he found true love and I am sure he is eager to see others do the same. Tee hee～♪
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_LISETTE_000_040: Have you spoken with my dear Hortefense yet? No? Well, do strike while the iron is hot─even as we speak, lonely hearts across the realm cry out for succor!
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_000_050: Why, if it isn't that most charming adventurer that helped me some time ago. I thank you again for your kindness; it is in no small part due to you that my eyes were opened to my true love. Mayhap this rather lovely lesson I shall impart upon you today will go some way towards repaying the favor.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_000_060: Well met, brave adventurer! I trust you have been sent by Lady Lisette for a lesson in love?
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_000_070: Excellent! Now, I myself have not always been the luckiest in love, but experience has taught me that each and every one of us has the potential to realize our romantic dreams─we simply must needs learn to properly express our passion! Pray watch my demonstration and do your best to reproduce it.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_100_070: Be not disheartened─your effort was a valiant one. If you lack for experiences from which to draw inspiration, why, mayhap you might try and picture your beloved...? Ah, on second thought, perhaps it is best if you persevere with your initial approach.
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_110_070: Alas, this reminds me of mine own struggles. But you must not falter! If I was able to overcome the timidity and self-doubt that once plagued me, surely a courageous adventurer such as yourself can achieve the same!
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_120_070: Mayhap it was my demonstration that was lacking... Let us try once more. This time, breathe in deep the love in the air and let the passion flow freely from your lips!
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_130_070: ...Do mine eyes deceive me? No, by the Fury, you've done it!
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_HORTEFENSE_000_071: Such fervor! Such passion! To see you transform like this before my very eyes─truly, this alone has made the journey from Ishgard worthwhile! Pray go forth and use your newfound knowledge─that you might forge an eternal bond with your beloved. Godsspeed!
TEXT_FESVLT301_02419_SYSTEM_000_080: You have learned the emote Dote!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_000: Now that you have learned the art of doting, 'tis time you put it to good use. As you may know, blowing a kiss in the direction of the apple of your eye requires unspeakable courage─which is why I propose you practice first!
