TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_001: To that end, I suggest you visit those who have supported you on your adventures thus far and express your appreciation. I speak of the three proprietors of Eorzea's Adventurers' Guild, of course! I know I certainly would never have found true love if not for the encouragement of mine own friends!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_002: Surely, naught could go amiss were you to give your favorite guildmaster or mistress a kiss─or two, or even three!─as an expression of your gratitude. Yes, I can imagine no way they could possibly misconstrue your actions.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_004: To begin with, why not head to the Carline Canopy? It's right in the neighborhood, and I hear that Baderon and Momodi have joined Mother Miounne there to partake in the festivities. Word has it that they shall also be heading to the Quicksand and the Drowning Wench later.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_010: Are you perchance still feeling too shy to share your innermost feelings with your true love? If you feel you are in need of more practice, why not pay another visit to the proprietors of the Adventurers' Guilds? They may appreciate the continued display of affection.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_011: Take heart, friend! Keep at it and eventually it will become second nature. Now, go forth once more and deliver some seasonal cheer to the guildmasters.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_020: Why do you tarry, friend? There is a whole new world of ardor and affection just waiting for you out there! Go and practice sharing your deepest emotions with your friends, that one day you will be prepared to share your soul with the one you hold dearest.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_021: Ah, is it truly that time of year once more? I cannot say I have had much occasion to celebrate Valentione's Day in recent years, but there certainly is something to be said for sharing your feelings with those dearest to you.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_022: 'Ad to come 'ere to sort out some guild business, but bloody 'ells those trees sure let ye know yer in Gridania. Really clogged up me nose, they 'ave. Aye, there's no doubt in me mind─I'm a Limsa man and ever will be!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_023: I'm just here to handle some guild matters, but I managed to snag a pipin' hot cup of tea from Mother Miounne on the side. It's the little things in life!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_030: Why, ! Whatever has gotten into you? I know 'tis the season for love, but I had always thought our own relationship to be more...professional.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_031: It was simply an expression of your appreciation, you say? I must admit, you startled me somewhat, but I am touched by the sentiment.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_040: Though truly, I have done nothing so significant to be deserving of such...profuse affection. On the contrary, it is I who should thank you for all you have done on behalf of Gridania and our realm. I hope we can continue to count on you for years to come, .
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_050: Though truly, I have done nothing so significant to be deserving of such...profuse affection. On the contrary, it is I who should thank you for all you have done on behalf of Gridania and our realm. I hope we can continue to count on you for years to come.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_060: Oi! What in the 'ells do ye think yer doin'!? Did I look like I was standin' 'ere just waiting for a big sloppy one!?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_061: Just yer way o' sayin' thanks, ye say? Well, I guess it is the season fer it... Didn't 'alf startle me clean out of me boots, mind ye!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_062: Not that I'm complainin' that someone finally decided to thank me for doin' this job. Yer a good , .
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_063: Anyroad, I best be on me way. Got a guild meeting to attend, as it 'appens. Do pop in the Drowning Wench next time yer in Limsa.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_070: ...? Are you feelin' quite all right? If I didn't know better, I could've sworn you just tried to kiss me!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_071: Your way of sayin' thanks!? Listen, it's not that I don't appreciate the sentiment, but don't you think the season's gone to your head a bit?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_072: Mind you, it has given me a nice little boost─and somethin' to smile about once the day's done! You may have an odd way of expressin' yourself, but I could get used to being thanked every now and then.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_073: Anyroad, it's about time for me to head off! Got a guild meeting scheduled, and you know they can't start without Ul'dah's most fiery desert rose.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_080: My duties with the guild frequently bring me to Ul'dah. 'Tis a fine city indeed, but this heat can be quite trying compared to the more temperate climes of Gridania. Yes, the forest will ever be my home.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_081: I always stop off 'ere to scoff some grub whenever I'm in Ul'dah. 'Aven't the faintest who Momodi 'as workin' the kitchens, but she chose well, I reckon.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_082: Your, ah...creative gesture of thanks back there got me thinkin'─there's somethin' to be said for takin' the time to express our true feelings to those around us. And I reckon Valentione's Day's as good a time as any to do it. Don't suppose you'd happen to have anyone in mind?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_090: Why, ! Whatever 'as gotten into you? I know 'tis the season for love, but I 'ad always thought our own relationship to be more...professional.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_091: It was simply an expression of your appreciation, you say? I must admit, you startled me somewhat, but I am touched by the sentiment.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_092: It warms my heart that we can count an adventurer as delightful as yourself among our ranks. Pray continue to grace us with your charming presence.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_093: I would love to stay and chat a while longer, but alas, I have a guild meeting I must attend. I look forward to seeing you again at the Canopy in the not-too-distant future, friend!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_100: Why, ! I do not mean to spurn your gratitude, but you are making me blush...
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_101: Truly, I have done naught so special as to deserve such a grand display of thanks. It is an honor being able to serve adventurers such as yourself─an honor I hope to continue to be blessed with for many years to come.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_102: Speaking of which, there is one last guild meeting for me to attend before the  is over. Farewell for now.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_110: Again!? Look, I get that yer grateful, I really do, but if yer expectin' me to treat you to a tankard o' me finest on the house, ye can think again!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_111: The guild's me job, after all, an' it's adventurers like you what do the dirty work. If ye really must show your appreciation, what say ye buy ol' Baderon a flagon of ale next time?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_112: Anyroad, I'd best be movin' on. Plenty o' guild dealin's still to be done, and someone 'as to do the doin'. Till next time, .
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_120: ...? Are you feelin' quite all right? If I didn't know better, I could've sworn you just tried to kiss me!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_121: Your way of sayin' thanks!? Listen, it's not that I don't appreciate the sentiment, but don't you think the season's gone to your head a bit?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_122: You won't find me blowin' kisses in your direction, but don't get me wrong─I'm grateful to you all the same. You're a shinin' star to adventurers the realm over, and I hope you'll continue to shine bright for years to come.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_130: Look, now. The sentiment's touchin' and all, but do you think you could find a more...subtle way of expressin' it? People might get the wrong idea.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_131: It is nice though, bein' thanked now and then, and your timin' is spot on given the season! You know what, you might be onto something here...
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_132: Think up a slightly more normal way of showin' your gratitude and I'd be more than glad to be thanked a hundred times over! You'd be setting a good example for all the other adventurers in the Quicksand too. You know, maybe it wouldn't hurt if you stopped by a little more often.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_140: The food at the Drowning Wench really has a special something to it, don't you think? I always make a point of stopping by when business brings me to Limsa Lominsa. The cuisine truly spurs me on to better the Canopy's dishes.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_141: Valentione's Day is great an' all, but it doesn' 'alf distract me workers from the task at 'and. I ain't payin' ye people to wander around in a lovey-dovey stupor!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_142: The climate here is a welcome change to the swelterin' winds of Thanalan, for sure. Although I can't say I'm too keen on that smell of what I'm guessing is...rotting fish?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_150: I suppose they do say the third time's a charm, but you're starting to make me feel somewhat flustered. Have I truly done enough to warrant all these displays of gratitude?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_151: Not that I meant to say your gesture is unwelcome. It is up to me to prove that I am worthy of your thanks.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_152: Speaking of which, I must get back to the Canopy. I have no doubt there will be plenty of adventurers there waiting for a nice hot cup of tea. Well, , I suppose I shall see you again sometime soon.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_160: Oi! What in the 'ells do ye think yer doin'!? Did I look like I was standin' 'ere just waiting for a big sloppy one!?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_161: Just yer way o' sayin' thanks, ye say? Well, I guess it is the season fer it... Didn't 'alf startle me clean out of me boots, mind ye!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_162: Not that I mean to belittle yer gesture, o' course! It's nice that someone finally decided to thank me for doin' this job. Much obliged, . I look forward to yer continued patronage o' the Wench.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_170: Again!? Look, I get that yer grateful, I really do, but if yer expectin' me to treat you to a tankard o' me finest on the house, ye can think again!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_171: The guild's me job, after all, an' it's adventurers like you what do the dirty work. If ye really must show your appreciation, what say ye buy ol' Baderon a flagon of ale next time?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_172: And I would 'ave ye know, I'm just as grateful for ye too─even though I might not be the best at showin' it. Just remember, there'll always be a seat for ye in me tavern, . Ye can count on that.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_180: I could've sworn we agreed ye'd treat me to some ale the last time we met. More importantly, don't ye 'ave anyone else ye fancy showerin' with yer love fer a change? Honestly, seems yer gratitude is as bottomless as the flagons at this very tavern!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_181: Which ain't to say I don't appreciate the sentiment. Yer sheer tenacity shows I must be doin' somethin' right─and I'll do me best to make sure I keep it up!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_182: Stop by whenever yer thirsty for the realm's finest ale, ! Heck, maybe if yer lucky, I'll bump into ye on the road somewhere.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_200: Look, now. The sentiment's touchin' and all, but do you think you could find a more...subtle way of expressin' it? People might get the wrong idea.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_201: It is nice though, to be thanked now and then─and your timin' is spot on given the season! You know what, think up a slightly more normal way of showin' your gratitude, and I'd be more than glad to be thanked a hundred times over!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_202: It's time I was on my way, anyroad. Plenty of guild matters to get to! No doubt I'll be seeing you in the Quicksand again soon─no one can resist its call for too long!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_210: Look, , I appreciate the attention and all, but are you seriously tellin' me there ain't anyone else out there you should be thankin'?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_211: Let me guess...you've not been so lucky in love lately? Don't feel like you can't open up to me about your worries─I know a thing or two when it comes to matters of the heart!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_212: Sadly I can't help you right now, as work calls, dear ! But don't forget, I'm always around if you need someone to talk to.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_220: Welcome back, adventurer! The rosy hue of your cheeks gives me the most tantalizing of glimpses into the journey of romance and passion you have embarked upon.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_221: But this is no time to be resting on your laurels! The moment you have been working towards is finally at hand. Go forth and lay your heart bare to the one for whom you pine!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_230: Oh.... I was hoping I might find you here. Your displays of gratitude gave me pause for thought, and before I knew it, I was making my way to this very spot.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_231: I could not help myself from wondering how best to prove that I am worthy of your thanks. It is somewhat embarrassing to admit, but it has even distracted me from my duties at the guild.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_232: And yet the answer was staring me in the face the whole time. Or should I say, its aroma wafting up gently into my nose. I speak of tea, of course. I can think of no way more natural for me to support the guild's adventurers.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_233: I simply need to make sure the Canopy continues to exist as a space where all those traveling through Eorzea may take respite. That is how it has always been and I pray it will never change.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MIOUNNE_000_234: Speaking of which, I should be getting back to the Canopy. Do stop by again when you feel in need of some respite from the road. I'll see to it you're served with a hot cup of tea which warms your heart, just as you have warmed mine.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_240: ! Just the  I was 'opin' to find. I'd been tryin' to make sense of all yer gestures o' thanks today and figured I'd just come and talk to ye meself.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_241:
It 'as to be said though, being a middle-aged bloke on Valentione's Day can make ye feel a lot like ye've been left at sea.
...Mayhap it's time I found meself a comely wench to settle down with.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_242: Oi, don't ye give me that look, now! The thought of a bloody litter o' little Baderons runnin' about scares me just as much as anyone, believe you me.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_243: Besides, I already 'ave a family bein' in charge of this guild as it is! Aye, me 'ands are plenty full with green adventurers wanderin' in every day─never mind actual bloody children.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_244: And never forget that ye too are part of me adventurer family! Wenches are all well an' good, but I reckon that the most important one 'as been mine all along. Aye, she may be drownin', but we ain't all perfect.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_BADERON_000_245: And I'll do me very best to make sure she's the finest of 'omes for all me adventurin' family. Speakin' o' the Wench, 'bout time I were 'eadin' back. I've left the pub in the 'ands of S'dhodjbi, and it's makin' me sweat to say the least. Don't forget to stop by again sometime soon, !
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_250: ! Just the person I was looking for! I was havin' a chuckle recallin' all your gestures today and decided I'd come pay you a visit─see if you hadn't thought up any new ways of showin' your gratitude.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_251: It might not look like it, , but believe it or not I do worry sometimes. I wonder whether or not all that I do is truly makin' a difference in the world, and that sort of thing.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_252: But then I see the huge smiles on the faces of so many adventurers, just like you, and I think of all the good you do for the realm.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_253: That's why I'm goin' to keep expressing my love through the Quicksand. In short: sorry, , but if you felt anythin' other than gratitude for me, you'll have to give up─there's far too many other adventurers that need my attention!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_MOMODI_000_254: And on that note, it really is time I headed back. Lookin' forward to seein' your novel new way of expressin' your thanks the next time you visit me!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_260: Although, judging by the look on your face, mayhap you are yet to discover your special someone? Pray wait a short while, dear adventurer, I have an idea. I shall return posthaste!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_LISETTE_000_261: Well, if it isn't House Valentione's favorite adventurer! Truly, we are ever in your debt for all you have done to help spread love across the land. Is there something you would ask of me?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_262: Dearest Lissie, as you know, I have been trying to teach our friend how best to express the love that lies deep within. As I began to wonder if my earlier instructions were not somewhat lacking, it hit me─what better way to show  how it is done than with a demonstration of our love!?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_264: We must needs have  see the romantic passion between us as it bubbles to the surface, before erupting, covering all in love's lava! Do you not agree, Lisette?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_LISETTE_000_265: Do you really think for one second I would do such a bleedin' ridiculous thing!? Are you sure just one adventurer's enough? Why don't we invite all of Eorzea to watch!?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_266:
'Tis no time to be getting cold feet, Lissie! The two of us have been bonded for eternity, to be one forevermore!
Or could it be─heavens, no! Has our love's candle had its ferocious flame extinguished?
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_LISETTE_000_267:
What are you saying, you absolute nincompoop! Only someone as dull-witted as you would think such ridiculous things!
You know you're my...handsomest honeysuckle.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_268: Oh, Lissie! My love for you is as the waves crashing ceaselessly against the shore─nothing shall remain untouched by our sea of passion!
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_269: ...Oh, still there, are you? My apologies for getting caught up in the moment. But heavens, you look like you've seen a ghost! As I have little else to teach you, mayhap 'tis time we put an end to this lesson. Let Menphina draw the curtain, as it were.
TEXT_FESVLT302_02420_HORTEFENSE_000_270: But do not fret, bold adventurer! We shall ever be there for you if you find yourself wanting for more succor. Fare thee well!
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Greetings, friend! Drawn to the beautiful adornments of Hatching-tide, I take it?
Oh, it's you, ! What a delight to see you again!

Since we found our “shining, golden treasure,” I've been visiting the little fellow as often as I'm able. He is fast growing into a fine young bird, and I smile to imagine what this year's event might have in store for us.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: I'm Jihli Aliapoh, and you are...? 'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I pray you will join in the revelry with us!

Lest you wonder, the festival was born of a prophetic dream I had a long time ago. It has since grown to become the grand celebration you see now, and I smile to imagine what this year's event might have in store for us.
You see, I've been blessed with a new vision: an egg, hovering in the air, from which a chocobo emerges to startle folk before going on to lay a magnificent, dazzling gemstone. Surreal, I know.
Yet, surreal as it was, if we can recreate the vision, something magical is bound to happen. For this we needed a hovering egg...which proved rather rarer than one might think.
But sure enough, my good friend and helper Nonotta managed to find precisely such an egg as appeared in my dream. Without a doubt a gift from the Archons of old!
With the egg, we shall host a rousing Hatching-tide to be remembered. In so doing, the dazzling gemstone will surely reveal itself to us.

If you would lend a hand in making my vision reality, please seek out Nonotta in Hyrstmill. She has care of the floating egg and will furnish you with further instructions. Off you go, now, and eggspeed!
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_030: Ah, back to help us celebrate another Hatching-tide? You have our thanks!
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_035: Greetings, adventurer. I take it you wish to help us celebrate Hatching-tide? You have our thanks!
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_040: This year, in order to recreate Jihli's vision, we are dividing participants into two groups: the startlers and the startled. As you seem to be an accomplished rider, I assign you to the former.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_041: Your task is simple: ride atop a hovering egg and give folk a jolly good startling. Lest you worry, it's as easy as riding a chocobo.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_042: You seem unsettled. Does something about the egg give you pause?
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_Q1_000_000: What will you ask about the egg?
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_045: Heh, we didn't actually find the egg so much as built it ourselves. We couldn't bear to see Jihli disappointed, you see.
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_050: Well, of course it's safe! We built it ourselves, I'll have you know!
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_055: Recall you the giant, floating eggs we used before? Well, it operates the same way─with wisdom and parts borrowed from the ancients. Add some refinements and external touches, and voilà! Ridable egg! The eggshilaration system, I call it, and it's a marvel of engineering, if I do say so my─
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_060: Hovering eggs simply don't...well, exist. We had to make it by borrowing the wisdom and parts of ancients. Add some external touches, though, and voilà! Ridable egg! The eggshilaration system, I call it, and it's a marvel of engineering, if I do say so my─
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_NONOTTA_000_066: I-I beg you, you mustn't breathe a word of this to Jihli! Promise me you'll keep it to yourself, cross your heart and hope to die!
TEXT_FESEST301_02421_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: Nonotta has care of the hovering egg. Please seek her out in Hyrstmill to receive further instructions. Off you go, now, and eggspeed!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_000: So, I take it you'll keep the eggshilaration system's true nature a secret?
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_001: You've put my mind at ease! With that settled, let's get you on eggback, shall we? Motte yonder will assist you; let her know when you are ready.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MOTTE_000_010: You wish to ride the eggshilaration system? But of course!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MOTTE_000_011: Hop on, and you should see a button. That's for launching the shockobo, a lifelike, shock-inducing chocobo doll. Why don't you try using it now on Nonotta? She won't mind, trust me!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_SYSTEM_000_012: Launch the shockobo at Nonotta to give her a fright. The action can be selected from the pet hotbar.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_015: Motte yonder will help you onto the eggshilaration system; let her know when you are ready.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_020: Uwaaah! Oh, my goodness... The shockobo never fails to work on me, and it's my brainchild.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_021: <sigh> If only it worked half as well on Jihli... When we used it on her, she simply chuckled and said, “Such a sense of humor the Archons must have had!”
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_022: Ack, but I shouldn't complain. Suffice it to say none of this is for Jihli's ears.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_023: At any rate, the show must go on. And from this point on, your role in the festivities begins in earnest.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_024: Festival participants are scattered throughout the Twelveswood. Find them and startle them silly with the shockobo. In return they'll give you shock eggs, which you can exchange for unique prizes.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_025: To begin with, try startling, say, three people. When you have their eggs, bring them back to me.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_026: Ah, the very image of Jihli's vision! Now, you handle the egg like an Archon, but how well can you handle the shockobo?
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MOTTE_000_030: Oh? Fell off the egg, did you? Never you mind─given the shape, it's bound to happen. Here, let me help you back on.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_ACTOR02422_000_040: Uwaaah! Twelve have mercy! 'Tis a demon bird, risen from the seventh hell to reave my soul! Woe is me! I am...I am undone!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_ACTOR02422_000_041: ...Well, how was it? My performance, that is. I'm an aspiring actor, you see, and I joined in Hatching-tide so I could practice my craft. Next time, I believe I'll explore...denial. Yes, just a hint to add depth to the character's vulnerabilities.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_ACTOR02422_000_042: Ah, but before I forget, this shock egg's for you. And with that, it's back to rehearsing for me.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MAN02422_000_045: Gah! S-Seven hells, I swear it's worse when you know it's comin'. So, er, what happens now? The chocobo lays a gemstone?
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MAN02422_000_046: ...No? Should've known it was too good to be true. More's the pity─was the main reason I volunteered for this. You can't put much store by dreams, bad as I feel for that Jihli lass.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MAN02422_000_047: Anyroad, here's your shock egg. Gotta hand out as many as I can if I wanna collect my prize.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_WOMAN02422_000_050: Eeeeeek! M-My heart fairly stopped. After so many frights, you think you'd get used to it...
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_WOMAN02422_000_051: But I must say, the egg never ceases to amaze me. How in the world do they make it hover like that?
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_WOMAN02422_000_052: Oh, but I owe you a shock egg, for a fine shock rendered. Loud as I scream each time, I find the sensation quite addictive. My thanks, adventurer!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_055: You seem to have mislaid the egg, adventurer. Pun intended. Talk to Motte, and she'll help you back on it.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_ACTOR02422_000_056: Won't someone launch a shockobo at me already? I'm itching to test out a new variation on a theme of “startled.”
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MAN02422_000_057: If you're not gonna fire a shockobo at me, bugger off. I've got shock eggs I need to give out.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_WOMAN02422_000_058: Oh, where's my next shock coming from? The suspense is too much to bear!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_060: Ah, welcome back. Have your startling efforts met with success, and you have the shock eggs to show for it?
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_061: Three eggs, precisely as ordered! You've done well, my friend.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_WOMAN02422_000_063: Hells' bells, that was a shock an' a half! You never mentioned there'd be others out there tryin' to startle us!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_064: Others? Whatever are you talking about?
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MAN02422_000_065: The spriggan ridin' a rock, what else? Fella appeared without warnin' an' gave me the fright of my life. I fair soiled myself!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_ACTOR02422_000_066: I as well! It was all so real and visceral, I didn't even have to act! Joining in the festival was the best decision ever!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_WOMAN02422_000_067: Hear, hear! Ah, but the exquisite flush of the fright begins to fade. I'll need another one soon. Perhaps if I were to follow the spriggan to Gridania... Oh, and thank you, Miss Dreamer! I haven't had this much fun in a long while!
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_NONOTTA_000_069: Um, adventurer? Rock-riding spriggans aren't part of the plan, and I have a terrible feeling about this. We may have need of your aid beyond simply startling townsfolk.
TEXT_FESEST302_02422_MOTTE_000_075: How fares the startling effort, adventurer? When you've collected three shock eggs, be sure to take them to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_000: You'll help us? I knew we could depend on you, adventurer. Thank you!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_001: Should the spriggan cause a commotion in the city, the blame would inevitably fall upon our festival. In the worst case scenario, the authorities might permanently ban it. We cannot allow that to happen!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_002: Let us make haste to Gridania. Jihli needs to be alerted...assuming all hells haven't already broken loose.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Ah, ! Nonotta has told me everything.
As she had feared, a rock-riding spriggan appeared in the city and began startling hapless citizens, one after another. It's been utter chaos, and everyone thinks it's all part of Hatching-tide.

It didn't take long for word to reach the Wood Wailers, who are none too pleased. They are threatening to take swift and decisive action, which is to say hunt down the intruder. It must not come to violence, . Nay, we must find a peaceful solution─reach out to the spriggan somehow.
Riggy is his name, and he's taken up residence at Greatloam Growery. By all accounts, he has become extremely agitated. We must soothe him somehow before the situation deteriorates. With me, .
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_015: There you are! I've informed Jihli of our spriggan problem, and she has a plan. Hurry and have it from her.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_STONESPRIGGAN02423_: Riggy is confuse! Confuse make fear! Fear make angry! Aaangryyy!
Riggy no bad spriggy! Riggy only watchy! Watchy copyyy!
You ride biggy egg! Riggy ride biggy rock! Same! Saaaaaame!
You make people laugh! Laugh make happy! Happy good! Riggy want make happy!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_028: It would seem Riggy was mimicking you. He simply wished to be a part of Hatching-tide.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: Well, our festival is open to one and all, and we'd all be richer for Riggy's presence. Don't you agree?
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_STONESPRIGGAN02423_: Riggy join! Joooin! Make much happyyy!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: Then it's official! Just one thing, though: the city is a little too crowded for the fun we have in store. Let's take the revelry over to Hyrstmill.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_032: We'll go on ahead to make preparations. Please join us when you are ready!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: Upset as Riggy is, we can't reach out to him. You'll have to soothe him first.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_036: Oh dear, Riggy is in quite a tizzy... Could you try and soothe him, ?
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_040: Ah, glad you could join us! With help from some volunteers, I'm pleased to report that Riggy is happily playing out in the forest.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_041: At first he was content to do the startling, but after a while he said that he wanted to be startled for a change.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_042: So we took him to a secluded place, the better to know the thrill of a good shock. And who better to deal that shock than you?
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_043: Your task is to search for Riggy in the Twelveswood. And when you find him, give him such a shock as he'll never forget!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_045: You'll earn shock eggs for your troubles, of course; we've given some to Riggy to give to you. Together with those you received earlier, you ought to have enough for a splendid prize!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_046: As before, Motte yonder will help you onto the eggshilaration system. Happy startling!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: Thank you for coming, . We have Riggy taking part in the celebration, and we could use your help. Pray speak with Nonotta for the details.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_MOTTE_000_050: Nonotta has informed me of the situation. Let's get you on the egg, shall we?
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_MOTTE_000_051: Now, Riggy has three shock eggs. If you want them all, you'll need to startle him not once, not twice, but thrice. When you've finished, return here and report to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_055: Motte yonder will help you onto the eggshilaration system; let her know when you are ready.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: I trust Nonotta has filled you in on your role. Pray speak with Motte when you're ready to ride the egg.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_STONESPRIGGAN02423_: Spriggyyy! You find Riggy! Very shocky funnyyy! Hee hee hee!
Riggy give egg! Egg for youuu! Now Riggy hide! Hide agaaain!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: You're not on the egg? Riggy is out there, eagerly awaiting a good shock. Let's not keep the little fellow waiting.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_STONESPRIGGAN02423_: Riggy want shock! You are shooock! No shocky, no findy! No findy, no eggyyy!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_067: You seem to have mislaid the egg, adventurer. Pun intended. Talk to Motte, and she'll help you back on it.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_MOTTE_000_070: Oh? Fell off the egg, did you? Never you mind─given the shape, it's bound to happen. Here, let me help you back on.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_STONESPRIGGAN02423_: Spriggyyy! You find Riggy! Find agaaain! Riggy give egg! Egg for youuu!
Next egg last egg! Laaaaaast! Riggy hide! Hide gooooood! You no find Riggy!
Spriggyyy! You find Riggy! Riggy hide good! But you find gooder!
Riggy give egg! Egg for youuu! Riggy give thank! Thank for shocky funny!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_100: Ah, welcome back. I understand you succeeded in finding and startling Riggy. May I see the three shock eggs?
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_101: Wonderful! Riggy had basketfuls of fun, and it was in no small part due to your superior startling skills. Now, if you could wait just a moment, Riggy has gone to fetch the others.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: We've found a wonderful new friend in Riggy, and it's thanks to you, . His enthusiasm has been infectious, a gift to the festival, and I never dreamed─
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_106: <gasp> Could it be? Yes...yes it must! The gemstone I beheld in my dream, that the chocobo laid─it's none other than Riggy!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: The magnificent rock Riggy rides upon, the dazzling smiles upon the faces of those whose hearts he touched... Together they appear as a priceless gemstone. There can be no mistake.
Yet another vision has become reality, and I owe it to every one of you. But you most of all, .
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_110: Ooh, that reminds me, our adventurer friend garnered a goodly haul of shock eggs!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_11: My word, look at all these! Such dedication calls for a special prize. The hovering egg─I want you to have it, .
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_112: Wait, what!? Y-You can't be serious, Jihli! We poured our hearts into building the eggshilaration system, stayed up nights to make it flo─ Oh...
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_113: Uwaaah! I didn't mean to say that out loud! N-No, wait, what I meant was─
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_11: The hovering egg is your handiwork? Why, that's incredible! You're a genius, Nonotta!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_115: You...like it? I-I thought you'd be upset that it's a contrivance rather than a gift from the Archons of old.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_11: The Archons work in mysterious ways, dear Nonotta. It was by their guidance, I believe, that you built the egg─an egg fit to serve as their vessel. I'm very proud of you.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_117: <sob> That means a lot to me, Jihli. Search as we might, we couldn't find a hovering egg. But with Hatching-tide fast approaching, we couldn't bear seeing you sad, and so...and so...
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_11: Say no more, Nonotta. Know that I'm truly grateful for everything. And I certainly wouldn't dream of giving away your precious creation against your wishes. So I ask your permission to gift  the...eggshilaration system, you call it? As  who led us to the gemstone, I can think of none other more worthy to ride it.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_NONOTTA_000_119: You have the right of it, Jihli! I would be honored if  were to ride it always!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_12: And you, . You are a dear friend, as dear as─nay, dearer than a magnificent, dazzling gemstone.
You've done much and more for us all, and the eggshilaration system is the least we can offer you in return. May it bear you to all you have ever dreamed!
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_MOTTE_000_125: It seems there was no hiding Riggy from you. If you have the three shock eggs, remember to show them to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST303_02423_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_12: I daresay things went well. Why, I could hear Riggy's laughter all the way here, and it put a smile on my face. If you've collected all three shock eggs, do hurry and show them to Nonotta.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_LOSER02424_000_001: A gil for your thoughts, ─oh, what am I saying!? Ever since I was forced to close my armor shop, gil's been harder to come by than an honest member of the Mirage Trust. Whatever is a penniless pauper like myself to do!?
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_LOSER02424_000_002: I'm not asking for boundless riches here! If only I had a few gil, I could head to the Gold Saucer and reclaim all that I've lost. They say it's as if MGP is raining down from the heavens these days!
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_LOSER02424_000_003: Mind you, if you're as well-to-do as you appear, you should really speak to the attendant come to the Ruby Road Exchange to promote the festivities. I'm sure she'll be much more keen to help those who are less...destitute.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_LOSER02424_000_004: What's with that puzzled look? Don't tell me you've never been to the Gold Saucer! If that's the case, go and speak to that well-heeled youth over yonder─the one that looks like a foppish dandy of sorts. He'll furnish you with a ticket. Sadly for me, that's where his generosity ends.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GSFESSTAFF_000_010: Interested in visiting the Gold Saucer? Why, you could not have picked a better time! We are currently in the midst of our annual festival, where our honored guests can look forward to basking in a veritable downpour of spectacular prizes!
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GSFESSTAFF_000_011: You say this will be your first trip to the Saucer? All the more reason for you to make the journey and see all the wonders our establishment has to offer!
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_SYSTEM_000_015: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GSFESSTAFF_000_020: That's why we have dubbed the festivities the Make It Rain campaign. But it's not just about the prizes, oh no! You can also look forward to─
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GODBERT_000_021: Well, if it isn't  from Thanalan! The way you lifted your legs and put up your hands, you were the very image of a Manderville man! Tell me, have you had a chance to partake in the festivities at my darling Gold Saucer?
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GODBERT_000_022: Oho, look who we have here! My muscles have not forgotten the tender touch of those soothing fingers. Why, if we were not both otherwise occupied, I would ask you to crack open a fine bottle of salamander oil and get to work once more! Hahaha. Now tell me, have you had the chance to partake in the festivities at my darling Gold Saucer?
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GODBERT_000_023: Oho, what have we here? Another adventurer come to make their dreams come true in my hall of wonders? I am Godbert Manderville, proprietor of the Saucer, to which I most heartily welcome you. Mayhap you have already partaken in the festivities?
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GODBERT_000_024: I can personally assure you that Manderville & Manderville has spared no expense in procuring a selection of prizes that is sure to tantalize and titillate fortune seekers of all stripes.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GODBERT_000_025: Fortune may rule in the halls of my Gold Saucer, but it was by no mere chance that our paths crossed today. And that is why I would present you with a gift befitting this most momentous occasion!
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GODBERT_000_026: Use it, and use it well. And with that, I must be off─countless guests are waiting for the firm handshake and stimulating discourse that only a Manderville man can deliver!
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GSFESSTAFF_000_027: Well, I do believe Lord Manderville said it all! Once you arrive at the Gold Saucer, seek out my fellow attendant Ollier in Wonder Square. Simply present to him your VIP card, and he will see to it that you are well looked after.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_LOSER02424_000_030: Oh, don't worry yourself on my account. I'll just be standing here, penniless and half-starved, taking the smallest of solace in the knowledge that at least some complete stranger is out there making  dreams come true.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_LOSER02424_000_035: If you've never been to the Gold Saucer before, try speaking with that well-heeled youth over yonder─the foppish dandy who's wearing that shite-eating grin. I'm sure he'll furnish you with a ticket. If only gil were as easy to come by...
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_OLLIER_000_040: Dearest adventurer, allow me to extend a most heartfelt and sincere welcome to the Gold Saucer! I trust you are finding the festivities to your liking? Whatever you have experienced thus far, let me assure you that the wonders have only begun.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_OLLIER_000_041: Why, is that what I think it is? A VIP card, and one personally stamped by Lord Manderville himself, no less!? It would be my absolute pleasure to redeem that on your behalf, .
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_OLLIER_000_042: Ah, seeing that signet always inspires me to redouble my efforts on behalf of our distinguished guests. But pray forgive me─I have strayed quite far from the topic at hand. I am pleased to announce that the services of our campaign attendant─and a host of spectacular prizes─are now at your disposal.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_OLLIER_000_043: Now, I daresay I've delayed you long enough. Enjoy the festivities, and may the Spinner guide you to fortunes beyond your wildest dreams!
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_SYSTEM_000_044: You can now purchase seasonal items from the campaign attendant. Please note that you will be unable to do so after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC101_02424_GSFESSTAFF_000_045: Once you arrive at the Gold Saucer, seek out my fellow attendant Ollier in Wonder Square. Simply present to him the card you received from Lord Manderville, and he will see to it that you are well attended to.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Ah, beg pardons, ! Yes, you, , the adventurer with the dignified bearing. Might you favor me with a moment of your time?

I am the inu bugyo, and I lead a Far Eastern delegation on a mission to foster the bonds of friendship with the people of Eorzea. This we seek to do by sharing the joys of our Heavensturn custom to you and yours.

Though the tradition exists in both our lands, there are some differences in how we celebrate a new turn of the seasons. Most notably, while the people of Eorzea choose a deity to be first among the Twelve, we in the Far East grant that honor to a beast.
And this year, the honor belongs to the noble dog! Behold my kabuto. Fashioned in the likeness of man's best friend, 'tis the very picture of loyalty and devotion.

The craftsman spared no detail─it is so lifelike, one can fairly picture it rousing to attention with a spirited bark. To you I would gift this helm...if you would but consent to cooperate in my mission.

Worry not, it shan't prove a difficult task for an adventurer of your caliber. We will be handing out advent mochi─rice cakes traditionally enjoyed on this occasion─and you need but help us spread the word.
You have my gratitude! Now then, are you perchance familiar with mochi pounding?
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_CHOICE1Q1_000_000: Are you familiar with mochi pounding?
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: (-Familiar Far Eastern Lilt-)And so  should be, for  was instrumental in our previous pounding efforts.
Greetings, my friend. Right glad am I that you have returned to help us.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Well! To think that you are already acquainted with the mochi daikan, and are no stranger to mochi pounding besides. The kami are kind to bless us with a  of your experience.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Indeed. With  at our side, our mission is guaranteed to be a success. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must make ready for the pounding. In the meantime, I ask that you gather as many people as possible.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_100_0: (-Far Eastern Lilt-)Impressive. 'Tis no ordinary adventurer who is versed in our ways.
Well met, friend. I am the mochi daikan, and making mochi is my solemn charge. That I should meet a fellow mochi enthusiast in this foreign land could only be ascribed to fate.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_100_0: Verily! With this adventurer to assist us, I have every confidence that our mission will be a success.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_100_0: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must make ready for the pounding. In the meantime, I ask that you gather as many people as possible.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_200_0: (-Far Eastern Lilt-)Then pray allow me to pound the knowledge into you.

Mochi is made by pounding freshly steamed rice in a large mortar until it becomes a sticky dough. This dough is then rolled into treats called advent cakes. Simple though they may be, they are central to our celebration, and as the mochi daikan, I am charged with their creation.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_200_0: You are intrigued, and small wonder─ours is a unique culture. Know that you will learn more about it in the course of the festivities, and 'tis our hope that you will enjoy yourself in so doing.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_200_0: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must make ready for the pounding. In the meantime, I ask that you gather as many people as possible.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Though we have distributed advent cakes in the past, this time we shall draw the crowds with an all new spectacle─one in keeping with this year's honored beast.

Permit me to introduce you to the star of the show.
...Taro! Come!
This is Taro, whom I raised with my own hands. Though small in stature, he is possessed of a big heart and is as clever as they come.
...Not to mention spontaneous. Well, no time like the present, I suppose. I ask that you accompany Taro and together promote our festival.
He is trained to perform a delightful trick, invariably attracting attention and adoration. This will afford you the opportunity to inform folk of the performance and free rice cakes.
With that, I shall make ready to receive our guests. Good luck, my friend, and may the kami smile upon our festival!
Taro is trained to perform a delightful trick, invariably attracting attention and adoration. This will afford you the opportunity to inform folk of the performance and free rice cakes.
I shall make ready to receive our guests. Good luck, my friend, and may the kami smile upon our festival!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_FVIEWER02425_000_02: Isn't he the most adorable little thing! I can't take my eyes off him!
My, cute and clever! Don't you just have it all!
Awww, he's gone already... I would've loved to play with him.
What? The little fellow's going to give a performance, and there'll be free rice cakes besides? I'll be there with bells on!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_MVIEWER02425_000_03: Was minding my own business when this little rascal comes scampering over. Is...is something going to happen?
Haha, look at him go! That is hands down the cutest thing I've ever seen! Never thought to have a dog before, but I could take you home right now!
...Well, I suppose it wasn't meant to be. And I so wanted to have a good cuddle... <sigh>
I can still see him, you say? There might not be cuddling, but there'll be rice cakes? I'm already there!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_BONEPOLISHER_000_03: The 'ells's this pathetic excuse fer a dog? All o' the puny runts I've seen, yer the puniest an' runtiest of 'em all!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_BONEPOLISHER_000_04: Ye gots a problem? If ye mean to step between Ghost an' his meal, ye'll 'ave to answer to the Rabid Wives, the newest an' meanest pirates in Limsa! That's assumin' Ghost don't feast on yer entrails first!
See, we don't take kindly to dogs what's good fer nothin' but a circus. Now Ghost is gonna 'ave to tear it limb from limb!
Gahahaha! Look at it run, leakin' piss all over the place!
Hmph, feeble thing like that gives dogs a bad name. Can't 'ave folk thinkin' that's 'ow dogs're s'posed to be, else our deckhounds won't sell.
Now, you listen well, ! This 'ere's Rabid Wives territory! If I ever catch that runt runnin' 'round 'ere again, there'll be 'ells to pay! Now, bugger off!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Ah, there you are! Taro came running back visibly shaken. What has happened?
What!? I have heard of these detestable pirates who make savage beasts of dogs─these Rabid Wives. To think that they would so callously threaten poor, harmless Taro...

The experience has so distressed him, he is in no state to perform. Nor would I place him in danger by making him conspicuous. 'Tis a most unfortunate turn of events, but we must make do with handing out mochi alone.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: <pant> <pant> T-Terrible news! Pirates have loosed vicious hounds at the pounding site! It's...it's utter chaos!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Vile fiends! Not only do they traumatize Taro, they would disrupt the mochi pounding as well!?
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: They came for Taro, too!? Damn them! If there is to be no performance, we must protect the mochi at the very least!
Adventurer, the festival's success is at stake. You have helped us to save the mochi before. Will you not help us save it again?
Adventurer, the festival's success is at stake. Will you not help us save the mochi?
We are in your debt! Let us make haste to the pounding site!
What's this, Taro? You wish to come along? Perish the thought! Shaken as you are, you are in no shape to join us. We will manage somehow, so remain here and stay out of sight.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Though he is unable to perform tricks, he still wishes to be of use... I wouldn't expect any less of my Taro. But nay, I cannot allow it, little one. Should those pirates see you...
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: 'Twould seem he is resolved to come whether we will it or no. Ah, but someone must keep watch over the advent cakes we retrieve. Mayhap Taro can be entrusted with this task?
Worry not, my esteemed bugyo. Lest you forget, our adventurer friend will be on hand. No harm shall befall Taro, I am sure of it.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: The heavens could not have sent us a more dependable adventurer. Very well! Let us together ensure that the festival is a success!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Now, there are two pounding sites. One is in middle La Noscea, to the southeast of the Zephyr Gate, and the other is in lower La Noscea, to the east of the Salt Strand. I shall see you there.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: The success of the festival rides upon the mochi. Pray save as much as you can!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_FVIEWER02425_000_06: Mmmmmm, the rice cakes are so good! The chewiness is habit-forming!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_MVIEWER02425_000_06: Ungh...unnngh...unnngah! <gasp> Whew, I damn near choked on rice cake... But I can't die─not until I've had myself a proper cuddle!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Thanks to you, we are able to hand out the advent cakes as planned. Not only that─witnessing your bravery has helped Taro to find his own again.
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: My heartfelt thanks for saving the mochi. Even as we speak, folk are enjoying our advent cakes. I daresay you will see familiar faces.
And for an unexpected but welcome turn, Taro has regained his aplomb! We will be able to proceed with the performance after all!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_BONEPOLISHER_000_07: (-Obnoxious Voice-)What did I say 'bout lettin' that runt roam these parts!?
This 'ere's a pirate town, a place fer strong folk. If ye wants to be strong, ye needs a big, strong 'ound. An' it jus' so 'appens we sell 'em─fer a million gil each. It's a right bloody bargain!
Don't even think 'bout leavin' without buyin'. It's plain rude, see, an' Ghost 'ere don't much care fer rude folk. Ain't that right, boy?
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: K-Kami preserve! Adventurer, you must protect the citizens!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: T-Taro, no! You don't stand a chance against that beast!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_BONEPOLISHER_000_07: Hmph, all bark an' no bite! Always the way of it with puny dogs! Ghost, put that yappin' thing out of its misery!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_FVIEWER02425_000_07: Look! Even the little one is standing up to these ruffians! We must be strong, too!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_MVIEWER02425_000_08: Aye! You don't scare us! Go back to the shitehole whence you came!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_BONEPOLISHER_000_08: Damn, all this commotion's gonna attract the Admiral's yellow pets... Y-Ye 'aven't seen the last of us!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: You've done it, Taro! Your courage lit a fire in our guests' hearts, and together you stared down a common menace! Verily, this is the spirit of camaraderie we sought to sow by our mission!
TEXT_FESNYR401_02425_DOGMISSIONARY_000_0: Well, the festival has barely begun, but I believe we can already declare it a great success. Taro has matured greatly, and it is all thanks to your heroic example. Pray accept this as a token of our gratitude.
Whenever you don it, may you be reminded of us─your friends from a distant shore.
Now, the celebration shall continue for a while yet. Should it turn out that the Rabid Wives haven't learned their lesson, I pray that you will lend us your strength again.
TEXT_STMBDY403_02612_RODNEY_000_000: A fine  to you, adventurer! If you've not yet deduced from my cheery tone, Mistress Krile and the others have made great strides in restoring the Aethernet, enabling us to access another region of the island!
TEXT_STMBDY403_02612_RODNEY_100_000: Pyros, they've taken to calling it, on account of all the fire-aspected aether. A new base camp has already been established, so that messy business is over and done with. Of course, they'll need all the help they can get with the expedition. All the help you can provide, that is.
TEXT_STMBDY403_02612_RODNEY_000_001: Anyway, as soon as you're ready to go, let me know and I'll see you on your way. Mistress Krile is probably dying to brief you on all her discoveries!
TEXT_STMBDY403_02612_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Forbidden Land, Eureka Pyros. Like Anemos and Pagos, Pyros can be explored in parties of up to eight players, or solo.
TEXT_STMBDY403_02612_SYSTEM_000_011: To embark on your journey to Pyros, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane.
TEXT_STMBDY403_02612_SYSTEM_000_012: Please be advised that all excursions into , are item level synced. Gear exceeding an item level of  will be adjusted.
TEXT_STMBDY404_02613_RODNEY_000_000: Ah, adventurer, you couldn't have come at a better time! The preparations for restoring the ward are in place, I'm pleased to report, and with our practiced efficiency, we've established a base camp on practically the doorstep of the Students' headquarters!
TEXT_STMBDY404_02613_RODNEY_100_000: Now, in keeping with tradition, the region in which the camp lies has been given a name: Hydatos, a reference to its watery disposition. Gods willing, this will be last corner of the island that the expedition will need to contend with.
TEXT_STMBDY404_02613_RODNEY_000_001: But without further ado, let me know when you are ready to head over. Mistress Krile is very keen to resume her efforts with your help!
TEXT_STMBDY404_02613_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Forbidden Land, Eureka Hydatos. Like Anemos, Pagos, and Pyros, Hydatos can be explored in parties of up to eight players, or solo.
TEXT_STMBDY404_02613_SYSTEM_000_011: To embark on your journey to Hydatos, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane.
TEXT_STMBDY404_02613_SYSTEM_000_012: Please be advised that all excursions into , are item level synced. Gear exceeding an item level of  will be adjusted.
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_ULGERIRONHEART_000_: Hm? That there is a sightseeing log, unless I'm mistaken. Do you perchance know a woman named Millith?
Hah, what are the odds! Millith is my niece, lest you wonder, and she has told me much and more about you in her letters.
Ah, but where are my manners? Ulger Ironheart, at your service. I'm an explorer like most of the clan, and my niece bade me share with you such knowledge I have accumulated. Here, lend me your log.
Let's see now... Definitely there...and there...and there...and there! Yes, that ought to suffice.
My explorations have taken me far and wide, but dearest to my heart are the regions of Ala Mhigo, beauteous in their ruggedness, and the lands of the Far East, glorious in their diversity.

There are many wondrous sights to be seen in these places, and I've written down the directions to them. Some will prove more difficult to reach than others, but if you're even half as resourceful as Millith says you are, I'm confident that you will find them all.
And with that, I shall leave you to resume your adventures. Go forth, my friend, and take in such breathtaking vistas as even my father, the great Roddard Ironheart, could not see in his lifetime!
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_SYSTEM_000_007: Stormblood entries have been added to your sightseeing log!
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_SYSTEM_000_008: You must be level 60 or above to record Stormblood vistas. Travel to the location indicated and fulfill the necessary conditions and you will complete the entry for that vista, earning experience points in the process.
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_SYSTEM_100_008: The newly added locations in your sightseeing log will be marked by an orb of light. Should you spot such an orb during your adventures, take a moment to stop and record the entry.
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_SYSTEM_000_009: Use your wits and the notes provided by Ulger to identify these stunning sights and the proper way to appreciate them, and see Ala Mhigo and the Far East as only the greatest explorers have seen them!
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_ULGERIRONHEART_000_: In my capacity as an explorer, I must inform you that the lands beyond are fraught with danger. If you mean to venture forth, you'd best have the means to protect yourself.
TEXT_STMBDY102_02920_SYSTEM_000_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must have at least one class or job at level 60 or above.
TEXT_STMBDY103_02921_KELTRAENG_000_000: I say, are you not from Eorzea? And by the looks of it, an adventurer besides?
TEXT_STMBDY103_02921_KELTRAENG_000_001: Marvelous! You see, I have been dispatched here by the Adventurers' Guild to spread recognition of our establishment while helping us gain a foothold here in the Far East.
TEXT_STMBDY103_02921_KELTRAENG_000_002: And what better way to the locals' hearts than by offering them our aid─through guildleves, of course. We already have plenty of work for those with the skills, and I hope we can depend upon yours as well.
TEXT_STMBDY103_02921_SYSTEM_000_003: You now have access to guildleves in Kugane. Speak with Keltraeng to undertake tasks for Disciples of the Hand and Disciples of the Land.
TEXT_STMBDY103_02921_KELTRAENG_000_010: I hope I can find skilled adventurers here, and enough of them to meet demand...
TEXT_STMBDY103_02921_SYSTEM_000_011: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 60 or above.
TEXT_STMBDY110_02941_GALIENA_000_000: Well met, adventurer. My name's Galiena, and I work at the House of Splendors for my aunt Rowena.
TEXT_STMBDY110_02941_GALIENA_000_001: Following her successful expansion into Idyllshire and the three city-states, she's decided to bring her operations here to Rhalgr's Reach.
TEXT_STMBDY110_02941_GALIENA_000_002: Our presence here serves to aid the recovery effort, creating jobs for refugees and stimulating the economy. With your skills, you would be of great help to us.
TEXT_STMBDY110_02941_GALIENA_000_003: And of course, if you have any collectables, I'd be happy to take them off your hands in exchange for scrips. With locations realm-wide, it has never been easier to do business with the House of Splendors!
TEXT_STMBDY110_02941_GALIENA_000_010: Well met, adventurer. If you know any able crafters or gatherers, I'd be thankful for an introduction.
TEXT_STMBDY110_02941_SYSTEM_000_011: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 60 or above.
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_RODNEY_000_000: Good news, adventurer! While you were away, Mistress Krile completed her work on the Aethernet relay, allowing us to access another region of the island!
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_RODNEY_100_000: I'm told it's quite different from Anemos─far, far colder, on account of a preponderance of ice-aspected aether. Accordingly, the team dubbed it “Pagos.”
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_RODNEY_000_001: They've already established a new base camp, and if you'd like to lend a hand with the expedition, you'd be more than welcome.
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_RODNEY_000_002: Just say the word and I'll see to the arrangements. I'm sure Mistress Krile will be overjoyed to see you again!
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Forbidden Land, Eureka Pagos. Like Anemos, Pagos can be explored in parties of up to eight players, or solo.
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_SYSTEM_000_011: To embark on your journey to Pagos, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane.
TEXT_STMBDY402_02942_SYSTEM_000_012: Please be advised that all excursions into the Forbidden Land, Eureka Pagos, are item level synced. Gear exceeding an item level of  will be adjusted.
TEXT_STMBDY201_02943_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Ah, who should stand before me but the hero who shattered the shackles of oppression in Doma and Ala Mhigo both! In spite of your burgeoning fame, I am honored that you should willingly share your precious time with this humble minstrel.

If I may ask, how are you enjoying the Far East? With its many charms, it is an easy place to like. Indeed, it holds a special place in my heart; you might even say it is a second home to me, often as I find myself here on my endless quest for verse.
And on this particular visit, the proprietor of this theater chanced to hear me perform and took a shine to my work. One thing led to another, and a number of my songs were adapted for the stage!
Such are the crowds they have drawn, I have since been commissioned to write pieces for a new production.
That is not to brag, mind you─nay, far from it. For though I am glad for the approval, the truth is I have been struggling to summon forth the inspiration with which to fuel my creativity.
...But of course! Your recent exploits could well provide me with the inspiration I need!

Such events you must have witnessed, such emotions experienced, in your struggle to liberate Doma and Ala Mhigo from the clutches of the Empire. Though the tales have been doing their rounds, there is no substituting a firsthand account. Nay, I would see from the eyes of  who stood in the thick of it and know the depths of  heart.

I shall remain in Kugane while I compose my pieces for the Mujikoza. Whenever you can spare a moment, I ask that you regale unto me your recent adventures, and I shall see to it they are immortalized within these halls!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: I know you. You've helped me in the past, and perhaps you will again. If the heat is not too much for you to bear, that is. But such heat can only mean one thing. Yes, the Moonfire Faire is upon us!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_MAYARUMOYARU_000_01: Ahhh, at last the gods have seen fit to send me an able adventurer. I've much to ask of you. If the heat is not too much for you to bear, that is. But such heat can only mean one thing. Yes, the Moonfire Faire is upon us!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_MAYARUMOYARU_000_02: And the festivities this year will be the greatest to date! Indeed, the fairegrounds are a new resort location at none other than Costa del Sol. It is a veritable paradise─aptly named the Isle of Endless Summer.

Hehehe, your interest is piqued. I can see that much in your eyes. No doubt you wish to hear more, but you will not hear it from me. Travel to the Isle of Endless Summer, and there seek out Haermaga. He is chief chaperone of the faire, and will tell you all you care to know.
Travel to the Isle of Endless Summer, and there seek out Haermaga. He is chief chaperone of the faire, and will tell you all you care to know.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_030: Well, well, well. It's been a long time. I've not seen you since the Moonfire Faire fell last. Tell me, is it your love of the celebrations that's brought you to me again?
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_040: Welcome to the Isle of Endless Summer. Tell me, is it your love of the faire that's brought you to me?
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_050: So, Mayaru Moyaru sent you, did he? Crafty little bugger, he is. Well, at least it's not the rumors that brought you like they have everyone else.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_051: Hm? Bah, forget I said anything. Rumors are just that after all─rumors. If you know not of what I speak, then it makes no matter. Come, let us discuss more important things!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_052: The Moonfire Faire is a festival we celebrate to fell the fiery Bombards. But it might be we've grown too good at that. The damned things have scarcely shown themselves since last year, and rightly so after that beating. We almost forewent the faire entirely this summer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_053: But then the master of Costa del Sol, Gegeruju himself, asked that we hold it to vitalize his newly created Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_054: So, while there is a bit of an ulterior motive behind this year's festivities, we could hardly refuse a request from Gegeruju. We owe him much and more for his tireless efforts with past faires. And so here we are.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_055: Yet I confess, there are far more patrons come to the isle than we anticipated. We find ourselves grossly short of hands. Would you care to lend yours? We've rewards aplenty to offer in return.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_056: Excellent! Your duties will be assigned to you by P'obyano at the─
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_GEGERUJU_000_057: Hello there, hello there. Tell me, how are the festivities proceeding? Is all well? My, there certainly are a number of lovely Miqo'te come out to play.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_058: All is as it appears. Never did we expect such scores. It is more than the others and I can handle.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_059: Master Gegeruju, please, let us not take any more of Haermaga's precious time. Stroll the grounds. See with your own eyes how the faire fares.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_GEGERUJU_000_060: Ever the effective manager, Jiriri. Very well, I will go and have a long, hard look at things. Mayhap I may even romp with these lovely kittens a bit.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_061: Apologies for the interruption, Haermaga. I know countless faire duties await you. Please, attend to them in good time.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_062: Aye, you needn't worry there. Attend to them, I will.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_063: Such assuring and diligent words. You adventurers are a blessing to us all. I shall distract you no longer. Good day, and have a merry Moonfire Faire!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_064: Where was I? Ah, yes. You'll want to speak with P'obyano about your duties. Off you go, then. Work awaits!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_065: Now just who the hells would spread a rumor like that?
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_HAERMAGA_000_066: Oh, don't pay me any mind. Nothing to see or hear here. You just go and keep yourself busy by helping out with the faire.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_070: Well, if it isn't ! It has been many moons, my friend. Pray tell, are you here to offer your aid once more?
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_080: Ah, pray tell, are you an adventurer looking to lend a hand with the faire? You have my thanks many times over. Gods know we could use the help.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_090: No doubt you've heard by now. This year's Moonfire Faire is being held to vitalize this newly founded resort─the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_091: One of the many events planned is fireworks by the water. We have a firework mortar we could certainly use your help with.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_092: There is more you should hear, but you will need to hear it from Jiriri. She is the overseer of all things fireworks for the faire.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_093: She is in the employ of Master Gegeruju, and charged with the running of this isle. You should go and introduce yourself. But be sure to report back to me when you see the deed done. Until then!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_094: Speak with Jiriri to learn more about the fireworks we have planned. And be sure to report back to me when you see the deed done. Until then!
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_100: I recall your face. You are the one I saw earlier in the company of Haermaga. Excuse me for not introducing myself then. Permit me to now─I am Jiriri, proprietor of this resort isle. Tell me, how can I be of service?
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_101: You wish to help with the Moonfire Faire festivities? Oh, your aid will be most welcome. Thank you for the offer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_102: The first job we would like to ask of you is the lighting of some fireworks. You will have to travel to the grounds where our visitors are gathered, and there throw a summer firework into a nearby firework mortar.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_103: Do that, and all faire-goers will be treated to a fiery flower of light in full bloom high above the ocean waters. Our grand display is in your hands now.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_104: Many and more faire-goers are asking for fireworks on the water. We'd like nothing more than to oblige them, but we simply lack the manpower to cater to each and every request. Thank the gods for sending you when they did.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_105: You need only throw the summer firework I gave you into a firework mortar near where our visitors are gathered. Be sure to report back to P'obyano when you are done.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_106: Oh, my... That adventurer there is quite the, ummm... Heehee. Yes, well... Gods be good.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_ADVENTERER02956_000: Beautiful! I'd grown weary looking for the treasure, but this... This is good for the soul.
Have you ever seen anything so amazing? I've been hunting for Moonfire treasure, but this is all the treasure I truly need.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_112: So you saw the fireworks lit. A job well done. No doubt it brought as broad a smile to your face as it did those of our faire-goers.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_JIRIRI_000_113: Make no mistake, this great success is due to your efforts as much as our own. Without the help of you and your brethren, none of this would be possible. I pray you continue to bless us with your boon.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_120: You succeeded in lighting the fireworks. Thank the gods for that. We had no one else to ask it of.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_121: Treasure...? Hmmm, I cannot say I know anything about that, but mayhap Haermaga does.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_122: Already he seems to have some secretive goings-on behind the faire. If anyone knows aught of whispers and rumors, it is him.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_123: Again, thank you for your help with the fireworks. If you've the time and inclination, please speak to any of the other faire chaperones, or even to me again. We've all more than enough work to ask of you.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_POBYANO_000_124: Your labors will be rewarded with Faire vouchers. You'll find you can exchange them for all manner of valuables.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SYSTEM_000_125: Faire vouchers can be earned by participating in the FATEs offered around the Isle of Endless Summer.
TEXT_FESSUM301_02956_SYSTEM_000_126: They are also rewarded by completing quests given by P'obyano, Hildelana, and Beaudefoin.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_000: Back for more, are you? I'll not turn away an offer to help. Would you see fit to light some more fireworks for us?
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_001: Just in case you'd forgotten how it is done─you need only throw a summer firework into a firework mortar near where the faire-goers are gathered.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_002: There is no need for you to speak to Jiriri any further. But this time, I ask that you light fireworks in three locations rather than just the one. Don't overheat out there!
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_010: You simply cannot get enough of these fireworks, can you, ? Very well, you'll hear no complaints from me.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_011: The task is the same as before. Light the fireworks by throwing a summer firework into a firework mortar near where our faire-goers are gathered. I will keep an eye to the skies.
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_020: Remember now─you must throw the summer fireworks into three firework mortars. The faire-goers await. Hurry along, now!
TEXT_FESSUM302_02957_POBYANO_000_030: Yet another job well done. Thank you, . If you care to help further, you know where to find me. Until then, have a merry Moonfire Faire!
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_000: Now there is a face I have not seen for a long time. Thanks again for all your help with those pesky Bombards at faires past.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_001: I'm taking a hiatus from the Go Go Posing Rangers. This year, my duties are here. Out of the frying pan and into the kitchen, eh? I hope that doesn't mean you aren't willing to help.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_010: I'm sorry, we aren't taking any more orders right now. Oh, you're not a customer? Please tell me you're here to offer help.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_020: Thank the gods! I'm as happy as any to see the faire so bustling, but we have more orders than we have cooks to make them. This kitchen is pure chaos.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_021: If you're willing to help, how about preparing some battered fish? There are more orders for that than anything else. We cannot make enough of the stuff!
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_022: You'll need some fresh haddock to make it, but that should be easy enough to find. I'd wager you can purchase it from the festive fisher.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_030: You are here to offer your culinary services? Well, they are most welcome. If you're able, how about preparing some battered fish?
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_040: I don't see any battered fish in your hands. If you need to gather ingredients, you can purchase the fresh haddock you'll need from the festive fisher.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_050: Oh, my! I've never seen more delectable-looking battered fish! The fairecomers who get these are in for a treat. Thank you for the help!
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_051: By the by, have you spoken to Beaudefoin just over there? He is just as busy as I am right now. If you fancy helping more, I'm sure he has a job to ask of you.
TEXT_FESSUM303_02958_HILDELANA_000_060: Thanks again for the wonderful battered fish. If you care to help in the kitchen again, just let me know. We can always use a talented culinarian!
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_000: Had a feeling I might see you again this summer. And what a pleasant sight you are! You're just the one to deliver me from this seventh hell.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_001: They're saying there are to be no Go Go Posing Rangers this year since the Bombards are not out. But I'm starting to think this resort nonsense is worse by far. I've never been so busy in all my life! You've got to help me.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_010: Ah, another adventurer come to help. And come at the right time. You're just the one to deliver me from this seventh hell.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_020: Here's what I'm hunting right now─haddock. We can't get enough of the damn things. We need every one in the ocean to fill all the orders for battered fish we're getting.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_021: I've never heard of a dish being so popular. Our haddock stocks simply can't keep up with the demand. I've got the festive fisher giving me all he catches, but it is still not near enough.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_022: Word is they're biting out at the North Shore. Catch three and bring them to me, would you? A grim fate awaits them, but we can hardly have a faire without food.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_030: You looking to put that rod of yours to work again? I can always use more fresh haddock. Well, what are you waiting for? To the sea, with you.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_031: Three fresh haddock, and quickly. Word is they're biting at the North Shore.
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_040: Have you got the three fresh haddock I asked for? Then go and cast that bloody line back in the water!
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_050: Those are some lively looking haddock. They'll make fine battered fish for some lucky faire-goer. Well done, !
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_051: Have you had a word with Hildelana, there? I don't envy the cooking that is being asked of her. Why not offer her a hand, as well?
TEXT_FESSUM304_02959_BEAUDEFOIN_000_060: Another haul of three fresh haddock, is it? My thanks again, friend. You're doing the gods' work.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_000: You again, is it? And it looks as though you've something you'd like to ask. Go on then, what is it?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_A1_000_001: What do you know of this summer treasure?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_A1_000_002: What do you know of these summer rumors?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_010: Treasure? I don't know what you're─ I haven't heard any─ Oh, very well. There's no point in deceiving you. You adventurers always find everything out sooner or later.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_020: Rumors? Why, there are always rumors. That's nothing to─ I don't think that─ Oh, very well. There's no point in deceiving you. You adventurers always find everything out sooner or later.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_030: I will tell you, but first you must help with the faire. Lend a hand to P'obyano and the others until things calm down a bit. Then I will reveal all I know.
