TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_031: Bring me seven Faire vouchers as proof of your labors. That is my price.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_040: Bring me seven Faire vouchers as proof of your aid. That is the price for all I know of rumors and treasure.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_041: Seven Faire vouchers, just as I asked. Thank you. We are grateful for the help.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_042: Now, then, about these rumors. It will not do to speak of them here. There is an island to the south where few souls go. Await me there. I will join you shortly.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_043: It will not do to speak of the rumors here. There is an island to the south where few souls go. Await me there. I will join you shortly.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_050: My apologies for keeping you waiting. Now... Where to begin?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_051: You are right─there is a rumor abound at the faire this year. The whispers say that Gegeruju has hidden a treasure somewhere on the isle, and whoever finds it during the festivities can lay claim to it.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_052: Just another shady rumor, much like that of Mistbeard's hidden treasure. It'd be foolish to go to Gegeruju himself with all this, but the trouble is, more than a few folk have taken the rumor to heart.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_053: If any ill comes of all this, it'll be a hassle to Gegeruju and a hindrance to the faire. And so I've taken to looking into things for myself.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_054: I've learned of certain places on the isle that Gegeruju has visited alone on more than a few occasions. Suspicious behavior, indeed, no?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_055: I mean to visit a number of these myself and expose whatever truth there is behind this mess. And I'd like to ask you to help.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_056: One of these places lies on an island to the north. I'll leave that one to you. If you find anything there of interest, bring word back to me.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_057: There are several places Gegeruju visits, alone and often. Travel to the one on the north island and discover whatever you can. I will survey the others.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SYSTEM_000_060: You discover a spyglass with Gegeruju's name engraved on it. Use it to learn what he was viewing.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SYSTEM_000_065: Search your surroundings for whatever Gegeruju was viewing. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target a sight and use the spyglass with .
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_SYSTEM_000_070: You see a group of ladies gleefully at play. This seems the perfect location to gaze at faire-goers from afar.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_080: You're back. Tell me, what did you find?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_081: Peeping? Aye, I found the places I visited to be ideal vantage points, as well. And this spyglass would seem to be the nail in Gegeruju's voyeuristic coffin.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_082: Still, damning as it may be, we'll have to catch him in the act. He is visiting the north island as we speak. Come, search for him with me.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_083: Gegeruju is visiting the north island as we speak. Let us find him and uncover the truth behind all this.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_090: Gegeruju is sure to be around here somewhere. But those Lalafell are so damned small, it can be hard to─ There he is!
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_100_090: Come on, let us be done with this.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_091: Gegeruju, I don't think there's any need to ask, but we will anyway. What in the hells are you up to?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_GEGERUJU_000_092: Ahahaha! That much is obvious, is it not? I am keeping a watchful eye on those beautiful ladies over yonder. Are they not an absolute treasure?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_093: A watchful eye? It looks to be no more than a peeping eye from where we stand.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_JIRIRI_000_094: Oh, by the gods, if you are not able to enjoy this spectacle for the wonder that it is, then I truly pity you. Heeheehee! My, oh my, just look at them!
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_095: Don't tell me you're caught up in all this business, as well.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_GEGERUJU_000_096: It is one thing to attend the festivities and applaud the Miqo'te's lovely dances. It is another thing altogether to keep vigil over their beauty from afar. I certainly am glad I chose to leave things to you this year, Jiriri.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_JIRIRI_000_097: Your praise means much. I daresay the faire would never have grown so lively had we not spread the rumors of a hidden treasure.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_JIRIRI_000_098: Come, Gegeruju. There are other places from which we must enjoy the view. It will not serve to linger too long in any one place, lest we be discovered. Therein lies all the fun, does it not?
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_GEGERUJU_000_099: Right you are! Let us away, then. There are countless other scantily clad Miqo'te being deprived of my watchful eye!
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_100: Well, things have gotten...interesting. Let us return and consider how best to deal with all this.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_110: So, it would seem the rumors of treasure were started by Jiriri in an attempt to fulfill Gegeruju's...desires. To think, this whole thing was a farce spun up by their perverse little minds.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_111: Very well, this is how it will be. If any trouble is born of this treasure nonsense, those two will answer for it.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_112: As for the faire, so long as the Bombards stay away, we've no need of adventurers' might. But we do have need of your aid.
TEXT_FESSUM305_02960_HAERMAGA_000_113: I hope we can count on you to continue helping with the faire. Enjoy yourself, and lend a hand where you can!
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_000: Ah, a welcome sight if there ever was! It has been too long. If only fate had not conspired to see our meeting would again be under such dire circumstances.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_001: As you may recall, a horde of mechanical bugs once threatened to disrupt our celebration of the realm's rebirth. Though we believed them exterminated, it pains me to say they have returned.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_010: Your pardon, . You are an adventurer, yes? Perhaps you can help.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_011: During one of our previous celebrations of the realm's rebirth, a horde of mechanical bugs threatened to disrupt the festivities. We believed them exterminated, but it pains me to say they have returned.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_020: When word of their presence first reached me I knew something had to be done immediately, that the good people of Eorzea may pray and reflect on the events of the Calamity in peace.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_021: That is why I enlisted the aid of the wandering minstrel who helped dispense with this mechanical menace once before.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_022: Sightings of the bugs ceased within a few days of his leaving Ul'dah. Yet despite his apparent success there is nary a trace of him. There is no answer from his linkpearl, and now I fear some ill fate has befallen him.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_023: It would mean the world to me if you would go and search for him. If he truly has met with misfortune, I have the utmost confidence you can see him to safety.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_024: Thank you ever so much! When last we spoke, the minstrel was making for Nophica's Wells.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_025: If the fates are kind, you will find some clue to his whereabouts there. Take care, and stay safe.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_026: Please hurry to Nophica's Wells. I only hope the minstrel is yet unharmed.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SYSTEM_000_030: This teleportation ward was created not long ago. Judging by the remains of the mechanical monsters strewn across the ground, this is likely the work of the wandering minstrel. Perhaps he is on the other side.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: An adventurer...? By what twist of fate did you find your way to a place such as this?
You came searching for me at the behest of Nonora? I see. She was right to send you, for I have indeed found myself in a most precarious position.
I stumbled upon a nest of the bugs which threatened to spoil our celebration. No doubt they wished for us to think them extinct, waiting for an opportune time to catch us unawares.

As I delivered the finishing blow to the last of these mechanical monstrosities, a trap was sprung and I was hurled into a void. When I awoke I was in this chamber, somehow stripped of my ability to use teleportation magicks.

You needn't worry, my friend. Whatever magicks were invoked have long since faded. Their effects on me, however, still remain. Considering these rather bleak surroundings, one might say I've been locked within a jail of sorts.
But no jail is without its key.

Upon inspecting this bug, I discovered there is, in fact, a command that when uttered will undo the magicks which bind me here. To that end I thought to peer into the inner workings of its mechanical mind, or what remains of it, and secure my path to freedom.

Much to my dismay, its mind was a maze─a complex labyrinth the likes of which I have never seen before. For days I have searched to no avail. Were I to delve into the maze again, I fear I now lack the strength to return. But I think I now see a solution to my problem.
Do you suppose you could traverse the labyrinth in my stead? Having come thus far, you certainly seem more than resourceful enough to see the job done.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SYSTEM_000_049: You can now access the cheap dungeon. Examine the battered bug to delve into the maze and discover how to set the wandering minstrel free!
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_050: He's trapped in their nest!? Then what in heavens' name are you doing here? Please, you must save him!
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The key to my escape is somewhere within that labyrinth. Please, you must find the command to dispel the magicks placed upon me.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SYSTEM_000_060: The following controls can be used to navigate the cheap dungeon:
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: You returned much faster than I anticipated, though I suppose navigating dungeons is all in a day's work for one such as you. I would offer you proper thanks, but first let us quit this place.
Once the bugs' magicks are dispelled, I should have no trouble teleporting us out of here. Now then, shall we be off?
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_11: Greetings, Warrior of Light. You needn't be alarmed.
This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
This is our second meeting, is it not? Truly the fates are kind to afford me this opportunity. I wished to thank you personally for your continued efforts in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_11: At last I come face-to-face with the great . Truly the fates are kind to afford me this opportunity. I wished to thank you personally for your continued efforts in Eorzea.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_11: Its rebirth seems as only yesterday, yet it has already been four long years. In that time, the clarion call of adventure has beckoned you up to the very heavens and back, and now it seems she would bid you pursue the liberation of a nation as well.
The realm is ever-growing, ever-changing, and it would not be possible without the deeds of you and yours─without your thirst for adventure.

These past four years have not been without their hardships, though. We have stumbled at times─fallen, even─but together at your side we have endured. I am quite confident we will continue to do so for many years to come.
You inspire us with your tales of adventure in Eorzea, and it is our fondest hope they serve as a constant source of joy and wonder.
May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal!
...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
Ever will we be watching over you and your deeds. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, Warrior of Light...
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: There you are. For a moment I feared you had been left behind. Words cannot well express my gratitude for─...Are you all right? By your expression, I would swear your mind had but recently returned from some waking dream.
Perhaps it is merely an aftereffect of the magicks employed in our escape. At any rate, I must return to Ul'dah. Nonora is no doubt beside herself with worry. Would you care to accompany me?
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_150: You've returned! But what of the wandering minstrel? Is he safe?
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_151: Oh, thank goodness. Would you mind waiting with me until he returns? If you have arrived, he cannot be far behind.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_200: It is so good to see you hale and whole! You were gone for so long I feared the worst.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: My apologies, Nonora. I am ashamed to admit I was bested by the bugs. The tale of my rescue, however, is a far more compelling story.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_NONORA_000_202: Unbelievable! And the bugs are no more, you say?
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Indeed. Now the good people of Eorzea may at last offer prayers to the victims of the Calamity in peace, no longer burdened by the impending threat of those metallic monsters.
Of course, this would not have been possible without your aid. On behalf of all those who would honor this day of remembrance, you have my sincerest thanks.
My work here complete, I believe it time I continued my journey, recounting the heroic deeds of adventurers such as you in song. In fact, if I might be so bold, I would write a verse in your honor...

'Neath azure skies a soul burned bright, stars soon gathered 'fore its might♪
By their radiance truths lay bare, a nation freed from deep despair♪

As the heavens take a crimson hue, friends now gather, old and new♪
By their deeds doth freedom ring, once more their hearts have cause to sing♪
...Let us now take a moment to remember those whose flames were extinguished too soon.
The tragedies of yesterday must not be forgotten, lest we take for granted the gifts of tomorrow.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SYSTEM_000_400: You have unlocked the Cheap Dungeon mini-game.
TEXT_FESANV301_02961_SYSTEM_000_401: Open the toy chest in any inn room to try your hand at this popular Eorzean pastime.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Happy Starlight! I am Amh Garanjy, Starlight celebrant. Are you perchance an adventurer? Your arrival is most timely. I should like to request your aid.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_010: At long last, we meet again! Surely it is Nymeia's providence that has guided you to me. It is in my capacity as a Starlight celebrant that I must ask for your assistance.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_020: The Starlight Celebration is the most wonderful time of the year, especially for the little ones. We strive to make each year's festivities more spectacular than the last. Yet there are those who would undermine our carefully laid plans.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_021: A spate of thefts has left many without decorations. Several of my associates have been tasked with the investigation, and as a result we are understaffed. Will you help us?
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_022: You will? I knew we could rely on you! Please speak with my trusted comrade Baenfaeld in Bentbranch Meadows. He will be grateful for any aid you can provide.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_023: Until we track down the thieves and reclaim our stolen decorations, we may have considerable difficulty carrying out our other duties...
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_030: Yes, I know ye just wanna help with the festival. But what can I do? Me hands are tied!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_040: Who're you? A 'venturer or summat of the like? What can I do for ye?
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_050: Well, I'll be! You're the one what helped with the Starlight bell a while back! To what do I owe the pleasure?
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_060: Oh, it was Amh Garanjy who asked ye to come here, was it? I had a feelin' she'd send someone. An' full glad I am she did!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_061: So she told you about all the decorations gettin' pinched? Terrible business, I tell ye. One mornin', we woke to find 'em all stolen! And the young'uns round here had only just finished puttin' 'em up. Poor little tykes... They was heartbroken!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_062: They're still down in the dumps about it now. Can't blame 'em really, 'specially after all the effort they put in. We've got people lookin' into the thefts, meself included, but no one to take care of the Starlight Celebration itself here in Bentbranch.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_064: Aye, you'll get yer chance! Ye think ye spent all that time practicin' for nothin'? Them younglin's will be grinnin' ear to ear when they see what you've got in store!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_065: What's that? Ye don't know what they're sayin'? Well, suppose not everyone understands bears like I do...
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_066: "We're glad someone nice is here to help us! Don't you worry─ We'll have them little ones smilin' again in no time!“ is what he was sayin'. Can't you see? It's written all over that adorable face of his!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_067: Hah! There's me explainin' bear-speak, when I haven't even told you what we'll be doin'! These three have been trained to lob these starbursts. Sparkly and colorful they are─like little fireworks!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_068: They'll do the chuckin', all you've got to do is ride 'em to the right place. And maybe show 'em where to chuck.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_069: That's the spirit! You'd think an explosion like that would sting a bit, but the boom's worse than the bite. Anyway, pick from Polaris, Kochab, and Pferkad. They're all good lads─just go for the one easiest to ride.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_AMHGARANJY_000_070: When the children see what you and the bears have planned, their faces will light up with joy!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_071: Come on, don't be shy! Go and say hello to the bear what's right for you!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_140: He said “All right  'venturer! Let's go and cheer up them children!” You can see the determination in his eyes─that steely resolve!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_141: Hya ha! I can tell you two're gonna get on just fine! Well, I've got some investigatin' to do.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_142: Suppose you other two might as well gimme a hand lookin' for the thieves. If ye're as good at sniffin' out criminals as you are at sniffin' out grub in the pantry, we'll have 'em in no time!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_BAENFAELD_000_144: I'll leave the starbursts to you an' yer new best friend! Now get out there an' spread some cheer!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_COMMITTEE03009_000_: Baenfaeld tells me you've agreed to help out. Oh, here comes  now. May Nymeia watch over you both!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_SYSTEM_000_146: Throwing a starburst here should get a favorable reaction.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_CHILDA03009_000_150: (-Surprised Little Boy-)Matron's teats! Oh, 'scuse my language... I mean, “Gods be good!” Did that bear just throw a bomb? Ha ha! Amazing!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_CHILDB03009_000_151: (-Gleeful Little Girl-)That was great! Why don't you show it to Taff? He's down by the chocobo stables.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_152: Why won't they listen? I'm not a liar!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_160: Huh, you scared me for a moment. The bear threw that? I guess that's funny, in a way... <sigh>
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_200: You're tryin' to cheer me up? That's very kind of you.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_201: Sorry. I guess I'm not havin' a very good day. No matter what I say, no one will listen!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_202: But you will, won't you? I'll tell you, if you promise not to call me a fibber.
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_210: You promise? All right, I suppose I can trust you...
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_211: You heard about the decorations goin' missin' didn't you? Well, I know who took 'em! I saw 'em do it!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_212: But when I told the others, they didn't believe me! They called me a fibber! It's not fair! I hate it!
TEXT_FESXMS301_03009_TAFF_000_213: But you're not like them. You believe me, right? If I tell you who did it, will you catch 'em and bring back all the decorations?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_000: You mean you'll get all the decorations back? Thank you so much, !
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_001: came lookin' for me, an' told me to leg it back here. Everythin' all right?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_002: You what? This little nipper saw the thief?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_003: I did! The Starlight Tree nicked all the decorations, and stuck 'em all over itself!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_004: Pull the other one, it's got bells on! We was robbed by a tree? Bit far-fetched, don't ye think?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_100_004: What d'you make of all this?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_110_004: You believe me? I knew you weren't like all the others! It really was the Starlight Tree I saw, I swear!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_120_004: You think I'm just tellin' stories? You're all the same! Well, I don't care if you believe me or not, I know what I saw! It was the Starlight Tree!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_006: All right, son, let's slow down, eh? You sure you didn't mis-see it? Bit too much cheese before bed perhaps?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_007: (-???-)Ho ho ho! This vigilant young man speaks the truth!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_008: It's you! You show up to help us every Starlight Celebration! Yer Go...
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_009: A wandering pilgrim, come to see justice is served! I can vouch for the boy's testimony, as I too witnessed this heinous crime with my very eyes! But what say you, adventurer? What do your instincts tell you?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_A1_000_000: The prime suspect is none other than...a treant!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_010: Verily, you have cut straight to the heart of the matter! For the true criminal is naught more than a common treant, draped in plundered Starlight Celebration finery!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_020: Indeed, it was the Starlight Tree, but in appearance only! A lowly treant claimed the decorations for itself, and assumed the guise of our most beloved of festive fauna!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_040: A treant! Come to mention it, if one of those made off with a load of Starlight gubbins, it might look a bit like a Starlight Tree!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_041: That is not all! For I saw not one, but a whole copse of these culprits, all similarly bespangled, shambling their way south.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_042: I had a mind to smite the wretched lot of them, there and then. But! I realized that if my hammer of legend were to strike down the fiends, the decorations we seek to reclaim would suffer the same fate! Another approach is needed, methinks.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_043: Aye, we've got to find a way to nab those bark-faced bastards without breakin' anythin'. But how are we to do that?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_045: "If we lob a bunch of starbursts at the treants, we can stun 'em without damagin' our stuff,“ ye say? Worth a try, I reckon!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_048: First, we track 'em down. If they're headin' south, the Starlight Celebrant by Galvanth's Spire probably saw 'em.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_049: I'll go ahead with the bears and have a word with the lad stationed down there. We'll wait for you before makin' our move.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_GODBERT_000_050: Ho ho ho! A fine plan indeed! All that remains is to round up the troublemakers, and make those darling children smile once more. Now go, adventurer! May the raging flames of your righteous soul spare not those who defy the will of Nymeia!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_051: You're going to Galvanth's Spire? I want to help too, but I know I'd only get in your way. So I'll keep an eye on things here!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_060: It's just as we suspected. A whole troop of 'em have been seen shufflin' about by the Mirror Planks.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_061: The bears are in position, and ready when you are. When our quarry shows up, have a word with the Starlight Bear handler to ride  and start flingin' them starbursts!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_062: Once you've got 'em stunned, we'll take care of the rest. There might even be a few more 'venturers willin' to join ye. Just do whatever it takes!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_063: I don't think I'd be any good fighting treants, so I'll keep out of the way. Wish I could watch, though!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_COMMITTEE00439_100_: Baenfaeld's told me all about the plan. I've got  right here, ready to throw some starbursts. Good luck out there!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_COMMITTEE00439_110_: is right here, waiting for you. Don't let those thieves get away!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_070: Oh, you're back! How did it go?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_071: Ah, there ye are! Great work, ! You too, ! Judgin' by the amount of decorations we got back, I'd say most of the treants've been dealt with.
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_072: We couldn't've done it without ye! So, Taff, you got anythin' ye want to say?
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_073: Thank you so much! I knew you'd come through for us!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_074: I'll make sure everyone knows what you did! Nymeia bless you, ! Good-bye!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_TAFF_000_075: You know, , you're just like one of the saint's little helpers!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_SYSTEM_000_110: You cannot be certain, but somehow you sense he is saying, “It was a pleasure to fight alongside you! We are thrilled that the joy of the Starlight Celebration has returned to Bentbranch Meadows.”
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_111: Ye have my thanks as well! 'Course, now we've got to put all the decorations back up, but I'm sure the young'uns won't mind helpin' out. The Starlight Celebration's been saved, and it's all because of you!
TEXT_FESXMS302_03010_BAENFAELD_000_112: There are still a few odds an' ends missin', probably tangled up in some other treants. If ye've got time, ye can help us look for 'em! The local youngsters, and the “T'riffic Trio” here would be right pleased if ye did!
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: Ah, it's you! The kind adventurer who helped us before! I do hope you'll forgive me for imposing upon you once more, but we have something of an unprecedented situation here...
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_INVESTIGATOR03011_1: You are an adventurer, yes, and an experienced one besides? Ah, Twelve be praised! We could do with the assistance of a  such as yourself...
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: You see, a wolfman claiming to have come from distant Doma wishes to join the Continental Circus!

Now, don't get me wrong─it's a fine thing the troupe does, going around Eorzea's great cities and livening up the various All Saints' Wake festivities. But I would never encourage someone to throw their lot in with the fiends!
And that's no exaggeration either. Mark me, friend: they're demons! Honest-to-gods monsters who delight in terrorizing decent folk like you and me!

...Though, to be fair, that mostly amounts to the occasional prank, like stealing your socks or spilling your drink when you're not looking. Still, there's no telling when they'll get a taste for blacker deeds!

I told all this and more to the wolfman, of course, but he just looked at me like I'd been quaffing milkroot all morning. Aye, at this rate, I fear there's nothing we can do to save him from a life of devilry...
Wait, I've got an idea! It's a little convoluted, but...if you and our Far Eastern friend joined the Continental Circus together, you could keep him from committing any truly unspeakable evils!

Yes, yes, that makes about as much sense as anything. By the by, the wolfman's name is Soga. He's quite sociable, so don't be hesitant to, say, wander over to the Whistling Miller and approach him without prompting.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_010: You...you do not fear me, Eorzean?
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_A1_000_001: I've had dealings with beastmen before.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_A1_000_002: Oh, I'm quaking in my boots.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_011: Would that more of your kinsmen could say the same. Most here regard me with suspicion, if not outright fear.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_012: Are you, now... Nevertheless, you have mustered the courage to speak with me, and for that I am grateful. Others make a concerted effort to pretend I am not here, as if my very presence is an affront to their Matron.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_013: I have found myself with more freedom to travel since the liberation of my homeland, and so I thought to come to Eorzea. Such is the reason for my being here, but what is yours for seeking me out?
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_014: With the aid of my countrymen I came to Gridania by way of Revenant's Toll. Such is the reason for my being here, but what is yours for seeking me out?
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_015: You too wish to join the Continental Circus? Ho, what fortune! I thought perhaps you were an associate of that nosy adventurer who attempted to deter me from my course...
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_016: Wheresoever I go in these lands, I am feared. Men avert their gaze, women cross the road to avoid me, children burst into tears.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_017: That, however, is my experience as a humble traveler. As a member of the Continental Circus, on the other hand, I would be lauded for this “talent,” would I not?
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_018: No longer would I be scorned and alone─nay, I would be rich in “nakama,” as the Hingans say. We too could be nakama!
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_019: Ah, but I am getting ahead of myself! I have yet to even ask you your name.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_020: , is it? It is an honor and a pleasure. Now, then─let us go and greet the Impresario!
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: It shouldn't be too hard to find Soga. Just stand around at a crossroads or some such and keep an eye out for, well...a wolfman!
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_IMPHEAD_000_030: Well, well, well. Two wanderers who wish to join our esteemed troupe of tricksters. Yet what is this strange sense of familiarity? Perchance naught more than a figment of my imagination, but...never mind.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_IMPHEAD_000_031: Well, well, well. Two wanderers who wish to join our esteemed troupe of tricksters. I cannot help but wonder at your motives, but it matters not in the end─if you truly yearn to strike fear into the hearts of your fellow man, that is enough.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_IMPHEAD_000_032: This year we will throw open the doors of our haunted manor once more, and as we have our hands full with the preparations, we would be fools to turn away you and your wolfman associate.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_033: Then you will permit us to join the Continental Circus? Just like that? Kami be praised! I am grateful to you beyond measure, good sir, and should be glad to assist you in any way you desire!
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_IMPHEAD_000_034: My, such enthusiasm! Very well, let us begin with a simple task─a test of your skills, rather, in which you shall attempt to frighten several subjects, sowing seeds of terror into their─ahem─thereby showing them a jolly good time.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_IMPHEAD_000_035: Afterwards, you may then encourage them to join in the fun as well, though... Hmm. That said, your comparatively plain disposition will not serve you well in this endeavor.
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_IMPHEAD_000_036: Fortunately, we have the means to bestow upon you rather simliar wolflike features! Take it, with our blessings!
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_SOGA_000_045: I wanted to let that adventurer know not to worry about me, so I gave a missive to one of those little postmen earlier. It twirled and said, “Thank you, kupo!”
TEXT_FESHLW401_03011_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: Soga wrote me a letter saying that the two of you were off to meet the Impresario? I'll leave you to it, then.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_000: You have the means at your disposal. Come, dress yourself in the guise of the werewolf, and let us see how terrifying you truly are!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SYSTEM_000_001: Equip a werewolf head, a werewolf body, a pair of werewolf arms, and a pair of werewolf bottoms, and then speak with the Impresario.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SYSTEM_000_002: You may use a werewolf attire coffer to acquire these items. However, please note that this item cannot be used outside large settlements.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SYSTEM_000_003: If you do not have a werewolf head, a werewolf body, a pair of werewolf arms, and a pair of werewolf bottoms in your possession, you can purchase them from a Calamity salvager.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_005: How generous they are to furnish you with a costume. We shall have much fun together, you and I!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_010: Hm? Why do you hesitate, my friend? I pray you present yourself to me in your full wolflike splendor!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_011: By the Twelve, what a hideous, monstrous abomination! You have a true gift for horror!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_012: But such is to be expected of an adventurer, is it not? One who would slaughter twenty men for a sack of gil and kill a twenty-first for fun. Oh, how your enemies must have feared you─how their spirits must cry out for vengeance!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_013: Uh...I think that means you have his approval, !
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_014: Yes, indeed. So frightened was I that I nearly wept and soiled myself. Clearly there is naught I have to teach you, so I bid you go forth and spread fear!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_015: You are quite good at this, aren't you? I wonder if it will come as easily to me, though...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_016: Well, there is only one way to find out! As the Impresario said, we must go forth and spread fear to the people of Gridania!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_PUMPKIN_000_017: (-Disembodied Voice-)Yes, yes, that's the spirit, little wolves...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_020: ('Twould be foolish to begin without first settling upon a strategy, yes? Let us then consider how we might most effectively frighten the people of Gridania.)
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_021: (Hmm...the people of Eorzea are wholly unfamiliar with my kind, so let us play to their worst fears. A feral growl of some sort should do nicely. “GRRR!” or some such, perhaps?)
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SYSTEM_000_022: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “GRRR!” to frighten the man.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_FRIENDLYMAN03012_00: Oh! Where did you come from, stranger? And what strange garments are you wearing? Is this some sort of prank? If it is, you're not doing a very good job of it...
Gaaaaaaaaahhhhhh!!! What in the seven hells is that!?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_100_031: Hahaha, such a face you made! But now I pray you be at ease, good sir. We are members of the Continental Circus, on a quest to spread joy through fear to the people of Gridania!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_FRIENDLYMAN03012_00: Bugger me, is that a talking wolf...man? And with a sense of humor besides... Huh. I suppose I ought to be glad you're not a feral beast here to kill me.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_034: Indeed! It is all in good fun, as you can see. What is more, if you too are interested in taking part, the Continental Circus will gladly furnish you with your own guise of the werewolf for free!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_FRIENDLYMAN03012_00: Heh, is that so? Well, the price is certainly right. I think I might just go and get one!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_036: That went splendidly, ! I daresay we make a fine team.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_037: Still, we shouldn't be too dependent on one another. Why don't we split up and try to scare three more Gridanians apiece? Afterwards, we can regroup and decide what to do next.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SYSTEM_000_045: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “GRRR!” to strike fear into the hearts of hapless Gridanians.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_046: (Remember that the guise alone will not be enough to scare most people. You have to play the part with a hearty “GRRR!”)
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_TOUGHWOMAN03012_000: Nice try, little wolf, but I'm not so easily scared! Heh, look at you, spreading fear and terror while wearing such an adorable outfit.
Eh? You say the Continental Circus is giving them away for free to anyone willing to go around trying to frighten people like you are? Why didn't you say so from the first?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_COWARDLYMAN03012_00: M-M-Matron's teats, don't do that! I'm no good with wolves...or bears...or rabbits...
...So, to summarize: you're offering me a chance to dress up like a buffoon and get revenge on all the people who ever wronged me? Heh heh, don't mind if I do!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_OLDWOMAN03012_000_0: My oh my, aren't you scary! It's almost more than I can bear...

At first there was just the one wolfman walking around, but now I see that you're everywhere. Can't say I entirely understand, but if this is the way the wind is blowing, then let no one say I don't also blow!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_TMARITAA_000_066: Your fur looks so soft! And my, what a big mouth you have! The better to eat me with, right?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_TDANAFA_000_067: For a moment there I feared I might have to summon the Wailers, but then I realized what you were about. Just goes to show you shouldn't judge people by appearances, eh?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_TOUGHWOMAN03012_000: ...Well? What is it? Or are you just going to stare at me in silence?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SYSTEM_100_068: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “GRRR!” to strike fear into the hearts of hapless Gridanians.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_COWARDLYMAN03012_00: All these wolfmen prowling our fair city... Maybe if I go and hide behind some shrubbery they'll leave me be...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_OLDWOMAN03012_100_0: Such a lovely tradition, All Saints' Wake. I do so look forward to the festivities every year.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_070: Scared your three, ? I did as well, though I thought to keep going until you arrived.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_071: I have to say, too, that I have had more and more trouble as time went on. It would seem that word has spread of our activities, and the citizenry have grown somewhat...accustomed to my features?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_072: Be that as it may, I should like to think the Impresario will be pleased with the many people we sent his way.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_TDANAFA_000_076: ...Would it be all right if I asked to touch his fur as well, you think?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_080: Hahaha! How wonderful, how fantastic! Would you believe there has been no end to the stream of Gridanians clamoring for a guise of the werewolf to call their own?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_081: We owe it all to you two and your tireless efforts. Marvelous, marvelous work!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_082: Heh heh...with every innocent that embraces their bestial nature, with every soul that delights in the darkness, we creep ever closer to the Night of Devilry...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_083: Um, what was that you said just now? Something about a “Night of Devilry”?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_084: Wh-What? Oh, no! I said the, uh...the “Light of Equality”! Ever closer do we, uh, creep to it. Yes, that will do nicely.
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_085: Anyway, once again I must commend you both on a job well done! I should be glad to welcome you to the Continental Circus!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_IMPHEAD_000_086: That said, it may take rather a long time to make it official─proper paperwork and procedure and so forth─and we really do have our hands full at the moment. I'll have the contracts ready for you to sign soon enough, though, don't you worry!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_FRIENDLYMAN03012_00: Got you two good, eh? Nearly scared you to death! Oh, this is too much─and I owe it all to you two!
I usually come to these popular things late, you know? Was running around a couple of years back with a bedsheet over my head, like a ghost, but no one was paying me any mind─but not this time!
It's a great way to strike up a conversation with a lady too, heh heh. Aye, I've got a feeling that this is gonna be a good All Saints' Wake for me, and in more ways than one!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_092: ...So that is why he welcomed me with open arms. At last I understand you, Impresario...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_093: You sought only to aid me in befriending the people of Gridania! To help them to understand that I was not some strange, otherworldly creature, but a kindred spirit!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_094: In dressing themselves in the guise of the werewolf, they have come to realize that beneath this fur beats a heart no different from theirs! Oh, how deep and meaningful this game has proven to be!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_095: But I mustn't be content with my lot here in Gridania, . No─I must go unto all the peoples of Eorzea and endeavor to befriend each and every one! Surely that is what the Impresario would want?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_096: Then it is settled. With regret I will decline his invitation, though I shall remain until the festivities are concluded. And then I shall embark on a new journey!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_097: A final favor to ask of you, if I may, my friend. If you happen to cross paths with that other adventurer, would you thank him for me, and tell him of my decision?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_WITCH03012_000_105: Now, now, there's no need for shoving! We have enough guises for everyone!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_106: Never did I think I would see so many people wishing to become a wolf! I wonder what my kinsmen in Doma would think...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: I've seen an awful lot of people running around the city dressed as wolves of late. I don't suppose you and Soga had anything to do with that?
...That's not the conclusion I would have drawn, but the important thing is that Soga decided not to join the Continental Circus.

Perhaps more importantly, the people of Gridania seem to have grown accustomed to our wolfman friend, as well as the guises the troupe has been distributing to the mischievous. Aye, it'll take more than that to terrify the average Gridanian!
...Like that haunted manor of theirs, I suppose. Yes, that is still a problem...
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_INVESTIGATOR03011_1: But we'll keep an eye on that, we will! There'll be no Night of Devilry on our watch, no sir!
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_PUMPKIN_000_114: Heh heh heh... When brought into the light, the wolf can seem less fearsome. But in the dark man and monster are as equals. As friends. Won't you come and join us?
TEXT_FESHLW402_03012_SOGA_000_115: Forgive me, my friend, but I fear I do not have the time to seek out that adventurer who was so worried for my well-being before. Should you chance to see him again, please let him know that I am well.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: Ah, yes. I heard from the illusionist that the preparations for the haunted manor are finally complete.

This too is but a means to a nefarious end, another method by which the Continental Circus plots to stoke the fears of the populace...but since no one seems to be particularly frightened of the werewolf costumes, maybe there's no need to worry.
Anyway, if you've a mind to look into the haunted manor, you can go and speak with the illusionist yourself.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_WITCH03012_000_005: I will be happy to tell you all about the manor and its many amusements in a short while, my dear adventurer. But first, I must take a brief rest. Distributing guises of the werewolf all day can be quite exhausting, you know.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_WITCH03012_000_010: Oh, it's you! The adventurer to whom we owe so very, very much! I've barely had time to breathe what with all the people clamoring for guises of the werewolf.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_WITCH03012_000_011: But, more importantly, you will be pleased to hear that our haunted manor is now open to the public!
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_WITCH03012_000_012: Before you enter, however, you would do well to learn more of the various amusements that await you inside. One of our harlequin guides would be happy to assist you.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_WITCH03012_000_013: And when you have mustered your courage and are ready to brave the manor, you need only let them know!
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_WITCH03012_000_014: Much as I would love to lead you there myself, duty calls. The people yearn to dress themselves as wolves, and we must do our utmost to oblige them. Take care!
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_SYSTEM_000_015: You now have access to the Haunted Manor seasonal instance. To enter the manor, speak with the harlequin guide in either Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_SYSTEM_000_016: The Haunted Manor is a light party instance (four players). There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_SYSTEM_000_017: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members will be filled out automatically via the matching system.
TEXT_FESHLW403_03013_INVESTIGATOR03011_0: Be my guest if you want to explore the manor, but I'm happy to leave it well enough alone, if it's all the same to you.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: Hmmm... You have the bearing of one who has seen more than their fair share of danger. Are you, perchance, one of the adventurers these lands are famous for? If so, I could certainly use your help.
I am the inoshishi bugyo, part of a Far Eastern delegation come to share our Heavensturn customs with the good people of Eorzea.

I have always found it fascinating that our celebrations of this momentous occasion are so similar, and yet so different. You see, in the Far East it is not a deity, but a totem animal which serves as herald for the coming year.

And at long last, the boar shall ascend to its rightful place in the heavens. To mark the occasion, I commissioned kabuto in its likeness, that all might bask in the glory of this most majestic and jovial of creatures.
Ahem, but I digress. I am in dire need of assistance, and would gladly offer you one of these celebratory helms as compensation for your time.

The task I have in mind should be markedly simpler than the adventures you're accustomed to. All I ask is you take my faithful companion Ibukimaru in tow, and spread word that we will be handing out advent mochi-rice cakes as part of our celebration of Heavensturn.
Speaking of rice cakes, are you familiar with the art of mochi pounding?
My, my. That I should find an adventurer versed in the traditions of my homeland. The blessings of the boar are already upon us!

Allow me to explain. Mochi pounding is the process by which we make our advent cakes. Freshly steamed rice is placed in a large mortar, then beaten into a sticky dough using a hammer. Though quite simple, these treats are a cornerstone of the celebration.
To ensure our mochi is pounded to perfection, I've enlisted the aide of a cylopes who should be hammering away as we speak right outside the city.

Yet for all my efforts, no one has shown even the faintest glimmer of interest. That is why I would ask you to go in my stead. I sincerely doubt the good people of Limsa Lominsa would deny the invitation of an adventurer. Especially one in the company of dear Ibukimaru, here.
Ah, he seems rather eager to get started. An excellent sign. I leave the rest to you, then.
If you can garner interest in even a handful of people, I would be ever so grateful.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CITIZEN03014_000_05: Ahem. Would you happen to know what this boar's doing here? I know a come-hither look when I see one, and the way he's been drinking me in is making me uncomfortable...
Heavensturn, you say? And there'll be cakes? You can be sure I'll attend and eat my fair share.

But are you certain it's to be the year of the boar? Word about town is it's the year of the cat... Then again, I never could remember the animals they celebrate over in the Far East. At any rate, thanks for the invitation.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CITIZEN03014_000_06: ...Yes, what is it? <sigh> Not more bad news, I hope.
They're making ready for the Heavensturn celebration? But I thought it was canceled.
I've been waiting all year for another chance to eat those delicious, sticky cakes. I can hardly wait!
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CITIZEN03014_000_07: Oh good, an adventurer. Would you mind giving me a hand doing away with this damned boar?
What do you mean he's part of the Heavensturn celebration? The way I heard it, the whole thing's been called off on account of this brute causing all manner of trouble for the Far Eastern delegation.
Hmmm. You've an honest face, so I'd like to believe you. Well, if there really is going to be a celebration, I'd be a fool to pass up the chance to have more of those cakes.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: Ah, you are returned. Were the townsfolk receptive to our offerings of sweets and merrymaking?
It would seem someone has gone to great lengths to mislead the good people of Limsa Lominsa. But who would have cause to disrupt the Heavensturn celebration?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_0: (-???-)Nyahahaha! Like kittens drawn to gaelicatnip, they played right into my hands.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: <gasp> Neko bugyo! What are you doing here!?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_0: As if I could stand idly by as you propagate this farce you call tradition, denying the regal feline the love and devotion it deserves!
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: You poor, misguided soul. Did you truly believe our plans could be sabotaged with a few baseless rumors?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_0: You underestimate me at your peril, inoshishi bugyo. I have gained powerful new allies here in Eorzea. Allies that have poised themselves to pounce on the very heart of your little celebration.
The cat shall yet have his cream. Just you wait and see. Nyahahaha!
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: My apologies, friend. 'Tis clear now that trouble has followed me here to Eorzea.

As I mentioned before, custom dictates we name a totem animal to herald the coming of the new year. It is said the kami descended from the heavens and bestowed this duty upon twelve animals, who would serve one after the other in a cycle that repeats to this very day. And while the truth of this tale has long since been lost to time, one thing is certain─the cat was not among the chosen, for there is no year of the cat.

Even so, there are those who believe the cat was spurned by the other beasts, and robbed of its place in the heavens. Seeking revenge for this alleged betrayal, these zealots labor tirelessly to foil any celebration that proclaims the ascent of a totem animal. The neko bugyo is their leader.
That he should come all this way, and with allies... This bodes ill.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_RICECAKEREEVE_000_1: Grave tidings from the pounding sites! Both areas are infested with strange cat-like creatures attacking any and everything that approaches the mortars. Between them and the thunderous hammers of the cyclopes, collecting mochi for our advent cakes is all but impossible.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: The advent cakes, of course! There can be no celebration without a sufficient store.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_RICECAKEREEVE_000_1: Surely there must be something we can do. Or perhaps... Hm?
! Yes, I thought I recognized you. No doubt those hellcats would seem more like kittens to a hardened adventurer such as you. Please say you will help us.
You've the look of a rather hardened adventurer. Yes, I imagine those hellcats would seem more like kittens to one of your caliber. Would you be willing to help us?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: We would be most grateful for any assistance you can offer.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_RICECAKEREEVE_000_1: Excellent. I shall return to the pounding sites and make ready for your arrival.
You wish to join me? Very well. Come, Ibukimaru, let us be off!
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: Though the task may seem daunting, there are but two pounding sites. One in middle La Noscea, to the southeast of the Zephyr Gate, and in lower La Noscea, to the east of the Salt Strand. Pray save what mochi you can from the mortars.
I will see to it the people of Limsa Lominsa are informed of the neko bugyo's deception. Please, do what you can to retrieve our mochi from the pounding sites.
Welcome back, my friend. Thanks to you, this year's Heavensturn is off to a wonderful start. See for yourself.
The people's concerns were allayed easily enough, and all doubts were cast aside once the mochi arrived from the pounding sites. I am in your debt.
Enough, neko bugyo. This is not a battle to be won or lost. What is there to gain from bringing misery to these people?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_1: Their misery is a small price to pay if the cat is to ascend to its rightful place in the heavens.
If you would defy me, then you leave me no choice. Go, my furry friend! Rip them to pieces!
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: Was this your ally who would see Heavensturn fall into ruin? It seems to me he's rather taken with our celebration of the boar.
You cannot change what has been ordained by the kami. Please, neko bugyo, I beg of you─abandon this foolish endeavor.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_1: Then what is to become of the cats? Their hopes and dreams left to foul like so much spoiled milk...
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_A2_000_000: Is this really what cats want?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_A2_000_001: You mean your hopes and dreams?
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_1: Well of course it is. At least...that's what I've always told myself.
My hopes and dreams? Well, I...
After all I've done, you would still offer me solace?
<sigh> Everything was so much simpler before I became a bugyo. There were no delusions of grandeur, no nefarious schemes. Only my love of cats that I hoped to share with the world.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: Neko bugyo, I...I had no idea.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_1: And any who would refuse my love will be made to suffer the consequences!
Ah, your belly is full. Good. There is much work to be done, and you will need your strength.
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: Wait! What are you─
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_CATMISSIONARY_000_1: Mark me, inoshishi bugyo─come the next turn of the heavens, the masses will clamor not for the boar, but the cute and cuddly cat! Nyahahaha!
TEXT_FESNYR501_03014_BOARMISSIONARY_000_: But...the boar will not be next year's totem animal... <sigh>

At the very least, we can take comfort in knowing this year's celebration can proceed unimpeded. Or so I hope. Should the neko bugyo and his feline companion return, I pray we can look to you for assistance once more.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_000: Have you come to listen to the silken strings of Simpkin, traveling troubadour and master minstrel? No?
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_001: You do, however, have the look of one who lives life on the road─and on the subject of wondrous wanderings and the musical expression thereof, I do mayhap have some small wisdom to offer.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_002: When I suddenly find my heart stirred by some spectacle of nature or inspiring act of derring-do, I simply let the emotion of the moment flow through my fingers and into my harp. I've found no sound to be as achingly beautiful as one born from that instant of genuine joy or wistful sadness.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_003: You need no special training or knowledge to give voice to the music of the heart─only a willingness to play the score as it writes itself across your soul.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_004: If you can accomplish such a surrender, then you will have created a piece unique unto yourself. And what melody could be more precious!?
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_005: Aye, I knew from the moment I laid eyes upon you─here is a  whose spirit begs for instrumental interpretation. Pray release your inhibitions, and favor the world with your performance!
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_006: To begin, you should simply play whichever notes catch your fancy. Let whimsy carry you up and down the scales, revel in the soaring heights and plunging depths, until you find a song which resonates with your being.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_007: Painted with the experience of your adventures, the timbre and tone will be yours and yours alone. Ah, I wonder what manner of music will fill the air... May the wind catch your composition, and deliver it unto my covetous ear!
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SYSTEM_000_010: You have learned “Perform”! When playing as a bard, Performance Actions can be found in the Actions & Traits window, accessed under Character in the main menu.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_020: I understand─the courage for such surrender does not come easily. My harp and I shall be in town for some time, so feel free to visit me again should you choose to pursue my musical teachings.
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SIMPKIN_000_100: You have a certain air about you. A musical air. Have you ever considered taking up an instrument...?
TEXT_SUBCTS051_03019_SYSTEM_000_101: In order to undertake this quest, you must change your current job to bard.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_000: Greetings, friend! You're just in time to lend us a hand with the Hatching-tide festivities!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_001: Do you know much about our egg-centric festival? It all began with our founder─Jihli Aliapoh─and her prophetic dreams.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_002: We've found that recreating Jihli's yearly visions leads to the most delightful of celebrations. Decorating eggs is part of it, of course, but there is so much more─one of our egg collectors will be happy to give you the whole story.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_003: Oh, , how wonderful to see you! Just in time to lend us a hand with the Hatching-tide festivities...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_004: You do remember how it all works, don't you? Jihli's prophetic dreams? The egg decorating? The joyous laughter of child and adult alike?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_005: Everything has been going to plan. ...Everything, that is, aside from one tiny, unexpected detail: the Dreamer has not had her dream this year!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_006: Jihli herself seems unperturbed, and suggested we go ahead with hiding eggs around town for people to find.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_007: And an egg hunt is, of course, a perfectly enjoyable event all by itself. Thus did we straighten our egg caps, and turn our efforts to the preparations...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_008: But now disaster has struck yet again! The eggs we so painstakingly crafted have been viciously and maliciously stolen!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_009: Please, adventurer! You must help us retrieve our Hatching-tide treasures!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_010: Oh, thank you! Having a hero like you on the job could make all the difference!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_011: Your cooperation is much appreciated. Having a hero like you on the job could make all the difference!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_012: And you won't be working alone─I've also secured the services of a talented tracker.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_013: If you head off right now, you should find her investigating the scene near the Greatloam Growery. She'll be the one shouldering a bow and wearing a decidedly fetching egg cap!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_020: Nonotta sent you to help, did she? Good, I could use a second set of eyes.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_021: ..., is it? You'll forgive me if I don't offer a name.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_022: When I accepted the job, Nonotta insisted I wear this ridiculous hat to be “in the spirit of things”...and I'd rather not have my colleagues hear about it. Ever.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_023: So if we happen to cross paths again in the future, you don't know me and I don't know you. Are we clear?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_024: ...Oh, , it's you! And surely you remember me! Leih Aliapoh?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_025: Ah, but maybe it would've been better had you forgotten. When I accepted the job, Nonotta insisted I wear this ridiculous hat. To be “in the spirit of things,” she said...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_026: Let's keep this festive garb between the two of us, all right? If that thrice-damned Wildwood finds out, I'll never hear the end of it. And that means no talking about it back at the guild, either!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_027: Right. Now that that's settled, we can focus on the task at hand.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_028: The eggs were apparently stored in a nearby hut. If we start from there and make our way down the path, we should find traces of the culprit.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_029: Should you come across anything out of the ordinary, bring it to me and I'll see if it has any relation to the crime. Let's catch ourselves an egg thief!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_035: Did you try visiting the Greatloam Growery? Our tracker should still be there, suitably adorned in a festive egg cap!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_042: You find a tuft of black hair caught on the edge of a broken plank. The strands are unusually thick and wiry. Might it have belonged to the egg thief...?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_048: You spy a splinter of some shiny type of rock. Might this have something to do with the egg thief...?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_049: You see evidence of someone passing through this area...but cannot tell who made the tracks.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_045: How fares your investigation? Any sign of our egg thief?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_100_045: We're fortunate this path has seen little passage. I can make out several distinct tracks...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_050: Found some promising clues, have you? Let me have a closer look.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_051:
We'll start with the shiny stone...
Hm, this seems to be a flake of mythril ore. Odd, since to the best of my knowledge, mythril deposits aren't naturally occurring in the Twelveswood.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_052: Then we have this black tuft of...hair? Fur? It's awfully coarse. Considering where you found it, it may very well belong to the thief. Nice work!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_053: Now it's my turn to share. If you look carefully, you'll notice the tracks on the ground here.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_054: Oho, marked those for yourself already, did you? But what do they tell you? Aside from “someone passed this way,” of course.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_055: I can make out three distinct sets. From the size and gait, the first one was likely a female Miqo'te. The steps are deep and deliberate, thus I suspect they were made by Jihli when she came to place the eggs.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_100_054: As for the second set, they belong to a smaller-than-average Lalafell. Judging by the wide and random path of the steps, I believe they were made by a panicked Nonotta when she discovered the eggs had gone missing.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_100_055: The true mystery here lies with the third, and smallest, set of tracks. At first glance I considered a beastkin, but the creature obviously walks on two legs. Putting together the evidence thus far, would you hazard a guess as to who─or what─is our culprit?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_056: Must you jest? Any Lalafell with feet that small and hair that wiry would be a terrifying sight to behold!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_057: Are you making light of the situation? Or are you simply not listening? Either way, can we be serious for a moment here?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_058: Ah, very good. I see the evidence at hand has led us to the same conclusion.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_059: ...Our egg thief is almost certainly a spriggan. And whilst the motive is yet unclear, we at least have a suspect to chase.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_060:
The spriggans of the Twelveswood lair in the Central Shroud...
Based on these tracks, the egg thief was very likely headed towards the Yellow Serpent Gate. Let's follow the spoor, shall we?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_070: You were a moment too late, . I spotted a spriggan cradling an egg and took him down with my bow!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_071: I didn't aim for anything vital, of course─we need him alive if we're to find out where he hid the rest of the eggs.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: Oh, Riggy, my poor friend. Lie still, and I'll have you mended in a moment...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_074: Your “poor friend”? Would you kindly explain what in the Matron's name is going on here?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: From your actions, I assume the two of you are on the trail of the missing eggs?
As fortune would have it, Riggy and I witnessed the crime itself! We watched, aghast, even as an egg-laden spriggan joined others of his kin and made off with his Hatching-tide spoils!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_077: You were there!? But I was told there were no witnesses. And what's the story behind this spriggan, then?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: Oh, Riggy here? This honorable and forthright soul pursued his brethren into their very lair, and escaped with one of the stolen treasures!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_RIGGY_100_078: Riggy is good spriggy! Bring back eggy!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: Unfortunately, however, the trail leading into the spriggan nest is too narrow for folk of ordinary size. And that's not even considering the woodland monsters which lurk along the way. Apparently they gave Riggy quite a scare...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_080: What, so our only recourse is to encourage “Riggy” to make another foray on our behalf? We'd best say our farewells to those eggs...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: ...I have an idea! What if we furnish Riggy with a linkpearl? Then we can lend him support during his expedition─give advice on how to deal with monsters, cheer him on, that sort of thing!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_RIGGY_100_081: Riggy try again! Listen to shiny speakyyy!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_082: ...Forgive me if I'm not filled with confidence. What say you, ?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: Thank you, ! I know he can do this!
Please, just give him a chance! I promise you, Riggy will give this his all!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_RIGGY_000_085: Riggy is readyyy! Jumpy, springy, and grab many eggyyy!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: I do believe we've restored Riggy's enthusiasm for the task. Now, if only I knew a little more about fighting mon─ Oh! You're an adventurer, aren't you? You should be in charge of the linkpearl!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_101: The following controls can be used to navigate Egg Hunter Riggy:
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_103: Collect 15 or more eggs to win the game. Hitting obstacles or being struck by enemy attacks will cause you to drop eggs, so do your best to avoid any danger!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10:
Oh dear, we seem to have missed a few eggs...
But never mind! Take a deep breath, calm your mind, and we can try again!
Oh, look at all these eggs! Well done, you two!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_100_106: Nice work, little one! I have to admit, I was wrong about you...and I'm sorry about the whole “shooting you with an arrow” thing, as well.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_RIGGY_100_107: Riggy not angry! Riggy happy everyone happyyy!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: Here, you should take these eggs and deliver them to Nonotta─she will be thrilled to hear we've tracked them down.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_108: ...Hm? I don't recall mentioning Nonotta's name.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: Oh! Well, you see, I...I'm a good friend of hers! And this isn't the first time I've helped out with an egg hunt.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_11: Ahem! Anyway, Riggy and I shall have another look around to see if we've missed any of those precious eggs! Fare you well, friends!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_111: That spriggan is an odd character, but it's the conjurer who makes my tail twitch. I suppose we have some good news for Nonotta, at least. Shall we?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_115: It seems we have no choice but to trust in this spriggan. And seeing as I, uh, put an arrow in him earlier, it might be best if you take the lead on this linkpearl strategy.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_RIGGY_000_116: Riggy ride biggy rock! Riggy springy down!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_RIGGY_000_117: Riggy try again! Jumpy, springy, and grab many eggyyy!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_120: Ah, there you are! I heard from our tracker friend that the eggs have been found! May I see them, please?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_121: Yes, this is one I decorated myself! Thank you so very much!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_122: Jihli, look! We have our eggs back!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_12: That's wonderful! We must have searched everywhere... Wherever did you find them?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_NONOTTA_000_124: ...In a spriggan nest, you say!? So the culprit was a spriggan all along?
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_125: Wha─? You've a strange sense of humor, friend, but I have to agree that the one responsible for this crime was no spriggan.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_127: Ah, well, that's true in part. But the spriggans were merely accomplices to the crime.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_128: There was a mastermind behind this entire affair...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_129: You might be this festival's organizer, but I suspect you planned the theft from the start! The conjurer who so conveniently appeared to heal Riggy...that was you!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_13: Yes, 'twas I who arranged for the eggs to “disappear.” But it was not my intent to deceive or distress you.

You see, I actually did have my prophetic dream this year. And the vision implied that if I hid the eggs myself, then the ensuing chain of events would lead to encounters both unexpected and wondrous.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_100_132: So everything that took place was an effort to recreate the details of your dream? No wonder you were so anxious to mend the spriggan's hurts...
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_13: I apologize for my trickery. But tell me, did you not enjoy meeting the charming Riggy, or the manner in which you recovered the lost eggs?
Speaking of which, there was a gift for you hiding inside one of the reclaimed treasures─a magical doll! 'Tis ever so adorable when they toddle along in your wake.

Ah yes, there is one more encounter we have yet to celebrate...
Yours and mine, Leih Aliapoh.
Some few days ago, I was cleaning out a storage closet and came across an old journal. It belonged to my mother, Mihli, a talented pratictioner of the healing arts.
In its pages she made mention of her sister, and the life her sibling led as a hunter in the depths of the Twelveswood.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_14: My aunt was said to have given birth to a single daughter. The girl grew to be quite a handful, plain-spoken and proud, with a knack for the bow... I think you know her name.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_141: (-Leih Aliapoh-)Well, I'll be a spriggan's second cousin. And a first cousin to you, it seems! Now that is an unexpected wonder.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_14: I thank you for your cooperation in this, . Even I was unaware of the surprise that would greet me this day.
If you aren't too weary, might you be interested in helping me hide the eggs once more? We may just witness a few more special encounters!
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_144: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_SYSTEM_000_145: Open the toy chest in any inn room to take another turn at this activity.
TEXT_FESEST401_03079_LEIHALIAPOH_000_145: I let Nonotta know that her eggs are safe and sound. All you need do is make the delivery.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Are you ready for some Hatching-tide magic, ? As my dream revealed, all you need do is help hide one of our eggs and an extraordinary encounter will ensue.

We've already been hard at work, spreading the word that anyone who finds a Hatching-tide basket is welcome to the gift the egg holds. I imagine quite a few folk will be out and about, searching for a slice of festival fun!
My vision has shown me the perfect hiding place─here, let me mark it down for you. Simply set the basket down at this spot, then step back and enjoy a whimsical collision of fates!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ESUMIYAN_000_010: Ah, yes, the season for egg hunting is upon us again. The whispers of the elementals have been growing ever more fervent...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KHLOEALIAPOH_000_01: Yes, I found one! I can't wait to open it and see what's inside!
...Oh, were you here first? You should have it, then!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ESUMIYAN_000_013: That is not necessary, little one. Pray take the egg, with my blessing.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KHLOEALIAPOH_000_01: No no no, that won't do! You look younger than Khloe, and Zhloe always says, “you have to be nice to the children younger than you!”
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ESUMIYAN_000_015: Ah, sweet child, you must not be from Gridania. Do you see these horns? That means I am a Padjal, and Padjali do not age as others do. Though I appear young, I am much, much older than you.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KHLOEALIAPOH_000_01: Is that true!? I guess you really do have horns...
Hmmm. Well, if you really are “much, much older,” then you must have been on lots of adventures! Khloe likes listening to stories and then making up her own. Can you tell me some of yours?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ESUMIYAN_000_018: Stories? I am not sure I have any tales that might capture your interest, little one...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ESUMIYAN_000_019: My apologies, but I must be on my way. I pray your Hatching-tide gift brings you joy.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KHLOEALIAPOH_000_02: W-Wait! Khloe will give you the egg! I just want to hear a story!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_03: What a pretty basket. Oh, this must be one of those Hatching-tide eggs!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MAISENTA_000_031: Joining in the egg hunt, are we?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_03: I was! I mean, I am! But you can have this one if you like. Zhloe's business will keep her in Gridania for a little while longer, so...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MAISENTA_000_033: No need for that─I was merely coming to see that the goods I provided for the festivities had been delivered in acceptable condition. The prize is all yours.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_03: Oh, I see! Th-Thank you, miss. I'll just take this, then...
Correct me if I'm wrong but...if you're providing wares for a festival this grand, then you must be a merchant of some renown. Perhaps you might share with Zhloe some of the secrets of your success!
Zhloe runs an orphanage, you see, and she's started a trading business to help cover the costs. But it's all so complicated! Any advice you could offer would be most appreciated!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MAISENTA_000_037: Ah, well I'm afraid trade secrets are not mine to share. I work for a company, you see, and I can't be seen giving advice to a potential competitor.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MAISENTA_000_038: However... If we were to agree upon some manner of profitable arrangement, then perhaps I could be of service to you. Not as a mentor, mind you, but as a trading partner.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_03: Oh! That would be wonderful, thank you!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SILVAIRRE_000_050: Aha, I have found one at last. This hunt has proven more irksome than I anticipated...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_000_051: Silvairre? What brings you to this part of town?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SILVAIRRE_000_052: ...I am merely passing through. Not that my personal affairs are any of your concern, Leih.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_000_053: ...Fair enough. And you did say that the egg hunt was “a frivolous distraction for children and simpletons.” You won't mind if I take this basket and be on my way, then.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SILVAIRRE_000_054: What!? But I found it first!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_000_055: Oh? I thought you were merely “passing though”?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_000_057: Here's the deal, my perpetually humorless colleague. You admit you were actually <gasp> enjoying the egg hunt, and I'll let you have this egg.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_SILVAIRRE_000_058: I care not for your ridiculous egg! Frolic like a fool if you must, but I have training drills to attend. Good  to you!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_000_059: Ah, Silvairre, I thought you would've mended that habit. You still cover your mouth every time you lie...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_100_059: Must he always play the part of a curmudgeon? At least his lies are easy to see through...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_LEIHALIAPOH_000_060: Such a target he paints upon himself. Let us see him explain things away after I plant this egg in his weapons chest!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_YWAIN_000_070: Oho, it seems I've found myself a Hatching-tide basket! There's not another soul in sight, after all, and 'twould be a shame to leave it there unclaimed...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_YWAIN_000_072:
Steady on there, lad.
After the egg, were you? Well, far be it from me to deprive a child of his sought-after prize...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_NICOLIAUX_000_073: Hey, don't I know you from somewhere? I'm fairly sure you're a lancer, but I forget the name...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_NICOLIAUX_000_074: Well, no matter! You seem kind of worn down, so I'm giving the egg to you. Hope it cheers you up!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_YWAIN_000_075:
Even at the rank of guildmaster, apparently I am a nameless, worn-down nobody...
Hmph. Younglings these days.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_YWAIN_000_076: Worn down...? That business with Foulques must be tiring me more than I care to admit. Mayhap I should retire early this evening...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_YWAIN_000_077: Worn down...? I suppose that unfortunate business with Foulques exhausted me more than I care to admit. Mayhap I should retire early this evening...
