TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_090: To find the egg, you must be the egg, hm hm hm...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_FUFUCHA_000_091: Oh, Master Beatin, what a pleasant surprise.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_092: Mistress Fufucha─the pleasure is all mine. Enjoying the merriment of the egg hunt, are we?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_FUFUCHA_000_093: I am. As much as I love being up to my elbows in soil, the excitement of the celebrations proved too strong a lure to resist. Although I appear to have arrived a touch late to claim this particular prize.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_094: Nonsense. You will have this egg─I insist! Consider it a token of appreciation for the all the fine logs with which you supply us.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_FUFUCHA_000_095: How can I refuse such a gracious offer. My thanks, Guildmaster.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_096: Yes, your botanists truly have an eye for the most splendid timber.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_FUFUCHA_000_097: I'm glad our harvest is of adequate quality...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_098: Now, now, no false modesty, child. Why, the teak we received the other day was of such surpassing beauty, I felt myself being drawn into its very grain...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_099:
The abundant oils... That supple surface...
It seemed an age ere the wood was dried, but my patience was repaid tenfold when I beheld its final form.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_100:
So resilient... So pliable...
Such a labor of love it was that I have yet to commit the planks to a project. The mere thought of what I might craft leaves me aquiver with anticipation...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BEATIN_000_101: Say, are you not free for the ? Shall we pull up some stools in the workshop and further discuss our mutual love for lumber? From forest to benchtop, there is so much joy we can share on the topic...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_FUFUCHA_000_102: I, er... I just remembered I forgot to water the succulents! Here, you take the egg! I really must be going...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MIOUNNE_000_120: <yawn> Festivals do help bring the crowds to the Canopy, but by the Matron am I exhausted...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MIOUNNE_000_121: Well, well, what do we have here? It must be one of those gift baskets everyone has been clamoring about.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_GEVA_000_122: Mother Miounne. On the hunt for eggs as well, are you?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MIOUNNE_000_123: I was just out stretching my legs and almost tripped over the thing. Pray take this one if you will─I must return to work.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_GEVA_000_124: You look weary, Miounne. Hatching-tide is a busy time for Gridania, and for you especially, I should think.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_GEVA_000_126: I've raised two children, dear. Compared to their inexplicable moods and capricious needs, the source of your distress is refreshingly obvious.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_GEVA_000_127: You will have tea with me, and I won't take no for an answer. We can't have the face of Gridania looking worn and haggard now, can we?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_MIOUNNE_000_128: I accept, then. But at the very least, you must allow me to brew the leaves.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_GEVA_000_129: Of course! I'd be a fool to pass up a cup poured by Mother Miounne herself. Come─let's take our ease for a bit, and crack open this Hatching-tide treasure together.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BODYGUARD01623_000_: Aha! I've found one! I only hope my lady will care for such a gift...
Wha─ Elder Seedseer! I'd thought you ensconced within the Lotus Stand!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KANESENNA_000_142: Keeper. The merry laughter of the townsfolk drew me out to join the celebrations, but I'd not thought to see you such an enthusiastic participant.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KANESENNA_000_143: Nor did I expect to stumble across an egg so quickly...though I believe you arrived some moments before me?
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BODYGUARD01623_000_: Nay, my lady! I'm certain you discovered the egg first! The prize is yours! Congratulations!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KANESENNA_000_145: Now, now, 'twould be unfair of me to claim what is rightfully yours.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BODYGUARD01623_000_: You could never be unfair, Elder Seedseer! Even if I were to take it, this egg would...belong to you...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_KANESENNA_000_147: ...There are other baskets to be found. I should be off, lest I miss my chance! Fare you well, Keeper.
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_BODYGUARD01623_000_: Elder Seedseer! You needn't search for another! I would give you anything...
Gods curse me for a coward! The perfect moment falls in my lap, yet my lips refuse to obey...
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: You have the basket and the spot where it needs to be hidden, yes? Then why do you linger!? Quickly now, ere Hatching-tide passes and its wondrous influence fades!
TEXT_FESEST402_03080_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: Well, ? Were you witness to a Hatching-tide encounter?
What mysterious magic this festival weaves! I knew you could help bring those meandering threads together!
Ah, but my dream was filled with many such splendid tapestries. Should you wish to hatch another unexpected meeting, I have more eggs for you to hide!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_000: Greetings, adventurer. Are you a lonely soul yearning for affection, or blissfully bonded to your beloved? Mayhap somewhere in between, or nowhere at all? Well, however you should identify, I, Lisette de Valentione, wish you all the blessings of love this Valentione's Day!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_010: ...Oh, 'tis you, dear friend! You have grown even more fetching since last we met, it took me a moment to recognize you. I am not surprised that fate should reunite us so, yet know that I am no less pleased for it.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_020: As you can see, the festivities are in full swing. Would that my esteemed ancestor, Lady Arabelle, could be here to witness the fruits of her legacy. A legacy born of the simplest of truths: all are deserving of ardor and affection.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_021: To ensure that her spirit lives on, my faithful retainers and I have journeyed forth from frosty Ishgard, that we might instill hearts the realm over with the warmth of truest love.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_022: And this year, I am proud to say that we have joined hands with the Sanctum of the Twelve, those purveyors of eternal love─a union forged in the very heavens!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_023: For our inaugural collaboration, we are offering couples the chance to test their affinity for one another. I cordially invite you to participate with the object of your ardor and affection!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_024: ...And here is where I send most people on their way. But you are not most people. Nay, for a capable adventurer such as you, I have a special request.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_025: You see, this year I've brought a trainee to help with the event, but she herself would benefit from some help.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_026: Her name is Astrid, and she is a little bit too...sober. Too rational. Yet where love is concerned, there is no surer guide than one's heart. Is this not so?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_027: I should be grateful if you would watch over her and lend her a hand when necessary. Oh, and pray keep the fact that you act at my behest between us.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_030: Remember, her name is Astrid. Pray watch over her and lend her a hand when necessary.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_031: Well met, my friend. I believe my lady fairest has tasked you with watching over Astrid.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_032: I myself tried to help the lass, but she was not welcoming of my assistance, and that is putting it rather mildly. I wish you better luck than I had.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_040: Oh, what am I to do? Sister placed her faith in me. I can't afford to fail. But at this rate...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_041: Eeeeeek! Er...I mean, if you're here for the affinity test, I'm afraid we aren't quite ready yet.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_042: No, wait. You're one of those adventurers, aren't you? Sister says that you and yours are ever willing to aid those in need. Well, I'm in direst need of aid right now!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_043: You see, I've been charged with devising and organizing a new affinity test for the Valentione's Day celebration, but there's been a little problem...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_044: Oh, who am I fooling? It's a huge problem! The moogles tasked with setting up the venue have all abandoned me, muttering moogle profanities as they fluttered off.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_045: I know not what I did to offend them. I only wished to do my part for the event─for love.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_046: I'm at a loss, adventurer. I beg you, find the moogles for me. And when you do, ask them what caused them to leave.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_050: Please hurry and find the moogles for me. And when you do, ask them what caused them to leave.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEA03082_000_06: Ahhh, this is more like it. Working too much─no, working at all is bad for the heart. Sometimes you just have to say, “Bugger this, I'm going home!”
Astrid wants to know why we up and left? First things first: lest there be any misunderstandings, what I said just now was─ahem─just a jest. We're definitely not being slack, kupo.

On the contrary, we care about the event. A lot. So when we saw what was being planned for the affinity test, well, we simply couldn't abide by it. It's all so stiff and dry, cracks are like to form between couples, kupo.
We wanted no part of that, and that's why we left. You can say as much to Astrid, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEB03082_000_07: <munch> <munch> Mmmmmm, if there's one thing that tastes better than kupo nuts you've earned, it's kupo nuts you haven't earned.
Astrid sent you, did she? Doesn't understand why we abandoned her? Well, the reason's quite complicated, kupo.
We moogles were working hard. No, really─we were toiling our little wings off in the name of eternal love. But we had no confidence in Astrid's affinity test, kupo.

No, her approach was all remonstrance and no romance. You can't expect couples to get in the mood for love that way, nor us to get in the mood for work. I'm motivationally challenged as it is, and this didn't help matters, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEC03082_000_08: <sigh> Is there a finer feeling than taking a nap while people around you work? Look at the poor fools, scurrying about, day in and day out. All that vain effort makes me want to laugh, kupohoho... Kupohohoho─!
What, Astrid wishes to know why we abandoned our work? Why, it's because we couldn't be bothe─ahem, I mean, her affinity test is the problem, kupo.
It's so dull and uninspired, couples are liable to fall asleep on the spot. Now, I'm usually all for sleep, but even I know that isn't the time and place for it, kupo.

Seeing this, we decided to leave. It's our way of protesting. And if we get to laze about in the bargain, well then, it's two birds with one stone!
...It's mostly about the protest, though. Make sure Astrid knows that, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_090: There you are! Were you able to find the moogles? What did they have to say?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_091: What? My affinity test...is to blame? But I poured my heart into it. That it should be so terrible as to drive our helpers away...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_100: So you agree with the moogles' assessment, and I should try to address the issues they raised?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_101: Yes... Yes! Sister has ever said that, wherever there is an obstacle to love, it falls to us to clear the way. And if my own test poses an obstacle, then by the Fury, I will improve it!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_110: So you think the moogles are simply making excuses for their laziness, and I should ignore their words? Even so, this gets us nowhere...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_111: ...Wait. You're testing my resolve, aren't you? Well, know that I shan't give up on love so easily! The moogles have the right of it, I can see that now. My affinity test is far from ideal, and by the Fury, I will improve it!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_120: So, um...how should I go about this? Let's see: there was “stiff and dry” and “all remonstrance and no romance” and “dull and uninspired.” There are so many issues, I'm not sure where to begin...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_121: (-???-)Ahem! Pray forgive me, but I chanced to be passing by, and couldn't help but overhear your conversation.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_122: Hmph, a likely story. As I've said a dozen times, Hortefense, your opinion is not needed. Scurry back to Sister.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_123: Now, now, is that any tone of voice to take with your brother-in-law? You must know that I only have your best interests at heart.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_124: But I am not one to overstay my welcome. I take my leave...and leave with our adventurer friend a piece of advice. For problems pertaining to moogles, one would do well to consult a moogle.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_125: He just can't help himself. Yet, loath though I am to admit it, he's right. It's best that we consult a moogle.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_126: Kuplu Kumu is nearby. He's the leader of the Sanctum choir. Let us go and seek his advice.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_130: I know not why Astrid dislikes Hortefense so. He is far from perfect, to be sure, but the bad is far outweighed by the good.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_131: He is possessed of a good heart. And a handsome face. And a toned body. And I'd be remiss not to mention his skillful swordsmanship, and I speak not only of combat, mmmmmm...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_132: <cough> <sputter> Y-You didn't hear any of that!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_133: As you have witnessed, Astrid does not take kindly to my...existence. Prithee look after her in my stead.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_100_134: This is Kuplu Kumu. Let us ask him for his advice.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_140: Well, if it isn't young Astrid. And I see you have brought a friend. Is there something you require, kupo?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_141: Yes, Kuplu Kumu. I seek your counsel with regards to my affinity test.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_142: I see, I see. Truth be told, I had anticipated such a problem, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_143: You did? <sigh> It seems everyone foresaw issues except me...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_144: Do not be hard on yourself. You meant well in trying to bring tangibility to love. Yet love is anything but tangible, kupo. No, it transcends the rational, living in our hearts rather than our heads, assuming as many forms as there are couples. It is that which evokes fuzzy-wuzzy feelings of excitation and─and kupolation, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_145: Excitation, I understand. Kupolation...not so much. But it's beginning to become clear to me now. What my affinity test needs is a dose of fun. And yet, fun has never been my forte. I'm afraid my definition of the word would fall flat with others.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_146: Well, it just so happens that we moogles are the foremost authorities on fun and frivolity! I will help you, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_148: Now then, we must also do something about those three layabouts. Their indolent ways are well known to me. Even at the Sanctum, they find excuses to avoid work at every turn, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_150: I suspect they have learned some bad habits from our sky-dwelling brethren. A spot of punishment wouldn't go astray, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_160: Their behavior reflects poorly upon our kind and cannot be tolerated. A spot of punishment wouldn't go astray, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_170: Adventurer, I will discuss how to improve the affinity test with Astrid. Meanwhile, will you go and round up the three moogles, kupo?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_KUPLUKUMU_000_171: They will be over by the Leatherworkers' Guild, their preferred place for being unproductive. If you find them uncooperative, just say that you will squash their poms, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEB03082_000_18: We're not being lazy, we're conserving our motivation. Should have enough saved up by tomorrow. No wait, make that next week. Safer to err on the side of conservative, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEC03082_000_18: Work is for the weak, sleep is for the strong. You're strong like me, so you should understand this, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEA03082_000_19: The chief summoned us, you say!? But...we're busy at the moment. Yes, lots of dawdling and dallying to do. We'll go a little later, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_A2_000_001: Astrid means to take your advice.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_A2_000_002: Come right now, or I'll squash your poms.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEA03082_000_20: Really? She took our advice to heart? Well then, we have work to do! Let's go, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEA03082_000_21: Nooo, not the pom! Anything but the pom! We'll go at once, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEA03082_000_22: <pant> Never worked...so hard in my life... <pant> But it felt sort of good, kupo...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEB03082_000_22: The chief threatened to withhold our kupo nuts for a month. A month! I...I did what I had to do, kupo... <sob>
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_MOOGLEC03082_000_22: My work is done, kupo... Now I shall slumber for all eternity... Zzzzzzzzz...
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_230: Ah, there you are! I'm pleased to say that, with Kuplu Kumu's sage counsel, we've managed to bring the affinity test up to acceptable standards of fun!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_231: Moreover, the three moogles returned and resumed setting up the venue. They worked with such enthusiasm, all was made ready in the blinking of an eye!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_232: Kuplu Kumu tells me he cast an enchantment on them that bestows motivation. Such practical magicks the moogles have!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_233: Now then, all that remains is to have a couple actually trial the affinity test.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_100_233: Adventurer, I could not have come this far without your help. Would you and your chosen do the honor of being the first souls to undertake the Valentione's Ceremony?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_234: Thank you! When you are ready, let the House Valentione servant yonder know, and you shall be escorted to the venue.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_235: At the ceremony's conclusion, you will receive a Valentione's Day chocolate. Be sure to return hither and show it to me.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SYSTEM_000_236: You now have access to the Valentione's Ceremony seasonal instance! To enter the venue, speak with the House Valentione servant at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SYSTEM_000_237: The Valentione's Ceremony is an instance designed for a party of two. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_SYSTEM_000_238: In the event that you register for the ceremony alone, your partner will be found via the matching system.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_240: You're back! Have...have you completed the ceremony?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_241: ...A Valentione's Day chocolate! Everything went smoothly, then? Excellent! With this, the ceremony is ready to be opened to the public!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_242: If truth be told, I shall be a nervous wreck until the festivities come to a close. But I have confidence that the ceremony will be a success. How could it not be, with the assistance I've received from you and the moogles both?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_243: I shall be fine by myself from here on. Thank you, adventurer. For everything.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_HORTEFENSE_000_250: Full glad am I to see that Astrid's efforts have borne fruit, and it was doubtless in no small part due to you. Allow me to offer you my heartfelt thanks.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_251: I have confidence that the ceremony will be a success. Thank you, adventurer. For everything.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_260: Ah, welcome back, my friend. I understand you have been kept on your feet, but the road of love was ever a long and winding one. Now, pray do not keep me in suspense─tell me how Astrid fared.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_261: Well, that's a godsdamned relief. Well-intentioned as she is, the girl can be a right pain in the arse. I'd say I'm sorry for subjecting you to her quirks, but I'm not. I knew you would guide her true, and I shall leave it at a thank you.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_262: ...What? Can't a woman let her mask slip from time to time? It's weary business, you know, this Valentione's Day thing.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_263: That's not why I thrust Astrid on you, though. No, I would've liked to help her myself, but I can't be there to prop her up forever. No, she needs to learn how to survive without me.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_264: Though you ended up shouldering much of the burden, I reckon Astrid has learned a great deal from her experience. Given time, she'll make a fine emissary.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_266: Sister? Who is this sister? My name is Lisette de Valentione, and my mission is to spread boundless love across the land!
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_267: Oh...er, right! F-Forgive me, Lisette. If it please you, I wish to make a report on the affinity test.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_268: The people are participating in droves, and by all accounts, they are enjoying themselves tremendously. Full many couples are said to be departing the venue flush with excitement, love writ plain upon their faces.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_269: Well, I believe we may declare the event a rousing success! This is proof positive of your progress, my dear. There is naught more for me to teach you. Your traineeship is complete.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_LISETTE_000_271: Now, I understand you owe much and more to our adventurer friend here. Do remember to express your gratitude. And even if you already have, no one has ever died from a glut of appreciation, is this not so?
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_272: Thank you for your kind help, adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT401_03082_ASTRID_000_273: Er... K-Kind and fair adventurer, you have helped me more than you shall ever know. W-With every fiber of my being, I thank you, and...er, p-pray for your continued support as I strive to...to till the fields of love within people's hearts!
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_000: Oh, my dear adventurer! If you have a moment, I would tell you about a wonderful event we are hosting this year.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_001: In a prior Valentione's Day celebration, we had fortune-tellers offer couples a glimpse of their future together. This proved tremendously popular then, and thus have we decided to revive it.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_002: For the duration of the festivities, the selfsame fortune-tellers shall be on hand at the amphitheatre, employing their all-seeing gaze to penetrate the haze of love's mysteries.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_003: You and your chosen partner need but present yourselves before them, and in mere moments you shall know your affinity with one another, be it in adventure, wealth, or romance.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_004: Should you be interested, I shall let our fortune-tellers know that you will be calling. A mere formality, to be sure─they have already foreseen your coming. And for another formality, pray report to me afterwards, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_010: Desire another glimpse at your future, do you? With a different partner, mayhap? Tee hee! Very well, I shall let our fortune-tellers know that you will be calling.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SYSTEM_000_020: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_030: Remember to take your partner with you when going before the fortune-tellers, and pray report to me afterwards, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SYSTEM_000_031: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_TREASURELUCKTELLER0: Ah, another couple wants to know if riches lie in their future. A wise choice, for rare indeed is the bond that can bear the weight of an empty coinpurse.
See here, I only specialize in telling the fortunes of couples. Bring one other, be it your lover or your friend, and I shall gladly tell you what treasure awaits in your future.
Well, let us see here... My  is registered to the Adventurers' Guild in ?
And your partner...born in this moon? Yes... Is the path you are destined to walk paved with gold, or will you end up on the street begging for coin? The cards shall reveal all!

The winds of fortune favor you two! They blow at your back, guiding you to the waters of La Noscea. With fishing poles in hand, go forth secure in the knowledge that your hooks shall not remain empty for long!

And if you are not yet avid anglers, now is the time to acquaint yourselves with a new hobby! But don't just go out in any old rags. Fortune often favors the fashionable. ...aye, you are guaranteed a healthy catch with garbs dyed just so.

Fortune smiles down upon you! Take advantage of this rare blessing, and venture deep into the woods. Bring your sharpest axes, and fate shall guide you to stout trunks fit for the realm's most luxurious wares.

A lucrative logging career shall provide a sturdy foundation for your future endeavors. But don't forget the importance of appearances; a fledgling lumberjack must stand out against  drab peers. Yes...  garb shall benefit you both within the forests and without.
A fortuitous reading indeed! Fate beckons you to , pickaxes in hand. There lie rocky outcroppings full to bursting with the earth's bounty.

Go there, and you shall be rewarded with riches most precious! But you must not go as you are and hope to succeed, oh no. Venture forth garbed in , and the earth shall give over its gifts even more readily.
The cards say chance is your most dependable ally! It would behoove you not to ignore this rare blessing. Board an airship bound for the Gold Saucer at once!

The denizens of the Saucer shall flock to you, drawn by the riches you gain from games of luck. But, alas, not if you go wearing that. No, fortune shall favor only those dressed in a glamorous getup of .

The winds of fortune blow languidly, but at least they do not blow against you. In the waters of Thanalan, fish swim to and fro, hungry for their next meal. It is there you should go if you wish for a chance at a profitable endeavor.

Fill your stomachs with fish caught by your own hands, and contentment at a job well done shall be your reward. Your luck may not be the best, but if you cast your lures wearing , then your fortunes may improve.

Hmmm... It seems the path to riches may be rather more taxing than you might have hoped. In the dense forests of La Noscea, stout trees await those with the patience to saw through their broad trunks.

Now may be the time to replace your dull wooden furnishings and tools with brand new ones, and take pleasure in the satisfaction hard work brings. What small luck you have in your endeavors may be augmented by an outfit of .

Hmmm... It seems wealth shall only come to you after grueling work. Go deep within the Black Shroud, to where rocks burst with valuable minerals, waiting for a pair of pickaxes to pry them from the earth.
Bedeck yourself in precious metals and gemstones plucked from the soil with your own hands. And what's this? The earth may be more generous with its gifts if you mined wearing an outfit colored .

Hmmm... You may not be swimming in gold, but neither shall you want for wealth. It may be in your best interests to take a direct approach to riches. With a treasure map to guide you, hunt for wealth long forgotten.

Although after many long and fruitless hours your hope may wane, if you persevere, fortune will see fit to reward you. And what's more, your luck will be much improved if you set out wearing attire colored .

Oh my. This is not good, not good at all. To be blunt, your luck has run out. Bring your fishing poles to the Black Shroud and wait out this spell of bad luck. Whether you catch fish or not is irrelevant; it is most crucial that you avoid any risky endeavors.

But beware as well the fish that bite at your lure. Not all taste the same, and an unappetizing catch may make an already bad day worse. Still, there are some measures you can take to mitigate your misfortune. An outfit of  may serve to keep the worst of it at bay.

Oh dear. It seems fortune has forsaken you. It might be best to indulge in a hobby and wait for this unlucky period to end. Logging, perhaps? Yes... Thanalan would be the perfect place. Lose yourself in the gentle whispers of the desert breeze, until fortune sees fit to smile upon you once more.

However, I would give a wide berth to anything wrought from wood in the meantime, lest a broken chair result in flushed cheeks and a sore arse. Luckily, you need not live in abject fear of misfortune. Keep yourselves dutifully wrapped in clothes of , and you may be spared fate's worst barbs.

Ah... I would not count on fortune to be your ally for the time being. In fact, it may be best to take refuge in the routine, until this run of bad luck comes to an end. The mining in La Noscea is said to be grand this time of year. Yes, busy hands will keep you from inviting hazard.

But take special care of any precious stones you may own. In a moment, a gem may slip loose from its setting, never to be seen again. However, it may be possible for you to mitigate fate's cruelty. Clothe yourselves in finery of , and perhaps the most unhappy circumstances will pass you by.

Oh no... It seems lean times are ahead of you. Even a treasure map, no matter how detailed, would bring you little more than dirt and a sore back. It's best to give up on any dreams of easy riches for now. You have to be realistic about these things, you know.

Guildleves, however, are just the thing for those who do not─or cannot─rely on luck. Honest pay for honest work. I suggest keeping your pockets filled with those until this unfortunate spell passes. And just to be safe, make sure you conduct the guildleves in attire colored , or else even those might end in failure.

Ah... Misfortune shall follow at your heels for some time. At all costs, stay away from the gaudy lights of the Gold Saucer! If you step foot into that playground of chance, then all of your hard-earned coin will vanish in a flash, leaving you with scant enough to take the airship back in shame.

No, no, that will not do. However, if the allure of the Gold Saucer is too much to bear, at least be content to gaze at it from a distance, your coinpurse far from its grasp. Perhaps if you were wrapped in clothes the color of , it might afford you some strength to resist your impulses.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_ADVENTURELUCKTELLER: So a pair of adventurers wishes to know if they are destined for song and celebration? It is this very question that my cards will answer, if you so desire.
A lone adventurer lives a life bereft of companionship. What interest is there in knowing that? Return to me once you've found another.
Ah, such eagerness! Well then, let us begin! Hmmm...  , are you?
And your partner? Yes...your fate is materializing before me. Are you destined for greatness, or will your names be lost to history? Look, and we shall see!

Oh my, you are a pair destined for glory indeed! Remain steadfast at each other's side, and they will tell tales of your deeds at the tables of admirals, Seedseers, and sultanas alike! The blessings of Llymlaen shall guide you to riches and renown.
The Navigator bids you set sail for the far-off islands called the Cieldalaes. There, you shall begin the first of many adventures that shall be remembered far and wide!
Ah, one of the Twelve looks favorably upon this pairing! Nald'thal beams down from the heavens. All misfortune you have suffered will be eclipsed by the magnitude of the glory that lies ahead of you.
Nald'thal's smile beckons you beneath the earth. Seek out an ancient wisdom buried in the cavernous deeps, and your search shall lead you to adventures most grand!
Ah, one of the Twelve has taken a liking to this pairing! None other than the venerable Halone has granted you Her fury. Any obstacles obstructing your journeys shall crumble before Her might.
With a reliable airship to carry you, venture to the furthest edges of the Sea of Clouds. Among the verdant isles lies a chance at glory and honor!

Ah, you have won the favor of one of the Twelve! The wise Thaliak shall bring harmony to your endeavors together. Even your most difficult tribulations shall serve only to build an unshakable bond between you.

Avail yourself of Thaliak's blessing and journey to the ruins of Sharlayan, where behind each crumbling parapet lies the potential for unforgettable adventure. And, what's more, it seems that there may be an unexpected reunion in store.

One of the Twelve smiles down upon you two! You are fortunate enough to have won the goodwill of Nymeia Herself! Nary a beast can withstand the combined might of this partnership with Her blessing safeguarding you.
After you have weathered countless trials, your path shall lead you to a weapon of unsurpassed power. With it, you shall fight your way into the annals of Eorzean legend!

While not the most heartening outlook, there is no cause for despair. The solitary islands of the Sea of Clouds hold much promise for grand adventure. But beware, for if you drop your guard for even an instant, you may risk losing everything you have worked for.

It may be best to beseech the Twelve for protection. Go to the mark of the Navigator in Limsa Lominsa, and entreat Llymlaen for Her guidance. To ensure Her blessing's efficacy, carry a fish─alive or dead─with you at all times during your journey.

Hmmm...Azeyma's scales remain level, showing neither favor nor disdain. The omens point to a great adventure slumbering deep beneath the earth. Alas, you cannot hope to succeed in this endeavor without each other's full trust.

Before you depart, journey to the mark of the Dusk Trader in Ul'dah, and beseech Nald'thal to tip the scales ever so slightly to your advantage. During your trials, always carry a precious gem on your person, as a symbol of His blessing.

Byregot Himself works to build a solid foundation for your partnership. In the Sea of Clouds opportunity for glory lies, but the road to obtain it is fraught with peril. Weather the storm, however, and the suffering will pale in comparison to the ecstasy of triumph.
Before you set off, beseech Halone for aid at the mark of the Fury in the Coerthas central highlands. Make sure always to carry a spear in your hands during your journey, and Her blessing is assured.

You have the reassurance of Nophica that the storms of hardship you are facing will only serve to nourish your future renown. I sense within the ruins of Sharlayan lie the seeds of adventure most thrilling, but only through concerted effort shall they bear any fruit.

The gods can offer you further aid, if you but ask. Go to the mark of the Scholar in Mor Dhona, and beseech Thaliak to grant you the wisdom to choose the most favorable path. Keep a shellfish close at hand during your journeys, and the Twelve will not forsake you.
To see a pair so loyal to each other makes Menphina Herself smile. Set out on a journey to forge a weapon worthy of song, and as the moon waxes, so too shall your work come to fruition.

Surely a journey of creation is worthy of the Builder's blessing as well. Wielding a golden hammer to please the gods, visit the mark of the Builder deep within the Black Shroud and beseech Byregot to lend His steady hand to your work.
This result is...unfortunate. It seems Llymlaen has turned Her eyes from you. Embark to the seas and you shall be met with only languid winds and clouded skies.

It would not be wise to journey across the waters, but you may seek the blessing of another of the Twelve. Journey to La Noscea and pray before the mark of the Wanderer, so that at the very least you shall have Oschon's blessing on the land.
Azeyma's scales are weighted against you, and She judges you harshly. Nald'thal has forsaken you, and to venture underground would mean facing the myriad dangers of the earth.

Your only chance to reverse this misfortune is to go to Thanalan and entreat the Twelve for mercy before the mark of the Warden. Only then may Azeyma's scales shift in your favor. In the meantime, it is best to stay above ground, safe under the protection of the sun and sky.

Oh my... Through affronts known only to Him, you have earned Rhalgr's wrath. Halone is unwilling to protect you from Her father's ire. Beware any adventures in the Sea of Clouds, for you will surely meet with tragedy.

Your only recourse is to request the blessing of another. Journey to Coerthas and pray before the mark of the Lover, and perhaps Menphina's tenderness will assuage Rhalgr's anger. For the present, make safety and security a priority, and do not take reckless risks.

Ah, it seems you two have become pawns in one of Althyk's inscrutable plots. Thaliak is loath to entangle Himself in such a precarious situation, and any endeavors you have planned in Sharlayan will be steeped in danger.

The only hope to wrest free from Althyk's machinations is to rely on the aid of another. Go to La Noscea and make your devotions before the mark of the Spinner, so that Nymeia's blessing may improve your fate. For the time being, however, it would be best to ensure each other's safety, avoiding dangerous battles at all costs.
Halone has chosen to test you two, and Byregot dares not interfere with His sister's plans. If you had hoped to build, or craft, be prepared to toil for longer than is reasonable.

Only one path remains to you if you wish to improve your standing in the eyes of the Twelve. Go to the mark of the Destroyer in Thanalan, and beseech Rhalgr to put a stop to His children's games. Until that time, proceed with caution, and do not let your impatience get the best of you.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_COMPATIBILITYLUCKTE: Another couple comes wishing to know if love can bloom between them. Well, 'tis why I am here! But be forewarned: I am but a servant of fate, and my words may not be what you hope to hear. Knowing that, do you still wish for me to divine your affinity for ardor and affection?

I don't see a partner with you. Do you expect me to tell you if you love yourself? No, no, that is entirely too dull. Come again with another, and I shall tell you what blossoms between you, be it love or...something else.
You answer without hesitation! I sense great confidence in your partnership! Hmmm... Let's see here. You were born in the , and thus your fate is guided by .
And your partner's nameday is? Yes... The threads of fate are coming together. Behold, the cards reveal a couple's fate!
You two are a match made by the Twelve!  Alas, even the most passionate relationship can benefit from a bit of variety.

Everyone loves to see their partner looking their best from time to time. During their next nameday, why not show off your most fashionable  outfit? It just might be the spark that brings you two even closer together.
No two adventurers are more meant for each other than you!  Alas, even the most promising relationship must be treated with care.

The  is a traditional staple of  cuisine, correct? Surely a sample of such a splendid dish would show your partner how much they are appreciated. All that's required is the smallest amount of effort, and you two shall never stray from each other's sides!
The stars must have been aligned when they brought this pair together!  But remember, there is more to life than adventuring. A private moment together can do much to enrich your relationship.
You hail from , correct? It may serve you both well to share a relaxing stroll alone through . There you shall be able to lose yourselves in each other's gazes and whisper many sweet nothings.
You two are destined to be together!  But sometimes you must remind people of your devotion.
Use your particular set of skills as  to lift up your partner both within the battlefield and without. Take care not to be lax in your duties, for a match such as this comes only once an era.
The gods themselves are envious of your affinity for each other!  But without growth even the most spirited relationship can become stagnant.

Strive always to be the  your partner deserves, and through mutual effort you will both be enriched by this relationship. Do not forget the passion of your first meeting, and make sure each moment together is just as ardent as that one.
Ah... It seems there is still work to be done between you.  But do not despair, for relations can change for the better, and with but a little effort you may yet win the heart of your desired!
Remember that being attentive to your partner's needs is essential. Even if they do not say it, there is likely much they are struggling with. Pay attention, and your partner will notice.
Now, pray do not be alarmed, but the stars show no particular favor to you two.  But you need not despair, for this fate is not set in stone.

Even the most hardened adventurers like to look their best from time to time. To celebrate your partner's nameday, present to them a heartfelt gift─a necklace, ring, or earrings─that shows the depth of your gratitude for their companionship. Before long, the lukewarm nature of your companionship may grow into something worthy of celebration!
Ah... It seems there is something to be desired between you two.  But there is still hope! Even the most frigid heart can be warmed by a homemade meal.

The key to a fruitful relationship lies in the kitchen. Treat your partner to a sweet , and they won't soon forget your generosity. But remember, this gesture is but the first of many that will be required to make your relationship blossom.
The cards say the relationship between you is...somewhat tepid.  Mayhap you have forgotten that there is more to a friendship than just nodding silently in agreement to each other.
You hail from , correct? Sit down with your partner at , and over a bottle or two of your preferred libations, have a lively conversation and become more well acquainted with each other.

Oh my. Truth be told, I've not made a reading this unfavorable in some time.  Suffice it to say, I suggest you end this partnership at once! Ah, but you have a look about you that says you refuse to give up. Well, if you must be so stubborn...

Sit down with your partner and have a frank discussion about all that you've endured together. Mayhap then you shall find out what caused this rift between you. Be aware, however, that the road to reconciliation may be longer and more arduous than is worth it.
Oh my. Your outlook is bleak, to say the least.  Hmmm... 'Tis a dark fate indeed. However, the situation isn't entirely hopeless.

Reflect upon how you've conducted yourself lately, and if you are honest with yourself, you may find much that needs improvement. If you value your partner's presence, take heed of their opinions as well and listen carefully to their point of view.
Ah... It pains me to say I must be the bearer of bad news.  The spark of passion that once existed between you has been extinguished, likely some time ago. Yet there may be a way to rekindle it.
Gather your oldest and most trusted allies, and venture into . Retracing the paths of your past exploits may serve to remind you both of what drew you together in the first place.
Steel your heart, for you may not want to hear this.  The situation looks dire, but pray do not be hasty in ending this partnership.

You must also ask yourself: Have I been setting my best foot forward as ? Be honest─and harsh─with your answers, and seek out the candid opinions of others as well. Strive to improve on your shortcomings and mayhap your partner may notice the effort you put into bettering yourself.
This reading is...not good. Not good at all.  It seems you two have forgotten what brought you together in the first place.

Go to where the adventure started. , was it?  is home to many fresh-faced adventurers in need of advice and aid. As a team, lend them a helping hand, and their bright-eyed gratitude may serve to remind you of the reasons you became partners so long ago.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SYSTEM_000_550: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are too far away.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_SYSTEM_000_551: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_560: Ah, if that isn't the look of a  who has glimpsed  future. Was the path adorned with rainbows and lined with flowers? Or did it fall short of that ideal?
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_561: Yet, whether the outlook is promising or no, pray remember that it is not the be-all and end-all.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_562: As is the case with the Valentione's Ceremony, these fortunes are but a means to spur love on its way. For indeed love has a long way to journey, and the most important step is the first.
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_563: ...Of course, if you so wish it, you can always have your fortune told again. You need but let me know. After all, there is no shame in the pursuit of love eternal and true!
TEXT_FESVLT402_03083_LISETTE_000_570: Ah, if that isn't the look of a  who has glimpsed  future. Remember, whether the outlook is promising or no, it is not the be-all and end-all. The most important thing is to take your first steps together.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_REPORTER03084_000_0: Excuse me, . Might I have a moment of your time? I'm conducting a survey for the Mythril Eye.
Are you aware that Ul'dah is presently celebrating Little Ladies' Day?

This year we're celebrating with a rather unconventional performance by the Songbirds. I say unconventional because they plan to have those in attendance take part in the show. Would you care to share your thoughts on the matter?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_A1_000_001: I was actually planning to attend.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_REPORTER03084_000_0: Ah, a fan are we? They're sure to be glad of another smiling face in the crowd.
Public awareness appears to be fairly high. Survey of attendees needed after the performance.
My word! You've not heard of Ulala, Narumi, and Masha Mhakaracca? They're set to perform at the Steps of Nald─all of Ul'dah has been abuzz with the news. Or so I thought.
At any rate, I would strongly encourage you to attend. You won't regret it.
Public awareness appears to be surprisingly low. Survey of attendees needed after the performance.

Where was I? Ah yes. If you would partake of the revelry, you should first speak with the royal seneschal over on Emerald Avenue. He will be overseeing this year's festivities and can tell you all there is to know.
The royal seneschal should be over on Emerald Avenue. Speak with him and you'll learn all there is to know of this year's Little Ladies' Day.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_020: ! My, what a pleasant surprise. It has been too long, my friend. Have you come to take part in the celebration?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_021: What's this? An adventurer come to take part in the celebration?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_022: The festivities are well underway, and the main event will be a performance by the Songbirds. But this will be no ordinary performance, mind you, for all in attendance will have the opportunity to participate.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_023: With that said, the Songbirds' success depends wholly on the number of people present. We have spared no expense to entice the good people of Ul'dah to come and enjoy themselves.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_024: In fact, we've prepared garments and illuminations for everyone who chooses to join in our merrymaking.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_025: Can we count on your attendance as well? It is to be a celebration none shall forget.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_026: Wonderful! To receive your attire and illuminations for the event you will need these promissory notes.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_027: Deliver them to Redolent Rose at the Weavers' Guild, and Deitrich at the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_028: When you have what you need for the festivities, pray speak with me again and I will explain what we have planned.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_029: There can be no celebrating without your garments and illuminations. Pray speak with me again after visiting the Weavers' and Alchemists' guilds.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_REDOLENTROSE_000_04: Yes? What can I do for you?
Ah! Another  in need of dress for the Songbirds' performance. Here you are.

Marvelous, are they not? The perfect attire to pay homage to the talented troubadours headlining this year's celebration. I was beside myself with excitement when the royal seneschal first approached me with the idea.

Of course, a single ensemble would fail to embody the grace and charm of the Songbirds, which is why I've prepared three! Each was designed using their signature colors. When the time comes, I trust you will choose the one best suited to support your favorite songstress.
Seeing a crowd of adoring fans, awash in vibrant shades of red, yellow, and blue, I have no doubt they will be impassioned to put on a spectacular performance.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_DEITRICH_000_045: Welcome to the Alchemists' Guild. How may I help you?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_DEITRICH_000_047: A unique request, to say the least, but they were designed according to the royal seneschal's specifications down to the letter.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_DEITRICH_000_048: They can be adjusted to glow one of three colors─red, blue, or yellow─and will shine brightly even in the afternoon sun. You and all the others will make for quite the spectacle, waving them in the air to and fro.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_REDOLENTROSE_000_04: I have every confidence you will look smashing in the garments I prepared for you. When the time comes, I trust you will choose the one best suited to support your favorite songstress.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_DEITRICH_000_050: Day or night, those lights will be a shining beacon among the crowd of fans attending the Songbirds' performance.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_060: Ah, you are returned. I presume you have everything you need for the performance?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_061: Splendid, splendid. Now you need only wait for the Songbirds to take the stage. Speaking of which, it seems their more ardent fans are already front and center.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_062: There are only a few now, perhaps, but judging by the throngs of people who requested promissory notes earlier, this is the start of something truly grand.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_063: And all the more grand for your presence. As for the specifics of the performance, I shall leave that explanation to my lovely assistant here.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_HANDMAID03084_000_0: The Songbirds will be performing several times throughout the day adhering to a strict schedule, so be certain not to be late.
We will hold onto your celebratory garments and illuminations for the interim. When you have need of them, come and speak with me. I will be more than happy to retrieve them for you.
As you have three sets of garments to choose from, however, I will need to know which you wish to wear to the performance.

Also, be certain to keep your illuminations at the ready. The girls are always overjoyed to see fans cheer for them using their signature colors. But above all else, remember to enjoy yourself. Today's performance will mean naught without the participation of you and all the others who attend.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SYSTEM_000_068: During this event, the FATE “Color My World” will appear on Emerald Avenue at the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SYSTEM_000_069: In order to participate in the FATE, you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and prepare yourself to join the Songbirds' crowd of fans.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SYSTEM_100_069: The status effect granted to you by the royal handmaiden can be removed at any time by leaving the area, or using the special action Curtain Call.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_SYSTEM_000_070: Upon joining the FATE, you will be given three special actions: Cheer On, Cheer Wave, and Cheer Jump. Each action uses a different colored set of illuminated rods to cheer for the Songbirds. Bear in mind each Songbird is especially receptive to fans who cheer using their signature color.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_100_070: Remember: your participation will be key to the Songbirds' success. The enthusiasm and adoration of their fans is certain to help them realize their true potential, making today's celebration all the more entertaining.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_080: Welcome back. Though I could watch only from a distance, you and the others seemed to be having a wondrous time. So, how was the performance? Was it all you hoped it would be?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_082: It feels like a lifetime ago when the girls first came together to perform. They say the road to celebrity is often paved with uncertainty, and goodness knows the Songbirds have had their fair share.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_083: Oh, but how they've grown. Both as performers and respectable little ladies. It truly warms my heart to see them so well loved by the public.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_084: To have come this far was only possible thanks to the support of people like you. Thank you again for gracing us with your presence today.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_085: Ah, girls! Your timing could not be more fortuitous. Come, come.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_086: I was just thanking this adventurer for coming to show  support. Seeing as you're all here, why not introduce yourselves?
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_ULALA_000_087: Good to meet you. I'm Ulala─soon to be Eorzea's premier songstress. Thank you so much for coming to our show today.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_NARUMI_000_088: , . I'm Narumi. I hope our performance was to your liking.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: I'm Masha Mhakaracca, but you can call me Masha. I think I may have missed a step or two during the show, but that can be our little secret.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_090: You remember , yes? I was just thanking  for coming to show  support.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_091: I'm sure you three have words of gratitude to share as well.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_ULALA_000_092: ! I knew you would come and see us perform.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_ULALA_000_093: But you and I both know which Songbird you were really cheering for. The smile on your face says it all.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_NARUMI_000_094: Good to see you again, . I hope today proved an enjoyable respite from your adventures.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_NARUMI_000_095: Looking out into the crowd, seeing all the dazzling lights and people dressed in matching outfits, it felt as though they were putting on a show for us. It was so exciting!
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Glad to see you found time between your adventures to pay us a visit.
The show this year was really something, wasn't it? To be honest, I wasn't sure it would go over well with our fans at first, but I've never been happier to be proven wrong.
I'd love to stay and talk a while longer, but we really must be going. It's nearly time for the next show.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_ULALA_000_099: We'll be performing every day until the festival ends, so don't be a stranger. I'll be looking for you in the audience.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_NARUMI_000_100: You will come to see us again, won't you? I don't know, but... I can't help but feel this may be our last meeting.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_NARUMI_000_101: ...I'm sorry. Pay me no mind. Of course you'll come to see us. Perhaps not on the morrow, but hopefully someday soon. Until then, I wish you all the best.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_102: Ever the busy birds, those three. Nothing brings them greater joy than thanking each and every one of their fans personally, which is why I'm positive they were thrilled to find time to speak with an adventurer such as yourself.
TEXT_FESPDY401_03084_BUTLER_000_103: In light of their success here in Ul'dah, I daresay they will soon be ready to spread their wings and share their music with all of Eorzea. I pray they can count on your support as they work to fill the realm with sweet birdsong.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SYSTEM_000_000: Should you choose to undertake this quest, you will receive no guidance from the journal or the duty list. You will need to read the text carefully and decipher the clues to determine your next course of action.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_002: Excuse me, . I hate to be a bother, but I have a favor to ask of you.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_003: During their last performance, the girls said they spotted a girl all by her lonesome on the street. She seemed to be lost, perhaps looking for her parents. They're terribly concerned but they can't very well cancel their subsequent shows to look for her.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_004: If you should happen to see this poor soul walking about, would you check on her and see that she's all right? When time permits, I too will do my part and help search for her.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_005: The poor girl. I pray she's okay. The sooner we find her, the better.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_0: Hmmm. I wonder where they could be...
Hm? What am I doing here?
Well, I've... I've lost something quite dear to me.
A necklace and pair of earrings my mother and father gave to me. They are my greatest treasures, and yet somehow I've managed to lose them.
On today of all days. All I wanted to do was go and see the Songbirds. Everyone seems so excited that they're here, but how can I enjoy their performance knowing my jewelry is missing?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_A1_000_001: Never fear! I'll find them for you.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_A1_000_002: Do you remember where you may have lost them?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_0: You will? Truly?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_1: I'm fairly sure I remember where I lost them, but my parents said it's too dangerous to venture outside on my own.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_0: Yes, I'm pretty sure I remember, but my parents said it's too dangerous to venture outside on my own.
Wait... You aren't thinking of going out there, are you?
Thank you , thank you!
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_1: If you leave through this gate, they should be somewhere close by.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_0: Oh, I know! Let me draw you a picture.
This is the last place I remember having them. I apologize if my drawing seems poor, but I hope it helps.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SYSTEM_100_020: Use hints in the watercolor sketch to find the lonesome lass's missing jewelry.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_0: I'm fairly certain that's where I lost them. Please stay safe out there.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SYSTEM_000_030: This doesn't appear to be what you're looking for.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SYSTEM_000_031: You find a necklace, but it's badly tarnished and covered with rust.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_SYSTEM_000_032: You find a faded pair of earrings. The fasteners appear stiff from lack of use.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_NAMELESSGIRL03085_0: Were you able to find them?
My jewelry! I never thought I'd see them again.
Thank you so much. I don't think I've ever been so happy as I am right now.

You were so swift to grant my request and brave the wilds of Thanalan. It reminded me of the stories my mother told me, of the seneschals who would go on great adventures to fulfill the wishes of those they chose as their princess.
Oh my! You would choose me?

Alright, then. Ahem...
Yea verily, thou art returned and brought unto me mine heart's desire. By your great deed, this shall be a momentous celebration, forsooth!
Hahaha, forgive me if I seem strange. I've always dreamed of being waited on like a princess. I couldn't help but try to play the part.
I do have one last request for you, though. Would you deliver this jewelry to a man named Tobyn at Crescent Cove?

Don't worry. When he sees them, he'll understand.
Now if you'll excuse me, I think the Songbirds will be performing soon.
Thank you. My dear, sweet seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_061: From a girl in Ul'dah!? What...what did she look like?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_062: I'd call you a liar if not for these. I can hardly believe it.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_063: The girl in white, this necklace, these earrings... I think you've met with my late aunt.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_064: I was but a babe when she was taken away from us, so I only know what my parents told me. Wasn't until I was older that I finally understood the horror of it all.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_065: The Little Ladies' Day celebration was like any other. The streets were lined with streamers, cherry blossoms far as the eye can see, and men were dressing up as seneschals looking to dote on the ladies of Ul'dah. But sadly, some of them weren't after a princess.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_066: A group of men were luring girls into alleys, then whisking them off to gods know where to be sold to the highest bidder. Guess they thought my aunt would fetch a high price... And you're sure you saw her, this girl in white with my aunt's jewelry?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_067: This may sound like utter nonsense, but... My folks said she wanted to take part in Little Ladies' Day more than anything in the world, to see what it was like being a princess for a day. Having never had the chance, maybe her spirit hadn't moved on yet.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_068: These celebrations have been much safer ever since they began hiring royal seneschals, and the Songbirds put on a show no little lady would want to miss. Not even my aunt, it seems.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_069: Thank you for delivering these to me. We never found her remains, but with these, I think now we can finally lay her spirit to rest.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_TOBYN_000_070: Thank you again for delivering these. At last my aunt can be at peace.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_080: ! I searched high and low, but could find nary a trace of a young girl matching the Songbirds' description. How did you fare?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_081: A spirit, you say? Could such a thing really be possible?
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_082: I cannot say if she belonged to this world or the next, but thanks to you, we may take solace in knowing her dreams of Little Ladies' Day have been fulfilled.
TEXT_FESPDY402_03085_BUTLER_000_083: I cannot thank you enough for dealing with this, but let's keep what happened between the two of us, shall we? If the girls ask, I will simply tell them she found her way home.
TEXT_SUBCTS501_03088_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Eager to listen to my harp, are you? For what higher praise could a minstrel ask than to have as an audience the very hero who provides inspiration for his songs!
Yet I have no fresh compositions I deem fit for a champion's ears. Would that I possessed something more to amuse you...
Ah! I've been struck by the most wonderful idea! You shall be the author─and the subject─of your own creations!
Yes! By weaving an epic with your own endeavors, you will find yourself casting a critical eye upon past deeds. Think of such works as muses for future growth!
'Tis no difficult thing to pen a poem─the words will come of their own accord, I assure you. Simply envision the scene, and describe the memories in faithful detail.
Omit naught and add naught, and the truth shall remain. Reciting the finished piece should then serve to bring the past to vivid life in your mind's eye.

And when you look back upon events with undistracted clarity, what was hidden in chaos may now seem blindingly clear. Especially when things are uncolored by the <cough> embellishments I might bring to the story...
May the recording of your sagas reward you with inspiration and insight. Oh, and do return sometime and share what you have wrought!
You now have access to the Duty Recorder, allowing you to document duties for viewing within an inn room.
Open the Duty Recorder interface located under Duty in the main menu, and view the help text for further details on how to use this feature.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_FRIGHTENEDWOMAN0313: Oh, forgive me, I...I had a rather frightful experience at the Gold Saucer not long ago. Only now have I managed to catch my breath from running.
As I was making for Wonder Square, I was assaulted by a pair of ghastly white creatures careening down the hallway. I glimpsed them but only for a moment before they vanished into thin air!
I'm convinced the place is haunted. No doubt the poor souls of gamblers who lost one too many turns of Cuff-a-Cur.

Judging by your dress, I take it you're an adventurer, am I right? Please, you must go and purge the Gold Saucer of those spirits. With such frightful specters lurking about, it could spell the end of the establishment as we know it.
Even as we speak, Lord Manderville is doing all he can to get the situation under control, but I fear he is at his wit's end. You must hurry, before it is too late.

If you've yet to visit the Gold Saucer, you will need a ticket for admission. Perhaps you could try speaking with that young man over there. He's been gloating of his winnings and seems to be in a generous mood. Perhaps you can persuade him to offer you one.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SYSTEM_000_007: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_FRIGHTENEDWOMAN0313: Lord Manderville is likely at the Gold Saucer deliberating on how to rid the Gold Saucer of its otherworldly infestation. Please, you must help him.

If you've yet to visit the Gold Saucer, you will need a ticket for admission. Perhaps you could try speaking with that young man over there. He's been gloating of his winnings and seems to be in a generous mood. Perhaps you can persuade him to offer you one.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SYSTEM_000_009: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_010: Well, well, if it isn't my beloved son's faithful companion, ! I presume it was word of our festival that guided your steps to the Gold Saucer?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_011: I remember you. Yes, the  with the strong-yet-tender fingers─. I presume it was word of our festival that guided your steps to the Gold Saucer?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_012: Ah, an adventurer. And well traveled judging by your garb. I presume it was word of our festival that guided your steps to the Gold Saucer this day?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_013: Hmmm. No, your stern expression would suggest business of some other sort. No doubt it was the rumors of apparitions haunting the Gold Saucer, then.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_014: Then perhaps your arrival will mark the end to our misfortune. Indeed, there is truth to the talebearings that brought you here. My staff have reported sightings of strange, ghost-like figures floating about the halls as recently as .
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_015: They seem to vanish as quickly as they appear. As such, we have yet to ascertain an accurate description of these supposed spirits. But regardless of their appearance, both my staff and patrons are beside themselves with fright.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_016: These disturbances bode ill for the Gold Saucer. Might I call upon your assistance in sleuthing out the truth behind these sightings?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_017: They were last seen at Event Square, but there seems to be no rhyme nor reason to the comings and goings of these spirits. Tread lightly, my friend. These halls are not as safe as they once were.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_018: Whatever it is that stalks the halls of the Gold Saucer, it never lingers about in the same location for long. I would suggest you make haste to Event Square 'ere they vanish again into the aether.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_LOSER03133_000_020: Spirits running about the Gold Saucer? I don't rightly know what they are, but I mean to catch them.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_LOSER03133_000_021: Raising a chocobo for the races exhausted all of my savings, you see. But if I had those flying faeries or whatever they are, I could sell them to make up for my losses and then some.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_LOSER03133_000_022: I've searched everywhere, from the Cuff-a-Curs to the Cactpot cashier counter, and nothing. I had considered giving up, but just as you arrived, I thought I saw something in the hallway here. ...You don't think they've gone off to Wonder Square, do you?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_LOSER03133_000_023: If you find anything, you won't forget about me, will you? The man who tipped you off to the faeries' whereabouts.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_TELBIKESULBI_000_02: Have I seen anything strange? Well, I thought I saw two white balloons floating down the hall─rather fancifully, mind you─toward Round Square. When I blinked they were gone. Likely my eyes playing tricks on me.

I hate to change the subject, but... What do you think of the fragrance I'm wearing? My companion promised to meet me here, but she's nowhere to be seen! I fear my choice of aroma has driven her away.
<sigh> Oh my dear, sweet, companion. Where ever could she be?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SYSTEM_000_030: You eye what appears to be a pair of bickering moogles, the likely cause of panic and distress in the Gold Saucer. Perhaps you should speak with them and see why they have strayed so far from the Shroud.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GIRLMOOGLE03133_000: Hm? If I didn't know better, I'd swear this  was looking right at us. But that's silly.  couldn't possibly see us... Could ?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Aaahhh! My sweet! This  is looking right at us. What do we do!?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GIRLMOOGLE03133_000: Settle down, my little pomkin. So long as you stay relaxed,  can't possibly see us, kupo.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Yes... Yes, of course, kupo! As if any of these simpletons could possibly detect us. Hahaha.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_A1_000_002: This simpleton is about to tear your pom off.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Gaaahhh! I-I didn't mean it. I swear! Please say you'll forgive me. Oh pretty please!
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GIRLMOOGLE03133_000: You must be that adventurer we've heard so much about, with the ability to perceive that which others cannot.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Ah! You're that adventurer? Oh my, this is such an honor. What business would the realm's greatest hero have with the likes of us?
A pair of white specters appearing and disappearing all about the Gold Saucer? Oh dear, I fear the fault for everyone's fright falls with us. Allow me to explain.
My sugar plum and I have always had a great interest in the culture of your kind. When I heard about this place, and that it was holding a festival, I could think of no better place to court her.

But with all these lights, and music, and throngs of people─it was such a shock, we inadvertently made ourselves visible to everyone here. There was screaming and poking─some even tried to catch us like playthings, kupo!
We've been blinking about searching for a place to relax, and eventually made our way here.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GIRLMOOGLE03133_000: It was absolutely awful. I've never been so embarrassed.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Now, now, my little moogleypoo. We had no way of knowing what to expect when we got here.

I think we'll be fine now, but we really should go and speak with the owner here. Mister Manderville, I think his name was. It may be best if you accompany us, kupo. Lest we cause another unwanted surprise.
I bet he's back at the entrance, apologizing to his poor guests. Let's hurry and set things straight.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_060: You are returned. With some clue as to the source of our troubles, I should hope.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Ahem. I believe we are the source of the distress you speak of, sir.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_062: Moogles! My, what a most unexpected surprise. Let me have a better look at you.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_063: Simply marvelous! Milky white fur like pearls, with forms as perfectly round. And your poms. They glow like crimson jewels, yet they seem so soft. If I may, would you permit me to inspect them more closely?
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GIRLMOOGLE03133_000: I would much prefer that you didn't, kupo...
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: This adventurer told us of the confusion we unwittingly caused, and we came to apologize.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_066: I see! You are the spirits that allegedly haunt the halls of the Gold Saucer. Knowing now the source of the problem, we need only look around us to see the solution.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_067: The likeness of moogles is a common sight here in the Gold Saucer. To say your presence was requested as part of the festival should more than suffice to explain what was seen here today.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_068: Misunderstandings aside, it is an honor to have you as guests.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_069: I will inform the staff, and see to it you are able to make use of our facilities even should you choose not to reveal yourselves to anyone else.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: Thank you, Mister Manderville, thank you! At last, another chance to woo─Ahem. To work on my aim at the monster toss. Yes, that's it, kupo!
Before that, though, I have a favor to ask of you. If it's not too much trouble, of course.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_072: I shall leave you three to your merrymaking, then. The staff must be made aware of our special guests.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GODBERT_000_073: Pray, enjoy the delights of the Gold Saucer to your hearts' content.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_SYSTEM_000_074: You can now purchase seasonal items from the campaign attendant. Please note that you will be unable to do so after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_GIRLMOOGLE03133_000: We won't reveal ourselves until we're absolutely sure it's safe. We don't want any more trouble.
TEXT_FESGSC201_03133_YOUNGMOOGLE03133_00: He's certainly an imposing figure, isn't he? I hope he isn't cross with us, kupo.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_SYSTEM_000_000: This quest contains branching sections, and the conclusion of this quest may differ depending on the choices you make. However, the rewards will remain the same.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Thank you again for your help earlier. I wasn't expecting the owner to be so kind and understanding.
Not only that, he's promised to ensure we can enjoy all the games without having to be seen.
Yes, today is certain to be a wonderful day, kupo! Isn't that right, snookums?
Ah, fancy meeting you here again. We were just about to go on another romp through the Gold Saucer. Isn't that right, snugglebum?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_100: There's so much to do, so much to see. I cannot wait any longer! Come, honeybunch, I want to see what's at Event Square.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: And there she goes! You haven't forgotten that favor I mentioned before, have you?
I'm not the spry, young moogle I used to be, and lately I've been thinking of settling down... Oh, my sweet butter bun─I can't imagine life without her. That's why I mean to propose!
But today needs to be absolutely perfect, and I need your help to make that happen, kupo.
Now, let's not keep her waiting, lest we sour the mood.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: I've never seen anything so colorful, so vibrant. I wish to see every ilm of this place, kupo. From top to bottom.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: What do you think of this game, pommypie? You operate a toy moogle to fetch prizes out of the tank. Doesn't that sound fun?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: I suppose so, but the people before us won't realize we're waiting, hidden as we are. There's no telling how long they will stay here. Oh kupokins, what are we to do?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Hold that thought, my little apple dumpling. I'll see if there's aught I can do to move things along.
Please, you have to help! At our present snail-like pace, today's outing will be a failure, kupo!
The people presently in front of us seem insistent on fishing out every toy in the tank. What do you think we should do?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A1_000_001: Be patient. They'll move soon enough.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A1_000_002: You should reveal yourselves to them.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A1_000_003: How about an innocent little prank?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: I suppose it's as they say about patience and virtue, or some such. <sigh> All right. We'll wait our turn.
Hmmm. Mister Manderville did say it should be safe to do so. All right. We'll show ourselves.
A bit of fun to help move them along, eh? An interesting proposal indeed. All right. I'll give it a try.
Wish me luck, kupo. Hopefully this will serve to keep my dear fluffems in good spirits.
That actually went rather well. We began talking of our favorite kupo nut recipes, and time practically flew by. In fact, it felt as though we didn't have to wait at all.

Thankfully no one was afraid once we uncloaked ourselves. Quite the contrary, we could scarcely keep people away. The children especially. Their constant pom squeezing was...unpleasant, to say the least.
It's been too long since I played a good prank. Even if it was only a little one, it was enough to move them along, and the children nearby certainly had a good laugh.
The Moogle's Paw was quite fun, but also very exhausting, kupo. We plan to visit Wonder Square next for a short reprieve.
I hope to see you there. Preferably somewhere my little cream puff won't notice.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Would you look at all these balloons and illuminations. A pity we haven't such wondrous things back home, kupo.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: It brings me great joy to see you so happy, my dear kuppycake, though nothing could be so wondrous as your smile.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Oh fluff muffin, you're so sweet. Ah, I shall treasure this moment always.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: (If we're to stay here a while longer, perhaps I can do something to impress her. But what...?)
Excuse me a moment, pookie pom.
She seems to be quite taken with the view up here, kupo. And while the mood is right, I'd like to do something to set her heart aflutter. Any thoughts?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A2_000_003: Celebrate with a toast of wine.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Of course! I can sing her a song. And perhaps do a little dance as well. What would I do without you?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Our song! It matches this scenery perfectly. Come, my little butterball, I wish to dance!
