TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Your plan was brilliant. Absolutely brilliant. I've never seen her so happy, kupo. I think it may be time to make my next move. Would you follow us back to Entrance Square?
Play it cool and bask in the beauty of silence? I'd never thought of that. I suppose it's worth a try.
...<wink>
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Is something the matter, sugar lump? Your eye is twitching.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: I'm afraid I'm no good at playing it calm and cool. She must think me a fool.
But I won't give up, kupo! We're heading back to Entrance Square. Can I count on you to be waiting in the wings?
Wine? My, how fancy. Though I suppose this is a rather fancy place, isn't it.
But that would mean showing myself to the barkeep. I know Mister Manderville said it would be okay, but I'm not so sure...
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A3_000_001: You've come too far to give up.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A3_000_002: Why don't I order for you?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A3_000_003: You could ask your beloved to order.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: You're right. I have to be brave for my sweetypom, kupo!
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_WYNKYN_000_057: How in the hells did this money get here?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_WYNKYN_000_058: Ah, of course. Some bashful bloke means to order the bartender's choice. Very well. I will prepare a drink to take their taste buds to a fantastical new world of flavors.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Would you really? Thank you!
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_WYNKYN_000_060: Sounds like you're celebrating quite a special occasion. Very well. I will prepare a drink guaranteed to take your taste buds to a fantastical new world of flavors.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: That may be for the best, kupo. I know nothing of drinks, and even the thought of speaking with the barkeep fills me with dread. I only hope this won't displease my fluffypoo.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: You want me to order the drinks for you? <sigh> My poor little sugar pom.
I've had plenty of wine in my day, but never anything quite like that.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Indeed. I feel like a new man─hic─new moogle, kupo!
The barkeep's drink was perhaps the best we've ever had. Thank you for the suggestion. Now that she's relaxed, I think the time is right to make my next move. To Entrance Square!
It's time, kupo. I'm going to pop the question. Oh, but I'm so nervous. My mouth is dry, and my tongue feels like a sponge. What if I say the wrong thing?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A4_000_001: You have to believe in yourself.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_A4_000_002: Well, there are other fish in the sea.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: You're right. What manner of moogle would I be to let all your generosity go to waste. All right. Here I go...
But I don't want fish, kupo. I want my moogledove! <sigh> Oh dear...
Erm. You'll wait here for me, won't you? I realize you've already done so much for me, but...I'd feel better knowing you're watching, kupo.
Dearest moogleypoo. My cutie patootie. Sweetums...my little cuddlemog...kupo nut of my eye... My jelly belly! I... Would you... <wheeze>
...MARRY ME, KUPO!
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Before I answer, there's something I need to say. Your friend over there should hear this as well.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: You...you knew?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: The lights of the Gold Saucer are bright, but not blinding, kupo. Of course I knew.
Well of course, kupo. After our last tour of the Gold Saucer, I assumed  would continue to keep a watchful eye on us.

Yet even though  was there, no doubt ready to jump to our rescue at a moment's notice,  didn't need to. I had my reservations before, but after seeing you try so hard to show me a good time today, well...maybe I was wrong about you, kupo.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: <gasp> Does that mean...?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Let's say I'll think about it.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Oh joy, oh rapture! Be still my quivering pom!
Thank you! A thousand times, thank you! This day wouldn't have been possible without you.
I think we'll stay here at the Saucer a while longer. At least until my heart returns to my chest, kupo.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: Even if  weren't here, though, I'm not sure what to think. Needlessly revealing yourself to people, the awkward silences... You're not the moogle I thought you were, kupo.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Wha...What are you saying...?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: I'm sorry, doodlepom, but my answer is no...to the moogle I see before me, at least. For the moogle I met in the Shroud, however, I may reconsider.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: <sigh> What a fool I've been. I had convinced myself I needed to be more daring, more adventurous. In the end, I only made a mess of things.
But next time will be different. I promise. Hopefully we'll run into you again on our next outing here at the Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: And don't think I didn't notice you sneaking off for advice.
Still, I was impressed by how hard you were trying to show me a good time.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Does that mean what I think it does...?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: If you think it means we should spend another day at the Gold Saucer, then yes.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: You can be hard to please, my dear fluffikins, but I will not back down from this challenge.
It seems our stay here at the Saucer has been extended.
Hopefully we'll run into you again.
If not for you, I doubt I could have shown her around, let alone profess my feelings.
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: A pity you had to spend your time with us, rather than enjoying the sights and sounds of this magnificent hall. But fear not─my little pomsybear will see you're duly compensated. Isn't that right, kupo?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_YOUNGMOOGLE03134_00: Sorry to keep you waiting, kupo. This was all I could manage on such short notice.
If you're still around, your advice would be quite welcome the next time I take her about the Saucer.
So welcome, in fact, I think I'll wait right here until you return... You will return, won't you?
TEXT_FESGSC202_03134_GIRLMOOGLE03134_000: If only such a place existed in the Shroud. I doubt I would ever leave, kupo.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Why, if it isn't ! How long has it been? A year? More, perhaps... I think the last time I saw you was also during the Moonfire Faire.

Don't tell me you've forgotten about it already! The festival was originally held to recruit adventurers to combat a Bombard invasion, but we gave them such a thrashing, they've hardly been seen since. Bombards or no, we still hold the event each year, providing wholesome fun for all the family!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_MAYARUMOYARU_000_01: Ahoy there, adventurer! It's another sweltering day here in Limsa Lominsa, and what better way to mark the coming of summer than with the Moonfire Faire!

Oh? So you're new to the festival? It all began as a way of recruiting adventurers to fend off a horde of Bombards. Even though the infernal menaces have all but disappeared, we still hold the event every year to provide wholesome family fun!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_MAYARUMOYARU_000_02: That's not all! It's an opportunity for members of the Adventurers' Guild to demonstrate their skills to faire-goers, and thereby inspire others to join our ranks.
I'll bet you know a trick or two, am I right? Then why not head to Costa del Sol and show them what a real adventurer looks like!
When you get there, just head for the gigantic wooden─ Ho ho! I nearly spoiled the surprise! Well, you'll just have to go and see it for yourself!

And trust me, you'll know it when you see it. Talk to the chaperones nearby and they'll have you performing feats of derring-do before you can say “Seven snippy snippers snipped several splendid subligars!”
You're still here? Time and tide wait for no , and nor does the Moonfire Faire. Don't miss your chance to shine, adventurer!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_030: ! How good it is to see you, old friend! The Moonfire Faire wouldn't be the same without you. And have we got a treat for you!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_040: Here for the Moonfire Faire, I take it? You seem like the sort who's not afraid to get  hands dirty and  feet wet─the sort we're looking for. Behold!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_050: Rising from the pristine sands and virgin waters of Costa del Sol, a wooden monstrosity so imposing, so unforgiving that all but the most courageous will run crying to their mammies! It can only be...the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_051: This event is sponsored by the ever-magnanimous Master Gegeruju! Under his watchful eye, no harm will come to our brave contestants. Or to the scantily clad ladies he seems to be ogling at present...
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_052: Ahem! Where was I? Ah yes. To become a true Eorzean Nimble Warrior, you must let nothing stand between you and your goal.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_053: This is the attitude we wish to instill in all aspiring adventurers. Through your example, we aim to teach them that there is no obstacle that cannot be overcome so long as you have discipline and determination. And a strong pair of legs, for there'll be jumping. Lots of it.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_054: You may observe other challengers emitting wails and curses, but these things are not the key to success. Nay, you'll need to rely upon an impeccable sense of balance, uncanny awareness of your surroundings, limitless patience, the acrobatic ability of an opo-opo─
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_055: ...Well, there are a few other things, but I'll leave it at that. Wouldn't want you to get discouraged before you've even started now, would we? Once you've banished any lingering apprehensions, I'll be happy to sign you up. Did I mention that we even have prizes for completing the course?
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_060: So, think you've got what it takes to be an Eorzean Nimble Warrior? That's the spirit. I'm sure the spectators can't wait to see you in action!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RFHULTIA_000_061: (-Mild-mannered Boy-)Um...excuse me, I'm here to register for the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. Am I in the right place?
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_062: You are indeed. But you do realize it's only open to fully fledged members of the Adventurers' Guild? No offense lad, but you seem a bit too wet behind the ears to be allowed to join...
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RMAJHA_000_063: (-Feisty Little Girl-)My brother is going to be the bestest adventurer in the whole wide world!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RFHULTIA_000_064: (-Mild-mannered Boy-)While it's true that I'm not an adventurer yet, if there is one thing I am good at, it is jumping! Will you at least let me try?
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_065: Sorry, son. If anything were to happen to you...
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RFHULTIA_000_066: (-Mild-mannered Boy-)Please! I would give anything for a chance to become an Eorzean Nimble Warrior! If I cannot enter, it will break my heart, and I shall throw myself from the top of the tower, and my sister will cry until the end of eternity, and─
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_067: All right, enough! I'll register you, but don't say I didn't warn you! The Eorzean Nimble Warrior course is no joke. If you do yourself a mischief and I get the blame for it, I'll have you hanging from the tower by your tail! <sigh> I can't believe I'm doing this...
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_068: To be on the safe side,  here will go first and show you how it's done. There's no shame in backing down once you see how stiff a challenge it truly is.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RFHULTIA_000_069: (-Mild-mannered Boy-)Thank you! I shall repay your generosity with an acrobatic display the likes of which the world has never seen!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RFHULTIA_000_070: Oh, where are my manners? I am R'fhul Tia and this is my sister, R'majha. It is our pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RFHULTIA_000_071: I am looking forward to seeing how a real adventurer tackles the course. And once you are done, it is my turn!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_RMAJHA_000_072: I hope you don't fall in the water!
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_HAERMAGA_000_073: Ha ha! You and me both! Now, let Beaudefoin know when you're ready, and be careful out there, understood?
TEXT_FESSUM401_03135_SYSTEM_000_080: You have learned the emote Splash!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_000: So, are you ready to face the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, to risk it all for a chance at glory? If so, you've come to the right place!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_001: Before you begin, allow me to explain the rules. The course is divided into three parts, which you have to complete in order. There is but one objective: to reach the chaperones standing on the platforms.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_002: You can take as long as you need, and if you fall off, just go back to the beginning of that section to try again. The first chaperone you need to reach is J'nangho, who'll tell you where to go next. Now, step into the jet of water and make us proud!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_010: Back for more? There are even more onlookers to impress than last time, so show them what you've got!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_011: Remember─just because you've beaten the course before, don't underestimate it.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_012: If you show a moment's hesitation or misstep by even half an ilm, you'll be in the drink before you know it. Or in the sand. Either way, very embarrassing. Anyway, J'nangho is waiting for you on her platform. Don't keep the spectators waiting─off you go!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_013: This may be the easiest of the three sections, but don't get careless.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_BEAUDEFOIN_000_014: That was very impressive and all, but you're going the wrong way!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_JNANGHO_000_020: Oh! Well done! But don't pat yourself on the back yet. There's still a long way to go!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_JNANGHO_000_021: Once you've caught your breath, make your way towards Hildelana at the end of the second section. Best of luck!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_JNANGHO_000_022: Do you need a rest? Enjoying the view, perhaps? There's no need to rush I suppose, but the spectators might think you're being lazy. And we wouldn't want that, would we?
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_HILDELANA_000_030: Such poise, such grace! A fine demonstration of what members of the guild are capable of.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_HILDELANA_000_031: However, I must save my most heartfelt congratulations for when you have conquered the third and final stage. Luckily for me, I will have the perfect view of your ascent to the top. Good luck!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_HILDELANA_000_032: It may seem rather daunting, and for good reason, but it is by no means impossible. Be sure to maintain focus and above all, don't look down!
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_POBYANO_000_040: You did it! I knew you would! Right from the start, I had a good feeling about you. I couldn't help but follow your progress every step of the way.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_POBYANO_000_041: And it seems I wasn't the only one. Your young friends jumped for joy when you reached the top.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_POBYANO_000_050: That reminds me─you'd better go and let Haermaga know that you finished the course. He struggles to watch the competitors and handle all of the registrations, so we ask all successful entrants to report to him afterwards. It helps us keep track of things.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_POBYANO_000_051: You don't have to hurry, though. I think you've earned a respite after all of your exploits. And watch your footing on the way down. We can't have you breaking your legs in front of everybody! That would certainly take the shine off of your achievement.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_POBYANO_000_060: In fact, I would say they cheered even louder than before. You've become quite a favorite with the crowds.
TEXT_FESSUM402_03136_POBYANO_000_061: You can try the course as many times as you like, so if you'd like to start again, talk to Beaudefoin. That way, we'll be able to give you the proper rewards.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_000: The hero has returned! I was watching intently from start to finish. A truly breathtaking display if ever there was one!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_001: That was incredible! I've never seen anything like it!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_002: I want to try it too!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_003: Ha ha! Maybe when you're a bit bigger, missy. How about you, R'fhul? It's not too late to change your mind.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_004: I think not. Witnessing 's spectacular victory has lit a fire in my soul!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_005: Today, I shall fulfill my destiny! Fame and glory, here I come!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_006: Wait, there's one last thing I─
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_007: <sigh> I did have a few words of advice for him, but perhaps he won't need it. Hopefully, he will have learned a thing or two from you, . Still, I can't help but worry for the lad. Could you keep an eye on him?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_009: I'll be watching from here, but it might be best to have someone nearby when he─I mean, if he takes a tumble.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_100_009: , that truly was a sight to behold! The way you made your way to the top... It was extraordinary!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_110_009: That was the bestest thing ever!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_011: Fhul! Oh no! We have to help him!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_020: <pant> I might have been a little...overzealous.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_021: Heh, after all my grand words... What a fool I must look! I still have a long way to go! Hahaha!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_023: Why are you laughing!? It's not funny! You're just a...big stupid-face!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_A1_000_001: Don't just stand there─go after her!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_A1_000_002: She doesn't seem to like big stupid-faces.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_030: R-Right. Er...where did she run off to, now? Please help me look for her!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_040: Nor do I like being called one. It seems we need to talk. But er...where has she run off to? Please help me look for her!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_053: It's no use. She won't talk to me.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_054: Well, you leave me no choice. There's only one way to deal with sulky little girls.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_056: Come on, ! Splash some water on her to make her laugh!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_057: A few splashes of water and she'll be giggling in no time!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_060: Eeek! That's cold! Tee hee hee!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_061: So, is Miss Sulky going to tell me why she ran off?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_062: I'm sorry... , you're not cross with me, are you?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_063: It's just that...after the festival, my brother's going on a long journey to become an adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_064: Long journey? What gave you that idea?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_065: I heard you talking about it with Mummy. And I know how much you want to be an adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_066: You didn't tell me because you thought I'd be sad. I'm right, aren't I?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_067: I've known all this time. And...it does make me sad. But I wouldn't want you to give up on your dream for me. That's why I told myself not to cry.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_068: I thought you'd be upset when you fell in the water. But you were laughing!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_069: You're right. I should've taken it more seriously, especially since you and  came to watch me.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_070: But I am serious about becoming an adventurer!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_071: You see, , we don't have a father, so I help our mother look after Majha. I realized that I needed to become a man, to become strong enough to support my family. I just didn't know how.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_072: But when I went to the Moonfire Faire a few years ago and saw the Cascadiers drive off those dreadful Bombards, I discovered my calling in life─to become an adventurer!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_073: If I were as brave as the heroes of the Adventurers' Guild, I could protect my family from harm. I could provide for them.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_074: As my first step towards becoming an adventurer, the Moonfire Faire presented the perfect opportunity. What better way to prove my worth than by overcoming the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_075: But I was so eager to prove myself, I got carried away. And you know the rest. I humiliated myself in front of everyone, so I tried to laugh it off. I didn't know what else to do! I never meant to upset you, Majha.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_076: But I haven't given up hope! What do you think, ? If I keep training, do you think that I could make it as an adventurer?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_A2_000_001: “Great oaks from little acorns grow,” as the saying goes.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_A2_000_002: There isn't much call for big stupid-faces, I'm afraid.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_080: Little acorns? Are you saying I should become a botanist?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_081: Aha! I think I understand now! Yes, I shall do my utmost to one day become a “great oak”!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_090: Not quite the words of encouragement I was hoping for, but it will take more than that to deter me!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_091: I mean, all things considered, today could have been a lot worse. At least I didn't crack my skull on a rock like that other poor chap. As long as I keep myself in one piece, I'll be an adventurer sooner or later!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_100: Mahja. You were right about a lot of things. It's true. I am going to be away from home for a while. And my face...yes, it probably is a bit stupid-looking from time to time.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_101: I didn't mean it! Your face is fine how it is! Well, most of the time, anyway. But if you're going away, will you make me a promise?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_103: You don't have to be a hero. Just be...just be safe. That's all I want!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_104: Very well, Majha. I promise I will never die. Erm...well, not any time soon, at least.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_105: Now that's settled, I think it's time for us to go home.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RMAJHA_000_106: Thank you so much! See you again!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_107: Wait, don't go running─ <sigh> Not again...
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_108: Before I chase after my sister again, I'd like to thank you. You're the kind of adventurer I aspire to be, and it was an honor to meet you.
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_000_109: If there's one thing I have learned, it is that “Actions speak louder than words.” That's right, isn't it?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_RFHULTIA_100_109: Yes, maybe I should aspire to be the strong, silent type too. Something to work on as I embark on my journey. But before I leave, I would like to spend some time with my family. Please give my regards to Haermaga and the others! Till we meet again!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_110: Welcome back. I trust all is well?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_111: Oh? He decided to become an adventurer after seeing the Moonfire Faire? Well, if that isn't a testament to the festival's power to inspire, I don't know what is!
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_112: <sniff> It warms the cockles of my heart, it does...
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_113: And as for you, you've helped make the festival a huge success! After all the casualties we've had, I was worried that the guild would accuse us of constructing a death trap! We've had a few minor maimings, true, but no one's died yet. That has to count for something, aye?
TEXT_FESSUM403_03137_HAERMAGA_000_114: Of course, this year's Moonfire Faire is far from over, so why not stay and soak up the atmosphere? You can even run the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course again, if you feel so inclined. On behalf of all of the chaperones, you have our heartfelt gratitude!
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_000: I say, are you not the affable adventurer whose able assistance enabled us to encounter the lithesome lady-warrior, Lightning? That you should present yourself at this precise pass could only be by Nald'thal's blessing!
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_001: I am, as you will readily recall, Dural Tharal, renowned reporter for the Mythril Eye. And should you be willing, I seek your service for what will surely be a splendid story.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_010: A hearty hail to you, adventurer. I am Dural Tharal, renowned reporter for the Mythril Eye. Should you be willing, I seek your service for what will surely be a splendid story.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_020: Are you aware of the latest object of many a sultanate citizen's ardent attention? Aye, it is the massive military maneuvers that the Immortal Flames will be conducting right here in our fair city, creatively called “The Calamity Retold.”
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_021: The maneuvers' main motivation is the aggressive attack upon Eorzea in which the Empire engaged ere the Calamity came to pass. In putting pen to parchment, I desire to delve deeply into the details of those dreadful days.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_022: I ask you to accompany me as I go about interviewing involved individuals, that I might promptly prod you for your personal perspective. Suffice it to say you will be copiously compensated for your kind cooperation. So, adventurer, will you aid me in my ambition?
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_023: You have my thorough thanks! Without further ado, then, pray come with me to the Hall of Flames. I have arranged an audience with one of the order's officers.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_030: This is the officer with whom we will have words.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_COLONEL03138_000_04: You are the ones from the Mythril Eye?
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_041: Correct, Commander. This reporter would relish your relating the facts and features of the forthcoming military maneuvers.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_COLONEL03138_000_04: I would be glad to speak about the Calamity Retold. I must warn you, though, that there may not be much to offer in the way of a financial perspective, which I know your paper favors.
Now then, let me begin with the objective. By holding the exercises in the city itself, we seek to cultivate awareness within our citizens of the ever-present Garlean threat.

Many Ul'dahns believe that they are safe within these walls. Nothing could be further from the truth. In the hours before the Calamity, the imperial army threatened us as close as Camp Horizon. A direct attack upon the city was very much in the realm of possibility.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_045: Thankfully, we were spared such a frightful fate owing to the fortitude of audacious adventurers.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_COLONEL03138_000_04: You know your history well, my friend. Aye, full many adventurers lent their strength to our cause. While the Brass Blades and the Sultansworn held fort in the city, those intrepid souls sallied forth to head off the Garleans. By their valor was an attack on Ul'dah forestalled.

We of the Immortal Flames count adventurers among our stoutest allies, and we hope to continue our successful partnership in the city's defense. To that end, we have invited adventurers the realm over to participate in the exercises.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_048: I see, I see. My thanks for taking the time for this talk, Commander.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_049: So, having heard his assessment, what is yours as an active adventurer? Is the sultanate safe with you and your plucky peers protecting it?
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_A1_000_001: Ul'dah is safe in our hands.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_050:
“Calmly confident, the adventurer assured me of the sultanate's sustained security. For while our defenses demand due diligence, an excess of apprehension avails us naught.”
...Yes, something in that spirit shall serve.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_060:
“Pointedly prudent, the adventurer advised against presuming that our preservation is promised. If the sultanate is to survive a savage strike, each and every one of her citizens must be invariably vigilant.”
...Yes, something in that spirit shall serve.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_070: Next, we shall seek out one of your fearless fellows, an adventurer who fought in the field at the flats of Carteneau. He awaits our arrival at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_ADVENTURERMOG03138_: Mmm-hmmm... Seems I picked a good time for a visit, kupo!
These exercises sound like fun. I do believe I'll take a peek...and maybe even lend a hand, kupo!
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_080: Here he is, the adventurer who has agreed to indulge me with an interview.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_ADVENTURER03138_000: You're the reporter as wants to know about Garlean shenanigans leadin' up to the Calamity? Where to begin, where to begin...

Right. So, soon after imperials began appearing near our cities, their commander took to visiting our aetheryte camps, spoutin' propaganda and demandin' our surrender. Might be as you heard about this.

The point, of course, was to incite panic. And it worked, damn the whoresons. Whole bunch of people around me started panickin', sayin' we should throw down our arms. But as many folk there were as panicked, about the same number got riled up good─yours truly included.

So I gathered my hot-blooded friends and we went after those imperials. Oh, we showed them exactly what we thought of surrender. And if the Garleans ever try anythin' funny again, I'll round up the old crew and teach 'em a lesson all over again. And that's my tale.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_094: Excellent, more material of moment for my factual feature. Now then, our next destination is the Thaumaturges' Guild, where we will ask after the account of another who lived through the Calamity.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_100: There you are. Our imminent interview is with the tired-looking thaumaturge thither.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_THAUMATURGE03138_00: I understand you wish to hear about my experience during the Calamity. Just as well. Whether I will it or no, it all comes flooding back to me this time of year.
While the invading Garleans posed a real and present threat, what I remember most vividly was the red moon Dalamud. Glowing its bloody hue, growing ever angrier, drawing ever closer...
Then the aetherytes turned a sickly color, and voidsent manifested in droves. They entered our world, it is believed, through aetherial rifts caused by Dalamud's growing proximity.

I shall never forget the terror that washed over me when I first faced them. The mere sight of those twisted beings threatened to suck all my strength away, and I might not be here now were it not for the band of adventurers who hurled themselves into the fray.

On numerous occasions and in various places, adventurers took it upon themselves to drive back the voidsent. Their bravery and selflessness are an example to us all, and I have nothing but gratitude and respect for them.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_116: Right, this leaves us with the last meeting, with a bloke of the Brass Blades. The person should be posted at the Gate of the Sultana.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_120: Here he is, the sentry who will speak to us of his struggles.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_PORTER03138_000_130: Just to get it out of the way─I don't know why you want my account. I didn't do anything noteworthy during the Calamity. Doubt I've got anything to offer your article.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_PORTER03138_000_131: But I agreed to talk, so I will. As you probably know, some of us Brass Blades fought at the battle of Carteneau as part of the Immortal Flames outfit. I was there too.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_PORTER03138_000_132: And the battlefield, well, it was the seventh hell on Hydaelyn. Death and destruction everywhere you looked. Folk were dropping like flies, Eorzeans and Garleans alike. Better soldiers, better men and women than me. But somehow I managed to survive.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_PORTER03138_000_133: Later on, I learned something. Apparently, some adventurers went and intercepted an imperial unit in Mor Dhona. A unit that was coming to flank us at Carteneau.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_PORTER03138_000_134: Luck might've kept me alive as long as it did, but if it weren't for those adventurers, I reckon I would've been another corpse at the Flats. I'd thank those adventurers, if only I knew who they were.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_135: With that, our questioning comes to a close. Let us return to the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_140: So, we heard about the Calamity from an assortment of angles, but all appear to agree on one aspect: adventurers played a particularly prominent role.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_141: As an active adventurer, what is your view on your predecessors' participation?
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_A2_000_001: I'm proud of what adventurers achieved.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_150:
“The adventurer articulated  approval of those daring deeds. In  eyes, I glanced a glimpse of conviction─the conviction to carry on as stewards of the sultanate.”
...Aye, an ending to that effect.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_160:
“The adventurer articulated  disapproval of those daring deeds. A stern statement that the sultanate's security is not their burden to bear.”
...Aye, an ending to that effect.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_170:
“The adventurer expressed no enthusiasm for events long ended. For  eyes were fixed firmly upon the future.”
...Aye, an ending to that effect.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_180: With that, I am amply armed to pen a piece that will please the populace. Many thanks for your invaluable input!
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_181: Now then, if you can manage a meager moment more, I request the pleasure of your presence at one last location.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_182: I have heard tell that a minstrel of obscure origin is out strumming songs about the Calamity. I would hear him in hopes that it affords my article an additional angle.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_183: The man has supposedly set his stage at the end of the exchange. Should this be of interest to you, feel free to follow me.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_190: Here he is, , the mysterious minstrel I mentioned. Let us listen to his vibrant vocals and silvery strings!
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Well met, my friends. How may this humble minstrel serve you?
An article for the Mythril Eye, you say? Full honored am I that you should seek me out! Make yourselves comfortable, then, and listen to my song...
The tale of nameless heroes who rose to defend the city as the red moon fell...
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_22: Greetings, Warrior of Light. You needn't be alarmed.
This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
Permit me to introduce myself. My name is Naoki Yoshida. Though who I am is of less import than the message I wish to share with you.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_22: Delighted am I to see you again, my friend. Truly, I am blessed to have had the pleasure of your acquaintance for so long.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_22: Looking back, the days and months have fairly flown by. Five years have already passed since Eorzea rose anew from its ashes.

In these five years, I have had the honor to know many Warriors of Light like yourself. Inimitable heroes, all, each with countless tales to tell. Tales of meeting and of parting. Of joy and of sorrow.
I often find myself wondering, what do you and yours think of the realm? Since you first set foot upon it, has it become a place that you might call home, to which you ever look forward to returning?
Know that naught gives me and mine greater pride than being able to build this world. And this pride we owe wholly to you, who choose to abide here.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_22: For that, we wish to give you our heartfelt thanks.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_22: A long journey yet lies ahead of us, and nothing would please us more than to continue it with you. Whither the road may lead, none can say for certain, but such is the allure of adventure, is it not?
...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
Ever will we be watching over you and your deeds. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, Warrior of Light. Till next we meet...
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_230: A stirring song, performed with a plenitude of passion! Thank you, my most magnificent minstrel. By your vivid verse, my story's success is solidly sealed.
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_DURALTHARAL_000_231: Adventurer, here is where we depart in different directions. With the fieldwork finally finished, I shall settle in a seat and put pen to parchment. 'Twas a joy to have you join me on this jaunt!
TEXT_FESANV401_03138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: If you have another moment, my friend, for you I have another song. A song about that which follows the Calamity. About that which is yet to come...

O hero of rebirth traversing,♪
Soar you the azure skies.♪
Upon your breast a crimson crest,♪
Shine Light down from on high.♪

O hero of rebirth transcending,♪
Weave you an azure lie.♪
By your deeds doth crimson bleed,♪
And Darkness quench the fire.♪

Though the world was reborn, rising from the ashes of its destruction, it can never return to how it once was. And so we must walk ever forward, keeping our gaze upon the future and seeking out new horizons.
But once a year, let us allow ourselves to halt our steps. Let us look back upon the past and remember those we have lost. For it is their memory that gives us the strength to carry on.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_000: Greetings, adventurer. I'm Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven, Gridania's leading tabloid. I'm hoping that I can rely on your kind assistance.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001:
Greetings, adventurer! It's been a while.
...Hm? Do not tell me you've forgotten about Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: You kindly helped me pen my feature article on the mysterious lady-knight, Lightning, and I'm hoping that I can rely on you once more.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003: You see, a certain rumor has been making its rounds of late.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004: No few travelers passing through Thanalan report seeing an unusual black vehicle along with peculiar mechanical soldiers. Do you happen to know anything about them?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_005: No? Let me tell you, then, that there is growing concern that they might be some unknown type of Garlean weaponry. Why, even the good people of Garlond Ironworks have been called upon to investigate.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_006: This promises to be a most compelling story, and I intend to be the first reporter to tell it. But in order to do that, I require the contribution of good folk such as yourself.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_007: Lest you wonder, the black vehicle was most recently sighted near Black Brush, in central Thanalan. Should you come into any information, I ask that you bring me word without delay!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_008: The most recent sightings of the black vehicle took place near Black Brush, in central Thanalan. Should you come into any information, I ask that you bring me word without delay!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_020: (-Young Man's Voice-)Gah! Why won't you move, damn it?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_021: (-Man in Black-)Hey, do you know if there's a garage nearby?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_022: (-Man in Black-)<sigh> Just my luck to have a breakdown in the middle of nowhere... What is this place, anyway?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_023: (-Man in Black-)Thanalan? Eorzea? That's on no map I've ever seen.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_024: (-Man in Black-)I'm not sure how I got here, and I've got no idea where I need to go...but I'm going nowhere at this rate. Isn't there anyone around here who can fix cars?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_A1_000_001: Garlond Ironworks might be able to handle it.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_A1_000_002: If anyone can get you moving, it'll be Cid.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_025: (-Man in Black-)Seriously!? Man, what a relief...
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_026: (-Man in Black-)Wait, what? Cid is here too!? What in the world's going on...?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_027: (-Man in Black-)Anyway, might as well keep pushing her along.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_028: (-Man in Black-)Hey, mind giving me a hand? She's heavier than she looks.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_029: (-Man in Black-)What's your name, by the way?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_030: Appreciate the help, . My name's Noctis, but you can call me Noct.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_031: And now that we're introduced, let's put our backs into it. <sigh> Talk about deja vu... Un. Believable.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_GARLONDIRONWORKSEMP: B-By the gods, she's magnificent! Such elegance, such refinement!
Ah, as you may have heard, we were tasked by the Alliance with investigating the mystery vehicle.
Master Cid himself should be close. If you'll excuse me a moment, I will direct him hither.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_036: ! Why am I not surprised that you're here already?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_037: So this is the machine... At a glance, it doesn't appear to be of Garlean make.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_038: The young fellow there─I take it he's the owner?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_039: And Noctis doesn't seem to know anything about Eorzea, you say? Peculiar...
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_040: Might he have lost his memories like I did?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_041: Hey, I'm right here, you know? Now, if you're done talking about me─you're Cid, right?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_042: Not quite the Cid I was expecting, but if you can fix the Regalia, then it's all good.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_043: I will be honest with you: this is technology I am unfamiliar with. I can't make any promises, but I will try my best.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_044: Appreciate it. There's...er, just one little problem. I don't have any money.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_045: Never you mind that. To be able to work on a unique machine such as this is its own reward.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_047: Oh, and . I trust you also heard about the mechanical soldiers.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_048: We're tasked with investigating them as well. By all accounts, they appear to be simply men, albeit armored head to toe and bearing advanced firearms. What betrays them is the unnatural efficiency with which they move.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_051: Magitek troopers. Robotic soldiers created by the Niflheim Empire.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_052: Come to think of it, the last thing I remember is being at a Niff base. It's kinda hazy...but there was a strange machine. And before I knew it, I was here, in this place you call Eorzea.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_053: That's quite an unusual tale, but then again I'm in the presence of unusual technology. I have no reason to doubt your words. You may have inadvertently activated a teleportation device and been sent to our world.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_054: At any rate, you seem to be acquainted with these mechanical soldiers. Perhaps you could investigate in our stead? They were most recently sighted near the Unholy Heir, not far to the east of here.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_100_054: Hmmm... If they really are MTs, they might hold some clue on how to return home...
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_057: It wouldn't do to leave our visitor to wander a strange land alone. Could you accompany him, ? Rest assured I'll tend to the Regalia in the meantime.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_058: Go on and follow Noctis, my friend. Rest assured I'll tend to the Regalia in the meantime.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_060: MTs, just as I thought. And a magitek armor to boot. They must have crossed over when I did.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_061: But I couldn't find any clues on how I might cross back. Gah, what am I supposed to do now?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_062: That old geezer? Well, he did seem to know his stuff.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_063: A reporter? That's...actually not a bad idea. She's bound to have loads of connections.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_064: You're coming along, right? Let's go check in on the Regalia.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_100_070: So, how fared you? Were you able to find the mechanical soldiers?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_110_070: You fought them!? So the rumors were true...
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_120_070: That being the case, I would very much like to examine the technology with my own eyes.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_130_070: I have a favor to ask, . The next time you encounter these soldiers, could you salvage their parts?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_GARLONDIRONWORKSRES: Ahem!  , may I ask that you bring said parts to either myself or my colleagues in the three city-states?
We will pass them along to the chief─after he has completed his long list of outstanding tasks!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_071: Don't worry, she's in a safe place. A reporter came sniffing about while you were away, so I decided to move her to the Dispatch Yard that we might carry out the repairs undisturbed.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_072: I'm pleased to say I was able to identify the problem, and I believe it can be fixed. However, it may take some time to fashion the replacement part.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_073: I see. That's good to know.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_074: (-Woman's Voice-)<gasp> You must be the mystery man!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_075: Ooh, I'm no fashion correspondent, but I like your look! A simple silhouette with an emphasis on the details!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_077: Ah, where are my manners? Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven, at your service!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_078: You are the owner of the mysterious black vehicle, yes?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_080: The Rega... I beg your pardon?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_082: Ah, so that's what she's called! A stately name!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_083: She's like nothing anyone has ever seen in Eorzea. May I ask where you hail from and how you came to be here?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_084: I'm from...far away. I was on a journey. We were fighting. Then suddenly I was here.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_085: I really need to find my way back. There's so much I have to do...
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_086: A mysterious young man, come from another world, desperately seeking a way home... A promising premise! Now then, may I ask what manner of journey you were on?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_087: Well, I was traveling with my friends. We were on our way to meet...someone important to me.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_088: Someone important to you? Could you please elaborate on the nature of your relationship with this individual?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_089: H-Hold on just a second. You're not the only one with questions, you know. I've got loads of my own.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_090: Well, sir, The Raven has many eyes and ears, and I would be happy to call upon them all for the answers you seek─if you'll agree to grant me an exclusive interview!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_092: Then it's settled! If you would accompany me to Ul'dah, we may continue our conversation while I put my connections to work.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_NOCTIS_000_093: Whew... That wasn't an interview─it was an interrogation.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_CID_000_094: I'll begin working on the replacement part for the Regalia, but it will take a while. Feel free to go about your own business in the meantime.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_100: Noctis was very cooperative, and I have lots of juicy morsels for my feature article. Lest you wonder, he was on his way to meet his beloved fiancée.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_101: Will the two sweethearts be reunited? With such a timeless tale of romance, the next edition of The Raven is certain to fly off the stands!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_102: C-Come now, don't look at me so. It's been so long since I last graced the front page. And as promised, I will help Noctis find the answers he seeks.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_103: I've already put the word out to my colleagues, and I expect to hear back from them any moment now.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_104:
Ah, speak of the devil!
...Yes, Kipih here. What do you have for me?
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_106: See, what did I tell you? We have a hopeful lead!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_107: We'll need to take a little trip together, the three of us. See to your preparations and let me know when you're ready to depart!
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SYSTEM_100_107: The FATE “Like Clockwork” will appear at the Clutch in central Thanalan over the course of the seasonal event.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SYSTEM_110_107: Completing this FATE will reward players with pieces of unidentified magitek.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SYSTEM_120_107: These items may be exchanged for various goods by speaking with an Ironworks hand.
TEXT_FESBKC001_03158_SYSTEM_130_107: Ironworks hands are posted at Black Brush and in each of the three city-states.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_100_000: Whew... That wasn't an interview─it was an interrogation.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_000: Ready to depart? Excellent! Our destination is the Twelveswood─more of those mechanical soldiers have been sighted there.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001: To be sure, my colleague only heard the rumors. I suggest first heading to Gridania and seeking out the witnesses.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_100_003: Ah, wait! New as you are to Eorzea, you may struggle to find your way around. Permit me to show you to Gridania.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_004: Wh-What? I'm not slackin' off or anything. Just checking out the clothing. Some really neat stuff here.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_HADREFORT_000_010: Mechanical soldiers? My apologies, but I'm not familiar with the rumors.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MARCQUELORT_000_011: Well, I am. Fellow I know claims he came upon them near the Hawthorne Hut in the East Shroud. At first he thought they were men, but on closer inspection, he says they were more like dolls.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_HADREFORT_000_012: And you didn't think to share this little tidbit with me, Brother? If I were to fall victim to these abominations, I shall consider my death on your head.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_ROUSTEBANT_000_013: Heard about the mechanical soldiers, have you? Indeed, they have been sighted in the East Shroud.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_ROUSTEBANT_000_014: While I do not personally know the details, the Wood Wailers are in a state of heightened vigilance throughout the Twelveswood.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MITAINIE_000_015: Mechanical soldiers? As a matter of fact, one of our sentries at Amarissaix's Spire reported encountering them while patrolling the Bramble Patch.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MITAINIE_000_016: At first he took them to be scarecrows, but as he approached them, they suddenly sprang to life and set upon him. We suspect that they are some heretofore unknown imperial weapon, and we are deliberating a response even as we speak.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MITAINIE_000_017: If your path takes you near that area, you would do well to exercise all caution.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_HADREFORT_000_018: I pray I do not run afoul of these mechanical monstrosities alone in the forest. The mere thought chills me to the spine...
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MARCQUELORT_000_019: As I said, the fellow I know claims he came upon the mechanical soldiers near the Hawthorne Hut in the East Shroud. At first he thought they were men, but on closer inspection, he says they were more like dolls.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_ROUSTEBANT_000_020: The mechanical soldiers were sighted in the East Shroud. While I do not personally know the details, the Wood Wailers are in a state of heightened vigilance throughout the Twelveswood.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MITAINIE_000_021: One of our sentries at Amarissaix's Spire reported encountering the mechanical soldiers. We suspect that they are some heretofore unknown imperial weapon, and we are deliberating a response even as we speak.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_022: Cat-people... Cat-people everywhere... Y'jhimei wasn't kidding.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_030: So, were you able to learn anything about the mechanical soldiers?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_A1_000_001: A man saw them near the Hawthorne Hut.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_A1_000_002: A Wood Wailer encountered them at the Bramble Patch.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_031: I see! In that case, if we were to keep watch at the Bramble Patch, we should be able to find them eventually.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_032: Well then, what're we waiting for?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_034: Please hurry after Noctis! The Twelveswood can be a veritable maze even for the locals, and it wouldn't do if he were to lose his way!
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_035: Please hurry after Noctis! The Twelveswood can be a veritable maze even for the locals, and it wouldn't do if he were to lose his way!
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_036: It's good that we took care of the daemon, but there weren't any clues this time either. <sigh>
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_041: No luck so far. Guess we play the waiting game.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_100_041: You hear that!? C'mon, let's check it out!
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_043: That thing's dangerous. We can't leave it running around.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_100_043: Heh, you're up for it too, eh? Come on then, let's do it!
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_044: First magitek troopers, now a daemon... What the hell's going on?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_A2_000_001: Let's take a rest for now.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_A2_000_002: All that fighting made me hungry...
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_045: Yeah, after a fight like that, I could certainly use a break.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_046: Now that you mention it, I'm pretty hungry too.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_048: So, what's your story? Why do you go around doing what you do?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_049: Protecting, huh? You and Gladio would get along, I bet. The big guy's always ready to throw himself into harm's way for us.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_050: Supporting, huh? Come to think of it, you do give off Ignis vibes. Specs is always hovering around, ready to pick up after us.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_051: What, you just wanna hang out with your friends? Heh, you're Prompto all over again. He's the life of the party, always ready with a quip to make us smile.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_052: We were traveling together─me and him and a couple of others. Hearing your story, I couldn't help but be reminded of them...
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_053: ...My purpose? That's a tough one. I guess you could say...it's keeping a promise.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_054: But I can't do that while I'm here. I have to get back to my own world.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_060: So, how did you fare? Were you able to find your answers?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_061: Nope. We found only more questions.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_062: Like how the hell a daemon ended up here as well.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_065: From your world, I assume. And it somehow came to be here, in Eorzea...
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_066: I'm no naturalist, but I imagine it being similar to a voidsent.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_067: And if even a monster such as that could find its way to our world, then surely─surely you can find your way back too!
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_069: I'll keep working with my colleagues to find new leads. So just sit tight for now.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_070: Actually, I'd rather go for a walk, check out the area a little. That's cool, yeah?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_071: Well, it should be safe enough if you keep close to the city...
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_076: Though I do not think that Noctis would disappear on us, I would feel much better knowing you were with him. Will you go and keep him company?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_077: I promise to have new information to share before long, so see that you both return soon, all right?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_078: I promise to have new information to share before long. See that you both return soon, all right?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_081: Well, you can tell Kipih she doesn't need to worry. I can take care of myself, and I'm not about to run off somewhere.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_082: I was just checking out the clothing at this stall here. And as I was browsing, the shopkeeper offered me some stuff for free.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_MAISENTA_000_083: Your friend has a fine physique and exceptional fashion sense. Having an attractive young man such as him model our garments is the best form of advertisement.
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_000_085: Anyway, I wanna explore some more. You're cool to hang out for a bit, yeah?
TEXT_FESBKC002_03159_NOCTIS_BATTLETALK_0: Careful! That's not your average monster!
I don't like the looks of that pillar!
Whoa, so that's how it works! I owe you one!
Ugh, that thing's trouble! We gotta do something about it!
Two pillars this time! I'll take one, you take the other!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_000: After all that, I still don't have any idea how I'm supposed to get home...
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_001: For now, it looks like there's nothing I can do except wait for Kipih to dig up clues.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_002: So I was thinking, I've come all this way to this beautiful place. I might as well try to see what I can of it, so I've got something to tell my friends.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_003: ...It may not look like it, but I'm kinda crazy about fishing. I go whenever I have time, and I've got time now, so I'm gonna hit up a place nearby. You should come too.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_004: I promise to have new information to share before long. See that you both return soon, all right?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_010: What took you so long? I've already reeled in a dozen.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_011: To be honest with you, I'm worried. I keep thinking, what if I never found my way back? And it gets me down.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_012: But being here in this tranquil forest and casting the line... It calms me. Helps me focus.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_013: I have to get back. People are counting on me.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_015: Oh hey, let's take a photo together. That massive waterwheel over there would make for a great backdrop.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_017: Huh, guess you don't have cameras here. So, a photo is a... Actually, let me just show you.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_019: Nice! I can practically hear Prompto say “Love the lighting!” Can't wait to show this to the fellas when I get back.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_020: You're right, we should be getting back ourselves. Come on, let's go.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_021: I promise to have new information to share before long. See that you both return soon, all right?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_030: , Noctis! Thank the gods you're back!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_032: I've just learned from a colleague that the mechanical soldiers have also appeared in Ixali territory.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_033: That in itself wouldn't be a cause for concern, but the beastmen responded with alarm to the trespassers and have summoned forth Garuda!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_034: That bird lady? Pretty sure we already took care of her. Back in my world, anyway.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_035: What!? You mean to say you are a primal-slayer like !?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_036: Primal? Is that like an Astral or a Messenger?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_037: Well, whatever it is, we'll take care of it one way or another. So, where's Garuda supposed to have appeared exactly?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_038: At the Howling Eye, her domain to the north. But it's nigh impossible to venture near, for Garuda shrouds her sanctuary with violent winds.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_039: If you are determined to face her, however, I will contact the Ironworks and request a loan of an airship.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_041: Very well, then. While you see to your preparations, I will secure your transportation.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_042: When you are ready, come and meet me in front of the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_045: You've proven yourself a friend. If we're gonna face Garuda together, I'll lend you the power of kings.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_046: It's a special power that I have, but I can share it with others.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_047: With it, you can quickly warp around, like you've seen me do. Might take some getting used to, but I'm sure you've got what it takes.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_048: Garuda's causing trouble because of the MTs, and I feel responsible for bringing them here. Let's go make things right!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_060: The airship is ready to bear you and Noctis into battle! Are your preparations in order?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_ELUSIVEIXAL03160_00: Squawwwkkk! Run! Run for your lives!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CONFUSEDIXAL03160_0: Like our goddess, it is...yet our goddess, it is not!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FRIGHTENEDIXAL03160: Nay, something else, that thing is! Flee this place, we must!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_064: (-Garuda-like Being-)Clamorous creatures... Why have they summoned me? And what strange land is this?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_065: (-Garuda-like Being-)Ahhh, the Chosen King, Noctis. So that is the way of it.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_066: (-Garuda-like Being-)Yours was the presence that drew me hither.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_067: (-Garuda-like Being-)Very well. Take up your weapon, Chosen King, and face me. We shall see if you are worthy of my power.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_068: You pack a serious punch, . I'm impressed.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_069: The Crystal has chosen well indeed. I acknowledge your strength, Noctis. Yours and your companion's both.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_070: Man, what is it with gods and trials? Do you always have to be so skeptical?
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_071: So it is decreed. At the world's peril do we grant our power unto the untested.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CID_000_073: She's unlike anything I've seen before, so it took me a while to get acquainted, but the Regalia is as good as new.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_074: Seriously? I owe you big time!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_075: Noctis. There is much you have left undone on Eos.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_076: Your presence here is an anchor, allowing me to link the two worlds. For you, I shall open the way.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_FF15GARUDA_000_077: Tarry not, for the gate cannot remain for long.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_079: Divinities... One minute they're trying to kill you, the next they're helping you. I'll never understand them.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_080: Thanks for the company, . It was nice going around with you.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_A3_000_001: I had fun! Let's do it again sometime!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_A3_000_002: Take care of business back home!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_081: Yeah, definitely. We gotta hang out again.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_082: You bet I will. And when everything's sorted, maybe we can hang out again.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_NOCTIS_000_083: Well, I better get moving. I've got a promise to keep, after all. Take care, now!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_090: Before Noctis went into the portal, I could've sworn I saw a woman amidst the light. An ethereal beauty dressed all in white.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CID_000_091: I saw her too. It seemed to me she was waiting for Noctis. Guiding him. I can only assume they share a deep bond.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_092: Oh! Then perhaps that was his fiancée!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CID_000_093: Perhaps so...and perhaps not. The sole person who could've enlightened us has vanished into the light.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_094: Well, whoever and wherever Noctis's fiancée may be, I do hope they are reunited.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_095: Right! While events are still fresh in my mind, I shall return to my office and put pen to parchment. Master Cid, many thanks for your cooperation!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_096: But the most thanks of all, I reserve for you, my dear adventurer. In no small part due to your help, Noctis managed to find his way home, and my article can reach a climactic conclusion. See that you do not miss it!
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CID_100_096: A strangely charismatic young man, was Noctis... In the end, we never learned the circumstances of his coming here.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CID_200_096: But if he has things he must do back home, as that Garuda-like being said, perhaps this was a trial that he had to overcome along his journey.
TEXT_FESBKC003_03160_CID_000_097: At any rate, old friend, I believe our work here is done. Wherever the long road may lead him, may Noctis ever ride in the light of the Crystal.
