TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_INVESTIGATOR03169_0: Ah, we meet again! Much to my relief, frankly─I could use the help of an adventurer who knows the Continental Circus and their fiendish proclivities.
I imagine you won't be surprised to hear that they're up to something new this year, and it doesn't seem entirely above board.
Not that anything a troupe of fell fiends posing as law-abiding citizens does is truly above board, but─well, you know.
Aha, a fellow adventurer! If you have a moment, I could use your help investigating a suspicious incident. Potential incident. Well, something that's generally suspicious.
Have you heard of the Continental Circus? I mean the group of performers in the amphitheatre over there─they unfailingly appear in Eorzea every All Saints' Wake.

However, just between you and me, they aren't truly performers at all! Not in the traditional sense. In fact, they're─and try to remain calm─fell fiends in disguise! Imps and tricksters and the like, you see.

Now, the Adventurers' Guild policy on the matter is to live and let revel as long as they don't get up to anything too evil, but I have reason to suspect they're plotting something truly diabolical for this year's “festivities.”

The troupe has been inviting folk to a certain manor, ostensibly for a “marvelous masquerade” in the spirit of All Saints' Wake. But I have been keeping constant watch, ever alert for signs of villainy, and the whispers of passersby tell a different story. I've even heard that some who entered have yet to return!

Personally, I feel that whisking the citizenry away into the night is a spot of mischief too far. And I'm sure you agree that something should be done before harm comes to unsuspecting revelers. We need to find out what the troupe is really up to─by feigning interest in the party.

The Impresario seems to have realized that I'm investigating the Circus─I can't imagine how. Regardless, he will know that I have ulterior motives, so you must go alone and then report back to me. I'll try to dig up additional information on the missing persons in the meantime.
Try to prise some information about the missing persons out of the Impresario if you can. But don't let on that I sent you!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0316: I'm sorry , but this year's festivities are so popular that we can fit not a single additional morta─er, guest in the mansion at the moment.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_020: Oh my, is that a familiar adventurer I spy? Hmmm... Though perhaps I am mistaken, for much and more is not as it seems this time of year, wouldn't you agree? Whoever you may be, I do hope you are having a properly dreadful All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_021: Oh my, is that an adventurer I spy? I do hope you are having a properly dreadful All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_023: Dear, dear... That simply will not do. But dry your tears, for the Wake is still young, and there are many frights yet to come! I'm certain we can make room at our marvelous masquerade for such an illustrious adventurer as yourself.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_024: Yes, a masquerade! Where the guests don guises both fulsome and frightful, and dance as long as they dare. Does that not sound charmingly reminiscent of the Night of Devilry in faerie tales?
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_025: Oh, to revel in such ghoulish delights! To join the madness in the streets, to see that palest of pumpkinheads leading a magnificent medley of fiends! It has been so long since the coming of the last true Night... How I curse each year wasted in the Great Gourd's absence!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_100_025: Ahem. Pardon me─I simply adore the idea of an authentic celebration. And though the Circus does its best each All Saints' Wake, we lack the, er, manpower to truly impart the thrill of this season the realm over.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_026: What we do not lack, though, is a frightfully abandoned mansion for our masquerade. Why, there are even rumors that its furnishings, with no master to serve, have taken on lives of their own and hold baleful banquets in the darkness of night! Aren't you dying to attend?
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_A1_000_001: I do have a few dozen guises I've been working on...
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_A1_000_002: What about the rumors of those who enter, never to return?
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_027: How splendid! In that case, you will no doubt want to join the masquerade forthwith. Do mind your surroundings when you enter the manor, though. Its corridors are labyrinthine, and who knows what frights lie in store?
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_028: Hm? I cannot say rumors of that sort have reached me, though they do sound like the makings of a chilling tale! I wouldn't be surprised if the mansion's sprawling corridors confused a guest or two, however.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_029: Regardless, I'm sure you'll have an absolutely spine-tingling time!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_030: Yes, and when mortal terror is at its zenith, the Night of Devilry shall return at long last...
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_031: Oh, that? Merely a new slogan for the Continental Circus, of course. To help revelers get in the spirit and such. Now, off you go!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_033: Why do I feel as if I'm being watched? Surely no one is aware of our true intentions this time...
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_SYSTEM_100_035: Whispers seem to emanate from somewhere nearby...
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_IMPHEAD_000_034: Who could be watching me? Aside from that odd fellow by the gate, of course.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_INVESTIGATOR03169_0: I'm keeping a close eye on activity at the amphitheatre. Let me know if you learn anything further of the Continental Circus's plans.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_SYSTEM_000_037: The voice continues its valiant attempt to sound spooky as it moves toward the Whistling Miller.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_PUMPKIN_000_040: (-???-)Delighted to be alive at last, aren't we, little ones?
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_PUMPKIN_100_040: Fear not, they mean you no harm.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_PUMPKIN_110_040: I do believe we've met before. Yes, in an autumn such as this...
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_PUMPKIN_120_040: Now, didn't you two have something to tell our friend here?
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Heheheh! You should've seen your face! It was hilarious! We went “boo!” and your eyes got huge and─you know, now that you mention it, I don't actually remember what we came here to talk about!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: <sigh> The plot. The evil one. The one that involves being loud and irritating in our mansion.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Oh, right! So, the other day, when I was sitting in the foyer being decorative─which is the same thing I did every day back before I could move, come to think of it─I saw a mummer carry a little girl away to the dark depths of the mansion. I could hardly believe my eyeholes!

Suspicious, right? And horrifying! But I couldn't do anything about it, on account of having no mouth to scream with. I mean, I had a mouth, but it didn't do anything, me being frippery and all. Anyway, that's when the lady with the hideous pumpkin on her head came along and imbued me with life!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: Please stop talking. You'll get us both turned back into objets d'art.
Right. So, what matters is that we began keeping an eye on the Impresario. And wouldn't you know it, he's plotting something.

As you are aware, the Continental Circus is luring people to the mansion for a masquerade. Once there, the guests will be kidnapped and turned into jack-o'-lanterns to inspire terror. With enough terrified victims, the troupe will be able to usher in the Night of Devilry.
I've resigned myself to the fact that I'll have to go out of my way to deal with this. If you want to put a stop to the Impresario's plans, I can help.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Me too, me too! The thought of that poor little girl being turned into a pumpkin and stuck in a corner is enough to send a chill down my seam. It would be terrible! Dreadful! The greatest travesty this world has ever seen! So...you'll keep it from happening, right?
Amazing! I knew we could count on you─well, not really, I suppose, since I just met you a few moments ago, but you do seem nice! Anyway, we'll head back to the mansion and meet you there!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_PUMPKIN_000_052: Heh heh heh... They certainly are enjoying themselves. The joy of conversation is a novelty to them, though to you it may be unworthy of remark.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_INVESTIGATOR03169_0: Did you glean anything of the Impresario's master plan?
Witnesses saw a mummer absconding with a little girl? That must be the Miqo'te child who was reported missing!
I inquired with the Wood Wailers as to whether there have been any suspicious incidents of late, and it seems they have been searching for one T'maritaa at the request of her family.
The situation is already far worse than I'd feared. We must locate the child at once, before any harm befalls her!

I will report what you've discovered to the Wood Wailers, and prepare to lead a raid on the mansion. In the meantime, you ought to disguise yourself and infiltrate the masquerade. See if you can discern where the girl is being held.
My thanks! I've seen the genial guiser escorting folk to the manor, so once your chosen costume is in place you should be able to convince him to let you inside.
You should be able to convince the genial guiser to let you enter the manor. Best of luck!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0316: Oho, another reveler ready to join our marvelous masquerade!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: I love having all of these people around! Yin doesn't care for the noise, and there's the whole horrendous kidnapping plot and all, but it's still fun to see the place so lively!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0316: Oho, another reveler ready to join our marvelous masquerade!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: Took you long enough. I'm not sure how much more of this “revelry” I can endure.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Oh wow, you're here already! I've been so busy reveling that the time just flew by!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: <sigh> Do you see what I put up with? Regardless, we should seek out the malevolent mummers and try to get some information on where they are keeping her. Pray that she hasn't already been turned into a pumpkin, or we'll be here for moons.
I doubt the mummers will tell us what we need to know if we ask politely, so we'll need to employ a bit of deception. Fortunately, I came up with a plan during the ample time you left me to think.
They should be more willing to speak to one of their own─namely, a fiend. So we'll need to turn you into one.
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: I bet you're wondering how we'll make you into a monster! You are, aren't you? Well, see, our very close friend with the hideou─I mean, festive pumpkin head has all sorts of powers. All sorts! And we asked to borrow one or two or three!
TEXT_FESHLW501_03169_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: Indeed. The powers we have will allow us to transfigure your appearance just as the members of the troupe do, albeit temporarily.
Go ahead and adjust to the idea of your visage being horribly reconfigured. When you're ready, let me know and I'll explain the plan in detail.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: That was fast─are you so eager to part with your current visage? I suppose I can see why. In any case, you'll need to turn yourself into one of three types of fiend to adequately blend in with the Continental Circus members I've observed skulking about the manor.
Much to my dismay, it seems that the troupe is already searching for their next victim. <sigh> Loudly searching.

Can you get them out of the way for a bit so that I can have some peace? In disguise, naturally, lest they know we're trying to foil their plot. The last thing I need is a bunch of ghouls running to and fro, screeching that the mortals are on to them.

Huh, you really came back. It's a good thing, too, because those Continental Circus fools don't know when to give up. They're making a cacophony looking for a new victim. Where they get the energy, I don't know.

Thankfully, what they lack in quietude they make up for in stupidity. I'm sure you can derail their efforts by interrupting their trains of thought. Subtly, mind. I don't want to think about the uproar you'll cause if you march straight up to them wearing that face. No offense intended.
Ahem. According to decorative eyewitnesses, the mummers currently on duty are in truth “diminutive, winged, pointy-eared creatures.”
Ahem. According to decorative eyewitnesses, the mummers currently on duty are in truth “large, winged, single-eyed creatures.”
Ahem. According to decorative eyewitnesses, the mummers currently on duty are in truth “alluring, airborne, long-taloned creatures.”

I assume that gives you a decent idea of what we're dealing with. All three mummers are currently on the ground floor, so you should have little trouble finding them. Now all that's left is to get you transfigured.

As you can see, some of my fellows are so taken with the idea that they have already donned the appearances of their favorite All Saints' Wake fiends. You need only speak to whichever has given herself the form you seek, and she will weave the magicks for you. <sigh> With boisterous enthusiasm, I'm sure.
Again, the mummers currently on duty are in truth “diminutive, winged, pointy-eared creatures.” Do try to retain that long enough to cross the room.
Again, the mummers currently on duty are in truth “large, winged, single-eyed creatures.” Do try to retain that long enough to cross the room.
Again, the mummers currently on duty are in truth “alluring, airborne, long-taloned creatures.” Do try to retain that long enough to cross the room.
Once you are hideously transfigured, you'll find the mummers elsewhere on the ground floor.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_BATGHOST03170_000_0: Aren't bats just the cutest little plague-bearers you ever did see? You want to be an oh-so-cuddly screeching nightmare too, right? I know you do!
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_AHRIMANGHOST03170_0: Feast your two tiny peepers on this giant eyeball! Isn't it ghastly? It's just so...big. And round! Don't you want one?
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUCCUBUSGHOST03170_: How do I look? Just kidding, I know the answer. Positively irresistible! I've made three people fall down the stairs  alone! Want to join me?
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_000_023: The action Tricksome Treat will become available on the pet hotbar once transfigured.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_000_024: Cast Tricksome Treat on malevolent mummers to startle them.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNA031: Oh, it's you. Why, exactly, aren't you guarding the memo? I need to be about finding our next victim, and mark my words─there will be seven hells to pay if I hear that some interloper has walked off with our guest-turned-pumpkin in the meantime.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNB031: Oh, wait, I'm also a fiend. Phew. Don't startle me like that! You made me forget who I am. And where we put that pumpkin! Drat! Ah, well, that's what the memo is for.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNC031: Honestly! Can't you just greet me like a normal agent of evil? Now I'm going to have to spend my whole patrol trying to remember what room we put the memo in.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNA031: Oh, is it time to change the watch already? Well, I appreciate your promptness, I suppose...
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNB031: O-Oh, right. We're both fiends. And you're ready to switch? That's a relief. My mother told me that if you hold a transformation too long, you get stuck that way...
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNC031: What is wrong with you? Forget it, just keep watch. I'm going to go and eat my weight in pumpkin pastries.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNA031: What are you doing here? This isn't your floor... I'll let it slide this time, but I'm going to have to report you if you continue to make a nuisance of yourself.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_000_039: Your appearance has aroused suspicion. Return to room 108 and take the form of a different type of fiend.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNB031: I-I mean, a different kind of fiend! I don't think you're supposed to be on this floor...
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_100_039: Your appearance has aroused suspicion. Return to room 108 and take the form of a different type of fiend.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNC031: You're not supposed to be here! We're on guard duty tonight! Honestly, you're useless, the lot of you...
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_110_039: Your appearance has aroused suspicion. Return to room 108 and take the form of a different type of fiend.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNA031: Oh, my apologies─that guise is unfamiliar to me. Are you a new recruit? In any case, that's the kind of enthusiasm for subterfuge that I like to see. I leave this post in your capable hands.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNB031: Y-You're truly a fiend, you say? What a remarkable disguise! V-Very effective. In fact, I think I'll have a seat for a moment. Calm my nerves and such. Please watch my post for me!
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNC031: Nice transformation, but was that really necessary? You must be new around here. Hmm... And if you're new, you probably don't know that if you scare another member of the troupe, you have to stand guard while they go and enjoy the buffet. Sorry, I don't make the rules!
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNA031: I'll thank you not to interrupt me unless it's truly urgent. I have important kidnapping to do.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_110_042: The malevolent mummer seems too focused on the task at hand to let anything slip. Casting Tricksome Treat while transfigured should break his concentration.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_130_042: The malevolent mummer seems to be dozing off and incapable of coherent communication. Casting Tricksome Treat while transfigured should snap her out of it.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUSPICIOUSCLOWNC031: Are those burning pumpkin cookies I smell? I wonder if I could sneak away, just for dessert...
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SYSTEM_150_042: The malevolent mummer seems too focused on fantasizing about food to let anything useful slip. Casting Tricksome Treat while transfigured should snap him out of his reverie.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_BATGHOST03170_000_0: Aren't bats just the cutest little plague-bearers you ever did see? You want to be an oh-so-cuddly screeching nightmare too, right? I know you do!
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_AHRIMANGHOST03170_0: Feast your two tiny peepers on this giant eyeball! Isn't it ghastly? It's just so...big. And round! Don't you want one?
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUCCUBUSGHOST03170_: How do I look? Just kidding, I know the answer. Positively irresistible! I've made three people fall down the stairs  alone! Want to join me?
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_BATGHOST03170_000_0: Oh, I see you're enjoying your new form! If the spell wears off and you need to get cute as a button in a hurry, you know where to find me!
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_AHRIMANGHOST03170_0: I spy with my massive, pulsating eye a fellow guiser! If you're ever in need of my assistance, resume your usual form. I will transfigure you into a most sightly ahriman.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_SUCCUBUSGHOST03170_: Yes, your transfiguration is quite the work of art. You are not as lovely as I, but I'm sure you can cause quite a few injuries regardless. Do come back if you need me to weave my magicks!
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: If you're done, let me remove that transfiguration for you. You wouldn't want your face to get stuck like that. Or would you?
And what did you learn?
Aha! I knew my plan would work! We've got you now, you rowdy little─
Ahem. Let's review the information you collected.
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Yes! Wait, what information? Oh, ! When did you get back?
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_GLOOMYGHOST03169_10: Ah, you're back. Why don't you fill me in while I remove these magicks...
TEXT_FESHLW502_03170_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: Ahaha! Take that, you raucous goons! That's what you get for interrupting my nap!
Ahem. I appreciate your cooperation, .
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Good work out there! I mean, I suppose I don't know how your work was, exactly, since I've been here the whole time and all, but you seem like someone who would do good work! So let's review! The...work! That you did!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: <sigh> If you had been paying attention, you would know that our friend here tricked the mummers into revealing a room number─201─and the existence of a memo regarding a pumpkin significant enough to be kept under guard.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: I see! So that means... Actually, I lied! I have no idea what's going on.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_A1_000_001: That memo holds information on the missing girl's whereabouts.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_A1_000_002: The mummers have an unsettling obsession with pumpkins.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt and assume that you're being obtuse on purpose. But on the off chance that there are two total imbeciles in the room, I'll put this plainly─we need to find that memo.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Oh! So the pumpkin...the pumpkin is...the little girl? Oh no! This is terrible!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: Indeed. Which means that you two should investigate room 201 posthaste and see if you can locate the memo. Off you go.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Hey, look! A thing! Doesn't this look like the thing we're looking for?
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_SYSTEM_100_010: The conspicuous memo contains notes scrawled in an unpracticed hand.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_SYSTEM_130_010:
(-Mummer's Memo-)Pumpkin─Cellarage
Ahriman + Succubus
Room Number = Eyes

TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: This has to be the one. It says “pumpkin” on it and everything!
Now we just need to count some eyeballs! You can do that, right? You seem like a great eyeball-counter.
Oh, and the eyeballs reminded me of these other balls! The pumpkin-headed lady gave them to me. They're subliming smokebombs that can break any skinchanger curse.
Just throw one at any old jack-o'-lantern you see, and it will turn back into its original form. Unless its original form was a pumpkin. Then it will stay the same!
That little girl must be so scared. Hurry and find the room─I'll be right behind you. Oh, but not in a haunting way! In a helpful way!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_SYSTEM_000_016: Decoding the memo and checking its solution against the Cellarage room numbers on your map will allow you to quickly locate the transformed captive amongst the plethora of suspicious pumpkins in the manor.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Did you figure out what room in the cellarage we need? I think it has something to do with the total number of eyeballs! Oh, but you probably knew that, since you seem like someone who would be good at understanding memos.

Just remember to use the subliming scalebombs when you find the right pumpkin. Otherwise you'll just be standing there, staring at a pumpkin! Which isn't so different from what I used to do every day, come to think of it.

TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_SYSTEM_000_020: As the smoke clears, the pumpkin remains a mere festive gourd...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: I knew that you would be skilled at pumpkin identification! And you did it, you saved the little...
...Wait, what?
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_023: (-???-)I can finally stretch my legs again! I finally have legs again. Ahhh...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Aaaaaahhh!
O-Oh gods, the little girl turned into a large man! It's terrible! It's dreadful! It's the greatest travesty this world has ever seen!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_A2_000_001: You shouldn't judge based on appearances, you know.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_A2_000_002: I'm pretty sure that's a different person.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: You're right. Quick, let's go ask if we should be screaming or not!
Oh, that does make more sense, come to think of it! Well, even if he isn't the girl we're looking for, we should probably follow him, don't you think?
I found him! I'm helping!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_030: Augh! Ghost stalker! Alright, Dawkin, keep it together...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_031: (-Dawkin-)Wait a minute, I know you. I apologize for my outburst─I'm a little on edge. One minute I was enjoying the masquerade, you see, and the next I'm a pumpkin in a dungeon. It's a bit much to take in.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_100_031: (-Dawkin-)Wait a minute, you're neither a ghost nor a stalker, are you? You're just an adventurer. My apologies─I'm a little on edge. One minute I was enjoying the masquerade, you see, and the next I'm a pumpkin in a dungeon. It's a bit much to take in.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_033: (-Dawkin-)Oh, little T'maritaa! You're considerably less orange than I was a moment ago, so I take that to mean that you've been safe in your hiding place all this time?
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_TMARITAA_000_034: Yep, I'm the best hider! There's not a fiend who's found me yet!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Hello, I'm confused!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_TMARITAA_000_036: Well, mister ghost, I was looking around this big scary mansion for good hide-and-seek spots when one of the people from the Circus saw me and started casting a spell on me─I know because it's happened before. Dawkin jumped in front of me, but he got turned into a pumpkin!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_TMARITAA_000_037: I ran away, and I wanted to go and get help, but there were too many people from the troupe guarding the way out...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_038: (-Dawkin-)Me, I just happened to be lost in the cellarage when I came upon that mummer casting the curse on her─not that I knew it was a curse at the time, mind, but it seemed right ominous─so I shielded her without a second thought. And then I was a pumpkin! Funny how these things happen, eh?
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_039: (-Dawkin-)Unfortunately, I wasn't much good to anyone after that. You must've been scared out of your wits all alone down here.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_TMARITAA_000_040: Don't worry, I was fine! These nice brooms kept me company while I hid.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_TMARITAA_000_041: Thank you for coming to save me again,  adventurer! And you too, mister ghost!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_TMARITAA_100_041: Thank you for coming to save us,  adventurer! And you too, mister ghost!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_042: (-Dawkin-)My thanks as well. I would've hated to be stuck as a jack-o'-lantern forever. Just sitting there decoratively, serving no purpose...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_DAWKIN_000_043: (-Dawkin-)Anyway, I'd be more than happy to escort T'maritaa here home to her mother. Hopefully next time we meet, I won't be a useless ornament! Haha!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: Wow, that was weird! And slightly offensive! But I'm glad that they're safe and everything worked out, you know, because when the pumpkin turned into a middle-aged man it was so scary and I thought we were in for a terrible tragedy for sure, but─ Oh, do you think we're supposed to tell Yin?
It certainly was surreal seeing a pumpkin come to life like that. But now that the mystery is solved, we can go back to reveling!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: The little girl turned into what!?
Oh. Oh, I see. <sigh> Well, what matters is that everything turned out in the end.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: And it's all thanks to ! It was really fun talking to you, and joking with you, and panicking with you, and running around with you! Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever had so much fun...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_GLOOMYGHOST03169_00: <sigh> And now that it's over, I can finally have some peace and quiet. The manor will be empty once again. And perhaps we must return to silence, as well. Not that I mind, but...
Do come and see us again.
Ahem. Yes, that's quite enough for now. Wasn't someone waiting to hear from you?
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_CHEERFULGHOST03169_: You can come back and talk to me any time! But for now you should talk to that suspicious man outside!
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_IMPHEAD_000_062: My pumpkin has vanished, you say? How could this be?
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_INVESTIGATOR03169_0: Aha, there you are! I was delighted to hear that you managed to rescue the girl, even without reinforcements. The less the Impresario knows of our resources, the better.
And perhaps the troupe's failure to keep ahold of their prey will give them cause to doubt the wisdom of their plans. We can only hope─and keep a close watch, of course.
I will remain at my post here, vigilant as always. If you could keep an eye on goings-on within the manor itself, I'd be grateful.
Hm, but what to do about the other issue...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_PUMPKIN_000_067: It is fitting that you bring the little ones delight, for they have watched over you for longer than you know. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_PUMPKIN_000_068: As for how the brooms that made the girl their playmate came to move, even I cannot say, for it was no magic of mine. But no matter.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_PUMPKIN_000_069: At the grand masquerade of All Saints' Wake, adventurers, monsters, and silent watchers are as one.
TEXT_FESHLW503_03171_PUMPKIN_000_070: Permit us our mischief, and we might just follow you home...
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_INVESTIGATOR03169_0: While you're in the area, I have one more tale that I'd like you to look into.
Another adventurer reported to me that she entered the manor intending to attend the marvelous masquerade, only to find a gathering of another sort entirely.

Where there should have been the chatter of conversation was deathly silence, and rather than revelers, voidsent stalked the halls. It sounds like the stuff of nightmares─and perhaps it was. But I don't feel right putting it down to an overactive imagination with the Continental Circus in town.
If you believe this tale to have some merit, I suggest you inquire with the enthralling illusionist. She seems quite keen on getting people to enter the manor...
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_WITCH03172_000_004: My, what a charming adventurer! I do hope you've been enjoying the masquerade.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_INVESTIGATOR03169_0: If you believe the tales of haunting experiences within the manor have merit, you should inquire with the enthralling illusionist. She seems suspiciously keen on her work.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_WITCH03172_000_011: You say our guests have witnessed the incomprehensible? Oh, my insuf─incomparable adventurer, but of course they have! During All Saints' Wake, light and shadow are hardly so different. Many have slipped beyond the veil, to see shattered the illusion of reality.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_WITCH03172_000_013: Our role is simply to prepare the venue for a broadening of perspective─to host a celebration like no other. I would be delighted to extend you an invitation to join us...if you dare.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_WITCH03172_000_014: Why the dour expression? If you're afraid, you need only speak to one of our harlequin guides before you go. Understand the rules, and you needn't risk losing more than most of your sanity.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_WITCH03172_000_015: Once you at last muster your courage, simply make your intentions known to them. They will be delighted to escort you.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_WITCH03172_000_016: As for me, I must take my leave. The guiser keeps asking for help with some manner of “ghost problem,” whatever you take that to mean. Sweet waking dreams, adventurer...
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_SYSTEM_000_017: You now have access to the Haunted Manor seasonal instance. To enter the manor, speak with the harlequin guide in either Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_SYSTEM_000_018: The Haunted Manor is a light party instance (four players). There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESHLW504_03172_SYSTEM_000_019: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members will be filled out automatically via the matching system.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Ah, 'tis always a joy to welcome a new face. I am a Starlight celebrant, and you must be...an adventurer in search of festive cheer, correct?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_001: ! How wonderful to see you! I just knew you'd be joining us again this year.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_002: We have lots of surprises in store, especially for the little ones. The Starlight Celebration wouldn't be complete without the beaming smiles of all those darling children!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_003: One of said surprises will involve a tradition from the frozen climes of Ishgard. A little snow makes the world glisten and sparkle, but too much can be ever so dangerous, as the Ishgardians know all too well. That is why the adults offer song to the Saint of Nymeia, so that he may keep the blizzards at bay.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_004: While the weather here in Gridania is nowhere near as inclement as that, a festive song like that would make the proceedings even more memorable. And when the singing is over, we'll give each child in the audience a present!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Luckily, several local businesses have agreed to fund all this merrymaking. Are you familiar with Maisenta of Black Rabbit Traders, by any chance? She has been particularly eager to lend us a hand.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_006: From the decorations to the costumes, there is scarcely an aspect of the celebrations in which she hasn't been involved.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_007: In fact, she has even agreed to arrange the musicians who will be singing here at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. The only trouble is, I haven't seen her for a while and I worry that she may have encountered...complications.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_008: Now, I'm sure there is nothing to worry about, but I would be ever so grateful if you could speak with her. Perhaps politely remind her that the success of the Starlight Celebration hangs in the balance?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_009: I'm dreadfully sorry to impose on you like this, but we are up to our baubles in tasks that simply cannot wait. Could you do me this one teensy favor?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_100_009: Oh, that's terrific! She's probably at her stall near the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_010: I do hope Maisenta hasn't experienced any “creative differences” with these musicians of hers. Artistic types are notoriously hard to work with, but I expect she knows how to keep them in line!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_020: , how lovely to see you! And might I say, seldom does a day go by that I do not think of the way you saved my precious Homunculi from the Baert Trading Company.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_021: , how lovely to see you! And yes, not only am I a staunch supporter of Hatching-tide, but the Starlight Celebration as well.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_022: Come to feast your eyes on my wares, have you? Or is there something you would like to discuss?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_023: Well, it was never my intention to keep Amh Garanjy waiting.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_024: I will happily explain everything, as soon as we take this conversation somewhere a little more...private. Might I suggest the secluded area by the Leatherworkers' Guild?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_025: Please excuse my need for secrecy, but the preparations for the festival have reached a crucial stage, and I cannot risk any outside interference─especially not of the female variety. All will become clear, I assure you.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_026: Maisenta wants to meet you somewhere secluded? Hmm... Are you sure this is about the Starlight Celebration? I can't imagine organizing a few songs would warrant this level of secrecy...
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_030: Thank you for agreeing to meet me here. I'm on good terms with Guildmaster Geva and she lets me use this space for...well, that's a story for another time. Or perhaps never.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_100_030: Naturally, a quiet spot like this is ideal for avoiding unwanted attention, while the guard─who has been asked to turn a blind eye─is an effective deterrent to any would-be eavesdroppers.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_031: As I am sure you know, the Homunculi cause a stir wherever they go, and I need them focused on the task at hand. It's strange to think that without your intervention all those moons ago, they would have escaped my clu─ahem─would have been lost to me forever, and here we all are, reunited.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_032: You will no doubt be pleased to hear that since the last time you saw them, my honey-tongued musical geniuses have been touring the breadth of the realm. Naturally, Black Rabbit Traders continue to enjoy a profitable relationship with Eorzea's most beloved traveling bards.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_033: I expect you remember the Homunculi from Hatching-tide all those years ago. Or maybe you've seen them delighting crowds and stealing hearts while on your travels?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_034: We of Black Rabbit Traders are more than happy to cover their expenses provided that they perform dressed in our wares. I can only hope that their post-concert proclivities do nothing to endanger our reputation...
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_035: It gives me great pleasure to introduce the Homunculi, the greatest musical sensation the realm has ever known. While I am not one to boast, I should point out that I played no small part in bringing them and my organization, Black Rabbit Traders, together in a mutually beneficial partnership.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_036: We cover their expenses while they promote our fine range of fashionable attire as they enchant hoards of besotted onlookers. Although I should warn you─any rumors of them siring a string of bastards across Eorzea are entirely unfounded. Well, mostly unfounded.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_037: Of course, it won't do to have this conversation interrupted by legions of squealing followers, hence our current venue. As for their role in the Starlight Celebration, I jumped at the chance to have them take center stage.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_038: Admirers will flock from malms around for the chance to see the Homunculi and their new, specially prepared material.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_039: I can picture it now... The dulcet tones of my beautiful bards filling the ears of festival-goers young and old, with Black Rabbit Traders making gil hand over fist from all of the garments we sell.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_040: And what's more, the presence of such renowned artists will raise the profile of the celebration, meaning that Amh Garanjy and her Starlight celebrants will have even more reason to be cheerful.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_041: All that remains is for the Homunculi to fulfill their part of the bargain, and put together a few songs for the concert itself. Therein lies the problem.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_OSCARLET_000_042: Were this any other performance, we would mesmerize the crowds with a few favorites from our repertoire, such as “Fair Lady, Return My Breeches” or “Hey Nonny, Nonny, Maiden Most Bonny.” Fearing that such material may not be...appropriate, we thought it best to work on some new pieces.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AUGUSTINIEL_000_043: But this occasion calls for traditional Ishgardian music, whereas we weave our entrancing melodies in the classic Gridanian style. To better fulfill the needs of the Starlight Celebration, we sought the aid of an Ishgardian composer.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AUGUSTINIEL_000_044: Upon taking receipt of the manuscripts, however, we found that they were written for a mixed choir. Four singers, two male and two female. It does not take a musical aficionado to appreciate that the Homunculi are ill-equipped for such a performance.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_ORSELFAUXL_000_045: To make matters worse, there simply isn't time to have the pieces rewritten. We are well and truly out of our element, like proverbial babes in the wood. Whatever will we do?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_046: All of this moping is getting us nowhere! Are you professionals or not?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_047: What we need are solutions, and fast. First of all, let us select our vocalists.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_048: Luckily, the composer has provided instructions on the kind of voices required to carry the melody. Though I must admit, I can make neither head nor tail of these notes.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_049: One of the female voices must be “as uplifting as birdsong on a crisp winter's morning,” and the other “ephemeral as a zephyr across a sun-dappled stream.” For the males, “reminiscent of a mighty oak's outstretched boughs” and “deep and cavernous as the bowels of the earth.”
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_050: We have to start our search somewhere I suppose.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_052: Can you think of anyone who possesses a voice “as uplifting as birdsong on a crisp winter's morning?”
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_055: Why hadn't I thought of that? If the cheerful manner in which she speaks is any indication, her singing voice may be exactly what we are looking for.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_056: Being a Starlight celebrant, she can hardly refuse. I daresay you've found the perfect candidate.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_057: Hmm...I can picture her being able to carry a tune. But wouldn't her duties as guildmaster take priority?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_058: Thank you for the suggestion, though. I was actually planning to ask Amh Garanjy, mainly because she is the person least likely to refuse.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_059: A chocobo!? Where the manuscripts mention birdsong, I don't think it was supposed to be taken literally! We can't have one of those smelly beasts kweh-ing its way through the concert.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_060: If I were you, I would avoid making similar japes in future─ It really doesn't suit you, dear. For lack of any better suggestions, how about...Amh Garanjy? Come to think of it, she may well be the perfect choice. A charming young lady like her is sure to have a singing voice to match.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_065: With that settled, we should move on to our second female vocalist. Can you think of anyone with a voice as “ephemeral as a zephyr across a sun-dappled stream?”
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_067: You're serious, aren't you? Hmm...I am somewhat partial to humming the odd tune while enjoying a long soak in the bath. I should be able to get through it without making too big a fool of myself. And it's for a good cause.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_068: The Elder Seedseer herself!? Have you taken leave of your senses? Generous and benevolent she may be, but I struggle to imagine her joining our little choir group!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_069: There's only one thing for it: I will just have to do it myself. My devotion to the Homunculi and Black Rabbit Traders compels me! There is also the fact that I have already invested too much in this venture to allow it to fail now.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_070: Well, I think we will have to disregard the composer's instructions in this case. Seeing as we are hardly spoiled for choice, perhaps we should set our sights a little lower.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_071: And by that, I mean “any woman who can sing.” Since time is of the essence, I nominate myself to fill this position. As much as I would rather avoid public humiliation, I will not have it said that I lack commitment.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AUGUSTINIEL_000_072: Maisenta, my darling! It would be an honor to join my voice with yours in musical matrimony!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_073: Let's not get carried away! For all you know, I could be a dreadful singer!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_OSCARLET_000_074: Fear not, my lady, for we shall be on hand to provide all the tutelage you might require. Though the question remains─which two lucky fellows will be accompanying you?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_ORSELFAUXL_000_075: “Reminiscent of a mighty oak's outstretched boughs.” I would say that description fits Augustiniel's soaring vocals.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_076: I couldn't agree more. Finding someone whose voice is “deep and cavernous as the bowels of the earth” may prove a little more challenging. The Homunculi's music rarely ventures into the lower notes.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_077: At the risk of volunteering myself for that role too, mayhaps we should put that matter to one side for now.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_078: , might I be able to ask a favor of you? Two favors, actually.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_079: Keen as always! And I haven't even told you what the favors are yet!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_080: I need you to collect a conductor's baton from Beatin of the Carpenter's Guild, as well as an order of choir surplices from Redolent Rose over at the Weavers' Guild in Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_081: After paying a visit to these master artisans, head straight to Amh Garanjy in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. She will be expecting you.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_082: In the meantime, it seems prudent for us to rehearse away from prying...ears. Now, make haste, !
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_091: So, , are you any closer to becoming one with the wood?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_092: Welcome back, . Are you here to show me your latest creation?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_093: Ah, yes. I have the conductor's baton right here.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_094: Since the guild seldom receives orders for such items, I thought it best to deal with this one personally. The maple gives it a certain degree of flexibility while the cork grip allows it to be held between thumb and index finger without fear of dropping it.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_095: I am confident that Maisenta will appreciate the quality of the craftsmanship. While my services do not come cheap, she is sure to feel that her money was well spent.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_096: And spend she did. In all honesty, a simple twig would probably suffice, but nothing is too good for her Homunculi. I must admit, I do not see the appeal in those preening pretty boys. The sigh of a saw on wood and the tap of a hammer on chisel are all the music I need.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BEATIN_000_097: Have a care as you transport that baton. 'Tis such a slight thing, you may even forget you have it on your person, until you sit down and hear a snap.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_REDOLENTROSE_000_10: Oh, what's this? A customer? Or perhaps some lackey sent on an errand?
Well, well. If it isn't . I trust you have not been neglecting your needlework.
The choir surplices? Not the most challenging request the guild has received, but a welcome change from all the plebeians asking us to add arse flaps to their culottes.

Another pleasant surprise was the amount Maisenta was willing to pay for them. So generous was she that I thought it only fair to include a few more. Knowing her, she will find a way to pitch them to festival-goers, so any surplus surplices could be sold on for a profit.
This could even mark the beginning of a very lucrative venture for Black Rabbit Traders and the Weavers' Guild.
Our mutual acquaintance is undoubtedly counting the gil as we speak, so I suggest you deliver these garments to her posthaste. Best of luck with the Starlight Celebration!
Was I speaking to myself when I told you to “deliver these garments posthaste?” No? I didn't think so. Now, off you go!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_110: You're back! I was considering sending out a search party for you too! Is everything all right?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_111: Unless I am very much mistaken, these look remarkably like a conductor's wand and some sort of smocks. This may seem like an odd question, but...why are you giving these to me?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_112: (-???-)Did I forget to tell you? Not to worry. All will become clear once you've changed into your surplice and are ready to rehearse.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_113: Rehearse? But I don't remember agreeing to sing! And I'm fairly certain you never even asked me!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_114: Sorry, dear. Change of plans. To be honest, knowing how committed you are to the Starlight Celebration, it never occurred to me that you might be opposed to the idea.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_115: Well, we cannot disappoint the little ones... I suppose it is only meet that I at least try.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_116: If it makes you feel any better, I will be singing too. Bear in mind that I lack your experience when it comes to entertaining the masses, so if there is anyone who should be nervous, it's me.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_117: Besides, there's no time for dilly-dallying. We still have to find a man with a voice “deep and cavernous as the bowels of the earth.”
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BAENFAELD_000_118: Are these the musicians? We'd better start checking the amphitheatre's...what did you call 'em? ...Accuse sticks? No, that don't sound right...
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_119: You there! Are you one of the Starlight celebrants?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BAENFAELD_000_120: Aye, and a member of the Adventurers' Guild besides. Every year, they give me leave to help out with the festival.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AUGUSTINIEL_000_121: Remarkable...his every word reverberates to the core of my soul. “Deep and cavernous as the bowels of the earth?” Why, he's Titan incarnate!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_122: My thoughts exactly. Who could have guessed that the perfect candidate was under our noses─figuratively speaking, of course─this whole time. How would you like to join our choir?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BAENFAELD_000_123: I don't see why not. When it comes to bein' big and loud, no one does it better than me!
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AUGUSTINIEL_000_124: Ha ha! Glad to hear! While I would normally balk at sharing my stage with rank amateurs, I am willing to make an exception. Obviously, none of you can even hope to reach my standards, but with sufficient practice, we should be able to approach “adequate” or even “not displeasing.”
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_125: As for Oscarlet and Orselfaux, I have something else in mind. While you may not be serenading us with your angelic vocals, you will instead be blessing the children with the presents I have prepared.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_126: I will make sure they keep their hands off of the children's mummies, no matter how “yummy” they might be. If the Homunculi can limit their flirtations to a well-timed wink here and a cheeky smile there, we'll have them eating out of our hands, without any “lasting repercussions.”
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_AMHGARANJY_000_127: Ummm...I have a question. Who is this conductor's stick for?
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_128: You catch on quickly, don't you? I'm not asking you to do this entirely from the goodness of your heart. I will see to it that you are appropriately remunerated. In some form.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_MAISENTA_000_129: I would say compared to the four members of the choir, you have the easy job. Judging from what I've seen at other concerts, you just need to look the part and wave the baton a bit. Simple.
TEXT_FESXMS401_03173_BAENFAELD_000_130: Rather you than me, friend. I wouldn't know where to start! I'm much more comfortable bellowin' away to me heart's content. Anyway, let me know when you're ready for some conductin'.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_000: Ready for a bit o' singin'? Oh, if you're wonderin' where Maisenta's gone, she's keepin' an eye on her stall. She'll be right back when it's time to get started, though.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_001: You'd think she'd have enough on her plate already, what with all that buyin' and sellin'. Good of her to find the time─and gil─to help us lot with the festival. Her voice ain't half bad, neither.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_002: It's hard to believe she wants someone like me to be in her choir. I don't know the first thing about music! Best I can manage is a few sea shanties, and that's only when I'm in me cups.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_003: Might as well make the most of it, I suppose. And if we're enjoyin' ourselves, maybe the younglin's will too. As long as they stick around long enough to get their presents, we can consider it a success.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_004: But how about you? Had a chance to practice your wand wavin'? If not...well, it's a bit late to start now, but I'm sure you'll pick it up as we go along.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_005: It looks like we've already got a few people lined up to watch the show. You can see the Starlight celebrants herdin' them together just over yonder.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_006: I'd watch out for that enthusiastic-lookin' lass over there, though. She's been tellin' folk about “the most lauded musicians the realm has ever known” and they seemed to be lappin' it up.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_007: I appreciate her drummin' up a crowd like that, but I think their expectations might be a bit too high, what with this bein' our first performance. Might be an idea to start with the other lot. They seem less like to take offense to a flat note or two.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_008: Once we're feelin' confident, we can take a crack at somethin' trickier. But you're the conductor, so you get final say as to what we sing and when.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_009: Well, there's no time like the present! Let one of the Starlight celebrants know when you're ready to begin.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_010: Quest difficulty and rewards will vary according to which Starlight celebrant you approach.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_016: We've still got plenty of festival-goers to entertain, so as soon as you're ready, let one of the Starlight celebrants know.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_017: Quest difficulty and rewards will vary according to which Starlight celebrant you approach.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_017: I'm not sure what's worse─downplayin' the performance and makin' the crowd lose interest, or exaggeratin' and risk them bein' disappointed. Mind you, if our singin' is up to snuff, we'll have nothin' to worry about.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_COMMITTEE03174A_000: Finished your preparations? That's good. <sigh> I've been struggling to keep the younglings amused while they wait. Then I told them that only the most well-behaved child would receive a present, and they soon settled down. Anyway, it's about time we got started. This way, please.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_100_020: Speak with this Starlight celebrant to begin the cantabile. You will earn two certificates of good cheer for successful completion of this piece.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_110_020: To attempt the capriccio, speak with the splendiferous Starlight celebrant. The rewards for successful completion vary according to difficulty.

TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_A1_000_003: How do I conduct a choir?
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_COMMITTEE03174A_000: Having second thoughts? Stage fright, perhaps? I don't blame you. I can't imagine standing in front of the crowd, pretending to know what I'm doing. Maybe you should come back once you've plucked up the courage.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_022: The choir will now perform a song. Time your inputs with the on-screen prompts.

TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_028: In the event of failure or quitting during the performance, you may attempt it again by speaking to either of the Starlight celebrants.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_COMMITTEE03174A_000: Oh, well done! That was a lot better than it could have been. I didn't have much hope, but I was pleasantly surprised.
Please give my regards to the members of the choir.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_COMMITTEE03174B_000: Hark! The conductor beyond compare makes  grand entrance! The crowd can barely contain their excitement! Are your preparations complete, maestro?
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_100_040: Speak with this Starlight celebrant to begin the capriccio. You will earn three certificates of good cheer for successful completion of this piece.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_110_040: To attempt the cantabile, speak with the saturnine Starlight celebrant. The rewards for successful completion vary according to difficulty.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_Q2_000_000:
Do you wish to begin the capriccio?
You will earn three certificates of good cheer for successful completion of this piece.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_A2_000_003: How do I conduct a choir?
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_COMMITTEE03174B_000: Oh, you require a little more time? As I always say “There is nothing in life as fleeting or capricious as inspiration.” Your adoring audience would endure a lifetime of waiting if only to witness a master at work for the briefest moment. A bell or two longer will make little difference.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_042: The choir will now perform a song. Time your inputs with the on-screen prompts.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_043:
When a blue prompt appears (left), time your input as the diamonds overlap.
When an orange prompt appears (right), make several rapid inputs until the prompt disappears.
The controls are as follows:
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_045: To access the Pause menu, press the  key or  button, from which you may choose to end the performance.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_046: If you fail to follow an on-screen prompt, you will incur a penalty.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_047: When a certain number of penalties have been incurred, the performance will not end immediately, but your attempt will be unsuccessful.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_SYSTEM_000_048: In the event of failure or quitting during the performance, you may attempt it again by speaking to either of the Starlight celebrants.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_COMMITTEE03174B_000: Bravo! It was everything I could have dreamed of, and more! That heavenly melody shall echo within not only our ears, but our hearts─now and forevermore. Indeed, future generations will still speak of the angels who once descended to bless us with their song.
Pray, pass on my sentiments of utmost gratitude to the members of the choir, the heavenly conduits through which your genius has graced Gridania, nay, Eorzea!
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_060: Phew! This singin' lark's harder than it looks! Good thing we had you to keep us in time.
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_061: 'Course, we'll be puttin' on more shows, all the way to the end of the Starlight Celebration. I think we'll be able to put on a fairly convincin' performance even without a conductor, but if you've got time to spare, why not join us for another singsong?
TEXT_FESXMS402_03174_BAENFAELD_000_062: Oh, and one other thing─I think Amh Garanjy wanted to say somethin' to you. Probably wants to say “thank ye” or summat.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_000: That was incredible! Considering that only Augustiniel has any real experience, it's hard to believe we were able to keep up with him. Of course, your conducting is what made it all possible. We would have been lost without you!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_001: As planned, Oscarlet and Orselfaux are handing out the presents. It truly is a marvel to see so many children arriving to collect gifts, but I do wish the Homunculi would pay more attention to the younglings and a little less to their mothers... Still, they are doing ever such a good job!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_OSCARLET_000_003: I'm dreadfully sorry, little ones! Unfortunately, the Saint of Nymeia has not blessed us with quite the right number of gifts...
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_ORSELFAUXL_000_004: We never expected the choral performance to be so popular. Had we known, we would have prayed for a few more parcels.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Oh no! Whatever shall we do? There must be something we can give them!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SADLYGIRL03175_000_: The Saint knows I've been bad... That's why I can't have a present! <sniff>
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_007: (-???-)Ho ho ho! Fear not, all ye faithful! The Saint of Nymeia has heard your prayers. Rejoice, for I am come bearing gifts!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_008: Hearken one, hearken all! For a bevy of festive treats awaits every good boy and girl, all courtesy of Mandervi─Ahem!─my little helpers!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_009: Now, who has been good this year?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_CHILD03175_000_010: Me, me! I've been on my bestest behavior!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_011: What a wonderful surprise! Your arrival is timely indeed!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_012: Ho ho ho! Think nothing of it! The Saint of Nymeia lives only to bring joy to the realm.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_013: But did I perchance see a young girl with tears in her eyes? Verily, my work here cannot be considered complete until that sweet child is smiling once more!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_014: Yes, I could not agree more. She was beside herself when she heard there was no present for her. I think she blames herself, for some reason.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_015: We must find her without delay. Although I get the impression that the sight of a member of the festival staff would be rather upsetting for her, at least until she has had a chance to calm down.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_016: , could you ask if anyone has seen her?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_017: Thank you. She can't have gone far, but keep your eyes peeled─Gridania is full of little nooks and crannies, perfect for hiding.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GODBERT_000_018: And with that, I must depart, for I still have many parcels to deliver, and so little time! May the blessings of Nymeia be upon each and every one of you! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_019: Thankfully, crying children are something of a rarity during the Starlight Celebration, so there is a high chance that somebody remembers seeing her.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SIMPKIN_000_025: A crying girl? Why yes, one went running in the direction of New Gridania. Though for the life of me, I could have sworn that they were tears of joy, presumably brought on by your magnificent display at the amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SIMPKIN_000_026: Had I known the truth of the matter, mayhap I could have offered a gentle melody of mine own, to ease whatever ails her troubled heart. I sincerely hope you find her, my fellow musician!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SIMPKIN_000_027: It saddens me greatly that such a young child could be so full of woe, particularly on such an occasion as the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_WOODWAILER03175_000: Sorry, can't say I pay much attention to bawling babes. Got enough of my own at home! Might be worth asking around the Adders' Nest, though. Always a lot of folk coming and going. Maybe one of them saw something.
Have you tried the Adders' Nest, like I said?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GAVIN_000_035: Why yes, I saw a girl matching your description darting off in the direction of the Acorn Orchard. But since this area is frequented by a large number of young children, I didn't think anything of it. It appeared to me that she was unaccompanied, though.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_GAVIN_000_036: A lot of the local younglings come to play in the Acorn Orchard, but rarely give the Twin Adders cause for concern, provided they stay well away from that waterwheel over there.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SADLYGIRL03175_000_: <sniff> I know you. You're the stick-wavy . From the concert. Are you cross with me?
Oh... Good. But that's why I got no present. Because I was naughty...
It's just me and Daddy. He's a Wood Wailer. But he's always busy. He only comes home at night. When I'm asleep.
But today, he wasn't busy. So we went to the market. I said I wanted a flower hairpin.
But he said “Next time.” When is “next time?” Maybe there is no “next time!” He's always too busy.
So I said “I hate you!” Then I ran away.
That's when I saw the concert. I wanted to hear the music. So I went there by myself.
But then I didn't get a present. It's because I said “I hate you” to Daddy and ran off.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_048: (-???-)It's not your fault, child. I am to blame.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SADLYGIRL03175_000_: I know you too! You're a singer!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_050: Ha ha! Not quite. Think of me as one of the Saint's little helpers.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_051: He is not the only one who gives presents. I've brought one too, just for you. Now, hold still and close your eyes.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SADLYGIRL03175_000_: Ah! The hairpin! Just what I always wanted! But how did you know?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_053: Well, a certain someone gave this to me to look after. He told me that you had been standing in front of Black Rabbit Traders, staring at it every day.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_100_053: That somebody also asked me to hold on to it, as a present for the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_110_053: Which is why when you asked him to buy it for you, he said “Next time.” He didn't want you to know he had already bought it.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_130_053: Yes, that's right. Now, why don't you run along and find him?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_SADLYGIRL03175_000_: Thank you Saint's little helper! Thank you stick-wavy ! I promise I'll say sorry to Daddy!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_055: <sigh> Whoever thought doing good deeds could be so tiring?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_056: You should have seen the way she was milling about near my stall, day after day, staring at my floral hairpins. And the way she'd been talking with one of the Wood Wailers, with that pleading look in her eyes, I suspected I'd found a customer.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_100_056: Sure enough, he came over one day and asked which of my wares the girl had been looking at. He bought it and requested that I keep it safe until the Starlight Celebration, no doubt to hide it from his daughter.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_110_056: Imagine my surprise when he came by, asking not after the hairpin, but his little girl! He'd been desperately searching for her after she ran off.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_120_056: I couldn't very well leave him to search for her on his own─certainly not on a day such as this. I am one of the Saint's little helpers, after all.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_057: Yes, you heard me correctly! Is it so surprising that I could get into the festive spirit? Besides, if I treat them with kindness now, her father may be inclined to buy her more presents in the future. Why, she might become a paying customer herself when she has money of her own to spend.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_058: That is the key to good business─plant the seeds and watch them grow. And to be honest, I underestimated how many presents we would need for the concert. It's a good thing I had the hairpin from her father to hand!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_059: Of course, I have you to thank for tracking her down. You are an awful lot easier to find than a wayward child.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_060: Come to think of it, Amh Garanjy would be relieved to hear that this little incident has come to a satisfactory conclusion. Would you be so kind as to put her mind at ease?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_061: I, on the other hand, have a rather more pressing engagement─I simply must change out of this unflattering costume. Although I suspect I may have to wear it again before the festival comes to a close. Well then, ta-ta for now!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_MAISENTA_000_062: Have you spoken to Amh Garanjy yet? Why not? She does strike me as the sort of person to concern herself with distraught children, especially if she holds herself responsible. Be a dear and put her mind at ease, would you?
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_071: My, my, Maisenta! She never ceases to amaze me! I suppose she can add “cheering up crying children” to her lengthy list of talents. And you seem to have quite the knack for finding missing persons. I daresay that comes in handy from time to time!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_100_071: Anyway, I hope we will be spared any similar misadventures for the rest of the festival. This is supposed to be a happy occasion, after all. If it gives even one youngling reason to be upset, it will have all been for naught.
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_072: But now that's over, and we can all go back to enjoying the Starlight Celebration!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_073: I know you have already done more than enough to help us, but if you fancy leading the choir again, the Starlight celebrants and I would be absolutely thrilled!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_074: We are still inundated with visitors from far and wide, all clamoring for a chance to experience an authentic yet unique Ishgardian music spectacle and receive a gift from the Saint. And here is one for you!
TEXT_FESXMS403_03175_AMHGARANJY_000_075: While I suspect that the presents may be somewhat more enticing than our singing, I can say without a shadow of a doubt the whole enterprise has been a roaring success!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: Ah, but you have the air of someone who has spent time abroad! Are you perhaps an adventurer─a  practiced in acquainting yourself with various cultures?
I come from the Far East, you see, where we celebrate Heavensturn just as the people of Eorzea do. But rather than a god, like your Twelve, we choose an animal to represent the coming year.

This year belongs to the foremost beast among them─the rat! And celebration of the rat's glory should not─nay, must not be confined to Far Eastern shores. Thus did I don a festive kabuto in the name of sharing our customs with all the world.

I was confident that I could easily surpass my dull-witted compatriots─those who have ventured to these foreign lands representing inferior beasts in years past─in this task. Alas, all has not gone to plan.

As the rat is considered a symbol of plenty and harbinger of fortune in my homeland, I thought to grace the people of Eorzea with the opportunity to pound mochi and make advent cakes alongside these lofty creatures.

Alas, the people of Eorzea seem loath to touch tubs of mochi lousy with rats, nor eat their laboriously prepared cakes! This can likely be attributed to cultural differences, as I mentioned previously.

The trouble with cultural bias is, of course, that people often do not recognize it within themselves, let alone make an effort to overcome it on their own. No─if they are to ever understand the rat's superiority, I must do the work of convincing them.
Unfortunately, I am uncertain as to what manner of local superstition about rats has given rise to their aversion─and without that knowledge, I have no means of assuaging their discomfort.
Might I impose upon you to speak with the townspeople here on my behalf? I am afraid they will not share their honest thoughts with me, for fear of causing offense.

You have my thanks! Perhaps you might begin with that elderly woman over there. She refused my invitation to join the festivities earlier─unsurprising, perhaps, as the elderly are often set in their ways.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_100_119: Heavens turned to Neneroon's turn for Heavensturn!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_IMANIA_000_020: I've spent the better part of my life trying to keep rats out of the grain stores─I can't imagine why I'd want them touching my food! Filthy creatures.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_IMANIA_000_021: And in any case, the idea of animals cooking is ludicrous. Even if there were, say, a particularly intelligent dog, it would still have no hands...
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_IMANIA_000_022: Anyway, this all seems fairly obvious. Ask anyone─they'll tell you the same!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_100: We must get to the root of this irrational dislike of rat-plagued delicacies!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_KLINDRAEL_000_030: Balderdash! Let a rat in your pantry and it'll eat you out of house and home, not cook you dinner. Not that you'd want it to, unless you think pestilence the finest spice.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_KLINDRAEL_000_031: If only a rodent will do for your purposes, however, you might try something like a rat, but rather more...sentient. A beast that's also a man, if you catch my drift.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_KLINDRAEL_000_033: A beastman, see? The Qiqirn. They look like rats, squeak like rats, chew through your unattended grain sacks like rats...but are not, in fact, rats. They can even use cutlery!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_KLINDRAEL_000_034: Quite. They look like rats, squeak like rats, chew through your unattended grain sacks like rats...but are not, in fact, rats. They can even use cutlery!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_KLINDRAEL_000_035: I doubt you'll find anyone here willing to eat food prepared by rats, but Qiqirn are another story. At least with them, you can be reasonably certain that the rice wasn't pounded with tiny plague-ridden feet. And there's one right over there─Neneroon, I think his name was.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_IMANIA_100_040: It's common sense, I tell you!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_050: You have a tale of Heavensturn to tell?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_051: Easterner say rats bring fortunate fortunes? Cultural difference different indeed.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_052: Lominsans think rats are dirty because rats eat anything. Even though eating is normal reaction to edible things!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_100_053: We also eat edible things, so often offended by offensive comparison to rats. Neneroon think Qiqirn in land where rats thought to bring fortune very fortunate.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_100_054: Oh, oh! Striking idea strike me!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_055: Neneroon help you help rat man make rats popular with Lominsan populace. Then Qiqirn gain favor by favorable comparison!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_056: Good, good! Then Neneroon follow you as follower, to help you as helper.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_KLINDRAEL_000_065: This fixation on rodents of yours is very odd─you do understand that, right?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: You have returned─and I see you have a majestic rodent in your company! This must be a sign that my fortunes are improving as we speak.
Ah, so in Eorzean culture, rats are considered unclean? That does explain the reactions...
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_100_072: Yes, rats and ratlike Qiqirn both. Too many hasten to hasty judgments.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_073: Neneroon think it better to better reputation of rats and Qiqirn at same time. Propose we work together!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: A marvelous idea─as I would expect from one of such furry features and elongated snout. With our wiles combined, we ought to be able to overcome the people's preconceptions, culturally ingrained or no!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_100_075: And bring fortunate fortunes to all!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: What, another one? Has something gone wrong with the mochi, now?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Unfortunately so. As you know, I have been hard at work preparing the mochi, pounding rice into an amorphous mass. And all was going to plan─or so it seemed, until the mochi began to jiggle on its own! I'm afraid that it's...it's alive.
Yes, I quite understand your surprise, but we have no time for it.

I know not whether this issue arose because I used the miraculous yet unpredictable waters of Daitenzan's soulspring in the preparation─it seemed a good idea at the time─or if it is simply down to the peculiar aether in this foreign land, but in any case, we must act!
I propose that we take up arms, and cut the mochi into advent cakes before its newfound sentience drives it to get any...ideas.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_RICECAKEREEVE_100_1: What say you, my friend? You have proven yourself to be unflappable in the face of danger, even that of a...peculiar nature.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: What say you, ? I grant that it is something of a peculiar situation we find ourselves in, but it is dire nonetheless!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_083: Neneroon will cut cuttings from mochi too! Rat man's event too important to have cut short!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: (-Mochi Daikan-)I am gladdened to hear it, good people of Eorzea. Please join us at the Zephyr Drift at your earliest convenience─I myself shall head there posthaste, lest the mochi wander off.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: (-Nezumi Bugyo-)This event has been troublesome indeed─but we shall persevere. We cannot let the year of the rat arrive without proper welcome!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_100_055: You introduce Neneroon to rat man, yes?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: What better way to demonstrate the astuteness and dexterity of the rat than to ruthlessly cleave living mochi into bite-sized pieces? ...Actually, I can think of several, but we must seize what opportunities the fates provide.
The size, the shape...this is truly magnificent work! You are a rat among men to be sure.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_111: Now Lominsans can taste tasty taste of mochi, and see rats bring fortunate fortunes after all!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: No doubt they would... The issue remains, however, how to entice them to taste it to begin with.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_113: Oho, a Far Eastern bugyo! Here for Heavensturn, are ye?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: Just so, good sir─I am the nezumi bugyo, come bearing the traditional Heavensturn advent cakes. How might I help you?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_115: Ah, allow me to introduce meself─Lyngsath, 'ead o' the Culinarians' Guild an' proprietor o' the Bismarck besides.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_116: I've got a solid sense o' smell─comes with the territory─an' I caught a whiff o' the most enticin' aroma emanatin' from hereabouts. I reckon it's comin' from them advent cakes ye mentioned.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_117: Try one, try one! These advent cakes freshly cut by Qiqirn and rats─and adventurer, neither Qiqirn or rat.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_118: So yer one o' the chefs what made these? Remarkable! Didn't know there were Qiqirn culinarians.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_119: Oh, Neneroon no chef! Only helper, helping with cuts.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_120: Give yerself some credit─takes a lot to prepare a dish, and if ye put in the work to make these, yer qualified to call yerself assistant culinarian at the least.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_121: Just as good as it smells! Fascinatin' texture, really. Chewy, but not in a bad way.
