TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_122: The flavor is subtle, an' just a bit sweet─I can tell ye used right fine rice. Pure water, too. There's somethin' else though, such as gives it this perfect consistency... A special technique or summat?
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: As you say, we use the finest ingredients from our homeland. The techniques involved are traditional as well─however, I daresay that they are not the special something which you detect.
For that, good sir, is passion!

The devotion of myriad rats, who made the arduous journey from the Far East to bring fortune to your fair land! The fervent hopes of Neneroon, who labors for the sake of his people! This random adventurer's zeal for violence! All have combined to create these superlative advent cakes.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_126: Hahaha! Passion, is it? I know somethin' o' that meself.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_127: Seems we've all got a lot in common, despite comin' from different places. Hmm...
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_LYNGSATH_000_128: It just so 'appens I've got an interview with the 'Arbor 'Erald later on. If it's all right, I'd like to mention yer advent cakes─let people know they can get 'em durin' Heavensturn. Could be a good opportunity for cultural exchange, an' all that.
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_NENEROON_000_129: The Harbor Herald!? So many readers would read of our mochi!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_MOUSEMISSIONARY_000: And the public will have little excuse to eschew our advent cakes once a renowned culinarian has vouched for them!
On behalf of rats everywhere, I thank you for your assistance, sir.
And you as well, adventurer. Your service shall not be forgotten─I will personally ensure that rats watch over you wherever you may go!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_A2_100_001: You're very welcome! Bring on the rats!
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_A2_100_002: Please don't trouble yourself! I hardly did anything, really...
TEXT_FESNYR601_03176_RICECAKEREEVE_000_1: Very well! Now, if you will excuse us, we must go forth and prepare to bring our advent cakes to the masses, who shall soon doubtless be clamoring for a fair plague's worth of rats to descend on their city!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Come one, come all! For Hatching-tide is upon us once more!
Oh, ! To see you again is like a dream come true!
Don't tell me... You are an adventurer, yes? Well, you certainly have the inquisitive nature of one, at any rate! May I ask your name?
Well then, , I should probably mention that Hatching-tide all began with a vision I had before the Seventh Umbral Calamity, in which the Twelve Archons delivered unto me a message.

From atop their giant, decorated eggs they called to me: “Arise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessels for our return.” When I awoke, I quickly set about filling the realm with all manner of painted ovoids. And thus did this joyous yearly celebration come to be!
And speaking of dreams, another strange vision came to me in the night. I dreamt that Riggy the spriggan was hiding a beautifully gilded Hatching-tide egg.

Though what I saw was not unexpected─Riggy is one of our most enthusiastic helpers, after all─I am sure that this premonition holds deeper meaning. Yes, as in years past, it is doubtless the key to a successful Hatching-tide.
I've already asked Nonotta to help Riggy secret away an egg. Would you care to accompany me as I inquire as to the progress they have made?
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_050: Ah, Jihli! If you're here to lend a hand, you're too late─Riggy and I have already finished. You're just in time to take part in our egg hunt, though!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_RIGGY_000_052: Eggy friend back again! Riggy happy!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_053: And will you be joining too?
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_055: Let me tell you, it's not as simple as looking for hidden eggs. Rather than scrabbling about on your hands and knees, you have to use your head!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_056: First, you'll need one of these!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: Is this a map? And what are all those letters for?
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_058: To help uncover the location of the egg, of course! Riggy and I have hidden it somewhere, and you'll need to solve our little conundrum to find it.
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: Hmm... This does indeed bear some resemblance to my dream, but I never expected Nonotta to turn a simple egg hunt into such a complex puzzle.
While riddles and such are not exactly my forte, if we put our heads together, I am sure we can unravel this mystery!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_JIHLIALIAPOH_200_06: If only I had the foggiest idea what to do with this map...
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_062: Oh! I almost forgot the most important part. Three spriggans have been dispatched to various places nearby, and each one will give you a different clue.
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_000_064: And finally, I've prepared a special egg hunter's costume for you, Jihli! You should wear it to help you get into the spirit of Hatching-tide!
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_06: Oh my, it does convey a...unique sort of zeal for egg hunting, at the very least.
TEXT_FESEST501_03202_NONOTTA_300_065: Don't worry, . There's one for you, too!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_001: Should you choose to undertake this quest, know that guidance from the journal, duty list, and map will be limited. You will need to read the text carefully and decipher the clues to determine your course of action.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_100_001: With that Archon egg out there waiting for you, there's no time like the present to break in your new spriggan jacket. I'm sure you'll agree that the tailoring is eggceptional!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_007: With your brand-new spriggan jacket equipped and your mind primed for the trials ahead, speak with Nonotta again.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_008: If you do not have a spriggan jacket in your possession, you can purchase one from the Dreamer at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_300_001: With that Archon egg out there waiting for you, there's no time like the present to break in your new spriggan jacket. I'm sure you'll agree that the tailoring is eggceptional!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_400_001: With your brand-new spriggan jacket equipped and your mind primed for the trials ahead, speak with Nonotta again.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_500_001: If you do not have a spriggan jacket in your possession, you can purchase one from the Dreamer at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_RIGGY_200_002: Friend ready for eggy! Ready, ready, readyyy!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_002: If you manage to find the gilded tourmaline egg, bring it to me for inspection. I'll know if you try to fob me off with a fake one!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: There will be no need for that─we shall find that egg in no time!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_005: Don't forget, you'll need to speak with all three spriggans to stand a chance of reaching the prize.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: , I shall leave locating the spriggans to you. In the meantime, I will attempt to make some sense of this map. Let us meet back here once we have a lead in our search for the egg.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_100_006: I have a map for you, too. Without giving too much away, I should point out that this holds the key to the whole mystery.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Since I am normally the one organizing these kinds of events, being able to participate makes a welcome change!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_020: Use the crumpled cartograph and hints provided to discover the location of the gilded tourmaline egg.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: Have you found the spriggans yet?
We should reconvene once we have enough information to form a hypothesis as to the egg's location.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_060: I recommend finding the spriggans first and making a note of where you found them. You never know─it could be important!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: You have found all three spriggans? Jolly good! What did they say?
First, second, third? They must be referring to some kind of order.
But how is it linked to the writing on the map?
Nonotta, are there any further clues for us to find?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_104: No, that's all you get, I'm afraid!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: By the Twelve! I cannot make head nor tail of this!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_RIGGY_000_106: Oh! Oh! Riggy know! Can Riggy say?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_200_107: Oh, pipe down, would you? , Jihli, once you have the answer, go to where you suspect the egg lies and call out “Egg Hunt” in a nice, big voice!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_107: Use the information gleaned from the three spriggans and the clues on the map to determine the gilded tourmaline egg's whereabouts.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_100_107: With the chat mode in Say, enter “Egg Hunt” while standing in the correct location to discover the item. With it in your possession, speak with Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_108: Should you require further hints, speak with Jihli Aliapoh.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_110: Between the two of you, I'm sure you can figure it out!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_MIOUNNE_000_150: Are you here for one of Mother's famous eel pies?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_MIOUNNE_000_151: Well, well. It seems Nonotta and Riggy have met their match.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_MIOUNNE_000_153: An egg, is it? I must say, it does feel somewhat artificial, but I suppose it's the right shape. In any case, it's now the property of the one who came here and uttered the password.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_15: Mother Miounne certainly has a point about it being strange. And is it my imagination, or did I hear a slight rustling sound from inside?
What I'm most interested in, though, is seeing Nonotta and Riggy's faces when they realize we have solved the mystery!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_16: I feel as though we are slowly getting closer to the answer...
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_Q1_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_17: While these letters are clearly not Eorzean, they are somewhat similar. It is not too hard to decipher them, but simply reading them from left to right reveals nothing but gibberish.
Obviously, their positioning in relation to the map below is vital in understanding the puzzle.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_Q2_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share more of her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_19: Hmm... The three spriggans must be linked to these letters in some fashion.
Can you remember where you found them?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_Q3_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share yet more of her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: Each of the spriggans mentioned something about first, second, or third, yes?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_21: Hmm... My guess is that this is probably as important, if not more so, than their locations. With that in mind, let's take another look at the map!
Our three furry friends were sent to these positions, and this is how their numbers are distributed.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_22: Yes, things seem much clearer now.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_Q4_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share even more of her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_23: Initially I thought the positions of the spriggans would indicate which letters reveal the answer...
...but none of them are in the same places. As you can see, they are all slightly off. So much for that idea!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_24: I wonder if the spriggans are trying to indicate a course of some sort?
If I move my finger from one point to the next... Hmm? 'Tis a name I know very well indeed. Now we need only find her...
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_246: So, you think you've found the answer? You'll still need to use the password, though. It's “Egg Hunt” in case you forgot!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_SYSTEM_000_247: With the chat mode in Say, enter “Egg Hunt” while standing in the correct location to discover the gilded tourmaline egg. With it in your possession, speak with Nonotta.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_100_250: So, have you got something for me?
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_250: Ho ho! Congratulations to you both for getting this far.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_NONOTTA_000_252: Yes, finding the gilded tourmaline egg was only the beginning! For inside it is...another map! This time, the prize you seek is a gilded topaz egg.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_25: Oh dear... I thought I had already surpassed the limits of my mental faculties. If these puzzles get any more difficult, I fear my head shall explode!
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_MIOUNNE_000_260: I shan't pretend that I understand what you're all doing. Something to do with Hatching-tide, I presume? As long as you're enjoying yourselves, that's the most important thing.
TEXT_FESEST502_03203_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_27: I knew we would find the egg!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_SYSTEM_000_001: Should you choose to undertake this quest, know that guidance from the journal, duty list, and map will be limited. You will need to read the text carefully and decipher the clues to determine your course of action.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: All right, Nonotta. We shall have a look at this new map of yours.
I can barely see anything with all these letters in the way!
Hmm...I suppose this must be Old Gridania.
Is there any chance we could have some more hints this time?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_006: Haha! Not on your life, Jihli. In fact, you can have some extra spriggans instead!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_007: There are five in total, each with a different clue. And if you think it will be more or less the same as last time, you'd better think again!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Our last attempt to decipher their code went rather well, so perhaps we should stick to winning ways. If I look for hidden words on the map and you seek out those spriggans, the egg will be ours in a jiffy!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_011: Here's your map, . I would wish you luck, but you'll need more than that to claim the prize!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_020: Don't come to me looking for clues! I'm the last person who'll help you. Mwahahaha!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_SYSTEM_000_030: Use the crinkled cartograph and hints provided to discover the location of the gilded topaz egg.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: There do not appear to be any significant differences between this map and the last, other than the location depicted and greatly increased number of letters. I think it is safe to say that the nature of the puzzle itself has not changed a great deal.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: Found them already! My word, that was quick! Did they provide any useful clues?
So they made a poor attempt at obfuscating their numbers this time? It seems their half-baked riddles were no match for your sleuthing skills.
Speaking of which, it seems we must face the true test... Now, let us piece together those clues and find the egg!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_103: You'll be needing the password too. This time it's “Eggceedingly Eggcellent and Eggsquisite Eggies!” ...Just kidding! It's “Egg Hunt” again.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_SYSTEM_000_105: Use the information gleaned from the five spriggans and the clues on the map to determine the gilded topaz egg's whereabouts.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_SYSTEM_100_105: With the chat mode in Say, enter “Egg Hunt” while standing in the correct location to discover the item.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_SYSTEM_000_106: Should you require further hints, speak with Jihli Aliapoh.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_100_150: Thrice-cursed funguars! There's no end to them and their blasted, blighted spore─ Oh, pardon me, . Can I help you?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_150: Egg hunt? What do you mean?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_151: Ha! I've been waiting so long for you to show up, I'd almost forgotten about the password! So, I suppose you'll be wanting that funny-looking egg thing that's been rolling about and getting underfoot.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_152: Pauline, Aldred, how about instead of standing there with your mouths open like a pair of hungry chicks, you go and check on that sickly beech tree?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_15: I am glad I finally caught up with you, ! It seems your hunch was correct.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_154: When your little friend in the silly hat and that lively spriggan came by and asked me to hold on to this egg, I didn't see any reason to refuse. But to be honest, I'll be glad to see the back of this thing, whichever side that is.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_155: Well done! Now you finally have your hands on the prize!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_156: Friend find prize eggy! Riggy proud! Proooud!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_15: I must say, you two are jolly clever for thinking up such a wonderful─not to mention difficult─game!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_158: Riggy love egg hunt! Everyone play together!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_159: But egg hunt over now. Riggy sad...
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_16: You just wanted to be helpful, didn't you? And you have been! There must be some other way of assisting us, but what?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_162: Well, if the lad's up to the task, I've a few odd jobs he can do around here.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_163: I daresay an enterprising young spriggan like him knows a few things about rocks, soil, and whatnot that we woodsmen could put to good use.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_164: That sounds perfect! He's ever such a hard worker, you know.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_16: What do you think of that idea, Riggy?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_167: You'll get a fair day's wage for a fair day's work, the same as the rest of us.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_168: Riggy do best! Do best work!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_16: I never expected that Riggy would go from hiding eggs to finding employment as a lumberjack's apprentice! While that was certainly not part of my dream, I think we can all agree it has led to a rather satisfying conclusion.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_170: Which reminds me, we should return to the amphitheatre and bring an official close to this year's egg hunt!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_175: Riggy come back soon, gabby friend!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_180: It's Gabineaux. Master Gabineaux, in fact, but that's only once you start working here. Anyway, enjoy the rest of your festival!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_17: And I thought these puzzles could not possibly get any trickier...
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_Q1_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: I wonder why there are so many more letters this time?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_19: Could it be that there is an extra step or two involved?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_Q2_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share more of her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: If we start by using a similar technique to the previous puzzle, what do we get?
It might even be more than just one word.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_21: I wonder if this will lead to the answer or simply another clue?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_Q3_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share yet more of her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_22: This is clearly a lot more complex than the last conundrum.
Perhaps it would be easier if I marked the locations of the spriggans on the map?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_23: Though obviously we still have to find the hidden word, or words, as the case may be.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_Q4_000_000: Would you like Jihli to share even more of her thoughts?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_24: It seems the sensible thing to do is combine all the information we have at hand.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_25: Goodness! It all looks rather messy, doesn't it?
Wait a moment... O, N, E, T, H, R, E, E, F, I, V, E?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_26: What a strange name! Hmm... Unless I am mistaken, that is not a name at all!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_Q5_000_000: Would you like Jihli to all but solve the puzzle for you?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_27: Yes, this must be “one, three, five.”
Hmm... Could that be it? Why, I believe I know someone in the Central Shroud by that name!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_280: You're not thinking about giving up, are you?
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_300: Now that we're all back at the center of the Hatching-tide festivities, the time has come to officially present the gilded topaz egg!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_301: It is with great pleasure that I award you...the rest of your spriggan costume!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_30: You mean to say there are other garments to match this glorious jacket? I cannot wait to try them on!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_303: Oh, Jihli! You were born to wear this sumptuous ensemble!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_304: Long blue legs! Pretty like spriggan! Blue like...not spriggan! Riggy confused!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_30: Oh, Riggy! You have a lot to learn about fashion, it seems!
On the other hand, you could teach me a thing or two about creating games for Hatching-tide. The same goes for you, Nonotta!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_NONOTTA_000_307: I'm glad all those evenings spent scratching our heads were not in vain.
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_30: And best of all, Riggy has found himself a job!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_31: Of course, I would never have solved that conundrum all by myself. Thank you ever so much, !
It looks like I will have to try harder than ever to stand a chance of matching the spectacular efforts of these two geniuses! I hope you will join us for next year's Hatching-tide!

Now that Nonotta and Riggy have proved that the puzzle can indeed be solved─provided one possesses a certain degree of intelligence─we can allow the festival-goers to participate. I do hope our spriggan helpers do not mind remaining stationary for the time being...
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_RIGGY_000_320: Riggy make game! Riggy chop wood! Riggy helping!
TEXT_FESEST503_03204_GABINEAUX_000_330: I shall need to make a space for the boy to sleep. Do you happen to know what spriggans use for bedding? A carefully arranged pile of rocks or some such, I expect!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_000: Do you not feel it in the air, adventurer? 'Tis Valentione's Day, and love, uh...runs rampant through the streets!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_001: We of House Valentione have returned to spread our message of Ardor and Affection, and honor the pure pursuits of our ancestor, Countess Arabelle.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_002: The true heart of the festivities, of course, is the Valentione's Ceremony!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_005: I shudder to think what might have befallen this wondrous tradition had you not offered me a helping hand the last time. Thanks to you, however, the people of Gridania were enraptured by the results!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_006: I shudder to think what might have befallen this wondrous tradition had your fellow adventurers not offered me a helping hand the last time. Thanks to them, however, the people of Gridania were enraptured by the results!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_010: Yet one must always strive to dream bigger, wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_011: I aspire to bring joy to more folk than ever before, and for that I shall need the aid of a stalwart assistant. A champion of love, if you will!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_012: Pray say you'll help me─I've learned only too well how foolish it is to flail about by oneself...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_013: Oh, praise your generous soul! I am sure that with your discerning adventurer's eye, you will soon spy those most in need of a friendly shove towards love!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_014: To that end, I would have you hand deliver these ceremony invitations to those who seem especially bereft of the ties of affection.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_SYSTEM_000_015: Astrid hands you a sheaf of invitations penned in a shaky hand and illustrated with crude pictures of what might generously be termed “moogles.”
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_SYSTEM_000_016: (-Ceremony Invitation-)Be it familial or romantic, betwixt lifelong friends or serendipitous strangers, all love is to be celebrated! Join us in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and partake in the festivities!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_017: As you can see, I'm hoping to draw in a more varied crowd this year.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_018: The Valentione's Ceremony shouldn't be only for those who have exchanged the vows of matrimony...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_019: It...it should be for everyone! Yes! (Light and airy, Astrid, light and airy.)
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_020: Go forth, my champion of love! Scour the corners of Gridania for those who seem bereft of affection and attention!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_025: Sweep through the streets of Gridania, and deliver those invitations to the emotionally downtrodden!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_026: <sigh> ...I know not how much longer I can keep up this cheery facade. But I must not disappoint Sister! (Smile and wave, Astrid, smile and wave.)
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_YOUNGGRIDANIAN03205: What can I do for you, ? It's been a dreary , to be honest, and I'd welcome a spot of excitement.
...Oh, the Valentione's Day celebrations. I've no one to take, so it's not really for someone like m─
Hm? What's this about serendipitous strangers? P-Perhaps I'll just drop by for a moment or two, then...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_OLDGRIDANIAN03205_0: Now, what could a  like you want with an old grumbler like me?
Well, that's a charming little invitation, isn't it? Seems they've made Valentione's Day more of a family affair.
...I wonder if my grandchild might enjoy the celebrations. It's my first time being a grandparent, you see, and I never know what to do with the wee scamp. Could be worth a look!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_040: Yes? Can we help you with something?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_041: Ah, the Valentione's Day celebrations. Isn't that an event for couples, though?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_042: But, look! The invitation says anyone is welcome this year. We could go together! You know, before you leave me behind and move to Ul'dah...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_100_042: Lisie, please, do we have to discuss this in front of strangers?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_043: I'm sorry, I'm leaving to begin an apprenticeship in weaving, and someone is having trouble being happy for me...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_044: Still, I've always wanted to try my hand at that beautiful ceremony, and it would make for a nice send-off. Shall we go?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_050: There  is! Our champion of love! Your honest words and gentle demeanor have encouraged all manner of townspeople to attend our event.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_051: There was one lonely gentleman who seemed terribly unsure until I introduced him to another forlorn participant. 'Twas a Valentione miracle how swiftly their shyness melted away!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_052: I also spied an old man and his granddaughter, who barely spoke two words to each other when they arrived. But by the end of the ceremony, they were giggling together like a couple of mischievous moogles!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_053: And even as we speak, a pair of lovely lasses are enjoying our affinity trials. They should be back any moment now!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_054: (-???-)Ugh, that was horrible! How could we be so out of tune with each other!? I wish we'd never come!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_055: Well, what did you expect, Taggy? You just kept forging ahead without even looking to see where I was...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_056: Well, you were plodding along like an overfed adamantoise! We were never going to reach the goal at that pace!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_057: And simply rushing through was the better strategy? If you had slowed down a touch, we might have had a better chance of winning the trial! Ugh, never mind...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_058: That isn't how it was supposed to go! And they were so excited to try the ceremony together... What could have happened to put them at such odds in there?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_059: They said something about “marking the occasion.” Do you have any idea as to what this occasion might be?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_060: I see. They wanted to do something special before Taggy left for Ul'dah...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_061: 'Tis unthinkable that these close friends would fail the ceremony so completely. 'Tis all a simple misunderstanding, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_062: Nay, I cannot bear to think of them parting ways like this...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_063: And what is more, I have a duty as an emissary of House Valentione. Adventurer, you and I will see the rift between these ladies mended! Understood!?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_A1_000_002: It's not our place to intervene.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_065: Mayhap this falls into the realm of meddling, but if we have a chance to save them from sadness, should we not at least try!?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_066: There is no time for flowery phrasing! We have to avert this Valentione's Day disaster before it is too late!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_067: Oh, thank you! I knew your kind heart would not let you ignore such a travesty!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_068: I will speak to Taggy, whilst you catch up to Lisie. The last I saw, she was running off towards the Whistling Miller!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_070: Lisie was running in the direction of the Whistling Miller. If you hurry, you should be able to catch her before it is too late!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_071: I'm sorry, but I'm not in the mood for talking. Just...leave me be.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_080: Oh, I know you─you're that adventurer who was handing out ceremony invitations.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_A2_000_002: This time I come not to invite, but to plead on love's behalf...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_081: Ah... You overheard our argument, didn't you? How awfully embarrassing.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_082: Taggy and I have been friends since we were children, and this is the first time we are to live so far apart. I just...I wanted these last moments to be special.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_083: But in my efforts to create the perfect memory, I may have been too cautious. And that is when the problems began...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_084: <sigh> I feel a burden has lifted from my shoulders. Thank you for listening, adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_085: I feel I should apologize to that tiny Valentione girl for our wretched behavior. I assume she is still in the amphitheatre?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_086: That Valentione girl is a passionate little thing, isn't she? I was subjected to a tearful request to make peace with Lisie...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_087: Thank you again for listening. I've yet to make my apologies to young Astrid here...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_090: My thanks, adventurer. You have brought back Lisie, and given these two friends the chance to undo the hurt which was done!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_091: Attempt the ceremony once more, and let angry words be forgotten!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_092: I only returned to offer an apology for souring the day with our quarrel. Testing our affinity again will likely give us the same result, or worse...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_093: And I only came back because your plaintive tears would be satisfied with nothing less. I did not agree to another run through that trial.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_094: But, perhaps... Perhaps if we could see how others completed the ceremony, we might stand a better chance.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_095: Then I should be happy to serve as an example! Allow me to fetch my sibling, Lisette, and we shall display the pinnacle of sisterly affection!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_096: Uh, whilst we appreciate the offer, I wonder if a performance by the very people who run the ceremony might be a little too perfect for us to emulate...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_097: Oh... I hadn't thought of that...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_098: What if we have the adventurer here show us how it's done? You already know our situation, so would you mind helping us out a little more?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_099: I doubt it matters who you take─I imagine someone of your kind nature could produce a good result with almost anyone.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_100: What a fabulous idea! I'm certain if you see how effortlessly  navigates the twists and turns of affinity, then you'll soon find yourself yearning to take another turn!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_101: Your quest awaits, my champion of love! Find a partner with whom you wish to attempt the test, and return with a Valentione's Day chocolate as proof of your deed!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_102: Thank you for doing this for us. We only want to see how other participants handle the course, so please enjoy the ceremony in whatever way you normally would.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_SYSTEM_000_110: You now have access to the Valentione's Ceremony seasonal instance! To enter the venue, speak with the House Valentione servant at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_SYSTEM_000_111: The Valentione's Ceremony is an instance designed for a party of two. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_SYSTEM_000_112: In the event that you register for the ceremony alone, your partner will be found via the matching system.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_115: We shall all be watching you with heart-shaped eyes, and waiting for you to return with your victorious piece of Valentione's Day chocolate!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_116: Show us how it's done, adventurer. Have you chosen a partner yet?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_117: The affinity test can be so intimidating. I wonder how they will rate you...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_120: Welcome back! We were all holding our breath in anticipation of your success! You've brought the chocolate, yes...?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_121: Thank you, adventurer─such an inspiring performance!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_122: As I am sure you saw, successful completion of the Valentione's Ceremony hinges upon showing your partner a certain degree of patience and consideration.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_123: But I refuse to believe such fine friends as you are incapable of such a feat. Nay, 'twas simply that you approached the challenge with two slightly different mindsets.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_124: Thus, I implore you...beseech you...beg you...to give your love one more chance...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_125: I think you've the right of it, Astrid, thank you.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_126: It was my fault, Taggy. I was more concerned with the result than simply enjoying the event itself. I wanted so badly to make our last memory together a good one...
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_127: Our last memory...? Ah, that's why you were being so anxious about our every move.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_128: It was my fault, too, then─I didn't realize how much this meant to you.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_TAGGY_000_129: But I never thought this would be our final farewell. After all, I can always hop on an airship and come back to visit.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_130: Oh...I suppose that's true. What a silly goose I've been.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_131: Will you take another turn with me, then? Just for fun this time?
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_133: Our thanks, Astrid. If you'd not been so unwilling to give up on our friendship, we may have parted ways for good.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_LISIE_000_134: Our thanks to you as well, adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_135: Whilst we're speaking of gratitude, I cannot express how much House Valentione owes you for making our event such a grand success!
TEXT_FESVLT501_03205_ASTRID_000_137: Ahem. Your deeds have warmed our hearts, my champion of love! May ardor and affection follow you this day, and all the days to follow!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_000: My dear adventurer! I saw what you did for my sister Astrid, and we of House Valentione are most thankful for your intervention!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_001: I was somewhat concerned about her lack of experience, but I see she is warming to her role quite nicely. I think you'll agree the ceremony is safe in her adorable little hands.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_002: As such, mayhap you can now spend a moment or two in service of your own entertainment. I, myself, am in charge of an event that many find endlessly enthralling...
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_003: The telling of fortunes! We have three seers of exceptional senses stationed right outside the amphitheatre, ready to unveil the myriad threads of your destiny.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_004: Does that not sound exciting!? Do you not yearn to hear the whispers of what the morrow might bring!?
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_005: You and your chosen partner need but present yourselves before these practiced prophets, and in mere moments you shall know your affinity with one another, be it in adventure, wealth, or romance.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_HORTEFENSE_000_006: Pray forgive my interruption, my lady, but should we not apprise this  of the rumored deceiver?
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_007: My stars! The thought had completely slipped my mind. Heed me well, adventurer, and ware you the false speaker of fortune who peddles her baseless predictions alongside our sayers of sooth!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_HORTEFENSE_000_08: This charlatan works without the accreditation of the academy. Thus if you encounter one who foresees suspicious futures, then I implore you to ignore her words.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_009: That said, I shall let our fortune-tellers know that you will be calling. A mere formality, to be sure─they have already foreseen your coming. And for another formality, pray report to me afterwards, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_015: Desire another glimpse at your future, do you? With a different partner, mayhap? Tee hee!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_016: Very well, I shall let our fortune-tellers know that you will be calling.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_SYSTEM_000_020: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_030: Remember to take your partner with you when going before the fortune-tellers, and pray report to me afterwards, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_SYSTEM_000_031: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_HORTEFENSE_000_032: Be certain you speak with one of our fortune-tellers, my , and ware the charlatan preying upon the sore of heart.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_TREASURELUCKTELLER0: Ah, another couple wants to know if riches lie in their future. A wise choice, for rare indeed is the bond that can bear the weight of an empty coinpurse.
See here, I only specialize in telling the fortunes of couples. Bring one other, be it your lover or your friend, and I shall gladly tell you what treasure awaits in your future.
Well, let us see here... My  is registered to the Adventurers' Guild in ?
And your partner...born in this moon? Yes... Is the path you are destined to walk paved with gold, or will you end up on the street begging for coin? The cards shall reveal all!

The winds of fortune favor you two! They blow at your back, guiding you to the waters of La Noscea. With fishing poles in hand, go forth secure in the knowledge that your hooks shall not remain empty for long!

And if you are not yet avid anglers, now is the time to acquaint yourselves with a new hobby! But don't just go out in any old rags. Fortune often favors the fashionable. ...aye, you are guaranteed a healthy catch with garbs dyed just so.

Fortune smiles down upon you! Take advantage of this rare blessing, and venture deep into the woods. Bring your sharpest axes, and fate shall guide you to stout trunks fit for the realm's most luxurious wares.

A lucrative logging career shall provide a sturdy foundation for your future endeavors. But don't forget the importance of appearances; a fledgling lumberjack must stand out against  drab peers. Yes...  garb shall benefit you both within the forests and without.
A fortuitous reading indeed! Fate beckons you to , pickaxes in hand. There lie rocky outcroppings full to bursting with the earth's bounty.

Go there, and you shall be rewarded with riches most precious! But you must not go as you are and hope to succeed, oh no. Venture forth garbed in , and the earth shall give over its gifts even more readily.
The cards say chance is your most dependable ally! It would behoove you not to ignore this rare blessing. Board an airship bound for the Gold Saucer at once!

The denizens of the Saucer shall flock to you, drawn by the riches you gain from games of luck. But, alas, not if you go wearing that. No, fortune shall favor only those dressed in a glamorous getup of .

The winds of fortune blow languidly, but at least they do not blow against you. In the waters of Thanalan, fish swim to and fro, hungry for their next meal. It is there you should go if you wish for a chance at a profitable endeavor.

Fill your stomachs with fish caught by your own hands, and contentment at a job well done shall be your reward. Your luck may not be the best, but if you cast your lures wearing , then your fortunes may improve.

Hmmm... It seems the path to riches may be rather more taxing than you might have hoped. In the dense forests of La Noscea, stout trees await those with the patience to saw through their broad trunks.

Now may be the time to replace your dull wooden furnishings and tools with brand new ones, and take pleasure in the satisfaction hard work brings. What small luck you have in your endeavors may be augmented by an outfit of .

Hmmm... It seems wealth shall only come to you after grueling work. Go deep within the Black Shroud, to where rocks burst with valuable minerals, waiting for a pair of pickaxes to pry them from the earth.
Bedeck yourself in precious metals and gemstones plucked from the soil with your own hands. And what's this? The earth may be more generous with its gifts if you mined wearing an outfit colored .

Hmmm... You may not be swimming in gold, but neither shall you want for wealth. It may be in your best interests to take a direct approach to riches. With a treasure map to guide you, hunt for wealth long forgotten.

Although after many long and fruitless hours your hope may wane, if you persevere, fortune will see fit to reward you. And what's more, your luck will be much improved if you set out wearing attire colored .

Oh my. This is not good, not good at all. To be blunt, your luck has run out. Bring your fishing poles to the Black Shroud and wait out this spell of bad luck. Whether you catch fish or not is irrelevant; it is most crucial that you avoid any risky endeavors.

But beware as well the fish that bite at your lure. Not all taste the same, and an unappetizing catch may make an already bad day worse. Still, there are some measures you can take to mitigate your misfortune. An outfit of  may serve to keep the worst of it at bay.

Oh dear. It seems fortune has forsaken you. It might be best to indulge in a hobby and wait for this unlucky period to end. Logging, perhaps? Yes... Thanalan would be the perfect place. Lose yourself in the gentle whispers of the desert breeze, until fortune sees fit to smile upon you once more.

However, I would give a wide berth to anything wrought from wood in the meantime, lest a broken chair result in flushed cheeks and a sore arse. Luckily, you need not live in abject fear of misfortune. Keep yourselves dutifully wrapped in clothes of , and you may be spared fate's worst barbs.

Ah... I would not count on fortune to be your ally for the time being. In fact, it may be best to take refuge in the routine, until this run of bad luck comes to an end. The mining in La Noscea is said to be grand this time of year. Yes, busy hands will keep you from inviting hazard.

But take special care of any precious stones you may own. In a moment, a gem may slip loose from its setting, never to be seen again. However, it may be possible for you to mitigate fate's cruelty. Clothe yourselves in finery of , and perhaps the most unhappy circumstances will pass you by.

Oh no... It seems lean times are ahead of you. Even a treasure map, no matter how detailed, would bring you little more than dirt and a sore back. It's best to give up on any dreams of easy riches for now. You have to be realistic about these things, you know.

Guildleves, however, are just the thing for those who do not─or cannot─rely on luck. Honest pay for honest work. I suggest keeping your pockets filled with those until this unfortunate spell passes. And just to be safe, make sure you conduct the guildleves in attire colored , or else even those might end in failure.

Ah... Misfortune shall follow at your heels for some time. At all costs, stay away from the gaudy lights of the Gold Saucer! If you step foot into that playground of chance, then all of your hard-earned coin will vanish in a flash, leaving you with scant enough to take the airship back in shame.

No, no, that will not do. However, if the allure of the Gold Saucer is too much to bear, at least be content to gaze at it from a distance, your coinpurse far from its grasp. Perhaps if you were wrapped in clothes the color of , it might afford you some strength to resist your impulses.
Should you wish another fortune told, my colleagues are skilled at reading the signs from the spheres of high adventure and rapturous romance.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_ADVENTURELUCKTELLER: So a pair of adventurers wishes to know if they are destined for song and celebration? It is this very question that my cards will answer, if you so desire.
A lone adventurer lives a life bereft of companionship. What interest is there in knowing that? Return to me once you've found another.
Ah, such eagerness! Well then, let us begin! Hmmm...  , are you?
And your partner? Yes...your fate is materializing before me. Are you destined for greatness, or will your names be lost to history? Look, and we shall see!

Oh my, you are a pair destined for glory indeed! Remain steadfast at each other's side, and they will tell tales of your deeds at the tables of admirals, Seedseers, and sultanas alike! The blessings of Llymlaen shall guide you to riches and renown.
The Navigator bids you heed an envoy from beyond the seas to the East. Listen well, and soon shall you embark upon the first of many adventures to be remembered far and wide!
Ah, one of the Twelve looks favorably upon this pairing! Nald'thal beams down from the heavens. All misfortune you have suffered will be eclipsed by the magnitude of the glory that lies ahead of you.
Nald'thal's smile beckons you beneath the earth. Seek out a land of entangled aether, and your search shall lead you to adventures most grand!
Ah, one of the Twelve has taken a liking to this pairing! None other than the venerable Halone has granted you Her fury. Any obstacles obstructing your journeys shall crumble before Her might.
All the signs bid you venture unto the heavens themselves. The great winged beast which soars through the skies will carry you towards glory and honor!

Ah, you have won the favor of one of the Twelve! The wise Thaliak shall bring harmony to your endeavors together. Even your most difficult tribulations shall serve only to build an unshakable bond between you.
Avail yourself of Thaliak's blessing and journey to the mysterious lands of the Far East. There shall beasts of surprising sagacity offer the potential for unforgettable adventure.

One of the Twelve smiles down upon you two! You are fortunate enough to have won the goodwill of Nymeia Herself! Nary a beast can withstand the combined might of this partnership with Her blessing safeguarding you.
After you have weathered countless trials, your path shall lead you to a weapon of unsurpassed power. With it, you shall fight your way into the annals of Eorzean legend!

While not the most heartening outlook, there is no cause for despair. The solitary islands of the Sea of Clouds hold much promise for grand adventure. But beware, for if you drop your guard for even an instant, you may risk losing everything you have worked for.

It may be best to beseech the Twelve for protection. Go to the mark of the Navigator in Limsa Lominsa, and entreat Llymlaen for Her guidance. To ensure Her blessing's efficacy, carry a fish─alive or dead─with you at all times during your journey.

Hmmm...Azeyma's scales remain level, showing neither favor nor disdain. The omens point to a great adventure on a newly discovered island. Alas, you cannot hope to succeed in this endeavor without each other's full trust.

Before you depart, journey to the mark of the Dusk Trader in Ul'dah, and beseech Nald'thal to tip the scales ever so slightly to your advantage. During your trials, always carry a precious gem on your person, as a symbol of His blessing.

Byregot Himself works to build a solid foundation for your partnership. Opportunity for glory lies in the east, but the road to obtain it is harsh and ashen. Weather the wastes, however, and the suffering will pale in comparison to the ecstasy of triumph.
Before you set off, beseech Halone for aid at the mark of the Fury in the Coerthas central highlands. Make sure always to carry a spear in your hands during your journey, and Her blessing is assured.

You have the reassurance of Nophica that the storms of hardship you are facing will only serve to nourish your future renown. I sense within the ruins of Sharlayan lie the seeds of adventure most thrilling, but only through concerted effort shall they bear any fruit.

The gods can offer you further aid, if you but ask. Go to the mark of the Scholar in Mor Dhona, and beseech Thaliak to grant you the wisdom to choose the most favorable path. Keep a shellfish close at hand during your journeys, and the Twelve will not forsake you.
To see a pair so loyal to each other makes Menphina Herself smile. Set out on a journey to forge a weapon worthy of song, and as the moon waxes, so too shall your work come to fruition.

Surely a journey of creation is worthy of the Builder's blessing as well. Wielding a golden hammer to please the gods, visit the mark of the Builder deep within the Black Shroud and beseech Byregot to lend His steady hand to your work.
This result is...unfortunate. It seems Llymlaen has turned Her eyes from you. Embark to the seas and you shall be met with only languid winds and clouded skies.

It would not be wise to journey across the waters, but you may seek the blessing of another of the Twelve. Journey to La Noscea and pray before the mark of the Wanderer, so that at the very least you shall have Oschon's blessing on the land.
Azeyma's scales are weighted against you, and She judges you harshly. Nald'thal has forsaken you, and to venture underground would mean facing the myriad dangers of the earth.

Your only chance to reverse this misfortune is to go to Thanalan and entreat the Twelve for mercy before the mark of the Warden. Only then may Azeyma's scales shift in your favor. In the meantime, it is best to stay above ground, safe under the protection of the sun and sky.

Oh my... Through affronts known only to Him, you have earned Rhalgr's wrath. Halone is unwilling to protect you from Her father's ire. Beware a gathering in Ala Mhigo, for your adventures will surely meet with tragedy.

Your only recourse is to request the blessing of another. Journey to Coerthas and pray before the mark of the Lover, and perhaps Menphina's tenderness will assuage Rhalgr's anger. For the present, make safety and security a priority, and do not take reckless risks.

Ah, it seems you two have become pawns in one of Althyk's inscrutable plots. Thaliak is loath to entangle Himself in such a precarious situation, and any endeavors you have planned in Sharlayan will be steeped in danger.

The only hope to wrest free from Althyk's machinations is to rely on the aid of another. Go to La Noscea and make your devotions before the mark of the Spinner, so that Nymeia's blessing may improve your fate. For the time being, however, it would be best to ensure each other's safety, avoiding dangerous battles at all costs.
Halone has chosen to test you two, and Byregot dares not interfere with His sister's plans. If you had hoped to build, or craft, be prepared to toil for longer than is reasonable.

Only one path remains to you if you wish to improve your standing in the eyes of the Twelve. Go to the mark of the Destroyer in Thanalan, and beseech Rhalgr to put a stop to His children's games. Until that time, proceed with caution, and do not let your impatience get the best of you.
Have you listened at the feet of my fellow fortune-tellers? Once you have received a full set of divinations, I believe Lady Lisette would love to hear from you!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_COMPATIBILITYLUCKTE: Another couple comes wishing to know if love can bloom between them. Well, 'tis why I am here! But be forewarned: I am but a servant of fate, and my words may not be what you hope to hear. Knowing that, do you still wish for me to divine your affinity for ardor and affection?

I don't see a partner with you. Do you expect me to tell you if you love yourself? No, no, that is entirely too dull. Come again with another, and I shall tell you what blossoms between you, be it love or...something else.
You answer without hesitation! I sense great confidence in your partnership! Hmmm... Let's see here. You were born in the , and thus your fate is guided by .
And your partner's nameday is? Yes... The threads of fate are coming together. Behold, the cards reveal a couple's fate!
You two are a match made by the Twelve!  Alas, even the most passionate relationship can benefit from a bit of variety.

Everyone loves to see their partner looking their best from time to time. During their next nameday, why not show off your most fashionable  outfit? It just might be the spark that brings you two even closer together.
No two adventurers are more meant for each other than you!  Alas, even the most promising relationship must be treated with care.

The  is a traditional staple of  cuisine, correct? Surely a sample of such a splendid dish would show your partner how much they are appreciated. All that's required is the smallest amount of effort, and you two shall never stray from each other's sides!
The stars must have been aligned when they brought this pair together!  But remember, there is more to life than adventuring. A private moment together can do much to enrich your relationship.
You hail from , correct? It may serve you both well to share a relaxing stroll alone through . There you shall be able to lose yourselves in each other's gazes and whisper many sweet nothings.
You two are destined to be together!  But sometimes you must remind people of your devotion.
Use your particular set of skills as  to lift up your partner both within the battlefield and without. Take care not to be lax in your duties, for a match such as this comes only once an era.
The gods themselves are envious of your affinity for each other!  But without growth even the most spirited relationship can become stagnant.

Strive always to be the  your partner deserves, and through mutual effort you will both be enriched by this relationship. Do not forget the passion of your first meeting, and make sure each moment together is just as ardent as that one.
Ah... It seems there is still work to be done between you.  But do not despair, for relations can change for the better, and with but a little effort you may yet win the heart of your desired!
Remember that being attentive to your partner's needs is essential. Even if they do not say it, there is likely much they are struggling with. Pay attention, and your partner will notice.
Now, pray do not be alarmed, but the stars show no particular favor to you two.  But you need not despair, for this fate is not set in stone.

Even the most hardened adventurers like to look their best from time to time. To celebrate your partner's nameday, present to them a heartfelt gift─a necklace, ring, or earrings─that shows the depth of your gratitude for their companionship. Before long, the lukewarm nature of your companionship may grow into something worthy of celebration!
Ah... It seems there is something to be desired between you two.  But there is still hope! Even the most frigid heart can be warmed by a homemade meal.

The key to a fruitful relationship lies in the kitchen. Treat your partner to a sweet , and they won't soon forget your generosity. But remember, this gesture is but the first of many that will be required to make your relationship blossom.
The cards say the relationship between you is...somewhat tepid.  Mayhap you have forgotten that there is more to a friendship than just nodding silently in agreement to each other.
You hail from , correct? Sit down with your partner at , and over a bottle or two of your preferred libations, have a lively conversation and become more well acquainted with each other.

Oh my. Truth be told, I've not made a reading this unfavorable in some time.  Suffice it to say, I suggest you end this partnership at once! Ah, but you have a look about you that says you refuse to give up. Well, if you must be so stubborn...

Sit down with your partner and have a frank discussion about all that you've endured together. Mayhap then you shall find out what caused this rift between you. Be aware, however, that the road to reconciliation may be longer and more arduous than is worth it.
Oh my. Your outlook is bleak, to say the least.  Hmmm... 'Tis a dark fate indeed. However, the situation isn't entirely hopeless.

Reflect upon how you've conducted yourself lately, and if you are honest with yourself, you may find much that needs improvement. If you value your partner's presence, take heed of their opinions as well and listen carefully to their point of view.
Ah... It pains me to say I must be the bearer of bad news.  The spark of passion that once existed between you has been extinguished, likely some time ago. Yet there may be a way to rekindle it.
Gather your oldest and most trusted allies, and venture into . Retracing the paths of your past exploits may serve to remind you both of what drew you together in the first place.
Steel your heart, for you may not want to hear this.  The situation looks dire, but pray do not be hasty in ending this partnership.

You must also ask yourself: Have I been setting my best foot forward as ? Be honest─and harsh─with your answers, and seek out the candid opinions of others as well. Strive to improve on your shortcomings and mayhap your partner may notice the effort you put into bettering yourself.
This reading is...not good. Not good at all.  It seems you two have forgotten what brought you together in the first place.

Go to where the adventure started. , was it?  is home to many fresh-faced adventurers in need of advice and aid. As a team, lend them a helping hand, and their bright-eyed gratitude may serve to remind you of the reasons you became partners so long ago.
Have you received readings from we fortune-tellers three? Romance is the obvious aspect, but matters of coin and courage can just as easily sway the balance of a relationship!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_SYSTEM_000_550: You cannot proceed. One or more party members are too far away.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_SYSTEM_000_551: To have your fortune told, you must form a party of two with another adventurer.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_560: Ah, if that isn't the look of a  who has glimpsed  future. Was the path ahead smooth and gilded with gold? Or was the road cracked and lacking in luster?
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_561: Whether the outlook is promising or no, pray remember that it is not the be-all and end-all.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_562: As is the case with the Valentione's Ceremony, these fortunes are but a means to spur love on its way. For indeed love has a long way to journey, and the most important step is the first.
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_563: ...Of course, if you so wish it, you can always have your fortune told again. You need but let me know. After all, there is no shame in the pursuit of love eternal and true!
TEXT_FESVLT502_03206_LISETTE_000_570: Ah, if that isn't the look of a  who has glimpsed  future. Remember, whether the outlook is promising or no, it is not the be-all and end-all. The most important thing is to take your first steps together.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_000: I don't know why this time should be any different. <sigh> I'm such a failure...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_001: Me! I'm what's wrong. I just don't think I can make it...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_002: Because I just don't think I can do it...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_003: Oh, forgive me, I was caught up in my own little world. I didn't mean to burden you with my problems. ...Unless, of course, you have a moment to spare for a stranger's woes?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_004: (-Nanaphon-)The name's Nanaphon. And more than anything in this life, I want to play the role of Senor Sabotender─that marvelous mascot for the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_005: (-Nanaphon-)They're holding auditions right now, in fact. I've tried my best in front of the judges before, but those moves, I just... My body refuses to cooperate.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_006: (-Nanaphon-)The seventh round of trials is just around the corner, and if I fail to qualify again, I think it might be time to face the truth: I'm just not cut out to be a sabotender.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A2_000_001: We can't all be succulent stars...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A2_000_002: Who knows? Maybe you'll make it this time!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A2_000_003: Wait...Senor Sabotender isn't a real sabotender?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_007: (-Nanaphon-)I suppose not. And besides, why would they pick me? I wouldn't even pick me...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_008: (-Nanaphon-)I appreciate the vote of confidence, but I'm afraid I have none myself...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_009: (-Nanaphon-)Surely you jest? Everyone knows it's a Lalafell in a costume. But it will never be this Lalafell in that costume...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_010: (-Gentlemanly Voice-)Ho ho ho! I may have some advice for you, my distraught and diminutive friend!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_011: (-Nanaphon-)I know you! Y-You're Godbert Manderville, proprietor of the Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_012: In the firm and supple flesh! Now, if I heard correctly, you're struggling to emulate our Senor's trademark shimmy, yes?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_013: (-Nanaphon-)Y-Yes, sir. It's long been my dream to slip on that sabotender suit and bring smiles to people's faces...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_014: A noble endeavor if ever there was one. And it certainly sounds as if you've been giving it the old Manderville try...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_015: ...Considering my position, it would hardly be sporting of me to favor one candidate above the others. No, I cannot help you directly, but shall instead point you in the direction of someone who can.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_016: Take yourself over to Black Brush Station, and find a fellow by the name of Ririzan. If you're willing to work for your dream, then he's the one to help you achieve it.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_017: Why don't you accompany our young friend here, adventurer? I daresay he could use the support, and even a veteran like you might learn a thing or two from the talented Ririzan!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_018: (-Nanaphon-)Oh, thank you, Master Manderville, thank you!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_019: (-Nanaphon-)Come on, adventurer─let's not waste another moment!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_020: I've always had a soft spot for the dreamers. Good luck with the instruction, and I'll see you at the Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_GODBERT_000_021: If you've never been to the Saucer, I suggest you catch the attention of that well-heeled youth over there. Rumor has it he has an extra airship ticket or two to give away!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_SYSTEM_000_022: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_030: I'm sorry to bother you, but are you Ririzan, by any chance?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_031: The very same. What may I do for you?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_032: ...Interesting. And might you share the reason why you are so determined to assume the role of Senor Sabotender?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_033: Of course─it's my favorite story! It all began when I visited the Gold Saucer on the day of its grand opening...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_034: It was all so magical. I was captivated by the splendid decorations, entranced by the games and attractions.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_035: But what truly struck a chord in my heart was the sight of Senor Sabotender, and the way he left delight in his wake. Even just the sight of his swift-stepping gait brought smiles and laughter!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_036: Though I strive to be cheerful myself, I have a gloomy streak that tends to rub folk the wrong way.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_037: So you can imagine my excitement when I saw how Senor Sabotender could light up a room without needing to utter a single word! I had found my calling.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_038: Ever since that day, I've attended every single casting audition in the hopes of winning the role. But I never seem to be good enough...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_039: Well, I, for one, am convinced of your dedication to the part. And as for mastering the movements, I may have a few pointers to give you.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_040: W-Wait, that spin, you─ You're him!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_041: It's been a while now, but yes...I was the original Senor Sabotender!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_042: Driven by my undying love for all things sabotender, I spent hours upon hours perfecting my mimicry of their movements─only to be rewarded with the sneers and mockery of my peers.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_043: But not from Godbert Manderville! No, that magnificent man accepted me in all my prickly ways, even going so far as to hire me as entertainment for his soon-to-be-opened Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_044: Everything from the design of the Senor's costume to his most subtle choreography was given over to my control.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_045: I strove to become a sabotender, body and mind, and for three whole days neither food nor water passed my lips. Then came the day of the grand opening...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_046: I marched and danced with all my might, and just as my shift was coming to an end, I tottered and toppled over the rail of a second floor balcony. My refusal to drink water had been my downfall.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_047: I survived the tumble, as you can see, but my leg was never the same. Extended performances became impossible, and I was forced to hang up the suit.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_048: I was only Senor Sabotender for a single day. But now fate has brought you before me, a fellow sabotender enthusiast...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_049: My course is clear. I cannot dance for long, but it should be sufficient to pass on the basics...assuming you're willing to learn?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A3_000_002: I'm not auditioning for the part...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_052: Wonderful! We can practice the moves together!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_053: This is the legacy of the very first Senor Sabotender! How can you not wish to be a part of it!?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_055: Well, I believe you've grasped the fundamentals. All that's left is to embrace the sabotender spirit...to become the Senor!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_056: Go, my thousand-needle neophytes! Impress the judges with the authenticity of your audition!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A4_000_001: I am one with the desert sun!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A4_000_002: I never saw the attraction of being green and spiky...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_057: Please don't tell me you're auditioning too! I'm nervous enough as it is!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_058: Do you mind!? This is my dream we're talking about here!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_059: I will make the most of your lesson, Master Ririzan! Thank you ever so much!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_060: Right. If you're ready, adventurer, it's time we were going. The Gold Saucer awaits!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_RIRIZAN_000_061: I know not to which gods the sabotenders pray, but I wish Nanaphon the very best of their blessings!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_070: This is it. My seventh audition, and my hands still shake as much as the first time.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_071: I-I was hoping for something a little more...instructional? But, yes, I will give it my all.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_074: But considering the disaster which befell Ririzan, I'll be sure to have a good gulp of water before I begin. Wish me luck!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_075: ...Thank you, candidate number six. Let us keep things moving, shall we? Number seven! Now is your time to shine!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_076: A Mister...Nanaphon, is it? Would you care to share something about yourself? Ambitions? Dreams?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_080: Ah, you've elected to remain mute, have you?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_Q6_000_000: What will you shout in encouragement?
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A6_000_001: You've become a sabotender in truth!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_A6_000_002: I can almost see the thousand needles!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_082: Yes. Yes! I am reminded of the first Senor Sabotender─of Master Ririzan himself!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_083: Yes. Yes! I feel I might be pierced at any moment!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_085: No need to take this to a vote. Mister Nanaphon, you are hired!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_ROLAND_000_087: A dedicated performance until the very end. I applaud you, sir.
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_090: I-I can hardly believe it! They hired me on the spot!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_091: I have to thank Master Manderville, and Master Ririzan...and last but not least, I have to thank you, adventurer! I never could have done this without your unwavering support!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_092: The next time you see Senor Sabotender, it might be me in that costume. I won't break character to speak, so pray do not think me rude...
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_NANAPHON_000_093: I will instead welcome you with the most genuine sabotender antics that I can manage─just as Master Ririzan taught me!
TEXT_FESGSC301_03207_SYSTEM_000_094: You have learned the emote Senor Sabotender!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_000: Please, good , you must help me! The young mistress has gone missing and I...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_001: ...I do beg your pardon. That is hardly an appropriate way to begin a conversation, is it? I quite forgot myself for a moment.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_002: (-Rodolph-)Allow me to introduce myself─I am Rodolph, and I have the honor of serving the noble Thorne family. The young lady of whom I spoke is Aldiytha Thorne, whose whereabouts, I regret to report, are currently unknown.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A1_000_001: Should I know who that is?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A1_000_002: Escaped her gilded cage, I take it?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_003: (-Rodolph-)A fair question, and one which I shall endeavor to answer to the fullest. “Spare no detail” are words I live by in my profession, you see.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_004: (-Rodolph-)Ahem. You have doubtless heard of the Thorne Dynasty, the period in Ul'dahn history that began some three hundred years ago. During this time, the Thorne family reigned in the sultanate.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_005: (-Rodolph-)Though they relinquished their stewardship over the nation in favor of restoring the Ul to the throne, the noble scions of the Thorne line have continued to occupy positions of great social importance. Lady Aldiytha is the eldest daughter of the current head of the family.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_006: (-Rodolph-)Alas, she has always been frail of body. For her protection, I do my utmost to keep her from the perils of the outside world. But she has been haler than usual as of late, and when I went to look in on her this morning, I found that she had, ah...given me the slip, one might say.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_007: (-Rodolph-)Ever courteous, she left behind a note stating that she intended to join in the Little Ladies' Day celebrations in town. I certainly understand her desire to do so, given that her health has prevented her attendance in all previous years.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_009: (-Rodolph-)However, it is far too dangerous for her to cavort about the city on her own. If she were to be taken ill, or some misfortune to befall her, I would never forgive myself. Oh, it's the Legend of the Lost Lady all over again!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A2_000_001: So, shall we start the search sometime this century, or...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A2_000_002: Oooh, the “Legend of the Lost Lady”? Tell me more!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_010: (-Rodolph-)Good heavens! In sparing no detail, I lost sight of the larger picture. Yes, we must find Lady Aldiytha immediately!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_011: (-Rodolph-)Ah, yes. In the tale, Princess Edvya, who had been her whole life confined to the palace, switched places with a common miller's daughter and slipped away. Her overprotective father, Sultan Baldric, flew into a panic, his army all but razing the miller's house as they searched.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_012: (-Rodolph-)With the princess returned, however, the sultan came to repent his hasty actions. He had the miller's house rebuilt, and insisted upon personally serving as seneschal to the man's daughter for a day. His zeal for the role sparked smiles across the city.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_013: (-Rodolph-)It is this legacy that lives on as Little Ladies' Day, on which we remember that each little girl is as dear as a princess, and should be equally treasured.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_014: (-Rodolph-)...Good heavens! In sparing no detail, I lost sight of the larger picture. Yes, we must find Lady Aldiytha immediately!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_015: (-Rodolph-)Though I admit that, even with the both of us set to the task, it will be nigh impossible to locate her without knowing where in the city she might be.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_016: (-Rodolph-)I have it! Responsible for overseeing the festivities as he is, the royal seneschal surely has knowledge that we lack. Lady Aldiytha may even have spoken with him. We should seek his aid first and foremost.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_018: Warm hearts as a treasured princess! Spark joy as a loyal seneschal! Join us as we celebrate Little Ladies' Day!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_020: The royal seneschal takes his role very seriously─I am confident that he will help us find Lady Aldiytha.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_021: It's wonderful to see you again, my friend. Have you come to celebrate Little Ladies' Day with us?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_022: Well met, adventurer! I am the royal seneschal, tasked with making this year's Little Ladies' Day bring joy to the hearts of one and all.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_023: Are you here to ─or perhaps you wish to act as seneschal for someone dear to you? Either way, I am certain we can make your dream come true.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_024: I am terribly sorry to bother you during the festivities, but we are in urgent need of your assistance.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_025: Why, if it isn't Rodolph! You seem quite distressed. Am I correct, then, in assuming that this concerns Miss Aldiytha?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_026: Er...yes, as it happens. She wished to join the other citizens in celebrating Little Ladies' Day, but she left home unaccompanied, and I fear that my chances of locating her without help are slim.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_027: That is distressing indeed. Though I have not seen her pass by, I shall of course join you in your search. I have yet to thank her for the daisies, after all.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_028: Daisies? No─we can spare no detail later. Lady Aldiytha is our priority!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_029: Well then, we can begin with the main thoroughfare on which we stand─it is at the center of the festivities, and is always bustling with little ladies and their seneschals. If Aldiytha wished to join the celebration, she could not fail to be drawn to it.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_030: In that case, we should spread out so as not to miss her. Kind adventurer, please search for a dignified young lady with long, dark hair between where we stand and the Gates of Nald. The royal seneschal and I will cover the opposite direction.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_040: (-Aldiytha-)Yes, I am Aldiytha Thorne. Why do you ask?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_041: (-Aldiytha-)Rodolph sent you? Oh dear, I didn't think he would find me so quickly...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_042: Lady Aldiytha! Thank the heavens that you are unharmed!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_043: Who knows what may have come to pass without your assistance? The two of you have my thanks.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_044: Come now, we had best return home before you tax yourself overmuch.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_045: (-Aldiytha-)I appreciate your concern, Rodolph, but that I cannot do. I have a mission this Little Ladies' Day, and I will see it through!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_046: A...mission? Whatever it is, it cannot be more important than your health. I will not simply wait until you collapse─or worse!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A3_000_001: It's her life─at least hear her out.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_047: (-Aldiytha-)Thank you, dear adventurer! I'm sure you'll understand why this is so important to me.
