TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_048: (-Aldiytha-)It's kind of you to worry about me. But I swear that I'm feeling perfectly well today. No trouble breathing, no dizziness...and I'm not planning to do anything reckless. Truly!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_049: (-Aldiytha-)You see, as a Thorne, Little Ladies' Day has always held special meaning for me. I was raised on the Legend of the Lost Lady─and as I grew older, it became my dream to bring joy to the people of Ul'dah, just as Sultan Baldric once did.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_050: (-Aldiytha-)My illness, however, has kept me from so much... Eventually, I decided that if I could not brighten people's hearts on Little Ladies' Day myself, I would at least contribute something that could. That's why I began growing daisies in the garden.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_051: (-Aldiytha-)Miraculously, as they sprouted and bloomed, my body grew stronger─and I began to think that my dream might at last come true. You and I both know that my fortune will likely not last, but that is all the more reason to do what I can right now! All I ask is for this one day.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_052: Such a kind soul! I cannot speak for Rodolph, but your words have touched me deeply─as have your actions. While the Thornes are always generous in their provisions for Little Ladies' Day, to receive so many beautiful flowers this year was a true delight.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_053: If I may ask, why did you choose to grow daisies? Your family's crest depicts peach blossoms, does it not? That is why we typically use them as a motif for Little Ladies' Day... Could we have been mistaken all this time?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_054: (-Aldiytha-)I'm glad that you asked, but that is a secret to be revealed at a later time! For now, I would like to begin weaving these daisies into crowns, so that we may present them to the many princesses of Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_100_054: Crowns of flowers! What a splendid idea! Please, allow us to assist you. I will set my staff to the task at once.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_055: (-Aldiytha-)Wonderful! The preparations will go so much more smoothly with the royal seneschal's cooperation. Rodolph, pray bear with me a little bit longer.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_056: I...cannot. Though I am loath to disappoint you, as your seneschal, it falls to me to protect you. Your health notwithstanding, it is simply not safe for you to wander the city. We cannot assume that all who walk these streets have motives as pure as your own─Little Ladies' Day or no.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_057: (-Aldiytha-)You can't mean to take me back! Not when I'm so close...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A4_000_001: I will accompany you, and guarantee her safety myself.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_A4_000_002: Allow me to serve as her seneschal today!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_058: Hmm... I suppose that she would be reasonably safe with you as bodyguard. Very well.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_059: Hmm... I have no means to protect her out here in the city, but you have. So if you were to take on that responsibility... Very well, then. But I cannot well cede all of my duties to you, so I will remain with you until the lady is ready to return home.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_062: (-Aldiytha-)Oh, thank you so very much! Let's go and crown some princesses right away!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_100_062: Lady Aldiytha! Please do not sprint so!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_063: Wait, we haven't finished making the flower crowns ye─never mind.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_064: Well, I have no doubt that she will succeed in putting smiles on the faces of many a little lady with her flower crowns─assuming she has them on hand. I will have my staff bring along the ones that are finished so that you can take some with you.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_100_064: Here we are. Please go after Miss Aldiytha, and see that these find their way to the heads of would-be princesses!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_070: Oh, I'm such a scatterbrain! You didn't happen to collect the flower crowns from the royal seneschal, did you? I would so like to present one to this young woman...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_071: If we work efficiently, I may be able to return the lady home before her father becomes worried.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_100_071: I'm sure little ladies across Ul'dah will be delighted to receive crowns of their very own.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYGIRL03208_100_07: Sorry, am I in the way?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYGIRL03208_000_07: Oh, a crown made of flowers! It's so pretty! Do you think that if I wear this, I can be a princess too?
I really can? This is the best day ever! I have to go and tell Father that he's my seneschal now!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_074: Did you see her smile? It's wonderful that, even hundreds of years later, the Legend of the Lost Lady can bring people such joy.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_075: Shall we try the Steps of Thal next? I'm certain we can find others who dream of becoming princesses.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_076: Lady Aldiytha! I spared no detail in warning you of the dangers of running mere moments ago!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_080: This woman surely deserves a flower crown! I know her husband will love it as well.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_081: I must admit, I scarce remember when last I saw Lady Aldiytha so happy.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYHUSBAND03208_000: My wife and I have come to enjoy Little Ladies' Day. I have been too busy with work to spend time with her as of late, but the festivities give me an excuse to put my duties aside and take her on a romantic stroll.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_100_082: There are still many princesses in need of crowns! We must do our utmost to pass these out to each and every one of them.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYWIFE03208_100_08: Hello, can I be of service?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYWIFE03208_000_08: A crown of flowers? Are you quite certain you mean to give this to me? Surely there are younger ladies whom it would better suit...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_084: There's no mistake, I assure you. Though you may no longer be little, I am certain that you are a lady who is a princess at heart.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYWIFE03208_000_08: Well, 'tis true that as a child, I always dreamed of being a princess. Frilly dress billowing as I glide gracefully through palace halls, with a doting seneschal at my side...
How...do I look? If you're going to laugh, hurry up about it!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYHUSBAND03208_000: You are a vision of beauty, my lady. If I may be so bold─it is an honor to serve one as lovely, as gentle, as...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYWIFE03208_000_08: Eep! Stop, stop! Oh gods, I'm blushing...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYHUSBAND03208_000: Well, don't go and make it seem embarrassing! I always dreamed of having a princess to treasure, you know! And I found you, and, er... Oh, now I'm blushing!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_PDYWIFE03208_000_09: Thank you. It seems both of our childhood dreams have come true! I never expected to feel so much like a princess at my age.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_092: What a darling couple. Little Ladies' Day really does have the power to touch people's hearts, no matter their age! For we were all children, once─children listening, starry-eyed, to tales of princesses and seneschals.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_093: Childhood tales...yes, I remember. It was for the same reason that I dreamed of becoming a seneschal. To do my utmost to make one lady, one princess, smile.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_094: But can I truly say I have been living up to that ideal as of late?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_097: I will be fine. Though I suspect you were right─I should not have run so much earlier.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_098: Let us return to the royal seneschal. I will contact your father and ask that a carriage be sent.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_100: I apologize for worrying you. I will be fine.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_101: Perhaps all of this excitement at once was a bit too much for her.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_102: Lady Aldiytha seems to be doing well for the moment, and we shall return home without further exertion on her part. Rest assured that there is no cause for you to worry.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_103: Thank you─because of your help, I was finally able to make my dream come true. I am so sorry to repay your kindness with more trouble.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_105: Now, now, don't you worry over making others worry! Then everyone will be worried! Why don't we discuss something else instead─perhaps you are ready to share with us your reasons for choosing daisies, for instance?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_106: But of course. I will tell you the story while we wait for the carriage.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_107: After Sultan Baldric served as seneschal to the miller girl, he chose to do the same once each year for other Ul'dahn ladies. It is said that this was his way of reminding himself─and others─that all girls should be treasured.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_108: Then, one year, the girl he had chosen to be princess for a day presented him with a bouquet of daisies, to thank him for his service.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_109: The daisies that grow in Ul'dah are hearty─capable of proliferating even in our arid climes. This made them popular amongst the commonfolk, for even those without a proper garden could grow or pick them. Of course, for the same reason, the nobles considered them beneath notice at best.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_110: Amongst the nobility, presenting someone with such common flowers might even be considered an insult. So when the little lady gave them to the sultan, his attendants could do naught but hold their breath in trepidation.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_111: But, knowing how hard the girl had worked to pick them, the sultan gladly accepted the daisies. He bade his attendants fashion them into circlets, and, removing his own royal crown, placed one on his head, and another on hers. “We're the same, you and I,” he said, smiling.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_112: Ever since, the Thorne family has considered daisies to be symbols of happiness.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_113: That your flower crowns had such meaning behind them... I had no idea. And as your seneschal, I should have. I should have asked. I should have listened to every detail.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_114: But I am listening now. And if there is one thing I have learned today, it is that every lady deserves to be treated as a princess. So, I ask...does that not include you as well?
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_116: To be honest, that is what I was hoping to hear. Oh, and it seems Rodolph has one for you, as well!
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_117: “We're the same, you and I!” ...I've always wanted to say that.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_118: It seems that my lady is not the only one following in the footsteps of Sultan Baldric today. You not only watched over Lady Aldiytha─you helped me understand what is most important to her. In granting her wish, you have granted mine as well. Thank you.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_119: I can hardly express my gratitude. I've never had such a wonderful day in all my life, and it's because you were here to help my dream come true.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_ALDIYTHA_000_120: Thank you. I only wish that I didn't have to leave so soon...
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_RODOLPH_000_121: If that is your wish, we will simply have to find a way for you to stay longer next year.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_122: For my part, I'm grateful to all of you. This will be a Little Ladies' Day to remember for many of us, I am sure of it.
TEXT_FESPDY501_03208_BUTLER_000_124: But it is not over for you and I, is it, adventurer? We must work to see flower crowns in the hands of many a princess and seneschal yet.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BUTLER_000_000: If you have the time, I could certainly use more assistance in presenting our flower crowns to those on Emerald Avenue. As I mentioned, it is at the center of our Little Ladies' Day celebration, and nary a moment passes without a would-be princess or seneschal walking by!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BUTLER_000_001: I will divide my remaining stock with you─please wait by yonder peach tree and offer crowns to any potential celebrants whom I have missed. My staff is weaving more as we speak, so return to me when you need to resupply!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BUTLER_000_002: I can scarce remember a more hectic Little Ladies' Day─but the smiles of newly crowned princesses and their seneschals make all of our efforts worthwhile, don't you agree?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BIGGS_000_011: We're here on Ironworks business─visiting the Miners' Guild to inquire about supplies and whatnot─but we hardly expected to see you here! What brings you to Ul'dah?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_WEDGE_000_012: Flower crowns for Little Ladies' Day? What a nice idea!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BIGGS_000_013: Indeed it is! I'll take one, if you don't mind.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_WEDGE_000_014: Er...if you say so. I'm not sure it'll match your goggles, though.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BIGGS_100_014: I'm not going to wear it! It'd make a nice decoration for our little corner of Rhalgr's Reach, is all.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BIGGS_100_015: We've been so harried lately, what with saving the world from Omega, sorting all the data, Cid's emotional issues... A floral decoration will bring some much-needed tranquility to the place.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_WEDGE_000_015: That may be a bit much for one ring of daisies to handle. I'd rather give it to Tataru─I think it'd bring out the pink in her eyes. She'd like it, wouldn't she?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BIGGS_000_017: Thank you kindly. It's so colorful... I bet Alpha would love it, were he here. I hope he's learned about Little Ladies' Day, wherever he may be.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_WEDGE_000_018: I bet he has─and all sorts of other things besides! Most of this world is new to him, after all. He's probably having a wonderful time, so we shouldn't...we shouldn't...
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NANAMOULNAMO_000_02: Why, how nice it is to see you, ! 'Tis I, your favorite common merchant's daughter, come to enjoy the Little Ladies' Day celebration.
Well met, adventurer. I am Lilira─no one of note, I fear. Merely another merchant's daughter.
Oho, is that a flower crown I spy? How lovely! Could I perchance trouble you for one?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_PAPASHAN_000_023: Lady Lilira, do you not think that a crown will cause you to, er...stand out overmuch?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NANAMOULNAMO_000_02: Not at all! This is a day on which all little ladies are as princesses, is it not? Or do you believe that a crown will not suit one such as I?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_PAPASHAN_000_025: M-My lady, that was hardly my intention...
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NANAMOULNAMO_000_02: Hahaha! I jest, I jest! I well understood your meaning.
Yet my point stands─as a little lady, it is fitting that I have a crown. And I would quite like one, besides.

I expect that everyone at home will be surprised─it has been quite some time since I was last a princess. Hmm, or shall I play the role of Sultan Baldric instead? “My lady, I am your royal seneschal!”
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_PAPASHAN_000_029: I only ask that you avoid any jests that may alarm your other attendants. I nearly perished on the spot!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_YELLOWMOON_000_030: <gasp> Could it be? The garland spoken of in faerie tales and romances... The accessory of my childhood dreams... A flower crown!?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_YELLOWMOON_000_031: How wonderful! It will perfectly suit a fair maiden such as I, don't you agree? Oh, I can hardly wait to show Bitter Snow─he'll fall in love with me all over again!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ADALBERTA_000_032: If it isn't Yellow Moon! I see you're enjoying your flower crown. We picked ours up from the royal seneschal just a moment ago. Aren't they cute?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_YELLOWMOON_000_034: And you, Mylla, are stunning! Somehow your steely gaze makes your crown all the lovelier. You should decorate your hair more often!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MYLLA_000_035: I feel utterly ridiculous. But Adalberta insists I wear the thing...
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ADALBERTA_000_036: Come now, there's no use pretending─you know you like it. And you'll be turning heads for the rest of the day. One head in particular, I'm su─
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MYLLA_000_037: Not. Another. Word. Do you hear me?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_YELLOWMOON_000_038: Now, now, no murder on Little Ladies' Day! It's not ladylike!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MYLLA_000_039: Oh, I would never harm Adalberta─she's one of my oldest and dearest friends. Even if she is constantly pestering me.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ADALBERTA_000_040: Well, someone has to do it!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SEVERIAN_000_050: ...Is that you, my loyal assistant? Why are you standing about gormlessly in the middle of town?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SEVERIAN_000_051: Why do your eyes fixate on me so? If you're in need of some piddling potion or other, direct your vacuous gaze at some other alchemist. My attentions are occupied by more important matters.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SEVERIAN_000_052: A flower crown? How utterly banal.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SEVERIAN_000_053: Though, were one to apply an admixture of the appropriate viscosity and translucence, it may be possible to preserve its beauty evermore, thereby defying principles that have heretofore been presumed unyielding... Perhaps I do require one after all.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_COCOBUKI_000_054: Hm hm hm... Guildmaster Redolent Rose, if I'm not mistaken. What brings you here?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_REDOLENTROSE_000_05: Ah, a master of the Thaumaturges' Guild! I recall the eyepatch, so you must be Coco...er...

That was it! As to your question, I've come to evaluate the fashions of the day. And by “evaluate” I simply mean “observe,” of course. I'm not keeping score. Who would do that? Hahaha... Anyway, the flower crowns certainly are charming, are they not?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_COCOBUKI_000_058: Charming...yes. Such an embellishment would ill suit me. Busi, on the other hand...
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_COCOBUKI_000_059: A pleasing headpiece, and perhaps suitable for later use in alchemic solutions. Busi will be delighted.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_REDOLENTROSE_000_06: His name may be impossible to remember, but he's unmistakably the eldest brother. I do hope his siblings know how much he cares.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SERENDIPITY_000_070: ! Are you helping the royal seneschal this year? How kind of you!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SERENDIPITY_000_071: Hello there, adventurer! Thank you for helping the royal seneschal─volunteers like you make Little Ladies' Day an event I look forward to year after year!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_HAMON_000_072: Oho, if it isn't ! And Mistress Serendipity, shimmering with youth!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_HAMON_000_073: If it isn't Mistress Serendipity, shimmering with youth!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SERENDIPITY_000_074: I'm...pretty sure that's just light reflecting off of my accessories. But what brings you here, Master Hamon?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_HAMON_000_075: Hamon Holyfist would never forgo a chance to celebrate with the ladies, ohohoho! Keeps me vigorous.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_HAMON_000_076: And what about you, Mistress Serendipity? Do you require a seneschal for the day? I would be at your beck and call─managing your mammets, polishing your hammers, delivering righteous blows to the teeth of persistent suitors...
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SERENDIPITY_000_077: Oh, my! That's very...specific of you, but I couldn't ask you to do that! And Chuchuto would probably be less than pleased to find you eschewing your own guild duties in favor of mine.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_HAMON_000_078: Oh, woe is me! Were I twenty─actually, better make that forty─years younger...
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SERENDIPITY_000_079: If you'd like to celebrate with someone, why not take one of these flower crowns to Chuchuto and tell her how much you appreciate her? I'm sure she'd be delighted to have your help with some of the more tedious guild work for the day, at the very least. Don't you agree?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_HAMON_000_080: Make a princess of my ever-devoted disciple, eh? Well, she certainly deserves it!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_POPOKKULI_000_090: Hm? You, you're that adventurer─! What are you up to?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_POPOKKULI_000_091: Hm, you have the look of an adventurer. If you're looking for beasts to slay, you're in the wrong place, I'm afraid.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SESERUKKA_000_092: Giving out crowns for Little Ladies' Day? Interesting! Shall we take one to Nenekko?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_POPOKKULI_000_093: Not a bad idea! She always did love it when we read the Legend of the Lost Lady to her as a child.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_POPOKKULI_000_094: She's been so immersed in her research lately that she's like to have forgotten about Little Ladies' Day altogether, which means it'll be a pleasant surprise!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_GREINFARR_000_095: Heh. She's a lucky girl, to have you two watching over her.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_SESERUKKA_000_096: While we're on the subject, Greinfarr, isn't there anyone you would want to give one of these crowns to?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_GREINFARR_000_097: Wh─ No! Of course not. I am far too busy training to even think of such things.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_GREINFARR_000_098: In fact, the Bronze Bull hears the call of the arena right now! Farewell!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ULALA_000_100: Why, it's ! I was hoping I might find our biggest fan amongst the , and here you are!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NARUMI_000_101: It's wonderful to see you again! I was so worried that we wouldn't meet this year.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: A happy coincidence indeed. And before you ask─because I know you will─though our performances aren't the main event this year, our stage career is still going strong. So I had better not see you fretting when you should be celebrating!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ULALA_000_103: Hello there, adventurer─I don't believe we've met. I'm Ulala, beloved star of the Songbirds and soon-to-be number one songstress in all of Eorzea!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NARUMI_000_104: I am Narumi. Though I lack Ulala's boldness, I too believe that our ensemble can reach the realm through our performances. I hone my voice night and day to make certain that when we do, I can stand proudly before our audience and lift their hearts with my song.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: And I'm Masha Mhakaracca─you can call me Masha. My voice may not be as sweet as Narumi's, but I more than make up for that with my dancing. I live to inspire our fans to move with the music!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ULALA_000_106: So, are you waiting for your ?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NARUMI_000_107: Oh, I adore flower crowns! May we each have one?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Come to think of it, this seems like the perfect opportunity for one of our signature friendly competitions. Shall we ask  to judge who wears her crown best?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ULALA_000_109: Oh, absolutely! It never hurts to gauge public opinion─and I'm confident that  will make the objectively correct choice.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NARUMI_000_110: No matter how many times we do this, I can't help but feel nervous! But, well..., what do you think? Who does the crown best suit?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_A1_000_001: Ulala─she's so cute I could die.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_A1_000_002: Narumi─the crown befits one gentle of spirit.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_A1_000_003: Masha─poised and graceful, as a princess should be.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ULALA_000_111: Ha, I knew you would choose me! I am no less pleased to hear it, though. Thank you!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_ULALA_000_112: The Songbirds will continue to flutter into hearts across Eorzea, so spare a thought for us as you wander far and wide. Until we meet again!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NARUMI_000_113: M-Me? I'm honored─thank you! I will remember your words, and I am certain they shall help me find my voice in times of need.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_NARUMI_000_114: I know not where or when it might be, but I look forward to the next time we meet!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Who, me? I realize that it was I who proposed the contest, but I wasn't expecting to receive such a compliment. Thank you!
This has been great fun─I hope we'll meet again soon. And wherever you go, remember that the Songbirds are singing for you!
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BUTLER_000_120: Ah, you have returned. How did you fare?
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BUTLER_000_121: What a charming tale! We shall have to relay it to Miss Aldiytha─she will be delighted to know that her crowns are the source of such happiness.
TEXT_FESPDY502_03209_BUTLER_000_122: For my part, I appreciate your continued assistance. Needless to say, you will always be welcome to join me in acting as seneschal to the little ladies of Ul'dah!
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_000: ! I was just about to contact the Scions to ask after my sister, and here you are to provide a report in person! What news?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_001: ...To the First!? One of the thirteen reflections, you mean...!?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_002: I had thought my field of expertise a complicated one, but I struggle to comprehend the enormity of your tale. Still, Shtola seems to be faring well enough, and for that I am grateful.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_003: Ah, yes! Before I forget, I actually had a message to pass on to you.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_004: Do you recall Summoner Jajasamu? Formerly of the Company of Heroes and current member of the Immortal Flames' summoner squad? He commands both an Ifrit- and Titan-Egi, and is likely one of the more seasoned...ahem. Well, I am sure you remember.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_005: He is in Gridania on leave, as it happens, and asked me to direct you to the Carline Canopy should you stop by for one of your unpredictable visits.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_006: I believe he wished to consult you on some private matter... 'Twould be kind of you to lend him an ear if you've a moment or two to spare.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_010: Have you spoken with the lieutenant? I believe he wishes to speak with you summoner-to-summoner.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_JAJASAMULALASAMU_00: ...Bloody hells! I was just thinkin' about ye, an' there ye are! Y'mhitra had a word on me behalf, I take it? Well, let's not stand on ceremony...
I'll not mince words with ye─I need some advice concernin' summoners in mortal combat.
They tell me ye've a special nature what prevents primals from enthrallin' yer mind.
So what I want to know is, what's yer thinkin' on bein' sent out to the front lines every time a beast tribe scrapes together a pile o' crystals?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_A1_000_000: That's just the way of things.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_A2_000_000: I'm happy to be able to help.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_JAJASAMULALASAMU_00: Such is yer fate, ye mean? So ye give in to the inevitable, and fight because it's yer duty to do so?
So ye just see it as yer rightful place? Folk need yer help, an' ye've been blessed with the means to help 'em...?
Well, that's one way o' lookin' at it. Me, I'm in it for the coin─have been ever since I sold me spells with the Company o' Heroes.

Most o' the soldiers I march with ain't much different. We're happy to put our lives on the line as long as there's a purse waitin' for us at the end o' the day. The pair what joined in on our last skirmish, though...now there's a whole 'nother story.
Ye've heard of Arenvald an' Fordola, aye?
The lad's one o' the Scions, same as you. No mystery there.

As for the lass...she's a bit more complicated. Former officer in the imperial army, captured by the Resistance an' steps away from the noose. Fightin' for Ala Mhigo as a conscript now, which is the only reason she's still breathin'.
Barely more'n sprouts, the both of 'em, an' they was deployed with the Flames to assist with downin' Ifrit.
From what I hear, they share yer resistance to primal influence. An' that's why─that's the whole reason they had the dubious honor of standin' in the thick o' the flames.
Meanwhile, me an' me fellow summoners was cowerin' in the shadows, sendin' out our egi to support these youngsters what've seen less than forty summers between 'em.
Can't say I cared much for the experience. It bothered me to think they was bein' made to fight a battle what weren't theirs, just because o' who they are.
Do ye think ye could talk to 'em for me? Ask how they feel about the whole thing? Yer about the only person I can turn to...
Me thanks. Ye'll find Arenvald in Rhalgr's Reach, an' he'll know where to find Fordola.
Arenvald was in Rhalgr's Reach last I heard. If ye could ask 'em me questions, it'd sure help me sleep at night...
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_070: , I heard you had returned! What can I do for our honored champion?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_071: Jajasamu said that...? Aye, we joined them against Ifrit, but I'd thought him more annoyed by our presence than concerned for our well-being.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_072: Hm, why don't I save you some time and include Fordola in this conversation. We can visit her in her cell over in the city.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_101: ...You again? And I see you've brought company. What is it now?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_102: My thoughts on fighting primals? Is that what you came all the way here to ask me about?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_103: I fight because I like the idea that I can help others─the feeling that my presence is needed. Not hard to explain, considering how my own mother decided she didn't want me around.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_104: And then there was that nightmare at the Waking Sands... A'aba and Aulie gave their lives to save mine, and I strive to be the sort of man whose life was worth saving.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_105: How very honorable. But no such lofty ideals rule my actions.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_106: My own will doesn't come into it. Fighting was part of the deal when they conscripted me with the other convicts─I follow orders, and I get to live. And if I died on the battlefield...? No one would shed a tear.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_107: Don't say that! You think I'd be glad to see you killed!?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_108: Hmph. You'd be about the only person who wasn't.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_109: And what about you, hero? You're usually the first one they throw into the dragon's maw. Let's hear what battles you've been made to fight.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_A1_000_200: I was summoned to a world drowned in Light...
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_A2_000_200: I joined the struggles of a man seeking to save a companion...
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_115: You journeyed to another star to...bring back the Darkness?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_120: You're saying you were involved in the affairs of a man who had passed through the rift between worlds? Someone who's been wandering as a ghost for a hundred years...?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_125: (-Fordola-)I'm not sure if you're the realm's greatest champion...or the realm's greatest liar.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_126: I believe you, , and want to follow the path you walk. Even if I could never hope to carry the same burdens, I can at least work towards having a sturdier back!
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_127: Speaking of burdens, you know a little something about that, don't you, Fordola? You weren't fighting for yourself, after all, but for your comrades. We are not so diff─
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_128: Don't pretend my “gift” is anything like yours.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_129: I wanted it─asked for it, even─but got more burden than I bargained for. How many souls were sacrificed for that research? No, the power they gave me was tainted from the beginning.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_130: But if I can do some good with it, then maybe they didn't die for naught.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_FORDOLA_000_131: Satisfied? Then leave me be. I've got training to do...
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_150: She still snarls like a chained dog...
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_151: Amidst all that growling, though, she gave us a glimpse of her true self. Enough that I'll know when to lend a shoulder, even if she wouldn't let me see her suffering...
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_152: N-Now don't be getting the wrong idea! Same age, same homeland─I can't help but care a little about what happens to her!
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_ARENVALD_000_153: A-Anyway, I have my own training to think of. Give my regards to Summoner Jajasamu!
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_JAJASAMULALASAMU_00: Ye've been to see them two youngsters, then?
Huh... So, that's the way of it, eh?
Well, I shouldn't be surprised considerin' the example they've been given to follow.
An' now that I know how they're approachin' these fights, I can adjust me own tactics accordingly. One's passionate, an' the other's reckless, so they'll both need some watchful support.
I'll do what I can to stand in for ye, though I doubt I'll ever replace ye. Aye, they'll call me “the second-best summoner in Eorzea”─how's that for humble!?
Right, I think it's past time I was on me way. Give me best to Y'mhitra, , an' thanks for humorin' me request!
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_190: Everything went well with the lieutenant, I trust?
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_191: I won't pry into the details, but I am glad to see you looking so content.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_192: To master summoning is an arduous journey, yet I imagine the going is made far smoother with a mentor such as you. I am somewhat envious of your younger colleagues.
TEXT_LUCKBC008_03217_YMHITRA_000_193: And if I am to mirror their progress, I must not allow my own scholarly research to fall by the wayside! Good day to you, !
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_EIRIKUR_000_001: Trades, eh? You've that look about you. Interested in putting those skills of yours to use undertaking a leve or two?
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_EIRIKUR_000_002: It's all above board─all handled under the auspices of the Crystal Exarch, worry not. We process and dole out a mountain of leves every day. Register with us and you can peruse the open ones at your leisure.
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_EIRIKUR_000_003: You'll be compensated too, in case you were afraid we were running some sort of charity. So─shall I put your name down in the ledger?
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_EIRIKUR_000_004: Right, then! , was it? Let me just finish filling out this remaining bit of paperwork, and then you'll be all set!
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_SYSTEM_000_005: You may now undertake Crystarium leves by speaking with Eirikur.
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_EIRIKUR_000_006: You dabble in trades? Could've fooled me. Are you sure?
TEXT_LUCKYR001_03602_SYSTEM_000_007: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 70 or above.
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_001: You are the esteemed , yes? Allow me to introduce myself. I am Mowen, founder and chairwoman of the Boutique of Splendors.
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_002: Master Alphinaud has spoken quite highly of you and your unparalleled artistic abilities. Quite highly indeed...
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_003: Forgive me my boldness, but I should be most honored if you were to register with us as a provider of collectables. As compensation, we can offer you a wide variety of goods that I am confident will meet with your approval.
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_004: Not direct compensation, to be clear. We have adopted a system rather similar to one with which you are doubtless familiar─and which I only recently learned of from Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_005: For every delivery, you will receive payment in the form of scrips. This exclusive currency is redeemable only with the Boutique of Splendors. Limiting, perhaps, but you will find that the equipment and materials we have on offer more than make up for any inconvenience.
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_006: The woman who first conceived this approach was brilliant, wouldn't you agree? A true visionary who managed to bring together people from all walks of life and reshape the world with her boundless compassion and generosity...
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_007: Oh, and I should mention that a negligible portion of the value of all collectables processed will be withheld to account for overhead and other assorted operating expenses. Doubtless I need not explain the necessity of this.
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_MOWEN_000_008: The Boutique of Splendors is always on the lookout for new artisans eager to share their talents with the world! Should you happen to know any such individuals, I pray you direct them to us!
TEXT_LUCKYR002_03603_SYSTEM_000_009: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 70 or above.
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_000: Hold a moment, sinner. You're not from around here, are you? A fellow wandering soul? An eternal inhabitant of the road? I thought so!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_001: Eirlalth's the name. My aspiration is to travel the whole wide world─though it's a fair bit smaller than it used to be, so as far as dreams go, it's a lot more realistic than you might think.
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_002: But danger still lurks in every corner and around every bend. Even so, this sinner's got nerves of steel! He's a born explorer, Eirlalth! There's no land too distant or place too forbidden, aye!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_003: But what is that I spy poking out of your pack? A log, if I am not mistaken. Give it over, if you would...
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_004: Aha, I thought so! A record of fantastic vistas and unforgettable sights! We're kindred spirits─amaro of a feather! Excellent, excellent!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_005: 'Tis only right that I share with you such wondrous experiences as you have with me. A collection of amazing vistas I cataloged myself that I guarantee will rival the best you have ever seen!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_006: Norvrandt may be a shadow of its former glory, but there is still joy and excitement to be found if you know where to look, my friend. So I implore you, look, look, look!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_007: Follow in my footsteps. Savor every moment of the journey. And then, when you feel you have discovered every secret this realm has to offer, start again. I promise you won't be disappointed!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_SYSTEM_000_008: Shadowbringers entries have been added to your sightseeing log!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_SYSTEM_000_009: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 70 or above to record Shadowbringers vistas. Travel to the location indicated and fulfill the necessary conditions and you will complete the entry for that vista, earning experience points in the process.
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_SYSTEM_100_009: The newly added locations in your sightseeing log will be marked by an orb of light. Should you spot such an orb during your adventures, take a moment to stop and record the entry.
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_SYSTEM_000_010: Use your wits and the notes provided by Eirlalth to identify these stunning sights and the proper way to appreciate them, and see Norvrandt as only the greatest explorers have seen her!
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_EIRLALTH_000_020: You're a new arrival, aren't you? Hmm... On second thought, never mind. What I had in mind is probably too dangerous for your sort.
TEXT_LUCKYR003_03604_SYSTEM_000_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must have at least one class or job at level 70 or above.
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_001: I bet I could do that...
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_002: Wha─ How long were you standing there in silence!? Don't you know it's rude to...to... Wait, aren't you that mortal bonded to Feo Ul?
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_003: Well now, isn't this a pleasant surprise! I've a proposal I was meaning to put to you, as it happens. Interested?
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_004: So these skywatchers you see all over─they're good at what they do, but even they can't tell you if it's raining or whatever back on the Source, no?
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_005: But with my help, they could! Aye, aye! I could cross the rift, see what the weather's like for myself, come back, and share my knowledge with these mortals by whispering to them in their dreams!
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_006: I could do the same for the skywatchers on the other side, too! Everyone would have all the answers, and they wouldn't even know how they'd got them! Mwahahaha! Wouldn't that be grand?
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_LORFEO_000_007: Your silence is all the approval I need. Off I go! Hehehe!
TEXT_LUCKYR004_03605_SYSTEM_000_008: Due to Lor Feo meddling with the dreams of skywatchers in the Source and the First, skywatchers may now provide forecasts for every region regardless of their location.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_000: Well, if it isn't the shining star who set so many hearts aflame with  high-flying feats at the Moonfire Faire! Thanks in no small part to your contributions, we were able to close the curtain on this year's festivities in style.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_001: Well, hello there! I do believe we met once at a Moonfire Faire of years past, did we not? If you've come for this year's festivities, I'm afraid to say they've already drawn to a close.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_002: Well, hello there! An adventurer, I take it? If you've come looking to take part in this year's Moonfire Faire, I'm afraid to say the festivities have already drawn to a close.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_003: Though the revelry and rejoicing may have ended, needless to say there's still plenty of work left to be done. Speaking of which, would you be averse to lending a fatigued festival attendant a helping hand?
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_004: While we were favored with spectacular crowds again this year, I fear that comes with an unfortunate aftereffect. Which is to say, this beautiful beach remains cluttered with an unsightly amount of rubbish and refuse─much more so than I could ever hope to gather up on my own.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_005: While I realize this is a rather trivial task to impose upon an adventurer of your stature, would you be so kind as to help me tidy up a bit? It really would mean everything to me.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_006: Should you find any discarded items, simply return them here to me. I will sort through them and see that they are disposed of in a proper fashion.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_010: Oh, hello again, friend. My aching back is forever in your debt for your help. Should you find any scattered pieces of refuse along the beach, simply bring them to me, and I will take care of the rest.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_020: Welcome back! I can already see that the beach is looking cleaner for your efforts. I would be happy to take any of the discarded items you picked up off your hands.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_021: Thank you, friend. We truly appreciate your efforts. After all, it just wouldn't do to launch the celebratory fireworks over a beach littered with jetsam and junk.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_022: Well, now. What have we here? This appears to be an ordinary bottle, but...is this a letter inside? How curious. Why, I do believe I'll take a closer look!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_023: (-Cryptic Letter-)Ne'er till land...Heavens spew crimson...seep black dooms...Stray seeds...Valiant...
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_024: ...It's no use. The ink is smudged in so many places, deciphering the letter in full is all but impossible. That said, all this talk of heavens spewing crimson and seeping black dooms─it isn't very pleasant, is it?
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_025: Wait, I just had a thought! What if this is a message─a warning of sorts─intended to help us forestall an impending calamity!?
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_026: Perhaps I'm overthinking this, but better safe than sorry, wouldn't you say? Why, I've half a mind to take off immediately to investigate further myself! ...Sadly, I still have another half of a beach here to clean.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_027: Please, might you be so kind as to look into the letter on my behalf? My friend Bran in Limsa Lominsa─he's a veteran reporter for the venerable Harbor Herald─just happens to be an expert on cryptic poems and prophecies. I'm sure he'd be able to tell you something about it!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_028: I'm terribly sorry to burden you with yet another menial task like this, but the fate of the realm may very well be at stake! And wherever this leads, I promise to compensate you properly for your labors. Safe travels, friend!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_035: Have you spoken to Bran yet? If there's anyone out there who can help us decipher the letter's mysteries, it's him!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_040: Well, slap me silly with a harbor herring! If it isn't the adventurer who tossed a few bread crumbs to this gaz when he was just a little bird learnin' to take wing. Tell me─what brings you back to Bran's huntin' grounds?
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_041: Something I can do for you, stranger? If you've business with Bran, best state it quickly. This gaz has leads to follow and incidents to investigate.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_042: P'obyano's wonderin' about this letter, you say? Well, you couldn't have come to a better place! Hand it over, my good , and let Bran see what he can't glean for you!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_043: Did Bran know it or did Bran know it!? There's no mistakin' these chocobo scratches. This is the quillmanship of none other than that rovin' minstrel of no small repute!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_044: As for the content of the letter, why, it's none other than a particularly portentous passage from the seventh verse of the Divine Chronicles, as writ by Mezaya Thousand Eyes so many years ago. If you'd care to hear it, ol' Bran'd be happy to perform a dramatic readin' of the full words.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_045: Ne'er till land consumes sun can sea bear moons, Heavens spew crimson flame, hells seep black dooms.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_046:
(-Bran-)Stray seeds quicken in ash's grey embrace.
Valiant blades forged under the Twelve's good grace.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_047: Pretty ominous to say the least, no? But I wouldn't be worryin' overmuch. Scholars posit that this was a prophecy foretellin' the Seventh Umbral Calamity, which as we all know has come and long since gone─and thank the Twelve for that.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_048: As for why our minstreling friend saw fit to scribble this down, bottle it and toss it into the sea─well, why don't we saunter on over to Ul'dah and ask the good man himself? After all, what with it being the Rising and all, it's as good an occasion as any to reflect 'pon the rebirth of our realm.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_055: The man himself, in the flesh! This gaz has prepared a host of juicy questions, and I can only hope he's inclined to answer them all!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_100_056: Bran's decided to interview the wandering minstrel, you say? Why, that sounds positively fascinating! It's enough to make me want to pick up and join you myself. Unfortunately, if I even thought of leaving this rubbish-littered beach before my job is through, I'd be in hot water, to say the least.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Well met, my friends. Might I interest you in a song?

...Oho. An interview with the Harbor Herald, you say? You do this humble minstrel a great honor. I would be happy to oblige, but be forewarned─there may be matters which I am not at liberty to divulge.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_062: But of course! Anythin' and everythin' you'd be willin' to tell me and my colleague here, ol' Bran would be nothin' but 'ppreciative!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Well, my friends. I must say, this brings me back a ways. I did indeed scribe this letter many, many years ago. Before the Calamity described therein came to pass.
With disaster looming nigh, I sojourned in a small farming village just a stone's throw from Bloodshore. Near what is now Costa del Sol, though none called it by that name in those times.

I spent night and day penning countless letters identical to this one. I placed each one in a bottle and cast them into the sea, in hopes of warning Eorzeans far and wide about the realm's impending doom. Many of my adventurer acquaintances assisted me in the task.
To think that one of those letters would find its way to you after so many years. Yes, fate works in mysterious ways...
Why, yes...I do believe that my muse stirs within me. If you might indulge me for a moment...
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_11: (-???-)Greetings, Warrior of Light. You needn't be alarmed.
(-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and you have my most heartfelt thanks for gracing this world with your presence, and your deeds of surpassing courage and valor.
It's a pleasure to welcome you here again, old friend. Or shall I call you...the Warrior of Darkness? In any event, it's been quite the adventure we've shared, you and I.
Oh, how the years have flown by since I crossed the rift to this world. I trust that your adventures here yet stir your heart and nourish your soul?
We are still here, just as ever, scribing the events that will go down in the history of this vast realm. A job, of course, that we could not do were it not for your extraordinary exploits.
One might even say that just as you have embarked on your adventures, we have also been on adventures of our own.

Each adventure brings meetings and partings, and countless trials that must be overcome. The task is never an easy one, but at journey's end, we emerge stronger, more enlightened, and closer to the individuals we want to be.
For this reason, and many more, this world─this world we share with you─is near and dear to our hearts as nothing else could be.
And so I will remain here, singing of your great deeds. Those that have come to pass and those that are yet a dream. And together, we will tell a tale that will live on long after we are gone.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_12: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
In truth, there are others who have messages they wish to share with you. But do not worry─we shall find a way.
Ever will we be watching over you. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, Warrior of Darkness. Till next we meet...
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_12: Ever will we be watching over you. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, hero of Eorzea. Till next we meet...
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_130: What a song! Why, that has to be the most mellifluous, movin' composition that I've ever heard! You've outdone yourself this time, my minstrelin' friend!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_BRAN_000_131: Why, I'd best get back to the Herald and put pen to parchment before I go forgettin' the words! Be seein' you, friend, and tell P'obyano the greatest gaz in Limsa sends his regards!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The Calamity took much from us, but Eorzea rose from the rubble and ashes to stand as strong today as ever she has. And to you, whose courage and devotion will see our realm to an even brighter tomorrow, I dedicate this song...

O hero of rebirth traversing,♪
Heal you this scarred land.♪
Lay bare cloistered truths and tame the skies,♪
Let azure guide your hand.♪

O hero of rebirth traversing,♪
Break you the tyrants' bonds.♪
Embrace your sin and chase the light,♪
To darkness a world will dawn.♪
When the Calamity razed this land, the Eorzea we once knew was lost to us forever. And yet, the realm as it once was lives on to this day in the hearts of those who call it home.

So it is that in this season of remembrance, my thoughts turn to those who are with us no more, and to the world that they left behind. For it is truly knowing and understanding our past that allows us to stride confidently toward our future.
While we can never regain all that was lost to us, we can remember─and let those memories give us the strength to forge our way to a brighter tomorrow. This is why we observe the Rising.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_150: Oh, there you are! I was wondering when you'd be back. Was Bran able to help you puzzle out the meaning of that ominous missive?
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_151: A years-old message to warn the people of the Seventh Umbral Calamity, you say? Phew! And here I was worried we were facing our impending doom all over again!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_152: At any rate, I owe you something for going above and beyond the call of duty for me today! This might not be much, but please take it with my most sincere gratitude.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_153: Speaking of which...it's the strangest thing. Ever since you left, we've had more and more of those bottles come floating in with the tide. I'm pleased to say that this time the words are not ominous in the least─and judging from the penmanship, it would seem that they come from a variety of senders.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_154: Yes, messages in bottles seem to be all the rage these days. Which would be all well and good if I weren't stuck with the task of keeping these sands shiny and spotless.
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_000_155: ...Which gives me an idea. If you're curious about the contents of the letters, perhaps you'd be willing to help me pick a few of them up? I'll even throw in a token provided by the festival authorities for each bottle you bring to me!
TEXT_FESANV501_03660_POBYANO_100_156: What are the tokens good for, you ask? Why, they can be exchanged for a veritable bounty of simply delightful seasonal goods with the Rising vendor. Take my word for it─it'd be more than worth your while!
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_000: After all you've already done, you're still willing to lend poor P'obyano a helping hand? You truly are a saint! Or perhaps you're just curious to find out what all these letters say? I couldn't blame you for that─I am too!
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_001: Anyhow, what with how many of them are washing in these days, I don't suppose they'll be too hard to find. Bring back to me what you've found, and I'll open them right up─my nails are quite suited for the task, mind you─so you can read the message at your leisure.
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_006: Have you found any of the bottled messages yet? It shouldn't be hard─why, there's so many of them that sometimes I feel like I'm tripping over one every other second! If you find one, just bring it back to me. I'm curious what they all say, too, after all!
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_SYSTEM_000_008: The other bottles appear to have been washed away with the tide...
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_010: Is that a message in a bottle I see in your hands, or are you just happy to see me?
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_011: Splendid! For doing your part to clean up the beach, I'm more than happy to furnish you with this spiffy, shiny, absolutely official Rising token.
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_015: You'll want to hold on to it─and acquire even more, if you can─so that you can exchange them for any of the wide array of exclusive festival goods and accessories available from our vendor.
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_POBYANO_000_016: In the meantime, why don't you take the letter and find a quiet spot around here to read it? I imagine that gazing up at the fireworks over the sea would do an excellent job of setting the scene. Whoever wrote this, and wherever they are, no doubt they want nothing more than for their words to reach an adventurer like you.
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_001_00: (-Small Bottle, Letter I-)How quickly the years have flown by since we first set up that message board on an unassuming street corner. Seeing the many and myriad words written there each day never fails to fill our hearts with joy and gratitude.

(-Small Bottle, Letter I-)Perhaps most enjoyable of all to read are the announcements of various festivities organized by adventurers. Gatherings of fellow clansmen, adventurous journeys to far-flung lands, and all sorts of delightful events.

(-Small Bottle, Letter I-)We tip our caps to the passionate adventurers who pour their heart and soul into organizing these outings. One might liken them to a lodestone, drawing people in and bringing like minds together wherever they go.

(-Small Bottle, Letter I-)Finally, we would express our thanks to all of you who take the time to keep diaries of your journeys. It is a pleasure and an honor both to have the privilege of sharing in your adventures.
With best wishes,
The Keepers of the Message Boards
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_002_00: (-Small Bottle, Letter II-)We hear that these days, it's all the rage for adventurers to gather in small groups and paint portraits of themselves striking stylish poses.

(-Small Bottle, Letter II-)As humble art supply provisioners, all we can do is provide the canvas, the palette, the paint, and the brush by which such works of art can be crafted. And we realize there is much we still must do to allow adventurers to fully realize their aesthetic visions.
(-Small Bottle, Letter II-)And yet, seeing the masterworks you are already creating each day instills us with pride and the passion to continue pursuing our craft.

(-Small Bottle, Letter II-)We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for allowing us to take part in this creative collaboration, and look forward to providing you with yet more materials to add to your artist's workshop in the future.
Wishing you eternal inspiration,
The Art Provisioners of Eorzea
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_003_00: (-Small Bottle, Letter III-)The other day at the aetheryte plaza, I happened upon a minstrel cheerfully strumming a tune before an admiring crowd of adventurers and townspeople.

(-Small Bottle, Letter III-)Impromptu concerts like these have been happening more and more of late, and I daresay nothing fills our hearts with joy quite like seeing people of all ages, backgrounds, and walks of life bonding over a love of music.

(-Small Bottle, Letter III-)To all the talented composers and instrumentalists out there, we thank you for providing a soundtrack to stir our own hearts. We hope that the music of Eorzea has served to render your adventures even richer and more memorable.
Ever in harmony with you,
A Humble Instrument-maker
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_004_00: (-Small Bottle, Letter IV-)I still remember the day. Fresh off the boat after a long voyage across the Ruby Sea, I strode into the gleaming Gold Saucer. I found an open space in one of the parlors, set up my table, and began to stack my tiles atop it.

(-Small Bottle, Letter IV-)Anxiety gripped me to the depths of my body and soul. What if Eorzeans had no interest in the Doman diversion I sought to provide? Would my long journey prove to be for naught?

(-Small Bottle, Letter IV-)Fortunately, my worries soon melted away. Within hours, the Manderville Tables were teeming with visitors─locals and travelers from far abroad alike─each more eager than the next to try their hand at the time-honored game of mahjong.

(-Small Bottle, Letter IV-)I am no mighty adventurer, and there is only so much I can do for this realm. And so I hope that, in some small way, the game I teach can serve to lighten adventurers' days, and relieve them from the many burdens they bear.
Until we meet at the tables,
An Anonymous Mahjong Tutor
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_005_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter I-)The mighty walls of Ul'dah were not built by one man. There were those that hewed the stones, and those that polished them. Those that carried them, and those that stacked them one atop the other until they reached the towering height you see today...

(-Medium Bottle, Letter I-)And it is not just the walls. Much of what you see in the world is, in fact, the sum total of the blood, sweat, and tears of countless men and women whose names and faces you will never see.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter I-)But there is one more who is essential to truly realize the creation of these wonders...and that is you. For without you, all the efforts of those nameless artisans would mean nothing at all.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter I-)And so we speak in unison when we say...thank you. Always remember that you are the reason we devote ourselves to our craft.
With gratitude,
The Nameless Artisans of Eorzea
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_006_00: (-Small Bottle, Letter V-)Lately, there is nothing I enjoy quite so much as walking the streets of Eorzea's residential districts, and stopping to admire the many homes open for public viewing.

(-Small Bottle, Letter V-)Seeing the furnishings my colleagues and I crafted with love and care tastefully adorning such warm and welcoming homes─oftentimes in remarkably creative ways─is perhaps the single most enjoyable sight an artisan can experience.

(-Small Bottle, Letter V-)At times, the layouts are so eccentric and unconventional that I fear it is only a matter of time before they come crashing to the ground...but I am nonetheless impressed with the sheer creativity on display.

(-Small Bottle, Letter V-)As for us, we will do all in our power to continue crafting stylish furnishings and ornaments. May you continue to find joy in decorating your happy homes.
With gratitude,
A Humble Woodworker
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_007_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter II-)A little bird tells me that Eorzea is a land where many a bard and minstrel plies their trade.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter II-)“Oh, what I would not give to visit that far-off land and hear their strummings with my own ears!” Such is the vain dream I hold in my heart each day, as I sit in this dark room, pounding away against a great machine of levels, dials, and blinking lights.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter II-)Countless sounds have been given life in this cold, dank place. Perhaps you have paid special heed to them, but doubtless many of you have not. There is no shame in this─on the contrary, this is proof that they have formed part of the natural fabric of this world.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter II-)And yet, at some point in your adventures, if you could pause for even a fleeting moment to take in all the sounds of the living world around you, nothing would give us greater pleasure.
In gratitude,
An Artisan of Acoustics
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_008_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter III-)To those who make a living in the world of the stage, audience reactions are everything. Each joyous cry, each shed tear...we feel it with you, our audience, and then some.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter III-)Even when the reviews are harsh, we do not look away. We listen to and reflect upon your every word, each time vowing to use it to provide more powerful and effective performances going forward.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter III-)There are times when the poets and playwrights ask more of us than we feel capable of providing, but never do we back down from a challenge. Everything we do, we do it for you─and we thank you for being an ever-appreciative audience.
Yours in gratitude,
A Humble Stage Director
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_009_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter IV-)From vast deserts and verdant forests to deep blue seas... From white-veiled snowfields to exotic townscapes, and sometimes even to distant worlds...

(-Medium Bottle, Letter IV-)Many a vista we have painted on our canvases, from familiar surroundings to far-flung locales. If even one or two of them have left an impression on you, there is nothing that would make us happier.
(-Medium Bottle, Letter IV-)And yet, all we can do is provide the backdrop─the stage on which you, the star of this adventure, will shine.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter IV-)From skies of azure and seas of ruby to the gentle darkness that comes after the light. Ever will we continue to put brush to canvas, that you might bring the worlds we draw to life.
Ever with you,
A Humble Landscape Artist
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_010_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter V-)Nothing warms my heart quite so much as when I see adventurers about town walking around wearing the clothes and fashions that I designed.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter V-)At times, the color and outfit combinations are beyond anything I'd ever imagined! This, in turn, inspires me to not rest on my laurels, but rather to strive to create yet newer and more eclectic fashions.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter V-)So to you, who I may never meet, and whose name I may never know, I have only this to say: thank you from the bottom of my heart for allowing the clothes of my creation to walk with you.
Yours sincerely,
A Humble Fashion Designer
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_011_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter VI-)A tale is not complete the instant the author pens the final word.
(-Medium Bottle, Letter VI-)No, it is not until the reader then takes the tome in hand, and the words enter their eyes, their heart...only then does the story told in those pages truly come to life.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter VI-)One could say that you are not only the protagonist of this grand tale of adventure, but also─in a sense─one of its authors. Your thoughts, your decisions, your actions─all serve to dictate the course of the story.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter VI-)And so we hope, that you will continue to enjoy with all your heart your adventures here. May you ever continue to breathe life into this world.
Sincerely,
A Teller of Tales
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_012_00: (-Small Bottle, Letter VI-)We have no strength to lend you in battle, nor can we craft wondrous items to serve you in your adventures.
(-Small Bottle, Letter VI-)We can't help you win a fortune at the Gold Saucer, nor can we lift your spirits with a happy tune.

(-Small Bottle, Letter VI-)At the end of the day, all we can truly offer is companionship─whatever small comfort you can derive from knowing that we'll always be at your side. And yet, for some reason─a reason for which we can only thank the gods─that's enough for you.

(-Small Bottle, Letter VI-)And so, we thank you: our friend, our master. Simply say the word, and we will follow you to the ends of the world and beyond. For you mean more to us than you will ever know.
Ever your faithful companions,
Your Minions
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_013_00: (-Medium Bottle, Letter VII-)Hello, friend. Are you perchance enjoying the fireworks? You can be honest with me. After all, I'm just one of the humble artisans responsible for the show you saw today.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter VII-)To tell the truth, my colleagues and I are responsible for more than fireworks. Storms of pounding rain and bolts of lightning, auroras that dazzle in the sky, mystic lights and the glowing of crystals. The lights and mists that you see upon the stage are all crafted by our hands.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter VII-)Fireworks are a fleeting thing, are they not? They dazzle the eye and move the heart, but in the next instance they turn to smoke, then fade and vanish without a trace. Think, just for a moment, of how it must feel to put one's heart and soul─and hours of blood, sweat, and tears─into creating something that lasts but an instant.

(-Medium Bottle, Letter VII-)But please do not misunderstand. We say this not out of bitterness, but with honor and pride─for nothing gives us greater pleasure than to know that our humble efforts have, even in the smallest of ways, helped your star shine all the brighter. And know that we will continue to pour all of our inspiration and imagination into illuminating your grand stage.
Yours in obscurity,
A Humble Artisan
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_014_00: (-Large Bottle, Letter I-)Fledgling adventurer, I pray this message finds you well.

(-Large Bottle, Letter I-)Though your journey has just begun, I sense you will yet make a name for yourself. We must all start somewhere, as I once did. And though not every avenue will lead to fame and glory, I have faith in you.

(-Large Bottle, Letter I-)Wherever your travels may lead, always remember this: You are not alone. When you stumble, there are those who would catch you. When you lose your way, there are those who would guide you back to your path.

(-Large Bottle, Letter I-)Perhaps someday, you will be the one taking the lead, showing others how it's done. Until then, keep fighting the good fight, and may good fortune befall you.
Yours,
A Fellow Adventurer
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_014_01: (-Large Bottle, Letter II-)It feels like only yesterday that the vows sworn on the shores of Silvertear Lake marked the beginning of the Seventh Astral Era.
(-Large Bottle, Letter II-)You may not remember me, but I was there alongside you─well, figuratively speaking─as we launched the attack on the Praetorium.
(-Large Bottle, Letter II-)I'll never forget the way you cut through the imperial lines─like a hot knife through butter. My unit would've been slaughtered if you hadn't arrived when you did.

(-Large Bottle, Letter II-)I was sent back to my hometown to recover from my wounds, but I wish I could've thanked you in person. Still, I'm grateful for the chance to see my family again, and would have you know that they appreciate your heroic deeds every bit as much as I do.
Your comrade in arms,
A Fellow Grand Company Soldier
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_014_02: (-Large Bottle, Letter III-)I can still remember the day you came swooping into Ishgard on the back of that dragon. I recall that it took even Ser Aymeric a moment to realize you were friend and not foe.

(-Large Bottle, Letter III-)I must admit, I was one of those archers prepared to fire upon your draconian steed. It's a good thing I was wearing my helmet, as I have no doubt my face was beet red with embarrassment when we saw it was you!

(-Large Bottle, Letter III-)Having said that, I'm sure I would've been lost among the crowd, as there were a fair few of us there to mark your return. Unfortunately, being one of the rank and file makes it rather difficult to directly express my gratitude for your brave deeds, which is why I chose to pen this letter.

(-Large Bottle, Letter III-)Even then, I must rely on the tides of fate to carry these words to you. Though as you have proven, miracles can─and often do─happen.
Ever your comrade,
A Devoted Temple Knight
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_014_03: (-Large Bottle, Letter IV-)I'd been a member of the Resistance for years, not that we ever had much luck against the Garleans. It felt like we went from one defeat to the next, our numbers growing smaller each time.

(-Large Bottle, Letter IV-)But that all changed when you and the Alliance arrived. Your brave deeds turned the tide not only here in Ala Mhigo, but all the way over in Doma, from what I've heard. I'll bet those imperials hardly knew what had hit them.

(-Large Bottle, Letter IV-)Even though the fighting here has come to an end, we face a hard road ahead. We'll need to band together as never before if we're to heal the wounds inflicted upon our land by the Garleans.

(-Large Bottle, Letter IV-)And yet we have faith. After all, it's you and your comrades who've given us this chance, and we'll be damned if we let it go to waste. You have our gratitude, hero.
Ever your comrade on the battlefield,
A Former Fighter of the Resistance
TEXT_FESANV502_03661_BOTTLELETTER_014_04: (-Large Bottle, Letter V-)I snuck this letter on board a certain apparatus before it was sent hurtling backwards through time and space. As it wasn't accounted for on the storage log, I could begin to calculate where─and when─it will eventually arrive.

(-Large Bottle, Letter V-)Even if I were to succeed in sending it two centuries in the past, the odds that it will safely reach the hands of that hero of legend are infinitesimal at best. And yet, the chance is not zero, and it is in remote possibility that I place my hopes.

(-Large Bottle, Letter V-)My ancestor─the first of the name I now proudly bear─once told me that the hero he befriended was, for all of  many talents, above all a  possessed of great fortune. Fortune that suggested that the Twelve themselves truly did smile upon .

(-Large Bottle, Letter V-)In that sense, it's not unreasonable to expect that it is indeed you who is reading my words today. And so, I say: thank you, my friend. Thank you for saving our past, and giving us hope for a brighter future. And above all, please look after him, won't you?
Yours,
Biggs, Third of His Name
Eighteenth President of Garlond Ironworks
TEXT_LUCKYB006_03662_PARALLELMINSTREL_00: Yes, I thought so. , correct? You've been keeping very busy if all the rumors are to be believed.
Hmm? Why are you staring at me with such intensity? Pray tell, have I said something to offend you?
TEXT_LUCKYB006_03662_A1_000_001: How in the seven hells did you wind up in this world?
TEXT_LUCKYB006_03662_A1_000_002: You can cross the rift. You of all people...
TEXT_LUCKYB006_03662_PARALLELMINSTREL_00: Judging by your cryptic comments I gather I bear a resemblance to someone you know? But I can assure you that we have never met before, you and I.
Don't believe me? Then let us be friends. The more you learn about me, the more you will come to realize how different I am from this other “me.”

I am a wanderer by trade, but a minstrel at heart. A keeper of tales, a singer of songs, a preserver of forgotten truths. Yet in defiance of my itinerant nature, I have elected to remain here for a time and compose new works.
You being a traveling sinner, I'm sure you've seen your share of adventures. Such stories often serve as the best sort of inspiration. Perhaps I could persuade you to regale me with one or two?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Greetings, adventurer! Are you feeling the heat? Because I certainly─ Hey! I know you! Thank you ever so much for joining us for another Moonfire Faire! The festivities really wouldn't be the same without you.
Greetings, adventurer! Looking for a way to beat the heat? Well, you're in luck! The annual observance of the Moonfire Faire is going on even as we speak!
Once upon a time─well, just a couple of years ago, in fact─the Moonfire Faire was a time when adventurers would band together to banish the threat of firesome fiery creatures called Bombards.

Now the Bombards are long since gone─at least we hope they are─but the tradition continues as a way to celebrate the daring exploits of adventurers the realm over, and through this, recruit some fresh blood for the realm's Adventurers' Guilds in the process. A worthy cause, I'm sure you'll agree!

But enough with the chitter-chatter─I'm sure you're eager to join the celebrations yourself, yes? Then you need only make your way to the Isle of Endless Summer at Costa del Sol and speak with our grand chaperone, Haermaga! I promise he'll be overjoyed to see you!

Greetings, friend, and a happy Moonfire Faire to you! If you're keen to join in the festivities─and who isn't, really─I encourage you to visit the Isle of Endless Summer at Costa del Sol and speak with our very own Grand Chaperone Haermaga!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_010: Well, if it isn't ! I was wondering when you'd show up! Why, you're such a mainstay around these parts each year that I felt terrible getting the festivities started without you. Anyhow, since you're here, I take it you're ready for another rousing Moonfire Faire?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_011: The highlight of this year's event is: you guessed it! The return of that time-honored test of agility and acrobatic aptitude known as the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course! And lest you think that you've seen this all before, let me be the first to say that the course has come back better than ever!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_012: Yes, Master Gegeruju has spared no effort in providing the ultimate challenge for high-flying adventurers! Word has it he even solicited opinions from the lovely ladies in his employ. “Gahahaha! Those kittens have claws, eh?”─or so I overheard him saying.
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_013: But there's more to an adventurer's skill set than performing death-defying feats. That's why we're offering two other events─the Iron Culinarian Challenge and the Angling Extravaganza─for those looking to celebrate the season in a more relaxed and reflective manner.
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_014: Well, what have we here? We've only just met, but that spark in your eyes tells me everything. You've come to take part in the festivities, and make this year's faire the most rousing incarnation of the event our realm has ever seen! Am I right? Of course I am!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_015: First, allow me to introduce the highlight of the event: the time-honored test of agility and acrobatic aptitude known as the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_016: Master Gegeruju has spared no effort in providing the ultimate challenge for high-flying adventurers. “Will they navigate these perilous paths with grace and poise, or suffer a humiliating fall? My lovely ladies can't wait to see! Gwahahahaha!”─or so I overheard him saying.
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_017: But there's more to an adventurer's skill set than performing death-defying feats. That's why we're offering two other events─the Iron Culinarian Challenge and the Angling Extravaganza─for those looking to celebrate the season in a more relaxed and reflective manner.
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_018: Emerge triumphant in any of these events, and you'll be rewarded for your efforts with a Faire voucher. Collect enough vouchers, and you'll be able to exchange them for any of a host of spectacular seasonal rewards!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_019: There's also, ah, just one little thing I was hoping to ask of you. There's this adventurer, see, who just signed up at the guild, and we can't help but feel he's in need of some, ah...veteran guidance and direction. We figure you'd be perfect for the job...if it's not too much trouble, of course?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_020: Wonderful! I can't thank you enough. Whenever you're ready, just say the word, and we'll send for him straightaway!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_030: Thank you ever so much, friend! I'm sure you'll be a wonderful influence on the lad. Give me just one moment...I'll summon him here.
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_032: Why, it's me! Your dear friend and companion R'fhul Tia! We braved the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course together on that memorable day, forming bonds of trust and friendship sure to last a lifetime!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_033: I'm so glad you came! I have incredible news, and I can think of no one I'd rather share it with. Brace yourself, friend: the mild-mannered boy you knew then is now a gods-honest adventurer! Can you believe it?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RMAJHA_000_034: Hi there,  Adventurer! It's so nice to see you again!
