TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_035: (-Amateur Adventurer-)Could it truly be!? Oh, but it is! Yes, I know you! You're that adventurer that everyone at the guild told me about!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_036: It's truly an honor and a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I'm R'fhul Tia, and I'm an adventurer, too! As of the other day, at least. I'm still quite new to this, you see. Nevertheless, I simply had to meet you in the flesh!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RMAJHA_000_037: Hi,  Adventurer! I'm R'majha, and I'm, uh...not an adventurer. I just came to play with my big brother! Will you play with me, too?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_038: So, ah, R'fhul Tia here just signed up at the Adventurers' Guild just last week. Typically, he'd be out honing his skills in hopes of becoming a full-fledged adventurer, but today he's come home to visit his dear little sister for the Moonfire Faire season. That's nice of him, I suppose?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_039: There's no “hope” about it, my good man! Let me assure you I am fully fledged, and then some. Why, just the other day I slew ten fearsome ladybugs in one fell swoop! Guildmaster Ywain of Gridania even told me I had “great potential!”
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RMAJHA_000_040: Wow, Fhul! You really are the bestest adventurer in the whole world!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_041: Haha! Would you expect anything less from your big brother? Okay, Majha, it's time to take out your hello stone!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RMAJHA_000_042: Hello, hello! Can you hear me, Fhul? Go give those nasty monsters a good beating for me! And try not to get yourself hurt, okay?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_043: Hello, hello! Worry not, little girl! Fhul the Fearless will see that these horrible fiends bother the good people of this town no more!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_044: Er, I understand that you're probably thrilled to have your very own linkpearl, but you really should save that sort of thing for, ah, more essential situations? I mean, it's sweet that you get along and all, but...
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_045: Anyhow! While there might not be any monsters around here, as such, I daresay that your sister had some good advice for you. Seeing as how you're still new to this adventuring business, you really should take care of yourself. After all, it's like they say: overconfidence can lead to, ah, all sorts of not-so-good things!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_046: Overconfidence? Perish the thought! I have precisely the right measure of confidence to match my rapidly burgeoning abilities. Abilities that I intend to put on full display for  here.
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_047: And with that, I stake my claim. , I hereby challenge you to battle!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_048: Not a duel to the death or anything so painful, of course. Our battlefield shall be these very fairegrounds. The first to earn four Faire vouchers will be the victor─and to the victor will go the honor, and the spoils!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_049: Oh dear. Let it never be said that you lack a sense for the dramatic. Well, what do you say, ? If you'll be participating in the festivities anyway, would you be so kind as to accept the lad's challenge?
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_RFHULTIA_000_050: Haha! I knew you wouldn't back down! But be forewarned, my friend: you'd do well not to underestimate your opponent today. And with that, let the games begin!
TEXT_FESSUM501_03663_HAERMAGA_000_052: Oh dear. Say what you wish about the boy, he certainly doesn't want for enthusiasm, does he? So, ah, anyway. If you're looking to get started, I'd be more than happy to explain the rules for this year's festivities. Just come and speak with me whenever you're ready!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_000: Thank you, friend! Your presence will go a long way in teaching the lad that there's more to being an adventurer than gallivanting about making bold and baseless proclamations. Now, without any further ado, allow me to explain the ground rules.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_001: The name of the game here at the Moonfire Faire is collecting Faire vouchers. These can be acquired through displays of your adventuring prowess, and subsequently redeemed for a host of enticing rewards.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_100_001: You can receive a whopping four vouchers for successfully demonstrating your high-flying acrobatic aptitude in the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. To participate, simply speak to the course registrar standing over by the shore.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_002: If you're the type who'd rather keep your feet on the ground, you can also receive a single voucher each time you complete the Iron Culinarian Challenge or the Angling Extravaganza. You can take part in these by speaking to my colleagues Hildelana or J'nangho, respectively.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_003: Should you have any other pressing questions about the festivities, Ethelia and her fellow Faire attendants would be happy to tell you more. Now, go out there and show us all─particularly a certain malapert Miqo'te─what you've got! I reckon four vouchers should be enough to put him in his place. Acquire them in whatever manner you prefer, then bring them back to me.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_004: Enjoying the festivities, friend? Remember, once you've acquired four vouchers, come back and show them to me. Together, we'll show that cocksure lad that a true adventurer walks the walk without all the talk!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_010: Oho! Back so soon? Let me guess...you've already acquired four vouchers for yourself?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_012: And all without even breaking a sweat! R'fhul Tia has yet to return, so I do believe that I can officially declare you the winner of this competition.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_013: ...Not that the outcome was ever in much doubt, of course. Anyhow, your decisive triumph should go a long way toward giving R'fhul Tia some much-needed perspective. Speaking of which, did you happen to see the lad out there?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_014: To tell the truth, I worry for the boy. When he first came to us a few years back, all starry-eyed and gushing about how he was going to be a great adventurer, I was happy for him. After all, what is the Moonfire Faire for, if not to encourage spirited young lads like him to join the ranks of those fighting for our realm?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_015: What's more, word has it that the lad lost his family. That one of the reasons he's so determined to follow this path is so he might protect his dear sister in his departed father's stead. That's why I'm all the more worried that he's in over his head.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_016: Mind you, we all know how it feels to get a touch overeager at our first taste of success. But this lad is taking this to an entirely unhealthy extreme. If he doesn't watch out, he's going to get himself killed out there.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_017: ...That's why I had the idea to recruit you for this little competition. Just maybe, I thought, a small taste of failure at the hands of one of his more accomplished peers, would teach him─gently, mind you─that there was still much for him to learn.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_018: Speaking of which, could I bother you to look around and check in on the boy? Just to ensure that he hasn't gotten himself into any trouble, that is. I'd go myself, but I'd be causing trouble myself if I abandoned my post in the middle of the festivities!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_019: Last I heard, R'fhul Tia had a mind to take on the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course and win himself four vouchers in one fell swoop. Perhaps you could find him or his little sister over by the shore?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_020: Last I heard, R'fhul Tia was talking about taking on the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. Would you be so kind as to go and check on the lad? Just to see that he hasn't gotten himself into any trouble and all...
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_030: Oh, hello, ! Are you looking for Fhul?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_031: Hmmm... I don't know how many slips of paper he has, but I do know that he's trying really, really hard!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_032: I just saw him over there by the spraying water, talking to that man in the colorful clothes. Maybe he can tell you more about how Fhul is doing. I know! Why don't we go talk to him together?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_033: Sorry to trouble you, friend, but you're doing great service by taking your time to be a role model for the lad. The guild needs more adventurers like you.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_040: And a very happy Moonfire Faire to you, little girl! I trust that you're enjoying the festivities?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_041: Hello, mister! Do you know where my brother went? His name is R'fhul Tia, and he's a great adventurer!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_042: R'what...? Can't say the name rings any─ Ah! You must be talking about that cocksure Miqo'te lad who just dropped by a short while ago!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_043: Why, if I'm not mistaken, I do believe that's him right over there. Yes, he's just about to take on the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_044: This is most exciting, don't you think? Ah─I've an idea! Why don't I give you a play-by-play of your brother's daring attempt at the course? That way, you can experience every death-defying leap as if you were right there with him! All right, here goes nothing!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_045: Here we have our brave young challenger, R'fhul Tia! Look at the fire burning in his eyes as he readies himself for the challenge before him! Yes, the boy lacks not for confidence or determination, but will that be enough to carry him to victory today?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_046: And he's off and running! There's really no need to run into the water jet, but hey, whatever floats the lad's boat. He approaches the water, and...
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_047: There he goes! Look at him shoot up, high, high into the sky! He flies through the air, and...!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_048: ...Yes, he's landed! With remarkable balance and poise given his relative youth and inexperience, he stands safely on the starting platform, with the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course looming before him! Yes, now the true challenge begins!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_049: The boy takes a few measured steps. He looks forward to the platform in front of him, and with a confident nod, he leaps, and...!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_050: Gods be good! He's lost his balance on the landing! Has the Miqo'te lad's brave challenge come to a sudden, shocking end!?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_051: But no...no! He's still up there!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_052: Yes, he's hanging on for dear life! What strength! What remarkable resilience!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_053: Hah! A slight miscalculation on the angle, nothing more. I'll just pull myself...right up...and...
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_055: Oh, the ignominy! The agony of defeat! R'fhul Tia's challenge is over, but not for lack of effort! Give the boy a round of applause!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_058: I bet this man can tell us how Fhul is doing!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_BEAUDEFOIN_000_059: I had high hopes for the lad, but alas! It would seem he still needs a bit more seasoning. No shame in that, of course. We all have to start somewhere, after all!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_060: <pant> <pant> Th...thank you, friend. Why...why do I feel like this isn't the first time this has happened?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_061: <pant> <pant> I Th...thank you, friend. I'm not sure what happened up there. One moment the platform was underneath my feet, and the next...it wasn't.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_062: B-But , why are you here!? We are in the midst of a heated contest, after all! You should be out there collecting vouchers, not showing sympathy for your rival!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_063: Oh, Fhul! Are you hurt? You should rest for a bit! Here, come with me!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_064: Rest? But I─ Ah, I suppose you're right. The contest can wait. After all, I don't expect  here has more than a voucher or two at this point.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_065: Speaking of which, why don't you come along? These faire games take quite a bit out of you─I imagine you're as exhausted as I am. Yes, I do believe there should be suitable place to rest just over thereabouts.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_066: Fhul! Fhul, are you okay!? Speak to me, Fhul!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_070: Ah, yes! I do believe all I needed was a little rest. Yes, just watch me! Now that I know precisely how that course works, I'm going to tear through it in record time! You'd best hurry back out there yourself, lest I get the jump on you in our little competition.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_071: Speaking of which, ...have you managed to get your first voucher yet? They certainly don't make it easy...
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_072: Bahahaha! That's a good one, my friend! As if any adventurer could acquire four whole vouchers in such a short...ah...er... You aren't serious...are you?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_073: Why, I...I'm not... Could you be saying that you already have two? But that would be... Wait...three, even? Ah...er... I'm not sure I like where this is going... You don't seriously have all four?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_074: But that's impossible! Inconceivable! How could anyone acquire four vouchers so fast!?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_075: Wow, ! You're really something! Isn't , Fhul?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_076: This can't be! I...I realize that I'm still new to this adventuring business, but never did I think there would be such a pronounced─and quite frankly, somewhat embarrassing─difference in skill between the two of us.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_077: But there is no arguing with the evidence before me. I am simply in awe of your prowess, friend. You are a role model to me and anyone who has ever aspired to be an adventurer!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_078: Why, to think I was so foolish as to think that I could compete with an honest-to-gods hero in earnest! Just thinking of it, I want to slap that brash and brazen boy in the face with a large harbor herring!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_079: But just you watch, . I'm going to train harder than ever before, and hone my skills over time, just the way you did. One day, when I truly have the talent to back up my words, will you accept my challenge once more?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_080: Thank you, friend! You've given me all the inspiration I need today!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_081: Yes, it's high time I embarked on my next adventure! Why, I do believe I'll join my companions in investigating those curious rumors surrounding Tam-Tara Deepcroft!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_084: Yes, it's me, Majha. Whatever is the matter? You gave your big brother a fright, just running off like that...
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_085: I'll be a good girl and stay out of trouble, so... Just promise me you'll take me to the faire again next year, okay?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_086: And promise me you'll take care of yourself, and not go anywhere too dangerous. I know you're a great adventurer, but, please... I just want you to be safe...
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_088: I promise, Majha. Your brother has learned an important lesson today. I'm going to follow in the footsteps of  here, and become an adventurer that you can truly be proud of.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_089: I'm already proud of you, Fhul. Hey, . Do you have any advice for my brother? He really looks up to you, you know.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_A2_000_001: Take one step at a time.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_A2_000_002: Don't run headlong into a horde of monsters.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_090: I see, I see... Start small, and gradually gain confidence and experience through small victories. Try to do too much too soon, and you'll end up dangling by a thread from certain demise...like I was just before.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_091: I see, I see... No matter how confident you might be, approach potentially dangerous situations with care and caution, lest you end up overmatched and overwhelmed before you know it!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_092: Thank you ever so much, my friend! Why, I've learned so much from you today that I feel like I've already grown leaps and bounds. I can't wait to put my newfound knowledge to use in my adventures!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_093: And with that, I do believe that Majha and I should be off. Pray give my regards to Master Haermaga, and assure him that I've taken today's lesson to heart.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RFHULTIA_000_094: Farewell, my friend. It has been an honor and a pleasure to do battle with you. Until the day we meet again, may you have the best of fortune in your adventures!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_RMAJHA_000_096: Fhul had a short nap, and now he's ready to go!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_100: Welcome back, friend! Did you manage to find R'fhul Tia? He hasn't gotten himself hurt, has he?
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_101: ...You don't say. Well, it sounds as if he's learned his lesson. And given how much the lad looks up to you, I reckon it's a lesson he'll not soon forget.
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_102: Be proud, friend. Adventurers like you are an inspiration to one and all─not just the boy, but everyone who's seen your exploits here at the faire today!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_103: Ah, but before I forget! We had a special gift prepared for you to thank you for going above and beyond the call of duty. Here you go─I can't think of anyone who deserves it more!
TEXT_FESSUM502_03664_HAERMAGA_000_104: And with that, I should return to my duties. I leave you to enjoy the festivities. Remember, you are free to take on the challenges and showcase your skill as often as you like!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_STAFF03665_100_000: Welcome, friend. I trust you're here to try your hand─or would that be your feet?─at the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, yes? Wonderful! My colleague here will get you signed up straightaway!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_000: Well, now there's a face I'd recognize anywhere! Welcome back, friend, and many thanks for joining us at this year's festivities! I trust you're ready to amaze onlookers with your characteristic brand of athletic derring-do?
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_001: Welcome, my friend, and many thanks for joining us at this year's festivities! I trust you're ready to amaze onlookers with your characteristic brand of athletic derring-do?
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_002: Very well, then! Without further ado, allow me to explain the rules of the challenge in full. Pay close attention, now─you never know what small morsel of knowledge may prove the difference between a glorious victory and a humiliating defeat!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_003: First, just hop atop that jet of water and let it propel you with a splash to the start of the course! From there, you'll have to navigate a sequence of precarious platforms and narrow ledges to make your way to the central checkpoint. Two hints for you: move cautiously, and try not to look down!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_004: When you reach the checkpoint, the first thing you'll want to do is speak with the chaperone stationed there. It's her job to confirm that all competitors have completed the full course fair and square, you see. From there, it's a straight shot to the goal, where my colleague P'obyano awaits.
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_005: The course may appear imposing, as well it should─Master Gegeruju's really pulled out all the stops this year. But fear not! You can take as much time as you'd like, and in the event that you should take an unfortunate and premature tumble, you can simply swim your way back to the starting point and try again!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_006: Are you ready? Then have at it! My colleagues and I will be cheering you on from down below!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_007: Welcome back, my athletically accomplished friend! Back to amaze onlookers with another remarkable run at the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, are we? Splendid! You already know the rules, so feel free to hop right onto that water spout and show everyone what you've got!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_008: Oh, and don't forget to report to the chaperone at the checkpoint, yes? We wouldn't want all to see all your efforts go for naught, now would we? But enough of my ramblings. Go forth, brave and honorable Nimble Warror!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_009: Your first objective is to make it to the checkpoint midway through. Remember to speak with the chaperone there before forging on to the finish line, or your triumph won't count and your acrobatic exploits will all have been in vain!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_BEAUDEFOIN_000_010: Most impressive, my swift and sprightly friend! I was convinced you were going to make it clear to the finish line in one fell swoop! You may have fallen short, but sweet victory is right there for the taking! Now get back out there and show the adoring crowds what you've got!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_STAFF03665_100_011: The course will give you a challenge, but it's far from impossible─especially for an experienced adventurer like yourself, I'd wager! Keep your eyes on your landing point, don't rush your jumps, and most importantly...try not to look down!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_FESSUMSTAFF03665_00: Congratulations! You've made it to the halfway point! And as challenging as this course is, I daresay that's an accomplishment in itself.

So pat yourself on the back and feel free to take a breather before you venture on. My colleague P'obyano is waiting at the finish line. Can you make your way there and claim your reward? I guess we'll see, won't we!
Feel proud, friend! Why, many of your ungainly peers never even make it this far. But don't get too comfortable yet! Half of the course still remains, and the road won't be an easy one.
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_POBYANO_000_030: You did it! And just as I thought you would! Right from the start, when I saw you leaping and bounding your way through the course like it was nothing, I had a feeling you were a Moonfire Faire veteran. And now I see that I was right!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_POBYANO_000_031: You did it! And just as I thought you would! Don't ask me why, but I had a good feeling about you right from the start! You'd better believe that at least one person who saw you conquer the course today will be strolling into their nearest Adventurers' Guild tomorrow to sign themselves up!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_POBYANO_000_032: I trust you have places to go and people to see, but should you ever wish to show off your skills again for all to see, the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course won't be going anywhere! ...At least, not until the end of the faire. You're welcome to rise to the challenge as many times as you like─simply talk to the chaperone at the starting line if you so desire!
TEXT_FESSUM503_03665_POBYANO_000_033: You did it! Once again, you've made our painstakingly constructed course appear about as challenging as a leisurely stroll on the beach! If you'd care to treat the faire-goers to another display of your astounding athletic ability, you're always welcome here!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_000: Greetings, my gourmet-inclined friend! Since you've stepped up to speak to me, I presume that you're looking to take part in the one and only Iron Culinarian Challenge? Oh, happy day!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_001: Don't fret if this is your first time, for the rules of the challenge are simple enough. First, I will prescribe for you a particular dish. Next, you'll procure the necessary ingredients and get cooking. Finally, you'll bring your creation back to me for inspection. If your culinary creation is up to snuff, you'll win yourself a Faire voucher for your efforts!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_002: And now, without further ado, the dish you'll be preparing for us is...battered fish! Never saw that one coming, did you?
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_003: It's a simple yet tasty treat that really is all the rage among faire-goers at this time of year. Crispy on the outside, lightly flaky on the inside...if you've never had it yourself, you really owe it to yourself to give it a try!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_004: Back again to take part in the Iron Culinarian Challenge, are we? Well, then you've come to the right place! I'll spare you the details, as I know you're an old hand at this by now.
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_005: If you're in need of fresh haddock, the friendly fisherman just over yonder would be happy to part with one of his catches...for the right price, of course. Now go forth, friend, and fashion a culinary creation that will win the hearts of all who partake in it!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_006: I just can't wait to feast my eyes on the battered fish you whip up for us, friend!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_010: Take a whiff of that simply scrumptious aroma! I can only assume that you have what I think you have?
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_011: Why, just look at it! Freshly caught haddock, battered and fried to a deep golden brown! Why, if I hadn't already wolfed down ten pieces just today, I doubt I could keep myself from devouring it on the spot!
TEXT_FESSUM504_03666_HILDELANA_000_012: But I jest. You may rest assured that your most mouthwatering creation will find a good home in the tummy of one of your fellow festival-goers. Take this Faire voucher as your reward, and take pride in a job well done. Farewell, and should you ever be so inclined as to show off your skills with a skillet once more, you know where to find me!
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_000: Welcome, fellow adventurer! As you surely see, it's that season of the year again, and the Moonfire Faire is in full swing! I trust that you're enjoying the festivities?
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_001: If you're just dying for the opportunity to flaunt your fishing skills for all the realm to see, then you've come to the right place! Welcome to J'nangho's Angling Extravaganza!
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_002: The rules are simple. I name a fish, and tell you the quantity of said fish I require, and you go out and do the fishing. Then you bring your haul back to me for fame, fortune, and fabulous prizes! ...In the form of Faire vouchers, that is.
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_003: Got it? Without further ado, your assignment is thus: catch for me three specimens of only the freshest haddock! Have you ever had haddock, friend? It really is quite the treat, especially battered to a golden brown. Mmm, haddock...
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_004: Well, if it isn't everyone's favorite angler extraordinaire! Well, at least you're my favorite─especially now, seeing as how you've come back to fetch me another haul of three fresh haddock! That is why you've come back, isn't it?
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_005: And with that, I say go forth, my friend! Go forth with fishing rod in hand, and lay claim to the bounties of the sea! I shall be waiting for you with bells on─and with an ample amount of vouchers to reward you for your efforts.
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_006: How fare you in your fishing exploits, friend? The waters around the island are simply swimming with haddock just waiting to be reeled in by an accomplished angler like yourself!
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_010: Do I smell what I think I smell? Why, my mouth is already watering at the prospect! If you have the haddock, pray hand it over with all speed!
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_011: Would you look at this! Why, this haddock is so fresh it feels like it could jump out of my hands and flop its way all the way back to the sea! Not that I'd let that happen, of course. Your catch is going straight to the hands of a skilled culinarian, who will make a tasty feast of battered fish for the faire-goers.
TEXT_FESSUM505_03667_JNANGHO_000_012: At any rate, you've proven yourself worthy and then some, and this voucher is your reward─take it with my blessing. We'll be here until the faire finishes up, so if you're looking to show off your skills again, you're welcome at any time! Until then, fare thee well!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_INVESTIGATOR03668_0: Aha! I spy with my keenest of eyes  who thwarted the evils of yesteryear! What a pleasant surprise it is to see you again. Would that I could say the same for that lot...
You there! I have a keen eye, and you strike me as an adventurer worth  salt. Might I ask for a moment of your time in putting a stop to evils bent on consuming the realm?
The Continental Circus, you see, has arrived once again─as it does every year when it comes time for All Saints' Wake─bringing ghosts and pumpkins and all manner of revelry to Eorzea.
I suspect, however, that the troupe is planning something rather more sinister than the distribution of sweet treats.
They're fell fiends in disguise, you understand. It's just what they do.
I have been unable to discern the nature of their vile plot as yet, but I am certain that something is afoot. Thus do I ask that you assist in my investigation.

I need you to speak with the Impresario. Learn what manner of entertainment the troupe is offering this year, and perhaps trick him into revealing something of what they're really planning. I will continue to observe the other members for any sign of suspicious behavior.
After years spent as the guild's official investigator, nothing gets past my discerning eyes. Nothing.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_020: A horrifying All Saints' Wake to you, traveler!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_021: ...But yours is a face that I have seen before. My, it is always such a pleasure to see a soul that so appreciates All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_022: Now...might this be your first All Saints' Wake? Oh, how I envy you! That you may yet experience it for the first time!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_023: Oh, All Saints' Wake! Those unhallowed nights when we may feast and frolic, free from prying saintly eyes!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_024: Mortals once feared it, it is true, hiding from the creatures that stalked the shadows. But now...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_025: Now, it is perfectly safe─all the better to cast your cares aside and enjoy the devilish surprises our troupe has prepared for the occasion!  Why, they're positively dreadful, if I do say so myse─
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: Oh, Impresario! It's dreadful! Dreadful, I say!
I raised that ahriman myself! Cared for it ever since it was a beady eye, newly torn from the Void by an unscrupulous peddler of exotic pets! And now it's deserted me! I feel so betrayed...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_028: Do you mean to say that the Circus ahriman has gone missing!? ...I suppose you do, as we've only the one.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_029: This is troubling indeed. My dear , might I ask that you aid us in searching for the missing creature?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_030: I hate to think of what might become of it, were it to be spotted by one who─er, mistook it for an agent of evil...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_032: Now, were I an ahriman─though I most certainly am not─I believe that I might find the crowds of the city intimidating. In which case, we had best turn our gaze upon the surrounding wilds instead. Perhaps the Central Shroud, to begin with─it can't have gotten far.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_INVESTIGATOR03668_0: You're on an errand for the Impresario? Well...I suppose that's one means of investigating what he's up to. Fear not─while you're gone, I will keep an eye on things here.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_050: Oh, I know you... I know you well.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_051: Well, now... I don't believe that we've met.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_052: Are you acquainted with this little one?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_053: It tells me that it's been working with the Circus, but it struggles to satisfy the Impresario's demands.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_054: Oh, sweetheart, you're not a disappointment. And your eye is charming. Yes, it is.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_055: Perhaps you are somewhat...different, but that's nothing to feel ashamed of. Isn't that right, hero?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_057: Ah, you found it! But why did the two of you not return right away?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_A1_000_001: What happened to the pumpkin-headed lady?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_A1_000_002: We were talking to someone a moment ago...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_058: A pumpkin-headed woman who disappeared without a trace? Why, you could only be speaking of the legendary leader of the armies of darkness─the Great Gourd herself!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_059: A mysterious figure who comes and goes at will? Why, that sounds to me like the ogre pumpkinhead, she who ushers in the Night of Devilry!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_060: ...I jest, of course! The ogre pumpkinhead would hardly break her silence after all of these years to speak with you!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_061: Er... What I meant, of course, is that the Great Gourd is merely a fable! If she were real, I am sure she would be delighted─no, honored─to know you! As are we all!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_062: My, you possess a spectacularly spine-chilling glare. It's enough to terrorize a voidsent! I mean...it would be. I assume.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_063: In fact... It is so very horrific that, were one seeking to train in the art of the dread gaze, there could be no better instructor─not even among fiends!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_064: And as it happens, we are in need of just such a tutor. We at the Continental Circus have standards to maintain, you see. To play a part in our troupe, one must be able to project a certain air of...eeriness. All in the name of delighting the public, of course.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_065: Alas, our friend here's gaze is somewhat...less than dreadful. Which simply will not do─particularly for an ahriman. I'm sure you understand. Under your tutelage, however, it may yet become a valued member of the Circus.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_066: Marvelous! Then it's decided. Our ahriman shall be your pupil.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: I...suppose. You will need to learn to ride it if you're to train it properly, though. Come, I'll show you.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_068: And once you mold it into a monster that inspires the deepest dread, a force for evil that renders even the most stalwart of mortals voiceless and trembling...our true work will begin!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_069: We shall usher in the Night of Devilry at long last! Recall the Great Gourd from her slumber, and feast as the world cowers before us!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_075: How is the ahriman's gaze coming along? It is chilling? Spine-tingling? Enough to kill a man from two-hundred yalms away?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: The ahriman is well trained─or at least I thought so until it ran off on me. Ahem. In any case, it ought to bear you as a passenger without objection.
I ask that you help it practice gazing upon unsuspecting fools until it gets the hang of doing so...dreadfully.
When it has learned to perform to your satisfaction, please accompany it back here to me. I should hate to be abandoned by my own ahriman. Again.
I understand that it is a bit...round, so if you fall off, return to me and I will help you reseat yourself. Now, up you go!
Taken a tumble, have you? Never you mind─I've fallen off of its head and onto mine more times than I can count! Back up you go!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_ADVENTURERA03668_00: There must be fiends around here somewhere... How am I meant to get anyone to call me “Fiendslayer” if I can't find any fiends?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_ADVENTURERB03668_00: Ugh, no one ever told me that adventuring was so tedious. And my feet hurt! And I'm hungry...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_ADVENTURERC03668_00: Another adventurer? Well, you had best find a different place to hunt. And the diremite webs are mine, got it?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_ADVENTURERA03668_00: B-Back, fiend, or you shall taste my blade!
Oh, that was...rather festive, actually? And that hat! It's fantastic!
Dear me, I had nearly forgotten that the All Saints' Wake season was upon us! Fiend-slaying can wait─I must don my guise posthaste!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_ADVENTURERB03668_00: Oh my! What an adorable giant eyeball you are! And dressed for All Saints' Wake, too!

I wish I were celebrating instead of training out here. “Slay three squirrels,” they said. “It'll be a challenge,” they said. You know what? I'm done here. I'm going back to town to stuff myself with pumpkin cookies!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_ADVENTURERC03668_00: Eurgh! Well, that was very...weird of you, but you won't scare me away from my hunting spot that easily!
Oh, you're with the Continental Circus? What a coincidence─I love All Saints' Wake! I'm out here hunting for diremite webs to decorate my cottage for the occasion, in fact.
But if the festivities have already begun... I must hurry back to Gridania! I would hate to miss a single ghost! Or voidsent! Or spider!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: You must have been terrifying─I saw three people running at such speed that they could only have been desperate to reach the safety of their homes. Extraordinary!
I'm ever-so-slightly offended that the ahriman seems to have responded better to your training than mine...but what matters is that it has proven itself useful.
We can only hope that this is enough to satisfy the Impresario. I don't think either of us could stand another lecture on the “fundamentals of fear.”
In any case, he ought to be informed of your progress immediately. He doesn't like to be kept waiting.
We will meet you at the amphitheatre─voidsent must be escorted by someone with the proper permissions to enter the city.
...And anyway, I'm not keen on letting it out of my sight again.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_130: Ah, you've returned! And how did the ahriman fare in its lessons?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: Splendidly! It sent not merely one, but three souls hastening home to quiver under their blankets. It has clearly learned to wield its dread gaze!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_A2_000_003: That is absolutely, positively what happened.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_132: Ah, but I saw them as well! All three running as if flames were licking at their heels!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_133: No need to be modest! If its gaze has become even half as horrific as yours, I have no doubt that it is capable of chilling victims to the bone!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_134: Just as I anticipated! The instant you fixed me with your stare, I knew that true evil lay within! I am delighted that you were able to share a bit of that with our ahriman.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_135: And you, young ahriman─congratulations! You have proven yourself to be a worthy member of the troupe.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_136: Go forth, and terrorize the masses!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: You traitorous little─ You want to go with ?
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_138: Hm... I'm not certain we can afford to part with such a valuable asset.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_139: On the other hand... So long as it continues to terrify, it needn't necessarily remain here to be of assistance. In fact, traveling would bring it into contact with even more victims...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_140: Very well! I am moved by your heartfelt plea, ahriman! I will permit you a leave of absence─so long as you continue to emulate your horrifying companion.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_141: Guide it well, adventurer. I look forward to seeing what horrors you visit upon the realm!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_142: My foolish children, ever eager to reclaim what was never truly lost.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_143: Its devilry takes a different form, but the night goes on─haunted by monster and mortal both.
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_PUMPKIN_000_144: And though you may think me absent, my eye is ever upon you...
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_IMPHEAD_000_150: I leave our ahriman in your sinister hands!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_BEASTMASTER03668_00: Abandoned, just like that! I can't believe it!
TEXT_FESHLW601_03668_INVESTIGATOR03668_0: You've returned at last! Did you uncover any unhallowed plots?
They attempted to train an ahriman to terrorize the populace, but it's your friend now? Well!
As long as it poses no risk to others, I don't see the harm in it accompanying you. Though I will make a note of this in the guild records, just in case.
I appreciate your willingness to get hands-on with this investigation. Speaking of which...
For my part, I have observed the troupe moving large quantities of supplies and issuing invitations to some manner of gathering.
Based on past experience, I cannot help but have a bad feeling about this...
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_IMPHEAD_000_000: Ah, my bone-chilling friend! You were so dreadfully helpful with our ahriman, I feel that I simply must repay you in kind.
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_IMPHEAD_000_001: Thus do I extend to you an invitation to our grand event─a sumptuous masquerade where you may revel to your heart's content! We have prepared a thrilling manor for our guests to explore, and all are encouraged to attend in the guise of their choice.
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_IMPHEAD_000_002: To you, however, I would offer something rather more...extraordinary. Within the manor, you will find an associate of the troupe who is frightfully well versed in the art of glamours─you will undoubtedly note his terribly convincing guise.
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_IMPHEAD_000_003: I shan't say a word more, lest I spoil the delights that await. If you would sate your curiosity, you must speak with him. Go on, now─don't delay! The genial guiser will show you to the masquerade.
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_IMPHEAD_000_010: Do speak to our associate at the masquerade─you'll feel like a whole new ! Or perhaps !
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_CLOWNGATEKEEPER_000: The Impresario's guest, correct? Come, I will escort you to the manor. Oh, and you will find our...associate...in room 108.
Come one, come all, to our marvelous masquerade! Ah─the Impresario's guest. Right this way.
TEXT_FESHLW602_03669_TRANSFORMHLW2019_00: Greetings, guest of the Impresario. Yes, I know you...
Tell me, have you ever wished to become someone else? I can do that for you. Free of charge! Ehehehe...
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_INVESTIGATOR03670_0: You're willing to help me investigate further? That's a relief! One simply cannot be too careful when it comes to the Continental Circus...

I know not whether you yourself have yet received an invitation, but the troupe is once again hosting a masquerade event in a vacant manor nearby. Now, we've received no complaints this year from those who have successfully attended this event. However...
Others have reported that they were escorted to what they assumed was the venue for the masquerade, only to find themselves pursued by fiends through the echoing corridors of a haunted mansion!

I grant that some people enjoy that sort of thing, bizarre though it may be. However, the guild would be remiss were we not to ensure that none have become lost or trapped in such a clearly unsafe location.

We can hardly ask the troupe for its cooperation in this matter, as I doubt that their intentions in terrifying unsuspecting revelers are pure. Of course, the only other option is to infiltrate the manor─and this is the course that I would ask you to pursue.

I believe that your first step should be to speak with the illusionist over there. Over the course of my observing the troupe's movements, I have seen her conversing with at least two people that would later report having been to the haunted manor.
To be quite honest, if you were to ask nicely, the illusionist might be willing to take you to the haunted manor straightaway. They're not the brightest, these fiends.
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_WITCH03670_000_020: Well, aren't you an appetizing little morsel! What can I do for you?
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_WITCH03670_000_021: You want to enter the haunted manor? Well then, of course you may! How could we refuse someone so charmingly foolhardy?
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_WITCH03670_000_022: You need only speak to one of our dear harlequin guides to be escorted to the site of your future nightmares!
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_WITCH03670_000_023: Of course, you may want to ask for a teensy little hint on how to survive, before you do... Else your mind shan't remain intact for long!
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_WITCH03670_000_024: Our manor isn't like the dreary, predictable spaces of your mundane world, you know. Oh, it has rules, to be sure─but they are fewer, and the consequences for breaking them all the greater for it...
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_SYSTEM_000_026: You now have access to the Haunted Manor seasonal instance. To enter the manor, speak with the harlequin guide in either Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_SYSTEM_000_027: The Haunted Manor is a light party instance (four players). There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESHLW603_03670_SYSTEM_000_028: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members will be filled out automatically via the matching system.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Well, what have we here? An adventurer, I presume? Why, it's a Starlight miracle─you simply could not have arrived at a better time! Oh, but where are my manners? My name is Amh Garanjy, and I have the pleasure of serving as celebrant for this year's festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Well, what have we here? If it isn't my favorite adventurer! Why, it's a Starlight miracle─you simply could not have arrived at a better time! As you may recall from our past meeting, I am Amh Garanjy, and I have the pleasure of serving as celebrant once again for this year's festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_002: As you can see, the celebration is in full swing, and I and my colleagues have once again transformed ourselves into the saint's little helpers to dole out gifts galore to the children of our fair realm.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Needless to say, there is more to Starlight season than presents and pretty ornaments. This year, we've once again decided to stage a musical performance. We will be ready to raise the curtain in a short while, and would be more than honored to have you in the audience!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_004: It is our fervent wish that the gift of song, too, serves to warm the hearts and brighten the faces of each and every young boy and girl in town.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_FESGIRL_000_005: Father! Oh Father, look! One of the saint's little helpers brought me a present!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_FESGIRLSDAD_000_006: Oho! Now, isn't that a splendid thing! And do you know what else? Mother and I have prepared a great feast for the family tonight! Let us head home as soon as the concert is over.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_FESGIRL_000_007: Will there be eel pie? You know I love an eel pie!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_FESBOY_000_008: Look! The show is about to begin!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_FESBOYSDAD_000_009: That it is, son. Word is that it's going to be even grander than last year's performance.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_FESBOY_000_010: And because you don't have to work at the markets this year, we can see it together! It's a Starlight miracle!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_011: Happy Starlight to you, child. Might I ask your name?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_NALIPPONCQUE_000_01: Huh? I...I'm Nalipponcque. What's it to you?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_013: Why, what a lovely name! You can call me Amh. Pray tell, why the long face? Was your present not what you hoped it would be?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_NALIPPONCQUE_000_01: N-No, that's not it at all. I love the stuffed chocobo the little helper gave me. T-Truly...I thank you for your kindness.
It's just that...you see, I really wish Father could be here.
Father serves in the Gods' Quiver. His name is Lartonphe. Perhaps you know of him?
Anyhow, he promised me a fortnight ago that this year─for certain!─we'd go to the festivities together. But then he was assigned to emergency duty. Ever since then, he scarcely comes home at night.
I know that these are dangerous times, and Father's task is an important one. But is it too much to ask that he could at least celebrate Starlight with his family?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_020: With the Gods' Quiver, you say? It couldn't be...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_021: Say, Nalipponcque... I have an idea. The concert will begin shortly. Why don't we watch it together?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_NALIPPONCQUE_000_02: Thank you, but I'd rather not. It wouldn't be any fun without Father, and besides...I don't care much for song and dance, anyway. Good evening to you.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_023: The poor child... As if it weren't hard enough being alone during Starlight season, it must be even more painful to be surrounded by happy families rejoicing together. If only there were something we could do to return the smile to his face.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_024: ...To tell the truth, I just had an idea. The boy said that his father is a bowman of the Gods' Quiver, did he not?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_025: As a matter of fact, a contingent from the Quiver has been enlisted to perform in our concert. It may merely be a coincidence, but I cannot help but wonder if this is the true reason Lartonphe is occupied of late.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_026: And so I ask of you, adventurer: would you be so kind as to lend your talents to help me chase the shadows from a boy's troubled heart?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_027: Thank you, my friend! The spirit of the saint truly does live on within you! A bowman by the name of Piers has been our main contact at Quiver's Hold. If there is anyone who could shed some light on the matter, it would be him.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_028: Have you spoken with Piers at Quiver's Hold? I beg of you, friend, pray help us track down Lartonphe, that we might put a smile on poor young Nalipponcque's face!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_030: I'm Piers, all right. Is there something you need?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_031: Lartonphe's boy is looking for him, you say? That's odd. It's true that our bowmen have had their hands full ensuring the city was safe and secure for Starlight season, but it's hardly so onerous a task as to keep them away from seeing their families entirely.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_032: That is, of course, unless...yes, that must be it.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_033: Allow me to explain. As you may know, the Starlight Celebration can trace its origins back to ancient Ishgard. Indeed, many of the choral tunes sung during the celebration to this day were passed down to us by their Temple Knights.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_034: To honor the tradition, we of the Gods' Quiver decided to join together with the Archers' Guild to take part in this year's Starlight concert, that we might lift the hearts of the children with song, just as our Ishgardian counterparts have done throughout the ages.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_035: Now that you mention it, Lartonphe is one of those who will be taking to the stage for the main performance. No doubt he intends to keep this a secret until the curtain rises.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_036: His mellifluous voice truly is a marvel to behold. Why, some would say he's the most talented tenor in all of Gridania.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_037: ...And his devotion to his craft is second to none. I would not be surprised if he gave the child some excuse about guard duty in order to sneak off and spend extra time rehearsing.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_038: The performance is almost nigh, yes? If you and your colleagues are concerned, I suggest you seek Lartonphe out and inform him of his boy's plight.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_039: Last I heard, he was headed to Bentbranch Meadows to reunite with his loyal chocobo, who was taken there for treatment after behaving erratically of late.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_040: On the off chance that he's already moved on, just speak with Eylgar at the stables. He's like as not to know where Lartonphe went next.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_045: Lartonphe is a passionate man in all that he does, but if there's two things he's more devoted to than anything, it's music and his feathered friend.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_EYLGAR_000_050: A quiverman by the name of Lartonphe, you say? Indeed, he left a few bells ago with his feathered friend in tow. If he hasn't returned to his post yet, I'd imagine they must have stopped off somewhere along the way.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_EYLGAR_000_051: The poor bird... She's not suffering from any physical ailment as far as I could see, and yet she's constantly crying out, champing at the bit, and stomping her feet.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_EYLGAR_000_052: I suggested to Lartonphe that perhaps the strain of recent battles is still weighing on her mind─happens to the birds just as it happens to us, you know─and that a leisurely walk through the woods might do them both some good.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_EYLGAR_000_053: Come to think of it, I remember him saying something about swinging by the Jadeite Flood on the way home. Mayhap you'd be able to find him there?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_EYLGAR_000_055: I can only hope that the soothing sights and sounds of the Jadeite Flood have helped to put that poor bird's heart at ease...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_SYSTEM_000_060: You look out far and wide, but find no sign of Lartonphe or his bird. Just as you are about to abandon hope, you make out a voice singing in the distance...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_074: Hoho! Impeccable rhythm, my friend! I knew from the day we met that you were a chocobo after my own heart!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_076: Oho, it seems we have a guest. And who might you be?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_077: ...Oh dear. It's true that I've been spending much of my time with my musical pursuits of late, but never did I think my boy would take it so hard...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_078: I truly have made a mess of things, haven't I? And at the very time of the year when the smiles of the children are to take priority above all else...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_100_078: Why, I could brighten the hearts of a hundred─nay, a thousand─children with my song, and it would mean not a thing if my dear Nali walked away with a frown!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_080: A fine bird, is she not? Aye, she is my most loyal and treasured companion. This is why I was all the more troubled when she started to behave strangely of late.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_081: And so, at the stablehand's suggestion, I took her on a stroll by the waters. Absent-mindedly, I began to hum a tune, when─wouldn't you know it─she started picking up her feet and prancing in time.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_082: That's when it came to me─she wasn't ill, nor troubled of heart or mind. Far from it─she shares my profound passion for music, and merely wanted to join me in song and dance all this time! Isn't that right, my friend?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_084: Typically, Quiver's Hold is a stern and somber place, but as the Starlight Celebration drew nearer and nearer, our halls were filled with music and song. Doubtless she's just been beside herself with a desire to partake in the festivities along with her master.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_A2_000_001: Truly a friend for all seasons!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_A2_000_002: Are you quite sure about that?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_085: In any event, never in my wildest dreams did I expect my companion to respond so enthusiastically to my humble renditions of traditional Starlight carols.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_086: ...Would that Nali felt the same way. Sadly, the boy is of an age where he's more interested in animals than in song and verse. I can only hope that seeing his father perform on the grand stage will change that...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_100_086: Oh, but the elementals take me! How soon I forget! You said my boy has already wandered away from the square, did you not!?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_110_086: Which means that he will miss my performance! He will cry into his pillow tonight, thinking that his miserable father abandoned him, and on Starlight, no less!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_088: Don't look so glum, you say? I suppose you're right. How can I hope to put a smile on my boy's face if I, myself, panic and frown?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_089: ...But I've rambled on enough already. The concert will be getting started at any moment, and my colleagues will be wondering what is keeping me. Might I ask one small favor of you before I go?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_090: Pray explain the situation to the Starlight celebrant, and ask her to seek out my boy and see to it that he attends the performance. I would surprise him with a Starlight memory that will fill his heart with joy.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_091: Thank you, my friend. You are truly a Starlight miracle in the flesh. And with that, my companion and I should be returning to the Hold. We shall see you at the concert─I trust you will be in attendance?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_PIERS_000_095: You were able to find Lartonphe, I trust? He returned not long ago. And it's a good thing, too! We were starting to worry we might have to delay the performance!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_100: Well, if it isn't my favorite little helper! How fare you? Were you able to track down dear Nalipponcque's father?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_101: ...I see. Indeed, I suspected that may well have been the truth of the matter. So Lartonphe's passion for his musical pursuits is what has kept him away from his family...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_102: I agree that a surprise appearance from his dear father would go a long way to raise the boy's spirits. Still, how are we to convince him to attend the concert? Yes, that is the rub...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_A1_000_001: He didn't seem interested in music...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_103: Indeed, he did not. There must be something the boy fancies, but what could it be...?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_104: Indeed, he sounded most pleased with his stuffed chocobo. If only there was a procession of chocobos or the like, perhaps we could convince him to attend, but I fear we have planned nothing of the sort...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_105: What's this you say? Lartonphe's companion is a chocobo that dances and sings!? How positively bizarre...er, delightful, that is! Positively delightful!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_106: If this remarkable bird were to take the stage with his dear father, no doubt Nalipponcque would be thrilled beyond belief! Why, he might even find himself enjoying song and dance as never he has before!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_107: Yes, I believe I know just what we have to do. Leave the boy to me. In the meantime, will you seek out Lartonphe once more and convince him to make his feathered friend a part of his performance? Tell him it's for his son's sake.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_110: If Lartonphe and the chocobo were to take to the stage together, I do believe it would be the boy's Starlight wish come true.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_100_120: Oh, for woe! Whatever am I to do?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_120: Forgive me, friend. I fear I find myself in the throes of desperation and despair. I had a mind to take the stage as planned, but I simply haven't the heart to do.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_121: What a fool I was! I meant to surprise the boy with a performance for the ages, but what will he think when he finds out that his father is a liar and a coward who was fa-la-la'ing when he was supposed to be protecting the people of Gridania from harm? Why, he'll never trust me again...!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_122: (-???-)What is this whinging and wallowing in self-pity!? And you call yourself a quiverman!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_123: B-Bowlord Lewin!? Wh-What brings you to this place...?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_124: I will ask the questions here, Lartonphe. Tell me: what is your sworn duty as a bowman of the Gods' Quiver?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_125: Wh-Why...of course it is to honor our pact with the elementals, to protect the Twelveswood from outside threats, and to see that not a single resident of fair Gridania comes to harm!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_126: Well, yes...I suppose that is all true. But to put it in more simple terms, one might say it is to preserve peace in the forest, and see that our citizens can live happy and contented lives.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_127: F-Forgive me, Bowlord. I do not quite understand what you are getting at...?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_MIAHMOLKOT_000_128: In other words, bringing smiles to the faces of Gridania's children is an important part of your duty to keep the peace in the Twelveswood! Do you understand meow─er, now?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_MIAHMOLKOT_000_129: We must honor the wishes of our forebears and pass them down to those who will follow in our footsteps. For it is only in doing so that we can see that the forest remains hale and hearty for ages to come.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LUCIANE_000_130: ...Interesting. Looking at you, I am reminded of my own father, once Bowlord of the Quiver in his own right.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LUCIANE_000_131: He was a passionate man─devoted above all to his duties─and I admired him more than anyone in the world. Though I did not follow directly in his footsteps, I have chosen to honor his memory in my own way─by training the brave souls who will keep our fair wood at peace.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_132: I-Instructor Molkot...and Guildmaster Luciane! Whatever has this humble bowman done to deserve this honor!?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_133: I have no children of my own, and I would be lying if I said that watching you now, even in your worries, did not evoke in me a sense of envy...and of regret.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_134: But even so, there is nothing I would rather see than a smile on the face of you and your boy. After all, it is the season for such things, is it not?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_135: And so as Bowlord of the Gods' Quiver, I command you: put your fears aside, take the stage, and serenade young Nalipponcque to your heart's content. My colleagues and I will do all in our power to see that your deeply held wishes reach the boy.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_136: Bowlord Lewin... I...I do not deserve this kindness.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_138: Ah, but there I go being all glower and gloom again. Thank you, my loyal companion─you are always there for me in my darkest times.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_100_138: And you, friend. You look as if there is something you wish to say. Do you have a proposal, pray tell, which might resolve my plight?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_139: What if I were to include my feathered friend in my performance? For Nali's sake? Come to think of it, the boy has always been fond of the birds...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_MIAHMOLKOT_000_140: His dear father and one of his beloved birds taking the stage together? Meow that's an inspired idea if I've ever heard one!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_MIAHMOLKOT_000_141: Apologies─a slip of the tongue. When I say “meow,” I mean “meow”... Grrr. Not meow─meow! ...Bah!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LUCIANE_000_142: I must say, it sounds like a foolproof plan to me as well. After all, the bird has been trained to serve on the battlefield. Surely a Starlight performance would be well within the realm of its capabilities.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_143: Then I daresay the matter is settled. I trust you have no objections, Lartonphe?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_144: N-None in the slightest, Bowlord Lewin!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_145: ...That is to say, if you do not, my fast, feathered friend. What say you? Will you do this for me and my boy?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_147: <sniff> Oh, whatever have I done to deserve such a constant companion...
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_149: <sniff> Ah, right you are. Turn that frown upside down, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_150: And with that, I have but one last humble request to make of you, friend. Would you be so kind as to conduct our forthcoming performance?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_151: While my companion here is eager and willing to ascend to the stage with me, this will be her first such endeavor. Mind you, I, too, cannot lay claim to having sung a duet with a chocobo before.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_152: Though she has only known you a short time, it is clear from the look in her eyes. She trusts you as much as anyone...her own master included. Were you to lead the performance, I have no doubt she would happily dance to your every instruction. Isn't that so?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_155: Just as I thought. So, what say you? Will you join us to make this Starlight a special one for my boy?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_A3_000_001: Let us make this a performance for the ages.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_A3_000_002: Let's just have fun up there, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LARTONPHE_000_156: Thank you, my friend! You truly are a saint. And with that, we should make for the amphitheatre. The others will want to be started any time now.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LEWIN_000_160: Does it surprise you that I agreed to be a part of the performance? Well, it should not. I have talents beyond bow-bending, after all.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_LUCIANE_000_161: None other than Bowlord Lewin himself appointed me to my post, and our guild has cooperated with the Quiver ever since its inception. This Starlight performance shall be no exception.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_MIAHMOLKOT_000_162: I'll thank you not to tell anyone that the fearless leader of the White Rams will be taking the stage this Starlight.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_170: Welcome back, friend! I see your mission was a success: Lartonphe and his charming little─or not-so-little, really─chocobo showed up not moments ago. I'm happy to report that I was also able to convince Nalipponcque to attend the show.
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_171: What's that? You'll be conducting the performance, you say? I knew you were a  of many talents, but I didn't expect you to volunteer yourself for this as well!
TEXT_FESXMS501_03722_AMHGARANJY_000_172: Still, I thank you, friend. We are ever in your debt. And with that, I do believe we are ready to get this show on the road. Whenever you would like to begin, simply speak the word.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Lartonphe and his feathered friend have finished their preparations, so we're ready to raise the curtain whenever you are!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_001: I heard the two rehearsing just before, and─without spoiling the surprise, of course─I must say, I was most impressed. For a man and his chocobo to pursue the musical arts so profoundly─all while keeping the Twelveswood safe from harm─why, it's truly an inspiration to behold!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Which is not to minimize your role in all this─heavens, no! As a humble token of our appreciation, we intend to reward you with special certificates of good cheer, which can be exchanged for a whole host of delightful seasonal goods specially procured by Black Rabbit Traders.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_003: If that sounds agreeable to you, let's get down to business─the business of putting smiles on the faces of every sweet little boy and girl in our audience.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_004: Needless to say, this means we need to be at our absolute best from the moment the curtain rises until the very last note is sung. Why, if even a single boy or girl got bored and left mid-performance, they'd have every right to revoke my Starlight celebrant credentials!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Fortunately, I can be certain that would never happen─not with an accomplished adventurer like you conducting the performance! Lartonphe has assured me that master and chocobo both are prepared to follow your every lead, so all I ask is that you keep the tempo rousing and upbeat.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_006: It would seem an enthusiastic audience has already begun to assemble. As soon as you feel ready, you need only speak to one of our two celebrants stationed nearby, each of whom has been tasked with gathering together a crowd for the performance.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_007: I should give you fair warning, however. One of my colleagues has─how shall I say it?─a tendency to be a touch overenthusiastic about things.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_008: I overheard her speaking to the spectators just before, and she was talking in no uncertain terms how this concert was sure to be “the stuff of legend” and feature “the most remarkable performers since Mih Khetto herself took the stage.”
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_009: Let it suffice to say that those in earshot of her will have high expectations for the performance, which means that there will be little room for error. Not that I doubt your ability to deliver a worthy show, of course─I simply suggest that you prepare yourself accordingly.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_010: And with that, I do believe it's time we gave our audience what they wanted. Thank you again, friend─I, too, can scarcely wait to see what you and the performers have in store for us!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_SYSTEM_000_011: Quest difficulty and rewards will vary according to which Starlight celebrant you approach.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_015: Feeling a bit of stage fright, friend? If you find yourself having doubts, just remember─it's all for the children!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LEWIN_000_021: Does it surprise you that I agreed to be a part of the performance? Well, it should not. I have talents beyond bow-bending, after all.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LUCIANE_000_022: None other than Bowlord Lewin himself appointed me to my post, and our guild has cooperated with the Quiver ever since its inception. This Starlight performance shall be no exception.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_MIAHMOLKOT_000_023: I'll thank you not to tell anyone that the fearless leader of the White Rams will be taking the stage this Starlight.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_PIERS_000_024: You were able to find Lartonphe, I trust? He returned not long ago. And it's good thing, too! We were starting to worry we might have to delay the performance!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723A_000: Finished your preparations? That's good. <sigh> I've been struggling to keep the younglings amused while they wait. Then I told them that only the most well-behaved child would receive a present, and they soon settled down. Anyway, it's about time we got started. This way, please.

Oh, it's you again this year? Very well. <sigh> The younglings are as restless as ever. I told them that if they didn't settle down, the saint's little helper would be bringing them a lump of goobbue dung for Starlight. Anyhow, I suppose we might as well begin. This way, please.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_SYSTEM_000_032: Speak with this Starlight celebrant to begin the cantabile. You will earn two certificates of good cheer for successful completion of this piece.

TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723A_000: Having second thoughts? I don't blame you. I wouldn't be caught dead up on that stage in front of all those expectant and eager faces. Oh, well...I suppose I'll just have to keep the children amused a while longer. Do come back when you've mustered the nerve, yes?

TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723A_000: Oh, that wasn't bad at all, now was it? I try not to get my hopes too high, but I'm pleased to say you surpassed my decidedly modest expectations.
There was one boy in the crowd who seemed particularly taken with the performance. Is it true that was his father up on the stage with the dancing chocobo?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_050: What a lovely performance, my friend! I never doubted you for a second. I only hope that our little friend Nalipponcque was as pleased with the performance as all the other smiling children.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LEWIN_000_051: Well? What did you think of my performance? I told you I was a bowman of many talents, did I not?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LUCIANE_000_052: To tell the truth, I was a bit anxious to take the stage, but I must say there's something positively infectious about bringing joy to others through song. I finally feel as if I understand why Jehantel chose the path he did.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_MIAHMOLKOT_000_053: I'll thank you not to ask meow to sing while I'm on duty, mind you.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_MIAHMOLKOT_000_054: Not meow─meow. Gah! Why do the words come out so much more easily when I'm singing!?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723B_000: Hark! The conductor beyond compare makes  grand entrance! The crowd can barely contain their excitement! Are your preparations complete, maestro?

Lo and behold! The conductor of legend makes  most triumphant return! Worry not, maestro─I have assured your adoring audience that this year will mark the arrival of your magnum opus! Are you ready to share the gift of your musical genius with one and all?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_SYSTEM_000_062: Speak with this Starlight celebrant to begin the capriccio. You will earn three certificates of good cheer for successful completion of this piece.

Then it shall be so! Worry not─they and I both would wait until nigh the end of time for the legendary performance you will inevitably bring to them!
