TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_SYSTEM_000_072: In the event of failure or quitting during the performance, you may attempt it again by speaking to either of the Starlight celebrants.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723B_000: Bravo! Oh, bravo! Why, it was as if the Twelve themselves descended from the heavens to grace our mortal ears with a harmony of sheer beatific bliss. No doubt our children, and their children, and their children to come will sing of the legendary performance they bore witness to this day.

Why, there was one child in particular who seemed above all to appreciate your singular genius. If I recall, they said his name was Nalipponcque, and his father was in the choir. I would be most interested to hear his thoughts on the wonders he heard.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_NALIPPONCQUE_000_09: Oh, Father! That was the best! I had no idea you were such good friends with your chocobo!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_091: Oho! Enjoyed the show, did we? I suppose all those hours your father spent rehearsing were not for naught! Ahahaha!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_NALIPPONCQUE_000_09: Rehearsing? You mean you weren't on emergency guard duty after all?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_093: I am sorry, Nali. I only meant to surprise you, but it seems my deception went too far. Can you forgive your fool of a father for saddening you...and during Starlight of all seasons?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_NALIPPONCQUE_000_09: It's fine, Father. I wasn't that sad, after all. More than that...when do I get to ride the chocobo!?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_095: Well, that depends on her, doesn't it now. What say you, my friend? Would you be amenable to giving my dear boy a ride?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_097: She says...it would be her pleasure.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_FESBOY_000_100: I want to ride the chocobo, too!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_102: She says come one, come all! The more the merrier!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_FESBOY_000_104: Your father is the best, Nali!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_107: What is it, boy? If it's within my power to grant, you need but say the word.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_NALIPPONCQUE_000_10: I was wondering...maybe you could teach me how to sing? I never enjoyed music much until I heard your voice, but...seeing you up on stage, it just looked like so much fun!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_109: But of course, my boy! Though I must say, there's really nothing to learn. Raise your voice and sing from the heart, and you're sure to bring joy to any and all who hear it! Isn't that so, my friend? Why don't you show Nali how it's done?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_NALIPPONCQUE_000_11: Ahahaha! She's singing! The chocobo's singing! I knew it─this is the best Starlight ever!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_LARTONPHE_000_120: Song is truly one of the greatest gifts the gods bestowed on us. Nothing else quite has the power to bring together people of all ages, all heritages, and all walks of life. Thanks to you, I was finally able to share my love for music with my son, and I will be forever grateful for it.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_NALIPPONCQUE_000_12: I know! Next year, why don't we sing together? That would be so much fun!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_SYSTEM_000_123: The chocobo appears to be enjoying the Starlight festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723A_000: If you haven't noticed, the audience is calling out for an encore. I told them not to get their hopes up, but if you wouldn't mind obliging, perhaps you should speak with Amh.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_COMMITTEE03723B_000: Maestro! You have heard the voices, yes? Your adoring fans are calling out─nay, desperately pleading for an encore from the depths of their souls! Surely you will not deny them your genius, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_130: To be perfectly honest, I wasn't sure what to think when a choir of bowmen took the stage, but it would seem my worries were misplaced. That was truly a most moving performance!
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_131: Why, just look at all those smiling faces! You and your friends have filled many a child's heart with cheer this Starlight. And not just that, you've brought together a father and his son...with a little help from their feathered friend. I daresay the saint himself would be proud.
TEXT_FESXMS502_03723_AMHGARANJY_000_132: You've more than earned yourself a rest, I'd say. So why not take some time to enjoy the festivities? And if you'd be willing to oblige your adoring fans with an encore before the season is through, simply say the word!
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Welcome back, friend! Might I take this to mean that you've decided to grace us with an encore? Why, it's yet another Starlight miracle! Rest assured that I myself and all the members of your chorus are ready to proceed whenever you are.
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Needless to say, your adoring fans have already assembled in droves. As soon as you're ready to take the stage, you need only speak to one of the two celebrants with whom you've already acquainted yourself.
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_SYSTEM_000_002: Quest difficulty and rewards will vary according to which Starlight celebrant you approach.
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Feeling a bit of stage fright, friend? If you find yourself having doubts, just remember─it's all for the children!
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_LARTONPHE_000_004: While I did not lack for confidence, I would be lying if I said I expected the reaction to be quite so enthusiastic. If the audience is calling out for an encore, who are we to refuse?
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_NALIPPONCQUE_000_00: You mean I can see the chocobo sing again? It's a Starlight miracle!

TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_LUCIANE_000_009: To tell the truth, I was a bit anxious to take the stage, but I must say there's something positively infectious about bringing joy to others through song. I finally feel as if I understand why Jehantel chose the path he did.

I told them that if they didn't settle down, the saint's little helper would be bringing them a lump of goobbue dung for Starlight. Anyhow, I suppose we might as well begin. This way, please.

TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_SYSTEM_000_055: The chocobo appears to be enjoying the Starlight festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_AMHGARANJY_000_060: Why, I daresay the performance was even better the second time around! Shows what a bit of seasoning can do for you, yes? Thank you for gracing us with your remarkable conducting talents once more!
TEXT_FESXMS503_03724_AMHGARANJY_000_061: Believe it or not, the audience is calling out for yet another encore. I realize that you have other commitments─saving the realm and all that─but if you would be willing to oblige them before the season is over, you need only say the word!
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_CUWMISSIONARY_000_0: Excuse me, , but are you by chance an adventurer? Yes, only one so well traveled would dress in such a peculiar manner... Though I suppose some might argue it is my garbs which make for a spectacle in these lands.
Ahem, perhaps introductions are in order before I give further offense. I am the ushi bugyo, and I am come from the Far East to share with these good people the traditions of Heavensturn.

The Eorzeans believe that, at year's end, the gods choose one among their number to serve next as a herald of good fortune, is that right? In the Far East, it is not a god, but one of twelve great beasts that is chosen.

And this year it is the mighty ushi! I believe the locals here know it as an ox? If you are unfamiliar with this most sacred of animals, you need but look upon the resplendent figure adorning my kabuto.
Indeed, Heavensturn is a most wondrous celebration, the capstone of our festivities being the pounding of rice.
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_A1_000_000: You mean mochi, yes? I've pounded my fair share.
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_A1_000_001: Rice is to be boiled, sir. Not pounded.
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_CUWMISSIONARY_000_0: Ah, a  of culture, I see. I have heard you adventurers are a worldly sort, and you are most certainly living up to your reputation.

Boiled? Surely you mean steamed. How else is it to gain its fluffy, sticky texture? It is that selfsame quality that allows us to make advent cakes. You see, once the rice is steamed, we place it into a large mortar, then beat the rice into a sticky dough. A seemingly monotonous way of cooking, but I assure you it can be quite fun, and the end result is a most delectable treat.

Wishing to make the most of this momentous occasion, we received permission from the Adventurer's Guild to have the rice pounded not by a cyclops but a Gozu, which bears a striking resemblance to the divine beast which heralds the coming year.
Everything appeared to be proceeding apace, but the pounding was set to begin ages ago, and not even a morsel of mochi has found its way here.
When last I spoke with the mochi daikan, he assured me the pounding was nearly complete. Something has gone amiss. I am certain of it.
, might I prevail upon you to go and visit the pounding site? Duty demands I remain here to inform as many as possible of the upcoming festivities.
A thousand blessings upon you. I eagerly await your return, and the delivery of our advent mochi.
Oh my. It would appear Wakamaru here wishes to accompany you.
Though but a young calf, Wakamaru is surprisingly astute. I assure you he will not be a hindrance.
The mochi daikan should be at the pounding site to the southeast of the Zephyr Gate.
The pounding site was said to be to the southeast of the Zephyr Gate. I pray your journey is an uneventful one.
You are returned. But what of the mochi daikan? And where is Wakamaru?
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: We are here ushi bugyo, and none the worse for wear, all things considered.
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_CUWMISSIONARY_000_0: Beset by sentient mochi? Having swallowed this year's reserves, mortar and all, I can but imagine what a terrible creature you faced.
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_RICECAKEREEVE_000_0: Would that this were the only time it was necessary to overcome such travails.
No doubt you remember last year's celebration of the rat, and the monster borne from the waters of Daitenzan's soulspring?
I believe a sliver of that mochi monstrosity somehow survived. How it found its way to our supplies is anyone's guess.

During last year's celebration of the rat, we thought to use the waters of Daitenzan's soulspring in the making of our mochi. Much to our dismay, this resulted in not a delicacy, but a dreadful beast unlike anything we had ever seen.
Though we thought it destroyed, I believe a sliver of that mochi monstrosity somehow survived. How it found its way to our supplies is anyone's guess.
TEXT_FESNYR701_03738_CUWMISSIONARY_000_0: But that is neither here nor there. Thanks to your efforts, the beast is no more, and we have more than enough advent cakes for our celebration!
As a small token of my appreciation, I offer you this─a kabuto much like mine own, adorned with a likeness of the majestic ox!
Ah, but before you leave... Might I be so bold as to ask a favor of you?
I wish to deliver treats to as many of the residents here in Limsa Lominsa as possible, and I suspect you know these streets far better than I.
If you are up to the task, we can discuss the details of my plan further.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_CUWMISSIONARY_000_0: Ready to deliver advent cakes to the masses, are you? Good.

The task shouldn't prove unduly difficult─I imagine the people will only be too happy to receive the treats. If you could take yourself to these four locations and hand them to passersby, that should suffice to spread word of our festivities.
And Wakamaru would accompany you once again, it would seem. Perfect. With him at your side, your intentions will be plain for all to see.
Now then, I shan't keep you any longer. Go forth and let the good people know that Heavensturn is upon us!

I trust you know these streets far better than I, but I have marked four suitable locations on your map. If you should see anyone whose curiosity is piqued by the sight of Wakamaru and your advent cakes, hand them one and move on to the next.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_000_011: , what a welcome surprise. In the company of a young calf... If you're working with the Far Eastern delegates, then I take it you have advent cakes. Might I trouble you for one?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BADERON_000_011: (-???-)R'ashaht! Shouldn't you be at yer post?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_000_012: Ah! W-Well, the lieutenant was on break, you see, and...erm...
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_000_013: ...Oh, it's just you, Baderon. I'll thank you not to startle me like that!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BADERON_000_014: Heh heh, apologies, Commander. I couldn't 'elp meself.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_100_014: What is it? Have you something on your mind?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BADERON_200_014: It's nothin', lass. It still feels strange to call ye by yer title, is all.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_000_015: What are you implying? Do you think me unworthy of my station?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BADERON_000_016: No, no. It's just...when I look at ye, I still see the spirited young adventurer what was determined to help damn near everyone as stepped in her path.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BADERON_100_016: That kind-hearted girl's still there, mind, but she's done some growin' too. I can't think of anyone better to lead the Foreign Levy. I'm proud o' ye, lass.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_110_016: I...I don't know what to say.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BADERON_000_017: Anyroad, yer handin' out them cakes, am I right? I'd be much obliged fer one.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RASHAHT_000_018: Ahem. If it's all the same to you, I ask that you keep that conversation private. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my post.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_LYNGSATH_000_031: What's this, now? Spreadin' a bit o' Heavensturn cheer, are ye? Hope that means ye've got advent cakes to share as well.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_NENEROON_000_032: Lyngsath! Neneroon was not expecting such an unexpected meeting.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_LYNGSATH_000_033: Well, well, if it ain't our trusty 'elper from last year's festival.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_NENEROON_000_034: Neneroon helped muchly, but Lyngsath's help was much more helpful. Many readers read the Harbor Herald, and many came to taste tasty advent cakes.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_NENEROON_000_035: Thanks to you, people found newfound respect for Qiqirns!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_LYNGSATH_000_036: Come now, I merely gave me honest opinion o' the food. It was yer 'ard work what won folk over.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_NENEROON_000_037: Lyngsath not credit himself with enough credit. Without your descriptive descriptions of cakes, people may never have tried them.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_LYNGSATH_000_038: Well, anyone what appreciates a good treat would've come 'round eventually, I reckon, but I appreciate yer kind words all the same.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_NENEROON_000_039: But enough talking talkatively! Neneroon would feast on feast of advent cake!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_NENEROON_000_040: Hardworking people work hard to make cakes. Neneroon think of them as Neneroon chew on chewy goodness!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_LYNGSATH_000_041: A strong sense o' duty, that one...
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_LYNGSATH_000_042: Well, I'll be off meself. Need to find a nice, quiet spot to enjoy me own morsel.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RHOSWEN_000_051: What's this, then...? Ah, right. 'Eavensturn. Let's 'ave one o' them cakes, then.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RHOSWEN_000_052: Actually, make it two. I know someone who'd be mighty sore to miss out.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_053: Ah, if it isn't the ever-ravishing Rhoswen! Come to secure some celebratory sweets, have you?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RHOSWEN_000_054: W-Wawalago! The 'ells ye doin' sneakin' up on folk like that!?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_055: Oho, I see you've not one, but two advent cakes. If I didn't know better, I'd say you were securing a snack for a significant someone as well!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RHOSWEN_000_056: Y-Ye've got it all wrong. I-I'm feelin' famished, see, an' one cake wouldn't be enough to satisfy me...
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_057: Is that right? And there I was boldly believing that one was bound for Carvallain!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RHOSWEN_000_058: N-Now ye listen 'ere! Ye say any more, an' I'll cut off yer blabbin' tongue─debts be damned!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_059: <sigh> Still fast to fly into a fury, I see... Small wonder you can't reel in a romantic rendezvous.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_RHOSWEN_000_060: Hmph! I'm leader o' the Sanguine Sirens. I've no interest in such nonsense!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_061: Such senseless stubbornness... If she's not true to her feelings, she'll never catch the fish she fancies.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_CARVALLAIN_000_062: What have we here? A calf? Ah, but of course─Heavensturn. You must be distributing advent cakes. If you have some left, I should like to have one.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_063: W-Wait, Carvallain. Someone has already come to collect a cake on your behalf.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_CARVALLAIN_000_064: On my behalf? I do not recall giving such an order to my crew.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_CARVALLAIN_000_065: Well, if it should transpire that they had the forethought to procure one in my stead, then all well and good. But until such time as this is known─a cake, if you please.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_WAWALAGO_000_066: Oh dear. A situation as sticky─though nowhere near as scrumptious─as the cakes. Speaking of which...may I have one too?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_HNAANZA_000_071: Just when I thought I heard a peculiar lowing... Brithael, come see! They're handing out advent cakes!
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BRITHAEL_000_072: Cake...? I'm afraid my stomach couldn't handle it right now...
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_HNAANZA_000_073: And there I was thinking your condition had improved.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_HNAANZA_000_074: At any rate, might I trouble you for two? One for me, and another for when his stomach's more agreeable.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_MERWYB_000_075: (-???-)I would have one as well, if I may.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_MERWYB_000_077: Well, well, if it isn't my esteemed guildmasters. Come to partake of advent cakes as well, have you?
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_HNAANZA_000_078: We have. We weren't aware you were fond of them too, Admiral.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BRITHAEL_100_078: Aye. An' busy as ye are, I thought ye would've sent someone to collect in yer stead.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_MERWYB_000_079: These advent cakes are said to bring one good fortune, are they not? I cannot well imagine good fortune would favor those unwilling to make an effort to personally receive it.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_HNAANZA_000_080: A sentiment with which we can relate, Admiral. The gods know we crafting folk are a superstitious lot.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_BRITHAEL_000_081: Aye, an' cakes aside, I've to say that just bein' out here amidst the festivities is doin' me good. My head feels clearer already.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_MERWYB_100_082: I too enjoy the opportunity to be out here alone, just another citizen, without an armed escort. Marshal Slafyrsyn will have a thing or two to say afterwards, but it is worth it.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_MERWYB_000_083: Now then, if you would be so kind...
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_MERWYB_000_084: My thanks. And now, to find a quiet place to enjoy this in peace.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_HNAANZA_000_085: We should be taking our leave as well. Thank you again for the cake.
TEXT_FESNYR702_03751_CUWMISSIONARY_000_0: Ah, you are returned, and with far fewer cakes than when you left!
In the Far East, it is said the ushi is the embodiment of honest and hard work─qualities which I see are shared by the adventurers of this land.
I have no doubt this year's Heavensturn will be a rousing success, thanks in no small part to you.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_000: My love burns brighter than the sun, and deeper than the sea. Gladly would I share it with thee, and thee, and...ooh, most definitely thee!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_001: Oh! But if it isn't a sight to set my flames of passion further alight! How fares my favorite emissary of ardor and affection?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_002: The merest glance into your eyes tells me that you are a  within whom passion runs deep. Might you be willing to serve me in my sworn quest to bring true love to pining hearts across Eorzea?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_003: Lovely! Without further ado, allow me to explain my plight. As it were, I had a mind to entrust the primary duties as emissary of ardor this year to my dearest sister Astrid. Why, if she were to rise to the challenge and prove herself my equal, just think of the unbounded love we might spread o'er the realm together!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_004: And yet, I fear my best-laid plans have already begun to go awry. Upon hearing of my decision, two of my esteemed colleagues took umbrage, believing that I was playing favorites. How could I not see, they insisted, that they would be more suited for the task than my as-of-yet-unseasoned sister.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_005: And so, on the eve of what should be the year's paramount celebration of love and romance, we find ourselves... Well, why not bear witness to this unfortunate display for yourself?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_006: Verily, these three are in need of outside intervention─someone who can convince them to put their petty squabbles aside in the name of spreading love and joy as befits the season. Someone like you, my most passionate friend! What say you?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_007: Wonderful! I knew you would never let me down. Well, then...shall we?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_008: My dearest colleagues! I would hear your thoughts on a matter of utmost importance. Pray curtail your discussion and come hither for just a moment.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_009: ...I said stop your godsdamned squabbling and get your worthless arses over here before I kick them from here to Coerthas!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_010: Ahem! Now, where was I? Ah, yes...
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_011: My beloved friends. Whatever would the illustrious Countess Arabelle think if she saw us bickering amongst ourselves like this? On the eve of the holiday honoring her most illustrious legacy, no less!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_012: And so, I would propose a solution fair for one and all. The three of you will each try your hand at easing the worries of a young man lost in love. The one who proves him or herself most suited for the task will be rewarded by being named high emissary of ardor for this year's festivities!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_013: Worry not, for it is not I who will be judging your worth.  here, an adventurer of no small renown and inimitable impartiality, will serve as arbiter for the challenge─along with the citizens of Gridania who we have traveled here to serve, of course.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_014: Surely, none of you could object to such an unbiased contest, yes? Simply think of it as an opportunity to show off your mastery in matters of love to a truly discerning audience.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_015: Leave it to me, Sis─er, Lady Lisette. I will bring the succor of love to this man's lonely heart, and show once and for all that I am your most worthy successor.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_016: A contest, you propose? Then a contest it shall be! I, Bert the Beloved, shall summon the full depths of passion from my burning heart and set this young man aflame with all-consuming zeal and ardor!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_017: ...True love cannot be achieved by spouting simple platitudes, nor by the brute force of blind passion. I will use my surpassing knowledge of the subtleties of the heart to achieve that which the two of you could scarce begin to comprehend.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_018: Such confidence! Such devotion to your duty! Why, it is enough to make a young lady swoon. Would you not agree, ? Now, then. Without further ado, allow me to introduce the subject of your first trial...
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_019: Recently, I was approached by a young man who spoke of his plight thusly: “How am I ever to find true love, if I scarce have occasion to even encounter the fairer sex?”
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_020: A most sad state of affairs, yes? Truly, my heart goes out to this poor man. And yet, surely his dark days of solitude and seclusion are over, yes? Verily, for three of the most capable and confident emissaries of ardor will now rush to his aid!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_021: ...Ah, yes. There is but one small rub. The young man in question would prefer to remain anonymous, and needless to say, we must respect his wishes. He has placed his trust in us, and it simply would not do for us to trumpet his heart's deepest desires to all and sundry.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_022: I am counting on you, dearest . Follow my dear colleagues to the man's side, witness their heartfelt efforts, and choose the one who you believe is most devoted to and capable of bringing love into his life.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_023: Now go forth to the Whistling Miller, my emissaries of ardor, and let your presence be a beacon of light to cast the shadows from the heart of this lonely young man! Should your confidence falter, remember that the Countess Arabelle is always watching over you from above!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_024: I have studied and trained harder than anyone to prepare myself for this day. I may be Lisette's own blood, but it is not nepotism or favoritism by which I was chosen for this role. I will show this once and for all!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_025: Hah! What can that wet-behind-the-ears wisp of a girl accomplish that Bert the Beloved cannot? Nothing at all, that is what! Once I assume my rightful position as this year's emissary of ardor, Gridania─nay, the whole realm─shall be blessed with the most passionate Valentione's Day in history!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_026: When it comes to matters of love, it is all too easy to lose sight of one's better judgment. This is why it is important to remain calm and collected at all times. Only I understand this─and that, I daresay, is why I am the only rational choice for the job.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_027: Go forth to the Whistling Miller, my friend! A young heart pines and yearns, and you must ascertain for me which of my dearest colleagues is most up to the task of delivering the succor of sweet affection!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_028: Ah! If 'tis not my kindred spirit in ardor and affection, the always-amorous, ever─er... Apologies, my friend. I fear I've not quite mastered my sister's rather...distinctive manner of speech.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_029: Well met, my adventuring friend! Though we have just met, I can see that your eyes burn with the brightest of passion. I am Astrid, kin to Lady Lisette and an aspiring emissary of love in my own right!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_030: I am Bert the Beloved, whose passion and fervor for matters of the heart are sung of the realm─nay, the world over! Like the brightest blaze does my heart burn, that it might kindle the romantic spirit of every soul I meet!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_031: ...Rodrigault, at your service. Since my childhood years, I have studied the art of love with a scholarly devotion unlike any other. I daresay there is not a single love poem or amorous tale that I have not read and analyzed a hundred times over. Little wonder, then, that my knowledge in the field vastly outstrips that of my peers.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_040: So you must be the yearning young man of whom Sister spoke. What troubles you this day? Open your sequestered heart to us, friend, and speak unto us your worries, that we might fill your lonely heart with the warmth of ardor and affection.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_042: Be not shy, my good man! In matters of the heart, one must be bold, lest you live the rest of your days in the shadow of those who have the courage to claim what you do not! Now then, let us know precisely that which you struggle, that we might come to your aid!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_043: ...Do not let my colleagues intimidate you. Let me, Rodrigault, know just what concerns you, and I shall use my powers of deduction to find a logical solution to your plight.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_044: (-Pining Gridanian-)...Very well. I know not what I have done to deserve your services, but I accept them with gratitude.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_045: Then let us proceed, shall we? In the name of fairness and objectivity, I propose that  here carry out the questioning. No objections, I take it? Excellent. , the subject is all yours.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_A1_000_001: What do you do for a living?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_A1_000_002: How do you spend your spare time?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_A1_000_003: What are you looking for in a partner?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_046: (-Pining Gridanian-)My profession? If it is all the same to you, I would rather keep the finer details to myself...
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_047: But of course! It is not our intention to pry. You need only tell us as much as you feel comfortable sharing, and nothing more.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_048: (-Pining Gridanian-)...Thank you. In that case, let it suffice to say that I perform a rather─how shall I put it?─physically demanding position. As such, I spend many hours of each day training my body for the task.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_049: (-Pining Gridanian-)I am not as wealthy as the merchants I often encounter in my duties, but I receive enough in the way of recompense to put food on the table. More than anything, I take pride in having earned the confidence of my subordinates and peers.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_050: A strong, confident type who holds a position of influence and commands the respect of many... I, for one, would say our man is a most eligible bachelor, would you not?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_051: (-Pining Gridanian-)Spare time is not something I possess in abundance. What little of it I have, I prefer to spend honing my body and mind that I might better perform my duties.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_052: Come now, my man! Surely there must be something you enjoy! A refreshing dip in a cold, clear stream? Afternoon strolls through the Twelveswood?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_053: (-Pining Gridanian-)Do not get me wrong─such activities sound pleasant enough. Most of all, though, it is serving the people that brings the most joy and fulfillment to my days.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_054: Now that's what I call commitment! What young lady could turn down such an earnest young man? Am I not right?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_055: (-Pining Gridanian-)To be quite honest, I cannot say I have ever given much thought to the matter...
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_056: Mind you, we speak not only of physical attributes. Perhaps you prefer a more matured, grounded individual? Someone who shares your tastes in food or drink? Any hint at all would be most welcome.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_YWAIN_000_057: (-Pining Gridanian-)I see. And yet...I am sorry. I fear nothing is coming to mind. After all, how am I to judge my feelings towards someone I have yet to even meet?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_058: ...A thoughtful and sensitive soul you are. Worry not, my friend. We shall pry no further on this matter. Thank you for your candor.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_059: Thank you very much for your cooperation, . Now, if you would just kindly wait a moment, good sir, my colleagues and I will consider your situation and endeavor to offer suitable advice.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_061: And so the battle begins! And if either of you think that I'll be showing you even the slightest mercy...you'd best think again!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_062: ...Beg pardon. Before we continue, there is something I would be remiss not to share with the both of you.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_063: There is one small truth that I have been concealing from you thus far. I am, in fact, privy to information about our client that you are not. In the interest of equity, I would share it with you.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_064: What's this!? Been sneaking around behind our backs to spy on the poor man, have we? I knew there was something shifty about you from the start...
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_065: It is nothing so dastardly, I assure you. When our masked man first approached Lisette to seek counsel, I could not help but overhear some of the rumors being spread about the man.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_066: Is that so!? Well, if you are willing to share this with us, I see no reason for us to refuse. I trust you agree, Bert?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_067: Very well. First of all, the man's claim of having the respect of his peers is no empty boast. Those who know our client speak quite highly of him as a man of integrity and honor.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_068: If there is one fault people find with him─as far as I have been able to glean─is that he can be a bit too serious for his own good.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_069: I see... That is most enlightening, indeed. Thank you, Rodrigault.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_070: Enlightening indeed! Perhaps I misjudged you, my good man. At any rate, now that all three of us have the same knowledge at our disposal, what say we begin the contest in earnest!?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_072: Very well, then! My colleagues and I will require a bit of time to ponder the matter, friend. Pray leave us be for a short while, and return at your convenience.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_090: Ah, you've returned! Curious as to what advice I intend to offer our lonely soul? I'd be happy to tell you! Put simply, he need only expand his horizons.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_091: It is clear, both from talking to the man himself and from what others say of him, that he has a sterling reputation as a leader and a strong pillar of his community.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_092: And yet, precisely because he holds a position of import and influence, it is likely not easy for him to find what he seeks at his place of employment.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_093: And yet, not having any real interests to speak of outside of his duties, our man's options are sadly limited. That is why I propose that he begin his search for his love among his clients─those who know him well enough to appreciate his strong character, but are not so close as to make such engagement uncomfortable.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_094: A most inspired idea, do you not agree? I trust I can count on your support when we take our deciding vote!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_095: Well, if it isn't the adventurer from before! Want to be the first to hear Bert the Beloved's brilliant idea, do you? Hah! I'd be happy to oblige!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_096: So we're dealing with a man who's diligent, devoted, and distinguished with regard to his duties. On the other hand, because of this, some find him something of a one-trick chocobo, as it were.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_097: And so, as I see it, the answer is clear as day: he need simply find himself a new pastime! This would afford him an opportunity to go out and meet new faces, and give him a fresh topic to broach with any special someone who strikes his fancy!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_098: As for what might be appropriate... Ah, but of course! What about woodworking? After all, there is nothing a young lady appreciates more than a man who is handy about the house, no? Talk about killing two ziz with one stone!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_099: Ah, I can just feel the flames of passion beginning to spark and sizzle! I know not what silly plans my colleagues are proposing, but I can trust you to vote for the obvious choice, yes? But of course I can!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_100: Come to hear my insight, have you? Very well. I ask you: do you recall our friend's response when we asked him what manner of individual he fancies?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_101: Precisely...he had no answer. A man who cannot answer such a simple query is a man who has lost sight of himself and what he truly seeks from life.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_102: That is why I intend to propose that our man spend some time at Stillglade Fane when he is off duty. By communing with nature, he might cast off his worldly worries and regain a sense of self, which in turn would afford him greater clarity in his pursuit of love.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_103: As devoted as the man is to his training, I have no doubt he would find himself more than up to the task of silent self-reflection. Perhaps he might even discover a new side of himself that he never knew was there.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_104: For indeed, how can one hope to truly understand and love another if one is not at peace and understanding with oneself? Yes, surely this is the best course of action for our masked man. I thank you in advance for your vote of confidence, friend.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_ASTRID_000_105: The man need only cast a wider net, and I'm certain he'll find the true love he seeks in no time at all. Surely you agree with my proposal, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_BERT_000_106: A new pastime is clearly and undoubtedly what our man most needs─and there can be none better than carpentry! Today a new bench or table, tomorrow a tryst with his new true love! Why, I can just see the flames of passion kindling before my eyes!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_RODRIGAULT_000_107: A meditation session or two at Stillglade Fane...yes, this is clearly the one true path to future happiness for our lovelorn friend. Being the intelligent  you are, surely you concur, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_110: And welcome back to you, my partner in passion! I trust that my three associates have each proposed a plan worthy of an emissary of ardor and affection?
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_111: No doubt choosing between the three will be a trying task. And yet I have naught but complete faith in your judgment. Choose the one you feel best embodies the spirit of Valentione's Day, and pray bring that individual to me. I shall be ever so tickled to see who you choose!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_112: Oh, but of course! There is one last thing. The preparations for the Valentione's Ceremony are at long last complete, and you are free to participate whenever your heart desires!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_113: What is this ceremony, you say? Why, the Valentione's Ceremony is a series of delightful trials especially devised to judge the affinity between two souls. Should you be looking to embark on a journey of love, I daresay there is no more fitting first step to take!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_LISETTE_000_114: It will be some time still before we render a decision as to who is most worthy to succeed me as emissary, so why not take the opportunity to enjoy the festivities in the meantime? I shall be oh-so-longingly waiting for your return, my dearest adventurer!
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_SYSTEM_000_115: You now have access to the Valentione's Ceremony seasonal instance! To enter the venue, speak with the House Valentione servant at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_SYSTEM_000_116: The Valentione's Ceremony is an instance designed for a party of two. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_SYSTEM_000_117: In the event that you register for the ceremony alone, your partner will be found via the matching system.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_SYSTEM_000_118: The next Valentione's Day quest may be undertaken by speaking with any one of the three aspiring emissaries─Astrid, Bert, or Rodrigault─all of whom await you in Old Gridania.
TEXT_FESVLT601_03752_SYSTEM_000_119: When you have decided which emissary most deserves your vote, seek them out and convey your support.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_SYSTEM_000_000: Please note that once you accept this quest, you will be unable to accept the quests “A Vote for Bert” and “A Vote for Rodrigault.”
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_SYSTEM_000_001: Furthermore, be aware that only votes cast during the designated voting period will count towards the final tally.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_002: I knew it! You've come to lend your support to me, have you not?
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_Q1_000_000:
You can only vote once.
What will you say?
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_A1_000_002: What is it that you propose again?
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_A1_000_003: I'd like to have a moment to think things over.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_003: Thank you, my friend─I knew I could count on you! Sister has trained me well. I am quite confident that my astute advice is just what our man needs to cast the worries from his heart and find the true love he seeks.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_004: Well, then. Shall we return to the amphitheatre and share the good news with Lisette? She will be so proud of me─of this, I am sure!
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_005: ...I understand all too well. You have only one chance to make your vote, and you would be certain it is the right one, yes? I appreciate your diligence in the matter. Put simply, I mean to suggest to our friend that he expand his horizons.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_006: It is clear, both from talking to the man himself and from what others say of him, that he has a sterling reputation as a leader and a strong pillar of his community.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_007: And yet, precisely because he holds a position of import and influence, it is likely not easy for him to find what he seeks at his place of employment.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_008: And yet, not having any real interests to speak of outside of his duties, our man's options are sadly limited. That is why I propose that he begin his search for his love among his clients─those who know him well enough to appreciate his strong character, but are not so close as to make such engagement uncomfortable.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_ASTRID_000_009: A most inspired idea, do you not agree? I trust that now I can count on your support?
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_BERT_000_010: I am not such a petty man as to begrudge you your right to cast your lot with another. But mark my words─you will regret not backing the winning chocobo when Bert the Beloved's proposal carries the day!
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_RODRIGAULT_000_011: It is most regrettable that I was unable to convince you of the merits of my case. Still, I am confident that the vast majority will see reason and cast their votes in my favor.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_LISETTE_000_020: Are mine eyes to be believed? Have you truly decided to cast your lot with my beloved sister?
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_LISETTE_000_021: Then so be it! Far be it from me to play favorites, but I must admit I take no small degree of pride and pleasure in this turn of events. Congratulations, my dear Astrid─'s vote is yours, and I daresay it will go far.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_LISETTE_000_022: Mind you, it is far too early to declare the contest won. There are countless other adventurers and Gridanian citizens who have yet to weigh in, after all. When the final results have been counted and compiled, pray speak with me anew.
TEXT_FESVLT602_03753_LISETTE_000_023: As an added incentive, it has been decided that once the victor is declared, the town will be redecorated with new ornaments of their choosing. Pray look forward to it, my dear friend!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_SYSTEM_000_000: Please note that once you accept this quest, you will be unable to accept the quests “A Vote for Astrid” and “A Vote for Rodrigault.”
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_SYSTEM_000_001: Furthermore, be aware that only votes cast during the designated voting period will count towards the final tally.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_002: Ho there, friend! I had a feeling you'd be back! I know not what the others have suggested, but there's simply no way it could hold a candle to the sheer boldness and brilliance of Bert the Beloved's advice!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_Q1_000_000:
You can only vote once.
What will you say?
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_A1_000_002: What is it that you propose again?
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_A1_000_003: I'd like to have a moment to think things over.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_003: Many thanks, my friend! I can assure you that you've chosen the winning chocobo in this race.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_004: And with that, I'd best be off to the amphitheatre to notify Lady Lisette of my forthcoming victory. You'll be joining me to celebrate, of course? Of course you will!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_005: What's that you say!? You've forgotten my infallible advice so soon? Ahaha, but I jest! Of course, I'm more than happy to expound once more if it will lead you to the obvious conclusion.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_006: So we're dealing with a man who's diligent, devoted, and distinguished with regard to his duties. On the other hand, because of this, some find him something of a one-trick chocobo, as it were.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_007: And so, as I see it, the answer is clear as day: he need simply find himself a new pastime!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_008: This would afford him an opportunity to go out and meet new faces, and give him a fresh topic to broach with any special someone who strikes his fancy!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_009: As for what might be appropriate, the answer is clear as day─woodworking! After all, there is nothing a young lady appreciates more than a man who is handy about the house, no? Talk about killing two ziz with one stone!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_BERT_000_010: Ah, I can just feel the flames of passion beginning to spark and sizzle! I know not what silly plans my colleagues are proposing, but I can trust you to vote for the obvious choice, yes? But of course I can!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_ASTRID_000_011: And here I was hoping you'd find it in your heart to vote for me. Oh, well. I suppose I can only hope that others rally to my cause.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_RODRIGAULT_000_012: It is most regrettable that I was unable to convince you of the merits of my case. Still, I am confident that the vast majority will see reason and cast their votes in my favor.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_LISETTE_000_020: Hm? Surely you cannot be serious! Anyone with half their wits about them could see that─ah...that you have deemed Bert the Beloved most deserving of your support in this endeavor!
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_LISETTE_000_021: As far as I'm concerned, the man's ideas are typically worth about as much as a sack of stale popotoes. But far be it from me to dissuade you! After all, there is a first time for everything.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_LISETTE_000_022: Mind you, it is far too early to declare the contest won. There are countless other adventurers and Gridanian citizens who have yet to weigh in, after all. When the final results have been counted and compiled, pray speak with me anew.
TEXT_FESVLT603_03754_LISETTE_000_023: As an added incentive, it has been decided that once the victor is declared, the town will be redecorated with new ornaments of their choosing. Pray look forward to it, my dear friend!
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_SYSTEM_000_000: Please note that once you accept this quest, you will be unable to accept the quests “A Vote for Astrid” and “A Vote for Bert.”
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_SYSTEM_000_001: Furthermore, be aware that only votes cast during the designated voting period will count towards the final tally.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_002: Ah, yes. I was expecting you. As a  of reason, I trust you have come to the logical conclusion.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_Q1_000_000:
You can only vote once.
What will you say?
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_A1_000_002: What is it that you propose again?
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_A1_000_003: I'd like to have a moment to think things over.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_003: Say no more, friend. You have chosen me, as any rational thinker would. There is hardly need to elaborate further.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_004: Come along, now. Lady Lisette is surely expecting us at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. You know the way, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_005: Clearly, you are not one for brash decisions. Rather, you would contemplate an issue to your satisfaction before rendering a verdict. A  after my own heart, I see. It would be an honor to share my deductions with you once more.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_006: You recall our friend's response when we asked him what manner of individual he fancies, do you not?
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_007: Precisely...he had no answer. A man who cannot answer such a simple query is a man who has lost sight of himself and what he truly seeks from life.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_008: That is why I intend to propose that our man spend some time at Stillglade Fane when he is off duty. By communing with nature, he might cast off his worldly worries and regain a sense of self, which in turn would afford him greater clarity in his pursuit of love.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_009: As devoted as the man is to his training, I have no doubt he would find himself more than up to the task of silent self-reflection. Perhaps he might even discover a new side of himself that he never knew was there.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_RODRIGAULT_000_010: For indeed, how can one hope to truly understand and love another if one is not at peace and understanding with oneself? Yes, surely this is the best course of action for our masked man. Thank you for your forthcoming vote of confidence, friend.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_ASTRID_000_011: And here I was hoping you'd find it in your heart to vote for me. Oh, well. I suppose there is still time to rally others to my cause.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_BERT_000_012: I am not such a petty man as to begrudge you your right to cast your lot with another. But mark my words─you will regret not backing the winning chocobo when Bert the Beloved's proposal carries the day!
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_LISETTE_000_020: Good gods, , anyone but─ahem! Anyone else might have been disheartened to see you stroll in with that self-important scholar instead of my dear sister. I, of course, remain ever impartial in this matter.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_LISETTE_000_021: One vote for Rodrigault it is! No doubt his dispassionate deductions were most convincing. I can only hope they satisfy our anonymous client as well as they satisfy the man who dreamed them up.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_LISETTE_000_022: Mind you, it is far too early to declare the contest won. There are countless other adventurers and Gridanian citizens who have yet to weigh in, after all. When the final results have been counted and compiled, pray speak with me anew.
TEXT_FESVLT604_03755_LISETTE_000_023: As an added incentive, it has been decided that once the victor is declared, the town will be redecorated with new ornaments of their choosing. Pray look forward to it, my dear friend!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to undertake this quest, you cannot have either of the quests “Bert's Big Idea” or “Rodrigault's Revelation” in progress.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_000: Well, if it isn't my most beloved of adventurers! You've picked the perfect time to come. Why's that, you say? Why, I was just about to announce the results of the contest and name this year's new emissary of love!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_001: So without further ado... Ladies and gentlemen, the votes have been counted, and the winner is...Astrid, and her proposal for our yearning youth to expand his search for love to new horizons!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_002: Far be it from me to take sides, yet ever since you told me that you cast your vote for my dear sister, somehow I knew she would emerge triumphant.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_003: I realize that my sister was not your first choice, but I do hope you will be so kind as to support her in her endeavors.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_004: And wouldn't you know it...there she is right now! Astrid! Oh, Astrid!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_005: Could it be? Did they truly choose me? Oh, but they did! How can I ever thank you, my friend? Without your vote of confidence to keep my hopes up, I doubt I could have lasted until this moment.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_006: Can you believe it, my friend? They truly chose me! ...Forgive me. I know that you were partial to one of my associates. Still, there will be no hard feelings between us, yes? Let us join together to bring the joy of love to Eorzea this enchanted season!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_007: As our newly crowned emissary of love, Astrid will now go proudly forth and put her carefully thought proposal into action, that one more soul in this realm may find the true love and happiness they so deeply deserve.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_008: On this momentous occasion, I would ask of you a special favor. Would you be so kind as to accompany Astrid on her adventure of the heart, that you might witness firsthand the passion of her words and the efficacy of her actions?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_009: Under different circumstances, I would perform the task myself, but given that the girl is my own flesh and blood, I fear it may be difficult for me to remain an impartial observer. You will humor me this time, will you not?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_010: Thank you for offering to accompany me, friend. It is most heartening to know I will not have to take on this imposing task alone. Our anonymous client has asked us to meet him at the amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_011: There are some preparations I must yet see to, so please go on ahead whenever you are ready. Pray take care, however, not to alert our friend to your presence. Find a suitable vantage point to watch me at work, and I shall see to the rest.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_012: Will young Astrid's carefully pondered plan succeed in bringing the succor of love to a young man's heart? Why, my heart flutters in anticipation! Pray watch over her from the shadows, and report back to me regarding all you have seen.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_020: (-Pining Gridanian-)My apologies. I hope I have not kept you waiting overlong.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_021: You are the lonely soul who sought our counsel to ease the pain of your heart, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_022: Er...yes, I suppose. My name is Ywain, and I am proud to serve as guildmaster of the Lancers' Guild.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_023: And I am Astrid de Valentione, emissary of love and ardor. Worry not, my shy and sensitive friend─no matter what depths of sadness and solitude you may have known, from this day forward your heart will be illuminated with the warmth and brilliance of love.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_024: Yes, I shall see to that. So without further ado, let us get to the task, shall we? As I recall, your plight was that you scarce knew where to begin your search for love in the first place. Fear not, for I have come to you today bearing the perfect solution...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_025: Expand my horizons, you say? Well, now that you mention it, I had plans to visit the Leatherworkers' Guild later today to deliver a shipment of animal hides...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_026: My dearest Ywain, but why did you not say so sooner? I daresay this is the perfect opportunity to take your first step on a journey to meet your destiny!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_GEVA_000_027: Well, if it isn't Guildmaster Ywain. What brings you here today? And who's this you've brought with you? She doesn't look like leatherworker material, if you ask me.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_028: Greetings, my dearest Guildmaster Geva! Many a tale have I heard of your beauty. I am Astrid of House Valentione, come to Gridania to bring ardor and affection in this, the loveliest of seasons.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_GEVA_000_029: ...Charmed. What's the meaning of this, Ywain? You were supposed to bring me a shipment of animal hides, not some melodramatic moppet. What is it you want from me?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_030: Ah, yes. I, er...was simply looking...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_031: Er, looking for love...as it were.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_GEVA_000_032: What in the─ Did you get bonked on the head by a berserk goobbue!? You know as well as anyone that I've a husband and two young ones at home!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_GEVA_000_033: Let's assume─for both our sakes─that was just an uncharacteristic attempt at humor on your part, and move right along to business. You did bring the hides you promised, didn't you─
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_MARCETTE_000_034: (-Vitriolic Voice-)What is all this blithering and babbling about!? How long do you intend to keep one of Eorzea's preeminent scholars waiting!?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_GEVA_000_035: Professor Marcette. What brings you to our humble halls today? Looking for another rare creature to use in your fieldwork?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_MARCETTE_000_036: Hmm...? You there! Yes, you with the vapid, empty stare on your face and the sack of animal hides in your meaty paw. Open that bag at once and show me the contents! Now!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_037: Me? B-But of course. These are the skins of a variety of beasts procured by members of my guild in the vicinity of the Gelmorra Ruins. I daresay there are some rare specimens among...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_MARCETTE_000_038: I do not recall asking for commentary! Have you ever heard the saying, “It's better to keep your mouth closed and let the whole realm assume you are a fool and a half-wit, than open your mouth and remove all doubt”?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_MARCETTE_000_039: Allow me to translate for your feeble mind: shut your maw, grab that sack, and come along with me, Research Assistant Seven Hundred and Eleven!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_MARCETTE_000_041: Is he talking again? Why, oh why do they insist on talking? As of today, you have the honor of joining Marcette, realm-renowned naturalist and esteemed authoress of the New Eorzean Geographic on her latest expedition into the unknown!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_MARCETTE_000_042: So do be silent and come along now, Research Assistant One Hundred and Twenty-four! And try to pick up the pace, will you? Science waits for no man, especially not some meathead like yourself!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_YWAIN_000_043: W-Wait a moment...just what is the meaning of─? I said, pray wait!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_050: Well, I daresay those two seem to have hit it off swimmingly!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_051: I do believe we can safely declare my plan to introduce Guildmaster Ywain to a potential love interest to be a resounding success. As for what becomes of their relationship from here, well...that is up to the two of them, is it not?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_052: In any event, I should be getting along─Sister will no doubt be eager to hear the results of our little operation. See you back at the amphitheatre, friend!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_053: I do hope dear Astrid's plan succeeded to her satisfaction. She did put so much of her heart and soul into this...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_100_060: Oh, there you are! I shared with my dear sister all the details of our encounter with Ywain and Marcette. Do you suppose she will deem my efforts a success?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_060: Welcome back, my beloved friend! Astrid has told me everything. To be perfectly honest with you, that was not precisely how I had envisioned everything working out...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_061: ...Which is why I seek your opinion as one who has served me loyally in the name of love. What say you? Was dear Astrid's approach worthy of the title of emissary of ardor?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_A1_000_002: It's a start, is it not?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_062: 'Tis a fair assessment, indeed. For as emissaries, all we can do is point two potential lovers in the same direction. Whether or not they choose to walk the path of passion together is up to them, and them alone.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_063: 'Tis a fair assessment, indeed. After all, when the poor man first came to us, he hadn't the slightest notion of where to even begin searching for love. Now, he has met an intelligent woman who, ah...clearly appreciates his diligence and devotion.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_064: Tee hee! You are truly a sensitive soul, friend. And yet, let us not jump to conclusions. There is many a happily married man who is all too happy to be forever at his beloved's beck and call! Perhaps our Ywain is no different?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_065: At any rate, I do believe I have heard all I need to render my verdict. Hear me, Astrid. By the powers invested in me by my forebears, I, Lisette de Valentione...
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_066: ...Do hereby declare you a full-fledged emissary of ardor! Oh, congratulations, my dear! How long I have waited to say those words!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_067: And with that, I have no qualms whatsoever placing the full of this year's Valentione's Day proceedings under your charge.
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_LISETTE_000_068: Well, Astrid? How does it feel to rise to the occasion? Have you aught to say to the sweet adventurer who made this occasion possible?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_069: B-But of course! Thank you! Thank you oh so much from the deepest, most boundless depths of my heart!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_070: I promise the both of you that the festivities will not end until I and my assistants have done all we can to aid every yearning soul in their quest for companionship!
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_071: So please, my friend, do enjoy yourself and─ah, er...that's right. How did it go again?
TEXT_FESVLT605_03756_ASTRID_000_072: ...Ahem. My love burns brighter than the sun, and deeper than the sea. Gladly would I share it with thee, and thee, and...ooh, most definitely thee!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to undertake this quest, you cannot have either of the quests “Astrid's Acumen” or “Rodrigault's Revelation” in progress.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_000: Well, if it isn't my most beloved of adventurers! You've picked the perfect time to come. Why's that, you say? Why, I was just about to announce the results of the contest and name this year's new emissary of love!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_001: So without further ado... Ladies and gentlemen, the votes have been counted, and the winner is...Bert, and his proposal that our yearning youth, er...take up woodworking!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_002: A very...creative solution, to be sure. That said, from the moment you told me that Bert's proposal had your support, I had a feeling that somehow he would emerge the victor.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_003: I realize that Bert was not your first choice─to be quite honest, nor was he mine─but I do hope you will be so kind as to support him in his endeavors.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_007: And wouldn't you know it...there he is right now! Bert! Oh, Bert!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_008: Oho! If it isn't the insightful adventurer who was the first to throw  support my way! To the surprise of neither of us, I'm sure, Bert the Beloved's flawless proposal has carried the day!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_009: Oho! Color me entirely unsurprised, for Bert the Beloved's flawless proposal has carried the day! Don't beat yourself up too much for supporting one of my vanquished foes, friend. I still welcome your assistance in any way you'd care to give it!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_010: As our newly nominated emissary of love, Bert will now go proudly forth and put his, er, rather bold proposal into action, that one more soul in this realm may find the true love and happiness they so deeply deserve.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_011: On this momentous occasion, I would ask of you a special favor. Would you be so kind as to accompany my associate on his adventure of the heart, that you might witness firsthand the passion of his words and judge the efficacy of his actions?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_012: Under different circumstances, I would perform the task myself, but given my own preconceptions about the man, I fear it may be difficult for me to remain an impartial observer. You will humor me this time, will you not?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_013: I have already reached out to our client, and he has agreed to meet me at the Carpenters' Guild. Clearly, he is as eager to see my plan come to fruition as I am!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_014: You are welcome to a front row seat at my certain-to-be-masterful performance as well. Just promise that you will not get too close. You wouldn't want to upstage the star of the show, of course. Now, come along!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_015: Will Bert's bold-faced plan succeed in bringing the succor of love to a young man's heart? Why, my heart flutters in anticipation! Pray watch over my associate from close by, that you might report back to me regarding all you have seen.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_020: (-Pining Gridanian-)My apologies. I hope I have not kept you waiting overlong.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_021: Oho! So our mysterious masked client finally removes his cover! And you would be...?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_022: Ywain, Guildmaster of the Lancers' Guild. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_023: A pleasure, indeed! And I am Bert the Beloved, aspiring emissary of love and the hero who has come to help you tap into your true passion and claim the love you so clearly deserve! And now, allow me to elaborate on how we will do precisely that!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_024: Take up a hobby, you say? Well, I do suppose that might afford me the chance to meet new people... But what manner of pastime would you propose?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_025: My good man, I thought you'd never ask! Take a look around you─do you not see where we now stand?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_026: The Carpenters' Guild? Do you mean to suggest I should take up...woodworking?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_027: You've hit the nail straight on the head! What else but woodworking? Not only is it a most virile and masculine activity fitting your ample physical prowess, it is sure to charm any lady searching for a man who pulls his weight around the house!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_028: Hmm. I cannot believe I am saying this, but...you may very well have a point.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_029: But of course I do! You'll be pleased to know that I've already worked out the details of your apprenticeship with Master Beatin. All you need do is stride through those doors, declare your arrival, and you'll be hammering and sawing in no time!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_030: Master Beatin! It is I, Bert the Beloved, come with the new apprentice I promised you!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_031: Yes, yes...no doubt another wide-eyed young fool who doesn't know a hatchet from a─Guildmaster Ywain!? You are my new pupil?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_032: What in the Twelve's name are you thinking? Did you get bopped on the head by the butt of a lance? I'm a busy man. I don't have time to entertain wayward warriors who want to play at woodworking...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_033: I...I assure you, Master Beatin, that I am quite serious about this endeavor.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_034: For I am...how shall I say it? Looking to better understand love, er...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_035: Eh, what's that you say? Looking to understand lumber...?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_036: Could it truly be? Have I misjudged you all these years? Here, I thought you a thick-headed warrior, when in fact you were a sensitive soul! A kindred spirit who marvels at the majesty of oak─revels in the resilience of rosewood...!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_037: Ah, forgive me, Master Beatin. It appears you misheard him. What Master Ywain's actually looking for is─
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_038: Well, why didn't you say so sooner, my boy!? My fellow guildmaster, a man after my own heart! Come, and I shall teach you to become one with the wood! To know every nook and cranny of every tree in the Twelveswood!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_039: Yes, when I am through with you─and mind you, I will not rest until I have imparted all of my knowledge─you will understand the mighty trees from which your precious weapons are crafted as well─nay, better!─than you know how to wield them!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_YWAIN_000_040: I... I thank you, Master Beatin, but that was not quite what I had in─
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_041: Be not shy or afraid, my boy! The trees of the Twelveswood welcome you with open arms!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BEATINE_000_042: Now come this way, my compatriot in carpentry... The wondrous world of all that is wood awaits you!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_050: I had heard the rumors of Master Beatin's boundless enthusiasm, but I must admit that turn of events caught me somewhat by surprise...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_051: Why, I daresay the man's sheer passion nigh outstrips my own! At least when it comes to wood, that is. I do hope Guildmaster Ywain was not too overwhelmed.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_052: Still, our man was looking for an encounter full of ardor and affection, and he has certainly found one! For who is to say the man's meeting must involve the fairer sex? Man, woman, wood...in matters of the heart, I daresay the difference is immaterial.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_053: At any rate, Lady Lisette is surely beside herself waiting to hear word of my inevitable rousing success. Let us go together and share the triumphant tidings!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_054: I do hope Bert's plan succeeded to our client's satisfaction. Why, I simply couldn't forgive myself if I allowed that overbearing fool to tarnish the good name of House Valentione...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_100_060: You arrive at last, my friend! Rest assured that I have shared with Lady Lisette all the details of Ywain's encounter with Master Beatin. No doubt it is but a matter of moments until she declares my effort a resounding success.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_060: Welcome back, my beloved friend! Bert has told me everything. To be perfectly honest with you, that was not precisely─or to be honest, not at all how I had envisioned everything working out...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_061: ...Which is why I seek your opinion as one who has served me loyally in the name of love. What say you? Was Bert's unusual approach worthy of the title of emissary of ardor?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_A1_000_001: That depends on the two of them...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_A1_000_002: It's a start, is it not?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_A1_000_003: There are many types of love...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_062: I suppose you are right. Their relationship now might simply be one of master and student, but when two men bond over a love of wood, who knows what sparks might fly, and what passions may yet be kindled?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_063: Indeed it is. After all, until today poor Ywain scarcely spoke with anyone but stoic soldiers not unlike himself. Now, he has found a kindred spirit with whom he might bond over a love for the natural world around him. Who am I─or anyone─to say where this might lead?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_064: Do you mean to say that our friend Ywain might, like Master Beatin, find his love for trees transcends all? I am not certain that is the sort of ardor we should be encouraging, but still...I suppose a passion for wood is better than no passion at all.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_065: At any rate, I do believe I have heard all I need to render my verdict. Hear me, Bert. By the powers invested in me by my forebears, I, Lisette de Valentione...
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_066: ...Do hereby declare you a full-fledged emissary of ardor! Congratulations, my young associate! I can quite honestly say I never expected to see this day.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_067: And with that, I have no qualms whatsoever placing the full of this year's Valentione's Day proceedings under your charge.
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_LISETTE_000_068: Well, Bert? How does it feel to rise to the occasion? Have you aught to say to the darling adventurer who helped make this occasion possible?
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_069: Thank you, friend! I'd be lying if I said I couldn't have done it without you─the results were quite decisive, after all─but nevertheless I most appreciate you tagging along every─well, almost every step of the way to offer your support!
TEXT_FESVLT606_03757_BERT_000_070: ...And with that, if you'll excuse me, I do believe I have a job to do. You! Yes, you! Over there! Do you truly expect to find true love looking like that!? Let Bert the Beloved show you how it's done and set you on a course for destiny!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to undertake this quest, you cannot have either of the quests “Astrid's Acumen” or “Bert's Big Idea” in progress.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_000: Well, if it isn't my most beloved of adventurers! You've picked the perfect time to come. Why's that, you say? Why, I was just about to announce the results of the contest and name the nominee for this year's new emissary of love!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_001: So without further ado... Ladies and gentlemen, the votes have been counted, and the winner is─well, this is a surprise─Rodrigault, and his proposal that our yearning young man seek love by first finding himself through meditation!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_002: A rather unique approach, to be sure. That said, from the moment you told me that Rodrigault's proposal had your support, I had a hunch that he might somehow emerge the victor.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_003: I realize that Rodrigault was not your first choice─to be quite honest, nor was he mine─but I do hope you will be so kind as to support him in his endeavors.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_007: And wouldn't you know it...there he is right now! Rodrigault! Oh, Rodrigault!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_008: It would appear that my proposal was the top vote-getter. But of course, that should come as little surprise to rational minds like ours, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_009: It would appear that my proposal was the top vote-getter. I trust that after having had some time to consider the matter, you too see why this is the only logical result.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_010: As our newly nominated emissary of love, Rodrigault will now go proudly forth and put his, er, rather atypical proposal into action, that one more soul in this realm may find the true love and happiness they so deeply deserve.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_011: On this momentous occasion, I would ask of you a special favor. Would you be so kind as to accompany my associate on his adventure of the heart, that you might witness firsthand the accuracy of his analysis, and fairly judge the efficacy of his actions?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_012: Under different circumstances, I would perform the task myself, but given my own preconceptions about the man, I fear it may be difficult for me to remain an impartial observer. You will humor me this time, will you not?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_013: I have asked my client to meet me just west of the amphitheatre. Pray come along. You might learn a thing or two about the importance of keeping a cool head when faced with the heat of passion.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_014: You may go on ahead now, if you wish. I will be along once I have seen to the necessary precautions and preparations.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_015: Will Rodrigault's bold-faced plan succeed in bringing the succor of love to a young man's heart? Why, my heart flutters in anticipation! Pray watch over my associate from close by, that you might report back to me regarding all you have seen.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_YWAIN_000_020: (-Pining Gridanian-)My apologies. I hope I have not kept you waiting overlong.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_021: A touch, mayhap, but think nothing of it. Guildmaster Ywain, I presume? I am Rodrigault, the emissary come to resolve once and for all the needless worries that plague your heart.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_022: Your plight─as I understand it, and understand it well─is that you feel you have not been afforded sufficient opportunity to find yourself a suitable partner. I, however, would propose that the source of this lies not without, but within...
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_YWAIN_000_023: You suggest that I meditate with the Hearers of Stillglade Fane in hopes of...finding myself?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_024: ...Precisely. Before a man can truly know and love another, he must know himself, and I fear I felt no small degree of doubts from the way you expressed yourself to my associates before.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_025: Never fear, however, as I have already made the necessary arrangements. E-Sumi-Yan assures me that by the time your instruction is through, you will be at peace with yourself not unlike how your Hearers are with the keepers of the forest. Now come along.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_ESUMIYAN_000_026: You must be Rodrigault. We have been expecting you. Now tell me, who is the wayward child you have brought to us tod─hm?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_ESUMIYAN_000_027: Guildmaster Ywain? I must say, you are among the last individuals I would have expected to see here today.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_ESUMIYAN_000_028: ...Which is not to say you are unwelcome here, of course. Tell me, my friend, what troubles your heart this day?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_YWAIN_000_029: Well, it is...how shall I put it?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_YWAIN_000_030: I have─in a manner of speaking, that is─come to gain a better understanding of love.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_ESUMIYAN_000_031: Love, you say? Why, yes...there can be no doubt that love is a powerful force indeed. After all, it is through our love of nature and the world around us by which we are granted the powers we wield.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_ESUMIYAN_000_032: Very well, my friend. Take a sedentary position, and let us begin to meditate. Before long, your eyes will be opened to the glory and grandeur of nature, and it will only be a matter of time until love fills your─
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_033: (-Girl's Voice-)...Brother E-Sumi. Somehow I don't think that's the kind of love your friend is seeking.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_ESUMIYAN_000_034: Sylphie! Don't sneak up on me like that! And...whatever are you suggesting?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_035: I'm saying that your friend here isn't looking to nurture a love for nature. He's looking for a more tangible sort of love. The kind you can hold...and touch.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_YWAIN_000_037: O-Old...? I'll have you know, I've seen but thirty-odd summers─
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_038: There's no need to protest. It is hardly a sin to seek companionship, after all. But if you want my advice...if you are truly committed to this cause, you could start by doing something about that outfit.
