TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_039: Surely you have to admit that it's a little bit...drab, don't you think?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_040: And after that─<sniff> <sniff>─excuse me, but have you been hunting in the wood? Because you reek ever so faintly yet distinctly of goobbue dung.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_041: ...Trust me when I say that meditation is the last thing that will help you. Come with me, and I'll teach you all you need to know about wooing the fairer sex.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_SYLPHIE_000_042: First on the agenda is a nice hot bath to get the stink off you. Following that, a trip to the markets to pick out some new garb that isn't caked in sweat and grime. Well? What are you waiting for!? With me, now!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_050: I know what you are thinking, friend. You are thinking that my plan was utterly and positively thwarted by the girl. Ah, how little you understand...
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_051: I never presumed to think that Ywain's meditation session would be carried out to its conclusion, oh no. It was simply part of my plan to set the pendulum in motion, that fate may carry our friend where it may.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_052: ...And where it has carried him is directly into the company of a most fetching young lass. A remarkable success, would you not say? Now come. Lisette will want to hear all about my success, and with all haste.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_053: I do hope Rodrigault's plan succeeded to our client's satisfaction. Why, I simply couldn't forgive myself if I allowed that self-styled, self-serving scholar to tarnish the good name of House Valentione...
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_100_060: I have already enlightened Lisette as to the precise manner in which my plan succeeded resoundingly. Let us await her verdict with the utmost of confidence.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_060: Welcome back, my beloved friend! Rodrigault has told me everything. To be perfectly honest with you, that was not precisely─or to be honest, not at all how I had envisioned everything working out...
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_061: ...Which is why I seek your opinion as one who has served me loyally in the name of love. What say you? Was Rodrigault's unusual approach worthy of the title of emissary of ardor?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_A1_000_001: That depends on the two of them...
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_A1_000_002: It's a start, is it not?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_062: Indeed...I suppose it does, my friend! After all, if young Sylphie provides the guildmaster with the wisdom he needs, and he proceeds to take it to heart, there is no telling how charming and handsome of a gentleman he might become!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_063: ...I suppose you are correct. Guildmaster Ywain was looking for a new encounter. While young Sylphie might not be suitable as the object of his affections, perhaps this meeting can be the spark that leads to a change in the man's romantic fortunes.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_064: Why, ─that is no way to talk about a man who has set aside his pride to seek our counsel! Though, to be fair, I could not help but take notice of his distinctive odor myself. Perhaps his meeting with young Sylphie was for the best, after all?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_065: At any rate, I do believe I have heard all I need to render my verdict. Hear me, Rodrigault. By the powers invested in me by my forebears, I, Lisette de Valentione...
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_066: ...Do hereby declare you a full-fledged emissary of ardor! Congratulations, my young associate! I cannot say I expected to see this day, but I welcome it with open arms and a warm embrace!
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_067: And with that, I have no qualms whatsoever placing the full of this year's Valentione's Day proceedings under your charge.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_LISETTE_000_068: Well, Rodrigault? How does it feel to rise to the occasion? Have you aught to say to the darling adventurer who helped make this occasion possible?
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_069: You have my gratitude, friend. While I still believe my selection was a most logical conclusion, I will admit that I still have much to learn about the art of love, and the task of spreading ardor across the hearts of the realm. Pray rest assured I will approach my new duties with due diligence.
TEXT_FESVLT607_03758_RODRIGAULT_000_070: At any rate, why not take some time to enjoy the festivities? I daresay you've earned it. As for me, I suppose I shall be off in search of other hearts to mend. Till we meet again!
TEXT_SUBCTS502_03759_OLDPERSON03759_000_: Ah! Nothin' like starin' out at the sea to bring an old man back to his glory days. Aye, the good ol' times when his whole life still lay ahead of him, and the greatest adventures were yet to be...
...Gah! Don't ye know better than to sneak up on your elders like that, young'un? Are ye tryin' to send me to an early grave? Well, not early, as such...

But don't tell me...aye, I can see it just from the look o' you. You're an adventurer, an' an accomplished one at that, yes? Aye, ye may not be the greybeard I am, but I reckon you've a memory or two you'd be keen on rememberin'.
So what say ye join me for a while before ye return to the road? After all, sometimes reflectin' on the past can be just what you need to discover the path ye'd forge into the future.
TEXT_SUBCTS502_03759_SYSTEM_000_004: You now have access to the New Game+ system. New Game+ allows you to relive the adventures of your past by replaying previous quests with your current character data.
TEXT_SUBCTS502_03759_SYSTEM_000_005: To replay old quests with New Game+, open the New Game+ interface located under Duty in the main menu, and select the chapter you wish to experience anew.
TEXT_SUBCTS502_03759_SYSTEM_000_006: Please note that special rules and conditions will apply when replaying quests with New Game+. For detailed information, please review the help text in the New Game+ menu.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_000: , ever a sight for sore eyes! What brings you here this day? Are you come to see our progress, or perhaps to contribute to it?
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_001: In any case, I owe you a debt of gratitude. Thanks to able and willing helpers such as your good self, the reconstruction effort proceeds apace. This court has fairly been reborn, I believe you will agree.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_AUGEBERT_000_002: Oi, Francel. I've finished my checks, and everything looks to be order. That's that for the court, I reckon.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_003: Glad am I to hear it. This is a momentous step in our project─one we could not have taken without the aid of Ishgardians and outsiders alike.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_AUGEBERT_000_004: Aye. At last, we've got a flow of materials comin' in, along with the hands to put it all to use. It begins in earnest.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_005: That it does, my friend. That it does.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_006: , Augebert. There is something I would ask of you.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_007: I bid you commit to your mind's eye the Firmament as it is now.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_008: When the last paving stone is laid, I would have you fully appreciate how much has been accomplished by the sweat of innumerable brows.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_009: For though Ishgard may arrive at a brighter future, we must never forget the path we walked to get there, fraught with sorrow and sacrifice as it was.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_010: If we do so, I fear we will lose our way again.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_AUGEBERT_000_011: Heh, same old Francel, though, eh? Try to unclench that jaw of yours a little, lad, else you're liable to give yourself a fever and collapse like you used to.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_012: Those days are long past, thank you very much!
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_013: <sigh> Just...remember what I asked. And pray keep it private. 'Tis a personal request to the two of you.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_AUGEBERT_000_014: Don't worry, you know I ain't no gossipmonger. Now then, if there's nothing else, I'll get back to it.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_015: All right, my friend. Take care you do not overwork yourself, and tell the others the same.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_016: Well, there you have it, . There will be a brief hiatus while we prepare for the next phase of construction. When all is in readiness, I shall make another announcement.
TEXT_LUCKHA002_03760_FRANCEL_000_017: In the meantime, do rest and recover your strength. 'Twas good to see you again.
TEXT_LUCKHA011_03841_AUGEBERT_000_000: It's completed, ! The New Nest! Ain't it a thing of beauty?
TEXT_LUCKHA011_03841_AUGEBERT_000_001: We're makin' faster progress than I'd dared to hope, and it's thanks to good folk like yourself.
TEXT_LUCKHA011_03841_AUGEBERT_000_002: As you know, the area's to be a residential quarter for Ishgardians, with them as lost their homes in the war given priority.
TEXT_LUCKHA011_03841_AUGEBERT_000_003: That's ever been Francel's first objective in all this─makin' it so no more citizens are freezin' or starvin'.
TEXT_LUCKHA011_03841_AUGEBERT_000_004: Goes without sayin' that we'll keep on needin' supplies. So keep 'em comin', eh?
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_0: I have to say, that was a most exhilarating battle! I never dreamed that I would have the chance to see such a ferocious warmachina with my own eyes!

You might find it odd that a citizen of Eorzea would be so excited by something sent by the Garleans to slaughter us in our thousands, but as an avid follower of all things gigantic and mechanical, I just can't help myself!

Oh, to be able to pilot such a majestic creation... Perhaps I should defect to the Empire and offer my services. Ahem! Ever since the time of the original Ultima Weapon, I have fallen in love with this fusion of Allagan and Garlean design. It takes my breath away!

So much so, that I used my spare moments at the Ironworks to develop a line of miniatures! And now, your recently vanquished foe shall be the inspiration for my next endeavor. Would you do me the honor of casting your gaze across the piece once it is complete?
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_A1_000_001: If that's what it takes to shut you up.
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_A1_000_002: Don't blame me if I smash it to smithereens.
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_0: Hmm? Did you say something? Whatever it was, I'm sure you were offering heartfelt words of encouragement! It's the support of fans such as yourself that make this such a worthwhile hobby.
I'm proud to say my work adorns the homes of many like-minded machina lovers. The Ultima Weapon and magitek reaper miniatures, to name but two of my creations, are especially popular.
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_1: Of course, I wouldn't be much of an engineer if I only made inanimate ornaments!
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_2: Behold! I have restored this Allagan relic, added a few flourishes of my own, and dubbed it the Real Virtuality Combat Simulation Experiencinator!
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_3: By feeding it various pieces of data, such as images of my replicas and so on, it is able to recreate a range of combat scenarios. For research purposes, of course. Not entertainment, oh no!
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_4: I can see you're practically champing at the bit to give it a try. There's no stopping you intrepid adventurer types!
TEXT_LUCKYB007_03842_WEAPONSGIENGINEER_0: It won't be long until my latest work is complete. All that remains are one or two final adjustments, so don't go anywhere!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Come one, come all! For Hatching-tide is upon us once more!
Well, if it isn't ! Back to enjoy the festivities for another year, are we? I could not be more pleased to welcome you once again.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Hm? Do you not recognize me? It's me, your old friend Jihli Aliapoh!
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)My name is Jihli Aliapoh, and it's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. No doubt you're wondering why I'm dressed the way I am. But do not worry─all will be clear in due time.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Now, don't tell me... You are an adventurer, yes? Well, you certainly have the inquisitive nature of one, at any rate! May I ask your name?
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Well then, , I should probably mention that Hatching-tide all began with a vision I had before the Seventh Umbral Calamity, in which the Twelve Archons delivered unto me a message.

(-Jihli Aliapoh-)From atop their giant, decorated eggs they called to me: “Arise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessels for our return.” When I awoke, I quickly set about filling the realm with all manner of painted ovoids. And thus did this joyous yearly celebration come to be!

(-Jihli Aliapoh-)And before you ask─yes, this costume is the result of yet another vision. I but recently dreamt that a veritable horde of hippity, hoppity rabbits descended on the realm for Hatching-tide, delighting children far and wide with their button-cute noses and cotton-white tails.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)“Why rabbits?” you may ask, and the question is a valid one. After all, rabbits do not lay eggs, nor are they traditionally associated with the Archons in any particular way.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)Unfortunately, I have no answers to that question. And yet, so vividly do I remember the smiles on the faces of each and every youngling in my dream that I swore I would bring this vision of Hatching-tide to life. Might you be so kind as to lend me a hand?
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_A1_000_002: I can find no eggscuse not to...
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)Oh, thank you, my friend! With your aid, I have no doubt that this year's incarnation of Hatching-tide will be the most exciting and extravagant yet!

(-Jihli Aliapoh-)And so, without further ado, I would encourage you to seek out my associate Nonotta near the Carline Canopy. She will be most happy to enlighten you as to how you might assist us in making this year's festivities something to remember!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_050: The happiest of Hatching-tides to you, my dear!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_052: (-Nonotta-)I may have more fur and whiskers than usual, but I can assure you that it is me inside this most charming costume. Nonotta, that is.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_053: (-Nonotta-)You recognized me? Oh, how astute you are, my adventuring friend! Indeed, it is none other than I─Nonotta!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_054: (-Nonotta-)Greetings, my adventuring friend! I trust you are enjoying the festivities? Jihli and I have spared no effort or expense to make this year's Hatching-tide the best Eorzea has seen!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_055: (-Nonotta-)Now, pray tell, what might I do for you?
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_056: (-Nonotta-)Come to help with the festivities, you say? Your presence is most welcome, and then some! Jihli and I have our hands─or should I say paws?─full here, and we would be most indebted to you for your assistance.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_057: (-Nonotta-)Allow me to explain. In the hopes of turning this year's Hatching-tide into a true event for the ages, we scoured the realm and procured a host of chickens that would lay for us the most remarkable eggs.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_058: (-Nonotta-)Sadly, the other day, I got distracted for a moment and neglected to properly shut the door to the storehouse where we were keeping them. Before I knew it, the birds had all flown the proverbial─or literal, in this case─coop.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_059: (-Nonotta-)Needless to say, without our hens, there can be no eggs. And without our eggs, there can be no Hatching-tide! Surely you can see our plight? And so I beg of you, my friend: please go out there and catch our precious birds before they are swallowed up by the beasts that prowl the wood.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_060: (-Nonotta-)I have but one more small request for you, and that is that you don one of these lovely rabbit suits and wear it while you go about the deed. Why, you ask? Let it suffice to say that Jihli's visions have never led us astray before, and I do not expect this to change.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_061: (-Nonotta-)You may be skeptical now, but believe me─once you put it on, you'll not readily want to part with it. And that's why I'm happy to say that we will be happy to gift one to you in commemoration of your efforts should you see the task through to completion!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: Did you manage to speak with Nonotta? If you can't find her, remember: she should be dressed not unlike I am.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_100: Oh, friend! You must track down our precious chickens! Our painstaking preparations for this year's Hatching-tide will be all for naught if you cannot!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_150: Welcome back, friend! I'm pleased to inform you that we've counted our chickens, and they've all safely returned to the coop! Truly, you have done us─no, all of Eorzea─a great service this day.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_151: And without further ado, I must report back to Jihli and share these good tidings. If you have no other pressing matters, pray join me. I'm quite certain our lead celebrant will want to offer her thanks in person.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: Nonotta! And ! I hear that─in no small part thanks to you─our most confounding chicken conundrum has been solved.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_A3_000_001: I found your chickens, all right.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_A3_000_002: Eggceptional work, if I do say so myself.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: Indeed, you have performed a most eggceptional service for us here today! Yes, you are truly a pareggon among adventurers! An eggsemplar of─ahem, forgive me.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_20: Yes, you are truly a pareggon among adventurers! An eggsemplar of─ahem, forgive me.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: At any rate, thanks to you, we can at long last begin the festivities in earnest! Let the curtain rise on a Hatching-tide to remember!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_204: As promised, you will now be rewarded with a stylish rabbit costume of your very own.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_205: We'd be most eggpreciative─ah, that doesn't quite work, does it?─if you could don it for the duration of the festivities to add an extra touch of charm and delight to the celebration.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_206: And with that, I had best get back to my post before the chickens run off again!
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_20: Don't tell Nonotta I said this, , but I am counting on you as much as anyone to make this year's Hatching-tide a resounding success. Promise that you won't go far, will you?
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_SYSTEM_000_300: This marks the conclusion of the first quest for this year's Hatching-tide. For details on when the second quest will be available, please check the Lodestone.
TEXT_FESEST601_03846_NONOTTA_000_210: I can't thank you enough for returning our chickens, friend. Jihli is positively overjoyed to know that the festivities will be able to go on just as she envisioned them!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: A happy Hatching-tide to you, my friend!
Thanks in no small part to your efforts, every last one of our egg-laying assets has been returned to us, and the festivities are in full swing!

As we speak, Nonotta is preparing for the highlight of this year's event: a grand procession in which a host of individuals dressed as rabbits will parade through the streets, handing out exquisitely decorated eggs to the children of the city.
Doesn't that sound like fun? If you'd care to join us─and we'd be most appreciative if you did─pray seek out Nonotta. My colleague would be more than happy to fill you in on the details!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_050: A happy Hatching-tide to you, friend! How do you fare on this most eggstravagantly eggciting of days!?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_052: Indeed! And why wouldn't you be? As you can see, the Hatching-tide festivities have gotten off to a rousing start!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_053: Oh dear...I seem to have gotten carried away here. Do egg─er, excuse me.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_054: Anyhow! Might I be correct in assuming that you're looking to take part in the grand procession? If so, then you've come to the right place.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_055: As Jihli no doubt explained to you, we have planned for a great parade of celebrants to walk the streets of the town, handing out eggs to every child in sight.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_056: These aren't eggs for eating, of course, but egg─er, exquisitely decorated ones hollowed out and housing a host of lovely gifts inside.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_057: These remarkable specimens have been prepared especially for the occasion by an impressive lineup of some of the realm's greatest luminaries. No doubt they're putting the finishing touches on their masterworks even as we speak!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_058: I was just about to go to our designated meeting point to receive them myself, but I fear that there are last-minute parade preparations that I must attend to here. Might you be so kind as to go in my stead?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: You will be joining us for the procession, won't you, ? It simply wouldn't be Hatching-tide without you!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_KANESENNA_000_100: Keep─ah, forgive me. I mean to say, you are the one come for the Hatching-tide eggs, are you not?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_KANESENNA_000_101: I am happy to inform you that they have been crafted precisely according to Jihli and her Dreamers' request, every last one housing a delightful treat that is sure to please a lucky child.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_KANESENNA_000_102: What manner of treat, you ask? Why, none other than home-baked cookies prepared by myself and my siblings from only the freshest ingredients harvested from the Twelveswood and blessed by the guardians of the forest.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_KANESENNA_000_103: I must admit, I am surprised to see that you will be the one to deliver them, but there is none who I would sooner trust with this most important delivery. Go with the elementals' blessing, that you might bring joy to the young ones of our fair city on this most wonderful of occasions.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_150: (-???-)Oho! If it isn't , my dear son's boon companion!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_151: (-???-)Oho! I trust you are here for the eggs?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_152: I observe that your expression is a curious one. Clearly, you are at a complete loss as to the identity of the virile gentle-rabbit who stands before you!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_153: Ah, but it is a fine Hatching-tide this year, is it not? The colorful decorations about the town, the festive mood in the air─why, it is enough to make a Mander─er, rabbit such as I lift up his legs, put up his paws, and dance!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_154: Ohoho! But I must not forget why I am here to begin with. Behold, a veritable chicken coop's worth of ornamental eggs, each containing a gold hairpin fashioned with a delightful egg motif!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_155: What child would not rejoice to receive such a stylish and special gift, I ask? None that I know! Ohohoho!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_GODBERT_000_156: Speaking of children, I wonder─whatever is my dear son up to these days? It has been so very long since he wrote...
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SUZAKU_000_200: .... When I heard that you would be playing a leading role in this year's Hatching-tide, I simply had to witness it myself.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SUZAKU_000_201: What's this? You do not recognize me? Why, you are as dense as a certain man I once loved... But I jest. My true form concealed within this costume, it is no wonder that you are confused.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SUZAKU_000_202: It is not the first time I have used my powers to take on another form, though I feel somewhat bereft without my wings.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SUZAKU_000_203: ...But enough about me. We have gifts that must be delivered to the fledglings, do we not? Ah, but my beloved, too, cared very much for children. In choosing the gifts I would prepare for the occasion, I gave much thought to what manner of present would do him proud.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SUZAKU_000_204: That look in your eyes... Yes, you have journeyed far and wide since felling the mad auspice Koryu. Those who have known suffering the realm over doubtless live freer today for your efforts. Do take care...and promise that you will never abandon the fight.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_MIOUNNE_000_205: Oh, it's you. Come to collect the eggs on behalf of Jihli and her Dreamers, yes?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_MIOUNNE_000_206: Rest assured I've prepared a full batch for you, each containing an assortment of sugar cookies prepared fresh at the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_MIOUNNE_000_207: Take them with my blessing, . And should you tire of the festivities, know that you're always welcome at the Canopy for a piping hot pot of tea.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_210: You'll gather the eggs from our patrons, yes? Just between the two of us, you may encounter some fascinatingly familiar personages if you do!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_250: There you are, my friend! I trust you had no trouble procuring the eggs?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_251: And there we are! I believe I speak for Jihli and all the Dreamers when I say that I cannot thank you enough!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_252: And with that, at long last the grand procession can begin! If you're still willing to take part, pray join me and your fellow participants at the starting line in Old Gridania!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_300: I do believe this will be the greatest Hatching-tide ever!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_350: Welcome back, ! Thanks to you, I'm proud to announce that the procession was a resounding success!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_351: Why, I've never seen so many happy children before! Some seemed quite intimidated at first to see a veritable army of oversized rabbits, but they quickly changed their tune after receiving the gift of extravagant eggs containing all manner of tasteful and toothsome treats!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_352: No doubt Jihli is overjoyed with how everything turned out. You'll accompany me to deliver the good tidings to our Dreamer-in-Chief, yes?
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_40: ! Nonotta! Once again, Hatching-tide has been a success beyond even my wildest dreams, and I have the two of you to thank for it!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_401: Thank you, Jihli. But we all know that none of this would even have been possible were it not for your prophetic visions and the remarkable passion by which you pursued making them a reality.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_40: You are far too kind, my friends. It is because of you that the parade was far and away the highlight of this year's festivities. Why, I was originally intending to stand aside and direct the procession, but everyone looked to be enjoying themselves so much, I simply had to take part myself!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_403: I, for one, will not begrudge you. But don't say that too loud─some might be less than happy to hear that you abandoned your post!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_40: At any rate, it was more than clear from the beaming smiles on the faces of all the children in attendance that this year's Hatching-tide has been nothing less than a resounding success!

Our patrons played a great part in this as well. Believe it or not, , every last one of them volunteered their services only after hearing that you would be a part of our festivities. Something that I, er, might have told them before you actually volunteered, but let's not overburden ourselves with details, shall we?

At any rate, there is no doubt that─because of you─our fledgling festival is more beloved by the people of Eorzea than ever before. When I think of a time when the children here today tell their children of their fond memories of celebrating Hatching-tide, it fills my heart with no end of pride and joy.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_NONOTTA_000_407: Dreaming of the future is all well and good, Jihli, but might I remind you that the festivities must still go on in the present? I daresay we both have a job to do.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_40: Oh, but right you are, Nonotta! I must be getting back to my post and prepare for the next procession.
If you have no other pressing matters to attend to, we would most appreciate if you could join us once more before the celebration is through. If not for us, then for the children!
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SYSTEM_000_500: New wares are now available from the Dreamers in exchange for bejeweled eggs.
TEXT_FESEST602_03847_SYSTEM_000_501: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. Open the toy chest in any inn room to take another turn at this activity.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_000: Oh, as I live and breathe! Is that  !? How long has it been? Truth be told, I had hoped against hope that I might see you on this most resplendent of days.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_001: For there is only one  who could make this Little Ladies' Day even more wonderful than the last! The maidens of Eorzea cry out for a seneschal of your caliber to dote upon them.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_002: You there! Now there is a strapping young  if I ever saw one! Doubtless come to join the Little Ladies' Day festivities, I am sure.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_003: Hmm? You have not heard of Little Ladies' Day? Well then, as the royal seneschal, allow me to bring you up to speed. On this day, as you might imagine by the name, the little ladies of the realm come first. Those of us with the heart of a gentleman must endeavor to bring smiles to each and every one of their faces.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_004: I'm doing my part by overseeing this event, and am seeking the aid of as many magnanimous souls as possible, so that every maiden in this fair city feels as exalted as the sultana herself!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_005: Of course, if the satisfaction of good deeds done isn't enticing enough, there are fabulous rewards to be had for any who assist me. What say you? Will you don the mantle of seneschal?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_006: I knew from the moment I saw you that you would be eager to serve! You have my thanks for what I'm sure will be a job well done.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_007: As for the job itself, it is most elegant in its simplicity. Go forth into the city streets, dressed to impress and with the spirit of the day in your heart.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_008: If you should see a young lady in any manner of distress or discontent, approach them as a gentleman would, lending an ear to their plight and a hand to their aid.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_009: (-Elegant Voice-)And I think I know of just such a troubled soul...
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_010: Oh, it's you! What a pleasant surprise! On this day more than any other, I recall fondly the little adventure we had when last we met. I am overjoyed that you would lend us your attentive hand once again.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_100_010: If you're worried about my condition, I'm pleased to inform you that I am much improved. I have received special permission to come into the city and participate in the festivities.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_011: Greetings, adventurer. Or should I say seneschal? I am Aldiytha of House Thorne, here to assist with the day's revelry.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_012: Lady Thorne, what fortuitous timing! I was just about to send this noble seneschal out on  mission, but it appears you have saved us the trouble of finding a maiden in need.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_013: Indeed. While strolling through Emerald Avenue I spied a young girl whose crestfallen expression served as a stark contrast to the merriment around her.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_014: I thought to call out to her, but she disappeared in the crowds before I had the chance. We must seek her out, and I believe three sets of eyes would serve better than one.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_A1_000_001: Let us search for this troubled soul together.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_015: Splendid! I knew one such as you wouldn't stand by while another suffered.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_016: I'll take that question as tacit agreement. I knew you'd be eager to assist me.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_017: All right, then. Be on the lookout for a Lalafell with flaxen hair. With haste and some luck, we should find her before long.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_018: Very well! Let us take to the Emerald Avenue, and bring cheer to this young woman's heart!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_019: Lady Aldiytha is the eldest daughter of House Thorne, an old family that even now holds a sterling reputation. She has ever been a stalwart proponent of Little Ladies' Day, and her assistance each year has proven invaluable.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_020: That Lalafellin girl couldn't have gone far. Keep an eye out for her distinct flaxen hair.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_CHEERFULCITIZEN0385: Huh? A Lalafell with flaxen hair? Matter of fact, I did see a girl fitting that description just moments ago.

I remember the look on her face more than anything. Although everyone around her was beaming, she was frowning like someone had just snatched her last lemoncake away. If you mean to follow her, she headed off towards the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
Last I saw her, she was headed towards the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Whatever's eating at her, I hope she finds some way out of the doldrums.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DIGNIFIEDCITIZEN038: Golden hair, you say? A Lalafell, you say? I did see a small figure with vibrant hair cross my path, but it could have just as well been a small child.
She was heading towards the Gold Court. Of course, only the Twelve know where she went from there.
If you head towards the Gold Court, you may be able to catch up to this person you're searching for.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_CLASSYCITIZEN03850_: Now that you mention it, I think I saw a girl like that not too long ago. She was ascending the steps of the Hustings Strip, although judging by her plodding steps, she was dreading whatever awaited her at the top.
By her age, I reckon she's a patient at Frondale's Phrontistery. Chances are you could catch her if you left now.
No one her age has business up there if they aren't a patient at the Phrontistery. If you leave now you might catch her.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_060: Have you been...following me? Why? I don't want any trouble.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_061: Trouble? Why, my dear girl, we're here to give you just the opposite!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_062: But first, perhaps an introduction and an explanation would allay your fears. I am Aldiytha Thorne, and we're here because it is our duty to see that no young girl walks the streets of this city with their head down.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_063: (-Momoru-)So that's why you were looking for me. I suppose I should thank you. I'm Momoru, by the way.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_064: The pleasure is entirely mine, Miss Momoru. Now, what exactly is troubling you? Tell us, and we shall do all in our power to set things right.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_065: (-Momoru-)Really? Well...you know Frondale's Phrontistery, right? I'm staying in the children's ward.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_066: (-Momoru-)You see, they don't let us go outside very often, and things were dreadfully boring. That is, until I met Lorie and we became the best of friends.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_067: (-Momoru-)We promised each other that we would both get better before Little Ladies' Day, so we could play under the peach blossoms together.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_068: (-Momoru-)But...but Lorie suddenly got worse! The physicians only gave me permission to leave, and Lorie had to stay behind.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_069: (-Momoru-)I didn't want to go without her, but I didn't want to miss this chance either. So...so here I am. But it's no fun all by myself.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_070: How tragic...my heart breaks to hear her tale.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_071: There must be something we can do for them.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_A2_000_001: You don't need to go out to “go out.”
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_072: Hmm? What an odd thing to say. What ever do you mean?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_073: <sigh> ...You have the right of it, of course. The physicians surely have good reason to keep little Lorie under their care. Still, we may not be entirely without recourse...
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_074: Ah! I know! We bring the festival to them! That way they can enjoy the splendor of Little Ladies' Day without stepping foot outside the Phrontistery.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_075: We can start by decorating the children's ward with the selfsame trappings which adorn the city.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_076: And there is yet more we can do. Perhaps a special guest could be arranged for the children. When we're done, I daresay Frondale's Phrontistery may come to rival Emerald Avenue in its pageantry!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_077: (-Momoru-)Really? Truly? I can't wait to see the look on Lorie's face when she sees! I just hope Master Damielliot says it's okay.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_078: (-Momoru-)Would you come with me to the children's ward, pretty please? I'm sure he would listen to you. I'll tell the alchemist at the entrance to expect you!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALCHEMIST03850_000_: Momoru could barely contain herself when she told me about you. She's waiting inside the children's ward. Do you wish to enter?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_080: Now this is the very essence of Little Ladies' Day! There is no greater deed than to bring smiles to those girls most in need of them!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_081: Now, where is this Master Damielliot? I hope he can be convinced of the importance of our mission.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_082: Don't worry, I'm sure he'll agree. You just have to ask nicely!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_STAFFA03850_000_083: Greetings. If you're here for an examination, you'll have to fill out a form first.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_090: Ah, now here's a face I did not expect to see today! What brings you to Frondale's Phrontistery? I hope you have not fallen ill.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_091: An adventurer? What business do you have at Frondale's Phrontistery? If you are ill, you must first fill out a form over there.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_093: ...I see. You mean to host a little Little Ladies' Day of sorts. I must say, it sounds like it would bring some sorely needed color to these otherwise drab halls.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_094: Very well, you have my full support! It would be remiss of me to deny those under my care the most effective medicine of all: joy!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_095: If I may, let's keep this a secret from the others for now, shall we? Children do so love surprises.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_096: Indeed. To that end, I suggest we decorate while the others are absent. There is just one obstacle, however─the sick are not known for their habit of coming and going.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_STAFFA03850_000_097: But Master Damielliot, have you forgotten? The children are soon to undergo their regular examinations, and will be away for the better part of the day. Would that not be the ideal time to decorate?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_100_097: Yes...yes, you are quite right. Excellent thinking. And no one would bat an eye if I were to conduct the examinations slightly earlier than scheduled. , could you summon the children to the examination room in my stead?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_098: Well, it seems we have the solution to our most pressing concern. I'll begin procuring the necessary trimmings.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_099: I also think it would be prudent to provide gifts for the children. No extravagance must be spared on this special occasion. My dear seneschal, can I depend on you to take care of this task?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_100: I know what I can do! Lorie is always talking about Redolent Rose of the Weavers' Guild. I think if we both give him our most winning smiles, he might be convinced to come for a visit!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_101: I say “we,” because   is coming too! Right?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_102: Now that we all have our duties, let us attend to them. Time is of the essence.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_103: With my knowledge of the children's tastes, and Lady Aldiytha's exquisite sense for design, I believe the decorations are in good hands.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_STAFFA03850_000_104: Godsspeed to you! Part of me wishes I was one of the children, so I could be spared the pain of waiting here in anticipation.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_105: Lorie is the one with red hair, in case you were curious. Once everyone's gone for their examinations, we can go to the Weavers' Guild and Lorie will be none the wiser.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MIQOTEGIRLA03850_00: Oh, hello there. Are you someone's ?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_HYURANBOYB03850_000: I haven't seen you before. Are you a new physician?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_LORIE_000_108: <sob> Oh, I hope Momoru is having fun out there...
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MIQOTEGIRLA03850_10: Oh, hello there. Are you someone's ?
Oh, the examinations!? Already!? I nearly forgot! Thanks for reminding me─I would've caught an earful if I was late again!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_HYURANBOYB03850_100: I haven't seen you before. Are you a new physician?
What!? Another examination! They already know I'm sick, why do they gotta keep poking and prodding me!? Ugh, well, I suppose I better go.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_LORIE_100_114: <sob> Oh, I hope Momoru is having fun out there...
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_LORIE_100_116: Oh, another examination already? That bitter medicine they gave me last time didn't help at all. Are they gonna make me drink it again?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_LORIE_100_117: I wouldn't mind it if they at least let me go outside. Everyone's probably having so much fun out there... I hope Momoru is too. I'll try to think of her when I'm forcing that poison down my gullet.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_100_110: Did you speak with everyone? Lorie didn't look too sad, did she?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_110_110: I suppose it's only natural for her to feel that way. But with a little effort, we'll turn her frown into a smile soon enough!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_110: Now let's be off to the Weavers' Guild to speak with Redolent Rose. Lorie always keeps me up late gushing about his designs!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_111: She just adores weaving, and she's had plenty of time in the Phrontistery to practice. She even made me a lace scarf, and says when she grows up she'll join the guild!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_112: A personal visit from Redolent Rose himself would set her as right as any medicine could. Let's be off!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_113: Oh, it's him... Uh... Hmm... What should I...?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALCHEMIST03850_000_: We are terribly busy with the decorations at present. Please return later.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REDOLENTROSE_000_12: Oh, what do we have here? A little bird has flown into my guild, but is too shy to sing. What, pray tell, could inspire her to grace us with her voice?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_A4_000_001: The others are counting on you!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_122: I... Yes, of course. Thank you!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_123: Master, uh...Rose? I have something to ask of you. You see, my dear friend Lorie is very sick, and she has always had a passion for weaving. If you could visit her at Frondale's Phrontistery...
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REDOLENTROSE_000_12: Say no more. A fledgling weaver is in need, and I shall gladly fly to her assistance. The tapestry of this guild's history ever requires new hands to sew it, after all.
Forgive me, but I have some matters I must attend to before leaving. Rest assured, however, that I'll make haste to the children's ward the very moment I am done.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_127: <sigh> We did it! Truth be told, in all the stories Lorie told me of Master Rose, I imagined him to be a little...littler. Lorie never told me how kind he was, though!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_128: Oh, I don't know if I'll be able to resist telling Lorie that Redolent Rose is visiting the Phrontistery. Promise to stop me if I begin to blurt it out. I hope everyone else is coming along as well as we are!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REDOLENTROSE_000_12: I didn't scare the girl, did I? I suppose even a figure as graceful as mine can be imposing to a Lalafell.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALCHEMIST03850_000_: We've managed to finish decorating, and I must say I am quite pleased with our efforts. Would you like to enter the children's ward?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REDOLENTROSE_000_14: (-Familiar Voice-)I daresay I could not have arranged a more pleasant display myself!
Indeed I am. And you must be the Lorie whom I have heard so much about.
Why, of course I do! I must say I envy you, to have such a devoted friend like little Momoru here.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REDOLENTROSE_100_14: She also told of your passion for weaving. Is it true you wish to join the guild someday? If so, pray allow me to answer any questions you may have─I would not dream of keeping the tricks of our trade from an aspiring guild member.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_147: Now then, if all the little ladies would gather around, I have presents for all of you!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_148: Place these peach blossoms in your hair, and become as princesses!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_149: Surely you all know the history of this day, when Sultan Baldric would serve as seneschal to a specially chosen girl.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_150: These accoutrements have roots in that tradition. One Little Ladies' Day long ago, a young girl beset by illness was chosen as Baldric's princess.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_151: Upon learning of her condition, he presented her with a wreath of peach blossoms to wear upon her head, much like the ones you now hold in your hands.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_152: Peach blossoms have long been said to ward off ailments of all manner, and some even believe they hold the key to eternal youth. It was with this in mind that the sultan gave his gift.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_153: Soon after that, the young woman made a complete recovery, and went on to live a long and fruitful life. Perhaps the legends of the blossoms' properties were true after all.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_154: Little ladies─little princesses─keep these always close, and if your sickness should ever seem too much to bear, remember the princess who came before you. As she did, you too shall regain your strength!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_156: Ah, but I didn't forget Master Damielliot. I have something for you as well. Here, wear this.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_157: Hmm. Like this? Does it suit me?
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_159: I suppose I should be grateful for that. However, I must admit, I fail to see how this trinket will help.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_160: Ah, but I haven't finished the story. The tale doesn't end with peach blossoms, oh no. The sultan also sent a handpicked physician─his very best─to care after his princess. That physician wore a monocle much like this one.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_161: I had a feeling that─besides lending an air of authenticity to the day─a monocle would become you. And so, with the help of the seneschal, I endeavored to procure one.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_162: Your efforts are much appreciated, my lady. I shall do my utmost to honor the example set by this physician, and will not rest until every one of my princesses returns to prime health.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_163: I trust you will only impress, Master Damielliot. Would you look at them? Those smiles embody everything beautiful about this day.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_164: Master Damielliot, my dear seneschal, I couldn't have achieved this alone. I'm in your debt.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_165: And let us not forget . You truly are a seneschal among seneschals.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_BUTLER_000_166: Indeed. Any would be hard-pressed to find a more gentlemanly company than the one gathered here. To another successful Little Ladies' Day!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REAUVERRE_000_166: Master Damielliot told me about everything you did for the girls. Thank you─it's been too long since I've seen everyone in such high spirits!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REAUVERRE_000_167: It's good to see you again, friend. My ailment still troubles me, but I'm determined not to let it win!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_REAUVERRE_000_168: By the way, Master Damielliot told me of the celebrations you arranged for the girls. Thank you─it's been too long since I've seen everyone in such high spirits!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_170: Lorie and the others will be talking about this for moons to come! We'll keep these in our hair until every one of us is better!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_171: We'll never forget what you all did for us today, I'm sure of it. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_172: Master Damielliot said you're welcome at the children's ward any time during Little Ladies' Day. Do come visit!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_173: Seeing poor Momoru in distress reminded me of that Little Ladies' Day long ago, and of my own struggles with my physical condition. It was clear then what needed to be done.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_174: Considering everything had to be arranged at such short notice, I'd say we pulled through splendidly. There was nary a frown to be seen, on both child and adult alike.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_175: And now, although it pains me to say it, I must return to my manor. My family tends to fret unreasonably if I'm absent overlong.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_ALDIYTHA_000_176: However, before I go, I do believe there is the matter of your gift. Master Damielliot is keeping it safe for you at my behest. May we meet again soon, adventurer!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_MOMORU_000_177: Come visit us any time─we'll be waiting!
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_180: I do not believe I have had the opportunity to thank you personally. Your efforts served not only to lift the children's spirits, but the staff's as well.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_181: Had Lady Aldiytha not already arranged to reward your cooperation, I certainly would have. That being said, these are yours.
TEXT_FESPDY601_03850_DAMIELLIOT_000_182: It is not often the children have the chance to meet an adventurer, let alone one so kind as yourself. Pray visit us again while you can.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_000: Greetings, . I am terribly sorry to trouble you again so soon, but may I have a word?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_001: As you know, our dear Lorie was overjoyed to receive a personal visit from Redolent Rose, whom she so admires. So very few are given such an opportunity, and I shall be forever grateful to you for your part in arranging it.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_002: However, Lorie is not the only one under our care. When the other children heard her story, they came asking me to invite all manner of illustrious figures to the ward.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_003: Of course, I would gladly grant their wishes if I could. However, I am but a lowly physician, and hold little sway outside of this Phrontistery. I do not sup with the sultana or go for leisurely flights on the backs of dragons.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_004: But an adventurer of your stature is no stranger to esteemed company, both within and without this city. The children and I would be eternally grateful if you would draw upon this circle of acquaintances to make their dreams come true one more time.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_005: I sincerely apologize for imposing upon you yet again, but it is not for my own sake that I beseech your aid. In return for your efforts, I have arranged a reward, but I fear it will only begin to repay the debt I already owe you.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_100_005: Young Reauverre, emboldened by your example, has chosen to serve as seneschal to our young ladies, and has helped sort all of their various requests.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_006: I asked them to write letters to the people they wanted to meet, although it seems not everyone had a specific person in mind. You can find them on the desk over there.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_007: Read through them, and if there are any among your allies and comrades-in-arms who might be fit to call upon, don't hesitate to tell me and I'll gather everyone here.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_008: I am well aware of how much I am asking of you, but the smiles of the children shall be worth the effort. If you could invite even just one more of your illustrious companions, it would mean the world to everyone here, myself included.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_009: The letters are still on the desk. I'm certain that among your friends there is at least one you can call.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_010: If someone comes to mind, tell me and I'll arrange to have everyone gather here for an audience.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_011: Young Reauverre seems to have been inspired by your example, and declares to any who will listen that he too will be a model seneschal. It is heartening to see him in such high spirits.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_040: So, have you read the letters? Do any of your storied allies fit the descriptions written within?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_041: Great! I'll call the girls here!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_A3_000_002: The First Sword of the Gladiators' Guild.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: Greetings, children. Is everyone having a splendid Little Ladies' Day?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENA03851_000_: It's the sultana! We are honored to be in your presence, Your Grace!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: Now now, there is no need for such stiff formalities. Pray call me Nanamo. And it is I who should be so honored to receive your invitation.
For our children are the most precious gemstones in all of Ul'dah. I am sure there is much and more I can learn from your stories, and full eager am I to hear them.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_PAPASHAN_000_054: Your Grace, each moment we remain here, urgent matters are mounting and left unresolved. We would do best not to tarry overlong.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: Papashan, do you forget the meaning of this day? For generations, the sultans of Ul'dah have put themselves at the complete disposal of their chosen princesses. Am I not beholden to the same tradition? Or do you mean to imply that a sultana cannot be a seneschal?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_PAPASHAN_000_056: I─ No, Your Grace, of course not!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NANAMOULNAMO_000_05: I am glad we have reached an understanding. Now, which one of you addressed their letter to me? Come forward, and I shall serve you as best I can.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_060: My friend here tells me that one among you has it in their head to become a gladiator. Raise your hand so I can judge if it's fit to raise a sword.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_062: Aye, that's an arm I'd fear swinging at me even on my best day. You have promise, but many a talented gladiator has seen their bright future smothered by the sands of the Coliseum. Would you like to know what separates the wheat from the chaff?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_063: Much akin to how a sword must be sharpened daily, one's skill with it must be practiced often and with diligence. The very best of us do this and more─they train always with purpose. They've an image in their head of the gladiator they'll become on the morrow, the next moon, and the next summer.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_064: Take this advice to heart, for it has guided me to where I am now, and I suspect will guide me further still. Now, imagine yourself with sword and shield in hand, ready to emerge victorious from your first tourney.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENB03851_000_: A tourney? You mean at the Coliseum? I've always wanted to go to one, but my ma says it's too crowded─that it'll make my condition even worse. So...I've never been.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_066: I see. Imagine yourself facing down a different foe, then─this condition of yours. Imagine that you've trounced it so thoroughly that it would never dare to plague you again.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_067: Triumph over this enemy and take back your health, and I'll personally see to it that you're invited to a tourney showcasing the fiercest fighters in our guild.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MYLLA_000_069: My word is as good as my sword. All I ask is that you put my advice into practice daily. Your first victory is yours for the taking.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_LYNGSATH_000_080: Oi, now I see why they call Ul'dah a jewel─it's got the prettiest little lasses this side o' Eorzea! Now who 'ere's the one with a taste for cakes and cookies?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENC03851_000_: Me, sir. Is it true you know how to cook?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_LYNGSATH_000_082: Hahaha! Aye, ye could say that. I've been known to whip up a dish or two when the fancy strikes me. Some've even asked me to cook whole meals for them, if ye can believe it─and then they asked for more!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_LYNGSATH_000_083: In fact, so many couldn't get their fill of my cookin' that I stumbled into the position of guildmaster for the culinarians. Ever 'eard of the Bismarck? I'm somethin' of a known quantity there, and we're always lookin' for talent. I understand yer a dab 'and in the kitchen yerself.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENC03851_000_: I...I suppose. I like to make sweets, and one day I hope to open my own shop.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_LYNGSATH_000_085: That's a worthy road to walk down, if I do say so myself. Ye'll lose track o' 'ow many days you've spent bent o'er an oven, 'owever, but I suspect that won't deter ye.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_LYNGSATH_000_086: Now that's the attitude I like to see. Now, lass, I came all this way on the promise o' cake─one that'd put the Bismarck's to shame. Would ye care to oblige me?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_SYSTEM_100_110: The royal seneschal is in charge of all matters related to the Songbirds, famed songstresses of Ul'dah. He may be able to arrange an audience with them.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_ULALA_000_110: Now this is a crowd! , you didn't tell us there would be so many of them! Greetings, everyone, and thank you for having us! Who wants an autograph!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NARUMI_000_111: Ulala, show a little restraint, please. We're in a sick ward, not on the stage.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Let's keep civil in front of the children, shall we?  told us one of you little ladies wishes to be a songstress when she grows up. Which of you is it?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_ULALA_000_113: Wow, look at her! She'd fit right in with the Songbirds! Who's your favorite? It's okay, you can be honest─it's me, isn't it?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NARUMI_000_114: I'm sure there are other things she'd like to talk about. Tell us, what made you want to follow in our footsteps?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENE03851_000_: I saw you perform once in Ul'dah, and by the end of the first song I knew what I wanted to be. Your voices, your dances, your costumes─everything was so enchanting.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Really? Thank you for the kind words, truly. As a performer, there is no greater gift than the heartfelt appreciation of a fan.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_ULALA_000_117: True, but being a songstress isn't all sunshine and lemoncakes. And becoming one was even less sweet. There were many hardships to overcome to get to where we are now, and certainly more are still ahead.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_ULALA_000_118: On the stage, we're perfect. But it takes effort off the stage to get there. Day after day for bells on end we practice. You have to be ready to endure that and more.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_NARUMI_000_119: Ulala! She is but a child!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: While Ulala's words may be blunt, there is wisdom in them. If we inspired this girl, don't we owe her honesty? Would that I was given the same gift when I was younger.

Not that I would've chosen any other path than this. Quite the opposite, in fact. For every moment of suffering there are countless more of fulfillment. Like this one, for example. Meeting our fans is always an occasion to hold dear.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_ULALA_000_122: That's right, I wouldn't dissuade any from pursuing their dream of becoming a songstress. Stay determined and practice every day, and before long I'm sure we'll see you on the stage with us!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_ULALA_000_124: But let me warn you─if you aim to be Eorzea's number one songstress, you'll have to face some stiff competition!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_091: Ah, I see there are still drab corners of the world where the name of Jandelaine has yet to grace the people's tongues.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_092: Not to worry, my dear ladies─by now I am well accustomed to the feat of delivering the light of beauty to Eorzea's darkest recesses!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDREND03851_000_: Uh, this is an aesthetician? He's not like I imagined...
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_094: Look carefully upon this visage, and then carefully inside yourself. Do so, and you shall come to see the truth.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_095: Not the truth of prosaic reality. No─the truth of the heart! The one truth that can stir your soul and transform it from dull to dashing. Will you dare to accept it, or will you forever consign yourself to mediocrity?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_096: Excellent, my lass. Then take hold of your scissors─figuratively, of course─and prepare to shear your ideal self free from the fabric of the common and shape it into something wondrous, as only an aesthetician can.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_097: Now, I shall excise the demon of ugliness from atop your crown, and you shall return to us a beauty reborn!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_098: Bid farewell to the life you knew, and prepare to see the world from a vantage placed squarely above the clamoring masses!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_099: Breathtaking...more lovely than words can say. No, you must not speak─you must bask in the moment.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_JANDELAINE_000_100: Today you step foot upon a new path─a path that will lead you to a beauty so profound that you shall have no choice but to one day join me in my quest to banish all hints of the grotesque from the land.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_130: So many children! Is this what you call a litter?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENF03851_000_: (-Awestruck Girl-)Is that...is that a dragon!? I can't believe it! It sure is small... It's not a poppet, is it?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_132: Can a poppet speak, child of man? I am indeed a dragon, and you may call me Kal Myhk.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENA03851_000_: (-Awestruck Girl-)Wow, it talks! Why are you so small? Are you a child like us?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_134: Hmph. If it pleases you to think of me as a child, then you may do so. What is it you children of men do for leisure, again? If I recall correctly, scampering about aimlessly outside is a pastime of yours. I suppose I could deign to scamper. What say you, ?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENB03851_000_: (-Hyuran Child-)But the physicians said we can't go outside...
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_136: Nonsense. Every child must bask in the sunlight from time to time. How else would they grow big and strong like my friend  here?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENB03851_000_: (-Hyuran Child-)We'd like nothing more than to go play, but we're sick. It might not look it now, but our condition can change in a moment's turn. We have to stay inside or else we might get worse.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_138: I see. How unfortunate. I was looking forward to making new friends and catching up with old ones.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_139: Still, that doesn't mean I can't return when you all are well. A day which will come soon, I'm sure.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_140: And when it does, we'll scamper enough to make up for today thrice over!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_141: Don't worry,  will be coming along too. I'll see to it personally.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_KALMYHK_000_142: It's a promise, then. And dragons never break a promise, even should a thousand winters pass. I hope to see you all before then, however, else I may no longer fit inside this tiny structure.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_150: Well met, well met!  told me to expect princesses, but I see now that the word hardly does this singular group of ladies justice!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_152: That's Namazu, young lady, and we do have names. Yes, yes. Mine is Gyorin, and the pleasure of making your acquaintance is entirely mine.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_153: Now, I've heard tell there was a girl here with ambitions of slumbering upon piles of coins and awakening in the lap of luxury.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENF03851_000_: (-Gawking Girl-)Me! Me! I wanna be rich!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_155: Ah, I know that glint in your eyes, for I had the same one in mine when I was your age─and truth be told, I still do! It's so rare to meet kindred spirits these days─ones that aren't trying to bankrupt me, that is!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_156: The first step to making a ponze of gold is to know your purpose, for that will serve to spur you forward when your fortunes are down and your coinpurse is empty.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_CHILDRENF03851_000_: (-Gawking Girl-)Well, I heard my parents arguing about how much it costs to keep me here... I felt so guilty...

(-Gawking Girl-)But I also realized how hard they were trying for me. That's when I decided to become rich─so I could make their life easy. I wanna get out of here and show them every corner of Eorzea!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_159: Ah, a more noble goal than most that go into the business of making money! That nobility will serve to help you survive through the lean times─and lean times there will be! Even I am yet to count myself among the affluent and well-to-do. But a Namazu can dream, and dream I shall! Yes, yes!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_160: That being said, if your aim is to fill your coffers, there's no better place than Ul'dah. Fortunes are made and lost every bell in this city, and a savvy merchant can massage the odds so that she wins more than she loses.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_161: Since you already have a purpose to drive you, your next step is to find a market. That requires research─dozens and dozens of conversations to discern what will sell and what's better off left buried in the sand. And even when you're not researching, you must be thinking about your research.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_GYORIN_000_162: Begin your journey with this simple advice in mind and soon riches shall flow to you. Should you succeed─which I'm sure you will─please visit me in Hingashi. I've no doubt two merchants of our aptitude can turn a mountain of coins into an ocean of them!
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_REAUVERRE_000_163: Now that was a sight to see! Who don't you know, friend?
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_170: I must admit, when I first requested your aid, 'twas out of desperation. I expected at best a short letter to read to the children, but you went the extra malm and provided us with an audience. I cannot remember the last time I saw everyone so happy.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_171: Joy was not the only gift you gave everyone, however. The heartening words of your allies will fortify the children's spirits in the days ahead, that they might overcome their illnesses and see their health returned. Please pass on our gratitude to your friends.
TEXT_FESPDY602_03851_DAMIELLIOT_000_172: And allow me to thank you personally. Your efforts have ensured that this Little Ladies' Day will always be remembered fondly by both the children and myself. You are welcome to visit us here any time you wish, and all the more welcome if you have another companion in tow.
TEXT_LUCKSA102_03942_RESISTANCERECORDER_: Blade . A moment, if you would. I serve as war historian for the Bozjan Resistance, and Marsak tells me you may be able to help in my work.

I needn't tell you how the atrocities of war can wear on a soldier. As such, it has become increasingly difficult to find one of sound mind and body who can accurately recount their experiences on the battlefield.
For a hardened warrior such as yourself, I suspect keeping an account of the foes you've faced should prove a rather trifling task.
That's not to say I expect a detailed record of your every interaction, mind. If you should trade blows with any notable figures, however, I would hear of it.
All information gathered from the battle for Bozja will ultimately be compiled within my field records. Here─you may use this to take note of any memorable encounters in the field.
I realize the burden this places on you, which is why I will see to it personally that you are duly compensated for your efforts.
TEXT_LUCKSA102_03942_SYSTEM_100_030: The Field Record is now available under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKSA102_03942_SYSTEM_000_030: Upon completion of certain quests, skirmishes, and critical engagements in the Bozjan southern front, you will obtain a sheaf of notes.
TEXT_LUCKSA102_03942_SYSTEM_000_031: These notes can then be used to add entries to the Field Record.
TEXT_LUCKSA102_03942_SYSTEM_000_032: Any unused notes can be exchanged for various rewards by speaking with the Resistance historian.
TEXT_LUCKSA102_03942_RESISTANCERECORDER_: A parting word of advice, if I may. While there is no telling what you will face on the southern front, Dmitar over there may be able to assist you in finding worthwhile battles for our field record.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_000: Excuse me! Yes, you, ! If I might have a moment of your time?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_001: My─ Oh! I know you! It's me─Nanaphon! You helped me audition at the Gold Saucer, remember!?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_100_001: Surely you haven't forgotten my performance!?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_002: My name is Nanaphon, and I'm here as a representative of the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_003: The thing is, my employers are holding one of their special limited-time events, where all attractions reward fifty percent more MGP...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_004: The campaign has been so successful, however, that we're having trouble catering to the unexpectedly enormous crowds!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_005: ...Thus do you find me accosting passersby, and offering temporary positions on our staff as attraction guides. Might you be interested in helping out in exchange for a generous payment?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_006: Wonderful! I'll let my supervisor know to expect you at Entrance Square in the Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_007: You...you've been to the Saucer before, haven't you? If you don't have a ticket for admission, I hear that young man over there is simply giving them away!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_000_008: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_009: As I said, I'll send my supervisor to meet you at Entrance Square. You shouldn't be waiting long!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_NANAPHON_000_010: And if you have any trouble boarding the airship, you can always appeal to the kindness of strangers. As a matter of fact, that well-heeled youth over there has a reputation for astounding generosity!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_000_011: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_020: Oho! I come to greet our recruited helper, and who should it be but  !
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_021: (-???-)Greetings, good , and thank you for coming! You've not been waiting overlong, I hope?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_022: I am Roland, the fellow entrusted with overseeing the daily affairs of this fine establishment.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_023: As Nanaphon will have explained, we are seeking temporary assistants for our terribly overworked Saucer staff.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_024: The sheer number of attractions can be overwhelming for visiting guests, hence the need for dedicated guides. Aside from providing information, one of their most vital duties is suggesting which amusements might best suit a particular individual's tastes.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_025: Your first task, then, shall be to visit a staff member in each of the five squares, and receive an explanation of the available attractions.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_026: Once you feel comfortably enlightened, I ask that you speak with our chief attendant here. He will put your newfound knowledge to a practical test!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_027: Visit each of the squares in turn, and listen carefully to the staff's explanations. I shall be waiting...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFA_000_030: Here in Minion Square, guests can challenge one another in the strategic contest known as “Lord of Verminion.”
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFA_000_031: Whether you wish to test the limits of your tactical brilliance or simply revel in adorable minion mayhem, this is the game for you!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFB_000_032: Card Square is home to the highly acclaimed and widely adored phenomenon we call “Triple Triad”!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFB_000_033: In this game, planning your card placements in advance is the key to claiming victory. Those who enjoy thinking ahead will find themselves right at home at our tables!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFC_000_034: Master Roland has informed me of your impending employment. Shall we commence your education in Round Square's attractions?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_Q1_000_000: Which attraction will you ask about?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFC_000_035: In Cliffhanger, a chocobo chick has stranded itself atop a forbidding mountain. Those who would rescue the lamentable creature must run a harrowing gauntlet of goblin bombs!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFC_000_036: It is a must for thrill-seekers and danger-lovers, but rather harder to recommend for folk simply looking to pet a feathery friend.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFC_000_037: There is nowhere to go but up in this grueling test of acrobatic prowess. We invite those sure of foot and strong of will to overcome the dizzying heights of this death-defying attraction.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFC_000_038: It perhaps goes without saying that guests who feel uncomfortable when faced with time limits and precipitous falls might do well to look elsewhere for entertainment.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_039: Ah, you must be our new guide-in-training. Where shall we start?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_Q2_000_000: Which attraction will you ask about?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_040: Typhon is an actual voidsent, summoned by the spell of a student of thaumaturgy and later employed here at the Saucer. During the event in question, you must try to anticipate where his next nasal eruption will occur, then maneuver to a location where you think you will be safe.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_041: Luck plays a large part in one's success, thus anyone can participate regardless of athletic ability. Any Way the Wind Blows is a must for those seeking to indulge in the excitement of the unpredictable!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_042: The Slice Is Right is an event requiring a combination of both luck and skill. The longer you survive, the greater the rewards, though you will have to contend with the fearsome Yojimbo!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_043: Think yourself fast enough to dodge the lightning strikes of the swordsman's blade? Then this attraction was tailor-made for you!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_044: Ah, yes. Cuff-a-Cur. Come one, come all, and test your might.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_045: The power of the punch is important, but so, too, is the precision!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_046: Steer the moogle, grab the ball, and win your MGP prize!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFD_000_047: We see a lot of gadget-lovers at this game. Also a lot of, ahem, “admirers” of the nearby attendants, if one pays attention...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFE_000_056: Fresh meat for the grinder, eh? Welcome to the family!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_Q3_000_000: Which attraction will you ask about?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFE_000_048: Bringing down the mallet with perfect timing is the way to win at Crystal Tower Striker.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFE_000_049: This is a game for those handy with a hammer, or who have the patience to wait for just the right moment to strike.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFE_000_050: In Doman mahjong, four players race to gather tiles and form a winning combination, all the while trying not to hand victory to their opponents.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFE_000_051: The rules are many and varied, but it's the contest of wits and cunning that brings people back for more. There's nothing else quite like it, especially for those with an interest in Far Eastern culture!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_060: Our fledgling guide returns! Do you think yourself prepared to meet and assist actual guests?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_061: Let us put you straight to work, then! Come along!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_HAMON_000_063: ...Working as a guide, you say? Well, I could use some suggestions.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_HAMON_000_064: (-???-)Hah hah hah! You look like the helpful sort!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_HAMON_000_065: You see, I'm having a terrible time choosing which game to play. In my younger days, I would impress the ladies with my vigorous pugilism, but I wonder if excelling at one of these amusements might have a similar effect...?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_HAMON_000_066: Oho, why didn't I think of that! Stand aside─the Holyfist needs to go and rack up a holy high score!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_100_066: Hamon seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_HAMON_000_067: ...Hm. I'm not sure how that'll bring the lovelies running, but I suppose some prefer the more thoughtful type.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_100_067: Hamon seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_MYLLA_000_068: (-???-)! What brings you to the Gold Saucer?
