TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_MYLLA_000_069: ...I see. Perhaps you might help me then.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_MYLLA_000_070: (-???-)Excuse me, might I ask for some assistance?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_MYLLA_000_071: I needed some time away from the Coliseum, but even in play I hope to find ways to improve my bladework. Would any of these diversions serve such a role?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_A6_000_001: Might I suggest Any Way the Wind Blows?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_A6_000_002: Might I suggest Crystal Tower Striker?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_A6_000_003: Might I suggest the Slice Is Right?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_MYLLA_000_072: Ah, so you must anticipate and avoid the sword strikes, yes? That sounds perfect!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_100_072: Mylla seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_MYLLA_000_073: I struggle to imagine how that could enhance my swordplay, but I shall take a look if I have a spare moment...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_100_073: Mylla seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ADALBERTA_000_074: (-???-)Fancy meeting you here. Taking a break from breaking rock, eh?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ADALBERTA_000_075: ...Ah, more work than play, then. Either way, I could do with some advice...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ADALBERTA_000_076: (-???-)You work here, yes? If you have a moment, I could do with some advice...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ADALBERTA_000_077: What kind of amusing things do they have for a miner like me? I've spent endless hours clambering about mountains and such, so I can handle some jumping and climbing.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_A7_000_001: Might I suggest the Moogle's Paw?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_A7_000_002: Might I suggest Leap of Faith?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_A7_000_003: Might I suggest Lord of Verminion?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ADALBERTA_000_078: Oh, that does sound like a challenge! I'd say my time in craggy places puts me at an advantage, but I suppose we'll see!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_100_078: Adalberta seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ADALBERTA_000_079: They say you should put work aside from time to time, but I wonder if something like that would keep my interest...?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_100_079: Adalberta seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_080: Thank you,  ─that should be sufficient for the moment. Now, I've reviewed the reports of your performance...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_081: ...And it seems every guest with whom you spoke was most pleased with your recommendations! An outstanding effort! Why, I might almost be convinced to take you on as a full-time employee!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_082: ...And it seems you hit the mark with one or two of your recommendations. A fair attempt, considering your lack of experience in the position!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_083: ...And it seems our guests were, without exception, rather underwhelmed by your recommendations. Perhaps more attention needs be paid to the subtle predilections displayed by each visitor, hmm?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_084: Success rate aside, I was personally impressed by your genuine enthusiasm and unfailing politeness.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_085: What think you,  ? Would you care to join our Gold Saucer family in a more official capacity?
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_086: Ahem! Master Roland! If you will recall our discussion, this was never to be more than a temporary arrangement─
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_087: Ahahaha! A jest, my good man, merely a jest! I could never ask   to abandon  chosen profession to alleviate a dilemma of our own making!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_ROLAND_000_088: I shall, however, thank you again for donating your precious time. Pray accept my heartfelt gratitude...and be sure to collect your payment before you leave!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_090: I, too, must once more express thanks for your timely assistance.
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_091: This “dilemma,” as Master Roland puts it, is a serious one, and I fear our dearth of guides may yet prove disastrous. Should you be willing to stay on a while longer, there is more work to be done...
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_STAFFF_000_092: But let us keep accounts current, shall we? Your wages, .
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_000_093: You have learned the emote Hmm!
TEXT_FESGSC401_03963_SYSTEM_000_094: You can also speak with the genial guiser, and join the marvelous masquerade in the Haunted Manor.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFFF_000_000: These crowds show no sign of thinning... Might you be willing to brave another round of interaction with our guests?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFFF_000_001: Splendid! Then I shall send you once more unto the breach! As of present, our most congested areas appear to be Event Square, Round Square, and Wonder Square.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFFF_000_002: Report to the Saucer's guides in any of these three squares, and see to it that our visitors are catered to!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFFF_000_003: Event Square, Round Square, and Wonder Square are all in need of supplementary staff, so take your pick!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_010: Thank you for coming! Are you ready to begin your shift?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_011: Excellent! Our guests await your assistance!

TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_039: ...It seems every guest with whom you spoke was greatly enthused by your recommendations! A flawless display of service! You really must consider joining us as a full-time employee!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_040: ...It seems you were a touch too hasty with one or two of your recommendations. Overall, I would mark it a fair attempt.

TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_042: But putting such matters aside, any effort made towards maintaining the Saucer's reputation for hospitality is most appreciated. Pray collect your wages from the chief attendant at Entrance Square!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEROLT_000_050: (-???-)Bloody hells! Give a man a break! Did ye follow me here or summat!?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEROLT_000_051: ...Just pitchin' in then, are ye? Well, ain't ye the perfect saint... Although come to think of it, might be as ye could do me a favor!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEROLT_000_052: (-???-)Oi! Yer a guide, ain't ye? I need ye to do some guidin'.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEROLT_000_053: Ye see, I'm lookin' for a game to stack them points up swift-like, but I don't fancy prancin' about or learnin' a bunch o' rules. I can swing a mean hammer, if that helps.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A4_000_001: Might I suggest Crystal Tower Striker?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A4_000_002: Might I suggest the Slice Is Right?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEROLT_000_054: Now that sounds custom-made for a master smith like me! Stand aside─it's time to loosen up the ol' swingin' arm!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_054: Gerolt seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEROLT_000_055: An' ye reckon me smithin' skills'll see me through summat like that? I s'pose I'll give it a look...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_055: Gerolt seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_THUBYRGEIM_000_056: (-???-)Ah! How pleasant to find a familiar face! Are you also come to enjoy a respite from the world's demands?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_THUBYRGEIM_000_057: ...The opposite, then. I was, in fact, in search of guidance...if you might indulge me.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_THUBYRGEIM_000_058: (-???-)Excuse me, . I find myself in need of guidance...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_THUBYRGEIM_000_059: Which of these many attractions would you recommend for an arcanist? A game which challenges the mind would be most preferable.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_THUBYRGEIM_000_060: Yes, the need for a solid strategy appeals to me. And as a customs officer, I've become curious to learn more of Far Eastern traditions. An excellent idea!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_060: Thubyrgeim seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_THUBYRGEIM_000_061: I imagine that would require me to exercise more body than mind...but, no, we mustn't neglect the physical in our quest for the cerebral.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_061: Thubyrgeim seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_COCOBUKI_000_062: (-???-)Hm hm hm... Have you been lured by this abyss of amusement as well, ?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_COCOBUKI_000_063: Ah, a guide to souls lost in the madness. Commendable. I, myself, would welcome a nudge in the right direction...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_COCOBUKI_000_064: (-???-)Guide! I have need of your services.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_COCOBUKI_000_065: I seek the diversion in which a voidsent creature─one summoned by the thaumaturgical arts of my own guild, no less─is featured most prominently. Know you of such an attraction?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A6_000_001: That would be Any Way the Wind Blows, I believe.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A6_000_002: That would be Triple Triad, I believe.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A6_000_003: That would be Cuff-a-Cur, I believe.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_COCOBUKI_000_066: So Typhon is here. I must inspect the measures employed in his containment, and ensure there is no danger to the populace. If you will excuse me...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_066: Cocobuki seems greatly appreciative of your answer!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_COCOBUKI_000_067: Hm? Is there perhaps another entity of the void here of whose existence I was unaware? I suppose it is possible...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_067: Cocobuki seems less than convinced by your answer...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_068: Thank you,  ─you've given me the chance to attend to several other vital duties. Now, shall we review your performance?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_069: Well, I'm happy to say that every guest seemed well satisfied by your recommendations! An admirable display of service! Has anyone spoken with you about becoming a full-time employee...?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_070: Well, I'm afraid you stumbled with one or two of your recommendations. On the whole, however, you did rather well for a novice.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_071: Well, I must say that our guests did not seem overly pleased with your advice. I suggest you study our attractions again, and more carefully consider which guest might find which amusement the most appealing...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_072: But putting such matters aside, we appreciate any effort made towards maintaining the Saucer's reputation for hospitality. Dismissed! Oh, and don't forget to return to Entrance Square and collect your wages from the chief attendant!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_JACKE_000_080: (-???-)Well, well, if it ain't the infamous ! Ye here for play, or is it other mischief ye've got in mind?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_JACKE_000_081: Honest work, is it!? Yer an odd cove, , but that don't mean I won't take yer advice.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_JACKE_000_082: (-???-)A fine  to ye, . If I could have a whid with ye real quick-like...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_JACKE_000_083: Tell me, which o' these games is most like to get a bloke's blood racin', then? Preferably somethin' what rewards nimble dew beaters an' a disregard for danger.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A7_000_002: Might I suggest the Moogle's Paw?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A7_000_003: Might I suggest Any Way the Wind Blows?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_JACKE_000_084: Oho, dodgin' bombs, eh? Now that does sound like a lark! Thanks for the idea!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_084: Jacke seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_JACKE_000_085: Hm... Might be as we've got different ideas o' what passes for excitement. Thanks all the same, though!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_085: Jacke seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SERENDIPITY_000_087: ...Working as a guide, you say? What a happy coincidence! I was actually feeling a bit lost...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SERENDIPITY_000_088: (-???-)Excuse me! Sorry to bother, but I'm afraid I'm feeling a bit lost...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SERENDIPITY_000_089: Could you point me in the direction of one of the less-intimidating attractions? Perhaps due to my occupation, I have a weakness for all things small and well made─and squealingly adorable, if I'm being honest.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A8_000_001: Might I suggest Any Way the Wind Blows?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A8_000_002: Might I suggest the Slice Is Right?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A8_000_003: Might I suggest Lord of Verminion?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SERENDIPITY_000_090: Armies of clockwork dolls!? All squeezed together in one tiny arena? Eeeeee!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_090: Serendipity seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SERENDIPITY_000_091: I...seem to have explained myself poorly. That promises to lead to a more terrified sort of squealing...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_091: Serendipity seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEGERUJU_000_092: (-???-)My dear adventurer! I would have thought you far too busy─and stiflingly straitlaced─to frequent a den of frivolity such as this!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEGERUJU_000_093: ...Ah, well that explains it. Seeing as you've taken a position to serve, I see no reason not to call upon your services...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEGERUJU_000_094: (-???-)Oh, guiiide! You are in the enviable position of providing a service to the master of Costa del Sol!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEGERUJU_000_095: I am, shall we say, an “admirer” of beauty of the kitten-ish kind. Is there some simple amusement which might also indulge my discerning gaze? And let me be clear: I am a creature of comfort, entirely unsuited to exertion or exhaustion.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A9_000_002: Might I suggest Leap of Faith?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_A9_000_003: Might I suggest the Moogle's Paw?
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEGERUJU_000_096: Just a few button presses, you say!? And some lovely young bunnies lounging nearby into the bargain! While I'm more of a “cat-lover,” variety is, after all, the spice of life!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_096: Gegeruju seems greatly enthused by your suggestion!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_GEGERUJU_000_097: That sounds terribly tiresome. Are you sure this will help me meet some pretty young thing? I shall...ugh...make an effort, then.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_SYSTEM_100_097: Gegeruju seems less than enthused by your suggestion...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_098: Thank you,  ─I'll not ask you to sacrifice your entire . Do allow me, however, a quick word to summarize your performance...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_099: ...Perfect! Simply perfect! Why, our guests might mistake you as one of our full-time employees!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_100: ...Adequate. Merely adequate. Although it seems one or two of our guests were somewhat leery of your recommendations, I cannot fault your enthusiasm.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_101: ...Abysmal? Awful? I take no issue with your demeanor, but please, for the love of Master Manderville, do listen carefully when the guests are explaining their desires...
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFF03964_000_102: Evaluations aside, we stand by our promise to reward those who work to maintain the Saucer's reputation for hospitality. The chief attendant will pay your wages back at Entrance Square!
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFFF_000_110: Thank you for your continued efforts! Here is your payment, as promised.
TEXT_FESGSC402_03964_STAFFF_000_111: Any further assistance you might provide during the campaign would be greatly appreciated!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Ah, you've come! There are but two constants in summer: sweltering heat and brave adventurers, and the Moonfire Faire cannot well begin in earnest until both have arrived. The sweat on my brow and your cocksure stride tell me that finally that time is here!

Ah, my eyes did not deceive me! Through the sun's burning and blinding rays, I spied a gallant figure approaching. I had feared that perhaps it was a mirage, but I'm overjoyed to see I was wrong─for it is yet another festive soul come to join the Moonfire Faire!
But first, it seems we have an uninvited guest on the shores of Costa del Sol that is causing chaos and alarm among our celebrations.

If reports from the Fishermen's Guild are to be believed, a gargantuan man-eating shark has been terrorizing the coast, gnashing its teeth and threatening to devour revelers whole. Needless to say, this has put something of a damper on an otherwise rousing event.
For a mercy, no one has yet come to harm, but I fear it is only a matter of time before the shark must sate its appetite. We must nip this problem in the bud before tragedy strikes.

While the members of our committee are doing their utmost to find a solution, a pair of capable hands could only speed things along. Haermaga, chief chaperone of the festivities, is standing by in Costa del Sol, eager to greet any potential volunteers.

Haermaga is standing by to set any volunteers to work as soon as he can. You can find him near the Isle of Endless Summer─and hurry, before he or anyone else ends up at the bottom of that shark's gullet.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_010: Well, well, the savior of the summer has arrived! I was afraid we'd have to pack up for safer shores, but now that the true apex predator has arrived, I believe we can stay readily put!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_011: You there! Could it be our call for aid has finally been answered? You certainly have the look of someone who's vanquished a predator or two in your day!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_012: Although I've yet to see it with my own eyes, there've been disturbing reports of an enormous shark lurking in the waters nearby.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_014: The Adventurers' Guild takes these reports seriously─our guests' safety comes first and foremost. Culling fiends is our bread and butter, and now it's time to show our mettle.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_015: Master Gegeruju means to protect his stake in the festival as well, and as we speak is assembling an elite team of shark hunters. They should be here soon, but I'd appreciate if you'd keep lookout with me in the meantime. Two pairs of eyes are better than one, after all.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BEACHGUY03966_000_0: Shark! Shark! Run for your lives!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_017: H-Hey, wait just a bleedin' minute! You don't mean to face that beast all by your lonesome, do you!? I'm not exactly dressed for combat here.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_A1_000_002: Why do you think I came all this way?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_A1_000_003: I've fried bigger fish than this before.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_019: Hah, spoken like a seasoned adventurer! But you're as foolish as you are daring if you think I'm letting you risk life and limb needlessly!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_020: Bigger fish!? Then let's hope this one's mother isn't nearby...
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_021: (-???-)Stay your weapon! Reckless heroics will only serve to incite the monster.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_022: Well, looks like you'll have to share the glory today. The certified shark hunters are here!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_023: Thracie, at your service! In years past the Cascadiers were formed to quench the Bombards' fiery rage, and in that same spirit the Bombardiers have assembled to send this new threat back to the depths. We will see safety returned to your beaches.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_024: Ba Go has been recruited to lend his expertise─knowledge, skill, expertise! Ba Go knows a thing or two about explosions! Haha! Heeheahhahaha!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_025: The Bombardiers, eh? I wish the guild would've mentioned that they were handing over the torch...
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_026: Ah, but the guild wasn't involved in our inception. The Bombardiers owe their existence solely to Master Gegeruju. He could not afford to wait for someone else's solution, but he could afford to make his own.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_027: This shark is unlike any I have seen in my long years of research. Judging from my analysis of its movements and behaviors, it means to leave its watery home and encroach upon these very shores.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_029: Why the hells would it do that!?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_030: That much remains a mystery. The beast's final destination is impossible to discern, but we would be fools to let it run amok.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_031: However, it seems to have no interest in attacking us. Yet. If we were to engage it directly, however, it may gain a taste for blood, and there is no telling how many innocent lives would be lost before its appetite was sated. If we're to coax it back whence it came, it must be done without spilling blood.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_032: And that is where our kobold friend comes in. In exchange for some rare alchemical supplies, he has offered to share with us his clan's methods for creating the selfsame bombs which so often threatened our realm in summers past.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_033: Yes, Ba Go treats his bombs most lovingly, most protectively! But Ba Go loves shiny materials just as much. Materials which were promised─sworn, pledged, promised!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_034: You must also promise not to tell the other kobolds that Ba Go shares his secrets. If they were to find out, Ba Go would never hear the end of their grumblings─complaints, moans, grumblings!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_035: To create a bomb that will become a breathtaking explosion is an art! One must pamper it as they would one's own child. Kobolds keep their secrets close, but Ba Go is generous─giving, kind, generous!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_036: ...Yes, indeed. Thanks to Ba Go's cooperation, we have managed to create our own Bombards, which should explode with enough force to disabuse this shark of any notions of coming further inland.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_037: Have you lost your bloody minds! The realm almost burned on account of those demons, and now you're using them as toys!?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_038: We must use the knowledge gleaned from conflicts past to see us safely through those to come. Don't you agree, adventurer? If you would offer your aid to our cause, me and the other Bombardiers would gladly welcome you among our ranks.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_039: Splendid! Any adventurer brave enough to draw their weapon against such an overwhelming foe is sure to be a formidable ally. Our operation will begin soon─speak with me when you are ready.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_041: Hehehe... Heahaha! The realm will be saved by a shower of flames!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_042: I suppose you are curious about the garments I'm wearing? All in due time, I promise.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_040: Greetings. I take it your preparations are complete? Then let's get right to it.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_043: The first obstacle we had to overcome was the matter of how to manipulate the Bombard without also putting ourselves in danger. And for that, we once again found inspiration in bygone days.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_044: Perhaps you have heard of the bomb dance? It is a tradition that originated in the Far East─performed during the summer, it is also said to have the power to influence the Bombards themselves. I asked Ba Go if his creations could be trained to respond to the movements and rhythm of such a dance.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_045: He assured me most emphatically that they could, and considering the nature of the threat before us, suggested we use a dance even more explosive than the bomb dance. Jiriri put forth one of her favorites─traditional steps performed by the Lalafells of the southern isles. Jiriri, if you will?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_045: Of course. If it pleases you, allow me to perform the flame dance, taught to me by my grandmother.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_100_046: Amazing, astounding, amazing! Such powerful movements would set the iciest heart ablaze─Ba Go shudders to think how it might inflame his little bombs!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_046: Jiriri tells me the dance's purpose is twofold. Not only did it spur the warriors of the isles to action, but it was said to mollify the savage spirits slumbering within the volcanic mountains overshadowing the villages.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_047: Considering the complexity of the steps, it may behoove you to first practice with a smaller specimen. 'Twould be a shame if our noble endeavor was cut short by a premature detonation.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_100_047: When again the shark emerges to wreak havoc, we will send forth one of our Bombards. Their flames will need some encouragement at first, so dance thusly to enkindle them.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_200_047: Continue the dance and the Bombard will be set ablaze, hopefully making it a match for that shark. If the creature's flames should begin to fade, however, then perform these steps to restore their vibrancy.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_300_047:
As simple as that!
And now we play the waiting game. Stay vigilant, and the moment you see even a fin emerge from the waters, brace yourself and we shall begin at once. There is much at stake, but I believe we are more than up for the task!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SYSTEM_300_047: Join the FATE “Bombard vs. Shark,” which will appear in the southeastern region of the faire grounds, and make careful use of the flame dance to lead the Bombard to victory over the shark.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SYSTEM_400_047: Pay close attention to the Bombard's health, and use both forms of the flame dance to empower it to drive its foe back to the ocean floor.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_048: The steps may seem intimidating at first, but I'm certain you'll master them in no time at all. You'll have to, if we're to have any hope of salvaging summer!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_SYSTEM_000_050: You have learned the emote Flame Dance!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_060: I must see that the other Bombardiers are carrying out their duties. We must work flawlessly if we're to succeed!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_061: To think that a humble Lalafellin dance might play a role in saving summer! Master Gegeruju will be overjoyed to hear the news─assuming our plan goes off without a hitch, that is.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_062: Look at her! So fiery─blazing, flaming, fiery! She is Ba Go's pride, and her explosion will be one for the songs! Heheheahaha!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_065: Well done! The operation went flawlessly, in no small part thanks to your noble efforts! We must report our success to Haermaga at once!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_066: Even my grandmother would have been impressed by your display!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_067: Did you see, did you see? Ba Go's bomb was so pretty─breathtaking, beautiful, pretty! Like an exploding star!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_070: You crazy bastards really went and did it! You put on a show I could see from here, and with a burning passion I could feel right down to the cockles of my heart!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_071: We could not have done it without ! I daresay the Bombardiers have not only carried the torch of their predecessor, but have set it ablaze with a flame that will burn forevermore!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_072: Ba Go's bomb went forth with such courage, such grace! Ba Go must work day and night to make another that will outshine her blaze of glory!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_073: I don't know about all that, but it's plain to see that your efforts have brought peace back to the shores of Costa del Sol. Seems we won't be canceling this year's Moonfire Faire after all.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_074: And yet, there are many questions left unanswered. How did that shark develop legs and hands? And for what purpose did it come ashore?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_FOERZAGYL_000_076: A thousand apologies, lass! Didn't mean to give you such a fright. This little bugger can scurry off quicker than a chocobo when it gets a mind to!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_077: Captain Foerzagyl! What brings you here? And what brings...that!?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_FOERZAGYL_000_078: My little friend here roams wheresoever the winds carry him. Isn't he just the cutest? A face you could kiss─if it weren't covered in scales, that is─and he's got the heart of an adventurer!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_FOERZAGYL_000_079: He flopped onto the deck of the Endeavor during one of our ocean fishing voyages, and it was love at first sight. We've been fast friends ever since.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_FOERZAGYL_100_079: I could ask for no better a shipmate on the high seas, and I reckon the feelin' is mutual. Well then, I'd best head back to the ship. The Navigator waits for no man─or shark!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_080: You don't think...? What if that big fish was here looking for that little fish?
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_081: Quite impossible! What would be the chances of that? Besides, even if it were the case, that tiny critter seemed to be quite content at Captain Foerzagyl's side.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_THRACIE_000_082: I suppose it matters not. By our deeds the Moonfire Faire has been saved, and we can return to the festivities.
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_BAGO_000_083: So bright, so violent, Ba Go's little bomb. Ba Go will never forget you...
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_JIRIRI_000_084:
Yes, you should rightly be proud of her contribution!
Anyroad, I should report back to Master Gegeruju at once. Doubtless he will jump with joy at the news of our victory!
TEXT_FESSUM601_03966_HAERMAGA_000_085: Everything's wrapped up in a neat little package, eh? No way these unresolved questions will come back and bite us in the arse? Well, if they do...I hope you can remember the steps to that dance!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HAERMAGA_000_001: Excellent job scaring away that man-eating shark, friend. Although I suppose we didn't actually witness it eating anything, man or otherwise... Anyroad, I reckon as long as we have those Bombards at our disposal, we can breathe easy for the time being.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HAERMAGA_000_002: By the way, Master Gegeruju sends his regards. Seems he's quite eager to learn more about that flame dance, and has given you the honor of an audience.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HAERMAGA_000_003: Might be best to go speak with him now─he's not known to enjoy waiting around.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HAERMAGA_000_004: Master Gegeruju seemed mighty eager to learn more of that flame dance of yours. Probably best not to keep him waiting for too long.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_010: Ah, the  of the hour arrives at last! Jiriri was just now regaling me the tale of your bravery and grace─a tale which I now see contains no exaggerations.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_011: Everyone in Costa del Sol, myself included, owes you a debt of gratitude. I understand it was quite the display.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_012: Indeed.  would have been right at home dancing along with my grandmother.  guided the Bombard to an effortless victory over that vicious beast.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_013: Ah, yes, the dance! A most curious thing!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_100_013: Jiriri has been serving me for longer than I can remember, yet I have just recently learned of it! Just how long have you been keeping this a secret?
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_014: I had only ever viewed it as a provincial tradition─not something that would pique your refined sensibilities, and certainly not something on which lives would hinge.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_015: My grandmother told me that the flame dance began as a way to quell the fiery rage of the goddess who slumbered in the mountains of the southern isles.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_016: It served not only as a form of protection─over time, new steps were added to stoke the spirits of warriors soon to depart to battle. Given those origins, it seemed the perfect fit for this unique problem we faced.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_018: Grace meets tradition... I daresay it embodies the spirit of Costa del Sol!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_019: You simply must perform it for me! Perhaps along with some of the other dancers? Yes, yes, with the graceful and lithe ones. I should very much like to see them swaying back and forth...
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_020: It seems Master Gegeruju has a...keen interest in the flame dance. I suppose it would be only fitting to let you do the honors─rest assured, your services will be well compensated. Will you oblige us?
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_021: Excellent. In that case, I shall see to the necessary preparations at once.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_022: In the meantime, recruit as many dancers as are willing, and I'm sure in no time we'll have an entourage that will please this most demanding of audiences.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_023: What were you two whispering about? Ah, I'd best not pry─anticipation is the most titillating part!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HAERMAGA_000_024: Let me guess─Gegeruju has charged you with some task or another. Well, if there's anything we can do, we're here to serve!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_KONEKO03967_000_030: Oh, it's you! I heard tell you put on a performance so fiery it scared away a shark as large as a house!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_KONEKO03967_000_031: Master Gegeruju wishes us to learn the dance? Of course, it would be our pleasure─it may very well come in handy the next time he's in one of his moods.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_KONEKO03967_000_032: My word! The steps are most elegant in their simplicity, but the movements are as fierce as a raging inferno. Truly it is a dance for the season!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_KONEKO03967_000_033: Now, everyone, let's practice until we get it right! Master Gegeruju will accept nothing less than perfection!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_RMAJHA_100_034: Summer is our favorite time of the year! We never miss the Moonfire Faire!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_RFHULTIA_000_034: Ah, , good to see you! I've heard the stories of your battle with the shark. I wish we had been there to cheer you on.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_RFHULTIA_000_035: Wait...are you...? You're the adventurer who scared away that brutish shark! People are telling stories about you up and down the beach. I wish we had been there to see it!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_RFHULTIA_000_036: Did you hear that!? 's teaching the dance to one and all! It doesn't matter if we missed the epic battle─we can scare the shark off ourselves next time it shows its moss-afflicted snout.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_RFHULTIA_000_037: Did you see that? Did you!? I think I've memorized it... Oh, I dare another overgrown fish to try and ruin our fun!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HILDELANA_100_040: Ah, warm sand under my feet, revelers frolicking about─and not a shark in sight!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_BEAUDEFOIN_000_039: And I see the summer brings yet another constant─when I heard you had arrived I knew we had nothing to worry about. I would like to thank you personally for your efforts in driving that beastly predator back to the depths.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HILDELANA_000_040: It reminds me of my days with the Cascadiers, when we beat the Bombards back by the skin of our teeth. What a reversal that this year our former foes would play a part in our salvation!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_BEAUDEFOIN_000_041: So you're the  Haermaga has been gushing about, and with good reason─from how he tells it, you single-handedly drove that ill-mannered predator back to the depths where it belongs.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HILDELANA_000_042: Your heroics bring me back to the days of the Cascadiers, when we drove back the Bombard menace by the skin of our teeth. What a reversal that this year our former foes would play a part in our salvation!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HILDELANA_000_043: Say again? You want to teach me this flame dance? Well, I suppose as one of the chaperones of the festivities, I should know the steps by which they were saved. Wouldn't you agree, Beaudefoin?
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_BEAUDEFOIN_000_044: Now that's a dance! Graceful yet powerful, refined yet torrid─it is summer embodied!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_HILDELANA_000_045: Its simplicity belies the power of its motions. I must admit, I'm somewhat hesitant to perform such a dance in front of Master Gegeruju, but as long as I'm not alone I'm sure I'll overcome my stage fright.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_050: I never imagined so many would be so eager to learn the flame dance. Thank you. If only my grandmother were here to see this...I have no doubt it would bring a smile to her face.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_051: While even a single dancer can make a strong impression, compared to a group performing in unison they are as a candle before a blazing bonfire. I've arranged matching attire for each of you, that your fire might burn ever brighter.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_JIRIRI_000_052: Once you've dressed for the occasion, meet us on the beach and we shall usher in the arrival of peace to the Moonfire Faire!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_GEGERUJU_000_053: Finally, the moment is at hand! I pray this dance is as every bit as invigorating as I've been led to believe!
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SYSTEM_000_054: Through the power of dance, you have restored peace and quietude to the shores of Costa del Sol. If aught appears to threaten this hard-won serenity once more, use the flame dance to send the menace scurrying back to its lair.
TEXT_FESSUM602_03967_SYSTEM_000_055: You may now purchase wares from the Moonfire Faire vendor. Participate in the FATE appearing in the southeastern region of the faire grounds to earn vouchers that can be exchanged for goods.
TEXT_LUCKHA021_03972_AUGEBERT_000_000: Well, if it isn't ! Take a look around and feast your eyes on Featherfall, the latest district of the Firmament, now open for business! And needless to say, we couldn't have done it without you.
TEXT_LUCKHA021_03972_AUGEBERT_000_001: As you doubtless already know, Featherfall's to serve as the Firmament's commercial district. Here you'll find a branch office of the Skysteel Manufactory, an impressive residence we call Hoarfrost Hall, and a lively marketplace where you'll find traders and merchants peddlin' goods from the realm over.
TEXT_LUCKHA021_03972_AUGEBERT_000_002: Aye, no end of merchants, craftsmen, and laborers have been beatin' down our doors hopin' to make a new home here. Not that I can blame them─why, I've half a mind to relocate here myself!
TEXT_LUCKHA021_03972_AUGEBERT_000_003: Lord Francel believes it's only a matter of time before Featherfall becomes the livin', beatin' heart of the Firmament, and from the look of things, I reckon it's half there already.
TEXT_LUCKHA021_03972_AUGEBERT_000_004: 'Course, it's still a work in progress, and there's plenty of construction and restoration work yet to be done. If you'd be so kind as to help us keep a steady stream of supplies flowin' in, we'd be grateful as ever.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Hullo there! Would I be correct in assuming you've come to view my exhibition?
You see, I'm an artist by trade and my chosen medium is stained glass. While it's not the easiest thing to work with, the results are worth the considerable effort required!

It's taken me a while to reach this point in my career, and this is actually my first public showing. I was wondering, if it's not too much of a bother, if I might give you a brief explanation of the subject matter.
Ahem. Then pray, my good , cast your eyes at yonder pane!

'Twas the final days before the fall of Dalamud, its inexorable approach foretelling our impending doom. Panic spread like wildfire, while many in their desperation turned on the sultanate. Looting and rioting broke out across Ul'dah.

To quell the masses, Her Royal Majesty Nanamo Ul Namo took to the streets with a guard consisting of only seven subjects, for they alone had the courage to stand with their sultana. There, she addressed the rabble.

"Heed me, my beloved citizens! The realm lies upon the brink of the Seventh Umbral Era. Yet so long as we live, we must not forget our compassion. Now is not the time to take from your neighbor, but to proffer him the hand of succor.“
She was determined not to let the city that the Immortal Flames were risking their lives to defend tear itself apart in their absence. Her words brought the people to their senses.

They laid down their arms and set about healing the wounds they themselves had inflicted on Ul'dah. Thanks to Her Grace's impassioned speech, those who returned from the battlefield found their home much as they had left it: a gleaming jewel in the desert.

<sigh> It all seems so long ago. To see the place today, you'd think that the people had entirely forgotten her words that day. The same hands that were once proffered in succor now grasp greedily at every last coin, even if it means one's fellow man must go hungry...

It's times like these that we must remind ourselves of the sacrifices of those who came before us, which is why the Rising festival is of such profound importance. I draw inspiration from Her Grace's deeds all those years ago, and through my work, perhaps others might do the same.

Dear me, I'd better stop before I'm overcome with emotion! There are in fact, matters to which I must yet attend, and if I'm not mistaken, you are an adventurer, yes? I've something you might be able to help me with, if you're willing.

In addition to having my stained glass on display, it's been arranged that a wandering minstrel will give a recital as part of the festivities. I'm looking to gather as many spectators as possible, but I fear I'll struggle to cover the necessary ground by myself. Perhaps you could give me a hand?
Twelve bless you, ! I plan to hand out these flyers, and with two of us, we'll be able to reach twice the number of people in the same span of time.
If you'd be so kind as to look for potential attendees around the Steps of Thal, I'll head for the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Let's meet there when you're done.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_RESIDENTSA03973_000: Stained glass? Depicting the sultana herself, no less. I've always been a loyal supporter of hers, and it would remiss of me to pass up such an opportunity. I shall be sure to attend.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_RESIDENTSB03973_000: Got somethin' you want diggin' up?
Hmm... Can't say I'm much of an expert when it comes to music and fine art, but it ain't often a bloke like me gets a chance to sample the high life. I'd be a fool to miss it!
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_RESIDENTSC03973_000: Hmm... That does sound rather intriguing. If it's the same minstrel my associates have mentioned on occasion, I had best go and see what all the fuss is about. I hear he's rather talented.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: I've still got one or two more flyers left, and so have you by the looks of it. Let's reconvene once they've all been distributed.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ASTIN_100_030: If I didn't know better, I'd think you were trying to avoid me...
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: All done? Much appreciated, but I'm afraid I've run into a bit of a problem...

I was in the process of a handing a flyer to this gentleman, when my friend Astin showed up out of the blue. As chance would have it, these two chaps are previously acquainted, though they do not appear to be on particularly good terms...
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07RESIDENTS04_00: But how am I supposed to pay you back if the amount keeps going up!?
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ASTIN_000_036: If you'd coughed up the money on the day we'd originally agreed, there wouldn't be so much interest to pay. You've only got yourself to blame.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: But Astin, if your interest rates weren't so high, perhaps he'd have been able to pay you back by now. I'm not saying you should wipe the slate clean, but surely you can come to a compromise?
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ASTIN_000_038: All I want is for him to honor our agreement. What's wrong with that? Besides, I've held up my side of the bargain, so why do I have to be the one to compromise?
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ASTIN_000_039: <sigh> But let's say I give you the benefit of the doubt, that you genuinely lack the means to pay me back. I'll grant you one week's extension, but if you still don't have the money by then, there'll be consequences.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07RESIDENTS04_00: Only a week? All right, you damned vulture, you'll get your gil. Then I'll be rid of you for good.
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: I'm sad to say that such incidents are part of everyday life in Ul'dah.
Someone in financial difficulty sees a moneylender as the answer to their woes, like an oasis in the desert. But it's only a mirage, an illusion of salvation, leading them into even greater debt.

Then again, many debtors will borrow money without any intention of paying it back, relying on an endless stream of short-term solutions. <sigh> I hope that those who look upon my art will remember the words of the sultana, and seek to help rather than exploit one another.
Those two chaps you saw arguing just now would benefit from it, I'm sure. You know, Astin wasn't always like that. He's picked me up when I was down more times than I can count.

We both grew up on the streets of Ul'dah with no one to turn to but each other. The only reason I'm even here today─making a living as an artist, of all things─is because of Astin and his talent for business. With a few words and a couple of handshakes, he could turn a gil into a gold mine.

But as the years passed, it became an obsession. No matter how much coin he made, it was never enough. I wish he'd realize there's more to life than personal gain, but nothing I say gets through to him.
That's part of the reason why I turned to stained glass art in the first place. It can express my inner thoughts far better than words ever could. Well, my words, at any rate.

Oh goodness, I do apologize! You must think I'm an awful bore to rope you into helping only to bombard you with complaints and sob stories. But enough of that─it's high time I returned to the exhibition and prepared for the arrival of the minstrel.
Ah, there you are. I hate to say this, but we've run into a slight problem. And by “slight problem,” I actually mean “rather a huge catastrophe.”
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07GOLDSMITH_100_: So huge, in fact, I need a moment to compose myself. While I'm loath to impose on you any further, I've a feeling I may need your help again, or at least some moral support...
TEXT_FESANV601_03973_ANV07RESIDENTS05_20: If we'd known this would happen, we would never have gone near it!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_100_: All right, enough panicking, it's time for decisive action!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: While we were out distributing flyers, these children were a little overzealous when it came to admiring my artwork. It seems they were unaware of the “look but don't touch” rule that normally applies to these things, and...well, it fell on the floor and shattered.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_A1_100_000: This calls for six of the best. No...their punishment must be more severe.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_A2_100_000: I suggest staging a play based on the same scene. I'll be Nanamo.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Not the first thought that crossed my mind, I must admit. The recital is due to begin any moment now, so the only viable option is to repair the smashed pane as best we can.
I think that with a little adhesive here and there, the spectators will hardly notice the cracks.

Unfortunately, I don't have any to hand at present. While I run off to fetch some bonding agent from the Alchemists' Guild, perhaps you could try piecing the broken glass back together? Don't worry, I'll show you how it's done.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07RESIDENTS05_20: If we'd known this would happen, we would never have gone near it!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Are you ready to begin?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SYSTEM_000_006: The following controls can be used to repair the stained glass:
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Oh? Mayhap you have a more pressing engagement? In all honesty, I can't imagine anything more urgent than this, but I shall wait until you are able to lend a hand.
Yes, that's perfect! With a few dabs of adhesive, it'll be as good as new. Well, almost. It should certainly suffice for the time being, though!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_100_: All's well that ends well, yes? The children were beside themselves with worry, but now, they're as delighted as I am!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: ...Hm? Oh, just a moment of nostalgia. I know from firsthand experience that moment of horror that comes when breaking an expensive piece of glass.

A few years ago, I was helping Astin with one of his ventures as an art dealer. I was in desperate need of gil so he hired me to transport a few pieces. That was when I dropped a case containing some valuable stained glass, and...I'll never forget the awful sound it made.
But rather than curse me for my clumsiness or fret over the money it had cost him, his only concern was whether I'd cut myself on any of the shards.
So you see, that's why I don't blame the children for their little misadventure. I suppose I'm following Astin's example.
Hmm... Actually, there's one more favor I'd like to ask of you.
I think if Astin were to see my stained glass, it might remind him of the days when there were things more important to him than money.

Of course, I've tried various approaches in the past, and most of what I say to him goes in one ear and out the other. But if it were to come from someone else, such as your good self, he might be more inclined to listen. Would you mind having a word with him?
You're too kind! Perhaps you could start by handing him this flyer and going from there.

I expect he's in the Quicksand, where he carries out much of his business. His clients tend to be a bit more malleable when they're in their cups, it seems. Anyway, if you could rouse his interest in the festivities, we'll leave the rest to him.

I'm sad to say, Astin's behavior has become rather easy to predict of late. Since his every waking moment is devoted to making others' coin his own, it's not hard to guess where he'll be at any given moment. If he isn't in the tavern, he's most likely at the market.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_031: I remember you. Bhen's assistant, yes? Or maybe he's yours... Either way, I appreciate you looking out for him. He needs all the help he can get.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_033: Though I must say, if you've something that requires my attention, I'd rather you kept it brief.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_034: Yes, I know all about Bhen's exhibit, thank you. Keeping my ear to the ground as I do, there's little that goes on in Ul'dah that escapes my notice. So why did he send you to advertise it to me?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_035: He wants to remind me of the good old days? I might've guessed it would be something as soppy as that. A lot's changed since then, but he's still the same daft sod he's always been.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_036: Not that it's necessarily a bad thing, mind you. It's his sentimental side that allows him to create such...evocative works of art.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_037: But I always felt that if he tried to make a living out of it, he'd lose the very essence of what makes his pieces so special in the first place. Rather than expressing himself, he'd have to pander to the tastes of wealthy but fickle clients to turn a profit.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_038: That's why I wanted to earn enough for the both of us, so he'd be free to pursue his dreams. While he doesn't need me to pay for his bed and board anymore, I'm still around to help him if he falls on hard times.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_039: And just to make it perfectly clear, it's not that I don't want to attend the exhibition. I decided not to go because if people were to think that Bhen is associated with a moneylender like me, it would ruin his good reputation.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_040: But if he insists that I go, perhaps I can make an appearance without drawing too much attention. Tell him I'll think about it, would you?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_041: Just so you know, “I'll think about it” does not mean the same as “yes.” I will give it due consideration, though.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: So, what did he say?
Hmm... I'll just have to wait and see.
Whatever the outcome, I'm very grateful for all you've done. And I'm sure you'll be pleased to hear I've saved you the perfect spot from which to view the event!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Citizens of Ul'dah! By my words be transported to the days before the Calamity, a time when all hope seemed lost. As the lesser moon hung low in the sky, a wave of terror washed over this fair city, turning neighbor against neighbor, brother against brother.
There, in the midst of chaos, she stood defiantly. And so our tale begins. Hearken now to “The Sultana's Seven”...
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Astonishing! I could see the events of that fateful day in my mind's eye as vividly as I see you now! Such a profoundly moving performance would surely have touched the hearts of everyone in attendance.
Astin! You came after all!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_052: An artist you may be, but subtle you are not.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_100_052: "Now is not the time to take from your neighbor, but to proffer him the hand of succor.“
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_110_052: A message to all of Ul'dah, I'm sure, but also one meant specifically for me. I have to admit, the sultana made a good point, and it still stands to this day. Maybe it's time I thought about earning an honest living...
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_100_: I knew you'd come around sooner or later!
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: And Astin, I can take care of myself now, so you needn't go to such lengths to support me.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_054: I'm glad to hear it, but let's get one thing straight: I didn't become a moneylender just to cover your expenses while you carved out a career as an artist.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_055: I just didn't want you to compromise your ideals and the quality of your work for the sake of keeping a roof over your head. Now you can concentrate on doing what you do best: bringing joy to people through your art.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_056: As for me, I should find a better use for my skills. Perhaps I could go back to being an art dealer. That way, you can create whatever works you please while I seek out potential buyers. It certainly beats making commissioned pieces for some pretentious buffoon.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: You're suggesting we go into business together?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_058: Yes, unless you have any objections to working with a very recently reformed moneylender?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Of course not! And I know just where to start: producing more panes featuring the sultana and her seven trusty followers!
Imagine the streets of Ul'dah lined with stained glass depicting its illustrious history. The sparkling jewel of the desert will shine brighter than ever!

This is more than I could've dreamed of. Of course, none of this would've been possible without your kindness, . You probably hear effusive words of praise quite often in your line of work, but I sincerely mean it: thank you for all you've done.
Oh, and there was one other thing I meant to tell you. The wandering minstrel was, ah...wondering if he could have a word with you.
In fact, he has a present of sorts to give you. He should be somewhere nearby. Best of luck finding him!
Having trouble tracking down the minstrel? Perhaps his wandering has already taken him to pastures new?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_ASTIN_000_067: Thanks to you and Bhen, I'm ready to turn over a new leaf. Once my debtors have given back what they owe, that is. And if they catch me while I'm still in a charitable mood, I might even be prepared to overlook the interest.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Ah, you are come, as I knew you would. J'bhen Tia speaks very highly of not only your skill at piecing together broken glass, but of your loyalty and compassion. Your virtues are many and varied indeed.

Were it not for your contribution, the festival would have been without its centerpiece. My accompaniment of song was naught but a garnish to the fine dish that was our mutual friend's glorious work of art. Perhaps you will allow me to express my gratitude with another piece I have composed?
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_07: (-???-)Welcome, Warrior of Light. Or should I call you Warrior of Darkness? You needn't be alarmed by these strange surroundings.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_07: (-???-)Greetings, Warrior of Light. You needn't be alarmed.
(-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Naoki Yoshida. It gives me great pleasure to finally meet you, brave soul who has chosen a life of adventure.
It is an honor to be reunited with you in this world between worlds. I have been following your adventures with great interest.
Your travels have taken you to lands far and wide, and you have encountered people of all walks of life, each with their own ideals, hopes, and dreams.
As time flows onward in a never-ending spiral, the course of history is guided by mortal hands. Though our existence be brief, our deeds echo for eternity.

Seven years have passed since the lesser moon descended. Seven years since mankind rose from the ashes. 'Twas a spectacle none shall ever forget, and that they live to tell the tale is cause for both celebration and reflection.
When we cast our minds back, it is not sorrow that fills our hearts, but joy. For we have been afforded a second chance, that we may learn from the lessons of the past.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_08: As we set forth towards new horizons, those with a thirst for adventure will lead the way. While there may be hardships and strife on the road ahead, there is no obstacle that we cannot overcome if we believe in ourselves...and each other.
Countless kindred spirits share our journey, and it is through mutual respect and understanding that we may create a better world.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_08: The future is what we make it, by our words and deeds, and we will forever be at your side, brave adventurer. You have our undying gratitude, now and always.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_08: ...The time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
Ever will we be watching over you. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, Warrior of Light and Darkness both. Till next we meet...
Ever will we be watching over you and your deeds. Guide the realm unto peace and happiness, Warrior of Light...
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: And lo, you are returned. Pray tell, are you left with pleasant memories, fleeting though they may be?
That is well, for such visions are wont to fade all too quickly, as the morning dew in the light of the rising sun. Mayhap another of my verses would make a suitable gift ere we part?

In the wake of calamity, Light descends once more,
To illuminate a world reborn, risen from fires of war.♪
'Neath the eyes of heaven, deception crumbles to dust,
Those divided by malice, united by bonds of trust.♪

On fields awash in crimson, battle raged far and wide,
In the name of liberty, the courageous few turn the tide.♪
Unto a distant realm, drowned in radiance unrelenting,
Strides forth the harbinger of night, iron will unbending.♪

...For the sake of their loved ones, there are those who take to the battlefield. And yet, those who remain behind have their roles to play. Protectors and the protected, providers and the provided for. Principles upon which every nation is built.

It is the duty of those who rule to ensure that these elements are kept in balance, even if they must face great peril. The words of the sultana ring as true in the here and now as they did on that fateful day. May each of us take them to heart as we face the new dawn as one.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SYSTEM_000_094: You have unlocked the jigsaw puzzle mini-game.
TEXT_FESANV602_03974_SYSTEM_000_095: Open the toy chest in any inn room to try this activity.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_INVESTIGATOR03995_0: Ah, we meet again! You're the adventurer who so kindly assisted with me with my investigation in years past, yes? Truth be told, your timing couldn't be better─there's a small matter I could use your help with should you have a moment to spare.

As you can well see from the decorations about town, All Saints' Wake is nearly upon us. And I am pleased to report that this year, at least, I have seen no sign of those fiends from the Continental Circus as of yet.

Hello there, friend. You have the look of a seasoned adventurer about you─and I would know, what with my superior powers of deduction. If you could spare the time, I could use your assistance in a matter I'm investigating at the moment.
Oh, thank you! Pray tell me: are you familiar with the Continental Circus?
The people of Eorzea know them as a traveling troupe of entertainers who visit whenever All Saints' Wake is upon us. However, in actuality they are a band of voidsent fiends in disguise.

That is not to say they get up to anything that goes beyond the realm of mere mischief. No, they are generally harmless, which is why I have been content to observe them from afar. Bizarrely I am yet to see any sign of them this time round despite the festivities being so close at hand.
That said, I do not mean to say that things have been uneventful of late. A rather peculiar gentleman known as the Scarlet Snout has appeared to fill the vacuum of absurdity left by the Circus.

Most suspicious as I'm sure you will agree. Which is why I set about investigating the matter, however things have not quite gone to plan and I was hoping you might be able to help me look into this strange character.
Do you think you could spare some time to ask the residents of Gridania about the Scarlet Snout?
Ah, you have my thanks. I shall continue to do my part in the meantime. Pray alert me should you learn aught of interest.
Ah, you have my thanks. I shall continue to do my part in the meantime. Pray alert me should you learn aught of interest.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENA03995_000_0: Can't say I've seen anyone matching that description myself, but now that you mention it...I remember a friend of mine saying she saw an odd character wandering about here the other day.

It stuck with me because she said he was dressed up in odd garb─almost like that of a jester. I can't guarantee that was the man you're looking for, but it sounds too similar to be a coincidence, yes?
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENB03995_000_0: ...Ah. So you're looking for this so-called Scarlet Snout as well, are you? Well, tough luck─I'm going to beat you to him!

See, I've heard that he's a well-heeled bloke who loves nothing more than to share his fortune with his friends. Ever since then, I've been searching high and low for him. Even if I did know anything, damned if I'm going to share it with anyone!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENC03995_000_0: A fellow with a red nose? Wh-Why, no. I've heard nothing of such a man! And I most certainly haven't been invited to a holiday feast organized by such an individual! Perish the thought!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_A1_000_002: You look as if you've seen a ghost.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENC03995_000_0: All right, all right! I'll tell you all I know. I was heading home from an errand when this fellow with a most prominent proboscis approaches me and asks if I'd visit him at his house. Said he needed someone to share his toys and sweets with.

At the same time, he made me assure him that I would tell no one of this offer─or that he even spoke to me at all. If he found out about this, I don't know what would happen. Promise me you won't tell anyone else!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZEND03995_000_0: A man with a red nose? Psst...listen. This is just between the two of us.

Aye, I've met the man of whom you speak. In fact, he even invited me to a banquet of sorts. Yes, I was relaxing by the river the other night, when I suddenly heard a voice that I couldn't quite place.

I turned around to see a man dressed in motley standing behind me. We got to talking─befitting his appearance, he's quite the jovial fellow─and after a pleasant little chat, he invited me to dinner at his home in the coming days.

I called it a banquet, but he assured me that it would be a modest affair with only him and a few of his newfound friends. He also swore me to secrecy─no doubt he doesn't want strangers to come and crash the event. So don't tell anyone else I told you about this, all right?
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENA03995_000_0: Did you have any luck finding the man you seek? My apologies for not being able to tell you more─my friend only saw the fellow in jester's garb the once.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENB03995_000_0: Have I met the Scarlet Snout? Maybe I didn't, but maybe I did! Either way, I'm not going to tell you anything!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZENC03995_000_0: Look, don't tell anyone what I told you, okay? If the red-nosed fellow found out and rescinded the invitation, I'd be devastated!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_CITIZEND03995_000_0: Promise me you'll say nothing about the banquet to anyone. I wonder what sort of food he means to serve...
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_INVESTIGATOR03995_0: Ah, you're back. Did you glean anything of interest, perchance?
Inviting total strangers to his abode and swearing them to secrecy? Most suspicious, indeed. Yes, I highly doubt he is inviting these people out of the kindness of his heart. Something is afoot here.
Speaking of which, I was able to uncover some new information myself. It would seem most sightings of the Scarlet Snout occurred by the river.

I suspect it would be relatively easy to spot him if we staked out the area. And yet, I am hesitant to go myself. I have been asking around for so long now that it is likely that our suspect knows me, and is taking pains to avoid me.

While I am loath to impose upon your kindness, might I ask you to take care of this alone? I promise that I will be watching from a safe distance, and will not hesitate to lend a helping hand should you need it.
Oh, thank you ever so much! Now, we've no time to lose. Let us hurry along to the riverbank─yes, right by the Leatherworkers' Guild should give us a good vantage point.
I will keep watch from here to ensure that the Scarlet Snout does not try any funny business.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: (-???-)Say there, ...
(-???-)No, not there. Here! Over here!
(-Scarlet Snout-)Greetings, my friend! It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance!
(-Scarlet Snout-)Oh, dear me... Why the cold reception? Surely my appearance doesn't frighten you...
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_A2_000_001: I've heard some dodgy rumors about you.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: (-Scarlet Snout-)Dodgy? Me? There must be some mistake. I'm sure whoever told you those things simply had the wrong end of the stick.
(-Scarlet Snout-)Truly? But how could that be? Why, I dress like this so I can bring laughter and levity to one and all!
But where are my manners? I should introduce myself. I am Papa Gruff, a humble clown. Would you care to share your name with me?
? Such a pleasant name─brings a smile right to my face. Oh, it feels like we're thick as thieves already!
But how to commemorate our newfound friendship? Oh, but of course! Why don't you join me at my humble abode for a feast? I swear, you haven't lived until you've been to one of my banquets!

I ask only one favor: you are to tell no one about this. It wouldn't do if some random stranger barged in on a gathering of friends, yes? And should I find out you have gone against my wishes, well...
Ah, but I jest! That's what I do, you see? I wouldn't dream of harming even a flea! You have nothing to worry about. Nothing at all!
Anyroad, come meet me under the Bentbranch Meadows bridge whenever you're ready, and I'd be more than happy to show you the way to my home. Well, ta ta for now!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_INVESTIGATOR03995_0: So that was our man, was it? I must say, his appearance was every bit as...distinctive as the rumors said. Pray tell, did he invite you to his feast as he did the others?
...I had a feeling this was how things might play out. While his actions are most suspicious, it is impossible to tell exactly what his goal is, and whether or not he has any malicious intent.

I suppose our best option is to play along for the time being. Might I ask you to head to Bentbranch Meadows and observe things from a safe distance? If it seems the Snout is up to no good, we'll put a stop to it straightaway.
I myself shall first return to the Adventurers' Guild in order to deliver my report. Let us rendezvous at our destination when we both are ready.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_SYSTEM_000_080: This location should afford you a good vantage point of the precise location the Scarlet Snout gave you. Observe from a distance in the hope that he reveals himself.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Ah, welcome, welcome, one and all! It is with great pleasure that I welcome you here today!
Er, perhaps that's a bit too formal for the occasion. Let's try this again. Ahem! My friends, welcome to the House of Gruff! By all means, make yourselves at home!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: (-???-)What the heck are you carrying on about over here? I could hear you from malms away!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: My beloved wife! What brings you here?
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: What brings me here? Why, our dear son and I were worrying you might burst a lung screaming like this!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTCHILD_000_08: Oh, Papa! Mumsy has told me all about the party. I can't wait to meet all of your new friends!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: Yes, darling. I'm sure it's going to be an absolutely splendid time.
No doubt your father here has invited sheer multitudes of illustrious guests. Isn't that so, Papa?
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: B-But of course, my sweet! Don't you worry─I can assure you the event will be quite the spectacle.
Heh. Just think of all those innocent fools sauntering casually to our abode...blissfully unaware that they are, in fact, marching towards their doom.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: Oh, how I love seeing the terror on their faces when they realize their fates! It is truly to die for─quite literally for them!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Yes, and with the fear we've extracted from the depths of their very souls, we can summon forth our fiendish friends and hold the banquet of our dreams: the Night of Devilry shall finally be upon us!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTCHILD_000_09: The Night of Devilry? Is that something fun?
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: It will be the most fun you've had, little one. Admittedly, I have yet to experience it myself, but I've heard enough of the legends to know it will not disappoint!
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Anyroad, our honored vict─er, guests are scheduled to arrive any moment now. Head back to the venue, my dear family. I shall return anon.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_MARKE_000_096: How fascinating. Yes, most fascinating indeed...
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Hm? Oh! It's you! My apologies, but I've not quite yet finished preparing for the festivities. Pray come back a bit later.
TEXT_FESHLW701_03995_INVESTIGATOR03995_0: Back from Bentbranch, are you? Pray tell me─what exactly did you witness there?
Good gods! This sounds like a plot most foul indeed.
Fortunately, help is at hand. Upon hearing my report, the guild saw fit to dispatch an expert in matters of the occult to aid us in getting to the bottom of this.
I'm most certain he will be able to help us come up with an effective way to thwart the Snout's villainy. Let me know when you are ready, and I shall introduce you to him.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_LISETTE_000_000: Do you feel it, my friend? Love is in the air, and I, Lisette de Valentione, shall encourage one and all to reach out and seize it by the fistful!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_LISETTE_000_001: But wait...I know you! I never forget a champion of ardor and affection! 'Tis simply wonderful to see you again!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_LISETTE_100_001: Ah, Valentione's Day! The time has come for me and my fellow emissaries to enfold this realm in the tender embrace of ardor and affection. But I fear my perfect plan has encountered a tiny wrinkle...
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_LISETTE_000_002: Did you perhaps recognize the anguish in mine eyes─the quiet desperation? Oh, what happy fortune has delivered unto me this gentle savior!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_LISETTE_000_003: The problem, you see, lies with young Astrid here. Oh, she does well enough as an apprentice, but she insists I allow her free rein as a full emissary. Too soon, I say! The bud has not yet flowered!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_004: Oh, Lisette. What more must I do to prove myself...?
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_005: (-???-)My dear child... Allow me to explain, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_006: (-Mysterious Moogle-)One cannot expect to master romance in a matter of months! True understanding of love requires expansive experience and nuanced knowledge! Acquisition of such whimsical wisdom is the work of years, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_007: A moogle...with a heart-shaped pom!? Where did you come from!?
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_008: I am Kupka Kupp, deliverer of penned passion, and maestro in the myriad matters of the heart! Any amateur emissary would be wise to heed my words, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_009: ...But I did not wing my way here to lecture green-stalked striplings. Nay, it is the adventurer with whom I have business.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_010: That letter's author is a girl by the name of Elyne─a dear friend of mine, and an incurable admirer of yours, kupo. Such a plucky young thing, she is, though lately stricken with deepest melancholy...
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_011: I cannot bear to see her brood so! If you will only help me, I am sure we can restore her usual good cheer, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_A2_100_002: As long as I don't do all the work...
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_014: Then you must allow me to help as well! We serve the cause of love in all its forms, and a mission born of friendship certainly qualifies.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_015: The more the merrier, kupo! I'll not turn away aid freely offered, even from a fumbling fledgling.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_016: Hmph. Well, I promise this “fumbling fledgling” will endeavor to do her best.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_017: First things first: why don't we hear what Elyne has to say in her missive to you, adventurer? Just as the eyes are windows to the soul, so might her words permit us a glimpse into her heart.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_018:
(-Elyne's Letter-)Dear ,
I hope this letter finds you well. I've always heard how brave you are, so I decided to be brave too and tell you my story.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_019: (-Elyne's Letter-)The truth is, I've never been outside the Twelveswood. I dreamed of building my strength and skills so that I could follow in your footsteps, and maybe one day see the sea with my very own eyes.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_020: (-Elyne's Letter-)But now I'm not sure that day will ever come. I suppose I'll just have to imagine those sparkling shores, and be content with the tales of your adventures. I hope the roads you travel always bring you home safe and sound.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_021: 'Tis obvious she thinks the world of you, . I wonder, then, what caused her to abandon her plans to travel the realm as you do.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_022: Elyne has spent long hours drilling in spear and bow, preparing herself for adventure... It makes no sense for her to suddenly give up, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_023: It certainly is a mystery. She loves the sea, yes? Perhaps if we visit the shore ourselves, it might provide the inspiration we need to encourage her.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_024: A fine idea, kupo! Come along with me to middle La Noscea, the pair of you. We can find a nice spot on the coast near the mouth of the Agelyss River!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_LISETTE_000_026: This is what Valentione's is all about, my dears. Go on, now! You can leave the festival events to me!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_028: I wish Elyne herself could see this. But if she can't─or won't─make the journey, then what would be the next best thing...?
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_030: Elyne loves to hear about the world beyond the Twelveswood, kupo! When I tell tales of my travels, she always hangs on every word.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_031: She seems especially enraptured by the idea of ocean waters sparkling in the sunlight. I suppose when one has lived one's whole life amongst the trees, such a sight sounds splendid indeed.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_032: What if we were to bring such a sight to Elyne? Perhaps a painting of the sea and its grandeur would serve to stoke the fires of this dream she has let burn so low!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_033: ...It just might work, kupo! Yes, I must have a canvas at once!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_034: Whilst I am occupied with my easel, you must gather a posy of the sweet-scented flowers from hereabouts. The heady fragrance of Vylbrand will surely excite Elyne's senses just as well as the sight of its beauty.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_037: Might I suggest the blooms just northwest of Tiller's Rest? Those are particularly lovely, and shall perfectly complement my art!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_038: The flowers if you would, my good . I must make preparations for my artwork!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_039: I shall see about providing Kupka with paints and such.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_040: That was quick! But Kupka was even quicker─the painting is finished!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_041: Ah, ! You encountered no difficulties picking flowers, I trust?
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_042: Perfect! A scent almost as evocative of this shoreline as the sea air itself, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_043: And with the paints our fledg─er, Miss Astrid was so kind as to provide, I have but this moment completed my depiction of the sea!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_044: I was able to employ a secret an artist once taught me about La Noscean shells: ground up and mixed with water, they make for pigments of surprisingly good quality. It seemed the perfect choice for the task at hand.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_045: Pray forgive me for calling you a stripling, kupo! Your assistance has been both apt and timely!
