TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_046: Right, then! Now that we have blooms and painting both, let us deliver our bounty of love. If I know Elyne─and I do─she will be mooning about in the vicinity of Sweetbloom Pier, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_050: ! It's really you! I... Kupka didn't say anything about bringing you back with him!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_051: and Astrid have been helping me prepare a little gift for you, Elyne!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_052: My work keeps me ever busy delivering love and happiness to others, but this time it's your turn, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_053: I've painted you a picture of the La Noscean sea! Do you like it? Astrid here made the paints herself out of seashells, kupo. And  carefully picked the perfect flowers to accompany the scene.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_054: It's so pretty! And this scent─I could close my eyes and imagine I was on a faraway island!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_055: Even more breathtaking sights and sounds─and smells!─await you in distant lands, kupo! Why not go and visit them yourself? Why give up on your dreams?
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_100_056: I tried to do better, I really did. But no matter how much I practiced my archery and spearwork, I never seemed to improve compared to the other students.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_057: Just wandering the Twelveswood is dangerous enough. If I can't even protect myself here, how could I think of exploring further? It was a silly idea...
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_A1_000_001: You should keep up your training.
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_058: Will it make any difference, you think? But maybe you're right. Maybe I gave up too soon!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_059: I...never thought of that. There's more than one way to become an adventurer, isn't there? I should go and visit the Conjurers' Guild!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_060: Become a botanist, you mean? I guess they do learn how to move safely through the wilds. That could be useful to know!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_061: Thank you Astrid, ─a little gift and a few inspiring words have done the trick! How delightful to see Elyne so positive again, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ASTRID_000_062: I am thrilled to have been of service! And, yes, what a wonderful feeling to put a smile on your dear friend's face!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_064: Hmmm, feeling, feeling... Why do I have the feeling I'm forgetting something, kupo?
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_KUPUKAKOPP_000_066: I still have a delivery to make in Ul'dah! The Songbirds must have their love letters, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT701_03996_ELYNE_000_067: Um, ? If you're not in too much of a hurry, do you think I could ask you a favor...?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_000: You'll help me, then? Oh, thank you, !
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_001: More than anything right now, I want to join Kupka on his trip to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_002: The problem is, I'm afraid my parents will be too worried to let me go. But if they knew that you were going with me...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_003: This could be your first step on the road to adventure!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_005: So you're saying you'll come!? Wonderful! Oh, I have to tell my parents right away!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_006: I shall be right behind you when you do, a voice of steady reassurance!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_007: I, too, would like to see this tale to its conclusion. One can hardly abandon the ship of love ere it docks safely in the harbor!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_008: Before we leave for Ul'dah, however, I should report to Lisette the reason for my continued absence. Let us convene at the airship landing when we are ready to depart!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_009: I really must deliver these letters...but I am curious to hear the nature of this favor, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_100_009: Elyne is happy and our work is done. Or so I thought! Pray lend the young lady your ear, .
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_010: They said yes! Kupka helped me convince them!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_011: Wonderful! And might I say, you look very smart in your traveling clothes!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_012: Yes, it is all very exciting, but let us not forget your promise to return within the agreed-upon time, kupo! All aboard for Ul'dah! Once we arrive, I must speak with the royal seneschal at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_015: Elyne seems to be enjoying herself, kupo! Perhaps we can see more of the city once I've tended to my duties.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_016: Such a big and noisy place! And look at all these buildings! Do they make everything out of stone, here?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_017: In case you were wondering, Little Ladies' Day was close to overlapping with Valentione's Day this year, so they decided to go ahead with the former here in Ul'dah to avoid a collision of festivals.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_020: Oho! We meet again, ! You have been keeping well, I trust?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_021: Well met, adventurer! I am the royal seneschal, and it is my great pleasure and privilege to oversee the joyous events of Little Ladies' Day.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_022: My dear seneschal, how time does pass us by, kupo! I come once more, bearing letters of love for the Songbirds.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_023: And how eagerly do they await your arrival, dear Kupka! Our lovely ladies are presently occupied with rehearsals for their upcoming performance, but they should be back any moment. ...Ahem, are these fine people all your assistants?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_024: Ah, how remiss of me, kupo! Allow me to make the introductions...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_026: But isn't this fitting! Why, it's as if  is acting as seneschal for this darling young princess!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_027: Yes! Exactly! And even as a Little Ladies' Day wish is coming true, so, too, are we fulfilling a mission of love for Valentione's Day. Two wonderful celebrations, joyfully coinciding...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_100_027: ...Oh, which reminds me! I have a missive here for you from Lisette, our eminent emissary of romance and affection.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_028: ...Hmmm. Seeing as our respective festivals are set to take place at much the same time, the Lady Valentione proposes a joint event of some manner.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_030: This is indeed a rare opportunity, and one too precious to be squandered. But what might be suitable, I wonder...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ULALA_100_030: (-???-)By the gods, I need a bath! But I'd say we're all ready for the big show!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_031: Ah, ladies! Kupka Kupp is here with your mail.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_032: I have a bundle for each of you, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ULALA_000_033: I thought for certain I would have the biggest pile this time! Why is it we always receive the exact same number of fan letters!?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_NARUMI_000_034: Well, I think it's nice... We're all equally loved!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Besides, it's about the content, not the quantity. All those words of admiration and encouragement...
This fan writes, “I can hardly wait to see your next performance, not to mention your newest outfits.” ...Gods, we haven't even decided what to do with our costumes.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_NARUMI_000_039: “A new look for a new us” was the idea, but if we don't come up with something soon, we'll be taking to the stage in what we're wearing now.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_040: What about the Valentione's Day costumes? I think they're really adorable!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_041: Elyne! That's a splendid idea! We could easily sew the same pattern using fabric in the Songbirds' signature colors─red, blue, and yellow.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ULALA_000_044: That is a splendid idea. A dash of Valentione flavor to spice up a Little Ladies' confection! It'll be the talk of the town!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_045: Well now, it would seem Lisette's desire for a joint event has found its answer.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_046: Indeed! I shall return to Gridania to arrange the costumes and report the good news.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_047: Pray take your ease, ladies. I will inform you once the new outfits have arrived.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_048: And what are your own plans? If you aren't otherwise occupied, might I ask for a helping hand whilst you await the return of your companion? There would be no rush─you could even complete the task as you take a tour of the city. What say you?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_049: Would you like to know why the Songbirds always receive an equal number of fan letters? Me too, kupo...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_050: I wonder what kind of task the seneschal wants us to do. Let's ask him!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_051: It is a simple errand, really: I've a single delivery that I should like you to make to the children's ward at Frondale's Phrontistery.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_052: We're to be trusted with a delivery!? I feel like an adventurer already!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_053: Oho, you've set your sights on becoming an adventurer, have you? Well then, Mistress Elyne, we must reward you accordingly: whatever portion of my delivery remains “unclaimed” shall be yours to keep. How does that sound?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_054: Y-You can count on me, sir! Um...what is this “children's ward” exactly, anyway?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_055: From what I understand, 'tis a place where little ones around your age are sent to recover from illness, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_056: There will be a lady there by the name of Aldiytha. Put the package directly into her hands, if you please.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_057: Yes, sir! On our way, sir!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ALCHEMIST03850_000_: A delivery from the royal seneschal, is it? The children's ward is right through here.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ALDIYTHA_000_062: ...I see! Well, you have my thanks, my little adventurer, as do your friends.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_063: If I may ask, Lady Aldiytha, where are all the children? I hadn't expected the ward to be so quiet, kupo...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ALDIYTHA_000_064: They're with the physicians, undergoing a scheduled examination. We put up decorations whilst they're away, you see, ready to surprise them upon their return!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ALDIYTHA_000_065: These sweets you've brought us from the seneschal are part of the celebrations. Perhaps you might like to stay and help hand them out?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_066: Oh! I would like that very much!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_067: Handing out sweets is an act of love, and very much in keeping with Valentione's Day tradition. As an emissary, it would be my duty and my joy, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_DAMIELLIOT_000_068: I was aware of plans to decorate the ward, but I did not expect we would be welcoming such delightful visitors as well.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_DAMIELLIOT_000_069: Look how happy the children are to meet Mistress Elyne and Master Kupka. It is not often they get to make new friends of their own age, not to mention a different city, so this is quite a special occasion.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_070: Lady Aldiytha gave me the leftover sweets as a reward! I guess that means we finished the job the seneschal gave us.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ALDIYTHA_000_071: And a fine job it was. I shall be staying here with the children for a time, so might I ask that you convey my regards to the seneschal?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_072: Of course! We should be getting back in any case, kupo! Astrid will surely have returned by now.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_074: We should tell the seneschal we made his delivery...shouldn't we?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_077: Thank you for delivering that most important cargo. And how is the Lady Aldiytha? Will she be joining us for the festivities?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_078: She said she needed to stay with the children for the moment. Oh, but she did let me have the rest of the sweets, just like you promised!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_079: But of course! It is only fair you be paid for services rendered.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_BUTLER_000_080: As for your companion, Mistress Astrid returned a short while ago with the promised costumes, and is assisting the Songbirds with the fitting. The ladies will be mounting the stage momentarily─you'll stay to watch their performance, of course?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ULALA_000_081: Ladies and gentlemen! Welcome, and thank you for coming to our concert!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_NARUMI_000_082: Valentione's Day festivities are in full swing, and now, here in Ul'dah, Little Ladies' Day has taken over the city! This is our chance to have double the fun!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Have you all noticed our Valentione-themed costumes? This performance is dedicated to the ideals of both festivals, and we mean to give our emissary friends a run for their money! Prepare to feel the love!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_084: The Songbirds are so amazing...and pretty...and lovely!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_085: It's no wonder they're so popular! With the way they can stir people's hearts, we may have to appoint them as honorary emissaries...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_086: I certainly feel inadequate after that performance, kupo. Perhaps I'm not as wise in the ways of love as I thought.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_NARUMI_000_087: Did you see how much the crowd loved our outfits, Elyne!? We have you and your friends to thank for that!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_088: I was just saying how pretty you three looked. I'm so glad it went well!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_089: I don't know when, or even if, I'll ever be a real adventurer, but this trip to Ul'dah felt like a great start─going on a journey, and helping out the seneschal...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: Oh, you want to be an adventurer? You must be very brave!
Chasing a dream is no easy feat, especially ones that take a great deal of training and dedication. Sometimes they seem so far away...but we reach for them all the same, don't we?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_NARUMI_000_092: That's because having a dream is the best thing there is! Sure, there'll be times when you feel it's all too hard, but remember to keep that fire inside burning bright!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ULALA_000_093: Exactly! And don't you ever say “if”! Stick with “when”! Your dream will always be there, waiting. Put one foot in front of the other, and you'll get there in the end.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ULALA_000_094: Praise yourself whenever you make it even one step further than the day before. That's what I do! It builds confidence, and helps you stay positive.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_095: I will! Thank you...all of you.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_096: I'll never stop chasing my dream...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_097: We had best be getting Elyne back home, kupo! Her parents will be expecting her!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_098: “Your dream will always be there, waiting.” Now isn't that a reassuring thought?
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_100: I suppose I better be heading home...but when I next come to Ul'dah, I'll have to bring some Twelveswood flowers for the children's ward.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_101: I'm sure they would love that, kupo! And it would be nice to have a longer chat with our new friends.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_102: Shall we board the airship, then? Lisette wished to see us upon our return, so pray join me at the amphitheatre if you have time.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_LISETTE_000_106: Welcome back, everyone! Our dear Astrid explained all the excitement when she came to arrange the costumes.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_LISETTE_000_107: I am so pleased to see you lifted out of that gloomy mood, Elyne! And I really must thank you for your excellent suggestion!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_108: Oh, Lady Lisette, you should have seen the Songbirds in their Valentione outfits─they were adorable!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_109: Thank you, . I never would have braved any of this if it weren't for you!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_110: Now, if an adventurer helps you, you're supposed to give them a reward. I'll have to ask Mother and Father what we can spare...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_A2_000_002: Don't worry about it. It was nothing.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_111: Hm? You mean my letter!? But that was only─ That hardly seems fair!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_112: It wasn't nothing! I will repay you for this! Someday...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_113: Fine. But only for now! Once I start making my way in the world, I'll repay you for everything!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_114: ...Well, I really should be going now. Please know that I'll never forget this for as long as I live!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_115: Thank you, Kupka, for encouraging me to write that letter. I always enjoy our talks in the wood.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_116: And thank you, Astrid, for staying with me until the end! I'll come to see you as often as I can before Valentione's Day is over.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ELYNE_000_117: And I can never thank you enough, ! I dream of the day we can travel together again!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_118: I know I was on a mission of love for Elyne, and yet somehow I feel I gained as much from the experience as she did.
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_119: I thought I understood what being an emissary was all about, but there is so much more. You were right, Lisette─I was trying to dash through the garden, when I should have stopped to count the petals...
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_LISETTE_000_120: Well, that's one way of putting it. But at least now you know what you don't know, and that's at least two-thirds of the journey!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_ASTRID_000_121: If I could bring as much joy as even one-third of the Songbirds, I would be happy!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_KUPUKAKOPP_000_122: Well, I shall be learning right alongside you, Astrid. It wouldn't do to have a fledgling outdo me, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT702_03997_LISETTE_000_123: Fear not, my eager emissaries! Valentione's Day is not over yet, and there's still plenty of love to spread around!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_000: (-Expectant Child-)Is it not Starlight season yet?
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_010: An adventurer, I take it? Why, it's as if the saint himself sent you to me! Oh, but there I go again. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Amh Garanjy, and it is my honor to serve as celebrant for the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_011: Well, if it isn't my favorite adventurer! I see the saint has once again guided you to me in this most wonderful of seasons. Truly, your very presence is a Starlight miracle!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_012: That said, I'm afraid I must apologize. There has been a bit of a rub, you see, and as such we're not quite ready to kick off the festivities as of yet.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_013: How shall I put it? Our troubles began when we encountered some unexpected delays in deciding on a theme for this year's event. Things spiraled from there, and as a result, we've been left with far too much to do in far too little time.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_015: As a result, we celebrants have been forced to recruit helpers of all stripes─from small children to strapping adventurers like yourself. Speaking of which, you wouldn't perchance be able and willing to lend us a hand, would you?
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_016: Oh, thank you, my friend! I daresay your generosity truly embodies the Starlight season. Without further ado, allow me to explain the tasks we would ask of you.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_GODBERT_000_020: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ho ho ho! It would seem you've found a most promising helper for me again this year!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: (-Listless Lalafell-)Another adventurer? And I suppose this one, too, will also be wanting some kind of reward for their services. I say, sometimes I wonder if this whole Starlight business is worth the effort─and the coin─we pour into it year after year.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_GODBERT_000_022: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Must you be such a killjoy, my young friend? Just look at the faces of the children around you. Why, each year they spend moons waiting in eager anticipation of this most joyous of seasons, and the most delightful presents they will receive!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: (-Listless Lalafell-)Ah, yes, the presents. Worthless trinkets foisted off on naive young fools in hopes of making them forget the mundanity of their everyday existences. If we truly wanted to bring joy to people, would it not be more prudent to invest in things that might actually improve the quality of their daily lives?
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_024: ...Ahem. Allow me to introduce Kamlito Halito, first son of a prominent family of surveyors in Ul'dah. He's journeyed here all the way from the sultanate to help us prepare this year's festivities. Standing beside him is the Saint of Nymeia himself, a man who no doubt needs no introduction.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Let me state for the record that I did not come here merely to deck the streets with gaudy lights and trinkets. I initially proposed to Father that we do away with all this mummery and transform this festival into something that would contribute more directly to the mutual economic prosperity of our nations and the realm as a whole.

But did he listen? No, he simply muttered something about how he didn't raise his son to be a stuffy spoilsport, and all but demanded that I accompany Lord Mand─pardon, the Saint of Nymeia here to learn something about “holiday cheer”─whatever that is supposed to mean.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_027: Come now, Kamlito! I understand that you are serious about your family business, but I daresay it wouldn't hurt for you to lighten up from time to time. Here, perhaps this will put a smile on your face...
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_028: (-Expectant Child-)Do you mean that truly? If I help you, I can get a present, too?
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_029: But of course, my dear child. Behold the twinklebox!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_030: Tucked beneath the many lids of this casket are hidden all manner of delightful wares. Why, they've been fashioned especially for this year's festivities by some of the realm's most celebrated crafters!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_031: For every task you complete, you will earn the opportunity to pop off one of its lids, and help yourself to the contents within.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_032: And that's just the start of it─needless to say, there will be even more glorious gifts in store for you when the preparations are complete and the festivities can kick off in earnest.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_033: You can think of this chest as something to tide you over in the meantime, and as our way of thanking you for lending us celebrants a helping hand in our time of need. What do you say, child?
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_034: (-Expectant Child-)Wow! This is wonderful! Mother and Father say I have to help out around the house during Starlight, so I don't know if I can come back.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_035: But I have plenty of time to help now! Just say what you need and leave it to Isainne to get things done!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_036: Isainne, is it? What a generous girl you are! Thank you ever so much.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_037: Needless to say, we've prepared some very special presents for adventurers like you as well, so I hope you can collect and enjoy them all!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Yes, yes...isn't that all so special? Now, if we're done getting all giddy about trifling baubles and toys, I should be getting back to work. <sigh> All those Starlight Trees aren't going to decorate themselves, after all...
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_039: Now then, if you're ready to get started, simply head west from the amphitheatre and speak to my colleague stationed before the waterwheel hut. She'll be happy to explain all you need to know to get started.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: All this work, and for what─to take it all down when the festivities are over? A thorough waste of time and effort, if you ask me...
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_COMMITTEE04017_000_: An adventurer? I was expecting young Isainne, but I suppose you'll suffice. I'd like you to get to work immediately taking down the decorations nearby.

Hold your chocobos, now. It's not as if we're calling the celebration off. It's simply that...well, you met Kamlito Halito, yes? He was in charge of this area, and let's just say his sense for what's appropriate for Starlight leaves something to be desired.

I can handle things here by myself, so I'd ask you to head to the Conjurers' Guild and take down any seasonally inappropriate decorations you might find. When you're through, you can bring the inappropriate ornamentation back here to me, and I'll see that it's properly stored away.
Ah, yes. That should do it, then. Isainne here finished cleaning up her assigned area as well─in half the time, I might add.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_061: Did you see some of those so-called decorations? It's as if that man has never attended a single day's worth of Starlight festivities in his life!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_COMMITTEE04017_000_: At any rate, I suppose I'll see to it that the ornaments you took down are replaced with something more festive. In the meantime, I'd appreciate it if you could report to Amh in my stead.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_063: Of course! Leave it to me!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_ISAINNE_000_070: Getting presents is fun, too, but what I really enjoy is helping out and sharing the Starlight spirit!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_080: Thank you for all your help, friend! I promise we'll get our act together one of these years. In the meantime, we truly appreciate your saintly efforts in helping us see that every child has a smile on their face for Starlight!
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_081: Allow me also to apologize on Kamlito's behalf for the extra work he created for you. The boy has much to learn, yes, but I've no doubt that he will come to understand what the spirit of the season is all about in due time.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_082: In the meantime, allow me to express my gratitude for all you've done in true Starlight fashion─with a present from the twinklebox. Go ahead, help yourself! And remember that there are more gifts waiting for you if you're feeling inclined to lend us your aid again.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SYSTEM_100_082: Upon completing each of the tasks assigned to you by Amh Garanjy, you may open one of the lids of the twinklebox and help yourself to one of the presents inside.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_083: Oh, and lest I forget, I'm not the only one who truly appreciates your efforts─far from it! We've been receiving messages from the realm over thanking you and your fellow adventurers for all you do for the people of Eorzea each and every day.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_AMHGARANJY_000_084: My colleague Baenfaeld here in the amphitheatre is holding on to them all, so if you're curious, simply say the word─he'd be happy to share the words of appreciation and good cheer.
TEXT_FESXMS601_04017_SYSTEM_000_085: Missives of gratitude from across the realm have arrived in time for Starlight season. A new letter will be available to read each time preparations for the festivities are successfully completed, so be sure to take a break from your efforts from time to time and speak with Baenfaeld.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_000: Getting presents is fun, too, but what I really enjoy is helping out and sharing the Starlight spirit!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_AMHGARANJY_000_010: I'm heartened to see you've decided to stick around. Apparently, there's another set of decorations that aren't quite up to snuff. Would you mind helping Isainne look into the matter and fix things up? I've asked her to wait just outside the amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_020: Oh, hello there. When I was on my way back before, some of the townspeople told me that there's something strange about the snowmen over by the Shaded Bower.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_021: Kamlito was in charge of those as well. I know that he's new to all this, but how hard can it be to make a snowman? Anyhow, let's go and see what's wrong, shall we? I'll race you there!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_030: There's something strange about these snowmen, yes, but...I can't quite put my finger on it. What do you suppose it is?
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SYSTEM_000_031: The snowmen seem to be facing in odd directions. Set them straight so that the Starlight festivities might proceed in good order.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_032: If you want to take another look from a distance, just ask me!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SYSTEM_000_040: The snowmen seem to be facing in odd directions─no doubt they were meant to face forward. Set them straight so that the Starlight festivities might proceed in good order.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SYSTEM_000_050: The snowmen are now facing straight so as to welcome customers to the shops.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_060: Wow! It's as if the snowmen are all smiling and inviting us in! Who'd have thought that turning them around a bit could make such a difference?
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Oh, it's you two. Whatever are you doing lolling about here? I've already finished my latest task. Behold! Take notes and perhaps one day you'll be able to work as efficiently.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SYSTEM_000_062: Once again, Kamlito Halito's decorations strike you as leaving something to be desired...
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_A1_000_001: Now I see why you work so fast...
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_A1_000_002: I believe the word you're looking for is “slapdash”...
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Why, the sheer nerve! Might I remind you that you people are lucky a personage as esteemed as myself has deigned to assist with such menial tasks!
In a just world, I would be placed in charge of the entire event, and you would be assisting me! That is where my true talents lie─not in making silly snowmen and putting lights on trees!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_065: You don't know the first thing about Starlight! That's why all your decorations were such a mess until this adventurer and I fixed them!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_067: It's true!  actually understands what Starlight is all about!  wants everyone who takes part in the festivities to feel the joy of the season, and it shows in the care  puts into every little task.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_068: Don't you care about making others happy? Or even being happy yourself? Why, I haven't seen you smile once the whole time you've been here!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Wh-Why I never! I came here to do a job, and against my will! Perhaps putting up these ridiculous decorations is enough to amuse a child like you, but I am a man grown─
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_070: So what if I'm a child!? I actually care about Starlight, and my decorations will put smiles on more faces than yours ever will!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Smiles this, happiness that. Be honest─Starlight is all about getting presents, yes? Then why don't I give you some coin? With money, you can buy whatever you want!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_072: I don't want your stupid money!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_GODBERT_000_074: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Making a poor child cry? Consider me...unimpressed, Kamlito.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_GODBERT_000_075: And yet, I cannot help but feel that there is more to that child's situation than meets the eye. I shall inquire further─in the meantime, pray return to Amh Garanjy and apprise her of your progress.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_KAMLITOHALITO_100_0: Perhaps I could stand to take my work a bit more seriously...
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_ISAINNE_000_080: This poor snowman... He's all alone...
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Perhaps I could stand to enjoy myself a bit more...
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_AMHGARANJY_000_090: Welcome back, friend! Thanks to your tireless efforts on our behalf, I am pleased to report that we are closer than ever to getting the festivities in full swing.
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_AMHGARANJY_000_091: Don't forget to help yourself to another present from the twinklebox. I daresay you've more than earned it!
TEXT_FESXMS602_04018_SYSTEM_000_092: Another thank-you letter has arrived from one of your admirers. Speak to Baenfaeld in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to see what it says.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_ISAINNE_000_000: This poor snowman... He's all alone...
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Perhaps I could stand to enjoy myself a bit more...
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Thanks in no small part to your tireless efforts, I daresay we're on track to begin the festivities sooner than I had anticipated! That said, I fear there's still more work to be done.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: <sigh> If only I weren't so utterly useless...
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_012: Hm? Did you say something, Kamlito?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: M-Me!? Oh, it was nothing! Nothing at all!
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_014: At any rate, the next job I'd like to entrust to you is preparing the tree. Speak to my colleague in the Acorn Orchard over in New Gridania, and she'll be happy to brief you on the task at hand.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: I can't see anything amiss with the decorations here. Whatever could be the matter?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_COMMITTEE04019_000_: Are you here to help? Remarkable! Splendiferous, even! I've just been inspecting the trees that have been put up around town, and I couldn't help but notice that something was amiss.

See here? Part of the trunk has been gnawed away, as if by an animal or the like. Were any more damage to be done to the tree, it might fall over, and that would be most perilous for any small child who happened to be standing beneath it at the time.
I had a mind to call for a skilled woodworker, that perhaps they might examine the tree and reinforce it for us. Might I ask you to head to the Carpenters' Guild in my stead?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: This adventurer will be going, you say? I suppose that means you won't be needing me. Very well, then... I shall...inspect the other trees, or the like.
No damage here as far as I can see. <sigh> If this is the only job I am good for, I might as well be thorough about it...
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_CARPENTER4019_000_0: Ho there! What brings you to the Carpenters' Guild during this season of celebration, friend?
Some cute little woodland creatures have been chewing away at your Starlight Tree, you say? Well, that won't do at all. I daresay this calls for an investigation.
Indeed...this tree looks as if it could topple over at any moment. Let me see if I can't reinforce the trunk a bit.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_COMMITTEE04019_000_: I cannot thank you enough, my friend! Clearly, you have summoned a carpenter of surpassing skill. I am most relieved to know that the children of Gridania need not fear any falling trees as they open their presents this Starlight season.

Ah, yes─I forgot to tell you. While you were visiting the guild on my behalf, Kamlito Halito was kind enough to go about inspecting the other trees in the area. I'm pleased to report that he assures me that not a one shows any suspicious gnawing or toothmarks.

He's a rather...dour fellow, isn't he? And yet it would seem he takes his work quite seriously. I daresay I was rather impressed at how closely he examined each and every trunk with such a painstaking eye.

He mentioned that he was heading back to the amphitheatre after finishing the job. Why, he didn't even stick around long enough to allow me to thank him for his efforts. Might you be so kind as to pass along a simple message of gratitude on my behalf?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_080: Looking for Kamlito, you say? I haven't seen him since he went off to inspect the trees. Do you suppose he's slacking off on the job again?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: I can't help but feel that something is missing. And yet...what could it be?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SYSTEM_000_091: Kamlito Halito is staring so intently at the snowman that it seems he might burn a hole clear through its body.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_1: I know! Mayhap a necklace of the finest gold with a sparkling gem inlaid would give it a glamorous appearance befitting the season!
But no...I might appreciate that, but I am not a child of Gridania. I must put myself in their shoes...whatever sort of snowman would bring a smile to their faces?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_A1_000_002: Are you still thinking about what Isainne said?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_KAMLITOHALITO_000_1: Hm? Oh, it's you. No, there is nothing amiss, per se. I simply had occasion to return here, and I was wondering if there was not something I could do to further improve upon my most inspired creation.
Hm? Of course not! I could not care less about the idle musings of children. I simply thought that perhaps my masterwork here could benefit from a finishing touch, that's all!
...Bah. Who am I fooling? It's true. I haven't stopped thinking about what the girl said for bells now.
Here I thought I would come here and put together a festival for the ages─and as it turns out, I can't even make a single child happy. Hells, I'm only making myself miserable as well.
And yet...I must not give up hope. There is still time for me to do my job right─to earn the right to open that chest of presents and claim the glory that is rightfully mine!
...And so I got to thinking. That child was looking at this snowman with a most intense gaze, was she not? No doubt she saw something in it that has managed to escape me.
...Forgive me. I suspect my work here might take longer than I expected. Pray report to Amh Garanjy ahead of me and tell her I shall be along in due time.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_110: Welcome back, friend! And another job well done, I am pleased to say.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_100_110: Well, what are you waiting for? Help yourself! You've more than earned it.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_111: Hm? Kamlito's still putting the finishing touches on his snowman, you say? Dare I dream that he's come to understand the true spirit of Starlight at last?
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_112: For indeed, this season isn't just about gaudy lights, toys, and trinkets. If every last child is not able to find something of joy here, we have not done our duty. And to make that possible, we must first find a reason to rejoice for ourselves.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_113: Our smiles light up the faces of the children, who in turn warm our hearts yet further, allowing us to further spread happiness across the realm.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_114: It is that cycle of giving and receiving, that ever-expanding circle of peace and joy that embodies the true soul of the Starlight season.
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_AMHGARANJY_000_115: So take your present proudly, my friend. Let it fill your heart with pure satisfaction, that you might have happiness aplenty to share with your fellow adventurers─and indeed, Eorzeans the realm over!
TEXT_FESXMS603_04019_SYSTEM_000_116: Another thank-you letter has arrived from one of your admirers. Speak to Baenfaeld in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to see what it says.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: There is more I would consider before returning to my duties. Pray go on ahead for the time being.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Starlight waits for no one! Without further ado, I would entrust you with the next most vital task in preparing for the festivities. Simply speak to my colleague stationed past Apkallu Falls on the way to the residential district to the north.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_020: I always wondered why the snowmen never melted, and now I know! Being able to see behind the magic of Starlight is a miracle in itself!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_COMMITTEE04020_000_: Back to offer your aid? Well, I suppose we could put you to use. Perhaps you've seen the snowmen around the area? Well, the truth is, we employ a little bit of sorcery to make sure they don't go melting in the event of untimely warm weather.

To that end, I'd task you with stuffing one of these here fragments of what we call eternal ice inside each one of them. If you could see to the ones near the manor district north of here, Isainne and I will take care of those by the Lancers' Guild. Pray meet us there when you're done.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_040: Why, just think of how devastated the children would be if those charming snowmen melted into nothing before Starlight was over! You're doing the saint's own work, my friend.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_COMMITTEE04020_000_: How goes the task? Once you've seen to the snowmen near the manor district, return here that I might know your work is done.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_042: Don't worry, Mister Snowman! I'll see that you stay with us till the very end!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_COMMITTEE04020_000_: ...And with that, I do believe our job is done.
I trust you've seen to your snowmen as well? Excellent. I'll survey the area one last time to make sure we haven't overlooked anything, so pray go on ahead of me and report back to Amh Garanjy.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_053: Say,  Adventurer...is there a special someone you'll be spending Starlight season with this year?
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_054: Oh, is that so? Then we'd best make the decorations extra pretty just for them, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_055: Oh, that's a shame. Well, I guess Starlight's more for children like me, after all...
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_056: I always used to come with Mother and Father, but they...um, are busy this year. That's why I decided to make myself useful and help out with the preparations.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_057: I had a mind to make a giant snowman, just for them, that we could all come see together! But I think they'll need to stay at home, so... Well, I guess it doesn't matter anymore...
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_058: Oh, but I should get back to work! See you around,  Adventurer!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SYSTEM_000_059: As Isainne races off, your mind drifts to Kamlito Halito, who you believe you last saw at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. How does he fare with his allotted task?
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_060: Looking for Kamlito, you say? I last saw him examining the snowmen around Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. Now that you mention it, I'd be much obliged if you could check in on him. Sometimes I worry the boy is too serious for his own good.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_061: Wow, just look at all of them!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Wh-Why, hello there, Isainne. I was just putting together another snowman of my own. What do you think...have I redeemed myself?
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_071: Oh, it's wonderful! I was just thinking how this snowman looked so lonely, and now he has a friend! Let's make one more!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Indeed...I suppose we've nothing better to do until the next delivery of ornaments arrives. Very well, then─to work!
Well, it appears I'll be occupied for a while here, yet. You've completed your task, yes? If you would be so kind, I would ask that you report to Amh Garanjy for the both of us.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_ISAINNE_000_080: The more, the merrier! Let's make another!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_090: Another task completed? And in spectacular fashion, I have no doubt! Just think of how many smiles you've put on the children's faces today. Take your reward, friend─I daresay you've earned it.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_KAMLITOHALITO_000_1: If it would not be too much to ask, we are in need of more snowman decorations. I have─ahem─made an executive decision to build one more.
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_101: With pleasure! I shall see that the necessary supplies are procured straightaway!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_102: That said, color me surprised, Kamlito. Could it be that you've finally gotten into the spirit of the season after all?
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_KAMLITOHALITO_000_1: Heh. One could say that, I suppose...
At first, I simply saw all this decorating as menial labor─trifling tasks far beneath one of my station.

And yet, seeing the twinkle in young Isainne's eyes every time I make a snowman or hang up a glittering star, I began to sense that I was part of something far larger than I had ever imagined. Before long, I realized the truth─that every one of my actions, no matter how humble, were indispensable in bringing good cheer to the hearts of the children in this realm.

And, perhaps more importantly, that such acts were diminished if performed without similar sentiments in my own heart. Yet I fear that in realizing this, I have been consumed by the sheer responsibility of these tasks, to the point that I feel almost petrified with a desire to get everything just right...
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_107: Ohoho! Worry not, my friend. There's still plenty of time to polish your creations to perfection before the festivities kick off in earnest. So long as you've got that Starlight spirit in you, you're more than fine in my book!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_AMHGARANJY_000_108: At any rate, our job is almost done─but that's all the more reason we can't afford to slack off or compromise until we've seen to the last of the preparations. The children are counting on us, my friends!
TEXT_FESXMS604_04020_SYSTEM_000_109: Another thank-you letter has arrived from one of your many admirers. Speak to Baenfaeld in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to see what it says.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Just you wait─my latest snowman is certain to be an artistic masterwork the likes of which Gridania has never seen! As soon as I finish it, that is...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Listen up, my favorite helper! It's time to bring some Starlight magic to the Greatloam Growery. Seek out my splendiferous colleague there─she'll be more than happy to share with you all you need to know.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_MOTHER04021_000_015: The wreaths are all so lovely...whichever should I choose?
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_CHILD04021_000_016: Ooh! I want the one with the bell! It makes such a pretty sound...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_COMMITTEE04021_000_: Ah, it's you again! Your assistance is most welcome, friend. I've been handing out wreaths for the townsfolk to decorate their front doors, but it would seem our supply has fallen woefully behind the demand.
A most generous individual at the Botanists' Guild has agreed to donate some of their loveliest works to our cause. Might I trouble you to make the trip there and procure them for us?
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_BOTANIST4021_000_03: Wreaths, you say? But of course! We've more than enough for one and all this Starlight. Pray take as many as you need with my blessing, and give the celebrants my best regards.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_BOTANIST4021_000_04: A very merry Starlight to you! Nothing gives this humble botanist greater joy than to see the doors of every house in Gridania decked with verdant greenery.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_COMMITTEE04021_000_: Just look at all of these lovely wreaths! The growers at the Botanists' Guild are nothing if not generous. At any rate, this should more than suffice─thank you, friend!
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_CHILD04021_000_051: Look! That adventurer's helping to get ready for Starlight! Isainne told me that she is, too. She says that every time she finishes a task, she gets a special present! I should have helped out, too...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_MOTHER04021_000_052: Isainne, you say? The poor child. I can't even imagine working so hard, what with all the hardships she now faces at home...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_COMMITTEE04021_000_: Hardships, you say? What is it that troubles the girl, pray tell?
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_MOTHER04021_000_054: I fear I'm not privy to all the details, but word has it her parents have not left the house in ages. Isainne's always running about town all on her own. She puts on a strong face, but I can't help but worry that she's suffering more than she lets on...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_MOTHER04021_000_055: It wasn't always like this, mind you. I remember often seeing the three of them together. Her father cut a tall, dashing figure, and always adorned his head with a stylish hat.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_MOTHER04021_100_055: Her mother had the gentlest of smiles, and was always clad in garb of matching patterns that she fashioned herself. Seeing such a loving family walk the streets together was always such a heartwarming sight. Sadly, for whatever reason, it is a sight we see no longer...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_COMMITTEE04021_000_: That is most troubling, indeed. Pray forgive me...I hadn't the slightest idea that anything was amiss when the girl came to offer her aid. I must have a chat with her...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_COMMITTEE04021_100_: Ah, but a host of lovely wreaths have just arrived from our friends at the Botanists' Guild. Pray help yourself to whichever strikes your fancy!
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_COMMITTEE04021_000_: Ah, forgive me. Your work here is done. Pray return to Amh Garanjy and collect your reward─you've most certainly earned it!
I had no idea that poor Isainne was enduring such troubles at home. I simply must have a talk with her to see if she's truly all right...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: ...Yes. The shape is perfect, if I do say so myself. All that remains is to decorate it!
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_AMHGARANJY_000_070: Well, if it isn't my favorite helper! I thank you most sincerely for yet another job well done. Well, what are you waiting for? Help yourself to another present from the twinklebox!
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Have the additional snowman decorations arrived yet, by chance? I'm most eager to get started on my latest masterwork.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_AMHGARANJY_000_081: That's the spirit! And indeed, they were delivered not moments ago.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Splendid! In that case, Isainne and I shall get to work at once.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_GODBERT_000_083: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ho ho ho! That's the kind of good cheer I like to see. Yes, 'twould appear that the Starlight Celebration is in good hands again this year.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_GODBERT_000_084: Ah, yes. Your colleague had mentioned some troubling news about young Isainne, so I took it upon myself to do some research into the matter.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Whatever is the matter? Is the child okay?
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_GODBERT_000_086: (-Saint of Nymeia-)The girl is fine, but I fear her dear father is less so. Stricken with a grievous malady, he lies bedridden, with Isainne's poor mother tending to him every waking moment of the day.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: That is most distressing, indeed. The poor girl...she never said as much, but doubtless she works as hard as she does in order to procure the medicine her dear father so desperately needs...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_GODBERT_000_088: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Sadly, matters are not so simple. The illness her father suffers from, sadly, is a common one these days, and it is said demand for medicine greatly outstrips the supply.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_GODBERT_000_089: No matter how diligently the girl works to earn the coin she needs, there is simply not enough of the remedy to go around...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_AMHGARANJY_000_090: Indeed. Though opening the twinklebox may light up her eyes, I can only imagine that what she truly wants for Starlight is to soothe her dear father's pain. If only there were some way we could help her do just that...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: While there may be naught we can do to heal what ails the man, perhaps we might be able to offer Isainne and her family a bit of Starlight cheer in this trying time.
The girl has been a most dutiful and generous little helper for us this season, has she not?

If we were to find some way to dedicate this year's Starlight Celebration to her and her loved ones─and in doing so make it the most spectacular success it's ever been─mayhap that might lift their spirits?
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_AMHGARANJY_000_094: Dedicate the celebration to her? An admirable idea, I agree, but however might we do that?
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_A1_000_002: If Isainne's father is unable to rise from bed...
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: The child spoke of her wish to make a snowman of incredible size, you say? No wonder she took such an interest in my masterpieces!
The child said she wanted nothing more than to enjoy the Starlight festivities with her dear mother and father, you say? If only there were some way we could make that possible...
As for the medicine, let me contact my associates and see if there is aught that might be done.
In the meantime, might I trouble you to see to the decoration of our final and most spectacular snowman? I am confident that you understand what would bring joy to Isainne's heart more than anyone.
...Oh, but it would seem you've already collected all the twinklebox has to offer. Pray forgive my presumption. I suppose you'll be leaving us to return to far more important matters.
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_KAMLITOHALITO_000_1: 'Tis not about the rewards, you say? Truly, you are the very embodiment of the Starlight spirit─a veritable incarnation of .
TEXT_FESXMS605_04021_SYSTEM_000_101: Another missive of thanks has arrived from one of your numerous admirers. Speak to Baenfaeld in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to see what it says.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_010: At long last, our preparations have almost come to an end. All that remains is to put the finishing touches on the mother of all snowmen and give our dear little Isainne a Starlight present she'll remember for a lifetime!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_011: And with that, shall we be on our way? I'm ready if you are.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_020: Now, let's get to work, shall we? I've prepared an assortment of decorative materials for the occasion, so feel free to let your imagination run wild!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_021: That said, we mustn't forget who our audience is. What sort of snowman do you suppose would most warm little Isainne's heart?
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_022: Ah, yes....you were saying how concerned she was that the smaller snowman might be lonely, yes? And how happy she was when he got a friend?
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_023: Perhaps there's a hint to be had there. What sort of decoration would make Isainne happiest of all? Give it some thought, and I've no doubt you'll be struck with inspiration!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SYSTEM_000_024: Reflect on all you've learned and decorate the snowman as best you can to delight your fellow helper.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SYSTEM_100_024: As the townspeople tell it, Isainne's father is the tall, dashing type, and rarely seen without his favorite hat.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SYSTEM_110_024: Her mother, on the other hand, was known to prefer wearing matching patterns.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SYSTEM_000_030: Now fully decorated, the three snowmen appear as if they were a family. Just looking at them warms your heart, and you can only hope Isainne feels the same. Return to Amh Garanjy and let her know your task is done.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_040: You've truly outdone yourself, my friend─this is nothing short of a masterpiece. I've no doubt Isainne will be overjoyed at the sight of your little snowman family.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Marvelous! Simply marvelous! While I am partial to my own creations, I can do nothing but tip my cap to your superior aesthetic sensibilities.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_GODBERT_000_051: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ho ho! I have seen many a snowman in my day, but never one that warms the cockles of my heart quite so much as your merry little snowman family. Truly, you are a snowman artisan of the highest order!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_ISAINNE_000_052: Look! The snowman has a mommy and a daddy! Why, it's just like a family─our family! Oh, how happy she must be!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: I only helped here and there─ deserves all the credit. How do you like it, Isainne? I daresay the little snowman isn't lonely anymore.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_ISAINNE_000_054: Oh, yes! Now that I know she's not alone, I can leave her to enjoy Starlight with her family while I return home to my own!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_ISAINNE_000_055: I'm sorry for making you do all this for me when you were already so busy yourself. Can you forgive me?
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: I am the one who should be asking for forgiveness, my child. After all, it is you who taught this stuffy, overly serious fool what the true meaning of Starlight was all about.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_ISAINNE_000_057: I may not be able to stay for the celebration, but this has already been the best Starlight ever! Thank you so much for letting me help. I'll treasure the presents from the twinklebox forever!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_GODBERT_000_058: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ahem. Kamlito, if you would...?
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: ...But of course. Those presents were simply to show our appreciation for your help. Of course, we have another present─and this one's just for you.
Or perhaps I should say...for your dear father.

As it so happens, God─er, the Saint of Nymeia here happens to be a patron of the apothecary that produces this medicine. When he shared your story with the proprietor, they simply insisted that we deliver this to you straightaway.

What's more, they have at long last discovered a means by which they can produce the remedy in vast quantities. Rest assured that all those who are suffering as your father is will have succor soon enough.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_GODBERT_000_064: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Speaking of your father, my child, I took the liberty of delivering the first dose to him in person. From the looks of it, it would seem you may well be able to enjoy the celebration after all─and I daresay that your dear father may even be feeling well enough to join you.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_066: A medicine that not even all the money in the realm can buy... It truly is a Starlight miracle!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Yes, this season has taught me much. Coin is but a means to an end─not a goal in and of itself. If it is not used to bring a smile to those who need it most, it has little more value than a lump of coal.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_GODBERT_000_068: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ho ho! I daresay you've come far in this short time, Kamlito. Your father will be most proud to hear of this, I'm sure. Yes, you will prove a worthy successor to him, I am sure.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: About that, Lord Ma─er, good Saint, sir...I've decided not to take over Father's business after all.

It surprised me as well. Over the course of preparing for Starlight, I could feel my heart changing─now, I am as certain of it as anything. When I return to Ul'dah, I mean to devote my efforts to doing all in my power to alleviate the plight of those who were not blessed with my privileges.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_GODBERT_000_071: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Oho...I misjudged you, my boy. You have matured far, far beyond even my wildest expectations. So much so, in fact, that I daresay your father will have a stern word or two for me...
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: At any rate, I am not returning anywhere until I've celebrated Starlight to the fullest with the children of Gridania─Isainne here first among them, of course!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_073: That's the spirit! And with that, I can finally present you and  with the greatest gift of all─the one I've been waiting to give to you from the start...
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_KAMLITOHALITO_000_0: Let me hazard a guess─the smiles of the little ones, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_075: Ahaha! Clearly, the Starlight spirit has taken hold in your heart now.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_AMHGARANJY_000_076: And with that, the moment we've been waiting for is finally at hand. Without further ado...let the festivities begin!
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_SYSTEM_000_077: Another missive of thanks has arrived from one of your numerous admirers. Speak to Baenfaeld in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to see what it says.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_Q1_000_000: How will you dress the snowman?
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_A1_000_001: Place a red knit hat on its head.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_A1_000_002: Place a black silk hat on its head.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_A1_000_003: Drape a green scarf around its neck.
TEXT_FESXMS606_04022_A1_000_004: Drape a red scarf around its neck.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_TIGGERMISSIONARY_00: You there. Unless my eyes deceive me, you strike me as a  that knows how to look after .
An adventurer, you say? Oh, how fortuitous! Ah, but where are my manners─I am the tora bugyo and it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Might I ask a moment of your time?
You are far too kind. Allow me, in that case, to explain my current situation. I have made my way to Eorzea as part of a delegation sent from Hingashi to partake in the Heavensturn celebrations.

I have been briefed that the Eorzeans believe that, at year's end, the gods choose one among their number to serve next as a herald of good fortune. In the Far East, it is not a god, but one of twelve great beasts that is chosen.
And this year shall belong to the formidable tora! You may know it better as a “tiger” in these lands. Regardless, you doubtless now understand why I come dressed in my present attire.
Now, allow me to proceed to the heart of the matter.
Normally we celebrate auspicious events with a spot of mochi pounding. However, I think you'll agree such a meager celebration is hardly befitting of the mighty tora!

No, I have something much grander in mind and am currently searching for like-minded souls to help me. Frankly, a battle-hardened adventurer such as yourself would be perfect. Should you be willing to aid me, I shall see you rewarded with a kabuto of your own. What say you?
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_010: (-???-)Why, tora bugyo. I see you have found a willing assistant at last.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_TIGGERMISSIONARY_00: Ah, your timing could not be better. Yes, this kind soul is willing to lend a much-needed hand.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_012: Well, I must say  certainly looks the part!
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_013: Would you not agree, Master?  is perfect for the ceremony.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_014: Ahem. You may want to hear  opinion on the matter first─can't you see  is positively bewildered at present?
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_015: Ah, but allow me to clear up exactly who we are first. We are a clan of mages practiced in the ways of onmyodo, come to perform a ritual designed to quell evil forces.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_016: It is nothing overly complex─we simply put on a performance that we hope will please the gods. The ritual this time has its origins in a rather old tale concerning a ferocious tiger.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_017: We will use our powers to give life to the tiger adorning the folding screen we have brought with us. Then you, in your role as bloodthirsty warrior, shall vanquish the foul beast! ...Assuming you agree to participate, of course.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_A1_000_000: You bet. I slay tigers for breakfast!
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_A1_000_001: Why do I have to take part in this again?
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_020: I knew we could count on you the moment I saw you! Hardened adventurers never back down from a challenge, after all.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_030: Tradition has long dictated that someone local to the area take part in the ritual. Only then is it guaranteed to be truly effective.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_031: So I will ask once again: are you willing to lend us your aid?
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_040: You have my sincerest thanks, kind adventurer. Now, if you will excuse us, we must ready the ritual site.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_TIGGERMISSIONARY_00: If you would head to the site in middle La Noscea, southeast of the Zephyr Gate, I shall see to inviting spectators to the performance.
The ritual is to be held in middle La Noscea. Pray go ahead. I will be along in due time.
Ah, you are returned. Judging by your contented expression, I assume the ritual was a resounding success!
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_051: I take it our friend here has delivered the good news?
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_KOZOU_000_052: Truly, an astounding performance! It was as if I was gazing upon the great Tenzen himself.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_060: And I am glad to see you are unharmed. Pray tell, are you familiar with a hero by the name of Tenzen?
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_070: Tenzen is the hero that inspired the ritual we just performed.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_080: You know of the Tale of Tenzen? Then you are more worldly than I gave you credit for.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_090: The Tale of Tenzen is far and away the most well-known epic in the Far East. Our little performance just now was inspired by but a part of it.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_091: Legend has it that upon stopping at a small village whilst on his travels, Tenzen encountered a starved, crazed tiger. Naturally, he made short work of the beast, thus saving the peasants from their plight.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_092: Tales such as this tend to become somewhat exaggerated over time, and while I cannot account for their veracity, the importance of helping those in need is something that cannot be overstated.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_TIGGERMISSIONARY_00: Allow me to extend our thanks to you once again for all you have done.
As promised, this kabuto is yours to keep.
TEXT_FESNYR801_04023_EASTONMYOJI_000_095: Thank you once again, noble adventurer. We intend to put on our peformance a few more times during Heavensturn. We should be glad for your assistance again if you are willing.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_TIGGERMISSIONARY_00: Ah, just who I wanted to see. I was wondering if you would be willing to help hand out a few advent cakes? It is customary for us to do so during Heavensturn.
We finished preparing them but a short while ago, and who better to share them with the townspeople than the  of the hour!
Come to hand out more advent cakes? You are too kind.
Here you are. Pray take these to Hawkers' Alley. I imagine it won't be long before you find passersby eager for one of these delectable delights.
Take those cakes to Hawkers' Alley on the lower decks and pray hand them out to the passersby.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_010: Can I interest you fine folks in some delicious rice cakes? There is no better way to celebrate Heavensturn than with a delicious treat!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_011: Hello there, old friend! What brings you here this fine ? ...Wait, have you come to help distribute advent cakes? Your timing could not be better.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_012: Why, hello there. Can I interest you in some advent cakes? What's that? You have been sent to help me, have you? Splendid!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_013: Back to spread more joy through advent cakes? Wonderful!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_014: All right. The key is to position yourself somewhere that sees plenty of footfall. I shall go ahead and hand my cakes out elsewhere.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_A1_000_001: Seems to be a local tavern owner.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BADERON_000_020: I 'eard some over 'ere was passin' about advent cakes. Never dreamed it'd be you of all people! Well, can we 'ave some?
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_LYNGSATH_000_021: Ah, that's it─that's the ruddy taste! I'd been wantin' to do somethin' with rice cakes at the Bismarck, but I still can't get 'em to taste like the real thing.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BADERON_000_022: Me an' old Lyngsath 'ere usually enjoy each other's company over drinks, but we nearly got into a brawl the other day talkin' about the best way to prepare rice cakes.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_LYNGSATH_000_023: Never did come to an agreement, though, so we decided we'd both try a hand at it an' see whose was best.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BADERON_000_024: In case yer curious, I cooked me rice cakes first, drizzled some Far Eastern soy sauce on 'em, and then wrapped the blighters in seaweed.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_LYNGSATH_000_025: Just listen to this tripe. They're best in a rich broth with a few choice ingredients. A piping-'ot soup with yer cakes is a sight better than that load o' bilge ye call food.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BADERON_000_026: Still itchin' fer a fight, eh!?
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_LYNGSATH_000_027: Well, that's generally 'ow it went, anyway. Doubt we'll ever find common ground at this rate.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BADERON_000_028: Ha, ye can say that again. At least we'll never run out o' things to talk about at the tavern.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_LYNGSATH_000_029: Sounds like yer givin' up to me!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BADERON_000_030: Anyroad, we'll be seein' ye around, . Stick yer 'ead in the Drowning Wench next time ye've got some time on yer 'ands.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SUNDHIMAL_000_040: Would you happen to be the one handing out advent cakes? I'm presently on break and find myself rather peckish. Could I trouble you for one?
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SUNDHIMAL_000_042: Ah, if it isn't Wawalago. What ever has you in such a hurry today?
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_WAWALAGO_000_043: Well, I helped myself to a rice cake back at the guild and, er, apparently it was Sisipu's...
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_WAWALAGO_000_044: She came at me with the anger of a thousand coeurls. I fear naught but savory replacement will sate her anger.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SISIPU_000_045: Oi, Wawalago! Hurry up and hand over that cake!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_WAWALAGO_000_046: Bloody hells, that's her! Sorry, no time for talk!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SUNDHIMAL_000_048: Oh dear. Would you mind if I took one more cake for Wawalago?
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SUNDHIMAL_000_049: In his panic, he seems to have forgotten to take a cake for her...
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SUNDHIMAL_000_050: Worry not. I shall see to it that all is well between them soon enough. I would not be much of a Yellowjacket if I were unable to solve a little scuffle such as this, after all!
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_SUNDHIMAL_000_051: You have my thanks! Well, time for me to take my leave.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_060: It has been too long since last we met, old friend.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_061: You do not recognize me? I concede the phantom you slayed recently was a fair likeness, but surely our battle was far more memorable.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_062: Tell me, what is it you are handing out to the people here?
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_063: A most delectable treat indeed. Ah, how I enjoyed feasting on them with Tenzen at my side.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_064: Though, it was not always pleasant. Even now I vividly recall the time Genbu found one such treat lodged in his throat, or when Seiryu thought to swallow one whole, burning his mouth, and all the while Suzaku clamored for Tenzen to come and help them.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_065: But enough reminiscing, you must be wondering why I have come all this way. Given the beast chosen as this year's herald, it piqued my interest to hear the onmyoji would be traveling here to perform their holy rites.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_066: What they summon are merely shades, but they are made in my image. As such, I felt compelled to ensure no harm came to the people of these lands.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_067: The tale itself is little more than fancy, of course, but I was surprised to learn you of all people were chosen to play Tenzen.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_068: If I may be honest, their failure to faithfully depict those past events vexes me at times, but that is neither here nor there...
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_069: It is a lasting reminder of our hard-won victory over Koryu, and the peace restored to the Far East. Viewed thus, I can see no reason to be unduly harsh in my criticism.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_070: It is comfort enough that we and the other Four Lords shall always remember the truth of Tenzen's life.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_072: Speaking of the others, I beg you keep my visit here between us. Should Suzaku and Seiryu learn that I had the singular good fortune of seeing you perform as Tenzen, well... I would rather not think on it.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_BYAKKO_000_071: And with that, I shall bid you farewell. I pray you continue to carry on Tenzen's legacy, as I know only you can.
TEXT_FESNYR802_04024_TIGGERMISSIONARY_00: Ah, you are returned, and I see you are without advent cakes.
Another day's work complete, then. Thanks in no small part to you. I pray you take your ease and enjoy the remainder of the Heavensturn celebration.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_100_000: A Resistance rank of  and  mettle are required to proceed with this quest.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_100_001: You are Resistance rank , and have amassed  mettle.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_100_010: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WAKADANNAOFMUJIKOZA: Now look here. My father was quite clear on the repercussions of returning to him without your next work.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WANDERINGWRITER_000: And for that you have my sympathies, but genius is a most fickle mistress, and her expertise was thoroughly spent but recently on a playscript promised to my dear friend Jenomis.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WAKADANNAOFMUJIKOZA: You honestly mean to say you have nothing? Not even an outline? I deserve that much after you were so generously compensated the other evening.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WANDERINGWRITER_000: Compensation...? That drink was meant to be payment for my services!?
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WAKADANNAOFMUJIKOZA: Well it certainly wasn't offered out of the kindness of my heart. Have you any idea how expensive that wine was?
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WANDERINGWRITER_000: As I recall, you and your wife were the ones who drank most of it. And you clearly have more money than sense, because that particular “vintage” was positively revolting.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WAKADANNAOFMUJIKOZA: And who might this be? Wait, don't tell me─another good friend come to rob me of your next playscript?
!? Champion of Eorzea, savior of Doma, that ?
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WANDERINGWRITER_000: Thus do I find myself wanting for inspiration. Have you, by chance, embarked on any fantastical journeys of late? Grand adventures to stir the soul and perhaps my writing hand to commit pen to paper?
The fabled blade Save the Queen given life, guarded by Gunnhildr's Blades... And you say this took place in the ruins of the Bozjan royal palace? My oh my, that is quite the riveting tale.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WAKADANNAOFMUJIKOZA: Aha, I know that look! You have an idea for your script.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_WANDERINGWRITER_000: You are quite right, my friend. The seed of inspiration has been planted.  stands in the royal palace─no, the royal cathedral! A suitably opulent location, at any rate. And the last descendant of Queen Gunnhildr stands ready to defy you in pursuit of her lifelong ambition!
“Why do you insist on standing in my way!?” she exclaimed, tightening her grip on the holy blade. “Are you truly so eager to meet your gods?”
“No! Any who would oppose me are undeserving of such a mercy! The only solace you shall have from my wrath will be damnation!”
...No. No, I fear having not seen the exchange firsthand, my prose will stray too far into the realm of fiction.
If I am to do your deeds justice, I must needs know all that took place that fateful day, down to the finest detail.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_000_020: You can now participate in the duty Delubrum Reginae (Savage).
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_000_021: An alliance of 24 to 48 players is required to register for this duty.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_100_021: The Party Finder may be used to recruit members for this duty by selecting Field Operations, then Delubrum Reginae (Savage).
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_000_022: After forming an alliance, the alliance leader must speak with the troubled gentleman in Gangos to register.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_100_022: While inside Delubrum Reginae (Savage), you will be subjected to a status effect that prevents resurrection by certain means.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_101_022: Raise effects granted via limit breaks and certain lost actions are exempt from this restriction.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_102_022: Without such means to recover in battle, due preparation will prove all the more essential in this encounter.
TEXT_LUCKSA211_04027_SYSTEM_000_023: You may also speak with the troubled gentleman for further details before entering.
TEXT_SUBGSC108_04030_CARDTOURNAMENT_000_: Enjoying your forays into the competitive world of Triple Triad? Should you feel unfulfilled in your desire for card-based conflict, then allow me to introduce you to our all-new “short tournament” selections!

The first of these trimmed-down tourneys is the “Open” tournament. Held on a regular schedule, this 8-person competition is designed for fair and balanced play. You don't even need your own cards to enter!
Each player builds a 5-card deck from a random selection of cards, and participates in three matches. The winners─and the rewards─are based on the overall results of these games.
TEXT_SUBGSC108_04030_SYSTEM_000_003: To enter an Open tournament, speak with the tournament official as a solo player during an active registration period.
TEXT_SUBGSC108_04030_SYSTEM_000_004: The official also provides useful information such as schedule details and rule explanations.
TEXT_SUBGSC108_04030_CARDTOURNAMENT_000_: The second concise contest available to you is the “Invitational” tournament. This option allows you to invite up to seven of your friends─or bitter rivals─and create your own exclusive event. The rules of the game are yours to decide!

The structure of the competition is otherwise the same as an Open tournament with regards to the number of matches played, and how the winners are ranked. Oh, and not to worry if you're a few members short of a full party─our house champions will step in to make up the numbers!
TEXT_SUBGSC108_04030_SYSTEM_000_007: To create an Invitational tournament, form a party with your chosen participants, then have the party leader register your group via the Duty Finder.
