TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_002: (-Notes on the Crime Scene-)Furthermore, the attendant was certain that no individuals other than fellow staff were seen behind the counter, as it would be instantly and blatantly obvious were a non-uniformed personage to breach this high-security location.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_010: (-Witness's Testimony-)According to a customer who happened to be observing the counter at the time, Hugue left his post briefly to show a guest around the floor. As far as the witness could see, no other staff came to fill the post during Hugue's absence.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_020: (-Brass Blade's Testimony-)A sour-tempered sellsword charged with tracking down the stolen horn groused and grumbled that he has searched everywhere for the invaluable object, but cannot find it for the life of him.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_030: (-Observations from the Crime Scene-)Surveying the general area of the crime scene, you could not help but feel that objects visible from a certain angle might be hidden from sight when viewed from others. Could this be relevant, somehow?
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_040: (-Words of a Frantic Attendant-)A Lalafellin attendant was in a panic upon discovering that their official uniform─a possession which Gold Saucer staff are instructed to protect with their lives─had gone missing, and has yet to be recovered.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_041: (-Words of a Frantic Attendant-)He has searched high and low, and asked his fellow staff members if they had seen it, but to no avail. Furthermore, it would seem no missing items have been delivered to the lost and found yet today.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_050: (-Words of a Blabbering Brass Blade-)A garrulous sellsword shared with you a story about Pipimaya, a senior member of the Brass Blades involved in the investigation. Pipimaya is an amiable fellow nicknamed “Master Mayapipi” by his subordinates. As the man tells it, it is unthinkable that he would ever ignore a friendly greeting.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_060: (-Words of an Astute Attendant-)The attendant was shocked and surprised to hear of the missing uniform, as the victim is a veteran employee widely known as one of the most careful and circumspect of all the Saucer staff.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_070: (-Words of Two Brass Blades-)A junior member of the Brass Blades shared his disappointment and dismay at having invited Pipimaya to the chocobo races for some off-duty entertainment, only to have his superior brusquely rush off without even acknowledging the poor newcomer's words.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_071: (-Words of Two Brass Blades-)Furthermore, his comrade mentioned that Pipimaya has a brother who is known to enjoy himself at the Saucer from time to time.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_080: (-Words of Two Effusive Attendants-)Some particularly talkative attendants were discussing Pipimaya's brother, a Gold Saucer regular whose single-minded dedication to earning massive quantities of MGP has only intensified as of late. The latest rumors among the staff say that he's set his sights on an invaluable prize.
TEXT_FESGSC503_04056_SYSTEM_200_081: (-Words of Two Effusive Attendants-)Furthermore, it would seem the sibling bears a striking resemblance to Pipimaya himself, as one of the employees appears to have confused the two for each other.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Well, if it isn't my favorite adventurer! Come to enjoy the Moonfire festivities again this year, have you? I promise you're in for a scorchingly, swelteringly good time!
Welcome, my adventuring friend! Come to enjoy the Moonfire Faire festivities, have you? I promise you're in for a scorchingly, swelteringly good time!

As you may very well know, the faire is a storied tradition that, in recent years, has served to promote the effort of the Adventurers' Guild on behalf of Eorzeans everywhere. Once again, we've got a piping hot plate full of exciting activities for one and all!
This year, we've also been tasked by none other than Master Gegeruju─our ever-generous patron of the event─with creating the ultimate icy dessert to stave off the heat.

We'd more than welcome the aid of a skilled adventurer like yourself─and needless to say, we'd reward you well for your efforts. If you'd be willing and able to lend a hand, simply hop over to Costa del Sol and speak to my colleague Haermaga!
Given any thought to helping us beat the heat this Moonfire season? My colleague Haermaga at Costa del Sol's Isle of Endless Summer is waiting for you with bells on!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_007: I do hope that Nekeke's okay...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_010: Well, if it isn't ! Come to help us create our frozen masterpiece, have you? Why, I couldn't have asked for a better partner in our confectionery challenge!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_011: Welcome, friend, and I hope you enjoy the festi─wait a minute. That's adventurer's garb, if ever I saw some. Did Mayaru send you to help with our confectionery challenge?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_012: And how glad I am to hear it! Gods' honest truth, we're in a bit of a bind here.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_013: You see, though we've been tasked with making the most delightfully frosty dessert, we are suffering from a lack of the all-important ingredient: ice.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_014: The shipment was supposed to come in bells ago, but word has it it's been held up by some disturbance in the area. Might you be so kind as to check with my associate P'obyano and see if she knows anything further? She should be just to the east of here, over on the beach.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_015: I reckon P'obyano should know something about the delayed shipment of ice. The lass's always on top of the latest comings and goings here.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_020: ! What a pleasure it is to see you again! Er, I imagine Haermaga's sent you to ask about the delayed shipment of ice.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_021: What's that you say? Haermaga's sent you to ask about the delayed shipment of ice?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_100_021: To be quite honest, the situation is something of a complicated one.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_022: As you may have heard, for this year's festivities, Master Gegeruju has imposed upon us a rather daunting task: preparing the finest frozen dessert the realm has ever seen.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_023: He promised us that he would spare not a single gil to see the deed done, so we decided to enlist the services of one of the realm's most prominent confectioners. All well and good to this point, yes?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_024: As it turns out, this confectioner was a hopeless perfectionist. Insisting that only the finest ice in all of Eorzea would serve for her creation, she hopped on the next vessel to the northern seas.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_025: ...And that's the last we saw of her. It's not that I fear for her life, mind you─pardon the pun, but she's one tough cookie. That said, the festivities are all but upon us, and if she doesn't make it back soon...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_BEACHGUY03966_000_0: (-Faire-goer-)Ye gads! That poor girl's drowning out there!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_028: That garb...yes, it's her! ! That's Nekeke, the selfsame confectioner of whom I just spoke! We must help her at once!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_029: Poor Nekeke! Do you suppose she's all right...!?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_BEACHGUY03966_000_0: As soon as I saw her, I swam out and brought her to shore, but...were we too late?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_BEACHGUY03966_100_0: Will she be all right now? In any event, I'll leave her to your capable hands.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_032: Oh, Nekeke! You've come back to us! Thank the gods...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_033: P'obyano? Is that you? Why...I'm back in Costa del Sol!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_034: You are, indeed! Whatever happened to you out there? Were you swept away in a storm!? Tossed from your boat by some eldritch horror from the depths of the sea!?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_035: I fear my memory is still hazy... As I remember, we sailed to the northern seas, where─after braving the elements and some vicious fiends set on making a meal of me─I succeeded in procuring the most pristine ice I've ever laid eyes upon.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_036: We began the journey back, and just as we were approaching Costa del Sol...it's no use. The only thing I remember is our vessel capsizing, and my body being flung from the deck along with my hard-won supply of ice.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_037: ...But at least I made it back in one piece. And I have you and your friend here to thank for that, P'obyano.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_038: Oh, my dearest friends! You, too, survived the shipwreck! Why, I couldn't be happier!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_040: Aren't they lovely? We met on one of the isles up north. I shared some of my treats with them, and next thing I knew, they were following me everywhere. They're gentle and strong─the most perfect companions, really.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_041: All right, that's enough of the touching reunion! My precious ice is scattered all about the place. Go round it up and bring it here─on the double, now!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_042: Well, would you look at that! They're quite clever, aren't they?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_043: Oh, lucky day! The seals are intact, and the ice inside undamaged and unmelted. That means only one potential rub remains...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_044: Yes, as a matter of fact... The ice, you see, is everything I hoped it would be. Which is why it was rather to my chagrin when I later discovered that a dreadful fiend slumbered in the rather large chunk of ice that I had loaded onto our vessel.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_045: Yes, it's all coming back to me now. As we neared Costa del Sol, with the balmy winds drifting in, I heard a dreadful rumbling coming up from the cargo hold...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_046: I rushed down to investigate, only to see the fearsome creature. It appeared rather perturbed by the heat, and it suddenly began to swell larger and larger, until...boom!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_047: ...It would appear my own carelessness was the cause of our unfortunate incident. Fortunately, my furry companions and I have survived the shipwreck, as has my stock of the purest ice!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_048: And yet, I fear that the fiend will be back, in search of the icy home I so unceremoniously stole from him. Whatever am I to do...!?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_049: Have no fear, my dear Nekeke! In faires over the years, my friends and I have fought off more Bombards than you can shake a stick at! Why, “Bombard buster” could be my middle name!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_050: Now, let's go apprise Haermaga of the situation─surely he'll have an idea as to how we can deal with the menace and kick the festivities off with a bang!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_051: Haermaga's an old hand at Bombard busting. He's sure to have a trick or two up his sleeve that will serve us well.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_052: I'm not sure how much help I'll be. And yet I'm the one who brought this menace here─it wouldn't do for me to just stand on the sidelines while you do all the heavy lifting.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_060: Ah, ! I was wondering when I might hear back from you and P'obyano.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_100_060: And I see our star confectioner has joined you as well! Pray tell, how did you fare?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_061: ...Oh dear. So while the ice has been safely procured, a blustery Bombard of behemoth-like proportions has been procured alongside it? No doubt that has something to do with the panicked screams I heard coming from the beach...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_062: But not to worry! After all, what is the Moonfire Faire if not a season for blasting ill-tempered, hot-headed balloons out of the air? And I know just the person to assist us in the effort! Just a moment, now...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_THRACIE_000_063: (-???-)...Say no more, Master Haermaga. I stand ever at the ready, my friends!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_THRACIE_000_065: Surely you have heard the tales of Thracie, brave leader of the Bombardiers and bane to Bombards the realm over! Or perhaps you haven't─but no matter! Pray rest assured that I and my companions will see safety returned to your beaches.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_BAGO_000_066: Ba Go, too, has come to save the day! And he has brought his fun little toys─trinkets, trifles, toys! Oh yes, Ba Go has brought his toys that go boom!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_RFHULTIA_000_067: And I'm R'fhul Tia! I may still be new to this adventuring business, but I promise you that what I lack in experience, I make up for in pluck! Pluck, spirit, and...er...determination.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_068: This whole mess was all my fault, and still so many of you have come to my aid. How can I ever repay you...
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_069: Nonsense, my dear! The ice you brought was at our behest, and all will be forgiven when you fashion for us the most delightful frosty dessert Master Gegeruju has ever laid eyes on! Besides, the exploits of Bombard-busting adventurers are sure to bring even more good publicity to the guild.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_070: That settles it, then! Let's get out there and show that oversized ball of ice that the Isle of Endless Summer is no place for his ilk!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_SYSTEM_100_070: The FATE “A Blizzard of Bombards” can only be completed as a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_071: Forgive me, my friends. I had every intention of joining you out there, but Master Haermaga would hear nothing of it. After all, he said, who would take my place in the kitchen if I were injured on the battlefield?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_072: And so, loath as I am to do so, I leave the Bombards in your most capable hands!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_073: I've no doubt you can handle the matter on your own, but hang my tongue if I'm not going to provide you with all the backup you require, and then some! Rest assured that some of my most capable colleagues will be joining you on the front lines.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_074: Be safe out there, ! I'll round up some potions in case we need a freshening up from time to time.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_076: Ah, ! Pray tell, how did you fare?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_080: That look of relief and supreme satisfaction on your faces...am I to surmise that you've succeeded in driving off that most baleful Bombard!?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_RFHULTIA_000_081: Indeed! And we scarcely even broke a sweat in the doing! Isn't that right, P'obyano?
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_POBYANO_000_082: Quite so, my friend. Though I daresay it wouldn't have been nearly so easy without  at our side. I can't thank you enough, my friend!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_THRACIE_000_083: And yet, we must remain ever vigilant, for there is no telling when the dread creature's friends may return to seek their revenge. In any event, the Isle of Endless Summer is safe for now, and that is what matters most.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_084: You truly are heroes─all of you!
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_HAERMAGA_000_085: Well, all's well that ends well, I say. And with that, I say it's time we retrieved our supplies from the beach.
TEXT_FESSUM701_04082_NEKEKE_000_086: Splendid! Just you wait, my friends! Nekeke is going to prepare the most marvelous dessert this realm has ever seen!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_002: It appears we were able to dispatch the Bombard before a panic broke out at the beach. That's a relief, to say the least.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_003: Oh, ! I can't thank you enough. Were it not for you, I'd have been too busy running for my life to even think of making Master Gegeruju's dessert.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_004: But all's well that ends well, and finally I can get down to what I was brought here to do! I promise you I'll be done before you know it, so why don't you and P'obyano entertain yourselves for the time being.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_100_004: Ah, and while you're at it, perhaps you could call Master Gegeruju as well. I'm sure he's more eager than any to see my masterpiece take form!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_005: Genius can't be rushed, my friend. Why don't you and P'obyano have a little chat in the meantime? I promise I'll be done in two swishes of a chocobo's tail.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_HAERMAGA_000_010: Ah, ! Truly impressive the way you chased off that Bombard. Not that I'd expected any less of you, of course.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_HAERMAGA_000_011: Ah, ! Truly impressive the way you chased off that Bombard. Why, one would never imagine that this was your first time taking part in the festivities.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_HAERMAGA_000_012: Thanks to you, I think we can safely say the guild's put on another impressive show this year. It's only a matter of time before our halls are overflowing with aspiring adventurers. Talk about making the best of a bad situation!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_HAERMAGA_000_013: Speaking of which, I heard Nekeke's nigh done with her delightful creation. I don't know about you, but I'm most eager to taste it myself─believe it or not, I have something of a sweet tooth!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_HAERMAGA_000_014: We should round up Thracie and R'fhul Tia as well. Ah, but leave that to me─I daresay you've earned yourself a respite. Why not enjoy a walk on the beach while you're waiting?
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_GEGERUJU_000_024: What's this you say? The fiends have been dispatched, and my prized dessert is ready for the tasting? Why didn't you tell me sooner!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_GEGERUJU_000_025: Oho! If it isn't the ever-resourceful and oh-so-forgiving adventurer who we so ignominiously tasked with gathering ingredients for our banquet.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_GEGERUJU_000_026: What's this you say? The fiends have been dispatched, and my prized dessert is ready for the tasting? Why didn't you tell me sooner!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_GEGERUJU_000_027: Nekeke's confections are said to be the sweetest and most sublime in all of Eorzea! I can scarcely wait to see what genius she's whipped up this time!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_030: Ah, ! Again, I thank you for your efforts in helping us dispatch the Bombards.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_031: To think that such a calamity would befall us on the eve of the festivities! But pray don't be too hard on Nekeke. She meant only to please, as she always has.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_032: ...Oh. In all the confusion, I forgot to mention it, but she's actually a childhood friend of mine. We used to play together by the shore, and one day, we were set upon by a vicious monster.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_033: We thought we were done for, but were saved in the nick of time by a kindly adventurer who swiftly dispatched the beast and whisked us away to safety. That's when I vowed that one day I'd serve the guild and repay my debt to the brave soul who rescued me.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_034: Meanwhile, Nekeke was a genius in the kitchen since she was just a girl. She chose the path of a culinarian in hopes of filling the bellies of adventurers all over with nourishing and toothsome snacks.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_035: In the end, she found her calling making sweets─as opposed to the sort of hearty meals that you and I might favor─but that's rather fitting for her. She's always had an independent streak, after all.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_036: In any event, she's positively overjoyed that her latest creation will be presented front and center at the faire, for adventurers all over to enjoy.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_037: More than anything, I'm just glad she's back with us, safe and sound.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_POBYANO_000_039: I'm just glad Nekeke is back with us, safe and sound. Until the next time she decides to venture off in search of some rare ingredient, at least...
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_100_039: Oh, it's you! You couldn't have come at a better time─I was just putting the finishing touches on my masterpiece. Pray wait for just a moment, won't you?
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_040: Adventurers, Eorzeans, faire-goers, friends! I am most proud to present my latest creation. I call it Costa del Hielo, and I promise you that it will please your tongue even more than it does your eyes!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_041: And to make sure that it doesn't melt─as well as to help all of you stay cool amidst the scorching heat, I leave you with a present from my furry friends!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_042: Ah, . Well? Did my dessert agree with you? After all the trouble I put you through, one can only hope so...
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_A1_000_001: It was more than worth the trouble.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_A1_000_002: Your friends put on quite the show.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_043: Now that's a relief to hear! If it provided you with true refreshment after all your travails─why, as a confectioner and culinarian, nothing would make me happier.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_044: Speaking of which...I had meant to tell you. Ever since you chased off those Bombards, my little friend here hasn't been able to take her eyes off you. Just look at her face─it's as if she's saying, “Oh,  Adventurer, what I wouldn't give to join you in your travels!”
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_045: Oh, truly? How kind you are! She'll be most wonderful company on the road─I promise you that.
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_NEKEKE_000_046: And with that, I'd best get back to the kitchen. After all, adventurers from all corners of the realm have come to taste my latest, greatest creation. Until we meet again, a happy Moonfire Faire to you!
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_SYSTEM_000_047: Thanks to your efforts, peace has returned to the beaches of Costa del Sol, and the festivities can commence in earnest. That is, until the Bombard menace rears its ugly head...
TEXT_FESSUM702_04083_SYSTEM_000_048: You may now purchase wares from the Moonfire Faire vendor. Participate in the FATE appearing in the southeastern region of the faire grounds to earn vouchers that can be exchanged for goods.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Come one, come all, for the season of Hatching-tide is here once more!
Oh, ! How delightful to see you again!
I am Jihli Aliapoh, and it's a pleasure to make your acquaintance on this most blessed occasion.
Don't tell me... You are an adventurer, yes? Well, you certainly have the inquisitive nature of one, at any rate! May I ask your name?
Well then, , I should probably mention that Hatching-tide all began with a vision I had before the Seventh Umbral Calamity, in which the Twelve Archons delivered unto me a message.

From atop their giant, decorated eggs they called to me: “Arise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessels for our return.” When I awoke, I quickly set about filling the realm with all manner of painted ovoids. And thus did this joyous yearly celebration come to be!

I must say, the prophetic dream I had this year was even more fantastical than usual. I was assailed with images of rabbits and chickens who worked together, paw in claw, to construct a wondrous backdrop for our festival.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_00: Always before when we made efforts to recreate my visions, the fates rewarded us with some special occurrence.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: And already it has begun. No sooner had I donned my bunny costume than a chicken-suited poultry farmer arrived in town with a flock of feathery charges, and offered to lend his assistance! Just as I foresaw!
There has, however, been one tiny bump in the road... You don't happen to have a few moments to spare, do you?
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_A1_000_001: I'm always up for an eggspedition!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Oh, it's just a simple errand, really─I promise not to take up too much of your time!
It's just that my good friend Nonotta went to collect eggs from the poultry farmer, and...well...she should have returned by now.
I'm certain it's nothing serious! ...But I would be ever so grateful if you could pay a visit to the Greatloam Growery and see what's keeping her.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_021: ? It's me─Nonotta! How might I be of service?
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_022: If you're in search of Nonotta, well congratulations─you've found me! So, er...who are you, and what might I do for you?
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_023: Jihli was worried, you say? Right. I should probably explain.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_025: ...But before we delve into that, I should introduce you to Master Pawlin.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_026: Greetings! Yes! I am responsible for the little darlings! We heard word of this delightfully egg-centric festival taking place in Gridania, and simply had to be a part of it!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_027: Er, by “little darlings” he means the chickens. And they seem to be a touch out of sorts at the moment.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_028: The idea was to have them on hand to lay fresh eggs for us, and I've been trying to help soothe a whole barnful of ruffled feathers...
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_029: But even wearing the costume didn't stop me from being battered by charging chickens or spattered with fresh droppings. Honestly, I'm not sure what was injured more, my body or my pride.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_030: The poor dears are simply not used to travel! Please don't think less of them if they act a bit rambunctious!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_034: Er, ... If you planned on being heroic today, now is the time!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_SYSTEM_000_036: As you stare into the eyes of the feathered fiend, you feel a brief connection being made...
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_SYSTEM_000_037:
Hand over the fancy feed, and I'll give you the eggs you need.
Thus spake those black, soulless eyes. ...At least, you think that's what they said.
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_038: H-How did you do that!? I thought it was preparing to go on a rampage!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_040: Hm? You think the little darlings want their “fancy feed”?
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_041: Well, I do have a special mix I developed with the help of a professional Bismarck culinarian...for extra-special occasions. And I suppose this qualifies!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_042: It's dreadfully expensive even in small amounts, but how could I withhold a treat from my beloved beauties!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_045: I think I have enough fancy feed for everyone. Come, Nonotta─the ladies await their feast!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_047: (-Pawlin-)Now, now, my little darlings, you needn't be so─ Ow! Such a feisty welcome! If we could just─ Ow ow ow! Not the fingers!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_048: (-Nonotta-)Please! We're just trying to─ Oof! Oh no! The feed's gone everywhere!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_049: Phew. That seemed to cheer them up immensely. I suspect we'll have some eggs to collect in rather short order!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_050: Cheer them up? They've worked themselves into an absolute frenzy...
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_PAWLIN_000_051: ...Perhaps our adventurous friend here would like to try  hand at egg collecting? I'll even give you one of my spare “work suits” to wear!
TEXT_FESEST701_04089_NONOTTA_000_052: What a, er, wonderful opportunity for you! Sort out your gear, say your prayers, and we can have you filling a basket with eggs in no time. Just say the word!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_001: Are you ready to brave the poultry gauntlet? I'm sure you have a preferred adventuring wardrobe, but if you wouldn't mind...I think you should wear the costume while you work!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_002: To business, then! The entrance to the chicken enclosure is locked up tight─just give the nod to Master Pawlin and he'll let you in. We're counting on you, !
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_003: Where I have failed, you must prevail. It simply wouldn't be Hatching-tide without eggs!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_PAWLIN_100_003: I'm sure you'll do just fine!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_00: Have you found Nonotta yet? Perhaps she was distracted by the Growery's fine flowerbeds...
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_PAWLIN_000_004: Ready? Then into the chicken run you go!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SYSTEM_200_004: The FATE “An Eggsistential Threat” can only be completed as a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_005: ! Your egg-collecting skills are unparalleled! I don't know how to thank you!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_PAWLIN_000_006: Truly, that was a masterful display!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_PAWLIN_100_006: I am, however, somewhat concerned that my bellicose beauties may harm themselves in their excited state. If you would be so kind as to make the delivery, I should like to remain here and keep an eye on the chicken run.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_008: I imagine poor Jihli must be frantic. Let us convey this precious cargo back to the amphitheatre straightaway!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_009: If I'm to be wearing this costume for the duration of the festivities, I think a quick wash is in order...
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Welcome back, ! I hear the egg collecting was not quite so simple an errand as we'd imagined.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A2_000_001: It was an eggsperience, that's for sure!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A2_000_002: I've seen the seventh hell, and it was full of chickens.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: You are an example to us all! Nonotta and I are most fortunate to have your assistance!
A veritable purgatory of poultry, you say? And yet you persevered nonetheless! Nonotta and I are most fortunate to have your assistance!
With your hard-won bounty in hand, we can now proceed to the important task of baking cookies and painting eggs for the children.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_019: Er, I am loath to impose upon you so soon after that harrowing ordeal, but I wonder if I might ask you another favor?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_020: Simply put, I need you to hand out tokens of gratitude to our tireless helpers, who will soon return from setting up all the Hatching-tide decorations.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_021: Such a duty should fall upon me, of course, but this soiled suit requires an immediate and thorough scrubbing...
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_022: Wonderful! Come to the front of the amphitheatre, and I'll have the gifts laid out for you in just a moment.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_02: Please convey my regards to our most-appreciated assistants!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_010: Here are the gifts I mentioned. I put together three different sets, but you can hand out whichever seems appropriate.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_100_010: Thank you again. I'm sure your choices will be perfect!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_011: Meanwhile, I shall see to cleansing the filth from my costume. Once you've finished with the presents, you can report directly to Jihli!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_020: Greetings. We have come to report the completion of our part in the decorations.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_021: 'Tis a joyful duty to assist with the Hatching-tide adornments, knowing that every inhabitant of Gridania might enjoy the festivities. I hope you, too, will take a moment to join in this rare chance for revelry.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_022: ...In charge of rewarding festival helpers, you say? I've not done aught so grand as to merit a reward, but in the spirit of the occasion I shall humbly accept your gift.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_Q4_000_000: Which gift set will you choose from?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A4_000_001: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A4_000_002: The painted eggs filled with treats.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_024: If you'll take the rabbit, then I shall claim this adorable chicken.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_BODYGUARD01623_000_: A gift from y-you...? I shall treasure it always!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_026: My, what lovely colors... And judging by this scent, there are baked treats hiding within. A perfect accompaniment for my morning tea.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_027: Well, isn't this exquisite... It shall grace my mantle as a memento of these happy celebrations.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KANESENNA_000_028: Such a lovely surprise! Now, if you will pray excuse us...
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_MIOUNNE_000_030: Hah, why am I not surprised to see you here? We had a guild meeting scheduled, but you know how adventurers are─we just had to get involved in the celebrations.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_MOMODI_000_031: And seein' how the Dreamers always do such a nice job of decoratin' Ul'dah, I figured this was the perfect chance for me to return the favor.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_BADERON_000_032: Eh? Passin' out presents to us laborers, are ye? Far be it from me to refuse a gift given freely!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_Q5_000_000: Which gift set will you choose from?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A5_000_001: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A5_000_002: The painted eggs filled with treats.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_MOMODI_000_033: Oooh, those are just darlin', ain't they? Not exactly a match for the Quicksand's decor, though, so I might need to keep 'em in my room...
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_MIOUNNE_000_034: Ah, these are the type they fill with baked delights! There's nothing better than enjoying a sweet treat after a hard day's work.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_BADERON_000_035: Don't go 'oardin' 'em all to yerself now. I've got time for a quick bite an' a cup o' Mother Miounne's best tea afore I make the trip back to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_MOMODI_000_036: Sounds like a grand idea. Count me in!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_BADERON_000_037: Now ain't that a delicate beauty! But where's a safe spot to put it? Wouldn't survive two days in the Wench, considerin' the unsteady state o' me regular clientele...
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_MIOUNNE_000_038: We'd best be off and leave you to your business, then. Do come visit us at the Canopy when duty permits!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KURENAI_000_040: ! You are also taking part in this curious festival? I confess I find it passing strange to be speaking with you thus beyond the boundaries of the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SANANA_000_041: When I said I was headed this way to scout market prices, I was informed─not asked, mind you─that Her Highness here would accompany me in “an effort to better understand the outside world.” Do me a favor and keep this from Shiosai, would you?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KURENAI_000_042: You say we are to be rewarded? I had thought our inclusion in the ritual painting of the chicken eggs was reward enough, and now you offer me gifts. I am overwhelmed by your generosity!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_Q6_000_000: Which gift set will you choose from?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A6_000_001: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A6_000_002: The painted eggs filled with treats.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KURENAI_000_043: Oh, are these...little animal dolls? And so wonderfully soft to the touch!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SANANA_000_044: Oho, I know a treat-filled egg when I see one. It's interesting how the presentation makes the contents feel that much more special... In fact, I reckon I could sell these for a profit if you weren't just giving them away.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KURENAI_000_045: Such delicate and splendid artifice. And you call this an “Ar-kon” egg? Nay, 'tis far too precious a treasure for me to accept.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SANANA_000_046: I thought you came with me to experience the “outside”? It's customary to receive eggs on Hatching-tide, so please, just take the gift.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KURENAI_000_047: Yes, I suppose you are right. After all, this would be the perfect souvenir for Hisui!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_KURENAI_000_048: <sigh> I shall make one last turn around town, then I suppose I should return home. I pray we meet again soon in Tamamizu!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_050: I don't know if my sense for decoration is all that appealing, but I seem to have made a feathered friend. She must be from the flock belonging to Master Pawlin.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_051: Watching the struggles from afar, I had come to the conclusion that chickens are troublesome creatures, yet this one seems docile enough. So far, she's been content to follow me around as I put the finishing touches on my adornments. Is it my costume, I wonder...?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_052: A gift? For me? I feel somewhat guilty accepting a reward for an activity I so thoroughly enjoyed...but if you insist!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_Q7_000_000: Which gift set will you choose from?
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A7_000_001: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_A7_000_002: The painted eggs filled with treats.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_053: These toys are certainly soft and pleasant to hold, yet I cannot help but wonder what kind of plant fiber was used in their construction. Curse of the professional botanist, I'm afraid.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_054: Are these the eggs they fill with treats? That would explain the delicious aroma. Just what I need after a hard day's work in the planting fields.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_055: These Archon eggs are exquisite, aren't they? Speaking from the viewpoint of one who provides raw materials to artisans, I am thrilled to see my humble contributions transformed into such works of art.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_057: You like it too, do you? Then I shall display it in a place of pride, where it shall serve as a memento of our brief and unusual companionship.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_FUFUCHA_000_058: Now, I think it's time I returned this wayward hen to her owner. Fare you well!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_NONOTTA_000_059: Thank you for taking care of that little task─I was finally able to take a scrubbing brush to my outfit. Oh, and please do tell Jihli our helpers have been rewarded!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: , my thanks for your assistance! Our little tokens were well received, I hope?
Once my own tasks were complete, I found myself veritably surrounded by sylphs and moogles! I suppose the hustle and bustle of the festival must have piqued their curiosity.
The moogles seem particularly focused on wheedling cookie after cookie out of me... We shall have to call upon Master Pawlin for more eggs so I can bake another batch.
But putting these trifling troubles and setbacks aside, our rabbits and chickens have done a fabulous job with the Hatching-tide decorations─the event is a huge success!
And after all you've done to contribute, you deserve to head out and enjoy it!
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SYSTEM_100_106: Speak with Nonotta if you wish to replay the gift-giving task from the quest “A Poultry Sum.”
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SYSTEM_000_107: You can also repeat the FATE “An Eggsistential Threat” by speaking with Pawlin at the Greatloam Growery.
TEXT_FESEST702_04090_SYSTEM_100_107: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: ...What do you mean, who am I? I'm Kipih Jakkya, reporter for The Raven! You helped me investigate that “visitor from another world,” remember!?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003: Anyway, this is perfect─I could use your assistance with another story. Assuming you have the time, that is?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004: Oh, you're an adventurer, are you? Was there something I can assist you with...?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_005: ...Now that I think about it, perhaps it is you who can assist me.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_006: I am Kipih Jakkya, reporter for Gridania's leading tabloid, The Raven! Might I steal a moment of your time?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_007: So, here's the thing. Just recently, an unusual visitor cut through Gridania's markets like a scythe, in a frenzy to purchase every Nymeia lily available. And I mean all of them!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_008: For what purpose, I hear you ask? Well, my friend, I sense the answer to that question will provide the basis for my next scoop, so I did some nosing around.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_009: No one I talked to could put a name to our mysterious flower fancier, but by all accounts, he and his cargo hold of lilies had departed for Ul'dah. Not wanting the trail to grow cold, I quickly grabbed my quill and notepad, and boarded an airship myself...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_010: ...And was quickly reminded of how hard it is to chase a story in unfamiliar territory. You know this town and its people well enough though, don't you? What say you to lending a hand to my investigative efforts?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_A1_000_002: I suppose if you need a guide...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_011: Wonderful! Then we've no time to lose.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_012: First things first, we pay a visit to the nearest drinking establishment. The local tavern is always the best place to pick up tidbits of gossip and rumor!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_013: If I recall correctly, the proprietress here serves the Adventurers' Guild in the same capacity as our Mother Miounne does in Gridania. For one so petite, she certainly exudes a commanding presence.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_020: My, my, those are some serious faces. What can I do for you this fine ?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_021: Oooh, playin' reporter, are we? Sounds like fun. Let's hear your questions, then.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_022: Ahem. We are attempting to track down a particular someone who purchased a suspiciously large number of Nymeia lilies in Gridania before transporting them here to Ul'dah. Any idea of who this person might be?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_023: Hmmm. We've more than our fair share of traders comin' and goin', and a large shipment arrivin' in the city is hardly a noteworthy occurrence.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_024: But now that you mention it... I do remember this florid minstrel fellow who came in just the other day. Said he'd pulled in from Gridania, and needed help haulin' a hefty delivery to the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_025: He's actually a familiar face in these parts. Never did get his name, though, strangely enough...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_026: ...A nameless traveler arriving from Gridania with a sizable cargo to move. That sounds promising!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_027: Like I said, it was just a request to move cargo.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_028: Before you run off to a possible dead end with the alchemists, I suggest you fish for more information inside the Quicksand. After all, where else can you find so many gossipy adventurers crammed into one spot?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_029: That certainly makes sense. Between the two of us, however, I see no reason why we cannot do both!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_030: I shall stay here and interview the clientele, while you chase down our other lead at the Alchemists' Guild. What do you think?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_031: Then that will be our plan! Once you've spoken with the potion mixers, make your way back here and we can discuss any new revelations.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_032: Asking the right questions is a reporter's most vital skill. I'll soon have these adventurers spilling the stories we need to hear!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_033: It might be as you already know this, but Severian, the alchemists' guildmaster, can be an...uncooperative sort. Probably best that you're the one who's goin' to talk with him.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_040: Ah, my loyal assistant! What brings you to the guild at this hour? ...Hah! As if I paid attention to the mundane concerns of “timekeeping.” Have you some stimulating morsel of esoteric wisdom to share?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_041: You brought questions? ...For a tabloid piece!? Think you that I, a thrall to academic exertion, have even a moment to spare on such trivialities!?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_042: So boldly do you approach a master of his profession. I warn you: this matter best be deserving of the precious moments you steal away from my unending research.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_043: You question me for a tabloid piece!? Away with you! I refuse to waste another instant on this trivial nonsense!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_044: Ah, but just a moment... Perhaps there is a shred of scholarly value to this after all. I vaguely recall the flamboyant character of whom you speak, and his request to process a vast quantity of floral material...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_045: 'Tis laughable that I would undertake such a menial chore, of course, so I assigned the task to my subordinates. If you wish to discuss the tedious details, Deitrich is your man.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_046: Go and bother Deitrich, now. Persist with your pestering, and I shall enlist you as a test subject for experimental elixirs.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_DEITRICH_000_047: Why, I should be delighted to assist you. This is regarding that large delivery of Nymeia lilies...?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_DEITRICH_000_048: Yes, the guild did accept a task involving said flowers, as commissioned by a nomadic minstrel gentleman.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_DEITRICH_000_049: And though I cannot reveal the nature of what we produced, I can tell you that it shall be distributed amongst the populace as part of the events of the Rising. If you wish to know more, then might I suggest you speak to the gentleman himself?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SEVERIAN_000_050: The minstrel's request was not daunting for its complexity, merely for its sheer volume. And we could not rely on─or indeed, even expect─the briefest assistance from Master Severian...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_060: Master Severian was his usual prickly self, then? In a way, it's reassurin'─like all is right with the world.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_061: Adventurer, you're back! Did the alchemists offer up any new information?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_062: So to summarize: this famously unnamed minstrel of nomadic inclination commissioned the manufacture of some as-yet-unknown item to be handed out during the Rising...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_063: Oh, I heartily agree that we should speak with him directly. And as luck may have it, I've just discovered that he means to put on a performance at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_064: I think it's time for one of my patented “on the spot” interviews, don't you?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_065: If we hurry over, we can catch him before he takes the stage.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_070: That colorful fellow there must be our minstrel...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_071: Greetings, sir! I'm terribly sorry to interrupt, but you are the famous “wandering minstrel,” are you not?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I am indeed. And what might I do for you fine people?
I am indeed...
And look whom you've brought to see me! Was there aught I might do for you fine people?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_075: I've been following you, to be perfectly honest. I am curious to learn more about the wagonload of lilies you turned over to the alchemists...not to mention your plans to distribute the results of their work.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: You followed me!? But how did y─? I mean, why would you...?
Ah, a writer for The Raven... That explains much. And did you also learn what I tasked the alchemists to create? Is the coeurl out of the bag for all to smell?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_078: No, I... We were hoping you might tell us.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Good, then my surprise remains unspoiled. The plan, if you must know, is to hand out bundles of potpourri to all and sundry during the Rising.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_080: As in...flowers mixed with spices? That aromatic stuff you see in bowls on parlor tables and the like?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The very same. Except my potpourri will delight the eyes as much as the nose, thanks to the alchemical wizardry infused by my co-conspirators.
Yet even without such enhancements, the scent of Nymeia lilies is known to promote calm and tranquility.
The Rising is a time of remembrance. Of mourning. It is a time when sorrow can overwhelm folk who lost friends and loved ones in the Seventh Umbral Calamity.
It is my hope that the lily's gentle perfume will afford such burdened souls a modicum of peace during this ofttimes melancholy memorial.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_085: Oh my... What a genuinely lovely idea!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Only just this moment we were making arrangements for a, ahem, “showcase” of my humble talents, where I shall hand out potpourri bundles to the audience.
Again, I am glad we met ere you inadvertently spread word of our little surprise gift. ...I trust you now have sufficient detail to write your article?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_088: Oh, yes! I have plenty to work with, thank you!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Splendid. Now, since you've joined the inner circle, so to speak, we must have you play a role in the performance.

Hah, you needn't fret so─I merely wish for your assistance in passing out potpourri. I can supply the crowd at the show, but it would be most helpful if you might deliver bundles to some other part of town.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_091: Oh, we would be happy to! And it could only help me flesh out the story!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_092: Let's head back to the Quicksand, adventurer. If we hand out bundles there, then we can be sure to cover folk from every corner of the city!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: We were low on helping hands to tell the truth, so this has worked out for the best. Please, come and meet me at the Ruby Road Exchange once you've finished with your task.
Ah, the hour of my performance draws near. Many times have I taken the stage in my life, yet that thrill of anticipatory terror never fails to run through me.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_095: ...Potpourri? Aye, hand out as much as you like─anythin' to overpower the scent of sweat-stained adventurer!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_096: Let's get to work, shall we?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MIMIO_000_100: (-???-)What is it you are giving out there, adventurer?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MIMIO_000_101: Ah, I know this scent... Nymeia lily, yes?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MIMIO_000_102: The flower is often placed on the graves of the fallen, a practice with which I am, alas, intimately familiar. Why choose this particular bloom?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MIMIO_000_103: I see. Perhaps the perfume does remind one of the peace of repose, rather than the violence which took our companions from us. It would seem the minstrel has given the matter some thought.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MIMIO_000_104: For Carteneau veterans such as myself, the season of the Rising can be a torment...like the throbbing pain of an old wound. I will keep this bundle close, I think, and breathe in its calm whenever I feel my thoughts turning grim.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_105: Keepin' busy there, ain't you, ? I know it's for the Risin' and all, but it tickles me to see a hero of your stature handin' out presents like a simple errand .
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_106: Keepin' busy there, ain't you, ? I know it's for the Risin' and all, but it tickles me to see a promisin' adventurer such as yourself handin' out presents like a simple errand .
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_107: I mean, ever since the first time we met, you've always been the type to lend aid where it's needed.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_108: And you haven't changed one bit. Makes me happy, it does...not to mention a little misty-eyed.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_109: The good you've done for folk will linger on─an unshakable foundation for your future. Keep goin' the way you're goin', my friend, and we'll all be the better for it.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_110: Here, why don't you let me have whatever bundles you've got left and I'll put them together with the ones I took from your reporter friend. If we leave a basketful out on the guild counter, I guarantee they'll hand themselves out before the Risin' is over.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_100_110: Mistress Momodi took a goodly amount off my hands, but I think we've done our fair share of the work. We should go and see the minstrel, and let him know we've completed our task!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_111: I wonder if that potpourri also loosens tongues... It seems everyone who took a bundle had a Rising tale to tell, be it a short remembrance or a lingering stroll down memory lane.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MOMODI_000_112: That potpourri of yours is fairly flyin' off the counter. I don't know if it's just the scent or what, but it's proven popular with the patrons.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_MIMIO_000_113: Seems everything I see at this time of year reminds me of fallen friends. But with your gift on hand to salve my senses, the memories will be bittersweet...as opposed to simply bitter.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The reporter and her most-qualified assistant return. The performance went well, I must say, but what of your story research? Were the townsfolk willing to share any moving material?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_121: Yes, they were unexpectedly forthcoming. I was regaled with many an anecdote from those who lived through the Calamity, and privileged to hear their treasured memories of those who did not.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_122: Back when the Calamity was poised to strike, I had only just earned my reporter's quill. I was rushing around town, questioning adventurers and taking notes...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_123: But as Dalamud descended ever lower, the streets erupted into chaos. It was then that I fled with my younger brother to the border and relative safety. There were a few less-prudent friends and colleagues who might still be here if they had done the same.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_124: In the years since, the world has risen from the ashes. I've done my best to rise along with it, but there are things I cannot─nay, should not─forget. Such are the thoughts which blossom in my mind when I breathe in that potpourri's perfume.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_126: I've enjoyed our collaboration this day, adventurer, and I shall attempt to write a piece that does it justice. What say you to “Rising Calm” as a title?
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: How fitting. I look forward to reading it.
I, too, sense the stirring of a new composition. A hopeful verse, dedicated to the continued safe passage of those who yet ascend the path out of catastrophe and despair...
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_13: (-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_13: It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and you have my most heartfelt thanks for gracing this world with your presence, and your deeds of surpassing courage and valor.
What a pleasure it is to welcome you here again, . And what a privilege that your chosen trail should run alongside mine for so long.
On a day such as today, I hope you will forgive me a brief bout of nostalgia.
It has been an entire decade since I first came to this world. I was a stranger here, a traveler in a troubled land, and the quest for its salvation consumed my every moment.

Countless trials were met and overcome, and the world not only survived─it flourished. This victory we owe to those who persevered alongside us; to those who explored and nurtured and loved this realm as much as we.
...Yes, it is you of whom I speak. Of our indomitable adventurers.
Ten years is a long time, yes, but for me the number holds no special significance. It is simply a count of the passage of days.
Success, however, would not have come without that accumulation of daily effort, and that is what makes it a milestone worth marking. Thank you for staying the course with us these many years.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_14: I will keep making plans for this world for the foreseeable future. It has become a part of my life, and to see it grow is an adventure in itself...
Rest well, Warrior of Light, for a grand convergence of events approaches. May the road upon which you must embark become the greatest of all journeys.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_144: And now I really must head home to write that article. You have my gratitude, ─I would still be floundering in the street without your assistance. Until we meet again!
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: A great many lives were lost in the flames of the Calamity, not to mention the chaos which followed. Yet it is the survivors who must face the challenges of living in this new era we have salvaged. To you, the champion in the vanguard of our efforts, I dedicate these verses...

Scarred by the falling of fiery stars, the land is reborn with new life.♪
God-slayer struck by an echoing roar, heavens ring with the promise of strife.♪

Beast and man, both, seek freedom or death in bloody inferno untamed.♪
By unbroken hopes, from a sky long undimmed shall the darkness of eld be reclaimed.♪

A merciless gale, an unending road, if this be the path we are fated,♪
Then pray be our dawn in the rift betwixt worlds, your soul's splendid light unabated.♪
I really must apologize for pressing you into service for my potpourri scheme. I tend to consider adventurers as fellow wanderers, and call upon the assistance of your kind with little reservation.
...As for the gifts themselves, there was another reason as to why I chose the Nymeia lily. Traditionally, the bloom is said to represent a prayer for safe passage.
The way ahead yet promises more hardship, and I wanted, at the very least, to wish you─all of you─the smoothest road for the coming journey.
TEXT_FESANV701_04091_SYSTEM_000_152: You have unlocked the jigsaw puzzle mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_LUCKSA321_04094_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR: Blade . Might I have a word?

Your valiant efforts on the battlefield continue to prove an ideal to which all of our soldiers aspire. After conferring with my superiors, they asked that you be made privy to the Resistance's highest accolades.
They are decorations awarded only to our most valiant soldiers, blessed to grant their wearers protection from those who would bring ruin to Bozja.
Few are those who possess the mettle to qualify for evaluation, but we believe you, Blade , may be worthy of this most prestigious of honors.
Players who are awarded Resistance honors will be granted increased attributes when undertaking duties in Save the Queen content.
A large amount of mettle must be amassed to be rewarded Resistance honors. Furthermore, it should be noted that no rewards other than an increase to attributes will be granted.
TEXT_LUCKSA321_04094_Q1_000_100: Submit to evaluation for Resistance honors?
TEXT_LUCKSA321_04094_RESISTANCECOUNCILOR: Very good. We shall be observing your exploits in the field with great interest, Blade .
When you believe yourself ready to receive of our honors, come and speak with me, and I will evaluate your performance accordingly.
You have unlocked Resistance honors. There are three types of honors, each of which increases various character attributes.

To receive Resistance honors, you must first amass sufficient mettle and speak with the Resistance councilor to receive proofs of mettle. These may then be exchanged for honors of your choosing. You can speak with the Resistance councilor at any time to learn more about Resistance honors.
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_000: Hmm... You strike me as someone who isn't afraid to get  hands dirty─and I don't mean that as a euphemism. Are you interested in a bit of good old-fashioned hard work?
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_001: ...But perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself. I am Grigge, one of Sharlayan's gleaners. It is our role to procure materials, samples, knowledge─all you can imagine, and more.
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_002: Naturally, 'twould be difficult for any one person to comb the world each time our countrymen ask something of us. Thus did we form a guildship, the better to share information and see the requests we receive to the hands of those best suited to fulfilling them.
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_003: Some requests, for instance, are better assigned to those who demonstrate a certain degree of finesse and persistence...and the calluses upon your hands tell me that you are one such person.
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_004: I understand that you may feel some trepidation, given the...er, somewhat lax selection process. As you like as not suspect, the Forum would never officially recognize a traveler from another nation as a gleaner.
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_005: ...Unofficially, however, we're up to our necks in requests as of late, and they're coming in faster than ever before. We'll take any talent we can get─and pay good coin for it─so please, tell me you're interested!
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_SYSTEM_000_006: You may now undertake gleaner leves by speaking with Grigge.
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_GRIGGE_000_010: Sharlayan or no, we are in dire need of skilled help right now...
TEXT_AKTKYR101_04170_SYSTEM_000_011: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 80 or above.
TEXT_AKTKYR102_04171_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: <gasp> Who should stand before me but the savior of the very star─the inimitable ender of the end! Your deeds are sung of far and wide, my friend!
As I understand it, your quest for the world's salvation brought you to Sharlayan. I, too, am here on a quest of sorts─the quest for musical inspiration.
Alas, magnificent though this repository of knowledge may be, I find there is only so much inspiration I can derive from tomes...
But where tomes alone fail to inspire, living words may yet spark the imagination!
So I beg you, will you not regale me with the tale of your quest to deliver the star? If such an adventure isn't fit to be an epic, I would not know what is!
Drawing upon both your firsthand account and the knowledge I attain here, I believe that I shall be able to weave the most marvelous of verses!
Should you be willing, pray let me know. I shall continue my research here in the meantime.
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_BABETHIRONHEART_000: Beg pardon, good . I could scarce help but notice that sightseeing log on your person. You wouldn't happen to be the adventurer my niece wrote about...would you?
...Aha! So it is you. Pleased to make your acquaintance. I am Babeth Ironheart, Millith's aunt and seasoned explorer.
Be a dear and hand me that log of yours. Millith told me all about how she helped you embark on explorations of your own, so it's only right that I share with you some wisdom of my own.
Let me see here... Oh, I can't forget to mention that... And done!
You should be all set, dear. I've jotted down everything I've heard about the most remarkable vistas the realm has to offer.

Of course, a few notes I've shared are naught more than rumors─some describing locales so fantastical that I can barely believe they exist. But as I always say, the true joy of exploration lies not in the destination, but in the journey.
So go forth, dear, and see what sort of journey these hints take you on. That sightseeing log of yours won't fill itself, you know!
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_SYSTEM_000_007: Endwalker entries have been added to your sightseeing log!
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_SYSTEM_000_008: You must be level 80 or above to record Endwalker vistas. Travel to the location indicated and fulfill the necessary conditions and you will complete the entry for that vista, earning experience points in the process.
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_SYSTEM_100_008: The newly added locations in your sightseeing log will be marked by an orb of light. Should you spot such an orb during your adventures, take a moment to stop and record the entry.
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_SYSTEM_000_009: Use your wits and the notes provided by Babeth to identify these stunning sights and the proper way to appreciate them, and see Thavnair, Sharlayan, and beyond as only the greatest explorers have seen them!
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_BABETHIRONHEART_100: Beg pardon, good , but you are an adventurer, are you not? Hmmm... Though perhaps one ill-suited for the exploration I have in mind.
TEXT_AKTKYR105_04174_SYSTEM_100_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must have at least one class or job at level 80 or above.
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_000: Oho! You must be . Mistress Rowena's told me all about you. Says you're quite the renowned !
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_001: The name's Ofpilona, by the way. The mistress's charged me with managing her Radz-at-Han branch. Lookin' forward to doin' business with you!
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_002: ...Which isn't to say I've got anythin' special to ask of you. All I mean is that your business is just as welcome here as it is at any other House of Splendors.
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_003: O' course, I'd certainly prefer you do more of your business here than anywhere else. Esteemed clients like yourself'll attract even more customers, y'see.
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_004: And if we keep drawin' in business at a good clip, before long we'll have to rebrand as Ofpilona's House of Splendors... That old witch won't know what hit 'er...
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_005: ...Er, don't you worry about that last part. Just peruse our wares and buy somethin' if it strikes your fancy!
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_OFPILONA_000_010: <sigh> What I wouldn't give to find an expert artisan...
TEXT_AKTKYR106_04175_SYSTEM_000_011: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 80 or above.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_000: 'Tis the season of ardor and affection, and romance is thick upon the air! I, Lisette of House Valentione, entreat you, dearest one, to breathe deep and take love's richness─its cloying, rosy radiance─into your bosom!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_001: Hold now a moment, traveler. This face... Yes, I know it well! You are love's humblest servant. Ardor and adoration's foremost champion! Ah, what a delight it is to see you once again, and in such bless'd times as these.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_002: Alas! Every rose has its thorns, and even this fairest of seasons is not without its trials. Indeed─trouble is afoot, and it threatens the hearts of all in this realm!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_003: Do you recall a moogle by the name of Kupka Kupp? Self-styled “munificent maestro of the myriad matters of the heart”? Heart-shaped pom? Ring any bells? Ah, excellent, for these woes we speak of are, specifically, his.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_004: A fellow of ours, a moogle well-versed in the myriad matters of the heart, has found himself in quite the quagmire! The sweet thing of which we speak goes by the name of Kupka Kupp, and is an emissary of penned passions and all such billets-doux.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_005: Valentione's Day is a joyous occasion, but not always so for those who acquit themselves as postmoogles of the realm. Kupka Kupp has his poor paws full delivering heartwarming missives far and wide, hither and thither. Though he would never admit it, I fear he's at wits' end.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_006: But you, benevolent adventurer that you are, can provide precisely what our hirsute herald requires oh-so desperately! Pray, lend Kupka Kupp your talents and retrieve him from the edge whereupon his wits now teeter so precariously!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A1_000_001: A working adventurer is a happy adventurer!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_007: Marvelous! You are a hero through and through. Kupka Kupp will be so relieved. I shall fetch him at once!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_008: Why, could it be...? So it is! ! Returned again this year to aid us in another Valentione's Day celebration, have you? Once an emissary of love, always an emissary of love, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_009: Ah! Why, yours is a face I know well. No introduction necessary, friends, for so renowned are you that I feel as if I have known you all my life. My postmoogle compatriots speak of your derring-do almost nightly, kupo. How they will bristle into puff balls when I tell them we are acquainted!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_010: Now then, I hear from Astrid that you would help me in my hour of need, for which I am most grateful. However, it is not the work itself that vexes me, but rather a colleague of mine─a clueless courier newly inducted into our vocation.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_011: Every Valentione's Day we emissaries are overtaxed, and this season has proven no exception. I had hoped to nip this issue in the bud by petitioning the deputy postmoogle for a helping paw or two. He obliged, but has sent someone altogether worthless...an undisciplined tyro!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_012: To make matters worse, the daft thing is painfully ignorant in the ways of the heart. You should hear the way she speaks to the clientele─“What an ugly gift. Love must be blind,” and such nonsense. Left to her own devices, I fear she will ruin Valentione's Day, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_013: “Give the girl the axe,” you cry! The impulse is very much with me, I assure you, but I can't rightly turn away the very assistance for which I begged. I would come across as the most wretched ingrate to ever have wings. Yet I haven't the time to train her, let alone the patience!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_014: Fret not, our harried herald! You are right to have sought our help, for I have come upon the cleverest of solutions to your predicament. We shall enlist the help of our doughty adventurer and House Valentione's very own Astrid to accompany said callous courier.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_015: You cannot be surprised at my suggestion. 'Tis a most natural fit! , so skilled in so many subjects, will teach your assistant the delicate art of the post, while Astrid shall instruct the moogle in the ways of ardor and adoration. There! A splendid plan if I do say so myself.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_016: Are you both sure you are up for the task? It isn't too great a bother?
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_017: What a seasonable relief indeed, kupo! I shall bring her to you at once, for there is not a moment to lose!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_018: May I introduce to you my fledgling postmoogle charge, Pukty Piko, and her loyal chocobo, erm... Oh dear, this is rather awkward. I confess your friend's name has slipped my mind, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_019: Salutations one and all! As for my chocobo, his name can't have slipped your mind─because he hasn't one. I refer to him simply as “my partner dear,” or when I'm feeling particularly silly, “bird.”
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_100_019: Many an acquaintance of mine has attempted to provide him a name or two, but none of them ever stick. Or should I say, I always forget them? In any case, you may call him whatever you like. It makes no difference, least of all to him.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_021: Y-Yes, well, be that as it may, I have tasked Pukty Piko with three deliveries, all of which I would ask you to join her on.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_022: These two are to accompany me? Very well. Who am I to turn away...whoever you are. Our first stop is the Carpenters' Guild─bird and I shall await you there.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_023: How fortunate Pukty Piko is to be joined by emissaries such as you and Astrid. For what better pair than you and she to teach a poor, benighted postmoogle the ways of ardor and affection─the pathways of the heart and soul!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_024: I've my own deliveries to attend to, I'm afraid, and cannot see this through to its conclusion. Know that all my thoughts and prayers go with you, though. Best of luck, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_025: Let's see how Pukty Piko acquits herself. Surely she can't be so terrible as Kupka described.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_030: Oh, the recipient is out on an errand or some such. A pity. As for the parcel, well...since no one is available to take it, I say we just leave it any old place. There are other assignments to be getting on with, after all.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_031: I say, now hold there a moment! I am no postmoogle, granted, but merely abandoning a package like this before a door seems a touch disrespectful, does it not? What we have here is a gift, an item crafted with love and care! It deserves to be treated as such. Who is this from, exactly?
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_032: A young woman, if memory serves. Daughter to the man meant to receive this. Oh yes, and there was something about her training at the Culinarians' Guild, I think? My memory is hazy.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A2_000_001: We ought to make the delivery in person.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A2_000_002: We wouldn't want anyone to steal the parcel.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_033: Hmmm, you make an interesting point.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_034: The man is out on an errand, yes? And since he is with the Carpenters' Guild, it stands to reason he is out collecting lumber, and from the Botanists' Guild like as not. We shall start our search there, for a Valentione's Day gift must be delivered straight into the recipient's hands.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_035: I believe we have found the man to whom the package was intended.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_040: A delivery for you, sir. You weren't at the guild when we came calling, so we took the liberty of tracking you down.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSA04465_000: All right, give it here, then. ...Oh, what's all this? Valentione's Day chocolate? Now this is a surprise.

My daughter's an apprentice in the Culinarians' Guild, you see. I'd heard she'd been selected to make the chocolates for the festivities this year, but I certainly didn't expect to receive any myself!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_043: And how wonderful that you did! It is not every day one's daughter is accorded the honor of crafting such a beloved confectionery. She must be quite the culinarian.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSA04465_000: That she is. My pride and joy, that girl. What a pleasant surprise this package was. Certainly made my day! I can't thank you enough for bringing it all the way out to me like you have. I'll never forget this kindness.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_045: Goodness... Seems like a bit of an overreaction to being handed some food, doesn't it?
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A3_000_001: He appreciated that we delivered it with care.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A3_000_002: That's what savvy postmoogles call “customer satisfaction, kupo”!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_046: Agreed. There is a lesson to be learned here, Pukty. Joy is not meant to be kept to oneself─it is a feeling that yearns to be shared. And we played a part in bringing him happiness, so it is little wonder that he wished to share his felicity with us.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_047: So, joy is meant to be shared? Hmmm... Well, when you put it that way, I suppose that's not so foreign a concept. When something makes me smile or laugh, I do tend to talk my companion's ear off about it, and I'm often made the happier for it!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_049: But enough about that─time is wasting! Best be off on our next delivery. The recipient awaits at the Whistling Miller, by the looks of it.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_050: I'm slightly concerned for our fair recipient. She appears to be in a state.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSB04465_000: I wonder...how are you doing, wherever you are? I wish I could hear of your travels, your adventures. It's been ages since I last had word from you.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_055: Pardon me, but I've a delivery for you, ma'am.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSB04465_000: For me? Oh, it's from one of my dearest companions. And look what they've sent. Pink seashells! Are they not extraordinary? Look at their vibrancy. Ah, and a card. “Happy Valentione's Day.” How delightful.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_057: Shells? Empty ones? You can't even eat those. At least the other fellow received chocolate...
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_058: P-Pukty! That is abominably rude! You must forgive our friend here. She is not accustomed to deliveries such as these.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSB04465_000: There's nothing to forgive, I assure you. I could hardly be upset after receiving a gift like this, and from a loved one I've not seen in quite some time.

My friend, you see, is an adventurer in their own right. They enjoy being cryptic, though, and never outright tell me where they have been. Rather, they make me guess by dropping hints in the form of curiosities such as these.
What a blessing this parcel is. I was only just wondering how they were faring and where their journeys had brought them. Thank you, Ms. Postmoogle. You have brightened my day!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_062: Love is a mystery, indeed. And a funny one at that.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_063: It is my pleasure to tell you, Pukty, that love is a many-splendored thing, and we each have our own unique way of expressing it. The friendship between that girl and her adventurer companion is a perfect example. That gift, which appeared mere frippery to you, was a treasure in her eyes!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A4_000_001: It's important for adventurers to check in with their loved ones.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A4_000_002: Perhaps her friend is in La Noscea.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_A3_000_003: Perhaps her friend is traveling the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_064: It is oft said that no news is good news, but I very much doubt that to be the case for those in your line of work.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_065: I suspect you may be right. Outside of a few specialty traders, seashells of that quality and color cannot be easily found in the landlocked regions of the realm, after all.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_066: So you mean to say...this was her friend's way of telling that young woman that all is well? Their way of assuaging any worries she might be harboring about their safety? Hmmm, how fascinating.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_067: To be sure, were I to be separated from my bird here by expansive seas or vast mountain ranges, I'd like to hear from him, from time to time.
