Perhaps not every day. That would be irksome. But...to know that he's in good health would be not altogether disagreeable, I suppose.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_068: Anywho, no sense in losing ourselves in thought, not when a parcel sits burning a hole in my satchel, kupo! Our next delivery takes us to Apkallu Falls. Let's away!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_069: This will be our third and final delivery of the day. Goodness, I don't know how these moogles do it!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSC04465_000: Really, they ought to be here by now. Don't tell me my gift has fallen afoul of bandits on its journey here!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_075: Greetings, sir. I have for you here a parcel from one of Ul'dah's preeminent art dealers, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_RESIDENTSC04465_000: At last! Her earrings, they've arrived! ...Goodness gracious. How stunning they are. This craftsmanship, this meticulous attention to detail! I couldn't have hoped for a better present for my wife. She'll be over the moon to receive them.

Her birthday is coming up, you see, and I wanted to ensure her special day is just that. I've even given Kupka Kupp's pom a vigorous pat─I hear tell that one touch is enough to bring a couple happiness for all their years to come. Let us hope so!

You did well to bring these all the way out here without a scratch on them, you know. I'd begun to worry that by the time I received them, the poor things would be nothing more than scuffed, dented rocks. You've got a bright future ahead of you in the postal service, friend. Thank you.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_079: Now this is odd. There's a flutter in my chest. A tickle in my stomach, kupo! Have I taken ill...or do compliments and words of gratitude always elicit this sort of response?
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_080: Trust me when I say you are not ill, Pukty. That flutter you feel, those ticklish sensations you described? That is fondness─a form of love, indeed─and it was made manifest by that man's appreciation for what you provided.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_081: Oh, so this love nonsense─why, it isn't nonsense at all, is it! It's quite wonderful, actually! I liken it to...that feeling when my bird and I settle down for an afternoon nap in the Twelveswood! When I tuck myself under his wing and we are warmed by the sunlight breaking through the trees.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_082: Perhaps you haven't mastered the concept entirely, but I do believe we are making strides in the right direction! You certainly seem more attuned to the ways of the heart than when we first made your acquaintance, at any rate.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_083: Now that all three parcels have reached the right hands, let us return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. No doubt Kupka Kupp is anxious to know how Pukty fared.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_LISETTE_000_084: Ah, our emissaries of ardor and affection are returned to us. I trust all is well in the hearts of the realm? Does the language of love still elude our perplexed postmoogle?
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_0085: Though I can't say for certain, I believe I'm beginning to understand why everyone is always nattering on and on about this “love” business. Its  mysteries are a little less, well, mysterious!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_086: Let us inform Kupka Kupp of our efforts. I am sure he is on pins and needles!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_090: Here they are, our agents of affection! Our heralds of the heart! Returned at last, and not before time, kupo! Tell me, how went your deliveries?
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_ASTRID_000_092: Splendid, each and every one. The recipients were all thrilled to receive their parcels, and I'm pleased to say that Pukty Piko learned something along the way.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_PUKTYPIKO_000_093: Yes, I do believe I did. Love is...well, it's quite a bit more complicated than I first imagined it to be. There are hidden depths to it, ones I didn't see before. I may not be an expert on the subject yet, but I would like to think my ignorance is not quite as dire as it once was.
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_094: You are making progress, certainly! I am glad of it. And just so long as you did not offend anyone, I could not ask for more. Anywho, I am indebted to you, Astrid, . You have spared at least three citizens of the realm from potential cruelty, however unintended it may have been!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_095: No, I am being too harsh. Pukty, you have shown a true, concerted effort to understand the labyrinthian complexities of the heart. And as a reward, I am inclined to set to you another task!
TEXT_FESVLT801_04465_KUPUKAKOPP_000_096: For in truth, your work is not yet finished. Much more is there to be done this Valentione's Day, kupo! When you've the time, speak with me again, and I shall tell you all about it.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_100_000: I do believe I'm beginning to understand this whole...ardor and affection business.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_000: There you are! And not a moment too soon. Your unwavering devotion to the ways of ardor and affection, love and romance, courtship and intimacy is both commendable and deeply appreciated.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_001: So, to the task of which I spoke. It involves a woman by the name of Aloyse, who only just posted a parcel with no small amount of urgency.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_002: However, she then returned, begging us to call off its delivery. A highly unusual request, and her eyes─twin pools of sorrow, kupo! She fled straightaway, ere I could even get my bearings, let alone ask what troubles her so. Will you help me seek her out?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_003: You are too kind! Now, as for this young woman: she is an Elezen of great beauty, and thus should not be an easy one to overlook. Last I saw of her, she had just made a sharp left at the fork in the road, unless my eyes deceive me.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_004: To the left, you say? That way lies the Greatloam Growery, if I'm not mistaken. I will accompany you there, Kupka Kupp.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_005: , Pukty Piko─you two will look near Nophica's Altar. Should you come upon her before we do, come find us at the Growery.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_006: Farewell, adventurer! Do not tarry, for the poor heartsick girl is in need of succor only you and yours can provide!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_007: Oh bother, kupo! There is neither hide nor hair of Aloyse here.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_008: Dear me, not a sign of anyone matching the description Kupka Kupp provided us.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_009: This woman here. Could this be Aloyse? I'm not much of an aesthete, but I know an Elezen when I see one!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_010: Who, me? ...Yes, I am Aloyse. Why do you ask?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_011: Kupka Kupp wants to see me, you say? But whatever for?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_012: He's beside himself with worry, kupo! He told us you turned tail and darted off looking dreadfully stricken─downright morose! You can understand his concern, surely.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_013: I see... I owe him an apology for worrying him as I have─and an explanation for my frantic flight as well! Kupka's still at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, correct? I'll go to him at once.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_014: Actually, he─ Never mind, she's already gone. I suppose I shall go and fetch him then, shall I? Meet us at the amphitheatre, , and do hurry─we wouldn't want her dashing off again.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_015: Such a look of heartbreak as ne'er I've seen on a woman. There must be something we can do for her.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_016: How fortunate you were to have come across her with such ease! In retrospect, I realize my description was rather subjective.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_017: Let us speak to Aloyse, find out what upsets her so.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_018: We had better at least get another epiphany about love for our troubles.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_020: First, let me start by saying how grateful I am that you would think to come and check on me.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_021: The truth of the matter is, I've received an offer of marriage. I meant to accept, which is why I came to you initially, Kupka, to see that my reply would be delivered safely.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_022: However, as I was writing to tell him “yes,” I found myself hesitating more than I ought to have been. I began to wonder if I was making a terrible decision, not only for me, but for him as well.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_023: The man who seeks my hand is of Ishgardian nobility and goes by the name Ezolmile. At the moment, he is...well, he is quite ill, and is seeking treatment here, in Gridania.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_024: Do not misunderstand me─I was overjoyed to hear of his devotion! A life spent with him would be a wonderful thing. But I'm no noble. I'm of the most common stock, no more special than a weed underfoot. I wasn't raised with the aristocratic manners a future wife of his requires.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_025: Who am I to marry into nobility? I must destroy my previous missive and pen a new letter, one telling him I can't go through with it...but that one I'll hand deliver. I won't have an emissary of love delivering such ill tidings.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_026: Now, I don't pretend to be an expert in the ways of the heart... But isn't love the desire to be with someone, forever and on? The desire for a trusted partner in this world, someone with whom you can share your joys and your woes?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_027: If you care for him, be with him! Wouldn't it upset you to do anything but? It certainly seems to have. I may not have much experience with this, but I know that were I and my chocobo to be separated, I wouldn't like it─not one bit. I don't believe giving up is the solution, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_028: Verily, I myself am of Ishgardian nobility and can thus speak from a place of authority. Each of our houses has its own traditions─it is our titles that connect us, not our principles. Before making your decision, seek the counsel of your beloved and learn what his family values.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_029: I could not agree more. After all, it is doubts you harbor, not a lack of affection. If you believe his heart to be yours entire, then trust that he will listen to your troubles─that you and he can solve them together! Why not send one more letter, explain what it is that vexes you?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_030: Yes, I see your point. It's unfair of me to hide my feelings like this. He's owed my honesty. But...how does one even write such a letter? I wouldn't know where to begin.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_031: Perhaps you should explain your apprehension about fulfilling your duties as wife to a man of a great house. Make it clear that, should you decide to join his social milieu, you will require time to study, learn, and train before you are comfortable.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_032: A word of warning, though! To compromise the very woman you are in order to bend to the rigors of nobility may leave you jaded, haggard, and altogether infuriated. Thus, I suggest you first inquire as to whether his family is capable of accepting you as you are.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_033: Why not simply write down all your worries? I don't fancy myself a poet of passions or what have you, but there's something to be said for getting everything out in the open.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_034: All of these ideas have a great deal of merit, and each should be given due consideration. , what say you? Which of these notions has struck a chord with you?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_A1_000_001: Ask for help adapting to his lifestyle.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_A2_000_002: Make clear that you won't compromise who you are.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_A2_000_003: Tell him exactly what concerns you.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_035: Thank you for your insight, everyone. I believe I know what I must do now.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_036: Then let us fetch you parchment, quill, and ink. Fortunate that you have us, you know, for we emissaries are never far from instruments of the post. Why, I shall even provide you with Valentione's Day-themed stationery.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_037: There, it's done. Now all that's left is for him to read it.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_038: My darling is likely in the Gentry's Ward. I know he enjoys sitting in solitude on a bench not far from the gates. He'll be there like as not.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_039: Then that's where we shall try first. We will be back with his response as soon as we are able!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_040: Tally ho, bird! Love's work awaits!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_042: Will this be a day of rapturous reconciliations, or of doleful dissolutions? Either way, we are ardor and affection's most faithful agents, and have a duty to see this through to its conclusion.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_043: I am a touch anxious to see how all this unfolds. Keep your tissues close at hand. We may yet be consoling a very distraught woman...
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_045: Oh dear... I'm so fidgety, I just can't sit still for nerves!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_046: No, I can't take this any longer. I refuse to stand idly by while my future is decided without me!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_047: That does it. I'm going to the Gentry's Ward this instant!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_048: Aloyse, you can't─ Aaand she's gone.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_049: Our duty as emissaries of love and affection demands we see that lovelorn lass through this trying time. I shall meet you at the gates of the Gentry's Ward!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_050: That man there must be Ezolmile, the well-to-do beau of whom Aloyse spoke.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_051: , you are good to come, but leave us postmoogles to our work!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_052: Oh goodness, my tummy's wound itself into one huge knot, kupo! I must be more nervous than I thought.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_055: I'm sorry to have run off again like that, but I just couldn't wait around twiddling my thumbs another moment more!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_056: We have for you a letter from one Ms. Aloyse herself, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_057: A missive? From my love? Thank you kindly, postmoogles.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_058: Perhaps it's not my place, but if I may...
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_059: Aloyse thinks a great deal of you. We watched her as she wrote that letter you now hold, and we could see plain as day how much she cares for you. If there's love to be found in this world, it's there, in every word she has put to that page.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_060: The heart and its intricacies aren't my forte, I admit, but if you've even half as much affection for her as she has for you, then what you two share is something wondrous. I only hope you can both weather whatever troubles come your way.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_061: “The heart isn't my forte,” indeed! For one who claims such a thing, you show remarkable perspicacity in the matter! You are quite changed from the moogle I once knew. Color me impressed, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_062: You are good to concern yourselves over my and Aloyse's affairs. Your kindness does you a good deal of credit.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_063: I shall pen my response this instant. Can I trust that you will deliver it straight to her once I've finished?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_064: We serve at your pleasure. Your trust is not misplaced in us, good sir!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_065: Did you hear that? He's going to reply! We should return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre at once. I don't want to be here when he's sent our postmoogle friends all the way back there!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_066: Yes, it would be rather awkward were his letter to have no recipient. Let us explain the situation to Lisette and wait for Pukty and Kupka's delivery.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_067: Fret not! We can oversee the delivery of Ezolmile's missive ourselves. All you need do is wait patiently with the others.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_068: I'm curious to see his reply. Not that I'm the one receiving the letter, or reading it for that matter... Goodness, it's none of my business at all, is it!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_069: I ought to have parchment and quill around here somewhere.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_000_070: Let us hope this all ends with tears of joy, rather than sorrow.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_071: I hope they return soon. Maybe I'm being silly, but I'm rather nervous to see what my darling has to say.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_075: Our eminent emissary of adoration and affection is with us once more! And now that we are assembled, we've only to wait for the custodians of Ezolmile's reply.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_076: I feel sick to my stomach. What if I've angered him? What if he calls off the whole engagement?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_080: We have returned! And with your beloved's painstakingly penned post in paw.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_081: I was wise to take your advice, Astrid.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_082: He thanks me for taking into consideration his position in life, but says that I needn't overly concern myself. His family is, as he puts it, “below the salt.” And though they're as well-heeled as any other house of their standing, they're not nearly so fusty.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_083: He says that there's no need to live a life I'm unaccustomed to, but that if I wish to learn more about his lineage and the social circle his family occupies, then he would do so with me. Isn't that thoughtful?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_084: I took your words to heart, Lisette, and I'm glad that I did.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_085: He writes me to say that he adores me for the woman I am, and that he would never push me to be anything less. He tells me I have a quality that is all my own, one that no other could ever hold a candle to, which is why he fell head over heels for me in the first place!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_086: His life here is a good one, one he's come to enjoy. So much so that he's even considering moving to Gridania permanently! I suppose there really isn't any need to worry about joining the upper crust, is there?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_087: Pukty Piko, I was drawn to your advice in particular.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_088: I wrote down all my worries, concerns, and questions in a clear and concise fashion, and he responded with...well, with some confusion, it seems. Although now, at least, he's aware of what troubles me, and for that he says he is grateful.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_089: He's very sweet here, you see. He tells me that together we will go down this list of mine and solve one problem at a time. Where we live and how will be up to us to decide─not his family.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_090: I have come to ensure my letter has reached you, and see if you have yet read it. After all, you did the same for me. It would be unkind to not return the favor, no?
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_091: Oh gods...how embarrassing! You caught me spying on you, didn't you!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_092: You're embarrassed? For what, pray? I found it endearing, my darling. Ah, these companions of yours, did they assist you in your writing to me? Then we are in your debt.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_EZOLMILE_000_093: Aloyse, my love. What say you to tea at the Carline Canopy? There, we can discuss our future─a conversation which is long overdue, I should think.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ALOYSE_000_094: Thank you, my friends. Where would I be without your help? And I promise, yours will be the first invitations we post once we've settled on a day.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_095: Goodness gracious me! Do mine eyes deceive me!? Pukty Piko! Y-Your pom!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_096: Why, it's adopted the very shape of the season, and is lovely beyond compare, kupo! And 'tis much of a muchness with mine, or so I flatter myself to think.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_097: I can't rightly explain it, but seeing those two together brought a flutter to my chest, a spring to my wings, and the next thing I knew, my pom began to tingle in the most peculiar of ways!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_098: It's just such a marvelous thing to know that we had a hand in ushering Ezolmile and Aloyse's story into its next chapter. And to think, it was all performed strictly through the art of the post!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_099: Affectionate missives are more than just the silly folderol I assumed them to be. I see now that they show what's in our hearts like nothing else can. And we emissaries are their trusted custodians!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_ASTRID_100_099: That we are, Pukty. Only do remember that letters require more than just love─they are also in need of names and addresses. And speaking of names, perhaps you might bestow one upon a certain chocobo? Think of it as a show of not only kindness, but of love, too.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_100_100: A show of love, you say? I suppose you're right. I was never able to recall the names given by my moogle acquaintances, but I bet I could arrive at something that actually sticks. I will give it some thought, make sure I've done this bird justice.
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_KUPUKAKOPP_000_101: My once-foolish fledgling has wings of her own at last. How proud I am to see you soar! You are a credit to the emissaries of ardor and affection with your heart-shaped pom. It is my most sincere honor to have you among our ranks and I pray that you will continue this most revered work!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_PUKTYPIKO_000_102: I would love nothing more, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT802_04466_LISETTE_000_103: What joy to be bless'd with so many couriers, and in this season of sublimity no less! 'Tis heartening indeed to watch our numbers grow and grow, for with so many, we can ensure that ardor and affection accompany all the fair creatures of this realm where'er their journeys take them!♪
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_000: ! I knew you would come. You've a marvelously convenient talent for appearing when we're in need, don't you? Anywho, trouble's afoot! Word has spread of our previous endeavors, which under normal circumstances would be cause for celebration, but not so today.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_001: We've been inundated with letters from across the realm, entreating our aid with all manner of vexations. Our fellows have left me here alone to field these pleas, but I can't see to all this by myself! Please, won't you assist me in bringing succor to the hearts of the weary?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_002: I've made a tidy little list of those who have written to us. No need to see to their troubles in any particular order, mind you. Just, try not to let a request slip through the cracks, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_003: Back again, I see! The heavy-hearted of the realm will rest easy knowing that you're on the case! Now then, which of these distraught Eorzeans will you assist this time?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_Q1_000_000: Whose dilemma will you see to?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A1_000_004: The one who dreams of the wider world.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_010: You would see to what plagues my heart? You are far too goodly, . I confess that Aloyse's joyful union touched me in a way most unexpected─it sparked within me jealousy, of all things! For in her happiness, I saw reflected my own desires.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_011: Yes, 'tis true! I am here to speak of my own beloved. The man with whom I wish to spend all my days and nights! The very gentleman to whom I am betrothed: one Ser Hortefense!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_012: The festivities have run us both off our feet, leaving us not a spare moment to while away together as we once did. It vexes me terribly, yet I cannot speak of it to him. I would flush like a schoolgirl and tie my tongue into knots! Instead, I mean to pour my woes onto parchment.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_013: Oh, this explains a great deal! At first I couldn't understand what was upsetting you so, but now it's all clear as crystal to me. Right then, on to this letter! First, what style should she write it in?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A2_000_001: Fill it with prolix paragraphs and poems, as is her wont.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_014: And how should she word her vexations?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_015: There! 'Tis done. For better or worse, the missive is penned.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_016: And all that remains is its delivery, which I will attend to right away!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_017: Goodness me... No sooner had Ser Hortefense read your letter than he made a beeline for the nearest door to race to your side, Lisette! It was all I could do to keep him from stampeding through the streets. A small miracle he had the presence of mind to even hold a pen.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_018: ...It says he has been fretting over the same things as I have! In which case, why not come to me sooner? Honestly! He also writes that we shall sit down for a proper meal once Valentione's Day has come and gone, so I suppose there's no sense in holding it over his head... Although I ought to!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_019: Ahem. Well! That settles my affairs, I should say. My deepest, most sincere gratitude for your help, . You've conducted yourself with the diligence and sagacity befitting an emissary of affection. Now go forth and bestow your romantic wisdom upon those in need!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_020: “Why do you dance around the issue at hand? Be plain with me or I will never understand”... Heavens, perhaps it would have been wiser to be more forthcoming about my issues.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_LISETTE_000_021: Well, irrespective of this noncommittal answer I've received, I am grateful to you for advising me in this matter.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ADVENTURER04467_000: We of the Adventurers' Guild seek to post a letter to our guildmaster, Mother Miounne.
Though we're yet an untrained and unblooded passel of adventurers, it still grieves us tremendously to admit that we sought her aid in a task we bungled not several nights gone.

We fear this blunder of ours will lower us in her estimation so abominably that we may never work again. We are determined to set this all to rights, but the question is how? What words will move Mother Miounne so that she will not see us as the lumbering dolts who stepped in it?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_028: Oh, that is a pickle! Count yourself lucky, though, for you're in the presence of a renowned adventurer, one who most assuredly understands well the problem you face. So, ? What advice can you impart to our flustered friends?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A4_000_001: Show contrition and gratitude in equal measure.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A4_000_002: Tell her that, barring this gaffe, you're sensational adventurers.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_029: And what would convince this Mother Miounne to provide them with more work?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A5_000_001: That failure is a novice's best learning tool.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A5_000_002: That you would do anything to make up for your previous mishap.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_031: Then I shall see to its safe and expedient delivery!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_032: Pardon my tardiness. Miounne was kind enough to set out tea for me, and I could hardly refuse such an offer. It warmed my heart, to see such munificence! And, now that I reflect on it, such hospitality too is one form of love, isn't it. But I digress, what does Miounne write?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ADVENTURER04467_000: What a relief it is to read this! She has seen how steadfast our convictions to the guild are. By hook or by crook, we shall not disappoint her! I, for one, am afire with determination!
Your advice has rung true indeed. Thank you for your wisdom. We shan't forget it!

Though she commends us on our ambition and zeal, she worries that we put our lives at risk by attempting tasks which exceed our abilities. I cannot deny the truth of what she says. Well, I'm decided─“circumspection” shall be our watchword going forward!
You were wise to advise us as you did. I thank you for your help.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_040: Fancy seeing you here! And fancier still that you are the one to assist me. My conundrum is that, as ever, my brother and I are concerned for Kan-E's well-being. We thought to write her, but I know not what to say, and A-Ruhn has lifted not a digit to help.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_041: I would ask her to be mindful of her health, but does that not sound rather...fussy? Even more so when couched in “dearest sisters” and formal prose! Though I suppose Kan-E is both formal and fussy herself...
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_100_041: What is more, I haven't much practice in the ways of penning properly worded missives. My sister is, as I mentioned, a touch on the fussy side, and holds manners and decorum in high regard. Little doubt that she will read my words with a rather critical eye.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_042: You speak of Kan-E-Senna, the Elder Seedseer? She is revered among our kind! To think I will soon be delivering a letter to her...what an honor! But enough about me─we're here for Raya-O-Senna! , how do you think she should go about this?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A6_000_001: No need to stand on ceremony─be frank about your concern!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A6_000_002: Show that you're serious by observing proper letter-writing etiquette.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_043: Very well, but who should we say this letter is from? Raya-O-Senna may be the one composing it, but it was both her and her brother who meant to ask after her well-being. Hmmm... What are your thoughts?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A7_000_001: It should be from the person who wrote it.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A7_000_002: It should be from both her and her brother.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_044: There, I have finished. Might I entrust its delivery to you?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_045: Why of course! And away I go, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_046: The Elder Seedseer is a wonderful woman, as many have said. She saw how nervous I was and put me at my ease immediately! Your sister is lovely indeed.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_047: I am glad to hear it. Let us see how she replies. Hm... She applauds me for the maturity I show in writing her, and says that as an older sister, she could not be more proud. What a curious response! I ask her to watch her health, and she commends me on my maturity?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_048: Strange as this answer is, it seems our words of worry have gotten through to her, thankfully. Though I was initially reluctant, I am glad we wrote her. My heart is lighter knowing she is well. Your assistance in these family matters is much appreciated.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_049: And I am glad to hear it. Now let's see how she replies. Oh, this is not what I expected to receive. Though she acknowledges our concern for her health, she prattles on about this, that, and the other thing, lecturing me all the while about “proper postal decorum”...
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_RAYAOSENNA_000_050: Oh well. 'Twas a worthy attempt. While I had hoped for a different response, I am grateful for your help all the same. If you will excuse me.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_055: Good , ! It's lovely to see you again after all this time. I want you to know that I've been keeping to your advice, and am training day in and day out. I'm hopeful that soon I'll be able to take to the open road!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_056: Greetings, . My name's Elyne, and it is an honor to meet one such as yourself. For you see, I've dreams of becoming an adventurer too. Oh, to think of all that you have seen, all the lands you have walked... How incredible!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_057: But as for why I'm here today, well...I want to write a letter to Kupka Kupp, to thank him for his support. Whenever I feel low, like I want to give up on my dream of seeing the world, Kupka is there for me to lift my spirits.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_058: A message for Kupka Kupp, hm? So, ? How do you think she should start it?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A8_000_001: Thank him for all his encouragement.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A8_000_002: Urge him to take time for himself during this busy season.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_059: And how should she finish the letter?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A9_000_001: Remind him not to overwork himself.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A9_000_002: Support him in his endeavors as he supports you in yours.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_060: I've taken your words to heart. I only hope this letter is enough to show Kupka how much he means to me.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_061: I'll make sure it reaches the right hands! Or paws, rather.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_062: If only you could have seen the look on Kupka's face when I told him who had written him. He couldn't stop twirling through the air! It was adorable, but don't tell him I said that. He was so touched, he managed to find time between his many deliveries to craft a reply, which I have here.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_063: He really was happy to receive my letter, wasn't he! He tells me he can feel my gratitude and love for him in every word I wrote. As wonderful as it is to talk with him in person, correspondence like this can be rather fun, too.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_064: I'm more motivated than ever to continue my training now. Thank you so much for the advice on my letter, . And thank you, Pukty Piko, for delivering it to Kupka!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_065: Oh, he writes me to apologize, saying that he never meant to cause me worry. An apology is the last thing I wanted from him. I think he might have misunderstood the intentions of my letter.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_ELYNE_000_066: Well, we'll speak soon enough and I'll straighten all this out. Thank you for taking the time to help me, . Farewell!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_070: Hm? I didn't even notice this letter until just now, kupo! It must have slipped into my stack right under my nose─which is something of an astonishment, actually, as its wonderful scent is hard to miss! Let's see, who is it for... Oh! Why, it's addressed to you, !
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_FEOUL_000_071: (-Faerie King's Letter-)I know very well the fun you're having right now─without me! Considering your tendency to be cold and cruel and heartless, it wouldn't surprise me in the least if I were to learn you've forgotten all about me.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_FEOUL_000_072: (-Faerie King's Letter-)Why, oh why must I be the one writing you!? Your beautiful branch is deserving of much more attention than you deem fit to provide! How mean and terrible and rude you are, sapling!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_073: Oh my, aren't they a─ Ahem, sprightly one. I don't know who sent this to you, suffice it to say that whoever it is will be very displeased if they don't receive a response. Perhaps it's best to pen one now, while you're here. So, who shall we make your letter out to?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A10_000_001: Dearest Titania, fair ruler of the fae!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A10_000_002: To my beautiful branch, Feo Ul!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_074: And how will you express your adoration for them?
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A11_000_001: Attach flowers and chocolate to your letter.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_A11_000_002: Remind them that they are always in your heart.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_SYSTEM_000_075: Having groveled sufficiently onto the parchment, you seal your letter to the faerie king.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_076: Now then, wait here while I... Oh my! The letter, it seems to be delivering itself, kupo! Stop. Stop, I say! Don't make me come after you! Oh bother... Wait for me, you silly thing. Wait for meee!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_077: Despite my best efforts to keep up, I lost the blasted thing somewhere out in the Twelveswood! Then, as if this story needed to be any more peculiar, I discovered a similarly scented missive on the road back─and wouldn't you know, it's addressed to you!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_FEOUL_000_078: (-Faerie King's Letter-)I just knew my sweet little sapling could suss out who I was from the clues I planted in my letter! Your affection for me was writ so plainly in your last correspondence, I shall return it here, in kind. How could I do less!
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_FEOUL_000_079: (-Faerie King's Letter-)My precious sapling, wherever your travels may take you, wherever the roads you walk lead, know that my heart goes with you. Every step of every path, be they through dungeons dank and dark or to mountain peaks magnificent, I am there, watching over you, always and forever.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_FEOUL_000_080: (-Faerie King's Letter-)Sweetest sapling, I am positively delighted to receive a message from you. Of that much, I can assure you.
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_FEOUL_000_081: (-Faerie King's Letter-)And only that much. For as far as the contents of your letter are concerned, I am less than pleased. No, I am putting it too lightly. I am so far from pleased that I find myself incensed. Wrathful. Furious! You, sapling, should show your lovely branch the affection I so rightly deserve...
TEXT_FESVLT803_04467_PUKTYPIKO_000_085: Your assistance has proven positively indispensable, ! If you've the time and inclination, do come by again. There is always more to be done, after all!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Greetings! Always a pleasure to meet a strapping adventurer like yourself. I'm Amh Garanjy, head celebrant in charge of the Starlight Celebration, and you've come at just the right time to assist me in preparing for the festivities! That is why you're here, isn't it?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Well, if it isn't my favorite adventurer! I hope you haven't forgotten about me since we last met. You'll be lending a hand with the festivities again this year, won't you? Because I could certainly use your help.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_003: You see, I have something of a beast problem. Nothing dangerous, I assure you! But it's not exactly my area of expertise, and I imagine a seasoned veteran such as yourself─with all your experience dealing with Eorzea's more exotic fauna─would be better suited for the task.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_006: This little fellow is Rudy. At least, that's what I've been calling him. He appeared all of a sudden as I was making my usual preparations, and now he doesn't seem to want to leave.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_007: I was wary at first, but he hasn't tried to cause any trouble. I daresay he's even better behaved than some of my little helpers! I've grown so fond of him, I just couldn't resist making him a little costume. Doesn't he look adorable in it?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_009: The only problem is that it's as if he's trying to tell me something. It seems terribly important to him, but for the life of me I can't figure out what it might be. I don't suppose there's anything you might be able to do to help, is there?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_011: Forgive me. I know I'm asking the nigh impossible. After all, it's not as if an adventurer like yourself has the ability to commune with beasts. Oh, whatever am I to do...?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_012: (-???-)It looks like you could use some help, my dear.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_013: What!? Did... Did that squirrel just speak?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_A1_000_001: By the Twelve! A talking squirrel!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_015: (-Talking Squirrel-)Ah, the reactions never fail to amuse. Yes, I can understand and speak your language just fine. For you see, I am what is known as an auspice─a beast proficient in the tongues of man. If you have traveled to the Far East, you may have encountered others of my kind.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_016: (-Talking Squirrel-)Oho! So you are familiar with my kind. Excellent. It will allow me to forgo all the tedious explanations.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_017: But allow me to introduce myself. I am Rissai, a wanderer who goes wherever duty, sentiment, and the sweet smell of delectable desserts take me!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_018: A meeting with an old friend is what called me to Eorzea, but your festivities piqued my interest. I couldn't help but overhear your conversation, and it struck me that I might be of service.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_019: With Rudy? You can understand him!?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_020: I would be a sad excuse for an auspice if I could not. So allow me to provide some enlightenment: it seems your furry little friend would entreat a favor of you.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_021: To wit, he is troubled by the fact that he's a bit of a runt compared to his brothers. They hardly even treat him like a real yeti, making fun of him for the tiny snowballs he makes.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_022: Snowballs? Indeed, I heard that yetis incapacitate and capture their prey by blowing frosty balls of snow and ice.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RUDOLPH_000_023: Yip... Yip yip yip yip yip yip yip! Yip yip! Yip!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_024: Your friend would politely point out that this is not true of all yetis. Rudy and his kin live peacefully deep in the mountains, a far cry from the savage beasts that roam Coerthas. They vie for supremacy amongst themselves not through violence, but by competing to see who can build the biggest snowballs.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_025: Rudy was practicing making snowballs in secret to prove himself when he fell from a small precipice and got himself lost. He wandered the forest aimlessly for days, and had just about given up all hope when a white-haired fellow found and rescued him.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_026: The kindly fellow in question was none other than the Saint of Nymeia, he says. Saved our poor Rudy before gallivanting off to the Starlight Celebration. Rudy, alas, didn't even get a chance to thank him. So now he wishes to find the saint and properly express his gratitude.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_027: What a touching story. Truly, a Starlight miracle! And I do very much wish I could help, but...
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_028: I'm sorry, Rudy. I fear I haven't a clue where the saint is right now. He never sticks to one place for too long, you see. Always busy delivering gifts to children the realm over.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_A2_000_001: Just be a good boy and the saint is bound to take notice.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_A2_000_002: The best way to show thanks would be to pay his kindness forward.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_031: That's right! You can be one of his little helpers and help bring joy to all the young ones for the Starlight Celebration! Why, if you're lucky, you might even be able to meet him again!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_033: Rudy says he would be happy to help─as, for that matter, would I. At the very least, I can avail you as an interpreter. You'll be lending a hand, too, won't you?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_034: I understand that this is all rather sudden, but please tell me you'll agree. I'm sure it would mean the world to Rudy!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_035: Splendid! Now, let us come up with a plan for getting this little one involved in the festivities.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_040: I leave Rudy in your capable hands. I do wish I could go with you, but my duties as head celebrant prevent me from leaving my post for too long.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_050: I thank you again for your aid. Now, there must be something special Rudy can do for the children this Starlight season, but what could that be? Might you have any ideas?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_052: What's that you say? The snowballs you make are so tiny that no one would ever want them? Do not be so hard on yourself, my little friend!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_053: Clearly, your talents simply lie elsewhere, and it is our job to help you find them. Perhaps you could join the choir, for example. Can you sing? Let's hear it!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_055: Thank you, Rudy. That was most...unique. Unfortunately, perhaps it's not the best fit for singing Starlight carols...
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_056: There must be something we can do. I would hear your thoughts, adventurer.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_A3_000_001: We could compose a carol to better suit his voice.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_A3_000_002: He could make snowballs for the snowball fight.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_A3_000_003: Snowball-themed gifts should do the trick.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_058: We could, yes. And yet, I do believe the season will be far more joyful and mellifluous if we do not.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_059: That is a possibility, yes. But the children rather enjoy making snowballs themselves. I am not convinced that taking the task away from them would bring them much joy.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_060: Snowball-themed gifts! Why, by the gods, I think you might be on to something!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_061: That reminds me... What do you think of these, pray tell? I picked them up in Ul'dah. They're some kind of traditional confection, but they look rather snowball-ish, don't they? Perhaps we could make something similar for the festival-goers to nibble on!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_063: That's right, Rudy! This is your chance to prove yourself once and for all! You're going to make the loveliest, most scrumptious snowball treats any yeti ever has! And we'll be with you every step of the way. You just need to have faith in yourself!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_065: Well, if it's sweets we're making, I know just the person to help─Mother Miounne at the Carline Canopy. I'm staying in a room there, and I must say I've found her confections to be second to none. Shall we, then?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_070: Mother Miounne! There is something my friends and I would discuss with you.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_071: Quite the motley bunch, I see. What is it that brings you all here?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_072: I see... In that case, you've come at the perfect time. I believe I know a way this might work in both of our favors.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_073: I'm in the midst of preparing Starlight gift boxes for the children at Bentbranch Meadows. Exotic snow-themed sweets would be a most welcome addition.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_074: Then furnish you with said sweets we shall! Er, that is, once we figure out precisely how we're going to make them...
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_075: You leave that to me. I'll have a working recipe for you before you know it. In the meantime, might I ask you to pick up some of the ingredients we'll need in advance? I'll put it all on my tab, so you can simply pick everything up and bring it back here.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_076: It would be our pleasure! And don't you worry, Rudy─our adventurer friend and I will handle the transactions.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_078: You'd do the shopping all by yourself, you say?  need only stand back and watch? If you insist...
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_079: What an eager little helper your friend is! Here, I've made a list of everything we need. Simply show this to the shopkeeps and they'll take care of you.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_080: The flour you can procure at the Whistling Miller, and the oil at the Botanists' Guild. Do try to stay warm out there, okay?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_081: And with that, let us be off! First stop: the Whistling Miller. With us, Rudy!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_090: So Rudy hands over this list of ingredients from Miounne, and the shopkeeper gives us what we need free of charge. This should be simple enough.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_WHISTLINGMILLERCLER: Is that...a baby yeti? And why is it dressed as one of the Saint of Nymeia's helpers?
A letter from Mother Miounne? Let's see here...
Ah, now I see! You're running an errand for the Carline Canopy. Well, I can certainly help with that. Give me just a moment and I'll fetch you your flour.
Here you are! This should be enough to last Miounne for a while. Don't work yourself too hard, now!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_107: Well, would you look at that! It would seem our friend Rudy is a natural at this. I daresay it couldn't have gone any smoother if we did it ourselves.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_108: Now, to the Botanists' Guild for some oil. Off we go!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_WHISTLINGMILLERCLER: That little yeti is a friend of yours, I take it? In either event, please send Mother Miounne my regards.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_120: All we need now is the frying oil. With any luck, it'll go as smoothly as the last time.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_125: Am I going daft, or did I just see a baby yeti dressed as one of the saint's little helpers looking this way?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_131: Ack! Begone, foul beast! Back to the forest with you!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_133: Oh dear. It seems our little friend is in something of a pickle.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_134: We could go to his aid...but let us wait a bit still. It would give the lad more confidence were he able to overcome the predicament himself.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_135: It won't leave... Oh, what to do? I'd rather not involve the Wood Wailers...
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_137: Hm? A note? Could it be that you're here on an errand of sorts?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_138: Well, I'll be! Cooking ingredients for Miounne? And here I thought you some savage beast who'd wandered in here to cause trouble. If frying oil is all you need, I'd be happy to oblige. Just a moment.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_139: Careful, now─it's heavy. And do take care on your way back to the Canopy, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_141: Well, would you look at that! Rudy managed fine on his own after all. And now that we have everything we need, let's head back to the Carline Canopy and get all this to Mother Miounne.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_SANDRE_000_145: A baby yeti on a shopping errand... Yes, I do believe I've seen everything. Give my best to Miounne, will you?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_150: He had us worried for a minute, but Rudy did a fine job. Why, we may as well not have been there at all!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_161: Good to see you back safe and sound! And just look at how well you performed your errand! You really are a wonderful little helper.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_162: And with that, we have everything we need to make sweet Starlight treats for the children. It'll take me a little while to prepare, so how about a cup of piping hot tea while you wait?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_163: That would be splendid, Mother Miounne! Though I daresay it might make me crave for a little something sweet to go with it.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_166: Amazing! I expected nothing less from you, Miounne. Truly, your confections are simply to die for!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_167: You flatter me, Rissai. Incidentally, you might be interested to hear that this is a traditional dessert called “schneeballs”─named after an old Hellsguard word meaning snowball. A perfect fit for a yeti, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_168: Oho! So it was no mere coincidence that they look like little snowballs!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_170: You know, Rudy... You shouldn't let yourself be discouraged by what your siblings might say to you. There's no shame in being different from everyone else.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_171: After all, just look at me! I'm hardly like all the other squirrels out there, and do I let it bother me? Not at all! We should be proud of what sets us apart from others, not ashamed.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_173: Once we finish making these, my gift boxes will be ready for delivery to Bentbranch Meadows. Speaking of which, would you like to help in handing them out? There's no better reward for hard work than watching the children's faces light up with joy.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_174: Don't worry, you won't have to do all the work─I'll be asking the Starlight celebrants to assist as well. Well? What do you say?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_176: Rudy says he'd love to─and would most appreciate if you would join us. You'll do this for him, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_MIOUNNE_000_177: You have my thanks. We'll make a few more batches of these and pack them up into the gift boxes for you. Amh Garanjy will be able to tell you what to do from there.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_178: Duly noted. Thank you for everything, Miounne!
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_190: Miounne's sweets are positively divine! I simply must bring some back for my friends in the East.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RUDOLPH_000_195:
Yip yip yip!
Yip yip yip!♪
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_200: Welcome back! I trust that everything is well with our newest little helper?
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_201: Rudy and the two of you are helping Mother Miounne make snowball-shaped confections? What a splendid idea! The children will be delighted, I'm sure.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_202: Well done, Rudy. I'm so proud of how far you've come.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_RISSAI_000_204: We would also like to assist in the handing out of presents at Bentbranch Meadows, if we may.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_205: Of course! I wouldn't want you to miss out on the joy of delivering the goodies and seeing the children's smiling faces.
TEXT_FESXMS701_04468_AMHGARANJY_000_206: Please don't go anywhere just yet, . There's more I'd like to discuss before you set off to deliver gifts to the children.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_000: As one of the saint's little helpers, it's Rudy's job to bring presents to the children and put smiles on their faces. And it's our job to help him!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Well, I do believe it's time to deliver presents to the children. You're still willing to help out, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_002: It would be our pleasure─Rudy's most of all. And we'll be there to support him all along the way.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Excellent! On to business, then! My fellow celebrant, Baenfaeld, has been placed in charge of this task. Seek him out at Bentbranch Meadows, and he'll tell you everything you need to know.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Head over to Bentbranch Meadows and tell Baenfaeld I sent you. He'll tell you just how you can go about putting smiles on the children's faces.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_010: I say, does Rudy not look a bit distressed to you? Can't say I blame him, of course. Being one of the saint's helpers is a lot of pressure for a little yeti.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_020: 'Bout time ye showed up! Amh mentioned that ye might be helpin' out─an' believe me, we can use all the help we can get.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_021: Then you will have ours! My yeti friend Rudy, , and I, Rissai, are more than happy to aid.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_022: Though I must say, Mother Miounne truly outdid herself this time. Just look at all these presents! Might I suggest that we split the duties, that we might deliver them to the children in a more efficient manner?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_023: , why don't you take a batch and go with Rudy? Meanwhile, I'll get started from the opposite side.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RUDOLPH_000_024: Yip! Yip yip! Yip yip yip yip yip yip yip!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_025: Dear me. Rudy's so raring to go that it might be best to stand aside a bit and leave him to it. It would do wonders for his confidence, and I'm sure the children would delight in getting a gift from a seasonally fitting snow creature.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_030: These treats ye brought us are simply scrumptious! Bite-sized with a crispy crunch and jus' the right amount o' sweetness... Ye best keep an eye on me, or I'll eat the lot!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_HUNGRYGIRL04469_000: I'm hungry! I hope our presents come soon so we can go home and eat...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_TIMIDBOY04469_000_0: I want a present, too, but... That man standing in front of them looks like he could eat me.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_HUNGRYGIRL04469_000: A present? For us? Why, you must be one of the saint's little helpers!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SYSTEM_000_054: Rudy presents the gifts with as much of a flourish as his tiny arms can muster.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_HUNGRYGIRL04469_000: Wow, these look absolutely delicious! And I was just thinking about how hungry I was. Lucky me!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_TIMIDBOY04469_000_0: Are you sure these are safe to eat? I suppose they must be, or that adventurer would do something about it. Anyhow, thank you.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_HUNGRYGIRL04469_000: Thank you, fluffy little helper! We'll be sure not to eat them all at once!
These are so tasty! Better than anything my mum could make.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_TIMIDBOY04469_000_0: These little snowballs are so sweet and crunchy... Thank you, little helpers!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BOREDBOY04469_000_0: All I got for Starlight last year was a tattered, hand-me-down hat... Then again, I suppose I should be grateful I got anything at all.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_QUIETGIRL04469_000_: I wanted to go into the city to see the Saint of Nymeia, but Mother told me it's too dangerous to go alone. Doesn't she realize I'm not a baby anymore?
Wait! I think it's holding something... What have you got there, little friend?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_SYSTEM_000_085: Rudy presents the gifts with remarkable aplomb.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BOREDBOY04469_000_0: Snowballs made of sugar? I've never seen anything like these before.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_QUIETGIRL04469_000_: They look so good! And I'm going to tell all my friends I got them from the cutest saint's helper of them all!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BOREDBOY04469_000_0: They smell delicious. Thank you very much for the gift, little helper! And you, too,  Adventurer!
Those snowball sweets were so good!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_QUIETGIRL04469_000_: I can't believe I got to meet one of the saint's little helpers! And that he was so fluffy!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_100: Behold, Rudy! The children simply adore the gifts you gave them!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_110: Ye should be proud o' yerselves. Yer snowball sweets're the talk o' the town, and not just among the wee ones. Ye've brought us all a Starlight miracle this year!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_WOODWAILER04469_000: (-Man's Shout-)What the─!? Yetis! Yetis in the ranch! Take cover at once!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_113: What in the seven hells is goin' on?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_WOODWAILER04469_000: I...I know not from where, but a pair of most fearsome yetis just stormed through the gates!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_117: Hm? Oh. Oh dear. Yes, I see...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_118: Lend me your ears, friends. There is no need to panic. Our large friends here haven't come to attack us. These are simply Rudy's siblings, come to take their little brother home.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_119: Yer a lucky little yeti to have such good family worryin' after ye, Rudy. Er, even if they do look like they're about to pummel ye...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_120: I cannot deny that they are somewhat...disgruntled. They disprove of the fact that Rudy allowed himself to be “captured” so easily.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_121: Captured? Think he can't fend for himself, do they?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_A1_000_001: Tell them that's not what happened!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RUDOLPH_000_128: Yip! Yip yip yip! Yip! Yip! Yip!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_129: Well? What're they sayin'? Did they sort it out?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_130: Oh, I'd say! Our little friend Rudy corrected them in scathing terms.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_131: He told them of the delicious snowball treats we made together, and how the children's faces lit up when we gave them their presents. He further added that he may be small, but he's proud as can be of what he accomplished─and shan't let anyone belittle him any more!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_133: Say, Rudy. How about letting your brothers try your snowballs? A taste is worth a thousand words, after all.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_134: Aye, nothin' like sharin' tasty treats to bring a family together.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_136: Well, isn't that nice of them? Rudy's brothers just apologized for how they've treated Rudy all this time. They said they're proud to call him a brother, and that he is more than welcome to join in their snowball fights from now on!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_140: Rudy's brothers have finally accepted him for who he is. Turns out all he needed was a little help and support. Isn't that right, ?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_145: Perhaps little Rudy had even more support than we thought. Aye, it's the damnedest thing, but I just can't shake the feelin' that there's someone else watching over us...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_151: Rudy says that he intends to return with his brothers to their mountain home, and that he so very much enjoyed his time with us. He only wishes he could have properly thanked the Saint of Nymeia before he left...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_152: I wouldn't worry about that. Aye, I reckon the saint heard ye clear as can be. Look! This was sittin' by those tasty morsels ye made. It's a letter─from you know who.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_153:
(-Enigmatic Letter-)Dear Rudy,
Your delightful little snowball treats simply sparkled with festive Starlight spirit. I daresay you were the finest of all my helpers this season! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_154: Do you hear that, Rudy? It would seem the saint was watching you work the whole time!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RUDOLPH_000_156: Yip yip! Yip? Yip yip yip! Yip yip...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_157: Oh, Rudy... Of course we will miss you too.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_158: . Rudy says that were it not for us, he never would have realized what he was capable of, or found the confidence to stand up to his brothers.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_159: He says that everyone he met here was so incredibly kind that he was able to make the best snowballs he's ever made.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_160: And finally, he says thank you, , for making this such a miraculous, memorable experienceーone that he will cherish for the rest of his life!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_162: Fare thee well, Rudy! And promise that you'll come back to see your friends again someday, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_163: Back home ye go, then! Take care o' yerself out there.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_100_163: Aye, it'll be lonely here without the little guy...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_100_164: Worry not, my friends. Your paths may very well cross again someday. After all, we never know what fate has in store for us.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_164: And with that, we had best return and report to Amh Garanjy. I suspect she'll be thrilled, if sad to hear that Rudy has gone away home...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_BAENFAELD_000_165: Amh'll be overjoyed to hear of yer success. I'd go with ye, but as ye can see, I've got me hands full with gifts still...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_166: Go on, . Tell her everything that happened with Rudy.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_170: All done handing out presents, are you? Thank you very much! And good work, Ru─ Wait...where's Rudy gone off to?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_171: Home with his brothers? But I didn't get a chance to say goodbye! Oh, to ruffle his fluffy fur one last time...
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_172: You were quite fond of the little fellow, weren't you?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_173: Of course! Who wouldn't get attached to that adorably pouty little face?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_174: ...But if he's happy now, that's all that matters. Allow me to thank you both once more.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_175: Not just for your help with the festivities, but for everything you did for Rudy as well. You helped him find the confidence he needed to make his siblings accept him.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_176: Why, if Rudy's exploits don't fill you with the spirit of Starlight, I daresay nothing willーas a matter of fact, I myself am feeling more enthusiastic about the Celebration than ever!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_177: And as head celebrant, I will do all in my power to spread smiles and joy with as much passion as Rudy did!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_178: I, too, very much enjoyed the time we spent together. Truly, it was full of new experiences to look back upon fondly. Isn't that so, ?
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_179: Yet I fear the time has come for us to part ways. After all, I've lands to traverse, people to meet, and sweets to eat!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_RISSAI_000_180: I very much hope to see you again someday. And who is to say? Should you ever find yourself in a pinch with a beast again, I may very well appear to lend an ear. Farewell!
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_181: Thank you, truly. I know it isn't much, but please take this as a humble token of my appreciation.
TEXT_FESXMS702_04469_AMHGARANJY_000_182: And believe it or not, the saint himself has expressed an interest in meeting you. No doubt he wishes to thank you in person! Whenever you have a moment, pray say the word.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_006: Hmmmmmm! I am in need of inspiration, but wherever to find it...?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_007: Happy Starlight, my friend! I hope that you can join me for another inspiring journey! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Is it strange that I got so attached to Rudy in such a short time? Either way, I only hope we can meet him again someday!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Ah, but this is no time to get all sentimental! I have work to do. And remember, the Saint of Nymeia wishes to have a word with you, if you've the time to spare.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_100_002: He didn't mention exactly what he wants, but he was most insistent that you come alone. Whatever do you think it could be?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_000_003: The saint wishes to speak with you again. You will humor him, won't you?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_000_005: I know not what it is, but the saint has something he would discuss with you. If you're not otherwise occupied, pray pay him a visit.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_010: Ho ho ho! Thank you for joining me, my adventuring friend! As no doubt you know, I am the Saint of Nymeia, bringer of gifts and joy to children all across the realm! Amh Garanjy has told me all about your exploits this Starlight season, and I simply had to express my gratitude in person.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_011: Truth be told, I was observing you the whole time from a distance. Why, I almost wish that I could have joined you myself, but it is my policy to stay out of the spotlight─or the starlight, as it were.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_012: Besides, you and your furry friends were having such a jolly time that I couldn't bring myself to intrude. Watching Rudy help make those delightful snowball treats and grow into a confident little helper was a wonder to behold. A true Starlight miracle!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_013: Which brings me to my request. I was hoping you might inspire me the same way you did young Rudy. For you see─as much as it pains me to admit this─I find myself at a loss for new gift ideas this year.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_014: If you don't mind, I was hoping we might spend a little time together─just the two of us. What say you, friend?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_016: I just want a taste of that inspiration of yours! Yes, I'm sure some quality time with you is precisely what I need to rekindle my creative spirit.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_017: Ho ho ho! No need to look so alarmed! I won't ask much of you. I would simply have you accompany me on a little stroll.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_018: The decorations are most lovely, after all—why not take in the festive atmosphere together? We can amble about Old Gridania and make our way to Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_019: There are a few spots in particular I'd like to take in with you along the way. Just one would be plenty if you've other places to be, though if you can spare the time, I would love to see three! And with that, let us be off. Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_020: Back so soon? I had a feeling you couldn't bear to be away from the jolly old Saint of Nymeia for too long. Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_021: Ready? Then let us enjoy ourselves a most inspiring stroll!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_200_021: The Saint of Nymeia is now accompanying you. Lead him to the designated locations and speak with him there.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_130_021: You may choose from among six of the saint's desired destinations: Apkallu Falls, the Lancers' Guild, the Leatherworkers' Guild, the marketplace, the watermill, and the Greatloam Growery.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_100_021: Furthermore, you must stay close to your companion in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_150_021: You can leave the saint behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_120_021: If you wish to have the saint join you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_150_021: What a lovely season for a stroll! I'm sure you agree, yes? There's no better way to stimulate the senses─particularly when I'm joined by an inspiring presence like yours, my friend! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_160_021: Are you sure you wish to part ways with the saint?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_022: Oho! Such a lovely, tranquil place, yes? Just gazing out upon the dancing water gets my juices flowing!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_023: I am all but certain that inspiration will strike me any moment now! Yes, I can feel it coming... Almost there...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_026: I was certain I had something for a moment there, but it seems to have eluded me. No matter! My mind is now clear and ready to be filled with new ideas. I must say, spending time with you has been every bit as stimulating as I expected!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_027: Oho! So these are the barracks of the Wood Wailers! It's most inspiring to see everyone hard at work.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_028: Mayhap they would also be inspired to feast their eyes on my own muscles. Though they may be difficult to see through all these clothes...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_031: Ho ho ho ho ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_032: Impressive, are they not? You are free to feel them for yourself if the sight alone does not suffice.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_033: Bwahaha! Come now, my friend, there's no need to be shy.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_034: Ah, but nothing stimulates the mind more than moving one's body. I daresay I'm feeling more inspired by the moment!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_035: Oho! What a remarkable collection of most masterfully crafted leatherwork! I would expect nothing less from the home of the Fen-Yll brand.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_036: These would make marvelous gifts, indeed...though perhaps not for children.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_037: For one as cultured as you, however, I do believe this bag would be perfect. It complements your powerful silhouette most remarkably. What do you say? Might you have something in mind for me?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_038: Ah, but there are few greater pleasures in life than exchanging presents with friends and loved ones. Just imagining the delight in their eyes upon receiving the item you so carefully chose for them...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_039: This stroll truly has been most eye-opening. Doing this every year, one tends to fall into a bit of routine. Slowly but surely, you are helping me remember the true joys of the season.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_040: Why, I daresay I'm feeling as excited and motivated as I did during the inaugural Starlight Celebration! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_041: Ah, but of course! If the perfect gift is to be found, what better place to search for it than in a marketplace chock-full of the finest wares? By all means, let us have a look around!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_042: Out of curiosity, what manner of purchase is it that usually inspires you to come to these markets? Arms and armor, perhaps? Or foodstuffs? Something more ornamental? Do tell me if anything has caught your eye.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_A3_000_002: I buy materials from time to time.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_044: Oho! I see! Prefer to make things yourself, then? 'Tis another quality we share! After all, I am known as one of the realm's greatest goldsm─er, pardon me.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_045: That is to say, as the Saint of Nymeia, I take pride in personally handcrafting every single gift that I deliver!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_046: “Belts”...? Ah, yes! Those fabled objects that were said to have once held up many an adventurer's pantaloons! And yet, it is strange. When I try to recall what they looked like, I see them only in silhouette, as if they stood betwixt me and a blinding glare...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_047: Well, there are certainly plenty of wonderful items from which to draw inspiration! As always, your perspective has proved most enlightening, my friend.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_048: Oho! What a lovely spot, indeed. I must say, attuning my ears to the sound of the babbling river and spinning waterwheel instills me with a transcendent calm!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_050: That said, it is a bit chilly here at water's edge, is it not? Most fortunate that I'm layered up nice and warm.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_051: Why, I daresay I was even feeling a bit hot. Yes, a bit of a cool air might have been just what I needed for inspiration!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_052: Perhaps I could make a gift of garb and garments to keep out the chill of winter. Yes, that would be a fine idea! Why did I not think of this sooner?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_053: Oho! Such a magnificent tree! Clearly, it's been tended to with the greatest of care.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_054: You can feel the love that those who work here have for nature. A gentle tranquility permeates the very air around us.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_055: It's quite the departure from the bustling crowds that are the norm at most places I visit. Why, just the other day at the Gold Sau-er, um...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_056: The Gold...source! As in a mine of sorts. Yes, I'm so inspired I feel as if I have struck gold! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_057: But what treasures still await us? Onward we go!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_058: It would appear that the Saint of Nymeia has found some small measure of inspiration. You may make for Nophica's Altar if you are ready to end your stroll, or accompany him to other locations that you might inspire him further.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_100_058: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_110_058: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to access these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_059: The Saint of Nymeia is in need of further inspiration. If there are other destinations you believe might inspire him, accompany him there.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_060: It seems the Saint of Nymeia is sufficiently inspired. Accompany him to Nophica's Altar when you are ready to depart.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_061: It would appear that the Saint of Nymeia has found the inspiration he seeks. You may accompany him to Nophica's Altar once you are ready.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_062: Pressing matters require your attention? By all means, do not let me keep you! I will be attending to business in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, so pray seek me out when you are ready to resume our little stroll.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_063: There you are! I was starting to worry you wouldn't be coming back. Ready to resume our inspiring excursion?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_070: Ho ho! As all good things do, it would seem our little journey together has come to an end. And I can just feel the fire of inspiration coursing through me! Many thanks for the kindling, my friend.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_071: Now all that remains is to bring my ideas to life in the form of gifts for the children. Yes, I must be off to my workshop.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_072: That said, I very much enjoyed our little Starlight stroll together. I do hope you feel the same?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_074: Ho ho ho! My apologies if I got a bit carried away at times.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_075: As the Saint of Nymeia, I've vowed to devote my life to helping others. I believe the two of us are rather alike in that sense.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_076: And your exploits this season have reminded me anew of just what the Starlight spirit is all about. Anyone, be they man or beast, can bring joy and wonder to the world if they so choose.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_077: It's a wonderful thing, is it not? I must channel all this vim and vigor towards crafting new gifts for the children! Alas, I fear this means our time together is at an end...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_100_077: Ho ho ho! Don't tell me─you're curious about what I'll be making for them, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_110_077: Walking about town with you, I was struck by the calmness I felt looking at the streetscapes veiled in white, and the warmth that welled up in my heart in seeing the smiling faces of the townspeople.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_078: That's when it hit me─I could craft snow globes! Yes, little spheres of glass depicting the Starlight season here in Gridania! The children would enjoy that, don't you think?
