TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_079: And with that, I'd best get to work giving physical form to my ideas. Do send Amh Garanjy my regards. Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_080: Oho? Well, if you insist, perhaps I could linger just a bit longer...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_081: Say, did you know that skilled Hearers can attune their ears to the voices of the elementals?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_082: It got me thinking: do you suppose that on certain special occasions, we could hear them as well? I daresay if there's any time that we might, it would be during the Starlight season!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_083: Shall we try it, then? Close your eyes and open your ears. Come now, it'll be fun!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_100_083: You close your eyes and listen closely to the sounds of nature around you.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_100_084: Slowly but surely, the bustling noises of the city fade, and you can feel your mind clearing...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_086: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Did you hear anything? If there's anyone the elementals would speak to, undoubtedly it is you!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_087: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Yes, it's only a matter of time, now. I'm certain of it. Whatever you do, don't open your eyes!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_088: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Yes, just like that... Don't move. And no peeking!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_089: A warm hand caresses your cheek.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_091: ...You've got a little something on your face.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_092: Fret not, it's gone now! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_093: You keep your eyes tightly shut, and focus on the voices of the elementals.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_SYSTEM_000_095: You hear mumbling whispers, but cannot discern precisely what is being said...
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_097: Oh! I fear you've caught me. I was hoping the image of your resting face would provide for me the last jolt of inspiration, but alas, it seems you were wise to my ruse.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_098: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Hmm... It would appear laymen like us cannot hear the elementals after all. Still, our moment of quiet meditation has brought me clarity of mind! I know exactly how I will get started on this year's presents.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_099: Joining you for a brisk stroll through the snow-veiled forest has truly invigorated me. My head is finally clear enough for me to start working on gifts for the children.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_100_099: Ho ho ho! Don't tell me─you're curious about what I'll be making for them, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_110_099: Walking about town with you, I was struck by the calmness I felt looking at the streetscapes veiled in white, and the warmth that welled up in my heart in seeing the smiling faces of the townspeople.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_100: That's when it hit me─I could craft snow globes! Yes, little spheres of glass depicting the Starlight season here in Gridania! The children would enjoy that, don't you think?
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_101: And with that, I'd best be off. Do send Amh Garanjy my regards. Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_103: Ho ho ho! Happy Starlight to one and all! I hope you boys and girls are looking forward to your presents this year! That adventurer over there inspired me with a wonderful new ideaーI think you're all in for quite the surprise!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_000_110: The saint was beaming from ear to ear on his way out. You must have had quite the time together!
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_AMHGARANJY_000_111: But where's my head? He left this as a special Starlight gift just for you. Well, I do hope you enjoy the festivities! And if you're so inclined, do check back in with the saint before the season's over. I'm sure he'd be overjoyed to see you again.
TEXT_FESXMS703_04470_GODBERT_000_112: Ho ho ho! Both my body and soul are warmed up and ready to go!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_000: Yes, you'll do just splendidly... You there! Yes─you, dahling. What say you to becoming a first-place fashion icon?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_001: Ah, forgive me. Where are my manners? The name is Marabel, dahling, and I am one of Eshtaime's Aesthetics' finest accessory artisans...which is how I plan to introduce myself once I complete my apprenticeship.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_002: Now, the crown jewel of this year's Little Ladies' Day festivities is a walk-off: an event in which the visually savvy strut the stage and vie for style supremacy.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_003: And while I'm no novice when it comes to competitions of this sort, I'm also not much of a winner, dahling. To be perfectly honest, I've never once managed to come out on top─but now that you're here, I'm certain my fortunes are about to change!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_004: After all, an adventurer such as yourself possesses so much of what I lack: knowledge, daring, and not least of all experience! So, what say you? Care to help this diamond in the rough earn her maiden victory?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_005: Splendid, dahling! Oh, you won't regret this in the least.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_006: Pah! To think that I would enlist your aid without recompense. You and I will split our winnings right down the middle, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_007: Now then, let's get down to brass tacks, shall we?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_008: Participants compete in pairs of two: one designer and one model. There are no restrictions on who can join─style icons of all shapes and sizes may enter. The only condition is that those who walk the stage don an ensemble inspired by the holiday.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_009: But as far as themes go, it's a touch broad. Makes it rather difficult to decide on a direction for the costume... Perhaps you can offer some inspiration, though! Tell me, dahling: what's one word that comes to mind when you think of Little Ladies' Day?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_010: Interesting... I suppose that should come as no surprise, given that the origins of this holiday lie in the tale of gorgeous Princess Edvya's disappearance from the palace.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_011: And while I appreciate your input, dahling, I'm afraid that's a bit too on the nose. If I am to create a truly prize-worthy ensemble, I'll require more inspiration... Wait─we could survey the citizens!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_012:
Yes, yes, that's a fabulous idea, if I do say so myself.
Listen, dahling: you and I will ask around for people's impressions of Little Ladies' Day and then rendezvous at Eshtaime's. Savvy? Ta-ta for now!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZENA04471_000_0: What comes to mind when I think of Little Ladies' Day? Hm... I suppose this isn't exactly about the day itself, but it makes me think of the peach blossoms that always bloom this time of year.

Whenever I see those flowers, I know this season's come around once more. And there's something so soothing about their coloration. I can't help but smile when I lay my eyes on those pretty pink petals!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZENB04471_000_0: Ul'dah really comes alive this time of year. Why, just look at all the decorations strung up around town! And no one would dare miss the Songbirds' annual show. The entire city turns out to hear them sing!
No other festival compares to the Little Ladies' Day celebration─not for me, at least. I don't know if that answers your question, but I hope it helps!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZENC04471_000_0: I've always dreamt of strolling through the streets on Little Ladies' Day wearing the most gorgeous gown I can find─like a proper princess, you know?
Unfortunately, I don't have proper princess money, and that sort of dress usually costs a small fortune. No choice but to keep dreaming, I suppose...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZEND04471_000_0: My memories of Little Ladies' Day are somewhat bittersweet. You see, there was a lass I once fancied. All I wanted was to dote upon her like the royal seneschal would. I would've done anything to catch her eye...

And while I did catch her eye, she didn't exactly like what she saw: “No seneschal would be caught dead wearing that revealing subligar!” I guess acting like a royal seneschal isn't good enough unless you look like one, too...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZENA04471_000_0: Whenever I see those flowers, I know this season's come around once more. And there's something so soothing about their coloration. I can't help but smile when I lay my eyes on those pretty pink petals!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZENB04471_000_0: Ul'dah really comes alive this time of year. Why, just look at all the decorations strung up around town! And no one would dare miss the Songbirds' annual show. The entire city turns out to hear them sing!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZENC04471_000_0: Unfortunately, a proper princess dress usually costs a small fortune, and I don't have real princess money. No choice but to keep dreaming, I suppose...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_CITIZEND04471_000_0: I admit my outfit was a bit revealing, but I didn't realize that was such a bad thing... I guess acting like a royal seneschal doesn't mean much unless you look like one, too.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_050: Well, how did you fare, dahling? Glean anything insightful?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_051: ...I see. That more or less aligns with what I heard as well.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_052: So many folks had their dreams of fashion grandeur dashed by oppressively expensive pricing. Not a new tale by any stretch, but a troubling one nonetheless.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_053: In that case, what if we were to put together an ensemble that's as alluring as it is affordable? Surely that would resonate with the audience... Yes, I do believe this will work, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_054: Just allow me to take some visual measurements first... I'll need a few yards of this, a spool of that...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_055: All right─I'm ready to set to work! You just sit tight while I go assemble the ensemble. Ta-ta for now, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_060: I'm back, dahling! At last, our costume is complete─not a single stitch out of place.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_061: Now all that's left is to win that walk-off. How are you feeling? Surely an experienced adventurer of your caliber doesn't get nervous in situations such as these.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_062: Pah! Of course not, dahling. Why, you've doubtless traversed the whole realm. This little stage should be child's play for you, no?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_063: ...Hm? Don't be daft, dahling. You'll be walking.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_065: This whole time I thought we had a mutual understanding that you would be my muse, but that look on your face tells me you hadn't the slightest idea. It seems my excitement got the better of me once again...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_066: The trouble is, this costume is couture, dahling─tailor-made for your beautiful body. I hate to ask this of you at the last minute, but would you mind modeling my work in the walk-off!?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_A5_000_002: If it won't fit anyone else...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_069: I simply can't thank you enough─primarily because there's no time. I'll help you slip into your costume backstage, so just meet me at the venue and we'll go from there. Savvy?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_070: See you at the Steps of Nald─and don't dally! Ta-ta for now, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_080: There you are, dahling! Your time to shine is finally here. Are you ready to strut your stuff?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_100_080: Oh! By the way, I prepared two ensembles for you: one inspired by the seneschal, and another inspired by the princess. Either should fit you just fine, but do you have a preference?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_081: Fabulous! I'll apply a few finishing touches, then. You just get ready to command the stage, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_083: I bid you welcome, and thank you all for attending our Little Ladies' Day celebration.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_084: Before we commence with today's walk-off, pray permit me to introduce the members of our esteemed judging panel.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_100_085: First, we have the host of the Gold Saucer's Fashion Report, the style-savvy superstar with a discerning eye and a thorny tongue: Masked Rose!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_086: Next, we have the headmistress of the Goldsmiths' Guild, the unrivaled artisan of exceptional accessories: Serendipity!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_087: And lastly, as the resident master of ceremonies, yours truly shall round out the panel.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_088: The winners of today's walk-off shall be awarded this resplendent crown. Enticing, no?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_089: Now, then! Without further ado, let us welcome our first pair of contestants...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_090: You look positively fabulous, dahling! Oh, Marabel, you've done it again.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_091: It sounds like we're up next... This is it!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_092: ...Next, we have our eighth pair of contestants: , modeling an ensemble designed by Marabel.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_100_092: Are you ready, ? If so, then step forth onto the stage!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MASKEDROSE_000_093: Oho... That's quite the unconventional combination. Color me impressed!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_SERENDIPITY_000_094: Me, too! It's such an inspired take on the theme.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_095: I would like to thank you all for participating in today's walk-off. Each ensemble was a visual delight, which made this competition a joy to behold but a challenge to score─a fine problem to have, I should say.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_096: Yet after much deliberation, we have settled on our winning pair.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_097: First prize in this year's Little Ladies' Day walk-off goes to...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_099: Congratulations to you both! Please, step right this way.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_100_100: We've witnessed many elegant ensembles today, but Marabel's was not lost among them. The panel was particularly impressed with the materials used: appropriately gorgeous yet surprisingly affordable!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_100: If you don't mind, Marabel, pray permit me to ask how it feels to emerge victorious today!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_101: Oh, it feels...unreal... I can <sniff> barely believe it!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_102: Look at that: the poor girl is completely overcome with joy! And what about you, ? How do you feel?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_A7_000_001: I had a feeling we would win.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_103: Indeed! Your ensemble was worthy of not only approbation, but the grand prize as well! My sincerest congratulations to you both.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_104: Now, before we bring the contest to a close, I have one more announcement.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_105: This stage will remain in place for the duration of the Little Ladies' Day celebration.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_106: Those who were unable to participate in today's competition are free to ascend the stage at their leisure and walk to their hearts' content!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_107: Now then, let us conclude by giving one more round of applause to our first-place fashionistas: Marabel and !
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_120: We did it, dahling! We really did it!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_121: Part of me honestly believed my losing streak would never end, but you helped me prove myself wrong...
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_122: I couldn't have done it without you as my muse. I simply can't thank you enough, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_123: And I must thank you for the splendid showing!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_124: Congratulations once again, you two. As promised, I now present you with your prize.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_BUTLER_000_125: And with that, I shall take my leave.
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_126: Here I still thought I might be dreaming...but now that I look upon this crown before me, the reality of our victory is finally settling in!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_127: And while I may still be but an artisan's apprentice, today's success has rekindled my burning desire to someday launch a brand of my own─so remember my name, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_128: Oh! And speaking of style, you heard the royal seneschal say that the stage would remain open for the duration of the festival, yes?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_129: Well, it sounds as though Masked Rose will be holding a special Fashion Check for all those interested. You've already proven yourself a more-than-capable model, so why not try envisioning an ensemble for someone else this time?
TEXT_FESPDY701_04471_MARABEL_000_130: And don't worry: I'd be more than happy to lend you my expertise should you require any styling assistance!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_000: Oh, hello there, ! Don't tell me, dahling─has your turn on the stage given you fashion fever?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_001: Well, it just so happens that the Masked Rose will be holding a Fashion Check as part of the day's festivities! Of course, we'll require a model, but if you have someone in mind, do let me know!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_002: You do the scouting, and I'll do the sewing─it's as simple as that, dahling. Just let me know when you're ready to start the show!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_010: Well? Ready to embark on your maiden voyage as designer extraordinaire, dahling? We'll need a model, but did you have anyone in mind?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_Q1_000_000: Who will you ask to be your model?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_011: A fabulous choice, dahling! Well, let's not waste time: call them over so we can commence our styling session!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_020: Now, I presume you've some reason for summoning me here?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_021: ...You want me to what!? I had heard today's festivities would include heretofore unseen entertainment, but I certainly didn't imagine I would be providing it.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_022: While I'm no stranger to public performances, gladiator tournaments are a vastly different beast than...whatever this gorgeous affair is.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_023: I can't say I see myself as fit for the role, but if you insist, I have little choice but to acquiesce.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_024: So this is our lucky model-to-be! You certainly know how to pick them, dahling. Now, what did you have in mind as far as a concept is concerned?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_028: Say no more! I'll go prepare an ensemble for our model-to-be. You just sit tight and get ready to awe your audience!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_029: ...Oh, splendid! That fits like a glove. Now, go out there and knock them dead, dahling!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_BUTLER_000_030: Thank you kindly for your participation. And now, let us hear our judge's evaluation!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_031: Such passion... Why, I could feel your spirit bursting through the seams and spilling forth onto the stage!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_032: There has never been a foe too ferocious for the gladiators' guildmaster─and today, you've proven there is likewise no foe too fashionable. You've slain the competition!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_033: 'Twas quite a treat to see you reveal a softer side on this stage. Why, it simply set my heart aflutter!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_034: There is great beauty in the fluidity of your fighting, and your ensemble today serves to highlight that elegance. Splendidly done!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_035: 'Tis strange: a simple walk across the stage never rattled my nerves until today. Perhaps it's because I'm so accustomed to having an opponent to train my eyes upon. I felt rather aimless without someone to watch.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_036: That said, it was rather refreshing to don a different set of clothes for once. Can't say I'll do it again any time soon, but I shall cherish this experience all the same.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MYLLA_000_037: Perhaps I'll put a touch more care into choosing what I wear henceforth─and should I require any assistance to that end, I hope I can count on you both.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_041: If you're in need of ore, I'd be happy to put in a request with the guild on your behalf...
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_042: ...Did I mishear you, ? You wish to make a model of me!?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_043: Oh, my... Although I had planned on taking part in today's festivities, this certainly isn't what I had in mind.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_044: But you've piqued my curiosity. I've always been enamored of life on the stage, after all. Very well─I shall be your muse!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_052: I am by no means a miner, but were you and I to cross paths in a quarry somewhere, not even the brightest gleaming gem could draw my eye away from your beauty!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_053: Those shimmering stones should consider themselves lucky to be unearthed by a living, breathing treasure such as you.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_054: Your ensemble evokes an elegance that is often sought yet rarely found─a diamond hidden amongst the dust and darkness. You are a treasure to behold!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_055: Why, this must be how you miners feel when you uncover a precious stone. And to think that I would figuratively strike it rich on my first attempt!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_056: A miner like myself isn't often thrust into the spotlight─especially given how much time I spend underground─and I think I might prefer to keep it that way.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_057: But I must say the ensemble you picked out was quite charming! So charming, in fact, that I'm inclined to wear it home.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_ADALBERTA_000_058: This was quite the unforgettable experience, if unexpected. Thank you both again for the invitation!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_060: Well? If you've got business with me, then be quick about it: I don't want to miss the Songbirds!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_061: ...What's that, ? You want me to get up on that stage!?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_062: Hah hah hah! It seems the Holyfist's good looks aren't lost on you. Well, if you think I'm a knockout now, you should've seen me in my youth!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_063: Say, if my turn as a model goes well, I might even enjoy some renewed popularity with the ladies─just like in the olden days. Well? No time to waste. Let's hop to it!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_071: Th-This is...a most novel ensemble. It provides a playful youthfulness that belies your years.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_072: And while I cannot imagine enrobing myself with those raiments, I must say the power pouring forth from within you pulls that outfit together in a way others would envy.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_073: You must forgive me for underestimating you, but I certainly didn't expect you to take such a fashion-forward approach to your ensemble...
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_074: I must say, I'm quite impressed. Why, you may even have a future as a model for the Mythril Eye! I daresay men your age could take a few pointers from your stylish sensibilities.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_075: What a thrill! Did you see the way those lasses watched me? Why, their lustful gaze was so hot it nearly burned clean through my costume!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_076: Who would've thought a simple change of clothes was all it'd take to bring this old coot back to his lady-killing heyday?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_HAMON_000_077: At this rate, I might as well start calling myself “Handsomefist” instead! Hah hah hah!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_080: If you're looking to embark on an expedition, you'd best run it by the chief first...
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_081: <gasp> Y-You want me to model for you? No...I couldn't!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_082: Although...if everything goes well, and word gets around to her...
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_083: V-Very well! I've made up my mind: I'll do it! Dress me as you see fit!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_A5_000_001: Ditch the goggles, show the face!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_A5_000_002: Dress in brown, show some style!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_091: Oh, I could get lost in those big, round eyes... Even a single glance makes my heart skip a beat! You Lalafell boys are simply adorable.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_092: And your ensemble today only serves to highlight your inherent cuteness. Why, I can barely restrain myself from leaping out of my seat and squeezing you right now!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_093: This all-brown ensemble of yours is so chic! If a stylish mechanist like you tried to sell me the most expensive magitek device you own, I'd pay top gil for it without question.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_094: While I recognize that folk in your line of work are often forced into wearing the same uniform day in and day out, I encourage you to experiment a little when you're off the clock!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_095: Th-That was unbelievably terrifying! The sound of my heartbeat was thundering in my ears the entire time!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_096: Would I could have only heard the crowd cheering for me... But seeing their smiling faces was exhilarating in its own right!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_WEDGE_000_097: ...Although I think this proves I'm better suited to staying behind the scenes. I-If you require another model, might I suggest Biggs?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_GODBERT_000_100: Well, then. Fancy a spot of strength training, adventurer?
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_GODBERT_000_102: I say, it certainly isn't in my nature to get all dressed up─or very dressed at all! But a new experience could be elucidating... Very well─I'll do it!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_110: Your calm demeanor belies a formidable passion that only a man of your years can exude─a fine wine that I would give anything to imbibe.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_111: And although those sunglasses may cover your eyes, I can feel your gaze piercing straight through my heart. Everything about your ensemble is fabulous!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_112: M-My word... Muscles upon muscles, all chiseled to perfection...
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MASKEDROSE_000_113: You have exhibited great courage in sporting such an austere ensemble─and for that, I must both commend and thank you. I shall not forget your fantastic physique as long as I live!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_GODBERT_000_114: Ohohoho! What did you think, adventurer? Certainly not an ensemble I would've chosen for myself.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_GODBERT_000_115: But your unique sensibilities have provided me with just the inspiration I needed. Yes, I can feel the creative juices surging through my entire body!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_GODBERT_000_116: I'd best set to work on my next piece before this spark fades away. Farewell!
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_130: Well done, dahling! Your model seemed to have a splendid time─and I quite enjoyed providing couture counsel as well.
TEXT_FESPDY702_04472_MARABEL_000_131: If you stumble upon another model-in-the-making, just let me know. I'd be more than happy to offer additional styling assistance!
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_INVESTIGATOR04520_1: Ready to proceed with our investigation, are you? Excellent. Allow me to introduce you to our esteemed collaborator. This is Marke, a specialist in matters of the occult dispatched by the guild to assist in apprehending the nefarious Papa Gruff.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_114: A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_115: Before we go any further, I wish to ensure that I have a grasp on the situation as it stands. If it's quite all right with you, pray share all you have learned about our quarry thus far.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_116: I see...quite fascinating, indeed. Yes, it was all as I read in that tome...
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_117: Ah, my apologies. I tend to get lost in my own thoughts sometimes. Allow me to begin by giving you a brief introduction to the so-called “Night of Devilry”─or, at least, as I understand it.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_118: It is said that during All Saints' Wake, the saints are invited to banquets in the heavens each and every night.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_119: At such time, the world below is left unprotected, and fiends summoned by the ogre pumpkinhead are free to wreak havoc on the defenseless denizens. One fiend in particular is said to be especially boisterous...
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_120: Aye, I speak of the one known as the Doomsday Clown.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_121: ...Though, perhaps, you know him better as “the Scarlet Snout” or “Papa Gruff”. In any event, they are all the same most nefarious personage. If the texts are to be believed, those who set foot in his domain are fated never to return.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_INVESTIGATOR04520_1: I say, just listening to this tale is enough to make my hair stand on end. That said, it seems we've quite a task on our hands even attempting to save his would-be victims. Have we no way of protecting ourselves once inside his lair?
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_123: I thought you would never ask. Pray feast your eyes on these fine creations of mine.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_124: I present to you two artifacts I have recreated by referencing a number of ancient tomes─together with some of my own personal touches, of course. Behold the fiendish lantern and a phial of warding holy water.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_125: But what do they do? You must wonder. Well, allow me to explain! First of all, the fiendish lantern emits a certain wavelength of light that voidsent absolutely detest.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_126: As for the warding holy water, it not only protects the holder's soul from being stolen, but also enables one to rescue the lost souls of others and return them to their mortal frames.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_127: I have not yet had the opportunity to test them and thus cannot vouch for their effectiveness, but I am very much hoping that they will serve you well─for both our sakes.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_INVESTIGATOR04520_1: Wait, you mean there's no guarantee that—
Ah, but it matters not. We face a potential crisis here, and beggars cannot be choosers in times of need. My friend, are you willing to put your faith in Marke's creations and do what needs be done?
Excellent! In the meantime, I shall do my best to ensure that the Scarlet Snout is not able to lure anyone else into his trap.

Speaking of the Snout, I have also heard another rumor─apparently, he has been handing out odd pumpkin cookies to those who attend his feast. Should you come into possession of such a confection, might you show it to me when you return?
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_132: Splendid. Before you go, allow me to furnish you with a linkpearl. Rest assured that I shall do my damnedest to support you from afar after you enter the dread clown's personal domain.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_133: Also, should you wish to know aught more about the items with which I have furnished you, just say the word.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_INVESTIGATOR04520_1: I shall return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and see that no other frightening high jinks ensue. When you have found out what you would about the Snout, pray visit me there.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_100_135: How fascinating. Yes, most fascinating indeed...
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: Hm? Oh! It's you! My apologies, but I've not quite yet finished preparing for the festivities. Pray come back a bit later.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Ah, if it isn't my friend, ! Terribly sorry for the delay. Your timing couldn't be better─I'm pleased to report that I've finished preparing for the festivities.
Let my loyal harlequin guide know once you're ready, and he'll be more than happy to show you the way to the venue.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_003: You now have access to the Phantoms' Feast seasonal instance.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_004: To join the feast, speak with the harlequin guide under the Bentbranch Meadows bridge or in the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_005: The Phantoms' Feast is a light party instance (four players). There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_006: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members will be filled out automatically via the matching system.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARKE_000_010: Ah, is there something you'd like to know?
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_011: It is said that during All Saints' Wake, the saints are invited to banquets in the heavens each and every night.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_012: At such time, the world below is left unprotected, and fiends summoned by the ogre pumpkinhead are free to wreak havoc on the defenseless denizens. One fiend in particular is said to be especially boisterous...
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_013: Aye, I speak of the one known as the Doomsday Clown.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_014: ...Though, perhaps, you know him better as “the Scarlet Snout” or “Papa Gruff”. In any event, they are all the same most nefarious personage. If the texts are to be believed, those who set foot in his domain are fated never to return. How utterly terrifying!
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_015: This is why I fashioned my greatest creations: the fiendish lantern and the warding holy water. Inspired by what I gleaned from many an ancient tome, I have no doubt that they will serve you well in your quest to quash the Snout's nefarious plot.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_016: The fiendish lantern emits a wavelength of light that voidsent absolutely detest.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_017: Should you encounter any such fiends, pray put it to good use. I have no doubt it will serve you well.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_018: The warding holy water not only protects the holder's soul from being stolen, but also enables one to rescue the lost souls of others and return them to their mortal frames.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_MARK_000_019: I have afforded you with a full phial, so please do not hesitate to use it should you come across any souls in need of succor.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_INVESTIGATOR04520_0: Ah, there you are! Glad to see you returned from the spectral realm in one piece! I say, did Marke's inventions provide adequate aid?

Relieved I am to hear that! Small wonder the man came so highly recommended. And of course, I must thank you for risking life and limb to put them to use. Thanks to you, we can rest assured that the souls of the Gridanian people are safe from the fiend's trickery.
I am full glad to finally lay my eyes upon this rumored cookie as well. Oh, and just to be safe, I took the liberty of advising the other invitees not to attend the feast...for their own good.
I am concerned, however, that some of them did not seem so keen on heeding my instructions. Should you find any that have gone on ahead, pray save as many of them as you can.
Now that we know that Marke's creations can be relied upon, there is no reason to think we should not be able to rescue everyone from the Snout's clutches.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PIERROTCHILD_000_02: P-Papa! Wh-Where have all my new friends gone? <sob>
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: Don't worry, sweetheart. Father will sort this all out.
What the heck were those abominable trinkets, anyway!? And why did you not warn me that one of those despicable adventurers might crash our party!?
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Oh, my beloved! Pray calm your heart. That adventurer  was one thing, but rest assured that none of our ordinary guests will be equipped with such artifacts. We shall have our fun soon enough─believe you me!
What's more, I found someone who has volunteered to help us in our quest. They say the best approach is to just wander around the town shouting out invitations to anyone within earshot.
Why, just imagine how many guests they'll manage to lure here with such a bold approach!
Now, listen to me. Be sure to invite as many people as possible, all right? The more terror, the better, I say!
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PIERROTFAMILYSERVAN: Your wish is my command, Master Gruff!
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_PUMPKIN_000_035: Heh heh... This will be a fine All Saints' Wake, indeed. That said, I do wonder who this mysterious new acquaintance might be...?
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_INVESTIGATOR04520_0: Rest assured that I will be keeping close watch on the Scarlet Snout to make sure that his baleful plans never come to fruition.

I will see to it that none of his expected visitors attend his banquet. Then, when he comes out to ascertain what has gone amiss...we will strike with an expert team assembled by the Adventurers' Guild, putting an end to the villainy once and for all.
In the meantime, I ask that you pray go and rescue anyone the Snout has already managed to lure into his domain. That would doubtless encourage him to abandon his scheme even sooner.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_039: You can now attempt the Phantoms' Feast seasonal instance again by speaking with the harlequin guide in either Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_040: Successfully completing the instance will earn you a pumpkin cookie.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_041: You can exchange cookies for items and equipment by speaking with the shady smock in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLW702_04520_SYSTEM_000_042: You can also speak with the genial guiser, and join the marvelous masquerade in the Haunted Manor.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Ah, hello, hello! Just the adventurer I was looking for. Feeling the heat? Well, nothing like a good swim in Costa del Sol to cool down─and while you're there, you might as well enjoy the Moonfire festivities!
Hello there! You look to me like an adventurer who can enjoy a good festival when they see one. And if I may say so myself, the Moonfire Faire is the finest of them in all of Eorzea!
The faire has served to promote the Adventurers' Guild in recent years, and I expect plenty of folks'll join the fun this summer─no one will want to miss the exciting show we're putting on.
That's right─due to popular demand and the wishes of Master Gegeruju himself, we brought back the challenge!
Intrigued, aren't you? Sate your curiosity by speaking with Haermaga in Costa del Sol!
Look for Haermaga on the Isle of Endless Summer at Costa del Sol. He can tell you everything you need to know!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_010: Ah, , here at last! You're here to give the challenge a whirl, aren't you? That hulking monstrosity erected upon the shore...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_011: Welcome to the Moonfire Faire, fair adventurer! You're here to give the challenge a whirl, aren't you? That hulking monstrosity erected upon the shore...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_012: The imposing fortress that turns grown men into weeping babes, the crucible which forges the fiercest of warriors or spits out their mangled remains─aye, the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_100_012: We've had some issues here and there which prevented us from constructing the course anew for a time, but we made it work this year to satisfy the fierce demand from our patrons.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_013: It hasn't merely returned, however─oh no, it's been updated and refined with a new circuit. I daresay it's a course...reborn!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_014: While the new circuit isn't physically demanding, it's no less a spectacle. We recruited the finest Gold Saucer technicians and a certain bomb expert to craft so many bombs into the new attraction, it feels like a damned volcano's erupting when they go off!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_015: Aye, 'tis a trial that tests the resolve of fledgling and experienced adventurers alike, as all are forced to not only calculate the timing of the impending explosions, but avoid the shockwaves that follow them too. If you think you're up to the task, then by all means, show everyone how it's done!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_100_015: Heh, you look eager to try your hand at it despite all the risks. And yet I don't get the sense that you're underestimating the challenge before you either... <sigh> It would do the young lad good to see the temperament of a veteran like yourself. Would that he could learn from your example...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_016: Ah, it's nothing─just, this talk about the course in all its newfound glory brought to mind a certain worrisome adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_017: Look, you wouldn't mind lending me a hand with something, would you? When you're not busy running the course, naturally. Give me a shout after this if you're interested.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_020: You'll lend a hand then? You have my gratitude. The matter in question is in regards to a certain new...ah, I suppose he isn't new anymore. Well, anyway, I want you to act as a model of sorts for a certain young adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_021: He's no stranger to you of course─recall a fellow by the name of R'fhul Tia? Came to the Moonfire Faire with his little sister R'mahja before, remember? The lad went and became an adventurer, and seems to have some experience under his belt now, but...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_022: The lad's name is R'fhul Tia. Comes to the Moonfire Faire regularly with his little sister R'mahja, and seems to be a well-meaning fellow for the most part. Recently, though...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_023: Well, to be frank, he's putting on airs. You'd better see him for yourself to get the real picture. I saw him heading to the north of the island with his sister earlier─you should be able to find him there.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_024: While he has his issues, there's no doubt in my mind that he has a promising future as an adventurer. I'll leave it up to you to decide how you want to go about it, but guide him back onto the right path, would you?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_025: R'fhul Tia should be somewhere on the north side of the island. How you go about it is up to you─just guide him back onto the right path.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_026: I begged my brother to bring me again this year, I just love it sooo much! And it's even more fun because he's with me!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_00: W-Wait a minute, you're...I can't believe this, you're like one of my heroes!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERB04540_00: Well, this is a pleasant surprise. Our mentor predicted you would join the festivities.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_030: Long time no see, ! I had a feeling we'd meet again. Don't be shy now, Majha!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_031: Hello, ! I'm so happy you're here. Today just keeps getting better and better!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_032: Ah, might you be ? It's an honor to finally meet you! O-Oh, and this right here is my little sister!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_033: Pleased to meet you,  Adventurer! My name is R'majha! Will you be playing with us today?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_034: Since you're here, there's something I want to tell you... Though I've only been an adventurer for a few summers, I've already made a name for myself. Hells, I even have a pair of apprentices!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_100_034: I suppose you'd expect as much for someone of my obvious talent, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_035: Anyway, where was I? Oh, right─my apprentices. Go on, introduce yourselves!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_00: Hello there, friend! The pair of us are just your average friendly ol' novice adventurers who wound up taking up an apprenticeship under our mentor here after he saved us from a sticky situation─he's a big fan of yours, by the way!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_10: The mentor we respect respects you, so if you really think about it, we ought to respect you too! And anyone who commands that much respect is clearly incredible. It's an honor, ─truly!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERB04540_00: I've heard all kinds of amazing rumors about you, . It's a pleasure to finally make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_038: So, I take it you also heard about the challenge and decided to join in the festivities?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_100_038: I won't lie, I'm itching to give the course a go myself! I hear they've even added a new bombastic circuit to it. Though, for a prodigy like me who completed it as a novice...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_039: The real challenge'll be not to fall asleep from boredom. Heh, a rising star like me has nowhere to go but up, after all!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_A1_000_002: You could try, you know, not being cocky as well?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_040: Heh, I appreciate the sentiment, but I'll be fine. It'll be easy enough to dazzle the audience.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_041: Still, it's an honor to be encouraged by the person I look up to─thank you!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_042: Nonsense, I'm being confident, not cocky! It just comes naturally to me─I guess this is what happens when you become a respectable adventurer, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_043: Watch me out there, . When I tear through that course, you'll understand what I'm capable of!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_044: Wh-What are you saying, ! And in front of my impressionable apprentices no less! You should be well aware of my historic achievement!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_045: Make no mistake, I've completed the course. The old me who made one blunder after another is gone. You'll see, just watch!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_046: Are you sure you're okay, Fhul? You've been acting odd lately...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_047: Am I okay? Hah! I'm better than ever. Don't you worry one bit, Mahjaーyour big brother's a fully fledged adventurer now. I'll give the crowd a show and be back before you know it.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_FHULTIA_000_048: From the moment I became an adventurer, I've always looked up to you. There's no one I want witnessing my finest achievement more than you, so if you can spare a moment to watch, please wait for me on the beach.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_00: It'll be okay, Majha. It's your brother after all. He'll pull through, surely...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERB04540_00: Yes, I'm sure you have nothing to worry about, my dear...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_052: You'll come too, won't you? I'll feel better if you're there!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_100_053: ...Eh? Ah, it's nothing. Don't concern yourself with my problems. R'fhul needs all the help he can get.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_054: Fhul... I really hope he'll be okay.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_00: It wasn't so long ago─the day R'fhul rescued us, I mean. We didn't know left from right, but still thought we had the chops to take on a rampaging beast. We'd have died had R'fhul, who happened to be passing by, not put his life on the line for us.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_10: Thinking back on it, the way he fought was downright clumsy─even to my eyes. But I will never forget how desperately he fought to save us... He showed us what it truly means to be an adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_11: That's why we decided to follow him. I know he'll do his best out there today, because that's the kind of man he is!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERB04540_00: Recently, R'fhul's been... Sorry. Forget I said anything.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_060: Do you see my brother? I can't see anything from here...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_061: (-???-)Aha, I sense a damsel in distress! Fear not, young maiden, for we are here to the rescue!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_062: (-Beaudefoin-)Ahem... Let the games begin! I, Beaudefoin, will humbly serve as herald of the proceedings.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_063: (-Haermaga-)<sigh> ...And I, Haermaga, have been unjustly nominated to assist him.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_064: (-Beaudefoin-)Together, not even the slightest happening shall escape our ardent observation!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_100_064: (-Beaudefoin-)Now then, let us look upon our contestant, the up-and-coming adventurer R'fhul Tia! With such a daunting trial before him, who knows what could be running through his mind right now. What do those stern blue eyes of yours see, Haermaga?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_065: (-Haermaga-)The lad looks eager to get up and at it, and in terms of physique, he looks to be in fine shape. That said, I can't help but notice some nervous energy in him as well.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_066: (-Beaudefoin-)Thank you, Haermaga. Let's wish him the best of luck out─ Ah! The contestant has just took off at a run, and is presently making his way to the first jet of water!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_067: (-Beaudefoin-)And he soars through the sky expertly! Wow, just look at that landing!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_068: (-Haermaga-)A splendid feat indeed. He managed it all without losing his footing. This is proof of his experience as an adventurer─he's well accustomed to moving under pressure─or above it, as it were.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_069: (-Beaudefoin-)And now, he is faced with a decision that will change the course of his fate. Does he take the tried-and-true path, or try his luck at the new circuit...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_100_069: (-Beaudefoin-)Which route do you think our sprightly contender will take, Haermaga?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_070: (-Haermaga-)The new circuit requires a contestant to be calm and collected in the face of a looming barrage of bombs. Unfortunately, I sense much fear in this one. If I were in his shoes, I would pick the old circuit without a second thought...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_071: (-Beaudefoin-)Ah, he's on the move! It seems he's made his decision: the new circuit! The timing of his movements leave much to be desired, however...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_072: (-Haermaga-)Even the slightest moment's hesitation could lead to a messy result, and I fear he teetered for too long... Cover your eyes folks, this could get ugly.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_073: (-Beaudefoin-)He managed to dodge the first explosion! And the second, the third, and the─
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_100_073: (-Beaudefoin-)Gods be good, the shockwave of the fourth explosion has sent him flying like a shooting star!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_074: (-Beaudefoin-)Ladies and gentlemen, even as the seawater salts his wounds, I regret to inform you that our contestant has been disqualified!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RMAJHA_000_075: No, no, no, this is bad! This is really, really bad!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_076: (-Beaudefoin-)Well, there goes our audience. This seems as fine a place as any to end the commentary. Please, go. R'fhul needs your help.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_077: (-Haermaga-)Right. I hope you haven't forgotten my request. I'm counting on you.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_HAERMAGA_000_078: Blast that Beaudefoin, the wily little bastard. I told him hundreds of times I'm not interested in this nonsense, but he still managed to get his way in the end... Er, mind if I ask what you thought of my─you know what, never mind. I don't want to know...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_BEAUDEFOIN_000_079: I leave the matter of R'fhul Tia's rescue in your capable hands!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_10: Not like this, R'fhul...not like this.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERB04540_10: I had my suspicions, but I hoped they wouldn't prove to be true...
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_081: Ah, lest you all misunderstand, that wasn't a serious attempt. If I really wanted to complete the course, I could've done it with my hands behind my back!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_082: But it'd hardly be entertaining if I just finished it in an instant. There's no drama. Now, when I go back and complete it with ease, the crowd'll go wild! Genius, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERA04540_00: Wait a minute, R'fhul... Is that what you really care about? If so, you're not the person I thought you were─the person I respected.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_084: Oh, uh, erm, I mean... I'm not just your average adventurer, you know? I need to amaze everyone!
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_ADVENTURERB04540_00: No, R'fhul... You're wrong. I guess you never understood what we admired about you. I'm sorry...but this is farewell.
TEXT_FESSUM801_04540_RFHULTIA_000_086: Wh-What... What did I do wrong!?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_100_002: Please , you have to do something! I've never seen my brother like this...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_000: Wh-Why... What did I do wrong?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_100_001: Maybe you could try to comfort him? You're his hero, so if that doesn't work, I don't know what will!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_010: <sniff> How could this happen... I don't understand...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SYSTEM_000_011: R'fhul Tia is gravely despondent. Perhaps comfort from the person he admires will lift his spirits.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_011: Thank you for showing me such kindness, . I'm still trying to wrap my head around why those two left. Is it because I failed the course? Because I looked pathetic?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_012: No, silly, that's not it at all!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_013: Really? It's not because I looked pathetic?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_100_013: Erm... Say, , do you have any idea why?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_A1_000_003: You tried to hide from your mistakes.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_014: That's true, but that's not the point! It's because he wasn't taking it seriously!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_015: Exactly, 's exactly right! You didn't take the challenge seriously at all!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_016: Hide...from a mistake? I don't quite understand, but it sounds wise! You didn't look like you were taking it seriously, Fhul!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_017: I wasn't taking it seriously...? So what? Even if I had, I would've failed all the same. I thought if I did it on purpose, then maybe...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_018: Ugh! Who would admire someone who gives up before they've even started? The brother I look up to always does his best, no matter how he looks or what others think of him!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_100_018: If you can't understand that, maybe I'll try the course myself and show you what I mean!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_019: (-???-)My, that is some remarkable gumption you have there little miss! Alas, I'm afraid children may not, under absolutely any circumstances, participate in the competition.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_020: (-Beaudefoin-)I hope you don't mind, but I overheard your conversation. My opinion? You're a pathetic excuse for an adventurer, R'fhul. Just awful.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_021: ...Y-You're right. You taught me so much, yet I put on such a miserable performance. Everyone must think I'm so very pitiful...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_022: (-Beaudefoin-)Just listen to yourself, lad. You want to know what your problem is? Vanity. You've lost sight of what's truly important.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_023: (-Beaudefoin-)Think back. Try to recall what Haermaga and I taught you─what it was that you admired about  in the first place.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_024: I...I think I finally understand. I was so focused on trying to impress my apprentices that I didn't fully commit myself to overcoming the challenge, and stopped being an adventurer in so doing... Aye, I became a coward instead.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_025: I─I betrayed their trust, and now they've seen me for what I truly am. There's no way I could make it up to them...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_026: What if you tried the course again, but took it seriously this time? I bet those two would watch!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_027: Again? But I've never actually succeeded. If I were to fail once more, I'd lose their respect forever...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_A2_000_001: It doesn't matter if you fail or succeed. What matters is that you try.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_A2_000_002: Show us what you're made of, adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_028: ... Thank you! I nearly made the same mistake all over again. This time, I promise you, I will do my best!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_029: Adventurer... You're right─I'm an adventurer! I need only focus on the challenge ahead!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_030: I'm sorry to ask more of you when you've already done so much, but can I ask you to serve as my inspiration once more? If possible, I would like you to go through the course ahead of me.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_031: Seeing you test your mettle would rekindle my aspirations of becoming a great adventurer. Please, help me to reclaim that dream─let me follow in your footsteps!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_032: You doing this─it means the world to me, . I will follow after you with everything I have!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_034: I know I can do my best if I'm following after you. When you begin your run through the course, I'll be there, right behind you.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_040: I appreciate you looking out for R'fhul like this. If you're ready to go, the jet of water yonder is roaring in anticipation of your arrival!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SYSTEM_100_040: Should completing the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course prove difficult, seek out a faire adventurer for assistance.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_041: Forget about R'fhul while you're jumping through obstacles, dodging explosions, and what have you─just relax, and have a good time! That will prove more fruitful to the lad in the end, anyway.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERA04541_00: You look like you've seen your share of adventure. Hells, I wager you could get through a silly ol' course like this with your eyes closed. That would be something to see─care to show the amateurs how it's done?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SYSTEM_000_043: Choosing to close your eyes will take you directly to the end of the first platforming section.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_Q4_000_000: Amaze onlookers and yourself by undertaking the course with your eyes closed?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_Q5_000_001: Proceed to the end of the first platforming section?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HILDELANA_000_050: Beaudefoin's kept me abreast of the situation, and after seeing the way you've carried yourself through the course so far, R'fhul's gotta be fired up!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HILDELANA_000_051: You're already at the halfway point, so it's not like you need to hear it from me, but good luck!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SYSTEM_100_051: Should completing the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course prove difficult, seek out a faire adventurer for assistance.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HILDELANA_000_052: Just halfway to go! I'll be watching how you and R'fhul manage from here!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERB04541_00: Well, well, well, what do we have here...an adventurer head and shoulders above the rest. If the remaining obstacles are to prove a challenge, I believe a handicap is in order. Why not do the rest of the course blind? You're not afraid of a little danger...are you?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_SYSTEM_000_054: Choosing to close your eyes will take you directly to the end of the course.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_Q6_000_000: Prove your courage to the cheeky faire adventurer by undertaking the course with your eyes closed?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_Q7_000_001: Proceed to the end of the course?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_POBYANO_000_060: Congratulations on making it to the end! Ah, I should mention that I've heard about the situation with R'fhul. He pursued you the entire time, never giving up despite the fear in his eyes. Even now...hey, look behind you!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_A3_000_002: Do not waver! You can do this!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_061: I did it, ! I really did it! Thank you for leading the way!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_062: Hah, now that I've made it to the end, I suddenly feel lightheaded... Forgive me, I will return after I've had a moment to catch my breath. Would you mind relaying the good news to Mahja?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_063: Bravo, bravo! A job well done─though I expected no less.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HILDELANA_000_064: Expertly done, ! Seems R'fhul managed to keep behind you the whole way. A seasoned adventurer like you can bring out the best in anyone, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_POBYANO_000_065: I was absolutely moved by─well, the way you moved through the course! But I must admit, it was even more touching to see R'fhul gain confidence as he pushed on. Truly, this is the way adventurers are meant to be!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_066: Sorry I couldn't keep up with you to the very end. My heart may very well burst out of my chest if it beats any faster, so I'm going to rest here for a bit... In the meantime, please let Mahja know what happened.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_070: Oh, you're back! How'd it go? Beaudefoin and Haermaga were “comment-trading,” but I want to hear about it from you!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_071: He did it─he really did it! I always believed Fhul could, but he never believed it himself. I'm so happy...
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_072: Fhul!  told me everything. I'm so proud of you!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_073: Oh, I didn't do much. Just followed after , really. Still...it felt good to try, and finally succeed at something.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERB04541_00: Please excuse us for interrupting, R'fhul. Do you have a moment?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERA04541_00: We... We judged you too quickly, and too harshly. It was only when we saw you making your way through the course that it dawned on us how wrong we'd been.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_075: You don't have to finish that sentence. I'm the one in the wrong here, after all. I...I am so very sorry, both of you!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_076: I let my desire for recognition cloud my judgment, and lost sight of myself in the process. It's little wonder you both reacted the way you did.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_077: That's why I'm starting over. This time, I will not waver from the path─nay, I shall follow wherever it leads, as a true adventurer should! With that said...do you think you could forgive me?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERB04541_00: I'll be honest─you were a dismal sight up there at first, looking as if you might collapse at any moment. But you didn't. You pushed through like a true champion, and now we are keen to see how far you'll go. Just like when we first met you.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERA04541_00: Aye, that's why we want you to forgive us...for losing faith, instead of believing in you like we should've. Given the circumstances, I understand if you say no, but... Would you consent to being our mentor once again?
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_080: Like you even have to ask. I couldn't be happier to have you both at my side!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_081: Thank you for bringing Fhul back to his senses, ! If you hadn't, these three never would've made up, and I would still be really sad. So...thank you, so, so much!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_082: I think we'll be okay now, so maybe you can do that “report” thing that Fhul always talks about? I don't really get it, but it seems important. And don't you worry about Fhul─I'll be watching him carefully!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RFHULTIA_000_083: This whole ordeal started because of my own foolishness, yet you still held your hand out to me. I've said it before, and I'll say it again─you, my friend, are my inspiration!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERA04541_00: Our mentor's mentor... Does that make you our grandmentor? It's like we're all one big family!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_ADVENTURERB04541_00: My entire life, everyone around me has called me cold...but watching you and R'fhul tackle the course lit a fire inside of me. I know now what I aspire to be.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_RMAJHA_000_086: Did my brother thank you properly? Well, let me thank you again just to be safe! Oh, and please don't forget about the “report” thing!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_BEAUDEFOIN_000_087: My, what a satisfying conclusion to this tale! You simply must regale it to Haermaga in all its glory!
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HAERMAGA_000_090: I could roughly see what happened from here, but I'd appreciate it if you filled in the blanks.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HAERMAGA_000_091: So the lad finally came to his senses in the end, eh? And he made up with those greenhorns while he was at it, too. You did well, . I was right to count on you.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HAERMAGA_000_092: With that, he's truly made his first step as a proper adventurer─and better yet, I don't have to feel anxious about leaving the three of them to their own devices anymore.
TEXT_FESSUM802_04541_HAERMAGA_000_093: Speaking of adventurers, I owe you a reward, don't I? Please, take this. You've more than earned it. And do try to enjoy the Moonfire Faire while it's around.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Greetings, friend. By your dauntless bearing, I assume you are an adventurer.
As for myself, I am a humble wandering minstrel. One who draws inspiration from the daring deeds of those in your calling.
Ah, if it isn't my dear adventurer friend! Pleased am I to see you again. Have you perchance come to join us in remembering the Calamity?
If you have a moment, there is a favor I would ask of you. Will you not hear me out?
Of late, more people are seeking to take up adventuring.
In part due to the promotional efforts during the recent Moonfire Faire, more people are seeking to take up adventuring.
Not all are yet wise in the ways of the world, however, and I fear they might fall prey to less-principled types in Ul'dah.
If one such as you were to help them on their way, I would feel more at ease. What say you? Will you not take a fledgling adventurer under your wing?
I'm truly grateful!

Now, I believe a carriage is due to arrive shortly. If you go and wait at the Gate of Nald, chances are a soul will wander in who has just embarked upon the path of adventure. Pray greet them and offer your help.
Worry not, you'll have no trouble identifying them. You need but look for someone absorbed in their surroundings.
Hehe, I daresay it will feel like glimpsing into the past─right to the part where you are greeted by a helpful stranger.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A1_000_002: Is this your first trip to Ul'dah?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_02: (-Bright-eyed Youth-)An experienced adventurer, you say? And you want to help me on my way?
(-Bright-eyed Youth-)Well, I could certainly use some guidance. I've never been anywhere near as big and busy as Ul'dah...
My name is Nhagi'a Jakkya, but just “Nhagi” will do. And as you rightly guessed, I'm an aspiring adventurer. That's why I left my village and came here.
So...I understand that you first need to register at the Adventurers' Guild. Do you know where it is?
Just through that door, is it? Thank you, I'll head there at once!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_026: Nhagi rushes off before you can offer further explanation. Perhaps you should follow him to the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_03: In...and out... In...and out... Come on, Nhagi, you can do it...
Oh, it's you again... To be honest, I'm quite nervous. It's heartening to have you here too.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_032: Why, hello there. What can I do for you today?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_033: The lad's here to register, is he?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_03: Yes, madam, I wish to join the Adventurers' Guild! My name is Nhagi'a Jakkya, and I'm sixteen years old─practically a man grown!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_035: Hehe, aren't we a lively one? Momodi's the name, and if you want to be an adventurer, then you've come to the right woman.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_036: There's nothing to it, really─you just need to write your name in the register. Come, come...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_037: With that, you're officially a member of the Adventurers' Guild. If you ever need a bit of advice about one thing or another, pay me a visit. Just don't go botherin' me every time you stub your bloody toe, all right?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_038: 'Course, I do enjoy hearin' tell of a gentleman's woes with the womenfolk from time to time...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_039: Now then, normally I'd offer you the grand tour...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_040: But in light of present company, I reckon you ought to have it from .
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_041: 's your senior in adventurin', after all, and you could do worse than to get  advice.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_100_041: 's a renowned adventurer, after all─the bleedin' champion of Eorzea─and you could do far worse than to get  advice.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_042: To begin with, mayhap you could recommend a guild here in Ul'dah for Nhagi to join?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_043: If it's too noisy in here, there are benches just outside where you can have a nice little chat.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_044: With your experience, I reckon you could give Nhagi some sound advice on a guild to join. Go on, have a little chat and see what might suit him.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_05: I must confess, choosing a guild is quite daunting... I'd appreciate any advice you can offer.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_051: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A3_000_001: Adventuring can be dangerous. What attracted you to it?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A3_000_002: Why did you want to become an adventurer?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_05: A merchant who was in the carriage with me─a Bre...something─asked me much the same thing.
At the time, I couldn't give a proper answer. I had a reason for leaving home, of course, but I couldn't express it in words.
But having now set foot in Ul'dah, it's become clear in my mind.
I wanted to know what lay beyond the horizon. Wanted to see it with my own eyes and be amidst it.
You've been to many places, right? You like it, then? Traveling, that is...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A4_000_001: I love traveling. There's nothing like the thrill of seeing new sights.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A4_000_002: Traveling is nice, but I'd prefer to put my roots down somewhere.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_05: So you do, so you do...
I have an older sister. During the Calamity, we fled Gridania and took refuge in a village in the mountains.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: I ended up staying in that secluded place, and it's long been a dream of mine to travel the world.
And yet...perhaps it's when we've seen the world that we know there's a perfect place for us. One we'd like to call home.
But inexperienced as I am, I don't know if I could live a life on the road. Is there a guild that could equip me with the skills I need?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A6_000_001: One representing students of the fighting arts.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: I see, a place where I can learn how to protect myself and others... If I recall correctly, Ul'dah is home to the Pugilists' and Thaumaturges' Guilds.
Of those two, I'd choose the pugilists. I've always enjoyed rigorous exercise, and am quite confident in my physical abilities. Yes, I believe this is the guild for me! I'll go and join at once!
I see, a place where I can learn a trade... Indeed, we can't always rely on fighting to make a living, and having the ability to gather or craft would be invaluable.

If I recall correctly, Ul'dah is home to the Alchemists' Guild. I happen to have some familiarity with medicinal herbs, and I daresay I can put the knowledge to use. Yes, I believe this is the guild for me! I'll go and join at once!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A7_000_001: Will you be all right by yourself?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A7_000_002: I can show you to the guild if you like.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: Thanks for your concern, but I should be fine.
If you still have time, though, could we meet again afterwards? There are a few more things I'd like to ask you about.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_100_06: Great! I'll look for you here when I'm done!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_070: You wait a good while, but there is no sign of Nhagi. Perhaps you should look in on him at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_071: You wait a good while, but Nhagi is nowhere to be seen. Perhaps you should look in on him at the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_MOMODI_000_072: Judgin' by how at ease the lad looks around you, I reckon you've got a knack for guidance. Mayhap you'd care to do my job for me? Hehehe...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_HAMON_000_080: That was a most impressive display, young one! Watching you, I'm reminded of myself in my youth─swift, strong, and handsome. Not to say that I'm not these things anymore, of course...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_08: You're too kind, Master Hamon! And I'm sure you're still all those things and more!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_CHUCHUTO_000_082: Now, now, Nhagi, take care you don't flatter the old man overmuch. His neck couldn't bear his head getting any larger.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_08: Oh, ! I'm glad to say that pugilism agrees with me. My thanks for your recommendation!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_HAMON_000_084: Well now, , to think that you're the one who sent Nhagi to us! The lad possesses rare talent, and I look forward to watching him grow in our art.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_HAMON_000_085: So you're the one who sent Nhagi to us! The lad possesses rare talent, and I look forward to watching him grow in our art.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_HAMON_000_086: Right then, my boy. Remember today's lesson well, and keep at your training. Next time, we shall try something a little harder!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_08: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting. So engrossed was I in the combinations, I lost track of time...
Oh, I should mention something. As I was training, a peculiar minstrel approached me. He said that, if I'm resolved to walk an adventurer's path, I should seek him out for a task.
Moreover, he asked that you accompany me. If you're willing, he's apparently waiting at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_HAMON_000_090: Always a pleasure to see you, . Come and shed some sweat with us again soon, do you hear?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_HAMON_100_090: Hm? If you want to shed some sweat too, then you're more than welcome.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_091: Idiot! Had my mental faculties been diminished as a result, what then!? The world would have forever been deprived of my genius, that's what!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_092: Ah, my loyal assistant, you are come at a good time! This fool of a trainee switched my drinking water with some unknown fluid...which I unwittingly imbibed!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_093: Who are you supposed to be? This trainee's keeper? Well then, you should know that the fool switched my drinking water with some unknown fluid...which I unwittingly imbibed!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_09: I-I'm sorry, Master Severian, but it was just a herbal tea. Y-You looked weary, and I thought that it might help...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_095: Why in the seven hells didn't you say so first!? That way I might have recorded my vital signs and ascertained the tea's effects!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_096: Such negligence ill befits an alchemist, and I ought to kick you out of my laboratory right now!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_097: Still...you completed the assigned tasks perfectly. In light of this, you have earned another chance. Very well, you may serve as my assistant─on a probationary basis.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_09: ...Ahem. I'm sorry you had to see that, . But it seems all is well...at least for now.

Master Severian truly lives and breathes alchemy. Though the tea is quite bitter, he thought only of its effects and made no comment on its taste. I believe I stand to learn much under him, and I'll do my best not to incur his ire.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_10: I must also apologize to you for keeping you waiting. So engrossed was I in the potion making, I lost track of time...
Oh, and one other thing. As I was at my work, a peculiar minstrel approached me. He said that, if I'm resolved to walk an adventurer's path, I should seek him out for a task.
Moreover, he asked that you accompany me. If you're willing, he's apparently waiting at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SEVERIAN_000_103: Hm, my body feels marginally warmer... It would seem the tea has the effect of promoting circulation...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: My friend, you have done a splendid job as a guide. I was right to entrust the task to you.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_11: What? Do you mean to say  approached me at your behest?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: did, I must confess. You see, for my next composition, I seek to capture the essence of the times. While any number of subjects would be worthwhile, of greatest interest to me is the recent rise in the ranks of adventurers.
In thus bringing different generations of adventurers together, I had hoped for inspiration to strike...and I'm pleased to say that it has!
Drawing upon your experience walking your path, you have helped Nhagi to begin walking his─a reminder that the present owes its existence to the past.
That is to say, the present and the past are deeply entwined. If we would capture the former, we cannot well disregard the latter. And this brings me to my next request...
I ask that you each find an object with a connection to the Calamity─the event which gave rise to the realm's rebirth─and present it to me with its tale.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_11: Well now, that sounds not unlike a treasure hunt...and it'd be my very first task as an adventurer! What do you say, ? Shall we do it?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Excellent. When you have your items, pray seek me out at the Ruby Road Exchange. I eagerly look forward to seeing what you bring.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_12: There are many vendors at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange, right? Chances are they'll have something, so let's begin our search there!
Come on, let's begin looking around!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_122: Nhagi'a Jakkya is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
