TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_123: You can leave Nhagi'a Jakkya behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_124: If you wish to have Nhagi'a Jakkya accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_100_124: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_200_124: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to initiate these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_12: An object with a connection to the Calamity... I wonder what manner of things we'll find!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_Q52_000_126: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Nhagi'a Jakkya?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_12: Oh, you need to be somewhere? All right, I'll wait for you in the area.
Ready to continue? Then let's go!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_129: Nhagi'a Jakkya has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_100_129: You must be accompanied by Nhagi'a Jakkya and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_13: Shall we look around some more? There's bound to be other things out there.
So far, so good. Let's look around just a little more.
...I daresay we've seen enough. Let's find a quiet spot to discuss what to bring back.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_000_133: You have seen enough objects and learned the stories behind them. Make your way to the end of the Sapphire Avenue Exchange with Nhagi'a and speak with him.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_140: Welcome, welcome! What is it that you're after?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_141: Objects with a connection to the Calamity, you say? Why, I have just the thing─an amethyst ring from Ishgard, steeped in sentimental value!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_142: Five years ago, on the eve of the Battle of Carteneau, a young Temple Knight set out from his homeland, wishing to do his part for Eorzea when his nation would not.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_143: Alas, the man never arrived in the Flats.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_144: En route, he came upon a merchant being attacked by a dragon...and lost his life going to the stranger's aid. This was his ring─an heirloom passed down through his line.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_14: What a tragic tale... But I wonder─how did the ring find its way back? If the knight fell, it seems the merchant couldn't have survived unscathed...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_146: Um...er... A-Ah, I remember now! Though the knight was mortally wounded, he succeeded in striking down the dragon. And with his last breath, he entrusted the ring to the merchant. Y-Yes, that's how it happened!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_LOLONU_000_147: So, what do you say? If you're interested, I would be willing to part with the relic for a special price─but for today only!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_14: Hmmm, this feels a bit dubious...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Greetings and welcome to my exhibit. Please feel free to browse at your leisure.
Oh, if it isn't ! How have you been, my friend?

I'm still working at my craft, as you can see. And for the Rising this year, Astin has organized this street exhibit for me. Please feel free to browse at your leisure, and don't hesitate to let me know if you have any questions.
Greetings and welcome to my exhibit. Please feel free to browse at your leisure, and don't hesitate to let me know if you have any questions.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_15: We're looking for objects that bear a connection to the Calamity. Do you have anything that fits the description?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: As a matter of fact, I do! Yonder pane, entitled The Sultana's Seven, depicts an inspiring event from the Calamity!

'Twas the final days before the fall of Dalamud, its inexorable approach foretelling our impending doom. Panic spread like wildfire, while many in their desperation turned on the sultanate. Looting and rioting broke out across Ul'dah.

To quell the masses, Her Royal Majesty Nanamo Ul Namo took to the streets with a guard consisting of only seven subjects, for they alone had the courage to stand with their sultana. There, she addressed the rabble.

"Heed me, my beloved citizens! The realm lies upon the brink of the Seventh Umbral Era. Yet so long as we live, we must not forget our compassion. Now is not the time to take from your neighbor, but to proffer him the hand of succor.“

Brought to their senses by her words, the people laid down their arms and set about healing the wounds they themselves had inflicted on Ul'dah. And those who returned from the battlefield found their home much as they had left it: a gleaming jewel in the desert.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_15: Her Grace sounds like a great ruler.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_16: Ul'dah is fortunate to have her watching over it.
Thanks for sharing the tale. It's indeed inspiring, and you've done an incredible job capturing it in glass!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_ANV07GOLDSMITH_000_: Having an exhibit all to myself, I can't help but feel a bit self-conscious.
But at the same time, I feel great satisfaction. And it encourages me to keep at my craft.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NANABE_000_170: Greetings! From daily necessities to unusual curios, I deal in all manner of wares. If there is something in particular you seek, you need but ask.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NANABE_000_171: Hmmm, objects to do with the Calamity... The two of you are adventurers, are you not? In which case, I have something that may be of interest.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NANABE_000_172: It's a journal I acquired from an adventurer who retired injured. The man recorded his experiences during the Calamity in detail, and I daresay it has value for students of history.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_17: Oho, an adventurer's firsthand account! I'd love to pore over it!
Do you keep a journal of your adventures as well, ? If so, I'd love to read it too one day. With your permission, of course...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NANABE_000_175: Oh, for another historical piece, I also have a scrapbook of articles from The Raven, Gridania's leading tabloid. These mainly cover events outside the Calamity, however...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_17: Articles from The Raven, you say? Hmmm...
Ooh, is this the local cuisine? Goodness, but everything looks amazing!
In the course of your journeys, you must have sampled all kinds of food. From simple fare to exotic feasts, I look forward to sampling everything too!
House of Splendors? What kind of place is this, I wonder...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_ANV09MOB1_000_180: I see you're not familiar with the House. We offer wares in exchange for scrips, but our services are available only to those whom we know and trust.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_18: So if I want to be a customer, I need to make a name for myself... One day, Nhagi! One day!
Right, this looks like as good a spot as any.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_19: I don't know about you, but that was all very new and exciting for me!
Talking to myriad people, learning the tale behind each object... It's been a great experience, and I won't soon forget it.
Now then, we need to decide what we want to take to the minstrel. Have you made up your mind?

I see, I see. I did consider that too, but in the end settled on something else.
...What is it? Hehe, if you don't mind, I'd like to keep it a surprise.
Come, let's purchase our respective items, and meet back where the minstrel awaits!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_100_194: You obtain the Ishgardian knight's ring.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_200_194: You obtain The Sultana's Seven pane.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_SYSTEM_300_194: You obtain the retired adventurer's journal.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_19: Hehe, you'll find out what I chose soon enough!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Welcome back. You've each found an item, I trust?
Well now, what have we here...?
A knight who set out to fight for the realm and gave his life for a stranger... Be it fact or fiction, 'tis a moving tale of valor and sacrifice.
It reminds us that, though many events may be beneath history's remembrance, they may have altered the lives of those who lived them.
Ah yes, The Sultana's Seven, I know it well. 'Tis an iconic tale of leadership amidst great adversity.
It may be said that Her Grace's actions that fateful day helped to forge Ul'dah as it is now. In that sense, it well suits the theme for my composition.
The journal of an adventurer, you say... Despite the vendor's claims, such records typically do not have much historical value, on account of their limited perspective and inherent partiality.
Yet by the same token, they have great value to me, for they offer a glimpse into the writer's heart. There is no richer material for penning verses.
Now then, what of you, young Nhagi?
And what might this be?
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_21: It's a scrapbook of articles from The Raven.
You see, my sister is a reporter for the tabloid. During the Calamity, she traveled the realm, interviewing adventurers about their journeys. And I loved nothing more than to hear her tales.

They seemed like such a diverse crowd, adventurers. No two people were alike. And yet they were united in the free, unshackled lives they lived. It struck a chord with me, and in time I found myself admiring them.
Looking back, it was my sister who instilled in me the desire to see the world─to become an adventurer. That's why I chose this scrapbook.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I see... The footprints someone leaves on their journey become the starting point for another...
Yes, a verse comes to me─a blessing for those souls who are taking their first chary steps into the unknown. Pray, lend me your ears...
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_60: (-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
'Tis a pleasure to meet you again. As I have in the past, I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
First of all, I wish to thank you for continuing to grace us with your presence. You and your fellow adventurers are our inspiration, and this shall never change.
The world, however, is an ever-changing place, mysterious in its elusiveness.
Unexpected hardships may turn our lives upside down. And though we all desire peace deep in our hearts, the sparks of conflict never cease to be struck.
Like an adventurer's journey, the world is constantly moving towards the unknown, and it takes considerable courage to alter course.
Yet I ardently believe that it is a small-but-significant step in our quest to create new adventures.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: Indeed, another great change is about to visit the world, and it shall open the way to exciting new journeys.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_61: And 'tis our abiding hope that our journey together shall ever continue on, to the distant horizon and beyond.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
Return to walking your path, and know that you are in our hearts always.
Till next we meet, I bid you safe travels.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_70: Thank you for the generous reward─and the uplifting verse. It gives me courage for the road ahead.
Speaking of which, it's time I set out on my own. Though it was brief, I enjoyed our time together, and I hope to see you again, somewhere out there!
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A99_000_001: Come what may, never forget to smile.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A99_000_002: Pass my regards to your sister.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_A99_000_003: I look forward to hearing your tales.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Though much and more was lost in the Calamity, intrepid souls continue to set forth, paving the way unto the future. In such a moment in history do we stand, and for you I would perform another song.

Your life is a riddle, to bear gladness and grief,
'Neath stars and through storms, the answers to seek.♪
Your footprints are threads, to be gathered and woven,
A song of dawn resplendent, dancing high to the heavens.♪

From the embrace of the gods though mankind has been torn,
Upon winds eternal lives and memories are borne.♪

The future is unwritten, bring it rapture or sorrow,
Our journey shall continue, unto tomorrow and tomorrow.♪
I wonder─how did you feel as you watched Nhagi set off? Did the sight fill you with worry for a fledgling adventurer? Or did it awaken fond memories of your own humble beginnings?

Whichever it may be, I know that yours is a journey more trying than most. There will be times when you are overcome by loneliness, and each step feels heavier than the last. In such a moment, I bid you remember this:
So long as you harbor love for this world, ever shall there be a place for you in it. Your adventures will never end.
TEXT_FESANV801_04544_000_800: You have unlocked the jigsaw puzzle mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_000: Wait...I know you! You're the case-cracking adventurer who came to our aid in the past! It's me, Ollier! Gold Saucer attendant and de facto investigator, at your service.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_001: ...Though truth be told, it's your services that we really need─if you can spare the time, that is. What do you say?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_002: Pardon me, my good . My name is Ollier, and I am employed as an attendant at the Manderville Gold Saucer. Could I perhaps trouble you for a moment of your time?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_003: Truth be told, we are in desperate need of a capable adventurer to assist us in a task of the utmost import. Might you perchance be willing to offer your aid?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_004: As you may have realized, we are currently in the midst of the Make It Rain Campaign, a yearly festival during which we hold a number of exclusive, limited-time events.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_005: Though you may be surprised to hear it, there are still those who have yet to experience all the wonders the Saucer has to offer. Thus have we─the staff of the Saucer─decided to take our show into town and spread the word.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_006: However, there has been one troubling development. Ever since we began this little campaign, one of my colleagues has been visibly out of sorts. Normally, he's the most cheerful of all of us, so let it suffice to say that we're deeply concerned.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_007: My colleagues and I have tried to look into the matter ourselves, but I fear the man is too proud for his own good, and refuses to admit anything is the matter. And so, I thought, perhaps an accomplished sleuth like yourself might succeed where we have failed. So...what do you say?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_008: My colleagues and I have tried to look into the matter ourselves, but I fear the man is too proud for his own good, and refuses to admit anything is the matter. And so, I thought, perhaps an experienced adventurer like yourself might succeed where we have failed. So...what do you say?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_009: Thank you, good ! Your generous offer is most appreciated.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_010: The man in question is currently on assignment in Limsa Lominsa. I will be heading there myself shortly after this─let us rendezvous by the Aftcastle as soon as you are able.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_011: ...Oh, but I've gotten ahead of myself. If you've yet to visit the Gold Saucer, you'll be needing a ticket for admission. In that case, I recommend you try speaking with that young man over there. He's been gloating endlessly of his winnings, and seems to be in the mood to share his good fortune.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_012: In order to continue this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_021: Majestic, isn't it? Of all the displays we painstakingly erected, this may be one that best showcases the Saucer's myriad refined delights.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_022: As for the fellow I mentioned... Ah, that's him right over there.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_GUESTA04584_000_023: It keeps spinning in circles... Do you think it's quite all right?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_GUESTB04584_000_024: All I know is it's making me dizzy just looking at it. Hey, you! Can't you do anything else!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_GUESTA04584_000_025: Look, you've angered it! Or perhaps that was some manner of impromptu dance performance...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_GUESTB04584_000_026: In any case, I can't say that I'm terribly keen to see what it does next. Not when we have a table waiting for us at the Bismarck!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_028: The bystanders having departed, Senor Sabotender slumps his shoulders in visible dismay.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_029: He's been like this ever since he got here. What say you? Will you speak with Senor Sabotender for me and see if you can ascertain what ails him?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_030: I'd give anything to see Senor Sabotender in his usual high spirits again...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A1_000_003: Give me a spin, will you?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_030: Senor Sabotender strikes a pose, but speaks no words. It's unclear if your message reached him...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_031: Senor Sabotender rushed off to the west. Perhaps he wishes to speak with you in a more secluded location?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_040: (-???-)My apologies for dragging you all the way over here.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A2_000_003: Senor Sabotender isn't a real sabotender!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_041: Oh, but of course! The name's Nanaphon. I play the role of Senor Sabotender─the Gold Saucer's beloved mascot. At least, I thought he was beloved...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_042: Have you forgotten so soon, ? It's me, Nanaphon! I play the role of Senor Sabotender─the Gold Saucer's beloved mascot. At least, I thought he was beloved...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_043: Ah, . So you noticed? As an actor, you think I'd be better at concealing my emotions...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_044: Surely you jest? Everyone knows it's a Lalafell in a costume. The name's Nanaphon, and I happen to be that Lalafell.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_045: Trying to lift my spirits with a jest, are you? I appreciate the sentiment, but I fear I'm not really in the mood...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_046: You saw that just now, didn't you? I did my damnedest to convey the sheer splendor of the Gold Saucer with my usual grandiose gestures, but my audience was clearly unimpressed.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_047: Alas, my gyrations and undulations are merely perplexing poses without the spectacles of the Saucer itself! Would that I could explain in my own words all that they are missing out on!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_048: Why don't I, then? Is it not obvious? Because we don't want to reveal to future patrons that Senor Sabotender isn't a real sabotender! ...Not until we've secured their patronage, at the very least.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_049: Whilst donning my costume, I am forbidden from uttering even a single word!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_050: Such is my plight, you see...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_051: At this rate, I will be forced to depart this place having succeeded at nothing but causing quizzical looks and utter confusion. I simply want to join my colleagues in spreading word of the Saucer's splendors across the realm!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A3_000_001: I could explain it for you.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A3_000_002: ...And that's where I come in! Somehow.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_052: What's this? You'd be willing to assist us in our cause!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_053: What a kind and generous soul you have, my adventuring friend! Why, your sheer magnanimity brings a tear to my eye...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_054: ...More than a few tears, even. But what am I doing here crying? I must prepare to welcome you to our little troupe. Pray let me know whenever you are ready!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_060: Ready for your first task? Excellent. Before that, however, allow me to give you an overview of our promotional campaign.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_061: We began with a survey asking for people's impressions of the Gold Saucer. Reviewing the responses, we noted that the vast majority of patrons cited the attractions as one of the venue's main selling points.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_062: While it is true that our attractions are a highlight, there is─as you are well aware─so much more to the Saucer! So we got to thinking about how best to go about informing the world of our lesser-known delights.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_063: I came up with four main features of the Saucer that I hope to promote to people. Which shall I explain first?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A4_000_002: How easy it is to get there!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A4_000_004: The lavish costumes of the staff!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_064: Ah, indeed! Whether it's the Mini Cactpot─which casual players can enjoy as many as three times a day─or the lucrative Jumbo Cactpot─available once per week─both offer Gold Saucer patrons a chance to test their luck and reap lavish prizes!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_065: Easy to enter and with incredible fortunes for the taking, the Mini and Jumbo Cactpots are among the most popular ways to rack up MGP─which can then be exchanged for a host of alluring prizes. Dream big and enter the Cactpot today─only at the Manderville Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_066: Tell me about it! Though the Saucer may seem far away to many─being located at the edge of the Sagolii Desert─did you know that airship passage is available entirely free of charge from all of Eorzea's major cities?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_067: And though the wonders that await you in the Saucer's halls are the main attraction, I'll have you know that the journey via airship is a singular delight in its own right. So why not invite that special someone to soar through the skies on the way to the realm's premiere leisure destination? The Manderville Gold Saucer─only a coin's toss away!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_068: Oho! Clearly I stand before a  of discerning taste. While the Saucer offers no end of games and attractions, refined patrons such as yourself are known to enjoy slipping away to our full-service bar for a refreshing libation or two.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_069: That's right! We've assembled the realm's best barkeeps to prepare a plethora of potables sure to wet your whistle and put you in the mood to marvel at the Saucer's many wonders. Do be sure to stop by!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_070: Ah─a keen eye for fashion, I see. Then you're sure to appreciate the unique costumes and couture worn by our staff─a wardrobe prepared by the sultanate's most esteemed tailors to meet the demanding aesthetic sensibilities of our owner, the incomparable Godbert Manderville.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_071: Be sure to bring something to cover your eyes─the sheer gorgeousness of these ornate outfits is likely to blind you if you do not! Yes, that's right─the Manderville Gold Saucer is a veritable gallery of the most glamorous garb our civilization has ever seen!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_072: ...Well? How did that sound? I daresay I've done a remarkable job of distilling the essence of the Saucer's appeal into concise verbiage. Simply remember all of that verbatim, and you'll be ready to help us spread the word of the Saucer wherever you go.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_NANAPHON_000_073: And with that, I do believe it's time for us to get this show on the road. Allow me to see to my preparations, and we can convene at the Aftcastle when we both are ready. Good? Good.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_080: You can feel Nanaphon's intense gaze upon you from within the Senor Sabotender costume.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_081: You are filled with determination to share the wonders of the Gold Saucer with the residents of Limsa Lominsa alongside your succulent companion.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_090: What 'ave we got 'ere? Yer a fair share...pricklier than the folks what usually show up 'ere at the Bismarck.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A5_000_002: This is the realm-renowned mascot of the Manderville Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_091: The what now? Ah, yer from that eyesore in the desert. Never been there meself─'fraid I'm much too busy fer them silly games. New dishes don't think 'emselves up!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_100_091: It's time to put what you've learned to use and spread the word about the wonders about the Saucer. Succeed in drawing the interest of influential Lominsans, and Nanaphon will surely be heartened.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A6_000_001: But it's the perfect place to bring that special someone!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A6_000_002: But haven't you dreamed of winning a fortune in the Cactpot!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A6_000_003: But you could partake in libations to delight even the most discerning epicure!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_092: Bah! No culinarian worth their salt has the time for that sort o' distraction. I suggest ye try yer luck elsewhere.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_093: Your sales pitch seems to have missed its mark. Perhaps a different approach might be more effective?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_094: Ye don't say? Hmm... Me inspiration could do with some refreshin'...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_095: Aye, I'll pay this Saucer o' yours a visit...jus' as soon as I know me apprentices won't burn this place down in the meanwhile.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_100: The 'ells ye want, drylander? State yer business quick, an' ye'd best hope it's worth me while!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_101: The Gold bloody Saucer!? Why would any pirate in 'er right mind set foot in that twinklin' hellhole!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A7_000_001: Haven't you dreamed of winning a fortune in the Cactpot!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A7_000_002: It's the perfect place to bring that special someone!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A7_000_003: Don't you want to feast your eyes on the realm's most gorgeous garb!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_102: Let me tell ye plain: no! I don't bloody care. Now get out afore I gut ye an' send ye to sleep with the fishes.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_103: Your sales pitch seems to have missed its mark. Perhaps a different approach might be more effective?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_104: Special someone? An' just who in the hells would that be!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A8_000_001: Perhaps your crew could use a respite?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A8_000_002: A certain pirate captain might appreciate the gesture.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_105: Me crew!? That's yer big idea? Then again...me girls what've retired from active duty could always use a break from tendin' to their little ones. I'd wager an excursion would do 'em well.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_107: If yer implyin' what I think ye are, I'd sooner keelhaul meself than spend one instant with than lyin' whoreson! Aye, ye'd not catch me dead goin' to yer stinkin' Gold Saucer with─bah! Just bugger off, already!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_100_110: Nay─from crayfish to catfish, goby to gudgeon, I've seen my share of sea creatures...but there's not a puffer in these parts so pointy as you.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A9_000_001: If it is spectacular spines you seek, none are senior to Senor Sabotender!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A9_000_002: And he makes a marvelous Manderville mascot!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_000_111: You're one suave sabotender, certainly. So much so, I suspect you sailed in from the Gold Saucer...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_100_111: But I'm sorry to say that salt-of-the-sea types like yours truly aren't suited to sordid gil-seeking. Simpler pleasures are my preference.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A10_000_001: But you could partake in libations to delight even the most discerning epicure!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A10_000_002: But haven't you dreamed of winning a fortune in the Cactpot!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A10_000_003: But don't you want to feast your eyes on the realm's most gorgeous garb!?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_000_112: Can't say I care much for such flights of fancy, . If you're looking for someone to bite that bait, you'd be better off speaking with Sisipu.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_113: Your sales pitch seems to have missed its mark. Perhaps a different approach might be more effective?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_000_114: What's this you say? Can I assume that this gorgeous garb adorns the figures of lasses both buxom and bonny?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_000_115: Well, why didn't you say so sooner!? I'll net the next airship to this Saucer of yours. Still, we should keep this between you, me, and the sabotender─let Sisipu assume I'm off on an extended angling excursion.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_KYOKYOROON_000_120: Kyokyoroon welcomes well-come customer! Customer, be welcome!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_KYOKYOROON_100_120: Not customer? Not come with custom?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_KYOKYOROON_000_121: Sparklies? Kyokyoroon love sparklies! Kyokyoroon can find sparklies at this Gold Saucer?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A11_000_001: You could learn how to dazzle and delight your customers!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A11_000_002: You could hit the Cactpot and become a gillionaire!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_A11_000_003: You could drink the tastiest libations in the realm!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_KYOKYOROON_000_122: Kyokyoroon puzzled by puzzling customer. Kyokyoroon not so interested now... Kyokyoroon busy with business. Too busy for bafflement.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_123: Your sales pitch seems to have missed its mark. Perhaps a different approach might be more effective?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_KYOKYOROON_000_124: Sparklies! Lots of sparklies! Kyokyoroon love sparklies more than customer. Kyokyoroon go to Gold Saucer straightway. Come back with many sparklies!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_125: You have done your best to spread word of the Gold Saucer among the residents of Limsa. All that is left is to reconvene with the staff by the Aftcastle and hope that your efforts bear fruit.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_127: Aye, I reckon a fancy new cocktail or two might be a fittin' addition to the Bismarck's menu! I'll be makin' the trip to the Gold Saucer soon as I'm able.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_RHOSWEN_000_128: Hmph. I suppose this Saucer place might make for an amusin' jaunt sometime...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_WAWALAGO_000_129: I'm off to the Gold Saucer to see the sights! If Sisipu mentions me, mum's the word.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_KYOKYOROON_000_130: Kyokyoroon love sparklies! Saucer has many sparklies? Kyokyoroon go look for sparklies at Saucer straightaway!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_100_130: You cannot help but feel that the crowd is sparser than it was just before.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_131: I have urgent orders from our superiors. All staff are to conclude their missions and make preparations to return to the Saucer posthaste!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_132: You can feel Senor Sabotender's piercing gaze upon you. It would seem that he strongly wishes you to return to the Saucer with him.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_133: I take it you'll be coming back as well? If so, pray come to the landing as soon as you're able.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_100_133: In order to continue this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_SYSTEM_000_134: Senor Sabotender says nothing, but gazes earnestly in your eyes. You get the distinct sense he is counting on your aid.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_LYNGSATH_000_140: So, where can a man get 'imself one o' those drinks that they're sayin' are the talk o' the realm?
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_STAFFA04584_000_141: Ah! Clearly, you are an individual of discerning tastes. Right this way, my good sir...
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_142: As you can see, business is booming. I'm pleased to say that we've even welcomed quite a few new guests from Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_143: Clearly, the efforts of my colleagues have paid off in more ways than one─and they could not have done it without you. Master Roland will doubtless be thrilled.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_144: Would that we could continue our promotion efforts afield for a while longer... But I fear that we need every able-bodied attendant here at home to deal with the ever-burgeoning crowds.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_145: That's your cue, Senor Sabotender! Let's give our guests a warm welcome─Gold Saucer-style!
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_146: In any event, I thank you. Not only have you helped us to expand our clientele, but─as you can see with your own eyes─Senor Sabotender is back to his typical energetic self.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_147: As his colleague and his friend, I cannot begin to express my gratitude.
TEXT_FESGSC601_04584_OLLIER_000_148: I can, however, offer you this as a small token of our thanks. Till our paths cross again, may fortune smile upon you at the Saucer!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_008: If only I could garner more interest...
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_RABBITMISSIONARY_00: Greetings, . From your bearing, I gather you are an adventurer. If so, there is a matter I would discuss with you!

Ah, but where are my manners? I am the usagi bugyo, a member of a delegation hailing from Hingashi, a nation in the Far East. Each year, we travel across the seas to share our tradition of Heavensturn with the peoples of Eorzea.

In this realm, it is held that the gods raise up one amongst their number each year to serve as a herald of good fortune. In the Far East, however, 'tis not a god, but one of twelve noble beasts that is chosen.
In previous Heavensturn celebrations, we gifted participants kabuto fashioned after the presiding beast. But this year, we have an even greater reward: an entire set of armor!
Lest you wonder, I am wearing the very prize we offer. Magnificent, is it not? Surely you wish to claim a set for yourself?

If you do, I encourage you to speak with the omikujishi standing near the Tempest Gate. He is a member of our delegation, and would be honored to present you with the armor. You need but heed his request.
Seek out the omikujishi near the Tempest Gate. He is in charge of this year's celebration, and will tell you how to participate─and win yourself this magnificent armor!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_010: Greetings, friend. I take it you have spoken with my associate, the usagi bugyo, and are willing to lend your assistance.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_011: Before I make any request of you, may I ask if you are at all familiar with the word “omikuji”?
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_A1_000_001: As a matter of fact, I am.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_013: Truly? To know omikuji, you must be familiar with the culture of the Far East indeed! That being so, I will keep my explanation of it brief.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_014: Omikuji, my friend. 'Tis an old tradition of the Far East, one I would not expect the people of this land to know.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_015: A form of fortune-telling, omikuji may be translated as “sacred lots” in your tongue. One receives a lot at random, and with it a message from the divine upon a piece of parchment.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_016: The message contains principles that describe what will bring one fortune─or misfortune. By taking these principles to heart, one will be visited with happiness.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_017: Omikuji are an indispensable part of the Heavensturn celebration in the Far East, and I'm honored for the opportunity to share this tradition with the people of Eorzea.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_018: Alas, perhaps due to a lack of familiarity, but a few souls have stopped to have their fortune told thus far... And this brings me to my request. If you are willing, I ask that you spread word of this auspicious opportunity to the townsfolk.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_019: You have my thanks! As a local, I trust you know where to look for potential participants. I look forward to receiving those souls you send my way!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_020: My thanks again for spreading word of the omikuji. I look forward to receiving those souls you send my way!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_ITOLWANN_000_030: Far Eastern fortune-telling, you say? I'd wager some of our patrons would be keen. Fortune favors the bold, after all, and most here don't want for audacity─sense be damned.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_ITOLWANN_000_031: I'll nudge a few customers your way while taking orders. It's the least I can do in return for the extra business we get thanks to Heavensturn.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_ITOLWANN_000_131: Folk need no encouragement to drink themselves under the table, but they need even less this time of year. I'll be mindful of who I send your way.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_HILDELANA_000_133: Just like that, another Heavensturn's upon us. As much as Beaudefoin and I enjoy chaperoning the Moonfire Faire, I must say it's nice to simply lose yourself in a festival.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_BEAUDEFOIN_000_032: A traditional test of luck for the new year? Consider me intrigued! As proud chaperones of the Moonfire Faire, we have a responsibility to learn what we can from other festivals.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_HILDELANA_000_033: The idea of entrusting one's fortune to chance is a bit too superstitious for my liking, but I'm certainly curious. We'll be sure to let our colleagues in the Adventurers' Guild know about it.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_RHOSWEN_000_034: I'd known the Far Easterners were back fer 'Eavensturn, but they're doin' fortune-tellin' as well this time, ye say?
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_RHOSWEN_000_035: These fortunes... They say anythin' about relationships? Ye know, between a man an' a woman?
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_RHOSWEN_000_036: J-Just curious, is all. D-Don't get any strange ideas.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_RHOSWEN_000_136: Reckon I'll go an' check out this omikuji. N-Not that I put any store by such nonsense, mind ye. I've got free time, is all...
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_TRACHRAET_000_037: I've seen my fair share of 'Eavensturn celebrations, but I can't say I've 'eard o' this omikuji business afore. Does sound interestin', though.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_TRACHRAET_000_038: When me shift ends, I'll head over with some comrades. Might make a nice diversion, an' I'll take the opportunity to welcome the Far Eastern delegation on behalf o' the Maelstrom.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_TRACHRAET_000_138: The Far Easterners come 'ere every year to share their culture with us. Least I can do is greet 'em properly on behalf o' the Maelstrom.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_040: You have finished spreading word of the omikuji? My heartfelt thanks!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_041: I daresay we can expect some participants to appear soon. Please stay and observe the proceedings!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_042: Welcome, one and all! It is my pleasure to introduce to you a time-honored fortune-telling tradition of the Far East: the omikuji!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_043: The process is simple. Begin by shaking yonder box until it dispenses a stick. There will be a number on the stick, which indicates which of these drawers you are to open.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_044: Take a piece of paper from that drawer. Upon it your fortune is written.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_045: Once you have read your fortune, you may tie the parchment to the rack yonder. By doing so, good fortune will become better still, whilst misfortune will be cleansed. Alternately, you may also keep the parchment with you to guide you throughout the year.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_046: So...who wishes to learn their fortune first?
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_HILDELANA_000_047: Yesss! Mine says “great fortune”─the luckiest you can get! There isn't a single negative thing written on it. Hehe, I can throw myself wholeheartedly into adventuring this year!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_BEAUDEFOIN_000_048: D-Damn it all! Mine says...“grave misfortune.” I'm doomed... Doomed, I tell you!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_RHOSWEN_000_049: “The one yer waitin' fer is on their way”...? “The love o' yer life will appear”...? Th-This is all too sudden!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_050: Ahhh, 'tis a fine feeling to have others experience and enjoy your culture... Now, what of you, my friend? Would you care to learn your own fortune? As thanks for your help, the first lot will be free of charge.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_A2_000_002: No thanks─I determine my own fortune.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_052: I must say, there is something to be admired in those who would make their own way. But should you change your mind during the festivities, you are always welcome to give it a try.
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_053: Then go on, give the box a good shake!
TEXT_FESNYR901_04588_OMIKUJISHI_000_054: Allow me to thank you once more. Without your help, these folk may never have discovered omikuji. Whatever the divine may have in store for you, I pray the coming year will bring you happiness.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_104: Goodness, I can't believe I'd never heard of omikuji before this!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_105: Ugh, what am I supposed to do now...?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_001: Forgive me, my friend, but might I ask for another moment of your time?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_002: In no small part due to your assistance, many are enjoying their first experience with omikuji. For some, however, it appears to be a source of stress...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_003: These two adventurers, for example, drew opposite results...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_004: “Great fortune,” it says! Can you believe it!? That means I have naught to fear... Aye, this is my chance to make it big as an adventurer!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_005: Seven hells, what a dreadful Heavensturn this turned out to be... “Grave misfortune”? What did I do to deserve such rotten luck?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_006: Do not be so disheartened, my friend. Though omikuji may foretell fortune and misfortune, they also provide us with guidance in our daily lives.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_007: A great blessing can become a curse should one view it as a license to act rashly. Similarly, a great curse can become a blessing should one heed its warning. What you make of your lot depends on you.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_008: So you say...but just look at Hildelana. At how happy she is. Why can't I be like that...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_009: My words failed to reach him, alas, but perhaps yours can. Could you try to rally his spirits?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_010: I cannot bear to see the poor man this way. Please, try to rally his spirits.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_120: Ah, woe is me! What am I to do when misfortune awaits me at every turn?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SYSTEM_000_121: Beaudefoin is crestfallen. Perhaps there is something you can do to rally his spirits.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_020: Ah, woe is me! What am I to do when misfortune awaits me at every turn?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SYSTEM_000_021: Beaudefoin is crestfallen. Perhaps there is something you can do to rally his spirits.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_022: Thank you for trying to cheer me up. I appreciate it, truly. But you do not understand the burden I bear. The burden of “grave misfortune” that weighs heavily upon my soul...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_023: This is rather more serious than I thought... Please, can you think of any other ways to lift him out of his malaise?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_024: The man seems convinced that he is hopelessly cursed, which is not at all the case. Please, try to lift him out of his malaise.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SYSTEM_000_131: Beaudefoin remains downcast. As a fellow adventurer, perhaps you have the capacity to psych him up.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SYSTEM_000_031: Beaudefoin remains downcast. As a fellow adventurer, perhaps you have the capacity to psych him up.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_032: Y-You're right. I mustn't give up the fight. And yet...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_033: Do you feel better, my friend?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_034: I see... If I may, what did the omikuji say in its entirety? As I mentioned, they do not only foretell one's fate, but also provide guidance in one's daily life.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_035: I must confess, I didn't see anything beyond the words “grave misfortune,” so shocked I was. I ought to have a proper read, I suppose. Let's see here...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_036: “Adventure: Thou must think of others before thyself.” Well, that isn't so bad. And next...“Prosperity: Prepare to lose thy treasured armor”...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_037: <whimper> I knew I shouldn't have read the blasted thing... This set of armor is my pride and joy─I worked myself to the bone earning the gil to pay for it. And now I'm going to lose it all...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_038: Come now, let us read the omikuji to the end!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_039: Look: “As the Navigator maintaineth Her net, so too must thou tend to thy friendships. Let not camaraderie's weave fall into disrepair.” ...Sage advice, would you not agree?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_A1_000_001: Treasure your comrades, and your luck may change for the better.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_A1_000_002: What matters is how you choose to act.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_041: Yes... Yes, you are right. My thanks to the two of you for helping me to see sense.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_043: Mochi daikan! Calm down and tell us what ails you.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_044: I-I was preparing for the mochi pounding when a young adventurer, cheerful and fearless, emerged from the city...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_045: At first I didn't pay her much mind...but then to my horror, she ran afoul of a group of enormous fiends! The monstrosities overwhelmed her in mere moments, and I rushed here as quickly as I could for help.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_046: A cheerful and fearless young adventurer? Kami preserve, could it be Hildelana!?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_047: What!? But...how can this be? She was supposed to have “great fortune”!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_048: Ugh, but this isn't the time for such questions... I must go to her aid!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_051: You strike me as an adventurer of considerable prowess. Will you not go after Beaudefoin and lend your aid if necessary?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_053: As much as I wish to help, I would only be a hindrance. Please see that both Hildelana and Beaudefoin are safe.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_060: Followed me here, did you? We both took a bit of a beating, but I'm pleased to say we're still breathing.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_061: I finished the guild's request without issue, but then I got greedy. If Beaudefoin hadn't arrived when he did, who knows what might have happened...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_062: I merely did what any friend would, Hildelana. I'm just glad I made it in time.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_063: I shouldn't have put you through that. And look what's become of your armor... I'm so sorry, Beaudefoin. It's broken because of me...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_064: Oh, don't mention it. It's a small price for protecting a dear friend, and one I'd willingly pay again and again.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_065: Heh, but if this didn't play out exactly as the omikuji had foretold...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_066: Well, let's return to the city. For one, I need to pay the armorers a visit, but we'll look for you afterwards!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_067: What a relief that neither of them came to lasting harm... Let us head back ourselves. The omikujishi will doubtless be eager to hear the tidings.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_069: Ah, there you are. Hopefully Beaudefoin and Hildelana will join us as well.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_070: Welcome back, my friend! I understand everyone is safe, but what happened out there?
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_071: My friends, I cannot well express how relieved I am for your preservation. It is because I failed to explain the omikuji in sufficient detail that you met with danger. I can't apologize enough...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_072: Please do not blame yourself. I'm the one who overestimated my own abilities. Having “great fortune” doesn't mean that one can act without due care, I realize this now.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_073: And I would have realized sooner had I properly read the omikuji beforehand. “Adventure: The way shall open to those who know their limits,” it says...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_074: But there's more. “Relationships: Thou shalt be blessed with stalwart comrades.” And I truly am.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_MOCHIDAIKAN_000_075: Ah, that reminds me─what became of your armor? You wished to have it repaired, I believe.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_076: Unfortunately, it was too far gone. The armorer told me it would make more sense to have a new one crafted...not that I have that sort of coin either.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_RABBITMISSIONARY_00: In that case, I believe we can be of service. We offer a set of yoroi─armor, in your tongue─as a reward to those who have helped to make this Heavensturn celebration better. You have more than earned it.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_078: Truly!? This sounds too good to be true...
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_RABBITMISSIONARY_00: Ah, but it is true, my friend, and no more than you deserve. Come now, don't be shy. Take your prize and try it on!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_BEAUDEFOIN_000_080: It's magnificent! Just magnificent! Heh, and to think my omikuji said “grave misfortune”!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_081: Take this as a lesson that, no matter your fortune, you still hold the power to shape your fate. And I believe the yoroi suits you well, if I might add.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_082: As you will recall, your fortune cautioned you to put the needs of others before yourself. And so you did, by risking your life to save your comrade. That selfless act may well have reversed your “grave misfortune.”
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_HILDELANA_000_083: I see! ...Actually, I don't. I don't really understand the workings of omikuji, but I do know that I'll always have Beaudefoin's back, just as he's always had mine. And, now that he has a new set of armor, perhaps we can take to the road. Together.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_084: I can't thank you enough for helping with the many unexpected troubles that occurred this day. I would be honored if you'd accept a set of yoroi of your own.
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_OMIKUJISHI_000_085: Furthermore, should you wish to draw omikuji, you need only say the word. Indeed, I hope to see you many more times before the festivities end!
TEXT_FESNYR902_04589_SYSTEM_000_086: You may now draw omikuji for the remainder of the Heavensturn festivities this year by speaking with the Far Eastern omikujishi.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: A happy Hatching-tide to you, friend! Are the eggsquisite decorations you see about you to your liking?
Wait, I know that face... If it isn't ! What a pleasure to see you!
Ah, but where are my manners? My name is Jihli Aliapoh, and I oversee the centerpiece of the celebration─the gloriously eggstravagant egg hunt!
You are an adventurer, are you not? If it wouldn't be too bold of me, might I ask your name?
─what a lovely and festive ring that has to it! But where was I? Ah, yes─the egg hunt! The tradition began several years ago, after I was blessed with a vision by the Twelve Archons of ages past.

As it happens, I was visited by a most curious dream again this year. In it, brave adventurers─not unlike yourself─were going about town, handing out decorative eggs in the company of, er...chickens and odd-looking rabbits.

Truth be told, I have struggled to grasp its true meaning. Still, if the past is any guide, the best way to get to the bottom of this is for us to recreate the image from my dream and see what good fortune it may bring!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_00: To that end, I've invited Master Pawlin─Limsa Lominsa's preeminent chicken farmer─and his flock here to Gridania, and furthermore placed an order for a full fluffle of rabbit-esque mammets resembling the ones from my dream.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: We have, however, hit a bit of a snag. It would appear the hens have not yet gotten acclimated to their new environment, and they've been raising quite the ruckus─making it nigh impossible to retrieve the eggs they've laid. Might you be willing to lend a hand?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Now that's a  after my own heart! You will be compensated handsomely in speggtacular rewards, of course! Hmm... That one perhaps needs some work.

In any case, Master Pawlin's chickens are being cooped at the Greatloam Growery─might I ask you to travel there and give them a look? My friend Nonotta works there as well, so I would be most grateful if you could also ensure that she's not...overly harried.
Do pass along my regards to Nonotta at the Greatloam Growery, yes?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_020: Hm? Oh! I...<wheeze>...remember you. Pray forgive me─I'm feeling terribly eggshausted at the moment.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_021: Is there something you need? Pray forgive me─I'm feeling terribly eggshausted at the moment.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_022: Jihli sent you to help? Well, that is most appreciated! In that case, allow me to explain.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_023: While it's true that we've been having trouble rounding up all the eggs, we also face a more pressing concern─the growery has been invaded by bizarre fluffy creatures!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_024: What's more, they're not content just to run around and make mischief. Why, they're tormenting the chickens and trying to steal the eggs for themselves!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_025: Needless to say, that has only driven the chickens into even more of a tizzy. It's been a veritable battlefield! Master Pawlin is doing all he can to keep the creatures contained, but even he seems just about at wit's end...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_027: M-Master Pawlin! Has our last line of defense been breached!? Oh, the poor man...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_030: Egads! Th-That's one of them! Our fearsome invaders from the gods know where!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_032: Good heavens─they both look as if they're out for blood! Whatever are we to do!?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_A2_000_001: Let me try to calm them down.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_A2_000_003: I think we can solve this by force.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_040: Such bravery! ...Not that I expected any less from you. In that case, good luck out there! And remember─close observation of both parties is the key to a successful mediation.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_041: Well, let's see. Perhaps you could attempt to soothe them? Cluck gently, or some such? Yes, do give it a go. And remember─close observation of both parties is the key to a successful mediation.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_042: F-Force!? And here I thought these little critters were savage. Are you perhaps the most savage of them all?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_043: Anyhow, before we resort to violence, perhaps you could attempt to soothe them? Cluck gently, or some such? Yes, do give it a go. And remember─close observation of both parties is the key to a successful mediation.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_044: Drawing upon your extensive experience in confronting myriad savage beasts, you gaze upon the two bloodthirsty creatures intently, taking in their every move and facial expression...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_045: The chicken and the bunny stand at odds, neither willing to give an ilm in their grudge match...or so you assess the situation.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_046: How fascinating... The chicken is understandably on its guard, fearing that the rabbit is targeting its eggs. But could it be that the bunny, too, harbors some resentment of its own?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_047: Now that I think about it, this creature bears a most uncanny resemblance to the rabbits Jihli described from her dream.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_048: I did some research of my own before you arrived─according to the tomes, it is so rare a creature that many consider it simply a myth. Have you by any chance encountered anything similar during your travels?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_050: You don't say!? I would have expected nothing less of a well-traveled adventurer such as yourself. No doubt you are already aware, but these most unique creatures are known in certain parts as...“happy bunnies.” There is something about their long ears, fluffy tails, and hippity-hoppity manner that brings a smile to one's face, yes?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_051: I see... Hardly a surprise, that─after all, very few have ever actually seen one in the flesh. Oh, incidentally, these most unique creatures are known in certain parts as...“happy bunnies.” There is something about their long ears, fluffy tails, and hippity-hoppity manner that brings a smile to one's face, yes?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_052: Yes, precisely! That is exactly where my resources say they were once spotted! As you are doubtless already aware, these most unique creatures are known up north as “happy bunnies.” Something about their long ears, fluffy tails, and hippity-hoppity manner brings a smile to one's face...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_055: Why, legend has it that simply encountering one is a sure sign that good fortune is headed your way. While they are not precisely the same creature, perhaps our most unique guests will also have a similarly auspicious effect on us?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_056: You, there! Mister Bunny! If you are truly as happy at heart as your compatriots of legend, might you not make peace with these fine chickens, and cooperate with us to make this year's festivities an eggstravaganza of merriment and good cheer?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_059: B-But this won't do! Why, our harbinger of happiness is fleeing from our very grasp─and our last chicken is running off with it! Something must be done!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_060: If Jihli's dreams are to be trusted─and I've never known them to be anything but─those bunnies and their unique power are the key to making this year's Hatching-tide festivities a rousing success!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_061: I beg of you, friend─follow those creatures! They may lead you to their fellow escapees. I'll do the same just as soon as I see to Master Pawlin's wounds.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_062: I wasn't able to make out where they were headed, but no doubt there was an eyewitness or two nearby. Pray gather what information you can, and round up the little critters as best as you are able. We can rendezvous back in town with Jihli.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_063: Were you able to find anyone who witnessed our bunnies' escape? I fear that Master Pawlin's wounds still demand my attention, so I'm counting on you to round them all up!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_PAWLIN_100_063: I did my best to calm them as their talons raged and rent my silks to shreds... Alas, it was to no avail.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_PAWLIN_000_064: Whatever could have gotten into my dear hens to send them into such a fluster? Why, I simply must go after─ow, that stings!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB4_000_065: Well, that was a sight if I've ever seen one. Bizarre-looking bunnies and chickens racing by me as if possessed...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB4_000_066: They were headed over that way─toward New Gridania. I can only hope they don't cause too much of a stir in town...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB4_100_065: Well, that was a sight if I've ever seen one. Bizarre-looking bunnies and chickens racing by me as if possessed...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB4_100_066: They were headed over that way─toward New Gridania. I can only hope they don't cause too much of a stir in town...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB1_000_070: Chickens and rabbits? They were headed for the aetheryte plaza. Go after them if you like─the Adders don't pay nearly enough for me to get mixed up in all this.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB1_000_071: But that chicken...why, I've never seen such a fierce-looking bird.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB2_000_072: Chickens and rabbits? Oh, I saw a whole army of them running off to the Carline Canopy!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB2_000_073: A whole army of strange rabbit-things and clucking chickens ran off toward the Carline Canopy! And there was a person in an odd costume running after them... Hatching-tide gets curiouser and curiouser every year!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_000_074: <huff> <huff> How do they get around so fast on those tiny legs? I'm not cut out for this...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_100_074: What's that? They're where now!? Good gods. ...Understood. I'll enlist the services of an able adventurer right away.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_000_075: Matron's teats! Don't sneak up on me like─ Wait a moment. Are you, perchance, an adventurer!?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_100_075: Nonotta sent you in search of the bunnies, you say? How fortuitous! That linkpearl call just now was from her─and she's tasked me with doing the very same.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_000_076: ...Just between you and me, however, I've yet to catch a single one. As I was running after them, their friends started showing up one after the next, and before I knew it, a veritable legion of them had hippity-hopped their way into the Twelveswood.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_000_077: I fear there's far too many of them for the two of us to handle alone. I'll go and call for reinforcements─could I trouble you to go on ahead to the Mirror Planks? According to Nonotta, that's where they were last sighted.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_2022ESTMOB3_100_077: In the meantime, I will do my best to rally others to our cause. Now, go quickly, friend─the fate of this year's Hatching-tide hangs in the balance!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_078: The FATE “Happiness Is a Warm Bunny” can only be completed as a Disciple of War or Magic.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: Oh, ! Say no more─I've heard everything. My sincere apologies for all the trouble we had to put you through, but let it suffice to say your efforts have all but saved this year's Hatching-tide from disaster!
Some stragglers are still running about, but we've captured the better part of both flocks. Nonotta, Master Pawlin, and my colleagues should be able to round up the rest in due time.
But there's even more good news! It seems the exercise went a long way to soothe our savage chickens, and we've retrieved eggs in abundance to decorate!
Ah, Nonotta! Master Pawlin! Allow me to thank you for your efforts, as well. I was just sharing the happy tidings with  here.
Wait...is this perchance one of the “happy bunnies” that were the source of this whole hullabaloo? Why, they truly are the spitting image of the little critters that came to me in my vision!
Seeing how calm and well-behaved it is now, I can scarcely believe it gave you such trouble! Your other chickens are resting easy now, I gather?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_PAWLIN_000_086: No worries there, Jihli, my dear! My birds have spent up all their nervous energy, and are as relaxed now as I've ever seen them. Why, after their little spat, it even seems that they've come to a mutual understanding with their fluffy new friends.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_087: I'm happy to say that the rabbits, too, are now obeying our attendants with scarcely a peep of argument. And─wouldn't you know it─just before, one of them handed us this crystal!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: Could it be...!? Why, they truly are harbingers of happiness and good fortune!

I have a good feeling about this, . Do come back later so I can fill you in on the details, yes? Needless to say, I'll also have a special something for you as a token of thanks for your services. As for now, I must prepare for the festivities...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_09: In the meantime, could I trouble you to lead these little fellows through the streets and join them in handing out eggs to the townspeople? If my dreams are any guide, I'm sure it will bring no end of smiles to one and all!
Well, aren't we all so eager? That's what I like to see!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_094: And with that, I'd best be putting the final decorative touches on these eggs! Whenever you're ready, just say the word!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: Curious as to just what sort of good fortune the bunnies have brought us? Tee hee...I knew you would be! And when we're both done with our duties, I'd be more than happy to tell you! In the meantime, good luck handing out those eggs!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_PAWLIN_000_101: If you hadn't taken care of the rabbits for us, I daresay it would have been all but impossible to round up my flock. Truly, I can't thank you enough!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_101: The happy bunny seems most proud of itself. It looks at you with eyes that seem to say, “Handing out eggs? I was born for this!”
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_104: The chicken looks at you with a warm, gentle gaze─as if to say that it is more than happy to entrust the precious eggs laid by its flock to you and your friends.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_105: Ready to start handing out some eggs? Lovely! In that case, here you go─pray take our little friends along and spread happiness the whole city over!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_Q4_000_000: Where will you hand out eggs?
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NICOLIAUX_000_110: A decorated egg? For me? How thoughtful!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NICOLIAUX_000_111: There's even a treat inside! Thank you ever so much.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_ESUMIYAN_000_112: Your efforts are sincerely appreciated. These seasonal celebrations bring so much joy to the children─and myself, I confess.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_ESUMIYAN_000_113: Still, I must say...it's been years since I've seen a traveler rabbit in the flesh. I never would have expected to encounter one here.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_ESUMIYAN_000_114: What's that? That nomenclature is unfamiliar to you? Ah, in the North they are known more...colloquially...as “happy bunnies,” are they not? They're said to usher in smiles and good fortune...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_ESUMIYAN_000_115: Before that─yes, since much older times─they were known as “traveler rabbits.” They have a habit of showing up at your side unannounced, then vanishing off somewhere before you know it. I recall seeing one in the Twelveswood when I was but a child.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_ESUMIYAN_000_116: Ah, but forgive me... You have other places you must be. We can talk another time─pray relax and enjoy the festivities when your work is done.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_FORESTLOVINGRABBIT_: Why, I daresay the wood used to fashion those decorations was among the finest I've ever laid eyes on. As always, your eye for quality timber is simply unparalleled.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_GRASSSTAINEDRABBIT_: You're far too kind, Master Bea─ I mean...my forest-loving, floppy-eared friend. Likewise, I have no doubt the wood rejoiced to find itself in the hands of one who understands it as well as you.
Oh! If it isn't ! How good it is to see you well.
An adventurer? I don't believe we've met...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_FORESTLOVINGRABBIT_: An egg for me? And what a charming little fellow carrying it. I accept your gift with gratitude.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_GRASSSTAINEDRABBIT_: How very clever you are! Though I did hear a rumor of some concern...
Yes, a little bird told me that creatures bearing no small resemblance to you were running wild through the streets of Gridania, trampling our precious greenery...
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_FORESTLOVINGRABBIT_: ...And nibbling at the bark of our precious trees─a most disconcerting story if there is any truth to it.
If my intuition is not mistaken, it appears the little creature is apologizing to us in its own way.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_GRASSSTAINEDRABBIT_: Well, as long as you've learned your lesson, I do believe we can forgive and forget.
Thank you for the thoughtful gift, and the happiest of Hatching-tides to you!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_REFINEDRABBIT_000_1: Greetings, . It is always a pleasure to have you here in Gridania...and 'twould seem you've befriended some rather charming little helpers!
Why, what a lovely egg. How very kind of you.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_RELAXEDRABBIT_000_1: And there's the most toothsome-looking little cake inside! Do stop by the Canopy when we've finished here─I've a brew that will accompany it perfectly.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_REFINEDRABBIT_000_1: , on behalf of all Gridania, allow me to thank you and your little colleagues for making this year's Hatching-tide so memorable. Once your work has concluded, I hope you will have time to relax and take in the cheer of the season.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_RELAXEDRABBIT_000_1: You and your new friends are welcome to stop by for a cup of tea as well, should the mood strike you.
...Though I daresay you ought to claim a table sooner rather than later. These sweets will draw adventurers by the droves!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_150: Oh, you're back! I do hope the eggsperience was an enjoyable one!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_15: Welcome back, ! How did you and your little friends fare?
Splendid to hear! At first, I feared that my dreams might bring only chaos and confusion to the realm this year, but thanks to you, I do believe we can declare this year's egg hunt a rousing success!
Oh, but how could I forget? In recognition of your tireless efforts on our behalf, my fellow Dreamers and I have prepared a very special Hatching-tide present just for you.

Did I mention how I procured mammets from the Goldsmiths' Guild for the festivities? This is one of them. Sadly, it was completely lifeless from the moment of arrival─it seems its core had come loose and fallen out on the way here.
But would you believe it? I slipped in that crystal the little bunny gave me, and in an instant its tail puffed up and it whirred back to life!
I'm quite confident it will bring its caretaker nothing but good fortune and smiles galore─and I would very much like that person to be you, . Thank you from the very bottom of my heart!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_NONOTTA_000_157: Now that all the hard work is done, I do hope you'll have the chance to relax and enjoy the festivities for yourself─they've only just begun, after all. And should you find yourself in the mood to help us hand out some more eggs, simply say the word!
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_100_158: Should you wish to replay the gift-giving task from the quest “Hippity, Hoppity, Happily,” speak with Nonotta again.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_159: If fortune smiles upon you, you may even find yourself encountering individuals who were not present in your initial venture.
TEXT_FESEST801_04590_SYSTEM_000_160: Furthermore, you have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. Open the toy chest in any inn room to try your hand at this seasonal pastime.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_BARDIN_000_001: Ahoy there, . Yer keen to visit one o' them island sanctuaries, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_BARDIN_000_002: Bugger me, yer unaware o' the fuss goin' on 'bout this 'ole affair?
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_BARDIN_000_003: <sigh> If ye 'ead southeast from 'ere─the isle o' Vylbrand, that is─ye'll reach the Cieldalaes. 'Venturers much like yerself've been granted the right to cultivate a number o' the deserted isles there.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_BARDIN_000_004: Don't get yer 'opes up, though. Ain't as if any and all can go an' get 'emselves a permit fer one o' them sanctuaries. Far as I can tell, 'ole project's still in its infancy, an' the Admiral's bloody fussy about candidates.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_BARDIN_000_005: Tell ye what─since I like ye, I'll take ye to any mate of yers' isle, safe an' sound. Ye need only say the word.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_SYSTEM_100_010: You may now visit the island sanctuary of a party member, free company member, or friend who has unlocked the feature by speaking with Baldin in the Moraby Drydocks.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_SYSTEM_100_011: You will be unable to visit an island sanctuary if the owner has forbidden access to their island, there is no one on the isle in question, or if the isle in question has already reached its maximum capacity.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_SYSTEM_100_012: Furthermore, you must be on an acquaintance's Home World if you wish to visit their island sanctuary.
TEXT_AKTKUA102_04644_SYSTEM_000_010: To unlock your personal island sanctuary, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Endwalker,” and proceed through the quest “Seeking Sanctuary.”
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SYSTEM_100_000: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 90 or above. Limited jobs are not permitted.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_001: Hello, how may I help yooou...you're , aren't you?
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_002: Aha! I thought I recognized that heroic mien!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_003: How wonderful to meet you! The name's Osmon.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_004: I'm a gleaner, as you may have surmised, mostly specializing in the collection of rare and curious books...and it would seem fate has brought us together!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_005: My work has given me an appetite for well-crafted stories, you see, but recently I've struggled to find any truly engaging material.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_006: So I thought to myself, “Self! Why waste all this time bemoaning the lack of quality literature, when you could be writing the exact kind of tales you enjoy!”
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_007: Which is why I'm so excited to be speaking with the vaunted champion, ! If I could convince you to share some of the minutiae of your adventures, it would lend my fiction an undeniable authenticity!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_A1_100_001: Let me tell you about the time I was just starting out...
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_A1_100_002: Here's a story of the Dragonsong War you may not have heard...
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_A1_100_003: Well, when I stood beside the Resistance fighters of Ala Mhigo, and later, of Doma...
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_A1_100_004: There's a lot to consider when you visit another world...or the world of the past...
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_010: (-???-)Well, that was a complete waste of─ Osmon? Are you actually chatting!? Scholar above, it's a miracle! And here I thought you capable of little more than grunts and sighs!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_011: Ugh... May I introduce Shallow Moor, my colleague and eternal tormentor.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_012: Oh, come now, it's just a bit of playful banter. Trisassant and I could use some good humor after failing to track down our quarry...
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_014: , this is an honor...and an incredible stroke of luck! You are the very person we've been searching for.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_015: If you will indulge me for a moment, I can explain the situation at hand.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_100_016: As you know, Sharlayan was charged in antiquity with fulfilling a sacred duty─a duty which kept the gleaners buzzing to and fro like angry hornets.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_017: Aye, we would complete one grueling list of procurements, only to be handed yet another. Then another. The work was all we knew.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_100_018: But now that those days are behind us, the tasks have slowed to a trickle. And we find ourselves, well, strangely idle.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_100_019: Thus the guildship, in its wisdom, has forged a partnership with the Adventurers' Guild. We now have a system in place where odd jobs from other countries can be funneled here to us in Sharlayan!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_020: The tasks they pass on to us are, for the most part, naught your average gleaner cannot handle.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_021: There is one client, however, who has asked for you specifically. And as the Adventurers' Guild has no official presence in our city, we agreed to the “odd job” of facilitating that request─think of us as their substitute Sharlayan branch, if you will.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_022: In any case, I'll be here at the counter, ready to provide you with the details! It doesn't appear to be an urgent matter, so feel free to engage the request whenever your schedule allows.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SHALLOWMOOR_000_023: Oh, and be sure to browse Trisassant's wares. He has a special selection available for anyone who takes part in our odd job enterprise!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_000_024: Ah, ...? I didn't quite get the chance before Shallow Moor commandeered the conversation, but I wanted to thank you for indulging me with your stories.
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_OSMON_100_024: Do you think we might talk again sometime? I should love to hear how this odd job of yours turns out!
TEXT_AKTKVA001_04651_SYSTEM_100_025: As a result of the partnership between the Adventurers' Guild and the gleaners' guildship, you are now able to accept an odd job from Shallow Moor at the peristyle.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_000:
As dawnlight kisses sky above,
So too eternal beams my love.
Though dusk may drown the world in grey,
The night shall taste─
...Why, hello there!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_001: If it isn't my hero of zeal, my champion of cherishers! 'Tis ever a pleasure to meet you in this rosiest of seasons.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_002: You, my dear adventurer, have the unmistakable gleam of a  who would champion the cause of love─of Valentione's Day!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_003: If you have a moment, I should be much obliged to hear your thoughts upon a certain matter of the heart. Of my heart, to be precise...
