TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_004: You see, my sister Astrid has been demanding to lead the celebrations this year. Yet while her enthusiasm does her credit, I simply cannot shirk my responsibilities as head emissary of ardor!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_100_005: No matter what I say, she refuses to budge on the matter, but perhaps she would heed reason were it to come from an impartial party─and such a charming one at that! So I beg you, will you not try to talk some sense into her?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_006: I heard what my sister told you, but I simply must be allowed to oversee the festivities this year! I have my reasons!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_007: Lisette herself has a love. Yet she devotes all her time and energy to the happiness of others when she should be focusing on her own!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_008: I must confess, I didn't always approve of my sister's choice of partner. With his lowly upbringing, I had believed Hortefense didn't deserve her.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_009: But through my work as an emissary, I've come to realize that such things as birth and station matter not so long as there is love.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_010: And you should be embracing this occasion to foster that love instead of worrying about others!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_011: <sigh> Look here, Astrid. I appreciate your concern, I do, but the reputation of House Valentione hinges on the success of these celebrations.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_012: As lady of the house, I've labored to ensure that everything has gone smoothly, year in and year out. Failure is not an option─you understand this, yes?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_013: I know this full well, Sister, and I won't fail us. I even have the assistance of our new emissary-in-training.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A1_000_001: I say leave it to Astrid. And if it'd make you feel better, I'll help too.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A1_000_002: Will this emissary-in-training spend more time helping or, you know...training?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_014: Well now, who am I to turn away an offer of help from such a charming adventurer?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_100_015: I must say, the thought did cross my mind...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_015: ...Then, would you be willing to assist us too, adventurer? Yours would be a most reassuring presence in our efforts!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_016: Yes, with your good self watching over Astrid, I believe I can entrust this year's celebration to her with an easy heart!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_017: I hereby leave our legacy in your hands. So long as you stay true to your heart, you will surely do us proud.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_018: And even should something go awry, fret not─there is little I cannot fix with my indubitable charms.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_100_019: I suppose I'll go and...embrace the spirit of the season.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_020: Whew! With Lisette gone, we may finally begin our work. Speaking of which, I must immediately impose upon you.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_021: Originally, I was meant to make the rounds with Emilie, our new recruit, to advertise the event we shall be hosting later on.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_022: However, now that I have officially assumed my sister's responsibilities, I'm required to remain here at her post. Might you accompany Emilie in my stead?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_023: Thank you! Pray wait a moment while I fetch her!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_024: Ahem! In love's fine season, our task is one─to spread gay tidings to all and...one? Erm, allow me to present our new apprentice of affection!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_100_024: Yes, well, the dress is quite a departure from my usual attire. But if I am to follow in Lisette's footsteps, I naturally must adopt her lovely image!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_025: Nice to meet you, adventurer! My name is Emilie, and it will be my pleasure to advertise the festivities together.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_026: Let Emilie know when you are ready to, er...fly forth upon the wings of ardor and spread the word of our happy congregation!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_027: Go forth, my sweet cherubs of passion! Deliver your messages of love and, er...return hither once you're done!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_031: This being my first time promoting an event, I'm not certain how to start talking to strangers... May I ask you to take the lead?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_032: Thank you! I'll be sure to observe you closely. Now then, shall we first head to the Leatherworkers' Guild? I daresay some folk there will be interested in our event.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSA04654_000: Looks like I'm early. Wonder if there's something to do to pass the time...
Looks like I'm early. Wonder if there's something to do to pass the time...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A2_000_001: Come and celebrate Valentione's Day with us!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A2_000_002: Hearken thee, for Valentione's Day, that grand celebration of ardor and affection, is come once more!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_037: Cheerful and to the point─that, I can do!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_038: Amazing! I can imagine Lisette herself delivering such a delightful invitation!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_039: Lali...ho? I-I am not familiar with its meaning, but how unique!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_040: Erm... Valentione's Day celebrations are being held at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre! There will be costumes and merrymaking and a special congregation wherein participants profess their love! Please join us if you have the time.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSA04654_000: Well now, that does sound like fun! I'll head over at once. My thanks for letting me know!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_042: That went well! Let's keep up the good work!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_043: Next, let's head to the Shaded Bower, on the way to the markets. Oh, and I shall try taking the lead this time─your example was most inspiring!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSB04654_000: Aaah, nothing feels so fine as finishing up a good day's work!
Aaah, nothing feels so fine as finishing up a good day's work!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_047: Come and celebrate Valentione's Day with us!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_048: Hearken thee, for Valentione's Day, that grand celebration of ardor and affection, is come once more!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_050: We are hosting Valentione's Day celebrations at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre! Come join us for refreshments, costumes, and a special event wherein participants proclaim their affections.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSB04654_000: A handsome invitation from a handsome lass! How could I refuse? I'll bring my wife too─she loves her festivals!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_52: W-Wonderful! We look forward to seeing you there!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_53: "Handsome“... If anything, I wanted to be winsome.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_54: I'll just have to try harder next time, I suppose...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_55: Well, let's make our way through the Ebony Stalls and to the Centaur's Eye.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSC04654_000: When they say “the quickest way to the heart is through the stomach,” do they mean with chocolates, or...?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_100_061: A very good  to you, miss! Do you not simply adore this sweet season of ardor and affection?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSC04654_000: Oh! You're one of the Valentione's Day people, I take it?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_062: Indeed I am! Over at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, we are hosting a delightful event with gorgeous costumes to try on and an opportunity to speak of love to your heart's content!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_RESIDENTSC04654_000: Well now, what a passionate and dashing emissary you are! Thank you for the invitation─and good luck with the festivities!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_065: I know it was said in kindness, but I just... No. This is no time to complain─not when Astrid's trying so hard to do her sister proud.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_066: She was hesitant about the dress─said that such attire doesn't become her─but she donned it anyway in order to be like Lisette. And she positively shines in it, don't you think?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_100_066: It was to help her shine even brighter that I decided to wear this suit.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_067: I believed it would serve to provide contrast when we're side by side onstage.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_068: But this─this simply isn't me. I've always preferred to look ladylike. Adorable. And being called “handsome” and “dashing” reminds me how far from myself I am right now. I need to persevere, I know this. It isn't the time to be selfish. And yet...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A3_000_001: I don't think having preferences is selfish.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A3_000_002: I'm sure Astrid would want you to feel comfortable.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_069: Truly? Then perhaps...I will speak with Astrid about it.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_070: I'll need a moment to gather my thoughts, but let's meet back at the amphitheatre shortly!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_071: ...A-Adorable? 'Tis very kind of you to compliment me so. Yes, very kind indeed... P-Please enjoy the festivities!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_076: I tried gathering my thoughts...but I still don't know how I should broach the subject with Astrid.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_077: Nevertheless, I'm determined to speak with her, and I would be grateful for your presence.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_080: W-Welcome back, my messengers of...messages. How fared your efforts?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_081: Oh, splendidly! We met many souls eager to celebrate this season of love. But...if I may, there's something I wished to discuss with you...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_100_081: ...L-Later, perhaps. You're looking a little pale, Astrid. Are you feeling well?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_082: Oh, er─fret not, Emilie! I am simply blanched with anticipation for today's most lovely events! Peaked with pleasure, as it were! Er...weak with, I mean!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_083: ...Oh, who am I fooling? The truth is, people have been bombarding me with compliments on my appearance. Every second person says that I look “sweet” or “adorable,” and it's been positively exhausting.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_084: As a daughter of nobility, I know I ought to desire such praise─beauty and grace are highly commendable virtues in our circles, after all.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_085: But one day, I met a knight─a fellow daughter of a noble house─and I found myself drawn to her strength and gallantry.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_086: Our famous ancestor Countess Arabelle was also a skilled warrior, you know. Alas, I've never had the physical disposition for such a rigorous calling.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_087: And though I find comfort in incorporating the spirit of chivalry into my guise and mannerism, if I'm to be an emissary worthy of succeeding Lisette, I must accept the attire that comes with the position, and set aside my own preferences.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A4_000_001: Emilie would be happy to trade outfits with you!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_A4_000_002: Embracing one's own preferences is also an expression of love─self-love.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_088: Uwaaah! Wh-What are you doing!? M-My thoughts─must gather my thoughts!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_089: It may be said that to prefer is to love. Still, as an emissary, I can't allow my personal concerns to interfere with duty.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_090: ...Ahem. Astrid. I know your feelings all too well...for I have them too, though in reverse to you.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_091: I find it uplifting to be called “sweet” or “adorable.” Yet I feel anything but in this “handsome” suit...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_092: As emissaries of love, our duty is to help people embrace their hearts. But how are we to do this if we don't embrace our own? If we don't love ourselves and pursue our own happiness?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_093: You're right, Emilie. You're absolutely right.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_094: There I was, chiding Lisette for ignoring her own happiness. Yet here I am, guilty of doing the very same thing...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_095: In order to become a great emissary like my sister, I had believed that I needed to emulate her completely. But that isn't the case.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_096: No, as my sister herself advised, I need to stay true to my heart.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_097: Only then can I hope to become the best emissary that I can be!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_098: Were it not for your encouragement, Astrid and I might have continued to be miserable, trying to be someone we're not. Thank you for helping us to be true to ourselves!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_ASTRID_000_099: Come, Emilie! Let us trade outfits at once!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_100: Just so... To succeed someone doesn't mean you have to imitate them. Now that Astrid has learned this, she's truly ready to take over the Valentione legacy.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_HORTEFENSE_000_101: Which means we can start considering our future in earnest. Among other things, I still need to pay my respects to your family.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_LISETTE_000_102: Y-Yes, well, we'll get around to it soon enough. Ishgard wasn't built in a day, you know...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_110: You now have access to the Valentione's Ceremony seasonal instance! To enter the venue, speak with the House Valentione servant at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_111: The Valentione's Ceremony is an instance designed for a party of two. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_112: In the event that you register for the ceremony alone, your partner will be found via the matching system.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_120: Emilie is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_121: You can leave Emilie behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_122: If you wish to have Emilie accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_100_122: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_200_123: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to initiate these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_123: Look, you can just see the amphitheatre from here. I simply love Valentione's Day─the soft colors, the hearts, the adorable costumes...
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_124: I'm so glad I found the courage to ask Lisette if I could become an emissary! It's nothing short of a dream come true.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_126: There's no shortage of Valentione's gifts to choose from at the markets. By all accounts, the most popular chocolate is from the Bismarck.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_127: Are you planning to give a special someone a gift too? Assuming you have the skills, they say nothing conveys your feelings quite like chocolates you made yourself. And if you're thinking flowers, a red Azeyma rose never fails to please!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_125: This is my brother-in-law's shop! He proposed to my sister on Valentione's Day, and they've been inseparable ever since!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_128: Let's do our best to gather a big crowd!
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_Q4_000_129: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Emilie?
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_130: Have urgent business, do you? Very well, I'll wait for you at the amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_EMILIE_000_131: Ah, you're back. Let's be off again.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_132: You must be accompanied by Emilie and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESVLT901_04654_SYSTEM_000_133: Emilie has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: My, what a wondrous surprise it is to see you here this fine autumn , my adventurer friend! Your assistance proved most essential to my past investigations, which is why I would again seek your aid.
Why, hello there! You strike me as the goodly sort of adventurer eager to help strangers at a moment's notice, and you couldn't have come at a better time! ...You are eager to help, aren't you?
You have my thanks. Now, tell me─does a traveling circus troupe known as the Continental Circus ring a bell?
Each year, when it comes time for All Saints' Wake, they set up shop here in town, conducting all manner of suspicious activity.

Though they appear to be ordinary performers, each and every last member is a most vile and despicable voidsent. Under the guise of events and festive merrymaking, they carry out acts both mischievous and malevolent.
But worry not, for I have a plan. This year, we shall hold an event of our very own, thereby supplanting their modus operandi. A brilliant scheme, would you not agree?

The main spectacle shall be a costume cortege, but for those without suitable guises, my colleagues at the Alchemists' Guild have devised a most ingenious solution─a special concoction that will temporarily transform any individual into a most ghastly visage!

That is where you come in. You must transform yourself with our potion and speak with the townspeople to spread word of the event. After giving them a good fright, you will need to dispel the enchantment, thus allaying possible concerns of ill effects from our wondrous brew.

A thousand thanks! I have prepared a selection of four elixirs for you to choose from atop the benches beside me. Choose the one that suits your fancy, then go forth and spread word of our costume cortege!
When you've finished, let us rendezvous near the Leatherworkers' Guild. Best of luck!

TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENA104655_000_: H-Hey, now that wasn't very nice! I thought I was done for...

A costume party hosted by the Adventurers' Guild? Well, with a potion like that, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't interested. Who knew it could be so simple to take on such a delightfully monstrous appearance.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENA204655_000_: Uwaaah! Don't just stand there, dearest, do something!
Wait, so... You're not a ghost...? Shame on you, I was nearly frightened to tears!
You were able to transform into that abomination by merely drinking a potion? Well, where might I procure a vial? I'd very much like to pay forward this little prank of yours!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENA304655_000_: Why, if you aren't the most adorable little thing I've ever seen! But where did you come from? Did you get separated from the rest of your litter?
Eek! Who are you, and what have you done with that darling little ball of fur!? ...That was you? Hmph. I refuse to believe you could have been anywhere near so cuddly and cute.
You mean, I too can transform into one of those adorable creatures? Then why am I still talking to you─I have a potion to drink!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENA404655_000_: Ack! ...Wait, a sasquatch? Strolling through the middle of town?
Oh, thank the heavens! I've not gone mad, then. If you were truly a sasquatch, I very much doubt I would live to tell the tale. Hahaha...hah...

I too can become a sasquatch if I were to participate in this costume cortege? I must admit, the idea of becoming something so hideous is rather unappealing, but I would be lying if I said I'm not intrigued. Perhaps I will give it a try.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_000_038: You have spread word of the costume cortege, but more people must know if the investigator's plan is to succeed. Transfigure yourself once more and continue promoting the event.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_Q00_000_040: You will be transfigured into a Continental eye after drinking this concoction. Proceed?

TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_000_044: Your appearance will be changed after drinking the mysterious concoction. After frightening a townsperson in your transfigured state, dispel the enchantment, and inform them of the planned costume cortege.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENB104655_000_: What an unsettling glare! Has no one ever told you it is rude to stare!?
Oh my, what a terribly clever disguise! I must say, I did not see that coming.

A costume cortege? And that alchemical concoction will allow us to masquerade as monsters, you say? If I might see how the world looks from the perspective of a voidsent, and one with a singular eye at that, consider my interest piqued.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENB204655_000_: By the Twelve, a wraith! Run, my love, run! I will fend it off for as long as I can!
M-My word, what is the meaning of this!?
I've heard tell of the upcoming costume cortege, but I didn't realize there might be such frightful fun, actually transforming into monsters. Perhaps we will go after all.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENB304655_000_: A flying...kitten? Adorable as it is, I hope it's not feral...
Oh my, that was you? Goodness, I've never seen such a thing before.
Ah, so you were promoting a costume event. If I too can take the air as an adorable kitten, I should very much like to attend!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_CITIZENB404655_000_: Nophica's teats, what in the world...?
All right , you've got some explaining to do. What the hells is going on?
We can transform into creatures with a mere potion? Had I not seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn't have believed you. Suppose we can at least give it a try.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_000_068: The townsfolk are abuzz with talk of the costume cortege. Rendezvous with the Adventurers' Guild investigator near the Leatherworkers' Guild and inform him that all is ready.

TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Ah yes, the investigator from the Adventurers' Guild. The fool drank our potion with all the concern of a newborn babe. How fitting he will remain just as helpless for the rest of his days.

TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTMOTHER_000_0: Oh my sweet, you've never looked more dashing!
Seeing as you have matters here well in hand, I'll return home to our little honeycomb, and ready a feast for my hardworking husband!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Well then, I'd best be off to finish my preparations. 'Twill be a night to remember...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_099: (-???-)You poor, poor thing. A lost child at wit's end. Perhaps I can be of assistance...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_200_099: The creature motions at you frantically. If only there was some way you could help it.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_100_099: Why do you look at me with such mistrustful eyes, dear? Your dubitation is quite misplaced...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A2_000_001: You're in league with Papa Gruff, aren't you!?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_101: Is this how you always treat newly met strangers? What if I told you I have a remedy to dispel this enchantment?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_102: Here, drink this. Given the situation, I do not blame you for being wary of gifts from a stranger, but I will gladly drink it myself should that ease your concern.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_INVESTIGATOR04655_0: I-It worked! You have my thanks...
Oh, my friend! You are truly a sight for sore eyes. <sigh> Never in all my years of service have I been so humiliated.

I knew those fiends would be up to no good. Knew they would take advantage of the season's festivities, as is their wont. Yet for all my vigilance, here I am, their very first victim. Oh, the shame of it all─'tis as a spear piercing my very soul.

A pleasure to make your acquaintance, though I wish we had met under better circumstances. As our fiendish friend explained amidst his gloating, I'm an investigator working for the Adventurers' Guild.

I knew that red-nosed charlatan would be up to no good. Knew he would take advantage of the season's festivities as he did once before. Yet for all my vigilance, here I am, his very first victim. Oh, the shame of it all─'tis as a spear piercing my very soul.
But thanks to you, I am free of that foul enchantment. I owe you my life, Miss...?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_110: I fear you'd sooner forget a name as unremarkable as my own. I am but a passing woman of science.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_INVESTIGATOR04655_0: I see... Ahem, may I assume that you are the selfsame individual who created the remedy?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_113: Heh heh heh... You may indeed. 'Tis a remedy which has required no small amount of fine-tuning─a frog tongue here, a rat's tail there─but I will spare you the details. Rest assured, the townsfolk too shall be returned to their original forms with a sufficient dose.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_115: As fortune would have it, I made plenty for everyone in case such a tragedy were to befall the city. Now, if you would be so kind as to distribute the remedy to those in need, Investigator?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_INVESTIGATOR04655_0: ...Understood. I know not your motives, but I'll not look a gift chocobo in the beak. This is the best hand we have to play, and I will accept full responsibility for the outcome, whatever it may be.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_INVESTIGATOR04655_1: While I tend to the townspeople, may I entrust you with capturing our crafty clown? Stores of the remedy are like to run dry should they claim too many victims.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_117: In that case, I will remain here to assist.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_INVESTIGATOR04655_0: Excellent! Once I've administered the remedy to the afflicted, I shall await you in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_119: It will be no easy feat to apprehend Papa Gruff. I have no doubt he will be expecting you to come after him.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_100_119: That is why I propose you give him a taste of his own medicine with a disguise. Ideally, the guise should be of one dear to him─one whom he would let down his guard around. What's more, I would suggest someone whose appearance you can recall clearly.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A3_000_001: I can remember Mama Gruff's appearance clear as day.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A3_000_002: He would never doubt his dear Little Gruff.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_120: Heh heh heh, his love and joy...perfect. He'd never suspect his dear wife.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_121: Oh my, his very own son? While an excellent idea, can you say with certainty you can recall his appearance? If not, the transformation will undoubtedly fail.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_122: Ah, you but recently laid eyes on his mistress, did you? Excellent. Then he will never see you coming...heh heh heh.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_123: When you're certain his guard is down, give him one of my special cookies. I've baked in an ingredient that will return him to his natural demonic form.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_124: Though I wish I could do more to help, I am little more than a simple doctor. An adventurer of your obvious talents is far better suited─and accustomed─to such risky undertakings.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_125: When you are ready, I shall provide you with a dose of my own transformative mixture.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_130: It shan't be hard to locate Papa Gruff. Knowing he prepares for the Night of Devilry, I suspect he will be waiting for more voidsent to gather.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_131: As such, he is most likely hiding in the vicinity of the riverbank, out of sight and out of mind. He will no doubt have returned to his guise as the Adventurers' Guild investigator, so as not to arouse suspicion.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_100_131: Now, recall an image of his beloved in your mind's eye, and I shall weave it into reality with the power of alchemy.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_Q3_100_000: The Wake doctor will transfigure you into Mama Gruff. Proceed?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_132: Remember: once you've found Papa Gruff, use whatever guile you can muster to trick him, then offer him my special treat.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_200_132: You will be transfigured into Mama Gruff. You must remain transfigured in order to progress with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_100_132: Speak with the Wake doctor to restore or prolong the transfiguration.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_133: Heh heh heh...I see the transfiguration has faded. We can't have that. Now, recall an image of Papa Gruff's beloved in your mind's eye, and I shall weave it into reality with the power of alchemy.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_134: Remember: once you've found Papa Gruff, use whatever guile you can muster to trick him, then offer him my special treat.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_100_134: You will be transfigured into Mama Gruff. You must remain transfigured in order to progress with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_000_135: Speak with the Wake doctor to restore or prolong the transfiguration.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_SYSTEM_000_136: Papa Gruff is certain to flee should you approach him as you are. Speak with the Wake doctor to disguise yourself as Mama Gruff and proceed with the quest.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Oh, my sweet snurbleberry! I thought you had returned home. Is aught amiss?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_Q0_000_141: Converse with Papa Gruff and persuade him to eat the Wake doctor's special cookie?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Don't tell me...is it because I didn't return your good-bye kiss? You know I'm easily flustered! Besides, my love, our plans would be in tatters should a passerby catch us sharing an intimate moment!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A4_000_001: Why, I merely wanted to make sure you were safe and sound, dearest!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A4_000_002: I was worried, and wished to be certain all is proceeding apace.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A4_000_003: I know you've been up to no good, mister!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Erm... You're not quite sounding yourself, dear. Is something the matter?
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)You came all this way because you were worried about me? <sniff> Oh, I am not worthy of such a caring succubus!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Wh-What are you saying, my love! I am in the midst of preparing for the Night of Devilry─now is not the time to be joking around! We can have our fun later...
(-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)But fear not, your beloved has everything under control. Thanks to that wide-eyed adventurer, the fools are drinking our concoction in droves!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A5_000_001: Enough with the act, you're not fooling anyone with that performance.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A5_000_002: You'd better not be lying, darling.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A5_000_003: You must have worked up an appetite with all this scheming.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Surely, my acting cannot be all that bad. I'll have you know I shadowed the investigator relentlessly, day in and day out without a moment's rest...
(-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)B-Believe me, there is naught to be concerned about! I must say, you are rather intimidating today...

(-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)You always know just what I need! But moments ago, I was thinking what I wouldn't give for a snack. I knew you were cunning, but if I didn't know better, I would say you're a mind reader as well.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A6_000_001: Oh stop it, you'll make me blush. For you, darling, I baked up a delicious batch of cookies. Here, have a bite!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A6_000_002: I hope you're hungry for ripe souls!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: (-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Cookies, my favorite! Well then, don't mind if I do!
(-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Oh, there you go teasing me again! Why, of course I'm hungry for delectable souls─and you know as well as I that we shall soon have more than our fill of them...
(-Papa Gruff-esque Investigator-)Goodness, it smells delicious. Oh, how I love a treat from my sweet...
(-Papa Gruff-)Wh-Wh-What is the meaning of this!?
Why you conniving little... You may have put a damper on my plans, but all is not lost! Yes, if I start again now, all can be ready in time for supper...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_156: (-Wake Doctor-)All Saints' Wake is meant for all to partake in and enjoy.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Y-You! It cannot be! Th-The Great Gourd of legend herself...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_158: You poor, misguided soul. Gone are days when you might wreak havoc as you please. This truth I will drill into your head, slowly and meticulously, until there is naught else you can think of.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_159: Have I frightened you, child? Forgive me. Such was not my intention...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_161: I wish only for man and monster to enjoy the revelry of All Saints' Wake in equal measure, nothing more.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_162: For a mercy, his mischief making was brought to a halt, thanks in no small part to your efforts. But if the day's festivities are to be canceled, despite all we have done, the townspeople would still suffer for his transgressions.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_163: He has caused much grief, and I will punish him accordingly. So I ask that you place your faith in me, and allow the festival to continue as planned. There will be no further disruptions. You have my word.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_A8_000_002: I'll stay on the lookout, if it's all the same to you.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_164: Heh heh heh... You have my gratitude...
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_165: Perhaps you should apprise the real Adventurers' Guild investigator of the present situation. He said he would await you at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, as I recall.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_167: Once you have done so, come and speak with me. There is somewhere I would like to take you, by way of recompense for the trouble this ill-mannered child has caused.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PUMPKIN_000_169: The investigator awaits your report. Pray speak with him.
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_PIERROTFAMILYSERVAN: Hello, ! I hope you are having a most pleasant and peculiar All Saints' Wake!
TEXT_FESHLW801_04655_INVESTIGATOR04655_0: Ah, there you are! You'll be relieved to hear I've finished administering the remedy to all the afflicted.
But tell me, how did matters fare on your end?
So, the fiend has been reverted to his true impish form? I see... Well, eccentric though she may be, if the doctor claims she can keep him on a leash, I believe her.
And with a surplus of curative potions, I can see no reason why the costume cortege should not continue. I will, of course, remain vigilant for other disturbances.

Your assistance has truly been invaluable, my friend. With this trouble now behind us, I trust you will take at least a moment's respite. Why not spend it donning the guise of monstrous and mischievous creatures?
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_001: So, you remembered my request. I am pleased.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_002: As I mentioned earlier, there is somewhere I would like to take you, though I'm afraid it is a place not easily reached. When you're ready to depart, pray speak with the usher here, and he will escort you.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_003: If you are expecting me to reveal the surprise to you here and now, you are sorely mistaken. Go, speak with the usher.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_MYSTERIOUSGUIDE0465: Ah, you must be the guest of honor. If it please you, I shall escort you immediately.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_Q0_000_000: Allow the unusual usher to escort you?
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_100_011: I shall take my leave first, and make the preparations necessary to receive you. Do not be alarmed by what you see, child...heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_MYSTERIOUSGUIDE0465: We shall not be far behind! Now, if you would follow me.
My, did you get lost along the way? No matter, I would be happy to escort you again.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_021: Surprised to see I have a home of my own, are you? Even the Great Gourd needs a place to rest her head.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_022: I have never invited a mortal to my home before. Consider this my show of thanks for ensuring All Saints' Wake could be celebrated this year unimpeded.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_023: I have never invited a mortal to my home before. Consider this my way of thanking you for ensuring All Saints' Wake could be celebrated year after year unimpeded.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_024: You may make yourself at home, and stay as long as you like.
TEXT_FESHLW802_04656_PUMPKIN_000_025: If you are concerned about Papa Gruff, do not be. He and I have come to an understanding. Some children must simply learn the hard way...heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_PIERROTFAMILYSERVAN: Hello there! Tell me, are you aware of the delightful costume cortege being held at present?
Of course you are! No small few have already joined in the merrymaking, and I daresay you would make a most welcome addition to their number!
How about it? Raring to give the next person you meet the fright of their life?
Oh, what a shame. What a shame indeed! Well, I shall be here should you change your mind. You will reconsider, won't you?
Wonderful! Take your pick from our selection of perfectly safe concoctions placed atop the benches beside me, and transfigure yourself into the creature of your desire!
Wh-What, do you not trust me? The potions are perfectly safe this time, I swear!
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_Q0_000_010: You will be transfigured into a Continental eye after drinking this concoction. Proceed?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_Q0_000_011: You will be transfigured into a wraith after drinking this concoction. Proceed?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_Q0_000_012: You will be transfigured into a gaelikitten after drinking this concoction. Proceed?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_Q0_000_013: You will be transfigured into a sasquatch after drinking this concoction. Proceed?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SYSTEM_000_014: Your appearance will be changed after drinking the mysterious concoction. After frightening a townsperson in your transfigured state, dispel the enchantment, and inform them of the costume cortege.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_Q0_000_015: Drink the concoction again to extend the duration of the transfiguration?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SYSTEM_100_020: You must be in a transfigured state before approaching the townspeople.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_CHILD04657_000_020: A monster...? Oh gods, a monster! Wh-What's it doing here!?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_Q0_000_021: Dispel the transformation and inform them of the costume cortege?
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_CHILD04657_000_022: Hey, you're not a monster, you're just some strange ! You said you transformed by drinking a potion? I wanna try too!
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_SYSTEM_000_023: You have spread word of the costume cortege. Report back to the harlequin guide in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLW803_04657_PIERROTFAMILYSERVAN: Bravo! With the aid of volunteers such as yourself, word of the event shall surely spread like wildfire throughout the entire city!
Here, I have a little something for you as thanks. Should you care to spread the word further, you are welcome to return any time. Now, off you go. Enjoy the festivities to your heart's content!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_000: How good it is to see you again, dear adventurer! You haven't forgotten me since last we met, I hope? It's me, Amh Garanjy.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Happy Starlight! You are an adventurer, are you not? I am Amh Garanjy, Starlight celebrant. 'Tis a pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_002: And may I say you've come at a most opportune moment. You see, we are planning some truly extraordinary festivities this year, but are presently shorthanded...
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_003: (-Erudite Man-)It's no good, Celebrant. We will require the aid of an adventurer after all.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_004: (-Erudite Man-)Oh! Dare I say  is an adventurer, and you have already made the arrangements?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Allow me to introduce Associate Professor Laurenssen of the Studium in Sharlayan. His are the festivities for which I am hoping to secure your assistance.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_006: Laurenssen, Faculty of Folklore. Delighted, I'm sure.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_100_006: Without further ado, then, I shall test your knowledge of the season. First question: what creature symbolizes the Starlight Celebration?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_007: An easy question, was it not? I apologize if I insulted your intelligence─indeed, the answer is “reindeer.”
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_008: Bear? Did you simply select your favorite animal, perhaps? No, my dear ─the correct answer is “reindeer.”
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_009: For your information, it is pronounced “yeti” not “yeeeeeeti.” Regardless, why on earth would such a savage creature symbolize the Starlight Celebration!? The correct answer is “reindeer”!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_010: You truly do not know!? Good gods, what impossibly large rock have you been living under? Well, permit me to relieve you of your ignorance─the answer is “reindeer.”
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_100_010: From gifts to garb, Starlight paraphernalia is often emblazoned with or designed in the image of these noble creatures.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_011: Now, for my second question─when did the Starlight Celebration begin to make use of this symbolism?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_012: When? You mean to say it was not always so?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_012: No indeed! Any mention of reindeer is conspicuously absent from the tale which inspired the celebration. Thus did I take it upon myself to delve into the truth of the matter.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_013: And after many a moon scouring literature, I discovered telling testimony in an ancient Ishgardian tome, which spoke of reindeer that amused younglings with delightful illusions!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_100_013: It was this spectacular act that earned reindeer their Starlight celebrity, I posit.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_014: And in order to prove my theory, I have journeyed to Gridania this Starlight Celebration with this trusty fellow, Blitzen!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_016: Oh! So Blitzen can use reindeer magicks?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_017: Yes, Blitzen is of a rare lineage, one that weaves illusions as a defense against predators. We have been keeping him under our care in Labyrinthos while conducting research on his abilities.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_018: Yes, Blitzen is of a rare lineage, one that weaves illusions as a defense against predators. We have been keeping him under our care in Sharlayan while conducting research on his abilities.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_020: 'Tis my belief that Blitzen can trace his ancestry back to the reindeer who delighted children with illusions in the Ishgardian tome.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_021: And I intend to have him do the very same for the children of Eorzea─confirming history by recreating it, as it were!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_022: You see, no matter how much I urged him back in Sharlayan, Blitzen refused to produce child-pleasing illusions. But in Eorzea, where it all began with his noble ancestors, I dare to hope that he will be suitably inspired.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_023: I welcome anything that will bring cheer to our sweet children! My duties bind me here, but I believe our adventurer friend will prove a most capable assistant.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_024: Indeed, your cheery disposition tells me you are the perfect candidate for the task I have in store. Can I count on your cooperation?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_025: Splendid. I thank you, as will posterity, I'm sure. Now then, your role is a simple-yet-crucial one─round up the children who will witness Blitzen create his illusion.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_026: I shall be at Apkallu Falls, making the necessary preparations. Good luck, and I will see you again anon!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_100_026: Perhaps you can begin your search along the path from the markets to the Lancers' Guild. I daresay a few younglings will be out gazing at the shops and decorations.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_027: Thank you for helping Laurenssen. If I chance upon any younglings, I will be sure to send them along as well!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_028: You'll show us the illusion this time, won't you, Blitzen? You have it in you, I know it!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_CHILDA04658_000_031: That sounds like fun and all, but I promised my mum I'd help her put up decorations. Sorry.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_CHILDB04658_000_040: Oh... I, er... I was told to buy a Starlight cake and hurry home. Sorry...
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_CHILDD04658_100_040: There's a magical reindeer that can create illusions!? Amazing!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_CHILDD04658_150_040: I've just finished my chores, so I'll head over at once!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_CHILDC04658_000_042: Oh, you're here to watch too? Hehe, I can't wait for it to start!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_060: Ah, you are returned! I trust a gaggle of rosy-cheeked younglings will be arriving shortly?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_100_061: <sigh> This is precisely the problem with today's youth─no concept of scholarship or the virtues of academic inquiry!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_062: ...I suppose this single ragamuffin will suffice. For the purposes of proof, the number of children isn't consequential, after all.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_063: Blitzen! The season of lights is in full glow, and a child stands expectant before you. Hearken unto the spirit of your ancestors, and bring forth your delightful illusions!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_064: ...C-Come now, Blitzen! Is this not the Starlight Celebration? And is that not a child, wide-eyed and innocent!?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_CHILDD04658_000_066: Bah, that's just a normal reindeer! The baby yeti from last year was much better. Oh well!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_067: W-Wait! Don't leave, I beseech you! There are crucial discoveries to be made in the name of folklore, for which your assistance is paramount!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_069: That...did not go as I hoped. <sigh> What am I to do now?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_070: Forgive me, but I need a moment to collect myself. Amidst the calm of the Greatloam Growery, perhaps... I shall return once my thoughts are clear.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_AMHGARANJY_000_071: So it didn't go as planned... That is unfortunate, but it's too soon to be giving up. Please bear with the professor a while longer.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_SYSTEM_000_080: You wait patiently, but Laurenssen does not return. Perhaps you should search for him.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_090: Oh, it's you... It seems I've been here rather longer than I thought. My apologies.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_091: I have been pondering my dilemma, but I believe I have identified the root of the problem─the children of Gridania are insufficient for my purposes.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_092: The original testimony was Ishgardian, after all, meaning that it is Ishgardian children I require. I was a fool to consider proving my theory anywhere else.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_093: You are familiar with Ishgard, are you not? Would you be willing to continue assisting me there?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_100_093: There is just one problem─Ishgard is closed to outsiders. As an adventurer, however, perhaps you know a way for us to enter the city?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_A2_000_000: How does Blitzen feel about all this?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_A2_000_001: You seem to be one reindeer short of a sleigh.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_A2_000_002: I don't think the children are what's insufficient.
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_094: Blitzen? Why, he would agree with me, of course. Isn't that so, Blit─ ...Oh?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_095: Whatever do you mean? I don't have a─ ...Oh?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_100_095: What do you mean? Apart from the testing site, what could possibly─ ...Oh?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_096: B-Blitzen! Where did you go!? Blitzen! Blitzen!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_100: I can't find Blitzen anywhere... Where could he have gone?
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_101: Gah, so absorbed was I in my thoughts, I must have left him somewhere!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_102: The gods know he can't bear being alone! Oh, he must be so frightened right now!
TEXT_FESXMS801_04658_LAURENSSEN_000_103: I-I must find him! M-Must find my dear boy!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_100_000: Blitzen is missing? Oh no, that's terrible... I hope you find him soon!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_000: Oh, B-Blitzen! Wh-Where could he have gone!?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SYSTEM_000_001: Laurenssen is in a state of distress. Try to soothe his nerves.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_010: M-My poor boy, he must be inconsolable for the loneliness! I-I must find him...but where do I even begin!?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SYSTEM_000_011: Laurenssen is in a state of distress. Try to soothe his nerves.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_012: <gasp> What am I doing? Blitzen needs me, and yet here I am, a blubbering mess...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_013: My apologies for subjecting you to such undignified behavior. Unforeseen circumstances have a tendency of rattling my nerves, but I am well now thanks to you.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_014: I shall go and search for Blitzen at once. May I count on your cooperation once more?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_015: My heartfelt thanks. For now, let us focus our search within the city.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_016: If you could make inquiries in the direction of Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, I shall retrace our steps back to Apkallu Falls. Quickly, now!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CITIZENA04659_000_0: A reindeer? Why, yes, I saw it go dashing through the snow towards Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CITIZENB04659_000_0: A reindeer, you say? As a matter of fact, one went trotting by the amphitheatre and down the lane not long ago.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CITIZENC04659_000_0: Mmm, perfection! Absolute perfection! The very incarnation of crystalline beauty! ...Oh, were you speaking to me?
Reindeer? I can't say that I did, transfixed to this frozen masterpiece as I was.
I vaguely recall having heard some clopping noises passing behind me, though... Must have been something of the sort.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CITIZENA04659_000_0: The reindeer was headed towards the amphitheatre. You should take a look there.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CITIZENB04659_000_0: Seemed to be in a bit of a rush, that reindeer. Make sure it doesn't run anyone over, eh?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CITIZENC04659_000_0: I didn't notice what creature it was that went by, I'm afraid. If indeed it was a creature. But more importantly, have you ever beheld such a magnificent snowman!?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_030: Oh, adventurer! Have you had any luck in locating─
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_031: Blitzen! Where have you been!? I have been running myself ragged in search of you!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_033: B-Blitzen? Why do you bray so?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_034: (-???-)Why, to summon me, of course! Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_036: (-Saint of Nymeia-)I am the Saint of Nymeia, and I have come at our antlered friend's behest to lead your misguided soul unto the soothing bosom of the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_037: (-Saint of Nymeia-)I will ask you plainly, young scholar─do you understand why you were unable to coax forth the legendary twinkling of this reindeer's magicks?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_100_038: (-Saint of Nymeia-)So you do not know. Fortunately for you, naught escapes the Saint of Nymeia's all-seeing eyes!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_150_038: (-Saint of Nymeia-)You see it too, do you not? The reason why our scholarly friend failed?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_Q1_000_000: What will you say to Laurenssen?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_A1_000_000: You've lost sight of the spirit of the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_A1_000_001: You've forgotten who the celebration is held for.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_039: What? Of course I haven't lost sight. All know that the Starlight Celebration is held for the benefit of...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_040: What? Of course I haven't forgotten. All know that the Starlight Celebration is held for the benefit of...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_041: (-Saint of Nymeia-)So you finally understand. Indeed, the Starlight Celebration exists for the good children of the realm. This, our antlered friend knows well.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_042: (-Saint of Nymeia-)But you, my scholarly friend─you were so obsessed with your work that you could only see the children as a means to prove your theory. Is it any wonder, then, that Blitzen was not minded to oblige your demands?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_043: It is as you say, good saint. Respecting the customs one seeks to understand is basic folklorist fieldwork. I shame my profession in forgetting it...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_045: My thanks for comforting me, my friend. And my apologies for ignoring your feelings.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_046: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Ho ho ho! It seems my job here is done.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_GODBERT_000_047: (-Saint of Nymeia-)I leave this man and this reindeer in your capable hands, adventurer. Happy Starlight to all, and to all a good !
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_048:
Right, there isn't a moment to lose. Let us resume our research─erm, forgive me. Force of habit...
Ahem! Let us resume our celebration of this wondrous season by bringing joy and happiness to children!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_100_049: That cry of distress... It comes from the other side of the aetheryte plaza. Come, my friends!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_050: O-Oh dear, what does one do at a time like this? Er, whimper not, little one! All shall be well!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_100_052: A crying child, you say? Please give them what comfort you can, and try to work out what the matter is.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_061: Oh dear... Distraught as she is, how are we to learn what ails her?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_062: W-We need to settle her somehow... With sweets, perhaps...or toys?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_064: Well done, Blitzen! Well done! Now we may ask after the source of her woes!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_066: Er, greetings, little one. Tell me─what is it that troubles you?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CHILDA04659_000_067: (-Tearful Tot-)Well, me and Mummy were on our way to the markets. B-But suddenly she wasn't there, and I got scared!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_068: I see. I expect that your mother is still nearby. In which case...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_069: IS ANYONE MISSING A CHILD!? WE HAVE A LOST CHILD IN SEARCH OF HER MOTHER!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_MOTHER04659_000_071: Oh, there you are! Thank goodness!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CHILDA04659_000_072: (-Tearful Tot-)Mummyyy! You were there...then suddenly you were gone! I was so scared!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_MOTHER04659_000_073: Oh, I'm so sorry, sweetling. I'm here now.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_MOTHER04659_000_074: Thank you so much for looking after my daughter, sir.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_CHILDA04659_000_075: (-Tearful Tot-)Thank you, sir! And you too, Mister Reindeer! Those shiny presents were really pretty.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_Q2_000_000: What will you say to Laurenssen?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_A2_000_000: I think congratulations are in order.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_A2_000_001: Your hypothesis was correct, I see.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_076: What? ...Oh, right! I suppose Blitzen just proved my theory, didn't he? I was too concerned with helping the little one to notice...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_077: Well, I shan't complain. Seeing as we've fulfilled our objective, shall we report back to Amh Garanjy?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_080: Ah, welcome back, everyone! How did you fare in the end?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_081: Very well, I'm pleased to say. We managed to reunite a lost child with her mother...and for a happy side benefit, succeeded in proving my theory.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_082: ...My, my, the three of you have been busy indeed. Thank you for your help, adventurer.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_083: Allow me to offer my gratitude as well. Were it not for you, I would have remained blind to what's truly important.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_085: Hehe, saying thanks as well, are you?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_086: But it seems to me you played as important a role as any today, Blitzen. You are as dependable a little helper as I have ever known.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_087: It's curious, though. At first he seemed wholly unmotivated to act, but then showed the illusion of his own volition. What do you suppose inspired his change of heart?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_088: I believe the answer is “concern.” In the beginning, he could tell that I held none for the children and sought only academic satisfaction. Pure of heart as he is, how could Blitzen be moved to assist me?
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_089: However, when he sensed that the concern I held for that crying child was genuine, he no longer felt resistance to using his powers.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_090: Blitzen sounds like quite the intuitive fellow!
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_091: Reindeer generally are. As herd animals, they are accustomed to sensing even the slightest shift in feeling or intent.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_092: And this is but another theory, but I suspect that Blitzen's ancestors conjured their illusions in response to the feelings of love and kindness they sensed in the people around them.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_093: Such reindeer were far more plentiful back then─some were even domesticated to pull sleighs. No doubt younglings had ample opportunity to witness the same spectacular illusions we now find so precious...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_094: It is truly unfortunate that Blitzen's kin have so declined in number...
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_095: But I will cherish their invaluable contribution to the Starlight Celebration. Thank you for sharing this fascinating history with us.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_096: If I was able to impart even a modicum of the passion I feel towards my subject, I will count myself very blessed indeed. Ah, but that reminds me.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_LAURENSSEN_000_097: There is one last task for which I would appreciate your assistance. To wit, sharing Blitzen's miraculous illusions─and the joy they inspire─with as many children as we can find.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_AMHGARANJY_000_098: Speaking in the true spirit of Starlight, Laurenssen! I daresay you'll be a little helper yet.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SYSTEM_000_100: Speak with Laurenssen to accompany him on a special Starlight Celebration mission.
TEXT_FESXMS802_04659_SYSTEM_000_101: Who knows what familiar faces you might encounter...?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Simply adorable, is he not?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_000_003: (-Lominsan Lass-)Why's this chocobo chick wearing that costume?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: Well met, friend, and welcome to our festivities. I am known in my homeland of Hingashi as the ryu metsuke, and it is my delegation's solemn charge to share our Heavensturn custom with the peoples of Eorzea, that we might join hands in revelry.

Although Heavensturn is observed in both our lands to mark the coming of a new year, there is a difference between our traditions. Here in Eorzea, a deity is chosen from among the Twelve to preside over the heavens, while in the Far East we honor one of twelve noble beasts.
And this year, that beast is the mighty ryu─a creature you Eorzeans might liken to a dragon.
Now, in order to liven up the festivities, we decided to have a pair of horsebird hatchlings─or should I say chocobo chicks─serve as mascots.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMETSUKE_100_0: Winsomely dressed in draconic attire, we were certain that they would delight all who laid eyes upon them.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: However, when the ryu bugyo, the leader of our delegation, presented one of the chicks to a crowd, the reception was disappointingly muted. We know not where we erred...
...I say, you are an adventurer, are you not? In the course of dispensing aid, you must have acquired some insight into the people's interests.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMETSUKE_100_0: Loath though I am to impose, will you not help us to identify our plan's failings? In so doing, we may yet find a way to win over the locals with our mascots.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: You have my thanks! To begin, I ask that you seek out the ryu bugyo.
For want of passersby, she decided to wander around this plaza with her hatchling.
When you find her, pray ask for her account of our dilemma, and thence help us find a solution.
The ryu bugyo is wandering around this plaza with her hatchling. Pray ask for her account of our dilemma, and thence help us find a solution.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: Oho, curious about our delegation too, are you? That is well, for I was just about to introduce our mascot Ryunosuke to this young lady!
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Feast your eyes on a horsebird among horsebirds, the pinnacle of plumage! I daresay Heavensturn has never hatched a mascot as utterly charming as our regal ryu.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_100_022: (-Lominsan Lass-)Well, he's certainly adorable...but what's a “ryu”? And why do you have him dressed up in that costume?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: An excellent question! You see, we wished to present the charms of the chocobo and the ryu in a lovable package. Just look at him waggle his scaly little tail─it's an exquisite combination, you must agree!

And it would be remiss of me not to mention the craftsmanship that went into the outfit. Our weavers spared no effort to evoke the might and majesty of the ryu in the diminutive form before you. The finished product is simply divine, is it not!?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_100_027: Um...I suppose? I still don't know what a ryu is...but never mind. Thank you for letting me play with him.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_12: <sigh> Yet again I failed to convey the virtues of our mascot...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_13: ...You come at the ryu metsuke's behest!? I should be most grateful for your aid, adventurer!
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_14: I seek only to share our mascots' charms with the people of Eorzea, but my every attempt has ended in failure, as you've just witnessed...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_15: Try as I might, I cannot see what I am doing wrong. If you have any advice─anything at all─I would be most eager to hear it.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_A1_000_001: Adorable is well and good, but you can't forget the other things.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_A1_000_002: You may want to talk more about the ryu.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Other things... It was my intent to have our mascots be the highlight of Heavensturn. You believe this is not enough?
Talk about the ryu, you say... Rather than tediously explaining tradition, I had hoped to initiate the people through our mascots. You believe this is not enough?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: Hmmm, it might avail me to speak with that young girl as well. Let her gaze upon Ryunosuke once more, and─
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: ...Oh? Wherever did our little mascot go?
Followed after the girl, you say!?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: We must find him, and quickly!
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Please, adventurer, will you not help with the search?
Thank you! Now then, I believe the girl set off in the direction of the tavern─the Drowning Wench, was it? If we find her, I daresay we will find Ryunosuke.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: Whatever it is the ryu bugyo is doing fails to speak to the locals. Please, help her find a way to win them over.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Ah, thank goodness you're here! I've been asking this guardswoman about the girl, but I am struggling to make myself understood...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SKAENRAEL_100_060: Perhaps you can help clear things up. The lady says she's looking for a girl with a “ryu,” but I haven't the faintest what that is.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_A2_000_001: To rephrase, it's a chocobo chick wearing a costume.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_A2_000_002: Imagine a dragon...a tiny, green dragon with googly eyes.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SKAENRAEL_000_061: Ahhh, then you must be speaking of the odd little critter I spotted a few moments ago. It was wearing what looked like a dragon costume, and was waddling after a young girl.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SKAENRAEL_000_062: I'm imagining it, all right, but I can't say I've ever seen─ Actually...hold that thought. Now that you mention it, there was a chocobo chick wearing what looked like a dragon costume. If that's your ryu, then aye, I saw it waddling after a young girl.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SKAENRAEL_000_063: I'm afraid I didn't observe where they went, though. Sorry I couldn't be of help.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Many thanks for your assistance! In my haste, I had neglected to explain the meaning of the word ryu...
As the ryu metsuke told me, the creature doesn't exist in Eorzea. If I had begun by clarifying that it is similar to a dragon, I could have avoided the misunder─
...Oh. I daresay I know now why our mascot has so struggled to win over the masses.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: I shall speak with this guardswoman a little more, in case she has aught else of note to share. Once I'm finished, I plan to scour the upper decks.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: In the meantime, might I trouble you to search the lower decks? Once we have finished, let us reconvene at Bulwark Hall.
Should you glean any valuable information, we can discuss it at Bulwark Hall once we have both finished our rounds. May your search prove successful!
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_AHLDSKYF_000_080: A young lass and a chocobo chick? I spied them walking past the aetheryte, though I couldn't say where they went from there.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SYSTEM_100_080: It appears the girl and the chocobo passed through the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXFISHSELLER04679_: A chocobo chick wearin' a li'l green dragon costume...? Hasn't come this way, I'm afraid. With customers scarce as they are today, I'd remember if somethin' like that walked by.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SYSTEM_100_081: It appears the girl and the chocobo did not come this way.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXWOMAN04679_000_0: A girl with an oddly dressed chocobo chick? She passed by here just earlier.

She looked a little lost, so I asked her if she needed help, but she told me she was fine─that she was heading to the Agelyss River. Though I left it at that, I can't help but worry for her, out there on her own. I hope you find her soon.
The little girl said that she was heading to the Agelyss River. I hope you find her soon.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXMAN04679_000_086: ...Hm? Aye, I know the lass you're after. Sibly's her name, and she's the daughter of a fellow merchant─a good friend of mine, in fact.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXMAN04679_000_087: You'd be hard-pressed to find a happier father and daughter. They go fishing at the river together all the time, they do.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXMAN04679_100_087: But he'll soon set sail for faraway lands, I'm told. Sibly's worried sick, and for good reason─the ocean's a fickle mistress, and even a simple voyage could cost a man his life.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXMAN04679_110_087: Anyroad, she came through here earlier, but I'm afraid I couldn't say where she is now. Perhaps someone else can help you there.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXMAN04679_000_088: Sibly's father plans to set sail for faraway lands, I'm told. Sibly's worried sick, and for good reason─the ocean's a fickle mistress, and even a simple voyage could cost a man his life.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SYSTEM_000_089: You've learned something of note. Continue scouring the lower decks for more information.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SYSTEM_100_089: You believe you have enough information on Sibly's whereabouts. Make your way to Bulwark Hall and report your findings to the ryu bugyo.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: There you are! By your triumphant expression, dare I hope you've learned something of the little girl and our mascot?
So the girl, Sibly, was headed for the Agelyss River? That you should find just the information we need is auspicious indeed!

For my part, in the course of speaking with the locals, I was able to learn more about dragons. That is, while they have many similarities with the ryu of the Far East, they are in fact different creatures.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: I had been under the impression that they were one and the same, but be it their folklore or their status in mortal society, they are quite distinct.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: I had assumed that the people of Eorzea were like me─that they thought the ryu was simply a dragon by another name.

I suppose it is little wonder that Sibly looked so puzzled during our first encounter... When next we find her, I shall do my utmost to explain the true meaning of our mascot. Now, off to the Agelyss River with us!
No sign of Sibly here... Perhaps she's further upstream.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_100_100: <sigh> I wish you didn't have to go, Papa...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_110_100: Huh? You're the adventurer from before... What are you doing here?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: <pant> <pant> Oh, thank the kami we found you, Sibly...!
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_NYXGIRL04679_000_10: A-And the lady in the fancy helmet, too! How did you know my name?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_100_103: I see... I'm sorry to cause you both trouble. I just wanted to visit my papa's favorite fishing spot, but your chocobo chick ended up following me all the way.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_110_103: Well, he's safe with you now. If there's nothing else, I'll be off...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Pray wait a moment! In the course of searching for Ryunosuke, we couldn't help but learn that your father will soon embark upon a voyage, and it has left you feeling troubled.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: I realize we are but strangers, but if you are not averse, will you not talk to us about it?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_100_105: It's all right. My papa, he...he's heading to Hingashi for trade. I heard that it's a long and dangerous journey, and it made me worry.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_110_105: I wanted to pray to the Navigator to keep him safe at sea.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_120_105: But then I found out that Llymlaen wasn't chosen this Heavensturn, and it made me worry even more...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: As you say, it isn't the Navigator, but the Keeper who presides over the heavens this year...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_100_106: But if not the Navigator, I thought I could at least pray to a god from the Far East. That's why I went to talk to you.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: So that is the way of it. You came to me hoping to beseech our divinities to protect your father...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: But in my fervor to showcase our mascot, I failed to lend an ear to your earnest desire.
Well, I hear you now, young one, and I shall tell you a tale about the ryu that will grant you comfort!
I just...er, need to recall a suitable one. Something that ideally features the ocean...
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_110_109: Oh? What's gotten into you, little one?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_SIBLY_120_109: Curious what lies that way, are you? It's a place called Woad Whisper Canyon. Papa told me that waterfalls appeared there after the Calamity, and they changed the flow of the Nym River.
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Waterfalls changing the course of a river...?
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: I believe I have the perfect tale for you, Sibly! One that will bolster your spirits as your father departs on his journey!
TEXT_FESNYX001_04679_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Let us head to these waterfalls, that we might avail ourselves of their ambience. Even Ryunosuke is keen, and we wouldn't want to ignore such a fortuitous omen.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_001: A story that will give me comfort...? I wonder what it's about!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: Whatever it is the ryu bugyo is doing fails to speak to the locals. Please, help her find a way to win them over.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Come, let us head to these waterfalls. They would provide the perfect setting for my tale.
Ahem! Let us begin... The ryu is a creature that shares many similarities with the dragons of Eorzea, but as I myself recently discovered, it is in fact a distinct being.

Nor is there just the one ryu. Nay, there exist myriad individuals, all of whom have their own tales. And the creature I will speak about is the mighty Seiryu, one of the Four Lords, who legend holds birthed a great waterfall in the Far East.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_034: Hee hee! That does sound exciting, doesn't it!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: In the region of Yanxia flows the One River, and its plentiful waters nourish nearby lands. In ages past, it is said Seiryu drank so deeply of the river that he altered its very course, and in so doing gave rise to a waterfall─the Dragon's Struggle.
While it is not widely known, Seiryu was also regarded as a guardian deity who protected people from disasters of water.
Indeed. Long ago, it was believed that calamities could be quelled by sacrificing a young maiden to a divine beast such as Seiryu.

And while no written records exist, there is a tale of a seaside village that fell in the path of a raging storm. Desperate to calm the heavens, the villagers offered unto Seiryu one of their daughters.

However, Seiryu showed no interest whatsoever in the young girl. To merely know the villagers' plight was enough for him, it seemed, and he turned the course of the storm and spared them untold devastation.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: A benevolent being is Seiryu, who wields his power over water for good. Even now he hears our prayers, and protects us and our loved ones from harm.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_11: That, my dear, is just one example of the noble beast we celebrate this Heavensturn. Together, let us offer a prayer to Seiryu, and wish your father safe travels and calm waters.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_041: That sounds perfect, miss! Thank you so much!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: We must thank Ryunosuke as well. Were it not for him, I might not have recalled the tale of Seiryu.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_046: Now you can pray to Seiryu for safe travels too, adventurer! ...Oh, but perhaps you already heard this story?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_A1_000_002: That was my first time hearing it too.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_A1_000_003: Straight from the serpent's mouth, in fact.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_047: Really? Well, then, I'm glad we could hear it together!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Y-You mean to say you've met the great Seiryu himself!? To think that he was more serpentine in nature... If this is true, we would be able to celebrate him in the year of the snake as well!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_049: Now that I think on it, miss, you said that no written records exist of that tale. How did you come to know it?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: An astute observation, Sibly. You see, my family is said to be descended from the maiden who was offered to Seiryu.

As long ago as the event took place, there is no way to confirm the tale's veracity. But if true, then it is by the grace of Seiryu that I am here, alive. Thus have I made it my mission to spread the word of his noble kind.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: Looking back, from the time you followed after Sibly, it is as if you have been guiding me, little one. I may be your caretaker, but it was you who was watching over me.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: With this, I now know what I must do to initiate people into our traditions, and I shall continue doing so for as long as the ryu reigns in the heavens.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: Come, let's head back to the city together. We wouldn't want to make your father worry, now would we, Sibly?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: Is that so? Glad am I to hear that our adventurer friend was of assistance.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: There you are, adventurer. Lest you wonder, young Sibly is now safely home, and I have just apprised the ryu metsuke of our fruitful outing.

Now that I have discovered a more suitable approach to my draconic dilemma, I wish to wander the city again for onlookers. Though I regret to impose upon you once more, your support with Sibly was most helpful... Might you accompany me while I make my rounds about the area?
With your discerning eyes, I am certain that you could readily identify those who might be receptive to our message. What say you?
I'm truly grateful! Come, let us set forth at once!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_078: The ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_079: You can leave the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke behind by entering a different area, or by speaking to them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_080: If you wish to have the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke accompany you again, return and speak with them at their original location.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_0: While you accompany my colleague, I shall remain here and regale passersby with tales from my own ryu repertoire. With Ryunosuke's brother Ryuji here, rest assured I shall not want for cuteness!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_090: You must be accompanied by the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke in order to proceed with quest objectives.
