TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_091: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are both at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_A2_000_002: Part ways with the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Ryu and dragon, east and west... While the differences between our cultures are numerous indeed, we have much and more to learn from one another. Together with Ryunosuke, I hope to leave a favorable impression!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_094: Are you sure you wish to part ways with the ryu bugyo and Ryunosuke?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Not to worry! We shall await you at the Aftcastle when you are ready to continue.
You are ready to continue? Excellent, let us be off!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_098: Ryunosuke puffs out his little chest, looking every ilm a proud ryu.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_102: Ryunosuke is the picture of sadness. He looks up at you with his forlorn eyes as if to say, “I'll be waiting at the Aftcastle.”
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_104: Ryunosuke puffs out his little chest, looking every ilm a proud ryu.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXMAN04680_000_105: And just like that, it's another Heavensturn. This year, I must look after myself better...by salving my soul with the sight of adorable creatures, oh yes! The more, the merrier!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXSAILER04680_000_: Eh? If ye've somethin' to say, then let's hear it. Don't jus' stare at me like a stunned pufferfish.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXYELLOWJACKET0468: I'm not slacking off, I'll have you know. This is a well-deserved break.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXMAN04680_100_110: By the gods... I had just resolved to salve my soul with the sight of adorable creatures this year, and what should appear but the most charming of chocobo chicks! What's your name, little one, and what is that winsome outfit you're wearing?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: You have a keen eye, sir. This little fellow is Ryunosuke, and he is dressed as a ryu─a dragon of the Far East. By thus attiring Eorzea's favorite beast of burden, we hoped to create a symbol of friendship between our lands.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXMAN04680_100_112: Well now, that this adorable form should harbor such splendid symbolism! I'd never heard of this ryu before, but now I'm keen to know more!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_11: In that case, sir, I invite you to seek us out at the Aftcastle anon. There, we will be glad to answer all your questions.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXMAN04680_120_112: Excellent, we shall head there at once!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXSAILER04680_130_: Hm? What the hells is that chocobo chick supposed to be dressed up as?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_14: Ryunosuke here is wearing a costume that mimics the ryu─dragons of the Far East. It is held that these creatures have mastery over water, and a sailor such as your good self may benefit from knowing about them.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXSAILER04680_000_: Huh, if you ask me, it looks more like a sea serpent. Hold it... It wouldn't have anythin' to do with that thrice-damned primal Leviathan, would it?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: I-I assure you there is no connection whatsoever. Far from causing disasters of water, the ryu is a benevolent beast that protects us from them. If you are interested in knowing more, I invite you to seek us out at the Aftcastle.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXSAILER04680_000_: Is that right? Still, here in Limsa, we've got the Navigator. That's all the protection we need on the high seas.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_10: Ah, yes! I understand the people of your nation look to Llymlaen to favor them with safe voyages. Be that as it may, disasters of water can strike beyond the bounds of the sea─in which case, placing your faith in the ryu could provide you with added assurance.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXSAILER04680_110_: Hah, I suppose it don't hurt to have more friends in high places, as it were. Fine, fine, I'll go and see what this is all about.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXYELLOWJACKET0468: ...Yes? How can I assist you and your...curiously dressed chocobo chick?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_13: If I may shed some light on the mystery of our mascot, little Ryunosuke here is named for the ryu─dragons of the Far East.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXYELLOWJACKET0468: Oh? I thought dragons are supposed to be fearsome. This fellow looks anything but.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Our costumed companion notwithstanding, the ryu is in fact a powerful and fearsome beast. Yet by the same token, they are fondly regarded as symbols of good fortune. Should you be curious about them, we would be glad to tell you more at the Aftcastle.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXYELLOWJACKET0468: A being that's regarded with both fear and fondness... Intriguing. Perhaps I'll pay a quick visit to the Aftcastle before returning to work.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Oh, what a relief to see the locals take an interest in the ryu! I daresay we have gathered enough people, so let us head back to the Aftcastle.
Come, my friend! Let us rejoin the ryu metsuke at the Aftcastle.
In that case, I shall go on ahead to the Aftcastle with Ryunosuke. See you there anon.
There you are, adventurer. Come, let us report to the ryu metsuke.
Look how exicted Ryunosuke is for the gathered crowd! Come, let us report to the ryu metsuke!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_1: Ah, welcome back, adventurer. If the crowd is any indication, you and the ryu bugyo have been busy!
So our bugyo makes her triumphant return! You have done a tremendous job to pique the interest of so many.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: You are too kind, metsuke. None of this would have been possible without the adventurer and Ryunosuke's help.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SIBLY_100_142: There you are, miss! My papa wanted to meet you, so I've brought him.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXMERCHANT00001_00: So you're the kindly folks who helped my Sibly. I haven't the words to properly thank you, but...I'm truly grateful for what you've done. I'm glad to see my girl smiling again.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Pray do not mention it, sir. We, too, owe Sibly much and more. How fares the preparation for your journey, if I may ask?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_NYXMERCHANT00001_00: Very well, thank you. And with Sibly praying to the legendary Seiryu for my safety, no matter how far I venture from home, I have no doubt that all will be well.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: I shall pray for your safety as well. What little we might do to help you on your way, we gladly do it.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_1: Indeed. While sharing the blessing of the divine beasts is a fine thing, naught is more rewarding to our delegation than fostering friendship between our lands.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: For all the help you've afforded us, I wish to give you a proper reward. Yet I do not know what might be suitable...
Ryunosuke? Are you saying you wish to accompany our adventurer friend?
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_1: Hm, I believe the little one wishes to be your charm against tumultuous waters─and he would be hard-pressed to choose a better companion. We still have Ryuji to aid us in our work, so if you so wish it, Ryunosuke is yours.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMISSIONARY_00: Ryunosuke, my little guardian... Thank you for everything. May your divine aura keep our friend safe.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_DRAGONMETSUKE_000_1: And may you and yours enjoy the rest of the Heavensturn season, my friend. Know that wherever the ryu roars, good fortune shall be upon you.
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_154: Should you wish to draw omikuji, the omikujishi has returned to offer his services for the remainder of the celebration. Seek him out for a Heavensturn fortune!
TEXT_FESNYX002_04680_SYSTEM_000_155: Furthermore, twelve extra fortunes have been divined this year. Keep a watchful eye on the “Adventure” section of your omikuji, and discover what new journeys might lie in wait for you.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_000: Ah, greetings, my friend! 'Tis good to see you─very good indeed, as it just so happens there is a matter with which I require assistance.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_001: As you will be aware, another Little Ladies' Day is upon us, and we are celebrating all ladies as princesses, attending to their every need.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_002: Begging your pardons, good , but you are an adventurer, are you not? If so, I should be much obliged for your kind assistance.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_003: I am the royal seneschal, and it is my honor to oversee Little Ladies' Day. In case you are unfamiliar, the festival celebrates all the maidens of the realm, and my duty is to see that each and every lady is treated as a princess.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_004: For this year's celebration, we are planning to distribute replicas of an antique folding fan to participants.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_006: Wishing to learn more about said fan, Miss Aldiytha, a scion of House Thorne, has taken it upon herself to investigate its origins.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_007: Alas, she has ever had a frail constitution and is feeling unwell. For now she rests at my insistence, but passionate as she is about the celebration, I worry that she won't stay put.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_008: Thus would I turn to you for help. In order to take the burden off my lady─who is also a treasured princess this day─might I prevail upon you to assist with her investigation?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_009: I'm truly grateful! Now, Miss Aldiytha should be resting on a bench in the Gold Court, so pray seek her out there. I leave her in your capable hands.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_BUTLER_000_020: Miss Aldiytha should be resting on a bench in the Gold Court, so pray seek her out there. I leave her in your capable hands.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_100_030: Oh, my apologies. I didn't notice you there.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_031: It's been quite some time. You are well, I trust? If you are looking to partake in the festivities, I would be happy to point you in the direction of the royal seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_032: Pardon me, but I do not believe we've met. Is there something you require?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_033: So the royal seneschal sent you... Well, I would be lying if I said that I didn't need the help. I'm in a worse way than I had realized...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_034: <sigh> I'm supposed to meet with two people as part of my investigation, but loath as I am to admit it, I'm in no condition to be up and about.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_035: As you may already know, I'm investigating the origins of an antique folding fan─the very one beside me─which I found in the Thorne manor one day.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_036: Curious about the design, which is unseen in Ul'dah, I turned to the history books─and discovered that it is of a style used in the palace during the Thorne Dynasty.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_037: Further research revealed that Princess Edvya, my ancestor who gave rise to Little Ladies' Day, once used such a fan in a dance she performed at a royal soirée.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_038: It was very beautiful, by all accounts, and I should have liked to see it.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_039: Inspired by this discovery, I consulted the royal seneschal, and it was decided that we would make replicas of the fan as gifts for this year's celebration.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_040: However, when we showed the fan to the artisan we hired, he declared that, while undeniably designed in the Thorne style, it was crafted much more recently─no more than a few decades ago at most.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_041: This led me to wonder: who had this fan made, and why? With my mother no longer with us, I went and asked my father, but he claimed to know nothing about it and said no more.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_042: Though he married into the family, he is the present head of House Thorne. If even he does not know, then I have to seek answers elsewhere.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_043: Additionally, if we learned how the fan was used during Princess Edvya's time, I thought that we could share the knowledge during the celebration. Thus did I arrange to meet with people who are versed in the history of our family.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_044: As I am now, however, I can scarcely stand without feeling faint. I'm sorry to impose, but might I trouble you to attend the appointments in my stead?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_045: I'm in your debt. Now, you will want to take the fan with you.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_046: Please show it when you meet the individuals in question. One is a reporter from the Mythril Eye, who will be at Arrzaneth Ossuary, and the other is a historian, who will be at the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_055: Lest you forget, the reporter is at Arrzaneth Ossuary, and the historian the Quicksand. Please show them the fan and learn what you can about it.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FESPDYARCHAEOLOGIST: Can I help you with something? I'm actually supposed to meet someone here, but she appears to be late...
Ah, so you've come on Miss Aldiytha's behalf. And this is the fan she wished me to inspect... Indeed, it is of a style hailing from the Thorne Dynasty.
It is said that Princess Edvya carried such a fan when she attended functions.
In those days, it was considered meet for noblewomen to cover their faces, to which end they carried folding fans on their persons.

But as the Legend of the Lost Lady would attest, Princess Edvya didn't concern herself with social norms. And at a royal soirée, far from using her fan to cover her face, she used it to perform an impromptu dance!
The sultan and his retinue of seneschals looked on aghast, but the guests were captivated by her performance, and erupted into rapturous applause when she finished.
That dance came to be known as the “Little Ladies' Dance,” and it is said to have been passed down through the women of House Thorne. The fan you hold, I expect, was crafted for that very purpose.

Curious, though... As a daughter of House Thorne, it seems to me that Miss Aldiytha should be aware of this legacy. In any case, I hope I was able to be of some help to her. Pray pass along my regards.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FESPDYJOURNALIST047: This fan... Aldiytha sent you, I take it. Very well, then, I'll tell you what I know.
When Aldiytha reached out about an antique fan she found, I was instantly reminded of a similar one that I saw long ago.
By her description alone, I couldn't be certain, but to see it here and now, there's no doubt in my mind: this fan once belonged to Aldiytha's mother, Claudia.
She was still half a girl at the time─fifteen summers old, perhaps─when I interviewed her for a Little Ladies' Day article. That day, she had this very fan with her.
She was out of sorts, though, and begged to sit down and rest. As tired as she looked, I decided to cut the interview short and ended up writing about something else.
I must say, I find it a little strange that Aldiytha should ask me about the fan. It belonged to her mother, after all. Surely she would know about it?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_090: Ah, you are returned. Thank you for attending the appointments in my stead. So, did you learn aught of interest?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_092: And it was used to perform the Little Ladies' Dance─a dance passed down through the women of our line?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_094: Forgive me, but I'm not sure what to think. I never knew about any of this─about neither the fan nor the dance. Why didn't my mother share the tradition with me?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_A1_000_001: Perhaps she was also unaware of it.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_A1_000_002: Perhaps she didn't have the chance.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_095: If this fan belonged to my mother, I'm inclined to believe she inherited the tradition, or was at least aware of it. But even if she'd wished to pass it on to me, she succumbed to illness when I was little...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_096: Yes, I feel that is the only plausible explanation. My mother succumbed to illness when I was little. Even if she had wished to pass on the tradition, she never had the chance to do so...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_097: Be that as it may, my father must have known something.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_098: I know not why he claimed otherwise and feigned ignorance about the fan, nor do I expect that he would willingly talk.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_099: Still...I want to know. About the dance, and about my mother. I'm sorry to impose yet again, adventurer, but won't you help me find the answers?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_100: This means a lot to me. Thank you.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_101: Now then, if my mother appeared at Little Ladies' Day with her fan, it seems likely that she performed the dance there. On that assumption, I propose we look for those who knew my mother around when she was involved in the festival. For this, wealthy middle-aged folk seems a likely place to start. Chances are they at least crossed paths with her in social circles.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_102: To that end, could you please try approaching affluent-looking individuals at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange and Eshtaime's Aesthetics? I shall await you here.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_110: In Ul'dah, those with wealth are wont to put it on display. I am counting on as much to lead us to someone who knew my mother.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FESPDYWOMAN04720_00: What's that? Do I know Claudia Thorne...and the dance she used to perform? May I ask who is asking?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FESPDYWOMAN04720_10: Goodness me, to think Aldiytha had no idea... I was good friends with her mother, I'm proud to say, and would be glad to share what I know.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FESPDYWOMAN04720_00: She was quite frail, was Claudia, and constantly took ill. As a result, she seldom attended social functions, and certainly never performed the Little Ladies' Dance in them.
She did, however, show it to me in private, and I consider myself blessed. It was so beautiful, I begged to learn it from her.
She kindly taught me, and she would have dearly loved to teach Aldiytha too, I'm sure. It breaks my heart that she never had the chance...
But if Aldiytha is keen to learn the dance, nothing would please me more than to teach it, a poor substitute though I may be for her mother.
She awaits at the Gold Court, yes? I shall go and find her there at once!
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_130: Where in the world did she disappear to...?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_131: Wh-What? Did I ever see the dance performed by Claudia Thorne!? As it happens...yes. Yes, I did...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_132: It was during a Little Ladies' Day celebration many years ago. Claudia was participating for the first time, and I had the honor of being her guide.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_133: By way of thanks for my company, she showed me the dance. Flourishing her fan, she moved with such majestic grace, I was left utterly transfixed.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_134: "A dance so lovely should be seen by all. Won't you perform it on stage at the festival?“ I suggested. And to my delight, she agreed with a smile.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_135: But no sooner did she finish enrapturing the crowds than she retreated out of sight, and all but collapsed to the ground.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_136: It was then that I learned of her frail constitution. Though I hadn't been aware, I felt no less terrible for making her overexert herself. I apologized profusely, begging her not to push herself ever again, and the sad look on her face when she nodded is something I've not forgotten to this day...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_137: Ah, but look at me prattle on to a complete stranger. My apologies. Now then, I was in the midst of looking for someone, so I shall excuse myself...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FESPDYLADY04720_000: A Thorne woman who once danced at the festival? I'm afraid I'm not familiar. Little Ladies' Day has always been a commonfolk's festival, after all.
If anyone were to know, I daresay it would be the head of the Thorne family. 'Tis under their auspices that the celebrations take place.
If anyone were to know about a Thorne woman who danced at Little Ladies' Day, it would be the head of the Thorne family. 'Tis under their auspices that the celebrations take place.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_160: Oh, there you are. A woman was here just now. She told me she was a friend of my mother's, and kindly taught me how to perform the Little Ladies' Dance.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_161: It's as beautiful as I imagined it would be, and I cannot thank you enough for finding this person. Now then, were you able to learn aught from anyone else?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_162: So my mother once performed the dance before a crowd, but the exertion was too much for her...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_163: From what I've now seen, the movements may indeed be trying for those of poor health.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_167: Those such as myself. Thus did my father choose to keep the dance a secret from me─out of concern for my well-being.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_168: ...Or so I speculate, at any rate.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_169: Lady Aldiytha! Thank heavens I found you!
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_170: Rodolph!? Wh-What are you doing here?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_171: What am I doing here? Begging your pardons, my lady, but you disappeared from the manor without a word! Both your father and I have been worried sick!
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_172: But all's well that ends well, and I see now that you were in good hands. Thank you, good , for looking after the young mistress once more.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_173: But all's well that ends well, and it seems that you were on hand for the young mistress. As her seneschal, allow me to express my heartfelt gratitude.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_174: Now then, my lady. Even as we speak, your father searches for you in the city. If you feel strong enough, let us seek him out together. It would set his mind at ease.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_100_175: Thanks to you, I've discovered things I never knew about my family, and I would have you at my side when I meet with my father. Will you come with me?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_110_175: Thank you. Your presence will give me the courage to seek the truth.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_176: Master Fortin should be somewhere in the Ruby Road Exchange. Please follow me.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_180: I told Father that I am perfectly fine, but he nevertheless insisted that I sit down...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_181: Master Fortin was beside himself with worry over the young mistress's health. He wishes to thank you for attending her.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_190: You... You're the  from earlier. I should have guessed you were the one who aided my daughter...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_191: I said what I said not realizing you had come at her behest, but what's done is done. Now, allow me to properly introduce myself. Fortin Thorne, head of the Thorne family, at your service.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_192: No more secrets, Father. Why did you hide the truth from me?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_193: I couldn't bring myself to tell you. Even as that fan and that dance hold fond memories of your mother, they are a painful reminder that she is gone.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_194: I couldn't bear to lose you as well. So please, return the fan, and forget about the dance.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_195: Father... I understand full well why you feel this way. Were I in your position, I would likely feel the same.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_196: But as much as I'm touched by your concern, I know about everything now. About Mother, about the fan, and even the dance...
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_RODOLPH_000_198: Lady Aldiytha, that was extraordinary! Where in the world did you learn how to dance so beautifully?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_199: An old friend of Mother's taught me. Despite all these years, she still remembered the entire dance down to smallest flourish.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_200: Mother brought you great joy when she danced for you that day. On coming to understand this, I knew that I wanted you to experience that joy again.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_202: Like I once apologized to your mother, I must now apologize to you.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_203: It was wrong of me to hide the fan and the dance from you, and I hope you find it in your heart to forgive me. If it is your desire to carry on the tradition, then I will not stand in your way.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_204: Thank you. But you know, Father...it is Little Ladies' Day. Rather than an apology, is there not a more appropriate gesture for the occasion?
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_205: As you say, my princess. As you say. I, Fortin Thorne, head of the Thorne family, do hereby pledge to serve as your royal seneschal. Your every wish is my command.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_206: ...Except, perhaps, when I judge that you are overexerting yourself. After all, Your Highness's well-being is my foremost priority.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_207: I shall bear that in mind. Without further ado, then, my first wish is to instruct festival staff in the Little Ladies' Dance, that we may share it with all who participate in the festivities.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_FORTIN_000_208: If that is your wish, then it is mine as well. On this day, all ladies are princesses, and everyone should by rights inherit the dance passed down in our family.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_209: I have a gift for you, adventurer, as a token of my gratitude. It isn't much, but please accept these instructions for the dance, along with a replica of my mother's fan.
TEXT_FESPDY801_04720_ALDIYTHA_000_210: Now then, there's no time to waste. We must distribute these fans to as many people as possible, and share with them the history of the dance. This will be a Little Ladies' Day to remember, oh yes it will!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_001: Heeeeee! Now's my chance! Now all shall know their splendor! <heavy breathing>
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Greetings, friend! And a happy Hatching-tide to you.
May I say that you look eggsquisite as always, ? 'Tis always a pleasure.
Allow me to introduce myself─my name is Jihli Aliapoh, and I facilitate the annual Hatching-tide festivities.
You are an adventurer, are you not? Might I ask for your name?
! 'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

In case you are unaware, Hatching-tide festivities were conceived a number of years ago, after I was first visited by the Twelve Archons in a stirring and prophetic dream─and I confess, I've been dreaming ever since!
Oh, I am most eager to share my latest dream with you! It was...highly peculiar, to say the least. You see, I beheld visions of that chilling creature of legend─the tonberry!

If past experience has taught me anything, it is that painstakingly recreating my dreams is sure to bring about good fortune. However, as tonberries are naught but figments of old fables, I began to doubt whether I could do justice to their ghastly appearance...
...But that all changed when this gentleman generously offered his assistance!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_019: (-Hamlyn-)<snort> Greetings, ! My name is Hamlyn, and I am what you might call a supreme connoisseur and passionate aficionado of all things tonberry.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_100_019: (-Hamlyn-)As you may or may not be aware, tonberries have heads as round and adorable as any egg, which is why I believe they are the perfect addition to the Hatching-tide festivities. <snort> So I donned the superior mantle of tonberry, and presented myself to Miss Jihli here. Hee...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: What luck, wouldn't you agree? Hamlyn was kind enough to furnish our other volunteers with tonberry guises, and we're all hard at work preparing for the upcoming fun.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A1_000_001: And a lot of eggy, stabby fun it shall be!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A1_000_003: If you wanted real tonberries, I know a few in upper La Noscea...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: Exactly! That's the spirit of Hatching-tide. ...Perhaps without the “stabby” part.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_023: (-Hamlyn-)Such is often the reaction of the unenlightened, yes. But it only fuels the fire of my passion! <heavy breathing>
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_024: (-Hamlyn-)You must be referring to those sightings near Bronze Lake. I wouldn't expect you to know this, but those creatures aren't true tonberries. They simply bear a vague resemblance to their descriptions in the old stories, and thus were nicknamed...thusly.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_025: (-Hamlyn-)No, the tonberries I speak of and adore above all else are the original and fictional creatures, spoken of in legend from time immemorial. <snort> Accept no substitutes!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: Considering my dream, I think that these festivities present a unique opportunity to share the tonberries' charm with the world. There is but one problem.
A group of sylphs has been making mischief throughout town. Playing pranks, sabotaging the decorations...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_028: (-Hamlyn-)Luckily, it seems a mere glance of the tonberry form is enough to send those leafy brigands fleeing in terror. Is it not remarkable how such an adorable visage can strike such fear into the hearts of some? Does not the contradiction of the tonberry's nature invigorate your very soul!? <heavy breathing>
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: Our other volunteers are using their tonberry guises to shoo away the sylphs as best they can, but we still find ourselves shorthanded. Would you be willing to assist us, ? Just until the mischief is mitigated.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: My sincerest thanks. Hamlyn has prepared a plethora of guises for us, so I'm sure he will have one that fits you.
It seems there's a trick to getting into that tonberry guise. I'm sure Hamlyn will be happy to assist!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_040: Now then, <snort> let us commence with this most sacred of ceremonies. Come closer... Hmhmhm...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_041: From the moment I saw you, I knew your small frame would lend itself perfectly to my creation. What an exquisite little tonberry you shall be! <shlorp>
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYSTEM_000_042: You must continue wearing the tonberry guise in order to progress.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYSTEM_000_044: Speak with Hamlyn to restore or prolong the garment change.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_045: Hmm... Hold still─I must make some adjustments.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_046: Whatever is the matter? Was donning the holy guise of tonberry too euphoric? Too itchy? No matter─I shall adorn you once more. Heeeeeeeee!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHB04721_100_047: This one brims with delight! What a laugh these ones shall have!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHE04721_100_048: Tee hee! Walking ones will be ever so shocked!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHA04721_000_050: This one put a warty one behind those shiny eggs!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHB04721_000_051: Hee hee! Walking ones will dance and shriek!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYSTEM_000_000_052: You must be wearing the tonberry guise provided by Hamlyn in order to progress.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHA04721_000_053: Hide well, warty one! Then spring out and make the walking ones screech and jump!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHA04721_000_054: Hee hee! This one can't wait!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A2_000_001: Let's have some eggy, eggy, stabby fun!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A2_000_002: Did you just call me a warty one?
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHB04721_000_057: Scary one! Scary one is here! Flee, flee!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHC04721_000_060: Not faaair! Those ones are having all the fun!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYSTEM_000_000_062: You must be wearing the tonberry guise provided by Hamlyn in order to progress.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHA04721_000_063: Well, if these ones can't have fun with tusked ones, walking ones won't have any fun either! This one will make sure of it!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A3_000_001: But how about some eggy, eggy, stabby fun?
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A3_000_002: You can have fun with me!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHC04721_000_066: Hyaaaaaa! Monstrous one! This is why these ones need tusked oneees!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHD04721_000_070: B-But if elder one finds out...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHE04721_000_071: What elder one doesn't know won't hurt elder one! Don't be a wilting one.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYSTEM_000_000_072: You must be wearing the tonberry guise provided by Hamlyn in order to progress.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHD04721_000_073: B-But...if these ones are naughty, elder one will become scolding one...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHE04721_000_074: No one will know it was these ones! Besides, it isn't that naughty... Hee hee!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A4_000_001: Don't be naughty─have eggy, eggy, stabby fun!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_A4_000_002: I think I'll be the judge of that.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHD04721_000_076: Gyaaaaaa! P-Please! Th-This one didn't mean any harm!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_SYLPHE04721_000_077: Eeeeeek! Sticky one! Get it away!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_080: <snort> I trust you return from a job well done?
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_081: I am sure Miss Jihli would like to hear the particulars. You may relay your report after I... <slurp> relieve you of that outfit. Hmhmhm...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_082: Well? Tell us─how did the tonberry fare? <heavy breathing>
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: I'm glad to hear those sylphs fluttered back home. Thank you for all of your help, .
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_086: Yes, you performed most admirably, not only in deed but in dress. Upon beholding a tonberry performing such selfless acts of valor, the citizens of Gridania are sure to have warmed to our adorable paragons of pointy justice─all according to <snort> plan.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: Our other volunteers are currently making the rounds and checking the rest of the decorations for any residual surprises, but I daresay we should be able to officially begin the celebrations soon.
All that's left is to wait for our Archon eggs to arrive from Ul'dah!
Which reminds me─Master Pawlin sends his regards. He is currently recovering from injuries sustained from a particularly sharp beak, and will therefore be unable to attend Hatching-tide this year...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_09: ...But he generously sent us dozens and dozens of delightful eggs! So many, in fact, we had to commission the Goldsmiths' Guild for help with their decoration.
I hope you enjoy the festivities! Something tells me this shall be a Hatching-tide to remember.
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_NONOTTA_000_094: It's the eggs, Jihli! The Archon eggs!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_NONOTTA_000_095: Sylphs swarmed the shipment as it entered the Central Shroud and zapped the delivery mammet into a frenzy. The caravan has been brought to a complete standstill!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_NONOTTA_000_096: If only you had seen it─the chaos, the carnage, the eggs! Our beautiful Archon eggs scattered across the ground, sylphs pilfering them like spriggans, and that smoking mammet rampaging like an aldgoat possessed. 'Twas sheer mayhem, Jihli!
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_NONOTTA_000_100: The sylphs presented no demands, offered no reason behind their rampant pillaging. But they did keep squeaking about “tusked ones” and “no fair” and “why should walking ones have all the fun?” What do you suppose they meant?
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_10: Ah. I heard the sylphs once held an annual spring festival, but there was an incident involving one of their fighting boars... I believe that was the end of such festivities.
I understand how it must pain them to see us cheerfully prepare for Hatching-tide, but those ill-gotten eggs won't ease their suffering. We must find a way to recover them...
TEXT_FESEST901_04721_HAMLYN_000_103: Heeeeee! If I may be so bold, <snort> I believe I have the perfect solution to your conundrum. 's assistance will be crucial, however. <heavy breathing> You will lend us your aid, yes?
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: I beg you, ─speak with Hamlyn and see how we might recover those Archon eggs!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_002: All those eggs... All those beautifully decorated─and expensive─eggs...
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_003: You wish to lend your strength to my brilliant plan, do you? <snort> Very well. Our divine mission is as follows─we must adorn ourselves in the guise of the tonberry, and scare the sylphs away from the fallen eggs!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_004: ...Ahem, it may seem like a rather familiar tactic, but terror cuts as sharply as a knife in the right hands. As does the power of the tonberry! <snort> We shall remind those sylphs of what adorable horror lurks in the shadow.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_005: It is time to take the tonberry's naturally winsome and captivating visage and transform it into a mask of pure evil.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_006: I...suppose that makes sense. But what of the delivery mammet? In its panicked state, it may easily mistake us for naught but common egg-thieves─er, perhaps not so common, considering the guises.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_007: That's where 's participation is crucial. <snort> Even an overexcited automaton is no match for an adventurer versed in the arts of warfare!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_008: Of course, I shan't be so cruel as to send you into battle as defenseless as a swaddled tonbabe.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_100_008: You may rely upon me to perform the necessary <shlorp> enhancements upon your guise, that shall grant any stabby sweetheart the ability to withstand even the harshest of electrified zaps! ...In theory, anyway.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_009: In the midst of adversity lies opportunity, as they say─or rather, in the midst of scattered Archon eggs stands the noble tonberry, that all might witness its triumphant glory!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Very well. Let us proceed with Hamlyn's plan and see that our eggs are recovered safely.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_011: Hmhm, excellent! <snort> I shall commence the enhancement of this guise at once and have it ready for deployment in two flicks of a tonberry's blade. ─let us meet where the bells of destiny toll. To arms!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: I shall contact the Adventurers' Guild to see if any there are willing to help as well.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_013: You'll find the caravan by the Mirror Planks in the Central Shroud. You can't miss it─not even if you tried.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_015: You did it, ! You truly did it!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_016: 'Twas sheer majesty, the likes of which I have never seen! <heavy breathing>
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: And here comes our hero now! Hamlyn has just been regaling us with the tale of your valor, .
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_021: We can't thank you enough for recovering those Archon eggs. Truly─from the bottom of our hearts and purses─thank you!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_023: My single regret is that no rapturous bystanders were present in those solitary woods to witness such valorous displays.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_024: Alas, the tonberry's majesty will once again pass unacknowledged. Yet, such is often the way with true goodness. <snort> The hero that works in secrecy for the betterment of all? My friends, their name is tonberry.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_025: (-Nonotta-)Profound, I'm sure. I must say, Hamlyn, your unflagging devotion to all things tonberry is both remarkable and admirable...
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_RESIDENTSB04722_000: We were in those solitary woods! And we saw what you did for us. ...Er, what the tonberries did for us.
I was heartbroken when a sylph snatched away the Archon egg that my friend had given me...
...But thanks to you, it was recovered safely. You tonberries have my eternal thanks.
I only wish you didn't have to scare the sylphs so badly. The poor things... Is there no other way to deter their mischief?
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_HAMLYN_000_033: Indeed! <snort> Consider this─if we decorate our eggs with a tonberry theme, the sylphs wouldn't dare snatch or sabotage them!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_034: A dark green coat on a large egg with two golden circles for eyes? Not bad at all. Perhaps even...cute!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_035: Jihli, perhaps this is what your dream foretold. Not just tonberry guises, but tonberry eggs and decorations as well!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_NONOTTA_000_036: In which case, we should send word to our Ul'dahn goldsmiths that we'd like another batch of Archon eggs in some striking shades of tonberry.
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: Of course, all our eggs are packaged during transit, meaning the sylphs will likely continue their mischief outside the city. I'm tempted to send a tonberry guard with the caravan, but the road from Ul'dah is far too long to attempt in such a guise.

We shall continue to consider possible alternatives, but in the meantime, should you happen to come across another waylaid shipment, I hope I can count on your assistance. Er...as a tonberry, of course.
Well, seeing as our Archon eggs have finally arrived, I daresay it is time to officially get cracking! Let the Hatching-tide festivities begin!
TEXT_FESEST902_04722_SYSTEM_000_100: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Ah, my prayers are answered! As the sun beat down upon my brow, my flagging spirits were kept aloft by the hope of your return. Now that you're here, I can say that the Moonfire Faire's success is assured!
Come one, come all! The Moonfire Faire is here to offer the realm's beleaguered citizens a diversion from the sun's scorching rays, and seeks volunteers from among the Adventurers' Guild's ranks!

Our festival has a long and storied history that hardly bears repeating, but for all intents and purposes, it's become the premier event of our guild. We hope to stoke the fires of adventurous hearts young, old, and all ages in between!

This season's main event has become a favorite among adventurers and revelers alike: the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course! Keeping vigil over the proceedings is the Sunshine Savior, guardian of the sandy beaches!

Who is the Sunshine Savior, you ask? If your interest has been piqued, then I encourage you to make haste to Costa del Sol, where Haermaga stands at the ready to apprise eager volunteers of the details!
Haermaga awaits to induct eager volunteers for this year's Moonfire Faire. Attend to him and you may even be fortunate enough to meet the fabled Sunshine Savior yourself!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_010: Well, if it isn't , as sure a guest to the Moonfire Faire as this stifling heat! Did Mayaru Moyaru's mention of the Sunshine Savior stir that heroic spirit of yours?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_011: Welcome to the Moonfire Faire! It's always a treat to see a new face, and one from the guild doubly so. Did Mayaru Moyaru's mention of the Sunshine Savior stir the spirit of heroism within you?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_012: I should hope so, because between you and me, we're in a bit of a bind. If you wouldn't mind lending an ear to our troubles, I'd appreciate the opinion of a fellow adventurer.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_013: Much obliged. You see, the faire's been no stranger to difficulties, make no mistake. People swimming where they shouldn't be, monsters treating the beaches like a bloody banquet, and all manner of other perils have put a damper on what's meant to be a time for celebration.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_014: To combat this, I came up with the idea of the Sunshine Savior, a brave soul whose duty would be to nip such problems in the bud before they become everyone's headache.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_100_014: Not only would they keep our patrons safe, but their deeds would raise the esteem of the guild as well. Not only that, but it would be the perfect opportunity to give our fresh blood a chance to shine.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_015: So I went looking for a stout arm from within our ranks, and after a process of stringent vetting, settled on an eager youth by the name of Lyonell.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_016: The lad seemed a perfect fit, but his spirits have taken a sharp dive since he arrived in Costa del Sol. Whatever the cause of his troubles, it's plain he needs a guiding hand or two to see him through them.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_017: So, if you've got the time and the inclination, I'd like you to help set him on the right path. Once he's found his footing, I won't ask you to dote on him any longer. How about it?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_018: You're a lifesaver, friend. Now then, follow me and I'll make introductions. Lyonell should be somewhere near the aetheryte─let's go find him, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_020: Apologies, but the lad seems to be missing. I explicitly told him to wait here...
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_MOB_000_021: (-Surly Voice-)Get yer bloody hands off of my goods!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_022: (-Tremulous Youth-)S-S-Sorry, terribly sorry! I only thought to help... The crates looked awfully heavy, you see...
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_023: (-Tremulous Youth-)B-But you're right to be wroth at me! Yes, for why would you need my aid, with my arms thinner than sprouting reeds... I see the error of my ways. I shall shovel buffalo dung as punishment!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_MOB_000_024: Ah, lad, sorry for snappin' at ye. Appreciate the thought, but the contents of these crates are my livelihood─can't trust just any passersby with their safe carriage, ye understand.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_MOB_000_025: And truth be told, you came at me like a chocobo takin' its first steps. You need to strut with a bit o' confidence if you don't want people lookin' at you crosswise, see?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_MOB_000_026: Ye've a good heart, lad. Anyone can see that. Work on yer manner and I reckon yer next attempt at charity'll go jus' fine.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_027: Hmm. I can hazard a guess at what happened here, but I'd like to hear your side of the story nonetheless. Mind filling me in, Lyonell?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_028: Oh, Master Haermaga! And who is this...?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_100_028: It can't be... Is this  my replacement!? Heavens forfend, I've been dismissed before my duty has even begun.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_029: There's no need for all that.  here is a member of the guild, and  here to help. But first, we need to know what's going on.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_030: I, ah... You see, I was awaiting orders like you asked, but then I spied that man struggling to carry his goods. I thought to offer a helping hand, but...well, you saw how the rest went.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_031: ...I see. I can't fault you for trying to do good, lad, but what he said was right: your manner is bloody strange, and has been ever since you set foot on these sands. I don't recall you being so timid when first we met─if something's weighing on you, you needn't shy away from sharing the burden.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_033: The truth is...I just can't bear to have my face seen by others. All those eyes on me...it's dreadful. Under a helmet, I have the confidence of a captain, but this heat has left me with no choice but to bare my naked face to all and sundry.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_034: I'm afraid I'm likely to do more harm than help if I can't get my nerves under control. But the festivities are due to start soon, and I can scarcely stand to look even you in the eyes...
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_035: So that's the way of it. I appreciate your candor, lad.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_036: If it's as simple as covering your face, we can get you sorted straightaway. Come with me to the storehouse. I have something there that I think you'll like.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_037: As for you, , you'd better wait on the beach for our return. Don't worry, we'll be back before you can break a sweat.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_038: And here we are! Feast your eyes upon Costa del Sol's Sunshine Savior!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_039: Blinded by its brilliance, aren't you? I had this lovely piece made the moment I conceived of the Sunshine Savior. A special commission from the Weavers' Guild!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_040: But genius isn't always obvious, I discovered. My colleagues claimed the coloring was too bold, the design too daring. I believe the word “gaudy” was tossed about. And so, with a heavy heart, I set it aside─until today, that is.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_041: By the gods, I feel a whole fulm taller! The fabric is so light it's like I'm wearing naught but my nameday suit! I'm ready to take on the world and then some!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_042: Masks are usually for hiding one's true nature, but this is the Lyonell I remember. If you ask me, he looks the spitting image of a hero. But what do you think, ?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_A1_000_002: I'm not sure if this is an improvement.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_A1_000_003: Are you bringing back the Go Go Posing Rangers?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_050: I'm overjoyed that you think so! Mark my words, the sands of Costa del Sol shall remain safe under the watchful eyes of the Sunshine Savior!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_051: Really? I'm quite taken with it─I'm particularly fond of the avian motif. With this, festival-goers can rest assured that they shall be safe under the watchful eyes of the Sunshine Savior!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_054: So you remember that, eh? Truth be told, the thought hadn't crossed my mind when designing the costume, but now that you mention it...
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_055: Ah, the Go Go Posing Rangers, I know their story well! Those dauntless heroes pitted themselves against the Bombards for the safety of the realm!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_056: And just as the flames of the Bombards were extinguished, the Rangers disappeared like a ship over the horizon. Hearing how they risked life and limb with no expectation of reward or fame is what inspired me to join the guild!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_057: Is that so? It warms my heart to know they left such a lasting impression on at least one young mind.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_058: Now then, Lyonell, consider this your official appointment as the Sunshine Savior. Go forth, and remember that you carry the reputation of the Adventurers' Guild on your shoulders. Don't crumble under the weight, lad.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_059: Become a savior worthy of your namesake, and our guests will soon forget the countless monsters and maladies that lurk beneath the tides. I know you won't disappoint!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_HAERMAGA_000_061: Lyonell has a gods-honest chance to make a good run of it now, but that depends on him.
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_062: As the Sunshine Savior, I must bear all the responsibilities that the title implies. I can do this...I can become an adventurer that others speak of in awe!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_063: By the way, I'd like to apologize for my embarrassing conduct before...
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_064: I admit a part of me is scared almost all of the time, but I can't let that dictate my life and my duty. Whatever happens, I swear to do all in my power to make this Moonfire Faire the safest yet!
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_065: That being said, I realize I still have much to learn, and would very much appreciate the aid of a seasoned adventurer such as yourself. Will you help me?
TEXT_FESSUM901_04723_LYONELL_000_066: Thank you, ! I look forward to growing under your wing!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_000: I'm ready to start whenever you are, !
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_001: Lyonell looks every ilm the hero, and no mistake. But looks aren't worth a damn if his heart isn't in it.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_100_001: How're you feeling under that mask, lad? Up for the work ahead?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_002: About that... As much as I'd like to jump right into the thick of things, I can't help but harbor some small doubts.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_100_002: The incident with the merchant earlier made me realize that it's one matter to want to aid those in need, but another matter entirely to know who needs it.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_003: Fortunately, I have  by my side─a seasoned adventurer who's helped  fair share of troubled souls. I've asked  to take me under  wing for a bit, and I hope to be a quick study.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_004: That's a capital idea, lad. Every adventurer has a few stories of being rewarded with scorn instead of coin. Strange as it sounds, a helping hand must be deft besides.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_005: Well then, let's revise your tasks, eh? Give you a chance to sharpen that nose of yours to the scent of unrest.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_006: Why don't you stand watch over the revelers gathered at the northeastern shores? If you spot trouble brewing, put a lid on it before it spills over.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_007: will attend you in a supervisory capacity. Before leaping into action, ask  for advice on how to conduct yourself.  guide you well, I've no doubt.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_008: Now then, off with you! The battlefield on the beach awaits─make me proud, you two, make me proud!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_009: A guild member by the name of Beaudefoin is standing by for someone to relieve him of his duty. Speak with him first, then show the realm the measure of a Sunshine Savior!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_011: This is it, ! It's time to prove myself worthy!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_012: Beaudefoin should be patrolling somewhere nearby, assuming he hasn't caught a nap under some shade. Relieve him of his post─I'll be here waiting for tidings of your success!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_BEAUDEFOIN_000_013: Why, if it isn't the Sunshine Savior, protector of the summer sands! Please, please, I release the beaches of Costa del Sol to your stewardship!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_SYSTEM_100_013: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_BEAUDEFOIN_000_014: Ah, yes. Before I go, allow me to furnish you with these linkpearls. A crucial tool for a pair of strapping guardians such as yourselves. Godsspeed, saviors!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_015: And now our watch begins! Go on, , tell me what you see. If there is trouble lurking about, the Sunshine Savior shall rise to action!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A1_000_001: A young Miqo'te lad and lass look like a sellsword just stole their lunch.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A1_000_002: A shifty pirate lass is sizing up a nearby man. Quite intensely, by the looks of it.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_RFHULTIA_000_020: Grrrggg...I failed again. I'll never master the course at this rate...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_RMAJHA_000_021: C'mon Fhul, I believe in you!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_RMAJHA_000_022: ...But nothing I say seems to help. I wish I knew how to cheer you up...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_023: The lad looks absolutely crestfallen. From what I can gather, he's having some difficulties with the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. I know what it's like to feel success slip from one's grasp time and again...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A2_000_001: Show him how a Sunshine Savior does it!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A2_000_002: Give him some words of encouragement!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A2_000_003: Leave him be. He'll learn more by lifting himself up.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_030: You want me to attempt the course? I'm equal to the challenge, you can be sure, but that would mean leaving my charges unprotected.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_031: If you ask me, it looks like the lad needs but a few words of encouragement. Yes, that should do the trick. , wait there─I'll be back in a flash!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_032: You read my mind, ! Encouragement is my forte! A few carefully placed words should lift this lad over the obstacle in his path. Wait there─I'll be back in a flash!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_033: I see the wisdom in that, truly I do. But I can't help but recall my own struggles─where would I have ended up if you and Master Haermaga didn't come along with a few encouraging words?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_034: Surely it couldn't hurt, could it? Wait here, ─I'll be back before you can think of a reason to object!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_035: The pair were thankful enough, and the lad seemed once again eager to tackle the course. All in all, a success for the Sunshine Savior!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_RHOSWEN_000_040: Bloody Carvallain, thinks he's too good for a pirate, does he?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_RHOSWEN_000_041: I'll make him see, I will. If I just ask him all nice-like...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_RHOSWEN_100_041: "Fancy a stroll on the beach, Carvallain?“ or some such... Bah, he'll just think I'm itchin' fer a duel!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_042: She's mumbling to herself an awful lot. The menacing provocations of a pirate, no doubt. What do you think, ?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A3_000_001: Just ask if something's the matter.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A3_000_002: Don't worry about her. Worry about the man!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A3_000_003: We should watch from a safe distance.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_043: I think you have the right of it, . Even I can see that this has the look of something dangerous. I'd best insinuate myself into the matter before it takes a turn.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_100_043: Ah, you're right! Anyone staring daggers like that can only have ill intent. I'll warn the man at once!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_044: The pirate ran off with nary a word of explanation. I can't help but feel as if I interrupted something... Ah, well, there's no telling what could've happened, so as far as I'm concerned, the Sunshine Savior can mark down a victory in his ledger.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_047: Are you certain? This has the scent of danger...or perhaps something foul has washed ashore. Ah, no matter, I shall trust your advice. It's what you're here for, after all!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_048: Hmm, I'm beginning to understand. She wishes to say something, but it's caught in her throat like a bone.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_049: ...Ah, she's given up. Judging from her manner, she may have the same reservations as I concerning showing her face to others. A kindred spirit, in need of aid...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_050: Alas, I have but a single mask, so I couldn't have helped even if I wanted. But you knew all of that, didn't you? Remarkable foresight, my friend, truly remarkable!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_060: Well, I see nothing amiss in this area. What about over there?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A4_000_001: A group of revelers are entranced by the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A4_000_002: Some muscular fellows are slumped over on the ground.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_MOBA04724_000_070: (-Faire Reveler-)Go on, jump! Jump like your life depends on it!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_MOBA04724_000_071: (-Faire Reveler-)You'll never make it from there! Watch out or you'll eat sand!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_MOBB04724_000_072: (-Faire Reveler-)Oh no, is he all right!? I think I heard a snap...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_074: Phew... Apologies for not waiting for your guidance, . I dived into the ocean without a thought for what would come next...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_075: Before I knew it, there was water under my mask. I was sure I'd meet my end then and there...but somehow, I found my bearings, and brought that man ashore. I suppose fortune favors the reckless, eh?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_MOBD04724_000_078: (-Muscle-bound Roegadyn-)My muscles burn for more... But gods, I can barely see straight...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_07: Oh no, that's not good! Should I call upon one of the chaperones!?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_080: I suppose this heat and intense exercise mix as well as oil does with water. Should I offer assistance?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A6_000_001: Tell them to find a spot of shade to rest in.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A6_000_002: Tell them to drink plenty of fluids.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A6_000_003: Look at all those muscles. They'll be fine.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_082: You're quite right! Even the strongest of us will wither before the sun without water and rest. I'll go and tell them as much!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_083: I see that, but what use are muscles before the pitiless rays of the sun? At the very least, I should recommend a short constitutional.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_089: I had a word with the men, and they insisted there was nothing to worry about. Still, my duty is to dig out the roots of trouble before they break soil, so in that respect I consider this a success.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_090: Speaking of which, I see no further signs of distress along the beach. I believe our relief should be along soon, and truth be told I'm glad for it. I can't bear this stifling heat for much longer...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_091: Still, better to be baking under the hot sun than drowning under the ocean waves. Every breath I took invited more water into my lungs... If one of the seven hells lies on the ocean floor, doubtless its doors were cast open for my arrival.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_092: But I'm grateful to be alive and well, and with a few feats of derring-do under my belt besides. That's in no small part thanks to you, ─your sound guidance led me to take action where I might have been paralyzed by doubt.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_093: I have Haermaga's costume to thank, too. It may very well have some special power to turn the timid into the lionhearted...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_BEAUDEFOIN_000_094: Impressive work, you two! I say you've earned some rest, eh? Allow me to watch over our patrons─I can only hope my stretch is half as eventful as yours was!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_100_096: I suspect Master Haermaga will want to hear of our successes here. Let's go and make our report.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_100: I know I yet have a long journey ahead of me, but I hope that I've taken at least a few bounding strides toward my goal.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_101: Ah, there you are! The stories of your deeds precede you─revelers up and down the beaches are taken with your bravery.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_102: The one you plucked from the sea even came to offer his personal thanks. By all accounts, your lost confidence has been restored, and more besides. I reckon you're ready to set off on your own, but I won't force it upon you if you've got lingering reservations.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_103: I... Well, truth be told, I wouldn't have been able to do it without 's help. And this mask, of course─donning it makes me forget the meaning of the word “impossible.”
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_104: Hmm... You have to realize that  won't be around forever, so inclined to adventuring abroad as  is. A savior needs to be able to carry their burden alone if they're to earn the trust of others.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_105: You know, you never did tell us why you're so frightened of showing your face. Something tells me you didn't crawl out of your mother's womb with your hands covering your eyes. Am I right?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_106: ...Aye. It happened when I was just getting my feet wet as an adventurer, during a job that should have been unremarkable...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_107: We were tasked with guarding a merchant caravan, which naturally drew the attention of a terrible, slavering beast. Instead of sticking it with a spear like I was supposed to, I was knocked senseless within moments.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_108: When I regained my senses, I saw that my partner had been dealt a grievous wound and the caravan was in shambles─the job was an utter failure. For a blessing, none lost their lives, but I lost all standing in the eyes of my allies and employers.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_109: They blamed me for their injuries and the damage to their goods, and rightfully so. The memory of their scornful gazes is etched in my mind, and I see them every time I look another in the eyes.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_110: So you coped with your fear by hiding behind a helm. It's starting to make sense...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_111: You know, Lyonell, that suit's more than a masterwork of comfort. There's a meaning behind its design, if you can believe it...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_112: See, it's meant to evoke the image of the Phoenix. That legendary bird symbolizes rebirth, rising from the ashes over and over again, each time shining brighter than before.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_113: Seeing your triumphs as a Sunshine Savior has made me certain that the Phoenix's fire burns within you, Lyonell. And when those flames are stoked, you'll be reborn with more courage than you ever could've imagined.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_114: All this time, I was wrapped in the Phoenix's embrace... Yes, if there's a chance I might be born anew, then the path ahead of me is clear!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_115: I'm heading back to the beach─this time without a mask!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_116: Something on your mind? Did I lay it on too thick?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_117: When you get to my age, you can't help but light fires under those that need it.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_118: And that lad needed it something fierce, so I lit a raging bonfire under his arse! Just had to work with the embers that were already there─that burning desire of his to help the downtrodden.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_501: Not so fast, ! If someone jumps to his rescue again, that fire I just lit will be snuffed out. We need to think of a way to help him that doesn't involve doing all the heavy lifting.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A30_000_001: The Sunshine Savior never backs down!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A30_000_002: Rise from the ashes of defeat, and be reborn!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A30_000_003: No monster can stand against Lyonell!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_A30_000_004: If you can't do it, no one can!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_MOB04724_000_600: (-Moonfire Reveler-) right! You're our Sunshine Savior! So save us!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_603: I can't let them down. I must uphold the reputation of the Sunshine Savior!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_605: Bathe in the flames of my rebirth! Bathe in the flames of the Phoenix!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_120: The lad looks unharmed─a small miracle, all things considered.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_BEAUDEFOIN_000_121: I came as fast as I could, but it seems I was not needed. Lyonell really made stew out of that shark, didn't he? It seems Haermaga was right about him.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_KHLOEALIAPOH_000_12: That was so scary! I thought it would eat me!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_12: Thank the heavens he was here! I don't know what I'd do if Khloe came to any harm...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_KHLOEALIAPOH_000_12: That was so frightening, but so exciting at the same time! I'm gonna write about you in my diary!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_12: Thank you, thank you, thank you! Khloe's safe, and it's all because of you!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_127: But I was only─ Ah, never mind that. You're most welcome, of course.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_128: I'm not sure what to call what just happened, but the word “miracle” comes to mind. Did I truly vanquish that bloodthirsty brute of a shark?
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_129: That you did, and without a single scratch on our guests. You showed them what the Sunshine Savior stands for and gave them a display they won't soon forget. All on your own, too.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_100_129: But even a savior isn't invincible, eh? Go with Beaudefoin and get yourself checked. Wouldn't want you to be done in by a few scrapes.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_131: and I will keep an eye on things here in case any other seaborne predators decide to try their luck.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_141: Thanks to you two, talk of the Adventurers' Guild is on the lips of all in Costa del Sol. As far as I'm concerned, we can consider the Sunshine Savior a rousing success and a boon for the guild.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_142: Lyonell here deserves a standing ovation for the bravery he displayed. Taking down a fiend like that and keeping the younglings safe is a feat very few can boast of.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_143: As my vision dimmed, I heard  call out to me. It was  words that delivered me from the brink, and allowed me to go further still.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_000_144: They might call me the Sunshine Savior, but you're the true hero of the day. You've given me the courage to go on alone, and for that there is no way I can repay you.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_145: Indeed our savior had a savior of his own. A fact we're all grateful for.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_146: I'm of a mind to make you an honorary Sunshine Savior, suit and all. Wear it well, and don't ask me how many more of these I have stashed away.
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_HAERMAGA_000_147: Now go on, forget your worries and take in your fill of the festivities, for the Moonfire Faire is safe so long as Lyonell stands as its guardian!
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_100_147: Aye, I shall remain vigilant for any signs of trouble. And if aught appears to threaten the peace...
TEXT_FESSUM902_04724_LYONELL_200_147: I'll be there to stop it!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001: As I live and breathe─is that !? What a pleasant surprise!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_A1_000_001: You're that reporter, right? Kip... Uh...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: Yes, yes, Kipih Jakkya, at your service. Or rather, at The Raven's service, I suppose. I never had the chance to thank you properly for before─the article I wrote with your help drew eyes from across the realm and beyond to our tabloid.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003: Don't tell me you've forgotten who I am? It's me, Kipih Jakkya, reporter─and dare I say wordsmith─for The Raven. Did you even read the article you helped me write? Too busy adventuring, I suppose.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004: It was the highlight of my already illustrious career, and I'm overjoyed to see you again. Actually, I'm in need of help to write my latest piece, and since fortune has placed you before me, I wonder if you wouldn't lend me a hand.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_100_003: How do you know my brother? I don't recall telling you his name... Now that you mention it, he did recently send me a letter...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_200_003: Ah, but this is no time to be speaking of such things. I'm in need of help to write my latest piece, and since fortune has placed you before me, I wonder if you wouldn't lend me a hand.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_005: You there, you have the look of the adventuring sort. I've been looking for someone like you to help me with my new piece.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_006: This is your golden opportunity to be immortalized within the pages of The Raven, Eorzea's preeminent tabloid. Rest assured that unlike reporters for more unsavory rags, I, Kipih Jakkya, credit all who contribute to my articles.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_007: What do you say? I promise that at the very least, you'll leave this experience more enriched and with an appreciation for the finer aspects of journalism.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_008: Your contribution shall be much appreciated, I'm sure. Now then, the matter at hand is this invitation, which was sent to The Raven offices from the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_009: We have been asked to write a piece on the festivities currently underway at the establishment. Naturally, as The Raven's most senior reporter, I was chosen for this privileged task.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_010: I carry the reputation of my publication on my shoulders, and there's no shame in recruiting an assistant or two with whom to share the weight. I need someone with keen skills of observation and a dazzling insight.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_011: Judging by our previous adventures, there is none more suited for this task than you, dear ! So, how about it? Can I count on you?
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_012: And judging by my previous experiences with adventurers, you should be well equipped for this task! So, how about it? Can I count on you?
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_013: Very good! Well then, let's depart to the Gold Saucer at once. The invitation states that a member of the staff awaits our arrival at Entrance Square.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_014: If you've never visited the Gold Saucer, go and speak with that young man over there. Earlier he was handing out free tickets with abandon, and you'll need one lest our journey be short-lived indeed.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_SYSTEM_000_015: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_020: Yes... It seems all the invited reporters have arrived... Understood, I shall proceed as planned...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_DURALTHARAL_000_021: If only we at the Mythril Eye could deliver an exclusive interview to our readers...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_PETYRWINSOME_000_02: Here we are in Ul'dah's premier center of leisure and entertainment. The readers of the Harbor Herald will be eager for an inside look at the revels which take place in these gleaming halls.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_023: There you are, adventurer! Let's not keep our host waiting.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_024: Ah, you must be from The Raven. Allow me to welcome you personally to the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_100_024: Oh, I did not expect to see you there,  ! You are always welcome as our honored guest.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_025: An honored guest, is it? It seems I picked the right adventurer for the job.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_026: is helping you? Well, I must say, this gives The Raven a significant advantage.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_027: With your arrival, all of our guests are present. Now, if I could have but a moment of your time...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_028: Illustrious reporters of Eorzea, I welcome you one and all to the Gold Saucer. My name is Ollier, and I have the distinct pleasure of serving as an attendant here.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_029: As you are well aware, we are currently holding our most fabulous event of the year─the Make It Rain Campaign.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_030: During its duration, guests may receive up to fifty percent more MGP, a currency which can be exchanged within these gilded walls for a bevy of fantastic goods. People of all stripes pour into the Gold Saucer during this event, eager to take their piece of the generous bounty we offer.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_031: However, some in Eorzea have yet to grace us with their patronage, which is why we have invited the most esteemed reporters in the realm to partake in our festivities...and prepared sizable compensation for your resulting articles.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_032: Of course, a simple tour would hardly suffice to satisfy such curious minds as yours. So we have taken the liberty of preparing a little diversion for the occasion.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_033: Behold this masterful mammet, made in the precise likeness of Godbert Manderville. We have hidden four throughout the Gold Saucer─one in each section, excluding Chocobo Square.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_035: Use your keen reporter's sense to seek them out. And to the one who finds the most mammets...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_036: We shall reward an exclusive interview with the man himself, President Godbert Manderville of Manderville & Manderville, famed goldsmith and proprietor of dreams!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_DURALTHARAL_000_037: No paper has ever succeeded in securing a personal interview with Godbert Manderville! Can you believe our luck!?
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_038: He's right─an interview with Godbert Manderville would draw more eyes to The Raven than news of another Calamity! This isn't a competition to be taken lightly!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_PETYRWINSOME_000_03: Hmm... The reward is worthwhile, to be sure, but both Master Tharal and I have come here alone, while The Raven seems to have sent two reporters.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_PETYRWINSOME_000_04: I propose that the Harbor Herald and the Mythril Eye join forces. That would even the odds enough, methinks.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_041: I've no objection to that. To the winners go Manderville's secrets─to the losers, pitiful ignorance. Let's keep our eyes well peeled, adventurer!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_042: Then let us make an addendum to the rules─in the case both teams find the same number of mammets, the swiftest to return will be judged the victor.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_043: Now, let the mammet hunt begin! Search every corner of our establishment, and may you find the bounties you seek.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_050: If there are four wind-up Godberts hidden out there, we should each search for two.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_051: You take Wonder Square and Round Square, and I'll cover the remaining two sections. An equal division of labor!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_052: If anything happens, we can stay in touch via this linkpearl. Now, let's find those mammets and win that interview!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_053: Which team of reporters will prove to have the keenest eyes and sharpest senses? I look forward to finding out.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_PETYRWINSOME_000_05: Since the mammet hidden in Entrance Square cannot be seen from the threshold, it can only be in Card Square. Heh heh, the interview is as good as mine.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_DURALTHARAL_000_055: Godbert, Godbert, where is the Godbert? Hmm... Nowhere, it seems.
