TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_PETYRWINSOME_000_06: Where could one hide in such an open space? If I were a mammet...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_DURALTHARAL_000_061: Godbert, oh Godbeeert... Ugh, where are you?
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_063: (-Kipih Jakkya-)Bad news, adventurer. It seems I wasn't quick enough to find the mammet in Entrance Square. Please tell me you're faring better than I.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_064: (-Kipih Jakkya-)You found one!? Thank goodness! We're still in the running. I'll make haste to Event Square─godsspeed in finding your final mammet!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_066: (-Kipih Jakkya-)Adventurer, good news this time! I found the mammet in Event Square!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_067: (-Kipih Jakkya-)You found yours, too? Then it's settled! That interview is mine─oh, is ours, of course.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_068: (-Kipih Jakkya-)We must report our victory to Ollier at once. See you at Entrance Square!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_070: There you are! Quite impressive work, I must say. To think we would trounce the opposition so convincingly─all thanks to your eagle eyes!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_PETYRWINSOME_000_07: Just a moment after I spied the mammet, I spied the reporter from The Raven picking it up. Oh, if only I didn't stop for refreshments...
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_DURALTHARAL_000_072: It seems I was no match for you, adventurer. You found both mammets before I even had a chance to take the lay of the land. I know who to call upon next time I need to search for treasure.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_073: Welcome back. Mistress Jakkya has informed me that you were able to find two mammets?
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_074: Indeed! Exactly two likenesses. The final results are as follows─three mammets found by the reporters of The Raven and one mammet by the reporters of the Mythril Eye and the Harbor Herald.
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_075: Which means that The Raven shall be rewarded with an exclusive interview with Lord Manderville! Congratulations to you both!
TEXT_FESGSC701_04727_OLLIER_000_076: Once you have sufficiently prepared yourselves, simply speak to me and I shall summon him forthwith.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001: This is a dream come true─a scoop to surpass all scoops! I've made my preparations, so whenever you're ready, just say the word.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_PETYRWINSOME_000_00: Just a moment after I spied the mammet, I spied the reporter from The Raven picking it up. Oh, if only I didn't stop for refreshments...
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_DURALTHARAL_000_003: It seems I was no match for you, adventurer. You found both mammets before I even had a chance to take the lay of the land. I know who to call upon next time I need to search for treasure.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_OLLIER_000_004: I trust you are ready for the interview? I shall call upon Lord Manderville, so please wait here until his arrival.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_OLLIER_000_005: As for the Harbor Herald and the Mythril Eye, I ask that you follow me.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_OLLIER_000_006: While none are as knowledgeable as Lord Manderville, our staff shall do their utmost to guide you upon an educational─and dare I say entertaining─journey of the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_007: Ho ho ho! Apologies for the wait. I take it you're the eagle-eyed reporter from The Raven.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_008: Accompanied by none other than my old friend , I see! You haven't decided to doff the mantle of adventurer in favor of a reporter's quill and ink, have you?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_010: Lord Manderville, 'tis a pleasure to make your personal acquaintance. My name is Kipih Jakkya of The Raven, and I have the honor of penning this exclusive interview with your esteemed personage.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_011: This adventurer was kind enough to assist me on this project, so please consider  a temporary member of our staff.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_012: Very good, very good! I am overjoyed to host you both at my darling Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_013: Naturally, I expect some initial awkwardness as I become accustomed to the process, but I shall do my utmost to bare both body and soul to your inquiries. Ask away!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_015: Your candor is much appreciated, Lord Manderville. Now then, perhaps you might share with us some exclusive details regarding the Gold Saucer's creation?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_016: Ohoho, a simple question! I thought you might ask me to divulge the secret of my family's peerless beauty, which has been carefully guarded for generations.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_017: Y-Yes, well, I intend to get there in time, of course. But the objective of my article is to convey the charm of your establishment to my readers, and where better to start than with the tale of its inception?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_019: Only a reporter most masterful looks past the beauty of the man to the beauty of what he has wrought. How delightful, indeed! Come, allow me to give you the grand tour whilst answering your question with pomp and circumstance.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_020: Let us head for the aetheryte plaza, which rests in the heart of the Gold Saucer. From there I shall guide, and show you why House Manderville's ingenuity knows no equal!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_021: I very much look forward to hearing the story of the Gold Saucer from the man himself!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_022: If there is any place you wish to see first, simply ask Master Godbert─you'll hear no objections from me.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_OLLIER_000_023: Have you finished with your interview already,  ? I was informed that Lord Manderville intended to commence his personal tour from the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_SYSTEM_100_023: Some of the following events cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_024: Allow me to welcome you anew to the Gold Saucer! I, Godbert Manderville, am at your complete disposal. Simply tell me where you wish to go and you shall have my personal escort!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_100_030: Pressing matters to attend to? Very well! I shall wait here until you wish to resume the tour.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_030: Five years after the Seventh Umbral Calamity ravaged Eorzea, the Gold Saucer rose from the sands of Ul'dah, serving as a beacon for all in the realm who sought leisure and diversion.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_031: For the Calamity had dealt the city-states a grievous blow, and each and every citizen had worked tirelessly to see their homes healed. I built the Gold Saucer to be a place where the beleaguered could forget their worries for a time and remember the feeling of a smile upon their faces.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_032: A noble purpose, to be sure─especially considering the amount of your own wealth you poured into reconstruction efforts.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_033: To build a legendary monument of recreation during such trying times must have been a challenge, considering the resources and manpower necessary for such an undertaking.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_034: But that is exactly why it had to be done! To give work to hands robbed of purpose by disaster and thereby construct the backbone of a thriving economy.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_035: I owe a great debt to each and every person under my employ. It was only by their hard work and diligence that the Gold Saucer was able to aid Eorzea in her time of need.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_036: As the cactus weathers hot desert climes, so too did my workers persevere with indefatigable spirit. For this reason, I chose the sabotender as our mascot, with the appellation “Senor” as a sign of respect for their contributions.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_037: All of that being said, the Gold Saucer is no charity. Quite the opposite in fact! An operation of this magnitude would soon shrivel in the sun without the steady flow of profit.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_038: There is much more I could say on the matter, but alas, we only have so much time! Let us return to the aetheryte plaza and perhaps consider a change of scenery.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_040: Ho ho ho! Round Square, yes! So famous for...eh...
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_041: ...Ah, yes, of course! Mt. Corel soars majestic over its domain! Have you ever seen its like before?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_042: I wager you haven't! For this peak that countless visitors climb and descend daily is a construction of my imagination. Do you know what inspired me?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_043: Inspired? This was fashioned based on a model?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_044: That it was, but I'm not surprised the name wouldn't ring familiar. Mt. Corel appears in a classic tale I used to enjoy immensely as a young lad.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_045: As a mountain that fed a booming mining industry, you can see how it would inspire the liberal use of explosives for this attraction.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_046: We procure our bombs from goblin artisans, thereby extending a unique commercial opportunity to merchants who might otherwise be shunned or feared by others.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_047: Naturally, we needed to ensure the explosives would create a thrilling spectacle without risk of injury. I myself spent many a day testing the efficacy of a variety of blasting powders upon my person... Oh, to be so young again!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_049: Alas, although I could expound upon this topic for moons, I'm sure your readers wish for an article as varied as the Saucer itself. Let us return to the aetheryte plaza and consider where we might go to next.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_050: Hoho, as the name implies, here is where we hold our grandest events. At present, Masters Typhon and Yojimbo perform their regularly scheduled show, to the delight of all and sundry.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_051: Ah, yes, speaking of this “Master” Typhon... I've heard tell that he's a terrifying monster, whose sneezes are powerful enough to send someone flying off their feet. Pardon my directness, but does this not pose a danger to your guests?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_052: Danger!? Why, no, none at all! You can rest assured that behind Master Typhon's frightening countenance lies the kind heart of a model employee who cares deeply for the safety of our guests.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_053: Ah, I remember the day we met fondly... Master Typhon had been ushered into our realm due to an attempt by the Thaumaturges' Guild to summon voidsent, and after a journey full of twists and turns that yielded him no means to return from whence he came, he decided to seek gainful employment.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_055: Once I heard of his story, I knew he would be perfect as one of our attractions. After the requisite job interviews, I hired him on the spot.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_056: Albeit, he did get off to a sticky start, unleashing sneeze upon mighty sneeze in alarming succession. However, once I realized he meant only to offer up a reprieve from that day's blistering heat, I thanked him for his kindness, and he has been amenable to constructive criticism ever since.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_100_056: Of course, you know quite well how refreshing Master Typhon's sneezes can be. The tales of your bout with him and Master Ultros are still told to this day. Oh, were I there to witness it myself!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_057: Now, as much as I would like to regale you further, I fear I'm on the edge of rambling. Let us conclude our tour of Event Square and return to the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_058: Wonder Square was envisioned as a place where our patrons can kick up their feet and take in the wondrous scenery we've arranged for them. The second floor is equipped with a cocktail lounge which offers the realm's finest libations.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_059: From what I've heard, this area is among the most popular. Is it true that you even offer games hailing from the Far East?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_060: Ho, ho, just so! Our Doman mahjong has received great acclaim since its introduction here. There is nothing quite like it in all the realm.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_061: 'Twas brought to my attention by an employee who spent time in the Far East. There, it is played as simple recreation, as a display of hospitality, or in fierce competition amongst commonfolk and nobility alike.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_062: Truly, it brings me great joy that people can come here to enrich themselves with games from distant lands. I only hope that we can introduce even more games from places far and wide to the people of Eorzea!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_065: Ah, but there is still so much to see! Perhaps we should return to the aetheryte plaza, and consider the next part of your hard-won interview.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_SYSTEM_000_066: Are you sure you wish to conclude Godbert's tour?
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_070: Feeling tired already, adventurer? Well, let it not be said that The Raven neglects to allow its assistants proper time for rest. I'll accompany Lord Manderville on the rest of the tour and bask in what tidbits of lore he deigns to offer!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_100_070: Very good. I believe I have more than enough information to write several articles!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_071: It's been quite a while since I've spoken of my beloved Gold Saucer at such length. I do hope my ramblings did not bore you.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_072: Far from it, Lord Manderville. I quite enjoyed your anecdotes, as I'm sure will each and every one of The Raven's readers!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_085: Ho, ho, I am delighted to hear it.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_086: We built the Gold Saucer to revitalize commerce and rekindle the spark of joy in people's lives.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_088: Laughter and smiles are as much a lifeblood as food and shelter. This place serves to fulfill that all too elusive need.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_089: Not only for our patrons, but for our workers who tirelessly keep the Gold Saucer operating smoothly. My greatest hope is for their happiness.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_090: I see... A beacon of joy, guiding people to the smiles they've forgotten. I believe I can use that...
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_091: Thank you for everything, Lord Manderville! This interview gave me all I need for a phenomenal article.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_092: Ohoho, it was entirely my pleasure. May your pen burst forth with inspiration as do the clouds with rain─or as the Gold Saucer does with MGP!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_093: Do be sure to speak with Ollier on your way out. He has something prepared that I believe will bring a smile to your face!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_GODBERT_000_094: Like gold itself, the ideals which guide this establishment are immutable. I invite the both of you to return whensoever you please!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_100: I can feel the ideas bubbling to the surface already... I must start writing at once!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_OLLIER_000_101: Welcome back. Allow me to thank you once again for answering our invitation.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_102: The pleasure was all mine. It was an honor to hear such firsthand accounts from the Gold Saucer's founder.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_103: I see now that this amusement center was designed with much care for the people it serves.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_104: In fact, I'm thinking of entitling my article “The Gold Saucer: Where Hearts of Gold Reign.”
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_105: I hope it will convince more people to come and visit for themselves─and perhaps take with them a heart full of mirth.
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_106: Of course I haven't forgotten you, adventurer. I shall make sure to credit you in my article front and center!
TEXT_FESGSC702_04728_OLLIER_000_107: Before you depart, allow me to present you with a small token of our appreciation. Our event will be underway for some time yet, so we hope you continue to enjoy all the Gold Saucer has to offer!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_001: Oh, if it isn't ! It's been too long, my friend.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: Oh, if it isn't ! It's always a pleasure, my friend.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003: And how fortuitous that you should appear now, just when I'm in need of help again. Pray hear me out.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004: Hm? You're an adventurer, by the looks of you... Perhaps you could assist me.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_005: I am Kipih Jakkya, reporter for Gridania's leading tabloid, The Raven, and I'm in need of help. Pray hear me out.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_006: You see, my brother recently wrote saying that he wished to meet me in Ul'dah during the Rising celebration. However, the appointed hour has come and gone, but I've seen neither hide nor hair of him.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_007: I've checked all the likely places in the city to no avail, and am beginning to worry. If it isn't too much trouble, may I ask you to help me find him?
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_009: Now, my brother is a youth of sixteen by the name of Nhagi. He recently became an adventurer─something he had aspired to since he was little.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_010: Being an adventurer yourself, perhaps you know of him if not crossed paths?
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_A1_000_001: I'm not familiar with the name, alas.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_A1_000_003: We met at the previous Rising.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_011: Aye, well, it would be too much of a coincidence, I suppose... At any rate, if he isn't in the city, chances are he went outside on some business.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_012: Not only did you meet him, you helped him on his way, you say? What an amazing coincidence!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_013: That being said, it doesn't necessarily mean you would know where he is now... If he isn't in the city, though, chances are he went outside on some business.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_014: To begin with, I propose we split up and make inquiries in case someone has seen him.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_015: If you could focus on this area, I shall speak with those in the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_016: Afterwards, let us reconvene by the entrance to the tavern.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_ADVENTURERA04765_10: Whenever the Rising comes around, I feel that little bit more thankful for what I've got. I'm goin' to do someone a good turn today, yes I will.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOB04765_200_017: The Rising is in full swing in Ul'dah. Please join us in remembering those who left us in the Calamity, and looking forward to a brighter future together.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_017: Excuse me, but I'm looking for an adventurer named Nhagi'a Jakkya...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_ADVENTURERA04765_00: Oh, Nhagi. Aye, I know the sprightly lad. Couldn't say where he is now, but last I saw him, he mentioned takin' on some delivery work.
He's a curious one, he is. Gets along with everyone well enough, but doesn't seem to like workin' in a team. What with talk of bandits prowlin' the road of late, I can't help but worry.
As I said, I couldn't say where Nhagi is now, but he mentioned takin' on some delivery work. Might be as that's what he's out doin'.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_000_022: Well, slap me silly with a harbor herring! If it isn't the adventurer who gave this gaz a story for the ages by bringin' that letter in a bottle way back when.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_100_022: So, what can Bran do for you this fine ?
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_000_023: Something I can do for you, adventurer? If you've business with Bran, best state it quickly. This gaz has leads to follow and incidents to investigate for the Harbor Herald.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_000_024: I see... With apologies, I haven't seen this Nhagi. As a matter of fact, I've been rather busy workin' on my upcomin' piece on the Rising.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_000_025: Why, just earlier I was interviewin' the ever-enigmatic wandering minstrel, who's got another unusual venture in the offin'. The letter forest, he calls it.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_000_026: If that piques your interest, I recommend you go and see the man. He's at the Gold Court, over on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BRAN_000_027: If you're interested in the letter forest, I recommend you go and see the wandering minstrel. He's at the Gold Court, over on the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOB04765_000_028: Greetings, adventurer. How may I assist you?
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOB04765_000_029: Oh, Nhagi. I understand he is doing some work for the wandering minstrel.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOB04765_000_030: I daresay his client can point you in the right direction...if you can track the man down, that is. I'm afraid I don't know his whereabouts at present.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOB04765_000_031: I understand Nhagi is doing some work for the wandering minstrel. If you can track the man down, I daresay he can point you in the right direction.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_SYSTEM_000_032: It appears Nhagi is carrying out some work for the wandering minstrel. If you talk to the man at the Gold Court, you should be able to learn more.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Ah, my dear friend, what a pleasant surprise this is! I trust you have been keeping well. Now then, how might this minstrel be of service?
So Nhagi's sister wishes to find him... Indeed, I have entrusted him with a task, and have an inkling as to where he might be.
Greetings, friend. By your dauntless bearing, I assume you are an adventurer. How might this minstrel be of service?
So Nhagi's sister wishes to find him... Indeed, I have entrusted him with a task, and have an inkling as to where he might be.
As you may have heard, on the occasion of this Rising celebration, I am hosting an exhibit called the letter forest.
All are invited to anonymously submit letters to this forest and express their gratitude and encouragement for another, and all may peruse the letters at their leisure.
Now, in order to collect missives from outside of Ul'dah, I have dispatched a chocobo carriage. Nhagi is escorting said carriage.
When he contacted me on linkpearl a while ago, he said that they had emerged from the Twelveswood on their way back to Ul'dah. Given the hour, they should have already arrived...
I know not what is causing the delay, but might I trouble you to look for them? I would go myself, except I am needed here at present.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: I'm truly grateful. In case it helps, the carriage was meant to pass through Black Brush Station, so perhaps you could take your search to that area. I pray that nothing has befallen them.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: As I mentioned, the carriage was meant to pass through Black Brush Station. That may be a sound place for you to begin your search.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_050: There you are. Were you able to learn aught of Nhagi?
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_051: Escorting a carriage for the minstrel, so that is the way of it...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_052: As suggested, let us take ourselves to Black Brush Station and try searching in the vicinity!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_055: ! No sooner did I arrive than this man came running, out of breath...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOBA04765_000_056: (-Midlander Merchant-)You're an adventurer? Thank the Twelve!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOBA04765_000_057: (-Midlander Merchant-)It's the bandits from the Quiveron Manse─they've fallen on a chocobo carriage over by the Clutch!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_MOBA04765_100_057: The carriage only had one guard, and he was sorely outnumbered. Please, you must help him!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_058: That has to be Nhagi... With me, !
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_05: Damn it... There's no end to them...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_BANDITA04765_000_06: We have you now, you stubborn little shite!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_061: Enough! Leave my little brother alone, or Twelve as my witness, you'll receive such a thrashing as you've never known!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_062: ...From this fearsome adventurer here, that is!
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: Sister...and  too!? That you should be the one to come to my aid... Thank you.
Y-You remembered! I've been well! More than well!
So you don't remember me... You can hardly be expected to, I suppose...
I'm sorry I didn't come when I said I would, Sister... Rest assured I'm not too badly hurt.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_070: That's a relief. I'll take a proper look at your wounds back in the city.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_071: I must say, I was quite surprised to learn that you had met ...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_07: helped me when I first arrived in Ul'dah. From registering as an adventurer to completing my first task,  kindly showed me the ropes.
Now, I had suspected that you were a great adventurer, but to send your foes running without even drawing your weapon... That's just incredible!
I'm sorry I didn't come when I said I would, Sister... Rest assured I'm not too badly hurt.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_075: That's a relief. I'll take a proper look at your wounds back in the city.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_07: It seems you're an adventurer too. Thank you for your help. What's your name, if I may ask?
... I'll remember it. To send your foes running without even drawing your weapon, you're clearly a great adventurer!
I still have a long way to go, embarrassing myself like I did... If I want Sister's approval, I need to grow stronger and be able to fight on my own...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_08: Ah, but first things first:  and I have a delivery to make for the Rising.
If you'll excuse us, we will hurry back to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_083: Let us head back as well. I had a mind to pay the minstrel a visit in any case.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_090: Thanks to you, Nhagi is safe.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_091: Still, what he said about making it on his own weighs on my mind...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_09: Sister was none too gentle dressing my wounds... Perhaps she's annoyed I didn't show up as promised.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Welcome back, my friends. Pleased am I to see that Nhagi is safe and well.
Rising attendants inform me they now have all the letters. With this, we may proceed with the letter forest as planned. Thank you, Nhagi.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_09: I'm so sorry I'm late. You see...
Were it not for , there's no telling what might have become of the letters and . In the end, I was utterly useless...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: So that is how it happened...
As Nhagi's client, allow me to thank you as well for coming to his aid.
That being said, my boy, you were far from useless. Nay, you bravely defended the carriage until help arrived. There is no need to belittle yourself so.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_10: Well,  didn't need to rely on anyone. No,  drove off the bandits with nary more than a stern look. I couldn't hold a candle to .
Like , I want to be able to deal with any problem without help. Otherwise I can't claim to be an adventurer worth his salt.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_104: Tell me, Nhagi. All this time, have you been working alone? Even for dangerous tasks?
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_10: That's right. A worthy adventurer doesn't rely on others. If I'm to be the kind of adventurer you approve of, I must be able to handle anything by myself.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_107: If that is what you believe, then I can't consent to you being an adventurer any longer. Return to our village and start over.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_10: What? But...you were so happy for me when I became an adventurer!
I'm working so hard to succeed. To prove to you that I have what it takes. But now...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_110: You've developed a grave misconception. Until you recognize what it is, I can't in good conscience approve of your calling.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_111: If you can't accept this─if you wish to remain an adventurer─then you must win me over. And it begins with pondering why you first embarked upon this path.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_11: ...All right, Sister. I'll think on this.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: It appears Kipih wants her brother to rethink what adventuring is to him. Had the question been posed to you, what answer would you arrive at, I wonder...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_122: I'm sorry you had to see that, ...
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_123: Despite how it may have appeared, no one wants my brother to succeed more than I do. To succeed and be happy. After all, I know better than any how hard he works.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_124: Unless he changes his ways, however, he is like to die somewhere out there. And even if he manages to stay alive, he would only know an arduous life. That's why I didn't go out of my way to be gentle when dressing his wounds.
TEXT_FESANV901_04765_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_125: If he could just focus on what actually matters... Instead, he obsesses about gaining my approval and compares himself to others... <sigh>
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: It appears Kipih wants her brother to rethink what adventuring is to him. Had the question been posed to you, what answer you would arrive at, I wonder...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_002: If truth be told, no matter what Nhagi wants to do, it is my intent to support him.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_003: It's his life, after all, and no one else's. It isn't my place to interfere.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_004: Be that as it may, if he is sabotaging his own aspirations with his obsession for my approval, I can't simply stand idly by and watch.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_007: Loath though I am to impose, until my brother has found his answer, might I trouble you to keep an eye on him?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Please take it as a request from me as well. Ever has adventuring been dangerous, and it is more dangerous still for one who spurns help.
Like Kipih, I do not wish for Nhagi to continue on his current path. As a fellow adventurer, please help him find a better way.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_011: Now then, on a related matter, I must pay a visit to the Weavers' Guild, but I will see you again anon. If you'll excuse me...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Nhagi set off this way, so you may find him at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. We leave him in your capable hands, my friend.
Be it gratitude or encouragement or sympathy, each of these letters bears the wishes of one soul for another.
For Nhagi to work so hard to see them delivered, at heart, I do not believe he rejects connections with others. Nay, something drives him to believe and behave as he does.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_022: I do not agree with Nhagi's belief that, if he is to be an adventurer worth his salt, he can't rely on others.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_023: Lest we forget, adventurers help others through the work they accept. To refuse to accept help in turn not only defies logic─it is saddening.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_02: Oh, it's you, . What is it?
Is that so... I'm sorry. This is really something I should be doing alone. Still, it's nice to have someone to talk to.
Like my sister bade me, I'm pondering why I chose to become an adventurer in the first place.
Kipih has looked after me since I was no more than ten, after our parents passed away.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_03: She was already a reporter by then, and her work took her to various places. From her I heard tales about adventurers and came to admire them.
Upon learning of the full extent of the impending Calamity, she took us to a village in the mountains, where our aunt lived.
“It's desperate times like these that people need stories of hope,” she used to say, and I believe she had wanted to remain in Gridania and continue her work. But she left─in order to keep me safe.

I was a burden to her then. I don't want to be a burden to her again. For that, I need to show her that I don't need to depend on others. That I'm a capable adventurer who can handle anything by himself.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_100_03: Ponder as I might, I can't understand what's wrong with that.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_03: Well, when it doubt, I suppose I should do what adventurers do and gather information. It would be good, I think, to speak with people like my sister─people who aren't adventurers, but are familiar with them.
Hmmm, who in Ul'dah would fit that description...?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_A1_000_001: How about the face of the Adventurers' Guild?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_A1_000_002: How about the local purveyor of information?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_A1_000_003: How about a business with extensive dealings with adventurers?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_03: Of course, who else but Miss Momodi!
In her capacity as guild representative, she's bound to have some valuable insights. I'll seek her out at once!
You mean Wymond? While he's certainly knowledgeable, the kind of information he deals in isn't exactly what I need.
You mean the House of Splendors, the place that offers quality gear in exchange for services?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_04: I had better not... Horror stories are rife of people who make the mistake of indebting themselves to the House, becoming forever indentured...
Instead, how about Miss Momodi, the face of the Adventurers' Guild?
In her capacity as guild representative, she's bound to have some valuable insights. I'll seek her out at once!

I still remember when I first came here to sign up. I was a nervous wreck then, but now this place feels like a second home, and I come all the time for crumpets. They make them so springy, and serve them drowning in butter and honey...
...S-Sorry, now isn't the time for that. Come, let's have a chat with Miss Momodi.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_045: Well now, if it isn't  and Nhagi. To what do I owe the pleasure of both your companies today?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_046: Well now, if it isn't young Nhagi...and in the company of another adventurer besides. Strange things do happen. What can I do for you today?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_04: I was hoping to get your advice on a certain matter...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_048: The misconception you've developed about being an adventurer... That's an interestin' one, I have to admit.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_04: Try as I might to figure it out, I keep going around in circles. I thought you might be able to offer some insights.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_051: This is just a gut feeling...but I reckon I understand what your sister's tryin' to say.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_052: Tell me, Nhagi. Suppose you fail to get your sister's approval, would you simply give up being an adventurer? Would it all become meaningless?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_053: From this here counter, I've indeed seen off many an adventurer. Each and every one unique, with dreams and destinations all their own.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_055: But in spite of their differences, they all share something in common─a reason for first embarking upon their journey.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_056: ─would you mind tellin' us why you chose the adventurin' life?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_A2_000_001: I wanted to see the world.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_A2_000_003: A friend recommended it to me.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_057: Hehe, how very like you. Keep that reason close to your heart now, you hear?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_200_057: If you're disinclined to share, then I won't pry. To look at you, though, it's plain you've got a proper reason. Keep it close to your heart now, you hear?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_300_057: Is that right? Hehe, how sweet. Keep that friend close now, you hear?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_058: And you, Nhagi? What inspired you to become an adventurer?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_05: It's simple, really. I heard about adventurers from my sister, and became infatuated with the lives they led.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: Like them, I wanted to be able to see the world while helping those in need.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_061: Then isn't that enough? Your sister's approval or no, you have a reason all your own.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: By the Twelve, I see now... At some point, my desire to prove myself to Kipih had displaced my own motive for being an adventurer...
That's the misconception Kipih wanted me to recognize... What a fool I've been...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_066: Wanting someone's approval isn't wrong in and of itself, mind. But it's got nothin' to do with why you're an adventurer.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_100_066: It shouldn't force you to do things you wouldn't otherwise do, like tryin' to handle everything alone.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_067: Well, that's enough from me for today. I've said my piece─what you do now is up to you, Nhagi.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_06: Thank you for helping me realize, Miss Momodi.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_MOMODI_000_069: Think nothing of it. It's my job to watch over you all. Nothing makes me happier than to see you happy, doing what you do.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_07: Thank you too, , for accompanying me. I think I know what to say to Kipih now.
And loath though I am to trouble you again, there's something else I'd like your help with.
You see, of the letters we collected in Limsa Lominsa, one was from an explorer who was seeking an escort for an expedition.
By now, that letter should be on display at the Gold Court. I want to show it to my sister, and I'd be grateful if you could help me find it. Come, let's rejoin the minstrel.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Ah, welcome back. Dare I hope you were able to find the answer?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_08: Yes, I'm happy to say. Miss Momodi helped me to come to a realization. And when I go to speak with my sister...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I see, I see. By all means, feel free to borrow the letter. Does it have any distinguishing characteristics?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_08: As I recall, there was a large drawing of a blue chocobo on it...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Very well. Let us all search together, the more swiftly to find it.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_09:
“Dear kindly Miqo'te adventurer,
Thank you for helping me to find my mother. I was scared at first, but you made me feel brave.
“I had lots of fun at the Gold Saucer, and it was even more fun because of you. I hope to see you again. Please take care.”
Why, it's the lost child from the Gold Saucer! The staff were tied up, so I helped to track down the mother. Hehe, what a fine feeling this is.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: A great many of these letters bear words of thanks for adventurers─a testament to the good that you and yours do out in the world.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_LETTERA04766_000_09:
(-Letter with a Blue Chocobo Drawing-)Dear adventurer,
How fares your journey? Mine continues, and I wake up to the sound of birdsong and lie down to sleep beneath the moonlight as I seek unblazed trails.

(-Letter with a Blue Chocobo Drawing-)Long ago, when an adventurer aided me, I was made to realize how alike we are. Deep down, we are simply travelers who thrill to make new discoveries. Thus do I write this letter now, in hopes of recruiting such like-minded souls to join me on an expedition.

(-Letter with a Blue Chocobo Drawing-)If you at all share in my desire to make the uncharted charted, then I invite you to seek me out at the Drowning Wench in Limsa Lominsa. Eagerly do I await your coming.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SYSTEM_000_097: This letter recruiting adventurers bears a drawing of a blue chocobo. It must be the missive Nhagi is looking for.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_LETTERB04766_000_09:
(-Letter with a Chocobo Carriage Drawing-)Dear not-so-new adventurer,
As a traveling merchant, I've had my fair share of happy encounters, but sharing a carriage with you stands out above them all.

(-Letter with a Chocobo Carriage Drawing-)For you see, I went on to sell veritable crate-loads of the ring I gave you, and turned enough of a profit to buy my own carriage. You shared with me your adventurer's luck, and I count my blessings every day.

(-Letter with a Chocobo Carriage Drawing-)My only regret is that I neglected to ask you your name, so I don't know your doings. If my instincts are on the mark, though, you've surely made a name for yourself. Wherever you are now, my friend, I pray for your continued safety and success.

(-Letter with a Chocobo Carriage Drawing-)No matter where I go, I often hear tell of your exploits, and it makes me inordinately proud to have met you. Till we meet again, my friend, I pray for your continued safety and success.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SYSTEM_100_099: While the contents ring a bell, this letter wasn't written by an explorer, nor does it bear a drawing of a blue chocobo. It isn't the missive Nhagi is looking for.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_LETTERC04766_000_10: (-Letter with a Shield Drawing-)As someone charged with the city's peace, I cannot overstate how much of a boon adventurers are to our efforts. Some folk had expressed concern that an increase in drifters would see a corresponding rise in crimes, but on the contrary, they are steadily declining.

(-Letter with a Shield Drawing-)Soldiers like ourselves are somewhat limited in the scope of our duties, and we are not always available to lend our citizens what assistance they need. Thus would I take this opportunity to express my heartfelt gratitude to adventurers, who step up to fill the void.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_LETTERD04766_000_10:
(-Letter with a Quill Drawing-)Esteemed adventurer,
Should you chance to read this letter, I pray it finds you well. Much time has passed since you helped us to rebuild in the wake of that terrible disaster, but we still remember you most fondly.

(-Letter with a Quill Drawing-)Our lives continue to be hard, and every day brings new challenges. Nonetheless, we have regained a semblance of what we once had, and smiles are beginning to return to faces.
(-Letter with a Quill Drawing-)The morrow will be brighter than today─this we dare to believe now thanks to you. And should you yourself face hardship, I pray that you believe the same.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_11: No luck over here so far... How about you?
A blue chocobo! Yes, this is the one!
All that's left, then, is to talk to Kipih. Do you know where she is?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: She went to the Weavers' Guild, saying that she had business there.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_100_11: At any rate, I'll look for her there. Thank you!
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: For this, too, might I trouble you to accompany Nhagi? Afterwards, I ask that you tell me how events unfold. I shall await you at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: If you are willing, please accompany Nhagi when he speaks with his sister. I am most eager to know what lies ahead for our young adventurer.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_11: You're here too, ? I must confess, I'm feeling rather nervous, so I appreciate your presence.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_120: Oh dear, you came to find me? My apologies for taking so long.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_121: So, Nhagi. Were you able to find the answer?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_12: Aye. To begin with, I want you to look at this.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_123: An explorer is assembling an escort for an expedition? Certainly sounds exciting.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_12: In wanting your approval, I was determined not to rely on others. But a part of me dearly wanted to be part of the expedition. To go where I dare not set foot alone. So I've decided that I will answer the invitation.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_125: Then...this means you've given up on trying to do everything alone?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_12: I had wanted to prove to you that I'm capable─that I'm no longer a burden. And in my obsession, I lost sight of why I became an adventurer in the first place.
To see what lies beyond the horizon and lend a helping hand to those I meet... That's what drives me, and I was able to remember this thanks to Miss Momodi and .
And whether or not you approve, I want to continue adventuring for my own reasons. Is...is that all right with you?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_129: Didn't you just say you didn't need my approval? But to be clear, I never actually intended to stop you.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_130: Do you remember what you once told me, Nhagi? Shortly before the Calamity struck.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_13: (-Young Nhagi-)Did you interview adventurers again today? What were they like? What kind of places have they been to?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_132: Heh, you never get sick of hearing about adventurers, do you?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_13: (-Young Nhagi-)Never, ever! When I grow up, I want to be an adventurer too!
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_134: Well, that's as fine an aspiration as any, but do you know what kind of adventurer you wish to become? A hero like in the tales, perhaps?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_13: (-Young Nhagi-)Oh, no, Sister, not a hero. Adventurers are free spirits, and I want to be the freest spirit of all! Oh yes, I'll travel the world and meet lots of people, and when I visit home, you can interview me as much as you like!
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_136: For that boy to spurn help for want of my approval... I couldn't bear to see it, and in order to bring you to your senses, I may have spoken a little sternly.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_137: As an adventurer, you'll experience no small amount of hardships, but you chose your path because you wanted to be free.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_138: So don't let yourself be shackled by expectation, be it your own or that of others, and instead take things as they come.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_139: So long as you are true to yourself and recognize your limits, you'll surely find a way forward. And remember: not even heroes can accomplish everything alone.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_140: Relying on others doesn't make you a lesser adventurer. If anything, the freer we are, the more we need to look out for one another. And that, I believe, is the essence─and beauty─of adventuring. Wouldn't you agree, ?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_A3_000_002: A hero needs friends as much as anyone.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_14: Understood, Kipih. I won't ever forget this.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_150: Knowing you, I expect you're raring to answer the explorer's petition in Limsa Lominsa. You'll be taking an airship, yes?
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_151: In which case, I shall give these garments to you now.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_152: I had them made for you, thinking it was past time you had something better.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_NHAGIAJAKKYA_000_15: For me!? Thank you so much, Sister!
I must thank you too, . You're the kind of adventurer I admire, and I'll keep on working hard to be like you.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_155: I couldn't have asked for a better person to watch over my little brother. I appreciate everything you've done for him, and look forward to meeting you again, be it for a story or something else.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_KIPIHJAKKYA_000_156: With that, we take our leave of you.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SYSTEM_000_158: You see the siblings off, safe in the knowledge that all will be well. Time to rejoin the wandering minstrel and relay to him the tale's happy conclusion.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Welcome back, my friend. Judging by your expression, I take it all is well with Nhagi and Kipih.
I see. Pleased am I to hear that.

When we first set out on our journeys, 'tis usually for the simplest of reasons. Yet as we make our way, those reasons may become lost in a haze of motives, causing us to lose sight of what truly matters.

In such a time, if we can but remember what prompted us to take our first step, we will always find the strength to take the next. Nhagi shall be fine, I am certain of it. My thanks for keeping an eye on him.
These events have inspired a new verse in me. A verse about the dreams of those who seek new worlds, and the hopes of those who see them off...
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_60: (-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
'Tis a pleasure to meet you again. As I have in the past, I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
Ten years have now passed since the world was reborn from its ashes. Since we set forth upon this journey.
Countless things have happened during that time, and I've had the pleasure of meeting many an adventurer along the way.
If truth be told, it hasn't always been easy. There are moments when I wonder why I must struggle so. Days when I'm tempted to cast it all aside.
But in spite of this, I always manage to carry on, and it is thanks to my wonderful comrades─and to you, our esteemed adventurers.
By now, I must have been regaled with tens of thousands of your tales. You usually share them with a smile, but even when it is with a frown, you tell me that you're still enjoying yourself.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: 'Tis no exaggeration to say that I derive all of my driving force from you all. From the bottom of my heart, I thank you.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_61: Ours is an unending journey, and nothing would make me happier than if we could keep walking it together.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_YOSHIDANAOKI_200_61: As you make your way, we promise that we will ever be at your side, matching you step for step.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
Much time has passed since the world was reborn from its ashes. Countless souls have made this place their home; every single one has left an indelible mark upon it.
Together we have built this world, and it is our sincerest hope that we shall continue to do so for many years to come.
So please be safe and well. May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I daresay Nhagi is aboard the airship by now. I pray that he and Kipih will find happiness upon their respective paths.
I hope you do so as well, my friend. If you would lend me an ear, I would dedicate these verses to your future.

By morning light the journey starts,
A trill of hope within our hearts.♪
On westerly wind, to river song,
Into the world, where we belong.♪

'Bove fields of white an azure sky,
Sunset's storm a crimson fire.♪
Jewels aglitter on pitch-black veil,
A new day dawns, so goes the tale.♪

By eternal wind we carry on,
Boldly towards a golden morn.♪
With mem'ries as a guiding star,
Shining our steps both near and far.♪
Where you will go, whom you will meet, what you will see... There is no telling what the future holds for anyone.
Yet come what may, I bid you never forget this: the bonds you forge, the memories you make, and the footprints you leave behind─they shall one day spur you forward.
So pray continue walking your own path. Wherever your journey leads, I shall be praying for your happiness.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SYSTEM_000_800: You now have access to the letter forest at the Gold Court. Speak with the tender stationed there to read the letters.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SYSTEM_000_801: Additionally, you have also unlocked the Kupo Kupo Adventure mini-game on the Steps of Nald. Speak with Nonora at the Ruby Road Exchange to play.
TEXT_FESANV902_04766_SYSTEM_000_802: This along with other mini-games may also be played by opening the toy chest in any inn room.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_000: If it isn't my favorite adventurer! You do remember me, don't you?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Pardon me, are you an adventurer? Allow me to introduce myself, I am...er...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_003: Much better! Starlight celebrant Amh Garanjy, at your service. I am ever so pleased to meet you during this most sacrosanct of seasons.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_100_003: In commemoration of the Ishgardian knights who once sheltered needy orphans from the cold, we strive to deliver joy and comfort to all younglings each Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_004: This year, we pay particular tribute to the figure at the heart of Starlight legend─the snowy-bearded captain dubbed the Saint of Nymeia. As you can see, we have commissioned replicas of his red coat and fluffy white beard.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_005: How better to delight the children than by distributing presents as the saint himself, after all!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_006: So far, we have been successful in spreading Starlight cheer. However...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_007: It seems there is a particular youngling who finds our felicitous festivities distressing.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_008: Were I free to wander, I would reach out to them myself and provide what aid I could. Alas, my duties as celebrant require my attendance here.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_009: Might you assist this child in my stead? I am sure they would welcome the insights of an adventurer such as yourself.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_010: I am most grateful. Let me summon the young lady who first brought this matter to my attention.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_011: Hello! My name is Saulinne. It's nice to meet you, .
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_012: As I told Miss Garanjy, I've seen a boy around here who...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_013: ...Oh! Look, there he is! Over there!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_100_013: ...I guess he didn't come to play this time either.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_014: That boy's been watching the stage from a distance ever since preparations began.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_015: At first, I thought he must be excited about the Starlight Celebration, but he always looks so sad! That's why I thought I'd try inviting him to play...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_016: But when I called out to him, he just ran away.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_017: Comforting others when they are troubled is a very kind thing to do. You did well to try, Saulinne.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_018: I just think nobody should be alone during the Starlight Celebration!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_019: He keeps coming back, so I'm sure there's something he's worried about. Maybe he's too shy to ask for a present...?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_020: Either way, I'm worried about him. Would you help me make sure he's okay, ?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_021: Then I'll leave this matter in your capable hands. I believe the boy ran off towards the Whistling Miller. Perhaps someone there knows more about him.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_022: Let's ask around! Please tell me if you learn anything, and I'll be sure to do the same.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_025: I believe he headed for the Whistling Miller. Perhaps someone saw him run by?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_026: I haven't found him yet, but I'll keep asking. Tell me if you learn anything!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_BOY04781_000_030: Oh, you must mean Tenny. I heard he moved here from Ul'dah recently.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_BOY04781_000_031: Can't tell you much more than that. He makes a point of keeping to himself.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GIRL04781_000_032: That boy who always comes to stare at the decorations? I know him! Er, I mean, I've seen him around before. I don't know his name. And I don't think I've ever seen him smile...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_WOODWAILER04781_000: A boy? Yes, ran straight past me towards the Greatloam Growery.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_BOY04781_000_035: We'd be happy to play with him, of course. But Tenny never seems keen on it.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GIRL04781_000_036: Why does he always look so sad? It's the Starlight Celebration! Maybe he didn't like his present...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_WOODWAILER04781_000: Straight towards the Greatloam Growery, like I said. Has he been up to mischief?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_038: I hope you and Saulinne find the boy soon. Perhaps someone in the area can help guide you to him.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_042: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go to the Greatloam Growery!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_050: Wh-Who are you? Some kind of adventurer?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_051: is! And my name is Saulinne. You were at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre earlier, weren't you?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_052: Would you like to go and join the Starlight Celebration with me? My friends will be there too, so we can all play together!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_054: They're really nice! ...Do you not want to?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_055: It's not that. It's...it's a long story.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_057: ...We just moved here for my father's job. And I know there's no point in moping about it, but I really, really miss my three friends back in Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_058: During Starlight, we'd show each other what toys we got and eat too many sweets and find all the best decorations in the city.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_059: We'd have so much fun! And each time we'd promise to play together the next year. But now...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_061: I used to love the Starlight Celebration, but now all I can think about is leaving my friends behind and betraying our promise.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_062: I'm sorry. I hope I didn't hurt your feelings by asking you to play...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_063: It's all right. You didn't know.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_064: But Tenny, doesn't this mean you'll never be able to enjoy the Starlight Celebration without feeling guilty? There must be something we can do...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_065: ! You're a grown-up─what do you think?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_A1_000_000: Sounds like something that three tickets to Gridania could fix.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_A1_000_001: Nothing screams “Friendship, kupo!” like moogle mail.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_A1_000_002: Pack your bags, kid─I'm smuggling you back to Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_066: I guess. But Ul'dah is so far away. That sort of journey is a lot to ask...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_068: That's it! I could send them presents!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_069: Wh-What!? There's no way my father would allow─wait, did you say smuggle? ...Thanks for the offer, , but I'll pass.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_070: That's a lovely idea! Everyone loves getting packages. And that way you'll be celebrating together─at a distance!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_071: What should I give them? Something you can only get in Gridania...?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_072: (-???-)Ho ho ho! The answer to that is simple.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_073: That snowy white beard─th-that's the real thing! You're the Saint of Nymeia, aren't you!?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_074: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Quite! Young Tenny, you need look no further than your own two hands─for presents crafted from the heart are presents full of heart. I shall rigorously assist you in every step of their creation as both an artisanal saint and saintly artisan!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_TENNY_000_075: ...I don't really understand, but thank you?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_SAULINNE_000_076: I'll help too! That way your presents will be crafted in half the time.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_078: Adventurer! Might we rely upon you to deliver Tenny's gifts once they are prepared?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_079: Though we could post them by more conventional moogles, a child's hard work and dedication ought to be hand-delivered by only the most trusted individual.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_080: And as you are both emotionally invested in Tenny's happiness and currently standing before me, I bequeath the task to you. You will do it, yes?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_081: Excellent. Then we shall realize these creations ere the Spinner sloshes Her nog. In the meantime, I would have you apprise Amh Garanjy of our efforts.
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_GODBERT_000_082: Once you have relayed your report, return here for the requisite packages. Chop-chop!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_090: Welcome back! Were you able to speak with the boy?
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_091: I see. To be separated from one's friends is heartbreaking, indeed. I only wish I too could help in some way...
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_092: ...Oh! I know just the thing─I shall transform you into a saint!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_093: I have a Saint of Nymeia costume that I would be most happy to gift you. Tenny's friends will be delighted for a visit from the Spinner's anointed herald!
TEXT_FESXMS901_04781_AMHGARANJY_000_094: Accept this with my warmest wishes, dear adventurer─I know you won't let us down!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Without further ado, let us transform you into the Saint of Nymeia! I have no doubt you will look every bit the part in the costume I gave you.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_000_001:
You must equip the following items in order to proceed:
Unorthodox Saint's Cap, Unorthodox Saint's Halfrobe, Unorthodox Saint's Gloves, Unorthodox Saint's Bottoms, and Unorthodox Saint's Longboots.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_100_001: Once you are dressed and have sufficiently fluffed your magnificent beard, speak with Amh Garanjy again.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_000_002: If any of the aforementioned items are not in your possession, you can purchase them from the recompense officer at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Incredible! I feel as though I am addressing the very captain of legend.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_011: Now then, pray return to the Greatloam Growery and collect Tenny's presents. The happiness of precious younglings is in your hands!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_012: I know you will make a marvelous Saint of Nymeia. Won't you try on the outfit I gave you?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_000_013:
You must equip the following items in order to proceed:
Unorthodox Saint's Cap, Unorthodox Saint's Halfrobe, Unorthodox Saint's Gloves, Unorthodox Saint's Bottoms, and Unorthodox Saint's Longboots.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_100_013: Once you are dressed and have sufficiently fluffed your magnificent beard, speak with Amh Garanjy again.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_000_014: If any of the aforementioned items are not in your possession, you can purchase them from the recompense officer at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_020: Tenny awaits you at the Greatloam Growery. Please ensure his presents are delivered safely!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_021: Welcome back, ! You should ask Tenny about the presents, hehe!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_030: The presents are ready! I thought it might take longer, but the Saint of Nymeia showed us how to weave them up in no time.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_031: We made three bracelets─one for each of my friends.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_032: You said you'd take them to Ul'dah for me, right? My friend Momolao always hangs around outside the Quicksand, so you should start there.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_033: If the others aren't with him, he'll tell you where to go. I don't know how to properly thank you for this, but...thank you, !
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_040: If the others aren't at the Quicksand too, Momolao should know where they are. Thanks for doing this, .
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_041: The Saint of Nymeia showed Tenny and me how to weave those bracelets, and making them together was a lot of fun! At least, I had fun. I hope Tenny did too.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_042: Pray hurry to Ul'dah and make your deliveries!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_050: Yeah, I'm Momolao. What've you got for me?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_051: From Tenny!? Oh Tenny, you...you big dummy!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_052: We've all been a mess since he left. It's just not the same without him.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_053: But now I know that some things will never change, no matter how far apart we are!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_054: He's still the same old Tenny. Still celebrating Starlight with us, hehe.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_055: He sent gifts for all of us!? Oh, someone's going to cry. I can feel it.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_056: Let's see─Larkin said he'd be in the Gold Court, and Othuel had to do something near Milvaneth Sacrarium. Thanks, . Tell Tenny “Happy Starlight” for us.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_MOMOLAO_000_060: You'll find Larkin in the Gold Court and Othuel by Milvaneth Sacrarium. They're going to love their gifts, I just know it.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_LARKIN_000_070: Hello, ! I've been very good this year. You can ask my friends!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_LARKIN_100_071: <sniff> I-I'm not crying! I just got snow in my eye... <sob>
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_LARKIN_000_072: ...Last year, we all stood right here and made a promise to celebrate Starlight together. And Tenny remembered! Even though he moved away!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_LARKIN_000_073: I thought that was the end for us, but friends always find a way, right? And Tenny will always be our friend! ...Tell him I said that, okay?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_OTHUEL_000_080: Er, how do you know my name!? ...Is that package for me?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_OTHUEL_000_081: Tenny sent this? He made this!? Haha, I guess he didn't forget about his mates after all.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_OTHUEL_000_082: It's funny; I just finished wrapping a gift for Tenny, too. A gift from all of us.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_OTHUEL_000_083: We wanted something with our names on it, so we pooled our pocket money and got him a bracelet. Great minds think alike, eh?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_OTHUEL_000_084: Anyway, if you're headed back to Gridania, could you take this to him? It'd mean a lot to us.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SYSTEM_000_090: All of Tenny's gifts have been successfully distributed. Now to make your final delivery─one addressed to Tenny himself.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_100: Did you find everyone? Did they like their presents!?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_102: A bracelet? And look, they carved their names into it: “Momolao,” “Larkin,” “Orthuel”...and “Tenny”!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_103: They must really miss you too. If this isn't proof of your friendship, I don't know what is!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_104: I never thought they'd send me something─and it's a bracelet, too! Great minds think alike, eh?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_105: I'm so glad everything worked out! Now you can enjoy the Starlight Celebration without any more worries.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_106: Saulinne... Thank you for helping me.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_107: I really was happy when you invited me to play before. So I hope...I mean, would you be my friend?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_115: I want to send them something even better next year! Hmm, what should I make...
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_116: We should tell Miss Garanjy the good news! Tenny and I will be right behind you.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_120: So not only were his handmade presents happily received, Tenny's friends sent him a thoughtful gift as well. None could ask for a better display of Starlight spirit.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_121: You have brightened many a young face today in your role as the Saint of Nymeia. It truly warms my heart!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_122: Still, I can't help but wonder if Tenny and his friends knew how fitting the gift of a woven bracelet is.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_123: In certain lands, such bracelets are customarily exchanged as a symbol of friendship, as it is said the intertwining strands represent lasting bonds.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_124: No doubt those younglings will enjoy each other's companionship for many a Starlight to come.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_125: We came to say thank you! Thank you, Miss Garanjy. Thank you, !
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_126: I'm grateful that I was able to keep my promise to my friends...and make another one along the way!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_127: I am glad to hear it. After all, the Starlight Celebration is meant to be enjoyed with everyone we cherish, be they near or far. Now then─what say you both to receiving your gifts?
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_AMHGARANJY_000_128: I gave those two their presents earlier, but they seem to be in search of companions...
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_SAULINNE_000_129: Let's invite them to play, Tenny!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_TENNY_000_130: Yeah! We can all celebrate together!
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_GODBERT_000_131: (-Saint of Nymeia-)A savior chosen to shield younglings from winter's wrath and provide them with every happiness this season can afford... Yet, not all gifts are within the saint's power to deliver.
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_GODBERT_000_132: (-Saint of Nymeia-)The gift of friendship, for instance...
TEXT_FESXMS902_04782_GODBERT_000_133: (-Saint of Nymeia-)Forsooth, I can only teach them to make pretty things and encourage from afar! May their Starlights be bright and their friendship everlasting. Ho ho ho!
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Perhaps I might persuade you to continue your work as the Saint of Nymeia?
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Splendid! Gridania will be ever the merrier for it.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Donors from across the realm have sent us a wide array of delights this year, so I would have you distribute them to younglings who pass by the amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_003: While I won't insist on the costume, you should know that you look very well in it. I shall leave the decision to you.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_005: Do make sure the children who pass by the amphitheatre receive their gifts.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_SYSTEM_000_010: You see a child approaching the amphitheatre. Reaching into your bag of gifts, you select...
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_A1_000_001: A pair of warm Fen-Yll boots.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_A1_000_003: A mammet produced by the Skysteel Manufactory.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_A1_000_004: A pair of mittens knitted with Azim Steppe wool.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MERWYB_000_010: Well, this is rather unexpected. I have but just finished attending to state business and thought to observe these celebrations ere I return to Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MERWYB_000_011: I understand the Bismarck donated baked sweets to be distributed as gifts.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MERWYB_000_012: Though I have little familiarity with the Starlight Celebration myself, one does not soon forget the joy of receiving such festival delights as a child.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MERWYB_000_013: I pray that the Bismarck's contribution provides Eorzea's young ones with many a fond memory.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_KANESENNA_000_020: Thank you for dedicating time to play saint for the younglings. Seeing the city awash with their bright smiles is but one virtue of this fine festival.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_KANESENNA_000_021: Were those not Fen-Yll boots you gifted just now? The atelier is known for its sturdy shoes, so I imagine that child will be afforded endless hours of play.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_KANESENNA_000_022: I used to run through these woods as a youth, and I can assure you that feet are the first to feel winter's bite. How reassuring to know that our children will spend the coldest season in warmth and comfort.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MOMODI_000_030: So you're the Saint of Nymeia I've been hearin' so much about! I snagged an invitation from the Adventurers' Guild, hopin' for some seasonal refreshment, and between all the smilin' youngsters and twinklin' lights, I haven't been disappointed!
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MOMODI_000_031: That garment you just handed off was Weavers' Guild craftsmanship, wasn't it? I'd recognize that style anywhere.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MOMODI_000_032: A certain fancy guildmaster's goin' to hear how well that poppet liked his present just as soon as I get back to Ul'dah. If he doesn't melt to rose oil on the spot, I'll eat my proverbial hat!
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_HONOROIT_000_040: Ah,  ! What an honor it is to have witnessed such a heartwarming and philanthropic exchange.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_HONOROIT_000_041: You gifted that child a Skysteel Manufactory mammet, did you not? I find it fascinating that toys created via modern technologies should be coveted for so traditional a festival as the Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_HONOROIT_000_042: In truth, I am conducting research into how such Ishgardian festivals are perceived and promoted in neighboring nations.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_HONOROIT_000_043: When I penned The White Yonder, I developed a particular curiosity regarding the effect of interpersonal exchanges on the transmission of cultural practices, you see.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_HONOROIT_000_044: Lord Emmanellain generously granted me leave to embark on this journey of inquiry, and I hope to compile what insights I gain here into another volume. ...Ahem. A happy Starlight to you, my .
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MAGNAI_000_050: ...What? Is my presence here so peculiar?
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MAGNAI_000_051: I have it on the authority of foreign traders that this Eorzean ritual is not simply a sacred distribution of gifts to children─it is an ideal setting in which to find my Nhaama.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MAGNAI_000_052: Hmph. Your denial is futile. Hidden somewhere in this wood is my gentle maiden of dusk, my ethereal dancer in the morning mist. I am certain of it.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MAGNAI_000_053: ...Yet all those I have yet observed appear to be mewling children, chattering kin, or shamelessly courting couples.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MAGNAI_000_054: Had I been aware of such a complication, I would have sought divine guidance before coming here. Then again, delaying my journey might have precluded attending this auspicious ceremony...
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_MAGNAI_000_055: ...Nay, I am born of the mighty Sun and naught can elude my gaze. Let legend remember that Magnai of the Oronir sought his Nhaama alone and discovered her wreathed in the light of Gridania's stars!
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_FOURCHENAULT_000_06: Before you ask, I am not here on official business. My wife wished to see the festivities, so I have accompanied her. That is all.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMELIANCE_000_062: So much for Starlight cheer! You know once, when the twins were little, Fourchenault gave them puzzles complicated enough to stump half the Studium─and that was genuinely his best effort at gift-giving!
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMELIANCE_000_063: But lo and behold: Alphinaud solved his without batting an eye, and Alisaie couldn't even be bothered to open the box. My gift was seeing this man dumbfounded by his two talented and drastically different children.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_FOURCHENAULT_000_06: Yes, well. The very notion that the Saint of Nymeia might visit our Sharlayan household was flawed from the outset. Regardless, such charades are behind us now; our children no longer lie awake hoping for Starlight presents.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMELIANCE_000_065: Perhaps. But I certainly wouldn't refuse a gift, were it offered.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_FOURCHENAULT_000_06: ...It appears I have business at Fen-Yll Fineries after all. If you'll excuse me.
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMELIANCE_000_067: That's right─I must send Mila a little something as well. Did you know she's begun work at the High Crucible? Oh, I am so proud of her!
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_070: Thank you for your assistance. I trust the younglings enjoyed their presents?
TEXT_FESXMS903_04783_AMHGARANJY_000_071: Should you have further time to spare for saintly duties, do not hesitate to return. May you have a very happy Starlight, adventurer!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: Oh my stars, could it be? The selfsame adventurer who helped us keep wickedness at bay and transformed All Saints' Wake from a night of screams into a day of revelry?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_1: Thank the Twelve for bringing you to us, for the fiends of the realm knock at our door once again, and we need a dauntless soul to help us ensure they don't tear it off its hinges!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: You there. You're an adventurer, yes? Eager to stare into the very depths of wickedness, am I right? Good, good, because we're in dire need of just such a dauntless soul.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_1: All Saints' Wake is upon us, you see, and that means the fiends of the realm clamor to plunge Gridania into a sea of chaos.
The host of this year's parade of horrors is a woman with a pumpkin for a head. I shudder to consider whether this is some elaborate costume, or─no, perhaps it is best not to know.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: Her strange appearance makes my skin crawl, to say nothing of her underlings... Why, one might think the Continental Circus was come again, hiding their monstrous intentions behind the guise of celebration!
We can be grateful that none have yet fallen under their spell, but I fear it is only a matter of time. We must act quickly to unearth their schemes.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_1: I would begin a thorough investigation at once, but I'm afraid my surveillance duties here prevent me from moving freely. That, my friend, is why I need you.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: Approach this pumpkin-headed witch under the flag of friendship, and offer your services to her ghastly celebration. If you catch even a whiff of foul deeds, I want you to put a stop to them before any innocents come to harm.
