I knew I could count on you! Now then, you can find our quarry just across the way at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, where she is doubtless attempting to draw any and all passersby into her ungodly procession. Humor her for now, but take care not to fall victim to her honeyed words.

The pumpkin-headed woman can be found at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, where she is attempting to coax the commonfolk into her terrifying cadre. Put on a mask of friendliness, and put an end to any evil she may be brewing up.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_020: Heh heh... It is you. I knew your arrival was inevitable, for any who once indulge in the revelry of All Saints' Wake cannot resist a chance to relive their experience.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_021: Heh heh... Have you come to join the glorious celebration that is All Saints' Wake? All are encouraged, and all are welcome.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_022: Oh, such eagerness. We are ever in need of willing hands to help with the festivities─preferably with bodies still attached.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_023: Of course, I understand you have been tasked with bringing to light any iniquity on my part. But you know from experience that I am perfectly harmless, so you are free to conduct your little “investigation,” if it pleases you.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_024: Of course, I understand a certain meddlesome investigator has tasked you with uncovering any iniquity on my part. Do I have demons and devils at my beck and call? I admit that I do. However, I mean no harm to you and yours, so I hope that our partnership can be mutually beneficial.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_025: Together, I believe we can make this All Saints' Wake into one that will be remembered for moons to come. Yet before we begin, allow me to illuminate the history of this event and our intentions here.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_026: On this most unhallowed of nights, the saints revel in their palatial heavens, and as their judgmental eyes become leaden from drink, the impure are free to feast and frolic without fear of punishment.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_027: In ages past, the commonfolk would rue the coming of this night and cower in their homes. That is, until the adventurers took it upon themselves to rid the streets of evil, thus turning the event into a celebration of your collective bravery.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_028: ...A joyous happening, to be sure. But what of the goblin, the ghost, and the gremlin? Unfortunately, there are many monstrous sorts who yet consider this a night to spread fear like a plague.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_100_028: And so it struck me: what if All Saints' Wake could be an occasion for celebration among mortal and monster alike? I believe there is room for light in even the darkest of hearts.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_110_028: Which brings me to the question of your involvement. I would have you aid a minion of mine named Papa Gruff in facilitating an All Saints' Wake that will allow yours and mine to join hands in mutual merriment.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_029: Perhaps you know Papa Gruff. He was once a voidsent so depraved that his kin spoke of him only in hushed whispers. But I have since shackled─or rather, politely reasoned with him to commit devilry no more.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_030: Knowing of his formidable magical prowess, I have set him to work under these guiding words: “Frighten enough to tickle, but not scar.”
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_031: Fear need not be an unpleasant experience, and Papa Gruff is doing his utmost to strike that delicate balance between felicity and fright. Not with much success, as I understand.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_032: I would love to proffer him advice myself, but I believe one such as you would know better what appeals to the mortals of this city. Might you give our beleaguered Papa Gruff a few words of advice?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_034: He should be putting on a performance near the Leatherworkers' Guild at present, assuming he has yet to be chased from Gridania's borders. Please speak with him, and give him my...encouragement.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: That pumpkin-headed harpy is up to no good, I can feel it in my gut. I trust you will do your utmost to uncover her evil plot.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_041: Papa Gruff decided the best place to dazzle the people of Gridania would be the Leatherworkers' Guild. I understand he is having trouble keeping his audience engaged, which runs markedly counter to the stipulations of our, ah...agreement. Needless to say, he requires your help.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: You! You're that meddlesome adventurer!
...Ahem. Rather, I see tidings of my humble performance have reached even your ears, good ! Please, honor me with your presence as my guest of honor.
My, what have we here? Another curious soul drawn to my wondrous show? You're in luck, for there happens to be a front row seat with your name on it.
Without further ado, I shall summon a foul, fell beast before your very eyes! I only hope you've brought a change of smallclothes.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWLANCER04785_000_: A monster? It'll take more than a magician's cantrip to scare me...
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Look here, my dear thrill seekers. Here lies an ordinary pumpkin─or is it? Take care not to blink, for any moment of distraction may well be your last...

Oh, the terror! Those bloodthirsty eyes, those razor-sharp fangs... F-Flee if you dare, but this hellhound will chase you to the ends of the earth to have its onze of flesh─and I would know, considering the scars of its wrath upon my backside!
Imagine each and every pumpkin adorning this fair city transformed into such a thing! ...Why, dread would prey upon Gridania to the last ilm, if I made it so. A veritable banquet of chaos!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWLANCER04785_000_: ...Bloody brilliant! You drew us in all that talk of monsters, only to dash our expectations with an adorable pup. I admit some confusion at first, but now I see you are a clown among clowns!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_0: Not a single bloodcurdling scream. But a smile is...not a complete failure, I suppose?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Ah, my pumpkin-headed master asked you to help me? Well, allow me to peel back the curtain, as they say.
Considering our previous acquaintance, this hardly bears repeating, but my true form is that of a voidsent.
If my master sent you, I suppose there's no harm in revealing my true identity. I am no clown, you see, but a voidsent.
My, not even a grimace. Well, I suppose it would be inconvenient if you ran away screaming after every sideways glance in my direction.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_0: Now, for the matter of this furry abomination...
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: "Frighten enough to tickle, but not scar,“ is the agreement that binds me to my master. I don't need to be told twice that summoning any of my kind would be in gross violation of that covenant.

So, remembering the deceptively winsome countenance of this vicious hellhound, I thought it would strike the perfect balance between horrifying and heartwarming. That is, until a child at an earlier show burst into tears at the pup's appearance.
Now I've seen a man react with a hearty laugh to the exact same dog, with nary a trace of fear in his voice. The difference is vexing! Tell me, is a puppy something to be feared or cuddled?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_A1_000_000: Feared by children and cuddled by adults. But sometimes the opposite.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_A1_000_001: Depends. What frightens one may make another smile.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Do you jest? You mean to say your kind's definition of terror...differs from person to person!?
I admit, that does explain the sheer contrast in reactions I've observed so far. And it does place me between a rock and a hellish, soul-rending place.
If my task was simply a matter of bringing people to fearful tears, the ground beneath you would already be soaked through. How in the hells' good name does one frighten to tickle...?
Ah, but you! You, with your delicate sensibilities can teach me to mix dread and delight into a charmingly chilling concoction. Let us begin at once!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_075: I trust you and Papa Gruff will get along like screams and bloodshed.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Let's get right to it, eh? First, we need to find people to scare─but not scar!
Your kind seems to gravitate towards the pumpkins we've placed throughout the city, which creates the perfect opportunity for mild mischief.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_0: One of our displays should be just over this hill and another is near the Lancers' Guild. Your job is to tell me what to transform the pumpkins into once we find suitable test subjects─let's see how well you tickle!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_082: Papa Gruff is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_083: You can leave Papa Gruff behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_084: If you wish to have Papa Gruff accompany you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_090: You must be accompanied by Papa Gruff and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_091: Papa Gruff has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: You may have heard terrifying stories of my past, but I regret to say the magicks I wield don't quite live up to my reputation. I only have a talent for minor transmogrification, really.
My master, on the other hand... Oh, I shudder to think what mayhem she would be capable of if she wished it.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_094: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Papa Gruff?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: I fail to see what could be more important than this task, but if you insist... Once you're ready, come and find me near the Leatherworkers' Guild. I'll be thinking up entirely new ways to make your kind scream with joy.
There you are! Well, All Saints' Wake doesn't last forever, so let's cook up a few frights!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWSERGEANT04785_00: An All Saints' Wake performance? Very well, but I face slavering monsters almost daily, so it will take something quite fantastic to make me flinch.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: Oh, I could make him flinch so hard his heart would burst in his chest...! <sigh> But that's neither here nor there. What type of ghoul would be suitable?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_A3_000_000: Give him the ghastliest ghoul you can muster.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: Well, if you say so. Allow me to oblige!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWSERGEANT04785_00: That...that gave me quite a fright. I only hope I never face such a monstrosity on one of my patrols, else my final act might be to soil my breeches. Well played, well played.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_105: This seasoned veteran of the Twin Adders has seen all the horrors of the Twelveswood. Perhaps something more stimulating is in order.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWBOY04785A_000_11: Eeek! Look at this scary thing!
These decorations are so scary... You're not here to trick me, are you?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: This one is ripe for the picking, hehe... Ahem! F-Forget I said anything. So? What type of ghoul do you suggest?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_A4_000_000: The most appalling abomination you can conceive of─and don't skimp on the ooze.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: Hehe, if you really think so...
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWBOY04785A_000_11: ...You know, when you look at it, it's actually kind of cute. The puff of smoke was a little scary though!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_115: You would do that to a trembling child? Who's the real monster here?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: I think I'm beginning to understand. If a fright doesn't kill your kind, it can actually be somewhat...pleasant!
I believe I'm ready to take the proverbial stab at it! Come, come; there should be more pumpkins around Apkallu Falls.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWSERGEANT04785_00: This looks almost real... I believe I might see this terrifying visage in my nightmares for some time yet.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWBOY04785A_000_12: It gets cuter every time I look at it. I wonder if any of the other pumpkins will transform.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWBOY04785B_000_13: So this is the All Saints' Wake, eh? Meh, I've seen worse.
Don't tell me you're supposed to send a chill down my spine. Clowns are for babies!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: For babies, are they? Hehehe, I'll make this lass wish she was back in her mother's womb!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: You there, little girl. Look well upon this pumpkin.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWBOY04785B_000_13: Ah...hah hah... Wh-What impressive magic! My heart won't stop pounding.
Da and Ma will have the fright of their life when I tell them I saw a real, honest-to-gods monster. I can't wait to tell them!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HLWBOY04785B_100_13: Haha, I'll think twice before I insult a clown again. Thank you for the thrills!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Did she say, “Thank you”?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_100_1: I scared her near out of her shoes, and she thanks me? Can't say I've experienced that before.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: I daresay I even enjoyed it! Yes, now is the time to capitalize upon this newfound “tickling” skill of mine. Let us visit the display near the Whistling Miller next.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HORTICULTURIST04785: Ungh... My eyes were playing tricks...they must've been.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Good day to you, young lady. Might you join me in celebrating the joyous occasion that is All Saints' Wake?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HORTICULTURIST04785: Celebrate? That's the last thing on my mind! Please, go and bother someone else with that ghoulish makeup.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Oh my, aren't you in a fright─and not the good kind, either. What happened, lass? Papa Gruff is here to help.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HORTICULTURIST04785: You...you'll really help? Well, I could certainly do worse than a clown. I've come from the Greatloam Growery, although “fled from” is probably more appropriate.
I was tilling the fields like always, when I heard a frightful voice from behind me. I turned around to meet it, and came face-to-face with the foulest monster I've ever seen!
When I regained my senses, I was here, my throat hoarse from screaming. No power in the realm can persuade me to return, not while that horror wanders unchecked.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: A monster...? But we haven't visited the Growery yet. What could it have been, do you think?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_A5_000_000: Maybe one of the transformed pumpkins from earlier?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_A5_000_001: We might have a real demon on our hands.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Impossible. Those illusions are no more capable of free movement than the pumpkins they sprang from. I believe something much more real may be lurking in Gridania.
You may very well be right. Those illusions I summoned are no more capable of free movement than the pumpkins they sprang from.
Yes, no doubt there are voidsent running amok.
Here I am, tying myself into knots trying to learn the subtleties of spookery, while some uncouth brute goes rampaging through the Twelveswood with nary a thought towards artistry.
If we forgive such behavior, our efforts to find glee in terror will have been for naught.
Tremble in fear no longer, lass! We shall investigate the matter.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HORTICULTURIST04785: Truly? You're the first people to believe my claims are more than seasonal mischief. Oh, I knew Father was wrong when he said all clowns were villains. Thank you!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Again those words ring strangely in my ears...however, 'tis not an entirely unpleasant sensation.

I know this wasn't why you were sent to assist me, but there's no telling how many of my kind we may find. A single void─er, clown can only achieve so much, so would you lend me your aid in case the situation gets undesirably bloody?
Thank you...
...Look at me, expressing gratitude, and to one of your kind no less. Well, no matter. Let us depart to the Greatloam Growery and settle this.
I see nothing out of the ordinary here...but I know they are close.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_HORTICULTURIST04785: That frightful thing snuck up on me at the Greatloam Growery... I fear it will be some time yet until I can work up the courage to return.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Our roguish quarry is close, doubtless lying in wait somewhere to catch us unawares. Once they show themselves, don't indulge them with anything but a face of stony indifference.
As I thought─a fellow voidsent. And what, pray tell, are you doing here?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_MAGICPOT04785_000_1: A brother of the void!? Then you know why I'm here─for the Night of Devilry!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_MAGICPOT04785_100_1: Once, we were free to carouse, creep, and caper, guided by the great pumpkin-headed archfiend.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_MAGICPOT04785_110_1: For too long we have been denied our demonic rights─and it is I who shall reinstate our grandest event!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_MAGICPOT04785_000_1: Yes, the age of the Great Gourd shall give way to the era of the Great Pot! Even now, my allies lie in wait throughout the city, ready to usher in the Night of Devilry. You must join us, brother! Join us as we rise again!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: No.
Even if I wanted to, my covenant prevents me from engaging in the wanton vileness you propose.

Regardless, I have no desire to join you for some cheap jaunt through the city with only a few startled mortals to show for it. Such indelicate devilry would only result in our swift and total annihilation.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_MAGICPOT04785_000_1: Ha! Spoken like a true coward! Don't tell me you're frightened of some sharpened sticks and clumsy clubs?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Oh, but I am frightened─as you too would be, had you tasted the full brunt of my master's fury. Perhaps you may yet, if you continue to insist upon this foolish course.
I have learned how to blend in with the people here and extract terror in such a way that does not tempt retaliation.
Your plan would bring but a single night of debauchery. Learn how to cohabit, however, and our collective revelry can last forevermore!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_MAGICPOT04785_000_1: Traitor! Then my minions and I will devour you and your  of a friend!
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_187: Naughty children ill deserve to join in the festivities. They should be happy as decorations, to serve as an example for any who would follow in their footsteps.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: M-My lady! How dread─er, I mean, pleasant it is to see you! Dare I ask why you grace us with your presence?
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_189: I caught wind of a voidsent disturbance and came here to investigate. When I heard your voices, I knew something was afoot.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_190: Heh heh... I must say, I am quite pleased that you see the merit in my approach to All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_191: Yet something must be done about the other beasts that have crept into the city. Let us give them the same treatment and continue enjoying this unhallowed season on our own terms.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: That wretch reminded me of myself, long ago. For but a twist of fate, I might even now be adorning the streets of Gridania by its side...
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_201: With your help, rounding up our reckless kin should prove to be a simple matter. Let us make this All Saints' Wake an occasion to remember for those who dwell in the light and shadow alike.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_203: If you sight any errant ghouls, perform the spell I demonstrated earlier.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_204: In so doing, we shall convince the residents of Gridania that the source of their supposed nightmares was naught but a cluster of mundane pumpkins.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_205: This wand possesses the transformative power you require. Simply swing it about in a grandiose manner and point it at your target.
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_PUMPKIN_000_206: Once the charms have been cast, I shall collect the pumpkins. I understand they are quite delicious when baked in pie... Heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLW901_04785_SYSTEM_000_207: You have learned the emote All Saints' Charm!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: That pumpkin-headed harpy is up to no good, I can feel it in my gut. I trust you will do your utmost to uncover her evil plot.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Just when I was getting the hang of being the life of the party instead of the death of it... Let's wrap this up quickly, lest this year's All Saints' Wake be remembered as a disaster.
I sense something sinister lurking deeper in these fields...
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_100_0: ...As well as a trail heading to the east. Perhaps towards the market or the Lancers' Guild.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Splitting up will be the easiest way to end this quickly. I'll escort the botanist from earlier back here and deal with whatever still haunts the Growery.
I shall use the opportunity to convince her that what she witnessed before was nothing but an overzealous pumpkin. That should put her heart at ease.
I will leave the rest of Gridania to you. Once the voidsent have been verily vegetated, meet me at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre so we can deliver my master news of our success.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_000_021: The Wood Wailer and the voidsent are locked in a tense standoff. Flick your wand and use the All Saints' Charm to lighten the mood.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWMONSTER04786A_10: Heehee... Leave me to my meal.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_110_021: Only the All Saints' Charm can turn this voidsent into a pumpkin and bring its reign of terror to an end.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWMONSTER04786A_00: A pumpkin? Wait...this is all part of the All Saints' Wake festivities, isn't it?
I must say, that made my heart skip a beat. If this is what adorns the streets, I cannot wait to see what the main stage has in store.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_000_026: The child is cowering from the menacing voidsent. Turn this tense situation festive with the All Saints' Charm.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWMONSTER04786B_10: Go away, can't you see I'm spooking? Heehoohoo!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_110_026: Only the All Saints' Charm can turn this voidsent into a pumpkin and bring its reign of terror to an end.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWMONSTER04786B_00: <shudder> If I don't look, it'll go away...
Huh... What!? It was a pumpkin the whole time!?
I can't believe I fell for that! ...But now that I know it was just a trick, I'd like to see it again!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWMONSTER04786C_00: No force can rival that of terror! And upon terror, we feast!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_000_031: This voidsent means to frighten the wits out of as many of Gridania's citizens as it can. Use the All Saints' Charm to bring a carved smile to its face.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWMONSTER04786C_10: Hm? Another trembling soul to feast upon?
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_110_031: Only the All Saints' Charm can turn this voidsent into a pumpkin and bring its reign of terror to an end.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FLWCITIZEN04786C_00: Whaaat!? It was just a pumpkin! I knew the Wood Wailers wouldn't let such wicked things into the city!
I've never seen such a feat of illusion before. If the rest of All Saints' Wake is as entertaining, I'd best go and find the main event!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_000_035: You have turned all the prowling voidsent into harmless pumpkins. Papa Gruff awaits at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to hear tidings of your success.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PUMPKIN_000_040: You are returned, and that means Gridania is free of mischievous voidsent. Heh heh...let us hear what Papa Gruff has to say.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: There you are. I took care of the voidsent still haunting the Greatloam Growery─did your hunt go as smoothly?
Good, good! Now we can safely say that the only frights in store for the citizens of Gridania are of the decidedly entertaining variety.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PUMPKIN_000_053: I took the liberty of gathering the pumpkins you created. Their punishment will not be eternal, but they can stand to remain in their current form for the duration of the festivities. It is the least they can do in repentance...heh heh heh.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_HORTICULTURIST04785: There you are, my fearless clown! Thank you for reassuring me. I had worried I might have to retire from my position at the Greatloam Growery and seek less haunted climates.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FUFUCHA_000_055: As the master of the Botanists' Guild, allow me to extend my personal thanks for helping my gifted pupil avoid such a decision. It would have been a grievous loss for all of us.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Oh, it was no trouble at all. In fact, I should thank you for being such an exemplary audience!
A true entertainer brings his all to every stage, be it a grand amphitheatre or cozy vegetable patch. I only hope you were half as thrilled as I was!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_HORTICULTURIST04785: That scary, er...whatever that was looked so real! I never could have guessed it was just a garden-variety pumpkin. Truly, I feel privileged to have seen a master of illusion at his craft.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FUFUCHA_000_059: As do I. Would that every day were so filled with surprises!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_FUFUCHA_000_060: As a token of our thanks, we've made some pumpkin cookies from our most recent crop. Please enjoy them in good health.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: I do believe I can get used to this “being thanked” thing. Well, since you've gone through the trouble, I'd best eat them before they've cooled.
This flavor...I've never tasted anything like it!
The cookie's aether is tinged with something I can't quite pin down. It's bold, but not overpowering.
Is this the taste of...gratitude? Oh, how much of my life have I wasted only supping on terror, when all along a whole world of flavors was left neglected...
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_HORTICULTURIST04785: I'm...not entirely sure what you mean, but I shall consider your words a compliment, nonetheless. These cookies are but a small token of my appreciation─I only wish I could have given more...
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PIERROTFATHER_110_0: You mean, I could potentially receive more gifts!? If frighten─er, performing my act will get me more baked delights, I'd better get to work straightaway! Why, this is shaping up to be quite the All Saints' Wake, indeed!
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PUMPKIN_000_067: Heh heh... I could not have imagined a better day of celebration for all.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PUMPKIN_000_070: Our success here is in no small part thanks to you. As I believe that Papa Gruff now has matters well in hand, I shall return to my manor─pray visit if you are so inclined.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_PUMPKIN_000_071: Ah, yes, before I forget. Do apprise that troublesome investigator of what has transpired here. Maybe he will finally cast his prying eyes elsewhere.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_INVESTIGATOR04785_0: What a fantastic yarn! Monsters plotting against monsters, all to make us happy?

I admit I find your story hard to swallow, but I also see no reason why a fellow guild member would lie... Very well, I shall take your tale at face value and consider these to be glad tidings indeed.
However, I cannot help but wonder if this was all an elaborate ruse. They knew we were watching them, and that may have compelled them to put on a show of charity.

After all, a monster cannot change its skin overnight. I shall continue to keep a close eye on their activities from afar. I thank you for everything you've done, and hope against hope that the evil has been laid to rest.
TEXT_FESHLW902_04786_SYSTEM_000_084: You now have access to Sneaky Hollow. Speak with the unusual usher at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to be escorted to the costume party.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_NOVICEADVENTURER047: F-Forgive me my boldness, but you are , are you not?
My apologies! Even if you are the spitting image, I suppose it was naive of me to presume that you are indeed the living legend . I shall have to keep searching...
Th-Then my search is at an end. A begoggled gentleman tasked me to find you, you see, in hopes of entreating your aid with...some matter he deigned not share with me.
Pray remain here, and I shall fetch him at once!
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: (-???-)Greetings, champion.
'Tis I who employed the young adventurer to facilitate this impromptu audience.
As for the why, I've a request that you─and you alone─can fulfill.
Pray listen well, for my tale begins with a most unsettling dream...

In it did I behold the evening sky, boundless and shimmering. As I drank deep of its beauty, I spied two stars sailing across the inky expanse─one of purest white, the other blushing scarlet, their courses set such that they might pass without collision.

Sharply and suddenly, the scarlet star shifted its trajectory. High above a burning landscape did its path intersect with that of the white star, their conjunction marked by a brilliant explosion of light. Even in slumber, I was awestruck by the spectacle.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_A1_000_002: A lovely tale, but I fail to see what that has to do with me.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Truth be told, mine own interpretation wavers. My rational mind says “meaningless dream,” whilst my artist's soul insists on “prophecy.”
I do not wish to make any claims with certainty. And yet...
Whatever greater meaning this vision might hold, I am convinced that the blazing white star represents the Warrior of Light. In other words, you.
And should these portents indeed foretell future events, you are thus fated to encounter the scarlet star─whomsoever they may be.
I therefore humbly request that you accompany me to the “burning land” from my dream, that I might witness the vision's denouement. I will compensate you for the trouble, of course.
The question is, which territory in Eorzea might be considered “burning,” metaphorically or otherwise...?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_A2_000_001: The Bowl of Embers where I battled Ifrit?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_A2_000_002: The Burning Wall in eastern Thanalan?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_A2_000_003: A place rich in corrupted crystal deposits? They can look quite fiery.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: While its relation to flame cannot be denied, mine instincts tell me nay. The scene from my dream was more ridge than bowl─a giant, flickering outcrop of...crystal, mayhap? Of course!
Ah, that cluster of immense crystals born of the Seventh Umbral Calamity. Aye, it well resembles the sweeping scene from my dream.
These crystals would have to be immense in size, akin to...to those which comprise the Burning Wall. Aye, that site well resembles the sweeping scene from my dream.
The first mystery is solved. We shall leave for eastern Thanalan and the infamous Burning Wall at once!
The Burning Wall... An apt name indeed.
'Tis said that these crystalline structures were formed when falling shards of Dalamud pierced the land's aetherial current.
Some see them as a symbol of rebirth─a manifestation of renewed life...
But that is neither here nor there. Let's have a look around, shall we? Spyglasses at the ready!
A spyglass would be the most efficacious method of surveying our surrounds. Pray alert me to any unusual discoveries.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_SYSTEM_000_041: Survey your surroundings for anything out of the ordinary. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target an area and inspect it with .
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_054: (-Strange Man-)A dream led you to me...?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I understand how absurd that may sound. We, ourselves, were unsure of what awaited us here.
As for who we are, I am content to be known as “the minstrel.” This stalwart hero is .
Might we have the pleasure of your name?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_058: Clive. I─ The last thing I remember was the ruins...
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_100_059: My head... Where...? How did I come to be in this place...?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: 'Twould seem you were knocked senseless. Confusion is to be expected.
For safety's sake, I suggest we make for town and have a Phrontistery physician look you over.
I shall see our patient receives proper treatment. Would you mind waiting for us at Scholars' Walk?
Our foundling is being cared for as we speak, but I'm told he should be released soon.
Hopefully 'twas naught that a bite of food and a little bed rest couldn't cure...
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_072: It was kind of you to wait, thank you.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: What of your condition?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_074: Much improved. The physiker also noted no signs of injury or illness.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_075: Yet my memories remain hazy. How did I end up there...?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_076: Whatever I was doing, it was important, I'm sure of it. I must return as soon as possible.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I see...
We cannot leave him in this state. We must help him restore his memories and find his way home.
What of this city, Clive? Do any parts of Ul'dah strike you as familiar?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_080: No... Maybe I've simply forgotten, but I recognize nothing.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Hm, not Ul'dahn, then. Still, I should like to think that the sights and sounds of a well-known locale will hasten your recovery.
The Burning Wall, the place where we found you, is situated midway betwixt Ul'dah and Gridania. Perhaps a trip to the Twelveswood is in order?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_083: Gridania, you say? The name rings no bells, but I have no better suggestions.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_084: And you would take me there?
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Meanwhile, I shall make the rounds of the neighboring settlements, and ask if any have heard of you. Let us rendezvous in Gridania anon.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_090: This entire situation has me knocked off balance, I'm afraid.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_091: , was it? I appreciate you coming to my rescue.
TEXT_FESSXT101_04796_CLIVE_000_092: Still, you must have your own business to attend to. We can set out whenever you're ready.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_001: Are we ready? Then let's head out.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_002: This Gridania the minstrel mentioned, is it far? Will we need mounts?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_004: Not that I mean to doubt you, friend. If you say we're boarding an airship, then that's what we'll do.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_010: , if I may ask a foolish question... Do these airships of yours actually fly?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_011: A foolish question indeed, then. Your expression tells me as much.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_A1_000_002: Is there no airship travel where you're from?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_015: It's odd... I know that the weapon on my back is called a “sword.” I understand what it's for and how to wield it.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_016: Foggy as my memories may be, my general knowledge seems intact.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_017: Yet hearing you speak of functional airships, I felt...confusion. Disbelief. For something that you clearly think of as commonplace.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_018: I can make no sense of it. Where was I before now...?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_019: Ah, but dwelling on this is pointless. Forward is the only way.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_020: To feel that bracing wind, the deck shuddering beneath your feet as you rise into the sky... My memory may be faulty, but that was an experience I'm sure I'd not soon forget.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_030: So, this is Gridania? It seems very unlike the city we just left.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_031: Where to begin...? I think it best if I follow your lead.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SYSTEM_000_032: Clive is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SYSTEM_000_033: You can leave Clive behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SYSTEM_000_034: If you wish to have Clive join you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_055: This city certainly has a different feel to Ul'dah. Not only the architecture, but the people as well.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SYSTEM_000_060: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Clive?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_065: An urgent task? Please, by all means. We can rendezvous back at the airship landing.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_070: Shall we continue from where we left off?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_080: This tavern... It reminds me of somewhere I've been before...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_081: No, it's no use. I can feel the memory, but it's like grasping at smoke. But maybe if you were to show me somewhere else?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_090: ...A chocobo!? Now that's something I recognize.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_091: Yet it's more than that. I had my own chocobo once, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_092: But as for the when or the where...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_100: An impressive crystal. Not a Mothercrystal, surely...?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_110: Ugh, when I try to remember, the fog in my head almost seems to grow thicker...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_120: This is a truly beautiful place.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_A3_000_001: You've taken a liking to Gridania, then?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_122: I do like what I've seen of it. Seems a peaceful life here among the trees, only...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_123: Brief flashes of this and that, but nothing to suggest I've been here before.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_124: I just can't shake the strangest feeling.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_125: As if it's too peaceful. And that doesn't sit right...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SERPENTSCOUT04797_0: Patrol reporting, Commander! All is quiet with the Ixal─no sightings of Garuda!
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_VORSAILE_000_127: For which we are profoundly grateful. At ease, soldier.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_129: You there! This Garuda you speak of─
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_VORSAILE_000_133: Memory loss, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. Though it seems Garuda's name has lit a spark of some sort.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_134: I was in a battle...with Garuda. I fought her, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_135: Please, you must tell me more. Anything that might help me remember my past.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_VORSAILE_100_135: Of course. Gridania owes a debt of gratitude to any who've stood against that destructive fiend.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_VORSAILE_000_136: However, there is one more suited to the task than I. Our Elder Seedseer is well versed not only in primal lore, but also in the treatment of bodily afflictions. She is surely your best hope for recovery.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_VORSAILE_000_137: I will send word ahead to Stillglade Fane. Stand ready to escort our guests to an audience.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SERPENTSCOUT04797_0: Pray find me at Nophica's Altar in Old Gridania, and I will see that you are granted entry to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_VORSAILE_000_150: I shall pray for the swift return of your companion's memories.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_151: The way back to what I've lost begins with Garuda. Of that I feel certain.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_SERPENTSCOUT04797_0: The Lotus Stand lies just ahead. If you would follow me, please.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_162: Commander Heuloix has apprised me of your friend's condition. This is he?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_163: A pleasure to meet you. I am Kan-E-Senna, Elder Seedseer of Gridania.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_164: I thank you for your gracious welcome.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_165: I am Clive...though beyond that, I fear my introduction may be lacking.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_166: Please, concern yourself not with proprieties─'tis your memory loss we are here to address. I am told Garuda's name awakened some previous recollection...?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_167: Yes. In the instant I heard it, a hazy vision of battle rose unbidden. I think perhaps if I could hear more of Garuda...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_169: Garuda is the deity revered by the Ixal, a people who once dwelled here in the Twelveswood.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_170: She appears as a winged entity, half-bird, half-woman, who commands the wind itself. Most frightening, however, is her capricious temper, as unpredictable as a howling storm.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_171: I should add that  has fought against Garuda in her primal incarnation.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_172: A winged woman of volatile temperament, with power over the wind... A fitting description of the opponent I remember.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_173: But a deity...? No, the will behind that monstrous visage was distinctly mortal.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I suspect Clive's Garuda and Eorzea's primal are not one and the same.
Mainly as Clive himself is not of our world.
I went back to where we discovered Clive and questioned folk in all the nearby settlements. Not one person recognized his description.
Such a distinctive tattoo escaping the notice of every local rumormonger for malms around? Improbable, to say the least.

That led me to consider another possibility. One consistent with past accounts I have heard of visitors from other worlds somehow stumbling through reality's curtain and finding their way to our star.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_180: My brand, it's... It's the mark of a Bearer.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_181: Does it pain you to remember?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_182: I feel the memories trying to surface, but when I strain to recall, a piercing ringing fills my ears...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_184: Another primal's name. 'Twould seem the pain has a less-than-tangible source.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_185: Long have I studied the healing arts, yet I sense no shadow of illness in your body. Your suffering stems not from injury nor sickness.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_186: Victims of terrible events have been known to suppress their own memories out of instinct...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_KANESENNA_000_187: One's subconscious denies attempts to confront the awful truth, the mind creating a shield of pain to protect the heart.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_188: The barrier is of my own making? How, then, am I to overcome it?
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Fate has brought us together, and together we shall triumph over this adversity!
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_200: So, you think me from another world...
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_CLIVE_000_201: And my memories of said world are not like to return unless I acknowledge some terrible truth. A truth my mind refuses to remember.
TEXT_FESSXT102_04797_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: 'Tis a confounding dilemma, I agree, and I have given thought to a solution.
I believe that the shackles which bind your mind may yet be struck off in the heat of battle. A drastic measure, perhaps, especially when not at your best.
Which is why I turn to you, . You are the twin to Clive's wandering star─your involvement is no accident.
The path I see is thick with thorns, but if you've the will to walk it, then gird yourself for war and await me at Apkallu Falls.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_001: The minstrel has a plan, it seems, but he shares little beyond confusing metaphor...
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_002: Still, I'm willing to indulge him if it means making progress.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_003: We're to meet him at “Apkallu Falls,” right? And where is that to be found?
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_004: Good─not far, then. Let's get on with it.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Because this waterfall is where the legendary Archon Louisoix gathered a band of adventurers in the time of the Seventh Umbral Calamity.
Their purpose: to extinguish the infernal Ifrit.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_014: Hngh. I know something is there, I just... Why can't I remember!?
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Clive recalled several words in the Elder Seedseer's presence─words which brought him pain. While the significance of “Bearer” eludes me, you and I are more than familiar with “Ifrit.”
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: Considering your reaction to the mere mention of the name, 'tis likely that the primal─or its equivalent in your world─is deeply connected to your condition.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Thus have I resolved to weave my lyrical magicks and bring you face-to-face with the Ifrit of our world.

Here, where Archon Louisoix paved an aetherial path to the primal's lair, will my words be given substance. And within the vision which takes form will you do battle with a phantom of our minds' creation.
Imaginary though this confrontation may be, I fear your suffering will be all too real. Yet you must persevere, for your hidden truth will not be unearthed without hardship.
Take heart, scarlet star, and call upon the strength of your shining twin! Your past awaits!
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_100_019: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 50 or above to proceed.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: (-Wandering Minstrel-)You stand in the Bowl of Embers, the site where the Amalj'aa summoned their patron deity...and the stage upon which the Warrior of Light became a slayer of gods.
(-Wandering Minstrel-)'Tis but convincing illusion─the body of recounted tale given breath by fanciful verse.
(-Wandering Minstrel-)Come forth, Lord of the Inferno!
(-Wandering Minstrel-)An accurate facsimile, yet not quite the Ifrit you know.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_A1_000_001: It's time to uncover the truth!
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_028: Alright. Time to find out who I am.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_031: That's the thing which killed Joshua! Yes...I've been on its trail, seeking vengeance for my brother!
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_032: This fiend must pay. Fight with me, !
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_100_032: During this battle, you will gain access to special duty actions as follows:
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_200_032: Use Rising Flames to charge the foe and inflict high damage.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_300_032: With the proper timing, you can use Dodge to avoid taking damage, even if you are within the area of an enemy's attack.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_400_032: Certain enemy attacks will be preceded by a countdown icon. When this countdown progresses to the Dodge icon, quickly use the Dodge action.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_500_032: After executing a successful dodge, the Dodge action will change to Precision Strike, which provides an opportunity to inflict additional damage.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_033: I blamed another...to spare myself the guilt.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_034: I feared that by accepting it, I would lose what little was left of me.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_035: But I accept the truth of it now.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_036: You are not Ifrit. I am.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: (-Wandering Minstrel-)In the battle against your own mind, 'twould seem you have emerged the victor.
(-Wandering Minstrel-)Intriguing...
The illusion is unraveled, yet you've brought a friend back with you...
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_041: This is Torgal, a wolf pup raised in the duchy. There is no more loyal ally in battle, and no keener guide when the road ahead is uncertain.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Ah... That would explain the aberration in the lingering aether. Torgal is here to lead you back to your own world.
Clive has embraced his harrowing past, and in doing so reclaimed the memories he lost. Though not a conscious act, he has manifested his readiness to return home in the form of a trusted companion.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_044: Even so, it was...difficult...to accept what I'd done.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_045: My younger brother─Joshua─was a kind and gifted soul.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_046: The inheritor of the Phoenix's flames, he was destined to become archduke, as our father had before him. But Joshua was murdered. His bright future cut short.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_047: From that day onwards, I lived for one purpose alone. A Dominant of Fire had slain my brother, and I would have my revenge.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_048: I spent years tracking the killer, until one day...I came to understand it had been me all along.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_049: I was young and distraught when I first summoned Ifrit. I hadn't known such power lurked within me─or that it could even exist at all.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_050: The transformation was instinctive, uncontrolled... And it was by my hand that Joshua died.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I can but imagine the anguish this caused you.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_052: There was anguish, yes, and a guilt I will never escape. But I cannot let it stop me.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_100_052: I was born the vessel for Ifrit's power, and I need to know why.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_053: It was in search of answers that I went to Phoenix Gate, and delved into the ruins below. There I found the courage to face my past and accept the truth─and then everything faded to black.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Hmmm, your tale suggests that something in the ruins─some mysterious force─was responsible for your inadvertent journey.
And if you arrived in Eorzea from a place sacred to the Phoenix and its flames, then it stands to reason...
I'm thinking that to see you home, then we must return to the beginning. Our road takes us back to the Burning Wall!
Once there, your furry comrade will lead us exactly where we need to go.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_000_061: Torgal's ears are pricked up, his senses focused on his surrounds.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_065: Such an incredible sight. I was in no state to appreciate these crystals the first time...
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: We've come this far. Now Torgal will be our guide.
Such was the purpose of his creation, after all.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_000_082: Once you choose to depart, Clive and the wandering minstrel will accompany you. Torgal will then begin leading you onwards.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_000_083: Follow Torgal to his destination and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_000_084: If you leave Clive or the minstrel for any reason, or lose sight of Torgal, you may try again by returning to the starting point.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_000_087: Once you choose to depart, Clive and the wandering minstrel will accompany you. Torgal will then begin leading you onwards.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I sense the end to this extraordinary tale is at hand.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_099: Don't mind me. Keep an eye on Torgal.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: A brief fellowship, formed beneath the wings of the Phoenix... 'Tis worthy of a poem in itself.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_Q3_101_099: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_102_099: Feeling lost? Maybe we should head back and start over.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: ...Leave? Some matter of heroic importance, I trust? Very well, we shall await your return at the spot where this expedition began.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_104_099: Come, Torgal is eager to run.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: I am ever ready to wander!
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_106_099: Once you choose to depart, Clive and the wandering minstrel will accompany you. Torgal will then begin leading you onwards.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_107_099: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: One can be forgiven for putting a foot wrong when faced with the sorrow of parting. No matter, we simply begin once more from the beginning.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_110_099: Speak with Torgal at the Burning Wall to try again.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The tale ends where it began.
Indeed.
I was baffled as to why this, of all places, would serve as a junction between our two worlds. But now I think I understand.
Some years ago, Eorzea was visited by a cataclysmic disaster known as the “Seventh Umbral Calamity.”
Yet even as fire and ruin threatened all we held dear, the world underwent a mystical renewal. 'Twas as if the star was reborn.
One theory attributes the miracle to a benevolent entity, claiming that the undying Phoenix flared into being to save us in our hour of direst need.

The Burning Wall itself is a scar left by those events, its crystal ridges having erupted from the earth overnight. Some believe these monoliths of solidified flame to be proof of the Phoenix's deliverance.
The bond with your brother, the Phoenix of your world, may have been the connection which brought you to this sacred place in ours.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_113: It seems our time together is at an end.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_114: Thank you both for all you've done.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_A4_100_115: Press on, friend. No matter how daunting the hardship, or bitter the truth.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_116: Always. No matter what fate awaits at journey's end...
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_117: And yours as well. You don't seem the type to stand still.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_CLIVE_000_118: Come, Torgal. We have answers to seek, and Valisthea awaits.
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: And then he was gone.
I feel the stirrings of a ballad...
...But, nay. 'Twould be hubris to imagine I could capture Clive's story from so fleeting an excerpt.
That honor belongs to someone else─someone privileged to see his tale to its conclusion. Sadly, the power to peer into other worlds was not granted me by this day's miracles.
I wonder, however, if you might manage it, .
Our little adventure is over. Set in motion as it was by a dream most cryptic, I must thank you for indulging my sudden and strange request.
As for your promised reward, I hope this is sufficient?
Torgal proved such a trustworthy guide that I thought to bind his likeness to a summoning whistle.
May his loyal spirit serve you well on your travels. Until we meet again!
TEXT_FESSXT103_04798_SYSTEM_000_140: You can now exchange MGP for special items by speaking with the Gold Saucer attendant at the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_LEWENA_000_000: Excellent. The next show should be commencing any moment now...
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_LEWENA_000_001: Hm? Eavesdropping, are we? How very quaint. If you must know, I will soon be making for Blunderville, that I might spectate a few rounds of organized chaos. You have heard of it, yes? ...No?
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_LEWENA_000_002: It shouldn't come as any surprise, but the Gold Saucer has once again deigned to dream bigger. They now offer a host of precarious obstacle courses─which they refer to as “shows”─and lavish prizes to those who participate.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_LEWENA_000_003: If you prefer something more thrilling than cards and Cactpots, perhaps you might find it to your liking. Speak with a curiously dressed man named Wy, and he shall guide you to Blunderville Square.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_LEWENA_000_004: If you wish to gaze upon the Saucer's newest attraction for yourself, you need only speak with Wy at Wonder Square.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_FGSENTRANCEMAN04801: Greetings! Ready to stumble on into Blunderville Square?
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_FGSCOUNTERMAN04801_: Welcome to Blunderville Square─the Gold Saucer's second-roundest square! I am known as the Beankeep, and it is my duty to guide newcome challengers to their premiere show. By that glimmer in your eyes, I take it this is your first visit?

Aha, as I thought! Never fear, however, for I shall explain all. Blunderville is a set of battle royale obstacle courses fit for up to twenty-four challengers─and you, my intrepid friend, look like our very next one!

Challengers are tasked with overcoming three particularly tricksy courses, and must race ahead of the pack if they wish to qualify for further challenges. Whether you fall flat during the first round or find yourself among the final few, you're sure to win rewards aplenty!
Should you bumble and stumble your way to the last round, then you, too, have a chance of claiming the coveted crown!
It can be quite a lot to take in, so I'll leave the finer details for later. In the meantime, have you any pressing questions? Comments? Concerns?
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_A1_000_002: What are those strange creatures wandering around?
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_FGSCOUNTERMAN04801_: Isn't it just? We have the Beans to thank for that. They inspired us to fill our shows─and our lobby─with the colorful whimsy you see before you.

An excellent question indeed! Our diminutive friends here are known as the Beans. Their curious coloration and delightful charms inspired us to construct this very hall─and our shows, of course─with creative abandon!

Though we know not where they originated from, we but recently discovered these little ones wandering the Gold Saucer. Their round physiques are reminiscent of legumes, so we eventually came to call them the Beans.

Be they voidsent or seedkin or something else entirely, they are adorably inquisitive creatures. You simply must hear them hoot and holler about the halls. I've no idea what they're attempting to say, mind you, but it all sounds quite precious.

On the other hand, you might be surprised to learn that Master Godbert Manderville, proprietor of the Gold Saucer, was the first to attempt communication with the Beans! I'm told they found his hearty laughter and muscular mannerisms most endearing.

It is thanks to his efforts that we found common ground with them, and in turn, they grew comfortable enough to show off their unique proclivities...such as racing through every obstacle that comes their way!

They may be a tad clumsy, but the spirit of competition that lies within them is a force to be reckoned with! Master Manderville was so moved by these displays, he immediately ordered the construction of this whimsical hall, that his new friends might have a place to frolic and play with others.
...Forgive me, was I rambling? Well, in any case, that, my good , is how Blunderville came to be!
You're more than welcome to take on our shows by yourself, or with an entire alliance of companions, if you wish!
Once you've made your preparations, simply speak with the registrar. We'll escort you to our next show as soon as every competitor is accounted for!

I believe that covers the basics, but if you've any other burning questions about what you might encounter along the way, I would be pleased to assist you. I wish you luck out there, and may you rise above the rest!
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SYSTEM_000_036: A custom HUD will be displayed in Blunderville.
TEXT_SUBGSC901_04801_SYSTEM_000_037: Should you wish to adjust the HUD settings before participating in your first show, open the System menu and select HUD Layout.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_000: Hello there, friend! Can you feel that? Love is in the air, just waiting to be snatched up by questing hands!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_001: That means Valentione's Day is upon us once more, and I, Astrid de Valentione, and my fellow emissaries are here to support all who would avail themselves of this bounty!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_002: Oh, but I know you─! Forgive me, I do get so caught up in my introduction. It is an absolute pleasure to see you again!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_003: You have the air of one in constant pursuit of adventure...and what greater adventure is there than to fall head over heels for another? Welcome, my friend, to the festival of ardor and affection!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_004: ...Come to think of it, an intrepid adventurer like you might be just what I require. Might I ask a favor of you?
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_005: A fellow emissary by the name of Emilie departed earlier to prepare a little surprise for our festivities, you see, but she's been gone for quite some time. I would like you to make sure she hasn't gotten herself into trouble.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_006: I would go myself or ask one of my associates to check up on her, but all are busy guiding our love-starved revelers. Will you do me this favor?
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_009: Before she left, Emilie said she would be practicing under the trees near Fen-Yll Fineries. No doubt you will find her there.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_010: You shall find Emilie practicing under the trees near Fen-Yll Fineries. Pray go with all haste.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_011: If I shift the angle just the teensiest bit, I bet I can triple the cuteness factor! No, quadruple it!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_014: Oooh, Astrid asked you to check on me? Well, isn't that sweet of you! It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance, !
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_015: Oh, it's you! What brings you here, ?
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_016: Ah, so Astrid asked you to check on me! I appreciate you coming on her behalf.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_017: I suppose you're wondering what I've been practicing here, so far away from prying eyes...
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_018: Patience, my friend, patience! If you truly wish to see what I've been cooking up, pray come to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_019: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_020: You brought her back as promised! Thank you, .
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_021: She intends to demonstrate her─what did she call it? Right, “love heart” on stage in just a moment. You can be part of her very first audience!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_022: That was, erm, yes...cute! So this is what you've been working on!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_023: The Gridanians are a reserved people who have long been reluctant to openly express their feelings to one another.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_024: Yet I believe it is of utmost importance that we open our hearts to those we hold dear─in this season of love most of all. Now is the time for everyone to shed their fears and wear their affections on their sleeve!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_025: That's what inspired me to come up with the love heart. I can only hope this simple expression is enough to motivate people to act!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_026: Well it certainly appears to have made an impression! Navigating matters of love is oft a nerve-racking task even for the boldest of us. Yet with this gesture, I believe you've given the townsfolk the perfect means to convey their feelings!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_027: Emilie, I encourage you to go about the city and perform the pose before any you might find floundering in the ocean of love. Go on and ignite the passion in their hearts!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_029: Would you mind lending a hand as well, ? As an adventurer, I'm sure you've touched the hearts of many. There are doubtless few more qualified to guide others in pursuing─and realizing─their passion!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_030: Wonderful! Now, before we set forth, I would ask you to remain on the stage for a while so we can judge your pose. Considering the import of our mission, I'm afraid we can't leave until it is flawless.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_031: My, I am equal amounts impressed and envious that you managed to perfect the gesture in so short a time! It took me ages just to get the hands right...
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_032: Ideally, I would like you both to get started immediately, yet I do wish we had another emissary...
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_033: (-???-)Then how serendipitous it is that I am here to offer my services!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_037: Ah, I believe an introduction is in order. The esteemed personage before you is none other than Lisette de Valentione, my dear sister and predecessor as emissary of Valentione's Day.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_038: Oh Astrid, ever one for propriety. Let not her introduction intimidate you, my dear. Call me Lisette, Lissie─whatever you fancy.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_039: How long has it been, my friend? Too long, surely. You have my personal gratitude for assisting Astrid with the celebration.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_040: Yes, well... Pleased though I am for your offer, should you not be enjoying the festivities with your beloved?
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_041: My adorable Astrid, though I may have relinquished the burden of leadership, I have not abandoned my duty as a herald of love.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_042: You said yourself that you lack for capable help. And I am here, yes? As a daughter of House Valentione, I cannot stand by as the flames of ardor dwindle.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_043: Let her help, Astrid. It might be just what she needs before her rendezvous with Hortefense!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_044: Emilie! I told you about that in confidence!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_045: Aha, so that's the way of it. In that case, your aid is most welcome.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_LISETTE_000_046: Well...with that settled, let us go forth and quicken the seeds of romance yet to sprout throughout Gridania. Pray teach me this pose of yours, Emilie.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_047: Yes ma'am! Might I suggest we split up? Our adventurer friend here can handle Old Gridania, whilst Lissie and I cover New Gridania.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_EMILIE_000_048: Given the season, you shall no doubt find more than one individual who is flummoxed by their feelings. Strike our pose before these lost souls, and with an outpouring of love grant them the courage to tell what's in their hearts.
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_ASTRID_000_049: There are a few areas in particular I'd like you to visit once you're ready. Just say the word and we can begin!
TEXT_FESVLX001_04808_SYSTEM_000_050: You have learned the emote Love Heart!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_000: Ready? Wonderful! I've marked out a few locations in the area where people tend to mingle.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_001: I'm confident you will find more than a few individuals in need of a little push. Show them your best rendition of the love heart to give them the courage they need!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_002: Pray visit the locations I marked on your map and perform the love heart to inspire those lost in the throes of love!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENA04809_000_0: Oh, my love, what have I done to incense you so!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SYSTEM_000_005: The dejected lad appears to have had an argument with his lover. Lift his spirits by unabashedly showing him the love heart!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENA04809_000_0: I see... It's a symbol of love─a call to bare one's heart, scars and all...

...My beloved stormed off earlier because I was terribly late for our rendezvous. I dared not tell her the reason for fear it would vex her further─I had been so preoccupied selecting a gift for her that I lost track of the time. I must apologize to her and explain myself.
Thank you for helping me to see that, my friend. Mayhap there is time yet for a Valentione's Day miracle...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENB04809_000_0: Such a perfect specimen...firm, but soft in the right places. Gods, I could just eat them right up! Er, not the produce, mind you─him, the proprietor! I only wish I knew how to tell him the way I feel...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SYSTEM_000_011: The hopeless lass is unable to muster the courage to speak to the proprietor. Stoke the flames of her passion by performing the love heart.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENB04809_000_0: That is an adorable pose...but why show it to me?

You meant to encourage me? That is very kind of you, but I'm afraid I find the prospect of confession daunting... <gasp> Though, I could ask him his professional opinion on which vegetables are most suited to be cut into heart shapes!

A completely natural question considering the spirit of Valentione's Day, yes? Truth be told, I've had my eye on him for some time now. I simply didn't know how to approach. But, thanks to your...unique motivation, I've finally found the inspiration I needed!
Though it occurs to me, how did the heart become associated with Valentione's Day in the first place? I hope to Nophica he doesn't ask me...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENC04809_000_0: Wh-What is it? If you have a matter to report, keep it short. I'm rather occupied at present...
Perhaps I could invite him to a meal? But how would I even broach the subject...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SYSTEM_000_016: The brassbound Wood Wailer seems distracted in a way only the lovelorn are. Perform your best love heart to snap her out of this stupor.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENC04809_000_0: S-Stop that! Wh-What manner of strange gesticulation have you just accosted me with? A curse? Nay, an insult!? Explain yourself this instant!
Oh, er, excuse me? I...need to be brave enough to express my feelings? Are you claiming that I, a proud lancer of the Wood Wailers, lack courage of all things?

Well... You would be right. I'm too craven to invite someone to a simple meal. But your gesture─now that I understand its intent─has kindled my warrior's spirit! I will carry out this task as if it were my sworn duty! My thanks, adventurer! ...And forgive me for assuming the worst.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_SYSTEM_000_021: You have taught the townsfolk to remain steadfast in the face of love and inspired them to act. Report the results of your efforts to Astrid at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZENB04809_000_0: How did the heart become the symbol of Valentione's Day?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_023: People can't seem to get enough of the love heart!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_025: You're back! Seeing as my sister has yet to return, might I ask you and Emilie to recount how you fared in the meantime?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_026: Well, I found the pose to be eye-catching if nothing else. Perhaps even embarrassingly so...even though it was I who invented it. Regardless, I am proud to say folk were practically lining up to see it!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_028: I see... Whilst I'm glad to hear others were spurred to action, it saddens me slightly that some do not know the origins of Valentione's Day's symbol─the heart.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_029: Which makes me wonder: are you two aware of how it came to be associated with Valentione's Day?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_A1_000_002: It has something to do with House Valentione...I think? Maybe?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_030: Then allow me to teach you! It all began with─
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_031: Indeed. But that only scratches the surface─allow me to elaborate. It all began with─
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_033: Lisette!? Heavens, your face is white as a sheet! What's wrong?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_034: Hortefense...I...I saw him speaking with a-a woman in the Carline Canopy... They were alone together, speaking intimately...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_035: You don't suppose it was... Oh gods, you don't suppose it was a tryst, do you!?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_036: Absolutely not! You know Hortefense would never be unfaithful to you! Nay, purge the very thought from your mind!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_037: I know, but...when I saw him and that woman whispering to each other like they were in their own little world, my heart stopped. Before I knew it, I was running from the sight of them as fast as my legs would take me.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_038: "Love is the fruit born of bravery!“ Have you forgotten these words, Lisette?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_039: They are our words, passed down by our ancestor, Countess Arabelle de Valentione.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_040: She summoned the courage to pursue love through all manner of hardship.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_041: And she was not merely a countess, but also a warrior true. Naught symbolizes what she fought for more than her crimson shield, forged in the shape of a heart. The symbol is a source of courage─remember that!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_042: Thank you, Astrid. You are right. Countess Arabelle would be mortified to see her progeny act with such cowardice. I must honor her legacy. I...I am ready. Hortefense! If he intends to elope with another woman and live to tell the tale, he has another think coming!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_043: Ahem. I am clueless as to the nature of Hortefense's connection with this mystery woman, but I daresay Lisette needs friends by her side. Might I prevail upon you both to join her?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_044: But of course! Leave it to us!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_045: You have my gratitude. I place her in your capable hands!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_046: We'd better hurry. She said Hortefense and this unknown woman were in the Carline Canopy. I'm sure that's where she's headed!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_047: I know that whatever comes, you'll be there for Lisette! Now please, head to the Carline Canopy with all haste!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_048: There you are! The situation looks rather tense...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_HORTEFENSE_000_049: Lisette? But our meeting was not to be until later...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_052: Gods, she's lost control of her tongue! What should we do?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_A2_000_000: Love is the fruit born of bravery!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_053: Hortefense Pastoroit! For what reason do you intimate yourself with this comely young maiden, knowing full well that another has entrusted her future to you?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_054: Well? Have you naught to say for yourself?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_055: Erm, it would seem nerves cause Lisette to fall back into the mannerisms of her noble upbringing...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZEND04809_000_0: Oh dear, I'm terribly sorry! This is all a misunderstanding. I came to Hortefense for counsel, as I admire the devoted relationship he has with you. I was hoping he could offer me advice in nurturing a similar bond with the one I adore...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_HORTEFENSE_000_057: Lisette, my love... My first thought was that you could not bear to wait another moment for our meeting. But now I see you could not bear the thought of me with another...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_HORTEFENSE_000_058: 'Tis as if the very Fury Herself stands before me! A goddess in both spirit and flesh, full of passion and devotion... Oh, what a fortunate man am I!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_HORTEFENSE_000_059: And I regret that my actions would cause you even a moment of suffering! Please set your heart at ease, my darling! I have eyes for none but you, now and forever. I only chose a private location so this young lady could seek counsel away from eavesdroppers.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_060: Oh. That's...it? Gods, I've made a complete fool of myself. Forgive me, both of you. That a lady of House Valentione should comport herself in such a way...I am completely ashamed.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZEND04809_000_0: If I may, my lady, I now understand why you would be upset. And I admire your bravery for confronting us. Would that I had the courage to give voice to my own feelings...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_062: I may no longer be the head emissary of love, but I am as well equipped as ever to speak on matters of the heart.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_063: Love is the fruit born of bravery, my dear. Though it is terrifying to bare your heart to another, it is more terrifying still to live never knowing what might have been. You must confess. I promise you the risk is worth the reward.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_CITIZEND04809_000_0: I...I suppose I would regret it for the rest of my days if I never found love because I was too afraid to fight for it. You're right, my lady. I will do my best!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_HORTEFENSE_000_067: Ungh... The sight of your angelic pose struck me to my very core... My heart is like to burst from my chest...
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_068: I think that means he'll live! Anyway, the two of us will return and apprise Astrid of what happened here. I trust you won't mind if we inform her that you and Hortefense will be partaking in the festivities earlier than scheduled?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_069: Well...'twas our plan from the beginning. And it would do much to smooth over this little...misunderstanding. Please extend my apologies to Astrid for any worry I might have caused.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_070: Let us return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre and give Astrid the good news!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_LISETTE_000_071: Oh for the love of─would you please get up?
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_073: I'll let you do the honors. It was your words which brought Lissie back to her senses, after all.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_080: Oh, I'm so relieved! It was all just an unfortunate misunderstanding... I must thank you for being there for my sister, it truly means the world!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_081: You deserve my thanks as well, Emilie!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_082: Don't mention it! I'm happy we were able to help.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_083: Though we've had our ups and downs, I believe we accomplished our goal of showing folk how important it is to express their feelings to those they hold dear. All in all, I'd say this Valentione's Day has been a success!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_084: Which reminds me... Although my explanation of the heart's origins was interspersed with some dramatics, I take it you were able to piece together its meaning.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_085: Yes, indeed. A noblewoman and a proud knight, Countess Arabelle's legacy lives on not only in the tradition of Valentione's Day, but in its symbol─her beloved heart-shaped shield.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_086: In commemoration of her brave pursuit of love in the face of insurmountable odds, the heart came to symbolize her─and eventually, the very concept of love itself, capturing the imaginations of men and women around the world.
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_087: Today, while many may recognize the symbol, few know of its history. With Emilie's “love heart,” I believe people will become curious to know the story of our tradition, and for that, I am overjoyed.
