TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_EMILIE_000_088: Countess Arabelle's tale will undoubtedly give many the courage to pursue love, just as it did your sister!
TEXT_FESVLX002_04809_ASTRID_000_089: May we all learn from the countess's example. I pray you and yours have a Valentione's Day overflowing with affection, my friend!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_NONOTTA_000_001: Hatching-tide is come once more, and I daresay we may've outdone ourselves this time! It all hinges on whether we can see Mistress Aliapoh's dream realized...
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_002: Ah, come to enjoy the Hatching-tide festivities, have you?
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Welcome, my friend! I take it the Hatching-tide decorations have caught your eye?
Oh, , is that really you? I had hoped I might see you again, but I did not dare assume. Nonetheless, it warms my heart that you are eager to revel in Hatching-tide once more.
It warms my heart to greet yet another reveler, for I am the host of this event─Jihli Aliapoh, at your humble service. If I'm not mistaken, you're an adventurer, yes? Might I have your name?
...a festive name, to be sure. I hope that you shall find all things Hatching-tide to your liking─in fact, I know you shall!

For I have seen it in a dream clear as the one I had many moons ago, where the Twelve Archons delivered unto me a prophecy which inspired this occasion. I have worked tirelessly since that night to do their words justice.
This year, it was again a dream that sparked my imagination...a dream of a goobbue, massive and marvelous, standing upon the stage where else but in Ul'dah, so many malms away!
Wreathed in radiant flowers of pink, the darling goobbue held in her hands an egg decorated most lavishly.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_NONOTTA_100_017: And there is but one time of year when the sandy brown of that city is accented by peach blossoms in full bloom. Yes, I speak of Little Ladies' Day!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_NONOTTA_000_018: The message of Mistress Aliapoh's dream was clear: combine the spirit of Hatching-tide and Little Ladies' Day to create the most eggciting day that jewel of a city has seen! Naturally, we sought out those in charge of the event and brought our proposal before them.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_019: 'Tis a pleasure as always, . I see ours is not the only celebration which can boast of your selfless assistance.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_020: 'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance,  . I have the honor of acting as this year's royal seneschal, and it is my duty to bring smiles and cheers to all the ladies of the realm.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_021: What is Little Ladies' Day, you ask? Why, it is a day when the maidens of Eorzea are doted upon as princesses by their very own loyal seneschal!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_022: Mistress Aliapoh's proposal was quite unprecedented. And so confident was she in her vision that she had already secured the services of a performer and his goobbue companion before meeting with us.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_023: I regret to say not all in Ul'dah share in her conviction. Many doubt the safety of such an act, which has brought our plans for Little Ladies' Day to a standstill.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_024: The trepidation is not without cause, mind you. Some fifteen years ago, a supposedly tame goobbue ran amok in the city streets, causing untold harm.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_NONOTTA_000_027: When the seneschal informed us of these circumstances, I got to thinking: we could hold a Hatching-tide event here in Gridania, with a goobbue as the main attraction!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_NONOTTA_000_028: Not only would this lift the spirits of Gridania's people, but it would prove to those in Ul'dah that the goobbue poses no danger. Surely that would put any doubts to rest!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: In fact, the performers have already arrived! Nonotta and I were treated to a display of their show, and I must say, never have I seen a goobbue so pretty and sweet.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_030: Out of all the paths forward we could have taken, this seemed to be the only one which might please all parties. I came to Gridania at once so I could act as a witness for my peers in Ul'dah.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_033: Since you're here, might you accompany me to the show? Someone as well versed in this realm's beastkin as you may be singularly qualified to tell us just how docile this goobbue is.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_A1_000_001: I expect quite a few eggs for my troubles.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_A1_000_002: Well, I'd hate to see Miss Aliapoh's dream shattered...
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_034: Eggs...? Quite an unusual form of payment, but I believe Mistress Aliapoh has plenty...
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_035: Regardless, the look on your face says you agree to my proposal. Many thanks, and I look forward to what is sure to be a fascinating show!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_036: As would I! While I'm certain that there is nothing to fear, having a stout arm by my side will be most reassuring.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_03: Well then, all is settled. The show of a lifetime awaits at Bentbranch Meadows─you had best not tarry.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_037: Agreed. Let us make our way there and speak with Aldemund, the performer in charge. Oh, I can hardly wait!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: The adorable goobbue is even now delivering eggtastic cheer to all in Bentbranch Meadows. Go there and speak with Aldemund─I'm sure he shall be most eager to treat you to their show.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_NONOTTA_000_041: I went to visit the goobbue along with Mistress Aliapoh. I must say, I never realized just how adorable they could be.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_042: I...I don't believe I've ever been this close to one before...
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_050: Oh, didn't see you there. Can we help you?
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_051: Greetings. I am the royal seneschal, in charge of making Little Ladies' Day most memorable for all ladies of the realm. Mistress Aliapoh has informed us that you have quite the show prepared for us.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_053: Ah, we've been waitin' for you! You'll be hard-pressed to pick your jaw up off the floor after you see what my Peatie has in store for you.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_054: I've been watchin' over her ever since the day I found her wanderin' the wilderness all by her lonesome. We spent ages lookin' for her family, but now I s'pose we're all each other has.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_055: Peatie? A lovely name, to be sure. And those flowers, are they peach blossoms? I daresay she is the very picture of a Little Ladies' Day princess!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_056: Haha, I'm glad to hear that, and I know Peatie is, too. She's thought of little else since the moment Miss Aliapoh came to us with her peculiar request.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_057: There's nothin' in this world we love more than hearin' an audience cheer, and I think this time we'll earn that and then some. We call this one “egg surprise.” Go on, Peatie!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_059: Impressive, ain't it? And all it took was a few glamour prisms. 'Course, that wasn't where the genius was required.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_061: It took us days and nights of rackin' our brains to figure out how to capture the spirit of two celebrations. In the end, though, I think we did about as good a job as could've been expected.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_062: Now here comes the rub. Ever since we arrived in Gridania, Peatie's been a little on edge. Hate to see her like this, but I think I've figured out what's causin' it.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_063: As you just saw, she's got no problem performin' in front of an audience of two. But when a whole gaggle of revelers showed up not too long ago, she just froze up.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_064: I see... She must not be used to such large crowds.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_065: Luckily, I managed to save the show by climbin' atop her head. That set her mind at ease and helped her find her courage.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_100_065: But I ain't as young as I used to be, and my knees are already cryin' out in protest at the prospect of climbin' her again.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_066: But you, on the other hand...I reckon you've got plenty of malms left in those adventurer's legs of yours. Might I trouble you to join our merry troupe and support Peatie durin' her star turn?
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_067: All you have to do is climb atop her and head toward the crowds. Show them our act, and tell the spectators to come to me for an egg of their own. Still plenty to go around.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_BUTLER_000_070: If Peatie's act is a hit in Gridania, it would do much to allay the concerns of my Ul'dahn compatriots. Best of luck, !
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SYSTEM_000_072: Peatie is eager to get her show on the road. Speak with Aldemund to ride her.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_075: Trust me, Peatie'll love havin' you aboard. Now's our chance to get these eggs into the hands of the eager Gridanians.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_076: She's too timid to wander off on her own, so if somethin' else demands your attention, she'll make her way back to me. Now get out there, and give Gridania an egg surprise!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_MAN04810_000_081: Ah, this must be that performing goobbue I heard so much about. Good show, good show! I think I'll get an egg of my own to remember this by!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_MAN04810_000_082: They said the show was over here, didn't they?
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SYSTEM_000_083: Mount Peatie and perform an egg surprise before spectators to spread Hatching-tide cheer throughout Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_GIRL04810_000_084: That was amazing! The rabbits were so adorable!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_GIRL04810_000_085: And that crown of peach blossoms is so pretty! I wonder if they give them out with the eggs... Let's go find out!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_GIRL04810_000_086: I don't see any eggs... Is this the right place?
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SYSTEM_000_087: Mount Peatie and perform an egg surprise before spectators to spread Hatching-tide cheer throughout Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_GENTLEMAN04810_000_: Oh my stars! What manner of─
Oh... You're promoting Hatching-tide? Yes, yes...I knew that, of course.
Splendid trick that was, truly. I never knew goobbues to be adept at anything besides eating, but you've expanded my horizons. Mayhap I'll partake in the festivities this year after all...
I heard the Hatching-tide festivities would be held here this year, but I've seen nothing out of the ordinary...
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SYSTEM_000_092: Mount Peatie and perform an egg surprise before spectators to spread Hatching-tide cheer throughout Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SYSTEM_000_093: The spirit of Hatching-tide is alive in Gridania. Return to Aldemund and tell him of Peatie's courageous performances.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_094: Ah, there you are. Peatie's itchin' to show her stuff to Gridania's citizens, so just hop right back on her whenever you're ready.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_SYSTEM_000_097: While Peatie's expression is inscrutable, you sense gratitude radiating from her. She seems to have enjoyed herself.
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_100: Good work, . Same goes for you, Peatie! I could hardly pass around the eggs fast enough!
TEXT_FESPDY901_04810_ALDEMUND_000_101: And it looks like Peatie's managed to conquer her fears. Let's hope these ovations are enough to conquer the seneschal's.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_001: There's not a single egg left. Good work spreadin' the word, .
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: I see you and Peatie are getting along like eggs and spriggans! I think you would agree that there could be no better an addition to the Little Ladies' Day festivities.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_NONOTTA_000_004: Did you see Peatie do her thing? 'Twas plain to me that she gave her all to getting every detail of the show just perfect. That's exactly the kind of enterprising spirit the realm's little ladies need!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_010: Although I've been but a bystander in affairs so far, what I've seen has been truly inspiring. Peatie is possessed not only of a kind heart, but the soul of an entertainer as well!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_011: I would have her be the main attraction of our stage in Ul'dah! On behalf of the Little Ladies' Day Planning Committee, I invite you to our city as honored guests!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_012: Well, I'm not one to decline such an eager invitation. Consider it accepted.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_014: But first, I'd best tell Miss Aliapoh that she'll be needin' more eggs. Go on to Ul'dah─we'll find our own way there before long.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_100_014: Wonderful! Then I shall depart at once and make the stage ready for your arrival.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_015: Ahem. You've helped tremendously already, but there's no denying that Peatie has taken a shine to you. Might you watch over her in Ul'dah for a while─just until she becomes accustomed to the crowds?
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_016: Every stage is different, so it might take a while until Peatie finds her footin'. But her desire to see people smile can't be doubted. She'll shine brighter than all the jewels in any merchant's coffers.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SYSTEM_100_017: Peatie appears excited for her next adventure: bringing joy to the hearts of the realm's little ladies.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: Our lovely Peatie is heading straight from her debut to the grand stage. I must leave at once to cheer her on!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_NONOTTA_000_019: As expected, Lady Aliapoh's dream is coming to fruition. Give the warmest of regards to the royal seneschal for me!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_020: Ah, you are arrived! You'll be glad to know that I've managed to win over the planning committee with my story of Peatie's show. Ul'dah's gates will be cast wide for her arrival!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_021: If she is amenable to the idea, I would have her be the star attraction on this year's stage.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_022: But the first order of the day is to spread the word! If we tell the citizens what we saw in Bentbranch Meadows, it is my hope that they will welcome Peatie with open arms.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_024: And if her show is a success, then we will have managed a celebration which spans from Gridania to Ul'dah, painting smiles upon the faces of all the realm's little ladies and egg fanatics alike!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_025: I shall stay here and drum up what interest that I can. , pray head to the Steps of Thal and do the same. Meet me at the stage afterwards and together we can shower Peatie with applause.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_026: Aldemund and Peatie will wait outside the city gates until the appointed time. Until then, it's up to us to spread the word and muster the largest crowd we can.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_WOMAN04811_000_040: A goobbue performer? Aren't they dangerous? I suppose a friend of mine was raving about the show she saw in Gridania...if it's the very same, I suppose it's worth a look!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_LADY04811_000_041: A goobbue, here in Ul'dah? <shudder> ...That dredges up terrible memories of the rampage I witnessed as a child...
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_LADY04811_000_042: How do you know that won't happen again? Have you seen this goobbue with your own eyes?
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A1_000_001: Yes, and she brought countless smiles to the people of Gridania.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A1_000_002: Yes, and she's as gentle as a tame chocobo.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_LADY04811_000_043: Is that so? Well, I see no reason why you would lie to me... Very well, I shall go. Perhaps in this way I can conquer my fears...
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_MAN04811_000_044: I didn't know goobbues were capable of anything more than mindless eating. Are you sure this “show” isn't just watching a beast chomping on hay?
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A2_000_001: The crowds of Gridania gave her a standing ovation.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A2_000_002: So what if it is? You'll still have a chance to see a goobbue up close.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_MAN04811_000_045: Well, when you put it that way... Besides, it's not as if I have aught else to do. All right, look for me among the crowd!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SYSTEM_000_046: The time of Peatie's performance draws near. Speak with the royal seneschal before she takes the stage.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_048: This crowd's got even my knees shakin'... I can't imagine what Peatie must be feelin'.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_050: My thanks, . It seems word has spread even further than I had hoped.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_051: And while this is cause for celebration, Peatie appears to be intimidated by their expectant gazes.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_053: 'Course, you could just hop up on her head and she'd calm down just like that. But we can't lean on you forever.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_054: Why don't you rally her spirits with some encouragin' words, ? Seems she's warmed to you, and I reckon she'd appreciate whatever you have to say.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_055: Come on, . Rally her spirits like you would your allies before a death-defyin' battle.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_056: She can dazzle them, she just needs to believe...
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_060: Truth be told, this is her first time performin' alone in front of so many people. I can see why her legs won't listen to her heart.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A3_000_001: Remember how happy you made everyone in Gridania!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A3_000_002: Don't worry, Peatie, I'm right here.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A3_000_003: Little Ladies' Day needs its princess!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_062: That did the trick! You've really got a talent for liftin' the spirits of the downtrodden, !
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_063: We are in your debt, truly!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_064: It's almost time. Lady Aliapoh should have arrived by now─, pray join the bystanders and give Peatie your heartiest cheer!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SYSTEM_000_066: Peatie is frozen with fright, but she may come to if you rally her spirits.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_067: The show shall start anon. Go on, join the crowd and lend your voice to the cheers!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_068: Your words were like a drop of water on a hot day. I reckon Peatie might even like you more than me!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SYSTEM_100_069: Peatie is ready to take the stage. Join the other bystanders to see what she has in store for Ul'dah's little ladies.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_070: And now for the final act! Bedecked in blooming flowers, this goobbue princess has prepared something unforgettable for all the little ladies out there!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: This is just how I envisioned it in my dream!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_LADY04811_000_072: (-Elegant Citizen-)And to think I ever believed goobbues were naught but wild beasts! Oh, I simply adore her!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_GUY04811_000_073: (-Animated Citizen-)If Hatching-tide is even half as thrilling as this show, I'd best catch the next airship to Gridania!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_074: Heh, all's well that ends well. The little ladies get a great show, and Hatching-tide gets more egg seekers.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: Their smiles are like so many flowers in full bloom! Peatie will be the talk of Ul'dah for moons to come.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_076: That she will, that she will. I have to thank you, Miss Aliapoh, for givin' us both the chance to bring a little brightness to so many lives.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: I've left Nonotta in charge of goings-on in Gridania. Oh, would that she could see my dream come alive!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_100_077: I reckon Peatie had the most fun out of everyone here.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SYSTEM_100_078: Peatie appears elated by the crowd's reaction, and gazes at the stage longingly.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_080: Thank you, Peatie, for bringing joy to the citizens of Ul'dah─especially its little ladies!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: That was better than I could have imagined. Hatching-tide and Little Ladies' Day both will be remembered as the highlights of the year!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_082: Couldn't have done it without your help, . We'll both be lookin' back on this experience with fondness for the rest of our lives.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_083: Speakin' of which...I've got to thinkin' maybe it's time I leave this performance business behind me, and let Peatie spread her wings. I think she'd be more than happy by your side, if you'll have her.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_084: As for me, I have it in mind to find a place to settle down and rest these old bones.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_085: I'd hate to tie Peatie down just when she's found her passion. If you bring her along on your adventures, she'll be able to deliver smiles to corners of the world I've only heard tales of.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_A4_000_002: Are you sure you can manage without her?
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_086: Truth be told, I only asked you as a formality, hah. I know I've placed her in good hands, .
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_087: Can't deny I already feel the tendrils of loneliness tuggin' at my heart, but they'll lose their grip so long as I know Peatie's with you.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_088: I look forward to hearin' of her exploits as I while the days away.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: I don't mean to be rude, but I am required in Gridania. Nonotta must know just how perfectly my dream manifested!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_ALDEMUND_000_090: Heh, give the lass our regards, eh? I'll stay here in Ul'dah until the festivities end─and who knows, maybe longer.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_091: And with that, allow me to thank you personally, . No princess in all the realm could have asked for a more devoted seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_092: And that includes Peatie. Seeing you dote upon her so dutifully reminded me why I volunteered for this position in the first place.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_BUTLER_000_093: Although Peatie's show has concluded, Little Ladies' Day has not! Pray enjoy all that we have prepared.
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_09: And don't be a stranger in Gridania, either!
TEXT_FESPDY902_04811_SYSTEM_000_100: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: That eclectic attire, that distinct scent of the unknown... You, my good stranger, must be an adventurer! You have found yourself in the company of Quevain, journalist for The Thavnairian Truth. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

Are you aware of the festivities currently underway at the Gold Saucer? They guarantee a generous MGP bonus to those who participate, but I have reason to believe that there is more to this celebration than meets the eye...

As a writer for the premier publication on unexplained and otherworldly phenomena, I was drawn not to the promise of copious Cactpots, but to the rumors of enigmatic water imps that have suddenly proliferated amongst the Saucer's patrons.
We at The Thavnairian Truth have been looking to expand our investigations across the star, and this supernatural scoop presents us with the ideal opportunity.

Why have the imps made themselves known now? What do they intend to accomplish? I must cover this groundbreaking story with all due haste...but I cannot hope to answer all these questions alone. Tell me, adventurer, would you aid me in my pursuit of truth?
Excellent, excellent! Then let us reconvene at the Gold Saucer's Entrance Square.

...Ah, but if you require a ticket to enter, I'm afraid I have naught to spare. Perhaps you might have better luck speaking with the well-heeled youth over yonder? He was loudly proclaiming something about a “not-so-small fortune” from the Saucer nary a moment ago.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_007: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: Ah, you've arrived. Notice anything...out of the ordinary?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_A1_000_001: What did it just say to me!?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_A1_000_002: I think our “creature” is in costume.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: Some manner of greeting, I presume. Though its cries are convincing, that impish form appears to be naught more than a well-crafted guise.
<sigh> Indeed... An imitation, and nothing more.
...And here I thought I could rival the editor in chief with my own unprecedented article. Now what am I to report? This is but child's play next to the extraterrestrial discoveries he has made!
We have found the source of the rumors, but... “Saucer Imps Unmasked: Just Normal Men and Women in Costume”? Why, that sounds more to me like a waste of good ink!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_10: It's unacceptable! Worthless! Unfit for consumption!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: Gods, I grow drowsy just thinking about writing such a thing. Our readership would be appalled!

Fortunately, there is another curious lead that I wish to pursue. In doing so, we may frame our story around the current festivities, then recount the role of the imps within them... Yes, that might suffice!

You see, as I awaited your arrival, I questioned the attendant at the front desk as to the imps' origins. Strangely enough, I was told that only a select few staff members were present in the planning stages of this affair, and fewer still know who proposed the initial idea.
I was, however, informed that a staff member on the floor─a man attending to an imp─may have the information we seek. If we split up and search the Saucer, we're bound to find him.
I shall leave Wonder Square to you. Let us reconvene here when our rounds are complete.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERSTAFF0481: Well met, my good ! My companion and I are delighted to make your acquaintance. He cannot speak like you and I, but I assure you, he is oh-so-fond of making new friends on this joyous, impish occasion.
What is the occasion, you ask? Why, the March of the Imps, of course! 'Tis a fresh new take on our annual celebration here at the Gold Saucer, as suggested by one of our staff.
When we first received word of it, we were rather baffled by the concept...but it seems to have left a positive impression on our guests!

To present our patrons with the most engaging experience possible, we've outfitted our attendants with impish attire. These costumed imps are free to frolic about the Saucer and bring joy to those they meet, with an adorable “squeee!” or a “ka-pa-paaa!”
“Why imps?” one might ask, and they would have good reason to do so! Alas, I myself was never told the exact reasoning.

But if you're keen to learn more of the March, I know just the imp who can assist you! He's the one who coined the idea for it, after all. I last saw him on the second floor at the Manderville Lounge. He may still be there, if you hurry.
If he should speak to you in the impish tongue, you needn't fret. He's particularly unique, even among his brethren, and he makes his intentions quite clear to those not versed in impspeak.
If you're searching for the imp I spoke of, you should be able to find him at the Manderville Lounge. He may still be there, if you hurry.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_042: Though you feel as if there's been some grave misunderstanding, the imposing imp suddenly entrusts you with a set of impish attire. His piercing gaze reaches into the very depths of your soul, and you somehow come to understand what he is trying to tell you: “Go forth, my stalwart apprentice.”
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_043: You have the sinking feeling that the imp will not provide you with the information you require until you have completed his task... It is now your solemn duty to don the impish attire and entertain the patrons in Event Square.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_044: You must continue wearing this costume in order to progress.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_045: Speak with the imposing imp to restore or prolong the garment change.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTA048: <sigh> ...I can't do this anymore. I'm tired of losing.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_051: You must be wearing the impish attire in order to progress.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTA048: Judging by the eccentric attire, I'm going to assume you work here.
Tell me, which of these attractions aren't stacked against me? I've lost nearly all my MGP today, and I need to find a way to earn it back somehow...
What, is that your way of consoling me? Hmph. As if I needed pity from an oversized frog.
Still...I appreciate the sentiment. Luck may not be on my side, but it's nice to know that someone else is.
Bloody hells, I wasn't expecting you to talk! N-Never mind the question, actually. I...I need a moment to recover from that.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_057: The patron appears to be displeased with your response... Perhaps you should try a different approach.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTB048: Those new mascots are awfully adorable, aren't they? I've been trying to muster up the courage to speak with one, but...initiating conversation isn't exactly my forte.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_059: You must be wearing the impish attire in order to progress.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTB048: O-Oh, hello there! You must be that new mascot that's been marching about. Some manner of imp, was it? I like your hat─er, head...thing.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_A3_000_003: <blip> <bloop> Affirmative. I am the pinnacle of imp technology.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTB048: How precious! I was a bit afraid to chat with you at first, but you're much friendlier than I imagined!
First Senor Sabotender, now you... Ahhh, would that I never had to leave the Saucer! I could spend the rest of my days surrounded by adorable creatures like you.
Wh-What in the world does that even mean!? Mascots are supposed to be cute and cuddly, not cold and calculating!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_064: The patron appears to be displeased with your response... Perhaps you should try a different approach.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTC048: Look at all the MGP I saved, Daddy! I wonder what kinds of prizes I can get...
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_066: You must be wearing the impish attire in order to progress.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTC048: Wow, you're one of those new mascots! You must know all about the prizes here, right? I saved up lots of MGP, but I'm not sure what to exchange it for...
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_A4_000_003: Why not exchange it for a water imp?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GOLDSAUCERGUESTC048: Hee hee, aren't you cute! If only I could take you home with me... Oh! I know! They have little imps that look just like you at the prize counter.
Daddy, I want a water imp! Let's go get one! Please? Pretty please?
H-How come you can talk!? Senor Sabotender doesn't talk! Why can't you be like him?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_072: You seem to have frightened the young girl... Perhaps you should try a different approach.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_073: Your impish antics have brought joy to the Saucer's patrons! Return to the imposing imp and inform him of your success.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_081: The imposing imp appears downcast, as if he was expecting someone else... Perhaps it would be best to remove your impish attire.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_SYSTEM_000_083: In the ephemeral moments that the imposing imp's gaze meets yours, you are overcome with a mysterious sense of obligation, and realize what he is trying to tell you: “Let us continue our discussion at Entrance Square.”
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: Ah, there you are. Loath as I am to admit it, my search for the one behind this event has yielded little success...
Regardless of my results, it's plain to see that the imps are well loved by all...but I cannot write an article on that fact alone. How did you fare, my honorary assistant?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_092: Oho! 'Tis a pleasure as always to see you at the Saucer, .
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_093: Greetings, fair patrons, and apologies for the sudden intrusion─I am Godbert Manderville, proprietor and namesake of this fine establishment.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: The Godbert Manderville!? Never did I think I'd meet a member of the Syndicate face-to-face... Surely you of all people must know who proposed the idea for this event?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_095: Your generous deeds this day have not gone unnoticed, so I believe an explanation is in order.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_096: It was I who proposed the idea for these festivities, as a matter of fact.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_097: Perhaps you are already aware, but we employ a voidsent known as Typhon here at the Gold Saucer. Summoned into this world by the Thaumaturges' Guild, he is a diligent soul who utilizes his formidable fungahs to our patrons' benefit.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_098: 'Twas not long after I hired Master Typhon that I became acquainted with a high-ranking member of the guild. Through him, I learned of a curious spell from ages past, known only as “Imp.”
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_099: True to its name, the spell transforms the target into the very beings you have espied marching about the Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_100: Master Ultros is proficient in the very same spell─mayhap you fell victim to it during your encounter atop the Dragon's Neck. He oft refers to imps as his “buddies” and “pals,” in fact.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_101: I found myself quite enamored with these adorable creatures, and sought to answer the questions that yet lingered in my mind: Where did the imps come from, and how did their spell fall into the hands of man?
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_102: I pored through what few resources were available on the subject, yet I could not find a definitive answer. Heartbreaking though it was, I was left with no choice but to leave the creatures' lineage shrouded in mystery.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_103: Nevertheless, I could not allow their history to fade into obscurity. When it came time to decide the theme of our annual festivities, I crafted the impish attire based on my findings, and proposed a celebration in their honor.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: You utilized these costumes not only to entertain, but to educate others as well... And with that, the full story is laid bare.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_105: Indeed... Though I know not if such a conclusion will prove ideal for The Thavnairian Truth.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: ...I feel a story coming on! “Myth Made Manifest at the Gold Saucer: Thaumaturgical History Reveals Imps' Mystery”!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_10: Hahaha... Yes! This is the scoop I seek!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: It is as Master Manderville says. Much about these imps remains an enigma...but they have brought countless smiles to the Gold Saucer. Readers shall doubtless want to learn of their existence, as well as the event that brought these few facts to the fore.
Such passion and drive to shed light upon the unknown is a fascinating tale─one that I shall do my utmost to depict!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_109: Ohoho! That's the spirit, lad. 'Twould be an honor to see our imps grace your publication's pages! I shall look forward to reading your account of it in the coming days.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_110: This young man's story will doubtless bring all the more attention to the March of the Imps, so I must express my thanks in the spirit of the celebration...with a set of impish attire, of course!
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_OCCULTJOURNALIST_00: You have my deepest gratitude as well, adventurer. Inspiration calls, and I must away to make these ideas a reality, but your contributions were vital to this discovery. You are more than deserving of reward.
TEXT_FESGSC801_04814_GODBERT_000_112: A job well done, my friend. The festivities shall be underway for some time yet, so I hope you will not squander the opportunity to enjoy this moment of respite and march with our fellow imps!
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_000: Excuse me, , but are you a trades by chance? You've the hands of someone with a long, storied career─hands that I would beg you lend to the good people of Tural.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_001: Here we accept petitions for aid on behalf of the Wing of Reflection. Be they from the common citizenry or fellow artisans, we use any and all tools of the trade at our disposal to ensure the needs of Tural are met.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_002: Since its founding, myriad tribes have gathered here unto Tuliyollal, commerce flourishing as the years passed. However, as one might expect from such a diverse people, business practices also varied greatly from tribe to tribe.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_003: While there are difficulties in trade we have yet to overcome, a great many troubles were resolved when the Dawnservant established the wingleve system.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_004: We serve as an intermediary between those who require aid, and the tradespeople with the requisite skills needed to fulfill these petitions in the form of leves.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_005: Are you familiar with leves? Hailing from across the salt, I would assume so.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_006: The Head of Reason adopted the system from the guildleves employed in Eorzea.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_007: The leve plates used depict the Dawnservant's journey building this nation, and the lessons learned from his companions along the way. A reminder that only together can we make Tuliyollal thrive.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_008: Of course, this sentiment of solidarity also extends to allies come from abroad, much like you. Which is to say, we would be honored to have your assistance.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_SYSTEM_000_009: You may now undertake wingleves by speaking with Malihali.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_MALIHALI_000_010: How are we ever to fulfill all of these requests? <sigh> What we need is someone experienced in trades.
TEXT_KINGYR101_05003_SYSTEM_000_011: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 90 or above.
TEXT_KINGYR102_05004_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: My word─is that you, !? I am overjoyed that fate would arrange this meeting, though I am not surprised. When I heard tell of your journey with Wuk Lamat, I had a feeling it would only be a matter of time until we crossed paths.
What am I doing in Tural, you ask? Why, I am come in search of unusual and fantastic stories that I may weave into songs, to spin tales that will enchant crowds the world over.

And this land has proven to be a treasure trove of folktales and legends unlike any that can be found across the sea. I have set each and every one to memory, and my head is swimming with new verses...
Yet for all the myths newly added to my repertoire, I still yearn for tales of newfound adventure. Tales involving parties that yet live─preferably recounted by someone with firsthand experience!
...And you are just such a ! Pray share with me everything that happened since you set foot in Tural, and I shall set it to song.
Every trial you endured during the rite of succession, every blood-curdling moment of your assault upon the levin-shrouded dome─I beg you spare no detail.
Your words will lend texture to my melodies and substance to my lyrics! Oh, I have a feeling my most memorable work is soon to come!

Of course, I understand you may not have the time at present. I shall be here for a while yet, polishing my prose to a mirror sheen. Simply come to me when you have a story to share, and I shall listen in rapt attention.
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_ELSEBEEIRONHEART_00: A fellow Eorzean, am I right? Do you fancy yourself much of a sightseer?
Dear old Millith gave you her journal? My, what a small world. It just so happens that I'm her cousin! Elsebee Ironheart at your service.

Well, if you've met Cousin Millith, I'm sure you can guess why I “crossed the salt,” as they say. This continent is positively brimming with sights unseen by Eorzean eyes, and I'm here to discover them all!
My twin sister and I, that is. You see, I had more interest in Yok, while she was drawn to the vistas of Xak. So it was that we parted ways at the bridge, each of us touring half of Tural.
...So give me your sightseeing log, then!
Let's see, let's see... Oh, how beautiful! I should like to see these places myself someday. Ahem, er, sorry, I was going to just scribble down...
...my notes on Yok Tural! I included what my sister shared with me of Xak Tural, but I'm afraid it isn't much.
My twin's name is Emeline and she's still wandering about over there. Given your natural affinity for Ironhearts, you'll doubtless run into her someday.
Well, I'm sure you've got places to be and vistas to behold. May your journey throughout Tural be bright and unforgettable!
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_SYSTEM_000_009: Dawntrail entries have been added to your sightseeing log!
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_SYSTEM_000_010: You must be level 90 or above to record Dawntrail vistas. Travel to the location indicated and fulfill the necessary conditions and you will complete the entry for that vista, earning experience points in the process.
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_SYSTEM_100_010: The newly added locations in your sightseeing log will be marked by an orb of light. Should you spot such an orb during your adventures, take a moment to stop and record the entry.
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_SYSTEM_000_011: Use your wits and the notes provided by Elsebee to identify these stunning sights and the proper way to appreciate them, and see Tural as only the greatest explorers have seen her!
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_ELSEBEEIRONHEART_10: Eager to behold Tural's myriad wonders, are you? Come and find me once you're a bit more experienced.
TEXT_KINGYR104_05006_SYSTEM_100_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must be level 90 or above.
TEXT_KINGYR105_05007_EMELINEIRONHEART_00: That tome...that wouldn't happen to be a sightseeing log, would it?
Millith! Now that's a name I haven't heard in a good long time. And dearest Elsebee...
She's my twin sister, you see, and I haven't seen her for thirty long years. Not since I was trapped during my exploration of Yyasulani.
It brings me great joy to know she is well. Pardon me for asking, but...might I see the notes she added to your log?
TEXT_KINGYR105_05007_EMELINEIRONHEART_10: She always did make such bold strokes of her lettering... Here.
TEXT_KINGYR105_05007_EMELINEIRONHEART_00: I've added my own notes. Some of the information may seem improbable at best, but I believe there is truth in every entry.
Were I younger, I would set out in search of these fantastic sights myself, but alas, my body can no longer endure such travels.
Though thanks to you, I feel lighter than I have in an age. If there is one thing I should wish, it is to see my sister again before I die. There is so much I would share with her...
But you have better things to attend to than an old woman's musings. Take care, kind adventurer. And may your journey lead you to vistas both bright and unforgettable.
TEXT_KINGYR105_05007_SYSTEM_000_009: New Dawntrail entries have been added to your sightseeing log!
TEXT_KINGYR105_05007_EMELINEIRONHEART_10: You wouldn't happen to know any experienced explorers, would you? I'm looking for someone to seek what vistas I cannot...
TEXT_KINGYR105_05007_SYSTEM_100_021: In order to undertake this quest, you must be level 90 or above.
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_000: Well, well, what have we here? I thought I knew all the prominent trades who pass through Solution Nine. Come to sign a contract, I trust?
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_001: You needn't fuss yourself over the details─the arrangement is blissfully simple. You provide me with product, and I compensate you for said product with scrips. A  of your expertise must surely recognize such a lucrative offer when they hear one.
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_002: In truth, it was the Turali who first introduced me to the many conveniences of trade with scrips. A system brought to them by a tradeswoman by the name of Rowena. But that is neither here nor there.
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_003: You will be well paid for your contributions─with scrips, naturally─and your earnings can in turn be used to purchase any of our wares that strike your fancy. So, what do you say?
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_004: Splendid! Simply splendid. And lest you worry, there will be no quotas to speak of. You need only make deliveries when inspiration strikes!
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_006: Here's to a most beautiful and profitable partnership! I very much look forward to doing business with you.
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_RHODINA_000_007: <sigh> What I wouldn't give for a capable trades. Now how am I to move all this merchandise?
TEXT_KINGYR106_05008_SYSTEM_000_008: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 90 or above.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Of all the coincidences! You will hardly believe it, but I was just this very moment reminiscing of the time you lent me your strength a twelvemonth past.

You see, I again find myself in pressing need of an adventurer's aid, just as I did last Rising. “Oh, if only  were here,” I thought to myself...and here you are! Well, then, what do you say? Shall we clasp arms once more?
Greetings, friend. By your dauntless bearing, I assume you are an adventurer─and come at precisely the moment I find myself in need of an adventurer's aid. Might I beg yours?

My thanks. The matter is this: I have been approached by a lady named Ayoyo who wishes to imprint her own inimitable mark upon the skies above Limsa Lominsa─I speak, of course, of the fireworks that illumine these Rising nights.
Learning of my contribution to previous years' festivities, she has enlisted me to her cause.
We already have the ear of the organizing committee. However, Lady Ayoyo has expressed a strong desire to consult with a storied adventurer before finalizing her proposal.
Come to the Yellowjackets' guardhouse at the base of the Coral Tower and I will introduce you.
Lady Ayoyo. One storied adventurer, as promised.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_011: Blessin's o' the Twelve upon ye. Name's Ayoyo, cannoneer first class with the Yellowjackets. 'S an 'onor to 'ave ye on board!
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Did I mention that it is the Yellowjackets who are in charge of this year's festivities? Not only in decorating of these fair Lominsan streets, but in designing and constructing the fireworks that brighten the skies above them.
Lady Ayoyo here is quite the savant in all matters incendiary and explosive, and so it has fallen to her to formulate a plan for the display's crowning glory.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_014: Me an' the other lads an' lassies of the cannoneers whipped up a load o' luvverly little drakes, snakes, and devils fer the Moonfire Faire, but more o' the same ain't goin' to cut it fer the Risin'.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_016: 'Cause it's all about rememberin' those we lost in the Calamity, ain't it? Them an' theirs deserve somethin' a mite specialer than a bunch of old bangers.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: An admirable sentiment, I'm sure. It would not do for our ode to such poignant memories to be aught less than memorable. Let us make this year's Rising one that the citizens of this fair realm will not soon forget.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_018: Took the words right out o' me mouth, dearie. Thing is, 'avin' 'ardly set foot out of Limsa in all me days, I don't reckon I'm best placed to know what's goin' through the minds o' the “citizens o' this fair realm”...
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: And so you would pick an adventurer's brains. One who has journeyed far and wide across this land we love, and knows it and its people intimately.

Yet before we call upon your particular wisdom, mayhap it would behoove us to seek out a wider range of opinions. Many and more look to the skies come Rising night, and the thoughts that run through their minds are no doubt as diverse. Let us learn them.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_021: Sounds like a plan! Mind if I join ye, dearie? Could do with learnin' some o' these thoughts meself.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_022: Right, then! Where's best to start askin' around? Some place a lot of outsiders gather, I reckon... 'Ow about we meet in the aetheryte plaza, down in the lower decks?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: While you two are so engaged, allow me to continue our discussions with the organizing committee. I shall await you by the Aftcastle.

Much and more are the preparations required for a firework display on such a grand scale, and every detail must be approved by the organizing committee. But let that be my concern─your primary objective must be the conception of the display itself.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_025: Can you see them too, my love...?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_026: The market is always bustling around the Rising season. Reminds me of the time the Grand Companies were restored.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_027: The streets're full o' life, the sky's full o' fire, and the westerly wind's fillin' our seafarer's sails as it does our 'earts. Ahhh, I couldn't've picked a better time to come home.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_028: Ah, balls. Should have written down what Baderon wanted...
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_030: Ye see them lights down 'Awker's alley, dearie? Decorations fer the festival, they are.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_031: Every year, when the streets are all decked out fer the Risin', me 'eart fills with...well, all kinds o' feelin's. Sorrow, pride. Regret...
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_032: But enough about me! We came 'ere to find out 'ow the other folks feel about it. Let's split up, head down the alley, and ask a few likely-lookin' customers each.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_033: We're on a schedule 'ere, so don't go askin' every single soul ye see. Four or five should do ye. I'll meet ye down by the ferry docks when ye're done!
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_034: Sorry to bother ye, dearie, but if I could be so bold...would ye mind tellin' me what the Risin' means to ye?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_040: Can you see them too, my love? ...Hm?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_041: ...You're involved with the fireworks, and want to know what I think of them? Well, just now I was wondering if they can be seen from far out in the offing. Do you know?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_042: ...I see. The reason I ask is that my husband is out there now. He meant to be back by Rising night, but it seems the tide didn't turn in his favor.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_043: He was so looking forward to the fireworks. I do hope that he can see them from where he is─that we can share them together, no matter how far apart we might be.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_044: That is my only request to you: that you make the finale as bright and boisterous as you can, that all those who cannot be together this Rising might still share in its message.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB05015_000_045: There are many like me who cannot be with their loved ones this Rising─whether by chance, or by tragedy. It is the fireworks that bring them together─so the louder and brighter they are, the better.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_050: Welcome, welcome! What may I interest you in this fine ?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_051: ...Ah, information, is it? Well, if you really must know, the whizzing and banging that fills the air this season always takes me back to the time just before the Calamity struck.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_052: A great festival was held to celebrate the reformation of the Grand Companies. People in the streets were hooting, and hollering, and setting off firespouts, and all the ships in the bay, now bedecked in Maelstrom colors, let loose their cannons.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_053: It seems so foolish now, knowing what was soon to befall us. But all that noise served a purpose nonetheless─drowning out the fear that ever whispered in our ears.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_054: It is my firm belief that the Rising fireworks serve the same purpose even now─they present a vision of loveliness, of togetherness, that we might forget our fears and be given hope for a brighter future.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SWOZBLAET_000_055: Aesthetics, my dear . That's what we need. A dash of true beauty to drive the shadows from our hearts and give us hope for the future.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_060: The streets are full o' life, the sky's full o' fire, and the westerly wind's fillin' our seafarer's sails as it does our 'earts. Ahhh, I couldn't've picked a better time to come home. You a sailor too, are you?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_061: ...Helpin' with the fireworks, ye say? Good on ye, . Aye, I've a few memories o' back then, if you've an ear to 'ear 'em.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_062: I'm a merchant seaman, ye see, always sailin' hither an' thither across the waves. Was just back from a trip to Radz-at-Han when the Calamity struck.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_063: Everyone was lookin' up to the sky, and that loathsome lantern that 'ung low in it.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_064: Like most folk, I don't remember much o' what 'appened in the days before or after it fell, but I'll never forget those faces.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_065: And that's what I love so much about the fireworks. Ye see the same faces lookin' up, but this time with a smile─reminds ye not only o' the bad times, but 'ow we got over 'em.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_MOB205015_000_066: 'Course, 'alf the folk who were watchin' Dalamud back then ain't with us no more. But they'll be watching the fireworks too, an' I reckon they'll bring the same smile to their faces as they do ours.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_070: Alright there. Anything I can do for you?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_071: ...You're asking for people's thoughts on the Rising fireworks? Heh! Would've thought a great hero like you would have better things to do with your time...but I suppose that's what makes you a hero, eh? Helping people out whichever way you can.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_072: ...You're asking for people's thoughts on the Rising fireworks? Heh! You adventurers don't half pick up some odd jobs.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_073: Well...I'm like most people, I suppose. I think of those I lost.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_074: My parents, most of all. I wonder if they're watching, too.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_075: Swum up from the bottom of the aetherial sea to see what all the crashing and banging's about.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_076: It's complicated, I suppose. I feel sad they're gone, but happy I'm not─and grateful to Baderon saving me and so many others.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_077: If they are watching, I hope they can see me, too. See that I'm doing alright for myself, that they might sleep soundly for another twelvemonth.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_078: I didn't learn this till long after he'd taken me in, but after the Calamity, Baderon banded together some old allies from his mercenary days and a few willing adventurers. They'd go round seeking out people like me who'd lost everything and try and put them back on their feet.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_SDHODJBI_000_079: I just made his job easier, drinking myself stupid and puking my guts out in his gutter. Maybe I should get him a little something by way of thanks...
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_080: Sorry to keep ye waitin', dearie. So, what did ye find out?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_081: Hmmm... Same 'ere. Was 'alf expectin' 'em to just like lookin' at the pretty lights, but it seems the feelin' runs a lot deeper than that.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_082: The memories o' the Calamity still sit 'eavy on their 'earts, but the Risin' fireworks go some way to liftin' that weight.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_083: So, any ideas fer the grand display? What kind o' thing d'ye reckon'd 'elp lift those spirits the most?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_A50_000_003: Something that reminds people of the past.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_A50_000_004: Something that gives people hope for the future.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_084: That'd do the job, alright! Ain't a Lominsan among us who ain't got a drop of pirate blood in her veins! Lightin' up the skies with buccaneerin' abandon would be just the way to put our own stamp on this year's festival!
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_085: Aye, ye might be right there. It's the same with folk as it is with ships─ye need to know where ye've come from to know where ye're goin'. A reminder of times past might be just the ticket.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_086: Hope fer the future, eh? That ain't a bad idea. Remindin' folk that however dark the night, dawn is just around the corner.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_087: The Risin' ain't just about mournin' those we lost, after all. It's about rememberin' the struggles of those who survived, to steer us to a brighter future.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_088: Aye, that's it... That's what Limsa needs this Risin'...
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_089: Ships. Cannons. A departure salute. Not just fer the fallen, but fer those settin' sail fer unknown shores. A vision o' the past, and o' the future...
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_090: An 'ole bleedin' armada filling Galadion Bay, lightin' up the very 'eavens! Who wouldn't want to watch that?
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_091: That's settled, then! Ah, the minstrel's goin' to love it! 'E said 'e'd be up by the Aftcastle, right? I'll see ye there!
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_092: Let's see, now... Fifteen 'undred weight of firesand, at five 'undred yalms from shore... Reckon we're goin' to need more ships.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Our intrepid adventurer returns─and positively bursting with inspiration, I take it?
...I see. A traditional seafaring salute, not only to the memories of the fallen, but to the future fortune of those who follow in their wake. A most fitting proposal, I'm sure.
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_102: Thanks, the both o' ye...but our work ain't done yet. There's a lot needs sortin' out before we can put this idea into action. So much to do, so little time!
TEXT_FESANX001_05015_AYOYO_000_103: If ye wouldn't mind 'elpin' us a little longer, dearie, I'd be forever in yer debt. Let me know when ye've got yer loins good and girded!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: A display of such grandeur is not merely a matter of crafting the fireworks proper. We shall require the cooperation of a great many people─several of whom may be less than disposed to offer it.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_001: Right, then. Let's get started, shall we, dearie?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_002: The plan is, we're goin' to line up an 'ole fleet o' ships across the bay, an' 'ave 'em fire a broadside into the sky!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_003: But before we go about findin' our fleet, we need to get the plan approved by the organizin' committee, and that means convincin' Commodore Reyner.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_004: I'll take the lead, but I ain't exactly got the silverest tongue, nor much experience nobblin' with the 'igher-ups. If you two see me strugglin', put in a word, won't ye?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Of course, milady. Your cause is ours.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_006: Thank ye, me dears! Together then, to the Coral Tower!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_007: Commodore Reyner worked 'is way up the ranks, all the way from rock bottom to the tippity top. 'E knows the workin's o' the thalassocracy in an' out, so any flaws in our proposal, an' 'e'll see right through 'em...
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Last I had the privilege of meeting with the Commodore was around the time of the Calamity. I had been arrested for conspiracy to incite rebellion. Naturally, it was all a misunderstanding.

Some other scurrilous soul had been singing songs of sedition. If not for Reyner and his relentless pursuit of the truth, I might still be lingering in the brig. He is a shrewd investigator who will brook no equivocation. Shall we, then?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_012: Wanting to make the Rising display special I can fathom, but the sheer scale of this proposal is beyond anything I imagined.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_013: Ayoyo, need I remind you that the first duty of the Yellowjackets is the keeping of the peace?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_014: Filling the bay with ships will not only disturb the daily workings of the harbor, but is sure to foment agitation among the commons. Knowing this, do you still mean to persevere with this outlandish plan?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_016: Every Lominsan 'eart, every Eorzean 'eart, still bears the scars o' the Calamity. All that loss, that 'ardship, that struggle...it cut deep.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_017: But the Risin' ain't just about lookin' to the past, it's about lookin' to the future, too. An' if it's our duty to watch over folk─keep 'em on the strait and narrow, like─I reckon it's our duty to see 'em off on another year's journey, too.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_019: I accept that your intentions are pure, but what of the logistics? I trust you have a plan as to who exactly will be providing─and paying for─this fleet of yours.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_020: Yes, Commander. We're goin' to petition the Maelstrom for the flagship, and the rest from, er...the Black Sails.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: O-Of course. One is wont to forget that those buccaneering souls remain bound to serve the Maelstrom in times of necessity. Lady Ayoyo would have us parley with the three great pirate captains and remind them of their civic duty...it seems.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_022: Aye, that's right. The pirates answered the Admiral's call back when the moon was fallin'. Fought an' died at Carteneau, same as the rest of us.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_023: When they 'ear about our plan to salute all those who fell, an' all those who didn't, I don't doubt they'll answer the call again.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_024: Hm! I wish you all the luck in the world in recruiting those rogues to your cause. You shall need it.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_025: Very well, then. Allow me to arrange the parley. Should you succeed in this feat, you may consider all of my remaining doubts answered.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_026: I bid you remember that you go to speak with pirates. Lawless marauders all. Pray that you do not say aught to offend them, lest we find ourselves with a mutiny on our hands.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_027: I shall have the Maelstrom summon the leaders of the three factions to the Anchor Yard. Pray go there and complete your preparations.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: We are to parley with pirates! Truly, life is but a succession of unexpected events.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_REYNER_000_029: The Rising is a time of remembrance. A time for us all to reflect on what we lost, and what we gained, when Dalumud fell. It gladdens me that my young officers should not forget the pirates' sacrifice.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_030: Cheers for stickin' with me, . I 'ope I can count on yer support in the next set o' negotiations an' all.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Of course, my lady. Alas, I fear the captains─those far-famed scourges of the seas─will prove rather less biddable partners than Commodore Reyner did.
While Rhoswen of the Sanguine Sirens may be swayed by emotion, Carvallain of the Kraken's Arms is of a much more mercenary mind. The Executioners, meanwhile, value honor and glory above all else.
If there is aught that unites them, it is a zealous spirit. Let us argue with passion, that we might inflame theirs.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_034: If it's passion ye're after, I've got that in bleedin' bucketloads!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_100_034: But I might need you two to jump in again, 'case me tongue decides to tie itself in an 'alf 'itch. Just say the first thing that comes into yer 'eads, an' I'll pick up after.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_035: Come on then, dearies, let's 'ead on over to the Anchor Yard an' get this parley started!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_040: Thanks fer comin'. The reason we asked ye here is─
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_041: Aye, the Maelstrom's summons laid it out fer us loud an' clear. Ye want us to 'elp ye with the Risin' fireworks.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_042: An' the answer's no! When my Sirens fire a broadside, it's to send our enemies to the bottom o' the briny, not to paint pretty pictures in the sky for drylanders to gawp at. We've better things to be doin' with our time.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_043: 'Tis a rare occurrence, to be sure, but I find that my opinion aligns with Rhoswen's. Our time is precious, as I am sure is yours. Let us hasten to draw these discussions to a close.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_045: I shall put it bluntly. I see no profit in this endeavor for myself and my men. So unless there is anything else...?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_A50_000_002: No profit? How sad that the great Carvallain should lose his nose for coin.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_A50_000_003: You would put the Admiral and the Yellowjackets in your debt.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_A50_000_004: Why, it is the perfect opportunity: to forge a deeper bond with Rhoswen.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_046: I did not come here to be insulted. If you know of a method by which the Krakens might stand to gain from this that I do not, then state it, or else hold your tongue. Or better yet, allow me to hold it for you.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_047: A debt of gratitude, perhaps, for providing the men and material for this pageantry entirely at our own expense. I saw no mention of the Krakens being compensated for our efforts in a material sense...or am I mistaken?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_048: If you should require my men and I to shackle ourselves to the Sirens, we should require even greater recompense.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The sheer scale of the spectacle we propose would no doubt draw all the lords and ladies of the realm to gather in the city. Personages of high renown, and deep pockets.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_050: Aye, an' if they saw you lot workin' 'and in 'and with the Maelstrom, it'd do wonders fer yer public image. Folks who normally wouldn't touch a pirate with a bargepole'd be queuein' up to do business with ye!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_051: I do believe you have a point, poorly phrased though it might be. To win legitimate business, one must project the image of a legitimate businessman.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_052: Sod yer image! An' sod anyone who's too lily-livered to trade with us! They can stick their bargepoles up their backsides! What's in it for the Sirens?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_A51_000_002: If you won't consider them customers, consider them quarry!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_A51_000_003: Don't you want to bring joy to the masses?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_A51_000_004: Carvallain's in. Don't you want to be...together?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_053: Hah! You do realize our days o' pillagin' every ship we see are long gone? Quarry my arse.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_054: Look, I enjoy the fireworks as much as anyone, I just don't see why it's got to be us what puts 'em on. We're pirates, not...vaudy-villains!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_056: Wh-What're ye tryin' to imply? I'd rather cut me arse off with a rusty cutlass than 'ave to spend another minute in that preenin' pissant's company! Me an' my girls are proper pirates!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_057: The Sanguine Sirens ain't all about the piratin' life, though, are ye? Ye run almshouses for the sick an' injured, an' those with child. Keep 'emselves busy with odd jobs, such as come their way.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_058: Them's yer 'unters, an' the folk who're drawn to the city to see the grand display, yer quarry.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_059: Ahhh, I see where yer goin' with this. Get the girls to set up stalls sellin' food an' grog an' the like, an' they'd make a killin'─providin' they 'ad all the right permits from the Yellowjackets. Ye're a shrewd one, you!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_060: Maybe I could lend 'em an 'and meself. They do say the best way to a man's heart is through his stoma─ <cough cough cough>
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: What of the Executioners? There is no dishonor in linking arms with Admiral Merlwyb and the Maelstrom, surely?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_HASTHWAB_000_062: You. Yellowjacket. I want ye to tell me one thing, and tell it true.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_HASTHWAB_000_063: This is Limsa Lominsa─the greatest port in all the realm. Ye could find this fleet o' yers without our 'elp, yet you've come 'ere beggin' fer it. Why?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_064: Because... Because I reckon you're the ones who need the Risin' most.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_065: The Black Sails only came together 'cause o' Carteneau. Ye could've upped anchor and sailed off into the sunset, but no─ye fought like demons on those cursed flats. Made 'eroes o' yerselves, and martyrs...
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_066: The way I see it, 's only right that those that lost the most, when they stood to gain the least, should be the ones to fire the salute to the departed.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_067: An' a salute to the departin', too. The Calamity changed the lives o' you pirates more'n anyone. If anyone should be celebratin' new beginnin's, it's those whose new beginnin's already begun!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_HASTHWAB_000_068: Heh heh... Ha ha ha! So it's all fer our own good, is it?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_HASTHWAB_000_069: I'm 'eadin' back to the Astalicia. Send word when ye've 'ammered out the details o' this display o' yers. We'll see what we can do.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_070: Can't rightly say no to you now, can I? We lost a lot o' good people back in Carteneau. Let's send 'em all off with a bloody great bang!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_071: I will join you, on one condition: that in your reminiscence of trauma past, you do not make a shameful spectacle of yourself. Pray do not force me to restrain you...again.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_RHOSWEN_000_072: I-I never forced ye to do nothin'! Ye'll keep yer 'ands off me if ye want to keep 'em, ye randy bastard!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_CARVALLAIN_000_073: Quite the fragile flower, isn't she? Well, then, I bid you adieu. My ships will not ready themselves.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: My hearty congratulations to both of you. It was my honor to play a supporting part, but it was your passion for the Rising that swayed them.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_075: Aaand...breathe! Gods, I was so nervous I could 'ardly speak! Thanks so much fer chippin' in when ye did.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_076: Could've never've got 'em on our side without ye. Right, then─time to put the finishin' touches to this plan o' mine! It's goin' to be wonderful, I just know it!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_AYOYO_000_077: Oh, an' about yer reward─I've given it to the minstrel. Ye can grab it from 'im. To new beginnin's, , an' may the Navigator's breath ever fill yer sails!
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: You did a great service, my friend, both for Lady Ayoyo and for all those who love the Rising─myself included. For that, I shall be ever grateful.
I expect it shall be still some hours before preparations for the grand finale are complete. Mayhap we could wait together?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_Q52_000_082: Wait for the firework display to begin?
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: While we wait, would you care to hear a verse that has lately come to me? It is a song of celebration─of encouragement, for all those who sail for unknown shores. Pray, lend me your ears...
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_60: (-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
'Tis a pleasure to meet you again. As I have in the past, I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
The road we have walked has been long and winding, full of perils and pitfalls, but we have enjoyed every step in your company. We hope that you feel the same about this last, great leap.
With every adventure we undertake, the longer the legacy we leave behind us. Yet a lengthy history need not mean a foreshortened future. Many adventures yet await.
We shall continue to chart a course into the great unknown─one that takes in all the diverse wonders this wide world has to offer─that your legacy might grow ever greater.

To be certain, it would be a less trying task to sleepwalk ever onward down the same, well-furrowed path. Yet to venture down paths untrodden, believing in the bright and glorious future that lies beyond them, is by far the more rewarding.
This is the gift that we wish to deliver unto you: the gift of adventure.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: And we pray, with all our hearts, that you will continue to walk with us.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_61: We thank you for joining us on this journey, heretofore and hereafter.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
One cannot know what fills the hearts and minds of those who look to the sky this Rising night. Perhaps you and I will see very different images in those explosions of light and color.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_61: But one thing I know for certain─that right here, right now, we look to the same sky.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: And though the paths that lay ahead of us may lead in very different directions, sometime, someplace, they shall cross again.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: 'Tis almost time for the display to begin. The consummation not only of our labors, but of the thoughts and prayers of the people of this fair city. A salute for the departed, and for those who set sail into unknown waters.
Many adventures yet await you, my friend. May the Navigator's breath ever fill your sails.

From eastern sea to eastern sky, the sacred sun ascends,
And voices stir: of wind, of waves, of ropes, of sails, of friends,♪
Who like the golden light of dawn that streams across the sea,
Set sunlit sail for foreign lands, may fortune follow thee.♪

Her journey done, so sinks the sun below the western waves,
And mem'ries stir: of friends of yore, asleep in wat'ry graves.♪
Let not our voices raised in song disturb your endless sleep,
But join us in our chorus and you dream among the deep.♪
An excerpt from an ancient mariners' song. A prayer for the safe return of those who sail o'er the far horizon, and for the peace of those who sleep beneath those same, eternal waves.

It concludes with a wish: that the voices of those whose spirits are stirred in anticipation of new adventure reach the ears of those whose adventures ended too soon, that they might be united as one. A fitting sentiment for the Rising, methinks.

And so I offer you my own, heartfelt wish: that even should your adventures carry you beyond the far-flung horizon of this wide world, we should meet once more in a twelvemonth's time, and look up to the same sky...together.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SYSTEM_000_800: You have unlocked the toy chest. Open the toy chest found in any inn room to play mini-games.
TEXT_FESANX002_05016_SYSTEM_000_801: Additionally, certain notable personages have been seen to frequent the Anchor Yard this Rising. Do the same, and you may be greeted with an unexpected encounter.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Do my eyes deceive me, or do I spy a familiar face who looks like  could do with some proper summer recreation? That's right─the sun's rays are out in full force, and so is our beloved Moonfire Faire!
Do my eyes deceive me, or do I spy a  who looks like  could do with some proper summer recreation? That's right─the sun's rays are out in full force, and so is our beloved Moonfire Faire!

These days, the event doubles as free promotion for the Adventurers' Guild, you know. The brave and the bold show off their heroics, and afterwards, the faire guests flock to the Guild in droves to hire them.
But the real star of the show is the acclaimed Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, bringing in hundreds upon hundreds of new challengers!
At any rate, we could really use more help out there, so if perchance I've piqued your interest, I suggest you ship out to Costa del Sol and speak to our chief chaperone Haermaga!
The Moonfire Faire is ever short of hands, so if yours happen to be idle at the moment, we'd love to have you in Costa del Sol!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_010: ! Now there's a sight for sore eyes. Did Mayaru Moyaru send you out here to lend a hand?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_011: Welcome one and all to the Moonfire Faire! You've got more of an adventurer's look about you, but... Well, we should be glad of the help regardless.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_012: This year, the event is shaping up to be a thrill for visitors and staff alike! Allow me to give you a brief outline of what we have planned.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_013: In case the screaming and splashing hadn't given it away, we've brought back the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course with all of its explosive challenges intact!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_014: And if the summer sun gets to be too much, grant yourself a refreshing reprieve by enjoying an icy treat or playing with the polar bears!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_015: Even better, this year we've added a little Far Eastern flair with these hand fans. They're called “uchiwa,” and they drive away evil spirits, or so I'm told.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_016: To ensure their authenticity, we hired an expert in the art of the festival─a little Namazu fellow─to craft us a hundred crates of them! And what color could be more fitting for Moonfire than bright, blazing red?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_017: To ensure their authenticity, we hired an expert in the art of the festival to craft us a hundred crates of them! And what color could be more fitting for Moonfire than bright, blazing red?
