TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_018: Seeing as the origins of the event can be traced back to the Bombard hunts of years past, I say uchiwa are a perfect fit for the spirit of the occasion─and judging from the sizable crowds, I'm far from the only one!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_019: The downside, of course, is that we presently find ourselves quite ill-equipped to manage a turnout of this magnitude. Personally, I'd like to bolster our security cadre if I can.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_020: As it stands, none of us would be able to leave our posts in the event of a serious emergency. So, given the fortuitous timing of your arrival, could I ask you to─
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_023: Did she say monster!? Damn it all! The people are starting to panic!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_024: Please, , you've got to help us. I'll stay here and try to keep the crowd calm─you head north and find that woman!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_030: That scream sounded like it came from somewhere north of here. If there is a monster, I need you to handle it!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MANA05182_000_031: Phew... Nothing gets me heated quite like the summer sun!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_WOMANA05182_000_040: The monster was just here, I swear it! It was leering at me from behind that rock, making these off-kilter little motions, and then it ran off to the east!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_WOMANA05182_000_041: I thought for certain it would come over here and...oogh, I feel faint! I need to go lie down...
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MANA05182_000_050: Damn... I didn't stand a chance against that thing!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MANA05182_000_051: You should have seen it! I was minding my own business out here, practicing my steps, when suddenly that thing showed up out of nowhere to challenge me to a dance-off! Then, after it utterly trounced me, it raced off again!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MANA05182_000_052: Would that I could tell you where, or even which direction. Although, come to think of it, I believe I saw something fall from its body.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MANA05182_000_053: Well, it doesn't much matter to me anymore. I can hear summer's call, and it must be heeded! To the ocean with me!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MANA05182_000_054: Whatever fell off the thing, you'll find it lying over there, if you think it will help your search.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_060: Glad as ever to see you again, ! Haermaga told us you might be in need of urgent assistance, so here we are!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_061: You there! Might you be the adventurer Haermaga consigned to the security detail? Worry not─the chaperones are here to help!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_062: We've heard reports of a green monster running amok. Have you learned aught in the way of a clue?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_064: It dropped something, did it? Looks to be a needle, by my reckoning.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_A1_000_001: It's obvious we're dealing with a cactuar.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_A1_000_002: It's obvious we're dealing with an inebriated weaver.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_100_064: Surely that woman would not have mistaken a drunkard for a monster. Given that it's green in color and possessed of needles, that would suggest some type of cactuar.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_065: Cactuars in La Noscea of all places? Surely they would struggle to survive so far removed from their native habitat of Thanalan...
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_066: (-???-)I am so, so sorry about this!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_067: M-Madam Memeja! If I'm not mistaken, was it not Master Gegeruju himself who invited you out to Costa del Sol?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_068: Yes, I traveled all the way from Ul'dah at the summons of my friend Gegeruju. Naturally, I couldn't bear the thought of my dear pets missing out on the fun and festivities, so I brought them along with me.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_069: Not for a moment did I ever think they would act out like this! You have my deepest apologies!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_100_069: They were perfect angels when we stopped in to see Gegeruju. He even gave them treats!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_070: But the moment I stepped away for a drink, they went mad, and poor Gegeruju couldn't rein them in!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_071: By the time I got back, they were gone... I swear to you, this has never happened before... <sob>
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_072: Well, that would certainly explain how a cactuar ended up in La Noscea. Regardless, if your pets pose a danger to the faire-goers, we may have to subdue them by force.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_073: No! Please! I've raised them since they were pups─they'd never hurt a fly! <sob>
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_074: I don't fancy the prospect myself, but what other option is there? Given that the Moonfire Faire would have no venue were it not for Master Gegeruju, I'd obviously prefer if we didn't upset a dear friend of his.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_075: Yes, termination should be a last resort. Let us first attempt to capture them.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_076: A sensible plan. Should things turn violent, it would only frighten the attendees. This calls for a more subtle approach─just the three of us, perhaps?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_077: Indeed. I would see this situation sorted swiftly that we might return to the faire.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_078: If we work quickly, we may manage to find it before it escapes the bounds of Costa del Sol. Thus I propose we split up. , my friend, will you search the west side of the island?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_090: Worry not, my friend─I have this area well in hand. You should take your search westward!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_091: Where could it have gone? You'd think a cavorting cactuar would be hard to miss here in La Noscea...
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_092: They're gone, they're gone, they're gone! My babies are GONE!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_HAERMAGA_000_093: P'obyano told me a cactuar is on the loose. Sorry for the trouble─can I count on you to handle it?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_101: It appears  did. But how are we going to capture it?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_102: I've never seen a cactuar look so dangerous. Is it just me, or is it radiating an aura of pure malice?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_103: I've never seen the poor thing like this, either! Come to think of it, Gegeruju told me it seemed to him as though they were possessed!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_104: In that case, perhaps the aura is an evil spirit. If only we could purify it somehow...
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_A2_000_002: What that thing needs is an exorcism.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_106: Of course! In the Far East, they use uchiwa to ward off evil spirits, right? Maybe our festival fans would work!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_107: In that case, allow me to do the honors!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_109: Yes! Well, that was easy. Shall we head back for drinks?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_110: Erm... Terribly sorry to interject, but I think there's been a misunderstanding.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_111: That's only one of my dear cactuars. I'm still missing the other six!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_MEMEJA_000_112: I do appreciate you finding Cacty, of course, but I'm worried about Cactilo, and Cactina, and Cactistopher, and─
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_POBYANO_000_113: Wait, so when you said “pets”─you brought seven cactuars to La Noscea!?
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_114: It is concerning, then, that we scoured every inch of the island and only found one. It appears we will have to take our search to the mainland.
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_BEAUDEFOIN_000_115: Very well! Let us take up our uchiwa and find these cactuars, that we might ease them of their torment!
TEXT_FESSUX001_05182_SYSTEM_000_120: You have learned the emote Uchiwasshoi!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_001: Oh, I'm glad to have Cacty back, and hale of mind to boot! Those fans are sure to work their magic on the rest of my dearies!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_HAERMAGA_000_002: P'obyano told me more cactuars are on the loose. Sorry for the trouble─can I count on you to handle it?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_BEAUDEFOIN_000_010: I take it you're ready to begin? In that case, let us review our objective.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_BEAUDEFOIN_000_013: First, we must seek out these cactuars. As soon as one is located, placate it with a gust from your uchiwa, then bring it back here. You, my friend, are in charge of searching the southwestern cliffside.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_020: Please, go and find the rest of my dearies! I'll stay here and keep a firm eye on Cacty─you have my word!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_022: Nothing over here. Could you check a little further south?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SYSTEM_000_025: The cactuar is dancing like a plant possessed, but a refreshing “Uchiwasshoi!” ought to do the trick.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SYSTEM_000_030: The cactuar appears to have snapped out of it, whatever “it” may have been.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_SYSTEM_000_031: Eager for your company, it walks right up to you, allowing you to grab it!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_BEAUDEFOIN_100_031: I only pray we managed to find them all.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_110_031: You've all done such a great job bringing my dearies back safe and sound!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_040: Welcome back. I don't suppose you've found any cactuars?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_041: And that brings us to seven. Excellent! We're done!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_042: And now that that's over with, I think I'll grab myself a drink and find a nice vantage point. Preferably somewhere in the shade.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_043: Oh, take me with you! I've been dying for a drink!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_BEAUDEFOIN_000_044: At last, the crisis is well and truly averted. Now I can return my focus to what matters most: ensuring a spectacular time is had by all! Seeing as Haermaga still needs a status report, could I ask you to see to that?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_BEAUDEFOIN_000_050: With those pesky cactuars back under control, it is time I livened things up around here. Would you be so kind as to relay the glad tidings to Haermaga?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_051: A refreshing breeze, a clear view of the cactuars... Yes, I think this area will do nicely.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_052: Hee hee! Oh, what a relief that my pets have returned. Isn't that right, Cactania?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_HAERMAGA_000_060: Welcome back, . It seems you had the cactuar crisis well in hand. You've done your part to keep the peace, and for that, I thank you.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_HAERMAGA_000_061: Now, what's this I hear about a “malicious aura”? Efficacy of the uchiwa aside, I'd rather like to get to the bottom of this, lest we suffer the same problem next year.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_062: I just wanted to report that the pet cactuars are resting safely away from the main festivities. I asked another chaperone to keep an eye on them.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_063: I cannot apologize enough for the trouble I caused.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_GEGERUJU_000_064: Yes, well, I am glad to have this matter settled quietly. My lovely ladies were quite frightened.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_GEGERUJU_000_065: That being said, speaking as one who has seen his share of dancers, your pets have star potential, my dear Memeja.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_066: Truly!? Perhaps I should have them formally trained!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_069: You're not seriously going to encourage that behavior, are you!? Lest you forget, it was pure coincidence that we found a peaceable solution through the use of our uchiwa. Were something like this to happen again, that luck may not hold!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_070: Surely you don't mean─I-I've learned my lesson, I swear it! As soon as we're home, I'll ensure they're trained to stay at my side at all times!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_071: That's all I ask. Incidentally, did you notice anything that might have served as the catalyst to their cavorting?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_072: No, I'm afraid not. I was away at the time, you see.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_GEGERUJU_000_073: I thought it quite strange myself. One moment they were downing their wine like sailors, and the next, it was as though they were possessed by some manner of wicked spirit!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_GEGERUJU_000_075: And what a fine vintage it was! I was delighted to be in like-minded company. Oh, the great conversation we could have had, if only they could speak...
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_076: Memeja, I can't believe I'm asking this, but is wine safe for cactuars?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_MEMEJA_000_077: How should I know? I've only ever given them the finest spring water from the mountains of Coerthas, myself!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_A1_000_001: It seems we have our culprit.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_GEGERUJU_000_078: Pah! They barely had a cupful each. And besides, it's not like I poured the stuff down their throats, did I?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_GEGERUJU_000_079: Alright, look─perhaps sharing a bottle wasn't the best of ideas, but how was I to know they couldn't hold their drink!?
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_HAERMAGA_000_080: Personally, I'm just glad the mystery's been put to rest. And seeing as Memeja's learned her lesson, I daresay we won't be seeing a repeat of this incident.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_POBYANO_000_081: Well, just in case someone else gives wine to some other cactuars, I'll be sure to let the chaperone team know to reach for an uchiwa rather than a weapon.
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_HAERMAGA_000_082: That would be much appreciated, P'obyano. Now, let us return to the festival. The Adventurers' Guild won't promote itself, you know!
TEXT_FESSUX002_05183_HAERMAGA_000_083: As for you, ─on behalf of the entire chaperone team, I thank you. Enjoy the remainder of the event, and don't be a stranger, alright?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_000: Heh heh... It's been more than a few moons since last we met, friend. As it so happens, I have a proposition suited to your talents. Are you prepared to throw caution to the wind and consort with fiends most foul once again?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_001: Heh heh... An adventurer, by the looks of you. Hmm... As it so happens, I have a proposition suited to a  of your talents. Are you prepared to throw caution to the wind and consort with fiends most foul?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_010: Of course you are. But before we get to the heart of the matter, let us reflect upon the history of All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_011: On this night do fell fiends emerge to cavort and careen, unconcerned with the judgments of those on high. For the halls of the saints' heavenly abode ring with merriment as the wine flows freely─and no one can be bothered to look down.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_012: Thus did gods-fearing folk greet this particular sunset with trepidation, daring not to venture from their homes. No longer. Nay, for adventurers came and drove out the voidsent, restoring safety to the city's streets and marking the occasion as one of jubilation.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_013: That's all well and good, but what of the poor forsaken fiends? Are they, too, not deserving of revelry? My wish is to see All Saints' Wake reborn as a celebration for all, be they ghost, ghoul, Gridanian, or otherwise!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_014: And how do I propose to accomplish this feat? Binding obligations, friend. I've convinced the more sinister sorts to enter into contracts which forbid them from preying on mortals. In exchange, they are permitted to partake in the festivities. But there's one troubled soul who still seems incapable of getting into the “spirit” of things.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_015: Perhaps you'd be willing to give them a helping hand? Nothing too devilishly difficult, I promise.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_016: Before you get started, you'll want to get a grasp of the particulars by speaking with Papa Gruff. He ought to be performing one of his shows by the entrance to the Greatloam Growery. Now go─I shall be watching your performance with great interest. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_020: Seek out Papa Gruff near the entrance to the Greatloam Growery. I daresay you'll find him in the midst of one of his performances. And remember: I shall be watching. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Although it pains me so, our humble performance must draw to a close. Let us then end things on a high note! Ladies and gentlemen, I bid you feast your eyes on the fantastic Philcox and his transformation magicks!
(-Disappointed Youth-)...What was all that about? The clownin' and whatnot was a right laugh, but that last bit was bleedin' rubbish! Come on, let's get outta here.
Once more you fail to muster up even an onze of magical prowess! I had the crowd in the palm of my hand─we'd have been the toast of the town if not for your blunder!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_033: (-Belligerent Fiend-)There you go again, shrieking the same old tune. I've had it up to my eyeball with this farce! Just because you know a few cheap tricks doesn't give you the right to treat me like that!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_100_033: (-Belligerent Fiend-)I can't stand the sight of you─let alone the thought of taking to the stage with you again! Good riddance!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Well, well. Fate has conspired for us to cross paths once again. Out with it, then. I know you're not here to swap pleasantries.
Hmm. You don't belong to my usual demographic... If you're not here to see one of my shows, then why are you here?
A foul fiend failing to get into the spirit of All Saints' Wake? I'd wager you speak of Philcox, the fellow who stormed off in a huff.

Like most of our ilk, Philcox and I have an insatiable appetite for aether. But unlike your garden-variety voidsent who hunt hapless mortals like beasts, we prefer to sate our hunger with their enthusiastic approval.
I tell you, there's no aether as delectable as you'll find in food gifted in genuine appreciation! Which set me to thinking: perhaps preying on mortals was an old-fashioned and misguided approach.
Thus did I commit to giving folk the sort of frights that dazzle and delight─winning hearts and minds, and in the process no small number of aether-laden delicacies.
And what better occasion for such terrifying amusements as All Saints' Wake? The method is catching, too; many voidsent now seek aether in this manner. Philcox is one such reformed individual.
When I first laid eyes upon him, I sensed promise. But get him in front of a crowd and you're lucky to get a smattering of half-hearted applause, let alone a few measly crumbs.
You'd be better off hearing it from the ahriman's mouth, though. He can't have gotten far.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_060: Heh heh... Pray see if you can't do something for poor Philcox.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_070: That sniveling whelp of an imp! Magicks this, magicks that... The sheer, unbridled cheek of it!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SYSTEM_000_071: Philcox is practically frothing at the mouth─so incensed is he by his treatment at the hands of Papa Gruff. You must soothe him before attempting to start a conversation.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_080: Can't he see the effort I put in day in, day out!? Yet still he cracks the whip!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_SYSTEM_000_081: Philcox is practically frothing at the mouth─so incensed is he by his treatment at the hands of Papa Gruff. You must soothe him before attempting to start a conversation.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_090: Apologies... I had taken leave of my senses. Your timely intervention is much appreciated.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_091: Wait. By the look of you, I'd say you're an adventurer. Let me guess. That pumpkin-headed lady sent you to check up on me, did she?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_092: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to tell you my tale... Try as I might, I just can't get the hang of transformation magicks, and without the means to delight the crowds, we're starved for appreciation.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_093: I'm an ahriman. Paralyzing prey with this big eye of mine? Not a problem. Turning them to stone with a petrifying glare? A trifling task. Hells, I can even smell despair and all manner of negative emotions in the people around me!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_094: Obviously, paralysis and petrification won't win over an audience. And my metaphorical nose for despair isn't going to put aether on the table either...
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_095: I ought to just tell that pumpkin-headed lady I'm not cut out for this business. If you're here at her behest, you'd better come too.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_100: ...That about sums it up. I gave it my all and have naught to show for it. Which is to say, I've come to the conclusion that I will never be an entertainer.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_110: Heh heh... I gather you had a hand in Philcox's decision to lay bare his thoughts and feelings?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_111: Not that it did any good. I'm still stuck at square one─underappreciated and underfed.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_112: Heh heh heh... Such a curious child. Are you truly so blind to your own potential?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_113: No doubt you have an inkling as to what I speak of. Pray share your wisdom with Philcox.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_CHOICE1A1_101_130: You can smell dark emotions. Use your gift to help those in need.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_CHOICE1A2_102_130: Stamp out any negativity you sense within the commonfolk!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_131: Hmm. Well, you'd be hard-pressed to find a voidsent who'd suggest that. I don't see how helping others helps me... But then again, I know little of mortal ways, so perhaps I should heed your advice.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_132: Erm, I suppose I could give that a go... But do you really think that if I rid people of their woes, they'll repay the favor? I'm unfamiliar with mortal customs, but if you say so...
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_140: Ah, wait! I see the logic in it now. What better way to make use of my talents and knock that pompous Papa Gruff right off his pedestal!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_100_140: No, no, no... I'm getting ahead of myself. I've no idea where to start.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_141: Heh heh heh... Perhaps I can lend a hand with a little...sleight of hand. Hold still.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_142: Not only is that getup guaranteed to turn heads, each and every thread is imbued with a potent magick to aid in your newfound purpose.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_143: Ohoh! You know, I think I can feel it. Maybe this isn't going to be so tough after all!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: There you are... Hmm. You know, I had thought to apologize for my harsh words earlier, since our act was my initiative and therefore our success─or lack thereof─was ultimately my responsibility. But I sense that you've been scheming.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_145: It pleases me to inform you, Papa Gruff, that I've found a way to win over mortals on my own terms!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: I find that hard to believe... But since you seem so confident, why don't we have ourselves a contest?

Whoever garners the most affection─and thereby the largest share of aether-rich victuals─wins. And to the victor go the spoils─of subservience! The loser will be bound to obey their every whim. How does that sound?
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_148: You're on! I hope you're ready to bow and scrape!
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Hmph. That mortal epithet about one's bark being worse than one's bite comes to mind... Prepare yourself, Philcox.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PHILCOX_000_150: I know I've got this marvelous magick outfit, but I'm still not entirely convinced I have what it takes to beat Papa Gruff on my own. Come with me! Just until I get the hang of things─that's all I ask.
TEXT_FESHLX001_05184_PUMPKIN_000_151: Very well. I shall leave Philcox in your capable hands. Heh heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_010: How about we try and find a troubled soul in need of aid? Ah, but let's get out of here first.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_020: Right. Time to look for folk harboring negative feelings. Give me a moment.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_021: I don't know if it has anything to do with that pumpkin-headed lady's enchantment, but my powers feel more potent than ever─I've already found someone! And whoever they are, they're awfully flustered.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_021: They're to the northeast, I think...though I'm not sure where exactly. The roads here can be confusing.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_022: Truth be told, this is my first time in the city. I've got a decent sense of direction, but I've yet to grasp the lie of the land. Could I trouble you to lead the way?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_023: Our flustered target is northeast of here. I'll be right behind you!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_024: Philcox is now accompanying you. Keep him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_025: You can leave Philcox behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with him and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_026: If you wish to have Philcox join you again, return and speak with him at the original location.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_027: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_028: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to initiate these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_031: Say, did I tell you that “Philcox” is just an alias? The pumpkin-headed lady suggested I use it to better engage with you mortals. My real name is actually...ah, what does it matter? It's not like we'll see each other again when this is over and done with.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_034: Ah, such glee. They mentioned a clown─I'd wager they've just had the, err...privilege of seeing one of Papa Gruff's performances.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_035: Listen, I'll be the first to admit that he's an expert illusionist, and you've only got to look at folk like these ladies to see that he knows how to work a crowd.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_036: But I won't be upstaged! I'll prove there's more than one way to win over an audience─by following your timely advice, that is!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_037: Given the delight written on their faces, our opponent must have earned himself some sustenance. Which means we've no time to lose! Onward!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_CHOICE2Q1_100_036: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Philcox?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_036: Something come up? Very well. I'll be waiting at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. Make sure you hurry back.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_037: You're back! Well then, lead the way once again!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PANICKED05185_000_0: Oh gods, where has she gotten to!?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_041: Ah, this must be the fellow my senses were leading me to. Shall we find out what ails him?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_042: You, there. What's gotten you so worked up?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PANICKED05185_000_0: Oh, forgive me! There was this poor little girl who'd been separated from her mother. I was helping her to look, but she suddenly disappeared!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PANICKED05185_100_0: I can't simply abandon her─but then again, I have an urgent personal matter to attend to, and... <sigh> I don't know what to do!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_044: In that case, why don't I and my associate look for the girl? Then you can see to your affairs without worry.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PANICKED05185_000_0: Thank you, thank you! She's a young lass dressed in blue! I hope you're able to find her forthwith!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_046: Hmm... He certainly was appreciative, yet here I am, empty-handed. Ah, forget the food, we have a lost child to find!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_047: I'm detecting a despairing presence to the east of here. Odds are it's the girl. Which means I have need of your navigational nous once again. After you!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_049: You must be accompanied by Philcox and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_050: Philcox has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: I should've known you'd turn up sooner or later.
I thought this would be a fine opportunity to accrue some appreciation, but the poor girl is beside herself─she keeps calling out for her “Mama”... Might I enlist your help?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_061: This must be the lost lass we've been looking for. If we want to earn her thanks, we'll need to reunite her with her mother, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_062: Which means we now have a lady to locate... Any suggestions?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_CHOICE2A2_101_060: Use your senses to search for someone feeling anxious.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_CHOICE2A2_102_060: Why don't you try coming up with an idea yourself?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_061: Ah. You're saying that the mother will be worried about her daughter having gone missing? Brilliant! This is exactly why I had you accompany me! Right then...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_062: I know I can't keep relying on you, but just thinking about having to think for myself is making me anxious...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_150_062: Ah, that's it: anxiety! That's how one would feel having misplaced their offspring, right? Then that's the emotion I need to find...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_063: Come, say something! Your silence is making me anxious...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_100_063: Ah, anxiety! I imagine that's how one would feel having lost their daughter! Hmm, let's see...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_070: Found her! I don't know which is the bigger boon, having you by my side, or this fancy finery.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_071: I think I've learned my way around the city, more or less. I'll handle this next part on my own. Wait here, I'll be back with the girl's mother in no time!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_DAUGTER05185_000_07: (-Formerly Distressed Damsel-)Thanks for finding Mama, mister!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_075: Do you believe me now, Papa Gruff!? Sweet, sweet appreciation, and all courtesy of my special talent!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: I can't help but notice they didn't offer you anything edible by way of thanks... For my part, I've already been rewarded with a tasty morsel.

That said, the gift of food is far from guaranteed... Indeed, perseverance is key. Which is why I find myself performing show after show. I suggest you approach this contest with the same tenacity, Philcox.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_078: I'm afraid he's right. Constant effort is key. Luckily, I sensed another troubled soul while I was tracking down the girl's mother. I'd better see what I can do to help.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_079: You know, I think I'm ready to go it alone now. Why don't you let our pumpkin-headed benefactor know? I'll come and find you when I'm done.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_0: Well, I'm afraid my next performance calls. Until we meet again, adventurer.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_082: You must be accompanied by Philcox and have him at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_083: Philcox has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_090: Heh heh heh... The adventurer returns, and at the precise moment I predicted. I do hope keeping Philcox company wasn't too taxing. What of our fiend and his endeavors?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_100: You have my thanks, truly. Ah, speak of the devils. Here they come.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Dear oh dear, that turned out to be a damn sight harder than I'd anticipated. And all I have to show for my travails is a single cookie. To think the first gift I'd receive would prove to be the last...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_102: Curses! I didn't receive so much as a crumb! I suppose this means you win... <sigh> Very well, I am yours to command, Papa Gruff.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_103: Heh heh... You admit defeat far too readily, Philcox.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_DAUGTER05185_000_10: (-Formerly Distressed Damsel-)Hooray! We found you! I wanted to thank you properly for helping me and Mama. I brought you a pumpkin cookie!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_DAUGTER05185_100_10: (-Formerly Distressed Damsel-)Hehe, I'm glad you like it! Farewell!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: That makes it one apiece. A draw, then... Still, Philcox─while you had some assistance along the way, you've nevertheless done yourself proud.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_107: To think I'd live to see the day Papa Gruff sings my praises. Awfully kind of you to finally admit that I might have worth!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: Hmph. Is that all you desire? My begrudging acceptance? Have you forgotten your reasons for joining in the festivities in the first place?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_109: O-Of course I haven't! The good people of Gridania are still in need of my help! And where there are commonfolk in need, there are cookies to be freed...and err, given to me.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PHILCOX_000_110: Adventurer, I had better get going. But before I do, let me say this. I might have found a way to make the most of my talents, but I wouldn't have been able to do so without you and the pumpkin-headed lady. I'm sure we'll run into each other again one of these days. Till then!
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PIERROTFATHER_000_1: The promise I sensed in Philcox when he and I first met wasn't illusory after all. I should take my leave, too. 'Twould be remiss of me to allow him to garner all the glory...to say nothing of the cookies.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_112: Heh heh... I'd say those two fiends ended up having themselves a frightfully fun-filled All Saints' Wake. Wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_113: And for your part in this, a fitting reward. I present to you a set of finery, as worn by Gridania's most emotionally-perceptive ahriman.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_114: Ah... Perhaps you wonder if your outfit is endowed with the same enchantment? You needn't worry. There never was an enchantment.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_115: Heh heh heh... That little charade was my way of giving Philcox the confidence he so sorely lacked. Although, I daresay such a measure was unnecessary, given he had you to cheer him on.
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_100_115: Ah, before I forget, you are hereby cordially invited to my humble abode for a get together of sorts. Do drop by─I assure you it will be frightfully entertaining...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_PUMPKIN_000_116: Anyway, your help is much appreciated. At this rate, my vision of an All Saints' Wake for mortals and voidsent alike might not be such a distant prospect. Though I do hope that these shenanigans haven't dulled your enthusiasm for this most occult of occasions...
TEXT_FESHLX002_05185_SYSTEM_000_117: You now have access to Sneaky Hollow. Speak with the unusual usher at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to be escorted to the costume party.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKEMISSIONARY_000: My, my, you look ready for all manner of arduous journeys and feats of valor. An adventurer, perchance?
Pray forgive my idle speculation. I am known as the hebi bugyo, and along with my fellow delegates have come to these shores that we might share our Heavensturn custom with the fine folk of Eorzea.

Both our peoples mark the turning of one year to the next, but how we do so differs in a few key respects. In Eorzean tradition, the Twelve choose one of their number to guide the realm throughout the coming year. In the Far East, however, custom dictates we honor one of the twelve noble beasts.

This year's totem is none other than the hebi─although the term “snake” might be more familiar to Eorzean ears. Where I hail from, this oft-reviled creature represents longevity and regeneration─owing to the miraculous manner in which the hebi emerges anew, time and time again, after shedding its skin.
That many and more may benefit from the noble beast's blessings, my fellow delegates and I have devised what we hope will be an entertaining little event...
I present to you the inaugural “Slithery Trivia Trial”!
Participants will wend their way snakelike through the city streets, and answer the questions posed by the trivia taskmasters they encounter.
I have bid my sisters─the three hebi yoriki─await their charges at certain locations throughout Limsa Lominsa.
As for you, adventurer, I urge you to seek them out and put your knowledge of Far Eastern customs to the test. And rest assured that an auspicious prize is yours for the taking should you succeed.
Consider it a means of stocking up on good fortune before your next foray out into the world. How about it? Have I piqued your interest?

This little event of ours is first and foremost about promoting insight and understanding. To that end, should you find yourself stumped during the quiz, simply say so, and my sisters will provide a helpful hint.
If it is a perfect score you seek, you may also wish to speak with the hebi doshin and acquire the knowledge you need.
The first quizmaster you shall face is the eldest of my younger sisters, the blue hebi yoriki. You'll find her a short distance north of here. Pray shed your misgivings and venture forth!
The blue hebi yoriki is waiting just north of here. What question lies in store for you? There's only one way to find out!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERA_000_02: The bracing ocean air, the hustle and the bustle─what a marvelous place! I do hope my dear sisters and I get a chance to do some sightseeing!
Oh, I keep getting caught up in the charms of this fair city! I have a question for you, Slithery Trivia Trial contender! Ahem, err...let me see.
Ready!? As you are no doubt aware, the snake is considered a most auspicious creature in my native Hingashi, but what blessing can one hope to receive from the humble hebi?
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_A1_000_003: I could do with some help.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_A1_000_004: I'll get back to you later with my answer.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERA_000_02: Wonderful, simply wonderful! Snakes are indeed said to be bringers of fortune!

Well, I can certainly see why you'd associate snakes with physical well-being. After all, some people partake of heady concoctions bottled with vipers and such to keep them virile and strong! But alas, unlike their spirit-steeped brethren, the snakes we're speaking of are said to bestow “fair fortune”!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERA_000_03: I'm afraid that's not quite right. Don't get me wrong, I'd be more than grateful for a little luck in matters of the heart... But I digress. The correct answer was “fair fortune”!
Very well, I shall give you a hint! In the Far East, snakes are said to be emissaries of the god of luck. Pray think on that before offering your answer!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERA_100_03: Understood! I shall be waiting right here. Feel free to present yourself again once inspiration strikes!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERA_000_03: By the way, there exists one scalekin in particular known to lavish extra helpings of luck on those who encounter it: the tsuchinoko! Where other serpents are sleek and slender, the tsuchinoko is broad and bulbous. Alas, few have ever laid eyes upon its decidedly un-snakelike form.
Anyhow, that brings my section of the quiz to an end! You'll find my younger sister, the yellow hebi yoriki, by the Drowning Wench. Pay her a visit for the next round of the Slithery Trivia Trial!
The next quizmaster is my sister, the yellow hebi yoriki! You should be able to find her by the tavern─the Drowning Wench. Pray speak with her!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERB_000_04: By the kami, this city is absolutely packed with people. 'Tis enough to send you dizzy...
Ah, give me a moment, contender.
You're aware that the snake is a symbol of luck, yes? Well, some snakes are luckier than others, and they happen to have one thing in common: their color. Any guesses as to what that might be?
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_Q2_000_000: Which color of snake is the luckiest of them all?
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_A2_000_003: I haven't the foggiest. How about a hint?
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERB_000_04: 'Tis true that in the Far East we associate red with auspicious occasions and the like. Not so for serpents, I'm afraid. The right answer was “white.”
Very good. “White” is the correct answer.

A glittering gold snake? Sounds like the kind of creature that'd do wonders for your finances. But in all seriousness, I don't think I've ever heard of anyone spotting a snake like that... “White” was the answer I was looking for.
Fine, I'll take pity on you. Apparently, there are a pair of snakes this very same color on the Gridanian flag.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERB_100_04: If you must... You know where to find me.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERB_000_04: White snakes are rare, mystical creatures─hence the association with good fortune...

But when it comes to rarity and mystique, there's one snake that deserves special mention: the elusive Great White Tsuchinoko. In times past, people would pray to the lucky serpent in the hope of receiving its blessings.
In the past hundred years or so, though, there hasn't been a single recorded sighting of the creature. Its existence is all but a fable these days.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERB_000_05: Anyway, you have just one question left. Head to the Bismarck to see my little sister, the red hebi yoriki.
The red hebi yoriki─the youngest of we four sisters, if you must know─is by the Bismarck. Don't keep her waiting too long...
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_000_05: Ah, what heavenly smells! I must remember to visit the Bismarck and pick up a few tasty treats for my sisters.
There you are, contender! I've been waiting for you! I hope you're ready for the last question!

I assume you heard all about how we Far Easterners used to revere the Great White Tsuchinoko, yes? I'm guessing my sister also told you how there's been nary a sighting for over a century now. A crying shame, I tell you!
Still, the people of Hingashi, being the resourceful people they are, found a suitable surrogate to pay respects to during Heavensturn... Any ideas as to what they might've turned to?
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_Q3_000_000: What did the people of Hingashi use as a substitute for the Great White Tsuchinoko?
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_A3_000_003: A nudge in the right direction would be much appreciated.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_A3_000_004: On second thought, I'll come back another time.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_000_05: Rice cakes! Precisely! To be honest with you, I'm surprised an Eorzean would even have an inkling... Color me impressed!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_000_06: An admirable attempt, but no, eggs are hardly the right shape. The correct answer is “rice cakes”!

Moogles are those furry white pig-like creatures you have here in Eorzea, yes? You're not far off with the color, but we're not too familiar with the fuzzy little devils in the Far East. No, the correct answer was “rice cakes”!
If you insist! I'll say this: our Heavensturn decorations involve one thing stacked on top of another!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_100_06: Not to worry, I'll be waiting for you right here!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_000_06: When I say “cake,” you're probably thinking of something nice and light, but the rice cakes we decorate our homes with during Heavensturn in Hingashi are rock hard!
We take one pebbly hard rice cake and stack it on top of another. You have to use your imagination a little, but they're supposed to look like the Great White Tsuchinoko itself!
Well, that brings us to the end of the Slithery Trivia Trial! Thanks for taking part.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_000_07: We can't forget your prize now, can we? For your efforts: a gift born of the finest, painstaking Hingashi craftsmanship!
And it'll be all yours in a matter of moments. H-Hold on, I, err...
Blast! I could've sworn we had plenty left...
Under normal circumstances you'd be walking away with an exquisite white tsuchinoko ornament, positively overflowing with good fortune!
But surrounded by all these enticing scents, I completely forgot to restock! My big sister is going to be livid!
Oho!? Seems there was one left after all! Phew...
Sorry about all that! Anyhow, it's all yours!
Oh, and, err...it's impertinent to even ask, I know, but... Could I trouble you to tell my sister─ah, the hebi bugyo, I mean─that I've run out of prizes?
I'd happily fetch more myself, but I ought to stay here just in case another trivia challenger shows up. So, can I count on you?
Much obliged! May the kami guide you!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKESISTERC_000_08: Go and tell my sister─that is to say, the hebi bugyo─that I need to restock!
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SNAKEMISSIONARY_000: Hmm. Am I to understand that my sister allowed prize supplies to run out and asked you to report this fact to me in her stead?
Clearly, my efforts at disciplining her have fallen short of the mark. I must redouble my efforts...
Please accept my sincere apologies... I shall send someone along forthwith to replenish our stocks.
Ah, what have we here. Did you perhaps drop your prize?
B-By the kami!
Our prizes may be exquisitely crafted, but they are mere ornaments. They do not possess the faculty for speech or locomotion, I can assure you.
Which leads me to think...could this be the fabled Great White Tsuchinoko of yore, unseen and unheard of for generations!?
To think I'd live to see the day! What a wonderfully auspicious occasion this is!
But I must say, it is passing strange that the Great White Tsuchinoko should appear in Eorzea, of all places. Perhaps it found its way on board our delegation's vessel before we set sail...
Perhaps you would be willing to take the creature with you on your journey?

Of course, for our delegation, the sacred serpent's coming is an event of great historical importance. Nevertheless, we cannot discount the notion that the Great White Tsuchinoko chose to appear before you in particular, that you might benefit from its blessings.
Besides, it appears quite taken with you...

Before I forget, I should point out that omikuji are available to draw for the rest of the Heavensturn season. It might prove to be a delightful distraction ere matters great and small call you to the road once again.
Not that you need fear drawing a less than encouraging fortune. Nay, with the Great White Tsuchinoko at your side, you are sure to overcome any hardships that come slithering your way.
You have my heartfelt thanks for joining in with this humble endeavor of ours. May the hallowed hebi guide you on the path of fortune till the heavens turn once again.
TEXT_FESNYX101_05186_SYSTEM_000_107: The Far Eastern omikujishi is offering his services for the remainder of the Heavensturn festivities this year. Speak with him to see what fortune has in store for you after your rendezvous with the Great White Tsuchinoko!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_XMXMARKETWARP_000_0: If you are come for the market, I must apologize. We are not ready to receive guests at this time.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_000: Well now, if it isn't ! Happy Starlight, my friend, and what a pleasure it is to see you again. Now, I should like to catch up on your recent doings...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Oh! Greetings, adventurer, and Happy Starlight! I am Amh Garanjy, Starlight celebrant. And you are..., you say? A pleasure to make your acquaintance. If this is your first time attending the festivities, I should like to personally guide you on your way...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_002: But I'm afraid I am rather overwhelmed with preparations at the moment...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_007: You see, this year we are hosting a new attraction in the form of a market called the Starlight Stalls.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_008: To that end, we have secured the kind cooperation of merchants and artisans across Gridania, who will sell unique Starlight-themed wares.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_009: The lights of the stalls are arranged to call to mind the stars above, and we are confident that grown-ups will enjoy the market as much as younglings!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_100_009: Or at least we would be if we can finish setting up the stalls. The work doesn't seem to be progressing, and we're unable to open the market as scheduled...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Say...if you aren't otherwise occupied, might you be willing to assist me? I've a mind to investigate the reason for the delay, and I could use an extra pair of legs on the ground.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_011: Thank you so much! Without further ado, please meet me at the market outside the city. The guide yonder will show you there.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_XMXMARKETWARP_000_0: I understand you are assisting Miss Garanjy. If you would please follow me, I will show you to the market.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_033: As you can see, there are workers in the midst of preparation. Let us each speak to a number of them and learn what troubles they might be experiencing.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_040: How fare you with the preparations? I see, I see...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_FEMALEWORKER05227_1: Have business with the celebrant too, do you? We'll be finished with him in a bit.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_LEATHERWORKER05227_: Y-You're with the celebrants!? Our apologies, we'll be ready soon!
It's just, we're not accustomed to running an open-air stall, much less when it's so cold...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_BAENFAELD_000_042: Lendin' Amh a hand, are ye? Much obliged. This year, most of us celebrants are here helpin' the stall holders set things up.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_BAENFAELD_000_043: That's because it don't do for 'em to close up their actual shops. They're spreadin' themselves thin for our sake, so it's only fair that we give 'em as much support as we can.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_BAENFAELD_000_044: Even so, the work's taken a toll on everyone. We celebrants would do more, but we can't exactly push things along by ourselves.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_FEMALEWORKER05227_0: We're almost done with our preparation─just discussing how to bring in our wares now. But it's so cold and I'm so tired, I just want to curl up and sleep...
Well, we'll be on our way. Need to keep at it if we want to finish up.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_LEATHERWORKER05227_: O-Our apologies for the delay! We'll be ready soon!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_BAENFAELD_000_055: We conceived the Starlight Stalls as a place for both children and grown-ups to enjoy. It certainly wasn't our intent for it to be so hard on stall holders...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_060: You've spoken with some workers? Splendid.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_061: So, what were you able to learn?
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_062: I see... Though everyone is trying their best, having to run their own shops at the same time has left them exhausted, and the cold only compounds matters...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_063: We should do something to revive them and ward off the chill. But what would be the best way...?
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_A1_000_001: Something sweet never fails to perk me up!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_A1_000_002: How about handing out hot drinks?
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_064: Ah, a splendid idea! That is bound to lift everyone's spirits!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SAULINNE_000_067: Hello, Miss Garanjy! Hello,  adventurer! It's been a while, but you remember us, I hope?
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SAULINNE_000_068: Hello, Miss Garanjy! Hello,  adventurer! My name is Saulinne, and my friend here is Tenny.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_TENNY_000_069: The Starlight Celebration is our favorite time of year. The Saint of Nymeia brings us presents, the city is adorned with beautiful decorations, and even the grown-ups look like they're having fun.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_TENNY_000_070: But this year, the grown-ups are really busy and aren't having any fun at all. When we noticed this, the two of us talked for a bit, and we decided...
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_TENNY_000_071: (-Saulinne and Tenny-)We'd like to become little helpers and help them!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_072: My, what kind souls you are! 'Tis the very spirit of the Starlight Celebration, and we would be most grateful for your aid!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_073: ─if you are willing, could you tend to the task of reviving the weary workers with our two little helpers?
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_075: Splendid. Please source something suitably revitalizing here in Gridania, and see it distributed. We celebrants will naturally bear the cost.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_AMHGARANJY_000_076: In the meantime, I shall return to the amphitheatre and apprise my fellow celebrants of the situation. If you have any problems, do not hesitate to let me know.
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_TENNY_000_078: Yes! We're going to be little helpers!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_SAULINNE_000_080: Hooray! We get to help Miss Garanjy!
TEXT_FESXMX001_05227_TENNY_000_081: Saulinne and I will do our best!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_000: Saulinne and I will do our best!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_010: If truth be told, we were eavesdropping when Miss Garanjy first asked you for help. We really wanted to become helpers, you see...
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_011: So we already knew that the grown-ups were cold and tired─and we know just the thing for it!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_012: That's right! A hot and sweet drink, like you suggested!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_013: It warms me up from my tummy to my fingertips. That's how I get through winters in Gridania even though I'm from Ul'dah!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_014: So come on, let's head to the Carline Canopy and ask Miounne about a drink!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_031: Saulinne went on in even though our parents said children shouldn't go to the Carline Canopy alone...
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_032: I decided to wait for you so I don't get in trouble.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_033: Young Saulinne has explained everything. You wish to serve drinks to the folk setting up at the Starlight Stalls, yes?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_034: The Canopy will have a stall too, but we've managed to finish our own preparations, so we'd be more than happy to assist.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_036: I've prepared a cask of mulled punch. Full of fruit and laced with spices, it'll fix the cold and weary right up.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_037: To mark the season, the Canopy was actually planning to offer a selection of hot beverages in these special mugs.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_038: We'd appreciate it if you could use them to distribute the punch. It'd be excellent promotion for our establishment.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_040: The cask is too heavy for little ones, but it shouldn't be a problem for a strapping adventurer such as yourself, yes?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_GODBERT_000_041: (-???-)Ho ho ho! To you who toil to make this Starlight Celebration wonderful, I would present a gift!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_GODBERT_000_042: I chanced to be passing by when I heard your conversation. I bid you follow me, my hardworking little helpers.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_043: A Starlight chocobo! And it's got a basket and a cask!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_GODBERT_000_044: 'Tis an excellent idea indeed to provide mulled punch to the cold and weary workers at the Starlight Stalls.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_GODBERT_000_045: To help you with your task, I took the liberty of borrowing a chocobo from the stables, and attired the fellow in a manner befitting the occasion.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_GODBERT_000_046: So go forth, little helpers, and together restore warmth and cheer to those in need!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_GODBERT_000_048: My, what a spirited pair you are! If you would come with me, I shall see that you look the part as well.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_MIOUNNE_000_049: I'll load the chocobo up and have someone take it to the market. Feel free to go on ahead.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_060: Look at our clothes, ! Great, aren't they?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_070: The Saint is amazing! Before we knew what was happening, he had already measured us and crafted our garments!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_071: A person from the Carline Canopy also brought the chocobo, so everything is set!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_072: Right, let's split up and hand out the punch while it's still hot. We've already filled some mugs to take around, so we'll leave the chocobo to you.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_073: We'll meet up again when we've finished!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_080: Would you care for some mulled punch? It's courtesy of Miss Garanjy.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_081: Thank you for your hard work!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_091: The chocobo is eager to begin. Lead it around the Starlight Stalls and distribute mulled punch to the workers.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_092: The eager chocobo is now accompanying you. Keep it at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_093: You can leave the chocobo behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with it and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_094: If you wish to have the chocobo accompany you again, return and speak with it at the original location.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_096: The chocobo is eager to begin. Lead it around the Starlight Stalls and distribute mulled punch to the workers.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_Q2_000_097: Are you sure you wish to part ways with the chocobo?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_099: The eager chocobo will return to the entrance to the Starlight Stalls. Find it there when you are ready to have it accompany you again.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_101: The chocobo is eager to resume working. Lead it around the Starlight Stalls and distribute mulled punch to the workers.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_102: The eager chocobo has yet to arrive. Be sure it is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_LEATHERWORKER05227_: W-We're preparing as fast as we can, I assure you!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_BAENFAELD_000_115: I thought Amh went back to town. Is everythin' alright?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_125: You must be accompanied by the eager chocobo and have it at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_LEATHERWORKER05227_: What's that? The celebrants are handing out hot drinks?
Ahhh, it's so blessedly warm! My fingers had frozen up, but I'm already starting to feel them again. Thank you!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_BAENFAELD_000_132: I thought Amh went back to town. Is everythin' alright?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_BAENFAELD_000_133: What do ye know, mulled punch! We appreciate ye lookin' out for us celebrants too!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_BOTANISTS05228_000_: I thought I saw a pair of children handing out something. You're with them, are you?
Oho, mulled punch! This is just what we needed to see us through our preparation. We'll enjoy it together, thank you!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_LEATHERWORKER05227_: Thanks again for the mulled punch! It's saved my fingers!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_BAENFAELD_000_145: I'd heard ye lot were handin' out somethin', but didn't expect us celebrants would get some too. Our thanks!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_BOTANISTS05228_000_: The mulled punch will help see us through our preparation. Many thanks!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_FEMALEWORKER05227_0: You're with the children, are you? The spices in the drink ought to wake us up. Thank you.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_160: There you are, ! Thank you for your help.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_161: You too, big fella! We saw you working hard taking the cask around. It must be much lighter now!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_162: We've just finished handing out the punch ourselves. Everyone was really happy!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_163: They all say they're just about done setting up...
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_164: Which means the Starlight Stalls can finally open!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_165: Miss Garanjy will be pleased to see how well things are coming along!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_166: Could you to go to the amphitheatre and fetch her?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_170: I can't wait for the market to open!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_175: Please go to the amphitheatre and fetch Miss Garanjy!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_190: Ah, it's you, . I've assigned celebrants to assist the stall holders in transporting wares. That should help to ease their burdens.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_191: Now then, how are you and the children faring in your efforts?
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_192: The mulled punch worked wonders, and everyone has just about finished setting up? Marvelous!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_193: I shall head to the venue at once!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_XMXMARKETWARP_000_1: The Starlight Stalls can open soon, you say? Miss Garanjy will doubtless be delighted to hear of this!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_300: Oh, what a relief that the market has opened as planned. And by all accounts, it's in no small part thanks to the mulled punch you served.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_301: I'm truly grateful to all of you!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_302: I think the fellow is saying, “You're welcome!”
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_303: For your hard work, my feathered friend, you can expect a special delivery of gysahl greens to the stables.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_304: Helping out was lots of fun! I hope we can do it again!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_305: Absolutely. But for now, you may leave the rest to us celebrants.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_306: We'll make certain that everything runs smoothly, so run along and enjoy the festival that you helped to make possible.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SAULINNE_000_307: We will...but first things first! You've been working very hard too, Miss Garanjy. You deserve a break yourself.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_TENNY_000_308: That's right! So let's all have some mulled punch together, while it's still nice and warm!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_520: Allow me to thank you again, . It's because of your kind assistance that we're now able to hold the market.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_521: By the by, after Saulinne and Tenny went off, I went to return our trusty chocobo assistant to the stables.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_522: And when I removed its barding, a note came tumbling out.
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_523: It read: “To our not-so-little helper , who helped little ones do big things, I present this gift of my own crafting.”
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_524: It seems clear the Saint intended for you to have the barding, so do take it with you. You've more than earned it!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_AMHGARANJY_000_525: Now then, you are doubtless keen to explore the stalls, so I won't keep you any longer. While the celebrations continue, the guide will show you here whenever you like, so please enjoy yourself to the fullest!
TEXT_FESXMX002_05228_SYSTEM_000_530: The vendors at the Starlight Stalls are now open for business!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: In honor and glory do we first lay eyes upon one another. I am the uma bugyo, the head of a delegation from the Far Eastern nation of Hingashi. We are come on a mission to tend to the fire of friendship with your Eorzea.

In honor and glory do we first lay eyes upon─
...Well now, yours is a countenance with which I am familiar. Long ago as it now was, 'tis like to have faded from your mind, but I am the uma bugyo, the head of a delegation from the Far Eastern nation of Hingashi. We are come on a mission to tend to the fire of friendship with your Eorzea.

This we seek to do by sharing the joys of our Heavensturn customs, which differs from those observed on these shores. While the people of Eorzea choose a deity to be first among the Twelve, we in the Far East grant that honor to one of twelve noble beasts.
And this year, the honor belongs to the horse, the most dignified and dependable of steeds!

Now, though I previously had the pleasure of introducing the horse in Eorzea, few are they still who have true appreciation for the creature. This time, therefore, it is my hope to better convey its appeal─its gallantry and majesty─to which end we are planning to have them march in a procession.

Presently, a member of our delegation is out spreading word of the event to the people of Limsa Lominsa. He wears a unique kabuto like mine, and has a delightful mascot with him besides. Alas, said mascot is as anxious as it is adorable, and we are having some difficulty handling it...
Hmmm... As an adventurer, I daresay you have a wealth of experience interacting with creatures great and small. If you are willing, might we prevail upon your aid?

In humility and gratitude do I receive your assent. Without further ado, my assistant, the uma yoriki, set off in the direction of the Drowning Wench. Pray seek him out and offer him your able assistance!
My assistant, the uma yoriki, set off in the direction of the Drowning Wench. Pray seek him out and offer him your able assistance!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_021: Come here, I say! Come here!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_022: <sigh> How am I to promote the procession when it refuses my every command...?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_023: Ah, forgive me! I did not notice you there.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_100_023: The uma bugyo sent you, you say? I could indeed do with some help!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_024: The little one there is a unicolt─the young of a unicorn, rare even in Eorzea. Our delegation was able to borrow it for this Heavensturn celebration, but as you can see, it is disinclined to obey me.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_025: While I am versed in the handling of horses and could tame the unruliest of them, this creature has eluded all my attempts to reach out to it.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_026: It appears to be daunted by its new surroundings, and will neither move nor respond to aught I say.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_028: What's this? The unicolt approaches you of its own accord!?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_029: Hmmm... When I collected it from Ishgard, I was told that unicorns favor those who are pure of heart.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_030: I had thought it a myth, but the creatures may truly have the ability to sense our intent. In my eagerness to use it for our festivities, I may have driven it away, while you drew it to yourself with your innocence.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_032: Well, well... Unless I am mistaken, it wishes to say that, with you, it would be willing to promote the Heavensturn procession!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_033: Loath though I am to impose, might I ask you to take the unicolt with you and spread the word of the event?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_034: The procession will set forth from the Zephyr Gate in middle La Noscea and strike southward. To begin with, you might try approaching the folk nearby.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_035: When you have finished, pray report to the uma bugyo. I leave the unicolt in your capable hands!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEYORIKI_000_040: The procession will set forth from the Zephyr Gate in middle La Noscea and strike southward. Please take the unicolt with you and spread the word!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: In assurance and anticipation do I note that you have met with the uma yoriki. Pray, take good care of the unicolt!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_051: The uma-no-unicolt is eager to set forth with you. Take it around the area and inform the locals about the Heavensturn procession.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_030: You must be accompanied by the uma-no-unicolt and have it at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_031: The uma-no-unicolt has yet to arrive. Be sure it is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_133: The uma-no-unicolt whinnies spiritedly, eager to promote the procession.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_034: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companion?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_036: Unless you are mistaken, the uma-no-unicolt will wait outside the Drowning Wench until you have finished your business.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_038: The uma-no-unicolt is eager to resume accompanying you.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_QUENTENAIN_000_060: Ah, it's Heavensturn again, ain't it? Our Far Eastern friends've got somethin' in store for us, I gather.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_QUENTENAIN_000_061: Well now, what a curious little creature... What exactly is it?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_A1_000_001: Let's see the same spirit you showed earlier.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_QUENTENAIN_000_064: So it's the Heavensturn mascot! An' I see now that it's a unicorn...which makes this the year of the horse, aye?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_CITIZEN05229_000_06: (-Seabound Adventurer-)That explains the style of its adornments. I'm mostly out on the sea so I don't have much contact with horses, but there was a thriving harness trade over in Kugane.
(-Seabound Adventurer-)Chocobos in Eorzea, and horses in the Far East... It's interesting, isn't it, how two different creatures in faraway lands came to be embraced in the same way?
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_QUENTENAIN_000_068: There's to be a procession outside the city, ye say? That sounds like a good bit of fun. We'll tell everyone we know about it!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_SYSTEM_000_070: The unicolt appears to be pleased at having promoted the event. Continue taking it around the city and spreading the word.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_QUENTENAIN_000_075: The procession sounds like a good bit of fun. We'll tell everyone we know about it!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_TRACHRAET_000_081: Eh? That a unicorn young I spy? An' it's the mascot fer this year's 'Eavensturn, ye say... I see, I see.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_TRACHRAET_000_082: Might be as yer aware, but the Grand Companies've been employin' 'orses on a trial basis─somethin' as came about years ago thanks to the 'Eavensturn celebration.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_TRACHRAET_000_083: Bein' 'ard to come by in Eorzea, they're not like to replace chocobos, but by all accounts they're comfortable creatures to ride.
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_TRACHRAET_000_084: Seein' the little one 'ere reminded me o' that. An' if the Maelstrom's also takin' part in the procession as I expect, I'll make a point of duckin' out to watch it!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_TRACHRAET_000_089: I'm quite certain the Maelstrom's also takin' part in the 'Eavensturn procession. That bein' the case, I'll make a point of duckin' out to watch it!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_RESTAURANT05229_000: Oh my! You gave me quite a shock...whatever you might be. I've never seen a horned beast like you before.
Ah, so that's why it's attired this way! I must say, I do enjoy it when Heavensturn comes to Eorzea.
It allows us to experience Far Eastern culture right here at home, and this procession sounds delightful. I assume the little one will be a part of it as well?
Hehe, how adorable! I'm not too familiar with horses, so I look forward to seeing them in all their gallantry and majesty!
I'll most definitely be going to watch the procession. My thanks for sharing word of it!
TEXT_FESNYX201_05229_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: Ah, you are returned. I am given to understand that you have been promoting the procession together with the unicolt.
And a most excellent job you have done of it, if the excitement among the townspeople is any indication. Allow me to express my heartfelt thanks for your assistance.
Now then, may I ask how our mascot fares? When last I beheld it, it was starting at fairly every sight and sound...
Well now, look how outgoing and cheerful you have become! Had I not known better, I would not think you the same creature!
Lest you wonder, there is a reason why we went through not-inconsiderable effort to have a unicorn be our mascot for this year's celebration.

It all began during my previous visit to Eorzea. In our impassioned desire to introduce the horse to your land, we had incurred the ire of a fraternity representing chocobo interests, with whose leader I engaged in a heated argument.

Thankfully, an Ishgardian knight chanced to be on hand─a charmingly irrepressible, silver-haired gentleman─who helped us to resolve matters in civility and amity. Bearing the crest of the unicorn upon his person, he smiled as he expressed his tremendous and equal admiration for horses and chocobos both.

In recalling that episode, I was reminded of the greatness of bonds that transcend nations. And so, when our delegation was due to visit Eorzea once more, I was inspired to reach out to the noble house to which that knight belonged.
For a time, I had feared what might become of this year's event. But thanks to the unicolt─and you for helping it come into its own─I have confidence that all shall be well.
Yes, all shall be well indeed!
Much like the Ishgardian knight, I believe you possess an innate ability to bring disparate hearts and souls together.
That being the case, with you having promoted the procession, full sure am I that we shall have a great crowd in attendance!
Now then, the hour of the event is upon us. We shall begin as soon as the preparations are complete!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_201: The uma-no-unicolt appears to be enjoying itself.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: Even as we speak, my faithful assistants should be seeing to the final preparations at the procession's departure point.
Being immediately outside the Zephyr Gate, the people should not have trouble finding it. I daresay even you could make your own way there, little one, now that you have been around the city!
Hehe, it does me well to see the unicolt in such good spirits.
Now, seeing as you kindly promoted the procession, it seems only natural that you attend it as well. Will you not do us the honor?
Excellent. Pray seek out the uma yoriki outside the Zephyr Gate. He can direct you to the best locations for viewing the event.
Pray seek out the uma yoriki outside the Zephyr Gate. He can direct you to the best locations for viewing the procession.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_021: The uma-no-unicolt whinnies cheerfully, eager for the procession to begin.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_022: Ah, so you have come too! I was quite surprised when the unicolt appeared alone...
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_024: In the short time it has been with you, it has become completely at ease around people. You truly have a way with beasts. Now then, those participating in the procession should be arriving soon...
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_025: Ah! These horses, might they be...
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_LIMSA05230_000_026: Indeed. They're the first to be brought in from the Far East after your delegation's visit years ago. Being of a breed suited to our climes, they've fared very well.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_LIMSA05230_000_027: We employ them in patrols and various other duties, and they've proven themselves most dependable.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_GRIDANIA05230_000_0: As their riders and carers both, it gives us great pride to present them before the people on the occasion of this Heavensturn!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_ULDAH05230_000_029: But to have our three steeds lined up side by side... I've no doubt that mine is the finest among them!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_GRIDANIA05230_000_0: I beg to differ! Mine has the brightest eyes, the shiniest coat, and noblest bearing! Any and all can see that it is the finest!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_LIMSA05230_000_031: Hehe! As you can see, we're quite taken with our horses!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_032: These splendid steeds will make their way together along the road, putting their gallant and majestic forms on display. A marvelous way to mark the coming of the year of the horse, I trust you'll agree!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_034: What's this!? You wish to join the procession!?
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_035: While I am impressed with your newfound courage, little one, I fear it would not be safe for you to run among war-trained creatures several times your size...
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_A1_000_001: I think it'd be a great addition to the event.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_A1_000_002: I'll be there to watch over it.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_036: Hmmm... If you will accompany it, perhaps there is no cause for concern.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_037: And 'tis true that the people would be delighted to see our adorable mascot. Very well, you may take part!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_039: Let us proceed in this manner: while the Grand Company horses travel along the road, the unicolt shall run freely through the fields with you at its side. That would help the procession end on a charming accent, I believe.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_040: Without further ado, then, the good officers and I shall set forth. We shall see you and the unicolt at the procession's end!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_061: The uma-no-unicolt is champing at the proverbial bit to set forth.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_064: The uma-no-unicolt is savoring the joy of running freely while being cheered on by the people.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_071: The uma-no-unicolt is eager to continue on to your destination.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_LIMSA05230_000_081: We were watching from here. You ran impressively, little one!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_082: Hear, hear! Be it a great stallion or a growing foal, few things are more magnificent than a horse in motion!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_083: In the Far East, 'tis believed that to behold the horse's majestic form in the new year is to pray for peace and plenty.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_084: Furthermore, the unicorn is a symbol of the bond between our lands─a mark of friendship that shall endure for generations. These two things serve to lend the procession even greater meaning!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_GRIDANIA05230_000_0: In Ishgard, the unicorn is held to be a sacred beast that assists in religious rites. 'Tis rather fitting that it should assist in Heavensturn as well.
