TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_087: Is that so? That is most fascinating, for the unicorn is also considered a sacred beast in the Far East, possessed of divine powers. Distant though our lands may be, we have much and more in common.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_088: To have the little one be part of the celebration is auspicious indeed!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_090: Haha! Truly, a horse in motion is a magnificent sight!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEYORIKI_000_091: With that, my fellows and I shall tend to the tidying up. In the meantime, I would be grateful if you could report to the uma bugyo. My thanks again for your invaluable aid!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_101: Unless you are mistaken, the uma-no-unicolt already wishes to go for another run.
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_HORSEMISSIONARY_000: In gladness and glee do I welcome your return. By the unicolt's buoyant bearing alone, I could tell that the procession was a rousing success!
You have done very well, little one, going far above and beyond your duty as a mascot. Rightly proud of yourself you may be.
Now, in the course of being at your side, our once-wary unicolt has forged a bond of trust with you. Is this not so?
Then in hope and faith do I ask that you take it with you on your journeys. In your care, I believe it can reach its full stride, and our Ishgardian friends would doubtless agree!
In parting, I bid you enjoy the Heavensturn festivities while they last. And on behalf of our delegation, I wish you health and happiness for the year ahead!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_110: Should you wish to draw omikuji, the omikujishi has returned to offer his services for the remainder of the celebration. Seek him out for a Heavensturn fortune!
TEXT_FESNYX202_05230_SYSTEM_000_111: Furthermore, twelve extra fortunes have been divined this year. Keep a watchful eye on the “Prosperity” section of your omikuji, and discover what new journeys might lie in wait for you.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_XMXMARKETWARP_000_0: Apologies, the stalls are overcrowded at present. I'd be happy to show you there once the number of attendees has eased.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_002: Happy Starlight, adventurer! I am Amh Garanjy, Starlight celebrant. And you are called , you say? 'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance! Might this be your first time partaking in the festivities?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_003: ! What a pleasure it is to see you again in this most festive of seasons. Allow me to reiterate my thanks for your contributions to Starlights past!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_004: Inspired by an old Ishgardian tale, the Starlight Celebration is about granting the wishes of children. And this year, we are bringing back the festive market that offers joy and merriment to young and old alike: the Starlight Stalls!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_005: The first time around, the Carline Canopy supplied us with kinderpunsch, a kind of mulled punch, which we provided to guests. It proved tremendously popular, so we are planning to provide it again─with a twist!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_006: Alas, with all the celebrants busy attending to the preparation at the stalls, we haven't been able to get working on said twist...
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_100_006: If you are not otherwise occupied, might you be willing to lend us a hand?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_007: I am truly grateful! Without further ado, please join me at the Carline Canopy stall at the market. There, I shall explain the particulars to you.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_008: When you are ready, the guide yonder will be glad to escort you through. I shall see you anon!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_XMXMARKETWARP_000_0: Ah, so you are the adventurer who has agreed to help us! If you would follow me, I shall take you to the Starlight Stalls.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MARKETSHOP05231_000: We're currently preparing our new product range. Please come back later!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_020: My thanks again for assisting us. I've asked Miounne to join me in explaining our punch plans. She should be along any moment now.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_030: Ah, so you're the adventurer who's been roped in to help.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_031: An excellent choice, given the fine work you did distributing the punch last festival. It was a favorite among attendees, and the mugs had the desired effect of promoting the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_032: As Amh may have mentioned, at last year's festival, the Carline Canopy prepared kinderpunsch for the people. This was distributed in mugs with a Gridanian design.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_033: When I mentioned this to my guild counterparts in the other city-states, they were keen to have their homes represented on the mugs as well. And so we had these beauties made.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_100_034: They bear local vistas and motifs, such as a galleon for Limsa Lominsa and a cactuar for Ul'dah, with seasonal flourishes worked in for the festive touch.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_100_035: Since we have now three lovely mugs, we thought it would be fitting to serve up three varieties of kinderpunsch.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_036: In Gridania, punch is traditionally made by simmering the juice of locally grown apples with blood currants, cinnamon, and various herbs.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_037: For the Lominsan and Ul'dahn varieties, I'm keen to incorporate ingredients found in their respective locales, but I haven't been able to decide on what...
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_039: (-Lively Youth-)Hello! Could we get some mulled punch, please?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_041: (-Lively Youth-)Are the pictures of other cities? I wonder what they're like!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_042: Ah, young Joultain! The punch isn't ready yet, but it shan't be long now. We are currently preparing two new varieties, you see, using ingredients from the cities shown on these mugs.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_043: Hehe, it does me well to see the younglings' curiosity for faraway lands.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_044: It further motivates me to serve up kinderpunsch that will not disappoint─which brings me back to the task we have for you.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_100_044: We ask that you investigate what ingredients we should use to create punch that best captures each nation.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_110_044: Gridania's market attracts many visitors from the realm over. An adventurer such as yourself should have no trouble identifying suitable individuals─and coaxing out the relevant information.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_046: Your confidence is most assuring! I shall apprise the other celebrants of the situation, and then return to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. I look forward to your findings!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_060: So you're an adventurer? That's so amazing!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_061: My thanks again for your kind assistance. I look forward to hearing what ingredients are suggested for our new varieties of kinderpunsch!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_LOMINSANCHEF05231_0: You want to make punch with a Lominsan twist? Then you'll want to use plenty of La Noscean oranges, lowland grapes, and lemons.
La Noscean citrus is renowned far and wide. It's featured heavily in Lominsan cuisine ever since sailors started using it to ward off scurvy, and I always ensure that our restaurant has ample stock.
I'm in charge of procurement at the Bismarck, you see. If you're after quality citrus, I'd be glad to introduce you to our suppliers!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_LOMINSANCHEF05231_1: If you're making punch with a Lominsan twist, I guarantee you can't go wrong with La Noscean citrus!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_ULDAHNLADY05231_000: What's that? Ingredients that are distinctly Ul'dahn? Well, most of my countrymen would say nopal and spices...but that would be selling our cuisine short, for dining should be an adventure!
The thrill of the unknown... The triumph of audacity... A dish should have all the drama of a championship bout at the Coliseum, oh yes!
Such an experience may be a little stimulating for children, but we grown-ups can appreciate a little excitement. Wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_ULDAHNMERCHANT05231: You wish to make a drink that represents Ul'dah? Tea would be a good place to start. We Ul'dahns can't get through the day without a good, strong brew!
It's served up anywhere you can get a feed─doesn't matter if it's a slap-up meal or just a sweet treat. I've heard tell that the sultana takes hers with generous helpings of butter and honey.
Aside from tea, Thanalan has specialties like vanilla, cloves, black pepper, and pearl ginger. The finest stuff can cost as much as gemstones.
If you're making a drink that represents Ul'dah, it needs to have tea in it. Butter and spice would make good accents too!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_079: Welcome back, . Were you able to learn anything promising?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_080: Oh, those ingredients seem representative of Limsa Lominsa and Ul'dah indeed! We celebrants should be able to procure the items, so pray leave it to us!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_081: Once the kinderpunsch has been prepared, we would be pleased if you would do the honors and serve it. When it is time, please present yourself to my colleague at the Starlight Stalls.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_082: And if you happen to have a moment now, might I trouble you to speak with the little ones from earlier?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_083: I am hoping that you could learn which city holds the greatest interest for each of them. In so doing, you would be able to recommend varieties of punch that would be the most meaningful.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_090: Please find the little ones and learn what city holds the greatest interest for each of them. And when it is time to distribute the punch, my colleague at the Starlight Stalls will assist you.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_COMMITTEE05231_000_: Rest assured our preparations are proceeding apace. One enthusiastic young man even offered to help.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231A_000_100: The punch is almost ready? I can't wait to have some!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231A_000_101: What do I like to eat? Hmmm...fruits! We have apples and berries here in the wood, but I'd love to try fruits from other places too.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231B_000_102: They're giving out hot drinks...? That sounds great!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231B_000_103: Um...I'm visiting with my mum. It's my first time in Gridania...so I guess I want to learn more about everything here.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_104: Oh, you're the adventurer from before! The mulled punch is almost ready? Hooray!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_105: I want to learn about all new places, so it's hard to decide on a punch. There's no ocean in Gridania, so it's my dream to go sailing everywhere on a big ship!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231A_000_110: I'll head over soon! I can't wait to see what kinds of punch there'll be. Something with fruits from other places, I hope!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231B_000_111: It's my first time in Gridania...so I guess I want to learn more about everything here.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_112: I want to learn about all new places. One day, I'll go sailing everywhere on a big ship!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_COMMITTEE05231_000_: Ah, excellent timing. We've received the last of the ingredients and are now brewing the new varieties of kinderpunsch.
We expect a throng of children will descend upon us as soon as we begin serving. Are you ready to attend to them?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_Q2_000_000: Are you ready to serve the punch?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_A2_000_002: I'd like to review the characteristics of the cities and their punch.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SYSTEM_000_123: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_COMMITTEE05231_000_: Gridania is located in the Black Shroud, the dominion of the elementals. The Carline Canopy's kinderpunsch uses generous amounts of apple and cinnamon, and is a veritable bounty of the forest.
Limsa Lominsa is a culinary cradle, where myriad cultures have come together courtesy of trade on the seas.
The Lominsan kinderpunsch blends foreign spices with La Noscean citruses, to produce a fusion of flavor that reflects the mingling of peoples in the city.

Ruled by the sultana Nanamo Ul Namo, the nation of Ul'dah thrives on commerce. Its bazaars are lined with exotic wares brought in by caravans, while the Coliseum throngs with nobles who seek the thrill of gladiatorial combat.
The Ul'dahn kinderpunsch is made by simmering dried fruits and black pepper in a sweet butter tea. The result is a flavor that is royally rich as well as stimulating.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231C_000_130: A friend of mine used to live in Ul'dah, and he tells me stories about it. I've always wanted to know what it's like there...if you have something like that?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231C_000_132: Wow, this is really good, like a sweet tea with spices! Is this what Ul'dah smells like, I wonder... I'm going to get my friend to come too!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231C_000_133: Wow, this is really good! But...is the flavor really Ul'dahn? I'm going to get my friend and ask him about it!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231A_000_134: I'd love to see what fruits from other places taste like. Do you have a punch that's made with them?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231A_000_136: Oh, it's sour, but sweet! I love it! I had no idea they grew so many kinds of citruses in La Noscea.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231A_000_137: This is a bit different, but it's still very nice! There's also a stall nearby selling orange juice, so I'll go and try some later.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231D_100_137: You here for punch too? Come on, let's go up together!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231D_000_138: I heard there's a place called the Coliseum where gladiators fight each other. I want a punch that'll make me feel like I'm there!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231D_000_140: So the Coliseum is in Ul'dah? I'd love to see a fight there one day...but right now there's a fight in my own mouth! Whew, the spices in this punch sure pack a punch!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231D_000_141: Ahhh, the spices in the punch are firing me up! I have to go and train─right now!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231B_000_142: Um...hello again. I've never had mulled punch before. I'm not sure which one I should try...
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231B_000_144: Thank you! I love the apple flavor, and the mug is beautiful too! Oh, I hope I can meet some moogles while I'm in Gridania!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_CHILD05231B_000_145: It's warm and delicious, thank you! It's been really fun here at the stalls. I'm going to keep exploring!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_146: Hmmm, what to choose... I suppose I'd like a punch that makes me feel like I'm sailing somewhere far away!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_148: Wow, what a great blend of flavors! And I just love the design on the mug. It's ships like this that connect the whole world!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_149: Wow, what a great blend of flavors! That reminds me, the merchants at the markets also sell wares from faraway places. I should take a closer look at them next time!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_150: Thank you, ! I've had a lot of fun!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_COMMITTEE05231_000_: It seems the children really enjoyed their punch. You did well indeed with your selections.
Well, that appears to be all of the children for now. Our thanks for helping them to enjoy their punch.
From hereon, we celebrants will tend to the punch distribution with your fine example as a guide. You need only report back to Amh Garanjy─she will be eager to know how we fare.
Please leave the rest of the distribution to us, and report back to Amh Garanjy. She will be eager to know how we fare.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_170: I've just finished putting out a few proverbial fires at the guild, so I thought I'd come by and see how you were getting on.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_171: The more the merrier, as I always say! And if you're here, my friend, may I assume that the kinderpunsch has been handed out to the little ones as planned?
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_172: We are truly in your debt. With your help, we have not only brought the children festive cheer, but also expanded their horizons.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_173: Of course, they're all more than welcome to return and try the other types of punch. The longer they enjoy themselves at the stalls, the better.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_174: There you are, adventurer! I wanted to thank you again─and Miss Garanjy and Miounne too!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_175: It was absolutely our pleasure. If you enjoyed the punch, then nothing would please us more.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_176: When I grow up, I want to be someone who knows lots about the world like you, ! I'll go and see what's out there for myself, and tell everyone all about it.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_JOULTAIN_000_177: And I want to tell everyone about Gridania too. The Starlight Stalls have reminded me just how much I love it here!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_178: That is a wonderful wish, and I've no doubt that the Spinner Herself has heard it!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_179: When the time comes, it'll be my pleasure to register you as an adventurer, young man. And I'll look forward to hearing your tales of courage and high adventure.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_MIOUNNE_000_180: That goes for you as well, of course.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_181: It seems you've truly inspired young Joultain. And should you still have time to spare, you could potentially inspire even more souls─by helping us serve up more kinderpunsch!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_AMHGARANJY_000_182: We'd also be glad if you simply enjoyed the festivities hereon─it is entirely up to you. While the celebration continues, our guide will be pleased to show you to the stalls. My thanks again, , and happy Starlight!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SYSTEM_000_185: The vendors at the Starlight Stalls are now open for business!
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SYSTEM_000_186: You can speak to the saturnine Starlight celebrant at the Starlight Stalls if you wish to help serve more kinderpunsch.
TEXT_FESXMX101_05231_SYSTEM_000_187: In so doing, you may well encounter some familiar faces!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_000: Ah, ─how wonderful to have such a reliable helper on hand. As you've no doubt noticed, the Little Ladies' Day festivities are upon us once more!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_001: 'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance,  . I have the honor of serving as the royal seneschal, and it is my duty to bring smiles and cheers to all the ladies of the realm.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_002: What is Little Ladies' Day, you ask? Why, it is a day when the maidens of Eorzea are doted upon as princesses by their very own loyal seneschal!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_004: By the way, I must ask... You know of the Songbirds, do you not? How silly of me! Of course you do.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_005: That trio of princess-styled entertainers were relative unknowns when they first took to the stage, but they've since become a Little Ladies' Day staple! Now we hope to introduce another such sensation...but this time the singer will be butler-themed.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_006: I've titled this new act the “Seneschal Prince”! A royal among servants, and loyal servant to his princess!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_007: The prince in question is scheduled to debut in the upcoming festival performance, but 'twould seem our chosen star is yet to return from picking up his costume.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_100_007: Though there is ample time ere the show begins, his prolonged absence is a source of concern, to say the least. If only I were not so preoccupied with preparations...
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_008: Would you mind looking in on him for me? “Picot” is his name, and he was meant to be speaking with a designer at Eshtaime's Aesthetics.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_010: I would be grateful if you could see what is keeping young Picot, and doubly so if you could render any needed assistance. He was on his way to Eshtaime's Aesthetics the last time we spoke.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_011: Ah...no, dahling, no. What I need from you are specifics.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_020: It has to shine with a sharp, frozen brilliance, like a blizzard slicing through the darkest night... A-And it should dazzle like a searing flame, threatening to burn your fingers at the merest touch! Doesn't that sound amazing!?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_021: Wait...which do you want? A freezing blizzard or a burning flame?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_022: Oh, maybe you can help! How can we create a silvery costume that melts into chaotic darkness? Should I give up on the shiny element?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_023: , how lovely to see you, dahling! Why, we haven't spoken since you helped me snatch victory in the walk-off. What brings you to Eshtaime's?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_024: An adventurer? What can Marabel, famed designer of Eshtaime's Aesthetics, do for you, dahling?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_026: Here at the royal seneschal's bidding, you say? Well, I could certainly use some guidance with this costuming conundrum.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_027: The costume itself is largely complete. I simply wanted to add the finishing flair in accordance with the “prince's” wishes, but I'm struggling to envision the image he's trying to convey.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_028: Well, there are just so many dimensions to looking “dashing.” How can one narrow the options down to a single idea...?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_MARABEL_000_029: Forgive me, dahlings, but I've other projects to attend to. Would you mind coming back once you've helped the lad decide on a more definitive direction?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_030: <sigh> This is not going well. I couldn't ask for a better opportunity, and here I am ruining my own debut...
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_100_030: Ah...it was , yes? I am sorry to drag you into this dilemma of mine.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_031: Of all those who auditioned, they chose me to be the Seneschal Prince. My job now is to become a star performer, and creating a dashing and princely persona seemed the best way to achieve that.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_032: So I did my research into the subject, delving into books about the most gallant individuals─how they act, how they dress, that sort of thing... But when I tried to explain, it all came out a jumbled mess.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_033: Hmmm, what makes the Seneschal Prince a prince among seneschals? Come to think of it, what exactly is a seneschal anyway?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_A1_000_001: An unobtrusive servant who anticipates his master's needs.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_A1_000_002: A person of impeccably proper manners.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_A1_000_003: Perhaps you should have researched that instead...
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_034: I see... Then my fixation on being “dashing” was entirely the wrong approach.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_035: You may be right. I've been approaching this from entirely the wrong angle.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_036: But at least now one thing is clear! I must learn the ways of a seneschal if I'm to be the best Seneschal Prince I can be!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_037: Hm, you seem a knowledgeable sort. Left to my own devices, I fear wasting time on the wrong thing again... Will you help me with my research?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_038: Huzzah! Then first things first, I say we speak with a wide variety of townsfolk, and learn what the general public expects of a seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_039: Let's split up that we might gather as many opinions as possible. I'll leave the Steps of Thal to you, and we can meet at the Gold Court afterwards!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_BUTLER_000_050: I would be grateful if you could see what is keeping young Picot, and doubly so if you could render any needed assistance. He was on his way to Eshtaime's Aesthetics the last time we spoke.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_NOBILITY05237_000_0: A seneschal? Why, yes, of course─I have one in my employ.
The accomplished ones foresee what must be done, and act without need for instruction. Those who stand around awaiting orders have no business taking the position.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_LADY05237_000_070: Ah, that word ever puts me in mind of the first royal seneschal himself, Sultan Baldric. It's said that every year one girl was chosen from the townspeople by lot, and he would attend to that lucky lass as her personal servant for the entire day.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_LADY05237_000_071: The festival is no longer about choosing a single princess, of course, but oh how I still daydream about having an attentive seneschal at my beck and call.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_LADY05237_000_072: As a child, whenever Little Ladies' Day came around I would always hold out hope that this would be the year I was chosen.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_WAITER05237_000_080: My impressions of a seneschal? Hmmm... Well, they strike me as people who excel at preparations. Performing tasks to a demanding lord or lady's satisfaction hinges upon their ability to think ahead─to plan events to perfection.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_WAITER05237_000_081: My work as a server at the Quicksand is similar in some respects.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_WAITER05237_000_082: We have a special Little Ladies' Day menu on offer this year, and I have everything memorized─the ingredients, the presentation, the flavors─down to the smallest detail. Everything from the main course to the beverages and desserts will be perfect.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_WAITER05237_000_083: Above and beyond one's prescribed duties, a server's mission is to ensure as many happy customers as possible.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_NOBILITY05237_000_0: A seneschal who cannot act on his own initiative is not worthy of the title.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_LADY05237_000_091: I'm rather taken with Sultan Baldric's “seneschal for a day” idea. Having someone devoted to your needs alone is like a dream come true, don't you agree?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_WAITER05237_000_092: Preparing for things in advance is a skill both seneschals and servers have in common. There is no better way to ensure satisfaction, be it for a customer or the master of the house.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_100: Oh, guess what, ! I was asking about seneschals in Pearl Lane, and a merchant offered me an amazing bargain.
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_101: He showed me a rare urn of “incalculable worth,” but even the “heavily discounted price” was far more coin than I could afford... Come to think of it, what do urns have to do with seneschals, anyway?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_A2_000_002: Could it be that...you're a little too trusting?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_103: Oh. Was I on the wrong track again? I could've sworn...
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_104: I see. So a seneschal is someone who serves others; someone who anticipates what needs to be done, and prepares for those tasks in advance. In my case, then, I should be a seneschal who...serves his fans?
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_105: Yes, when I put it like that, it just feels right! I should be thinking of ways I can make the crowds happy!
TEXT_FESPDX001_05237_PICOT_000_106: And that's exactly what I'll do. Now, if you could stick around a while longer, I'd appreciate some help in becoming the best seneschal I can be!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_010: I am to don the mantle of the Seneschal Prince... Yet while I've grasped a clear picture of the theme, I must needs think of how best to embody the manner.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_011: A seneschal exists to serve. To ensure happiness and satisfaction. Which, incidentally, is how this all began for me.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_012: I once knew a girl, years ago. She was my childhood friend─my cherished princess.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_013: But alas, she was born with a terrible ailment. She could not rise from bed, let alone leave the house, and thus I took it upon myself to bring the outside world to her.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_014: I acted out all sorts of tales. A hero's saga. A jester at court. If she wished to hear of it─if it would but make her smile─I would assume any role under the sky.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_015: One fateful day, I happened to see a songstress in town. She dazzled the audience, and the elated looks upon their faces... I had to rush back to my princess's bedside to share the experience.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_016: I sang and danced my heart out for my audience of one─a performance for her and her alone. Oh, how her eyes lit up!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_017: Her happiness was everything I ever wanted. It spurred me to practice day and night, and as I did, I began to feel I truly was a famous performer.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_018: Then, all too soon, did Thal call her to His somber halls.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_019: Ever since, I've dreamed of making a big name for myself as a singer. If I could perform upon some grand stage, then perhaps my voice would rise up and reach her ears once more!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_020: That's why I auditioned for the role of the Seneschal Prince, and why I leapt for joy when I heard that I'd been chosen.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_021: Yet even though I began all this for her, it has become every bit my own dream as well. I yearn to sing as that songstress did, and stir the hearts of the crowd!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_022: Ahem... Thank you for listening, . Talking to someone helps to put my thoughts in order.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_023: Right, back to the task at hand! Once I've settled on how to best serve my audience, then I should have all the specifics Marabel needs to finish the costume.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_024: Let's head over to the Little Ladies' Day stage, shall we? With the better part of the preparations finished, it's likely begun to draw a crowd─the sight might inspire some ideas for my seneschal debut!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_030: Ah, there you are! Work on the stage proceeds apace... Will Picot be ready to perform?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_STAFF05238_000_031: Let us spare not the smallest detail─we'll give the fans a show to remember.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PRINCESSFAN05238_00: The heavenly Narumi will soon be here in person! I've thought of nothing else for days and days!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_WAITERB05238_000_03: Hmmm... There's always quite a crowd gathered by the stage. Perhaps I should have a word with the royal seneschal and ask if I can pass out some flyers.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_SYSTEM_000_040: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_050: The stagehands seem swamped with last-moment adjustments, and you can see the fans have already begun to gather.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_051: If I'm to decide how to act as the Seneschal Prince, then it's now or never! Let's see what clues the scene has to offer us.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_060: Yes, of course. If we're speaking of seneschals, we should look no further than the royal seneschal himself.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_061: Such a courteous demeanor, and so precise in his movements... Now that I think on it, no matter the work we do together, he is never less than thorough with his preparations.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_062: And I imagine he would be more than willing to help us implement any new plan we might propose...
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_070: See there? A particularly eager Songbirds fan─come early to ensure a front-row experience, no doubt.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_071: Rather too early, in fact. My act is first on the program, so he'll be in for quite a long wait before his idols take the stage.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_A2_000_001: Can we make him more comfortable?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_A2_000_002: Should we bring him a bite to eat?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_072: Yes, of course... He must be exhausted from standing there all this time. The least I can do is make him more comfortable for the duration of my performance.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_080: Ah, an employee of the Quicksand! Did they not mention offering some exclusive menu over the course of Little Ladies' Day?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_A3_000_002: I was curious about that myself.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_081: Knowing such a thing is only available during the festival makes it all the more tempting, doesn't it?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_082: Hmmm... I wonder if they'd be willing to bring out a light meal for the audience? Not only would it benefit the fans, but it would also be an excellent promotion for the Quicksand itself.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_090: How can I serve the crowd...? Aside from the usual singing and dancing, there must be something I can do.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_100: I've been thinking, . There is no rule which demands people must stand to cheer and enjoy a performance, is there?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_101: Why not have the Quicksand deliver some light refreshments─Little Ladies' Day-themed, of course─and aim for a more relaxed experience?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_102: I mean, it's hardly a novel concept. One often orders a meal while taking in a play, or has a flagon in hand while the minstrel strums his lute in the tavern. We would simply encourage the same idea!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_103: Naturally, I shall rouse the crowd with song and dance, but this will help define the seneschal side of my stage character!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_104: The act is finally coming together! As the Seneschal Prince, I shall both serve and entertain!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_105: Come, there's not a moment to lose. I must first consult with the royal seneschal, and then hurry off to make my request to Mistress Momodi at the Quicksand!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_107: But I must also inform Marabel of my costuming decisions. Argh, there is no time!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_A4_000_001: Shall I talk to her in your stead?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_A4_000_002: Let's divide the tasks between us.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_100_107: You... You would do that for me?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_110_107: Oh, thank you, ! I would be most grateful if you could explain the costume concept to Marabel for me.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_109: You truly are my savior! I give you my word the show will be a great success. Please, do be sure to attend!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_120: ...Which is why I was hoping to organize the event to allow people to eat and drink while they make merry!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_121: Hrm, yes... The idea has merit! I shall arrange for tables to be brought out.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_MARABEL_000_130: , dahling! How fares our princely seneschal?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_MARABEL_000_131: So the show will feature a healthy dash of hospitality, eh? Sounds fabulous!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_MARABEL_000_132: A singer with a seneschal's poise and a prince's style... Yes, dahling, I know exactly what this costume needs. Leave it to me!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_MARABEL_000_133: Please let the royal seneschal know that I'll have the outfit ready in time for the performance.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_140: Thank you for lending a hand to young Picot! 'Tis good to know the issue with his costume has been resolved.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_141: As I mentioned, the Seneschal Prince is to be the main new attraction for this year's Little Ladies' Day, and Picot himself is to give the show's opening address.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_142: I cannot imagine how events might have unfolded without your assistance. You will stay and watch his performance, yes?
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PRINCESSFAN05238_00: I've been standing for so long my feet have fallen asleep. But at least the show is about to begin!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_STAGEFANA05238_000_: It should be starting any moment now. The first act is the debut performance for a new singer, isn't it? The Seneschal, uh...Prince?
What would a prince of seneschals be like, anyway? I have no idea what to expect.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_203: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our Little Ladies' Day performance!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_204: I am Picot, the Seneschal Prince, and I shall be your guide to an ephemeral world of wonder.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_205: I imagine you are all weary from the wait. Though it be but a trifle, we have taken the liberty of arranging for refreshments─a special festival menu prepared by our friends at the Quicksand.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_206: Peach-infused tea accompanied by a selection of spring-inspired sweets... We invite you to enjoy these delights while you enjoy the show.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PRINCESSFAN05238_00: That's for us!? Thank the gods, I was so thirsty!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_STAGEFANA05238_000_: Oh, that new menu has been on my mind all day! What a lovely gesture!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_209: I am overjoyed to see you thus pleased. Should this repast meet with your approval, pray consider a visit to the Quicksand following the show.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_211: I must ask that you keep all eyes on me. Without your full attention, I am wont to grow jealous.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_212: Fair princesses, won't you step closer? I promise this shall be a princely performance to remember.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_213: Settle in, my dear audience, and enjoy the spectacle of the Seneschal Prince!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_214: He not only entertains with song and dance, but also captures the crowd's hearts with warm hospitality. A wonderful display.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_NARUMI_000_216: It seems we have quite a show to follow.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: And the Songbirds will deliver! We'll take the stage by storm and build this excitement to a raging crescendo!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_300: The Seneschal Prince's debut has been a grand success! The audience was thoroughly entertained.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_310: , thank you for coming to my performance!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_311: It was all so magical! To see such enjoyment upon each face in the crowd was an indescribable feeling.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_312: And did you see how they responded to the touches of hospitality? The Quicksand server even came over to thank me for how quickly word spread about their festival menu!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_313: What a stunning debut by the Seneschal Prince! We've already been swamped with demands to know when you will be performing next... In fact, I'm thinking of setting up an encore performance while the festival is still ongoing.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_314: Is that so? Well, then, I shan't disappoint my fans!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_315: I wonder if my dear friend was watching me, too, from Thal's distant halls...
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_317: Thank you again for giving me this opportunity.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_319: For as long as I have the privilege of standing on that stage, I mean to spend every moment delighting all who attend!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_320: Ah, I almost forgot! I had Marabel craft you a matching costume.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_321: I was not alone up there in front of the crowd─I felt you standing beside me, as you have been every step of the way.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_322: Given your part in all this, you are every bit a Seneschal . So please, do me the honor of accepting this gift.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_PICOT_000_323: 'Tis the least I can offer for your patient assistance. Now, I must be off to prepare for my next appearance!
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_325: I, too, offer my sincerest gratitude for elevating our celebrations to ever greater heights.
TEXT_FESPDX002_05238_BUTLER_000_326: The Little Ladies' Day festivities have only just begun, but I suggest you go and enjoy them while they last!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Hatching-tide is upon us once more! I hope the season finds you in eggcellent fettle?
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: For my part, , it is an absolute pleasure to see you again!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: My name is Jihli Aliapoh, and I lead this annual celebration. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance. May I ask your name?
Well, , I hope this is the beginning of a firm friendship!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: While I have your attention, allow me to expound upon the nature of this year's festivities.
Hatching-tide has its origins in the days before the Seventh Umbral Calamity, when twelve sages of an era past appeared before me in a startling vision.
I have been visited by such dreams ever since, and this year was no exception. I saw a great mass of eggs, as vivid as those before you now, borne aloft unto the heavens...
Making dreams manifest has never failed to lend wonder to Hatching-tide before, so needless to say, I intend to bring my latest vision to life.
Speaking of which, the eggs I commissioned ought to arrive any moment now...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_035: Oh, Jihli, it's a disaster! The cart toppled over en route! Thankfully the driver was unscathed, but I can't say the same for the eggs...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: Good heavens! I'm glad to hear the poor driver was unharmed, but without the eggs, how are we to breathe life into my dream?
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_039: D-Don't worry! I'll simply fashion some more eggs myself!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_040: Though to create the quantity required will take time, and we're already facing at least a minor delay at this point...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: If only I could assign someone to help you. Alas, the other Dreamers are busy enough as it is, and I must see to the schedule alterations myself...
But wait, ! Perhaps you'd be willing to lend a hand?
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_100_42: !? How wonderful to see you again! Knowing what an eggsemplary assistant you are gives me cause for hope. If you're happy to help, that is?
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_110_42: It's a pleasure to meet you, adventurer! I do hope you'll consider helping us get Hatching-tide back on track.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_043: Thank you! The first order of business will be procuring more of the necessary egg supplies from the merchant.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_044: Our supplier should be in the market. He's a burly fellow, so he won't be difficult to spot. We can only hope he has enough stock...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: I'm sorry that I cannot attend to the eggs personally, but your assistance will make all the difference. Thank you!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_MARCHANT05242_000_0: Ah, yer that Dreamer who was 'ere before, ain't ye?
A right ol' mess to be sure. 'Fraid I'm all out o' the supplies ye need, though.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_063: O-Oh... Is there really nothing you can do for us?
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_MARCHANT05242_000_0: Well, I do 'ave some tatty ol' odds n' ends─er, surplus wares─that might be o' use. If you want 'em, they're all yers.
Might not be exactly what ye needed, but I'm sure ye can cobble somethin' together with these. The storage fees were eatin' into me prof─I mean, I'd rather see 'em put to good use!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_066: When I ordered the initial batch of supplies, I remember thinking what a kind fellow he was. He's certainly proved me right! Anyroad, we'd better take stock of what he's given us.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_072: Let's see... This leather looks durable. We have some metal springs and rings that could do for a mechanism of some sort... And these lengths of timber could be cut down to a more portable size.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_073: I think these herbs and resins are used to concoct water-repellent alchemical solutions. Never tried it myself, but there's a first time for everything!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_074: Besides that, there are plenty of bits and bobs. We should have no trouble when it comes to decoration.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_075: Unfortunately, we won't be able to recreate the eggs Jihli saw in her dream with these. We could make something far easier to get off the ground though: parasols! The trick will be making them look eggy enough...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_A1_000_000: Any rounded object looks like an egg from far enough away! It's science.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_A1_000_001: The shell makes the egg, as they say. Do they say that? Anyroad, we should paint them.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_080: I see! We can mimic the shape of an egg with the canopy, and add some seasonally appropriate patterns to the outer shell. I can picture it now!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_090: You're right! With some festive patterns on the outer canopy and a convincingly eggy structure, the parasols might just make for a worthy replacement!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_100: That's it, let the eggs turn to parasols in your mind's eye...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_101: If we maintain the egg shape for the canopy and add plenty of festive decorations, they'll more than look the part!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_110: Parasols are a sight more fiddly than your standard egg, though. With just the two of us, production will take far too long...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_111: So we'll need to enlist further help, just as I did with you.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_112: Fortunately, the guild artisans should be less likely to balk at a request for parasol parts than a rush order for myriad eggs, particularly if we supply the materials.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_113: Let us first pay a visit to the Leatherworkers' Guild. I'm sure they'll be able to transform our leather into something fit for a canopy.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_160: I've explained the situation to Geva, and she seems inclined to sympathy. If we keep our manners about us, we should manage to secure the guild's assistance.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_GEVA_000_170: Ah, if it isn't . You must be the adventurer assistant Nonotta spoke of. She was just informing me of your plight.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_GEVA_000_180: You must be the adventurer assistant Nonotta spoke of. She was just informing me of your plight.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_GEVA_000_190: Many of our apprentices are looking forward to the Hatching-tide celebrations─you shall have the guild's aid. Although I'm afraid we lack some of the resources needed to work your leather into parasol canopies.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_GEVA_000_191: The material is water resistant to a degree, but nevertheless porous. Untreated, it will degrade over time and begin to rot, but our stock of coating is perilously low at the moment.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_192: If it's a water repellent you're after, say no more! We just so happen to have the necessary ingredients, so I can see to its preparation.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_194: In the meantime, would you take this timber over to the Carpenters' Guild and request that they craft the parasol frame? We can meet up by the Black Rabbit Traders' stall anon.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_GEVA_000_220: Trust that your leather is in capable hands.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_221: Maisenta has played a part in Hatching-tide preparations for many years now. Whether it be procuring materials or providing useful tidbits, she's always been a pleasure to deal with. In fact, it was she who introduced me to that burly Roegadyn fellow who gifted us the supplies.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_222: When I asked if she'd help see those ingredients refined into the right alchemical solution, she didn't hesitate for a moment! She's making arrangements as we speak.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_223: That's why we have to ensure this year's Hatching-tide is a resounding success. Not just for Jihli and her visions, but friends like Maisenta who've helped along the way!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_MAISENTA_000_224: I'm delighted to play a part in realizing another Hatching-tide for the ages. Leave the alchemical solution and the finer details to me─I'll soon have everything sourced.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_230: Why do you stand there like a frightened schoolchild? If you need something, speak.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_240: You wish this timber fashioned into parasol frames? Very well. I shall see it done by competent hands.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_250: Parasol frames? A task not beyond your own skill, no doubt, would the imminence of the holiday not force you to compromise their quality. You have done well to seek aid, , and you shall have it.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_260: And you would have us undertake this task with how little time left until Hatching-tide? <sigh> Very well...
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_270: The younglings in the Acorn Orchard await the festivities. For their sake, no effort will be spared in the parasols' preparation.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_290: We shall commence work right away. Let your associates know that the Carpenters' Guild has the matter in hand.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_BEATINE_000_300: The timber you provided lacks the flexibility needed to create arching ribs. However, Mistress Fufucha will doubtless assist in procuring what we need.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_310: I trust everything went well at the Carpenters' Guild. I've just placed an order for the alchemical solution and a few other things besides!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_311: The next step will be to piece all the parts together into a prototype parasol.
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_NONOTTA_000_312: I'll bring the prototype over to Jihli once I've finished, so you can go ahead and wait with her!
TEXT_FESESX001_05242_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_32: Welcome back, ! You'll be pleased to hear that I've adjusted the schedule to accommodate our little mishap, and all is set to proceed. How fare the eggs?
Substituting parasols for eggs? What a wonderful idea. I can hardly wait to see what Nonotta cooks up for the prototype─though wait we must!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Nonotta will surely be along any moment now.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_NONOTTA_000_010: Sorry to keep you both waiting! Allow me to present you with the very first Archon egg parasol!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: What a fine example of ingenuity. It's magnificent!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_NONOTTA_000_012: I'm so glad you approve! With your blessing, I'll begin producing more to distribute!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: In the meantime, we find ourselves at a loose end.
But we cannot let Nonotta outstrip us in Hatching-tide spirit! There must be more we can do...
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_A1_000_000: Let's show off your parasol to the townsfolk!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_A1_000_001: Perhaps we can drum up a crowd with the promise of gifts?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: But of course! We ought to promote our newest addition to the festivities. If we tell even a few Gridanians that these gorgeous accoutrements will be available to those who celebrate with us, word will spread of its own accord!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_03: What's the matter, ? You seem to have taken a sudden, intense interest in my parasol.
Ah, that's it! What better way to draw celebrants than to show them this parasol─and promise them one of their very own?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_04: With that in mind, I shall keep mine unfurled and on display. You use your adventurer's instincts to identify those most in need of egg-themed accessories.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_05: The market is always busy. Let us look for potential celebrants there!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_051: Jihli is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_052: You can leave Jihli behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_053: If you wish to have Jihli accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_054: While you are accompanied, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_055: Enter the glowing area and speak with your quest companions to initiate these bonus conversations. Enjoy exploring your surroundings together!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_06: When I think back to the very first Hatching-tide, it's a marvel just how popular the occasion has become. I have so many people to thank for their efforts─yourself included!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_07: We Dreamers are responsible for all the decorations you see throughout the city. Take that basket over there, for instance. I came up with the idea and Nonotta worked her magic to create the final product!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CHOICE2Q1_000_000: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Jihli?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_08: Ah, do you have some pressing business to attend to? Not to worry, I shall be waiting for you at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre. Seek me out once you are able!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_09: There you are! Let us be off!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENA05243_100_1: I say, madam! You must tell me where I might acquire a resplendent parasol like unto your own.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_110_10: At our Hatching-tide event, of course! How about it? Will you join us at the amphitheatre?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENA05243_000_1: I'd be delighted. As a true connoisseur of eggs both decorative and edible, I attend annually in hopes of glimpsing ovoid perfection, and this parasol surpasses my every imagining. Such elegance! Such egginess!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENB05243_100_1: Why, that parasol is an absolute delight. It's not often you see that level of craftsmanship paired with such decorative flair. This might be the finest egg-inspired apparel I've ever seen! Might I ask who was responsible for this masterpiece?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_110_11: The Leatherworkers' Guild, the Carpenters' Guild, Black Rabbit Traders, and our Dreamers all had their parts to play. And if you join us in celebrating Hatching-tide, you can receive one just like it!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENB05243_000_1: Ah, I should've known that the guilds' artisans were involved. If it means getting my hands on a parasol, I'd be more than happy to take part in the festivities!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENC05243_100_1: Heavens above! Is that adorable parasol fashioned after an Archon egg!?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_110_12: Eggsquisite, isn't it? If you join us at the amphitheatre, you will receive one just like it!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENC05243_000_1: For years I have searched for a parasol as darling as an egg, getting sunburned and soaked by turns, and you offer me one free of charge! 'Tis a Hatching-tide miracle!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_13: I expect those three will tell all and sundry about our parasols. Our work here is done!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENA05243_000_1: This is fine work indeed, but my heart craves something more!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_CITIZENC05243_000_1: <sigh> If only I could find a cute little parasol...
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_143: You must be accompanied by Jihli and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_150: Jihli has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_16: Well, that went rather swimmingly. You clearly have an eye for egg connoisseurs!
I shall go and see how many attendees are gathered at the amphitheatre. Feel free to join us when you have a moment.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_NONOTTA_000_171: The folks you gathered certainly are enthusiastic about showing off their parasols! Fortunately, no one's yet lost an eye.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: Look, ! Isn't the sight of those parasols simply marvelous!?
Eggs held aloft... Just as in my dream!
We certainly did. Shall we officially declare this Hatching-tide a success?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_MAISENTA_100_184: (-???-)Hold that thought. You've yet to see the half of it.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: Maisenta! I'm not quite sure I follow...
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_MAISENTA_100_185: Quite a few of my customers asked about your parasols─more than can comfortably gather here, in fact. Nevertheless, I took the liberty of handing out stock to those who came inquiring.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_MAISENTA_110_185: With how many left my stall with a smile on their face and a parasol in hand, the whole city is awash in floating eggs.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: That's incredible! To think the parasols are bringing joy even beyond our celebration...
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_NONOTTA_100_187: Wait, Jihli! They're one and the same, aren't they? The celebration has spread across the city, borne by a great mass of floating eggs!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: Y-You're right! I was intent on gathering people here, but the eggs in my dream were far too numerous to contain in one place. They were always meant to be seen far and wide.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_18: That our original plans met with misfortune was a blessing in disguise, for we've touched the hearts of more people than I'd dared to imagine. There's no doubt in my mind: this will go down as a Hatching-tide to remember!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_MAISENTA_110_189: Black Rabbit Traders shall continue distributing parasols to those who ask─they may be free of charge, but they're drawing business in spades. Nonotta told me how to assemble them, so I can prepare as many as necessary.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_18: Truly, where would we be without your ingenuity, Nonotta?
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_NONOTTA_000_190: I couldn't have done it without our able adventurer! Ah, that reminds me. I have something for you, .
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_NONOTTA_000_191: That's the very second parasol I ever made─after Jihli's, of course. I thought it fitting that you receive it.
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_19: With eggs aloft across the city, all that's left is to enjoy the festivities. Your work may have finished, , but Hatching-tide most certainly hasn't!
TEXT_FESESX002_05243_SYSTEM_000_200: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_001: Greetings, good ! I am Astrid de Valentione, emissary of ardor and affection. My fellows and I have come to help folks convey the depths of their hearts to a special someone this Valentione's Day!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_002: ...Oh, if it isn't ! 'Tis ever so lovely to see you again─and precisely when I have need of a capable adventurer!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_003: Hmm... Begging your pardons, but you are an adventurer of some experience, are you not? If so, I would dearly appreciate your aid!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_005: Permit me to explain the situation.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_006: For this year's event, we are providing people with bouquets of roses to help them make their feelings known.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_007: But as it happens, the botanist who is kindly providing us with the flowers, a man named Laurovic, appears to be having difficulties of his own in love...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_008: As emissaries, we should like nothing more than to assist him, but we're given to understand the situation is complicated. That being the case, might I trouble you to act in my stead?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_009: We are in your debt! Without further ado, please seek out Laurovic and lend an ear to his woes. He is like to be at the Greatloam Growery.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_010: Laurovic is like to be at the Greatloam Growery. Please seek him out and lend an ear to his woes.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_015: Oh, Sylginie, my love... Where have you gotten to?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_016: Ah! Forgive me, I didn't notice you... Is there something you require?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_017: Miss Astrid sent you to assist me, you say? That's very kind of you both.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_018: You see, there is someone I desperately wish to find...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_019: Allow me to begin from the beginning. A few years ago, an Ishgardian botanist arrived here in Gridania.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_020: Sylginie was her name, and in part due to our shared fondness of roses, we struck up a friendship─a friendship that blossomed into love.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_021: The months that followed were the most wonderful of my life, filled with unforgettable days.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_022: But then one day, she disappeared without a word...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_023: ...Leaving behind only the seeds of a rare variety of rose.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_024: The flowers being given out this Valentione's Day are grown from those very seeds.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_025: It was my hope upon hope that the word of them would reach her, and then she might be compelled to return to me.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_026: And as if in answer to my prayers, who should I spot in the crowd just now but her! She wore the rose earring I gifted her, so there's no mistaking it!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_027: Alas, as I made my frantic way towards her, she vanished amidst the throng... Please help me look for her, I beg you!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_029: Now, Sylginie is an Elezen maiden with silver hair. You'll want to keep an eye out for someone of that description, who has the earring I mentioned.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_030: If you could search near Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, I will do the same in the Ebony Stalls.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_031: Afterwards, let us meet before Fen-Yll Fineries. May the Spinner lead us to Sylginie!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_CITIZEN05251A_000_0: Sylginie...? I am not she, I'm afraid, but I do hope you find her.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYSTEM_000_036: Alas, this woman is not Sylginie.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_CITIZEN05251B_000_0: Oh, this isn't a rose on my earring, but orchids. Though in light of the festivities, a rose would certainly be more fitting.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYSTEM_000_038: Alas, this woman is not Sylginie.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_040: That he should go to such lengths to find me... I love him still, I truly do. But I'm too ashamed to meet him...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_041: I just wished to see the roses that lovers are giving one another. Please tell Laurovic that he should look for me no more. That he should forget me...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_CITIZEN05251A_000_0: I hope you find who you're looking for.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_CITIZEN05251B_000_0: I ought to have worn a rose earring for the festivities.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_045: <sigh> I'm afraid to say I had no luck... Dare I hope you were able to learn something?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_046: What? F-Forget her? She cannot ask me to do such a thing!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_047: Pray excuse my interruption. I am Ser Titouan, a knight of House Haillenarte. Do I have the pleasure of addressing the botanist Laurovic?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_048: The roses being distributed during the current festivities─may I ask where you acquired them?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_049: Those? Why, I grew them from the seeds given to me by my love, Sylginie...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_050: So it is indeed the Driancoin, the rose permitted to be grown by none save our house. To think that she would bring it to a foreign nation...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_052: She tended House Haillenarte's rose gardens until a few years ago, when she vanished without a trace.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_053: Our house takes the rose for its symbol, and the Driancoin is the foremost of all the species. Sylginie had care of them on account of her skills.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_054: But when Coerthas froze over in the Calamity's wake, every last plant withered away. 'Twas believed that she fled out of shame.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_055: When she entrusted me with the seeds, she made no mention of their importance. Why did she give them to me? This is all such a shock...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_056: Indeed. Never did I imagine that the rose would end up not only surviving in a foreign land, but thriving.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_057: So the reason you seek Sylginie...is in order to bring her to account?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_058: While she has violated our laws, she has saved the Driancoin from extinction. As such, I doubt she would face much of a punishment if any. Nevertheless, my duty is to ascertain the truth of the matter.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_059: In that case, will you not allow me to search with you? Though Sylginie bade me to not do so, I cannot bear to do nothing...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_060: Hmm... Mayhap we can have her come to us instead, by devising a rumor that would draw her attention.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_061: Let us try it. As much as it chafes me to deceive her, I'll do what I must to see her again.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_062: Then the question is what manner of rumor to employ. Have you any thoughts?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_A2_000_000: Laurovic has been apprehended by an Ishgardian knight.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_A2_000_001: Laurovic is to duel an Ishgardian knight.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_063: I see... By suggesting that Laurovic has been apprehended on suspicion of the seeds' theft, I daresay Sylginie would come rushing to his defense.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_064: W-We wouldn't actually fight, of course? I can't wield anything save botanist's tools...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_065: On the assumption that Sylginie is aware of your limits, I daresay she would come out of worry for your safety. We needn't go so far as to cross swords.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_066: How about this: I have apprehended you on suspicion of the seeds' theft. I daresay that would bring Sylginie rushing to your defense.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_067: Yes, that may well work. As for the location, I believe the Greatloam Growery would be as suitable a place as any.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_068: Then it is settled. Let us split up and recruit some citizens to our cause. And lest we cause undue commotion, be sure to clarify 'tis but a ruse.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_100_068: Understood. We meet again at the Growery.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_RUMOR05251A_000_075: So you want this rumor to reach the woman with a rose earring? Very well, we shall help! The roses brought my love and I together─this would be a fine chance to give back.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_MAISENTA_000_076: I should be glad to tell our other customers as well, in the spirit of the occasion.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_MAISENTA_000_078: Should it happen to win me Laurovic's favor, and lead to a better deal with the guild for the blossoms we use in our popular rose tea... Well, who am I to argue?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_RUMOR05251B_000_079: Laurovic wishes to be reunited with his love, you say? It would be too tragic if they couldn't be together... You may count on us to spread this rumor far and wide!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_RUMOR05251B_000_080: What? An Ishgardian knight has taken a botanist prisoner!?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_RUMOR05251B_000_081: ...Ohhh, it's just a ruse to find his sweetheart! Well then, consider me part of it. When it comes to endeavors in love, we have to help one another!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_RUMOR05251B_000_082: What? A botanist will duel an Ishgardian knight at the Greatloam Growery!? Don't tell me they're fighting over you!?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_RUMOR05251B_000_083: ...Ohhh, it's just a ruse to find his sweetheart! Well then, consider us part of it. When it comes to endeavors in love, we have to help one another!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_085: There you are. I was able to recruit a good number of citizens to spread the word.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_090: I'm truly grateful for your help, . But I'm beginning to worry that Sylginie won't come...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_091: She must, or else I would have suffered through all of your lovesick rambling for naught.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_092: What? But I was merely expressing the wonders of true love. One day, someone doesn't exist in your life. The next, you cannot imagine life without them...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_095: 'Twas I who made off with the Driancoin seeds, not Laurovic! Release him, I beg you!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_096: Laurovic stands no chance against you! Do not hurt him, I beg you!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_097: This feud relates to you, does it not? Please, help me stop it.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_098: Oh, Sylginie, at long last I've found you! Hear me, my love. Ser Titouan means me no harm, I assure you.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_099: I am sorry for causing you alarm, but I couldn't bear the thought of never seeing you again. And so I spread a false rumor, with help from  and Ser Titouan.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_100: I have heard all about the Driancoin. Will you not tell me why you entrusted me with the seeds and left?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_102: Please believe me when I say it was for the sake of the Driancoin.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_103: The rose wasn't made for the extreme cold that had overtaken Coerthas. Believing the conditions to be ideal in the Black Shroud, I brought the seeds here, where I met you.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_104: But not only did I fail in my duty to my house─I violated its rules as well. I have no right to be happy...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_105: That is why I chose to entrust you with the seeds before disappearing. 'Twas an unkind thing I did to you, and I'm truly sorry.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_106: When I heard that the roses would be handed out during Valentione's Day, I couldn't help but come and see for myself, though I knew that I couldn't stay...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_107: Oh, Sylginie... To think that you carried such a burden...
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_108: But whatever you may have done, you have every right to be happy!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_109: It is thanks to you that the Driancoin now adorns the city, bringing happiness to all. You are a brilliant botanist, and the guild would surely welcome you as a member. Will you not do the honor of growing roses beside me, my love?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_110: 'Tis true you violated the rules of House Haillenarte. Yet you did so with noble intent, and your actions saved our most precious rose from extinction.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_111: In recognition of this, I will speak in your defense. And I will make a recommendation to our house that we officially entrust the growing of the Driancoin to the Botanists' Guild.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_112: Unworthy though I may be, I would gladly grow roses beside you for all my days.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_113: All's well that ends well. Mayhap you would like to say a few words to the happy couple?
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_120: Go on, offer the happy couple a few words.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_121: Thank you for lending Laurovic your aid.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_125: , Ser Titouan. Sylginie and I are reunited, and it is thanks to the two of you.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_126: We shall go and share the happy tidings with Miss Astrid.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_128: My task is done, so I shall return to Ishgard─with my own happy tidings that the Driancoin blooms once more.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_TITOUAN_000_129: In due course, our house will send a representative to make arrangements regarding the care of the rose. Till next time, my young botanists, I bid you farewell.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_130: Will you not come with us to the amphitheatre, ? I'm certain Miss Astrid will wish to see you too.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_131: Oh, to walk with Sylginie at my side again... If this is a dream, then may I never wake up!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYLGINIE_000_132: I will forever cherish the bouquet Laurovic gave me, and I will never forget this day.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_140: Welcome back, ! Laurovic and Sylginie have told me all. On behalf of the emissaries, I thank you for helping them to find one another again!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_LAUROVIC_000_141: You couldn't have sent a better adventurer to my aid. We're in your debt as well, Miss Astrid.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_142: I must say, 'tis truly felicitous that the Driancoin should reunite the people who grew them.
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_ASTRID_000_143: They are a wonderful token of one's love, and should you have a special someone in your heart, , I urge you to present them with a bouquet as well!
TEXT_FESVLX101_05251_SYSTEM_000_144: You have learned the emote Bouquet!
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Well now, if it isn't my adventurer friend . It could only be a blessing from the Navigator that we should meet again here and now.

You are an adventurer, if I am not mistaken. And you are called , you say? Well met, my friend. I am a humble minstrel, and it could only be a blessing from the Navigator that you should approach me here and now.

You see, I have been struggling to find inspiration for a new song to perform this Rising. I have a mind to speak with the locals for their tales, for which I could use your able assistance. Might you be willing to accompany me?
During the Rising, we remember those we lost in the Calamity even as we turn our attention to a brighter future. 'Tis my hope to hear a tale that inspires one and all to look forward.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: During the Rising, we remember those we lost in the Calamity even as we turn our attention to a brighter future. 'Tis my hope to hear a tale that inspires one and all to look forward.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Now then, there is no better place for talk in Limsa Lominsa than the Drowning Wench. Let us first seek out the barkeep, Baderon, and see if he has aught of interest to share.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_008: What's the 'arm? Ye'll get yerself killed, that's the 'arm. I ain't lettin' one so young sign up.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_009: Why do ye wants to become an adventurer so badly anyway, R'tcha?
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_010: There's this place I need to go to. The problem is, the Yellowjackets won't let a child leave the city alone.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_011: But if I was an adventurer, I'd be responsible for myself. I could go wherever I please, whenever I please. So please, let me sign up!
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_013: I've got a responsibility to those I sign up. If I let someone what's clearly unprepared 'ead out there an' they end up 'urt or worse, I wouldn't be able to live it down.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_014: An' don't even get me started on the damage it'd cause the guild's reputation. So ye can forget about signin' up until yer older. Much older.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_015: But it has to be now, during the Rising! Hmph, why do you have to be so...so...responsible!?
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_016: It comes with age, lass. Now, run along an' get yerself 'ome.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_018: Ah, sorry ye 'ad to see that. The little cub's bent on becomin' an' adventurer, but I said no an' sent 'er on 'er way.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SDHODJBI_000_019: Still, I can't help but worry. She doesn't strike me as the sort to give up easily.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_020: True, that... Wouldn't surprise me a whit if she tried to sneak out anyway.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_021: I 'ate to impose, but do ye reckon ye could keep an eye on R'tcha? I'd do it meself, but I can't up an' leave the tavern.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The timing of the Rising seemed to be of the essence to the little one. Intriguing, would you not agree? Let us ask her about that.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_023: I'm in yer debt. Now, the nearest city exit's the Tempest Gate, over by the Aftcastle. I suggest ye begin by talkin' to Klindrael, the sentry yonder.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_BADERON_000_024: I'd forgotten 'ow right stubborn younglings can be. The gates are watched, so I don't think R'tcha'll come to 'arm, but I feel better knowin' yer keepin' an eye on 'er too.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_SDHODJBI_000_025: Lominsan children are a boisterous lot, to put it mildly. Forbid them from doing something, and you all but guarantee that they will do it.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: The Yellowjackets keep constant watch at every city gate. If R'tcha has come through, they will have surely seen her.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_KLINDRAEL_000_030: The lowlands of La Noscea await you on the other side of the Tempest Gate.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_KLINDRAEL_000_031: At Baderon's behest, you say? As it happens, a girl of that description did come through just a moment ago.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_KLINDRAEL_000_032: She was at the heels of a Miqo'te peddler, so at a glance one might think them parent and child, but the way she kept stealing glances behind her made me suspicious.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_KLINDRAEL_000_033: So I alerted my comrade Ayoyo outside, and I expect she's stopped the little one for questioning. If you're worried, you should seek her out.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Our thanks for the information. We shall find your comrade at once.
'Tis well the Yellowjackets noticed her ere she had gotten far.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_036: Damn it, they saw straight through my disguise...
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_040: Well now, if it ain't the good minstrel an' our kindly 'elper! Pleasure to see the two o' ye again. What brings ye 'ere today?
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_041: An' who might the two o' ye be?
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_042: So Baderon sent ye after the little one... I was jus' about to ask 'er what she's up to.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_043: R'tcha, was it, dearie? Even without others tellin' ye, ye ought to know it's dangerous out 'ere.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_044: What is it that ye want to do so badly, ye'd risk yer life like this?
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_045: There's something that I need to see. It doesn't matter if it's dangerous. I have to go.
