TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: We understand that you have your reasons, R'tcha. Even so, we cannot in good conscience allow you to wander the wilds alone.
So here I would make a proposal. Rather than becoming an adventurer, why not employ the services of one?
With a dependable adventurer at your side, you would be able to reach your destination safely. This, I believe, is your best option.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_049: But...I don't have any money. And what adventurer would want to help a child anyway?
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Why, our friend here, of course.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_A50_000_003: As long as I get paid...
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_A50_000_004: If you're happy with this humble vagrant.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: I shall be glad to provide suitable recompense in R'tcha's stead. While a part of me hopes that this will lead to inspiration for a song, above all, I feel compelled to lend a helping hand.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_052: You'll really help me? Oh, thank you so much!
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_053: I'm glad it worked out fer ye. But as a client, there's somethin' ye need to bear in mind.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_054: That is, ye've got to give the adventurer yer trust. Be honest with what exactly it is ye need, an' 'll be able to help ye all the better.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_055: The place I want to go to is a lighthouse here in lower La Noscea. It's named for one of the Twelve.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_056: I heard a rumor from a kid in town, you see. He told me that ghosts appear there during the Rising.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_057: They're supposedly lighthouse keepers who died in the Calamity, and they spirit children away to the realm of the dead. But that's got to be nonsense, and I want to prove it!
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_058: O' the two lighthouses in the area, Oschon's Torch is the only one as civilians can still get to. Don't recall 'earin' nothin' about ghosts, though...
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_059: I can't 'elp but be curious, so I'll come along. 'Avin' a Yellowjacket with ye oughta make things easier, I reckon.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_060: That's outside of a skirmish, anyway. Bein' a cannoneer, I'm more at 'ome blastin' things from a distance. If we run into angry fiends on the road, they're all yers.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: If young R'tcha is heading to Oschon's Torch, then someone should report as much to Baderon.
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_AYOYO_000_062: As I said, I'd never 'eard about ghosts appearin' at the lighthouse. Wonder why R'tcha's so interested in 'em...
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_064: ... I'll remember that. Thank you so much for helping me!
TEXT_FESANX101_05297_RTCHA_000_065: We'll go to Oschon's Torch, and we'll see if the rumor about the ghosts is true!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: If young R'tcha is heading to Oschon's Torch, then someone should report as much to Baderon.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_002: As I said, I'd never 'eard about ghosts appearin' at the lighthouse. Wonder why R'tcha's so interested in 'em...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: As much as I would like to accompany you, someone should return to the Drowning Wench to apprise Baderon of these developments.
Besides, to hear your accounts afterwards─what you learned and felt─will also bring unique inspiration. I wish you an enjoyable and insightful excursion.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_006: Right, to begin with, 'ow about we 'ead east to Madman Bridge? It'd give R'tcha a chance to see the sights.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_007: The path can be steep in places, so take care ye don't take a tumble, now.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_008: I'll be fine, don't worry! Let the adventure begin!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_009: An' 'ere it is─Madman Bridge. If ye 'ead north, ye'll get to the Red Rooster Stead, but our destination takes us south.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_010: A vital route fer trade, is the bridge, but it prowls with bandits an' fiends beyond. That's why it was given its name, as a warnin' to younglings.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_011: Look, a river! And there's some sort of strange animal!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_012: We sometimes see children out this way with their folks, but I take it ye've never been?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_013: Actually, I have. It was a long time ago, though. Before my parents died in the Calamity.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_014: It's alright. I like it at the orphanage. Everyone's really nice, and I have lots of fun.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_015: That'd be Llymlaen's Shoals, I take it?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_016: It's an orphanage run by a former Sanguine Siren, in case ye wasn't aware. A fine place by all accounts.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_017: If that's where R'tcha's from, I'll 'ave one o' me comrades contact 'er caretakers. Wouldn't do to let 'em think she's missin'.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_018: Right then, next we'll make fer Oschon's Embrace, up this 'ere 'ill. Take it slow so ye don't wear yerself down.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_019: Me fellow Yellowjackets patrol these parts. Lest ye worry, they know I ain't on some pleasure jaunt.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_020: Whoa! We're so high up! This is amazing!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_021: Hehe, I felt the same way when I looked out from 'ere fer the first time.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_022: This bridge was built where a tidal wave sundered the land durin' the Calamity. It's a symbol o' our people's determination to rise above tragedy.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_023: Miss Dorathia─that's the headmistress─said that we Lominsans work hard because we hate to lose and like what we do.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_100_023: What about you, ? Do you like being an adventurer?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_A50_000_002: I wouldn't want to be anything else.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_A50_000_004: I'd rather not work at all, to be honest.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_024: Hehe, that's what I thought. When I grow up, I hope I'll like what I do as well!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_025: Really? I guess it's not so simple...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_026: Really!? I guess it's not so simple...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_027: My parents liked what they did, I think. When the Calamity struck, they didn't run away. They were noble souls, Miss Dorathia said.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_028: She promised to tell me everything one day, but I don't know how to feel when they're gone, and...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_029: Ungh, I can't find the words. I want to be a good client, though, so I'll think on it.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_030: Seems R'tcha's got somethin' she needs to get off 'er chest. In wantin' to verify the rumor, mayhap she... Ah, but there's no use speculatin'. Come, let's press on.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_033: That there's Oschon's Torch, one o' two lighthouses 'ere what are named fer gods.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_034: The lighthouse keeper's a bloke named Rostnzeh. Ye can ask 'im about ghosts an' anythin' else ye like.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_036: So, about the reason why I want to know about the ghosts...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_037: My father and mother were lighthouse keepers, you see. But they disappeared during the Calamity and were never found.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_038: When I heard the rumor, I thought that maybe─just maybe─they were the ones haunting the lighthouse.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_039: So that's why ye want to prove the rumor wrong. Ye couldn't stand people thinkin' yer parents were doin' terrible things.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_040: Aye... But a part of me wishes that the rumor was true. Then I'd be able to talk to my parents again. There's so many things I'd like to ask them...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_041: Well, whatever the truth is, we'll find out soon. Let's keep going!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_042: I can understand the desire to see those who're gone─to say words to them ye couldn't in life. It's a feelin' everyone knows at some point.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_050: Whoa, the sea's frozen in a splash! Amazing!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_051: This area was 'ard 'it by the Calamity. On top o' the tidal wave washin' away big swaths o' land, a piece o' Dalamud came crashin' down yonder.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_052: They say it caused aether to gush out o' the land an' crystallize all at once.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_053: At that time, I was with Miss Dorathia. She was my mother's friend, and she took me to a safe place.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_054: I was very little then. I didn't fully understand what was happening. But the Calamity really was a frightful thing...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_055: I can't imagine how it was for Father and Mother...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_056: Rostnzeh's been 'ere since the Calamity. It's lonely work, an' 'e's always glad to 'ave guests.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_057: Even if there aren't any ghosts, I...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_058: Well now, if it ain't guests. What brings ye to the Torch?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_060: Ghosts durin' the Risin'... For all me years as a keeper, I've not seen nor heard about such things at any lighthouse I know. It's certainly the sort of place as children might believe haunted, though. Might be as someone mistook me or some laundry for a specter.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_061: So Father and Mother weren't ghosts after all...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_062: But I must say, it's a surprise to see R'atoh's little girl here. Yer parents showed me the ropes when I was startin' out as a keeper.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_063: They had charge o' Llymlaen's Ring yonder. Nowadays it's on a little isle, but there used to be a stretch o' land connectin' it.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_064: A dangerous stretch it was, rife with nasty beasts. Ye needed to hire adventurers, and grizzled ones at that, just to deliver supplies.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_065: If you knew my parents, please tell me about them!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_066: They left me in Limsa Lominsa during the Calamity and died in the tidal wave.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_067: Why did they go out there even though it was so dangerous? What was going through their minds? I want to know...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_068: I was stationed elsewhere at the time, so I only read this in a report...but your folks did everythin' they could to protect Llymlaen's Ring.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_069: They built a breakwater, usin' anythin' and everythin' they had on hand. But in the end there was no stoppin' such a monstrous wave.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_070: Countless souls went missin' when it struck, an' the Maelstrom mounted search and rescue operations. I joined in the effort, but I'm afraid they were never found...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_071: Know, though, that yer folks didn't die in vain. By manning their lighthouse to the very end that day, they guided many vessels safely to shore and saved many lives.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_072: I see... They really were noble souls, like Miss Dorathia said.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_073: But if I could choose, I wish that they were still here...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_074: This is just a thought, but how'd ye like to stay the night and hear more about yer folks?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_ROSTNZEH_000_075: It'd only be the mundane, everyday things, but what I know, I'd be glad to share with ye.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_076: I'd like that! I'd like that very much!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_100_100: I got up early to look at the lighthouse. Where my father and mother used to be...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_101: For the longest time, I'd felt as though they'd abandoned me.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_102: I wanted to see them one more time so I could ask them why they had to go. And to tell them that I miss them.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_A52_000_003: Are you disappointed there weren't any ghosts?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_103: In the end, there weren't any ghosts. Still, I'm glad I could learn about my parents.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_104: Maybe a little. Still, I'm glad I could learn about my parents.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_105: It made me realize that I want to become someone who helps others. Like them and like you.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_106: So thank you! For bringing me here!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_107: Well, it ended up bein' a longer jaunt than expected, but I'm glad we did it.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_108: Thank you so much for coming with me, both of you!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_109: Yer very welcome, dearie. Ye can always come to me if ye need anythin'. Just no more tryin' to sneak out, ye 'ear?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_RTCHA_000_110: Well, I better get back to the orphanage. Hopefully Miss Dorathia won't be too mad at me...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_111: Ye'll be wantin' to report to the minstrel, I expect? In which case, a comrade o' mine tells me 'e's at the Anchor Yard.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_AYOYO_000_112: I'll see to it R'tcha gets 'ome safely. Be sure to catch the special fireworks afterwards, eh?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Ah, welcome back, my friend. Was young R'tcha able to find that which she sought?
So her true purpose was to see if the ghosts were her parents who were taken by the Calamity...
A tale is born when someone acts in the name of another. As there are so many tales out there, it is impossible for us to know every single one.
Yet a tale may occasionally find its way to those who need it most. Such as that of the lighthouse keepers, whose courage and sacrifice have come to guide their child years after their passing.
Thank you, . Not only for granting R'tcha's wish, but for providing me with inspiration as well.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: While we wait for the special fireworks to begin, might you tell me more of your excursion?
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Yes, it comes to me... A verse for all who strive onwards, this day and every day...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_60: (-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.
'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
'Tis a pleasure to meet you again. As I have in the past, I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude.
For long years, we have walked together with you on this grand adventure.
It is a never-ending journey, one that shall continue tomorrow as surely as it does today. The most natural of things.
Along the way, I have endeavored to keep my gaze firmly fixed upon the future.
Of late, however, I have been keenly reminded that we must occasionally look back upon the path we walked, that we might remember the lessons learned.
In the course of our adventures, it seems that I too have grown.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: To learn from successes and failures both, and forge ahead with humility and sincerity...
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_61: This is what I had resolved to do at journey's beginning, and I resolve to do so anew.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_YOSHIDANAOKI_200_61: Nothing would please us more than to continue having you at our side on the road ahead.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_YOSHIDANAOKI_300_61: And I pray that, upon this journey of life that we have the honor to share, the light of the Crystal shall ever shine!
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
This world shall yet endure. And as we continue to make our way, I pray that we shall have occasion to meet again.
Till that day, I wish you the happiest of journeys. Fare you well.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Most happenings in our lives have no bearing on the fate of the world. More often than not, they go unobserved and unremarked.
But you, my friend, gather up such forgotten tales and see them delivered. In so doing you bring joy, and as a token of my gratitude, I dedicate to you this song─a song of journeys fulfilling.

In gleaming gold the sun does rise,
The boundless sky it calls.♪
In silver pale the path of men,
A white and endless pall.♪

So far away the guiding light,
That you do now espy.♪
But flames of life their warmth impart,
To comfort and inspire.♪
Take heart, my friend, for here we stand,
And so we shall remain.♪
Your destination reach you shall,
By memory's refrain.♪
I have no doubt that you, R'tcha, and Ayoyo shall give rise to a great many more tales.
Your tales, in particular, may be more varied than those of others. There may be times when you face great hardships, and the weight is more than you can bear.
In such a time, I bid you remember this: no matter how great your burdens, the tales that you have gathered shall ever be your strength─a beacon to light your way in the darkness.
TEXT_FESANX102_05298_SYSTEM_000_800: You have unlocked the toy chest. Open the toy chest found in any inn room to play mini-games.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Ahoy, ! Wishing you could sail away from the summer heat? This year's Moonfire Faire has exactly what you need!
Ahoy, adventurer! Wishing you could sail away from the summer heat? This year's Moonfire Faire has exactly what you need!
Our festival is the valorously perspiring face of the Adventurers' Guild, so I beg that you partake in our offerings.
This year's star attraction is the Queen Lhaminn, a ship fully remodeled into the ultimate seaside resort!
If you seek thrills─and some much-needed chill─head to Costa del Sol and speak with Chief Chaperone Haermaga.
We would love for you to join us in Costa del Sol! You will join us, won't you?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_010: Ah, ! Precisely who I was hoping to see. Mayaru Moyaru sent you to help us, I expect?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_011: Ah, now here's a strapping ! Precisely who I was hoping to see. Mayaru Moyaru sent you to help us, I expect?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_012: Well, don't be a stranger. Come up, and I'll tell you all about our event.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_015: Welcome aboard the Queen Lhaminn! First, an overview of her facilities.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_016: This venue was designed to incorporate Eorzea's premier summertime recreations. You name it, we have it.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_017: Water chutes, a deluxe swimming bath, a performance area, and...for the true thrill seekers...cannon rides!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_018: Master Gegeruju spared no expense for this year's faire, and its novelty has garnered swarms of visitors.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_019: But when you're out on the water, there's no telling when disaster might strike. Fortunately, we've hand-selected a team of elite swimmers for just such an eventuality.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_020: Lhaminn's Coastguard is standing by to help visitors in need!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_021: It is to this force that I would recruit you, provided you're willing.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_A1_000_001: Any incentives I should know about?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_022: You will, of course, be compensated─and the stylish, Ul'dahn-made uniform will be yours to keep!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_023: Your first task will be a simple patrol. Speak with our guests and ensure everyone is having a safe and enjoyable time here.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_024: Checking in with your colleagues is also standard protocol. Once you've made your rounds, report back to me.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_025: Ah, but your uniform! Ask P'obyano and she'll find one in your size.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_026: Get dressed and start patrolling, guards. I'm counting on you!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_POBYANO_000_035: Thanks for joining the Coastguard! Let's get you dressed for the job.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_POBYANO_000_036: Now, where did I put the -sized uniforms...? Ah, here we are.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_POBYANO_000_037: Off you go, then! These facilities won't patrol themselves.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SYSTEM_000_038: You must continue wearing your Coastguard uniform in order to progress.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SYSTEM_000_039: You will change back to your normal garments if you move too far away. Look to your map for the garment change's area of effect.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SYSTEM_000_040: Speak with P'obyano to restore or prolong the transfiguration.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_045: You'll need to be properly dressed for your patrol. P'obyano will have a uniform in your size.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_046: Well now, you cut quite a dashing figure! Let me know if you spot any trouble on your patrol.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_POBYANO_000_047: Allow me to adjust your uniform. Hold still...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_POBYANO_000_048: ...What happened to your uniform? Actually, never mind. I'll fetch another.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENA05321_000_0: This thrill... <pant>... It speaks to me... <pant>...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SYSTEM_000_054: You must be wearing the uniform provided by P'obyano in order to progress.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENA05321_000_0: This thrill... <pant>... It speaks to me! And now I simply must speak to you!
My great-grandmother...she originally hailed from the south sea isles, where our people catapult themselves into the treetops to dislodge coconuts.
“Is a cannon ride a catapult?” I thought. Only one way to find out, and so I recklessly launched myself, rocketing through the air as my courageous ancestors once did!
Yes... To honor their memory, I think I'll go another round!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_059: Are you enjoying the Queen Lhaminn, my friend? Worry not, for the brave men and women of Lhaminn's Coastguard shall ensure the safety of all.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_060: Joined the Coastguard, have you? From this post, I shall keep a watchful eye on our cannon riders.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_061: And in such comfort! Here in the water, this magnificent uniform is as a second skin!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_062: The artisan who stitched these is unmistakably a master of their craft. Were I to have the opportunity, I should very much like to thank them.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HILDELANA_000_063: Hmmm... If only I had some help here...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HILDELANA_000_065: Oh, fantastic! I was just hoping another guard would come along. There's a bit of trouble...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENB05321_000_0: It's hard to see from the surface, but this beam's starting to splinter. Thought I'd alert the Coastguard before someone gets hurt.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HILDELANA_000_067: I wanted to report the issue straightaway, but I need to make sure that other guests do not approach this area...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HILDELANA_000_068: Could you consult Haermaga about this in my stead? We'd do well to send for repairs.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENB05321_000_0: Much obliged to the both of you. We're all in safe hands with you lot on patrol!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_075: Say it for me one more time! If ever you're in danger or need assistance, seek the color...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_077: Right you are! Lhaminn's Coastguard is working tirelessly to ensure the safety of all. May our yellow garb shine like a beacon for those in need!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_080: Wait─is that you, !? I didn't know you joined the Coastguard! Oh, it's a dream to be working alongside a famed adventurer like you!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_081: Oh, my apologies! I didn't see you there. Another adventurer come to join the Coastguard, I take it?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_082: As you can see, I'm teaching our guests how to spot us. Lucky we're all wearing this eye-catching shade of yellow, eh?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_083: ...Hold on. You don't suppose the artisan who crafted our uniforms chose this color for that very purpose, do you!?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_084: What an astonishing level of forethought. I'd better put as much effort into my lecture as the weaver put into this uniform!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_085: Thank you, master artisan, wherever you may be!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HILDELANA_000_086: Don't forget to mention the splintering beam to Haermaga, all right?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENB05321_100_0: Another guard, I take it? If you have a moment, I need to speak with you and your comrade here.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENB05321_110_0: Keep your distance, . We're resolving a safety concern at the moment.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_087: Every onze of consideration sewn into this uniform will be passed on directly to our guests. I'll make sure of that!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RMAJHA_000_088: Those uniforms sort of look like the Yellowjackets of Limsa Lominsa. Are they supposed to?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENC05321_000_0: Anxious as I am to see what's aboard the Queen Lhaminn, I'd be a fool not to listen to the Coastguard's lecture. Safety first, as they say!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_CITIZENC05321_100_0: Right─if I have any concerns, I now know exactly who to look for. Full speed ahead!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_110_089: Gone on break, have you? Be sure to retrieve your uniform from P'obyano before you resume your shift.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_090: Welcome back, my friend. Anything to report?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_091: The water chutes have a splintering support beam? I'll arrange for repairs straightaway.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_092: As for our other guests, I'm glad to hear that all is well. It sounds like our uniforms are serving their purpose admirably. No doubt the weaver who made them would be glad to hear─
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_094: Someone is in need! Quick, take this spyglass and find them!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_SYSTEM_000_100: Search your surroundings for the distressed guest. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target an area and inspect it with .
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_101: Over there? Leave it to me!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_102: Phew... Who knew this thin fabric would feel so heavy in the water? Should have thought to wear a uniform myself.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_103: (-Rescued Guest-)I can't thank you enough. My leg seized up, and the current began pulling me out to sea...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_104: You should come and rest awhile on deck. We have a healer aboard who can take a look at you.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_105: I confess, I'd hoped to introduce the two of you in a more dignified fashion, but ah well.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_106: Anyroad, let's return to the Queen Lhaminn. I'll explain everything there.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_107: Hurry! Time is of the essence!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_108: There you are, . Go and get dressed, and I'll tell you the glad tidings.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_110: Good news! According to the healer, no lasting harm was done─and we have your sharp eye to thank for it.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_111: Now then, it's time the two of you were properly acquainted. This woman is none other than─
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_113: We just got word of the rescue. Is the poor soul all right?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_114: Ah, you three. All is well, all is well.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_115: Allow me to introduce T'zanza, the Ul'dahn weaver responsible for the peerless uniforms you're all wearing.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_116: (-T'zanza-)An honor to make your acquaintance. I was anxious to see if my pieces were functioning as intended, so I decided to participate in the festivities as a guest.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_117: (-T'zanza-)I'm afraid my exhaustion from work caught up to me at a critical moment... I can only apologize for the trouble I've caused.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_118: No trouble at all! Your successful rescue is but proof that your clever design functions precisely as you intended─is that not so?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_119: (-T'zanza-)That's true. Even at a considerable distance, my eyes were naturally drawn to that vivid yellow...
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_120: (-T'zanza-)I am glad to know that my design does what little it can to help keep people safe.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_RFHULTIA_000_121: You're too humble by half! These uniforms give us the confidence to do our jobs, both in and out of the water!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_122: (-T'zanza-)Truly? You're too kind. Now I can return to my atelier with an easy heart.
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_123: Leaving so soon? Surely you've earned a break from your work. Come, stay awhile!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_124: And speaking of earning things─that uniform is now yours, . May you wear it with pride!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_BEAUDEFOIN_000_125: Oh, how very generous, Haermaga. You fully intend to prevail upon  aid for the remainder of the festival, don't you?
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_126: N-No, I─! Bah, break time's over! Back to work, the lot of you!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_HAERMAGA_000_127: As for you, , feel free to enjoy the faire to your heart's content─but as always, safety first!
TEXT_FESSUX101_05321_TZANZA_000_128: Oh, don't worry about me. I'm feeling much better now that I've caught my breath.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_CITIZEN05322_000_00: Fair stranger, did you hear of the sensational Gold Saucer festivities currently underway?
All who participate are entitled to a handsome MGP bonus, not to mention discounts on a bevy of prizes. A simply unmissable opportunity, I'm sure you'll agree!
What's more, I gather they're hosting special Triple Triad classes for younglings─all taught by the cardinal of cards himself, King Elmer III!

Which reminds me... A rather peculiar rumor concerning the king has been circulating recently. My friend Ollier works at the Saucer, and by his telling, it's causing much consternation among the staff.

Judging by your indomitable gaze and well-worn garb, I'd wager you're an adventurer. If any of this has whet your appetite for intrigue, I suggest you journey to Card Square and speak with Ollier directly.
Ah, look at me blabbering on! I'd best be off, for I shan't rest until every Ul'dahn in this fine city is privy to the Gold Saucer festivities!
If you've not yet had the pleasure of visiting, I suggest you speak with that well-heeled youth over there. I hear he has a spare ticket or two. Perhaps he'll deign to furnish you with one.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SYSTEM_000_007: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_010: Well, I never! If it isn't  . It's a pleasure to see you again. Which of our myriad games and entertainments will you be dabbling in today?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_011: You came all this way to discuss the rumor with me? I'm touched that you'd take interest in what must seem a trifling matter, but if you're willing, I'd be ever so grateful for your assistance─
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_020: Allow me to bid you a warm welcome to the Manderville Gold Saucer. How might I be of service?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_021: You came all this way to discuss the rumor with this humble attendant? I'm touched that you'd take interest in what must seem a trifling matter, but if you're willing, I'd be ever so grateful for your assistance─
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_100_03: I thought it best that I myself inform you of the details.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_03: I am King Elmer, and while it's not technically royal blood coursing through these veins, my reign over Card Square is absolute. Of all our Triple Triad-playing staff, I am without question the strongest.
Alas, an unsavory rumor threatens to topple my metaphorical crown. There are mutterings that the king is no more skilled than a fresh-faced novice...
I am the final hurdle before fledgling players go on to challenge the realm's best Triple Triad tacticians. Overcoming my curated strategies is paramount to their future standing.
And yet my prowess is called into question!? Inconceivable!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_100_035: This ordeal has proven rather stressful for King Elmer III. As I'm sure you can appreciate, even the most level-headed among us can...unravel during times of crisis.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_110_035: It's worth noting that our records don't indicate any crushing defeats of the like to blemish his reputation. As far as the Gold Saucer is concerned, King Elmer III continues to fulfill his duties with the utmost skill and professionalism.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_03: Painstakingly have I honed my skills─analyzed countless techniques! All that I might provide our guests with thrilling experiences!
If this rumor isn't contained, the very meaning of challenging me would be lost!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_038: These murmurings affect not just the king himself but the entirety of Card Square and all who would test their mettle within its gilded confines. We must act swiftly to ensure they spread no further.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_039: Before you arrived, we established that none of our colleagues are the origin of the rumor, but the task remains to find those responsible. Can we count on your aid?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_040: Thank you, adventurer! Your assistance is most appreciated.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_04: As much as I'd like to help, between my regular duties and teaching the younglings, I simply don't have the time. Please do accept my apologies.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_042: I propose we split up and question some of the patrons. I shall begin my inquiries in Round Square, which leaves Wonder Square in your capable hands.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_043: Let us reconvene in the aetheryte plaza shortly.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_050: I don't suppose I could have a moment of your time? I have a few questions concerning a rumor currently circulating...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_05: This kingly mantle may be a mere work uniform, but when it comes to cards, I'm deadly serious!

Owing to my formidable skills, I must hold back when facing my opponents, but I commit myself to each match with complete sincerity. Like every contender here in Card Square, my chief aim is to entertain!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORA05322_000_0: If yer after the king, I just spotted him here in the square losin' a round of Triple Triad. He got absolutely trounced. Must be something goin' on...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORB05322_000_0: The rumor must've passed me by, but I just spotted King Elmer III striding off toward Event Square. To catch a glimpse of him roaming the Saucer─why, it's a gift from the Spinner Herself!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORC05322_000_0: The notion that the king is anything but a consummate master of Triple Triad is preposterous! I heard he was around here somewhere, though... Where could he have gotten to?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORA05322_000_0: I reckon he lost on purpose, mind. All this “rumor” business must be in aid of an event or somethin'.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORB05322_000_0: The king was headed towards Event Square! Perhaps he's off to teach some darling little young ones about the wonders of Triple Triad?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORC05322_000_0: That rumor is utter drivel! King Elmer III is a force to be reckoned with at the card tables. Strange that he should be wandering around here in the first place...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_100: Ah, adventurer. How fares your investigation?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_101: Your findings mirror my own. For a blessing, it seems few patrons actually believe the rumor.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_102: Although, the sightings of a “king” wandering around outside Card Square are cause for concern. As far as I'm aware, King Elmer III hasn't left his table...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_A1_000_001: A second king walks among us!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_A1_000_002: We have an impostor on our hands.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_103: When you put it that way, it sounds rather exciting! Alas, this second “king” is nothing more than a pretender.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_104: I am of the very same mind.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_105: Their motives are unclear, but if they are indeed the source of the rumor, it behooves us to act. Let us make for Event Square and seek out this false king.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_106: I have yet to spy the pretender, though I remain convinced they are here in the square. Pray lend your keen eyes to the search.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORD05322_000_1: King Elmer III, what are the chances!? We must duel!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: (-King Elmer III?-)But of course. Prepare yourself for a royal thrashing!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_VISITORD05322_000_1: Huzzah! I beat the king! 'Tis true what they say, you're as weak as they come!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: (-King Elmer III?-)B-Bested by one of my subjects? Oh, the shame!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_114: Adventurer! Have you sighted the pretender?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_115: There he is, our false king. Let us approach.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: Say, do you fine folks partake in the delights of Triple Triad? If you're in the mood for a round or two, King Elmer III shall be glad to oblige!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_A2_000_002: I daresay we've found the source of the rumor.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_A2_000_003: For a king of cards, you seem awfully devoid of talent.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: U-Usurper!? How dare you. It is I, King Elmer III!
R-Rumor? What in the seven hells are you talking about?
N-No need to be so scathing! I'm doing my very best, I'll have you know.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_10: Wait, you're a Gold Saucer attendant!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: Curses. You're here to detain me, aren't you...
No, I won't let you! I'm not ready to give up my crown!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SYSTEM_000_160: You recover a King Elmer III card safe and secure within a protective case. You had better present your find to Ollier.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_170: Please accept my apologies for dashing off like that. I'm afraid my efforts were in vain... I soon lost sight of him. Oh, did you find something?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_180: A King Elmer III card. These were commissioned as an exclusive gift for his most ardent fans.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_181: For Triple Triad enthusiasts, King Elmer III's unwavering dedication to the game inspires respect and devotion in equal measure.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_182: I'd be willing to bet our impostor is one such fan. With that in mind, I'd like to see this card returned to him...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_183: Though I fear he'll simply flee should we approach him directly. We'll need to devise a plan.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_STAFF05322_000_191: Now then, don't fret. We'll make an announcement, and your mother will soon come and get you.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_STAFF05322_000_193: Absolutely! How about we head somewhere easier to find?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_A3_000_001: Let's summon him with an announcement!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_A3_000_002: We could use that card of his as bait and lure him out.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_200: Of course! I'll announce that we've found a lost card─if he's half the King Elmer III fan I suspect he is, he'll soon come to collect it!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_201: I shall make arrangements right away. In the meantime, I'd ask that you wait by the main counter for the impostor to appear.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_210: (-Saucer Announcement-)A King Elmer III Triple Triad card was recovered in Event Square. We kindly ask the rightful owner to present themself at the main counter.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: Praise Nymeia! I feared I'd lost you for good... Hm?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_21: I thought I might offer Ollier assistance during my break─little did I know I'd be chasing down an impostor! I can only presume this is him.
You there. Having a novice masquerade as the king is a grave threat to the order of Triple Triad. If word spreads that I'm a feeble opponent, what thrill is there to be had in challenging me?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: F-Forgive me... That was never my intention.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_216: Why commit to such a guise in the first place?
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: Look, I love Triple Triad, but I'm hopeless when it comes to playing. I thought that mimicking you would somehow make me stronger─give me a taste of victory...
Then one day, someone mistook me for the real king. I got carried away and started pretending I was you. Obviously, that's no way to improve my game, but...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_21: Forget my kingly comportment, it's methods and tactics you must imitate! Only after rigorous analysis of your foes' stratagems will you grow stronger.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_22: When I began my journey, I struggled immensely. But by studying my opponents─learning and leveraging their skills─I gradually improved, and thus developed my own identity as a player.

Of course, it didn't come easy. Some opponents were difficult to mimic, and only after countless defeats did I carve a path to the throne. In a sense, the “king” is a composite of all those players I bested along the way.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_222: From your telling, the concept of imitation is clearly an intrinsic part of the game...
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_22: Indeed. To succeed in the world of Triple Triad, you must seek out worthy opponents, commit their tactics to memory, and build up your repertoire. I look forward to the day you face me─not as some pale imitation, but as a fully fledged player with your very own identity!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_THEKINGSIMPOSTOR_00: Just you wait! One day I'll be ready to challenge the real King Elmer! Oh, and sorry again for all the trouble I've caused.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_22: As it seems the rumor has caused little damage, I'm inclined towards lenience. I hope that strikes you as agreeable, adventurer.
Right, I believe that's case closed. I'm glad we were able to resolve this before any lasting harm was done. You have my gratitude.
I better get back to Card Square. Do drop by sometime!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_KINGELMERIII_000_24: I appreciate your aid, adventurer. Whenever you wish to face the great King Elmer, I'll be here, ready and waiting atop my proverbial throne!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_250: I'm relieved we were able to nip this in the bud. By way of thanks, please accept this King Elmer III card.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_251: It's one of the very first we had printed, from those reserved by King Elmer III himself. A rarity among rarities, if you will.
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_OLLIER_000_252: Anyhow, with the festivities still in full swing, I do hope you stay and unwind. After all this talk of Triple Triad, I imagine you're itching to put your acquisition to the test in Card Square!
TEXT_FESGSC901_05322_SYSTEM_000_253: You have learned the emote Overreact!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_001: Oh! Well met, friend. I am Astrid, emissary of love and ardor. Though the Valentione's Day celebrations are underway, I'm afraid that we are still preparing for the main event of the day.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_003: ...Why, if it isn't ! It is a pleasure to see you again.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_004: And I am Emilie, aspiring emissary of love! Say, you have the air of an adventurer about you.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_005: We're in dire need of assistance to see the festivities get underway, and an adventurer might be just what we're looking for. If it's not too much of an imposition, might I ask for your aid?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_100_005: Oh, thank you! We've been hard at work getting everything ready for today. I even designed this fetching new outfit! And everything was perfectly in hand until we ran into a spot of bother.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_006: Allow me to explain: to celebrate Valentione's Day, we were to serve rather generously sized cakes to be shared with one and all. However, operations ground to a halt at the last minute, leaving our plans─and cakes─half-baked...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_007: The emissaries dispatched to assess the situation should be returning presently with further details. Would you mind joining us at the amphitheatre entrance to meet them?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_010: If you would join us at the entrance, it shouldn't be long before the emissaries arrive.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_015: It's most heartening to have your aid. The giant cakes are the keystone of this Valentione's Day, you see!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_020: Oh, it's bakery bedlam in there, kupo! Those pesky mammets should be creating confectionaries brimming with ardor and affection, but instead, they insist on being a nuisance and an obstruction. It was all too much for us to handle alone...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_021: As I suspected, this may be best left to someone more skilled in the art of physical altercations...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_022: I'm sure you remember Kupka Kupp, our moogle emissary of love, messenger of ardor and affection to lovelorn souls the realm over. This year, once again, he has been kind enough to pitch in with the festivities!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_023: This is Kupka Kupp, our moogle emissary of love who labors tirelessly to deliver missives of ardor and affection to lovelorn souls the realm over. He has been instrumental in the celebrations of many a Valentione's Day!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_024: How could I turn down a request for aid after hearing the plan for such lavish deliveries of love, kupo? Many paws make light work, as they say, so I collared a fellow mog and flew over posthaste to lend our aid to the pâtissiers of House Valentione!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_025: These deliveries of love are nothing less than the cakes in question. Valentione's Day is a time to foster affection for one another, and how better to do so than by sharing a sweet treat?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_026: When we shared our vision with Kupka Kupp, we soon came to the realization that we would need a facility capable of baking confectionery of colossal proportions.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_027: As luck would have it, there was an old manor on the outskirts of the Twelveswood...so House Valentione snapped it up and turned it into a grand pâtisserie! Everything was falling into place...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_028: ...until the bespoke mammet pâtissiers commissioned from the Goldsmiths' Guild went on a rampage.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_029: I would swear they had lost their minds had they any to begin with. Why, the little fiends took us for common cake thieves, kupo! They all but barred off the kitchen in their ceaseless frenzy!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_030: Though we have a whistle to stop the mammets in emergencies, they were upon us before my little lungs could fill with enough puff. I fear the situation may be beyond my power, kupo...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_031: Even with the mammets behaving so, we cannot recklessly destroy such custom clockwork pieces. Which means...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_032: Please, ! You're our only hope! Will you dodge the malfunctioning mammets, decorate the cakes, and save Valentione's Day?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_033: For the sake of those eagerly awaiting the festival─I beg you!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_A3_000_001: It'll be a piece of cake!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_035: You two no doubt have matters to attend to here, so allow me to accompany our brave adventurer friend and provide what support I can, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_036: Thank you! I'm sure that together, you will soon have matters in hand.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_037: You now have access to the pâtisserie seasonal instance.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_038: To enter the pâtisserie, speak with the House Valentione pâtissier in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_039: The pâtisserie is a light party instance for a party of one to four players. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_040: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members can choose to enter with their current party, or choose to fill their party automatically via the matching system.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_045: My thanks again for agreeing to see the first batch of cakes completed! If you speak to a House Valentione pâtissier, they will escort you to the pâtisserie.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_050: Valentione's cakes are a classic way to celebrate, so we thought it would be fun to have special, enormous cakes, all lavishly decorated with love and care! The preparations have been quite a lot of work, truth be told...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_051: Still, Astrid has her reasons for deciding to serve such grand cakes to everyone. I'll do whatever I can to see her plan succeed─but for now, that success rests on your shoulders, !
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_055: Allow me to express my thanks for your assistance, too─for I am most eager to deliver a freshly baked slice to a dear friend of mine, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_056: In preparation for the festivities, we used our moogle magicks to ripen an array of fruits─both seasonal and otherwise─which we brought along with other suitable decorations. Feel free to leave the recipe and design to me!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_057: We cannot allow this setback to stymie the celebrations─not when so many have worked so hard. Come, adventurer, and let us show these mammets the power of love!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_060: Welcome back! I hear it was a resounding success!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_065: Thanks again for your aid, kupo. What an honor it is to deliver such a grand missive of ardor and affection, in all its sugar-frosted glory!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_066: The usual missives, incidentally, have been entrusted to a reliable apprentice of mine. I'm sure deliveries are underway as we speak, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_070: I must offer my thanks again, ! I've never seen such charming confectionery. Now, we can finally get the festivities underway...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_071: That said, with such a large-scale operation, we can hardly ask you to oversee the production of each and every cake. Would you be able to share the secret to your success?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_A1_000_001: Keep a keen eye on your surroundings.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_A1_000_002: Let no mammet go unpunished, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_073: So, the key is to locate the required ingredients and identify the most suitable path to the cake. I'll send a request to the Adventurers' Guild and ensure they include this sage advice!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_074: I see... It's important to make sure the mammets don't cause too many problems, which means carefully considering when to use the stop signal. I'll send a request to the Adventurers' Guild and ensure they include this sage advice!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_075: So, it's a case of using your finely honed physique and mental fortitude to push forward, boldly withstanding the heat of the kitchen... I'll send a request to the Adventurers' Guild and ensure they include this sage advice!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_076: I'll see to the appropriate transportation to the amphitheatre, so we can get the cake served up!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_077: Although I'm glad the celebrations can finally begin, I can't help but wonder what drove the mammets to madness...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_078: Something on your mind, Kupka Kupp?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_080: Kupka Kupp seems to have noticed something. Perhaps we can get to the bottom of this!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_085: Why would the mammets suddenly turn on us?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_091: With you there to wrangle the mammets, I was able to observe them more closely. And what should I see, kupo, but traces of moogle magicks!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_092: And the only other mog who would have had the opportunity to cast magic in the vicinity would be Kupna Kuko, who helped prepare the fruit. Mayhap he knows something of this.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_093: Well, it seems our next course of action is decided. We must find this Kupna Kuko and see what he knows!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_094: I didn't espy him in the pâtisserie, so I suspect he may be somewhere in Gridania. Though, in all likelihood, he would attempt a quick escape should I confront him alone. , would you mind accompanying me as suitably intimidating backup?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_095: Thank you! I'll join the search once I've submitted a request to the Adventurers' Guild for additional cake-decorating support.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_096: Kupna Kuko is fond of strolls by the waterwheel, so the nearby Lancers' Guild seems as good a place as any to begin our search, kupo.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_100: Thank you for agreeing to help look for this Kupna Kuko fellow! Once I've submitted this request to the Adventurers' Guild, I'll join the search.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_105: I hope you find Kupna Kuko and get to the bottom of all this! For my part, I shall remain here and make sure there is cake enough for everyone.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_120: Kupo-po-po! Oh, I can picture it now─dozens upon dozens of cakes being presented to the adoring public!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_121: For the mammets will be hard at work by now. Yes, everything moves according to my master plan!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_122: And all these confectionery delights will appear with neither man nor mog raising a paw! The commotion has been rather greater than expected, but surely 'tis naught but boisterous enthusiasm. Kupo-po-po-po!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_123: Kupna Kuko...! I believe we've found the mog to blame. Come, ─together, we shall deliver justice!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_A2_000_002: Come quietly─or I'll pull off your pom.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_125: Kupopopo! Who in the name of Good King Moggle Mog XII─may His Mognificence remain unsummoned in his sovereign splendor─are you!?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_126: Oh, such murderous intent...! Spare me! Spare this cute, fluffy mog!!!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_128: Ah, Astrid! Not only did Kupna Kuko know something of the matter, it turns out he's the very maker of the mischief!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_129: What!? But you said he helped you prepare the fruit... Whatever could he have hoped to achieve by causing the mammets to malfunction?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_100_129: Malfunction!? Great kupo nuts, you say they're malfunctioning?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_130: Oh no... I had such fun helping with the cakes that I returned to the pâtisserie after delivering the fruit. But, Kupka Kupp was nowhere to be found─attending to another of his many duties, I suspect.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_131: Then, it struck me, kupo! If everyone was so busy, wouldn't it be better if the mammets could make the cakes all by themselves? And so, I cast a little moogle magick!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_132: Which then caused the mammets to malfunction. Kupna Kuko, you must undo whatever spell you've woven, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_133: W-Well... It may have been fairly easy to cast, but it's not so easily undone. Any attempt to dispel it is liable to end in exploded mammets.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_134: That would be far too dangerous for the mammets and─perhaps, more importantly─the cake! For now, we have a team of eager adventurers helping decorate cakes and we've ascertained that there was no intentional sabotage...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_135: Oh, what a fine mess you've made. Why didn't you think to ask anyone else before deciding on this plan?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_136: <sniffle> I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I didn't mean to cause problems, I just...I just wanted everyone to have as much cake as their hearts desired, kupo...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_137: Well...as an emissary of love, I'm never one to turn away a helping hand. Any ideas you have, you can always bring them to me. Especially if they're about cake!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_138: Listen well, Kupna! Whether delivering missives or lending aid, you must always see the task through for the intended recipient─with love!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_139: With love? Even though I'm not an emissary...?
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_140: As long as one puts their heart into it, anyone can spread love and affection! Just look at ─thanks to , the Valentione's Day festivities can go ahead. And I think it's past time we went and enjoyed them for ourselves!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_145: What a palaver, kupo! Though, I was most relieved to find Kupna Kuko harbored no ill intent.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_146: And with my dear friend Elyne partaking in the festivities, I couldn't be happier!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_150: What colossal cakes! And so many, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_155: Just look at how many cakes we managed to prepare! And to see everyone sharing a joyous moment over a tasty treat─oh, it's wonderful to see the preparations pay off!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_160: As you can see, the day's main event is well underway, and cake has been served to one and all! Once again, allow me to thank you for your assistance.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_161: The confectionery you contributed is here, in pride of place! And thanks to your advice, the adventurers who undertook the request to decorate additional cakes were wildly successful.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_163: What a light and fluffy texture, kupo! It's simply divine!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPNAKUKO_000_164: And everyone seems to be having such fun. Is that what being an emissary is? Seeing people bask in these warm feelings...? Why, this might even be worth doing the hard work myself, kupo!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_KUPUKAKOPP_000_165: Ohoho... At last, you see. This is ardor and affection! This is the essence of love!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_166: It looks like everyone is having a good time!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_167: And it's thanks to your help that we made it this far.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_168: To think we were this close to everything falling apart at the final step...
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_169: I couldn't bear the thought, not after all the hard work Astrid put in to make this happen.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_170: I'll not deny I had my heart set on it. Not so long ago, I came to realize that sharing food and sharing a moment of bliss together is but another form of love.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_171: While the gifting of chocolate is the traditional practice, a part of me hopes that what we've created here today might become a new tradition.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_172: Sharing ardor and affection with loved ones and feeling their heart's answer in return... It is my most heartfelt wish that people across the realm are blessed with many such opportunities.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_173: And so, , if you feel inclined to venture into the kitchen once more, we should gladly welcome additional cakes! Our celebration is just getting started, after all.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_EMILIE_000_174: And I must insist that you partake as well, before you go rushing back to the pâtisserie! I'll get you a slice right away.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_ASTRID_000_175: And I'll put the tea on! Won't you sit with us for a while? I think we've earned this!
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_176: You can now attempt the pâtisserie seasonal instance again by speaking with the House Valentione pâtissier in either Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_177: You may earn Valentione's Day chocolates by completing the pâtisserie.
TEXT_FESVLX201_05325_SYSTEM_000_178: Valentione's Day chocolates may be traded to the House Valentione maid in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre for gear and items.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_001: Say, aren't you ? I've heard even the Wing of Protection speaks highly of you. If you have a moment, I was hoping for a quick word.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_002: Well, if it isn't ! Tell me, do you have a moment?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_003: Animal carcasses have been turning up one after the other over in Shaaloani, and we've yet to figure out why. We were preparing to launch an investigation, but then we received this...
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_004: A distinctive style to be sure, but it's undoubtedly a mark bill. No less peculiar than the client who delivered it, either. Too small for a Hhetsarro, and yet too furry to be a Lalafell. Whatever distant land they hail from, I doubt I've ever heard of it.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A0_100_001: The bill's design is certainly different.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A0_100_003: I feel like I've seen a bill like this before...
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_100_004: So you've handled a request like this previously? I'll be damned!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_005: Lately, there've been sightings of a large beast roaming the plains, which we believe is responsible for the rash of carcasses. From what I've heard, it bears a striking resemblance to the creature depicted on this bill.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_006: To be frank, we'd all rest easier if the one who helped fell Valigarmanda were the one to take this on. Would you lend us your strength?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A0_000_001: I was yearning for a good hunt.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A0_000_002: If it's been deemed a threat, it must be eliminated.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_008: Oh, I've a feeling it'll be one to remember! Now, the client should have all the details you need to get started. No doubt they've been eagerly awaiting a skilled hunter to take on this task.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_009: Indeed. This is a matter we would be wise to approach with all due caution. It'd be best to speak with the client directly, as they'll be able to apprise you of all the details.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_010: They should be hanging about the tavern in Hhusatahwi. I expect you'll have no trouble finding them.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_015: The client appears to be of a race not from these parts. You'll find them soon enough if you look around the tavern in Hhusatahwi.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_020: An unfamiliar birdlike creature stands before you, vaguely reminiscent of a chocobo...
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Yes, I'm the Felyne who put out the bounty on the monster. Are you a hunter?
Then you must be familiar with monsters of all kinds. In which case, I have one I'd ask you to hunt, assuming you're up for it.
Yippie! An adventurer-hunter at long last! You'll aid me in this hunt then, won't you?
“Meownster”? What in the... Oh, I see. You've met one of my kin before, haven't you? I hadn't realized other Felynes have ventured to these parts!
But putting that aside, I've been searching for a capable hunter to aid me in my quest. Can I count on your help?
Wonderful! You don't seem to have a Grand Hub for hunters in this land, so I was beginning to lose hope I'd find anyone.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: Ah, I'd better begin by telling you how I arrived here. It relates to our mark, you understand.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: The mark in question? None other than Guardian Arkveld.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: The creature normally resides in the Forbidden Lands. My comrades and I were in the midst of investigating its territory, when...
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: ...A spiderlike thing appeared as if out of nowhere! Before we could make heads or tails of what it was, a cocoon nearby burst open, and from it emerged a newborn Arkveld. The two then began to clash in a fierce battle for supremacy.
As the battle came to a head, the mysterious invader created a ring glowing with light. Before we knew it, the Guardian had disappeared without a trace.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: And then, all before me turned white... When I came to, I found myself in this land of Tural.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Oddly enough, the invader spoke just moments before the flash. I think it said “program...loop upgrade.” I have no idea what that means, but I'm guessing it has to do with why I'm here.

I was searching for a way home with my companion when I learned that a Guardian Arkveld was wreaking havoc nearby. I thought it best that I recruit a hunter to take it down before it could bring ruin to the wilds.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: Now that you're up to speed, I'd say we better get started.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_200: I'm sure this goes without saying, but when tracking prey, it's important to know what signs to look for─every creature leaves its own unique trail.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Guardian Arkveld's most distinctive traits are its white coat and scales, as well as the chain-like tendrils on its forelimbs, which it can extend and retract at will to bind its prey...if it doesn't slice you to pieces first.
Whatever ground the beast treads, it's certain to leave behind marks from dragging its tendrils.
From what I've heard, it was sighted in an area north of here called Yawtanane. Let's see if we can't find signs of its passage.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: I'm regretfully unfamiliar with the monsters in these parts, so I hope you don't mind taking the lead in our search.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: It's easier to track monsters that leave something behind, but in Arkveld's case, that'll be tricky. I think the best we can hope for is a few strands of its fur or markings left by its tendrils.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_160: Are you sure you wish to part ways with the stray Felyne?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Ah, you have urgent business elsewhere? Understood. I'll wait where we began our survey until you've finished.
Welcome back! Let's resume our search for Arkveld, shall we?

I noticed there are quite a few people in this town carrying curious weapons. I took such folk for hunters, at first, but it turns out they're members of a group that catches folks up to no good. The “Dustwatch,” I think they're called.

The hunters of my land are no strangers to capturing their quarry either, you know. We use shock or pitfall traps to immobilize a beast, and then unleash a barrage of tranq bombs to put them to sleep!
I happen to be an expert at laying traps, so I'd be happy to put my talents to use should any fugitives cross our path!

As I understand it, sandstorms sometimes sweep across these plains, is that right? The Forbidden Lands similarly have a tumultuous climate, the environment shifting greatly with the change of seasons.

In the Fallow period, the land grows barren, so monsters fight over what limited food they can find. And come the intense weather conditions of the Inclemency period, apex predators begin to emerge, making it a very precarious time.
But after that comes the period of Plenty, when flora and fauna flourish in abundance. No matter the season, there's always something new to discover, bringing fresh excitement with each expedition!
Oh, curious about my companion here, are you? They're called a Seikret, and they were transported here alongside me.
They're fatigued from our long journey, however, so I'm letting them rest here. I'll introduce you properly later.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_195: You must be accompanied by the stray Felyne and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_196: The stray Felyne has yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_200: A heap of withered weeds. It bears an unmistakable resemblance to the plant matter found on tumbleclaws native to the region.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: I gather these dried weeds were left behind by a monster that uses them to camouflage itself. They certainly bear no connection to Arkveld.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_200: In the Forbidden Lands, there are creatures called Mimiphyta that also mimic flowers to hide from predators.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_300: Heh, I remember this one time, some hunters disguised themselves with headwear in the spitting image of Mimiphyta. I'm not pulling your tail when I tell you it was impossible to distinguish them from the real thing!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_400: In any case, I don't see signs of Arkveld here. Let's keep looking.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_203: A pungent, sticky substance adheres to these clumps of yellow hair. Judging by the local fauna, these are likely the remains of a sunbeard, gorged upon by a grasslands worm.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: Hmmm. Not sure what left this behind, but Arkveld has white fur, not yellow. Come to think of it, all Guardians have a white coat.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_200: Even the Guardian variant of Rathalos, crimson King of the Skies, is clad in white. At least, that's what I've heard.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_400: But that is neither here nor there. We should get back to our survey!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_206: The markings on the ground suggest something massive was dragged across it, with armor-like scales strewn about the area.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: These scales... I'm certain they came from Guardian Arkveld!
To think it came so close to a settlement... Thankfully, it turned away, but there's nothing stopping it from coming back. We need to find its lair before anyone gets hurt.
With everything we've found, I believe we have what we need to locate our prey.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: If we're to give proper chase, we should call on my comrade resting back in town. Could I trouble you to gather a few samples before we go?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: My feathered friend here is called a Seikret. Not only does it make for a reliable mount, but it can also carry all the essentials for a hunt thanks to its sturdy build. And that's not all─it can even memorize a monster's scent and track it down!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: Now, it's the Seikret's time to shine!  Not only do the creatures make for reliable mounts, but they can also carry all the essentials for a hunt thanks to their sturdy build. And that's not all─they can even memorize a monster's scent and track it down!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Try letting it smell what you gathered.
Looks like it's picked up the scent. Now it can guide us to Arkveld!
There's no time to waste. If you would mount the Seikret and scout out the location of our mark, I'll see to preparations for the hunt.
Here, take this “linkpearl” contraption. Managed to barter for it after exchanging a few things with a traveling merchant. With this, we should be able to stay in contact even when we're apart.
Now then, you need only trust in the Seikret to guide you. I'm sure you'll find Arkveld in no time!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_300: The Seikret grunts cheerfully. It seems eager for you to climb onto its back.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: (-Stray Felyne-)Hellooo? Are you there? Oh good, I can hear you. This linkpearl is a true gem!
(-Stray Felyne-)Though Arkveld lay dormant within its cocoon for a long time, Guardians are said to awaken when they sense a powerful presence nearby.
(-Stray Felyne-)It may have turned back after approaching the settlement because something even stronger drew its attention.
(-Stray Felyne-)That stormy dome in the distance marks a land dominated by fierce lightning storms, right? I sure hope that's not where Arkveld was headed.
(-Stray Felyne-)What!? You found the remains of a monster? Quick─examine the corpse to see if there are any signs it was preyed upon!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_350: The beast has breathed its last. You see no bite marks on its body, suggesting the creature may not have been attacked as an act of predation.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: (-Stray Felyne-)...I'd expect as much from a Guardian. You see, unlike your average monster, they have no need to eat their prey.
(-Stray Felyne-)I think Arkveld may be fixated on the energies in this place, and felling any other monsters that get in its way.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A1_000_002: It doesn't need sustenance to survive?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: (-Stray Felyne-)Interesting, I didn't realize such creatures exist in this land. The world truly is full of limitless wonders.

(-Stray Felyne-)Guardians are a little different, but a creature gaining immense strength from an extraordinarily long life puts me in mind of “tempered monsters.” Very powerful creatures, where I'm from.
(-Stray Felyne-)It's all rather complicated, but in short, Guardians do not possess an organ for digestion.
(-Stray Felyne-)That's why they never attack out of a desire to feed.
(-Stray Felyne-)What!? That sounds like a turf war! Clearly Arkveld's been on edge since it arrived here. I bet it's lashing out at anything it deems a threat.
(-Stray Felyne-)At this rate, it's going to throw the whole ecosystem out of balance. We have to stop it, but how...
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: (-Stray Felyne-)Oh, I've got it! Try taking out a pod from the pouch on the Seikret─you'll know you've found the right one if it makes your nose wrinkle!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_150: (-Stray Felyne-)It's called a dung pod, and as you've undoubtedly noticed, it possesses a frightfully fetid smell. Whether it's a single monster or even a horde, a well-positioned throw would send even the most rabid beasts packing!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_200: (-Stray Felyne-)It has no effect on Guardians, but the scent should be unbearable for whatever Arkveld's fighting. Throw it with everything you've got!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: (-Stray Felyne-)Arkveld fled as well? Hmm... Perhaps it perceived you too as a threat, and returned to its den to recover its strength.
(-Stray Felyne-)While I'm sure you'd love to give chase, I'd like to regroup first. Stay put for just a moment─I'll be there in two shakes of a Rathalos's tail!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_380: Judging by the Seikret's gallant posturing, it's eager to resume the hunt.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Had that turf war continued, it may have reached nearby settlements. Thank goodness the dung pod worked as well as it did.
Arkveld's lair appears to be further ahead. I expect it's recuperating from its battle and won't be emerging anytime soon.
While you were searching for the Guardian, I took it upon myself to put together a Camping Kit.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: Let's set up shop near Arkveld's lair and prepare for the grueling hunt before us!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_200_402: Proceed to set up camp and make final preparations?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: I put together a Pop-up Camp in the clearing ahead. Once we've made our preparations, we can dive into Guardian Arkveld's den!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_415: The Seikret is on alert, ready to act at a moment's notice.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Come, come, make yourself at home! No need to worry about any pesky monsters─I've already checked the area and we're perfectly safe.
First things first: we feast! One should never hunt on an empty stomach, as we hunters say.
I managed to gather everything we need to have ourselves a barbecue, so let's get to grilling!
Mmm... Delicious! Now, with your appetite sated and spirits soaring, I bet you could take on even the mightiest of monsters!
Here, take these mega potions as well. They'll come in handy during the hunt.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: They're a special blend of the potions distributed by the Hunters' Guild, mixed with fresh honey harvested by yours truly. Thankfully, we were in a period of Plenty just before I was transported here.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_200: With that, I think you're all set!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Allow me to formally make my request: please hunt Guardian Arkveld, and protect the life on these plains!
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_603: During the battle the Windward Wilds, you will gain access to the duty action Mega Potion.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Arkveld is a formidable monster, but so long as you keep heart, I know you'll prevail!
You did it! You defeated Arkveld! Now these plains will know peace once more.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A4_000_001: It's thanks to you that I even knew of this threat in the first place.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_A4_000_002: Now we need to find a way to get you home.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Oh, stop it. You'll make me blush! It was nothing, really. I'm just thankful you have a hunting association in this land too.
Where I'm from, the moment you issue a request, you'll have a swarm of hunters on your doorstep, itching to carry it out. The quest counter's always bustling as a result!
Ah! I suppose I'd better find a way back to the Forbidden Lands soon. And yet...
Wah, I nearly forgot!
I'm not entirely sure how I'll make it back to the Forbidden Lands, I'll admit. And yet... I don't feel awfully anxious about it.

It's not every day that you get spirited away to a vast continent like this, you know? I'd like to see the sights and speak with the people. I'll find a way back in the course of that, I'm sure of it.
I wouldn't mind learning more about the myriad monsters and resources here either. I'll see where the winds take me, and fill out my field guide as I go along.
Who knows? By the time I make it home, I may have filled the whole thing. Do you think I'd be a worthy adventurer by then?
We ought to inform the Dawn Hunt folk in Tuliyollal that we've succeeded in our hunt.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_814: The Seikret gazes at the surroundings with interest.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SMITHERY05374_000_8: We'll process any materials you retrieve from monsters, and if you bring back something particularly rare, we'll happily exchange it for one of our goods.
