TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_900: Ah, so the hunt was a success. Well done. Well done, indeed. Perhaps now life can return to normal for the fauna of Shaaloani.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: By the way, we carved some scales from Arkveld's hide. Would you be able to craft anything with them? It'd be an awful waste to leave them as only a souvenir...
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_902: Well now─this is a rare find. If you speak with the smithy here, I'm sure he could fashion armor with it, or at the very least, exchange it for other wares.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_HUNTER05374_000_903: Be sure to drop by again should you find any other noteworthy materials.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: Hmm? What brings you here, my friend? Already finished feeding?
My, would you look at that... It seems they've grown fond of you.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_100: If you're not opposed, why not take them along with you on your adventures?
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_200: Yippie! You couldn't ask for a better companion.
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_WANDERINGFELYNE_000: With that settled, I believe it's time I was getting on with my own adventure. Thanks for everything, !
TEXT_KINGYX901_05374_SYSTEM_000_907: The hunt has only just begun! Earn further rewards by facing Guardian Arkveld in the Windward Wilds (Extreme), which may be unlocked by speaking with the wandering minstrel in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0537: A league of traveling performers has reserved the masquerade venue as their own this All Saints' Wake. If it is an invitation you seek, look no further than my pumpkin-headed acquaintance onstage!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_010: Heh heh... Well met, adventurer. 'Tis once again All Saints' Wake─the season where fiends make for fine friends. Enjoying the festivities, I trust?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_011: Heh heh... We meet again, adventurer. Enjoying the festivities, I trust?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_012: While the saints are away, a well-known theater troupe has stopped in Gridania to play... They host a grand masquerade in the old manor, that they might sate their hunger for merriment.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_013: Recall now, my friend, the Continental Circus, for they have returned to revel in the bone-chilling nights of All Saints' Wake.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_014: You have yet to meet these fearsome folk, but they are known as the Continental Circus─performers who relish the bone-chilling nights of the All Saints' Wake season.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_015: Their ghoulish gala is the talk of the town. And knowing the troupe's appetite for mischief as I do, I sense what lies in store...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_016: I implore you to view the spectacle for yourself. You need only speak with the genial guiser. He shall guide your steps to the Haunted Manor.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_020: The children of the Continental Circus may appear to you as ordinary performers, yet they are far from it... All shall be revealed in due time.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0537: Come one, come all, to the Continental Circus's grand masquerade! Shall I guide you to the festivities, good ?
Come one, come all, to the Continental Circus' grand masquerade! Shall I guide you to the festivities, good ?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_040: I bid you welcome, dear guest. It is our honor to host you─
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_042: The overly inquisitive adventurer from seasons past!? I-It, er...has been quite some time...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_043: N-Not that adventurers are unwelcome, mind. I harbor no ill will against them whatsoever! Now tell me, what brings you to our manor of happy horrors?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_A1_000_002: A suspicious introduction for one who claims to harbor no ill will.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_A1_000_003: Not scheming up more plans for the Night of Devilry, are you?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_045: Are you, now? Then I ask you forgive me my initial scrutiny. Past experiences have made me rather...wary of adventurers, let us say.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_046: That is not my intention, I assure you! Alas, past experiences have made me rather...wary of adventurers, let us say.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_047: Certainly not! This All Saints' Wake, I would prefer not to be at the receiving end of your guild's incorrigible investigations.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_048: But I tire of shadowy schemes and the accusations that often follow. So I shall lay bare our secret as a gesture of good faith. However...you must swear never to share with others what I reveal.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_049: Though we of the Continental Circus disguise ourselves as mortal men and women, we are in truth a troupe of otherworldly creatures. For some of us, our monstrous “costumes” are, in fact, our true form. Were my own glamour dispelled, you would see me as I truly am─an imp.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_050: Not so long ago, our ultimate goal was to drown this realm in blackest night and usher in a long-coveted legend among my kind: the Night of Devilry, where our leader, the Great Gourd, would rise again and strike terror into the hearts of men.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_051: But as a few voidsent compatriots have recently taught us, there lies a reward even sweeter than mortal fear. One that fills our hearts and satiates our souls─gratitude!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_100_051: One taste, they said, and we would be unable to deny the fulfillment it brought us. Thus, the Circus abandoned its malevolent ambitions to pursue honeyed words of appreciation instead.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_052: When glorious autumn twilight reigns supreme across this realm, mortal and voidsent must join hands in harmony, and carouse to their hearts' content! In doing so, all shall know unforgettable thrills and chills beyond comprehension!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_053: Our masquerade is proof of this desire. Listen well, and you, too, shall hear our guests cry out in splendor!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_057: Wh-Why, that's not splendorous at all! Please, you must believe me. We have no intention of affrighting our guests! At least, not like this...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_058: <sigh> Everyone swore a solemn oath to entertain. How has it come to this?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_059: Oh, you needn't glare those daggers at me! I haven't the foggiest as to what has transpired... But perhaps you might use your skills of inquiry to our benefit.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_060: I beseech you, adventurer, survey the manor and discover what has brought our patrons such distress, starting with the second floor. I shall remain here to oversee affairs.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_061: Once you have identified the cause of this chaos, you must inform me with all due haste! Should fell rumors begin to spread, I fear the Adventurers' Guild's suspicions will soon follow...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SYSTEM_100_061: You may now use mounts within the Haunted Manor.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_070: I shall do my utmost to salvage this sordid situation from here. Please, investigate the manor in my stead and find out what is going on.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_VISITORA05375_000_0: <shudder> Hungry puddings down the hall, armed zombie jesters down the stairs... They didn't tell me this masquerade would have me running for my life!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUDDING_100_080: Silence! Silence, I say! You must─you must─go away! Where we go, chaos and devilry follow! Remain here, and in chaos you shall wallow!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SYSTEM_110_080: This performer is too absorbed in their mischief to listen to what you have to say.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_VISITORA05375_120_0: <sob> This isn't what I signed up for...! They said this masquerade was going to be fun!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUDDING_130_080: Chaos! All shall fall into chaos, I say! And you must not stand in my way!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_ZOMBIE_000_082: Heh heh... Next, I could gouge out some eyeballs... Maybe even gobble up a few fresh organs while I'm at it...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SYSTEM_000_083: This performer is so absorbed in his own machinations that he hasn't noticed you.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_ZOMBIE_100_083: Now that I think on it, I can't gouge any eyes in this glamour. But perhaps I could dispel it for a fleeting moment while no one's looking... Heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_VISITORD05375_110_0: Excuse me, ... Have you seen any elixirs around here? That creature in the pot won't stop asking for one, but they cost more than my allowance can afford...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_MAGICPOT_000_087: No elixir!? Then no treats for you!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_VISITORD05375_000_0: There must be an elixir around here somewhere... If I give one to the creature in the pot, do you suppose it'll give me treats in return?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_MAGICPOT_000_094: Gimme an elixir! And some candy, too!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_100: The intrepid adventurer returns. How fared the others?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_101: Hm. Despite our newfound mission, we do still take great pleasure in mortals' fits of fright. I suspect they have forgotten themselves and prioritized their own enjoyment over that of our guests.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_102: I do empathize with their plight, and they've yet to cause any lasting harm... Mayhap it would be best to indulge them this once, and allow them their fun─
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_104: We cannot allow my brethren's antics to go unchecked. But if they will not listen to the reprimands of a kindly adventurer, I can hardly imagine they would heed mine...
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_105: (-Pumpkin's Whispers-)Heh heh... At an impasse, are we? Return to me, child, and I shall offer my aid.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SYSTEM_000_107: It seems the Impresario cannot hear the voice of the pumpkin-headed apparition, but you sense it would be wise to heed her advice and return to Gridania.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_IMPHEAD_000_110: Has that mortal mind of yours contrived any reasonable solutions? We cannot afford to let the rest of the troupe have their way for much longer─I daresay our patrons will soon reach their limits. For now, I shall continue to watch over matters here and consider our options.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_120: You are returned. The children of the Circus are a fascinating bunch, are they not? Their antics never fail to amuse me.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_121: But while their intentions are pure, we must calm those who have lost themselves in feats of fear. I believe I can conjure something that will do just that.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_122: I shall begin the preparations. For your part, I would ask you to procure a few necessary ingredients.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_123: I require All Saints' cookies and a decorative pumpkin. The shady smock over yonder is like to have a few cookies to spare. As for the pumpkin, the Botanists' Guild possesses a pumpkin patch for our needs. Seek out the Greatloam gourdkeep─he will be happy to oblige you.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_130: Remember this well: I require All Saints' cookies and a decorative pumpkin. The shady smock by the gates is in possession of spare cookies, while the pumpkins grow in the fields of the Botanists' Guild.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SHADYSMOCK05375_000: Hee hee... Sorry, dearie, we're not selling at the moment─ Hm? Here on behalf of the pumpkin-head, you say?
Well, if it's for her, I suppose I could make an exception... But you'd best keep it a secret from our other guests!
There you go! One bag of freshly baked All Saints' cookies. Send the pumpkin-head my regards, won't you?
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKINGARDENER0537: In need of a decorative pumpkin, are you? Well, you're in luck! I've got a plump and round one here─freshly carved, no less.

We of the Botanists' Guild take great pride in our pumpkins, and are glad to share them with one and all. They make for sweet treats and charming decorations this time of year... I do hope you'll make good use of yours!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_SHADYSMOCK05375_000: I owe your pumpkin-headed friend a bit of a debt, y'see... Wouldn't want to go too long without repaying it. But that's another secret I'd rather you keep to yourself!
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKINGARDENER0537: We decorate the city-states with pumpkins this time of year to honor the Great Gourd, the patron spirit of All Saints' Wake. The carved faces are modeled after its depiction in legend, and it has long been a staple of the season.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_161: Excellent, excellent... These will make for a most magnificent result.
TEXT_FESHLX101_05375_PUMPKIN_000_162: Now, I shall concoct a creation that will strike terror into the hearts of naughty children who have forgotten their purpose, and joy into the hearts of weeping mortals...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_000: Has that mortal mind of yours contrived any reasonable solutions? We cannot afford to let the rest of the troupe have their way for much longer─I daresay our patrons will soon reach their limits. For now, I shall continue to watch over matters here and consider our options.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORA05376_000_0: <sob> This isn't what I signed up for...! They said this masquerade was going to be fun!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORD05376_000_0: There must be an elixir around here somewhere... If I give one to the creature in the pot, do you suppose it'll give me treats in return?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_000_003: Now that I think on it, I can't gouge any eyes in this glamour. But perhaps I could dispel it for a fleeting moment while no one's looking... Heh heh...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_000_004: Chaos! All shall fall into chaos, I say! And you must not stand in my way!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MAGICPOT_000_005: No elixir!? Then no treats for you!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0537: I am told there is a...situation occurring at our masquerade, but I have faith that you will solve it! Shall I guide you to the manor?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_010: Heh heh... Now, let us put an end to the Continental Circus's cruel tricks, shall we?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_011: With the materials you have gathered, I shall prepare the solution we require... But all good things take time. I suggest you return to the manor and inform the Impresario of our plan. All shall be made clear soon enough.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_020: Those who play their tricks with ill intentions cannot be left to their own devices. Joy is meant to be shared, not hoarded─a lesson all naughty children must learn.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_030: Welcome back. I regret to report that circumstances remain unchanged here in the manor. Have you any new ideas to share?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_031: “Concocted a creation,” you say? Of what kind?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MYSTERIOUSGUIDE0537: Apologies for the wait! My master proudly presents...a ghoulish gift for our dear Impresario!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_033: My word! This doll is the spitting image of...of me!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MYSTERIOUSGUIDE0537: 'Tis no ordinary doll, I assure you! You may operate it by riding atop its head. And that's not all─take control, and you shall have a bevy of illusory spells at your disposal!
These illusory spells are based on the materials our adventurer friend so kindly provided us: delectable delights for the worthy, and a haunting trick for those undeserving of treats.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_036: I see... A solution to mollify both parties.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_037: Might I leave the operation of this magicked doll to you, adventurer? In this mortal glamour, I doubt I'd be able to maneuver it as well as you.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_038: Once you have shown them the error of their ways, order them to return to me, and I shall reeducate them on the parts they must play here.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_039: Our guests also deserve recompense for their prior treatment. I ask that you send them to me as well, that I might offer them sweets in apology. I cannot bear to end their All Saints' Wake on a dour note.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MYSTERIOUSGUIDE0537: So your plans are made, yes? Then I shall return to my master. I wish you happy frightening and delighting!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_050: ...Well, then. I suppose all that's left for you to do is operate this mechanical me! I suggest you begin by marching it right up to the second floor and calming the commotion above.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_051: And remember: my fellow performers should be convinced to return with the pumpkin's trick. I ask that you reserve the treats for our guests! We mustn't give them more undue fright...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_052: Should you find yourself separated from our pumpkin friend, simply return to me, and you may hop on its head once more. Now, then, off you go!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_055: Ah, there you are. Our clockwork companion has been awaiting your return. Now, off you go, and remember: tricks for the performers, treats for our guests!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SYSTEM_000_060: While riding the Ambulario, you must use the correct actions to calm the voidsent and guests. Should you become dismounted, you may speak with the Impresario to ride the Ambulario again.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORA05376_000_0: You're the ringleader of the Continental Circus, aren't you!? P-P-Please, have mercy...! My heart can't take any more of this!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SYSTEM_000_072: You appear to have used the wrong spell. You must use the Trickster's Treat ability on this guest.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORA05376_000_0: What!? What more could you possibly─
Magic candy? Was that your doing?
They're offering cookies and candy as an apology, you say? Gods, I deserve a treat after all this... I'll be on my way, then!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_110_075: How dare you! How dare you get in my way! I don't need treats! I'll make you pay!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SYSTEM_120_075: You appear to have used the wrong spell. You must use the Treater's Trick ability on the Continental Circus member.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_140_075: I-Impresario, no! I've been good all this time! It's not what you think! I've done no crime!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_150_075: Oh, dear... The Impresario isn't happy with us? Then I'll hurry to him, lest I cause further fuss!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_110_077: O-Oh. You're no guest. It is kind of you to offer me a treat, but I must abstain. And, erm...please refrain from touching any nearby weaponry.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_120_077: Augh! The hells was that for!?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_130_077: Strange... It felt as though the Impresario was slapping me across the head, but it did not hurt. Has he conjured up some new illusion?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_140_077: You say he's summoning the whole troupe to the front of the manor for a talking-to!? Now that you mention it, I have been a bit...overzealous about frightening our clientele. I-I'll hurry back right away!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORD05376_000_0: What strange pumpkins... But I mustn't get distracted! I still need to find that elixir.
They're giving away free treats!? Hooray! Then I'll march right up to that Impresario and tell him to “gimme candy!”
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MAGICPOT_000_111: Ohhh, sweet, sweet candy! Gimme candy! Gimme more!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MAGICPOT_000_113: Gone already? Ah... No more magicks for me.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MAGICPOT_000_114: Wh-What!? He summons us to the foyer!? Yesss... Hahaha, yes! Then to the Impresario I shall go!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_000_120: <sigh> I dedicated myself too fiercely to my role, and forgot the oath I made to the Impresario... How shameful of me.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_000_121: Oh, the Impresario, did he roil with rage! This bump on my head's going to last a whole age...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MAGICPOT_000_122: Gimme an elixir! And candy, too! Gimme enough candy for everyone!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_130: I owe you a great debt, adventurer! With your aid, I was able to give these members of the troupe a good scolding.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_131: While a few frights are necessary to amplify the delights we provide, we must never allow the former to overshadow the latter. It is our solemn duty to provide the smallfolk with a memorable All Saints' Wake experience!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_000_132: We felt the very same, Impresario. Even though the adventurers always came for us, even though we knew what it was like to be punished and scared in years past... We lost ourselves, striking fear into the hearts of those who didn't deserve it.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_000_133: Chaos is good for us, but not for them! We must bring smiles to their faces again!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_MAGICPOT_000_134: Hear, hear! Less chaos! More treats and smiles!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_A1_000_001: Then let's enjoy All Saints' Wake, hand in hand!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_A1_000_002: Undue chaos will be promptly punished!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_ZOMBIE_000_135: Indeed! And we shall do our part with a performance worthy of the season!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUDDING_000_136: No more punishments, please! We'll remain good hosts, so be at ease!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_137: All right, my fellow thespians! It's time we greeted our guests with good cheer. Return to your places, and give them all the masquerade they deserve!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_138: With that settled, I believe I should be able to handle the troupe from here on out. I cannot thank you enough for your assistance, adventurer.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_139: Ah, and before I forget... Is the one who crafted that mechanical masterpiece an acquaintance of yours? If at all possible, I'd like to express my thanks to them as well.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_140: A woman sporting a white pumpkin head...? That sounds awfully like the legendary Great Gourd, who would command the voidsent forces on the Night of Devilry...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_141: Haha, but I jest! Legends are precisely that─tall tales, and no more! Allow me that joke, at least!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_142: In any event, you mentioned she awaited your return at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre, did you not?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_143: Pray allow me to join you. I should very much like to meet this pumpkin-headed acquaintance of yours.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_100_150: Heh heh... 'Tis a pleasure to finally meet the famed Impresario.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_CLOWNGATEKEEPER0537: I hear you've saved the Continental Circus's masquerade, adventurer! I'll gladly escort you to the Haunted Manor as many times as you'd like. Shall I guide you there now?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_090_160: So this is the one you spoke of. She does exude a...legendary sort of aura. If you were to tell me she was the Great Gourd, I'd certainly believe it. But of course, that's simply not possible.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_160: Heh heh... All's well that ends well, I see. Was my clockwork creation of assistance?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_161: Indeed it was. My brethren have remembered their duty to entertain, and I daresay our guests shall be all the merrier for it.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_162: That is well... I trust you will continue to give this city's mortal residents an exhilarating All Saints' Wake experience.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORD05376_000_1: (-Cheery Child-)Trust me, it's lots of fun in the manor! Let's all go!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORB05376_000_1: (-Fretful Child-)You're sure...? Those scary monsters won't eat me up?
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORD05376_000_1: (-Cheery Child-)They might give you a bit of a fright, but it's all in good fun! They're giving away lots of treats, too!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORC05376_000_1: (-Hasty Child-)Well...if you say so. But you have to promise you'll stay with us the whole time!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_VISITORD05376_000_1: (-Cheery Child-)Of course! I wouldn't leave you two behind! Come on, then, let's go!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_168: Yes, all is well... Those children's smiles are proof of it.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_169: How strange. I feel as though I'm truly enjoying All Saints' Wake for the first time. It's...rather refreshing, actually.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_170: I shall continue to put forth my best effort, that the Continental Circus's name might be known in every corner of the realm!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_171: But for the present, my duties call me to the manor. Thus do I ask of you, adventurer, to spread word of our deeds, and speak of us fondly in your travels.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_172: That clockwork creature you possess is a reflection of myself─and of my troupe, as well. Use it with pride, and perhaps others will want to know more of us in so doing...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_173: A sound plan. Yours is the face of the Continental Circus, after all.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_A2_000_002: As long as your mischief-making days are over...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_174: One day, perhaps tales of my troupe will overshadow even those of the Great Gourd! But until then, I shall continue my work─to convey to the realm all that the Wake can offer! Ahaha!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_175: Now, then, 'tis time I returned. As you well know, I cannot leave those scoundrels without their ringleader for too long.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_176: We shall be performing at the manor for the remainder of the season. Should you wish to join in our festivities, you are welcome to visit us as often as you please.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_177: In that case, I, too, shall open my haunted home to you, adventurer. Join me in my gardens, if you dare...
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_PUMPKIN_000_178: Simply speak with my servant, and he shall guide you to my abode. You may entertain yourself there for as long as you wish.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_IMPHEAD_000_179: The season of devilry and revelry lingers yet, and we shall thrive upon it! May you carouse to your heart's content this All Saints' Wake!
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SYSTEM_000_180: You now have access to Sneaky Hollow. Speak with the unusual usher at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to be escorted to the costume party.
TEXT_FESHLX102_05376_SYSTEM_100_180: Furthermore, the shady smock and her associates are now open for business.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_000: Come again? A sin eater fused with a voidsent?
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_002: Tell me. You were investigating a ruined church of the First Light?
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_003: You possess a singular talent for dredging up memories I'd sooner forget.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_004: ...Not that I can fault you for it. Remembrance is the burden of the living.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_005: What you described sounds like a voidsent I once defeated in the Thirteenth. Back before...any of this.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_006: At the time, I was just another memoriate, traveling the land and hunting the monsters that preyed upon the innocent.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_007: ...Until I realized one such monster could be of use to me.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_008: When I sealed it in memoria, I had no other thought but preventing its resuscitation.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_009: But when I agreed to journey to the First as the Ascians' hidden emissary, I remembered that voidsent.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_010: A creature of its caliber could turn the tide of battle. It could lend me the strength I needed to prevail.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_011: Drawing its power from the memoria would have been a simple matter.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_012: Yet after bringing it here, I left it to gather dust upon my desk in Lakeland.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_013: If I truly had wanted to defeat Ardbert, that voidsent would have been my solution...
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_014: But I was afraid. Afraid of being twisted by Darkness like so many memoriates before me. Afraid of becoming what I hated the most.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_015: Never mind that it was far too late. The Ascians' puppet, fearing corruption... Absurd, don't you think?
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_A1_000_018: Part of you always wanted Ardbert to succeed?
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_020: You are kind to say so.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_021: Succeed in slaying the monster, you mean? I wish I had. Would that I'd been a traitor only to myself─I could've believed my heart was in the right place, if nothing else.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_022: Absurd, yet in no way amusing. I agree.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_023: Above all, I was naive to think that the memoria would be safe in my former quarters, even once they were rendered inaccessible to mortal interlopers.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_024: Sin eaters must have been drawn to the memoria's concentrated Darkness. They would have provided enough Light to break the seal─and suitable fodder for the fiend in its newfound freedom.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_025: In sparing the First from its wrath, you have prevented untold devastation.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_026: I know that words will not absolve me. Yet, as one who draws breath upon this star, I offer them nonetheless.
TEXT_KINGDD104_05408_CYELLA_000_027: Warrior of Darkness... Nay, Warrior of Light. I thank you.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: Come one, come all! For the happy season of Hatching-tide is upon us once more!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_A1_000_001: And what an eggcellent season it is!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_A1_000_003: A pleasure to meet you, er...?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_00: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)That's the spirit! How lovely to see you again, . You remember me, yes? It's Jihli Aliapoh, come with another vision to share!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)Haha! I sense a kindred spirit in you, my friend─one that appreciates the eggsquisite bounties of springtime! My name is Jihli Aliapoh, and it is an honor to make your acquaintance.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Why, these adorable accessories have been exclusively prepared for this year's festivities!
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)It is ever so good to have you with us again, . Happy Hatching-tide!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_100_00: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)My name is Jihli Aliapoh, and it is my honor to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_00: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)Jihli! Jihli Aliapoh! ...Oh, is this the first you've seen me without my cap? For a moment, I feared you had forgotten me!
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)I am charged with overseeing the festivities here. May I ask your name, adventurer?
(-Jihli Aliapoh-), allow me to officially welcome you to the celebration of Hatching-tide!

(-Jihli Aliapoh-)This annual event began with a dream I had right before the last Calamity─and ever since, I have done my utmost to realize the prophecies spoken unto me whenever springtime returns to the realm!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_01: (-Jihli Aliapoh-)This year, I dreamt of marvelous golden eggs rising from curious flora.

(-Jihli Aliapoh-)As we speak, our Dreamers are hiding eggs in the Black Shroud for participants to lift from the shrubbery, thereby reenacting my dream! Successful seekers will be awarded with very stylish glasses.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Although...no little time has passed since I've had word from dear Nonotta, who is organizing the operation. I cannot help but worry something has gone awry.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)If only I could go and find her myself, but alas, I have duties to attend to here...
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Of course! , perhaps you would be so kind as to seek Nonotta out in my stead?
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)Thank you! I hope she has returned to Gridania safely. It would be worth checking the aetheryte plaza before venturing further afield.
(-Jihli Aliapoh-)She, too, should be wearing a pair of our thematic glasses─hers in the shape of a chicken!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_02: Were her spectacles created before mine, you ask? ...While I am uncertain as to whether the chicken preceded the egg, Nonotta chose the former. I would check the aetheryte plaza for her before searching elsewhere!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_040: My glasses? They're a prize for participating in this year's Hatching-tide festivities, but─
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_041: Marvelous! I chased a leafy beast and discovered a most fortuitous chicken. But for now, I must away. I look forward to these Hatching-tide festivities, these springtime delights!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_042: Hello, adventurer, and a happy Hatching-tide to you! How can I be of service?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_043: Oh, hello, ! A happy Hatching-tide to you. How can I be of service?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_044: Jihli sent you? I suppose I have been gone for a while, but I've been having trouble hiding our eggs in the arena...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_045: As I was working, these tall, thick grasses suddenly sprung forth! I tried to trim them back, but not even my best garden scythe could make the smallest impression. At best, I managed to snip a couple of leaves...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_046: Now, I cannot help but worry that our arena is carpeted not by typical brambles, but a variety of leafkin... We can hardly send our egg hunters into a nest of monsters! Oh, what to do...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_047: You would help? A godssend, truly! Then let us start by gathering information about this peculiar plant─though I know adventurers generally prefer to slay monsters first and ask questions later.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_048: I shall head for the Botanists' Guild. In the meantime, if you could ask around the Carline Canopy regarding the strange specimen, I would greatly appreciate it.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_049: Here, take one of the leaves I managed to salvage. Let us reconvene at the aetheryte plaza once we have gathered what information we can.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_16: Thank goodness Nonotta is hale and whole! Here I was fearing some monstrous, eggy accident... Thank you for your assistance!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_GUILDLEVESGIRL05425: Greetings, adventurer. Have you come seeking a contract?
This leaf...I daresay it comes from some variety of flytrap.
We often receive petitions regarding roselets, but I don't believe I've seen leafkin of this particular shade of green. Curious...

Just as typical plant life flourishes during this season, so too do leafkin. I would not be surprised if some aberrant strain had developed in the process. If you require assistance in culling it, do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_ADVENTURER05425_000: Hey there, . You looking to hire? I'm good with a lance.
Oh, I recognize this─a whole swarm of this leafkin was crowding a little corner of the Black Shroud just the other day. Never seen anything quite like it, so I tried giving it a poke.
But would you believe it? The leaves and flowers just kept growing back, easy as you please. Eventually, I just gave up. If there's one thing I can't stand, it's feeling impotent.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_WAITER05425_000_067: Welcome to the Carline Canopy. If there is any way I might be of service, you need only ask.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_WAITER05425_000_068: While I am well-versed in the leaves steeped for myriad teas, my knowledge can offer no insight on this particular specimen. My apologies.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_WAITER05425_000_069: However, we did have a guest come in search of strange leafkin just moments ago.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_WAITER05425_000_070: An Elezen gentleman wearing shaded spectacles. He introduced himself as an alchemist specializing in the study of wild beasts.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_WAITER05425_000_071: While he did seem somewhat...eccentric, perhaps an expert of his standing might offer the assistance you require? I believe he said he was bound for Old Gridania, should you desire to seek him out.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_GUILDLEVESGIRL05425: That leaf may belong to a mutation. If it gives you any trouble, we can help.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_ADVENTURER05425_000: What's worse, that damned leafkin didn't so much as give me a proper fight! Just sprang back all the thicker, like the elementals were sneering at me. <sigh> Gods, but I'm lonely...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_WAITER05425_000_082: The alchemist seeking curious leafkin said he had business in Old Gridania. You may still be able to catch him.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_091: According to the folks at the Botanists' Guild, the leaf belongs to a type of highly durable leafkin...so durable, in fact, that the pieces you and I possess are, apparently, still very much alive. <cough> Er, what did you discover?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_092: So others have been similarly unsuccessful in cutting them back? In which case, developing an alternative strategy does seem in order...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_093: The alchemist you mentioned seems like a good lead, don't you think? An Elezen with shaded spectacles...perhaps that was the fellow with whom I was speaking earlier.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_094: He did say something about chasing a leafy beast, after all. Let's head over and see if we can't find him!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_100: Here he is! The gentleman who asked about my glasses!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_110: Ohoho? The fortuitous chicken has found me again! Along with a  of adventure...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_111: (-Herberin-)Yes, that sounds like me! Ravenous for leafkin large and small, the wayfaring alchemist Herberin, at your service.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_112:
(-Herberin-)Wha...aaa...aaat!? Why, this is the very leaf I have been pursuing for moons upon moons!
Moons upon moons upon moons upon moooooons!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_113: (-Herberin-)...That is to say, if you are seeking assistance in combating this menace, I would be happy to help.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_114: We would be much obliged! As an alchemist, would you say that some sort of concoction might be effective against this creature?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_115: (-Herberin-)Ohoho! Doubt you not the efficacy of my concoctions, little chicken. With this aberrant leaf in his possession, Herberin the Great can finally realize his purpose for traveling to the Twelveswood─can finally seize his quarry by the stalk and wrestle it into submission!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_116: (-Herberin-)...But my enthusiasm overcomes me. You see, as I was poring over leafkin of this very persuasion, my eyeballs were subjected to quite a piece of mischief. Since then, they burn like all seven hells if exposed to sunlight, wind, or most anything.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_117: (-Herberin-)So long as I wear these tinted lenses, I can remain upright and free of blinding pain and nausea for several bells at a time! Quite long enough to brew a tincture that shall spare you both a similar fate. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have ingredients to procure from the Shaded Bower.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_118: W-Wait! At least allow me to foot the bill!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_120: By the time I caught up with him, he had already finished his shopping...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_130: Aha...hahaha... Just the bare sight of that leaf has imbued me with untold mercantile stamina. Like lightning flashed my gil, and like a mountain grew my spoils!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_131: Now then, I must gather my thoughts... The leafkin in question is a troublesome strain of flytrap possessed of vitality so great that it sprouts forth with abundance from the very spot it has been shorn.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_132: Therefore! By thwarting its regenerative properties, we may cut this terror down to size not only in the metaphorical sense, but the literal!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_133: You two have living pieces of its tender, floral flesh. Combined with my chosen ingredients, they should yield a distillation that will forestall the creature's recovery.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_134: The effects will be temporary, but a skilled hand needs only a few moments, no? Soak your scythe in Herberin's Bane, and mow with all your might!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_135: What wonderful news! Can you imagine if the creatures were only susceptible to fire? An egg hunt through a field of ash is hardly what Jihli dreamed of...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_136: Fire? Heavens forfend, my dear chicken! The act of snipping in itself is transcendent communication, or so they say.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_137: To inhale the life breath of the forest. To welcome within one's heart the bounties of the land. To occasionally have one's eyes squirted with burning venom. These are the experiences we live for.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_138: Not to mention all the free samples of plant life to be gained along the way! Were I not liable to keel over at any moment, I would like nothing better than to slice the shrubbery by your side. However, I have every confidence that a brave adventurer such as yourself will succeed where I have failed.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_139: Now, let us commence! Make me the happiest man in the realm, and bestow upon me your leaves!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_140: Just as oil dissolves oil, the extracts from this leaf shall counteract their own regenerative properties...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_141: Whereby this should be brought thusly, and that should be...? Yes! From all angles may this scythe strike true!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_142:
Hnghhh...
I offer up...my masterpiece...my soul...my well-lubricated garden scythe...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_143: In your hands, may it hack away our hardships...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_A2_000_002: You can leave the rest to me.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_145: L-Let's not get too carried away, shall we!? Think of the children...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_146: Now that our garden scythe is equipped to cut back the flytraps, we are one step closer to reclaiming our arena.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_147: Rest assured, your efforts will be rewarded with exclusive Hatching-tide gifts! But, er, do take care to avoid any squirting venom.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_148: Herberin the Upright would like to join this sortie to observe the effects of his alchemical miracle. Insofar as they can be observed with scalded eyeballs.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_149: Of course! Let us watch 's work from a safe distance.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_150: Our arena is a fair walk from here, so I will have the Dreamers arrange for a chocobo carriage. Come and find me when you are ready to depart!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_160: Oooh, I cannot wait to see those beautiful fronds fall like rain beneath your blade!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_169: Ready to clear our arena of troublesome sprigs and stalks?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_170: Just say the word, and an egg usher shall whisk us away!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_000_171: You can now participate in Sprig Cleaning.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_000_172: Wield a special garden scythe to slay troublesome traps and retrieve Archon eggs. All classes and jobs are eligible to participate in Sprig Cleaning.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_000_173: Speak with the egg ushers in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard to travel to the arena.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_180: When you're ready, just speak with an egg usher!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_190: What glory... In my mind's eye, I can still see the arc of your scythe, the crisp shredding of the leaves...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_200: Magnificent work! Thanks to you, our Hatching-tide participants may search for eggs in safety and comfort.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_201: Indeed, my alchemical solution exceeded even my own expectations. You have delivered me a vision, a dream!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_202: Not to mention sprigs of a most troublesome trap! How I shall probe, how I shall stare─all without risk to what remains of my vision! Hoo hoo!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_203: Well, I'm glad he seems pleased with the results. Go ahead and tell Jihli that our egg hunt may proceed as scheduled!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_210: I'm sure Jihli will be thrilled to hear that our egg arena is operational!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_22: Our arena was filled with leafkin!? No wonder preparations were taking longer than expected. I am glad to hear the issue has been resolved and that everyone emerged unscathed!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_221: Not only did  clean up those sprigs and sprouts,  also managed to retrieve what eggs were lost to the foliage. We should be ready to hide the eggs anew and begin the festivities!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_22: I would like to thank the alchemist who was so crucial to the operation. Do you think Master Herberin is still in Gridania?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_224: The man himself! You sound, er, cheerful?
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_225: Fair chicken, “cheerful” does not describe the half of my mood. For Herberin the Peerless has made a discovery for the ages!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_226: From the leafkin samples you provided me, I was able to concoct a regenerative ointment for my poor, blistered eyeballs. I am cured!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_227: My habit of sticking my face too close to my object of study has, at long last, served me well. For where once venom splashed, so too did an antidote!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_228: Can you imagine how else we might manipulate the properties of these fantastic creatures? We could develop cures upon cures, devise agents upon agents!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_229: We are witness to a golden age of alchemy, rising resplendent from fields of fell leafkin!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_23: Goodness! This must be what the eggs in my dream represented─the bright hopes for the future that this discovery portends!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_231: So it was you, my oval comrades, who spoke of destiny. Had I but listened... Alas, Herberin has been a fool.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_232: But no longer! I shall hereby heed the wisdom of Egg and continue my work with full faculties. All thanks to you!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_NONOTTA_000_233: You seem to possess a great appreciation for the spirit of Hatching-tide! And also a pair of our promotional glasses...
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_HERBERIN_000_234: Oh, these? These I wear not for protection against the elements but as a reminder of the catalyst that changed my fate forevermore! Hmm hmm!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_JIHLIALIAPOH_000_23: It does me proud to see how Hatching-tide brings joy to one and all─and our celebrations have but scarcely begun!
, please accept these glasses as a token of our appreciation. You have more than earned them.
Our Dreamers will continue patrols of the arena, but we may well need some further trimming. Your assistance would be much appreciated─and rewarded with special Hatching-tide gifts!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_000_238: You can participate in Sprig Cleaning as many times as you wish during the seasonal event period by speaking with the egg ushers in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre or the Acorn Orchard.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_090_238: Race against the clock as you slash your way through endless stages of shrubbery, and aim for the highest score possible!
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_100_238: You may earn special brilliant eggs by completing Sprig Cleaning.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_110_238: Special brilliant eggs may be traded to the Dreamer in Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre for gear and items.
TEXT_FESESX101_05425_SYSTEM_000_239: You have unlocked the Egg Hunter Riggy mini-game. To play mini-games, open the toy chest found in any inn room.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_100_001: Now, who to recruit? Someone well versed in the Gold Saucer's attractions would be ideal, but...
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SYSTEM_200_001: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the quest “It Could Happen to You,” which can be undertaken at level 15.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_001: Why,  ! What fortune that we should meet again. You have been well, I trust?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_002: Would that our meeting were under more fortunate circumstances. I'm in something of a bind at the moment, but perhaps that is why fate has guided your steps here. Might I borrow your ear a moment?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_003: As you may have heard, the Make It Rain Campaign is in full swing at the Gold Saucer. My peers and I are come to advertise the festivities, but we lack the staff required to cover the whole of Ul'dah. I do not wish to impose, but...might we prevail upon you for your assistance?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_004: Greetings, . Pray forgive my presumption, but you are an adventurer, yes? You've the unmistakable air of their worldly sort. Courageous, diligent, hardworking...and generous with your time, I should hope.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_005: I am Ollier, and I serve as one of the many attendants at the Manderville Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_006: The famed Make It Rain Campaign is currently underway, and we are come to Ul'dah to promote the festivities. If we wish to spread word of it more thoroughly, however, we will require extra support. Namely, yours, if you are so inclined.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_007: Wonderful! It's a great help to us, truly.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_008: Pray meet me at the Gold Court, and I shall give a more detailed account of the circumstances─I believe our collaborators are scheduled to perform there shortly.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEA05443_000_01: Why, it's adorable! And clever, as well!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEB05443_000_01: Such sleek, silky fur! But if it's not quite a Qiqirn, and not quite a rat, what is it, exactly...?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_100_011: Ah, you've arrived! Ere I begin with explanations, I think it best to let you first experience this year's main attraction.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_012: (-Animated Announcer-)People of Ul'dah, lend me your ears! Allow me to present my dear friends, come all the way from the Far East! These are the Globe-trotter Otters, this year's ambassadors to the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_013: We bid you join us for the ongoing Make It Rain Campaign, where merriment abounds and dreams are made manifest with mounds of MGP! Whether you wish to play the Cactpot, race chocobos, or try your hand at mahjong, there is fun for one and all at the Manderville Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEA05443_000_01: “Globe-trotter Otters,” she said? I've not seen their like before...but now I feel as though I've been missing out my whole life!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEB05443_000_01: And if we go to the Gold Saucer, we may encounter more of those furry little gentlemen? I suppose it has been a while since my last visit...
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_017: The Auri performer there is Mistress Ajisai. She and her otter companions hail from the Far Eastern nation of Nagxia.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_018: I am told Lord Manderville owed her people a great debt. 'Twas he who invited her troupe to lead our campaign this year. An apt choice, for they dazzle and delight passersby with their performances.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_019: While promotional efforts here at the Gold Court are all well and good, we haven't the hands to cover as much ground as we initially envisioned. As such, I thought it prudent to seek out a trustworthy adventurer who could guide one of the otters around town.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_020: Ah, this must be our assistant!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_021: We are most delighted to meet you, . I am Ajisai, and this here is my friend Usosuke.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_022: Isn't this grand, Usosuke?  here is taking you to roam the city!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_025: You say  seems a trustworthy sort? My, that's rather high praise coming from you, and quite rare besides.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A1_000_003: I'm sorry, say that again? I was distracted by your adorable otter...
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_026: Indeed I do! For generations, my home village has lived in harmony with otters. Having spent my entire life with them, I am well accustomed to their speech and mannerisms.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_027: I can scarcely blame you! Their round little eyes, their precious waggly tails, their damp, fuzzy heads... Oh, it's all so wondrous!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_028: You see, for generations, my home village has lived in harmony with otters. Having spent my entire life with them, I am well accustomed to their speech and mannerisms.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_029: In fact, Mistress Ajisai is an avid conservationist who has dedicated her life to protecting the otters and their habitats. A portion of the proceeds from this year's campaign will go towards Nagxian otter preservation efforts.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_030: That they will! It is precisely why I wish to bring as many patrons as possible to the Saucer. Their support─and yours─may save countless otters, so your cooperation would be most appreciated!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_031: For promotional purposes, we have prepared you a uniform and a special backpack, not unlike the ones Mistress Ajisai and I are wearing. When you are ready, just say the word and I shall present you with the raiments you require.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_041: Nagxia and its neighbors were ravaged by the conflict between the Empire and the resistance. My village was no exception...
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_042: But fate has smiled upon us. You see, when Lord Godbert traveled across the star in his youth to hone his craft, he abided in our village for a time.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_043: Moved by the plight that befell my home, he sought to strike a deal that would benefit us all. His earnest wish to repay my people's hospitality rekindled the fires of hope in our hearts.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_044: You are ready, then? Excellent. Once you have donned your uniform and backpack, pray accompany Master Usosuke as he makes his rounds of the Steps of Thal.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_045: Usosuke is possessed of a keen instinct for locating crowds!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_046: But given the limits of his vocabulary, we'd like for you to speak in his stead and inform patrons of the Gold Saucer's myriad wonders.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_047: Ollier and I have a meeting to attend, but once we have finished, we mean to canvas the Steps of Nald with the rest of the Globe-trotter Otters in search of potential patrons. May the kami of fortune see fit to bless us both!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_048: Now, be a good little otter for , Usosuke!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_050: Do keep a sharp eye on Master Usosuke, my friend!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_053: Oh? Removed your uniform, have you? Allow me to remedy that.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_100_053: I must say,  , the backpack and uniform suit you rather well. I shall be here if you require any adjustments, so do not hesitate to call upon me. Go forth, my friend, and advertise away!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SYSTEM_000_055: You must be wearing the Gold Saucer uniform and backpack provided by Ollier in order to progress.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEC05443_000_06: Oh, my! What a precious little darling you are! Where did you come from?
Oh, Mother, look! Isn't he sweet? I think he's trying to tell us something.
I see! So they're having a festival at the Gold Saucer! Will there be more adorable animals like him wandering about?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A2_000_001: There's plenty of chocobos to meet at the racetrack.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A2_000_002: Their mascot's a lovable, huggable sabotender!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A2_000_003: There's a special strategy game just for mammets and minions!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEC05443_000_06: That sounds like a dream come true! I'd love to see it all for myself... Can we go to the Gold Saucer, Mother dearest? Can we?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLED05443_000_06: We'll need to consult your father about it. He did recently bring up the subject of taking more family outings, though, so I doubt he'll refuse.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEC05443_000_06: Thank you so much for finding us! If I see you at the Gold Saucer, I'd love to spend more time with you!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SYSTEM_000_068: Usosuke skitters off in search of prospective patrons. Follow him to help spread word of the Make It Rain Campaign!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEE05443_000_06: What a masterfully woven tuxedo! Dapper enough to charm fashion aficionados, yet versatile enough to please even the sartorially challenged. Who are you, my diminutive debonair? And who are you wearing?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEE05443_000_07: Why, I've not seen a classier creature in all my days. Have you some business with us?
Ah yes, the Make It Rain Campaign. Lord Godbert always did have a penchant for dressing his mascots in dignified raiments.
And I see you are dressed in some striking accoutrements as well. Tell me, as an aficionado of all things fashion, what might I gain from going to the Gold Saucer?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A3_000_001: You can exchange MGP for all manner of unique garments.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A3_000_002: You can gain an appreciation for the Manderville aesthetic!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A3_000_003: You'll love Masked Rose's Fashion Report.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEE05443_000_07: Is that right? I normally have no interest in gaudy amusement parks, but that sounds rather promising. Perhaps it's worth experiencing for myself.
Thank you, my fuzzy little gent. You have given me a fresh new perspective on the Saucer...and that tuxedo is absolutely flawless, I must say.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SYSTEM_000_077: Usosuke sets off once more in search of potential patrons! Follow him to his next destination.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_USOSUKE_000_081: Prrr! Pip pip pip! Prrr, pip pip!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEF05443_000_08: Heh, let me guess─something's afoot at the Gold Saucer?
Ahhh, so the Make It Rain Campaign's returned, eh? Haven't been to the Saucer in an age...but I really ought to change that. We owe much and more to Lord Godbert, after all.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_A4_000_001: Was there something he helped you with?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEG05443_000_08: The three of us were Ala Mhigan refugees, y'see. The average Ul'dahn didn't take so kindly to us, and despite our best efforts, our job prospects were slim to none─but Godbert Manderville changed all that. Hired the three of us and more to help build his Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEF05443_000_08: I don't suppose your companion's tuxedo was based on Senor Sabotender's, was it?
Senor Sabotender's a favorite of mine... Him, and all he represents.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_PEOPLEF05443_000_09: Construction on the Saucer started soon after the Calamity. In those days, Dalamud's aftermath haunted every waking moment of our lives.

And yet, despite it all, there was an old Lalafellin man among the workers who loved nothing more than to make us laugh. Every day he'd think up some new dance or pose to lift our spirits. Some called him eccentric, but none could deny the joy he brought us.

After our work was done and the Saucer was built, old Godbert sought that man out and dubbed him the first Senor Sabotender. Even now─even if it's not the same man in the suit─I can't help but grin when he strikes his famous pose.
It ain't much of my business anymore, but... Keep on spreading that joy to others. Just like our friend did.
Anyroad, didn't mean to talk your ear off. I'll let you get back to it. And don't you worry─we'll find time to visit the Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_SYSTEM_000_098: With his rounds complete, Usosuke strolls off in the direction of the Gold Court. It would be best to reconvene with him and report to Ajisai.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_100: A warm welcome back to you,  . Your timing is impeccable─Ajisai and I are just returned from the Steps of Nald. I daresay our exhibitions were a resounding success!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_101: Welcome back, . I must extend my thanks to you once again for accompanying dear Usosuke!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_102: You ought to thank  as─hm? Is something troubling you, Usosuke?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_USOSUKE_000_103: Pip pip pip! Pip pip, piiip!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_104: You wish to learn Senor Sabotender's famous pose!? What inspired this, all of a sudden?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_105: Hm... Did aught occur during your rounds?
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_106: Ah, so that is the way of it... I imagine Usosuke yearns to uplift others in the selfsame spirit of Senor Sabotender.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_108: A noble desire, that─and one that can feasibly be arranged. I shall speak with Lord Godbert and request the tutelage of our current Senor Sabotender.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_109: Our patronage has thrived thanks in part to his efforts, after all. Master Usosuke's continued endeavors will be a boon to guests and staff alike!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_AJISAI_000_112: We may never have made this discovery without your assistance, . I am in your debt!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_114: Well, then, I believe it's high time we made our way to the Gold Saucer.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_115: Pray meet us there at your earliest convenience,  . Your reward awaits!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_120: Ah! There you are. Allow me to express my thanks again for spending time with Master Usosuke.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_121: He and his fellow Globe-trotter Otters took to their posing lessons most diligently! Our current Senor Sabotender was quite impressed with the results, just as I'm sure our clientele will be.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_122: What's more, I am pleased to report that this year's promotional campaign is proving incredibly profitable. It pays to take the Gold Saucer directly to Ul'dah, so to speak, and you were an invaluable asset to our success.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_OLLIER_000_123: In recognition of these efforts, Lord Godbert has expressed interest in personally presenting you with your reward. Allow me to take you to him.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_201: ! Welcome, my friend, to the Gold Saucer!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_202: Ollier tells me you have done us a great service, promoting our campaign with aplomb! As you can see, the Saucer is teeming with satisfied guests.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_203: And so, in the spirit of innovation with which I pride my craft, 'tis my great privilege to bestow upon you my newest masterpiece.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_205: I present to you Senor Otter, a mammet crafted in the likeness of our friend Usosuke. This miniature globe-trotter and the backpack we entrusted to you earlier are yours to keep.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_206: As Ollier may have mentioned, I have pledged to invest a percentage of our profits into otter preservation efforts, and we are off to a most heartening start. On behalf of all involved, you have my heartfelt gratitude.
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_207: The Gold Saucer is─and shall ever be─a place of merriment for all who enter. Which is why I should hope we can expect your patronage, as well!
TEXT_FESGSX001_05443_GODBERT_000_208: Until then, know that we eagerly await your next visit!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_001: Why, if it isn't ! 'Tis my great pleasure to welcome you to this year's Little Ladies' Day festivities.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_002: Well met, adventurer, and welcome to our Little Ladies' Day festivities! Allow me to introduce myself... I am known as the royal seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_003: It is my duty─and the duty of all who take on the role of “seneschal” this season─to help grant the manifold wishes of ladies across the realm, that they might be pampered as princesses for a day. Such is Little Ladies' Day tradition!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_004: Have you partaken in this year's concerts yet, my friend? The Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince are, as ever, our shining stars on stage, and they have been practicing oh-so-diligently for this event.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_006: (-???-)My, my... How marvelous! What seasonal sensations... The Songbirds and Seneschal Prince's performances have propelled their popularity to a fever pitch.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_007: (-???-)Their economic exploits have defied every expert's expectations. As they balance billions of gil in gains, the masses cannot help but contemplate─why do folks flock to them? What forces drive this formidable fount of funds to flow?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_008: Ahem! Forgive me my raucous rambling... I am Dural Tharal, renowned reporter for the Mythril Eye.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_009: I mean to gather information on these prominent performers and pen a piece for our next publication!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_010: I could scarcely ask for a more perfect opportunity for promotion! Where the Mythril Eye goes, fame and prestige are bound to follow. The Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince will be thrilled to hear of this!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_011: A thousand, thousand thanks! Then without further fanfare, I shall solicit the citizens of the city-state for their feedback.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_012: ...Though now that I think on it, my tendency to focus on the financials might poison the piece's perspective, so to speak. An objective observer would be ideal.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_A1_000_002: This objective observer can help...if you're willing to pay.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_014: Why, yes! Your impartial input would be naught but a benefit.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_015: Excellent! Fret not─you'll be duly compensated for your cooperation.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_016: Permit me to brief you on our performers, then. The knowledge will doubtless prove a useful reference for your upcoming report.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_017: I shall begin with the Songbirds─the pride and joy of Little Ladies' Day! Our talented trio consists of Ulala, dressed in crimson...then we have Narumi, clad in yellow, and, of course, Masha Mhakaracca, donning blue.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_018: They have come far from their humble beginnings, and their tireless efforts have recently borne fruit. Of late, their concerts have taken the realm by storm, winning countless new fans across Eorzea.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_019: And 'twould be remiss of me not to mention Picot, our dashing Seneschal Prince in violet. He is the newest addition to our lineup, and a rising star in his own right! He stole many a heart last Little Ladies' Day.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_020: They inspire one another─as well as their crowds─in equal measure! Their musical prowess is as a fresh spring breeze, breathing new life into the celebration as we know it.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_021: This year, we shall be outfitting concert attendees with a unique line of themed apparel and illuminations for the occasion, complete with matching colors for each member of our merry band.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_022: So you appeal to all audiences, allowing spectators to support their favorite singer... A sound strategy! Meanwhile, your prized performers pinpoint their most passionate fans in the process, making for a more memorable experience!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_023: With that, I believe I have enough to embark on our excursion. When you are set to search the city for some tried-and-true testimonials, simply say the word!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_025: May your collaboration with Dural Tharal be a rousing success! I shall continue with my work here, but I eagerly await the finished product!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_030: Let the collaboration commence! To begin, I suggest we search away from the stage so as not to startle any spectators. Perhaps we might pursue possible leads near the perimeter of the Gate of Nald?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_031: We need but seek out and speak to those in Songbird and Seneschal shirts! Shall we?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_032: What specifically about these singing celebrities encourages fervent fans to fly to them...? Duty demands I discover the truth!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_Q3_000_033: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Dural Tharal?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_034: Ah, attending to some errands elsewhere? Worry not. I shall return to the royal seneschal at the Ruby Road Exchange─join me there when you are ready to resume reporting!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_035: Let us recommence our journalistic jaunt!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_000_036: Dural Tharal has yet to arrive. Be sure he is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ULALAFAN05444_000_0: Come on, put your backs into it, you two! Channel your inner Ulala, if you must!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_000_041: You should have Dural Tharal accompanying you before proceeding with your inquiry.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ULALAFAN05444_000_0: Keen to learn about our favorite Songbird, you say? Well, we here are the Ulala faithful!
Gods, where do I even begin? Her presence on stage is second to none, and her warm smile can melt even the coldest hearts... She may be small, but the power in her voice more than makes up for it!

And that's to say nothing of her passion for her fans and the music─it's why she dons such fiery red hues! I speak for us all when I say we'd do most anything for her if she asked with that winsome little smile of hers.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_045: So your small-yet-esteemed singer's stunning stagecraft stirs your sentiments, you say... Duly noted. I suppose I could sympathize!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_MASHAFAN05444_000_0: You're working on a report with your colleague? Well, that's lovely, but...where are they?
You're interviewing folks for a piece on the Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince? Oh, I'd love to participate! I'm a Masha fan, through and through.

She has the most amazing voice, and there's something about the way she dances that really speaks to me. You can tell she puts pride into every facet of her performances, and it never fails to take my breath away!

In fact, her dedication inspires me to be more mindful in my day-to-day living! Even with something as simple as descending the stairs, I'll often find myself thinking, “I must be careful. Masha needs me!”
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_MASHAFAN05444_100_0: Speaking of dedication, I hear Masha's come up with one of the limited-time dishes being served at the Quicksand. We ought to sample it for ourselves!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_054: So Masha's perseverance provides a particular sense of purpose past performances, extending into the everyday... Fascinating, all of it!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_060: With that, I assume we've accounted for all the aficionados in the area. However...if that Masha fan tells it true, those seasonal Songbird snacks are bound to bring multitudes to Mistress Momodi's establishment! Come, let us continue our queries at the Quicksand!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ULALAFAN05444_000_0: Long as Ulala keeps singing─and even if she doesn't─we'll never stop cheering for her! And with these brilliant red illuminations to match her fiery spirit, I'm sure she'll always feel our hearts reaching out to her.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_MASHAFAN05444_000_0: Masha is constantly striving to be a better Songbird, but she's already the definition of perfection, if you ask me!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_NARUMIFAN05444_000_: Erm. I apologize, but...have we met? I-If you're attempting to sell me something, I'm afraid I must politely decline...
Ah, you're reporting for the Mythril Eye, are you? Well, as you've doubtless ascertained, I am one of Narumi's fans.
Though she may be the most demure of the three Songbirds, she harbors a quiet strength and endless compassion that we cannot help but cherish.

She approaches her art so delicately, so exquisitely, that it feels as though she is speaking to all her fans as individuals. It compels us to support her in her every endeavor, that she might always know happiness in the spotlight.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_074: So Narumi employs a subtle-yet-sincere approach... Imagining such a saintly smile on stage, why, I could certainly see the appeal!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_PICOTFAN05444_000_0: Hm? I don't mind you interviewing me, but...you don't strike me as a reporter.

Asking about the stars of Little Ladies' Day? Well, you've come to the right place! Most folk are head-over-heels for the Songbirds, but I've only got eyes for Picot. His debut last Little Ladies' Day really won me over.

As Seneschal Prince, he takes it upon himself to treat his fans like royalty. He's incredibly handsome, of course, but his honeyed words and that sweet little smirk are the highlights of his every show... Would that he could be my prince every day!

Oh, and when you shine his violet illumination in the crowd, he does notice, even if you're in the very, very back row! Last Little Ladies' Day, he winked in my general direction, and...well, even if he didn't actually wink at me, I'd like to believe it was so!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_084: The mere thought of Picot's past productions is enough to make most fans swoon─a true testament to his talent! And if the rumors are true, he strives to serve all his fans, be they lads or little ladies. Which means there's hope yet that I too can be a princess under his sovereign smile...
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_090: Ahem! As assumed, our performers possess a fiery fanbase! With this wealth of wisdom, I am well prepared to write. But one thing struck me as strange─while we were wandering, I espied an elegant young lady surveying the Songbirds' and Seneschal's stage from afar.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_090: I am interested in interviewing her as well, if she is so inclined... Shall we sally forth and see what she says?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_NARUMIFAN05444_000_: If my single voice can encourage Narumi to press on as a singer, even in the slightest, then there would be no greater joy. Her songs grant me courage, and I wish to give back to her in any way I can.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_PICOTFAN05444_000_0: By the by, did you know that Picot devised this meal especially for the seasonal menu here? Beneath the bold flavors, there's a hint of something delicately sweet...just like him!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_RODOLPH_000_097: Lady Aldiytha suffers from a frail constitution... Should the worst come to pass, 'tis my solemn duty to remain at her side.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_100: Why, if it isn't the kindly adventurer from seasons past! 'Tis I, Aldiytha Thorne! You have been well, I trust?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_101: Greetings to you both. I don't believe we've met... I am Aldiytha Thorne. Is there aught I can assist you with?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_102: Such serendipity! A scion of the honored House Thorne! I had heard that your house had contributed a substantial sum in support of these festivities. Come to celebrate and see the show, I gather?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_103: Indeed. On behalf of House Thorne─and out of my own curiosity─I wished to behold the annual concert with my own eyes. 'Tis heartening to know the annual performances have blossomed into such a passionate showcase of song and dance.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_104: Would that I could join the audience and show my own support...
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_RODOLPH_000_105: Though you are hale enough to travel this day, I must advise against it, my lady. We cannot risk worsening your condition.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_106: Alas, it is as Rodolph says. I've not the strength to sway to the rhythm and jump about as I please.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_107: But from this vantage point, I can, at least, gaze upon the stage and the audience from afar─a rather enlightening experience, all told.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_108: Even from this distance, it is easy to tell how much the performance means to all of them. How joyful they all are...
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_109: Hee hee... I daresay their energy is contagious.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_110: Delight and devotion take many forms. If these crowds can find happiness by supporting their beloved singers─if we can garner their interest in this holiday, but even for a fleeting moment─then I could ask for little else.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_111: A poignant point you make, my lady! And it's as you've ascertained─all who answered our inquiries delighted in describing their preferred performers, each selecting to celebrate in their own way.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_112: There is no correct answer as to how to celebrate the season, for only together could they make Little Ladies' Day the fine festival it has become. Such is likely a significant source of its singers' success.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_113: I must thank you thoroughly for your thoughtful theories! It shall serve as a fine addition to my article.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_114: They are merely fleeting thoughts I had as I enjoyed the performances...but I am pleased they could be of use.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_ALDIYTHA_000_115: I wish you both a delightful Little Ladies' Day!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_120: I owe you one for your committed cooperation. Indeed, I've amassed all manner of ardent accounts from the fans!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_121: Some show support by cheering in cacophonous cries to the stage, while others watch wistfully from a ways off, or make merry by feasting on festive foods... As the performers' popularity proliferates, so too do prospective methods to please their fans.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_122: Merriment made for one's pastimes is a mysterious, marvelous matter. For our favorite fads, we often find ourselves opening our wallets without so much as a second thought! Even I am no stranger to that.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_000_123: But I digress! It's time we saw these Songbirds and Seneschal Prince for ourselves, to fully fathom what all the fuss is about...provided we have permission from the royal seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_124: Now that we know what makes these singers so special, 'tis time we took part in the main event!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_130: Welcome back. How fared the interviews?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_130: They went well. Wonderfully well, in fact. As our last task, we wished to watch one of the performances, if we are welcome to do so.
