TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_131: By all means! I would love nothing more than to read of your impressions when all is properly published.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_131: For a more objective observation, I'd like to spectate the show from afar. Might I ask you to take to the crowds?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_110_131: Excellent! Enjoy the event, and we will reconvene once the stage has settled.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_132: The handmaiden here will furnish you with a set of Songbird-themed attire and a portable illumination. Once you've obtained what you require, you need only wait for an opportune moment to join the crowd.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_000_133: During this event, the FATE “Live from Ul'dah” will appear on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_000_134: In order to participate in the FATE, you must first speak with the royal handmaiden at the Ruby Road Exchange and prepare yourself to join the Songbirds' and Seneschal Prince's crowd of fans.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_000_135: The status effect granted to you by the royal handmaiden can be removed at any time by leaving the area, or using the special action Curtain Call.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_000_136: Upon joining the FATE, you will be given four special actions. Each action uses a different colored set of illuminated rods to cheer for the Songbirds or the Seneschal Prince. Bear in mind each performer is especially receptive to fans who cheer using their signature color.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_140: Still in need of apparel for the event? Our royal handmaiden shall provide you with all you need.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_150: You have my thanks for your participation, adventurer! Your fervor out in the crowds did not go unnoticed.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_150: My, my, what a marvelously masterful performance! Even from a distance, I could not help but offer a round of ardent applause!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_110_150: The fans' passion burned with brilliance that was all but blinding, matched only by the fiery fervor of the performers! I see now why so many are drawn to such shows!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_100_151: Now, it's time I inquired about your immersive involvement: how did it feel to savor the sights and sounds of such a spectacle?
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_A3_000_001: Admit that you reveled in every moment.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_A3_000_002: Empathize with the fans' undying passions.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_A3_000_003: Nod in silence as if you completely understood what just happened.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_110_151: Excellent, excellent... Thank you for the thoughts! I shall account for your attendance in my article!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_120_151: Struck speechless by the show's sonance!? Rest assured, your silence speaks a thousand words!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_130_151: With this, I should be able to pen the perfect piece! But I dare not delay─Little Ladies' Day is only so long, after all!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_DURALTHARAL_140_151: I give you my gratitude, adventurer. You have earned your rightful reward! I must take my leave, but may the fates see fit for us to meet again!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_152: 'Twas a pleasure to see you enjoying the show! Do not hesitate to join in again if you feel so inclined. We've plenty of performances scheduled!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_BUTLER_000_153: I offer you my gratitude for aiding Dural Tharal, and wish you a wonderful Little Ladies' Day!
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_100_160: Certificates of collaboration may be traded to the royal servant at the Ruby Road Exchange for gear and items.
TEXT_FESPDX101_05444_SYSTEM_110_160: You may also exchange them for unique emotes that vary from the quest reward. Participate in the performances and collect as many as you can before the festivities conclude!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_000: Allow me to thank you again, adventurer, for such an enthusiastic showing at our recent concert.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_001: As it happens, the Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince are scheduled to take a break from the spotlight in mere moments... Might you be interested in speaking with them?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_002: I am certain the four of them spotted you in the crowd. They would doubtless be pleased to learn of your recent journalistic exploits on their behalf.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_003: Greetings, adventurer! Your timing is impeccable─the Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince are about to take another short reprieve from the stage. Would you care to speak with them?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_004: I am told your previous words to them proved most inspiring, and they would be overjoyed to hear from you again, should time permit.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_005: You are free to speak to whomever you'd like, of course. Just say the word, and I shall summon them here.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_010: So, which of our stars do you wish to converse with?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_Q1_000_000: Who would you like to speak with?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_011: But of course! I shall go and fetch them right away. Until then, would you kindly wait by that peach tree over yonder?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_020: Apologies for the wait! When I heard you dropped by to see us, , I simply had to make sure I looked my best!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_021: Greetings! Ulala here─but you already knew that! Thanks ever so much for cheering us on!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_022: I spied you in the audience, you know! I take it you joined the rest of my adoring fans in crimson, yes? Oh, what am I saying─of course you did!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_023: If you attend another concert, rest assured I'll be keeping an eye out for you. And if you're not waving my colors around, well... Let's just say you and I will have some words! Tee hee hee!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A2_000_001: You and the Songbirds have my support!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A2_000_002: My illuminations will glow forever red in your honor!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_024: Well, that's very sweet of you to say! We've got to put forth every effort for the fans. We certainly wouldn't be where we are today without them!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_025: As well they should! I am, of course, Eorzea's premier songstress─or...aiming towards that lofty title, anyway. A Songbird's work is never done!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_026: Your concern is appreciated, but you needn't worry over us. With the love and support of our fans, there's no obstacle I can't overcome!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_ULALA_000_027: In any event, we've plenty more shows to put on, so do join us again! You'll be cheering “Ooh la la, Ulala!” in time with the rest of them soon enough.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_030: I'm terribly sorry for the wait...but what a joy it is to see you, ! Are you well?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_031: My apologies for the wait, . I was honored to hear you wished to speak with me.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_032: Yours was a welcome presence in the audience. Thank you kindly for your warm support during our last concert.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_033: It's still odd to think an average girl like myself could become a realm-wide singing sensation. Even now, there are days when I fear this fame is but a fleeting dream, and I might soon wake from it.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A3_000_001: It's no dream─you've earned your praise.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A3_000_002: You're doing just fine out there.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A3_000_003: You'll always have your fans' support.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_034: A most heartening sentiment. Thank you... I shall endeavor to keep those words close and recall them in times of uncertainty.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_035: Thank you. I'm pleased to hear that. With the girls and Picot on my side, I know I have others to count on if I'm ever to falter. I'll continue to give everything I have─for myself, and for them as well.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_036: And I shall ever be grateful for them. They are a dedicated bunch, and their unending support is a constant reminder of my achievements as a Songbird.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_NARUMI_000_037: Though life as a star may seem surreal at times, in my heart, I am well aware this is reality... And I must continue to prove worthy of this privilege. That is why I will do my utmost to ensure our performances bring warmth and joy to you and all of our adoring fans.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: I hope I didn't keep you waiting overlong! How are you faring, ?
Apologies for the wait! The seneschal says you've done us Songbirds a great service by singing our praises in the Mythril Eye. You have my sincerest thanks.
It's rather hard to believe I've been in show business for so long now... Fame and fortune is all well and good, but I won't be satisfied with that alone. The road to perfection is never-ending.
I wish to hone my craft and keep dazzling our audiences! To that end, I've recently begun proposing new and more challenging dances and songs, that we might reach ever greater heights.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A4_000_002: I believe you'll reach those greater heights.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A4_000_003: Your drive to improve is inspiring.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_MASHAMHAKARACCA_000: That means a great deal to me─I'll do my best not to disappoint!
That's the goal, yes! Hearing such encouragement, how could I possibly regret this path I've chosen?
I'm pleased to hear it. Let us keep following our dreams, then. They can lead us to the most wondrous of places if we let them.

Now, I'm not the only one striving to improve, mind─Picot and the girls work tirelessly to deliver stellar performances as well. We'll continue to reach for the stars on every stage we stand upon! And wherever we go, I hope we'll cross paths with you from time to time.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_050: Apologies for the wait, ! When I heard it was you who requested my presence, I ran here as fast as I could.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_051: My deepest apologies for keeping you waiting. You are , yes? The royal seneschal's told me much about you.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_052: It's been exhilarating to perform for such passionate crowds, time and time again... Our fans are truly special.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_053: It's my hope that I can answer every fan who waves a violet illumination in my honor... Of course, that includes you, . I appreciated your support during the last show.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A5_000_001: You'll always have a fan in me!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A5_000_002: You're quite dedicated to your service as a seneschal.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_A5_000_003: You're like a prince possessed on stage!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_054: Huzzah! A fan's support is a powerful thing, you know. Why, every time I hear such praise, I feel as though I could sprout wings and fly!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_055: But of course! I wish to make every fan─be they princess or seneschal─feel as though I am their humble servant.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_056: Y-You think so? I've always felt that my stage persona didn't differ much from my true self, but I suppose I tend to lose track in the heat of a performance...
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_PICOT_000_057: Wherever you find yourself in the audience, know that I shall have my eyes on you. As Seneschal Prince, I am honor-bound to ensure your experience is unforgettable. The next time we meet, may it be under my violet lights!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_060: How did your conversation fare? Good, I trust?
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_061: Excellent! I thank you for your time. Your words are bound to fuel the fire in their hearts, I am sure!
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_062: Should you wish to speak with anyone else for the duration of Little Ladies' Day, you need only ask! 'Tis the least we can do for you.
TEXT_FESPDX102_05445_BUTLER_000_063: Our performances shall continue for a while yet, so please do enjoy the festivities to your heart's content!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_MAYARUMOYARU_000_00: Ahoy, ! Wouldn't you rather be frolicking in the ocean waves than sweltering in the sunbaked Lominsan streets? Luckily, the Moonfire Faire is upon us once again!
Ahoy there, adventurer! Wouldn't you rather be frolicking in the ocean waves than pickling in your own perspiration? You're in luck, my friend─for the Moonfire Faire is in full swing!

As well as providing respite from the heat, the faire has become an opportunity for the Adventurers' Guild to demonstrate the skill and capabilities of its members─including your fine self─to the people of Eorzea, whether potential petitioner or prospective recruit.
Our star attraction is the Queen Lhaminn, a ship fully remodeled into the ultimate seaside resort. Relaxation, refreshments, and giant cannons...it truly has everything!
Suffice to say, I certainly wouldn't be standing around in this heat if not for my duties. Get yourself down to Costa del Sol and speak with Grand Chaperone Haermaga to join the summer fun!
What are you still doing here? The azure waters of Costa del Sol are calling!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_010: Ah, ! Mayaru Moyaru roped you in again this year, did he? Always glad to have you on board.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_011: Ah, I can tell an adventurer when I see one! Welcome aboard, friend. I daresay Mayaru Moyaru sent you along, did he?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_012: The Moonfire Faire is a roaring success─just take a look around! Talk of the Queen Lhaminn's splendor has spread far and wide, and folk have journeyed from across the realm to see it.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_013: A fine thing, to be sure. Still, expecting those who've never so much as smelled a sea breeze to plunge headfirst into the spray...well, it don't always go to plan. We can't have anything impacting the guild's reputation─be it injuries, drownings, or boredom.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_014: So, we've thought up a way to ease our less confident guests into the season a little more gentle-like. And we could use the help of an adventurer such as yourself to convince them that the terrors of the deep won't be terrorizing these shores any time soon.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_015: You remember P'obyano─she's down on the sands below, and I'm sure she'll be more than happy to give you the details.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_016: Look for a gold-haired Miqo'te, down on the sands below, and you'll find P'obyano, another chaperone. She'll be more than happy to give you the details.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_017: P'obyano is down on the sands below, shoring up our new attraction.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_020: Oh, if it isn't ! How lovely to see you!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_021: Oh, hello! Are you looking for someone?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_022: Haermaga sent you along, did he? Perfect timing!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_023: Many of our faire-goers aren't terribly confident around water, you see. Swimming classes are already on offer, but even getting into the ocean is a step too far for particularly nervous guests.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_024: First things first─we need to show them that they can enjoy being beside the seaside! Allow me to introduce...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_025: Our inflatable mograft, proud vessel of the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_026: Adorable and practical, if I say so myself. Spacious enough for guests of any size to lounge comfortably above the water, listening to the lapping of the waves with the sun on their face... Who could fail to fall in love with the ocean?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_027: Though, being dragged out to sea wouldn't be terribly relaxing, either. We've employed magicks to set the rafts on a predetermined course around the shallows─one we ensured was free of ferocious wavekin.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_028: Still, the creatures of the sea are nothing if not unpredictable. For additional security and peace of mind, I'd like a member of the Adventurers' Guild to act as an escort.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_029: Which brings me to my request! How would you like to be our resident tour-guide-turned-bodyguard?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_030: Wonderful! I can rest easy knowing our cruise is in good hands.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_031: Our first guests are already waiting on the opposite shore. Just let the chaperone know I sent you, and we can get the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise underway.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_032: I'll wait for your arrival at the end of the route. I'm keen to hear how our guests enjoy the maiden voyage!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_033: I'll stay here to receive our guests─don't keep them waiting! They should already be down on the shore with the guide.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_100_033: You found P'obyano, then? I appreciate you mucking in.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_GURENSTAFFA05457_00: Might you be the adventurer escorting our guests?
Thank you for agreeing to help. The two young ladies here have come all the way from Gridania to attend the faire. However...
As soon as our Miqo'te guest spied the ocean, she became quite agitated. I can't see her boarding the raft in this state.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_GURENSTAFFA05457_10: Perhaps it will set her mind at ease to know such a stalwart adventurer is to accompany her. Would you be kind enough to speak with her?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_GURENSTAFFA05457_11: I'm sure that our guest will feel much reassured to know she's in such reliable hands!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_039: I-I can't do it! Just look at how deep it is! I'll sink like a stone. And I'm sure I heard someone talking about dangerous wavekin...! No, I can't!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_040: Come now, Lho, it'll be all right! We won't stray far from the shore, remember? And look, here's our adventurer escort!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_100_040: I do apologize─she was so looking forward to this, but the sight of the ocean seems to have awoken some kind of instinctual fear. I just don't know how to reassure her...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A2_000_000: I'll protect you, no matter what!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A2_000_001: I can fell anything in this ocean with a single strike.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A2_000_002: If anything happens, I'll be here to fix you up, all right?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_110_040: ...You will? You do look like you'd take a shark bite to the face without flinching...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_120_040: R-Really? With that kind of confidence, you must be incredibly strong!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_130_040: Truly...? Then...you're able to heal any hurt? It sounds like you can adjust to anything!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_140_040: ...A-All right. I'll trust  and ride the moogle!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_GURENSTAFFA05457_15: I'm heartened to see her fears have been assuaged! Once your own preparations are complete, please give Miss Eavan the word. The mografts are ready and waiting!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_GURENSTAFFA05457_00: Please take a moment to ensure you are prepared for a leisurely ride. The cruise will depart as soon as our guests give the word.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_046: I-I can do this! I can do this!!!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_047: You found P'obyano, then? I appreciate you mucking in.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_050: They said these follow a predetermined course, so I don't suppose it'll matter if a novice like me takes the lead! , I trust you have our backs!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_051: Promise to stay right behind me, okay? You have to promise!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_SYSTEM_000_053: Float away on the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_055: Th-The nice adventurer is right here! I'm fine, I'm absolutely fine...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_056: Look at the scenery! Doesn't the beauty calm your nerves, Lho?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_057: Buildings atop the ocean...! How do they stop the posts from rotting, I wonder?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_058: The breeze must feel so nice up there... How different everything is to Gridania!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_059: Eavan, Eavan! A crab! I've never seen one like that in the Twelveswood's rivers!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_060: Where? Oh, I missed it! I'll have to keep my eyes peeled...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_061: Beds on the beach? Now that sounds more my speed!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_062: I could doze right off to the sound of the waves...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_063: Swimming classes! Oh, how I would love to learn how to swim! ...As long as we don't go too deep.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_064: Let's do it! Now that we've overcome this, we can do anything together, Lho!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_065: Um, are we supposed to be heading right for that massive ship...?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_066: That's the queen-something-or-other? Oh, Eavan, it's amazing! I'm so glad we came!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_070: Welcome, welcome! How did you enjoy your first ocean voyage?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_071: It was wonderful! The feel of the raft swaying with the leaping waves was exhilarating! And the Queen Lhaminn is so imposing up close! It took my breath away!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_072: I saw the most unusual creatures! And everyone looks to be having such fun playing in the sea.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_073: Honestly! You'd never know she'd been about to run for the hills before you turned up. Thank you for giving her the courage to enjoy herself like this.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_074: While I'm tempted to go for another ride, following the same route again might get a little stale. Perhaps it would be fun to have something else to do during the cruise. What do you think, Lho?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_075: Why, we can do anything you like, Eavan! I'm perfectly at home on the high seas now! ...B-But, maybe nothing too adventurous...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_076: That's an interesting suggestion. If the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise offered different activities, it might keep guests coming back to ride again and again!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_077: Did the ride over here give you any inspiration, ?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A1_000_000: A guide giving information about the local area?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A1_000_001: Some cold treats to snack on?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A1_000_002: Small, handheld water cannons to drench your companion?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A1_000_003: A perilous course lined with bombs!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_A1_000_004: It couldn't possibly be any more fun.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_078: That sounds lovely! I did wonder about the architecture and fashion of Costa del Sol on the way here. Everything is so unlike Gridania!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_079: I'd love to learn more about the ocean flora and fauna, too!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_080: Yes, a leisurely chat may make the experience even more relaxing. And it seems likely to appeal to visitors unfamiliar with Costa del Sol!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_082: There are sweets made of ice? That sounds perfect in this heat!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_083: But I wouldn't want to drop them overboard, with how the raft sways...
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_084: Indeed, foodstuffs may not be a good fit for the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise. Though a refreshing juice might be just the thing to stay cool and hydrated─so long as it were not prone to spilling!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_086: Hmm...perhaps it would work on the beach, but I don't think I'd be able to relax and enjoy the scenery if someone was firing upon me for the entire cruise!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_087: Come on, Eavan─it would be such fun! Don't tell me you're afraid of getting wet?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_088: Since we have everything set up, we could always tailor the experience for different guests. Perhaps we could offer the water cannons as an advanced option─assuming all participants are willing!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_091: The poor moogles will pop, and we'll all be swallowed up by the sea!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_092: Ahaha, ! Bombs at the Moonfire Faire? Surely not! <cough> Don't worry, that's just the...adventurer sense of humor.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_100: Well, that's given me plenty to think about. Thanks to you three, I'm confident we'll make an even more pleasant pleasure cruise!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_LHOMUJUUK_000_101: Come on, Eavan, let's go and look around the Queen Lhaminn! Have you seen that giant water slide?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_EAVAN_000_102: Don't you want to get something to eat first? I don't know what they're serving here, but it smells amazing!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_103: That sounds like my cue to show our guests around the Queen. Would you mind letting Haermaga know how things went?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_POBYANO_000_104: Thank you! And I hope you'll enjoy the rest of the faire!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_110: Sounds like those Gridanian lasses had a grand old time!
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_111: As did you, by the wistful look on your face. No need to ask, friend! Here, I've secured an inflatable mograft for you as thanks. The magical limiters have been removed, so you can take a piece of Costa del Sol summer with you wherever you go.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_112: If I know adventurers─which I do─then you're no doubt thinking of all the unlikely and wildly inappropriate places you can ride this beauty. I won't ask! Just remember: safety first, you hear?
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_113: Oh, but before you go floating away to the ends of the universe, it seems like word spreads fast. Faire-goers are clamoring to ride the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise. If you've the time and inclination to escort some more guests, the help would be more than welcome.
TEXT_FESSUX201_05457_HAERMAGA_000_114: Either way, I hope you enjoy the rest of the faire. Perhaps I'll even take the ol' mograft for a spin myself and admire the Queen from a more intimate angle! Hahaha!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_HAERMAGA_000_000: How are you enjoying the faire, ? Fancy another jaunt on the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise? Of course you do!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_HAERMAGA_000_001: Our man on the coast sent word that some folks turned up looking to ride the mografts, and when they heard they'd be joined by an adventurer, they requested you by name.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_HAERMAGA_000_002: You know the place─just along the shore from Costa del Sol. Head on down there when you're ready, and make sure your friends enjoy the ride!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_HAERMAGA_000_003: The cruise starts from the same place as last time, on the shore down from Costa del Sol. You're not going to keep your friends waiting, are you?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_GURENSTAFFA05457_00: Ah, , thank you for agreeing to escort our next guests. They were quite insistent that you be the one to join them.
Their identity? Yes, they were quite distinctive.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_A1_000_001: ...three esteemed figures in the Adventurers' Guild.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_GURENSTAFFA05457_00: If you'll wait but a moment, I'll inform them that their escort has arrived.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_010: L-Listen 'ere, Carvallain, ye spineless cod! This is a challenge─a test o' yer courage, if ye have any under that puffed-up shirt. Don't ye go gettin' any funny ideas, ye 'ear me?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_011: I daresay the entire beach heard you. Though I remain skeptical that a seasoned pirate should find anything in these shallows to test their mettle. Unless some manner of ambush lies in wait...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_012: , how lovely to see you. Baderon invited Momodi and I to experience the La Noscean summer. As you can see, we're quite enjoying ourselves.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_013: Ul'dah and Gridania are a good ways from the sea, so a trip to the coast makes for a nice change of pace. I feel like a young girl again, hehe!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BADERON_000_014: Another day by the sea is nothin' new for ol' Baderon, so I'll be sittin' on the Queen's deck with a flagon o' ale fer company while  enjoy the cruise.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_015: 'Tis lovely to see you, . Fourchenault and I have fond memories of a trip to La Noscea many years past, just the two of us. We were both in agreement that we were long overdue another visit!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_01: My apologies if we have called you away from any matters of import─Ameliance was most keen to see you once she heard you were in attendance. We can be on our way at once, if you should be so kind as to join us.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_017: Ah, there  is! Afraid we're here on business today. The Ironworks is helping the Queen Lhaminn keep her shine─which is to say, Jessie sent us along to maintain the lights.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_018: And I thought it only meet that I inspect the quality of these vessels, as consultant to the Ironworks. Let us see if the accomplished hero makes an equally accomplished guide, shall we?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_019: Hmph. Do not look so surprised. What stage more fitting for the union of the most radiant son of Azim and his Nhaama than a land taking the Sun for its very name? Come─I grant you leave to render your service. Prepare us our vessels!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_020: These small, scouting crafts shall allow Brother Magnai to survey the surrounds from atop the ocean, that he might find his Nhaama. Do not mistake his summons for a petition of aid, khagan. Your presence is merely a matter of convenience.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_021: Not a word o' this to anyone, scrag, or I'll cut out yer blabbin' tongue fer me stew!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_022: The Siren is as foolish as she is boorish if she believes her transparent ploy will lower my guard.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_023: With you joining us, I feel quite at ease.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_024: I'd best not have so much fun that I topple in. I don't much fancy being left behind by the raft!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_025: Fourchenault insists I take the lead, to better enjoy the view.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_02: ...If you have something to say, then say it.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_028: A coat of red paint, a decent propulsion engine, perhaps a few weapon systems...yes, there's potential...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_029: Be glad, khagan, for the minor role you shall play in the legend of the Sun and his Nhaama.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_100_029: The road to this land was long and arduous. I will not suffer to see Brother Magnai return disappointed.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_SYSTEM_000_031: Float away on the Watery Wings Pleasure Cruise?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_035: Time to see what ye're made of, ye lily-livered fop! K-Keep yer eyes on me!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_036: (Indeed, I must observe her keenly till I can discern her true motive.)
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_037: <sigh> Thus compelled to look upon her unrefined visage, 'tis a test of endurance rather than courage...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_038: ...Wh-What's with that look?! I-I'll cut yer eyes out yer gawpin' face!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_039: Pay more attention to yer surrounds, yer surrounds! Unless ye wants me to haul yer arse out o' the brine!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_040: I would rather a watery grave than accept the hand of a Siren. And I rather suspect I could simply stroll back to shore.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_041: ...Still, the faire is remarkably peaceful this year. 'Tis well, given the Krakens have provided our financial backing.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_042: Aye...I can jus' imagine me girls an' their little ones splashin' about. ...Not a bad life.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_043: Sorry excuse for a pirate like yerself could stand to 'ave a few lessons, eh, Carvallain?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_044: Misplaced concern, for you'll find I'm quite adept in the Ishgardian style. Your form, however, no doubt resembles a half-submerged spriggan...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_045: We seem to be nearing the end of the course, and I cannot say there has been much need for courage thus far.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_046: Speak fer yerself! Me 'eart's racin' up 'ere...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CARVALLAIN_000_047: Well, I fail to see how a pleasant ride around the coast was a test of anything more than my patience. Perhaps inspecting the outfitting of the Queen Lhaminn will be a more valuable use of my time. If you will excuse me.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_RHOSWEN_000_048: Did ye hear that? Pleasant, 'e says...! I'd best think of me next “challenge”... I-If the coward's got the stones to face me!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_050: It was sweet of you to suggest I take the front, but I hope I'm not blocking the view!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_051: I can think of none better suited to lead. Besides, I'm happier keeping an eye on things back here.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_052: Miounne dear, you might need to duck through here...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_053: What is an adventure without a little danger?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_054: ...How beautiful. If only I could take this view back to the Carline Canopy.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_055: Shall we commission a painter? I can think of the perfect spot on the Quicksand's walls.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_056: How novel! Perhaps I should consider setting up something similar, for Canopy patrons to soak up the forest air.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_057: They really do seem to love the sun 'round here!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_058: You might not expect it of a desert girl, but I'm a strong swimmer. Nothing clears the head like a few laps of the Goblet's pool.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_059: In that case, how about a little race? I've swum the rivers of the Twelveswood since I was a girl, so I can hold my own.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_060: Look, the Queen Lhaminn! I do hope Baderon isn't too bored, sittin' up there all by his lonesome.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_061: I rather think he would have enjoyed the cruise. We must insist he join us next time.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MIOUNNE_000_062: I've always pictured the sea as raging and tempestuous. What a delight to find it has a gentle side, too. A refreshing change of scenery, to be sure.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MOMODI_000_063: Wasn't it just lovely? And now I'm dyin' to sample the La Noscean drinks... Got to be keepin' an eye on the competition!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BADERON_000_064: Now that, I can 'elp you with! An' my first flagon were all the finer for the view. Always a pleasure to see friends enjoyin' 'emselves, an' all the more so when it's in yer own backyard. Thanks for showin' 'em the ropes, .
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_065: Aren't these mografts the most darling things? If only Alphinaud and Alisaie were here!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_06: I am counting on your discretion, . Under no circumstances are my children to hear of this...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_067: Wouldn't it be wonderful to live out our twilight years somewhere like this?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_06: These pillars are quite close. Take care not to lean overly far, Ameliance.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_070: I'm a grown woman, Fourchenault─you needn't fuss so.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_071: Doesn't that take you back? Remember that night we lay together on the grassy slopes of Tranquility and watched the ocean? How young we were...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_073: Might Alphinaud improve his swimming with similar training...?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_07: I harbor my doubts. The boy just...isn't very buoyant.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_075: I can almost feel my cares being washed away by the natural beauty. We must not leave it so long until our next visit, Fourchenault.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_07: I will accompany you wheresoever you wish─always.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_AMELIANCE_000_077: The vibrant sea of Costa del Sol seems a world apart from the ocean around Sharlayan─and yet both leave one feeling quite exhilarated!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_FOURCHENAULT_000_07: Admittedly, I find my spirits rather uplifted. ...I was a much younger man when last I felt this unencumbered. Thank you, .
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_083: Can't you get a little more speed up, Garlond!?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_084: They must be quite confident in the magical pathfinding to lead the course under the buildings like this...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_085: Is it automatically compensating for the movement of the waves...? Hmph. Child's play.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_086: Nero! You haven't capsized back there, have you?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_087: Why, is the vessel proving too much for you? Say the word and I'll take your place, Chief.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_088: Just imagine if we had a couple of those on the deck of the Enterprise...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_089: The view wouldn't be half bad. I rather enjoy looking down on the world.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_090: In this heat, the idea of a dip is quite inviting... If only I'd brought a bathing suit!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_091: A far cry from the Academy ice plunge. Though herding new students into freezing waters did instill a certain camaraderie.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_092: We're approaching the Queen Lhaminn...time to get to work, Nero!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_093: I can scarcely conceal my delight.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_CID_000_094: Ahh, I feel quite invigorated! Our maintenance work will fly by after that. I'll give you a shout if we stop by again, .
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_NERO_000_095: Very interesting indeed─for such a rudimentary contraption. Granted, my expertise lies not in magic, but the control systems seem more than adequate. Should I return to investigate further, I expect you to make yourself available!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_096: Onwards, Baatu! In search of my Nhaama!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_097: Have you ever seen a more gallant figure than our most radiant brother, khagan?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_098: Hmph. They build their abodes on stilts in supplication to the Sun...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_099: Similar in purpose yet inferior in execution to the awe-inspiring heights of the Dawn Throne.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_100: What light? Could it be my Nhaama's smile, shining softly on the waves? Nay, 'tis only the reflection of the Sun...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_101: The ocean is vast, Brother Magnai, and our search is young.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_102: S-Surely my Nhaama would not expose her tender, sleeping form to one and all...?
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_104: This ocean knows no shadow. To bathe in its waters is not an entirely unappealing proposition...
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_105: Indeed. How I should have liked to visit with my dear wi...<cough> Wh-Why, look there, Brother!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_106: It would appear our time draws to a close. Yet I do not forsake the search for my ethereal moon, shimmering like the light upon the waves...!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_107: And you shall not walk that path alone, Brother Magnai!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_MAGNAI_000_108: My Nhaama must be modest indeed, to conceal herself so from my radiance. Very well! If she means to test my sincerity, let me show myself to be true. My journey shall continue, as surely as the Sun does rise!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_BAATU_000_109: This land is indeed blessed by the Sun. Its rays reach even the ocean floor, as though the water were naught but glass. Just as our most radiant brother's light shall surely shine upon his Nhaama!
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_HAERMAGA_000_110: Thanks for helping out again! I should've known an adventurer of your caliber would be in high demand.
TEXT_FESSUX202_05458_HAERMAGA_000_111: Wouldn't surprise me if others come asking for you. Feel free to stop by again if you have the time!
