TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_XMXMARKETWARP_000_0: My apologies, the Starlight Stalls are somewhat overcrowded at present. I will be happy to guide you there once things have calmed down a little.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_100_000: An adventurer, I presume? Though not an official Starlight celebrant myself, I am here at Amh Garanjy's behest, to assist with the celebrations.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_101_000: Why, if it isn't . My thanks again for your assistance with my previous research on the historical role of reindeer in the Starlight Celebration. Blitzen is thriving, delighting young ones the realm over with his festive illusions.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_001: Merry Starlight, good adventurer! My name is Amh Garanjy, head celebrant of the Starlight Celebration. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_010: Merry Starlight, ! It must be the will of the Spinner Herself that draws us together again. Will you not indulge me, and allow me to regale you with the tale of the Starlight Celebration?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_020: The Starlight Celebration originated in the snowy lands of Ishgard, and has become a festival in which the Saint of Nymeia delivers gifts to children the land over.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_021: We celebrants do what we can to bring additional cheer and goodwill to the season, hosting events that take the celebration beyond the simple distribution of gifts. And this year, there's a particular tradition whose revival we hope will amaze and delight!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_030: Well met, adventurer. Associate Professor Laurenssen of the Studium in Sharlayan. Amh Garanjy requested my expertise in the recreation of said tradition, namely...
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_040: My thanks again for your kind assistance when last I visited the Starlight Celebration. Come now, 'tis I─Associate Professor Laurenssen, of the Studium. Amh Garanjy requested my expertise in the recreation of said tradition, namely...
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_049: (-Agitated Boy-)Excuse me! You're in charge of the Starlight Celebration...celebrations, aren't you? Will you help me do something for my friend? Please!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_050: Oh, um...s-sorry for interrupting. I'm Aitken, and I have this friend who lives in Bentbranch Meadows. I was really looking forward to seeing her this Starlight...
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_051: But her parents said they're too busy to bring her to Gridania. Is there any way we can take the Starlight Celebration to her? ...I-I mean, to all the children at Bentbranch who are missing out!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_053: The road to Gridania is perilous indeed for a child traveling alone. Though I believe we may have the perfect solution to your quandary, young Aitken. Yes, with its well-trodden tracks and spacious clearing, Bentbranch Meadows may be the ideal location!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_054: You see, my boy, we are in the midst of reviving a tradition recorded in ancient texts, in which the saint's helpers would ride a reindeer-drawn sleigh, ringing a bell to announce the coming of the Saint of Nymeia himself.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_100_054: Bentbranch Meadows sounds like a wonderful first stop for the sleigh! And I'm sure the little ones would be delighted to see the tale come to life.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_100_070: Thanks to Professor Laurenssen's guidance, matters are already well in hand. As a matter of fact, requisite materials have already been procured and the designs finalized. Would you be willing to lend your aid in the rest of the endeavor, ?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_100: Thank you so much! Is there anything I can do to help?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_104: In that case, you may assist me in seeing that the materials are duly prepared and in fetching my eager reindeer colleague from the stables. Though, building a sleigh is somewhat beyond my expertise. It would be prudent to enlist the aid of some local artisans...
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_105: Perhaps you could handle the negotiations with the Carpenters' and Leatherworkers' Guilds, ? In the meantime, I shall be requesting the assistance of a certain someone, who I am sure will more than rise to the occasion.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_106: Once all the arrangements have been made, you'll need a place to work. Luckily, there is ample space at the Starlight Stalls, and we Starlight celebrants are more than happy to set some aside for your use. Our wonderful guide will see you there once everything is in place!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AMHGARANJY_000_110: Though I have my hands rather full running the Starlight Celebration here, I will ensure all celebrants know to lend their support. I look forward to hearing how the young ones in Bentbranch Meadows enjoy the festivities!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_BEATINE_000_120: Yes? I'm a busy man─out with it.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_BEATINE_000_130: A sleigh to delight the younglings? A most compelling request indeed, and one I should not be so churlish as to decline.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_BEATINE_000_140: You require my assistance in creating a sleigh? How could I refuse your impassioned request, especially one to bring joy to the younglings?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_BEATINE_000_150: Very good! I relish the opportunity to work alongside you as a fellow carpenter, . With our hands shall we create a supple and sturdy sleigh, fit for the saint himself...!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_BEATINE_000_160: I must see to my tools. Let us rendezvous at the Starlight Stalls anon.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_BEATINE_000_170: I shall join you at the Starlight Stalls anon once I have seen to my tools.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GEVA_000_180: You have a petition for the guild?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GEVA_000_190: A sleigh, you say? Well, if it's for the children, I can hardly refuse. I shall see to the matter personally.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GEVA_000_200: As a mother myself, I can hardly refuse a plan to bring joy to the children. Let us make the finest sleigh the Twelveswood has ever seen, .
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GEVA_000_210: Before I step away, there are a few loose ends I must tie up here. I shall join you at the Starlight Stalls shortly.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GEVA_000_220: I am attending to a few matters here, but I shall be along to the Starlight Stalls shortly.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_SYSTEM_000_230: Laurenssen and Aitken will be glad to hear that Beatin and Geva have pledged their tools to the cause. Speak to the Starlight Stalls guide and join them at the Starlight Stalls.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_XMXMARKETWARP_000_2: Aitken and Professor Laurenssen are already waiting for you at the Starlight Stalls. Allow me to show you there posthaste!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_100_250: We found everything you might need to make a sleigh! ...Or at least, I think we did, anyway. Now we just need someone who knows how to put it all together!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_100_260: Impeccable timing, . Materials for the sleigh have been acquired, sorted, and neatly stacked. And our reindeer friend is most eager to begin!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_101_260: Lest you wonder, my dear boy Blitzen remained behind this time. Though his talents for weaving glamours are unparalleled, this particular tradition relies more on physical prowess.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_100_261: No need to recount the blow-by-blows of your conversations─your triumphant visage says it all. Let us await their arrival.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GODBERT_000_270: (-???-)Ho ho ho! Wait no more, for we have arrived!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_271: Thank you, everyone, for agreeing to help my friend! W-Wait...the Saint of Nymeia is here to lend a hand, too?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GODBERT_000_272: (-Saint of Nymeia-)A certain pink-haired celebrant told me that a young man at the stalls had a fervent wish to deliver Starlight cheer to an absent friend. My heart was stirred! My hammer roused! Why, 'tis only natural that the saint lend his aid!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_273: When I asked for help, I never dreamed that the Saint of Nymeia himself would answer! Oh, I just know my friend will be delighted!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_GEVA_000_274: Between us, we should make short work of the wooden carcass, the leather seats and reins, and the golden decorations. Let's make sure these children have a Starlight gift to remember, shall we?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_ASSISTANTGIRL05464_: (-Intrigued Girl-)What's the Saint of Nymeia doing here? Has he come to deliver gifts?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_276: No, he's here to help us build a sleigh! Then, a reindeer is going to pull it down to Bentbranch Meadows, to see my friend and everyone there.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_ASSISTANTBOY05464_0: (-Intrigued Boy-)That sounds kind of fun! Can we help?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_278: Of course! We're just about to start.
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_279: I see we have yet more reinforcements! Now, I want each of you to pick an artisan and listen carefully to their instructions. Understood?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_280: As an expert on the source material, I shall be assuming the arduous role of supervisor. This sleigh is no mere toy, and I will ensure our recreation is faithful!
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_LAURENSSEN_000_282: And, undoubtedly, an important task for any supervisor is to delegate. , your role will be to review progress and resolve any potential issues. I trust you have no objections?
TEXT_FESXMX201_05464_AITKEN_000_283: Come on, everyone! Let's make this the best Starlight ever!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GEVA_000_001: Come looking for me, have you? There were a few matters that required my attention, but I shall be returning to assist with the sleigh momentarily.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GEVA_000_002: The reins are quite challenging, given the requisite sturdiness. The seat cover, on the other hand, is relatively simple─I shall ask my eager assistant to tackle that task.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_ASSISTANTGIRL05464_: I just got to touch the hide! It's so strange to think that it'll soon turn into cord and a seat.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_BEATINE_000_004: To my great shame, the condition of my tools was less than ideal. I have returned to the guild for just a moment, to rectify this oversight...!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_BEATINE_000_005: If the curvature of the wood slips even a little, the rider will sense it innately. Understand that something is...wrong. My assistant has been entrusted with the important task of measuring, and measuring again. For such is the secret to perfection!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_ASSISTANTBOY05464_0: Master Beatin has been telling me how to...assure quality? It's rigorous and tedious, but kind of satisfying. And he says it's really important!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GODBERT_000_007: Aitken has a keen eye and skilled touch. It would be a waste of potential were he not to enroll in a guild one day!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_008: The saint is amazing. Every time I come up with an idea for the decorations, he makes it a hundred times better!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_011: Normally, I am absorbed in my research at the Studium. Opportunities to recreate folk traditions in real life are few and far between─so I will see to it that the sleigh is a most faithful recreation.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_012: My presence as supervisor is essential, as is the work by our artisans and eager assistants. The final piece of the puzzle is for you, my friend, to take a hands-on role in assessing progress and maintaining morale.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_013: Though I am sure the prospect of contributing to our understanding of the Starlight Celebration's history is motivation enough, I can't deny it is a little chilly...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_014: The little ones might appreciate some kind of warm beverage, wouldn't you agree? The celebrant at the stall over there appears to be handing out just such refreshments─I'm sure the children will be delighted with your thoughtful gift!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_020: Just who exactly is this Saint of Nymeia? Evidently, he is an artisan of extraordinary talent...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_COMMITTEE05231_000_: A nice mug of kinderpunsch for our hard workers, is it? I heard all about the sleigh from Amh Garanjy. Take these to the little ones. They're welcome to have as much as they like!
I'll pour another mug for you, so you can come and warm yourself once you've seen to everyone else.
Come back once you've given the children their drinks, and I'll make sure there's a nice, warm mug of kinderpunsch waiting for you.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_ASSISTANTBOY05464_0: What's that? You have something for me?
I love mulled punch! Thank you!
Master Beatin is teaching me the art of inspection. This sleigh is going to be perfectly proportioned, you'll see!
I never knew there were so many ways to measure a piece of wood. It's not the most glamorous work, but it's kind of fun!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_ASSISTANTGIRL05464_: Oh, hello ! Are you here to watch us work?
Oh, mulled punch! Let me just hold it for a moment...my hands are so cold!
I've been helping make the leather to cover the seats. Guildmaster Geva knows so much, and she explains everything so patiently! When I grow up, maybe I'll become a leatherworker.
Guildmaster Geva says you need to use different hides to make different things. Don't worry, we have everything we need to make the comfiest seat!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_061: Thank you! My friend loves kinderpunsch too... I hope we can drink it together next time.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_062: Actually, I wanted to ask you something. Professor Laurenssen showed us which patterns to use for the sleigh, but we've decided to add a special decoration too.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_063: They asked me to come up with something that captures the spirit of the Starlight Celebration. But I don't know what would make my friend happy...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_100_063: Though, I suppose that's not really anything to do with the Starlight Celebration, either. Then I just end up thinking in circles! What do you think I should do?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_A1_000_001: Fill your heart with thoughts of your friend!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_A1_000_003: It will be more meaningful if you decide for yourself. Even if it's hard.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_064: Thank you! I think...I think I have an idea. I can see it now─it's going to be great!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_100_064: ...You're right! I said I wanted to do this myself, so I need to see it through. It might be a struggle, but I'll come up with something amazing!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_065: With the Saint of Nymeia to help me, I know we'll create something amazing. Just you wait and see!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSTEM_000_070: All the children have gratefully received their warm beverages. Report back to the saturnine Starlight celebrant for your own mug of kinderpunsch.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_COMMITTEE05231_000_: Welcome back. As promised, here's a fresh mug of kinderpunsch for you!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_090: Ah, here you are. I don't mean to intrude upon your break, but...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_091: The sleigh is finished! Come and look, !
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_092: Well? Isn't it the best sleigh you've ever seen?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GEVA_000_093: Thanks in no small part to my capable assistant. You have the makings of a fine leatherworker!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_BEATINE_000_094: And your work with a ruler was exemplary, son. Precise, diligent, and suffused with respect for the wood. Bravo!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GODBERT_000_095: Ho ho ho! And your inspired design is the perfect accent to elevate the entire sleigh, Aitken.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_ASSISTANTGIRL05464_: Don't you need to get going to Bentbranch Meadows, Aitken? You mustn't keep a girl waiting!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_ASSISTANTBOY05464_0: Introduce us next time she's in Gridania!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_102: Once I have hitched my reindeer colleague to the sleigh, I shall proceed directly to Bentbranch Meadows. It would be much appreciated if you could join us there, .
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GEVA_000_110: Trite as it may be, it is always a delight to see children work their creativity. Do not let such inspiration go to waste.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_BEATINE_000_111: What a pleasure to introduce children to the joys of carpentry.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_112: The reindeer ran here so quickly!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_120: <huff> <wheeze> Welcome, . <huff> <wheeze> Driving a sleigh is...<huff> <wheeze>...surprisingly tiring. All that remains is to ring the bell, and...and...the tradition will be...<wheeze>...complete!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_121: The Professor is about to keel over, so I think it might be best if you take the reins, . You'll make a convincing helper, too!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_122: Thank you! I'll go and tell my friend! ...B-But, I haven't seen her for a while. Maybe that's why my chest feels so tight...!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_123: ...Ah, the enviable energy of youth. It was worth making the sleigh for his sake alone, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_124: The local Starlight celebrants have already spread word to the children of Bentbranch Meadows that the peal of a bell from a reindeer-drawn sleigh will signal the imminent approach of the saint. All that remains is for you to take the reins and ring the bell in the vicinity of any children you encounter!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_130: It seems my reindeer colleague became a little lost. Never fear─the sleigh is ready.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_100_130: Now, ride forth and let the bell ring out!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_140: Look, a saint's little helper, just like I told you! And that's the sleigh I helped build!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GIRLFRIEND05465_000: Wow, you really made that? Aitken, I'm impressed!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_142: Ehehe... <cough> A-Anyway, the bell rang, so that means the saint is here! Come on, let's go!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GIRLFRIEND05465_100: Oh, Aitken! It's so good to see you!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_100_140: Oh, it's you! Quickly, ring the bell! It'll make her day!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSMES_100_141: Aitken appears to be waiting for the bell to ring. Speak to Laurenssen in Bentbranch Meadows to ride the sleigh and ring the bell in Aitken's vicinity.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSMES_101_141: Aitken appears to be waiting for the bell to ring. Ride the sleigh and ring the bell in his vicinity.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMBOYA05465_000_1: Look! The little helper on that fancy sleigh rang the bell, just like those grown-ups said!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMBOYB05465_000_1: Hm...how intriguing. Let us go and see if we can find the saint, shall we?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMBOYB05465_101_1: It would be a fun tradition. If it actually happened.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMBOYA05465_100_1: Just wait, I'm sure a helper on a sleigh will turn up. And the bell will ring, just for us!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSMES_100_151: The boy appears to be waiting for the bell to ring. Speak to Laurenssen in Bentbranch Meadows to ride the sleigh and ring the bell in his vicinity.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSMES_101_151: The boy appears to be waiting for the bell to ring. Ride the sleigh and ring the bell in his vicinity.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMGIR05465L_000_1: Wow...it's a real reindeer...! I was waiting for you.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMGIRL05465_000_1: Thank you, little helper. Now that you've rung the bell, I can go see the saint!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_FARMGIRL05465_100_1: I wonder if the little helper will really come...if I'll really hear the bells...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSMES_100_161: The girl appears to be waiting for the bell to ring. Speak to Laurenssen in Bentbranch Meadows to ride the sleigh and ring the bell in her vicinity.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSMES_101_161: The girl appears to be waiting for the bell to ring. Ride the sleigh and ring the bell in her vicinity.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_170: Exemplary work. It seems your foray was a resounding success! Let us observe how the situation unfolds...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_180: The little ones seem quite delighted. Indeed, I daresay we can consider this renewed tradition a successful addition to the festivities. And in my capacity as a folklorist, it has opened several intriguing new avenues for research as well.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_181: Here, this is the professor and the adventurer I was telling you about. They helped build the sleigh!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GIRLFRIEND05465_000: Thank you for bringing the Starlight Celebration to all of us out here in Bentbranch Meadows! I can't remember the last time everyone was so happy!
And thank you, Aitken. Did you...do all this for me?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_GIRLFRIEND05465_100: Even though Gridania is so close, I've missed you. I've been...lonely out here. So, it means a lot!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_101_183: Oh, erm, I-I...I missed you, too.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_184: A-And...a-anyone would do the same! For a friend!!!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AITKEN_000_185: A-Anyway! Let's go back over to the saint! We don't want to bother Professor Laurenssen and , right?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_186: Now then, perhaps I shall excuse myself too. This is, after all, an excellent opportunity to further investigate the links between this tradition and the current Starlight Celebration.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_LAURENSSEN_000_187: I don't suppose I could impose upon you to report back to Amh Garanjy in my stead? Once again, my heartfelt thanks for your cooperation─and Merry Starlight, my friend!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AMHGARANJY_000_200: Welcome back, ! I gather from your triumphant demeanor that the sleigh proved fit for purpose, and the tradition was successfully recreated?
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AMHGARANJY_000_201: Wonderful! Thank you so much for all your help.
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AMHGARANJY_000_202: While you were away, the little ones who helped build the sleigh asked that I hold on to a gift for you. It's another reindeer-drawn sleigh─a perfect recreation of the earlier recreation, if you will!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AMHGARANJY_000_203: It seems that they enjoyed themselves so much, they begged the artisans to help them build another sleigh just for you. You must have made quite the impression!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AMHGARANJY_000_207: And I hear the Saint of Nymeia personally convinced this reindeer to come along─though he neglected to mention where he found it...
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_AMHGARANJY_000_208: I hope you'll continue to spread the wonderful tradition that Professor Laurenssen revived, and ring the bell for little ones the land over. I am certain its cheerful peals will fill their hearts with joy!
TEXT_FESXMX202_05465_SYSTEM_000_210: The vendors at the Starlight Stalls are now open for business!
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_MAMMETBLACKCAT_000_: You there! Yes, I do mean you, ! Tried your hand at Keybound Brawler yet? Hmmm? No? Didn't think so.

Well, you're in for a thrill! It's the first game of its kind at the Gold Saucer, y'see. In it, you defend your territory from oncomin' hordes of enemies, and if you manage to make it through, the rewards you reap will be ever so sweet!
Sounds exhilaratin', right? Well, then...what're you waitin' for!? Don't be shy! There's nothin' like tippity-tappin' those keys and lettin' that magic fly!
All you need to do is find my friend W'zazanh at Wonder Square, and she'll steer you in the right direction.
I guarantee you'll leave Keybound Square with a smile on your face and a spring in your step! The Gold Saucer's meant to be a happy place filled with happy people, after all!
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_KTGENTRANCEMAN05466: I have been tasked with leading guests to Keybound Square. Shall I escort you there, ?
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_KTGCOUNTERMAN05466_: Greetings, dear guest, and welcome to Keybound Square─the third-roundest square in all the Gold Saucer, depending on who you ask. I gather this is your first time on the premises?

Well, then, you've come to the right typist! In this particular attraction, you and up to three of your companions must defend your base against the assaults of foul foes and fiends. But fear not, for you shan't go unarmed!

You'll be equipped with our specially developed magitype keys. With them, you must input the enchanted words that manifest themselves over your enemies' heads and repel them with a powerful barrage of magicks!
But time is of the essence, as you must wield your words wisely to defeat the oncoming swarms─and their master─before your base's barrier shatters!
...Ahem! I believe that covers the basics, but do not hesitate to let me know if aught was unclear─I am happy to answer even the most minuscule of questions!
Taken an interest in the mammet, have you? Well, he's our mascot, and proud of it! He's done a fine job attracting guests aplenty to Keybound Square.

Rumor has it that Lord Manderville discovered the poor thing gathering dust in a corner of the Saucer's storehouse. He performed a thorough investigation as to who first commissioned the clockwork creature, yet even he could not glean an answer.

Normally, we would dispose of items of such dubious origins...but Godbert Manderville is no normal man, you understand. Charmed by the mammet's outgoing nature and playful lilt, he put it to work immediately.
He was right to do so, if you ask me. Our mechanical friend has guided a plethora of guests here, and we're all the livelier for it! The more the merrier, as it were.

Ah, yes! That reminds me─you're welcome to play Keybound Brawler alone, or with friends! Whether you choose to go solo or in a group, you can play to your heart's content and earn all manner of valuable prizes!
After you've gathered enough, you may exchange your Manderville Gold Credits with my good friend, the MGC trader. Do peruse his wares when you have the chance!
When you are ready to play, simply speak with our friendly registrar and we shall prepare a group for you posthaste!
And should you ever have any other burning questions, I, your faithful magitype master, will of course be happy to assist.
Now, then, I shan't keep you any longer! Go forth, and may your keystrokes guide you to victory!
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_YESNOCHECK_000_029: A keyboard is required to participate in Keybound Brawler. The  and  cannot be used, so please ensure that you have a keyboard connected before registering for a game.
TEXT_SUBGSC801_05466_SYSTEM_200_029: You must agree to the conditions and press OK in order to complete this quest.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_001: Heh heh... You are well come to the All Saints' Wake festivities, adventurer. I hope our celebration is to your liking.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_002: Heh heh... 'Tis a pleasure as always, adventurer. Are our spectral spectacles to your liking this All Saints' Wake?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_100_002: In seasons past, this frightening festival was once a prime opportunity for mischievous voidsent to run rampant, that they might satiate their souls with mortal fear... These days, however, they have chosen to celebrate hand in hand with visiting adventurers.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_110_002: Indeed, there are countless ways to revel with them─you could don magicked glamours at their masquerades, or dance through their haunted mansions for your fill of tricks and treats. The creatures of darkness welcome all forms of frolic.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_003: As this is the season for friendly fiends, I am hosting guests this year: curious children of the void, drawn to this mortal coil. Though I trust you will keep that last bit a secret from the smallfolk.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_004: How they longed for the warm, welcoming company of mortals! While it is a lengthy ordeal to manifest their dreams into reality, they are sparing no effort to proffer their hands in friendship.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_005: But newly come as they are to this world, they have much to learn before they can succeed. So I ask you, friend─would you lend them your worldly wisdom as an adventurer, and ensure their plans safely come to fruition?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_006: Excellent... Your aid will doubtless mean the world to them, and enhance the festivities besides. You will find the little ones by the Whistling Miller, preening for the merriment to come.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_011: Allow me to introduce the children. The tallest there is Dodd. Next to him is Pattin, and last but not least is young Bea.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_012: Hullo there! Our costumes aren't too terrifying, are they? Won't scare mortals out of their skin, right?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_100_012: Why, I find you all fittingly frightening. You needn't worry so.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_BEA_000_013: Pattin, you big oaf! Did you forget the pumpkinhead's advice!? You have to let us introduce ourselves before we start frettin' about our costumes in front of mortals!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_014: It's just...we've heard so much about the voidsent who entertain mortals during All Saints' Wake, you know? Now that we're really here, I just can't wait to join in!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_015: It's just...all the voidsent from the Continental Circus had a grand old time with mortals at the last Wake, and I can't bear to miss out on the fun a moment longer!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_DODD_000_016: What Pattin said! I wanna try the sweet, sugary aether of mortal gratitude more than anything in the whole wide world!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_017: Exactly! But we must make sure we don't scare the mortals too much with our true forms. That's why the costumes are so important!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_BEA_000_018: But now that we have 'em on, what do we do next...? We've never played with mortals before. Normally we run and hide away, 'cause if we try playin' one of our normal games with 'em, we'd end up tearin' 'em to shreds...
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_020: To shreds, you say...? Perhaps you might consider this mortal, then─I wager a seasoned adventurer is more...durable.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_022: Oh, dear, you're an adventurer!? P-P-Please, spare us! We haven't actually killed anyone! In case you were wondering!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_100_022: Heh heh... You have naught to fear, Pattin. This one's pledged  service to us.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_DODD_000_023: Well, that's a relief... To think we'd have a real, live adventurer helping out!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_BEA_000_024: Oooh, pleeease teach us how to play with other mortals! Pretty please? If we aren't allowed to tear 'em limb from limb, what can we do?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_A1_000_001: We'll turn your running and hiding into a game!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_A1_000_003: I'm sturdy enough to survive your games!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_026: Utilizing their strengths is a fine idea. Hm... If mortal children revel in games of hide-and-seek, I see no reason why voidsent children wouldn't.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_027: Ah, of course. Mortal children do so love their games. And voidsent children would, too, I'd wager...
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_BEA_000_028: Truly!? So we could rearrange your limbs for fun? And you won't die from all the blood loss!?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_029: Now, now... You would do well not to inconvenience our friend or  extremities overmuch. We require a less gory game, suitable for man and voidsent alike... Would hide-and-seek suffice?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_031: Heh heh... 'Twould seem I have some explaining to do. While I elaborate on the rules of the game, adventurer, would you seek out some volunteers to join us?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_032: Bring ones that won't die easily! Y'know...just in case. Since there's already three of us, and one of you, two more mortals should be enough!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PUMPKIN_000_033: A prudent plan. I suggest you find a few able-bodied adventurers come to partake in the festivities. Once you have recruited them, join us at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_ADVENTURERA05467_00: Hm... I suppose that counts as training of a sort. I'd like to take in the scenery a moment more, but I shall join you shortly.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_ADVENTURERB05467_00: Oho, hide-and-seek with an All Saints' Wake twist? I've been craving a thrill like this... 'Twould be my pleasure to join you!
But first, I crave a preparatory meal at the Carline Canopy, if you don't mind. Let us reconvene at the amphitheatre!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_ADVENTURERA05467_00: I appreciate the invitation. I'll make for the amphitheatre as soon as my business here is done.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_BEA_000_056: We may have only just learned of it, but we're gonna host the best, most frightenin' game of hide-and-seek ever! Just you wait!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_DODD_000_058: Hee hee... D'you think we'll make good hide-and-seekers?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_GRAVEYARDGATEKEEPER: Greetings... I am here to─well, perhaps it would be prudent to keep my role a secret for the time being.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_070: So you've grabbed us some guests? Oh, thank you muchly! The pumpkinhead taught us all about hide-and-seek while you were gone.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_BEA_000_071: She sure did! She even prepared a place for us all to play!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_DODD_000_072: Since All Saints' Wake is such a special occasion, we thought we'd work some of our magic into the game, too.
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_073: Oh, yes! This isn't your voidmother's hide-and-seek, no, .
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_100_073: Now, it starts out like any old game─anyone who's “it” has to find those who aren't. But our hiders won't just be hiding. They're going to don costumes, like us!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_074: So seek us out, if you dare...but another twist awaits: will the costume-clad hiders you find be genuine? Or one of the magicked shades we've conjured? That's up to you to figure out!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_075: What d'you think? Fun and nonlethal, right?
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_A2_000_002: Only one way to find out!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_A2_000_003: Magicked shades or no, I'll find you all!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_076: Hurrah! We have the adventurer's seal of approval!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_100_076: Hurrah! I like your enthusiasm, adventurer!
TEXT_FESHLX201_05467_PATTIN_000_077: With that settled, let the games begin!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_001: Y'know how adventurers like parties? Well, Dodd and Pattin and I decided we'd do somethin' similar and take on, um...what's the word? Roles? Roles! That way, we get the work done faster. I'm the one that casts lots of scary magicks!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_GRAVEYARDGATEKEEPER: Greetings... I am here to─well, perhaps it would be prudent to keep my role a secret for the time being.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_010: Listen up, everyone! It's time we put our game to the test!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_011: Since this'll be our very first one, we'll let you be “it,” adventurer! We three are better at hiding, anyway.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_012: Huzzah! We ought to get a head start and make for the haunting grounds, then.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_013: Pattin tidied up some costumes for the other mortals, so he's gonna dress 'em up while Dodd and I start workin' our magic. We'll see you there!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_014: Heh heh... So the game is afoot.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_016: Once you have made ready, my grave guide shall lead you to the venue. We will ensure the other participants arrive safely there as well.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_GRAVEYARDGATEKEEPER: Greetings... 'Tis my solemn duty to escort our guests to the Dire Deepcroft.
Should you choose to join me, however, know that all manner of otherworldly phenomena may befall you in that accursed place... Do have care, adventurer.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_030: Let's see... Illusory magicks, all ready and accounted for! You won't believe your eyes when the games begin!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_040: There you are, adventurer! We're nearly ready, in case you were wonderin'.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_041: But what's takin' the other mortals so long? I know we have no choice, but I don't want to wait anymore...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_042: Ta-daaa! Our new friends are ready!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_00: This suit's surprisingly comfortable...easy enough to run and hide in, at least. Our uncostumed friend here will be seeking us out, yes?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_044: sure will! Once  starts countin', it means we all have to find a place to hide, and fast!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_045: What Bea said! Now, since you're “it,” you'll need some all-seeing gourds. If you think you've found someone─and not one of our illusions─lob one right at them!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_046: If your hunch was right, the gourd will react! If your target was just an illusion...well, you'll have to try again. But at least you'll have less fake ones to worry about.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERA05467_00: Hold on a moment. If your illusions are no less similar to the genuine folk in costume, how will  be able to see through your ruse?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_049: Oh. Right... I forgot that you mortals can't see through illusory magicks the way we can. The illusions don't talk, and if you squint hard enough, you can probably spot the difference, but... Hmmm, what other oddities could we add to them?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_10: What's all this about “you mortals”? All men are mortal─yourselves included...I hope.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_11: In any event, for those of us who are not crafted from illusory magicks, I suggest we strike unique poses, that we might be easier to seek out.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_120_049: Oh! Oh, yes! That's an excellent idea. You heard him, everyone: once you're set in your hiding spots, pose away!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_130_049: While the others adjust the magicks, let's kill some time with a practice round, adventurer!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_050: Remember to throw an all-seeing gourd if you think you've found the real me. If you succeed, we can all play for real!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_051: Now, go on and count to ten, and I'll hide while you do!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_060: (-Curious Costume-)Oh! D-Don't mind me! I'm just an illusion! Oooh, so scary...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_063: (-Pattin-)But that's all right! Now you know how to properly use your gourds.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_064: (-Pattin-)Let's move on to the main event, shall we? Everyone else had plenty of time to hide deeper in by now.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_065: (-Pattin-)When you've found us all, meet us back where we started. I'll let you count to ten again while I hide─happy hunting!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_066: Your voice echoes and bounds across the dismal stone corridors as you commence your count. Slowly, you open your eyes upon reaching ten, and prepare to seek out the five costumed participants hidden within these halls.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_068: This costume doesn't quite match the ones worn by Pattin and the others...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_069: Pattin wasn't wearing a costume like this...was he?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_070: The costumed creature vanishes without a trace. The others must be elsewhere.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_081: Though barely audible, a whisper wanders through the eerie silence.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_082: (-Pattin-)Awww, you got me! I'll go back to the entrance like I promised.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_083: (-Curious Costume-)Heh heh...  never find me here─oh.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_084: A hushed voice reaches your ears...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_085: (-Bea-)Aw, no! You found me fair and square... I'll see you at the entrance!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_086: This costume is clinging to the shadows in a desperate attempt to remain hidden there...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_087: (-Dodd-)You did it! You found me! Back to the entrance I go.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_088: The silhouette lingering before you has surprisingly excellent posture...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERA05467_00: (-Adamant Adventurer-)You've a sharp eye, friend. I'll go ahead and make my way back.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_091: Although it remains silent, it dances without a care in the world.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_00: (-Ebullient Adventurer-)Oho! Saw right through my dance, did you? Back to the entrance for me, then...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_093: No response. It appears to be an illusion...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_094: This tiny costumed creature sways in the silence.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_095: This costumed creature doesn't resemble the bears you're looking for...though you concede that it is a remarkably good dancer.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_099: Those webbed feet don't match the children's costumes one bit...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_106: Hullo again! Pattin was so excited that he started dashin' all over the place before you got here!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERA05467_00: As I suspected, running and hiding in such heavy equipment came with its own challenges... I ought to train like this more often.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_00: Welcome back! Exhilarating game, wasn't it?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_110: That was amaaazing! You were the best “it” we ever could've asked for, adventurer!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_111: That was lots of fun! When I saw you readying those gourds, I thought my heart was gonna jump out of my chest!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_00: Indeed. That was a grand old time! I could go another round, in fact.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_113: That would be delightful! If I had my way, I'd want to play with you all for another fifty years, at least!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_114: Hahaha! Say, if we're gonna play again, there's one more thing we mustn't forget!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_115: Oh, that's right! Before we go another round, we need someone else to be “it.” I piiick...me!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PHANTOM05468_000_11: (-Pattin?-)Hee hee... I'm so glad I found you. This was so much fun!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_120: There you are! You hid so well, we thought we'd have to tear the whole place up!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_122: You're incredible, adventurer! I'm surprised you could hide better than we can...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERA05467_00: You are talented indeed... Seeing your skills inspires me to keep honing my own.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_00: Good to see you returned. That you didn't even need a costume to blend in is a testament to your skills!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_GRAVEYARDGATEKEEPER: 'Tis a relief to see you unharmed...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_130: Where in the world were you hiding, adventurer!? We looked everywhere for you, but you were nowhere to be found... We even started yelling for you and everything before we came back!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_A1_000_001: You still managed to find me, though!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_A1_000_002: What do you mean? You found me, didn't you, Pattin?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_133: We searched and searched, but we couldn't find you at all!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERA05467_00: Wherever you hid, you evaded us entirely, even when we pooled our collective efforts. We attempted to call out to you when we took our leave, as well. Mayhap our voices did not reach as far as we envisioned...?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_ADVENTURERB05467_00: I will say, though, turning the tables on us and making us all search was a sly move! Do let me know if you play again─I could do this for days, had I the chance.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_136: Heh heh... Rumor has it the Dire Deepcroft is home to the spirits of the dead. 'Tis possible that someone else wanted to join in your game and took the form of young Pattin so as not to startle you.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_100_136: You needn't worry overmuch. I suspect the spirit involved harbored no ill will─just a desire to play.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_137: I took the liberty of sealing off the more dangerous areas before you all entered, so your mortal companions should be safe. The children have learned much from the three of you today.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_BEA_000_138: Guess what!? Those adventurers gave us candy! “As thanks for the game,” they said!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_DODD_000_139: What Bea said! Mortal gratitude really is as sweet as they say. Now that we have something safe to play, we ought to try inviting the adventurers ourselves next time!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_140: Speaking of gratitude, don't you all have something to say to your new friend?
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_141: Oh! Yes, we do! Give me just a moment, and...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PATTIN_000_142: Thank you so very much, adventurer! We made a scary suit for you, too, so now you can match us. We hope you like it!
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_143: The Dire Deepcroft shall remain open to you, if you wish to return for any reason... May your revels there bring you frights and delights alike.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_144: And of course, I shall leave the gates to Sneaky Hollow open, as well. If it's a masquerade you desire, you need only speak to our usher, and he shall lead the way.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_145: Everyone deserves to carouse as they wish during this season, after all─mortal and voidsent, the living and the dead...
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_PUMPKIN_000_146: Heh heh... Of course, 'tis our duty to ensure the creatures of the void do not overstay their welcome. I hope I can count on your assistance again when next the seasons turn.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_147: You now have access to Sneaky Hollow, the Haunted Manor, and the Dire Deepcroft. Speak with the grave guide to be escorted back to the Dire Deepcroft.
TEXT_FESHLX202_05468_SYSTEM_000_148: To attend the ongoing masquerades at Sneaky Hollow and the Haunted Manor, speak with the unusual usher or genial guiser at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Well now, if it isn't my friend . 'Tis a pleasure to see you again─and a stroke of serendipity that it should be here and now.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_WANDERINGMINSTREL_1: You are an adventurer, if I am not mistaken. And you are called , you say? Well met, my friend. I am a humble minstrel, and 'tis a stroke of serendipity that you should approach me here and now.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: You see, just earlier, I chanced to meet a woman who was looking for an acquaintance. Being a visitor to Vylbrand, however, she struggles to make headway, and could use the assistance of a reliable adventurer.
If you are willing to provide your aid, I should be glad to compensate you for your troubles. I only ask that you share the details with me afterwards.

As a minstrel, I am ever in search of inspiration for song, and much can be had during the Rising, when we remember the past even as we look to the future. So, what say you? Will you do me this favor?
I am truly grateful. Without further ado, I bid you seek out the woman in question, a Keeper of the Moon garbed in red. She was making inquiries over at the Aftcastle, and is like to still be there.
While you attend her, I shall be nearby taking in the observance. I look forward to hearing your report at the conclusion of your task.
The woman in question is a Keeper of the Moon garbed in red, and she should still be making inquiries over at the Aftcastle. Please help her to track down her acquaintance.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_010: <sigh> Still not so much as a clue... Where could she have gotten to?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_012: The minstrel sent you to help me? Well now, how very thoughtful of him. I must admit, I'm at my wit's end.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_013: (-Bathu Molkoh-)Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Bathu Molkoh, a member of Orchestra Gridania, and as you've already heard, I'm searching for someone. Can I truly count on your aid?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_014: (-Bathu Molkoh-)So, the person I seek is a woman named A'nimuili. I have to find her. I simply have to.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_A1_000_001: Why do you want to find her so badly?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_015: (-Bathu Molkoh-)Why? Because she's my biggest rival, and I need to settle matters with her!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_016: (-Bathu Molkoh-)L-Loved one!? Perish the thought! She's my biggest rival, and I need to settle matters with her!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_017: (-Bathu Molkoh-)Nimuili is a musician like me, and we've been battling it out in exams and competitions for years now.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_018: (-Bathu Molkoh-)Freakishly talented, is Nimuili. Looks carefree as you please, but no one immerses themselves in the music like her, and her expressiveness is second to none. As hard as I practice, more often than not, she'd get the better of me.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_019: (-Bathu Molkoh-)But then she disappeared. Just up and left, some time after the Calamity struck. Word has it she became an adventurer, but it makes no sense. She had poured her life into music. Why would she suddenly cast it aside?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_020: (-Bathu Molkoh-)She hasn't been seen in Gridania since then, and for a while I'd feared the worst...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_021: (-Bathu Molkoh-)But then an acquaintance involved in the Rising told me that she's been seen in Limsa Lominsa, and I made my way over as fast I could!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_022: (-Bathu Molkoh-)N-Not that I care for her or anything. I want to give her a piece of my mind, is all─tell her to return to music and not waste her talents!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_023: (-Bathu Molkoh-)But since arriving here, I haven't found a single clue. I'm not sure where to begin looking...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_A2_000_001: Drinking holes are always a good bet for information.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_A2_000_002: The Adventurers' Guild might know something.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_A2_000_003: There are probably surer places for making inquiries.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_024: (-Bathu Molkoh-)Indeed... In which case, we'll want to head to the tavern yonder─the Drowning something. Come on!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_025: (-Bathu Molkoh-)Indeed... Like that tavern yonder─the Drowning something. That's bound to have a good crowd. Let's try our luck there!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_030: Right, the Drowning Wench─that was the name. How macabre... Anyway, let's try speaking with the barkeep first.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_031: Greetin's, friends, an' welcome to the Drownin' Wench. I'd ask what yer 'avin'...but ye don't look as though yer 'ere fer food an' drink. Got business with the guild, I take it?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_032: Well, if it ain't . I'd ask what yer 'avin'...but ye don't look as though yer 'ere fer food an' drink. What can I do ye fer, then?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_033: An adventurer what 'ails from Gridania, name of A'nimuili...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_034: Ah right, the archer lass. I remember signin' 'er up and seein' 'er runnin' around these parts.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_035: That bein' said, we ain't s'posed to divulge the particulars o' guild members...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_036: Well, I s'pose there's no 'arm in sharin' a thing or two. After the Calamity, we 'ad no shortage of inquiries fer missin' persons, an' I understand the pain o' not knowin' what's become o' yer own.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_037: Since signin' up with the guild, A'nimuili's mainly taken on the little tasks. Deliverin' packages, clearin' away debris, an' aye, searchin' fer people too.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_038: That's rather...unexpected. I'd assumed adventurers did grander things, like exploring new lands and solving mysteries. Otherwise, why would Nimuili give up her life's passion?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_039: Some few adventurers embark on grand quests an' accomplish great feats, 'tis true enough.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_040: But most are content to make a difference in folk's everyday lives, an' A'nimuili struck me as the sort what simply enjoyed 'elpin' others.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_041: Ye also 'ave to remember, the Calamity turned lives upside down. I expect she 'ad 'er reasons fer choosin' a new path.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_042: Now then, if ye wants to track down yer friend, the quickest way would be through 'er work.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_043: O' late, she's taken on a bunch o' jobs fer the Risin', an' old Lyngsath was one of 'er clients. Ye could do worse'n 'ave a chat with the bloke.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_044: It's a fair distance to the Bismarck, an' I'd hate fer our visitor to run afoul o' Limsa's less savory elements. Make sure she gets where she needs to go safely, eh?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_045: Thank you, Baderon. I'll keep your words in mind.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BADERON_000_046: Don't mention it, lass. An' whatever it is ye intend afterwards, I pray yer able to reunite with A'nimuili.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_047: I'd wanted to tell Nimuili to give up adventuring and return to music. But now I'm not so sure...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_048: What led her to make her choice? By retracing her steps, perhaps I can understand her better...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_049: I must say, it's amazing how quickly we managed to pick up her trail with your help. I'm also impressed that Baderon remembers the adventurers he's met.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_050: Right, let's do as suggested and seek out Master Lyngsath. Pray lead the way!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_060: The famous Bismarck... I'd dreamed of visiting, if not quite under these circumstances.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_061: Hopefully Master Lyngsath can point us in Nimuili's direction!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_Q51_000_000: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Bathu Molkoh?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_062: Has something urgent come up? Very well, I'll wait back at the Drowning Wench.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_063: There you are! Come, let's go and find Nimuili!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SYSTEM_000_064: Bathu Molkoh has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SYSTEM_000_065: You must be accompanied by Bathu Molkoh and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_070: There are adventurers in this apothecary too... Delivering herbs, by the sounds of it.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_071: When you think about it, we rely on adventurers for many things in everyday life.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_072: That being said, no matter how essential the task, surely Nimuili doesn't need to be the one to do them.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_073: She has incredible talent as a musician and loved being one. What could have happened to make her abandon her path...?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_075: Did you know, ? This place is famous not only for its cuisine, but for hosting soirées with renowned musicians as well.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_076: It's a great honor to be invited to perform here, and Nimuili and I used to make a big fuss about who would get the call first.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_LYNGSATH_000_077: Well now, ye two've got questions written all over yer faces. What is it ye be needin'?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_LYNGSATH_000_078: Ah yes, A'nimuili. 'Elped us set up a stall fer the Risin', she did.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_LYNGSATH_000_079: The festival's close to 'er 'eart, apparently, an' she worked like a woman possessed. We finished in no time thanks to 'er.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_080: I see... Did she mention where she was lodging, by any chance?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_LYNGSATH_000_081: Not to me, she didn't. She was also 'elpin' the Yellowjackets with the fireworks, though, so mayhap ye wants to talk to Ayoyo over at the Coral Tower.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_082: The keepers of the peace in Limsa Lominsa? Thank you, we'll head there at once!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_083: It's a relief to know─ I-I mean, it raises my hackles to hear how Nimuili's been gallivanting about!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_084: At any rate, it's good to speak with folk who know her directly. What was Nimuili doing for the Yellowjackets, I wonder...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_LYNGSATH_000_085: The Yellowjackets're in charge o' the fireworks fer the Risin', an' A'nimuili was 'elpin' 'em with that. Might be as Ayoyo knows somethin' of 'er whereabouts.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_090: Oh, 'ello there. Ye stand within the Coral Tower, 'eadquarters o' the Yellowjackets. Is there an incident ye wish to report?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_091: Oh, if it ain't our kindly 'elper . What brings ye to the Coral Tower this fine ?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_092: Aye, we 'ad A'nimuili procure us some ingredients fer the fireworks. Can't 'ave too much o' the flamin' colors this time o' year, as I'm sure ye can appreciate.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_093: As I understand it, she wants to aid them as suffer in the Calamity's wake, an' was keen as mustard to be involved with aught to do with the Risin'.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_095: If ye wants to know where she is, I suggest ye speak with Dorathia, the headmistress o' Llymlaen's Shoals. A'nimuili regularly lends 'er a hand at the orphanage.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_096: When I chanced upon Dorathia earlier, she was on 'er way to 'ave a cup o' tea at the Missin' Member, so she's like to be over at the Aftcastle. If ye can find 'er, might be as she can direct ye to yer friend.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_097: Sh-She's a rival, not a friend... But I'll do as you suggest and look for Miss Dorathia. Thank you for the advice!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_098: As I said, A'nimuili regularly lends a hand at Llymlaen's Shoals. If anyone knows where she is, it'd be Dorathia.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_AYOYO_000_099: The lassie seems quite worried fer 'er friend─ahem, rival. 'Ope ye find 'er soon.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_100: I'm sorry for making you run all over the place with me, but thanks to you, we're getting closer to tracking down Nimuili.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_101: But what a surprise to learn what she's been doing as an adventurer. Helping those who suffer in the Calamity's wake... Hmmm...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_110: Begging your pardon, but might you be Miss Dorathia of Llymlaen's Shoals?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_111: That's me alright. An' who might ye be?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_112: So that's the way of it. Nimuili's been doin' all sorts of odd jobs fer us, from makin' repairs 'round the place to procurin' necessities. All the children adore 'er─ain't that right, R'tcha?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_RTCHA_000_113: Nimuili always plays songs for us. Beautiful, soothing songs.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_114: Most o' the little ones at the Shoals lost their families in the Calamity. Years on, they still suffer from nightmares an' anxiety.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_115: The music what Nimuilia plays comforts 'em like nothin' else. To know to do that, she 'erself must've known tragedy too.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_116: So she didn't abandon her passion, but rather shares it...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_117: ... At first, I thought only to convince Nimuili to return to music.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_118: But now, I understand why she made her choice. What she's doing is meaningful, and it wouldn't be right to tell her to give it up.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_119: So...what should I say to her when we meet? I'm at a complete loss...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_RTCHA_000_120: You're Nimuili's friend, right? Do you miss her?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_121: W-We're not friends, but rivals! Th-That's right, rivals!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_122: To have her not only disappear, but take up a dangerous trade besides... I've missed her as well as feared for her.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_123: And when I imagine that I wouldn't be able to strive beside her or hear her music anymore...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_100_123: It's too much for me to bear!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_RTCHA_000_124: Then when you find Nimuili, tell her you're glad to see her again!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_125: Ye never know when a loved one'll be taken from ye, so make sure to leave naught unsaid. This is somethin' as I've learned over the years.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_126: Now then, if ye'd been bent on makin' Nimuili go back, then I would've feigned ignorance. But as it stands, I see no reason to 'ide 'er whereabouts. Ye'll find 'er in Aleport, over in western La Noscea.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_127: The area was 'ard 'it by the Calamity, and she went there to do 'er bit. Take the ferry in front o' the Fishermen's Guild─it sails straight to the port.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_128: I will! Thank you, both of you!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_RTCHA_000_130: How did I know she was Nimuili's friend? Hehe, that's easy.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_RTCHA_000_131: I once asked Nimuili why she was so good at her instrument. She said it's because she has a friend at home who tries harder than anyone. She doesn't want to be outdone, so she practices every day.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_RTCHA_000_132: I knew Bathu was that friend as soon as she told us her story!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_133: This little one's mother was an old friend o' mine, but she was sadly one o' the ones taken in the Calamity.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_DORATHIA_000_134: So when I gave that advice, I was speakin' from experience. Bein' stubborn gets yer naught but regret, believe ye me.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_140: In the course of searching for Nimuili, I've come to realize many things.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_141: For one, if I tried to make her go home, she isn't like to listen. No, we'd probably end up shouting at each other and parting on bad terms.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_142: That's the last thing I want, and I'm truly grateful to you and everyone for opening my eyes.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_143: Now, just to confirm, but you're coming to Aleport too, yes? I'm starting to feel a little nervous and could use the support...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_150: According to Miss Dorathia, Nimuili should be working in this area...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_151: (-???-)And we're back! So, where do you want the crate?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_MOB05510_000_153: My thanks, lass, you're always a great help. I'll take it from here, so you can run along and collect your reward. When you have time, come and play some songs at our village again, eh?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_100_153: Nimuili! I've found you at last!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_154: Bathu!? Good gods, it's been so long!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_155: “It's been so long”? That's all you have to say?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_156: You vanished with nary a word! No one knew where you were!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_100_156: Do you have any idea how worried I've been!?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_157: Wh-What's this all of a sudden? I feel as if I'm missing something...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_158: So you thought I'd given up music, and came all this way to drag me back... Hehe, it's flattering in a way.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_159: That was the original plan anyway, before I learned that you've been dedicating yourself to those who suffered in the Calamity. That you've been using music to bring people comfort.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_160: My father fought and fell at Carteneau. And when my sickly mother died after that, it made me stop and consider what I truly wanted to achieve with the gifts I have.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_161: It didn't take long to arrive at the answer. I wanted to share the joy of music with all who strive to make their way in our Calamity-ravaged world.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_162: Yes, I understand that now. Yours is a worthwhile calling, and I won't try to convince you to come back.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_163: Still, I can't help but feel sad. I had assumed you'd always be there as my rival, but then you gave that up and and found another path...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_164: Gave up? Hardly! You've always pushed me forward with your relentless pursuit of perfection, and I felt that I needed to find my own sound.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_165: One day, I hope to express my experiences on this journey in song. And when I do, you had better still be there, with your skills sharp as ever!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_166: Ahahaha, spoken like a true rival! All this time, I've been running around in circles!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_167: It goes without saying that you can do as you please. But I want you to promise me one thing...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_168: Wherever you are, stay safe. And visit me from time to time!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_169: That's two things! But all right. I can do that much.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_170: . Meeting Nimuili again has taken a weight off my heart, and I can't thank you enough for accompanying me all this way.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_171: I'm truly glad that the minstrel sent you.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_172: Now then, you and I have some catching up to do. I want to know everything─where you've been, what you've seen, the songs you've played...as both a friend and a rival!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SYSTEM_000_173: You have seen Bathu Molkoh's quest to find her dear friend to a happy conclusion. The wandering minstrel will be eager for your report.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_174: I hear the children at the orphanage are quite fond of you. What do you play for them?
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_175: All sorts of songs, but the old classic On Windy Meadows is probably their favorite. Nothing warms the heart like seeing their smiles, let me tell you! You should join me for a duet next time!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_BATHUMOLKOH_000_177: I-I'm a busy person, I'll have you know... But if you insist, I suppose I can spare a moment!
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_ANIMUILI_000_178: To think that Bathu would come looking for me...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Welcome back, my friend. By your elated expression, I take it you met with success in your search.

So the two friends whose paths diverged after the Calamity were happily reunited during the Rising, with each gaining newfound understanding for the other... 'Tis a joyous outcome, and I am glad I entreated your aid.

I must say, it is quite fascinating how we define ourselves through our connections. Our endeavors may be our own, and no one else's. Yet there are often others who walk the selfsame path, and their presence can serve to guide and inspire.
Be it a shining beacon, a warming flame, or a consuming blaze, how those individuals are perceived may vary. But it is by virtue of their existence that we are able to see where we presently stand.
Yes, I believe I have the makings of a new verse, and I owe it to you. If you have time still, I should like to hear your tale in more detail. Will you not join me for the fireworks?
We have a moment before the display begins. While we wait, will you not lend an ear to my verse? It is a song of comfort and hope, dedicated to all who forge on in the Calamity's wake...
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_60: (-???-)This is a world that exists outside your reality. Could it be a dream? A flight of fancy conjured by your weary mind? Perhaps...or perhaps not.

'Tis a pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Naoki Yoshida, and I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude. Lest you wonder, an enchanting concert is to be held at this venue, and I have come to attend it.

'Tis a pleasure to meet you again. As I have in the past, I have beckoned you here that I might express my gratitude. Lest you wonder, an enchanting concert is to be held at this venue, and I have come to attend it.
“Music is about enjoying sound. Everyone should be able to enjoy it freely.”
These are the words of a comrade and composer.
Looking back, I marvel at how long we have been on this journey with you and yours.
We have experienced good times and bad. Partaken of the sweet and the bitter both. But through it all, ever did music resound, captivating and wondrous.
Even as our journey unfolded, many events have taken place in the world beyond. Events that shape our values and way of life.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: I for one have changed with them, and I am quite certain you have as well.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_100_61: So it only follows that this world, too, must undergo change.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_200_61: A transformation driven by our hope that your journey will always be worthwhile.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_300_61: As we forge ahead, nothing would please us more than to continue having you there beside us.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_400_61: Enjoying your adventures freely, to the accompaniment of marvelous music.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_YOSHIDANAOKI_000_61: ...Now, the time has come for this vision to end; time for your eyes to open from this waking dream.
This world shall yet endure. And as we continue on our way, I pray that the notes that resound from each of us shall have occasion to rise together once more in harmony.
Till that day, I wish you safe and happy travels. Fare you well.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Countless souls abide in this world, and the connections we forge with one another give rise to the symphony of life. In the course of your journeys, you will have heard such music.
You yourself have been a performer, creating music with those around you. In recognition of this, I wish to dedicate to you another verse, that your footfalls may resound for all to hear...

Upon the wind they echo far,
The songs of life upon our star.♪
With journeys' mark the land abounds,
Beyond the morrow to resound.♪

Though sun may set and twilight fall,
The stars a gleam on blackened pall.♪
Our songs shall e'er light the way,
And guide us forth to break of day.♪

As we make our way in the journey of life, we choose with whom we walk. Sometimes, however, someone may appear upon the road unannounced, and we find ourselves taken in directions we had not imagined.
For instance, had you not lent young Bathu your aid, she and A'nimuili would not enjoy the connection they now share.

To thus appear before others is your destiny, I daresay, and I cannot help but wonder what you will see and hear in your journeys to come. When next we meet, I pray you will regale me with your tales once more.
TEXT_FESANX201_05510_SYSTEM_000_800: You have unlocked the toy chest. Open the toy chest found in any inn room to play mini-games.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: Still savoring the afterglow of the fireworks, are you? You look somewhat dazed, as if you have just awakened from a dream.
You actually had a dream, you say? And in it, you met an individual who bore an uncanny resemblance to me...
While I know not the significance of your vision, I have an inkling as to this “enchanting concert” that was mentioned.
If you are otherwise unoccupied, would you care to attend it together?
Excellent. Let us make our way to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre in Old Gridania at once.
It appears we have arrived during an intermission.
Do you see the piano on the stage?
It is there for one and all to play during the Rising.
As young A'nimuili also knew, music is possessed of the power to comfort and inspire.
It can even restore faded memories to vibrant life, together with the emotions they once evoked.
With these wondrous effects in mind was the piano set up. 'Tis quite inspired, would you not agree?
Ah, a performer has taken to the stage.
Th-This unmistakable arpeggio! Could it be...?
This song is familiar to me. The performer could well be an esteemed predecessor of mine!
There is only one way to know for certain. I shall go and speak with him after he has finished playing.
Apologies for the wait.
My suspicions were correct. Permit me to introduce to you the legendary composer...
...Nay, it isn't my place to reveal his identity. Not when he has gone to such lengths to remain anonymous, that he might simply delight in music with us.
Know, however, that you have been touched by his works, somewhere out there. This, I guarantee.
This  is an aspiring adventurer. Might you have any words you would like to offer ?
This  is an accomplished adventurer, and a renowned hero besides. Might you have any words you would like to offer ?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_030: Greetings, adventurer. Tell me─have you been enjoying the music that colors your journey?
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_031: This question, I also pose to you over yonder.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_032: It is not only the battles and stories, or the music which brings them to life, but how you choose to interact with the game that truly shapes the experience.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_000_033: For being part of this final-yet-unending fantasy, I give you my heartfelt thanks!
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_010_033: As a token of my gratitude, please accept this gift.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_020_033: Oh, and do remember the name “con TIKI.” It's a little project of mine.
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_NOBINOBI_030_033: Don't mention anything to our minstrel friend, though!
TEXT_FESANX202_05520_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: It seems you are privy to a secret. But worry not─I am not one to pry.
Now then, enveloped in the warmth of enchanting music, I shall return to my wanderings.
After all, the adventure promises to continue for quite some time to come.
